papers.title: Can Learning to Answer Spatial Questions Improve Novel-View Generation?
papers.abstract_en: Generating novel views from limited observations requires preserving both the appearance and spatial structure of a scene. Although recent approaches exploit fine-grained geometric cues, they do not explicitly model high-level semantic and spatial properties such as object identity, attributes, and inter-object relationships. In this work, we investigate whether 3D language understanding can provide complementary supervision for novel-view generation. We introduce Ask4NV, built on a pretrained unified multimodal model with a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture. Our model incorporates camera geometry into both VAE and ViT representations and leverages understanding features during generation through joint self-attention with a modality-aware attention masking strategy. Experiments demonstrate strong image quality and geometric consistency in novel-view generation, alongside competitive 3D language understanding. Further analysis shows that joint training improves cross-view correspondence in VAE representations and similarity in a 3D-aware feature space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Ask4NV 把 3D 语言理解引入新视角生成 (novel-view generation)：在统一多模态模型的 Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) 架构上，将相机几何编码进 VAE 与 ViT 表征，并用模态感知注意力掩码在生成时通过联合自注意力利用理解特征。联合训练同时提升 VAE 表征中的跨视角对应与 3D 感知特征空间相似度，图像质量与几何一致性表现强。
Motivation: 从有限观测生成新视角需同时保持外观与几何，但现有方法只用细粒度几何线索，未显式建模物体身份、属性与物体间关系等高层语义与空间属性。
Method: Ask4NV 基于预训练统一多模态模型与 Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) 架构；把相机几何注入 VAE 与 ViT 表征，生成阶段用模态感知注意力掩码 (modality-aware attention masking) 使理解特征与生成路径做联合自注意力，实现 3D 语言理解作为补充监督。
Result: 实验显示新视角生成在图像质量与几何一致性上表现强，同时具备有竞争力的 3D 语言理解能力；进一步分析表明联合训练提升了 VAE 表征中的跨视角对应以及 3D 感知特征空间中的相似度。
Conclusion: 3D 语言理解可作为新视角生成的互补监督，联合训练同时改善生成质量与表征的跨视角一致性。

papers.title: Representation Conditioning for Generation
papers.abstract_en: Representation-alignment methods effectively accelerate the diffusion transformer training. REPA, for example, uses a pretrained vision encoder to supervise an intermediate layer through an MLP projection head which is discarded after training. It aims to import semantics from the vision encoder to the diffusion backbone. While this objective is achieved at early layers by back-propagating the alignment loss, there is no guarantee that later layers, supervised by the velocity prediction loss alone, can well access such semantics. We propose a simple solution, representation conditioning (RECON), to improve semantics in later layers. During training, we feed the pretrained vision encoder tokens into later layers; during inference, because we no longer have the clean image, we reuse the MLP head (as a proxy to the vision encoder) and project its output tokens to the later layers. Our method adds no parameters and leads to much faster convergence: RECON is $63\times$ faster than SiT and $25\times$ faster than REPA. Code is available at https://github.com/saeidrazavi/RECON
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RECON 在扩散 Transformer 训练中把预训练视觉编码器的 token 直接喂进后期层做条件，推理时用训练后保留的 MLP 投影头代替编码器生成这些 token，使后期层也能访问语义。收敛显著加速：比 SiT 快 63 倍、比 REPA 快 25 倍，且不增加参数。
Motivation: REPA 用对齐损失把视觉编码器语义注入扩散骨干的中间层，但后续层只受 velocity prediction loss 监督，没有保证能访问这些语义。
Method: 训练时将预训练视觉编码器的 token 输入后期层作为条件；推理时因无干净图像，复用训练后保留的 MLP 投影头（作为视觉编码器的代理）投影其输出 token 到后期层。方法不增加参数。
Result: 收敛速度比 SiT 快 63 倍，比 REPA 快 25 倍；不引入额外参数。
Conclusion: 把视觉语义以条件形式直接注入后期层，比仅靠早期层对齐更有效，且可在零参数开销下实现大幅训练加速。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hierarchical Residual Policy Learning for Real-World Mobile Manipulation with Sparse Human Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Mobile Manipulation (MoMa) is a cornerstone of autonomous robotic systems, yet real-world fine-tuning remains a formidable challenge because of high-dimensional action spaces and intricate coupling between heterogeneous modules. In this paper, we propose HiRe-MoMa (Hierarchical Residual Mobile Manipulation), a systematic framework for stable and sample-efficient real-world fine-tuning of complex MoMa systems. At its core, HiRe-MoMa adopts a Hierarchical Residual Architecture that fine-tunes a frozen base policy. A Policy-Agnostic Residual learns additive corrections atop the base policy, while Hierarchical Decoupling splits the residual into mobile-base and manipulator-arm heads with unidirectional conditioning, mitigating gradient interference and aligning corrections with the platform's physical hierarchy. To improve sample efficiency in data-expensive real-world settings, we propose Expert-Guided Value Alignment, which leverages sparse human interventions with under 20% training coverage to reshape the critic's value landscape, effectively guiding autonomous exploration through expert priors. Extensive real-world experiments on the TIAGo++ platform demonstrate that HiRe-MoMa consistently enhances task performance with only around 30 minutes of online interaction, regardless of the base policy architecture. To our knowledge, this is among the first frameworks to enable efficient on-robot fine-tuning for mobile manipulation in the real world, providing a practical paradigm for deploying complex robotic systems in dynamic, human-centric environments. Further details can be found on our project website: https://hire-moma.github.io/
papers.comment: Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026); Project Website: https://hire-moma.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HiRe-MoMa 针对真实世界移动操作 (mobile manipulation) 微调，提出分层残差架构：在冻结的 base policy 之上学习加性残差，并把残差解耦为移动底盘与机械臂两个头、只做单向条件化以缓解梯度干扰。配合稀疏人类干预（覆盖率低于 20%）做 Expert-Guided Value Alignment 重塑 critic 价值面，在 TIAGo++ 上约 30 分钟在线交互即可稳定提升任务表现，且与 base policy 架构无关。
Motivation: 真实机器人微调代价高：动作空间高维、异构模块耦合复杂，且真实数据采集昂贵，导致样本效率低、训练不稳。
Method: Hierarchical Residual Architecture 冻结 base policy，Policy-Agnostic Residual 在其上叠加加性修正；Hierarchical Decoupling 将残差拆为 mobile-base 与 manipulator-arm 两个头并采用单向条件化；Expert-Guided Value Alignment 用覆盖率低于 20% 的稀疏人类干预重塑 critic 的价值面，引导自主探索。
Result: 在 TIAGo++ 平台的真实实验中，仅约 30 分钟在线交互即可一致提升任务表现，且不依赖 base policy 的具体架构；人类干预的训练覆盖率低于 20%。
Conclusion: 分层残差加稀疏专家干预的价值对齐，可以在真实移动操作平台上实现高效、稳定的机上微调，适用于动态人机共存环境的部署。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Modeling and Understanding Neural Weights of Humanoid Policies with Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in robot learning have driven rapid progress in humanoid control, enabling increasingly agile behaviors in the real world. However, humanoid control networks are typically obtained through conventional training procedures, while comparatively little attention has been given to directly modeling the distribution of their learned weights and generating functional networks in weight space. In this work, we investigate whether high-performing humanoid control networks can be generatively modeled directly through their weights. We adopt a latent diffusion framework that couples a linear autoencoder with a Diffusion Transformer. The autoencoder compresses actor network parameters into a compact latent space, and the Diffusion Transformer models the distribution of these latents. Trained on networks collected from reinforcement learning for the Unitree G1 robot, our approach generates deployable networks that perform various motions in the real world, including walking, dancing, and spin kick. Beyond generation, we further study the learned weight space to better understand the structure captured by these humanoid control networks. We identify a structural principle in the first-layer weights that consistently reflects the robot's kinematic prior. Notably, this kinematic prior emerges under both Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Imitation Learning (IL) training, suggesting that it is not specific to a particular optimization process but may instead reflect common knowledge associated with humanoid embodiment. Together, these results demonstrate the feasibility of generative modeling in humanoid network weight space, while providing initial insights into the information encoded by their learned weights. Additional results are available on our project website: https://humanoid-weight-diffusion.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 latent diffusion（线性自编码器 + Diffusion Transformer）直接对 Unitree G1 人形机器人 RL 策略网络的权重分布建模，生成可部署的控制网络，实机完成 walking、dancing、spin kick 等动作。分析首层权重发现稳定反映机器人运动学先验的结构，且该先验在 RL 与 IL 训练下都出现，说明它来自人形本体而非特定优化过程。
Motivation: 人形控制网络目前都靠常规 RL/IL 训练逐个获得，几乎没有工作直接对学到的权重分布建模并在权重空间生成可用网络，权重里编码了什么结构也缺少理解。
Method: latent diffusion 框架：线性自编码器把 actor 网络参数压缩到紧凑 latent 空间，Diffusion Transformer 对这些 latent 建模分布；训练数据来自对 Unitree G1 机器人做强化学习收集的网络，生成的网络直接部署到实机。
Result: 生成的网络在实机上完成多种动作，包括 walking、dancing 和 spin kick；首层权重中识别出一致反映机器人运动学先验的结构原则，该先验在 RL 与 IL 两种训练下均出现。
Conclusion: 人形控制网络的权重空间可以被生成式建模并产出可部署策略，权重本身还携带与人形具身相关的公共知识，而非只反映特定优化算法。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: VITAL: From Visual Motion to Precise Action
papers.abstract_en: World-action models aim to turn visual anticipation into driving decisions, yet typically train action experts on trajectory representations defined independently of visual dynamics. This motivates deriving action targets directly from visual motion. We first examine a simpler setting in which trajectories are reconstructed from recorded future images. Even without the need for future prediction, reconstruction captures the dominant maneuver but leaves centimeter-scale errors. We therefore introduce VITAL (Vision-Induced Tokens for Action Learning), an action tokenizer that couples a visually derived motion scaffold with a compact residual encoding the trajectory error left by that scaffold. This representation makes visual motion the principal prediction target and gives small metric corrections a separate, normalized learning scale. Using flow matching, the action expert jointly predicts both components from the current image, ego state, and navigation command, without generating future images at inference. The same residual coordinates support bounded reinforcement post-training that refines execution while keeping the predicted visual scaffold fixed. With only one action denoising step, VITAL achieves 90.8 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 navtest, within 0.13 points of its ten-step score at 3.29x the end-to-end inference speed. Without retraining, it achieves 91.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest and 38.6 on navhard. Project page: https://worldbench.github.io/vital
papers.comment: Technical Report; 37 pages, 14 figures, 19 tables; Project Page at https://worldbench.github.io/vital GitHub at https://github.com/worldbench/VITAL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VITAL 把动作目标直接从视觉运动中导出：先用未来图像重建轨迹得到视觉运动骨架 (motion scaffold)，再用紧凑残差编码骨架留下的轨迹误差，动作专家用 flow matching 从当前图像、自车状态与导航指令联合预测两部分，推理时不生成未来图像。单步去噪在 NAVSIM v1 navtest 上得 90.8 PDMS，与十步分数仅差 0.13 点，端到端推理速度提升 3.29 倍；不重训即可在 NAVSIM v2 navtest 拿 91.1 EPDMS、navhard 拿 38.6。
Motivation: 世界-动作模型通常在与视觉动态无关的轨迹表示上训练动作专家，动作目标与视觉预期内在脱节；而纯轨迹重建虽能抓住主要机动，仍留下厘米级误差。
Method: VITAL (Vision-Induced Tokens for Action Learning) 是一个动作 tokenizer：视觉导出的运动骨架加一个紧凑残差项编码骨架误差，两者坐标共享；flow matching 让动作专家从当前图像、自车状态和导航指令联合预测两部分，推理阶段不生成未来图像；同一残差坐标支持有界的强化后训练，在固定视觉骨架下只精修执行。
Result: 仅 1 个动作去噪步，NAVSIM v1 navtest 达 90.8 PDMS，与其 10 步分数相差 0.13 点，端到端推理速度为 3.29 倍；不重新训练在 NAVSIM v2 navtest 达 91.1 EPDMS、navhard 达 38.6。先验设定中，仅从未来图像重建轨迹即可捕获主要机动但留下厘米级误差。
Conclusion: 把视觉运动设为主要预测目标、把度量级修正放进独立归一化的残差通道，可在极少去噪步下保住驾驶分数并大幅提速，且残差坐标可直接承接强化后训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CommerceGen-Studio: An End-to-End Framework for Commercial-Grade Main-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: We present CommerceGen-Studio, an end-to-end framework for generating commercial-grade main images for e-commerce Stock Keeping Units (SKUs). Our framework is organized along a three-stage pipeline of information extraction, semantic rewriting, and multi-condition generation: Prompt-Eval-Refine-Loop Agent (PERL-Agent) distills heterogeneous SKU metadata into concise selling-point text lists through an iterative closed loop of VLM and LLM roles scored by a reference-free rubric. Layout Thinker Optimization (LTO) aligns the rewriter with both caption and rendered-image quality via alternating domain-specific policy optimization. SKU-DiT, trained under Reinforce-Distill-Reinforce (RDR) progressive training, conditions jointly on the white-background product image, the trademark crop, and the structured layout to hold subject fidelity, trademark integrity, and character-level text accuracy together. The framework runs in production at a scale of millions of main images per day with a latency of a few seconds per image, which we believe makes it among the first systems of this kind to operate at commercial scale. We also release CommerceGen-Bench, a benchmark of hard cases collected from live traffic across all product categories. On it, our framework achieves the highest overall scores among the evaluated open-source baselines on both editing tracks, with and without prompt enhancement. papers.title: DynThinker: Unifying Static 3D and Dynamic 4D Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Achieving general spatial intelligence requires a unified understanding of both static 3D and dynamic 4D. However, we find that existing models struggle to excel at both: 3D post-training can weaken dynamic understanding, while 4D-specialized models often lack strong static 3D reasoning. Our analysis reveals that this spatial--dynamic interference is highly non-uniform across parameter groups, with the balance between static and dynamic capabilities particularly sensitive to changes in late-layer MLPs. To address this interference, we propose DynThinker, a unified framework for jointly strengthening static and dynamic spatial reasoning. Decoupled Exponential Moving Average (D-EMA) applies configurable group-wise averaging to constrain drift in interference-sensitive pretrained parameters while preserving flexibility for capability enhancement. Spatial-Dynamic Fusion (SDF) complements D-EMA by selectively integrating spatial and temporal priors from a dynamic geometry encoder into intermediate VLM representations under semantic guidance. Across ten metrics spanning nine static 3D and dynamic 4D benchmarks, DynThinker achieves the highest average score among all evaluated models. Notably, DynThinker achieves 56.0 on ReVSI, 67.2 on DSR-Bench, and 51.2 and 40.1 under the sample-wise and group-wise evaluation protocols of DSI-Bench, respectively, setting new state-of-the-art results among the compared open-source models across all four evaluations within a unified model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynThinker 统一静态 3D 与动态 4D 空间推理，指出二者干扰在参数组间高度不均、且对后期层 MLP 最敏感，用解耦 EMA (D-EMA) 约束敏感参数漂移，配合语义引导的时空融合 (SDF) 注入动态几何先验。在九个 3D/4D 基准十项指标上取得被评模型最高平均分，ReVSI 56.0、DSR-Bench 67.2、DSI-Bench 样本级 51.2 与组级 40.1，为所比开源模型中统一模型的四项新 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有模型难以同时做好静态 3D 与动态 4D：3D 后训练会削弱动态理解，4D 专用模型又缺乏强静态推理，即空间-动态干扰问题。
Method: 提出 DynThinker 统一框架：D-EMA 对干扰敏感的预训练参数做可配置的分组滑动平均以约束漂移，同时保留能力增强的灵活性；SDF 在语义引导下把动态几何编码器的空间与时间先验选择性注入 VLM 中间表征。
Result: 在九个静态 3D 与动态 4D 基准共十项指标上取得所有被评模型最高平均分；ReVSI 56.0，DSR-Bench 67.2，DSI-Bench 样本级协议 51.2、组级协议 40.1，四项评测均为所比开源模型中统一模型的新 SOTA。
Conclusion: 空间-动态干扰集中在特定参数组（尤其后期层 MLP），用分组 EMA 约束加先验注入可在单一模型内同时强化静态 3D 与动态 4D 推理。

papers.title: Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents
papers.abstract_en:
Training language agents is bottlenecked by the high cost of long-horizon rollouts, yet standard agentic reinforcement learning (RL) learns only from a terminal scalar reward, leaving the supervision in intermediate steps largely unused. Prior work exploits this supervision through value targets that estimate per-step success probabilities or observation targets that fit environment response. Both are hard to construct well: (1) value targets come from the same single scalar signal for each step in the trajectory, and (2) observation targets, such as web pages and terminal logs, are long and noisy and reach only one step ahead. We propose 
ame, which adds a third kind of multi-step action targets. On successful on-policy trajectories, 
ame trains the policy backbone to generate the action sequences that follows each history. Each action is also supervised when forecast from the preceding histories, forming a temporal ensemble that the shared backbone absorbs during training, and this enables acting and forecasting to co-evolve. The policy still acts one step at a time at inference, with no overhead. Across five benchmarks (ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, WebShop, $τ^2$-bench, and AppWorld), 
ame (1) achieves stronger aggregate performance than GRPO and RL baselines with predictive auxiliary targets across simulated environments, while improving overall performance on both realistic applications; (2) delivers up to $1.9	imes$ and $2.0	imes$ higher sample efficiency than ECHO and GRPO, respectively, on ScienceWorld; and (3) achieves these gains with a single policy backbone, without additional models, separate pretraining, or inference overhead. The codebase is available at https://github.com/ulab-uiuc/CoPE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CoPE：在语言智能体的 agentic RL 中加入第三类多步动作目标，在成功轨迹上让策略骨干同时学习生成后续动作序列，并从历史预测每一步动作，形成时间集成 (temporal ensemble)，使 acting 与 forecasting 共同进化。在五个基准上聚合性能超过 GRPO 与带预测辅助目标的 RL 基线，ScienceWorld 上样本效率最高达 ECHO 的 1.9 倍、GRPO 的 2.0 倍，且推理时仍逐步行动、无额外开销。
Motivation: 长程 rollout 成本高，而标准 agentic RL 只用终端标量奖励，中间步骤监督基本浪费；已有 value targets 只能从同一标量推导，observation targets（网页、终端日志）冗长含噪且只能前看一步。
Method: CoPE 在成功 on-policy 轨迹上训练策略骨干生成每个历史之后的动作序列，并让每个动作同时接受从先前历史出发的预测监督，构成被共享骨干吸收的时间集成；推理时仍逐步行动，不引入额外模型或单独预训练。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop、τ²-bench、AppWorld 五个基准上，聚合性能强于 GRPO 与带预测辅助目标的 RL 基线；ScienceWorld 上样本效率最高为 ECHO 的 1.9 倍、GRPO 的 2.0 倍；在真实应用类基准上整体性能也提升，且只用单一策略骨干、无推理开销。
Conclusion: 把多步动作预测作为第三类辅助目标，可以在不增加模型与推理成本的前提下同时提升语言智能体的性能与样本效率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: GeoThinker-$F$: Endogenous Predictive World Representations for Fast Spatial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Existing geometry-aware Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) increasingly rely on external 3D encoders to provide structural priors, but executing these additional encoder paths at inference introduces substantial latency and computational overhead. We propose GeoThinker-$F$, an efficient framework that internalizes spatiotemporal perception by transforming causal MLLM hidden states into predictive latent world representations. Our key insight is that intermediate semantic representations contain sufficient information to predict useful representations of current geometry and future semantics, without requiring an exact reproduction of features from a dedicated 3D encoder. To realize this idea, GeoThinker-$F$ adopts a decoupled two-stage training strategy. In the first stage, the MLLM backbone is frozen while lightweight Latent Frame Prediction (LFP) heads learn from an offline 3D geometry expert and next-frame semantic targets. In the second stage, the external expert is removed, and the model is jointly optimized to generate and selectively integrate its self-predicted priors through a specialized Spatial-Grounded Temporal (SGT) Fusion module. Extensive evaluations show that GeoThinker-$F$ eliminates runtime dependence on external 3D geometry encoders while maintaining competitive performance across diverse spatial intelligence benchmarks. It achieves up to a $3.6\times$ inference speedup, reducing latency from $1.45\,\mathrm{s}$ to $0.40\,\mathrm{s}$ while retaining strong spatial reasoning performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoThinker-F 把外部 3D 几何编码器的结构先验内化为 MLLM 隐状态自预测的潜空间世界表征：先冻结主干、用轻量 Latent Frame Prediction 头从离线 3D 专家和下一帧语义目标学习，再移除外部专家并用 Spatial-Grounded Temporal Fusion 融合自预测先验。推理期不再依赖外部编码器，最高 3.6 倍加速，延迟从 1.45 s 降到 0.40 s，同时保持有竞争力的空间推理性能。
Motivation: 几何感知 MLLM 靠外挂 3D 编码器提供结构先验，但推理时额外执行这些编码器路径带来显著延迟与算力开销。
Method: 解耦两阶段训练：第一阶段冻结 MLLM 主干，轻量 Latent Frame Prediction (LFP) 头从离线 3D 几何专家与 next-frame semantic targets 学习；第二阶段移除外部专家，联合优化生成并选择性融合自预测先验，融合由 Spatial-Grounded Temporal (SGT) Fusion 模块完成。
Result: 在多个空间智能基准 (spatial intelligence benchmarks) 上消除对外部 3D 几何编码器的运行时依赖并保持有竞争力的性能；推理最高加速 3.6 倍，延迟由 1.45 s 降至 0.40 s，同时保留强空间推理能力。
Conclusion: 中间语义表征已含足够信息来预测当前几何与未来语义的有用表征，无需精确复现专用 3D 编码器特征，因此外挂编码器可以整体内化而不牺牲空间推理。

papers.title: Feed-Forward Multi-View Feature Coding for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods enable efficient reconstruction of 3D scenes from sparse multi-view images in a single forward pass, without scene-specific optimization. However, existing feed-forward scene-coding pipelines first generate a complete Gaussian representation and then encode its geometry and appearance attributes separately, often involving non-differentiable operations. The resulting 'generate-then-compress' pipeline requires complex attribute-specific codec designs and limits rate-distortion performance by restricting the exploitation of cross-attribute redundancy. We propose multi-view feature coding for Gaussian splatting (MFGS), an end-to-end feed-forward framework for scene coding. Instead of compressing an explicit Gaussian representation, MFGS extracts multi-view features from the input images and encodes them into a compact bitstream. Through end-to-end rate-distortion training, MFGS learns compact multi-view features that jointly represent geometry and appearance, enabling the receiver to predict Gaussian attributes from the decoded features. We further introduce importance-guided Gaussian selection to accommodate different rendering budgets, allowing the receiver to adjust the number of Gaussians used for rendering from the same bitstream. Across RE10K, ACID, and DL3DV, MFGS achieves 99.76-99.86% bitrate savings over the generate-then-compress pipeline, as measured by BD-rate, while reducing total GMACs by 52-55% and providing an approximately 12 times end-to-end speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MFGS：把前馈 3DGS 场景编码从「先生成高斯再分别压缩几何与外观」改为端到端地提取多视图特征并编成码流，接收端由解码特征直接预测高斯属性，并用重要性引导的高斯选择适配不同渲染预算。在 RE10K、ACID、DL3DV 上相对 generate-then-compress 管线 BD-rate 节省 99.76–99.86%，总 GMACs 降低 52–55%，端到端加速约 12 倍。
Motivation: 前馈场景编码管线先生成完整高斯表示再分别压缩几何与外观，含不可微操作，属性专用编解码器复杂，且割裂跨属性冗余，限制率失真性能。
Method: MFGS 是端到端前馈场景编码框架：从输入多视图图像提取特征并编码为紧凑码流，通过端到端率失真训练让特征联合表示几何与外观，接收端由解码特征预测高斯属性；另引入 importance-guided Gaussian selection，使同一码流可按渲染预算调整高斯数量。
Result: 在 RE10K、ACID、DL3DV 上，相对 generate-then-compress 管线按 BD-rate 计节省 99.76–99.86% 码率，总 GMACs 降低 52–55%，端到端加速约 12 倍。
Conclusion: 直接编码多视图特征而非显式高斯表示，可让几何与外观共享跨属性冗余，从而同时改善率失真、计算量与端到端速度，并支持同一码流下的渲染预算调节。

summary_sections.result: 在 RE10K、ACID、DL3DV 上，相对 generate-then-compress 管线按 BD-rate 计节省 99.76–99.86% 码率，总 GMACs 降低 52–55%，端到端加速约 12 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 直接编码多视图特征而非显式高斯表示，可让几何与外观共享跨属性冗余，从而同时改善率失真、计算量与端到端速度，并支持同一码流下的渲染预算调节。

papers.title: Your Transformer Is Secretly Elastic
papers.abstract_en: Scaling up transformers has produced models with broad capabilities, deployed across heterogeneous hardware and fluctuating workloads. Yet, model families offer only a few fixed sizes (e.g., S, B, L), forcing users to commit to a model based on hardware and latency constraints. This rigidity is often suboptimal under varying query loads. We introduce a retraining-free method that elastifies pre-trained transformers into a single model that adapts on-the-fly across a continuum of computational budgets. Our key contribution is a differentiable relaxation of the functional unit-ranking problem: unlike prior work, which optimizes a single importance weight per MLP block or attention head, we rank every individual MLP neuron and attention head jointly, on a common scale, by minimizing the model's loss under soft pruning across many sparsity targets, all at once. Across 27 vision and text transformer encoders ranging from 22M to 8B parameters, our method yields smooth degradation up to 60% sparsity and outperforms one-shot baselines under deep pruning. For example, pruning DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 to 50% sparsity removes 427M parameters while reducing ImageNet-1k linear-probing accuracy by only 0.8%, without the need for weight correction or retraining. At 60% sparsity, a pruned AugReg ViT-B/16 model achieves up to $1.80\times$ higher throughput and $1.26\times$ lower single-query latency on an A100 GPU. Elastic models are produced in minutes, with construction time scaling sub-linearly with parameter count.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把预训练 Transformer 变成单一弹性模型：对每个 MLP 神经元与 attention head 在统一尺度上做可微排序，一次训练覆盖连续稀疏度区间，推理时按算力预算即插即用。在 27 个视觉与文本编码器（22M–8B）上平滑退化到 60% 稀疏度，DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 剪到 50% 去掉 427M 参数、ImageNet-1k linear-probing 精度只降 0.8%，无需权值修正或重训练。
Motivation: 模型家族只提供 S/B/L 等少数固定尺寸，用户必须在硬件与延迟约束下一次性选定，查询负载波动时这种刚性配置常常次优。
Method: 提出免重训练的弹性化方法：把功能单元排序问题做可微松弛，不像先前工作只给每个 MLP block 或 attention head 一个重要性权重，而是联合地在统一尺度上排序每一个 MLP 神经元与 attention head，通过在多个稀疏度目标上同时最小化软剪枝 (soft pruning) 下的模型损失来实现，构造耗时随参数量亚线性增长。
Result: 覆盖 27 个视觉与文本 Transformer 编码器（22M 到 8B 参数）：平滑退化至 60% 稀疏度，深度剪枝下优于 one-shot 基线；DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 剪至 50% 稀疏度移除 427M 参数，ImageNet-1k linear-probing 精度仅降 0.8%，无需权值修正或重训练；60% 稀疏度下 AugReg ViT-B/16 在 A100 上吞吐最高提升 1.80×、单查询延迟降低 1.26×；弹性模型数分钟内产出，构造时间随参数量亚线性。
Conclusion: 逐神经元与逐 head 的统一重要性排序可以在一次免重训练的构造中覆盖连续算力预算，让单一模型替代固定尺寸家族并保持接近原精度。

papers.title: Price of Anarchy of First-Price Auctions in Agentic Markets
papers.abstract_en: An agentic market is a decentralized serving-time market where AI agents bid to claim each user prompt. An agent's bid is based on its expected value for the prompt, which is the expectation of the reward for its response minus its inference costs. First-price auctions (FPAs), in which the highest bidder pays its bid and receives the prompt, are a natural way to allocate prompts in such a market, since they are simple and transparent to run, and do not require central knowledge of private capabilities and costs. However, FPAs are not truthful: participants may bid less than their true value in the hope of a larger profit, and the prompt may then be allocated to someone other than the bidder who values it the most. This welfare loss is quantified by the $\textit{price-of-anarchy}$ (PoA). In this paper, we argue that agentic markets are likely to possess features that reduce the price-of-anarchy. The first is a $\textit{competitive floor}$, which occurs when multiple bidders usually value the prompt above some baseline share of the optimal welfare (e.g., because the best models are often distilled into cheaper alternatives, which perform similarly). We show that competition among them then limits the welfare loss, which can be driven to zero as the floor rises. The second feature is $\textit{near-independence}$ of values after conditioning on the prompt, which occurs when most of the predictable variation in the expected value is determined by the difficulty of the prompt. As the value distribution approaches conditional independence, we can derive an efficiency guarantee that approaches a factor of $1 - 1/e^2$ of the optimal welfare. Thus, both features give rise to welfare lower bounds that are significantly better than the well-known general case of $1 - 1/e$. We validate these results empirically using auctions with strategic bidders simulated on the EmbedLLM prompt routing dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 AI agent 竞拍用户 prompt 的 serving-time 市场中，一价拍卖 (FPA) 因非 truthful 报价造成福利损失，其 price-of-anarchy (PoA) 由两个结构特征压低：竞争下限 (competitive floor) 越高福利损失可降至零；条件独立近似越强，效率保证趋近最优福利的 1-1/e²，两者都显著优于一般情形的 1-1/e。作者在 EmbedLLM prompt routing 数据集上用策略性 bidder 模拟验证了这些结论。
Motivation: 一价拍卖简单透明、无需中心掌握各 agent 的私有能力与成本，但参与者会低于真实价值出价，导致 prompt 被分配给并非最看重它的 agent，产生福利损失；需要刻画 agentic market 中何种结构能把这一损失压到远好于一般下界 1-1/e 的水平。
Method: 从 price-of-anarchy 框架出发分析两个结构特征：一是 competitive floor，即多个 bidder 对 prompt 的估值都高于最优福利的某个基线比例（如最佳模型被蒸馏成性能相近的廉价替代品）；二是给定 prompt 后估值近似条件独立，即期望价值的可预测变化主要由 prompt 难度决定。结论用 EmbedLLM prompt routing 数据集上的策略性 bidder 模拟做经验验证。
Result: 竞争下限存在时竞争限制福利损失，且福利损失可随 floor 升高被驱动到零；估值分布趋近条件独立时得到趋近最优福利 1-1/e² 的效率保证。两个特征给出的福利下界都显著优于一般情形的 1-1/e；结论在 EmbedLLM prompt routing 数据集的策略性 bidder 拍卖模拟中得到经验验证。
Conclusion: agentic market 的两个可识别特征——蒸馏带来的竞争下限与由 prompt 难度主导的条件独立性——使一价拍卖的福利损失远好于一般 PoA 下界，因此 FPA 在此类市场中比一般理论预期更高效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Continuum Attention
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Continuum Attention (CA), a causal Transformer attention operator that replaces discrete key and value lookup with integration over a continuous, piecewise linear memory curve. Each query induces an exponential relevance density along the curve. Integrating the density and interpolated values yields exact normalized attention from closed form exponential moments, including half token boundary contributions. The gradients follow analytically from moments of order at most two, enabling parallel GPU implementations while retaining quadratic sequence complexity and the standard Transformer decoder. Compared with ordinary softmax and focal attention, CA reduces mean validation negative log likelihood by 0.0200 and 0.0480 nats per byte, respectively, winning all paired comparisons. An additional disjoint validation slice yields a 0.0457 nats per byte advantage over the strongest selected softmax baseline, with a paired 95% confidence interval. These findings motivate continuous integration as a promising attention alternative while leaving larger scale generalization open.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Continuum Attention (CA)：因果 Transformer 注意力不再离散查 key/value，而是在连续分段线性记忆曲线上积分，每个 query 沿曲线诱导指数型 relevance density，用闭式指数矩得到精确归一化注意力（含半 token 边界贡献），梯度由至多二阶矩解析给出。相对普通 softmax 与 focal attention，验证集平均负对数似然分别降低 0.0200 与 0.0480 nats/byte，全部成对比较获胜；更大规模泛化仍待检验。
Motivation: 离散 key/value 查找把注意力权重限制在 token 边界上，作者要给出一种连续化、可闭式求值且可并行求梯度的注意力算子，作为 softmax 的替代。
Method: CA 用连续分段线性记忆曲线取代离散查找：query 沿曲线诱导指数 relevance density，密度与插值 value 的积分由闭式指数矩给出精确归一化注意力（含半 token 边界贡献），梯度解析地来自至多二阶矩，可在 GPU 上并行实现，同时保持二次序列复杂度与标准 Transformer decoder 结构。
Result: 验证集平均负对数似然相对普通 softmax 降低 0.0200 nats/byte、相对 focal attention 降低 0.0480 nats/byte，且赢得全部成对比较；在另一独立验证切片上相对最强的选定 softmax 基线优势为 0.0457 nats/byte，并给出配对 95% 置信区间。
Conclusion: 连续积分可以作为注意力的一种可行替代并带来可测的 NLL 改善，但更大规模上的泛化仍属开放问题。

papers.title: Learnable Hodge-Laplacian Driven Mixture of Experts for Steady-PDE Surrogates on Coarse Unstructured Meshes
papers.abstract_en: Current approaches for steady partial differential equations surrogate models on unstructured meshes apply a single mixing mechanism to the whole solution. This paper proposes an architecture that partitions the solution among vanilla transformer experts, each focused on a different spectral scale. The partition is built from a discrete Hodge Laplacian $L_0=\star_0^{-1} d_0^{\top}\star_1 d_0$, that serves as a fitting layer measuring high-frequency content. A gating mechanism takes the mesh as input and produces the per-vertex weights that recombine the expert outputs. AirFRANS is a steady Reynolds-averaged Navier--Stokes (RANS) airfoil benchmark. We evaluate our approach in a reduced remeshed version of the benchmark with each unstructured mesh counting 9.6K faces and 4.9K vertices. We compare our approach with the Transolver on the same dataset and dataset slit. Our approach reduces relative $L_2$ error by 31\% and interior mean squared error by 47\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对粗非结构网格上的稳态 PDE 代理模型，用离散 Hodge Laplacian L0 作为高频内容拟合层，把解按谱尺度分区送入多个 vanilla transformer expert，再由以网格为输入的 gating 机制生成逐顶点权重重组输出。在 AirFRANS 减重网格版（每网格 9.6K 面、4.9K 顶点）上相对 Transolver，相对 L2 误差降 31%，内部 MSE 降 47%。
Motivation: 现有稳态 PDE 非结构网格代理模型对整个解用单一混合机制，无法按谱尺度分别处理不同频率成分，粗网格上高频误差集中。
Method: 以离散 Hodge Laplacian L0=⋆0^{-1} d0^T ⋆1 d0 构造分区并作为度量高频内容的拟合层；解被分给专注不同谱尺度的 vanilla transformer experts；gating 机制以网格为输入产生逐顶点权重，重组各 expert 输出。
Result: 在 AirFRANS 稳态 RANS 翼型基准的 reduced remeshed 版本（每非结构网格 9.6K 面、4.9K 顶点，与 Transolver 同一 dataset slit）上，相对 L2 误差降低 31%，内部均方误差 (interior MSE) 降低 47%。
Conclusion: 按 Hodge-Laplacian 谱尺度分区的多专家混合，比单一混合机制更适合粗非结构网格上的稳态 PDE 代理，误差主要在内部区域改善。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in interpreting screens and executing keyboard and mouse actions. However, games, with their visually rich worlds and diverse mechanics, remain challenging and offer a demanding next step toward general digital control. Current game-agent learning pipelines often rely on large-scale demonstrations with limited coverage of dynamic game states, while scalable environments for interactive training remain difficult to obtain. We introduce Player-1, a post-training framework for learning game control beyond demonstrations through synthetic experience. We extend the computer-use action space with relative pointer motion, sustained inputs, and composite actions. For supervised initialization, we fine-tune computer-use models on 6,044 curated gameplay trajectories that pair recorded actions with task instructions and visual reasoning. We construct Player-1-Gym, sixteen synthetic 2D and 3D environments designed around control demands shared across games. Programmatically verifiable rewards and randomized observations and control dynamics support multi-environment reinforcement learning with PPO. The resulting Player-1-9B and Player-1-35B-A3B improve MineDojo-300 success over their SFT policies by 27.8 and 17.7 percentage points, respectively. Player-1-9B reaches 38.33% success compared with 12.63% for the strongest evaluated baseline, with further gains over SFT on ViZDoom-10 and GameWorld. Further analyses show that broader synthetic environment coverage improves transfer, while the use of composite actions that combine multiple keyboard and mouse inputs increases during RL. We demonstrate that learning from synthetic experience substantially improves game control beyond supervised initialization, with gains that generalize beyond the RL training suite.
papers.comment: Project Page: https://player-1-project.github.io/ and code: https://github.com/TencentARC/Player-1
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Player-1 是一个用合成经验做游戏控制后训练的框架：扩展 computer-use 动作空间（相对指针移动、持续输入、复合动作），先在 6,044 条人工整理的游戏轨迹上做 SFT，再在 16 个可程序化验证奖励的合成 2D/3D 环境中用 PPO 做多环境强化学习。得到的 Player-1-9B 在 MineDojo-300 上成功率比其 SFT 策略高 27.8 个百分点，达 38.33%，而最强被评估基线仅 12.63%。
Motivation: 游戏世界视觉丰富、机制多样，现有游戏智能体学习管线依赖大规模演示但对动态游戏状态覆盖有限，可交互的训练环境也难以获得。
Method: 在 computer-use 动作空间上加入相对指针运动、持续输入与复合动作；监督初始化阶段用 6,044 条整理的游戏轨迹（动作配任务指令与视觉推理）微调 computer-use 模型；随后构建 Player-1-Gym（16 个围绕游戏共通控制需求设计的合成 2D/3D 环境），以可程序化验证的奖励和随机化的观测与控制动态做 PPO 多环境强化学习，产出 Player-1-9B 与 Player-1-35B-A3B。
Result: Player-1-9B 与 Player-1-35B-A3B 在 MineDojo-300 上相对各自 SFT 策略分别提升 27.8 和 17.7 个百分点；Player-1-9B 成功率 38.33%，最强被评估基线为 12.63%，并在 ViZDoom-10 与 GameWorld 上相对 SFT 继续提升。进一步分析显示更广的合成环境覆盖改善迁移，复合动作（组合多个键鼠输入）的使用在 RL 过程中增加。
Conclusion: 从合成经验学习能在监督初始化之外大幅改进游戏控制，且增益可泛化到 RL 训练套件之外；更广的合成环境覆盖与复合动作是有效的设计方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Latent Compaction with Test-Time Training
papers.abstract_en: Long contexts enlarge key--value (KV) caches, increasing memory use and attention costs during generation. Compressing these caches must preserve information for unseen questions. We introduce **Latent Compaction**, which learns a compact document-specific cache through test-time training. We initialize cache entries using reconstruction importance, teacher attention, and key-space diversity. Training first fits attention outputs and log-normalizers to those of the full cache, with reconstruction-selected entries held fixed. It then jointly optimizes the entire cache through end-to-end distillation from the full-cache model. Model weights remain frozen throughout, and training uses only generic prompts about the document, without access to downstream questions or answers. Experiments on RULER, LongBench, and Phonebook Lookup demonstrate substantial gains over budget-matched compression baselines. On a RULER, for example, our method achieves 96.7% accuracy at 32$\times$ compression, compared with 40.0% for KVZip+. The method also transfers across model scales and families, with retrieval gains on both Qwen3 and MiniCPM5. These results show that treating the KV cache as a neural network and optimizing it with test-time training can preserve retrieval accuracy under aggressive compression. The code is released at https://www.github.com/THUNLP/latent-compaction
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把长上下文的 KV cache 当作一个可训练的神经网络，用 test-time training 学出文档级紧凑 cache，在模型权重全程冻结、只用与文档相关的通用 prompt 的条件下做端到端蒸馏。RULER 上 32× 压缩时准确率 96.7%，同预算的 KVZip+ 只有 40.0%，且在 Qwen3 与 MiniCPM5 上都能迁移。
Motivation: 长上下文使 KV cache 膨胀，推高生成期显存与注意力开销；但压缩必须保住对未见问题的信息，现有预算受限的压缩方法在高压缩比下检索准确率崩塌。
Method: 先用 reconstruction importance、teacher attention 与 key-space diversity 三路初始化 cache 条目；第一阶段拟合完整 cache 的注意力输出与 log-normalizer，reconstruction 选出的条目保持固定；第二阶段对整个 cache 做端到端蒸馏联合优化。模型权重全程冻结，训练只用关于该文档的通用 prompt，不接触下游问题与答案。
Result: 在 RULER、LongBench、Phonebook Lookup 上相对预算匹配的压缩基线有大幅提升：RULER 上 32× 压缩达到 96.7% 准确率，KVZip+ 为 40.0%；检索增益在 Qwen3 与 MiniCPM5 两个模型规模与家族上均可迁移。
Conclusion: 把 KV cache 视作神经网络并用 test-time training 优化，可以在激进压缩比下保住检索准确率，且无需改动冻结的模型权重或下游任务信息。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One Task, Many Interfaces: Simple Cross-Interface Consistency Training Improves LLM Agent Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Post-training binds the competence of an LLM agent to the interface it was trained on. Semantics-preserving perturbations of that interface, such as renaming an action or changing the notation, leave the underlying task unchanged yet make the agent worse at it. Scoring each sample independently means interface randomization only broadens this dependence from a single interface to the training interface distribution, so out-of-distribution perturbations still degrade the agent. We propose Cross-Interface Policy Regularization (CIPR), a self-supervised objective that replaces action names with uninformative identifiers and presents each training sample under two interfaces in which equivalent actions are identified by construction. CIPR penalizes the KL divergence between the action distributions induced under the two interfaces, so the policy behaves consistently across them. We evaluate CIPR in both supervised and reinforcement-learning post-training, where it improves robustness. On agentic function calling, held-out interface perturbations reduce the accuracy of a post-trained agent by nearly 25%, and CIPR recovers 10.5% while leaving accuracy on the unchanged interface intact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Cross-Interface Policy Regularization (CIPR)：把动作名换成无信息标识符，并让同一训练样本以两个等价接口呈现，用 KL 惩罚两个接口下动作分布的差异，使策略跨接口一致。在 agentic function calling 上，留出的接口扰动使后训练 agent 准确率下降近 25%，CIPR 恢复 10.5%，且原接口准确率不变。
Motivation: 后训练把 LLM agent 的能力绑定到训练接口：语义保持的接口扰动（改动作名、改记号）任务不变却让 agent 变差；逐样本打分下的接口随机化只是把依赖从单一接口扩成训练接口分布，分布外扰动仍会退化。
Method: CIPR 是自监督目标：动作名替换为无信息标识符，每个训练样本以两个接口呈现，其中等价动作由构造已知；惩罚两接口诱导的动作分布之间的 KL 散度。分别在监督后训练与强化学习后训练中接入。
Result: 在 agentic function calling 上，留出 (held-out) 接口扰动使后训练 agent 准确率下降近 25%，CIPR 恢复其中 10.5%，同时未扰动接口上的准确率保持不变；CIPR 在监督与 RL 两种后训练设置下均提升鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 跨接口一致性正则能把接口依赖从训练分布内推广到分布外扰动，恢复部分因扰动损失的准确率且不牺牲原接口性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond LLM Judge: Mechanical Verification for Agentic Autoformalization
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a novel method for verifying Lean formalizations that goes beyond LLM-judged faithfulness. Unlike most verification methods, which rely on LLMs or trained models, our method combines LLM-based semantic review with mechanical numerical and vacuity checks, providing checkable feedback and detecting errors missed by LLM judges. We apply this method, along with our Extract-Verify-Proof autoformalization pipeline, to construct the Formalized Library of Mathematical Functions (FLMF), a partial formalization of the NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions (DLMF). On three labeled datasets, our method achieves the lowest accepted-error rate among the evaluated methods, measured as the fraction of incorrect statements accepted by the verification method. Expert review of the results also identifies translation and source defects in existing datasets. Code available at https://github.com/annamei1/FLMF-Ch7ErrFunc-Release.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出超越 LLM judge 的 Lean 形式化机械校验方法：把 LLM 语义审查与机械数值检查、空虚性 (vacuity) 检查结合，输出可复核的反馈并抓出 LLM judge 漏掉的错误。配合 Extract-Verify-Proof 自动形式化流程构建 NIST DLMF 的部分形式化库 FLMF，在三个带标注数据集上取得被评估方法中最低的 accepted-error rate（被判为正确但实际错误的语句比例）。
Motivation: 现有 Lean 形式化校验大多依赖 LLM 或训练模型打分，会接受实际错误的语句且反馈不可机械复核，自动形式化流水线因此缺少可靠的质量闸门。
Method: 校验方法组合 LLM 语义审查与机械数值检查、空虚性检查，产生可检查的反馈；再与 Extract-Verify-Proof 自动形式化流水线结合，用于构建 FLMF（NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions 的部分形式化），并在三个带标注数据集上与已评估方法比较 accepted-error rate。
Result: 在三个带标注数据集上，该方法的 accepted-error rate（被校验方法接受的错误语句占比）在被评估方法中最低；专家复核还识别出现有数据集中的翻译缺陷与来源缺陷。
Conclusion: LLM 审查必须配机械数值与空虚性检查才能压低形式化语句的漏检错误率，机械可复核的反馈比纯 LLM judge 更可靠。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Recovering Reliable Supervision via Critique-Guided On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on its own rollouts with token-level supervision from a teacher, assuming that the teacher can reach a correct answer from any prefix the student writes. We call this property the recoverability of the teacher and show it fails on incorrect rollouts: the teacher follows student errors, although it recognizes them. We propose CriticOPD, using error recognition to restore recoverability. The teacher critiques an incorrect rollout, allowing the student to rewrite its solution following the error. The resulting output, including the critique as privileged information, is scored by the teacher while the student uses the revision without the critique for training. On two Qwen3 students and six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CriticOPD improves OPD, with the largest gains on competition problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: On-policy distillation (OPD) 假设教师能从学生写的任意前缀恢复出正确答案，作者把这一性质称为 recoverability，并证明它在错误 rollout 上失效：教师会顺着学生的错误走，尽管它能识别该错误。CriticOPD 用错误识别来恢复 recoverability——教师先对错误 rollout 写 critique，学生据此重写解法，教师对含 critique 的修订输出打分，学生训练时只用去掉 critique 的修订。在两个 Qwen3 学生和六个数学推理基准上 CriticOPD 改进了 OPD，竞赛类题目上提升最大。
Motivation: OPD 的 token 级监督依赖教师能从任意学生前缀恢复正确答案，但这一 recoverability 在学生写错时并不成立，导致错误 rollout 上的监督不可靠。
Method: CriticOPD：教师对错误 rollout 生成 critique，学生跟随该错误重写解法；教师对包含 critique（作为特权信息）的修订输出打分，学生训练只用不含 critique 的修订版本。
Result: 在两个 Qwen3 学生模型和六个数学推理基准上，CriticOPD 相对 OPD 带来改进，其中竞赛类题目 (competition problems) 上的增益最大。
Conclusion: 教师能识别学生错误这一事实本身可用于恢复 OPD 所需的 recoverability，从而在错误 rollout 上给出可靠监督。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Any Time, Any Space: A World-State-Centric Framework for Agentic Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Long-form agentic video generation must turn a screenplay into shots that remain spatially and temporally consistent across nonconsecutive requests. Passing prompts or recent frames between shots does not provide a shared spatial frame for revisiting a scene or a time-indexed record for replaying an earlier event. We present Any Time, Any Space (ATAS), which compiles a screenplay into shot requests with explicit location, camera, and event-time references. Before generation, it retrieves relevant evidence from a scene memory of registered static geometry and an event memory of dynamic observations indexed by scene, event, and time. After generation, ATAS reconstructs and registers the clip. It updates memory only when review and state checks accept the observation, while film delivery remains independent of memory admission. Across four video generators, ATAS improves all reported cross-shot consistency measures and achieves the highest aggregate benchmark score for each backbone. It also outperforms the compared agents and 3D-guided methods on target-image spatial revisit, leads three event-recapture criteria, and receives the highest human ratings on all six criteria. The video results and code are available on our project page: https://lhmd.top/atas/.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 长程 agentic 视频生成中，镜头间只传 prompt 或最近帧无法提供回访场景的共享空间坐标系，也没有可重放早前事件的时间索引记录，导致跨非连续请求的空间与时间一致性断裂。
Method: ATAS 先把剧本编译为含 location、camera、event-time 引用的 shot requests；生成前从 scene memory（已配准静态几何）与 event memory（按场景、事件、时间索引的动态观测）检索证据；生成后重建并配准该片段，仅当 review 与 state checks 接受该观测时更新记忆，影片交付与记忆准入解耦。
Result: 在四个视频生成骨干上，ATAS 改善全部报告的跨镜头一致性指标，并在每个骨干上取得最高聚合基准分；在目标图像空间回访上优于所对比的 agent 与 3D 引导方法，领先三项 event-recapture 准则，并在全部六项人工评分准则上获得最高分。
Conclusion: 以世界状态为中心、把空间与时间引用显式编入镜头请求并配合受审核的记忆写入，可以在任意时间、任意空间回访场景与事件，同时保持影片交付独立于记忆准入。

papers.title: Scaling Discovery Requires Forgetting
papers.abstract_en: Automated research with LLM agents has shown promising results in various domains. Through iterative refinement and scored verifiers, LLM agents are capable of discovering new ideas. There are different ways to scale automated research: let one agent iterate for longer, run several agents in parallel, or further let the parallel agents communicate and build on one another's candidates. However, we find that all three strategies eventually plateau as the agents accumulate history. Each agent becomes anchored to its own past attempts, making fewer and smaller edits. Beyond this point, additional budget brings little further improvement. In this paper, we show that the key to scaling discovery further is to forget. Periodically discarding the search state, including every agent's session and the candidate history, and restarting from the best candidate found so far, unblocks the search and pushes the same budget further. We implement forgetting in a team of agents with communication and evaluate it on four tasks spanning heuristic programming, kernel optimization and model training. The results show up to 15% improvement compared to parallel agents, and up to 39% compared to a single agent. Our results suggest that, for open-ended discovery, what an agent is allowed to remember matters as much as how much compute it is given.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 自动科研智能体的三种扩展方式（单体长迭代、多智能体并行、并行且互相通信）都会因累积历史而停滞：智能体锚定在自己过去的尝试上，编辑越来越少、越来越小。周期性丢弃搜索状态（含各智能体会话与候选历史）并从当前最优候选重启，能在同等算力下继续推进，在启发式编程、kernel 优化与模型训练四类任务上相对并行智能体最高提升 15%、相对单智能体最高 39%。
Motivation: LLM 智能体通过迭代精化与打分验证器已能产出新想法，但三种主流扩展策略都会随历史累积而平台化，额外算力不再带来改进，搜索被锚定效应卡住。
Method: 在带通信的多智能体团队中实现周期性遗忘：丢弃全部搜索状态（每个智能体的会话与候选历史），从迄今最优候选重新开始；在覆盖启发式编程、kernel 优化和模型训练的四类任务上评测。
Result: 在四类任务上，加入遗忘后同等预算相对并行智能体最高提升 15%，相对单智能体最高提升 39%。
Conclusion: 对开放式发现任务，智能体被允许记住什么与其获得多少算力同等重要；周期性遗忘是解锁继续扩展的手段。

papers.title: A$^3$PreCore: Robust Rigid Registration for Native FLAIR-Space Brain-Mask Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Reliable brain-mask transfer into native fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) space can fail when T1-to-FLAIR rigid registration is unstable. We developed A$^3$PreCore, a six-degree-of-freedom rigid-registration strategy that aligns the full bias-corrected T1-weighted image to native FLAIR using normalized mutual information while preserving the established T1-space anatomical mask. We also introduced extended quantitative quality control (E-QC), which characterizes mask extent, field-of-view-relative position, FLAIR intensity support, boundary support, inferior morphology, and pairwise geometric disagreement. In 78 participants with paired T1-weighted and FLAIR imaging, A$^3$PreCore was compared with fsl_anat and the Brain Extraction Tool (BET). Gross rigid-body misregistration occurred in 21/78 fsl_anat outputs (26.9%) and 0/78 A$^3$PreCore outputs (exact two-sided McNemar p=9.54 x 10^-7). Among 57 participants without gross fsl_anat misregistration, A$^3$PreCore preserved close agreement (median Dice=0.993; median paired Delta NMI=-0.00007, p=0.429). A$^3$PreCore remained broadly concordant with BET (median Dice=0.955), with less inferior and extracranial extension in representative comparisons. Method-blinded neuroscientists ranked A$^3$PreCore first in 35/40 participants (87.5%). E-QC additionally exposed severe orientation-related disagreement not evident from global descriptors or centroid displacement alone. These findings support A$^3$PreCore as a robust native-FLAIR brain-mask transfer strategy and E-QC as a complementary framework for multidimensional mask characterization and participant-specific geometric quality control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: A³PreCore 用六自由度刚体配准把偏置校正后的 T1 全图对齐到原生 FLAIR 空间（normalized mutual information），保留 T1 空间解剖掩膜，从而稳定脑掩膜迁移。78 名受试者中 fsl_anat 出现 21/78（26.9%）粗大错配，A³PreCore 为 0/78（McNemar p=9.54×10⁻⁷），盲评神经科学家中 35/40（87.5%）将其排第一。
Motivation: T1 到 FLAIR 的刚体配准不稳定时，脑掩膜迁移到原生 FLAIR 空间会失败，而全局描述子与质心位移看不出方向相关的严重不一致。
Method: A³PreCore 以 normalized mutual information 为相似度，对偏置校正后的 T1 加权全图做六自由度刚体配准到原生 FLAIR，同时保留既有 T1 空间解剖掩膜；配套提出 E-QC，刻画掩膜范围、相对视野位置、FLAIR 强度支撑、边界支撑、下部形态与成对几何不一致。在 78 名配对 T1/FLAIR 受试者上与 fsl_anat、BET 比较，并由盲评神经科学家中排序。
Result: fsl_anat 输出 21/78（26.9%）出现粗大刚体错配，A³PreCore 为 0/78（双侧精确 McNemar p=9.54×10⁻⁷）。在无 fsl_anat 粗大错配的 57 人中，A³PreCore 保持接近一致（median Dice=0.993，median paired ΔNMI=-0.00007，p=0.429）；与 BET 仍大体一致（median Dice=0.955），代表性比较中下部与颅外延伸更少。盲评神经科学家中 35/40（87.5%）把 A³PreCore 排第一；E-QC 暴露出全局描述子与质心位移看不出的方向相关严重不一致。
Conclusion: A³PreCore 可作为稳健的原生 FLAIR 脑掩膜迁移策略，E-QC 作为多维掩膜表征与个体化几何质控的补充框架。

papers.title: PhySGA: A Physics-Space Grounded Agentic Framework for Generalizable and Interactive 3D Composition
papers.abstract_en: 3D object composition is pivotal to digital content creation and robot simulation, while also serving as a critical testbed for physical intelligence in foundation models. Previous methods either leverage large language models to directly predict object coordinates, or utilize generative diffusion priors to synthesize composite images for visual alignment, both of which rely on static priors in digital spaces. However, these methods consistently struggle with complex compositions such as precise hanging, gravity-driven settling and hidden containment, as these tasks require interactive construction processes involving global planning, fine-grained alignment, and physical simulation. To address these challenges, we propose PhySGA, a Physics-Space Grounded Agentic Framework for 3D composition via agent exploration and physical simulation, enabling the universal interactive assembly of rigid, articulated, and deformable objects. Directly applying vanilla LLMs or VLMs to this task proves insufficient, as current models inherently lack grounded physical understanding and interactive construction experience. To overcome this limitation, we design a collaborative feedforward-feedback architecture: an Assembly Agent focuses on geometric and kinematic reasoning for global step planning and coarse adjustment, while a Critic Agent reasons over contact dynamics for simulator state diagnosis and fine-grained closed-loop correction. Furthermore, Action Routers map semantic planning and analysis onto executable physical primitives within the simulator, while a task-specific Self-Evolving Skill Library distills historical trial-and-error feedback into reusable experiences, boosting success rates and minimizing exploration attempts. Extensive experiments within Isaac Sim demonstrate that PhySGA significantly surpasses existing methods in relation fidelity, physical plausibility, and visual quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhySGA 把 3D 物体组合从静态先验预测转为在 Isaac Sim 中由智能体探索加物理仿真完成的交互式装配，覆盖刚体、铰接体与可变形体。Assembly Agent 负责全局步骤规划与粗调，Critic Agent 基于接触动力学诊断仿真状态并闭环细调，Action Router 把语义规划映射为可执行物理原语，Self-Evolving Skill Library 把历史试错蒸馏为可复用经验。在 Isaac Sim 实验中在 relation fidelity、physical plausibility、visual quality 上显著超过现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法用 LLM 直接预测坐标或用扩散先验合成对齐图像，都依赖数字空间的静态先验，在精确悬挂、重力沉降、隐藏容纳这类需要全局规划、细粒度对齐与物理仿真的复杂组合上失效；vanilla LLM/VLM 本身缺乏落地的物理理解与交互装配经验。
Method: 提出 Physics-Space Grounded Agentic Framework (PhySGA)：协作式前馈-反馈架构中，Assembly Agent 做几何与运动学推理以规划全局步骤和粗调，Critic Agent 针对接触动力学推理仿真器状态并做闭环细粒度纠正；Action Router 将语义规划与分析映射到仿真器内可执行的物理原语，任务专属 Self-Evolving Skill Library 把历史试错反馈蒸馏为可复用经验。
Result: 在 Isaac Sim 内的大量实验中，PhySGA 在 relation fidelity、physical plausibility 与 visual quality 三项上显著超过现有方法，并提升成功率、减少探索尝试次数。
Conclusion: 把物理仿真与智能体探索、经验蒸馏结合，能让 3D 交互式装配处理静态先验做不到的悬挂、沉降与容纳类复杂组合，且对刚体、铰接体、可变形体通用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Speculative Sampling in Interactive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Interactive video generation commonly relies on small bidirectional chunks to reduce response latency. Yet our preliminary experiments show that larger chunks improve video quality and better utilize GPU parallelism, allowing more latents to be sampled with only a modest increase in sampling time. Motivated by these observations, we propose Speculative Sampling, a strategy that combines the modeling power of large bidirectional windows with the low-latency interaction of small ones. It expands the modeling window by appending noise latents as padding and caches the resulting predictions for reuse when the condition remains unchanged. Predictions are delivered incrementally, while the uncommitted future remains replaceable. Our latency analysis shows that this removes the waiting-time lower bound imposed by chunk boundaries, shifting the optimization focus from reducing chunk size to accelerating per-chunk sampling. Bidirectional window size thus becomes a decision variable for jointly optimizing visual quality and sampling time, rather than a necessary constraint on low-latency interaction. This opens a path to serving large bidirectional models in interactive streaming systems without complex streaming post-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 交互式视频生成用小双向 chunk 换低延迟，但 Speculative Sampling 通过在条件不变时追加噪声 latent 作 padding 扩大建模窗口并缓存预测复用，增量交付且未提交的未来可替换。延迟分析表明它消除了 chunk 边界施加的等待时间下界，把优化重点从缩小 chunk 转向加速单 chunk 采样，双向窗口大小因此成为画质与采样时间的联合决策变量。
Motivation: 交互式视频生成为压低响应延迟被迫用小双向 chunk，牺牲了画质与 GPU 并行度；大 chunk 能提升质量并多采样 latent，却带来等待延迟。
Method: Speculative Sampling：在条件不变时向双向窗口追加噪声 latent 作 padding 以扩大建模范围，缓存该预测供后续复用；预测增量交付，未提交的未来帧保持可替换，并配套延迟分析刻画等待时间下界。
Result: 初步实验显示更大 chunk 提升视频质量并更好利用 GPU 并行，采样时间仅小幅增加；延迟分析表明该策略移除了 chunk 边界带来的等待时间下界，使优化焦点从减小 chunk 尺寸转向加速单 chunk 采样。
Conclusion: 双向窗口大小应作为画质与采样时间的联合优化变量而非低延迟的硬约束，该路径让大型双向模型可直接服务交互式流媒体，无需复杂的流式后训练。

papers.title: PerSo: Investigating Facets of LLMs' Social Intelligence in Real-World Persuasion Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the social intelligence of large language models (LLMs) is increasingly important for applications involving human-AI interaction and multi-agent environments. Social intelligence comprises two aspects: cognitive intelligence, the ability to infer others' mental states, and behavioral intelligence, the ability to select appropriate social actions based on these inferences to achieve social goals. Persuasion provides a natural testbed in which both aspects are simultaneously at play, yet prior benchmarks typically evaluate them in isolation using synthetic scenarios. We introduce PerSo, a benchmark that evaluates both aspects on real-world persuasion dialogues from Reddit's ChangeMyView community, using an LLM-in-the-loop pipeline to construct the evaluation tasks, validated through human annotation. Our evaluation of diverse LLMs shows that performance generally scales with model size but varies across dimensions. The strongest LLM slightly surpasses the best observed human performance on the behavioral task, while the best human participant remains ahead on the cognitive task.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 17 figures, 10 tables. Ali Zamani and Soroush Esfahanian contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PerSo 用 Reddit ChangeMyView 的真实说服对话构建基准，通过 LLM-in-the-loop 流水线生成任务并经人工标注校验，同时考察 LLM 的认知智能（推断对方心智状态）与行为智能（选择合适社交行动达成目标）。评测显示性能大体随模型规模上升但各维度不一：最强 LLM 在行为任务上略微超过观察到的最佳人类表现，而认知任务上最佳人类参与者仍领先。
Motivation: 既有 LLM 社会智能基准多用合成场景，且把认知与行为两方面分开评测，无法反映真实说服对话中两者同时起作用的情况。
Method: 以 Reddit ChangeMyView 社区的真实说服对话为语料，用 LLM-in-the-loop 流水线构造评测任务，并通过人工标注 (human annotation) 校验；随后评测多种 LLM，分别度量认知智能与行为智能两个维度。
Result: 多样 LLM 的表现大体随模型规模扩大而提升，但跨维度差异明显；最强 LLM 在行为任务上略微超过观察到的最佳人类表现，最佳人类参与者在认知任务上仍领先于模型。
Conclusion: 在真实说服场景中，LLM 的行为智能已可触及人类水平，但推断他人心智状态的认知智能仍落后于最佳人类。

papers.title: Detection of Potato Plant Leaf Diseases using Convolutional Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Potato is an important food-security crop in Ethiopia, but its production is affected by foliar diseases, particularly early blight and late blight. This study develops a lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN) to classify potato leaves into three categories: healthy, early blight, and late blight. The proposed model was trained using 2,215 images from the PlantVillage dataset and evaluated on an independent field dataset containing 247 images collected from potato farms in Banja, Awi Zone, Ethiopia. On PlantVillage, the model achieved 99.04% training accuracy, 98.21% validation accuracy, and 98.66% test accuracy. On the field dataset, it achieved 90.28% accuracy. The study also compares the proposed CNN with VGG16 and MobileNetV2 in terms of classification performance and computational efficiency. The proposed model contains 446,787 trainable parameters, occupies approximately 1.70 MB, and requires an average of 5.58 seconds per training epoch in the reported experimental setup, compared with 9.96 seconds for VGG16 and 7.68 seconds for MobileNetV2. The results demonstrate the potential of a compact CNN for potato leaf disease classification and highlight the importance of independent field evaluation, where image conditions are more variable than in controlled benchmark datasets. The proposed approach may support preliminary disease identification for smallholder farmers in Ethiopia and similar agricultural settings.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. The study presents a lightweight CNN for three-class potato leaf disease classification and evaluates it on PlantVillage and an independent field dataset collected in Banja, Awi Zone, Ethiopia

papers.title: Reliability-Aware Multimodal Sentiment Prediction Under Local Modality Missingness
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal sentiment models are usually evaluated on complete utterances, yet streams often lose a contiguous span of text, audio, or video. We study local missingness on aligned CMU-MOSEI features. Our reliability-aware network (RM-Net) keeps the original temporal positions, represents unobserved positions with a learned token, outputs bounded per-modality intensity contributions gated by observation quality, and is trained with dual-view masking of contiguous segments. We fuse five RM-Net seeds with a LoRA-adapted BERT text expert, using a fusion weight that depends only on the visible fraction of content tokens. Architecture, checkpoint, and fusion choices were made on the validation split. On the held-out split, the fused model reaches a macro-F1 of 0.655 on clean inputs and 0.634 under 40\% mixed missingness; its two-view average exceeds the auxiliary-head baseline by 0.024 (95\% video-cluster bootstrap interval [0.003, 0.045]). Because this split was inspected during development, these numbers are not a blind test. For explanations, exact Shapley attributions over the eight modality subsets and position-level occlusion show that top-ranked positions reduce the predicted-class probability faster than random positions (AUC gap 0.113 on validation). We also describe an auditable word-level alignment pipeline for raw clips; its outputs do not feed the predictive models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多模态情感识别中连续片段缺失（local missingness），提出可靠性感知网络 RM-Net：保留原始时序位置、用学习 token 表示未观测位置、按观测质量门控各模ality 强度贡献，并用连续片段双视图掩码训练。在 CMU-MOSEI 上融合 5 个 RM-Net 种子与 LoRA 适配的 BERT 文本专家，留出集 macro-F1 干净输入 0.655、40% 混合缺失 0.634，双视图平均比辅助头基线高 0.024（95% video-cluster bootstrap 区间 [0.003, 0.045]）。
Motivation: 多模态情感模型通常只在完整语句上评测，而真实流常丢失一段连续的文本、音频或视频；现有方法未针对这种局部缺失设计可靠性度量。
Method: RM-Net 保留原始时序位置，用可学习 token 表示未观测位置，输出受观测质量门控的有界逐模态强度贡献，以连续片段的双视图掩码 (dual-view masking) 训练；融合 5 个 RM-Net 种子与 LoRA 适配的 BERT 文本专家，融合权重只依赖可见内容 token 比例，架构/检查点/融合选择在验证集完成。
Result: 在对齐的 CMU-MOSEI 特征上，留出集 macro-F1 干净输入 0.655、40% 混合缺失 0.634；双视图平均比辅助头基线高 0.024（95% video-cluster bootstrap 区间 [0.003, 0.045]）。解释方面，八个模态子集上的精确 Shapley 归因与位置级遮挡显示排名靠前的位置比随机位置更快降低预测类别概率（验证集 AUC 差 0.113）。
Conclusion: 可靠性门控加双视图掩码能在 40% 局部缺失下把 macro-F1 保持在 0.634（干净 0.655），且这些数字来自开发期间被检视的留出集，不是盲测。

papers.title: PrismaCoder: Pushing the Boundaries of Open Multimodal Code Intelligence through Decomposed Rubric Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal code intelligence connects the symbolic world of programs with the visual world their execution creates. Interest in this capability is burgeoning, as models are increasingly asked to produce charts, webpages, animations, and semi-structured documents. Recently, proprietary models have pushed far ahead, producing interactive artifacts even from a text description or a screenshot alone. Yet their data and training remain closed, and open progress is held back by the quantity and quality of available data and by the pipelines and methods for producing it. Quality is the harder of the two, since a sample must be correct as a program, well built, and above all visually right once rendered. No existing signal covers all three. Execution often returns just a pass or fail, code similarity does not map to the visual output, and task-specific verifiers do not generalize. To push open progress further, we start from the data side with PrismaForge, a hierarchical data pipeline centered on a synthesized rubric that decomposes these factors into checkable criteria. The same rubric serves as both filter and reward: it curates the supervised corpus, then drives reinforcement learning on visual-coding tasks. Leveraging PrismaForge for data synthesis and filtering, we build PrismaCoder-2M, the most diverse open dataset for multimodal code intelligence and the largest to date. On the model side, we train PrismaCoder-9B and PrismaCoder-35B on this data and release both. They lead the open state of the art by a wide margin and rival leading proprietary systems. Our analyses further show that the proposed rubric-based pipeline improves multimodal coding performance across model backbones. We release our code and data at https://qiushisun.github.io/PrismaCoder-Home/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PrismaCoder 用分层数据管线 PrismaForge 合成一条把「程序正确、构建良好、渲染后视觉正确」拆成可检查条目的 rubric，同一条 rubric 先当过滤器筛出 PrismaCoder-2M 监督语料，再当奖励驱动视觉编码任务的强化学习。基于该数据训练并开源 PrismaCoder-9B 与 PrismaCoder-35B，两者大幅领先开源 SOTA 并可与领先闭源系统竞争，且 rubric 管线在不同模型 backbone 上都提升多模态编码性能。
Motivation: 开源多模态代码模型落后于闭源系统，瓶颈在数据质量：执行信号只给 pass/fail，代码相似度对不上渲染出的视觉结果，任务专用 verifier 又无法泛化，没有单一信号同时覆盖正确性、构建质量与视觉正确性。
Method: PrismaForge 分层数据管线以合成 rubric 为核心，把程序正确、构建良好、渲染视觉正确三类因素分解为可检查条目；该 rubric 既用于筛选监督语料得到 PrismaCoder-2M，又作为奖励驱动视觉编码任务的强化学习。随后在该数据上训练 PrismaCoder-9B 与 PrismaCoder-35B 并开源。
Result: PrismaCoder-2M 被作者称为迄今最多样的开源多模态代码数据集、规模也是最大的；PrismaCoder-9B 与 PrismaCoder-35B 大幅领先开源 SOTA 并与领先闭源系统相当；分析显示 rubric 管线在不同模型 backbone 上均提升多模态编码性能。
Conclusion: 把正确性、构建质量与视觉正确性拆成同一条 rubric 同时充当数据过滤器和 RL 奖励，是推动开源多模态代码智能的可行路径，代码与数据已随模型一并发布。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Revisiting Simple Baselines for Relational Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Relational deep learning has emerged as a powerful paradigm for learning end-to-end predictive models over relational databases by representing them as temporal heterogeneous graphs. Recent advances based on graph neural networks and Transformers have achieved strong performance across diverse domains. However, the effectiveness of simpler relational baselines remains underexplored, making it difficult to assess how much architectural complexity is needed to achieve strong predictive performance. Motivated by the observation that predictive signals arise from target attributes, relational attributes, and historical labels, we revisit how effectively these signals can be exploited using simple propagation methods. We adapt fixed low-pass feature propagation to relational entity graphs and train an MLP for prediction. The resulting predictions are further refined using Correct-and-Smooth, a graph-based label propagation algorithm that incorporates historical labels over task-specific meta-graphs connecting target entities. Across classification and regression tasks on RelBench, an MLP trained on neighborhood-filtered features outperforms one using only target-entity features on most tasks and recovers a substantial portion of the performance of heterogeneous GNNs. Correct-and-Smooth provides further gains from historical labels, although applying it requires a separately constructed meta-graph because connections among target entities are not directly specified by the relational entity graph. Together, our studies revisit the effectiveness of established propagation methods as simple RDL baselines while identifying canonical meta-graph construction as a key challenge for effective label propagation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 RelBench 上重估关系深度学习 (RDL) 的简单基线：把固定低通特征传播 (fixed low-pass feature propagation) 适配到关系实体图上训练 MLP，再用 Correct-and-Smooth 在任务专用 meta-graph 上融合历史标签做后处理。邻域过滤特征的 MLP 在多数分类与回归任务上超过只用目标实体特征的 MLP，并恢复了异构 GNN 的相当一部分性能；Correct-and-Smooth 在此之上继续带来增益。
Motivation: GNN 与 Transformer 类 RDL 模型表现强，但简单关系基线的有效性研究不足，难以判断达到强预测性能究竟需要多少架构复杂度。
Method: 把固定低通特征传播适配到关系实体图，用 MLP 做预测；再用图标签传播算法 Correct-and-Smooth，通过连接目标实体的任务专用 meta-graph 融合历史标签对预测做进一步修正，信号来源为目标属性、关系属性与历史标签。
Result: 在 RelBench 的分类与回归任务上，用邻域过滤特征训练的 MLP 在多数任务上优于只用目标实体特征的 MLP，并恢复了异构 GNN 性能的相当一部分；Correct-and-Smooth 借助历史标签进一步提升，但需要单独构造 meta-graph，因为关系实体图本身不直接给出目标实体间的连接。
Conclusion: 成熟的传播方法足以充当有效的 RDL 简单基线，而 canonical meta-graph 构造是标签传播能否有效的关键难点。

papers.title: Generative Representation Learning for Scalable Latent Tokenization
papers.abstract_en: We introduce an approach for self-supervised representation learning designed to be used as a tokenizer for generative modeling. Our objective supervises a representation loss by factorizing the pointwise mutual information of the data, which we estimate by taking information differences between conditional predictions from a learned generative model. We justify our algorithm theoretically and empirically, demonstrating that our generative approach to representation learning avoids dimensional collapse and feature suppression in cases where commonly used methods like DINO and LeJEPA fail. Moreover, we show our representation learning technique is scalable; expending more compute leads to predictably better latent tokenization. For the first time, we perform a careful analysis of the combined flop efficiency of tokenizer and generative model and demonstrate that our approach is a compute-optimal improvement over direct diffusion for pixel-space generation, obtaining an FID-50K of 2.18 with JiT-L. Applied to ImageNet and the text-to-image dataset GPIC, we show tokenizer encoder scaling laws for diffusability, where extrapolating our approach achieves representations in 7x fewer FLOPs than DINOv2 on ImageNet and 8x fewer FLOPs than WebSSL on GPIC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种面向生成建模的自监督 tokenizer 表征学习方法，用学习到的生成模型对数据点互信息做因子化，以条件预测之间的信息差监督表征损失。理论上与实验上论证该方法避免维度坍缩与特征抑制（DINO、LeJEPA 在这些情形下失效），且算力投入越多 latent tokenization 越好：FID-50K 达 2.18（JiT-L），在 ImageNet 上比 DINOv2 少 7 倍 FLOPs、在 GPIC 上比 WebSSL 少 8 倍 FLOPs 即可外推出同等 diffusability 的表征。
Motivation: 自监督表征作为生成模型 tokenizer 时，常用方法（DINO、LeJEPA）会出现维度坍缩与特征抑制；同时缺少 tokenizer 与生成模型联合 flop 效率的分析，无法判断算力如何分配。
Method: 以点互信息 (pointwise mutual information) 因子化构造目标：用学习到的生成模型给出条件预测，取其信息差估计该互信息，再监督表征损失；并首次对 tokenizer 与生成模型的联合 flop 效率做分析，与像素空间直接 diffusion 对比。
Result: JiT-L 上取得 FID-50K 2.18，相对像素空间直接 diffusion 是 compute-optimal 改进；在 ImageNet 上外推达到与 DINOv2 相当 diffusability 的表征只需 7 倍更少 FLOPs，在文本到图像数据集 GPIC 上比 WebSSL 少 8 倍 FLOPs；tokenizer encoder 的 diffusability 呈 scaling law。
Conclusion: 用生成式互信息因子化训练 tokenizer 可以规避 DINO/LeJEPA 的维度坍缩与特征抑制，并让算力投入转化为可预测的 tokenization 改善，在 tokenizer+生成模型联合效率上优于像素空间直接 diffusion。

papers.title: ActiveEvidence: Decision-Focused Evidence Graphs with Verifiable Acquisition Gaps
papers.abstract_en: A multimodal agent must decide whether visual evidence is worth acquiring, which candidate or resolution to query, and when further interaction can no longer change its decision. We study this problem under a strict free-metadata/paid-observation boundary, stochastic vector costs, and a frozen execution trace, and treat it as decision-certifiable active evidence acquisition. A Counterfactual Evidence Interaction Graph (CEIG) represents unary evidence value, signed second-order interaction, and directed conditional harm while maintaining explicit score enclosures for unresolved interactions; a decision-weighted enclosure objective tightens the bounds that can change action identity. Gap-directed refinement evaluates only interactions that can displace the incumbent acquisition and stops once an $ε$-decision certificate shows that unresolved terms cannot change the selected action beyond a declared tolerance. The certificate is model-relative: it verifies policy-consistent optimality under the pinned learned score, and semantic quality is measured separately through post-freeze labels. Paired continuation rollouts learn the downstream value of paid previews, an online operational cost filter is separated from independent finite-policy-family trajectory certification, and an acquisition monitor with an independently implemented verifier binds every certificate to the frozen trace. On 640 cases split into 384/128/128 training, validation, and test cases, the controller reaches task score 0.842, grounding F1 0.816, evidence recall 0.873, 1.74 accepted calls, 286.5K visual tokens, and 742ms p95 latency. Dense replay of issued certificates shows 0.992 action agreement and a 0.988 certificate rate while evaluating 19.6 instead of 191.4 expensive interaction terms per decision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ActiveEvidence：在严格区分免费元数据与付费观测的多模态智能体中，用反事实证据交互图 (CEIG) 表示证据价值、有符号二阶交互与定向条件危害，并以 ε-决策证书在未解交互无法改变所选动作时提前停止。在 640 个案例（384/128/128 划分）上任务分 0.842、grounding F1 0.816、证据召回 0.873，平均只发 1.74 次被接受的调用，每步只评估 19.6 而非 191.4 个昂贵交互项。
Motivation: 多模态智能体需要判断视觉证据是否值得获取、查询哪个候选或分辨率、以及何时继续交互已无法改变决策；未解交互的穷举评估昂贵，而缺少可验证的停止判据。
Method: 构建 Counterfactual Evidence Interaction Graph (CEIG)，显式保留未解交互的分数包络 (score enclosures)，用 decision-weighted enclosure objective 收紧可能改变动作身份的边界；gap-directed refinement 只评估可能挤掉当前最优获取的交互，ε-决策证书确认未解项在声明容差内不影响动作后停止。证书为 model-relative，语义质量用 post-freeze 标签单独度量；配对 continuation rollouts 学习付费预览的下游价值，在线成本过滤与独立的有限策略族轨迹认证分离，并由独立实现的 verifier 把每张证书绑定到冻结执行轨迹。
Result: 640 个案例（训练/验证/测试 384/128/128）上任务分 0.842、grounding F1 0.816、证据召回 0.873、平均 1.74 次被接受调用、286.5K visual tokens、p95 延迟 742ms。对已签发证书的 dense replay 显示动作一致率 0.992、证书率 0.988，每次决策只评估 19.6 个昂贵交互项而非 191.4 个。
Conclusion: 在冻结执行轨迹下，用可验证的 ε-决策证书剪掉不会改变动作的交互，可以在保持策略一致最优的同时把昂贵交互评估量降到约十分之一。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Physics Is the Network: Fast, Training-Free Neural Emulation
papers.abstract_en: Neural emulation need not require learning a substitute for known physics. We investigate PolyNets that couple a continuous-time neural representation of polynomial dynamics with a simple recurrent network for discrete-time integration. When the governing coefficients are known, the resulting tensor graph requires no training and preserves the prescribed numerical scheme while enabling efficient hardware execution and parallel simulation. Using the one-dimensional Korteweg-de Vries equation, we compare PolyNet with CPU and GPU finite-difference Runge-Kutta solvers and three trained neural models: a state-map emulator, a physics-informed predictor, and a learned-tendency integrator. Analytical soliton solutions provide a reference for amplitude and phase errors across grid resolutions, 10^6 dispersively scaled time steps, ensembles of up to 10^4 trajectories, and varying initial amplitudes. PolyNet achieves accuracy comparable to the numerical solvers, including at amplitudes outside the learned models' training conditions. It combines this fidelity with high GPU throughput, approximately constant over the tested resolution range, and favorable ensemble scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PolyNet 把多项式动力学的连续时间神经表示与一个简单循环网络做离散时间积分耦合，当方程系数已知时张量图无需训练即可保留既定数值格式。在 1D Korteweg-de Vries 方程上，对照 CPU/GPU 有限差分 Runge-Kutta 与三个训练型神经模型，PolyNet 精度与数值求解器相当，且在超出训练条件的振幅下仍成立，GPU 吞吐在所测分辨率范围内近似恒定。
Motivation: 神经仿真通常要先学一个已知物理的替代模型，既费训练又可能丢失既定数值格式；作者要检验当控制系数已知时，能否不训练就拿到数值求解器级精度与 GPU 吞吐。
Method: PolyNet 由连续时间的多项式动力学神经表示加一个简单循环网络做离散时间积分构成；系数已知时生成的张量图不需训练并保留指定数值格式。以 1D Korteweg-de Vries 方程为对象，用解析孤子解作振幅与相位误差参考，对照 CPU/GPU 有限差分 Runge-Kutta 求解器与三个训练模型（state-map emulator、physics-informed predictor、learned-tendency integrator）。
Result: 在跨网格分辨率、10^6 个色散标度时间步、最多 10^4 条轨迹的系综以及不同初始振幅下，PolyNet 精度与数值求解器相当，包括在超出训练模型训练条件的振幅上；同时保持高 GPU 吞吐，在所测分辨率范围内近似恒定，并有良好的系综扩展性。
Conclusion: 当物理系数已知时，神经仿真可以不训练替代模型，直接以张量图形式保留数值格式并兼得精度与 GPU 吞吐，且对超出训练条件的初始振幅更稳健。

papers.title: The Wealth of Agents: Scaling Agentic AI Across Developers
papers.abstract_en: Today's agentic systems are typically designed, built, and deployed by single developers with full control over all participating agents. While this simplifies development, it limits the potential scale of agentic systems. We study multi-developer agentic systems (MDAs) which enable developers to collaboratively build agentic systems to push frontier capability beyond what any individual developer could achieve alone. We construct empirical and theoretical models of developers to compare MDAs with single-developer agentic systems (SDAs). On GAIA, a general assistant benchmark, a population of specialized developers whose individual agents do not exceed 35% accuracy reaches 70% when their agents are combined in an MDA. This MDA performs 12 percentage points above the median general-purpose SDA built with several times each specialist's development budget. Our theoretical models show how MDAs can incentivize specialization and encourage more efficient use of aggregated developer resources. Put together, our results make a preliminary case for MDAs as a new scaling axis by enabling developers with diverse capabilities and resources to advance agentic AI collaboratively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多开发者智能体系统 (MDAs)，让多个开发者各自构建专精 agent 并组合协作，突破单开发者系统 (SDAs) 的能力上限。在 GAIA 上，个体 agent 准确率不超过 35% 的专精开发者群体，组合成 MDA 后达到 70% 准确率，比用数倍开发预算构建的通用 SDA 中位数高 12 个百分点。
Motivation: 当前 agentic 系统由单个开发者全权设计部署，限制了系统规模与能力上限；需要一种机制让能力与资源各异的开发者协作，把整体能力推到任何单个开发者之上。
Method: 构建开发者的经验模型与理论模型来对比 MDA 与 SDA；将多个专精开发者的 agent 组合成 MDA，并在通用助手基准 GAIA 上评测，同时用理论模型刻画 MDA 如何激励专精化与更高效地聚合开发者资源。
Result: 在 GAIA 上，个体 agent 准确率不超过 35% 的专精开发者群体，其 agent 组合成 MDA 后达到 70% 准确率；该 MDA 比用数倍于单个专精者开发预算构建的通用 SDA 中位数高 12 个百分点。
Conclusion: MDAs 可作为 agentic AI 的一条新扩展轴 (scaling axis)：通过让能力与资源多样化的开发者协作，激励专精化并更高效地聚合开发资源，初步证据支持其超越单开发者系统。

summary_sections.conclusion: MDAs 可作为 agentic AI 的一条新扩展轴 (scaling axis)：通过让能力与资源多样化的开发者协作，激励专精化并更高效地聚合开发资源，初步证据支持其超越单开发者系统。

papers.title: VASPO: Self-Distillation with Privileged Value Estimation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation provides dense supervision for reasoning models via a privileged self-teacher. However, this supervision reflects local token preferences rather than the expected return of an unguided student continuation. Recent methods combine this signal with GRPO. They use GRPO for update directions and the teacher for signal scaling. However, we demonstrate a more effective integration within PPO. Specifically, we identify complementary positional dynamics: privileged information enhances a critic's value-prediction accuracy toward the response's end, whereas self-teacher guidance is strong initially, drops mid-generation, and rebounds finally. These insights motivate Value-Augmented Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (VASPO), wherein a self-teacher and critic evaluate identical privileged information at student-generated prefixes. The critic computes token-level PPO advantages from predicted continuation returns, while the self-teacher modulates selected positive advantages via bounded probability ratios. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, VASPO improves mean accuracy over PPO by 2.59 and 1.81 percentage points on Qwen3-4B and OLMo3-7B variants, respectively, and achieves the highest mean accuracy among evaluated methods on Knights and Knaves. Our code is available at https://github.com/cii030/VASPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VASPO 把特权自蒸馏 (privileged self-distillation) 与 PPO 结合：critic 与 self-teacher 在学生生成前缀上评估同一特权信息，critic 用预测的续写回报算 token 级 PPO 优势，self-teacher 用有界概率比调制部分正优势。在六个数学推理基准上，相对 PPO 平均准确率在 Qwen3-4B 变体上提升 2.59 个百分点、OLMo3-7B 变体上提升 1.81 个百分点，并在 Knights and Knaves 上取得所评估方法中的最高平均准确率。
Motivation: on-policy 自蒸馏的监督反映的是局部 token 偏好，而非无引导学生续写的期望回报；近期方法把该信号与 GRPO 拼接，只用 GRPO 定方向、teacher 定缩放，方向与信号的分工并不匹配。
Method: 在 PPO 框架内做整合：识别出位置互补动态——特权信息在响应末段提升 critic 的价值预测精度，而 self-teacher 引导在生成初期强、中段回落、末段反弹。VASPO 让 self-teacher 与 critic 在学生生成的前缀上评估同一特权信息，critic 输出基于预测续写回报的 token 级 PPO 优势，self-teacher 通过有界概率比 (bounded probability ratios) 调制被选中的正优势。
Result: 六个数学推理基准上，VASPO 相对 PPO 的平均准确率提升：Qwen3-4B 变体 +2.59 个百分点，OLMo3-7B 变体 +1.81 个百分点；在 Knights and Knaves 上取得所评估方法中的最高平均准确率。
Conclusion: 把特权价值估计放进 PPO 的优势计算、而非只做 GRPO 的信号缩放，能在数学推理上稳定超过 PPO；self-teacher 的调制应按其随位置变化的强弱施加于正优势。

papers.title: Bayesian Learning to Select Fair Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Evaluations of classifiers (AI or human or agents) often assume a batch setting in which every agent produces labels on every example in a test set, which can be expensive or impractical in many contexts. This motivates online policies that adaptively select agents to query as examples arrive and update policies as outcomes are observed. We study the problem of selecting, in an online stream, the agent that best balances (i) predictive performance and (ii) subgroup fairness of a sensitive attribute, and that allows for delayed observations of true class labels. We formulate this as a Bayesian multi-armed bandit problem using Thompson Sampling, explicitly balancing accuracy and fairness. We conduct empirical evaluations on real-world datasets spanning problems involving tabular classifiers, large language models, and human labelers, demonstrating substantial reductions in regret relative to baselines. Our theoretical contributions include guarantees on the performance of the selected agent that incorporate both the accuracy and fairness aspects of the problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把在线选择标注 agent（表格分类器、LLM、人类标注者）建模为带延迟反馈的 Bayesian 多臂老虎机，用 Thompson Sampling 在预测性能与敏感属性子群公平性之间显式权衡。在真实数据集上相对基线显著降低 regret，并给出同时涵盖准确率与公平性的所选 agent 性能保证。
Motivation: 批式评测要求每个 agent 对测试集全部样本打标，成本高且不现实；线上流式场景需要在样本到达时自适应选择查询对象，同时还要兼顾子群公平性与标签延迟。
Method: 将在线 agent 选择形式化为 Bayesian multi-armed bandit，采用 Thompson Sampling 并在目标中显式平衡 accuracy 与 sensitive attribute 的 subgroup fairness，允许真实类别标签延迟观测；评测覆盖表格分类器、大语言模型与人类标注者三类 agent。
Result: 在涵盖表格分类器、LLM 与人类标注者的真实数据集上，相对基线实现 regret 的大幅下降；理论部分给出同时纳入准确率与公平性两方面的所选 agent 性能保证。
Conclusion: 把公平性直接写进 bandit 目标并用 Thompson Sampling 在线选 agent，可以在标签延迟下同时保住预测性能与子群公平，替代昂贵的全量批式评测。
