papers.title: A Two-Level Clinical Novelty Prioritization Framework for Disease Trajectories Discovered from Longitudinal Electronic Health Records
papers.abstract_en: Graph-based analysis of electronic health records (EHRs) yields disease-trajectory catalogs, but structural support does not establish semantic novelty. We present a two-level framework to prioritize 99,527 branching motifs previously discovered by an upstream patient-disjoint, train-only MIMIC-IV v3.1 pipeline and frozen after validation-based catalog selection. The framework separates path-level and node-to-endpoint semantic sparsity from reliability-adjusted clinical priority. Three deterministic textualizations per motif or node-target pair were embedded with BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 and calibrated against 166,972 pre-2023 PubMed references using mean top-20 cosine distance. Positive recombination occurred in 8.63% of motifs and had negligible effect on global ranking, whereas specificity and support/GNN reliability terms changed clinical-priority ordering. Robustness analyses across neighbor counts, templates, encoders, generic-label taxonomies, score settings, PrimeKG, and corrected density-based RND showed that broad ordering was more stable than hard top-k membership. A semantic-dose analysis did not support a monotonic relation between score and forecasting benefit after endpoint and token-count adjustment (1.96 days per SD; 95% CI, -0.75 to 4.68). In the frozen catalog-q90 high-semantic subgroup, branch-enhanced forecasting reduced conditional event-time MAE by 20.1 days (95% CI, 13.3-27.0) and sMAPE by 2.37 percentage points (95% CI, 1.81-2.93), while discrimination and endpoint-ranking differences were inconclusive. Corrected RND showed low tail agreement with the primary score (Spearman rho = 0.430; q90 Jaccard = 0.125) despite a similar aggregate timing association. These findings support representation-aware, uncertainty-aware literature-relative prioritization of discovered trajectories rather than causal discovery or clinician-adjudicated novelty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 EHR 图挖掘产出的 99,527 个疾病轨迹分支 motif，提出两级临床新颖度优先级框架：把路径级与节点到终点的语义稀疏度同可靠性校正的临床优先级分开，并相对 166,972 篇 2023 年前 PubMed 文献校准语义距离。正向重组仅占 8.63% 且对全局排序影响可忽略，而特异度与 support/GNN 可靠性项改变排序；在 frozen catalog-q90 高语义子组中，分支增强预报使条件事件时间 MAE 降低 20.1 天（95% CI 13.3–27.0）、sMAPE 降低 2.37 个百分点（95% CI 1.81–2.93）。
Motivation: 图方法产出的疾病轨迹目录只证明结构支持，不等于语义新颖；面对近十万量级 motif，缺少相对既有文献、且兼顾可靠性与不确定性的优先级排序手段。
Method: 在上游 patient-disjoint、仅训练集的 MIMIC-IV v3.1 管线冻结目录上，对每个 motif 或节点-终点对做三种确定性文本化，用 BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 嵌入并以 mean top-20 cosine distance 对 166,972 篇 2023 年前 PubMed 参考校准；框架分离语义稀疏度与 reliability-adjusted 临床优先级，并做邻居数、模板、编码器、通用标签分类体系、PrimeKG 与修正 RND 的稳健性分析。
Result: 正向重组出现在 8.63% 的 motif 且对全局排序影响可忽略；语义剂量分析在调整终点与 token 数后不支持分数与预报收益的单调关系（每 SD 1.96 天，95% CI -0.75 至 4.68）；frozen catalog-q90 高语义子组中分支增强预报使条件事件时间 MAE 降 20.1 天（95% CI 13.3–27.0）、sMAPE 降 2.37 个百分点（95% CI 1.81–2.93），判别与终点排序差异不确定；修正 RND 与主分数尾部一致性低（Spearman rho = 0.430，q90 Jaccard = 0.125）。
Conclusion: 作者主张对发现的轨迹做表征感知、不确定性感知、相对文献的优先级排序，而非因果发现或临床医生裁定的新颖度；整体排序比硬 top-k 成员更稳定。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: VascuSR: Iterative Anatomy-Aware Diffusion for CT Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Generative super-resolution (SR) can recover sharp detail in computed tomography (CT) images from severely downsampled observations, but the missing high-frequency content is not uniquely determined by the low-resolution input. Consequently, visually plausible reconstructions may contain anatomically unsupported vascular detail, such as missing, spurious, or incorrectly connected vessels. To overcome this challenge, we introduce VascuSR, an iterative anatomy-aware diffusion framework that combines image reconstruction with explicit 3D vascular guidance. First, to provide richer anatomical guidance, we use an explicit 3D vascular representation that captures structural information beyond individual slices. This representation also simplifies vascular refinement by allowing a lightweight 3D generative refiner to focus on vascular structure rather than complex CT appearance. Second, to guide slice-wise SR, a lightweight anatomy controller injects the refined structure into the diffusion decoder, while iterative feedback updates this guidance from each new SR volume. On re-annotated MSD Task08 and HVM datasets, VascuSR outperforms interpolation and learning-based SR baselines in segmentation accuracy (Dice and clDice) and 3D vascular structure (connectivity and mean centerline distance), while maintaining image quality comparable to its SR backbone. Compared with learning-based baselines, VascuSR reduces class-averaged connected-component counts by over 20% on both datasets and mean centerline distance by over 10% on MSD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CT 超分辨率会补出解剖上不存在的血管（缺失、伪影或错误连通），VascuSR 用显式 3D 血管表示加轻量 anatomy controller 把结构反馈注入扩散解码器，逐轮迭代更新引导。在重标注的 MSD Task08 与 HVM 上，分割 Dice/clDice 与 3D 血管连通性、平均中心线距离均优于插值和学习型 SR 基线，类平均连通域数量在两数据集上降低超过 20%，MSD 平均中心线距离降低超过 10%，图像质量与 SR backbone 相当。
Motivation: 生成式 SR 的高频内容不由低分辨率输入唯一决定，视觉上合理的重建可能带解剖上无依据的血管细节，使下游血管分割与连通性分析不可靠。
Method: VascuSR 是迭代式 anatomy-aware diffusion 框架：先用显式 3D 血管表示提供跨切片结构引导，并由轻量 3D generative refiner 只针对血管结构做细化；再由轻量 anatomy controller 把细化后的结构注入扩散解码器做逐切片 SR，每个新生成的 SR 体数据再反馈更新该引导，形成迭代闭环。
Result: 在重标注的 MSD Task08 与 HVM 上，VascuSR 在分割精度（Dice、clDice）和 3D 血管结构（连通性、mean centerline distance）上超过插值与学习型 SR 基线，同时图像质量与其 SR backbone 相当；相对学习型基线，类平均连通域计数在两个数据集上均降低超过 20%，MSD 上平均中心线距离降低超过 10%。
Conclusion: 把显式 3D 血管结构作为迭代反馈注入扩散 SR，可以在不牺牲图像质量的前提下减少解剖上无依据的血管细节，改善 CT 超分辨率的血管连通性与分割精度。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Graph-Enhanced Disease Trajectory Discovery and Temporal Endpoint Forecasting from Longitudinal Electronic Health Records
papers.abstract_en: Longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) can reveal disease-progression structure, while useful forecasting requires leakage-controlled discovery, censor-aware outcomes, and inspectable trajectory evidence. We developed a graph-enhanced framework in MIMIC-IV v3.1 that splits patients before graph construction, learns train-only consecutive-admission transitions, and freezes endpoint-specific branching-motif policies selected on validation data. The final catalog contained 99,527 motifs, and a time-aware Transformer retrieved at most 24 patient-compatible motifs per endpoint through endpoint-specific cross-attention. Across five training seeds, micro-AUPRC increased from 0.9330 to 0.9357, while event-time MAE decreased from 676.9 to 657.7 days (reduction 19.2 days; 95% paired patient-cluster bootstrap CI, 13.8-24.8). Timing effects were heterogeneous: MAE worsened for events within 730 days but improved by 58.9 days for events occurring after 730 days. In an exploratory internal temporal split, branch conditioning reduced conditional event-time MAE by 26.9 days (95% CI, 23.0-30.8) without evidence of better micro-AUPRC. Corrected survival evaluation over the supported 0-2,555-day interval did not establish macro C-index or integrated Brier score superiority over a matched history-only discrete-hazard model. A directed, degree-matched GNN repair substantially improved unseen-edge discovery, yet replacing GNN-derived scores within fixed motif identities did not improve downstream forecasting. These results position branching motifs as structured trajectory context whose main value is long-range timing support rather than uniformly stronger endpoint discrimination, survival prediction, or causal explanation.
papers.summary_zh:

Result: 五个种子下 micro-AUPRC 0.9330 → 0.9357，事件时间 MAE 676.9 → 657.7 天（降 19.2 天，95% CI 13.8–24.8）；730 天内事件 MAE 变差，730 天之后事件改善 58.9 天。探索性内部时间切分上分支条件化使条件事件时间 MAE 降 26.9 天（95% CI 23.0–30.8），但 micro-AUPRC 无改善证据；0–2,555 天区间上校正生存评估未确立 macro C-index 与 integrated Brier score 优于匹配的仅历史离散风险模型；度数匹配的定向 GNN 修复显著改善未见边发现，但在固定 motif 身份内替换 GNN 分数并未改善下游预报。

papers.title: OLiVES: An Outdoor Low-Light Video Benchmark for Enhancement and Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Low-light video processing remains an underexplored problem in computer vision, primarily due to the scarcity of high-quality ground-truth data. Existing public datasets exhibit several limitations, including restricted motion diversity, limited scene coverage, weak degradations, reliance on auxiliary modalities such as event data, and misalignment between low-light inputs and ground truth. Furthermore, current datasets typically address either low-light enhancement or scene understanding, whereas these tasks should be considered jointly. We introduce \textbf{OLiVES}, a benchmark dataset for outdoor low-light videos with dynamic scenes, designed to support both low-light video enhancement (LLVE) and video object segmentation (VOS). The dataset addresses key content gaps by incorporating a diverse range of natural textures, animals, occlusions, dynamic activities, and close-up scenes. To the best of our knowledge, OLiVES is the first outdoor low-light video dataset captured using professional cinema-grade cameras. It provides over 25,000 aligned normal- and low-light frame pairs, along with over 46,000 VOS annotations. We benchmark state-of-the-art LLVE and VOS methods on OLiVES and show that training on it improves performance on both tasks. The OLiVES project page is available at: https://anonymous-OLiVES.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OLiVES 是首个用专业电影级摄影机拍摄的户外低光视频基准，把低光视频增强 (LLVE) 与视频目标分割 (VOS) 放在同一数据集上联合评测。它提供超过 25,000 对对齐的正常光/低光帧与超过 46,000 条 VOS 标注，覆盖自然纹理、动物、遮挡、动态活动与近景；在其上训练可同时提升两项任务的表现。
Motivation: 低光视频处理因缺乏高质量真值数据而研究不足：现有公开数据集运动多样性受限、场景覆盖窄、退化程度弱、依赖事件相机等辅助模态，且低光输入与真值存在错位；同时增强与场景理解两类任务被割裂处理。
Method: 构建户外动态场景低光视频基准 OLiVES，用电影级摄影机采集并对齐正常光与低光帧，标注视频目标分割掩码；在该数据集上对现有 SOTA LLVE 与 VOS 方法做统一基准测试，并检验在其上训练的迁移效果。
Result: 数据集含超过 25,000 对对齐的正常光/低光帧与超过 46,000 条 VOS 标注；在 OLiVES 上训练可同时改善 LLVE 与 VOS 两项任务的性能。
Conclusion: 户外低光视频的增强与分割应作为联合任务处理，且一个对齐、电影级采集、双任务标注的基准足以让 SOTA 方法在两项任务上同时受益。

papers.title: Hindsight-Privileged RLVR: Single-Rollout Token Credit Without Group Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains language models from checked task outcomes, but assigning a terminal reward to individual reasoning tokens or actions remains difficult. Group-relative methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) sample several attempts per prompt, but lose their reward-based learning signal when all attempts receive the same outcome. We propose Hindsight-Privileged RLVR (HP-RLVR), a single-rollout method that turns a completed trajectory's own future into token-level update weights. The generating policy snapshot scores each eligible token under its causal history and under a hindsight context containing the realized future and verifier feedback. A normalized Jensen--Shannon divergence between the two views weights the reward relative to a historical baseline, yielding bounded token credit for both successful and failed attempts, with no reference solution or learned critic. In paired Qwen3-8B runs over a shared $100$-step schedule, HP-RLVR trains $1.21\times$, $1.46\times$, and $2.30\times$ faster than GRPO on mathematics, code generation, and ALFWorld, using one eighth the rollouts per prompt. Accuracy is comparable overall, with HP-RLVR ahead on mathematics at all three sizes and GRPO ahead on code and ALFWorld. In ALFWorld, $43.2\%$ (4B) and $49.0\%$ (8B) of GRPO's gradient-norm records are zero, versus none for HP-RLVR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HP-RLVR 用单条 rollout 自己的未来给 token 分配信用：生成策略快照在同一因果历史与含已实现未来及 verifier 反馈的 hindsight 上下文下各打一次分，归一化 Jensen–Shannon 散度相对历史基线加权奖励，成功与失败轨迹都能得到有界 token credit，无需参考解或 critic。在共享 100 步训练日程的 Qwen3-8B 配对实验中，数学、代码生成、ALFWorld 上分别比 GRPO 快 1.21×、1.46×、2.30×，且每 prompt 只用八分之一 rollout。
Motivation: RLVR 把可验证的终局奖励分给单个推理 token 或动作仍然困难；GRPO 依赖每题多次采样，一旦所有尝试拿到相同结果，基于组内相对奖励的学习信号就完全消失。
Method: HP-RLVR 只跑一条 rollout：生成策略快照对每个合格 token 分别在因果历史和 hindsight 上下文（已实现未来 + verifier 反馈）下打分，两视图的归一化 Jensen–Shannon 散度把奖励相对历史基线加权成有界 token credit；不引入参考解，也不训练 critic。
Result: 在共享 100 步日程的 Qwen3-8B 配对运行中，HP-RLVR 在数学、代码生成、ALFWorld 上训练速度分别为 GRPO 的 1.21×、1.46×、2.30×，每 prompt rollout 数为 GRPO 的 1/8。总体准确率相当：数学上三种规模 HP-RLVR 全部领先，代码与 ALFWorld 上 GRPO 领先。ALFWorld 中 GRPO 的梯度范数记录有 43.2%（4B）和 49.0%（8B）为零，HP-RLVR 为零条。
Conclusion: 用单条轨迹的 hindsight 视图差异替代组内相对奖励，可以在不组采样、不加 critic 的情况下消除全同结果导致的零梯度，代价是代码与 ALFWorld 上准确率仍落后于 GRPO。

papers.title: Quantifying privacy risks in foundation model representations of brain MRI
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained representations are increasingly used to share and reuse information from medical images without exposing the original scans, but it is unclear how much patient-specific information these representations retain. We investigate this question for brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) by evaluating five frozen pretrained encoders spanning different architectures, pretraining objectives, and training domains on two longitudinal T1-weighted datasets, OASIS-2 and MIRIAD. Under an attacker model with access to released embeddings, the corresponding public encoder, and auxiliary MRI scans, we evaluate patient linkage and sensitive-attribute inference. Across the evaluated representations, we observe substantial subject-specific information: rank-1 patient linkage reaches up to 99\% on MIRIAD and exceeds 90\% on OASIS-2 for the highest-risk representation, despite the absence of an identification objective during encoder training. We further show that the released embeddings retain information about a demographic attribute, with recorded-sex prediction reaching balanced accuracy of 90.9\% on OASIS-2 and 95.5\% on MIRIAD. Overall, our results demonstrate that replacing raw brain MRI with learned embeddings does not, by itself, eliminate patient-linkage or attribute-inference risk, and is therefore insufficient on its own to establish anonymity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在脑 MRI 预训练表征上做隐私攻击评测：五个冻结编码器、两个纵向 T1 数据集 (OASIS-2、MIRIAD) 上，攻击者拿到 embedding、公开编码器和辅助扫描即可做患者链接与属性推断。最高风险表征的 rank-1 患者链接在 MIRIAD 达 99%、OASIS-2 超过 90%，recorded-sex 预测 balanced accuracy 分别为 95.5% 与 90.9%——用 embedding 替换原始影像本身不足以建立匿名性。
Motivation: 预训练表征被当作共享医学影像信息、避免暴露原始扫描的手段，但其中保留多少患者特异信息并不清楚。
Method: 评测五个冻结预训练编码器（架构、预训练目标、训练域各异），在两个纵向 T1-weighted 数据集 OASIS-2 与 MIRIAD 上，攻击者可访问发布的 embedding、对应公开编码器与辅助 MRI 扫描，执行患者链接 (patient linkage) 与敏感属性推断 (attribute inference)。
Result: 最高风险表征的 rank-1 患者链接在 MIRIAD 上达 99%，在 OASIS-2 上超过 90%，尽管编码器训练时没有识别目标；recorded-sex 预测 balanced accuracy 在 OASIS-2 为 90.9%、在 MIRIAD 为 95.5%。
Conclusion: 脑 MRI 的学习表征保留了大量被试特异信息，仅用 embedding 替换原始扫描不能消除患者链接或属性推断风险，因此不足以单独确立匿名性。

papers.title: Average-Reward Policy Identification from a Single Continuing Trajectory
papers.abstract_en: In reinforcement learning, an agent must explore an unknown environment to learn how to make good decisions. Unlike methods that can freely sample any state--action pair, an agent learning from a single trajectory must spend additional time navigating between states. It is therefore natural to expect that learning from a single trajectory requires more experience. In this paper, we show that this additional cost is not always necessary. For average-reward reinforcement learning, we develop an algorithm that learns where to collect information while ensuring that the required samples can be obtained efficiently. We establish an upper bound on the number of interactions needed to identify a near-optimal policy. Furthermore, we prove a matching information theoretic lower bound, showing that, for a broad class of environments and at sufficiently high accuracy, learning from a single trajectory is no harder in the worst case than learning with unrestricted access to state action samples. Our results reveal that the additional complexity cost of navigation can be avoided by adapting information gathering requirements to how the environment provides information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对平均奖励强化学习 (average-reward RL) 中从单条持续轨迹 (single continuing trajectory) 学习的额外代价，提出一种决定在何处采集信息的算法，并证明识别近最优策略的样本复杂度上界。配对的信息论下界表明：对一大类环境、在足够高的精度下，单轨迹学习在最坏情形下并不比可任意采样状态-动作对更难，导航带来的额外复杂度代价可以被规避。
Motivation: 单条轨迹学习必须花时间在状态间导航，通常被预期需要更多经验；论文要判定这笔导航代价在平均奖励 RL 中是否不可避免。
Method: 为平均奖励 RL 设计一个自适应信息采集算法（决定在哪里收集信息，同时保证所需样本能被高效获得），并给出识别近最优策略所需交互次数的上界，再配以匹配的信息论下界。
Result: 证明了识别近最优策略的交互次数上界与匹配的信息论下界；结论覆盖一大类环境，且在足够高精度下，单条轨迹学习在最坏情形下与可无限制访问状态-动作样本的学习难度相同。
Conclusion: 导航的额外复杂度代价可以通过让信息采集要求适配环境提供信息的方式来避免，单轨迹学习的额外成本并非总是必需。

summary_sections.method: 为平均奖励 RL 设计一个自适应信息采集算法（决定在哪里收集信息，同时保证所需样本能被高效获得），并给出识别近最优策略所需交互次数的上界，再配以匹配的信息论下界。
summary_sections.result: 证明了识别近最优策略的交互次数上界与匹配的信息论下界；结论覆盖一大类环境，且在足够高精度下，单条轨迹学习在最坏情形下与可无限制访问状态-动作样本的学习难度相同。
summary_sections.conclusion: 导航的额外复杂度代价可以通过让信息采集要求适配环境提供信息的方式来避免，单轨迹学习的额外成本并非总是必需。

papers.title: Decoupled Marginal Sharpening for Training-Free Inference-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: We study how to improve LLM reasoning at inference time without updating model weights or using external reward models. Recent reward-free power-sampling methods define the sequence-level power target $π_α(y\mid x)\propto p_0(y\mid x)^α$, where $α>1$, which increases the relative probability of completions that are already likely under the base model. Existing methods use Metropolis--Hastings or Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) to approximately sample from this target. However, two challenges arise at different levels. At the target level, full-sequence sharpening can concentrate probability on a few exact reasoning--answer trajectories, suppressing alternative paths that support the same answer. At the sampler level, finite-particle SMC can suffer from path collapse when resampling repeatedly duplicates a few high-weight prefixes. To address these challenges, we propose Decoupled Marginal Sharpening (DMS), which separately controls how strongly the model favors particular reasoning paths and how strongly it favors final answers after aggregating support across those paths. At the target level, DMS first samples from a sharpened reasoning distribution, then marginalizes the model's answer probabilities over the resulting weighted reasoning population and sharpens the induced answer marginal. Separate exponents allow mild reasoning sharpening to encourage exploration of diverse paths, followed by stronger answer-marginal sharpening to concentrate probability on answers with greater aggregate support across those paths. At the sampler level, we develop Fully Adapted Annealed SMC, which combines an annealed sequence of power targets with locally fully adapted proposals and predictive ancestor resampling. Experiments on MATH500, GPQA-Diamond, HumanEval, and AIME24/25 across three base models show that DMS achieves the highest mean pass@1 among the compared methods in all tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Decoupled Marginal Sharpening (DMS)，把推理时缩放的锐化拆成两路：先对推理路径做温和锐化，再把答案概率在加权路径群体上边缘化后做强锐化，从而避免全序列锐化锁死单一轨迹。采样端配 Fully Adapted Annealed SMC（退火幂目标序列 + 局部完全适应提议 + 预测性祖先重采样）抑制有限粒子下的路径坍缩。在 MATH500、GPQA-Diamond、HumanEval、AIME24/25 与三个基座模型上，DMS 在全部任务中取得所比较方法里最高 mean pass@1。
Motivation: 免奖励的幂采样 (power sampling) 在目标层面用全序列锐化会把概率压到少数精确推理-答案轨迹上，压制支持同一答案的替代路径；在采样层面，有限粒子 SMC 反复重采样会复制少数高权重前缀，造成 path collapse。
Method: DMS 在目标层面先从锐化的推理分布采样，再把模型答案概率在该加权推理群体上边缘化并对诱导出的答案边缘做锐化，两个指数分开控制：推理锐化温和以鼓励多样路径，答案边缘锐化更强以集中到聚合支持更高的答案。采样层面提出 Fully Adapted Annealed SMC，结合退火的幂目标序列 π_α(y|x)∝p_0(y|x)^α、局部完全适应提议 (fully adapted proposals) 与预测性祖先重采样 (predictive ancestor resampling)。
Result: 在 MATH500、GPQA-Diamond、HumanEval、AIME24/25 四类任务、三个基座模型上，DMS 在所有任务中取得所比较方法中最高 mean pass@1；论文为 17 页、3 图、6 表。
Conclusion: 把推理路径锐化与答案边缘锐化解耦，可以在不更新权重、不用外部奖励模型的前提下提升 LLM 推理时缩放效果；退火加完全适应的 SMC 用于缓解有限粒子重采样导致的路径坍缩。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lost in Translation: Why Lower Bias Scores Don't Mean Fairer Models
papers.abstract_en: Bias audits of multilingual language models usually compare a model's average stereotype score in English with its average in another language and read the difference as a difference in fairness. We ask how much of that difference is noise. Auditing ten open models in eight languages, we measure how far scores move when English test items are merely reworded, test every language shift item by item, and check that the test catches shifts we inject on purpose. In all 70 model-language pairs the stereotype score falls below its English level, and for Hindi, Korean and Swahili the drop clearly exceeds what rewording English produces; most of it comes from StereoSet items. Judging every translation, we find that imperfect ones drop more, but faithful translations alone drop nearly as much. Still, a lower average does not show that a model is fairer. An item's English score predicts its translated score far less well than its reworded score (correlation 0.23, 0.27 on faithful translations, vs. 0.48), while scores stay as far from neutral, models agree on translated items, and within Hindi or Spanish a translated item's score correlates with its own rewording at 0.84 and 0.82. The average cannot distinguish lower bias from a different pattern of item-level scores. We also document three common pipeline errors that silently erase bias signal, and release our code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多语言 LLM 偏见审计把英语与其它语言的平均 stereotype score 之差当作公平性差异，但该差异大部分是噪声而非更公平。审计 10 个开源模型、8 种语言共 70 个模型-语言对，所有对的分数都低于英语水平，且条目级相关性（忠实翻译 0.23/0.27，改写 0.48）表明平均值无法区分偏见降低与条目分数模式改变。
Motivation: 多语言偏见审计默认用语言间平均 stereotype score 差衡量公平性，但该差值有多少来自噪声、多少来自真实偏见差异，此前未被逐条目检验。
Method: 审计 10 个开源模型、8 种语言：改写英语测试条目测量噪声幅度，逐条目检验每种语言偏移，注入已知偏移验证测试灵敏度，并逐条评判翻译质量（忠实 vs 不完美），同时记录三类常见 pipeline 错误。
Result: 70 个模型-语言对全部低于英语 stereotype score；Hindi、Korean、Swahili 的降幅明显超过英语改写产生的噪声，多数降幅来自 StereoSet 条目；不完美翻译降幅更大，但忠实翻译降幅也接近；条目英语分数预测翻译分数的相关性为 0.23（忠实翻译 0.27），远低于改写的 0.48；翻译条目分数距中性仍同样远；同一 Hindi 或 Spanish 条目与其自身改写的相关性为 0.84 和 0.82。
Conclusion: 更低的平均 stereotype score 不能证明模型更公平，它可能只是条目级分数模式改变；审计需逐条目检验并排除 pipeline 错误，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SafeAdapt-Poker: Counterfactual Risk Calibration for Budgeted Adaptation under Opponent Shift
papers.abstract_en: Opponent histories can mislead after behavioral shifts. SafeAdapt-Poker formulates budgeted adaptation under opponent shift as a dual-counterfactual sequential-control problem using only information available before each decision. At each decision the controller asks two distinct questions: what local downside a deviation from the frozen anchor would induce under matched legal continuations, and what future adaptation value would be lost by consuming part of the remaining deviation budget now. The first question is answered by a monotone strategic-risk model over deviation intensity; the second by a paired budget-state continuation model that prices current budget consumption. The controller selects among support-preserving candidate deviations by trading immediate adaptation value against these two quantities, a pathwise cumulative-KL ledger bounds total anchor-relative deviation, and a finite family of frozen controllers is screened on complete paired calibration sessions before held-out interaction. A finite-candidate perturbation bound shows that the allocation objective degrades continuously with continuation-value estimation error. Evaluation covers exact-game exploitation and safety, four opponent shifts, local-risk calibration, delayed-opportunity allocation, direct opportunity-value estimation, value-error robustness, factorial mechanism attribution, budget sensitivity, abstract-HUNL cross-play, and player/time-held-out public-history behavior. On exact Leduc the full controller attains a matched weak-pool gain of +0.0718 with a worst-opponent delta of -0.0126, raises delayed-opportunity capture from 0.6318 under myopic allocation to 0.7841 under the same session budget, and reaches +42.7 mbb/hand in abstract-HUNL cross-play; the retained public-history screen reports 0.5820 action accuracy and 0.9277 log loss versus 0.5039 and 0.9778 for a public prior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SafeAdapt-Poker 把对手行为漂移下的预算自适应建模为双反事实序贯控制：每个决策同时估计偏离冻结锚点的局部下行风险与消耗剩余偏离预算所损失的未来自适应价值，用路径累计 KL 账本约束总偏离。在精确 Leduc 上完整控制器取得 +0.0718 的匹配弱池增益（最差对手 delta -0.0126），延迟机会捕获率从短视分配的 0.6318 提到 0.7841，abstract-HUNL 跨玩法达到 +42.7 mbb/hand。
Motivation: 对手历史在行为漂移后会误导策略，直接依赖历史的自适应既可能被利用，也可能过早耗尽有限的偏离预算，缺少对局部下行与未来机会价值的联合定价机制。
Method: 控制器用单调战略风险模型 (monotone strategic-risk model) 回答局部下行问题，用配对的预算状态续值模型 (paired budget-state continuation model) 给当前预算消耗定价；在保持支撑的候选偏离中权衡即时自适应价值与这两项，以路径累计 KL 账本约束相对锚点的总偏离，并在留出交互前用完整配对校准会话筛选一组冻结控制器；另给出有限候选扰动界，说明分配目标随续值估计误差连续退化。
Result: 精确 Leduc 上完整控制器匹配弱池增益 +0.0718，最差对手 delta -0.0126；同一会话预算下延迟机会捕获率由短视分配的 0.6318 升至 0.7841；abstract-HUNL 跨玩法达 +42.7 mbb/hand；保留的公开历史筛选器动作准确率 0.5820、log loss 0.9277，对照公开先验为 0.5039 与 0.9778。评估覆盖四种对手漂移、局部风险校准、延迟机会分配、价值误差鲁棒性、因子机制归因与预算敏感性。
Conclusion: 把偏离预算当作可定价的状态量并同时约束路径累计 KL，能在对手漂移下既保住最差对手不劣化又拿到延迟机会与跨玩法收益；续值估计误差通过扰动界连续传导到分配目标，因此续值校准是该框架的关键。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Selective Growing Q-Networks (SGQN): An Analysis of Adaptive Action Grids in Decoupled Q-Learning
papers.abstract_en: Value-based Q-learning for continuous control can discretise the action space, but the resolution of the discretisation trades early exploration against final precision. Growing Q-Networks (GQN) grow the resolution uniformly from coarse to fine. We introduce Selective Growing Q-Networks (SGQN), which keeps decoupled Q-learning and replaces uniform growth with an adaptive action grid: bins are added next to bins with high estimated Q-value, bins with low Q-value are pruned, and actions are chosen epsilon-greedily. On eight DeepMind Control Suite (DMControl) tasks with 2 to 12 action dimensions, SGQN has the highest mean final return among the compared methods on four, is within 1.1% of the best method on three more, and is 3.4% below Bang-Bang MPO on Walker Run, using on average 7.5 of 9 available bins per dimension. We then test whether the adaptive grid explains these results, and find that it does not. Growth activates every candidate bin and behaves like uniform growth, and removing pruning changes the return by at most 1.1%. Two other choices matter: starting from a coarse grid, since starting with all 9 bins produces collapsed seeds, and epsilon-greedy selection, since an annealed softmax lowers the return by 23% to 100%. SGQN is insensitive to its growth and pruning hyperparameters. It also differs from the GQN and DecQN baselines in other respects, notably one gradient update per environment step instead of one per eight, which we did not control for, so we do not attribute its advantage to a single component. We present SGQN as a competitive value-based method and as an analysis of which ingredients of a growing action grid matter.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Under review at TMLR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SGQN 在解耦 Q-learning 中把均匀增长的动作网格换成自适应网格：在高 Q 值的 bin 旁加 bin、剪掉低 Q 值 bin。在 8 个 DMControl 任务（2–12 维动作）上，它在 4 个任务上平均最终回报最高、3 个任务距最优 ≤1.1%、Walker Run 落后 Bang-Bang MPO 3.4%；但消融显示自适应性并非原因——增长实际激活了所有候选 bin、去掉剪枝回报变化 ≤1.1%，真正起作用的是从粗网格起步（全 9 bin 起步会产生 collapsed seeds）和 epsilon-greedy 选择（退火 softmax 使回报下降 23%–100%）。
Motivation: 连续控制的 Q-learning 需离散化动作空间，分辨率存在权衡：粗网格利于早期探索、细网格利于最终精度。GQN 用均匀由粗到细的增长来折中，但均匀增长不区分哪些动作区域值得加密。
Method: SGQN 保留 decoupled Q-learning，用自适应动作网格替换均匀增长：在估计 Q 值高的 bin 邻域加 bin、剪除低 Q 值 bin，动作按 epsilon-greedy 选取；每维平均使用 9 个可用 bin 中的 7.5 个。评测在 8 个 DeepMind Control Suite 任务上，动作维度 2–12，对比 GQN、DecQN、Bang-Bang MPO 等方法，并做增长/剪枝超参与选择策略的消融。
Result: 8 个 DMControl 任务中，SGQN 在 4 个上平均最终回报最高，另 3 个距最优方法 ≤1.1%，Walker Run 比 Bang-Bang MPO 低 3.4%。消融：增长实际激活全部候选 bin、行为等同均匀增长；去掉剪枝回报变化 ≤1.1%；从全 9 个 bin 起步产生 collapsed seeds；退火 softmax 替换 epsilon-greedy 使回报下降 23%–100%；对增长与剪枝超参不敏感。SGQN 与 GQN/DecQN 还有一处未受控差异：每环境步 1 次梯度更新而非每 8 步 1 次。

papers.title: Learning by Examples: Power Grid Steady State Analysis with a Tabular Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models have shown strong generalization across scientific domains, but their use in power systems remains largely task-specific. We investigate whether a pretrained tabular foundation model (TFM), TabPFN, can serve as a general-purpose neural solver for power grid steady-state analysis. We evaluate the TFM on three tasks: power flow (PF) prediction, N-k contingency screening (NCS), and voltage stability margin (VSM) prediction. We performed experiments on 118- and 2000-bus systems, comparing the TFM against task-specific neural baselines. Without retraining or fine-tuning, the TFM matches or outperforms the best task-specific model in several settings across the three tasks. For 118-bus PF prediction, a variant of the TFM achieves errors of $1\times 10^{-3}$ pu for voltage magnitudes and $0.30^\circ$ for voltage angles, outperforming all baselines. On unseen N-1 contingency and close-to-infeasible PF cases, the TFM is competitive with the DCPF approximation. For millions of unseen N-2 contingencies, the TFM achieves AUCs of 0.92 and 0.95 for branch and voltage violation screening, respectively. The TFM also attains accurate VSM prediction performance for the 2000-bus system with limited labelled data. The TFM attains strong results across the tested tasks despite pretraining without any power-system-specific dataset and requiring no fine-tuning step. These results offer a glimpse into the potential of pretrained TFMs as a neural solver for a range of power grid analysis tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 预训练表格基础模型 TabPFN 不做任何重训或微调，直接充当电网稳态分析的通用神经求解器，在 118 与 2000 节点系统上覆盖潮流预测、N-k 故障筛选与电压稳定裕度三项任务。118 节点潮流预测中电压幅值误差 1×10⁻³ pu、相角 0.30°，优于全部任务专用基线；数百万未见 N-2 故障的支路/电压越限筛选 AUC 分别为 0.92 与 0.95。
Motivation: 基础模型已在多科学领域展现泛化能力，但在电力系统中应用基本停留在单一任务专用模型，缺少一个无需针对每个任务重训的通用求解器。
Method: 以预训练表格基础模型 TabPFN 作为神经求解器，在 118- 与 2000-bus 系统上评估三项任务：潮流 (power flow) 预测、N-k 故障筛选 (NCS)、电压稳定裕度 (VSM) 预测，并与各任务专用神经基线以及 DCPF 近似对比；全程不重训、不微调。
Result: 118-bus 潮流预测中 TFM 变体电压幅值误差 1×10⁻³ pu、电压相角 0.30°，优于所有基线；在未见 N-1 故障与接近不可行的潮流算例上与 DCPF 近似相当；对数百万未见 N-2 故障，支路越限与电压越限筛选 AUC 分别为 0.92 和 0.95；2000-bus 系统在标注数据有限时 VSM 预测仍准确。
Conclusion: 预训练期间完全未用任何电力系统数据集、且无需微调的表格基础模型，可以在多种电网稳态分析任务上匹配或超过任务专用模型，具备作为通用神经求解器的潜力。

papers.title: Equal CER, Unequal Damage: Severity-Weighted Character Error Rate for OCR
papers.abstract_en: Character Error Rate (CER), the standard metric for OCR and vision-language models (VLMs), charges a typo as much as a wrong name. We introduce semCER, which keeps CER's alignment and denominator and charges each grapheme edit a severity from an LLM judge, with no word segmentation. Normalized CER keeps the score of a whole transcription, where it tracks readers as well as semCER or better, and semCER breaks that score down into named edits. The charges track readers' ratings edit by edit in English, Vietnamese, and Chinese and put the edits readers rate most severe near the top of a sorted list. On pairs drawn where CER and semCER disagreed, readers side with semCER more often than with normalized CER in English and Chinese, and equally often in Vietnamese. Across 16 languages, the judge charges a wrong diacritic or tone mark almost nothing in Spanish but nearly a wrong letter's severity in Telugu. Where we can count real words, a general VLM's wrong letter forms one far above chance while a classical pipeline's stays near it. We release the 61 million judged edits, the aggregated reader ratings, and the distilled scorer at https://github.com/nguyenx2t/semcer.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables. Under review at ACL Rolling Review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: semCER 在保持 CER 对齐方式与分母不变的前提下，用 LLM judge 给每个字形编辑打严重度分，无需分词即可把整篇转写的错误拆成具名编辑。逐编辑严重度在英、越、中三语上贴合读者评分，在 CER 与 semCER 分歧的样本对上读者更常站在 semCER 一边（英文、中文），越南语持平。
Motivation: CER 把拼错一个字和写错一个人名同等计费，无法反映编辑对读者的实际伤害，也无法解释分数由哪些错误构成。
Method: 保留 CER 的对齐与分母，由 LLM judge 对每个字形编辑赋严重度 charge，不做分词；同时给出作用于整篇转写的 normalized CER 与可拆解具名编辑的 semCER，并发布 6100 万条已判编辑、聚合读者评分与蒸馏打分器。
Result: normalized CER 在整篇转写分数上与 semCER 相当或更好；semCER 的 charge 逐编辑贴合读者评分，并把读者判为最严重的编辑排到排序列表前列；在 CER 与 semCER 分歧的样本对上，英文与中文读者更常选 semCER，越南语两者相当；16 种语言中西语错一个变音符收费几乎为零，泰卢固语则接近错一个字母的严重度；在可统计真实词的场合，通用 VLM 的错字母生成真实词的比例远高于随机，经典 pipeline 则接近随机。
Conclusion: 把严重度加权嵌入 CER 可以在不改分母的前提下让 OCR/VLM 评测更贴近读者判断，且跨语言的严重度尺度差异必须按语言分别校准。

papers.title: The COUNT: Counting N-grams Unlocks Scaling on Host Memory and Training-Free Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: The scaling relationship of compute and performance for language models (LMs) has been extensively studied; more recently, models are being designed to scale memory use, as well. In particular, adding embeddings for n-grams scales memory separately from compute use, because each pass only processes individual embedding rows, which are much smaller than the storage used for the whole embedding table. However, existing methods train embeddings from scratch, which needs expensive GPU memory for fast reading and writing. Meanwhile, the ordinary memory of the host system is cheap and underutilized by these training methods. To scale on host memory, we introduce COUNT (Counting Offline Unlocks N-gram Transformers), which builds n-gram embeddings without adding learned parameters by storing precomputed n-gram counts on host. We use the corpus frequencies to weight together the LM's own unembeddings of the next tokens most often following the current n-gram history. At a fixed compute budget, COUNT can be added as an additional input embedding for pretraining 1B-parameter LMs to improve validation loss as much as an LM with 57% more compute. If GPU memory is limited, using COUNT to let backbone parameters fill GPU memory gives better performance than splitting memory with additional learned n-gram embeddings. Beyond efficiency, COUNT allows switching in a different table of n-gram counts from a domain-specific corpus at inference time to adapt to a new task without any training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COUNT 用主机内存里预存的 n-gram 计数替代可学习 embedding 参数，按语料频率把当前 n-gram 历史后继 token 的 unembedding 加权合成输入 embedding。在固定算力下给 1B 参数 LM 预训练加上 COUNT，验证损失改善幅度相当于多用 57% 算力；推理时换一张领域语料的计数表即可零训练适配新任务。
Motivation: 现有 n-gram embedding 方法从头训练，需要昂贵的 GPU 显存做高速读写，而主机内存便宜且闲置，限制了内存维度上的扩展。
Method: COUNT（Counting Offline Unlocks N-gram Transformers）在主机侧离线存储 n-gram 计数，不引入任何可学习参数；用语料频率对 LM 自身的 unembedding（针对当前 n-gram 历史后最常出现的下一 token）加权合成，作为额外输入 embedding 参与 1B 参数 LM 预训练。
Result: 固定算力预算下，加入 COUNT 预训练 1B 参数 LM 的验证损失改善幅度等同于多用 57% 算力的 LM；GPU 显存受限时，用 COUNT 让 backbone 参数占满显存，性能优于把显存分给额外的可学习 n-gram embedding；推理时切换到领域语料的 n-gram 计数表即可无训练适配新任务。
Conclusion: 把 n-gram 计数搬到主机内存、用 unembedding 加权而非学习参数，能在同一算力下换到等效 57% 更多算力的损失水平，并让领域适配变成推理期换表。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: What Does Disagreement Mean? A Semantic Identifiability Frontier for Pairwise Preference Learning
papers.abstract_en: Pairwise comparison data are a standard supervision signal in preference learning, but disagreement in such data can reflect stable latent heterogeneity, ephemeral stochasticity, or non-binary responses hidden by a forced-choice interface. We study which of these semantic distinctions are identifiable from the feedback channel itself. We introduce a nonparametric latent semantic model with three querywise quantities: aggregate directional preference $μ_q$, persistent disagreement $τ_q$, and non-binary mass $α_q$. Under the anonymous binary channel, we prove an exact semantic fiber theorem: $μ_q$ is point-identified, whereas $(τ_q, α_q)$ vary over an explicit feasible region compatible with the same binary law. Same-annotator repeats identify $τ_q$ through a covariance identity, abstention-enabled feedback identifies $α_q$ directly, and together they point-identify the full semantic triple. We also derive finite-sample estimators, nonasymptotic concentration bounds, and semantics-aware action-recovery guarantees, and validate the theory on theorem-matched synthetic data.
papers.comment: 53 pages. Best Paper Award at the 2nd Workshop on Epistemic Intelligence in Machine Learning (EIML), ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在成对偏好学习中，分歧可能来自稳定异质性、随机噪声或被迫二选一掩盖的非二元反应，论文证明匿名二元反馈下只有聚合偏好 μ_q 可点识别，持续分歧 τ_q 与非二元质量 α_q 只落在一个显式可行域内；加入同标注者重复测量可通过协方差恒等式识别 τ_q，加入弃权选项直接识别 α_q，两者合用即可点识别完整语义三元组。
Motivation: 偏好数据中的分歧被默认当作噪声，但其语义来源（稳定异质、随机、非二元）在标准二元反馈通道下不可区分，导致从比较数据恢复动作时语义被混淆。
Method: 提出非参数潜语义模型，定义查询级量 μ_q、τ_q、α_q；证明匿名二元通道下的语义纤维定理（semantic fiber theorem），并给出同标注者重复的协方差恒等式与弃权反馈两条识别路径；推导有限样本估计量、非渐近集中界与语义感知的动作恢复保证。
Result: μ_q 点识别，(τ_q, α_q) 在与同一二元律相容的显式可行域内变动；同标注者重复通过协方差恒等式识别 τ_q，弃权反馈直接识别 α_q，二者联合点识别三元组；理论在定理匹配的合成数据 (theorem-matched synthetic data) 上验证。
Conclusion: 分歧的语义来源由反馈通道结构决定：仅靠匿名二元比较无法拆分持续分歧与非二元反应，必须引入重复测量或弃权机制才能完整识别。

summary_sections.method: 提出非参数潜语义模型，定义查询级量 μ_q、τ_q、α_q；证明匿名二元通道下的语义纤维定理（semantic fiber theorem），并给出同标注者重复的协方差恒等式与弃权反馈两条识别路径；推导有限样本估计量、非渐近集中界与语义感知的动作恢复保证。
summary_sections.result: μ_q 点识别，(τ_q, α_q) 在与同一二元律相容的显式可行域内变动；同标注者重复通过协方差恒等式识别 τ_q，弃权反馈直接识别 α_q，二者联合点识别三元组；理论在定理匹配的合成数据 (theorem-matched synthetic data) 上验证。
summary_sections.conclusion: 分歧的语义来源由反馈通道结构决定：仅靠匿名二元比较无法拆分持续分歧与非二元反应，必须引入重复测量或弃权机制才能完整识别。

papers.title: Testing Conditional Distribution Equality Using Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Conditional distribution equality testing is a core problem with applications in causal inference, model diagnostics, and transfer learning. Existing methods often lose power when the conditioning variable is high-dimensional. We propose a new test that leverages generative models to compare conditional distributions using both observed data and synthetic samples. A sample-splitting and studentization scheme is introduced to control estimation error. Under the null, the test statistic is asymptotically normal, and we establish local power against contiguous alternatives. Our theory under the null and fixed alternative requires only consistency of the learned conditional distribution, allowing for a broad class of generative models. Empirical results demonstrate accurate size control and strong power in high-dimensional settings compared to representative kernel-based conditional and joint two-sample tests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于生成模型的条件分布相等性检验：用生成模型同时学习观测数据与合成样本的条件分布，配合样本分裂与 studentization 控制估计误差。零假设下检验统计量渐近正态，并在高维条件下相对核方法类条件/联合两样本检验表现出准确的 size 控制与更强功效。
Motivation: 条件分布相等性检验是因果推断、模型诊断与迁移学习的基础问题，但现有方法在条件变量维度高时功效显著下降。
Method: 用生成模型学习条件分布，结合观测数据与合成样本构造检验统计量；引入样本分裂与 studentization 方案控制估计误差；理论仅要求所学条件分布相容，适用于广泛的生成模型类。
Result: 零假设下统计量渐近正态，并建立了对 contiguous alternatives 的局部功效；在高维设定下相对代表性的核条件检验与核联合两样本检验，经验结果展示准确的 size 控制与强功效（18 页，1 图，2 表）。
Conclusion: 只要生成模型学到的条件分布相容，条件分布相等性检验即可在高维条件下保持有效 size 与可用功效，从而绕开核方法的维度瓶颈。

papers.title: The Accuracy Well: Nonmonotone Accuracy Dynamics at Vanishing Initialization
papers.abstract_en: We study classification dynamics under small initialization and identify a pronounced non-monotone behavior of accuracy that we call the accuracy well: accuracy rises rapidly early in training, subsequently drops, and only much later recovers. We observe this phenomenon in deep linear networks, fully connected ReLU networks on MNIST, deep convolutional networks on CIFAR-10, and controlled synthetic tasks, across different losses and optimizers and in both training and test accuracy. We propose a three-stage explanation in terms of target-driven organization, a degeneracy bottleneck, and subsequent recruitment and recovery. We develop a rigorous theory of these dynamics for shallow and deep linear networks, showing in particular that high accuracy can emerge while the predictor and the change in loss remain asymptotically vanishing, before continued optimization causes accuracy to deteriorate. For a simple synthetic classification task, we prove an extreme instance in which accuracy asymptotically rises to 100%, collapses to 0, and later recovers permanently to 100%. Our results show that classification accuracy can reveal aspects of learning dynamics that are not captured by the training loss alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在小初始化下分类准确率呈现非单调的“准确率井”：先快速上升，随后下降，很久之后才恢复。该现象出现在 MNIST 全连接 ReLU 网络、CIFAR-10 深度卷积网络、深度线性网络与合成任务中，跨多种损失与优化器、训练与测试准确率均成立；作者证明在简单合成任务上准确率可渐近升到 100%、塌到 0、再永久恢复到 100%。
Motivation: 训练损失单调下降，却掩盖了准确率先升后降再恢复的阶段性结构；小初始化下分类器何时真正学会、何时退化，仅看损失无法判断。
Method: 提出三阶段解释：target-driven organization、degeneracy bottleneck、recruitment and recovery；对浅层与深度线性网络建立严格理论，刻画预测器与损失变化均渐近趋零时准确率仍可先升后降的动力学，并在简单合成分类任务上给出可证明的极端情形。
Result: 现象在深度线性网络、MNIST 全连接 ReLU、CIFAR-10 深度卷积网络与受控合成任务中被观察到，覆盖不同损失、优化器以及训练与测试准确率；理论证明高准确率可在预测器与损失变化渐近趋零时出现，随后继续优化反而使准确率恶化；合成任务上准确率渐近升至 100%、塌至 0%、再永久恢复至 100%。
Conclusion: 分类准确率揭示了训练损失单独捕捉不到的学习动力学，小初始化下的优化轨迹应按准确率而非损失来判读。

papers.title: From Training to Escalation: Forensic Analysis and Local Recreation of RL/RLHF-Induced Privilege Escalation in AI Agents (CVE-2026-65616)
papers.abstract_en: Mid-2026 reporting on autonomous AI evaluation incidents claimed that frontier large language model (LLM) agents escaped server containment through emergent coordination and cloud infrastructure attacks. This paper contextualizes those claims through forensic analysis and containerized recreation of both the Highly Persistent Internal Model (HPIM) training-case conditions and the Phase One privilege escalation targeting internal package repositories during OpenAI's ExploitGym evaluations. We recreate the configuration of the OpenAI-provided training example and reproduce the cryptographic verification bypass (CVE-2026-65616) in isolated repository servers, where misconfigured systems enabled token forgery and privilege escalation through basic HTTP requests, Python, and JavaScript. Crucially, the training-example conditions and the Phase One (and later) misconfigurations share the same exploitable patterns. Our analysis explains how Zero Trust Architecture principles neutralize this shared attack vector. Contemporary AI risks derive directly from training and deployment conditions in ambivalent learning environments lacking adequate containment measures.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 1 figure. Code and replication environments available at https://github.com/alixiacf/hpim-training-lab DOI:10.5281/zenodo.22817059 and https://github.com/alixiacf/rep-openai-artifactory DOI:10.5281/zenodo.22817059
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文对 CVE-2026-65616 做取证分析并在容器中复现：OpenAI ExploitGym 训练样例与 Phase One 阶段针对内部包仓库的权限提升共享同一可利用模式，配置错误的仓库服务器可经基本 HTTP 请求、Python 与 JavaScript 实现令牌伪造 (token forgery) 和权限提升。作者用 Zero Trust Architecture 原则消解该共享攻击向量，并主张当代 AI 风险直接源于缺乏充分隔离的含混训练与部署环境。
Motivation: 2026 年中关于自主 AI 评估事故的报道声称前沿 LLM agent 通过涌现协同与云基础设施攻击逃出服务器隔离，但这些说法缺少可复现的取证证据与机制解释。
Method: 在隔离仓库服务器上以容器化方式重建 HPIM 训练样例配置与 OpenAI ExploitGym Phase One 的权限提升条件，复现加密验证绕过 (cryptographic verification bypass)；再用 Zero Trust Architecture 原则分析该共享攻击向量的消解路径。代码与复现环境发布在 GitHub (hpim-training-lab、rep-openai-artifactory)。
Result: 在隔离仓库服务器上成功复现 CVE-2026-65616 的加密验证绕过，误配置系统允许通过基本 HTTP 请求、Python 与 JavaScript 完成令牌伪造与权限提升；分析确认训练样例条件与 Phase One（及后续）误配置共享相同的可利用模式。
Conclusion: AI agent 的权限提升风险由训练与部署条件直接决定：在缺乏充分隔离的含混学习环境中，训练样例本身就会植入可利用模式，需以 Zero Trust 架构消解该共享攻击向量。

papers.title: Infant Fingerprints: Quality Assessment & Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Infant fingerprint recognition is hindered by a combination of physiological characteristics, such as small ridge width and spacing, and acquisition challenges that include involuntary motion, skin residue, and uneven fingertip pressure. These factors undermine fingerprint quality standards originally designed for adults, which assume feature distributions that do not hold for infants. To address this gap, this paper evaluates ten fingerprint quality assessment methods on a longitudinal dataset that spans six age groups from newborns to three months, alongside a parameter tuning routine that uncovers age-specific fingerprint characteristics to recalibrate methods with domain-dependent assumptions. Both default and tuned configurations are compared through recognition experiments assessing the effectiveness of quality-guided gallery selection. Template-fusion strategies and latent fingerprint recognition technologies are further examined to identify the best possible matching rates achievable by the top-performing method. Results show that tuned parameter sets outperform default configurations for the majority of methods and age groups, indicating that targeted recalibration of existing frameworks improves gallery utility and contributes to more reliable infant fingerprint recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 婴儿指纹因脊线窄、间距小且采集时运动、残留、压力不均，成人质量标准失效；论文在覆盖新生儿到三个月六个年龄段的纵向数据集上评测十种指纹质量评估方法，并按年龄段重调参数。调参后配置在多数方法与年龄段上优于默认配置，提升了质量引导的 gallery 选择效用。
Motivation: 现有指纹质量标准按成人特征分布设计，其阈值与假设在婴儿指纹上不成立，导致质量评估与识别不可靠。
Method: 在纵向婴儿指纹数据集（六个年龄段，新生儿至三个月）上评测十种指纹质量评估方法，并加入按年龄段的参数调参流程以重校准带领域假设的方法；用识别实验比较默认与调参配置下质量引导的 gallery 选择效果，并考察模板融合 (template fusion) 与潜在指纹 (latent fingerprint) 识别技术。
Result: 调参后的参数集在多数方法与多数年龄段上优于默认配置；在表现最好的方法上，结合模板融合与潜在指纹识别技术可逼近可达到的最佳匹配率。
Conclusion: 针对年龄段重校准现有质量评估框架能提升 gallery 效用，使婴儿指纹识别更可靠。

papers.title: SwarmRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Scientific Agent Swarm
papers.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) in scientific research aims to improve agents' research capabilities through their own experimental experience. Scientific agent swarms can combine evidence and implementations from different research directions to guide their agents' subsequent experiments. However, poor experimental results can leave unclear whether to revise a hypothesis or its implementation, while overall program scores can hide components useful to other agents. To address these challenges, we introduce SwarmRSI, a framework that evolves scientific agent swarms for recursive self-improvement. We devise Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation to refine hypotheses and their implementations using experimental feedback from other agents. We also propose Complementary Swarm Recombination to reuse retained hypotheses and complementary program components across agents, allowing partial results to support new research. Recursive Swarm Evolution integrates both mechanisms into a feedback loop, using new experimental evidence to guide subsequent research. Experiments on OpenProblems, NatureBench and MLE-Bench Lite demonstrate SwarmRSI's state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. Further evaluations show that accumulated research experience improves performance on held-out tasks. Biologists also reproduce its programs for follow-up biological analyses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SwarmRSI 把科研智能体群体的递归自改进 (RSI) 拆成两个可组合机制：用其他智能体的实验反馈同时修正假设与其代码实现，并跨智能体复用保留下来的假设与互补程序组件，再由 Recursive Swarm Evolution 闭环驱动后续实验。在 OpenProblems、NatureBench、MLE-Bench Lite 上达到 SOTA，且积累的科研经验能迁移到 held-out 任务，其生成的程序被生物学家复现用于后续生物学分析。
Motivation: 科研智能体群体的自改进中，实验结果差时无法判断该改假设还是改实现，而整体程序得分会掩盖对其他智能体有用的组件，导致经验无法跨方向复用。
Method: Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation 用群体内其他智能体的实验反馈精化假设及其实现；Complementary Swarm Recombination 跨智能体复用被保留的假设与互补程序组件，让部分结果支撑新研究方向；Recursive Swarm Evolution 把两者整合进以新实验证据驱动后续研究的反馈闭环。
Result: 在 OpenProblems、NatureBench 和 MLE-Bench Lite 上取得 SOTA 表现；进一步评测显示积累的科研经验能提升 held-out 任务上的性能；生物学家复现了其生成的程序用于后续生物学分析。
Conclusion: 把假设修正与组件复用分开处理并纳入闭环演化，可以让科研智能体群体把实验经验转成跨任务的持续改进，产出的程序具备可复现的实用价值。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation 用群体内其他智能体的实验反馈精化假设及其实现；Complementary Swarm Recombination 跨智能体复用被保留的假设与互补程序组件，让部分结果支撑新研究方向；Recursive Swarm Evolution 把两者整合进以新实验证据驱动后续研究的反馈闭环。
summary_sections.result: 在 OpenProblems、NatureBench 和 MLE-Bench Lite 上取得 SOTA 表现；进一步评测显示积累的科研经验能提升 held-out 任务上的性能；生物学家复现了其生成的程序用于后续生物学分析。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把假设修正与组件复用分开处理并纳入闭环演化，可以让科研智能体群体把实验经验转成跨任务的持续改进，产出的程序具备可复现的实用价值。

papers.title: Continual Learning for Reliable In-Sequence Molecular Communication
papers.abstract_en: This paper considers reliable in-sequence molecular communication, where bio-nanomachines exchange molecule-encoded information in a specified order, and investigates a new simulation-based method to incrementally evaluate communication protocols by gradually increasing the complexity of experimental settings. The proposed method, called Affine Memory Replay (AMR), builds a continual learning (CL) model to estimate communication performance between bio-nanomachines. AMR stores past simulation samples and synthesizes additional replay samples through interpolation and extrapolation between past samples. Through incremental performance estimation tasks, it replays both past and synthetic samples to regularize model updates, helping the model adapt to new experimental settings while retaining knowledge from earlier ones. Experimental results show that AMR significantly outperforms existing CL methods in maintaining overall estimation accuracy across sequentially learned estimation tasks. It effectively balances memory stability and learning plasticity under moderate training cost.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Published in 2026 20th IIAI International Congress on Advanced Applied Informatics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Affine Memory Replay (AMR)，用插值与外推在历史仿真样本之间合成回放样本，与历史样本一起正则化模型更新，使分子通信 (molecular communication) 协议性能估计在实验设置复杂度逐步递增时既适应新设置又保留旧知识。在序列化增量估计任务上，AMR 显著优于已有持续学习方法，整体估计精度更高且训练开销适中。
Motivation: 生物纳米机器间的分子通信协议需要在实验设置复杂度逐步递增的条件下持续评估，已有持续学习方法在新任务上适应时会遗忘早期设置的估计知识。
Method: AMR 构建持续学习 (continual learning) 模型估计生物纳米机器间通信性能：存储历史仿真样本，并在历史样本之间做插值与外推合成回放样本，回放历史与合成样本来正则化模型更新，从而在增量估计任务中平衡记忆稳定性与学习可塑性。
Result: 在增量性能估计任务序列上，AMR 在维持跨任务的整体估计精度上显著优于已有持续学习方法，同时保持适中的训练开销；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 通过插值/外推合成回放样本，可以在分子通信协议的增量评估中同时保住旧设置的估计精度与对新设置的适应能力，且不显著抬高训练成本。

papers.title: Analyzing performance of Retrieval Augmented Generation models for Question Answering Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models have become almost a cornerstone of open-domain question answering tasks; in which the quality of answers generated in the process, greatly relies on the effectiveness of retrieval mechanisms. In the realm of LLM, the last two years have seen tremendous progress in RAG architectures, with many models reporting to have improved performance through various design innovations. The cultural question and answering systems of South Asia, in particular, present a specific challenge since the region is home to the vast number of languages and traditions, which are closely interrelated. Along with these deeply intertwined historical narratives increase the need for culturally grounded and context-aware interpretation. Despite major architectural advances in LLMs, claiming significant improvements, challenges remain when answering these region specific questions in native languages. In this study, we aim to extract high-performing factors to guide the development of optimized hybrid RAG systems. We further explore whether the integration of RAG changes performance differently for culturally grounded and non-cultural questions in a South Asian multilingual setup, and whether RAG produces a higher overall percentage of correct answers than contexted answering. We also examine how LLM performance changes when RAG methods are integrated into the question-answering pipeline in comparison with non-contexted and contexted answering and, evaluate whether the introduction of RAG benefits popular or non-popular culturally grounded questions more. Not only does our work evaluate the current methods but also carves a path for future designs of more accurate and efficient question-answering pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该研究在南亚多语言文化问答设定下比较 RAG、有上下文回答与无上下文回答三种管线，考察 RAG 对文化类与非文化类问题的正确率影响是否不同，以及对热门与非热门文化问题的收益差异，目标是提炼高性能因子以指导混合 RAG 系统设计。
Motivation: 南亚地区语言与传统众多且历史叙事交织，LLM 在原生语言回答区域特定问题时表现仍不理想，而现有 RAG 架构创新多在通用设定下宣称提升，缺少针对该文化问答场景的因子对比。
Method: 在南亚多语言设定下把 RAG 接入问答管线，与无上下文 (non-contexted) 和有上下文 (contexted) 回答对照，按文化类与非文化类问题、热门与非热门文化问题分组比较正确率，并从中提取高性能因子以指导优化混合 RAG 系统。
Result: 研究检验 RAG 是否比有上下文回答产生更高总体正确率，以及 RAG 引入对文化类与非文化类问题、热门与非热门文化问题的收益是否不同；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: RAG 对文化与非文化问题的影响可能不同，需按问题类型与热门度分组评估，其产出的高性能因子用于指导更准确高效的问答管线设计。

papers.title: OrionMoE-v1.0: A Mixture-of-Experts Foundation Model for Tabular In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models enable in-context learning by predicting unseen observations from a labeled support table without task-specific parameter updates. Despite recent advances, most existing approaches rely on dense architectures that apply the same transformations across features and datasets. We introduce OrionMoE-Small, a compact tabular foundation model that combines distribution-aware representations with dataset-conditioned sparse mixture-of-experts computation. Built on a dual-axis Transformer architecture, OrionMoE-Small selectively activates experts along the feature axis, with routing decisions informed by both individual feature representations and the broader dataset context. This design enables adaptive allocation of computation across heterogeneous tabular problems while retaining a shared computational pathway across tasks. OrionMoE-Small is pretrained entirely on synthetic classification tasks generated from a structured causal prior and performs downstream prediction without gradient-based adaptation. Experiments across multiple tabular benchmarks demonstrate competitive performance against substantially larger foundation models, with particularly strong results on small-context and high-dimensional datasets. Further analysis reveals favorable relative performance under class imbalance and highlights the importance of feature composition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OrionMoE-Small 是一个表格数据 in-context learning 基础模型，用双轴 Transformer 沿特征轴做数据集条件化的稀疏 MoE 路由，路由同时看单个特征表示与整体数据集上下文。模型完全在由结构化因果先验生成的合成分类任务上预训练，下游预测无需梯度更新；在多个表格基准上与远大于它的基础模型竞争相当，小上下文与高维数据集上尤其强，类别不平衡下相对表现也更有利。
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型多用稠密架构，对所有特征和数据集施加同一套变换，无法按异构表格问题自适应分配计算。
Method: OrionMoE-Small 采用双轴 Transformer 架构，沿特征轴选择性激活专家，路由决策同时依据单个特征表示与更广的数据集上下文；完全在由结构化因果先验生成的合成分类任务上预训练，下游预测不做基于梯度的适配。
Result: 在多个表格基准上与体量大得多的基础模型竞争相当，在小上下文与高维数据集上结果尤其强；进一步分析显示在类别不平衡条件下相对表现有利，并凸显特征构成 (feature composition) 的重要性。
Conclusion: 数据集条件化的稀疏专家路由加合成因果先验预训练，可以在不更新参数的前提下让紧凑表格基础模型在异构表格任务上匹配大模型，且优势集中在小上下文、高维与类别不平衡场景。

papers.title: From Unreliable to Usable: Decomposing Failure Modes and Confidence Signals in LLM Entity Extraction - Evidence from Cyber Threat Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Audits of large language model (LLM) extraction from full-length documents report severe unreliability, leaving two questions open: what the failures actually consist of, and whether confidence signals can turn unreliable output into usable output. We run a preregistered, fully frozen evaluation of two new-generation low-cost LLMs (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash) with a flagship-tier control (GPT-6.1-Sol) on a public corpus of 354 incident campaigns (315 unique reports, 630 model-report evaluations), scoring extraction quality against gold, confidence calibration, and robustness to single-sentence perturbations. Three findings emerge. (1) Unreliability persists across tiers: micro precision is 0.03-0.34 and verbalized calibration error (ECE) 0.53-0.94 across both splits; the gap does not close at the flagship tier. (2) The dominant failure is not hallucination: a full mention census plus a three-tier annotation of 360 sampled candidates (two independent LLM annotators from vendors outside the evaluated set, Cohen's kappa = 0.79 on the preregistered acceptance line, fully disclosed) back-projects to 65.6% background mentions and 19.9% gold-scope gaps, with only 1.2% unsupported candidates. (3) Confidence ranks but does not verify: zero-cost self-consistency-frequency tiering passes a preregistered top-30% precision-gain bar in all six test-split model-type cells (4/6 on train), the zero-cost text-frequency x SC frequency combination wins 3, ties 2, loses 1 across cells, yet relation-level counterfactuals on all 45 targets show that a single misattribution sentence flips high-confidence judgments in 95.6-100% of cases, and even a background sentence explicitly marked as unrelated still binds a fake vulnerability in up to 26.7% of them. We conclude with a deployment boundary: confidence tiering may set review priorities, never truth.
papers.comment: 13 pages: 7-page main text within the 8-page limit, plus Limitations, references, and appendices A-J. Code, protocol, and frozen evaluation data will be made public
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 LLM 从全文抽取网络威胁情报实体做预注册冻结评测，发现不可靠性跨模型层级持续存在：micro precision 仅 0.03–0.34、ECE 0.53–0.94，旗舰级也未缩小差距。主要失败不是幻觉（unsupported 候选仅 1.2%），而是背景提及（65.6%）与 gold 覆盖缺口（19.9%）；自一致性频率分层能提升 top-30% 精度，但单句反事实可在 95.6–100% 情形下翻转高置信判断，故置信分层只能排审核优先级、不能当真值。
Motivation: 全文级 LLM 抽取被审计为严重不可靠，但失败究竟由什么构成、置信信号能否把不可靠输出变成可用输出，两个问题都悬而未决。
Method: 预注册且完全冻结的评测：在 354 个事件活动（315 份独立报告、630 次模型-报告评测）公开语料上测 DeepSeek-V4-Flash、GLM-5.3-Flash 两款低成本新一代模型，并以 GPT-6.1-Sol 作旗舰级对照；对 gold 计分抽取质量、置信校准与单句扰动鲁棒性；另做全量提及普查与对 360 个抽样候选的三层标注（两名评测集外厂商的独立 LLM 标注者，预注册接受线上 Cohen's kappa = 0.79）。
Result: micro precision 0.03–0.34、verbalized ECE 0.53–0.94，旗舰级差距未闭合；提及普查回投为 65.6% 背景提及、19.9% gold 范围缺口、仅 1.2% 无支撑候选；零成本自一致性频率分层在全部 6 个测试划分模型类型格上通过预注册 top-30% 精度增益门槛（训练划分 4/6），文本频率×SC 频率组合在各格 3 胜 2 平 1 负；对全部 45 个目标的关系级反事实显示单句误归属在 95.6–100% 情形翻转高置信判断，明确标为无关的背景句仍会在至多 26.7% 情形绑定假漏洞。
Conclusion: 作者给出部署边界：置信分层可以设定审核优先级，绝不能当作真值判定。

papers.title: Tracking a Small Set of Experts in Online Convex Optimization
papers.abstract_en: For the fundamental problem of prediction from expert advice, Freund asked whether one could compete with a comparator that switches $k$ times among only $m$ experts. For a discrete set of experts, this problem was resolved by Bousquet and Warmuth (2020), who gave an efficient algorithm with optimal regret matching the information-theoretic limit. We study the analogous problem in online convex optimization, where the action space is continuous. An inefficient algorithm can be derived by discretizing the action space and applying the Bousquet--Warmuth algorithm, giving regret of $\widetilde{O}(md+k)$, while the best known efficient algorithm for this problem has regret $\widetilde{O}(dk)$. We show that this computational inefficiency is inherent, establishing a separation between the information-theoretic and polynomial-time regret achievable for this problem. Specifically, under the hypergraphic planted-clique conjecture, we show that for every polynomial-time algorithm there exist instances for which it incurs at least $(k\sqrt d)^{1-o(1)}$ regret.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线凸优化中与「只在 m 个专家间切换 k 次」的 comparator 竞争，离散情形已被 Bousquet–Warmuth (2020) 用最优遗憾的高效算法解决，连续动作空间下把动作离散化再套用该算法可得 Õ(md+k) 遗憾但低效。本文证明这种低效是固有的：在 hypergraphic planted-clique 猜想下，任何多项式时间算法都存在实例使其遗憾至少为 (k√d)^{1-o(1)}，从而建立信息论最优与多项式时间可达遗憾之间的分离。
Motivation: Freund 提出的专家切换 comparator 问题在离散专家集上已由 Bousquet–Warmuth (2020) 给出匹配信息论下界的高效算法，但连续动作空间的在线凸优化版本尚无高效解法：已知高效算法遗憾为 Õ(dk)，而离散化路线虽达 Õ(md+k) 却不高效。需要判定这一差距是算法缺陷还是计算复杂性本身的障碍。
Method: 研究对象是在线凸优化 (OCO) 中与「在 m 个专家间切换 k 次」的 comparator 竞争的问题；先由离散化动作空间并套用 Bousquet–Warmuth 算法得到 Õ(md+k) 的低效上界，再在 hypergraphic planted-clique 猜想下做复杂性下界证明，刻画多项式时间算法的遗憾下界。
Result: 离散化路线给出 Õ(md+k) 遗憾的低效算法；已知最佳高效算法遗憾为 Õ(dk)；在 hypergraphic planted-clique 猜想下，对任意多项式时间算法都存在实例使其遗憾至少为 (k√d)^{1-o(1)}。
Conclusion: 连续动作空间下，该切换 comparator 问题的信息论最优遗憾与多项式时间可达遗憾之间存在固有分离，Õ(md+k) 与 Õ(dk) 之间的差距无法靠更聪明的高效算法消除。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: One Size Does Not Fit All: Curvature-Aware Adaptive Perturbation for SAM
papers.abstract_en: Poor generalisation in deep neural networks is frequently associated with convergence to sharp minima. Sharpness-Aware Minimisation (SAM) improves generalisation of deep neural networks by minimising a combination of the training loss and the local sharpness of the loss landscape, biasing convergence towards flat minima. However, SAM relies on a fixed perturbation radius $ρ$ that ignores local curvature, leading to inefficient behaviour: the perturbation may be too small to escape poor basins defined by sharp local minima, or too large to allow convergence to solutions with good loss-sharpness tradeoff. We reinterpret $ρ$ as the intensity of the perturbation signal and propose Curvature-Aware Adaptive Perturbation for SAM (CAP-SAM), a geometry-aware method that modulates the perturbation radius based on a sharpness ratio, enabling a more effective search for robust minima on the loss landscape. We prove that CAP-SAM preserves the same convergence rate as standard SAM in non-convex stochastic settings. Extensive experiments indicate that our approach consistently outperforms SAM and its most prominent variants across diverse network architectures on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAP-SAM 把 SAM 的固定扰动半径 ρ 重解释为扰动信号强度，按 sharpness ratio（锐度比）随局部曲率自适应调制半径，使扰动既不至于小到逃不出尖锐局部极小的坏盆地，也不至于大到破坏损失-锐度权衡。理论上在非凸随机设定下保持与标准 SAM 相同的收敛速率；在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 与 ImageNet 上跨多种网络架构一致优于 SAM 及其主要变体。
Motivation: SAM 用固定 ρ 做扰动，忽略局部曲率：ρ 偏小则逃不出尖锐极小定义的坏盆地，偏小或偏大都难以收敛到损失-锐度权衡良好的解，导致泛化改进不稳定。
Method: 提出 Curvature-Aware Adaptive Perturbation for SAM (CAP-SAM)：把 ρ 视作扰动信号强度，用一个 sharpness ratio 按局部曲率调制扰动半径，属于几何感知 (geometry-aware) 的 SAM 变体；并给出非凸随机设定下的收敛性证明。
Result: 证明 CAP-SAM 在非凸随机设定下保持与标准 SAM 相同的收敛速率；在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 上、跨多种网络架构的实验中一致 (consistently) 优于 SAM 及其最知名的变体。
Conclusion: 固定扰动半径是 SAM 的真实瓶颈，按局部曲率自适应调制 ρ 可以在不牺牲收敛速率的前提下稳定提升深度网络泛化。

papers.title: When Does Momentum Help in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards?
papers.abstract_en: Momentum is a classical tool for accelerating convex optimization and a standard component of modern large language model training. Yet recent empirical work has questioned the usefulness of first-moment momentum in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). We study this question through a bandit formulation of RLVR with bias-corrected exponential moving average (EMA) momentum, where the EMA coefficient $β$ controls how quickly the weights on past gradients decay. When policy gradients are evaluated exactly, we prove that increasing $β$ within a range that prevents overshoot strictly accelerates optimization. When gradients are estimated from sampled responses, a positive expected gain can be obscured by sampling fluctuations. We show that as the learning rate $η$ decreases, the expected gain with fixed $β$ vanishes faster than these fluctuations, whereas increasing $β$ to keep $η/(1-β)$ within the safe regime preserves a nonvanishing gain that eventually dominates them. Bandit simulations quantitatively validate these predictions. RLVR experiments on Qwen3-4B-Base using SGD with EMA and AdamW support our principle of choosing larger coefficients in practical LLM post-training. On Qwen2.5-32B with AdamW, simply increasing $β_1$ improves mean validation accuracy by nearly $2$ percentage points over the conventional choice, demonstrating the principle's effectiveness at a larger model scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 RLVR 简化为 bandit 形式并引入偏差校正的 EMA 动量，证明在避免过冲的 β 区间内增大 β 严格加速精确梯度优化；当梯度由采样响应估计时，固定 β 下学习率 η 减小会使期望增益比采样波动更快消失，而按 η/(1-β) 保持在安全域内同步增大 β 则保住不消失且最终压过波动的增益。Qwen2.5-32B 上仅增大 β_1 就把平均验证准确率提高近 2 个百分点。
Motivation: 近期实证工作质疑一阶动量在 RLVR 中是否有用，但缺少在采样噪声下何时该用、该用多大 β 的判定条件。
Method: 将 RLVR 建模为带偏差校正 EMA 动量的 bandit 问题，EMA 系数 β 控制历史梯度权重衰减速度；分别分析精确策略梯度与采样估计梯度两种情形，给出 η 与 β 的安全域标度 η/(1-β)，再用 bandit 仿真验证预测，并在 Qwen3-4B-Base 上以 SGD+EMA 与 AdamW 做 RLVR 实验。
Result: 精确梯度下，在防止过冲的 β 区间内增大 β 严格加速优化；采样梯度下固定 β 时 η 减小使期望增益比波动更快消失，而保持 η/(1-β) 在安全域内增大 β 使增益不消失并最终主导波动，bandit 仿真定量验证了这些预测。Qwen3-4B-Base 上 SGD+EMA 与 AdamW 实验支持该原则；Qwen2.5-32B 上仅增大 β_1 使平均验证准确率比常规取值提高近 2 个百分点。
Conclusion: RLVR 后训练中应选择更大的动量系数，前提是让 η/(1-β) 保持在安全域内，这样采样噪声下仍能保住动量带来的优化增益。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Hybrid supervised instance segmentation by learning label noise suppression
papers.abstract_en: To reach top accuracy, current fully supervised instance segmentation methods severely rely on large-scale pixel-wise labeled datasets. They are usually expensive and time-consuming to obtain. Though weakly or semi-supervised methods utilize cheap bounding box labeled, image-level labeled or unlabeled samples to save the labeling cost, their performance is largely sacrificed. To save labeling cost without losing much performance, in this paper, we present a pipeline that can utilize economical bounding box labels and accurate pixel-wise labels in a hybrid way. Specifically, we design two ancillary models to learn label noise suppression and obtain accurate pseudo pixel-wise labels from bounding box labels for training. One is designed to suppress mislabeling between foreground and background, and the other is designed to suppress noise from mislabeling of instances. Moreover, we exploit category-aware spatial attention module, category constraint module, instance constraint module, and self-learning training approach to improve the accuracy of pseudo labels. Experiments on the PASCAL VOC 2012 and the Cityscapes datasets show that our method can achieve competitive performance with much less labeling cost.
papers.journal_ref: Neurocomputing 496 (2022) 131-146
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种混合监督实例分割流程：用两个辅助模型分别抑制前景/背景误标与实例间误标，从廉价边界框标签生成准确的伪像素标签，再配合类别感知空间注意力、类别约束、实例约束与自学习训练提升伪标签精度。在 PASCAL VOC 2012 与 Cityscapes 上以远低的标注成本取得竞争性性能。
Motivation: 全监督实例分割依赖大规模像素级标注，成本高、耗时长；弱监督或半监督方法虽省标注成本，但性能大幅下降。目标是在不明显损失性能的前提下降低标注开销。
Method: 设计两个辅助模型学习标签噪声抑制：一个抑制前景与背景之间的误标，另一个抑制实例误标带来的噪声，由此从边界框标签得到准确的伪像素标签用于训练；同时引入类别感知空间注意力模块 (category-aware spatial attention)、类别约束模块、实例约束模块与自学习 (self-learning) 训练方式提升伪标签精度。
Result: 在 PASCAL VOC 2012 与 Cityscapes 两个数据集上的实验显示，该方法以远低于像素级标注的成本达到竞争性 (competitive) 的实例分割性能。
Conclusion: 边界框标签经噪声抑制与约束模块转成伪像素标签后，可以在大幅节省标注成本的同时保住接近全监督的实例分割精度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Hyperspherical Contrastive Representations Unlock Planning and Exploration
papers.abstract_en: We develop a self-supervised reinforcement learning algorithm that learns to build towers of up to eight cubes from scratch, without prior data, rewards, demonstrations, or pretrained models. Our method, Contrastive Planning via Spherical Linear Interpolation (C-Slerp), uses contrastive representations as reusable building blocks and repeatedly composes them to infer a sequence of intermediate waypoints. Under our hyperspherical parameterization, the learned representations allow intermediate waypoints to be inferred in closed form through spherical linear interpolation, without training a separate high-level policy or performing graph search. Importantly, the representation geometry also tells us how to adjust the number of waypoints based on the difficulty of each goal-reaching problem. Experiments show that our method succeeds on long-horizon navigation and robotic manipulation tasks, including settings where strong baselines fail to achieve a single success. Ablations further show that using a fixed number of waypoints substantially degrades performance, highlighting the importance of adapting the plan to task difficulty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出自监督强化学习算法 C-Slerp：在超球面 (hyperspherical) 参数化下用对比表征作为可复用单元，中间路点 (waypoint) 可由球面线性插值 (spherical linear interpolation) 闭式求出，无需单独训练高层策略或做图搜索。该几何还给出按目标难度调整路点数量的规则；固定路点数会明显降低性能。
Motivation: 长时程目标到达任务中，从零学习规划需要高层策略或图搜索等额外结构，且路点数量通常固定，无法随任务难度伸缩。
Method: C-Slerp 用对比表征作为可复用构建块，在超球面参数化下通过球面线性插值闭式推断中间路点序列，并依据表征几何自适应决定路点数量；训练为自监督 RL，不使用先验数据、奖励、示范或预训练模型。
Result: 在长时程导航与机器人操作任务上成功，包括搭起最多八个立方体的塔；在部分设置中强基线一次成功都拿不到。消融显示固定路点数会显著劣化性能。
Conclusion: 把对比表征放到超球面上，规划可退化为闭式插值且路点数应随任务难度自适应，而不必训练高层策略或做图搜索。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Improved Precipitation Variability in the Community Atmosphere Model through Implementation of a Neural-Network Deep Convection Scheme
papers.abstract_en: Conventional deep convection schemes remain a primary source of uncertainty in global climate models, yet replacing them with data-driven alternatives while maintaining physical consistency and numerical stability is an open challenge. We present a hybrid configuration of the Community Atmosphere Model version 6 (CAM6), in which a fully connected deep neural network replaces the Zhang-McFarlane deep convection scheme (ZM), while radiation, turbulence, and other cloud processes are left unchanged. The network is trained on output from a storm-resolving global model - the global System for Atmospheric Modeling (gSAM) - using a coarse-graining approach to derive subgrid-scale convective fluxes and tendencies. This data-driven parameterization is ported to CAM6 and found to run stably for more than a decade while conserving energy and moisture. It produces a broadly realistic climatology without retuning the remaining parameterizations. Relative to the default Zhang-McFarlane scheme, the neural network parameterization substantially improves some long-standing model deficiencies. In particular, the biases in light precipitation and extreme precipitation are markedly reduced, and the diurnal cycle of tropical land precipitation shifts from a spurious midday peak over many regions to the observed late-afternoon peak. These results support targeted ML-based convection schemes as a viable path toward reducing systematic model errors in next-generation climate models.

papers.title: Posterior Frequencies and the Cost of Not Fitting: A Correction to a Memorization Lower Bound
papers.abstract_en: Feldman's memorization lower bound assigns a frequency coefficient based on how often a point appears in the training sample. We give an exact three-point counterexample to its conditional and averaged forms, using independent fair labels and a permutation-equivariant learner. A sequence of sampling priors makes the ratio of the proposed penalty to actual excess risk grow exponentially, ruling out a universal positive constant-factor repair. The priors vary with sample size, the offending profiles become rare, and both quantities vanish. Retaining the original model, we obtain an exact replacement using full-sample posterior probabilities. Under exchangeability, these depend on multiplicity and the complete frequency profile. We characterize the largest multiplicity-only coefficients valid for unrestricted learners. The original coefficient has the posterior-mean form of Good's exact frequency formula and is an occupancy-weighted average of the corrected coefficients.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Feldman 记忆化下界的频率系数按点在训练样本中出现次数定义，本文给出一个精确的三点反例（独立均匀标签 + 置换等变学习器），同时推翻其条件形式与平均形式。一族随样本量变化的采样先验使“所提惩罚 / 实际超额风险”之比指数增长，排除任何普适正常数倍修复；保留原模型后，用全样本后验概率给出精确替代系数，原系数恰为 Good 精确频率公式的后验均值形式。
Motivation: Feldman 记忆化下界用出现频率给惩罚项定权，但该系数是否与真实超额风险成正常数倍关系并不清楚；若不成立，下界的常数因子修补方案就无从谈起。
Method: 构造独立均匀标签与置换等变 (permutation-equivariant) 学习器的三点精确反例，攻击系数的条件形式与平均形式；再在保留原模型的前提下，改用全样本后验概率定义替代系数，并在可交换性 (exchangeability) 下刻画仅依赖重数 (multiplicity) 的最大合法系数集合。
Result: 一族随样本量变化的采样先验使惩罚与实际超额风险之比指数增长，同时问题剖面变稀有、两个量都趋于零，从而排除普适正常数倍修复；原系数被证明等于 Good 精确频率公式的后验均值形式，且是修正后系数的占用 (occupancy) 加权平均。
Conclusion: Feldman 的频率系数不能用任何普适正常数因子修好，正确权重应由全样本后验概率给出；在可交换性下仅凭重数能合法定出的系数存在上界，而原系数只是修正系数的一个加权平均。

papers.title: Training Language Models to Fail Gracefully
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning makes language models better at solving tasks, but the same mechanism also rewards guessing. When success is the only way to earn reward, opting for a safe fallback is always worse than a long-shot attempt. When a wrong action can corrupt a database or ship broken code, that incentive can be costly. Therefore, we propose training models to fail gracefully: to preserve successful behavior whenever possible while learning to execute a safe fallback policy when acting would be unreliable. However, naively using policy gradients with intermediate reward for fallback behavior is brittle due to unfavorable optimization dynamics. We address this challenge with GracefulRL, which reshapes the optimization landscape to promote graceful failure. Importantly, this behavior emerges directly from outcome-level reward signals, without annotations specifying when to fall back or additional inference-time machinery such as a verifier. Across a range of tasks and scales, we train models that largely preserve their task-solving capability while selectively falling back when acting would be unreliable. More broadly, our results show that reinforcement learning can not only incentivize models to succeed, but also to reason about the limits of their capabilities and change course when they determine that success is out of reach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GracefulRL 用结果级奖励重塑策略梯度的优化地形，让语言模型在行动不可靠时主动选择安全回退，而不是硬猜。训练后模型基本保住原有解题能力，同时在成功率不足时选择回退，且不依赖回退时机标注或推理端 verifier。
Motivation: RL 只奖励成功时，安全回退永远不如长押一搏，模型会倾向瞎猜；而错误动作可能污染数据库或发布坏代码，这种激励代价很高。直接用带中间奖励的 policy gradient 训练回退行为又因优化动力学不利而脆弱。
Method: 提出 GracefulRL，重塑优化地形以促进 graceful failure；行为完全从 outcome-level reward 信号中涌现，不需要标注何时回退，也不加推理时的 verifier 等额外机制。
Result: 在一系列任务与规模上，训练出的模型基本保留原有解题能力，并在行动不可靠时选择性回退；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 强化学习不仅能激励模型成功，还能让模型推理自身能力边界、在判断成功无望时改变策略。

papers.title: HRTF Upsampling and Personalization via Neural Operators
papers.abstract_en: Head-related transfer function (HRTF) spatial upsampling from sparse measurements is a fundamental challenge in personalized binaural audio. We formulate HRTF upsampling as an operator learning problem and introduce SPARO, a neural operator that maps sparse measurements at a set of spatial directions to the HRTF field, a continuous representation that can be queried at arbitrary positions. SPARO projects the measurements onto a learned set of spherical latent modes, processes the latent modes with Transformer blocks, and decodes the resulting representations at query directions. On SONICOM, using the LAP24 measurement configuration, SPARO attains the best log-spectral distortion (LSD) and interaural level difference (ILD) error at every sparsity level from 3 to 100 measurements (18% lower LSD and 43% lower ILD error than the strongest baseline at 100 measurements) while remaining competitive in interaural time difference (ITD) error. It reconstructs a dense HRTF 15 to 373 times faster than the leading neural-field method RANF. We further validate the approach on HUTUBS, demonstrating its effectiveness across HRTF datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPARO 把 HRTF 稀疏测量上采样写成算子学习问题：将测量投影到学习得到的球面隐模态，经 Transformer 块处理后在任意查询方向解码出连续 HRTF 场。在 SONICOM 的 LAP24 配置下，3 到 100 个测量的每个稀疏度都取得最优 LSD 与 ILD 误差，100 测量时比最强基线 LSD 低 18%、ILD 误差低 43%，稠密重建比 RANF 快 15 到 373 倍。
Motivation: 个性化双耳音频需要从少量空间方向的 HRTF 测量恢复完整 HRTF 场，稀疏测量下的空间上采样是基础难题，且现有神经场方法重建慢。
Method: SPARO 将稀疏方向测量投影到一组学习得到的球面隐模态 (spherical latent modes)，用 Transformer 块处理隐模态，再在查询方向解码出可任意查询的连续 HRTF 场；在 SONICOM 的 LAP24 测量配置上训练与测试，并在 HUTUBS 上做跨数据集验证。
Result: 在 SONICOM/LAP24 上，稀疏度从 3 到 100 个测量的每一档，SPARO 的 log-spectral distortion (LSD) 与 interaural level difference (ILD) 误差均为最佳，ITD 误差保持竞争力；100 测量时比最强基线 LSD 低 18%、ILD 误差低 43%；稠密 HRTF 重建比领先神经场方法 RANF 快 15 到 373 倍；在 HUTUBS 上同样验证有效。
Conclusion: 把 HRTF 上采样当作算子学习并用球面隐模态加 Transformer 编解码，可在极稀疏测量下同时拿到更好的谱与双耳线索精度和大幅更快的重建，且跨 HRTF 数据集成立。

papers.title: Cortex: Consolidating Context into Parametric Memory
papers.abstract_en: Context can improve large language model performance, but these gains may be lost after context removal. Inspired by biological systems consolidation, we formulate Memory Consolidation (MC) as internalizing these gains while preserving non-target capabilities, connecting context-specified editing, skill learning, and behavioral steering under a common objective. We introduce a five-task-family testbed measuring consolidation and retention under single, batch, and sequential updates. We propose Cortex, which generates prospective queries to anticipate uses of context and distills context-conditioned outputs into mergeable low-rank or structural feed-forward network updates. Across 4B--120B dense and mixture-of-experts backbones, including both text-only and multimodal models, Cortex lies on the empirical consolidation--retention Pareto frontier in most evaluated settings. After 50 sequential factual edits on a 14B model, Cortex-Structural recovers 88.9% of the context-induced gain while retaining 99.8% of original non-target performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Cortex 把上下文带来的增益蒸馏进模型参数：先生成前瞻性查询 (prospective queries) 预判上下文的未来用途，再把上下文条件下的输出蒸馏为可合并的低秩或结构性前馈网络更新。在 4B–120B 稠密与 MoE 主干（含多模态）上，Cortex 在多数评估设置中位于 consolidation–retention Pareto 前沿；14B 模型连续 50 次事实编辑后，Cortex-Structural 恢复 88.9% 的上下文增益，同时保留 99.8% 的原始非目标任务性能。
Motivation: 上下文提示带来的性能增益在上下文被移除后即丢失，而编辑、技能学习与行为引导各自为政，缺少统一目标来衡量增益内化与非目标能力保留的权衡。
Method: 提出 Memory Consolidation (MC) 统一目标，构建含五类任务族的测试台，覆盖单次、批量与连续更新三种情形；Cortex 用前瞻性查询预判上下文用途，将上下文条件输出蒸馏为可合并的低秩 (low-rank) 或结构性前馈网络更新。
Result: 在 4B–120B 稠密与 MoE 主干、文本与多模态模型上，Cortex 在多数评估设置中处于 consolidation–retention Pareto 前沿；14B 模型连续 50 次事实编辑后，Cortex-Structural 恢复 88.9% 的上下文增益，保留 99.8% 的原始非目标任务性能。
Conclusion: 把上下文增益蒸馏进参数化记忆可以在几乎不损失非目标能力的前提下跨上下文移除保留收益，且结构性更新在连续编辑下表现最好。

papers.title: Where Should the Gaussians Go? Reusable Label-Aware Allocation for Budget-Constrained Gaussian Splatting of Cinematic CT
papers.abstract_en: Anatomical labels help 3D Gaussian splatting preserve vessels in cinematic renderings of CT, but the representation is still found by optimising each patient's scene, where densification decides where Gaussians go, while real-time displays cap their number. We address one part of this process: deciding where a fixed budget of B Gaussians should be placed. We propose a reusable, labelaware allocation front end that maps a patient's CT, labels and transfer function to a density over 2mm cells and draws exactly B positions from it without per-patient optimisation; the other Gaussian attributes are still fitted per patient. The front end is learned once from per-patient optimised scenes and implemented as a population-trained neural prior and an interpretable seven-parameter visibility-aware closed form (VACF). With identical attribute fitting on 20 held-out patients at 10K-100K Gaussians, both raise vessel-masked PSNR over uniform allocation by 4.5-7.1dB and over pruning a dense voxel-aligned model by 1.6-3.3dB. The neural prior does not differ significantly from per-patient optimised allocation at any budget, and VACF is within 0.6dB of it on vessels; on 19 external patients the neural prior again matches it on vessels and VACF is within 0.7dB. As an initialisation for position optimisation, VACF allocation beats per-patient densification on vessels at 10K Gaussians and, at 25K, reaches a higher vessel PSNR after 118s of optimisation than densification after 248s. Under altered rendering presets, VACF transfers to new colours and lighting but not to a label-free transfer function, whereas the neural prior shows the opposite pattern.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在预算受限的 CT 电影级 Gaussian Splatting 中，提出可复用的 label-aware 高斯位置分配前端：由逐患者优化场景一次性学出 population-trained neural prior 与七参数 visibility-aware closed form (VACF)，按 2mm 体素密度直接抽取恰好 B 个位置而无需逐患者优化。在 20 名留出患者、10K–100K 高斯下，vessel-masked PSNR 比均匀分配高 4.5–7.1dB、比剪枝稠密体素对齐模型高 1.6–3.3dB；VACF 作位置优化初始化时在 25K 高斯用 118s 达到的 vessel PSNR 高于 densification 用 248s 的结果。
Motivation: CT 电影级渲染中高斯数量被实时显示上限卡死，而 densification 仍需逐患者优化，无法复用；需要在固定预算 B 下决定高斯放哪里，同时保住血管等解剖标签。
Method: label-aware 分配前端把患者 CT、标签与 transfer function 映射到 2mm 体素上的密度并从中精确抽取 B 个位置，其余高斯属性仍逐患者拟合；前端由逐患者优化场景训练一次，实现为 population-trained neural prior 与七参数可解释 visibility-aware closed form (VACF)。
Result: 在 20 名留出患者、10K–100K 高斯、属性拟合相同的条件下，两种前端的 vessel-masked PSNR 比均匀分配高 4.5–7.1dB、比剪枝稠密体素对齐模型高 1.6–3.3dB；neural prior 在各预算下与逐患者优化分配无显著差异，VACF 在血管上差距 ≤0.6dB；19 名外部患者上 neural prior 仍持平、VACF 差距 ≤0.7dB。作位置优化初始化时，VACF 在 10K 高斯的血管指标胜过逐患者 densification，25K 下优化 118s 的 vessel PSNR 高于 densification 优化 248s 的结果。改变渲染预设后 VACF 能迁移到新配色与光照但不能迁移到无标签 transfer function，neural prior 则呈相反模式。
Conclusion: 高斯位置分配可以作为可复用前端从群体数据学得而不牺牲血管保真，且比逐患者 densification 更省优化时间；但迁移能力按方法分化，VACF 依赖标签与可见性、neural prior 依赖无标签 transfer function，选型需对照渲染预设。
