papers.title: From Human Corrections to Learned Segmentations: A Critical Mathematical Review of Information, Learning, and Human Effort
papers.abstract_en: When does a human correction become useful learning, and what establishes better segmentation at matched human effort? This critical narrative review follows feedback through its selection, learner update, and evaluation. It compares active learning, machine teaching, interactive segmentation, and sequential predictive evaluation using a common mathematical account of target information, predictive error, response predictability, and human work. An exact Bayesian update converts evaluation-label information into expected log-loss improvement; an excess-risk decomposition explains what an approximate learner can lose. Conditional information decompositions separate the roles of selected locations, labels, and displayed context. Empirical comparisons show why response protocols, update mechanisms, and effort denominators matter, distinguishing current-mask refinement from reusable learning and simulated interaction from human evidence. We identify what logs can reveal, what requires independent evaluation, and what remains model-dependent. The resulting research priorities are to test what selection reveals, whether using it improves assimilation, and whether the resulting interaction policy benefits segmentation at matched effort. These are distinct claims: predicting a teacher's responses need not identify human intentions or establish better learning. No new acquisition algorithm or empirical superiority is claimed.
papers.comment: 40 pages, literature-selection and search record included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于人工修正如何转化为可复用学习的批判性综述，用统一数学框架（目标信息、预测误差、响应可预测性、人力工作）比较 active learning、machine teaching、interactive segmentation 与 sequential predictive evaluation。核心论断是：预测教师响应不等于识别人类意图，也不等于在同等人力下建立更好的分割；作者明确不主张新采集算法或经验优越性。
Motivation: 人工修正何时构成有效学习、在匹配人力下何以确立更好的分割，缺少统一的数学口径；现有工作混淆了当前掩膜精修与可复用学习、模拟交互与真人证据。
Method: 以精确贝叶斯更新把评估标签信息转化为期望 log-loss 改进，用 excess-risk 分解解释近似学习者的损失，并用条件信息分解区分被选位置、标签与显示上下文各自的作用；按选择、学习者更新、评估三段追踪反馈回路。
Result: 综述给出的实证比较结论是响应协议、更新机制与人力分母的选择会改变结论，并据此区分当前掩膜精修与可复用学习、模拟交互与真人证据；同时指出哪些可由日志揭示、哪些需独立评估、哪些仍依赖模型。
Conclusion: 研究优先级是检验选择揭示了什么、使用它是否改善 assimilation、以及该交互策略在匹配人力下是否惠及分割——这是三个彼此独立的主张。作者明确不主张新算法或经验优越性。

papers.title: FOLD: Position-Free Far Memory with Local Order for Long-Context Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM generation through lightweight drafting and parallel verification. It is particularly promising for long inputs, where KV-cache access costs can be amortized over multiple accepted tokens. Yet most drafters are trained on short sequences and degrade on long inputs, while long-context training is costly. Existing training-free approaches restrict the context window, rescale positions, or augment recent context with retrieved distant entries. Drafters, however, read target hidden states that already encode contextual and positional information, and their lightweight architecture makes full-history attention affordable. We propose FOLD, a training-free method that preserves exact local positions and treats all distant entries as far memory at a shared position. To counter attention dilution as the memory grows, we sharpen attention within it to emphasize relevant entries while separately controlling its total weight relative to the local window. Across six target-drafter pairs and diverse benchmarks of up to 256K tokens, FOLD predominantly delivers the highest speedup, with the best case more than doubling the speedup over autoregressive decoding, from 2.08$\times$ to 4.22$\times$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FOLD 是面向长上下文推测解码 (speculative decoding) 的免训练 drafter 位置编码方案：保留局部窗口的精确位置，把所有远距离条目当作共享位置的 far memory，并对 memory 内注意力做锐化、单独控制其相对局部窗口的总权重，以抵消注意力稀释。在六组 target-drafter 组合、最高 256K token 的多样基准上，FOLD 多数情况下取得最高加速，最佳情形相对自回归解码的加速从 2.08× 提升到 4.22×。
Motivation: 多数 drafter 在短序列上训练、遇到长输入即退化，而长上下文训练成本高；现有免训练方法靠截断窗口、重缩放位置或检索远端条目补救，但 drafter 读取的目标隐状态本身已编码上下文与位置信息，轻量架构下全历史注意力本可负担。
Method: 免训练方法：局部窗口保留精确位置，全部远距离条目折叠为共享单一位置的 far memory；对 memory 内部注意力做锐化以突出相关条目，同时独立控制 memory 相对局部窗口的总注意力权重，缓解随 memory 增长的注意力稀释。
Result: 在六组 target-drafter 配对、覆盖最高 256K token 的多样基准上，FOLD 多数情况下给出最高加速；最佳情形相对自回归解码的加速由 2.08× 提高到 4.22×，即超过翻倍。
Conclusion: 长上下文推测解码的 drafter 不必靠长序列训练或检索增强，只要把远端历史折叠为受控权重的 far memory 并锐化其内部注意力，就能在 256K 级输入上拿到最高档加速。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: STP-GUI: Spatially-Aware Token Pruning for Efficient Web-GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid development of vision-language models (VLMs), Web-GUI agents have achieved promising performance in interacting with real-world interfaces through screenshot-based grounding. However, high-resolution screenshots and multi-turn histories introduce excessive visual tokens, causing substantial inference overhead. Existing token pruning methods, mainly designed for natural images, often select tokens independently based on importance scores, which can fragment the local visual structures required for recognizing small GUI elements such as buttons, icons, and hyperlinks. In this work, we propose STP-GUI (Spatially-aware Token Pruning for GUI agents), a query-guided token pruning framework that preserves fine-grained instruction-conditioned token scoring while performing spatially coherent window-level selection under aggressive token reduction. A lightweight selector is optimized through policy learning while the VLM backbone remains frozen. Experiments on Online-Mind2Web show that \papername achieves a favorable efficiency-performance tradeoff under low token budgets. At 21% token retention, it preserves 77.7% of full-token performance while reducing inference latency by 31% and FLOPs by 57%. Results on Android in the Wild further suggest that the method transfers to mobile GUI environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STP-GUI 针对 Web-GUI agent 的高分辨率截图与多轮历史导致的视觉 token 膨胀，提出查询引导的空间感知 token 剪枝：在激进压缩下做窗口级空间一致选择，同时保留指令条件下的细粒度打分。在 Online-Mind2Web 上，21% token 保留率时保住全 token 性能的 77.7%，推理延迟降 31%、FLOPs 降 57%，并在 Android in the Wild 上显示可迁移到移动 GUI。
Motivation: 高分辨率截图与多轮历史产生大量视觉 token，推理开销大；现有面向自然图像的剪枝按重要性独立选 token，会打碎识别按钮、图标、超链接等小 GUI 元素所需的局部视觉结构。
Method: STP-GUI 是 query-guided token pruning 框架：细粒度的指令条件 token 打分与空间上连贯的窗口级选择结合，在低 token 预算下做激进剪枝；轻量 selector 通过 policy learning 优化，VLM backbone 保持冻结。
Result: 在 Online-Mind2Web 上，21% token 保留率下保住 77.7% 的全 token 性能，推理延迟降低 31%，FLOPs 降低 57%；Android in the Wild 上的结果显示该方法可迁移到移动 GUI 环境。
Conclusion: 在低 token 预算下，把空间一致的窗口级选择叠加在指令条件打分之上，能在大幅削减视觉 token 的同时保住大部分 GUI grounding 性能，且可跨桌面与移动 GUI 环境迁移。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: From Relevance to Validity: Zero-Shot Tool Selection via Functional and Contextual Validation
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly face tasks from unseen domains and execution contexts, making zero-shot tool selection essential for identifying tools that can satisfy task requirements. Existing dominant methods mainly rely on relevance ranking, but semantic matching alone cannot ensure that a tool is functionally compatible or remains applicable in a new context. We preliminarily identify a \emph{transfer-validity gap}, where semantically relevant tools may still fail to satisfy functional or contextual requirements after transfer. To address this gap, we propose \methodname{}, a progressive validation framework that complements semantic relevance with endpoint-grounded functional compatibility and task-conditioned contextual evidence. Across cross-domain and cross-dataset transfer, \methodname{} consistently improves capability ranking, with larger gains under functional or contextual ambiguity. Ablation results further confirm the complementary contributions of functional and contextual validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 零样本工具选择中，语义相关不等于可用：论文提出渐进式验证框架，把语义相关性与 endpoint-grounded 的功能兼容性、任务条件下的上下文证据结合，先按相关性排序再逐级验证。在跨域与跨数据集迁移设定下该框架持续提升能力排序，功能或上下文歧义越大增益越明显，消融确认功能与上下文验证各自贡献互补。
Motivation: LLM agent 面对未见过的领域与执行上下文时只能零样本选工具，而主流的相关性排序只做语义匹配，无法保证工具功能兼容或在新上下文中仍然适用，作者称之为 transfer-validity gap。
Method: 提出渐进式验证框架：在语义相关性排序之上，先做 endpoint-grounded 的功能兼容性验证，再补充任务条件化的上下文证据，逐级筛选工具；评测覆盖跨域与跨数据集迁移，并对功能验证与上下文验证做消融。
Result: 在跨域与跨数据集迁移上，该框架持续提升 capability ranking，且在功能或上下文存在歧义时增益更大；消融结果显示功能验证与上下文验证带来互补贡献。
Conclusion: 零样本工具选择需要在语义相关性之外显式验证功能兼容与上下文适用性，两者互补、缺一不可，尤其在歧义场景下。

summary_sections.method: 提出渐进式验证框架：在语义相关性排序之上，先做 endpoint-grounded 的功能兼容性验证，再补充任务条件化的上下文证据，逐级筛选工具；评测覆盖跨域与跨数据集迁移，并对功能验证与上下文验证做消融。

papers.title: Look Before You Restore: Learning to Predict Before Acting for Agentic Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Agents for mixed-degradation image restoration typically learn what a tool does to an image only after running it: failed calls waste computation and harmful outputs go unnoticed until too late. We propose PreActIR, an agentic restoration framework that predicts tool consequences before execution. For each candidate tool, a tool-conditioned world model forecasts changes in residual degradation, image quality, and fidelity, together with the risk of harm and the uncertainty of the prediction. The agent executes the top-ranked candidate, and an independent verifier commits or rolls back its output before the agent replans from the observed state. PreActIR also audits whether performance is limited by the selector or by the candidate space, and studies targeted tool adaptation as a controlled way to expand that space. In a controlled evaluation that fixes the candidate pool, verifier, and budget and employs reference-annotated degradation states, PreActIR uses 42.5% fewer real tool calls and 63.4% fewer rejected calls than reactive, execute-then-evaluate trial and error, while improving Y-PSNR by 0.92 dB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PreActIR 在执行修复工具前先用工具条件化世界模型预测每个候选工具对退化残差、画质、保真度、伤害风险与预测不确定性的改变，只执行排名最高者，并由独立 verifier 决定提交或回滚后再重规划。在固定候选池、verifier 与预算的受控评估中，相比先执行再评估的试错式 agent，真实工具调用减少 42.5%、被拒绝调用减少 63.4%，Y-PSNR 提升 0.92 dB。
Motivation: 混合退化图像修复 agent 只有在调用工具后才知道它对图像做了什么：失败调用浪费算力，有害输出要到事后才被发现。
Method: 对每个候选工具，用工具条件化世界模型预测残差退化、图像质量与保真度的变化，以及伤害风险和预测不确定性；agent 执行排名最高的候选，独立 verifier 对输出做提交或回滚，之后从观测状态重新规划。框架还审计性能瓶颈来自 selector 还是候选空间，并研究定向工具适配作为扩展候选空间的受控手段。
Result: 在固定候选池、verifier、预算并使用参考标注退化状态的受控评估中，相比 reactive 的先执行后评估试错：真实工具调用减少 42.5%，被拒绝调用减少 63.4%，Y-PSNR 提升 0.92 dB。
Conclusion: 先预测工具后果再执行，加上独立 verifier 的提交/回滚，可以在混合退化图像修复中同时省下工具调用并提高修复质量。

papers.title: Hypothesis Selection via Weighted Medians
papers.abstract_en: Given $n$ distributions (hypotheses) $\mathcal H=\{H_1,\ldots,H_n\}$ and samples from an unknown target distribution $P$, proper hypothesis selection seeks a distribution whose total variation distance to $P$ is close to the best achievable within the known distributions. We give an algorithm that, using $O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log(n/δ))$ target samples, running in $O(n\varepsilon^{-2}\log(n/δ))$ time, with probability at least $1-δ$, returns $H_{\hat i}$ satisfying $d_\mathrm{TV}(P,H_{\hat i})\leq 3\min_{i\in[n]}d_\mathrm{TV}(P,H_i)+\varepsilon.$ The algorithm achieves the optimal approximation factor and sample complexity. The running time improves the dependence on the failure probability from polynomial to logarithmic in the state-of-the-art bound $\tilde{O}(n\varepsilon^{-2}δ^{-1})$ of Aamand, Aliakbarpour, Chen, and Silwal (COLT 2026), thereby answering their Question~2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出一个基于加权中位数的 proper hypothesis selection 算法：从未知目标分布 P 抽样，在候选分布族中选出总变差距离近似最优者，达到 3 倍近似因子与 O(ε⁻²log(n/δ)) 的最优样本复杂度，运行时间 O(nε⁻²log(n/δ))，把失败概率 δ 的依赖从多项式降到对数。
Motivation: 在 n 个候选分布中按 TV 距离做 proper selection 时，已知最优结果（Aamand, Aliakbarpour, Chen, Silwal, COLT 2026）的运行时间对失败概率 δ 是多项式依赖 Õ(nε⁻²δ⁻¹)，作者要回答该文提出的 Question 2。
Method: 提出基于加权中位数 (weighted medians) 的选择算法，输入为 n 个假设分布 H₁…Hₙ 与来自未知目标分布 P 的样本，输出某个 H_î 使 d_TV(P,H_î) 不超过最优候选的 3 倍加 ε。
Result: 以至少 1−δ 的概率满足 d_TV(P,H_î) ≤ 3·min_i d_TV(P,H_i) + ε；样本复杂度 O(ε⁻²log(n/δ))，运行时间 O(nε⁻²log(n/δ))，两者均为最优；相对 COLT 2026 的 Õ(nε⁻²δ⁻¹) 把 δ 依赖由多项式降为对数。
Conclusion: proper hypothesis selection 可以同时拿到最优近似因子、最优样本复杂度，以及对失败概率的对数级运行时间依赖，从而回答 Aamand 等人的 Question 2。

papers.title: ReAl: Refine neural operators via aligning dynamical flow
papers.abstract_en: Neural partial differential equation (PDE) surrogates trained with mean squared error (MSE) can capture dominant dynamics but often lose high-frequency information and fine-scale structures. Generative models (e.g., Flow Matching) can capture the distribution of fine-scale details, yet stochastic errors may accumulate during autoregressive rollouts and compromise long-term stability. To address these limitations, we introduce Refine and Align(ReAl), a model-agnostic plug-in that augments pretrained PDE surrogates to improve the reconstruction of high-frequency structures associated with complex physical phenomena. In the refinement stage, a conditional flow-matching model learns the residual distribution around the deterministic base prediction, recovering missing fine-scale structures while retaining the dominant dynamics. In the alignment stage, to mitigate the generative discrepancies amplified in the autoregressive rollout, particularly in chaotic systems, we generate multiple trajectories from the same input and reinforce the refiner with trajectory-level rewards, thereby achieving long-horizon dynamical alignment. Experiments across diverse surrogate architectures and PDE tasks demonstrate that ReAl consistently improves high-frequency fidelity, forecasting accuracy, and long-horizon stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReAl 是一个即插即用模块，用条件 Flow Matching 在确定性 PDE 代理的预测周围学习残差分布以补回高频结构，再用同一起点采样多条轨迹、以轨迹级奖励强化 refiner，抑制自回归 rollout 中放大的生成误差。在多种代理架构与 PDE 任务上一致提升高频保真度、预报精度与长时程稳定性。
Motivation: MSE 训练的神经 PDE 代理能抓住主动力学但丢失高频与细尺度结构；生成模型能补细节却在自回归 rollout 中累积随机误差、损害长时程稳定性，尤其在混沌系统中。
Method: ReAl（Refine and Align）分两阶段：refinement 阶段用条件 Flow Matching 学习确定性基预测周围的残差分布，恢复细尺度结构同时保留主动力学；alignment 阶段从同一输入生成多条轨迹，以轨迹级奖励强化 refiner，实现长时程动力学对齐。模型无关，作为插件增强已训练的 PDE 代理。
Result: 在多种 surrogate 架构与 PDE 任务上，ReAl 一致提升高频保真度、预报精度与长时程稳定性；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把生成式残差细化与轨迹级奖励对齐结合，可在不改动基代理的前提下同时改善 PDE 代理的高频重建与长时程稳定。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: Fractional is Better: Learnable Derivative Orders in Neural Operator Learning
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, enabling fast surrogate solutions to partial differential equations. Despite remarkable architectural diversity, these methods often share a common input representation: raw coordinate-value pairs $(x, u(x))$. We ask whether inputs aligned with PDE differential structure can improve learning. Through Picard iteration on mild solutions, we show that derivatives of the input appear explicitly in the solution operator, suggesting that providing derivative features should reduce the network's implicit differentiation burden. We prove this intuition: providing derivative features improves approximation bounds from $O(W^{-(s-m)/d})$ to $O(W^{-s/d})$, where $W$ is parameter count, $s$ is input regularity, $m$ is the PDE order, and $d$ is spatial dimension. Our central finding, however, is a surprise: the optimal derivative order $β^*$ is strictly less than the PDE order $m$. This gap arises from a bias-variance tradeoff in spectral space that we characterize in closed form. Learning $β$ from data achieves automatic spectral regularization. We introduce $\partial$-NO (del-NO), for derivative-augmented neural operators, an architecture-agnostic augmentation that provides learnable fractional derivative features to any neural operator backbone. Across benchmark problems and architectures, $\partial$-NO consistently improves prediction accuracy, with learned orders that reflect a representation of known physics modulated by noise and finite-sample constraints.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. 37 pages, 11 figures, 13 tables. Code: https://github.com/FaresBMehouachi/delNO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ∂-NO (del-NO) 给任意神经算子 backbone 加入可学习的分数阶导数特征作为输入表示：Picard 迭代表明解算子显式依赖输入导数，把逼近界从 O(W^{-(s-m)/d}) 改善到 O(W^{-s/d})。核心发现是最优导数阶 β* 严格小于 PDE 阶数 m，源于谱空间的偏差-方差权衡，从数据学 β 即自动实现谱正则化；在多组基准问题与架构上一致提升预测精度。
Motivation: 神经算子普遍用原始坐标-值对 (x, u(x)) 作输入，与 PDE 的微分结构不对齐，网络被迫隐式承担微分负担，逼近速率受 PDE 阶数 m 拖累。
Method: 从 mild 解的 Picard 迭代推出解算子显式含输入导数项，据此构造架构无关的导数增强模块 ∂-NO：向任意神经算子 backbone 提供可学习的分数阶导数特征（阶数 β 由数据学习），并以闭式刻画谱空间偏差-方差权衡来解释 β* < m。
Result: 理论逼近界由 O(W^{-(s-m)/d}) 提升至 O(W^{-s/d})（W 参数量、s 输入正则性、m PDE 阶数、d 空间维数）；核心结论是最优导数阶 β* 严格小于 m；在多组基准问题与多种架构上一致提升预测精度，学到的阶数反映已知物理表示受噪声与有限样本约束后的调制。
Conclusion: 输入对齐 PDE 微分结构确实降低隐式微分负担，但导数阶数应作为可学习超参数而非取满 PDE 阶数 m——分数阶、由数据决定的 β 自动实现谱正则化。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Beyond Expert Rankings: Contrast Calibration for Mixed-Precision MoE Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models activate only a few experts per token, yet all expert weights must be stored. Mixed-precision quantization reduces this storage cost by assigning higher bit-widths to sensitive experts and lower bit-widths to resilient ones, but expert rankings alone do not determine how strongly to weight their errors. To address this gap, we propose NatScale, a contrast-calibrated allocation framework for mixed-precision MoE quantization. It uses a model-specific power transformation to calibrate gradient-based expert weights to an information-theoretic contrast target while preserving rankings. We jointly evaluate each expert's gate, up and down configurations to estimate its output error. We then combine these errors and calibrated weights with an existing prior based on weight spectra, variance and precision decay to select configurations under a storage budget. Across three models, NatScale achieves the lowest native-to-quantized KL divergence and the highest top-token agreement in all nine settings against five allocation baselines. It also yields the lowest perplexity in seven settings. These findings highlight the importance of objective-aware precision allocation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NatScale 用模型特定的幂变换把基于梯度的专家权重校准到信息论对比目标（保持排序不变），再联合评估每个专家的 gate/up/down 配置输出误差，与基于权重谱、方差和精度衰减的先验结合，在存储预算下分配混合精度位宽。在三个模型、九个设置上对五个分配基线，取得最低的 native-to-quantized KL 散度与最高的 top-token 一致率，并在其中七个设置取得最低困惑度。
Motivation: 混合精度 MoE 量化中，仅凭专家排序无法决定各专家误差应被赋多大权重，导致存储预算下的位宽分配偏离真正的量化目标。
Method: 提出 NatScale：用模型特定的 power transformation 将梯度得到的专家权重校准到信息论 contrast 目标且保持排序；联合评估每个专家的 gate、up、down 配置以估计其输出误差；再把这些误差与校准权重，同基于 weight spectra、variance 与 precision decay 的既有先验结合，在存储预算下选配置。
Result: 在三个模型的九个设置上对比五个分配基线，NatScale 全部取得最低的 native-to-quantized KL 散度和最高的 top-token 一致率，并在七个设置中取得最低 perplexity。
Conclusion: 精度分配必须对齐量化目标本身，而不只是复现专家敏感度排序；对比校准的权重加权能改善混合精度 MoE 量化的 KL、top-token 一致率与困惑度。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.motivation: 混合精度 MoE 量化中，仅凭专家排序无法决定各专家误差应被赋多大权重，导致存储预算下的位宽分配偏离真正的量化目标。
summary_sections.method: 提出 NatScale：用模型特定的 power transformation 将梯度得到的专家权重校准到信息论 contrast 目标且保持排序；联合评估每个专家的 gate、up、down 配置以估计其输出误差；再把这些误差与校准权重，同基于 weight spectra、variance 与 precision decay 的既有先验结合，在存储预算下选配置。
summary_sections.result: 在三个模型的九个设置上对比五个分配基线，NatScale 全部取得最低的 native-to-quantized KL 散度和最高的 top-token 一致率，并在七个设置中取得最低 perplexity。
summary_sections.conclusion: 精度分配必须对齐量化目标本身，而不只是复现专家敏感度排序；对比校准的权重加权能改善混合精度 MoE 量化的 KL、top-token 一致率与困惑度。

papers.title: ReferFlow: Beyond Final-Target Localization for Complex Referring Expressions
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models have made significant progress in referring expression comprehension (REC), yet most REC benchmarks still focus on final-target localization. Complex queries often involve intermediate visual references with different dependencies on prior grounding, but final-only evaluation leaves this process unexamined. To address this gap, we formulate trajectory-level REC, in which models receive an ordered sequence of grounding steps constructed from a single complex query and localize the target regions associated with each step. We instantiate this setting in ReferFlow-Bench, which characterizes structured region transitions through four trajectory types, namely Refinement, Shift, Reset, and Mixture. Experiments show that current models struggle to consistently ground intermediate visual references across successive steps. We further propose ReferFlow, which decouples interleaved text-latent trajectory generation from coordinate decoding. Specifically, Stateful Region Latent Reasoning represents each target region as an object-indexed state composed of continuous latents, with explicit visual and spatial supervision to preserve region information for subsequent grounding. Trajectory-Aware Parallel Decoding then recovers all coordinate blocks in parallel through four geometry-constrained refinement rounds, with each block conditioned on its corresponding trajectory prefix, thereby reducing within-box sequential dependencies and eliminating cross-box autoregression. We further apply Grounding-Aware GRPO to promote consistent grounding across steps and learn adaptive trajectory generation from complex REC queries. ReferFlow achieves leading performance on general REC benchmarks and ReferFlow-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把复杂指代表述从“只定位最终目标”改写为 trajectory-level REC：一条复杂查询拆成有序 grounding 步骤，模型逐步定位每一步的目标区域。ReferFlow 用 Stateful Region Latent Reasoning 把每个区域表示为 object-indexed 连续 latent 状态，再用 Trajectory-Aware Parallel Decoding 经四轮几何约束并行恢复全部坐标块，并以 Grounding-Aware GRPO 促进跨步一致 grounding，在通用 REC 与 ReferFlow-Bench 上取得领先表现。
Motivation: 现有 REC 基准只评最终目标定位，复杂查询中那些依赖先前 grounding 的中间视觉引用完全不被考察，模型在连续步骤上能否稳定接地无从判断。
Method: 提出 trajectory-level REC 设定与 ReferFlow-Bench，按 Refinement、Shift、Reset、Mixture 四种轨迹类型刻画结构化区域转移；模型侧将交错的文本-latent 轨迹生成与坐标解码解耦，Stateful Region Latent Reasoning 用带显式视觉与空间监督的 object-indexed 连续 latent 保存区域信息，Trajectory-Aware Parallel Decoding 以四个几何约束 refinement 轮次并行解码各坐标块（每块以对应轨迹前缀为条件），再用 Grounding-Aware GRPO 训练跨步一致接地与自适应轨迹生成。
Result: 实验显示当前模型难以在连续步骤上一致地 grounding 中间视觉引用；ReferFlow 在通用 REC 基准与 ReferFlow-Bench 上均取得领先表现。
Conclusion: 复杂指代表述的评测必须下沉到中间 grounding 步骤，而把区域状态显式建模、并行解码坐标块并用 grounding 感知的 RL 对齐，是让多步定位保持一致的可行路径。

papers.title: Human Demonstrations as Post-Training Data for Any Robot Body: Retargeting the Object, Not the Hand
papers.abstract_en: Human demonstrations are today used largely for pretraining vision-language-action models, with little ability to use the same data for target-embodiment or task-oriented training, which scalable deployment of robots in industrial and general environments depends on. A human demonstration recorded on a simple and scalable device such as a mobile phone can serve as post-training data for a robot whose body differs in structure and capability from the human who recorded it. This is made possible not by retargeting the hand's motion but the object's. A capture yields a body-free record: the object's pose over time, its contact intervals, and a reconstructed 3D object with provenance. Any robot, given as a URDF and a short descriptor, is solved against that record and scored in simulation against the demonstrated object motion as ground truth: the human-to-simulation leg of human-to-simulation-to-robot transfer, measured per robot. Each (robot, episode) pair gets one outcome: pass, failure with a named mode, or refusal, with its reason, before any motion. The method runs as a working system over a growing collection; the set analysed here is a sample of it: 42 captures solved on 8 robots, 157 pairs, of which 31.2% pass, 52.2% fail, 14.0% are refused and 2.5% are unauditable (kinematic feasibility, +/-50 mm / +/-15 deg, in simulation). Refusals held up: every pair the checks refuse on stored evidence yet ran anyway failed (13 of 13; 5 on a body whose public model welds its hand). A description file could not be shown to screen a robot: its outcomes were barely more predictable than guessing. No policy has yet been trained on the record. The record decides what a robot may post-train on; whether the policy then works on the real robot is the simulation-to-robot question, answered downstream.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 17 figures, 7 tables, 2 algorithms; 56-page supplement as ancillary file. A subset of episodes with their per-robot outcomes: https://playground.dxtr.co
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把人类演示重定向到物体而非手：手机采集得到与身体无关的记录（物体位姿时序、接触区间、带来源的 3D 物体重建），任意以 URDF 加简短描述给出的机器人在仿真中按该记录求解并打分。在 42 次采集 × 8 台机器人的 157 个 (robot, episode) 对上，31.2% 通过、52.2% 失败、14.0% 被拒绝、2.5% 不可审计（运动学可行性，±50 mm / ±15 deg）；拒绝判定可靠——13 个被检查拒绝却仍运行的对全部失败。
Motivation: 人类演示目前主要用于 VLA 模型预训练，难以复用于目标本体或任务导向的后训练，而机器人规模化部署正依赖这一点；不同机器人身体结构与能力差异大，直接把手部动作重定向过去并不可行。
Method: 采集阶段只记录物体：位姿时序、接触区间与带来源的 3D 物体重建，形成 body-free 记录；给定机器人 URDF 与简短描述，针对该记录求解，在仿真中以演示的物体运动为 ground truth 打分，构成 human-to-simulation-to-robot 转移的第一段。每个 (robot, episode) 在任何运动之前给出唯一结果：pass、带命名失败模式的 failure、或带理由的 refusal。
Result: 在 42 次采集、8 台机器人、157 个配对的样本上：31.2% pass、52.2% fail、14.0% refused、2.5% unauditable，判据为仿真中的运动学可行性与 ±50 mm / ±15 deg 的物体运动误差。拒绝判定在留存证据上成立：13 个被拒绝却仍运行的配对全部失败，其中 5 个属于公开模型把手部焊死的机器人本体。仅凭描述文件无法筛掉不可行机器人，其结果可预测性几乎等同于随机猜测。
Conclusion: 物体重定向让人类演示成为任意机器人身体的后训练数据，记录本身决定某台机器人可以拿什么做后训练；策略能否在实体机器人上工作属于下游的 simulation-to-robot 问题。目前尚无策略在该记录上训练过。

papers.title: Lifted State Policy Optimization: Internalizing Self-Correction through Transition Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Preference optimization ranks final answers and trajectory RL maximizes aggregate returns, yet neither credits the local change that turns a flawed reasoning state into a better one. We introduce Lifted State Policy Optimization (LSPO), which establishes this finite, cost-adjusted transition as the primary unit of learning. Each textual answer is augmented with a learned continuous coordinate, forming a lifted state that an energy function evaluates and orders. A shaped reward drives energy descent net of edit and step costs, and an internalization loss absorbs selected low-energy answers into the direct generator. On Qwen3.5-27B, the resulting single-pass policy reaches 71.8% aggregate accuracy across mathematics, science, code, and logic benchmarks, matching test-time reflection at 71.9% with 28% lower latency and 25.8% fewer tokens. The pattern holds across dense and mixture-of-experts backbones, and matched controls confirm that transition credit and the lifted coordinate each contribute, as does answer internalization. Our code is available at https://github.com/Venomrko/lspo.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Originally titled "Self-Correction as Transition Geometry: Internalizing Reasoning via Lifted State Policy Optimization."
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LSPO 把「把有缺陷的推理状态改好」的那一步转移 (transition) 作为学习的基本单位：每个文本答案附加一个可学习的连续坐标构成 lifted state，由能量函数评估排序，shaped reward 在扣除编辑与步成本后驱动能量下降，再用 internalization loss 把低能量答案吸收进直接生成器。在 Qwen3.5-27B 上单次前向策略在数学、科学、代码、逻辑基准上聚合准确率 71.8%，与 test-time reflection 的 71.9% 持平，同时延迟低 28%、token 少 25.8%。
Motivation: 偏好优化只对最终答案排序，轨迹 RL 只最大化聚合回报，两者都不给「把错误推理状态改成更好状态」的局部变化以信用 (credit)，自我纠正因此只能靠测试时反思而非内化。
Method: LSPO 将有限的、成本调整后的转移设为学习单位：文本答案拼接一个学习得到的连续坐标形成 lifted state，由能量函数评估并排序；shaped reward 在扣除编辑成本与步成本后推动能量下降；internalization loss 把选出的低能量答案吸收进直接生成器，从而单次前向即可输出。
Result: Qwen3.5-27B 上单次前向策略在数学、科学、代码、逻辑基准的聚合准确率为 71.8%，与 test-time reflection 的 71.9% 相当，延迟降低 28%、token 减少 25.8%；该模式在稠密 (dense) 与 mixture-of-experts 两类骨干上均成立，matched controls 确认转移信用、lifted 坐标与答案内化各自都有贡献。
Conclusion: 把自我纠正建模为带成本的转移几何并内化进生成器，可以在不牺牲准确率的前提下用单次前向替代测试时反思，且转移信用与 lifted 坐标缺一不可。

papers.title: NeuroDETR: Multiscale Discrete Spatiotemporal Tokenization for Asynchronous EEG Event Detection
papers.abstract_en: Asynchronous EEG event detection supports practical brain-computer interfaces by identifying event classes and temporal boundaries directly from continuous recordings without predefined event boundaries at inference time. The primary challenge lies in extracting event-related patterns embedded in ongoing background activity. To address this, we propose \textbf{NeuroDETR}, a discrete spatiotemporal multiscale framework that combines structured tokenization with event-aware feature refinement. Multiscale temporal codebooks capture brief responses and sustained dynamics, while Spatial-Pyramid VQ hierarchically encodes spatial structure across EEG channels. These complementary representations form a compact event memory for jointly classifying events and estimating their onsets and offsets. Before tokenization, we apply FOCAL, an event-aware sparse attention module that uses predicted event presence to guide temporal feature refinement and spatial aggregation, emphasizing likely event periods while preserving context across the recording. Experiments on eight EEG datasets that span diverse paradigms demonstrate state-of-the-art performance. These findings provide a basis for the development of BCI systems that recognize meaningful neural activity during continuous interaction and monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuroDETR 用多尺度离散时空 tokenization 直接从连续 EEG 中同时分类事件并回归起止边界，推理时无需预定义事件边界。多尺度时间码本配合 Spatial-Pyramid VQ 编码通道结构，FOCAL 稀疏注意力以预测的事件存在性引导时序细化与空间聚合；在八个跨范式 EEG 数据集上报告 SOTA 表现。
Motivation: 异步 EEG 事件检测要在持续背景活动中定位事件类别与时间边界，而推理阶段没有预定义边界可用，事件相关模式容易被背景活动淹没。
Method: NeuroDETR 采用离散时空多尺度框架：多尺度时间码本分别捕捉短促响应与持续动态，Spatial-Pyramid VQ 对 EEG 通道做层次化空间编码，两者组成紧凑 event memory 联合完成事件分类与 onset/offset 估计；tokenization 之前用 FOCAL 这一事件感知稀疏注意力模块，以预测的事件存在性引导时序特征细化与空间聚合，在强调可能事件段的同时保留全记录上下文。
Result: 在覆盖多种范式的八个 EEG 数据集上实验，报告达到 state-of-the-art 表现（摘要未列出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 结构化离散 tokenization 加事件感知注意力细化，可为 BCI 在连续交互与监测中识别有意义神经活动提供基础。

papers.title: Non-asymptotic Convergence of Average-reward Q-learning with Options
papers.abstract_en: We study the finite-sample convergence of Q-learning algorithms for the average-reward formulation of Reinforcement Learning (RL) with options. While options allow temporarily extended and hierarchical actions, the average-reward formulation incorporates continual tasks beyond discounted and episodic RL. We establish the first $\tilde{O}(1/\text{iterations})$ convergence guarantees, in the mean-square sense, for average-reward option Q-learning algorithms in both the inter- and intra-option settings. First, we prove that both inter- and intra-option Bellman operators satisfy multi-step span contractions under unichain assumptions. Then, we propose synchronous estimators of these multi-step option Bellman operators leading to two variants of option Q-learning. Finally, we extend the stochastic approximation framework to prove convergence rates of these two algorithms under the minimal assumptions used in the literature.

papers.title: Doc2Harness: Benchmarking LLMs on Long-Horizon Harness Engineering of Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agents driven by large language models are increasingly deployed on long-horizon tasks, where they use tools and modify real workspaces. How well they perform depends as much on the harness around the model as on the model itself. Existing benchmarks measure downstream task success under a fixed harness, leaving harness engineering itself unexplored. We propose Doc2Harness, a two-stage benchmark that evaluates long-horizon harness engineering directly. In Stage 1, a build model operating inside a fixed builder harness receives an interface-only contract skeleton and a development document that consolidates behavior across twelve frontier harnesses, and then constructs a complete candidate harness in an isolated container. In Stage 2, the frozen candidate harness runs in containers separate from the construction environment, one per test case, and is driven end to end by a scripted mock model. We score each test case using four observable channels, namely the requests sent to the model, the files on disk, the process exit code, and the command output; positive controls rule out vacuous passes. Across nineteen frontier models, each evaluated with three independent builds on 328 test cases, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest pass rate at 53.05%, while the weakest model reaches 27.44%, a gap of roughly twenty-six percentage points. Even the strongest model fails nearly half of the test cases, and failures cluster around how cross-cutting functionality is split across modules. To our knowledge, Doc2Harness provides the first deterministic benchmark for measuring long-horizon harness engineering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Doc2Harness 是首个直接评测长程 harness 工程本身的确定性基准：Stage 1 让 build 模型在固定 builder harness 内凭接口契约骨架与开发文档在隔离容器中构造候选 harness，Stage 2 用脚本化 mock model 端到端驱动冻结后的候选 harness。19 个前沿模型各做 3 次独立构建、跑 328 个测试用例，GPT-6 Astra 通过率最高 53.05%，最弱 27.44%，差距约 26 个百分点；最强模型仍近半失败，且失败集中在跨切功能如何拆分到各模块。
Motivation: 现有基准都在固定 harness 下测下游任务成功率，harness 工程本身从未被直接评测，而长程 agent 表现与模型周围的 harness 同等关键。
Method: 两阶段基准：Stage 1 中 build 模型在固定 builder harness 内接收 interface-only contract skeleton 与整合了 12 个前沿 harness 行为的 development document，在隔离容器中构建完整候选 harness；Stage 2 将冻结的候选 harness 放进与构建环境分离的容器（每测试用例一个），由 scripted mock model 端到端驱动，按发给模型的请求、磁盘文件、进程退出码、命令输出四个可观测通道打分，并用 positive controls 排除空洞通过。
Result: 19 个前沿模型各 3 次独立构建、328 个测试用例上，GPT-6 Astra 通过率最高 53.05%，最弱模型 27.44%，差距约 26 个百分点；即便最强模型也失败近一半测试用例，失败聚集在跨切功能跨模块拆分处。

papers.title: When Does Task-Aware Imputation Matter? An Analysis of Robustness Under Train-Test Mismatch
papers.abstract_en: Missing data is a pervasive challenge in machine learning, often degrading predictive performance and complicating model deployment. Most existing approaches treat imputation as a preprocessing step independent of the downstream task, a separation that becomes problematic under train-test mismatches in missingness mechanisms or rates. We introduce a unified framework that treats missing entries as variables in a task-conditioned optimization problem. We instantiate this framework in two settings: an amortized approach for scenarios with missing data at both training and test time, and a latent optimization approach for settings where only training data is incomplete. The evaluation is conducted on 98 tabular datasets, and robustness under train-test mismatches is assessed on 36 datasets. Results reveal that reconstruction error constitutes a poor proxy for predictive utility (Spearman rho approximately 0.16 to 0.32), and that task-aware imputation becomes critical in scenarios where classical methods fail to recover complete-data performance, achieving win rates of up to 80% in challenging train-test mismatch scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把缺失值填补写成任务条件化的优化问题，缺失项作为变量与下游预测联合求解，在训练与测试缺失机制或缺失率不一致时显著优于与任务解耦的经典填补。98 个表格数据集上重建误差与预测效用的 Spearman rho 仅约 0.16–0.32，困难的 train-test mismatch 场景中胜率最高达 80%。
Motivation: 多数方法把填补当作与下游任务无关的预处理步骤，一旦训练与测试的缺失机制或缺失率不一致，重建质量好并不等于预测性能好，模型部署因此退化。
Method: 统一框架把缺失项作为任务条件化优化问题中的变量：一是 amortized 方式，训练与测试阶段都有缺失数据；二是 latent optimization 方式，仅训练数据不完整。在 98 个表格数据集上评测，并在 36 个数据集上评估 train-test mismatch 下的鲁棒性。
Result: 重建误差与预测效用的 Spearman rho 约 0.16–0.32，说明重建误差是预测效用的差代理；在经典方法无法恢复完整数据性能的困难 train-test mismatch 场景中，任务感知填补胜率最高达 80%。评测覆盖 98 个表格数据集，鲁棒性分析覆盖 36 个。
Conclusion: 填补应与下游任务联合优化而非独立预处理；在缺失机制或缺失率发生 train-test 错配时，任务感知填补是恢复完整数据性能的关键。

papers.title: InfiniSplat v2: Analyzing and Improving Feed-Forward 3DGS from Any Views
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction builds 3D scenes directly from input images for novel view rendering, but learning Gaussian attributes from predicted geometry for high-quality rendering under large viewpoint changes remains challenging. We analyze limitations in Gaussian attribute learning and introduce InfiniSplat v2, which improves rendering quality through architectural and training changes. Our method decouples geometry and attribute prediction with a frozen geometry branch, aligns predicted Gaussians using ground-truth camera poses during training, and adopts large-angle target view supervision. Across six datasets, the feed-forward outputs of the same trained model achieve state-of-the-art mean LPIPS and DISTS among the evaluated methods in both pose-conditioned and pose-free settings. In the pose-conditioned setting, mean LPIPS and DISTS decrease by 25.8% and 32.9%, respectively, compared with the strongest evaluated baselines. We further find that opacity learned with only image reconstruction supervision suppresses geometrically inconsistent points. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/InfiniSplat2/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InfiniSplat v2 通过冻结几何分支、解耦几何与高斯属性预测，并用真值相机位姿对齐预测高斯、以大角度目标视图做监督，提升前馈 3DGS 在大视角变化下的渲染质量。在六个数据集上，同一训练模型的前馈输出在位姿条件与无位姿两种设定下均取得所评方法中最好的平均 LPIPS 与 DISTS；位姿条件下相对最强基线平均 LPIPS 降低 25.8%、DISTS 降低 32.9%。
Motivation: 前馈式 Gaussian reconstruction 能直接从输入图像重建场景，但从预测几何学习高斯属性、在大视角变化下获得高质量渲染仍然困难。
Method: 解耦几何与属性预测并冻结几何分支 (frozen geometry branch)，训练时用真值相机位姿对齐预测的 Gaussians，采用大角度目标视图监督 (large-angle target view supervision)，并通过架构与训练改动改进渲染质量。
Result: 在六个数据集上，同一训练模型的前馈输出在位姿条件 (pose-conditioned) 与无位姿 (pose-free) 设定下均取得所评方法中最好的平均 LPIPS 与 DISTS；位姿条件下相对最强基线平均 LPIPS 与 DISTS 分别下降 25.8% 与 32.9%。另发现仅用图像重建监督学到的 opacity 会抑制几何上不一致的点。
Conclusion: 把几何与属性预测解耦并用真值位姿对齐、配合大角度视图监督，可让前馈 3DGS 在大视角变化下达到所评方法中的最优渲染质量；opacity 的图像重建监督本身具有剔除几何不一致点的作用。

papers.title: Training Dynamics of Transformers on Unbounded Inputs: Attention Learning Can Lag Output Layer Learning
papers.abstract_en: The success of transformers is attributed to several factors, including their capacity to express formal languages over variable-length inputs, and ability of the attention mechanism to focus on relevant input features. However, there is limited understanding of the training dynamics of shallow transformers, specifically how to decouple the learning of the attention and the output (feedforward) layer. A natural extension of the theory of one-step gradient feature learning in feedforward networks suggests that one could first learn the attention weights with a single gradient step, and then train the output layer. We show that this fails for a shallow transformer trained to recognize a star-free language from unbounded-length input. We prove that the transformer can be trained to recognize the language with a three-phase gradient descent: the output layer is updated first, followed by an attention update, and the output layer is fine-tuned in the third phase. In contrast, the language cannot be learned by training only the attention or output layer, or by a single attention-layer update followed by finetuning the output layer. We empirically show that ``attention learning lagging output layer learning" is beneficial in other language recognition, regression, and in-context learning tasks as well.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在无界长度输入上训练浅层 Transformer 识别 star-free 语言时，先学 attention 再训输出层的直觉方案失效；证明必须按三阶段梯度下降训练：先更新输出层，再更新 attention，最后微调输出层。只训 attention 或只训输出层、或单步 attention 更新后微调输出层都无法学会该语言，且这种 attention 学习滞后于输出层学习的次序在其他语言识别、回归和 in-context learning 任务上也有实证收益。
Motivation: 浅层 Transformer 训练动力学缺少把 attention 学习与输出层学习解耦的理论；由前馈网络单步梯度特征学习理论外推的先学 attention 再训输出层方案，在无界长度输入上并不成立。
Method: 在无界长度输入上分析识别 star-free 语言的浅层 Transformer 训练动力学，证明三阶段梯度下降收敛：先更新输出层，再更新 attention，第三阶段微调输出层；并对照只训单层、单步 attention 更新加输出层微调等替代次序，另在语言识别、回归和 in-context learning 任务上做实证检验。
Result: 证明三阶段次序（输出层 → attention → 输出层微调）可训练成功；只训 attention、只训输出层、或单步 attention 更新后微调输出层均无法学会该 star-free 语言。实证上 attention 学习滞后于输出层学习的次序在其他语言识别、回归和 in-context learning 任务上也有收益。
Conclusion: 浅层 Transformer 在无界输入上的可训练性依赖于分阶段的层间更新次序，输出层必须先于 attention 学习，前馈网络式的先特征后输出解耦不成立。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Read, Parse, Describe: Unified Document Parsing with Visual Element Description Generation
papers.abstract_en: Document understanding systems are typically evaluated as separate components via layout analysis, optical text recognition, reading-order prediction, and image captioning. This separation leaves scientific figures, captions, and visual semantics weakly connected, and fails to measure whether a model can produce a single page-level parse that is both structurally faithful and semantically accessible. We introduce Read-Parse-Describe, a unified dataset for document parsing with visual element description generation. Given a page image, models are required to output an ordered list of layout elements containing bounding boxes, semantic labels, reading-order indices, recognized textual content, and alternative text descriptions for visual elements. The benchmark is built from 2,402 documents, comprising 18,163 continuous pages, 125,218 layout elements, and 11,338 visual instances. Besides, we further propose a plug-and-play space-awareness enhancer that reuses multi-layer visual features and injects grid-aware spatial guidance into vision-language tokens for layout-aware generation. Experiments across end-to-end VLMs and pipeline parsers show that existing systems still struggle to jointly recover reading order and visual semantics, while our enhanced model achieves strong joint performance. These results highlight the need to move beyond isolated document parsing modules toward unified models that jointly read, parse, and describe complex documents. The new dataset and code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/yufanchen96/RPD

papers.title: TreeFlex: Agents Navigating Their Own Search Trees
papers.abstract_en: A ReAct-style agent accumulates observations, intermediate results, and failed attempts in a single context. As this context grows, stale and off-path information consumes its limited capacity and obscures relevant evidence, making focused reasoning increasingly difficult. We introduce TreeFlex, a framework in which the agent's own policy decides where to search. The agent records each intermediate state, with a short summary, as a node in a search tree maintained by the harness. The policy is a single language model that acts in two roles. In the Reflection role, it has a global view of the tree through these summaries and picks a node to resume, together with an instruction. In the Execution role, the harness restores the path that led to that node, and the model carries out the instruction with the usual task tools until it saves a new node or proposes a solution, which Reflection then approves or sends back to another node. Through these choices, the policy decides whether to deepen the current line, branch from or revisit an earlier state, verify a proposal, or stop, without a fixed traversal order or a score for each node. We train navigation, task actions, checkpointing, and proposal review jointly with a tree-aware adaptation of GRPO, using task-level outcome rewards augmented by process rewards. After small-scale RL of a 4B model, with the same active-context limit for all methods, TreeFlex reaches 48.8% accuracy on a challenging deep-research benchmark, versus 41.5% for flat ReAct and 42.8% for FoldAgent, and its Pass@8 is about ten points higher than either. On SWE-bench Verified, with all three systems trained with RL from the same 9B model, TreeFlex resolves 54.9% of tasks, versus 43.3% for FoldAgent and 45.2% for its step-wise variant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TreeFlex 把 agent 的中间状态存成带摘要的搜索树节点，由同一个语言模型以 Reflection 角色全局选节点恢复、以 Execution 角色沿恢复路径执行，从而自主决定加深、分支、回访、验证或停止，摆脱固定遍历顺序。用树感知的 GRPO 联合训练导航与动作后，4B 模型在 deep-research 基准上达到 48.8%（flat ReAct 41.5%、FoldAgent 42.8%），SWE-bench Verified 上 9B 模型解决 54.9%（FoldAgent 43.3%）。
Motivation: ReAct 式 agent 把观测、中间结果和失败尝试全堆在一个上下文里，过期与偏离路径的信息挤占容量、掩盖关键证据，导致深入推理越来越难。
Method: harness 维护搜索树，每个中间状态连同短摘要存为节点；单一 LM 分担 Reflection（凭摘要全局选节点与指令）与 Execution（harness 恢复到该节点的路径后用任务工具执行）双角色，Reflection 还负责批准或驳回提案。用树感知改造的 GRPO 联合训练导航、任务动作、checkpointing 与提案评审，奖励为任务级结果奖励加过程奖励。
Result: 在相同 active-context 上限下，4B 模型经小规模 RL 后 TreeFlex 在一个高难 deep-research 基准上准确率 48.8%，对比 flat ReAct 41.5%、FoldAgent 42.8%，Pass@8 比两者都高约 10 个百分点；SWE-bench Verified 上三系统均从同一 9B 模型做 RL，TreeFlex 解决 54.9%，FoldAgent 43.3%，其 step-wise 变体 45.2%。
Conclusion: 让策略自己决定在搜索树上往哪走，配合树感知的 RL 训练，能在固定上下文预算内同时提高深研与软件工程两类任务的解决率。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Are We Overthinking One-Step Generation?
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow matching are now dominant frameworks for generative modeling in continuous domains, but they typically require multiple network evaluations at inference. This has motivated extensive research on one-step generative modeling primarily built on diffusion and flow, though existing approaches often rely on complex training machinery. In this work, we introduce Priming Models, a simple two-stage framework for training one-step generators. Motivated by the difficulty of distributional training from scratch, Priming Models are first trained on a reconstruction objective, e.g., pixel-space denoising at a fixed noise level, before undergoing feature-space distributional post-training. Our central scientific finding is that this simple reconstruction stage is already enough to entirely alleviate the difficulty of distributional training. Empirically, across class-conditional image generation, text-to-image generation, and world modeling, Priming Models significantly advance the Pareto frontier of training compute vs. generation quality. On ImageNet at $256 \times 256$ resolution, we achieve a state-of-the-art FID of $1.19$ among one-step generators using approximately one-tenth the training compute of prior methods with comparable FID. We open-source our codebase at https://github.com/JaeyeonKim01/priming.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Priming Models：两阶段训练一步生成器，先在固定噪声水平的重建目标（如像素空间去噪）上预训练，再做特征空间的分布后训练。核心发现是仅靠重建阶段就足以完全消除从零做分布训练的困难；在 ImageNet 256×256 上以约十分之一训练算力取得一步生成器 SOTA FID 1.19。
Motivation: 扩散与流匹配推理需多次网络评估，一步生成研究多依赖复杂训练机制；从零做分布训练本身困难，导致训练算力与生成质量的权衡难以推进。
Method: Priming Models 两阶段框架：第一阶段用重建目标（固定噪声水平的像素空间去噪）预训练，第二阶段在特征空间做分布后训练，得到单次前向的一步生成器；在类条件图像生成、文生图与 world modeling 上检验。
Result: ImageNet 256×256 上一步生成器取得 SOTA FID 1.19，训练算力约为先前可比 FID 方法的十分之一；在类条件图像生成、文生图与 world modeling 上显著推进训练算力 vs 生成质量的 Pareto 前沿。
Conclusion: 重建预训练已足以化解一步生成器分布训练的困难，一步生成的算力-质量权衡可由简单两阶段流程而非复杂训练机制来推进。

papers.title: Argument Graph Uncertainty: Quantifying Uncertainty from the Logical Structure of Reasoning Chains
papers.abstract_en: Reliable uncertainty estimation is essential for deploying large language models in high-stakes reasoning tasks, yet most existing approaches rely on expensive sampling strategies or shallow token-level signals that ignore the internal logical structure of model outputs. We introduce Argument Graph Uncertainty, a post-hoc framework for multiple choice question tasks, that estimates model confidence directly from the logical structure of a single chain-of-thought reasoning trace. Our method uses either a lightweight instruction-tuned model or a simple deterministic rule to segment the reasoning chain into propositional units, then applies a NLI model to infer relational edges and construct two complementary argument graphs over these segments. The resulting edge scores are aggregated into a Dirichlet posterior over answer options, whose concentration yields calibrated uncertainty estimates reflecting both local step-to-step coherence and global logical consistency across the reasoning trace. Evaluated on GPQA, MMLU-Pro and TruthfulQA, our method consistently surpasses token-based and consistency-based uncertainty baselines across multiple reasoning models. We further demonstrate through extensive combination analyses that argument graph uncertainty captures an orthogonal signal to existing approaches, making it a complementary component in uncertainty ensembles. Crucially, our framework requires no additional calls to the evaluated model and relies entirely on small, efficient auxiliary models, producing fully interpretable, per-node uncertainty attributions at low computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Argument Graph Uncertainty：把单条 CoT 推理链切成命题单元，用 NLI 模型推断关系边构成论证图，将边分数聚合成答案选项上的 Dirichlet 后验，用其浓度作为校准不确定性。在 GPQA、MMLU-Pro、TruthfulQA 上一致超过基于 token 与基于一致性的不确定性基线，且无需对被评估模型追加调用。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 不确定性估计依赖昂贵采样或浅层 token 信号，忽略输出内部的逻辑结构，难以在高风险推理任务中给出可解释的置信度。
Method: 后处理框架：用轻量指令微调模型或确定性规则把推理链切成命题单元，NLI 模型推断关系边并构建两个互补的论证图，边分数聚合为答案选项上的 Dirichlet 后验，浓度给出同时反映局部步骤连贯性与全局逻辑一致性的校准不确定性；仅需小型辅助模型。
Result: 在 GPQA、MMLU-Pro、TruthfulQA 上，跨多个推理模型一致优于 token-based 与 consistency-based 不确定性基线；组合分析显示该信号与既有方法正交，可作为不确定性集成的互补成分；无需对被评估模型追加调用，输出可解释的逐节点不确定性归因且计算开销低。
Conclusion: 推理链的逻辑结构本身携带与 token/一致性信号正交的不确定性信息，用小型辅助模型即可低成本提取并用于集成。

papers.title: Comparative Evaluation of Deep-Learning based DoA Estimators for Real-Time ISAC Beamforming
papers.abstract_en: Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) systems rely on accurate Direction-of-Arrival (DoA) estimation for effective beamforming and spectral-efficiency enhancement. While numerous classical and deep-learning-based DoA estimation methods have been reported in the literature, their suitability for real-time ISAC operation remains insufficiently understood because practical deployment requires consideration of both estimation accuracy and computational latency. This paper presents a unified evaluation framework for systematically comparing classical and learning-based DoA estimators within an ISAC beamforming pipeline. Representative classical and learning-based DoA estimators, together with an ensemble architecture, are integrated with Singular Value Decomposition (SVD)-based beamforming and evaluated under identical operating conditions. The impact of DoA estimation accuracy, inference latency, beamforming-weight generation time, and resulting effective spectral efficiency is investigated. Results show that different estimators occupy distinct operating points in the accuracy-latency-performance design space. Although learning-based approaches substantially reduce estimation time compared with MUSIC, the overall processing latency increasingly becomes dominated by the computational cost of SVD-based beamforming. Among the evaluated methods, the Regression Convolutional Neural Network (RCNN) exhibits a favorable balance between estimation accuracy, computational efficiency, and beamforming performance, making it a promising candidate for real-time ISAC deployment. The findings further suggest that future low-latency ISAC systems may benefit from beamforming strategies that reduce or avoid computationally intensive SVD-based beamforming-weight generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ISAC 波束成形流水线里统一比较经典与深度学习 DoA 估计器，把估计精度、推理延迟、波束权生成时间与有效频谱效率放进同一设计空间。学习类方法相比 MUSIC 大幅缩短估计时间，但总延迟逐渐被 SVD 波束成形的计算开销主导；RCNN 在精度、计算效率与波束成形性能之间最均衡，是实时 ISAC 部署的候选。
Motivation: 已有 DoA 估计方法众多，但实际部署同时受估计精度与计算延迟约束，两者在实时 ISAC 运行中的取舍此前缺乏系统比较。
Method: 构建统一评估框架，把代表性经典与学习型 DoA 估计器（含一种 ensemble 架构）接入基于 SVD 的波束成形流水线，在相同工作条件下评测；考察估计精度、推理延迟、波束权生成时间与由此得到的有效频谱效率。
Result: 不同估计器在精度-延迟-性能设计空间中占据不同工作点；学习型方法相比 MUSIC 显著缩短估计时间，但整体处理延迟日益被 SVD 波束成形的计算成本主导；RCNN 在估计精度、计算效率与波束成形性能之间表现出较优平衡。
Conclusion: 实时 ISAC 的瓶颈会从 DoA 估计转移到 SVD 波束权生成，未来低延迟系统应采用减少或避免高开销 SVD 的波束成形策略。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 构建统一评估框架，把代表性经典与学习型 DoA 估计器（含一种 ensemble 架构）接入基于 SVD 的波束成形流水线，在相同工作条件下评测；考察估计精度、推理延迟、波束权生成时间与由此得到的有效频谱效率。
summary_sections.result: 不同估计器在精度-延迟-性能设计空间中占据不同工作点；学习型方法相比 MUSIC 显著缩短估计时间，但整体处理延迟日益被 SVD 波束成形的计算成本主导；RCNN 在估计精度、计算效率与波束成形性能之间表现出较优平衡。
summary_sections.conclusion: 实时 ISAC 的瓶颈会从 DoA 估计转移到 SVD 波束权生成，未来低延迟系统应采用减少或避免高开销 SVD 的波束成形策略。

papers.title: Hierarchical Gaussian Processes for Survey Weighting: Local Equivalent Weights in Structured Populations
papers.abstract_en: Regression-based survey weighting connects model-based population estimation with design-based inference through equivalent weights. For nonlinear models, equivalent weights can be defined locally through the sensitivity of a poststratified population estimator. However, conventional regression models may inadequately capture nonlinear relationships and complex interactions across sparse poststratification cells. We develop a survey-weighting framework based on hierarchical Gaussian process (HGP) regression, combining structured group-level effects with kernel-based smoothing to share information across related cells. We derive Gaussian posterior prediction formulas that exploit the structured covariance representation to reduce computational costs. We also establish a uniform convergence result for the posterior predictive mean under stated regularity conditions and construct local equivalent weights by matching the first-order sensitivity of a plug-in poststratified estimand to that of a weighted average of fitted response means, with both derivatives taken with respect to the latent mean-scale vector. Simulations show that HGP achieves lower population-weighted prediction error under nonparametric structure, whereas logistic regression performs well under correct parametric specification. Additional analyses examine sample size, frame coverage, subgroup prediction, and population-mean agreement. An application to the Future of Families and Child Wellbeing Study illustrates the method. Overall, this work extends local equivalent-weight construction to nonparametric modeling and provides a computational framework and conditional theoretical results for survey weighting in structured, sparse populations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把分层高斯过程 (hierarchical Gaussian process, HGP) 引入基于回归的调查加权，用结构化组层效应加核平滑在稀疏 poststratification 单元间共享信息，并按 plug-in poststratified 估计量对潜均值-尺度向量的一阶敏感度匹配构造局部等价权重。仿真显示在非参数结构下 HGP 的总体加权预测误差更低，而在参数模型正确设定时 logistic 回归表现良好。
Motivation: 非线性模型下局部等价权重依赖后分层估计量的敏感度，但常规回归难以刻画稀疏 poststratification 单元间的非线性关系与复杂交互，导致总体估计的模型设定风险。
Method: 以 HGP 回归为骨架，结合结构化组层效应与核平滑跨相关单元共享信息；利用结构化协方差表示推导高斯后验预测公式以降低计算成本；对潜均值-尺度向量求导，使 plug-in poststratified 目标量与拟合响应均值加权平均的一阶敏感度匹配，从而得到局部等价权重。
Result: 仿真中 HGP 在非参数结构下取得更低的总体加权预测误差，logistic 回归在参数设定正确时表现良好；另考察样本量、抽样框覆盖率、子群预测与总体均值一致性，并在 Future of Families and Child Wellbeing Study 上做应用。
Conclusion: 在正则条件下后验预测均值具有一致收敛结果，局部等价权重构造可扩展到非参数建模，为结构化稀疏总体的调查加权提供条件性理论与计算框架。

papers.title: Beyond Static Cues: Unified Dynamic Detection of MLLM Backdoors via Dual-Flow Trajectory Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical domains, yet their susceptibility to backdoor attacks remains a formidable challenge. While existing defenses have evolved from visual-centric patch cues to unsupervised internal attention statistics, they are fundamentally constrained by a reliance on static snapshots and attack-specific heuristics. Given the intricate interplay between dual modalities, the vast design space for multimodal triggers allows diverse threats, such as textual injections, sub-perceptual noises, and coordinated cross-modal triggers, to easily circumvent such rigid priors, particularly when attack types are unknown in real-world applications. In this paper, we rethink backdoor detection by shifting the diagnostic paradigm from static observations to dynamic output evolution. We observe that a successful attack inevitably hijacks the model's decoding trajectory, skewing internal modal contributions during generation while maintaining an abnormal output invariance despite input perturbations. To capture this behavior, we propose EVO-Detect, a unified detection framework that monitors the dynamic evolution of internal signals during early decoding steps through two complementary channels: Attention Flow and Logits Flow. The attention branch measures how image-text attention allocation evolves during early generation, whereas the logits branch quantifies the sensitivity of the output distribution to modal perturbations through interventional ablations. We then convert these trajectories into compact sample-level metrics and normalize them against negative-control signatures so that natural perturbations are less likely to be mistaken for backdoor evidence. Extensive evaluations show that our approach substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines such as BYE and TCAP across diverse attack families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 EVO-Detect：把 MLLM 后门检测从静态快照转到早期解码阶段的动态轨迹，用 Attention Flow 与 Logits Flow 两条通道捕捉攻击对解码轨迹的劫持。在多种攻击族上显著优于 BYE、TCAP 等 SOTA 基线。
Motivation: 现有后门防御依赖视觉 patch 线索或无监督注意力统计等静态快照与攻击特定启发式，面对文本注入、亚感知噪声、跨模态协同触发等多样触发器设计时容易失效，尤其在攻击类型未知的真实场景。
Method: EVO-Detect 监控早期解码步的内部信号演化：Attention Flow 分支度量生成过程中图像-文本注意力分配的变化，Logits Flow 分支通过干预性消融 (interventional ablations) 量化输出分布对模态扰动的敏感度；两条轨迹被压缩为样本级指标，并用负控制签名 (negative-control signatures) 归一化，以降低自然扰动被误判为后门证据的概率。
Result: 在多样攻击族上的评测显示，EVO-Detect 显著优于 BYE、TCAP 等 SOTA 基线。
Conclusion: 成功后门攻击必然劫持解码轨迹——生成中内部模态贡献偏斜且输出对输入扰动异常不变；据此用动态双流轨迹检测可在攻击类型未知时统一覆盖多类触发器。

papers.title: Efficient Test-Time Adaptation For Robot Policies
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement-learning policies for robot locomotion can fail at deployment when operating conditions shift (e.g., rough or slippery terrain, payload changes, sensing degradation), and retraining or manual recalibration is often infeasible under on-device latency and memory constraints. We study test-time adaptation (TTA) for robotic control: adapting a pretrained policy online and in a self-supervised manner during execution, without access to rewards. Our starting point is a lightweight baseline that updates only the actor using a frozen pretrained critic as a deployment-time performance surrogate. Building on this, we introduce TEMPO, a test-time entropy-regularized, memory-guided policy optimization method that stabilizes critic-driven updates under severe shift. TEMPO combines (i) an entropy-promoting regularizer on the critic's predictive distribution to mitigate overconfident extrapolation, and (ii) a score-based memory, inspired by prioritized replay, that prioritizes low-value ("hard") observations and applies importance sampling to focus limited computation on the most informative deployment conditions. Across Go1, Go2, and G1 in MuJoCo Playground under four representative shifts and multiple architectures, TEMPO yields consistent gains, reaching up to 80% improvement in a single-device setting. We further validate on a physical Unitree Go2 with an added calf payload, where fully on-device adaptation improves performance over the non-adapted baseline across real-world episodes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TEMPO 把机器人运动策略的测试时自适应 (test-time adaptation) 做成可在设备端在线运行的自监督更新：在冻结 critic 上加熵正则抑制过度自信外推，再用基于分数的记忆优先采样低价值困难观测并做重要性采样。在 MuJoCo Playground 的 Go1、Go2、G1 四类分布偏移下最高取得 80% 提升，实体 Unitree Go2 加小腿负载时也优于未自适应基线。
Motivation: RL 运动策略部署时会遇到崎岖湿滑地形、负载变化、传感退化等条件偏移，而设备端延迟与内存约束使重训练或人工重标定不可行。
Method: 起点是只更新 actor、冻结预训练 critic 作为部署期性能代理的轻量基线；TEMPO 在此之上加两部分：对 critic 预测分布的熵促进正则以缓解过度自信外推，以及受 prioritized replay 启发的基于分数的记忆，优先低价值困难观测并用重要性采样把有限算力集中在信息量大的部署条件。
Result: 在 MuJoCo Playground 的 Go1、Go2、G1 上、四类代表性偏移与多种架构下取得一致增益，单设备设置最高达 80% 提升；在实体 Unitree Go2 加小腿负载的测试中，完全在设备端的自适应在真实场景 episode 上优于未自适应基线。
Conclusion: 在冻结 critic 上同时加熵正则与困难样本记忆，可以让策略在严重偏移下于设备端在线自适应，无需奖励信号。

papers.title: Reflect After Failure: Brain-Inspired Self-Evolving Agents for Embodied Spatial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have made substantial progress in spatial reasoning, and self-evolving agents further extend these capabilities to embodied environments by learning from interactions. However, current self-evolution remains particularly challenging in embodied spatial tasks, complex and multi-step decisions from partial visual evidence making it difficult to determine why an execution fails. The failure may stem from misperception, insufficient exploration, or incorrect planning, yet execution feedback alone rarely reveals which component is responsible. As a result, simply accumulating interaction experience can reinforce ineffective strategies. To address this, we propose HiMeco, a brain-inspired self-evolving agent for embodied spatial intelligence, inspired by metacognitive monitoring and hippocampal memory consolidation. Through Hippocampal-Metacognitive Reflection, HiMeco diagnoses failures in perception-exploration-planning (PEP), then compares execution attempts to derive reusable strategies and guidance for avoiding recurring errors. It also abstracts interaction programs into parameterized skills, using evidence contracts and execution-based validation to determine their retention and reuse. These strategies and skills guide subsequent interactions, with memory updated only between rounds and model parameters kept frozen. HiMeco achieves state-of-the-art performance on ESI-Bench, and it also improves accuracy on EmbSpatial-Bench by 3.94 percentage points without evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出脑启发自进化智能体 HiMeco：用元认知监控与海马记忆巩固，在感知-探索-规划 (PEP) 三段上诊断失败归因，把执行尝试比对成可复用策略，并将交互程序抽象为带证据契约与执行验证的参数化技能，仅在轮间更新记忆、冻结模型参数。在 ESI-Bench 上达到 SOTA，EmbSpatial-Bench 在不进化条件下准确率提升 3.94 个百分点。
Motivation: 具身空间任务中失败可能源于误感知、探索不足或规划错误，仅靠执行反馈难以定位责任组件，单纯累积交互经验反而会强化无效策略。
Method: HiMeco 包含 Hippocampal-Metacognitive Reflection 模块：先在感知-探索-规划 (PEP) 上诊断失败归因，再比对多次执行推导可复用策略与避错指引；同时把交互程序抽象为参数化技能，用证据契约 (evidence contracts) 与基于执行的验证决定保留与复用，记忆只在轮间更新、模型参数保持冻结。
Result: 在 ESI-Bench 上取得 state-of-the-art 表现；在 EmbSpatial-Bench 上即使不做进化，准确率也提升 3.94 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把失败归因到 PEP 具体组件并据此提炼策略与技能，比单纯累积交互经验更能带来可迁移的具身空间能力提升，且无需更新模型参数。

papers.title: Event Cameras versus Frame Cameras for Synthetic-Aperture Imaging: A Simulation Study
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic-aperture imaging (SAI) removes occluders such as foliage by integrating many views of a scene along a camera path. It has so far been used mainly with frame cameras. We ask whether an event camera has advantages for SAI, and answer the question in simulation, where both sensors see exactly the same scene and the same camera movement. A densely rendered Blender sequence is turned into frames with an EMVA~1288 noise model of an industrial global-shutter camera, and into an event stream with the v2e simulator parameterized like a Sony IMX636. The frames are integrated with the existing airborne optical sectioning renderer. For the events we add a new integration path that projects every single event onto the focal plane at its own interpolated pose, so no events have to be binned into frames. We compare the two sensors in three main runs and an additional dark high-speed test. In a bright scene at 25,m/s the frame camera records only three images on the path and cannot remove the occluder, while the event camera reconstructs the target, even after an event-rate controller drops most of its events to fit the camera link. At the same speed in a 5,lux scene the event camera no longer resolves the target either. In a 5,lux scene at 5,m/s both sensors reconstruct the target at similar quality. We also compare the data one traversal of the aperture costs. At high speed the capped event stream still shows the target at the same data volume as the three frames. At 1,m/s we compare both cameras at two matched data budgets, and there the event camera has no advantage over the frame camera in reconstruction quality. The data rate of the event camera depends on the scene and is highest exactly in the fast bright scenes where it is needed most.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在仿真中对比事件相机与帧相机做合成孔径成像 (SAI)：逐事件按插值位姿投影到焦面的积分路径，使事件相机在 25 m/s 明亮场景（帧相机全程只采到 3 张、无法去遮挡）仍能重建目标，即使事件率控制器为适配链路丢弃了大部分事件。但 5 lux + 25 m/s 下事件相机同样失效，5 lux + 5 m/s 下两者质量相当，1 m/s 两个匹配数据预算下事件相机无优势。
Motivation: SAI 沿相机路径积分多视角以去除枝叶等遮挡，此前主要依赖帧相机；高速下帧相机采样过稀，是否换事件相机更有利缺少同场景同运动的公平比较。
Method: 用 Blender 密集渲染序列分别生成帧（EMVA 1288 工业全局快门噪声模型）与事件流（v2e 模拟器，参数化为 Sony IMX636）；帧走既有 airborne optical sectioning 渲染器，事件走新积分路径，把每个事件按自身插值位姿投影到焦面、不做帧分箱；共三次主运行加一次暗光高速测试。

papers.title: Extreme-Scale Super-Resolution of Homogeneous Turbulence from a Single Realization
papers.abstract_en: Homogeneous turbulent flows exhibit recurring multiscale structures across spatially separated regions, suggesting that a single flow realization may contain sufficient information to learn representations of unresolved scales. We investigate this hypothesis through an extreme super-resolution framework in which a wide-activation deep super-resolution (WDSR) network is trained exclusively on overlapping patches extracted from a single high-resolution turbulent realization. Previously unseen flow fields are reconstructed through patchwise prediction followed by Hann-window-weighted overlap-add assembly. The framework is evaluated for two-dimensional homogeneous isotropic turbulence at super-resolution factors of x32 and x64, representing severe spatial under-resolution. Despite the limited training data, the proposed approach reconstructs coherent vortical structures and recovers fine-scale features more accurately than conventional interpolation. Spectral and statistical analyses further demonstrate improved recovery of high-wavenumber energy content and multiscale flow characteristics. To assess the effectiveness of exploiting internal spatial information, we compare the proposed framework against WDSR models trained on 1, 25, 50, and 100 complete high-resolution snapshots without patch extraction. This comparison distinguishes the benefits of localized learning from those associated with increasing the number of training realizations. The results demonstrate that exploiting spatial redundancy within a single turbulent realization enables accurate reconstruction of previously unseen flow fields, even under extreme spatial under-resolution. These findings establish single-realization patch-based learning as a promising data-efficient approach for turbulent super-resolution when high-resolution training data are scarce.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用宽激活深度超分辨率网络 (WDSR) 仅在单个二维均匀各向同性湍流高分辨率实现的重叠 patch 上训练，配合 Hann 窗加权 overlap-add 拼装，实现 x32 与 x64 极端超分辨率重建。结果显示该单实现训练能重建相干涡结构、恢复高波数能量与多尺度统计，且优于常规插值，并可与用 1、25、50、100 个完整快照训练的 WDSR 对比，说明单实现内的空间冗余足以支撑未见流场的准确重建。
Motivation: 高分辨率湍流训练数据稀缺时，超分辨率模型难以覆盖未解析尺度；需要检验单个流实现中反复出现的多尺度结构是否已包含足够的学习信息。
Method: WDSR 网络仅在单个高分辨率湍流实现的重叠 patch 上训练，推理时逐 patch 预测并用 Hann 窗加权 overlap-add 拼装；与在 1、25、50、100 个完整高分辨率快照上训练（不做 patch 提取）的 WDSR 对比，以区分局部学习与增加训练实现数的收益。
Result: 在二维均匀各向同性湍流的 x32 与 x64 超分辨率设置下，单实现 patch 训练的重建比常规插值更准确地恢复相干涡结构与细尺度特征；谱分析与统计分析显示高波数能量与多尺度流动特征的恢复得到改善，并与用 1、25、50、100 个完整快照训练的 WDSR 进行了对比。
Conclusion: 单实现、基于 patch 的学习在高分辨率训练数据稀缺时是一种数据高效的湍流超分辨率路径，即使在极端空间欠分辨率下也能准确重建未见流场。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: SpectrumQuant: Spectrum Alignment for LLM Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Orthogonal transforms have emerged as an effective tool for low-bit quantization of large language models (LLMs), as they reshape activation distributions without changing the underlying model function. Existing approaches typically rely either on fixed data-agnostic transforms, such as Hadamard rotations, or on calibration-time optimization of learned rotations. We study rotation selection from first principles and show that maximizing covariance leads to spectral alignment and provides a principled criterion for constructing quantization-friendly orthogonal transforms. Based on this insight, we propose SpectrumQuant, a closed-form rotation method that estimates activation covariance from calibration data and uses it to construct a covariance-aware orthogonal transform for post-training quantization. Our formulation characterizes quantization-friendly rotations as compositions of alignment and mixing components, while recovering Hadamard matrices as a special case. Interestingly, a class of butterfly matrices belongs to this category. In the realm of LLM quantization, SpectrumQuant bridges the gap between data-agnostic structured rotations and learned rotations, providing an effective and efficient data-aware alternative for post-training quantization. Experiments on Llama and Mistral models show that SpectrumQuant is competitive with state-of-the-art rotation strategies while requiring less than one-third of the GPU memory and significantly less time than learned rotations approaches like SpinQuant and DartQuant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpectrumQuant 从校准数据估计激活协方差，用闭式解构造协方差感知的正交旋转做 LLM 训练后量化 (PTQ)，把数据无关的结构化旋转与学习式旋转之间的空缺补上。在 Llama 与 Mistral 上性能与 SpinQuant、DartQuant 等 SOTA 旋转策略相当，而 GPU 显存不到其三分之一，耗时也显著更低。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 低比特量化的正交变换要么用 Hadamard 这类数据无关的固定旋转，要么靠校准阶段迭代优化学习旋转，后者显存与时间开销大；缺少既有数据感知又便宜的构造方式。
Method: 从第一性原理出发证明最大化协方差可导出谱对齐 (spectral alignment)，据此用校准数据估计激活协方差并闭式构造协方差感知的正交变换；把量化友好旋转刻画为对齐分量与混合分量的复合，Hadamard 矩阵是其特例，一类 butterfly 矩阵也属于该类别。
Result: 在 Llama 与 Mistral 模型上，量化性能与 SpinQuant、DartQuant 等 SOTA 旋转策略相当，GPU 显存需求不到学习式旋转方法的三分之一，耗时显著更少。
Conclusion: 协方差最大化给出的谱对齐是构造量化友好旋转的原则性判据，闭式协方差感知旋转可在不牺牲精度的前提下取代开销大的学习式旋转。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: MMLA-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through RTT and RTMA
papers.abstract_en: An agent can improve its behavior within an unresolved problem by changing how it acts and which experience it retains. We propose MMLA-RSI, a recursive self-improvement scheme with two implementations in Memory-Mediated Learning Architecture: Reasoning-Time Training (RTT) changes the policy state $Φ$, while Reasoning-Time Memory Adaptation (RTMA) changes authoritative memory $M$. Each route also makes its adaptation method an object of improvement. A current numerical updater trains the policy proposing its successor; a current memory manager chooses the records available to the process proposing its successor. An independently admitted successor takes over the same role in the next generation. We give bounded executable rule languages, shared task/proposal interfaces, and one algorithm for either route or their composition. The RTT instance changes scalar schedules in a clipped-momentum update. The RTMA instance chooses NULL or a complete-row write with possible eviction. A fixed interpreter, trusted committer, and independent evaluator bound what can change. State versions, read closures, and conditional properties describe causal execution, accepted transitions, and finite work. Existing numerical-component studies motivate the construction. In four-candidate program selection, retaining LARC feedback updates reduces expected error by 24.65 and 36.65 percentage points for two trained initializations. In chronological continuous-integration replay, feedback binding is positive while retention increases loss. Completed SQL studies improve substantially over an unadapted substrate but do not establish the required additional online benefit. These results characterize their declared components. The two recursive routes and their joint realization are specified here; their beneficial recursive chains and discovery efficiency remain to be evaluated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MMLA-RSI 提出一种递归自我改进 (recursive self-improvement) 方案，含两条路线：Reasoning-Time Training (RTT) 改策略状态 Φ，Reasoning-Time Memory Adaptation (RTMA) 改权威记忆 M，且各自把改进方法本身也作为被改进对象。四候选程序选择中，保留 LARC 反馈更新使期望误差下降 24.65 与 36.65 个百分点（两种训练初始化）；但递归链的收益与发现效率尚待评估。
Motivation: 智能体在未解决问题中既可改行为也可改留存经验，但现有机制很少把“改进方法本身”纳入改进循环，也缺少界定哪些部分可变的执行边界。
Method: 在 Memory-Mediated Learning Architecture 中给出有界可执行规则语言、共享任务/提议接口与统一算法；RTT 实例用 clipped-momentum 更新中的标量调度，RTMA 实例在 NULL 与整行写入（可带驱逐）间选择；固定解释器、可信提交器与独立评估器约束可变范围，用状态版本、读闭包与条件性质刻画因果执行。
Result: 四候选程序选择中，保留 LARC 反馈更新使期望误差下降 24.65 和 36.65 个百分点（两种训练初始化）；按时间顺序的持续集成回放中反馈绑定为正而留存反而增大损失；SQL 研究相对未适应基质显著改善，但未确立所需的额外在线收益。
Conclusion: 两条递归路线及其联合实现已被形式化说明，但其有益递归链与发现效率仍待评估；现有结果只刻画各自声明的组件。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: CASI: Credit Assignment via Set Intervention for Agentic Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly generate multiple retrieval actions jointly, while downstream systems often provide only one reward for the resulting set. Broadcasting this reward provides a valid score-function gradient estimator for the expected set-level objective, but does not determine a coalition-dependent within-set attribution. We introduce CASI (Credit Assignment via Set Intervention for Agentic Retrieval), which constructs the missing counterfactual information through snapshot-grounded set intervention: generate and retrieve once, hold replayable snapshot components fixed, and evaluate alternative subsets under common conditions. Shapley aggregation converts these marginals into within-set credit, which bounded zero-sum advantage shaping incorporates into policy optimization. For m >= 4, singleton, leave-one-out, and full-set endpoints do not generally determine the Shapley allocation; under additive set values, extra coalition evaluations are redundant. In a five-action sponsored-search setting, exhaustive auction replay over 1,200 requests reveals substantial coalition dependence. Under the training-time evaluator, CASI achieves the highest median cosine similarity to a replay-defined Shapley reference among evaluated credit rules; under a sensitivity backend, CASI does not outperform Singleton. Across five independent training runs, CASI-trained policies achieve higher held-out auction-replay set value than Singleton- or Broadcast-trained policies. In a randomized seven-day production A/B test on 10% of traffic, the CASI-trained policy yields an observed 3.51% lift in the primary advertiser-value metric over production control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CASI 用快照接地的集合干预 (snapshot-grounded set intervention) 为 LLM 多动作检索的集合级奖励做反事实归因：生成与检索一次后固定可回放快照，只替换子集评估，再用 Shapley 聚合得到集合内 credit，经零和优势整形 (zero-sum advantage shaping) 进入策略优化。在五动作赞助搜索设定中，1,200 条请求的穷举拍卖回放显示 credit 显著依赖联盟结构；七天 10% 流量生产 A/B 中主指标（广告主价值）相对线上对照提升 3.51%。
Motivation: LLM 一次联合产生多个检索动作，下游却只给整集合一个奖励；广播该奖励虽是集合目标的有效 score-function 梯度估计，但无法决定集合内各动作的联盟相关归因。
Method: 生成并检索一次后固定可回放的快照组件，在共同条件下评估备选子集得到边际贡献，用 Shapley 聚合转为集合内 credit，再由有界的零和优势整形并入策略优化；论文还给出 m ≥ 4 时 singleton、leave-one-out 与 full-set 端点一般不足以确定 Shapley 分配、而加性集合值下额外联盟评估冗余的结论。
Result: 五动作赞助搜索设定中，1,200 条请求的穷举拍卖回放揭示显著的联盟依赖；训练时评估器下 CASI 对回放定义的 Shapley 参考的中位余弦相似度在所评 credit 规则中最高，敏感性后端下 CASI 不优于 Singleton；五次独立训练中 CASI 策略的留出拍卖回放集合值高于 Singleton 与 Broadcast 训练的策略；七天 10% 流量随机生产 A/B 中主广告主价值指标相对生产对照观测到 3.51% 提升。
Conclusion: 集合级奖励必须补上联盟相关的反事实归因才能定出集合内 credit，CASI 的快照干预加 Shapley 聚合在赞助搜索上同时改善离线归因一致性与线上主指标；但其优势依赖评估后端，敏感性后端下并不胜过 Singleton。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 生成并检索一次后固定可回放的快照组件，在共同条件下评估备选子集得到边际贡献，用 Shapley 聚合转为集合内 credit，再由有界的零和优势整形并入策略优化；论文还给出 m ≥ 4 时 singleton、leave-one-out 与 full-set 端点一般不足以确定 Shapley 分配、而加性集合值下额外联盟评估冗余的结论。
summary_sections.result: 五动作赞助搜索设定中，1,200 条请求的穷举拍卖回放揭示显著的联盟依赖；训练时评估器下 CASI 对回放定义的 Shapley 参考的中位余弦相似度在所评 credit 规则中最高，敏感性后端下 CASI 不优于 Singleton；五次独立训练中 CASI 策略的留出拍卖回放集合值高于 Singleton 与 Broadcast 训练的策略；七天 10% 流量随机生产 A/B 中主广告主价值指标相对生产对照观测到 3.51% 提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 集合级奖励必须补上联盟相关的反事实归因才能定出集合内 credit，CASI 的快照干预加 Shapley 聚合在赞助搜索上同时改善离线归因一致性与线上主指标；但其优势依赖评估后端，敏感性后端下并不胜过 Singleton。

papers.title: Predicting Unseen Scientific Interactions: Conditional Flow Models Hallucinate Non-Additive Effects
papers.abstract_en: Conditional generative models are increasingly used for scientific prediction beyond the direct training support. Yet scientific questions often concern whether one intervention changes the effect of another. Such interactions can be of primary interest while explaining little of the total variation, allowing models to appear accurate overall without recovering the relevant scientific effect. It remains unclear how these models learn interactions and when these successfully extrapolate to unseen conditions. We therefore study interaction recovery in flow-matching models using a physiological time-series simulator, drug dose-response data, combinatorial cell perturbations, and molecular conformer generations, where we separate recovery from hallucinated interaction structure. In the controlled setting, individual effects are learned much earlier than interactions and models hallucinate interactions where none exist. Across settings, we find qualitatively different generalization problems, with successful prediction depending on whether condition structure continues from observed to held-out targets. When it does, interactions are recoverable. If not, models can generate plausible responses while missing the interaction. We furthermore find that hallucinations increase as targets become less identifiable, and that successful interaction recovery in output space can fail under nonlinear readouts. Finally, we show that aggregate fidelity metrics can conceal whether models learn and extrapolate interactions.
papers.comment: Accepted as an oral at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: AI Data Readiness for Scientific Discovery (AIDaR). Code: https://github.com/SamGijsen/interaction-flows
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究条件流模型 (conditional flow matching) 在训练支撑之外能否恢复科学交互效应：在生理时间序列模拟器、药物剂量-反应、组合细胞扰扑与分子构象生成四类任务上，主效应远早于交互被学到，且模型会在不存在交互处幻觉出交互结构。当 held-out 条件结构能从观测条件延续时交互可恢复；不能延续时模型仍给出貌似合理的响应却漏掉交互，且目标可辨识性越低幻觉越多、输出空间的交互恢复在非线性 readout 下会失效。
Motivation: 科学问题常关心一个干预是否改变另一个干预的效应，而交互效应可能只占总变异的一小部分，使条件生成模型在总体精度指标上看似准确却没学到真正的科学效应；目前不清楚这类模型如何学交互、何时能外推到未见条件。
Method: 在 flow-matching 模型上研究交互恢复，用四类数据集分离真实恢复与幻觉的交互结构：生理时间序列模拟器（受控设定）、药物剂量-反应数据、组合细胞扰动、分子构象生成；并检验输出空间交互恢复在非线性 readout 下的表现，以及聚合保真度指标是否掩盖交互学习情况。
Result: 受控设定中主效应远早于交互被学到，模型在无交互处产生幻觉；跨设定发现泛化问题性质不同，成功与否取决于条件结构是否从观测延续到 held-out 目标——可延续时交互可恢复，不可延续时响应貌似合理但交互缺失；幻觉随目标可辨识性下降而增加；输出空间的交互恢复在非线性 readout 下会失败；聚合保真度指标会掩盖模型是否学到并外推交互。
Conclusion: 条件生成模型在训练支撑外的交互恢复取决于条件结构的延续性与目标可辨识性，总体保真度指标不足以判断交互是否被学到，评估时需单独检验交互恢复而非只看聚合精度。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: From Plato to Aristotle: Toward a General Theory of Representation Hypotheses
papers.abstract_en: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) holds that increasingly capable models converge toward a common representation. However, recent studies have shown different views on aligning representations via their neighborhoods, spanning trees, and distances. We show that these views can differ because the alignment criteria behind them sit at different points of one lattice, and we formalize this explanation as the Lattice Representation Hypothesis (LRH). Under the LRH, the convergence claimed by the PRH is agreement at the top of the lattice, whereas its evidence comes from neighbor overlap, a criterion near the bottom. The Aristotelian Representation Hypothesis (ARH) restricts convergence to local neighborhoods because calibration keeps the growth of neighbor overlap with model size but largely removes that of centered kernel alignment. We show that this removal can come from calibrating a maximum over layers, so global convergence remains open. Back into Plato's Cave (BPC) infers coarse shared structure from the collapse of neighbor overlap on larger evaluation sets, whereas we trace it at least partly to a fixed number of neighbors covering shorter distances. We show that the spanning-tree overlap used by Structure over Geometry (SOG) mostly repeats one-nearest-neighbor overlap. The LRH also extends to independently trained models, whose training procedure and objective decide the criteria met reliably across runs. We prove this claim for the training procedure in a linear autoencoder and for the objective in a finite contrastive Gibbs model. Experiments on dozens of pretrained vision and language models and thousands of runs of both theoretical models support these conclusions. We hope this work paves the way toward a general theory of representation hypotheses, with a framework to analyze them and compare their evidence. Project page: https://eethanshi.github.io/LRH
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 PRH、ARH、BPC、SOG 等表征收敛观点统一到一个对齐准则格 (lattice) 上，形式化为 Lattice Representation Hypothesis (LRH)：PRH 声称的收敛是格顶的一致，而其证据（邻居重叠）位于格底，二者不在同一准则上。ARH 把收敛限制在局部邻域，因为校准基本保留邻居重叠随模型规模的增长、却大幅削掉 centered kernel alignment 的增长，故全局收敛仍属未决问题。
Motivation: 近期研究对「模型表征是否收敛」给出互相冲突的结论（邻域重叠、生成树、距离等视角各执一词），原因是这些对齐准则处在同一格的不同层级，被当作同一命题的证据来比较。
Method: 提出 LRH，把各类对齐准则组织成一个格并说明 PRH 的主张与证据分处格顶与格底；分析 ARH 的局部收敛限制（校准作用于跨层 maximum，保留邻居重叠增长而移除 CKA 增长），指出 BPC 的邻居重叠坍缩部分源于固定邻居数覆盖更短距离、SOG 的生成树重叠基本重复 one-nearest-neighbor 重叠；并为线性自编码器的训练过程与有限 contrastive Gibbs 模型的目标各证明一条关于跨次训练一致性的结论。
Result: 在数十个预训练视觉与语言模型上的实验，以及两个理论模型的数千次运行，支持上述结论；校准使邻居重叠随模型规模的增长基本保持、而 centered kernel alignment 的增长被大幅移除；固定邻居数在更大评估集上覆盖更短距离，可部分解释邻居重叠的坍缩；SOG 的生成树重叠大多重复 one-nearest-neighbor 重叠。
Conclusion: 表征收敛的相互矛盾证据可以由准则所处的格层级解释，全局收敛仍未解决；跨次训练中哪些准则被可靠满足由训练过程与目标决定，这为表征假说的一般理论提供了分析与比较证据的框架。
Relevance: 18
