papers.title: A Valid Watermark Is Not a Valid Identity: Spatial-Spectral Adversarial Face Evasion with Watermark Preservation
papers.abstract_en: Facial image watermarking can support traceability and certification in biometric pipelines, but provenance or manipulation detection alone does not guarantee reliable biometric identity. We introduce a watermark-preserving face evasion attack that targets this gap under a black-box watermarking setting, without access to the watermarking components. The proposed PGD-L_2 attack guides adversarial perturbations with spatial and spectral preservation terms to reduce face-recognition similarity while limiting pixel-level distortion and high-frequency changes that may interfere with hidden watermark cues. Evaluated on controlled facial images with two watermarking schemes, two face-recognition models, and two datasets, the attack achieves evasion rates above 92% at operational thresholds while preserving watermark recovery above 93% for StegaFormer and above 99.7% for FaceSigns, with visual quality above 47dB PSNR at epsilon_2=2.0. These results expose a structural gap in watermark-based facial certification: a face image can remain watermark-valid and visually faithful while becoming biometrically unreliable.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE International Joint Conference on Biometrics (IJCB 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出黑盒设定下的水印保持人脸逃逸攻击 PGD-L_2：用空间与频谱保持项约束对抗扰动，在压低人脸识别相似度的同时不破坏隐藏水印。在两种水印方案、两个人脸识别模型和两个数据集上，操作阈值下逃逸率超过 92%，同时 StegaFormer 水印恢复率保持在 93% 以上、FaceSigns 超过 99.7%，epsilon_2=2.0 时 PSNR 高于 47dB。
Motivation: 人脸图像水印可支撑生物特征流程的溯源与认证，但水印有效性或篡改检测并不等于可靠的生物身份，二者之间的结构性缺口缺少攻击层面的验证。
Method: 在无法访问水印组件的黑盒水印设定下，PGD-L_2 攻击以空间保持项与频谱保持项引导对抗扰动，既降低人脸识别相似度，又限制像素级失真和可能干扰隐藏水印线索的高频变化。
Result: 在受控人脸图像上，用两种水印方案、两个人脸识别模型和两个数据集评估：操作阈值下逃逸率超过 92%，水印恢复率对 StegaFormer 保持在 93% 以上、对 FaceSigns 超过 99.7%，epsilon_2=2.0 时视觉质量 PSNR 高于 47dB。
Conclusion: 一张人脸图像可以在保持水印有效与视觉忠实的同时变得生物特征上不可靠，说明基于水印的人脸认证存在结构性缺口。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TANGO: RNA Topology and Geometry Co-Design
papers.abstract_en: Designing RNA sequences that satisfy target tertiary-structure objectives is an important problem in RNA engineering, with broad applications in synthetic biology and therapeutics. Existing 3D RNA design methods have made substantial progress, but they largely treat the target fold as a geometry-only objective. This is incomplete for RNA, whose functional folds are specified not only by tertiary geometry but also by secondary base-pairing topology. We therefore formulate RNA inverse design as a topology-and-geometry co-design problem and propose TANGO, a multi-objective multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for this task. TANGO adopts a staged curriculum: it first learns a topology-aware policy from secondary-structure targets, then transfers this policy to tertiary-structure targets to train a general co-design model, and finally applies frontier-guided fine-tuning to refine target-specific trade-offs among secondary-structure fidelity, tertiary-structure fidelity, and sequence diversity. Experiments show that TANGO generates diverse and novel designs, improving tertiary- and secondary-structure performance by 18.3% and 52.7%, respectively, over the strongest baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TANGO 把 RNA 逆设计改写成二级结构拓扑与三级结构几何的多目标协同设计问题，用多智能体强化学习的分阶段课程先学拓扑感知策略、再迁移到三级结构目标、最后做前沿引导微调。在相对最强基线上，三级结构与二级结构性能分别提升 18.3% 与 52.7%，并生成多样且新颖的序列设计。
Motivation: 现有 3D RNA 设计方法把目标折叠只当作几何目标，忽略了 RNA 功能折叠还由二级碱基配对拓扑指定，导致设计目标不完整。
Method: 提出 TANGO：多目标多智能体强化学习框架，采用分阶段课程——先从二级结构目标学习拓扑感知策略，再把该策略迁移到三级结构目标训练通用协同设计模型，最后用 frontier-guided fine-tuning 在二级结构保真度、三级结构保真度与序列多样性之间做目标特定权衡。
Result: 相对最强基线，三级结构性能提升 18.3%，二级结构性能提升 52.7%；生成的设计被描述为多样且新颖。
Conclusion: 把二级结构拓扑与三级结构几何作为联合目标协同设计，比几何单一目标更能同时抬高两类结构保真度并保持序列多样性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 把二级结构拓扑与三级结构几何作为联合目标协同设计，比几何单一目标更能同时抬高两类结构保真度并保持序列多样性。

papers.title: Resolution Allocation with Learnable Resizing and Spectral Filter Parameterization
papers.abstract_en: Learnable downsampling and spectral-domain filter parameterizations have each made convolutional networks more flexible, but their interaction has not been systematically examined. We bridge this gap by examining convolutional kernels learned in the spatial and spectral domains, together with learned downsampling ratios under a cropped resizing implementation. We find that spectral and spatial kernels respond differently to learned resolution allocation, with larger gains for the spectral kernel. We observe this consistently on three datasets (EuroSAT, CIFAR-10 and STL-10) and at two model sizes (differences in accuracy gain of +0.013 to +0.028 on held-out test sets). Part of this difference reflects the greater gain of the spectral kernel from retaining more spatial area, but the difference remains positive when total retained area is matched. This pattern is observed across datasets and model sizes, although its magnitude and dependence on the complexity budget vary with model size and the resizing implementation.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在卷积网络中系统比较空间域与谱域 (spectral domain) 核参数化在可学习下采样比（cropped resizing 实现）下的表现：谱核对可学习分辨率分配的响应更大，留出测试集上准确率增益比空间核高 +0.013 到 +0.028，且在总保留面积匹配后差值仍为正。
Motivation: 可学习下采样与谱域滤波参数化各自提升了卷积网络的灵活性，但两者如何相互作用此前没有被系统研究，尤其是分辨率分配如何差异化地影响两类核。
Method: 在 cropped resizing 实现下联合学习卷积核（空间域 vs 谱域参数化）与下采样比，在 EuroSAT、CIFAR-10、STL-10 三个数据集和两种模型规模上做对照，并控制总保留空间面积以分离“保留更多空间区域”这一因素。

papers.title: CSWBench: Evaluating Context-Sensitive Code-Switching in Creative Writing
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated multilingual capabilities across diverse language generation and understanding tasks. Yet effective code-switching requires more than multilingual proficiency: models must decide when, where, and why to switch languages in ways that fit the surrounding context. This context-sensitive ability remains insufficiently evaluated. We introduce CSWBench, a benchmark for evaluating context-sensitive code-switching in creative writing through two complementary settings: Focused Narrative and Extended Narrative. We further propose CSWEval, a theory-informed framework with two complementary levels: event-level evaluation of Licensing, Contextual Appropriateness, and Functional Gain, and whole-text evaluation of task-specific quality---overall literary and narrative quality in Focused Narrative and quality emphasizing multilingual organization in Extended Narrative. Evaluating twelve LLMs, we find that models exhibit meaningful but uneven code-switching competence across narrative contexts. Model differences are particularly pronounced in multilingual literary integration, while multilingual-focused dimensions show stronger difficulty effects overall than the general narrative dimensions; narratively salient switches are associated with stronger contextual and functional realization; and event-level CS quality is moderately associated with whole-text performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CSWBench，评测 LLM 在创意写作中按上下文决定何时、何处、为何切换语言的能力，含 Focused Narrative 与 Extended Narrative 两种设定；配套 CSWEval 从事件级（Licensing、Contextual Appropriateness、Functional Gain）与全文级两个层面打分。评测 12 个 LLM 显示语境敏感的语码转换能力存在但不均衡，模型差异在多语文学性整合上最突出。
Motivation: 多语能力不等于语码转换能力：模型需依上下文决定切换时机与位置，而这一能力此前缺少系统评测。
Method: CSWBench 设 Focused Narrative 与 Extended Narrative 两个互补设定；CSWEval 事件级评 Licensing、Contextual Appropriateness、Functional Gain，全文级评任务特定质量（前者为整体文学与叙事质量，后者强调多语组织），共评 12 个 LLM。
Result: 12 个 LLM 的语码转换能力有意义但不均衡；模型差异在多语文学性整合维度最显著；多语聚焦维度整体上比一般叙事维度表现出更强的难度效应；叙事上显著的切换与更强的语境与功能实现相关；事件级语码转换质量与全文表现中度相关。
Conclusion: 语码转换需按上下文评测而非只看多语能力，且事件级质量与全文质量只是中度关联，两者应分开度量。

papers.title: FlowSep-RF: Rectified Flow Matching for Single-Channel Radio-Frequency Signal Separation
papers.abstract_en: Single-channel radio-frequency (RF) signal separation is important for interference mitigation when a signal of interest overlaps with a co-channel interferer in time and frequency. Classical matched filtering and LMMSE receivers are limited under structured non-Gaussian interference, while diffusion and score-based methods often require iterative sampling or optimization. We propose FlowSep-RF, a rectified flow matching framework that learns a clean-endpoint transport from the received mixture to the signal of interest. The model combines time-domain IQ samples with frequency-domain features and recovers the separated waveform using one endpoint velocity evaluation. We evaluate FlowSep-RF on QPSK mixtures with OFDM-BPSK, OFDM-QPSK, and RFChallenge CommSignal2 interference against classical, discriminative, and generative baselines. FlowSep-RF achieves the lowest average BER and MSE among evaluated baselines across all three settings with one-step inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlowSep-RF 用整流流匹配 (rectified flow matching) 学习从接收混合信号到目标信号的干净端点传输，把时域 IQ 采样与频域特征结合，仅用一次端点速度评估即可恢复分离波形。在 QPSK 与 OFDM-BPSK、OFDM-QPSK、RFChallenge CommSignal2 三类干扰的混合上，其平均 BER 与 MSE 在所有被评估基线中最低，且推理只需一步。
Motivation: 单通道射频信号分离中，匹配滤波与 LMMSE 接收机在结构化非高斯干扰下受限，而扩散/score 类方法需要迭代采样或优化，实时干扰抑制难以落地。
Method: 提出 FlowSep-RF：以整流流匹配建模从接收混合到感兴趣信号的传输，网络输入同时包含时域 IQ 采样与频域特征，推理时只做一次端点速度评估得到分离波形；对比对象包括经典、判别式与生成式基线。
Result: 在 QPSK 信号叠加 OFDM-BPSK、OFDM-QPSK 与 RFChallenge CommSignal2 干扰的三个设置上，FlowSep-RF 取得所有被评估基线中最低的平均 BER 与 MSE，并保持一步推理。
Conclusion: 整流流匹配可以把生成式分离的多步采样压缩到单步，同时在结构化共道干扰下保持比经典与判别式接收机更低的 BER/MSE。

papers.title: FUSE: Fairness-aware Update Screening against Byzantine Exploitation in $q$-Fair Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Client-level fair federated learning, in the form of $q$-fair federated learning ($q$-FFL), agnostic federated learning, or tilted empirical risk minimization, has emerged as an attractive solution to equalize utility across heterogeneous clients. This paradigm grants high-loss clients greater relative influence, while a central server aggregates their loss-weighted updates into a single shared model. Yet, the Byzantine robustness of $q$-fair federated learning has been largely neglected, leaving the server unable to tell legitimate fairness-induced amplification from malicious update scaling. To address this critical gap, we formalize the problem of Byzantine-robust $q$-fair federated learning under an \emph{update-only interface}, in which the server observes nothing but the fairness-scaled client updates. Our analysis under shared class-conditional label skew shows that fairness scaling preserves the nonnegative class-mixture structure of honest updates, while replacing their unit-sum constraint by a client-dependent radial scale. Moving beyond magnitude-based screening, we show that this warped geometry supplies two complementary tests, one radial and one structural, that a single norm cannot provide. We then introduce FUSE, a structure-aware robust aggregator that uses a small trusted labeled dataset for coefficient recovery, scale and cone-consistency screening, and post-screening step-size control. Across four benchmarks and seven Byzantine attacks, FUSE improves seed-wise worst-attack accuracy over the strongest baseline on each benchmark by 3.9--30.1 percentage points, while largely preserving the influence of the high-loss honest clients that fairness is meant to protect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在只看得到公平缩放后客户端更新的 update-only 接口下，FUSE 用小规模可信标注集做系数恢复，再用径向与结构（cone 一致性）双重筛查加筛查后步长控制，区分公平放大与拜占庭恶意放大。在四个基准、七种拜占庭攻击下，逐种子最差攻击准确率比各基准最强基线高 3.9–30.1 个百分点，同时大体保留高损失诚实客户端的影响。
Motivation: q-FFL、agnostic federated learning、tilted ERM 会给高损失客户端更大权重，服务器无法区分公平诱导的放大与恶意更新缩放；q-fair 联邦学习的拜占庭鲁棒性此前基本被忽略。
Method: 在共享 class-conditional label skew 假设下分析：公平缩放保持诚实更新的非负类混合结构，只把单位和约束换成客户端相关的径向尺度。FUSE 借此做两个互补检验（一个径向、一个结构），用小规模可信标注数据集恢复系数，执行 scale 与 cone-consistency 筛查，并在筛查后做步长控制。
Result: 在四个基准与七种拜占庭攻击下，FUSE 的 seed-wise 最差攻击准确率比每个基准上最强基线高 3.9–30.1 个百分点，同时大体保留公平本应保护的高损失诚实客户端的影响。
Conclusion: 公平缩放扭曲后的更新几何提供了单一范数筛查拿不到的径向与结构两类判据，使 update-only 接口下的 q-fair 联邦学习能同时抗拜占庭并保住公平性。

papers.title: Harness Policy Distillation: Aligning Agent Policies with Runtime Semantics
papers.abstract_en: Deploying a general-purpose model as an agent means running it inside a product-specific runtime harness that decides which actions are executable, how state advances, and when the loop may terminate. Ordinary trajectory supervision shows which action was taken but leaves the runtime semantics behind that action implicit. We introduce Harness Policy Distillation (HPD), which makes these runtime control semantics an explicit training target alongside actions to align the harness policy. HPD replays reference trajectories through the harness to recover the runtime semantics that are implicit in ordinary trajectory data, and represents them as control documents at each model-call boundary. These documents provide privileged information for a teacher to generate actions, while harness verification ensures that the resulting targets are executable under the runtime contract. We jointly train a shared model on the runtime semantics recovered from control-state privileged information and native history, thereby internalizing these semantics into the model policy. At deployment, the trained model uses the original harness interface without requiring the control document or any additional supplement. On TRAJECT-Bench with the Pi harness, Qwen3-8B trained with HPD reaches 22.98% autonomous task success and 49.23% runtime compliance, against 3.09% and 19.90% for the unadapted model. Harness-verified teacher actions substantially improve the native deployment policy, while joint control-state supervision provides further gains in task completion and runtime compliance. HPD turns executable runtime semantics into dense supervision for learning harness-compatible actions at each decision boundary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Harness Policy Distillation (HPD)，把 agent 在产品运行时 harness 中的控制语义（哪些动作可执行、状态如何推进、循环何时终止）作为显式训练目标，与动作一起蒸馏进模型。在 TRAJECT-Bench 的 Pi harness 上，Qwen3-8B 经 HPD 训练后自主任务成功率从 3.09% 升到 22.98%，运行时合规率从 19.90% 升到 49.23%。
Motivation: 通用模型作为 agent 部署时受产品专属 runtime harness 约束，而普通轨迹监督只标注实际采取的动作，动作背后的运行时语义是隐式的，导致策略与 harness 契约不对齐。
Method: HPD 将参考轨迹在 harness 中重放，恢复隐含的运行时语义并表示为每个模型调用边界上的 control document；该文档为 teacher 提供特权信息生成动作，harness verification 保证目标在运行时契约下可执行；随后在 control-state 特权信息与原生历史两路语义上联合训练共享模型，部署时只用原始 harness 接口，不再需要 control document。
Result: TRAJECT-Bench + Pi harness 上，HPD 训练的 Qwen3-8B 自主任务成功率 22.98%、运行时合规率 49.23%，未适配模型分别为 3.09% 与 19.90%；harness 校验的 teacher 动作显著改善原生部署策略，联合 control-state 监督在任务完成与运行时合规上带来进一步增益。
Conclusion: 把可执行的运行时语义转成每个决策边界的稠密监督，就能让模型策略与 harness 契约对齐，且部署时无需特权控制文档。

papers.title: Long-Horizon RL Needs Muon
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents must coordinate reasoning, tool use, and environment feedback over extended interactions. Learning from sparse outcome rewards requires weighting trajectories of different lengths and updating the policy while rollouts are still being collected. We examine a single-rollout asynchronous recipe combining Muon, token-averaged loss, truncated importance sampling, and auxiliary length and tool-error penalties. Single-rollout sampling allows asynchronous learning without waiting for multiple trajectories for the same issue. We study optimizer choices and recipe components for repository-level issue resolution across two model families. The evaluated training runs show higher training success with the full recipe than with the baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对长时程智能体在稀疏结果奖励下的强化学习，提出单 rollout 异步训练配方：Muon 优化器 + token 平均损失 + 截断重要性采样 (truncated importance sampling) + 辅助长度与工具错误惩罚，使策略可在 rollout 采集过程中边采边更新。在两个模型家族的仓库级 issue resolution 上，完整配方的训练成功率高于各基线。
Motivation: 长时程智能体交互轨迹长短不一，稀疏结果奖励需要对不同长度轨迹加权，而同步训练必须等同一 issue 的多条轨迹采完才能更新，造成算力闲置与学习低效。
Method: 单 rollout 异步配方：Muon 优化器配合 token 平均损失处理变长轨迹权重，截断重要性采样支持边采集边更新策略，另加辅助的轨迹长度惩罚与工具错误惩罚；在两个模型家族上研究优化器选择与各配方组件的贡献，任务为仓库级 issue resolution。
Result: 在两个模型家族的仓库级 issue resolution 训练中，完整配方（Muon + token 平均损失 + 截断重要性采样 + 长度/工具错误惩罚）的训练成功率高于所比较的基线训练运行。
Conclusion: 单 rollout 异步采样配合 Muon 与变长轨迹加权，可在不等待多条同 issue 轨迹的前提下提升长时程稀疏奖励 RL 的训练成功率。

papers.title: GLoD-LVSM: Learning Geometry-Grounded Continuous-LoD Scene Representations for Large View Synthesis Models
papers.abstract_en: Large view synthesis models (LVSMs) reconstruct scenes from sparse views and render novel views quickly, but they incur unnecessary storage and rendering costs due to token redundancy. We present GLoD-LVSM, a compact, geometry-grounded scene representation for LVSMs with continuous levels of detail. First, instead of learning a fixed set of scene anchor initializations, GLoD-LVSM learns a continuous field that initializes a flexible number of anchors to match the desired budget. A condenser then aggregates scene information into these anchors, with both the field and condenser trained end-to-end. Second, the condenser infers reference-token and anchor geometry to guide compression through geometry-grounded attention, improving rendering quality and enabling frustum culling during decoding. Compared with existing LVSM scene-compression baselines, GLoD-LVSM achieves the best trade-off between rendering quality and scene token count. Compared with the uncompressed base model, GLoD-LVSM reduces the scene-token count by 33.4% and accelerates rendering by $1.23\times$ with no quality loss. Under a relaxed quality-loss budget, the reduction increases to 85.5%, with $3.00\times$ rendering speedup. Further analysis reveals that view-synthesis supervision yields emergent scene depth and self-organized anchors that align with surfaces and adapt their density to local texture complexity. Beyond rendering, we further show that our scene representation also supports scene-semantic understanding, highlighting its potential for broader downstream tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GLoD-LVSM 用连续 LoD 的几何锚点场替代固定锚点集，把稀疏视角大视场合成模型的场景 token 压缩到 33.4% 且渲染加速 1.23×、质量无损；在放宽质量损失预算下压缩 85.5%、加速 3.00×。视角合成监督还会涌现场景深度与贴合表面、随局部纹理复杂度自适应密度的锚点。
Motivation: LVSM 能从稀疏视角快速渲染新视角，但 token 冗余带来不必要的存储与渲染开销，现有场景压缩方法在质量与 token 数之间权衡不佳。
Method: 学习一个连续场，按目标预算初始化可变数量的锚点，再由 condenser 聚合场景信息到锚点，场与 condenser 端到端联合训练；condenser 推断参考 token 与锚点几何，用 geometry-grounded attention 引导压缩，并在解码时支持视锥剔除 (frustum culling)。
Result: 相比未压缩基线模型，场景 token 数减少 33.4%、渲染加速 1.23× 且质量无损；在放宽的质量损失预算下，token 减少达 85.5%、渲染加速 3.00×。与现有 LVSM 场景压缩基线相比，在渲染质量与场景 token 数之间取得最佳权衡。
Conclusion: 几何接地的连续 LoD 锚点表示可以在不损失渲染质量的前提下大幅压缩 LVSM 场景 token 并提速，且视角合成监督本身即可涌现出与表面对齐的深度和自适应密度锚点，表示还可支撑场景语义理解等下游任务。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Adversarial Reinforcement Learning for Robust Planetary Landing
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) policies for planetary landing and other aerospace guidance, navigation, and control tasks are commonly trained under randomized disturbances to improve robustness. However, typical stochastic perturbation sampling assumes independent variations, whereas real mission disturbances often exhibit spatial and temporal correlation and cannot be reproduced through independent random draws. This work investigates adversarial reinforcement learning to discover challenging off-nominal conditions. A secondary agent generates physically constrained perturbations that degrade the performance of a landing controller, forming an asymmetric sequential zero-sum game. Training proceeds in three stages: baseline controller learning, robustness enhancement with stochastic perturbations, and an iterative adversarial phase in which the controller and disturbance generator are alternately optimized. Preliminary experiments in a three-degree-of-freedom landing environment show that adversarial disturbances reveal vulnerabilities missed by conventional randomization and provide early indications that, with a more extensive training campaign, the approach can yield improved robustness and stronger generalization under previously unseen perturbation regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对行星着陆 DRL 控制器在独立随机扰动下漏掉相关性扰动漏洞的问题，用对抗强化学习训练一个物理约束的扰动生成器，与控制器构成非对称序贯零和博弈，三阶段交替优化。三自由度着陆环境的初步实验显示，对抗扰动暴露了常规随机化遗漏的脆弱点。
Motivation: 着陆与航天 GNC 的 DRL 策略通常靠随机扰动提升鲁棒性，但独立采样假设与真实任务中时空相关的扰动不符，随机化覆盖不到这类 off-nominal 工况。
Method: 训练分三阶段：先学基线控制器，再用随机扰动做鲁棒性增强，最后进入迭代对抗阶段，控制器与扰动生成器交替优化；次级 agent 生成物理约束的扰动以劣化着陆控制器性能，构成非对称序贯零和博弈。
Result: 在三自由度 (3-DOF) 着陆环境的初步实验中，对抗扰动揭示了常规随机化遗漏的脆弱点；作者称在更大规模训练下该方法有望提升鲁棒性与对未见扰动体制的泛化。
Conclusion: 对抗式扰动生成比独立随机采样更能找出着陆控制器的薄弱工况，但当前证据来自初步实验，更强的鲁棒性与泛化有待更充分训练验证。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Contrastive uncertainty learning for robust multi-structure segmentation in lower-pelvic MR
papers.abstract_en: Boundary delineation of anatomical structures in prostate MRI is often compromised by regional ambiguity. Automated segmentation methods relying on global overlap loss functions tend to be insensitive to surface deviations, leading to significant errors in ambiguous regions. Most existing uncertainty-aware methods treat uncertainty as a post-hoc quality indicator or prediction filter. We propose Contrastive Uncertainty Learning (CUL), a supervised framework that uses predictive uncertainty to directly guide representation learning. Using Monte Carlo Dropout, CUL identifies voxel-wise uncertainty and structures the embedding geometry accordingly: low-uncertainty, correctly predicted features form stable voxels while high-uncertainty or misclassified features are actively repelled, preventing feature collapse at difficult boundaries. We evaluate CUL on a 589-scan 3D prostate MRI multi-structure segmentation task (8 anatomical structures) using a ViT with UperNet decoder architecture. Average Dice ($83.38\%$) remains comparable to the baseline ($83.35\%$), while surface distance decreases significantly ($p<0.001$) across 6 of 8 anatomical structures. A hard-case analysis reveals a $22{\times}$ asymmetry between significantly improved and degraded cases ($18.8\%$ vs $0.9\%$). Ablation studies show that removing uncertainty-guided sample selection eliminates improvements for the transition zone, while replacing the contrastive objective with a boundary loss additionally removes bladder improvements, demonstrating that both uncertainty-guided sampling and the contrastive objective are essential for the observed gains. These findings demonstrate that the proposed uncertainty-guided representation learning is a useful mechanism for reducing the risk of extreme errors in safety-critical medical segmentation
papers.journal_ref: Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention -- MICCAI 2026 Workshops and Challenges
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Contrastive Uncertainty Learning (CUL)：用 Monte Carlo Dropout 得到体素级预测不确定性，把低不确定且预测正确的特征聚成稳定簇、主动排斥高不确定或误分类特征，从而在困难边界处防止特征塌缩。在 589 例 3D 前列腺 MRI、8 个解剖结构的分割上，平均 Dice 83.38% 与基线 83.35% 持平，但表面距离在 8 个结构中的 6 个上显著下降（p<0.001），硬案例中显著改善与恶化的比例为 18.8% 对 0.9%（约 22 倍不对称）。
Motivation: 前列腺 MRI 中区域模糊导致边界勾画困难，基于全局重叠损失的分割对表面偏差不敏感，而现有不确定性方法只把不确定性当作事后质量指标或预测过滤器，不参与表征学习。
Method: CUL 是有监督框架：先用 Monte Carlo Dropout 估计体素级预测不确定性，再据此构造嵌入几何——低不确定且正确的特征作为稳定体素，高不确定或误分类特征被主动排斥；骨干为 ViT 加 UperNet decoder。消融中移除不确定性引导的样本选择，或把对比目标换成 boundary loss。
Result: 在 589 例 3D 前列腺 MRI 多结构分割（8 个解剖结构）上，平均 Dice 83.38%，与基线 83.35% 基本持平；表面距离在 8 个结构中的 6 个上显著下降（p<0.001）。硬案例分析中显著改善案例占 18.8%、恶化占 0.9%，约 22 倍不对称。消融显示去掉不确定性引导样本选择后 transition zone 的改善消失，把对比目标换成 boundary loss 后 bladder 的改善也消失。
Conclusion: 不确定性引导的表征学习能在不损失平均 Dice 的前提下压低极端表面误差风险，且不确定性引导采样与对比目标两者缺一不可。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Scaling Multilingual Mixture-of-Experts: How Language Coverage Changes Capacity and Compute Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Multilingual models share capacity across languages, so adding languages can hurt performance on existing ones. Mixture-of-experts models expand this capacity with little additional per-token computation. Given this extra capacity, does adding experts reduce what each additional language costs? To answer this question, we propose a repetition-aware joint scaling law relating number of active parameters, training tokens per language, number of experts, and language coverage. Fitted on 26,300 per-language loss observations from 64 pretrained configurations, our law reduces prediction error on held-out configurations by 28% relative to the strongest evaluated baseline. At matched number of active parameters and training tokens per language, 32 experts reduce the loss penalty of expanding from 12 to 200 languages by 83% compared with a dense model. Our law further shows that broader language coverage favors more experts across a wider range of compute budgets, guiding capacity allocation as multilingual models scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 repetition-aware 联合 scaling law，把活跃参数量、每语言训练 token 数、专家数与语言覆盖度放进同一公式，刻画多语言 MoE 扩容时新增语言的代价。在 64 个预训练配置的 26,300 条 per-language loss 上拟合，held-out 预测误差比最强基线低 28%；同等活跃参数与每语言 token 下，32 个专家把语言从 12 扩到 200 的 loss 惩罚比 dense 模型减少 83%。
Motivation: 多语言模型共享容量，加语言会拖累已有语言表现；MoE 以很小的每 token 计算扩容，但新增专家能否摊薄每种语言的代价缺少可预测的定量刻画。
Method: 提出 repetition-aware joint scaling law，联合建模活跃参数量、每语言训练 token 数、专家数与语言覆盖度；在 64 个预训练配置上收集 26,300 条 per-language loss 观测进行拟合，并在 held-out 配置上与多个基线比较预测误差。
Result: held-out 配置上的预测误差相对最强评估基线降低 28%；在匹配的活跃参数量与每语言 token 数下，32 个专家相比 dense 模型把语言覆盖从 12 扩到 200 所带来的 loss 惩罚减少 83%；scaling law 表明在更宽的 compute 预算范围内，更广的语言覆盖都对应更多专家。
Conclusion: 专家数应随语言覆盖度一起上调：在更宽的算力预算区间内，更广的多语言覆盖都偏向配置更多专家，该 scaling law 可直接用于多语言 MoE 的容量与算力分配。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: held-out 配置上的预测误差相对最强评估基线降低 28%；在匹配的活跃参数量与每语言 token 数下，32 个专家相比 dense 模型把语言覆盖从 12 扩到 200 所带来的 loss 惩罚减少 83%；scaling law 表明在更宽的 compute 预算范围内，更广的语言覆盖都对应更多专家。

papers.title: P2Patch: Exploit-Guided Vulnerability Repair
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents for automated program repair, patching software vulnerabilities through multi-step reasoning and tool use. Yet these systems typically validate a patch against the same evidence used to construct it -- a static alert, sanitizer trace, published exploit, or test suite. A patch that blocks that one piece of evidence can therefore look successful while remaining vulnerable to the same vulnerability with some variation. We present P2Patch, a generative adversarial repair system that treats each patch as a new attack target. Starting from a normalized vulnerability finding, an exploitation agent constructs a reproducing proof of vulnerability (PoV), a patching agent repairs the program, and the exploitation agent then attacks the patched program for a distinct same-vulnerability exploit. Every successful exploit becomes a permanent repair requirement, and the final patch must block all PoVs accumulated during the patching process, with construction-time PoVs kept strictly separate from held-out evaluation oracles. Across 101 C/C++ and Java CVE subjects, this adversarial loop surfaces a distinct confirmed exploit in 41% of runs after the patch has already blocked its original construction-time PoV. Against single-pass repair from the same finding using Claude Code, P2Patch raises held-out fix-closed coverage from 78.1% to 84.7% and beyond-upstream coverage from 42.1% to 62.5%. Under the same held-out oracles, it also certifies more attack paths as blocked than recent state-of-the-art agentic repair systems on overlapping subjects. These results show that adversarial testing and independent security oracles expose repair gaps that one-shot validation misses.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables. M. Iranmanesh and S. Moradi Sabet contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/P2Patch/P2patch
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: P2Patch 把每个补丁当成新的攻击目标：利用 agent 先从规范化漏洞发现构造可复现 PoV，修补 agent 修程序，利用 agent 再针对修补后程序构造同漏洞的差异化利用，成功利用即成为永久修补要求，最终补丁须挡住全部累积 PoV。在 101 个 C/C++ 与 Java CVE 上，补丁已挡住构造期 PoV 后仍有 41% 的运行被挖出新的确认利用；相对同源单遍修复（Claude Code），held-out fix-closed 覆盖率从 78.1% 提到 84.7%，beyond-upstream 覆盖率从 42.1% 提到 62.5%。
Motivation: LLM 自主修复通常用构造补丁的同一份证据（静态告警、sanitizer 轨迹、已发布 exploit、测试套件）来验证补丁，只挡住该证据的补丁看似成功却仍可被同漏洞的变体利用。
Method: 生成式对抗修复循环：从规范化漏洞发现出发，exploitation agent 构造 reproducing proof of vulnerability (PoV)，patching agent 修复程序，exploitation agent 再攻击修补后程序寻找差异化同漏洞利用；成功利用累积为永久修补要求，构造期 PoV 与 held-out 评估 oracle 严格分离。
Result: 在 101 个 C/C++ 与 Java CVE 主体上，对抗循环在补丁已挡住原构造期 PoV 后仍有 41% 的运行挖出新的确认利用；相对同一发现上的单遍修复（Claude Code），held-out fix-closed 覆盖率 78.1% → 84.7%，beyond-upstream 覆盖率 42.1% → 62.5%；在同一 held-out oracle 下，重叠主体上比近期 SOTA agentic repair 系统认证为已阻断的攻击路径更多。

papers.title: Retrieval Over Training: Similarity search-based Model Selection for Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection is a fundamental task for time-series analytics, with important implications for the downstream performance of many applications. Despite the large number of anomaly detection methods proposed in the literature, recent benchmark studies have shown that no single detector performs best across highly heterogeneous time series. Therefore, a practical and scalable solution is to develop a model-selection method that, for a given time series, selects the anomaly detector most likely to perform well. Nevertheless, the model selection approaches proposed in the literature suffer from a significant drop in accuracy when applied in Out-of-Distribution (OOD) settings. In this paper, we tackle the aforementioned limitation and propose RAMSAD, a retrieval-based framework for model selection in time-series anomaly detection. Given a new time series, our method queries a knowledge base of previously observed instances, retrieves the top-k most similar series, and transfers detector recommendations from their performance profiles. The framework can operate with standard similarity measures as well as embedding-based representations. Our results show that RAMSAD outperforms existing baselines in In-Distribution (ID) settings and is the most robust selector in OOD, where, when selecting a small subset of detectors, it matches or exceeds ensembles that run the entire detector pool, at a fraction of their cost. Overall, we demonstrate that similarity-based retrieval constitutes a strong and efficient foundation for model selection in time-series anomaly detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 RAMSAD：用相似度检索替代重新训练，为新时间序列挑选最可能表现好的异常检测器。它查询已观测实例知识库、取 top-k 相似序列并迁移其性能档案中的检测器推荐，兼容标准相似度与 embedding 表示。在 ID 设置上超过既有基线，在 OOD 上是最稳健的选择器，只跑小子集即可匹配或超过跑满整个检测器池的集成，成本只是其一小部分。
Motivation: 已有大量时序异常检测器，但基准显示没有单一检测器在高度异质的时间序列上普遍最好；现有模型选择方法一到 Out-of-Distribution (OOD) 设置精度就显著下降。
Method: RAMSAD 是基于检索的模型选择框架：对新时间序列查询已观测实例的知识库，检索 top-k 最相似序列，并从它们的性能档案 (performance profiles) 迁移检测器推荐；相似度既可用标准相似度度量，也可用 embedding 表示。
Result: 在 In-Distribution (ID) 设置上优于现有基线；在 OOD 上是最稳健的选择器，当只选择一小部分检测器时，匹配或超过运行整个检测器池的集成，而成本只是后者的一小部分。
Conclusion: 基于相似度的检索可以作为时序异常检测模型选择的强而高效的基础，尤其在 OOD 场景下以低成本替代全池集成。

papers.title: PAWA: Panoramic Action-conditioned World Modeling for Multiple Agents
papers.abstract_en: A multiplayer world model must predict how the independent actions of several players change a shared environment, including changes outside a player's current field of view. A point-of-view (POV) video captures such changes only after they enter its field of view, whereas panoramic video records the surroundings in every viewing direction and has served as an intermediate representation of the world state in recent world models. Learning this task therefore requires synchronized POV and panoramic videos of interacting players together with their actions, yet no existing dataset provides this combination in Minecraft, an established testbed in which players act independently in a shared, modifiable 3D world. We present PAWA, a dataset and framework for action-conditioned panoramic multiplayer world modeling. The dataset pairs each player's POV video with world-stabilized panoramic video and aligned actions. Its distributed pipeline decouples CPU gameplay capture from GPU rendering, scales beyond 64 simultaneous players, and re-renders each recorded session under new observation configurations without replaying the gameplay. On this dataset, we develop a dual-tower model that jointly predicts POV and panoramic video and couples the two streams through cross-attention that aligns tokens observing the same direction in a shared world frame. We further introduce a quadratic-phase player encoding that provides many more player codes than existing rotary codes at the same embedding dimension. Experiments show that PAWA outperforms state-of-the-art multiplayer world models in POV prediction quality while also producing high-fidelity panoramic predictions. The dataset and collection pipeline are open source to support further research on multiplayer world models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PAWA 提出面向多人世界的动作条件全景世界模型数据集与框架：在 Minecraft 中把每个玩家的 POV 视频与世界稳定化的全景视频及对齐动作配对，用双塔模型联合预测两路视频并以 cross-attention 对齐同方向 token。实验显示其 POV 预测质量超过现有 SOTA 多人世界模型，同时产出高保真全景预测。
Motivation: 多人世界模型需预测多个玩家各自动作如何改变共享环境、包括视野外的变化，但 Minecraft 中尚无同时提供同步 POV、全景视频与动作的数据集。
Method: 数据管线将 CPU 游戏采集与 GPU 渲染解耦，支持超过 64 名同时在线玩家，并可在不重放游戏的情况下按新观测配置重渲染会话；模型为双塔结构联合预测 POV 与全景视频，用 cross-attention 在共享世界坐标系下对齐观察同一方向的 token，并引入 quadratic-phase player encoding，在相同 embedding 维度下提供远多于现有 rotary codes 的玩家编码。
Result: 在该数据集上，PAWA 的 POV 预测质量超过现有 SOTA 多人世界模型，同时生成高保真全景预测；采集管线扩展到超过 64 名同时玩家。
Conclusion: 同步 POV、全景与动作的配对数据加上方向对齐的双塔联合预测，是多人动作条件世界建模的有效路径；数据集与采集管线开源。

papers.title: MAEM: Mitigating Recency Bias via a Replay-Free, Capacity-Controlled Dynamic Mixture of Experts for Class-Incremental Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) excel on graph-structured data but suffer catastrophic forgetting when classes arrive sequentially. In class-incremental graph learning, predictions are often dominated by recently learned classes, causing severe recency bias. Dynamic expansion can isolate knowledge across sessions, but many methods assume task-incremental settings and require task identities at test time to select branches or heads---information unavailable in class-incremental learning. Learnable routers offer an alternative, yet continual fine-tuning the router on new data can bias routing toward recent components. We propose MAEM, a replay-free, capacity-controlled dynamic mixture-of-experts framework for class-incremental graph learning. MAEM builds representations with Simplified Graph Convolution (SGC) and trains a dedicated expert for each new session, then freezes it to protect prior knowledge. For routing without task IDs or a shared trainable router, each expert uses a masked autoencoder (MAE); test nodes are assigned to the expert with the lowest reconstruction error, reducing routing-level recency bias. When the expert pool reaches a fixed capacity, MAEM merges the least-used experts via Git Re-Basin alignment and further distills them into a fused expert using topology-aware pseudo data synthesized from MAE distributions (DeepInversion-style), without storing or revisiting historical graph data. On four class-incremental graph benchmarks, MAEM mitigates recency bias, outperforms strong continual graph learning baselines, and keeps model capacity bounded under strict replay-free learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAEM 是面向类增量图学习 (class-incremental graph learning) 的免回放、容量受控动态专家混合框架：每个新 session 训练并冻结一个专家，测试时用各专家的 masked autoencoder 重建误差最低者来路由，绕开任务 ID 与可训练 router；专家池达到固定容量后用 Git Re-Basin 对齐合并最少使用的专家，再用 MAE 分布合成的 topology-aware 伪数据 (DeepInversion 式) 蒸馏为融合专家。在四个类增量图基准上缓解了 recency bias，优于强持续图学习基线，且在严格免回放下保持模型容量有界。
Motivation: 类增量图学习中预测被最近学到的类主导，产生严重 recency bias；动态扩展方法多假设 task-incremental 并依赖测试期任务 ID，而可训练 router 在新数据上持续微调又会把路由偏向近期组件。
Method: 用 Simplified Graph Convolution (SGC) 建表示，每个新 session 训练专属专家并冻结以保护旧知识；路由不用任务 ID 也不用共享可训练 router，而是给每个专家配 masked autoencoder (MAE)，测试节点分给重建误差最低的专家；专家池达固定容量时用 Git Re-Basin 对齐合并最少使用的专家，并用 MAE 分布合成的 topology-aware 伪数据 (DeepInversion-style) 蒸馏成融合专家，全程不存不回看历史图数据。
Result: 在四个类增量图基准上，MAEM 缓解了 recency bias，优于强持续图学习基线，并在严格免回放学习下保持模型容量有界。
Conclusion: 免回放的类增量图学习可以通过冻结专家加重建误差路由来压低路由层面的 recency bias，并用对齐合并加蒸馏把容量限制在固定上限内。

papers.title: The minimal width of neural networks and immersions of real projective space
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the minimal width of deep neural networks that can approximate all continuous functions from $\mathbb{R}^n$ to $\mathbb{R}^m$ in the topology of uniform convergence on compact subsets. We show that whenever the real projective space $\mathbb{RP}^{n-1}$ admits a smooth immersion into $\mathbb{R}^n$, the minimal width is at least $n+\min\{n,m\}$, assuming that the activation function is continuous and monotone. As a consequence, the minimal width of ReLU networks is $n+m$ whenever $n$ is equal to 2, 3, 4, 7 or 8 and $1\le m \le n$, extending results of Hanin-Sellke and Hwang. This suggests an intriguing connection between the approximation theory of neural networks and differential topology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把神经网络逼近全体连续函数所需的最小宽度下界，归结为实射影空间 RP^{n-1} 到 R^n 的光滑浸入问题：只要这种浸入存在，连续单调激活下最小宽度至少为 n+min{n,m}。由此得到 ReLU 网络在 n=2,3,4,7,8 且 1≤m≤n 时最小宽度恰为 n+m，推广了 Hanin-Sellke 与 Hwang 的结果。
Motivation: 神经网络宽度下界此前主要靠逐例构造论证，缺少把拓扑障碍转成统一宽度下界的机制；Hwang、Hanin-Sellke 的 n+m 结论只覆盖特定维数，一般情形的下界仍不完整。
Method: 以实射影空间 RP^{n-1} 到 R^n 的光滑浸入存在性为拓扑障碍，对连续且单调的激活函数推导逼近全体连续映射 R^n→R^m（紧集上一致收敛拓扑）所需的宽度下界 n+min{n,m}；再把该一般条件实例化到 ReLU 网络的低维情形。

papers.title: Design Space Exploration of Reinforcement Learning Configurations for Post-Legalization Placement
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) have recently been explored for VLSI placement optimization, but their effectiveness for post-legalization placement refinement remains unclear. This paper presents a systematic design space exploration of a GNN-Proximal Policy Optimization (GNN-PPO) framework across three ISPD2015 benchmarks. We evaluate 18 configurations covering reward functions, GNN architectures, action spaces, candidate-set sizes, and training strategies. We analyse the results we obtain to identify pitfalls and to assess the prospects and opportunities of the RL methods for post-legalization placement. On top of that we propose a design classification approach to guide the design decisions of RL models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 GNN-PPO 用于 VLSI 后合法化布局 (post-legalization placement) 做系统设计空间探索，在 ISPD2015 三个基准上评测 18 种配置，覆盖奖励函数、GNN 结构、动作空间、候选集大小与训练策略，并据此识别常见陷阱、提出指导 RL 设计决策的分类方法。
Motivation: GNN 与 RL 已被用于 VLSI 布局优化，但它们对后合法化布局细化的实际效果仍不清楚，缺少能指导配置选择的系统性依据。
Method: 以 GNN-PPO 框架为对象，在 ISPD2015 三个基准上系统评测 18 种配置，变化维度包括奖励函数、GNN 架构、动作空间、候选集大小和训练策略；在结果分析基础上提出一种设计分类方法 (design classification approach) 来指导 RL 模型的设计决策。
Result: 在 ISPD2015 三个基准上评测 18 种 GNN-PPO 配置，覆盖奖励函数、GNN 架构、动作空间、候选集大小与训练策略五个维度，并从中识别出 RL 方法用于后合法化布局的陷阱与机会。
Conclusion: RL 用于后合法化布局细化的可行性取决于配置选择，作者主张用设计分类方法来系统化地做 RL 模型设计决策。

papers.title: Scaling Multilingual Safety and Reasoning Evaluation through Reasoning-Guided Translation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed across languages, yet their safety and reasoning capabilities remain predominantly evaluated in English. Translating existing benchmarks offers a scalable approach to multilingual evaluation, but preserving task-specific meaning across languages presents significant challenges, particularly for harmful requests, mathematical reasoning, and conversational interactions. We introduce a reasoning-guided translation framework for constructing multilingual evaluations designed to preserve the structure and intended meaning of diverse benchmark tasks. Our approach separates translation strategy selection from large-scale generation, combining reasoning-guided configuration selection with task-aware validation, targeted repair, and independent quality screening. Using this framework, we develop a source-aligned evaluation collection spanning seven safety, conversational, and mathematical reasoning resources across 11 languages. The resulting collection achieves 99.94\% coverage of intended item--language pairs in the two subsets requiring repair. Evaluations of open-source LLMs reveal distinct language-dependent vulnerabilities, including inconsistent refusal behaviour and substantial reasoning degradation in lower-resource languages. These findings highlight the importance of task-sensitive benchmark construction and systematic quality assessment for understanding multilingual model behaviour beyond English.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 reasoning-guided translation 框架，把翻译策略选择与大规模生成解耦，用于把英文安全、对话与数学推理基准转成跨语言评测集。在 11 种语言、7 个资源上，需要修复的两个子集达到 99.94% 的 item–language pair 覆盖；开源 LLM 评测显示拒绝行为不一致，且低资源语言推理明显退化。
Motivation: LLM 安全与推理评测几乎只在英文进行，直接翻译基准难以保留任务结构与本意，尤其在有害请求、数学推理和对话任务上。
Method: 框架分离 reasoning-guided 配置选择与大规模生成，配合 task-aware validation、targeted repair 和独立质量筛查 (independent quality screening)，产出 source-aligned 评测集合。
Result: 构建覆盖 7 个安全、对话与数学推理资源、11 种语言的评测集合；在两个需要修复的子集上达到 99.94% 的预期 item–language pair 覆盖。开源 LLM 评测揭示拒绝行为不一致，以及低资源语言中显著的推理退化。
Conclusion: 多语言模型行为要超出英文来理解，基准构建必须任务敏感并配套系统化质量评估。

papers.title: Glance Forcing: Making Bidirectional Diffusion Autoregressive at a Glance
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive generation underlies real-time, causal video synthesis and is the backbone of video world models. Today's dominant approach distills a bidirectional diffusion model into a causal few-step student, but existing pipelines make this conversion prohibitively expensive, requiring offline Probability Flow ODE} (PF-ODE) trajectories that cost tens of thousands of GPU-hours and terabytes of storage. We show it can be made dramatically more efficient. Pushing this efficiency to its extreme, we reduce trajectory supervision to a single sample, the strictest setting possible, and find that it causes severe quality collapse. We trace this to the teacher's trajectory geometry: the high-noise regime, governing semantic layout and motion, and the low-noise regime, governing fine texture exhibit fundamentally different curvature and optimization behavior, so a single monolithic student cannot jointly fit both, causing severe representation interference. Motivated by this, we propose Glance Forcing, a lightweight distillation framework that decouples the denoising trajectory into two complementary slow and fast experts, each guided by a tailored, stage-specific objective, while keeping the pretrained teacher entirely frozen. This decoupling further reveals a general mechanism underlying few-step distillation: PF-ODE distillation mainly straightens the few-step trajectory geometry, while the subsequent distribution-matching stage independently governs distributional quality. Using only one PF-ODE trajectory, Glance Forcing already surpasses the fully-trained state-of-the-art baseline, raising the VBench Total score from 84.04 to 84.22 while cutting trajectory-collection cost from thousands of GPU-hours to about one A100-GPU-hour, with markedly larger gains in dynamic degree, VisionReward, and instruction-following, and consistent preference from human raters over strong baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Glance Forcing 把双向扩散蒸馏成自回归少步视频生成的代价压到极限：只用 1 条 PF-ODE 轨迹监督，将去噪轨迹解耦为慢、快两个专家并各配阶段专属目标，教师全程冻结。VBench Total 从 84.04 提到 84.22，轨迹采集成本从数千 GPU-hour 降到约 1 个 A100-GPU-hour。
Motivation: 把双向扩散蒸馏成因果少步学生需要离线 PF-ODE 轨迹，代价高达数万 GPU-hour 与 TB 级存储；把监督压到单条轨迹又会因高噪（语义布局/运动）与低噪（细纹理）区曲率与优化行为不同而产生表示干扰、质量崩溃。
Method: Glance Forcing 将去噪轨迹解耦为慢、快两个专家，各用阶段专属目标监督，教师保持冻结；并给出机制解释：PF-ODE 蒸馏主要拉直少步轨迹几何，随后的 distribution-matching 阶段独立决定分布质量。
Result: 仅用 1 条 PF-ODE 轨迹即超过 fully-trained SOTA 基线：VBench Total 84.04 → 84.22，轨迹采集成本从数千 GPU-hour 降到约 1 个 A100-GPU-hour；dynamic degree、VisionReward、指令遵循提升更明显，人工评分者对强基线有一致偏好。
Conclusion: 少步蒸馏中轨迹几何拉直与分布质量是两个可分离的机制，因此单条轨迹的阶段解耦监督足以取代昂贵的全量轨迹采集。

papers.title: Mixed Poisson diffusion models and application to posterior sampling
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are a powerful framework for learning complex probability distributions. While widely used diffusion models for continuous data rely on Gaussian noising processes, we instead develop diffusion models based on Poisson noise. More precisely, we introduce and study a new mathematical framework, called Mixed Poisson Diffusion Models (MPDM), with noising dynamics driven by multivariate counting processes. Our methodology is motivated by Poisson inverse problems. The success of Gaussian diffusion models has led to their use as prior models in a growing number of posterior sampling methods for inverse problems. However, most of these approaches focus on Gaussian inverse problems, in which observations are generated through a deterministic forward operator corrupted by additive Gaussian noise. By contrast, Poisson inverse problems, where observations are discrete and Poisson distributed, remain comparatively underexplored in this literature. Building on our Poisson generative dynamics, we develop a natural framework for posterior sampling in Poisson inverse problems and derive several posterior sampling algorithms based on the proposed model. We evaluate our approach on realistic Poisson inverse problems and show that the resulting framework is well suited to this class of problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Mixed Poisson Diffusion Models (MPDM)：把扩散的加噪过程从高斯换成由多元计数过程驱动的 Poisson 噪声，并据此为 Poisson 逆问题构造后验采样算法。在真实感 Poisson 逆问题上评测，该框架适合这类离散计数观测的后验采样。
Motivation: 高斯扩散先验主导的后验采样方法大多只处理加性高斯噪声的确定性前向算子，而观测为离散 Poisson 分布的 Poisson 逆问题在该文献中相对被忽视。
Method: 构建 MPDM 数学框架，加噪动力学由多元计数过程 (multivariate counting processes) 驱动而非高斯加噪；基于该 Poisson 生成动力学推导多个后验采样算法，用于 Poisson 逆问题。
Result: 在真实感 Poisson 逆问题上评测所提框架，结论是其适合这一类问题；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: Poisson 噪声驱动的扩散先验可作为 Poisson 逆问题后验采样的自然框架，把扩散后验采样从高斯观测推广到离散计数观测。

papers.title: Continual pretraining Prostate MRI ViT Encoder for task alignment
papers.abstract_en: Building foundation models for MRI has emerged as a promising direction for advancing medical image analysis and improving accessibility of task specific models. Existing approaches primarily focus on effective pretraining strategies and evaluating their performance across diverse downstream tasks. While these methods show performance gains, limited attention has been given to understanding task alignment between pretraining and downstream objectives. Unlike language models, where the two stages are naturally aligned, such alignment is less evident in vision based applications. Motivated by this gap, we explore continual pretraining. Specifically, continually pretraining a pretrained ViT encoder using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on a prostate segmentation task to enhance task alignment and downstream performance. We further perform layer-wise representational analysis using Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) to assess representational shifts and their correlation with task outcomes. Our experiments show improved performance in 3 of 6 downstream tasks and comparable results in the others. Our Feature analysis reveals that, for segmentation tasks, continually pretrained encoder features exhibit greater similarity to those of the finetuned encoder than the original pretrained encoder, correlating with observed performance gains.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 IEEE 23rd International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 MRI 基础模型中预训练与下游目标缺少对齐的问题，用 LoRA 在前列腺分割任务上对预训练 ViT 编码器做持续预训练 (continual pretraining)，并用 CKA 做逐层表征分析。6 个下游任务中 3 个性能提升、其余持平；分割任务上持续预训练后的特征更接近微调后编码器的特征，与性能增益相关。
Motivation: MRI 基础模型研究集中在预训练策略与下游评测，但预训练目标与下游目标之间的任务对齐 (task alignment) 缺乏关注；与语言模型两阶段天然对齐不同，视觉模型的这种对齐并不明显。
Method: 用 Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) 对已预训练的 ViT 编码器在前列腺分割任务上做持续预训练；再用 Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) 做逐层表征分析，评估表征偏移及其与任务结果的相关性。
Result: 6 个下游任务中 3 个性能提升，其余任务结果相当；特征分析显示，对分割任务，持续预训练编码器的特征比原始预训练编码器更接近微调后编码器的特征，且与观察到的性能增益相关。
Conclusion: 在下游任务上做持续预训练可以缩小预训练与下游目标的表征差距，对分割类任务带来性能增益；表征相似度可作为任务对齐的诊断指标。

summary_sections.conclusion: 在下游任务上做持续预训练可以缩小预训练与下游目标的表征差距，对分割类任务带来性能增益；表征相似度可作为任务对齐的诊断指标。

papers.title: Robust Counterfactuals for Markov Decision Processes under Statistical and Causal Uncertainties
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual reasoning (asking what would have happened, had a decision been different) is a powerful tool for identifying causes of failure and explaining the behaviour of AI systems in sequential decision-making tasks. In Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), two sources of uncertainty complicate counterfactual inference: statistical uncertainty in the MDP transitions when the MDP is estimated from trajectory data, and uncertainty about the unknown causal model, as there are multiple structural causal models (SCMs) compatible with each MDP. Existing work addresses these two challenges in isolation. We address both simultaneously by introducing a framework for partial counterfactual inference in MDPs that is robust to both statistical and causal uncertainty. Our approach provides: 1) closed-form analytical bounds for the counterfactual probabilities that are valid across all SCMs entailed by a given interval MDP (IMDP); 2) a method to compute minimal robust interventions to achieve a desired counterfactual outcome via pessimistic value iteration on the induced counterfactual IMDP. Since the latter is constructed using our analytical bounds, our approach remains efficient and scalable to realistic MDP environments. Experiments across multiple case studies demonstrate our method's robustness and practical utility for identifying minimal sets of actions that, if changed, would have led to improved outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个在 MDP 中同时对统计不确定性（区间 MDP，IMDP）与因果模型不确定性（多个兼容 SCM）做稳健反事实推断的框架：给出对所有被 IMDP 蕴含的 SCM 都成立的反事实概率闭式解析界，并在诱导出的反事实 IMDP 上用悲观值迭代 (pessimistic value iteration) 计算达成目标反事实结果的最小稳健干预。多个案例研究表明该方法稳健且能识别出「若改变即可改善结果」的最小动作集合。
Motivation: 从轨迹数据估计的 MDP 同时带有转移概率的统计不确定性和因果模型（SCM）的不确定性，而现有工作只分别处理其中一种，导致反事实推断在两种不确定性并存时不可靠。
Method: 构建区间 MDP (IMDP) 表示统计不确定性，推导对所有被该 IMDP 蕴含的 SCM 均有效的反事实概率闭式解析界；在解析界诱导出的反事实 IMDP 上运行悲观值迭代 (pessimistic value iteration)，求达成指定反事实结果的最小稳健干预。
Result: 在多个案例研究上展示了方法的稳健性与实用性，能识别出若被改变即可改善结果的最小动作集合；解析界使方法保持高效并可扩展到真实规模的 MDP 环境。
Conclusion: 统计不确定性与因果模型不确定性可以被同一个框架同时覆盖，且借助解析界构造的反事实 IMDP 使最小稳健干预的计算保持可扩展。

papers.title: HGRP: Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network for Routability Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Routability prediction enables rapid evaluation of placement quality without routing, providing effective feedback for routability-driven placement optimization. Recent machine learning methods have achieved efficient routability prediction through data-driven approach. However, their prediction performance highly depends on the capability of input representations to capture essential circuit information. To address the limitations of existing circuit representations in simultaneously preserving logical topology, physical layout and routing resource information, this paper proposes HGRP, a heterogeneous graph neural network for routability prediction. HGRP models the cells, nets, and routing grids as distinct types of nodes and explicitly represents topological connectivity, spatial mapping, and grid adjacency, thereby constructing a heterogeneous graph representation that preserves multi-level circuit semantics. Based on the representation, a heterogeneous message passing mechanism is developed to enable information interaction and feature fusion among distinct types of nodes, effectively learning the complex correlations between circuit structures and routing behaviors. Experimental results on the CircuitNet dataset show that HGRP improves F1-score by 18.69\% relative improvements compared with the state-of-the-art in the congestion prediction task. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/ShenShan123/HGPR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HGRP 把电路的 cells、nets、routing grids 建成三类异构节点，显式编码拓扑连接、空间映射与网格邻接，再用异构消息传递学习电路结构与布线行为的关联，用于布线性 (routability) 预测。在 CircuitNet 拥塞预测任务上，F1 相对当前最优方法提升 18.69%。
Motivation: 现有电路表示难以同时保留逻辑拓扑、物理布局与布线资源信息，导致 ML 布线性预测的输入表征不足、性能受限于表示能力。
Method: 构建异构图：cells、nets、routing grids 作为不同类型的节点，显式表示拓扑连接、空间映射与网格邻接；其上设计异构消息传递机制，实现跨类型节点的信息交互与特征融合，学习电路结构与布线行为的关联。
Result: 在 CircuitNet 数据集的 congestion prediction 任务上，HGRP 的 F1-score 相对当前最优 (state-of-the-art) 方法提升 18.69%（relative improvement）。
Conclusion: 同时保留逻辑拓扑、物理布局与布线资源的异构图表示，是提升布线性/拥塞预测精度的有效路径；代码已公开。

papers.title: What and Where in Identifying and Quantifying Conventions in Humans and AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative success rests in part on implicit communication. Partners converge on conventions: regularities that give an action meaning beyond its direct effect. Yet conventions are usually observed only indirectly: a score drop when partners are swapped shows that a convention existed, but not what it was or where it was used. In the card game Hanabi, the exact probability that a play fails can be computed from the hints received and the cards in view. Players who use conventions succeed more often than this prediction allows; the resulting margin is the convention gap. Off-belief learning provides a hierarchy of agents (levels 1-5) whose first level uses no conventions by construction and whose later levels use progressively more. For humans and these agents on one scale, we ask what the conventions are and where they are used. On what: in two independently collected corpora of human games, humans show a larger gap than every agent level. On the conventions both populations use, however, humans do no better than level 2. The human advantage is concentrated in a situation that no agent level learns to use: hints that point to a card other than the ones they touch. On where: conventions depend on what the player already knows about the card, not on how recently it was hinted, and they are used most in the mid-game; humans use them earlier and later in the game than the agents. In interventions on the agents, blocking a single high-gap situation costs little, because meaning reroutes to other situations, but blocking several together costs far more than the sum of the single costs. Thus, the convention gap turns conventions from an inferred cause of score loss into a measurable, comparable, and causally testable object.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Hanabi 中把「约定」变成可测量对象：用可精确计算的失败概率作为基线，实际成功率超出该预测的余量定义为 convention gap，据此在同一尺度上比较人类与 off-belief learning 分层智能体（levels 1–5）。两份独立人类游戏语料中人类 gap 大于所有 agent level，但在双方共用的约定上人类不优于 level 2；人类优势集中在「提示指向的并非被触碰的牌」这一无人工智能体学会的情形。干预显示单独阻断一个高 gap 情形代价很小（意义会改道），同时阻断多个的代价远大于各自代价之和。
Motivation: 约定通常只能间接观测：交换搭档后的分数下降只能说明约定存在，无法说明它是什么、用在哪里，因而难以比较人类与 AI 的合作机制。
Method: 在 Hanabi 中利用提示与可见牌可精确计算每次出牌失败概率，以实际表现超出该预测的余量构造 convention gap；把人类与 off-belief learning 的 levels 1–5（level 1 按构造不使用约定）放到同一尺度，分别在「what」（哪些约定）与「where」（何时何地使用）两侧分析，并对智能体做阻断干预实验。
Result: 在两份独立采集的人类游戏语料中，人类的 convention gap 大于每一个 agent level；在双方共用的约定上，人类不优于 level 2。人类优势集中于指向非触碰牌的提示这一无 agent level 学会的情形；约定取决于玩家对该牌已知信息而非提示的新近程度，且在 mid-game 使用最多，人类比智能体更早也更晚使用。干预中阻断单个高 gap 情形代价很小，同时阻断多个的代价远大于单个代价之和。
Conclusion: 约定可从「推断出的分数损失原因」变成可测量、可比较、可因果检验的对象；人类的整体优势来自智能体完全未学会的特定情形，而非共有约定上的更强运用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Investigating Behavior Cloning from Few Demonstrations for Autonomous Driving based on Bird's-Eye View in Simulated Cities
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates the use of Behavior Cloning (BC) for autonomous driving from a bird's-eye view (BEV) perspective in simulated urban environments. BC uses supervised learning to mimic expert driving behaviors. Previous works have applied BC in the CARLA simulator but did not fully address the challenges of traffic light compliance. Our approach enhances BC by integrating a kernel density estimator to adjust training sample weights based on action density, thereby improving the learning of rare but critical actions such as stopping at red lights and accelerating at green lights, specially in scenarios of scarce number of expert demonstrations. Using BEV inputs, which provide an abstract top-down view of the driving environment, our method simplifies the policy learning process. The trained convolutional neural network (CNN) outputs steering and acceleration actions based on these BEV inputs and additional state variables. Experimental results in the CARLA simulator demonstrate that our weighted BC method significantly improves driving performance, achieving higher route completion compared to standard BC. This weighted approach proved to be crucial in learning correct driving behaviors, particularly in test environments not encountered during training, highlighting its potential for enhancing autonomous vehicle navigation.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Accepted manuscript (author version) of the paper published in the proceedings of BRACIS 2024 (34th Brazilian Conference on Intelligent Systems, Belém, Brazil, 17-21 November 2024). Project page: https://sites.google.com/view/weighted-bc
papers.journal_ref: Intelligent Systems. BRACIS 2024. Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNAI), vol 15413, pp. 155-168. Springer, Cham, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 CARLA 模拟城市场景中，用核密度估计 (kernel density estimator) 按动作密度加权行为克隆 (Behavior Cloning) 的训练样本，提升红灯停、绿灯起步等稀有关键动作的学习效果。基于鸟瞰图 (BEV) 输入的 CNN 输出方向盘与加速度，加权 BC 在路线完成率上显著高于标准 BC，尤其在训练未见过的环境中。
Motivation: 此前在 CARLA 上应用 BC 的工作没有充分处理交通灯遵守问题；在专家示范数量稀缺时，稀有但关键的动作（红灯停、绿灯起步）在训练样本中占比极低，标准 BC 难以学到。
Method: 用核密度估计 (KDE) 按动作密度为训练样本加权，缓解示范稀缺下稀有动作被淹没的问题；策略为 CNN，输入 BEV 抽象俯视图加额外状态变量，输出转向与加速度动作，在 CARLA 中训练与测试。
Result: 在 CARLA 模拟器中，加权 BC 的路线完成率 (route completion) 显著高于标准 BC，尤其在训练期间未遇到的测试环境中；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 按动作密度加权是让少量示范下的 BC 学到正确驾驶行为（尤其是交通灯合规）的关键，且能提升对未见环境的泛化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Drivers of LLM Consensus Formation Under Competing Incentives: A Simulation Study
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent environments that produce unanimous agreement, both in intended interactions that need coordination and in unintended emergent interactions. Consequently, understanding how LLMs with competing incentives reach consensus is crucial to better interpret and design LLM collectives. We introduce an evaluation, based on the Network Consensus game, to assess the mechanisms driving this process. Here, a network of agents must agree on one of two colours to receive a payoff, but agents are offered different payoffs for the agreed colour. We vary components such as communication access and network structure and assess six open-source models and one closed model (ChatGPT 5.6-sol). We find that open-source LLMs reach consensus less often than humans in comparable experiments and only if messages are communicated across the global network. ChatGPT 5.6-sol, however, is able to reach consensus with communication limited to its neighbours and with no communication ability. This is achieved through lower stubbornness and higher majority-following tendencies, and by providing more information about its neighbours' states in messages. However, situating agents in a highly clustered graph reduces consensus, regardless of these traits, demonstrating that both system design and individual model traits drive collective outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用基于 Network Consensus game 的仿真评估 LLM 在竞争激励下如何达成共识：网络中各 agent 需就两种颜色之一达成一致以获取收益，但不同 agent 对同一颜色的收益不同。六个开源模型达成共识的频率低于可比实验中的人类，且只有消息在全网传播时才达成；ChatGPT 5.6-sol 在仅邻域通信甚至完全无通信时也能达成，靠更低 stubbornness、更高的随大流倾向和消息中透露邻居状态实现，但高聚类图会压低共识，与个体特质无关。
Motivation: LLM 多智能体系统会自发产生一致同意，无论是否为协调而设计；要解释和设计 LLM 集体，需要弄清竞争激励下共识由哪些机制驱动。
Method: 提出基于 Network Consensus game 的评估：网络 agent 必须就两种颜色之一达成一致才能拿到收益，各 agent 对同一颜色的收益不同；系统性改变通信可达范围与网络结构，比较六个开源模型与一个闭源模型 ChatGPT 5.6-sol。
Result: 开源 LLM 达成共识的频率低于可比实验中的人类，且仅当消息跨全网传播时才达成；ChatGPT 5.6-sol 在通信限于邻居乃至无通信能力时仍能达成共识，机制是更低的 stubbornness、更高的 majority-following 倾向，以及在消息中提供更充分的邻居状态信息；把 agent 置于高聚类 (highly clustered) 图中会降低共识，与这些个体特质无关。
Conclusion: LLM 集体结果同时由系统设计（通信范围、网络结构）和个体模型特质驱动，因此解读或设计 LLM 共识需两者一起看。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: What Makes a Social Agent's Interactions Effective? Learning from Verifiable Outcomes in Paired Worlds
papers.abstract_en: Effective social interaction requires more than fluent responses: agents must reach plans that fit the participants' needs and circumstances. Existing evaluations of social agents mainly rely on LLM judges that rate the conversation, without checking the resulting plan. We introduce HICO-Bench, a benchmark of 180 everyday coordination scenarios, such as resource allocation, scheduling, and authorization, in which two agents with private information converse and then independently record the plan they agreed on. A program checks Feasibility (the two records match and satisfy both participants' private conditions), and an LLM judge checks Integrity (the conversation supports the recorded plan); passing both is a Verified Success. Each scenario has two versions that share the same public context but differ in one private condition, so the correct plan differs between them. Across thirteen LLMs, 36% of conversations rated highly for goal completion fail Verified Success. To learn from outcomes that arrive only at the end of a conversation, we propose Paired-Credit Policy Optimization (PaCPO). After each turn, PaCPO asks the agent for a tentative plan, checks it in both versions of the scenario, and rewards the turns after which the tentative plans fit their respective versions. PaCPO raises Qwen3-8B's Verified Success from 20.4% to 28.3%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出社交智能体基准 HICO-Bench：180 个日常协调场景中两智能体带私有信息对话后各自独立记录达成的计划，用程序校验 Feasibility、LLM judge 校验 Integrity，两者都过才算 Verified Success。跨 13 个 LLM，36% 被评为高目标完成度的对话实际未通过 Verified Success；据此提出 PaCPO，让 Qwen3-8B 的 Verified Success 从 20.4% 升到 28.3%。
Motivation: 现有社交智能体评测只靠 LLM judge 给对话打分，不检查对话最终产出的计划是否真的可行、是否被对话支撑，高分对话可能根本没达成有效方案。
Method: HICO-Bench 每个场景有共享公开语境、仅差一个私有条件的两个版本，正确计划因此不同；程序校验两份记录是否一致且满足双方私有条件（Feasibility），LLM judge 校验对话是否支撑记录的计划（Integrity）。训练侧提出 PaCPO：每轮后让智能体给出 tentative plan，在场景两个版本中分别校验，奖励那些使 tentative plan 符合各自版本的轮次，从而把只在对话结束时到达的结果信用回传到各轮。
Result: 跨 13 个 LLM，36% 在 goal completion 上被高评的对话未通过 Verified Success。PaCPO 将 Qwen3-8B 的 Verified Success 从 20.4% 提升到 28.3%。
Conclusion: 对话层面的高分不等于计划真正达成，用可校验的成对场景结果做逐轮信用分配能提高社交智能体产出可行且被对话支撑的计划。

papers.title: SWE-Stream: Scaling Executable Training Data for SWE Agents via Progressive Construction and Elastic Streaming
papers.abstract_en: Software engineering agents have advanced rapidly, but scaling their training remains constrained by the limited availability of high-quality executable tasks. Development histories contain valuable signals for constructing such tasks, yet they often require substantial reconstruction due to incomplete environments, missing tests, and inconsistent artifacts. We present SWE-Stream, a system for scaling executable SWE training data through progressive construction and elastic streaming execution. SWE-Stream progressively validates and refines task candidates, reusing existing artifacts when possible and applying targeted completion only when necessary. An elastic scheduler asynchronously coordinates construction stages under shared resource constraints, adapting execution budgets based on observed workload demands. Using development histories from 10,728 repositories across six programming languages, SWE-Stream constructs 80,874 validated tasks and collects 118,688 successful trajectories. Fine-tuning Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 on these trajectories achieves resolve rates of 69.0%, 49.3%, and 45.42% on SWE-bench Verified, Multilingual, and Pro, respectively. In a controlled comparison with approximately matched training budgets, SWE-Stream achieves a 45.6% resolve rate on SWE-bench Verified, outperforming three existing data sources. Moreover, its streaming construction strategy improves efficiency, delivering $1.45\times$ the accepted-task throughput of batch construction and accepting 13.2% more tasks than fixed-limit streaming.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWE-Stream 用渐进式构建与弹性流式调度，把开发历史批量转成可执行的 SWE agent 训练任务：在 10,728 个仓库、六种编程语言上产出 80,874 个已验证任务与 118,688 条成功轨迹，微调 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 后 SWE-bench Verified resolve rate 达 69.0%。同等训练预算下 45.6% 超过三个现有数据源，流式构建吞吐为批量构建的 1.45 倍、比固定限额流式多接受 13.2% 任务。
Motivation: SWE agent 训练受限于高质量可执行任务稀缺：开发历史常因环境不完整、测试缺失、产物不一致而需要大量重建。
Method: 渐进式构建对任务候选逐级验证与精修，能复用既有产物时复用、必要时才做定向补全；弹性调度器在共享资源约束下异步协调各构建阶段，并按观测到的负载调整执行预算。
Result: 在 10,728 个仓库、六种编程语言的开发历史上构建 80,874 个已验证任务、收集 118,688 条成功轨迹；微调 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 后 SWE-bench Verified、Multilingual、Pro resolve rate 分别为 69.0%、49.3%、45.42%。约匹配训练预算的对照中 SWE-bench Verified 达 45.6%，优于三个现有数据源；流式构建吞吐为批量构建的 1.45 倍，比固定限额流式多接受 13.2% 任务。
Conclusion: 渐进式构建加弹性流式执行能在固定资源与预算下扩大可执行 SWE 训练数据规模，并同时提高任务接受率与构建吞吐。

papers.title: HEM-Med: A Hierarchical Agentic Memory Framework for Safe Multi-Center Medication Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Medication recommendation (MR) is critical for clinical decision support. While existing MR methods are mostly designed for single-center learning, where only one independent hospital is involved, multi-center MR with hospitals of different scales has become increasingly demanding in practice. In multi center settings, abundant data from large medical centers can improve recommendation performance for low-resource centers. Despite a few preliminary attempts on this task, two critical gaps remain. Gap 1: Existing multi-center methods fail to disentangle transferable cross-hospital clinical experience from hospital-specific prescribing patterns, limiting clinical feasibility and physician acceptance. Gap 2: They commonly overlook multi label safety constraints of MR, including drug-drug interaction risks and local formulary feasibility, which are essential for safe real-world deployment. To address these gaps, we propose HEM-Med, a novel hierarchical agentic memory framework for multi-center MR. To address Gap 1, we design a disentangled hierarchical memory module that builds patient-level medication context attribution records and disentangles them into cross hospital experience memory and hospital-specific residual memory. To address Gap 2, we introduce a safety-aware medication set generation module, which integrates dual-level experience retrieval with safety-aware set decoding to produce clinically relevant, safer, and locally adaptive medication recommendations. Experiments on a real-world multi-center eICU dataset show that HEM-Med outperforms representative transfer learning, LLM-based, and MR baselines in terms of both recommendation accuracy and safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HEM-Med 用分层智能体记忆做多中心用药推荐：把患者级用药上下文归因记录拆成跨医院经验记忆与医院特异残差记忆，再用双层经验检索加安全感知集合解码生成药物集。在真实多中心 eICU 数据集上，其推荐准确率与安全性同时超过代表性迁移学习、LLM 与 MR 基线。
Motivation: 多中心用药推荐中，现有方法既无法把可迁移的跨医院临床经验与医院特有处方模式分开，也忽略药物相互作用风险与本地处方集可行性这类多标签安全约束，难以安全落地。
Method: 分层智能体记忆框架 HEM-Med：disentangled hierarchical memory 模块构建患者级用药上下文归因记录并拆分为跨医院经验记忆与医院特异残差记忆；safety-aware medication set generation 模块以双层经验检索配合安全感知集合解码输出药物集。
Result: 在真实世界多中心 eICU 数据集上，HEM-Med 在推荐准确率与安全性两个维度均优于代表性迁移学习基线、LLM 基线与 MR 基线。
Conclusion: 把跨医院经验与医院特异处方解耦、并在解码阶段显式施加安全约束，可在多中心用药推荐中同时提升准确率与安全性。

papers.title: Value-Guided Repulsion for Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Drifting models have emerged as a highly efficient and stable paradigm for policy design in offline reinforcement learning (RL). However, standard drift policies determine repulsion solely from geometric relationships among generated actions and therefore cannot distinguish them by expected value. To address this limitation, we introduce Value-Guided Repulsion Q-Learning (VRQL) to integrate action value estimates into the particle interaction field. For each state, VRQL combines geometric kernel distance with a normalized Q value scaling. This mechanism assigns greater repulsive influence to particles with lower values while strictly retaining attraction toward behavior action. Consequently, this value-guided interaction field aligns behavior regularization with policy improvement without adding an auxiliary behavior model stage. On 50 OGBench task configurations and 6 D4RL AntMaze configurations, VRQL demonstrates highly competitive performance against established baselines, suggesting that value-guided particle interaction is an effective method for offline RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 离线强化学习的 drifting policy 只按动作几何距离决定排斥，无法区分动作价值高低。VRQL 把归一化 Q 值并入粒子交互场：几何核距离与 Q 缩放共同决定排斥强度，低价值粒子受更强排斥，同时严格保留对行为动作的吸引。在 50 个 OGBench 任务配置与 6 个 D4RL AntMaze 配置上取得与既有基线高度竞争的表现。
Motivation: 标准 drift policy 仅凭生成动作间的几何关系施加排斥，无法按期望价值区分动作，行为正则与策略改进方向脱节。
Method: 提出 Value-Guided Repulsion Q-Learning (VRQL)：对每个状态，将几何核距离与归一化 Q 值缩放结合构成粒子交互场，低 Q 粒子获得更大排斥力，同时严格保留对行为动作的吸引；该机制无需额外的辅助行为模型阶段。
Result: 在 50 个 OGBench 任务配置和 6 个 D4RL AntMaze 配置上，VRQL 对比既有基线表现出高度竞争的性能。
Conclusion: 价值引导的粒子交互能同时对齐行为正则与策略改进，是离线 RL 中有效且无需辅助行为模型的机制。

papers.title: Dimension-Optimal Dynamic Regret in Exp-Concave Online Learning
papers.abstract_en: Tracking changing comparators is a central problem in online learning. For exp-concave losses, previous work established the $T^{1/3}P_T^{2/3}$ dependence on the horizon $T$ and Euclidean path length $P_T$ for fixed dimension, while the optimal cost of dimension remained unresolved. We resolve this question by establishing a sharp $d^{1/3}$ curved dimension factor, improving the $d^{2/3}$ factor of recent switching and interval reductions [1, 2]. To achieve this improvement, we develop a proper, full-information learner on compact convex subsets of $\mathbb{R}^d$ that adapts to the unknown path length and, under fixed dimension-independent diameter, gradient, and curvature parameters, guarantees $$\operatorname{Reg}_T(u_{1:T}) \le \widetilde{O}\left(d+\min\left\{d^{1/3}T^{1/3}P_T^{2/3},\sqrt{TP_T},T\right\}\right).$$ A matching lower bound on a diameter-one Euclidean ball establishes the minimax frontier up to logarithmic factors when $T\gtrsim d^2$, including the transition from the curved rate to larger path budgets. The lower bound already holds for losses that depend on only one coordinate per round, isolating an unavoidable cost of learning across directions. Our upper bound follows from square-root Gaussian KL control of comparator movement and a cancellation argument that pays for history restarts. The curved learner maintains $O(\log^2 T)$ Gaussian states, uses one gradient per round, and runs in time near-linear in $T$ under a Mahalanobis-projection oracle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 exp-concave 损失的动态遗憾 (dynamic regret) 问题上，把固定维度下已知的 T^{1/3}P_T^{2/3} 依赖补上维度代价，得到尖锐的 d^{1/3} 因子，改进近期 switching/interval 归约的 d^{2/3}。上界 Reg_T ≤ Õ(d + min{d^{1/3}T^{1/3}P_T^{2/3}, √(TP_T), T})，在直径为 1 的欧氏球上给出匹配下界，T ≳ d² 时确定 minimax 前沿（至多差对数因子）。
Motivation: 跟踪变化的 comparator 是在线学习的核心问题；exp-concave 损失下 T 与路径长度 P_T 的 T^{1/3}P_T^{2/3} 依赖在固定维度时已知，但维度的最优代价一直未解决。
Method: 在 R^d 的紧凸子集上构造 proper、full-information 学习器，自适应未知路径长度；上界由 comparator 移动的 square-root Gaussian KL 控制与抵消历史重启代价的 cancellation 论证得到。学习器维护 O(log² T) 个 Gaussian 状态，每轮用一次梯度，在 Mahalanobis-projection oracle 下运行时间近线性于 T。
Result: Reg_T(u_{1:T}) ≤ Õ(d + min{d^{1/3}T^{1/3}P_T^{2/3}, √(TP_T), T})，维度因子由 d^{2/3} 降到 d^{1/3}；直径 1 欧氏球上的匹配下界在 T ≳ d² 时确立 minimax 前沿（至多差对数因子），含从 curved rate 到更大路径预算的转变；下界对每轮只依赖单个坐标的损失即已成立。

papers.title: Cross-Model In-Context Neurofeedback Reveals (Limited) Activation Control in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Probes on activation vectors are widely used to detect misbehavior in language models, but their success relies on the assumption that models cannot control what their activations encode. Humans can learn, through neurofeedback, to control the firing of even single neurons, and recent studies investigated whether this ability extends to language models, reaching conflicting conclusions. No experimental design so far disentangles competence at the task from genuine access to one's own activations. We fill this gap with in-context neurofeedback sessions, in which a "subject" model is asked to maximize (or minimize) a score derived from its activations, shown back to it at every turn. In our first experiment, the sentences are generated either by the subject or by a second "writer" model, while the score always derives from the activations of the subject. We test ten open-weight models from five families, with sizes from 9B to 32B. Some models move their own scores considerably, but no more than a writer of comparable competence moves them. Is this because the task requires no privileged access, or because the subject controls its activations while processing the sentences, whoever wrote them? To answer this, we prefill a fixed sentence as the subject's reply at every turn and ask it to increase or decrease the score. Three out of ten models show small but consistent control effects. We further ask whether models can control their activations to the point of fooling an activation monitor. We make models repeat sentences a monitor would flag, such as a deceptive answer for a deception monitor, and ask them to raise or lower the monitor's score. No model learns to lower it, but one model can raise it. In-context control of a model's own activations might not yet be a threat to activation monitors, but it exists in a few models and needs to be tracked as models evolve.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 11 figures, 5 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/Dundalia/control-with-neurofeedback
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 in-context neurofeedback 检验 LLM 能否控制自身激活：受试模型每轮看到由自己激活算出的分数并被要求最大化或最小化。十个 9B–32B 开源模型中，部分模型能明显移动分数但不超出同等能力的 writer 模型；固定预填回复后仅 3/10 显示小幅但一致的控制效应；无模型能降低欺骗监控器分数，仅 1 个能抬高。
Motivation: 基于激活向量的 probe 依赖“模型无法控制其激活编码内容”这一假设，而人类可通过 neurofeedback 控制单神经元放电，已有研究结论互相冲突，且现有实验设计无法区分任务胜任力与对自身激活的真实访问。
Method: in-context neurofeedback 会话：受试模型每轮收到由自身激活导出的分数并被要求最大化或最小化。实验一让句子由受试或第二个 writer 模型生成、分数始终取自受试激活；实验二每轮预填固定句子作为受试回复再要求升降分；第三步让模型重复监控器会标记的句子（如欺骗监控器下的欺骗回答）并要求升降监控器分数。覆盖五个家族十个开源模型，9B 到 32B。
Result: 十个开源模型（五家族，9B–32B）中部分能大幅移动自身分数，但不超过同等能力 writer 的移动幅度；预填固定句子后仅 3/10 模型显示小幅但一致的控制效应；无模型学会降低激活监控器分数，1 个模型能抬高它。
Conclusion: in-context 激活控制目前对激活监控器尚不构成威胁，但在少数模型中确实存在，需随模型演进持续跟踪。

papers.title: RM-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Generative Reward Models
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning on Mixed-domain preference data (Mix-RL) has become the mainstream approach for training general-purpose Generative Reward Models (GRMs). However, Mix-RL suffers from two critical bottlenecks: the reward sparsity induced by outcome rewards, and the cross-domain interference arising from jointly optimizing heterogeneous capabilities, which together give rise to imbalanced capability acquisition and pervasive reward hacking. Inspired by the success of On-Policy Distillation (OPD) in multi-domain capability integration, we introduce RM-OPD (Reward Modeling via On-Policy Distillation), a two-stage framework that separates specialist acquisition from capability integration. First, we cultivate domain-specialized teacher models via single-domain GRPO fine-tuning, allowing each expert to reach its performance ceiling in isolation; then we consolidate these teachers into one student model through (i) routed on-policy distillation, which provides dense signed token-level supervision on student-generated critiques; (ii) domain contribution reweighting, which reweights token guidance toward target domain shares, preventing specific domains from dominating optimization; and (iii) optional criteria context distillation, which conditions teachers on domain-specific evaluation criteria to sharpen token-level supervision. Across multiple RM benchmarks and two base models, RM-OPD consistently outperforms vanilla Mix-RL and other strong baselines, achieving overall superior performance and exhibiting an emergent "teacher-surpassing" effect. These results establish RM-OPD as a promising paradigm for building generalist GRMs.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 4 figures; includes references and appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RM-OPD 把混合域偏好数据上的生成式奖励模型 (GRM) 训练拆成两阶段：先用单域 GRPO 微调出各域专家教师，再经路由式 on-policy 蒸馏把它们整合进一个学生模型，得到稠密的 token 级带符号监督。在多个 RM benchmark 和两个基座模型上，它一致优于 vanilla Mix-RL 与其他强基线，并出现教师被学生超越 (teacher-surpassing) 的现象。
Motivation: 混合域 RL 训练 GRM 存在结果奖励带来的奖励稀疏，以及异构能力联合优化造成的跨域干扰，导致能力获取失衡和普遍的 reward hacking。
Method: 两阶段框架：先对每个域做单域 GRPO 微调得到达到各自性能上限的专家教师；整合阶段用 (i) routed on-policy distillation 在学生自己生成的 critique 上给出稠密带符号 token 级监督，(ii) domain contribution reweighting 按目标域占比加权 token 引导以防某域主导优化，(iii) 可选的 criteria context distillation 让教师以域专属评测条件为上下文来锐化监督。
Result: 在多个 RM benchmark、两个基座模型上，RM-OPD 一致优于 vanilla Mix-RL 及其他强基线，取得整体更优性能，并呈现 emergent teacher-surpassing 效应。
Conclusion: 先分域获取能力、再做路由式 on-policy 蒸馏整合，是构建通才 GRM 的可行范式，且学生可超过其教师。

papers.title: MultiPartyTurnBench: Benchmarking Floor Control in Multi-Party Spoken Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: Full-duplex speech systems must decide when to enter, hold, or relinquish the conversational floor, even as multiple speakers overlap or backchannel without taking it. Existing evaluations study dyadic turn-taking or end-to-end agent behavior, but lack a unified, controlled evaluation of genuine floor transitions against confusable non-events in multi-party settings. We introduce MultiPartyTurnBench (MPTB), a benchmark of 240 synthetically generated, channel-separated conversations spanning two to five speakers and six interaction types. MPTB evaluates two complementary tasks: End-of-Turn (EOT) detection distinguishes genuine turn completion from temporary holds, while Interruption (INT) detection distinguishes successful floor takeovers from non-floor-taking speech. Exact event-conditioned annotations enable causal evaluation using false-positive-constrained recall and signed latency. Across acoustic, semantic, and turn-projection baselines, we find a stark asymmetry: learned systems achieve 82.5-92.6% EOT recall at 4.3-11.8% false-positive rates, while INT detection suffers from missed takeovers or excessive false activations. This asymmetry extends to five full-duplex agents which achieve 86.1-95.8% balanced accuracy on turn entry, yet perform near chance (46.9-54.7%) on selective interruption handling. Gemini-3.8-Live yields to 97.7% of backchannels, whereas MiniCPM-o-4.5 yields to only 1.4% of genuine interruptions. These findings establish selective floor control as a distinct, unresolved challenge for reliable multi-party voice interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MultiPartyTurnBench (MPTB) 是针对多方全双工语音的地板控制 (floor control) 基准：240 段合成、声道分离的 2–5 人对话，含六种交互类型，用事件条件标注做 EOT 检测与打断 (INT) 检测的因果评测。结果呈强烈不对称——EOT 召回 82.5–92.6%（假阳率 4.3–11.8%），而选择性打断接近随机（46.9–54.7%），Gemini-3.8-Live 对 97.7% 的 backchannel 都让步、MiniCPM-o-4.5 只对 1.4% 的真实打断让步。
Motivation: 现有评测只覆盖二人轮换或端到端 agent 行为，缺少在多方场景中把真实地板转换与易混淆非事件（backchannel、未夺权发言）统一、受控区分开的评测。
Method: MPTB 提供 240 段合成且声道分离的对话（2–5 位说话人、六种交互类型），设两个互补任务：End-of-Turn (EOT) 检测区分真正轮次结束与临时保持，Interruption (INT) 检测区分成功夺权与非夺权发言；采用精确的事件条件标注，用假阳率约束下的召回 (false-positive-constrained recall) 与带符号时延 (signed latency) 做因果评测，覆盖声学、语义与轮次预测 (turn-projection) 三类基线。
Result: 学习系统 EOT 召回 82.5–92.6%，对应假阳率 4.3–11.8%；INT 检测则表现为漏夺取权或过度误触发。五个全双工 agent 在轮次进入 (turn entry) 上平衡准确率 86.1–95.8%，但在选择性打断处理上仅 46.9–54.7%，接近随机。Gemini-3.8-Live 对 97.7% 的 backchannel 让步，MiniCPM-o-4.5 仅对 1.4% 的真实打断让步。
Conclusion: 选择性地板控制是与轮次结束检测不同的、尚未解决的挑战：现有系统能可靠判断何时接话，却无法在多方语音中区分该让的 backchannel 与该抢的真实打断。
Relevance: 4
