papers.title: Optimizing Sparse Boolean Rule Networks using Mixed Integer Linear Programming
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of learning accurate and cognitively simple binary classifiers that are directly interpretable as Boolean rules. We propose mixed integer linear programming (MILP) formulations for training sparse disjunctive normal form (DNF) networks, viewed as small networks with a conjunctive hidden layer and a disjunctive output layer. Contrary to previous work that uses MILP for inductive rule learning, we start with a fixed network structure, for which we then find optimal weights. A regularized objective explicitly trades off misclassification costs against sparsity, yielding globally optimized rule sets. Our main technical contribution is an enhanced formulation that substantially reduces the number of integer decision variables and eliminates redundant constraints, while preserving exact Boolean semantics for all feasible solutions. Furthermore, we develop a combined approach based on initialization and dropout to break symmetries in the weights between rules, mitigating redundancy, and encouraging more diverse and stable rule representations. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and UCI datasets show that the advanced formulation improves computational efficiency and achieves competitive or superior accuracy compared to established interpretable baselines, including SAT-based DNF learning and well-known rule- and tree-based learners. Overall, our approach provides a principled optimization framework for learning compact Boolean rule sets with explicit control over accuracy and sparsity trade-offs.
papers.comment: Preprint (submitted version, prior to peer review) of a paper accepted at RuleML+RR 2026, to appear in LNCS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 MILP 在固定网络结构下直接求解稀疏 DNF 布尔规则网络的全局最优权重，正则化目标显式权衡误分类代价与稀疏度。增强 formulation 大幅削减整数变量数并消除冗余约束，同时保持所有可行解的精确布尔语义；在合成基准与 UCI 数据集上计算效率更高，精度相对 SAT-based DNF 学习及规则/树模型等可解释基线具有竞争力或更优。
Motivation: 既准确又认知简单、可直接读作布尔规则的二分类器难以训练：以往 MILP 规则学习多用于归纳式规则搜索，而非在给定网络结构下求最优权重。
Method: 把稀疏 DNF 网络视为「合取隐层 + 析取输出层」的小型网络，用 MILP 在固定结构下求最优权重；正则化目标权衡误分类代价与稀疏度。技术贡献是增强 formulation：大幅减少整数决策变量、删除冗余约束且保持精确布尔语义；另用初始化加 dropout 的组合方法打破规则间权重对称，抑制冗余并鼓励多样稳定的规则表示。
Result: 在合成基准与 UCI 数据集上，增强 formulation 提升计算效率，精度相对 SAT-based DNF 学习及规则、树类可解释基线达到竞争力或更优水平。
Conclusion: 在固定结构下用 MILP 全局优化权重，可为紧凑布尔规则集提供精度与稀疏度显式可控的原理性优化框架。

summary_sections.method: 把稀疏 DNF 网络视为「合取隐层 + 析取输出层」的小型网络，用 MILP 在固定结构下求最优权重；正则化目标权衡误分类代价与稀疏度。技术贡献是增强 formulation：大幅减少整数决策变量、删除冗余约束且保持精确布尔语义；另用初始化加 dropout 的组合方法打破规则间权重对称，抑制冗余并鼓励多样稳定的规则表示。
summary_sections.result: 在合成基准与 UCI 数据集上，增强 formulation 提升计算效率，精度相对 SAT-based DNF 学习及规则、树类可解释基线达到竞争力或更优水平。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在固定结构下用 MILP 全局优化权重，可为紧凑布尔规则集提供精度与稀疏度显式可控的原理性优化框架。

papers.title: Gap Detection: Mitigating Homogenization through Demand and Defensibility
papers.abstract_en: Language models often produce semantically similar answers to open-ended questions, even when many plausible alternatives exist. Generating useful alternatives requires identifying both what the query calls for and what existing responses already cover. We introduce Gap Detection, a framework that searches for relevant but unoccupied directions in a shared text embedding space. Its objective, GapScore, combines query relevance (Demand) with dissimilarity to the nearest existing item (Defensibility). The framework optimizes this product on the unit sphere, maps candidate directions to concept words with a language model, and uses task-specific filtering and constrained prompting to turn those concepts into text. On five curated topics and 90 INFINITY-CHAT queries, the reported mean relative reductions in output Collision are 12.8% and 10.8%, respectively. We also instantiate the framework for generative engine optimization over four product markets and for iterative synthetic-data augmentation. In the latter setting, with 100 training examples per method, Gap Detection reduces Collision from 0.324 to 0.298 relative to undirected accumulation and increases the Vendi Score from 27.16 to 29.20; the accuracy difference is one example on a 40-example test set. Component ablations expose the trade-off between semantic separation and relevance, while also showing that better direction scores do not uniformly yield better downstream metrics. These results support explicit gap search as a practical mechanism for diversifying content, with task validity checked separately from geometric novelty.
papers.comment: 24 pages; submitted to ICLR 2027, under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Gap Detection 框架，在共享文本嵌入空间中搜索「相关但未被占据」的方向：目标函数 GapScore = 查询相关性 (Demand) 与到最近已有条目距离 (Defensibility) 的乘积，在单位球面上优化该乘积，再用语言模型把候选方向映射为概念词并经任务过滤与受约束提示生成文本。在五个主题与 90 条 INFINITY-CHAT 查询上输出 Collision 的平均相对降幅分别为 12.8% 与 10.8%；在合成数据增广设定下（每方法 100 个训练样本），Collision 从 0.324 降到 0.298，Vendi Score 从 27.16 升到 29.20，但 40 条测试集上的准确率差异只有一个样本。
Motivation: 语言模型对开放式问题的回答语义高度同质，即使存在大量合理替代方案；要生成有用替代，需同时判断查询要求什么以及已有回答覆盖了什么，而现有生成过程缺少对「未被占据方向」的显式搜索。
Method: Gap Detection 在共享文本嵌入空间中定义 GapScore，为查询相关性 (Demand) 与到最近已有条目的不相似度 (Defensibility) 之积；在单位球面上优化该乘积，用语言模型把候选方向映射为概念词，再经任务特定过滤与受约束提示 (constrained prompting) 生成文本。框架另被实例化用于四个产品市场的生成式引擎优化 (generative engine optimization) 与迭代式合成数据增广。
Result: 五个主题与 90 条 INFINITY-CHAT 查询上，输出 Collision 的平均相对降幅分别为 12.8% 与 10.8%。合成数据增广设定（每方法 100 个训练样本）中，相对无向累积 (undirected accumulation)，Collision 由 0.324 降至 0.298，Vendi Score 由 27.16 升至 29.20，40 条测试集上的准确率差异为一个样本。消融显示语义分离度与相关性之间存在权衡，且更高的方向分数并不一致地带来更好的下游指标。
Conclusion: 显式 gap search 可作为内容多样化 (diversification) 的实用机制，但任务有效性需与几何新颖性分开检验——方向分数更高并不保证下游指标更好。

papers.title: OneLA: Learning Many Worlds from Latent Actions
papers.abstract_en: Learning world models across diverse domains calls for a unified control space, yet ac- tion interfaces vary across domains and action annotations are often scarce. Latent ac- tions learned directly from videos offer a promising way to establish such a space without explicit action supervision. However, learning shared latent actions across domains re- mains challenging, as variations in appearance, embodiment, and dynamics can entangle domain-specific visual cues with transferable transition structure. To this end, we intro- duce OneLA, a simple framework that learns continuous latent actions through a shared orthogonal dictionary and a common predictive objective, without task-specific designs or cross-domain alignment losses during latent action pretraining. These latent actions pro- vide a shared conditioning interface for world models, with lightweight adapters mapping native control commands into the same space. Conditioned on latent actions and the cur- rent visual state, the world model predicts context-dependent transitions for controllable rollout. OneLA improves action readout across domains and reduces action cycle-transfer rotation error by 24.8% over the strongest evaluated baseline. A joint-training comparison further shows a 20.5% improvement in Human Preference Score v3 (HPSv3) for real- scene generation. These results suggest a path toward general-purpose world models that learn from diverse videos and support flexible control through latent action space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OneLA 用共享正交字典与统一预测目标从视频学连续 latent action，作为跨域世界模型的统一控制接口，轻量 adapter 把各域原生指令映射到同一空间。动作 cycle-transfer 旋转误差比最强基线降 24.8%，真实场景生成的 HPSv3 提升 20.5%。
Motivation: 跨域世界模型缺少统一控制空间：各域动作接口不同且动作标注稀缺，外观、具身与动力学差异会把域特有视觉线索和可迁移的转移结构纠缠在一起。
Method: 从视频直接学连续 latent action，用共享正交字典 (shared orthogonal dictionary) 加统一预测目标，预训练阶段不做任务特定设计也不加跨域对齐损失；latent action 作为世界模型的共享条件接口，轻量 adapter 把原生控制指令映入同一空间，再由世界模型在 latent action 与当前视觉状态下预测上下文相关的转移以做可控 rollout。
Result: 动作 cycle-transfer 旋转误差比最强评估基线降低 24.8%；联合训练对比中真实场景生成的 Human Preference Score v3 (HPSv3) 提升 20.5%。
Conclusion: 不依赖跨域对齐损失的共享正交 latent action 字典即可改善跨域动作读出并支撑可控 rollout，指向从多样视频学通用世界模型的路径。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Dataset-Level Regularization for Joint-Embedding Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised joint embedding learning aligns representations of augmented views while regularizing their distribution to prevent collapse. Regularization aims to shape the overall representation distribution, but most joint embedding methods restrict its computation to the active minibatch. We propose out-of-batch regularization, which maintains a dataset-level state in CPU memory and uses globally constructed per-instance targets during minibatch training. Evaluated on natural images and biomedical datasets, these anchors approximate the full-dataset regularization gradient more faithfully than conventional minibatch estimation at small batch sizes. Applications to contrastive (SimCLR) and non-contrastive (SIGReg) approaches show consistent improvement over the corresponding in-batch objectives for image classification, minority-class performance under controlled imbalance, instance retrieval, and continued self-supervised pretraining, with the largest gains at small batch sizes. These results suggest that dataset-level regularization can be decoupled from minibatch optimization, making batch size an optimization choice that does not affect the geometry of the regularizer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 out-of-batch regularization：在 CPU 内存中维护数据集级状态，为每个样本构造全局目标，使联合嵌入自监督的正则化不再局限于当前 minibatch。在自然图像与生物医学数据集上，该正则对 SimCLR 与 SIGReg 在图像分类、受控不平衡下的少数类性能、实例检索和持续自监督预训练上均一致优于对应的 in-batch 目标，且小 batch size 时增益最大。
Motivation: 联合嵌入自监督方法的正则化本应塑造整体表示分布，但多数方法只在活跃 minibatch 内计算，导致正则几何随 batch size 改变。
Method: 在 CPU 内存维护数据集级状态，训练时用全局构造的 per-instance 目标（anchors）近似全数据集正则化梯度；将该 out-of-batch 正则分别接入对比方法 SimCLR 与非对比方法 SIGReg。
Result: 在自然图像与生物医学数据集上，anchors 比常规 minibatch 估计在小 batch size 时更忠实地近似全数据集正则化梯度；SimCLR 与 SIGReg 在图像分类、受控不平衡下的少数类性能、实例检索、持续自监督预训练上均一致优于各自 in-batch 目标，增益在小 batch size 时最大。
Conclusion: 数据集级正则化可以与 minibatch 优化解耦，使 batch size 变成纯粹的优化选择而不再影响正则项的几何。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: LLM-Based Policy Compliance Verification of Loan Applications
papers.abstract_en: Banks rely on extensive internal policy frameworks to ensure that corporate lending decisions comply with regulatory requirements and internal risk standards. Reviewing loan applications against these policies is a largely manual and knowledge-intensive process, which can lead to overlooked policy violations or exceptions. This report presents a prototype of an LLM-based policy checker that automatically verifies loan applications against internal lending policies. The proposed approach follows a two-step architecture. First, compliance-relevant rules are automatically extracted from policy documents and converted into structured, machine-readable representations. Second, loan applications are evaluated against the extracted rules to identify policy exceptions, non-compliant findings, missing information, and cases requiring manual review. Evaluation results demonstrate that the rule extraction process is highly stable across multiple runs and consistently captures rules identified as critical by a domain expert. When evaluated on 11 real loan applications with known policy exceptions, the system successfully detected the majority of these exceptions and identified additional compliance issues that had previously been overlooked during manual reviews. While the approach produces false positives and cannot fully replace human judgement, the results indicate that LLM-based policy compliance verification can provide valuable support in the loan application verification process by highlighting potential compliance risks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 银行贷款审批的政策合规核查目前靠人工逐条比对内部制度，容易漏掉违规与例外。本文提出两步式 LLM 政策检查器：先从政策文档自动抽取合规规则并转成结构化机器可读表示，再用这些规则评估贷款申请，标出例外、不合规、信息缺失与需人工复核的条目。在 11 份已知存在政策例外的真实贷款申请上，系统检出了多数例外，并额外发现人工复核阶段已遗漏的合规问题。
Motivation: 银行对公贷款要同时满足监管要求与内部风险标准，靠人工对照大量内部制度核查申请，知识密集且容易漏掉政策违规或例外。
Method: 两步架构：第一步从政策文档自动抽取合规相关规则并转为结构化、机器可读的表示；第二步用这些规则逐条评估贷款申请，输出政策例外、不合规发现、信息缺失以及需要人工复核的案例。
Result: 规则抽取在多次运行间高度稳定，并持续捕获领域专家判定为关键的规则；在 11 份已知存在政策例外的真实贷款申请上，系统检出其中多数例外，还发现了人工复核时已遗漏的额外合规问题。
Conclusion: LLM 政策合规核查可以作为贷款申请核查的辅助手段，突出潜在合规风险；系统仍会产生假阳性，无法完全取代人工判断。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: R&D activity in INAF on light instrumentation for continuous optical turbulence monitoring
authors: Sam Ragland (4) ((1) INAF - Osservatorio Astrofisico di Arcetri
ADaptive Optics National laboratory of INAF
papers.abstract_en: Measurements of optical turbulence are essential in both ground-based astronomy and free-space optical communication systems contexts for multiple reasons including supporting and optimizing Adaptive Optics. Similarly, forecasting these parameters is highly valuable for planning observational campaigns; however, it requires at least two years of continuous data to generate a reliable training dataset. The most commonly used instruments to monitor continuously the optical turbulence include DIMM, MASS, SLODAR, RINGSS sensors. The Arcetri team is leading two operational forecast systems for two different Observatories: ALTA above LBT, and FATE above VLT. Both systems are in continuous evolution and obviously forecast performances depend also on available measurements. Our long-term goal is to develop our own instruments to obtain continuous measurements directly from local observations. In this work, we present an automated system designed for continuous seeing measurements using multiple sensors. This portable station integrates a Cyclope, a RINGSS unit, a scintillometer which operate together to provide comprehensive night-time atmospheric information. We will compare the performance of low-cost sensors, such as the Cyclope and the scintillometer, with that of the RINGSS turbulence profiler, which has been fully installed and programmed by our team in collaboration of LBT team. A dedicated insturment for night and day-time measurements is planned for near future. This system incorporates a fully automatic on-site system that monitors operational status, delivers real-time information on sensor conditions and measurements, and manages synchronization with the data storage unit. The system's real-time acquisition capability enables continuous turbulence analysis, supports R&D activities, facilitates local data generation, and allows on-site testing of forecasting methodologies.
papers.comment: 6 figures, 1 table, SPIE Proc. Adaptive Optics Systems X, 2026, Vol. 14150, id. 141506R
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: INAF 团队提出一套便携式连续光学湍流监测站，把 Cyclope、RINGSS 湍流廓线仪和闪烁仪组合起来做全自动化夜间视宁度测量，并与 ALTA（LBT 上方）和 FATE（VLT 上方）两套业务化湍流预报系统对接，用于自产本地训练数据以支撑预报方法的现场检验。
Motivation: 光学湍流预报需要至少两年连续观测才能构建可靠训练集，而现有 DIMM、MASS、SLODAR、RINGSS 等监测设备成本高、部署受限，制约了天文自适应光学与自由空间光通信的观测规划。
Method: 便携站集成 Cyclope、RINGSS 湍流廓线仪与闪烁仪协同工作，配套全自动在站系统监控运行状态、实时回传传感器状况与测量数据并与存储单元同步；将低成本传感器（Cyclope、闪烁仪）与团队自装自编程的 RINGSS 廓线仪做性能对比，并规划昼夜两用的专用仪器。
Result: 该系统具备实时采集能力，可实现连续湍流分析、支撑 R&D、生成本地数据并支持预报方法的现场测试；摘要未给出具体对比数值。
Conclusion: 自建连续湍流监测能力是提升 ALTA 与 FATE 等湍流预报系统性能的前提，低成本传感器与 RINGSS 廓线仪的对比将决定其可用性。

papers.title: Attention-Based Spatio-Temporal Approach for Fire and Smoke Detection
papers.abstract_en: In various industries, smoke and fire are two of the most important threats in the workplace. One of the common methods for detecting smoke and fire is the use of infrared thermal and smoke sensors, which cannot be used in outdoor applications. Therefore, the use of vision-based methods seems necessary. The problem of smoke and fire detection is spatiotemporal and requires spatiotemporal solutions. This paper presents a method that uses spatial features along with temporal-based features to detect smoke and fire in the scene. It consists of three main parts; the task of each part is to reduce the error of the previous part so that the final model has a robust performance. This method also uses transformer modules to increase the accuracy of the model. The results of our model show the proper performance of the proposed approach in solving the problem of smoke and fire detection and can be used to increase workplace safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向户外烟雾与火焰检测提出一种基于注意力的时空视觉方法：空间特征与时序特征分三部分级联，每部分负责降低前一部分的误差，并插入 transformer 模块提升精度。作者称该方法在烟雾与火焰检测问题上表现出良好性能，可用于提升工作场所安全。
Motivation: 红外热感与烟雾传感器无法用于户外场景，而烟雾火焰检测本身是时空问题，需要能同时建模空间与时间信息的视觉方案。
Method: 以视觉输入提取空间特征与时序特征，三部分级联、后级任务是降低前级误差，整体架构中加入 transformer 模块以提高检测精度。
Result: 作者报告所提方法在烟雾与火焰检测问题上具有良好表现；摘要未给出具体数据集、指标或与基线的数值对比。
Conclusion: 烟雾与火焰检测应作为空间加时间的联合建模问题处理，级联误差消减配合 transformer 可得到稳健的检测性能并服务于工作场所安全。

papers.title: In-Context Batch Black-box Optimization via Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Batch black-box optimization is important for expensive systems where many candidates can be evaluated in parallel, yet only a few rounds of evaluation are affordable. In this regime, effective batch construction must identify multiple promising regions while avoiding redundant evaluations, and conventional Bayesian optimization can require increasingly difficult batch-selection procedures as the batch size grows. We introduce Flow Matching for Thompson-Sampling Refinement (FMTR), an amortized approach that learns offline a continuous, history-conditioned proposal distribution from which variable-size batches can be sampled. FMTR is trained offline by conditional flow matching on Thompson-sampling argmaxes refined toward high-value regions via a horizon-dependent Langevin pushforward map, adapting the exploration-exploitation tradeoff over the optimization horizon. At test time, the model parameters remain fixed and batch generation requires neither task-specific surrogate refitting nor numerical acquisition optimization. FMTR achieves strong performance against batch BO and in-context baselines on synthetic and real-world benchmarks, while substantially reducing the computational cost of batch selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 FMTR：用条件流匹配离线训练一个以历史为条件的连续提议分布，测试时直接采样可变大小的批候选做黑盒优化，无需重拟合代理模型或数值优化采集函数。在合成与真实基准上对批式贝叶斯优化和 in-context 基线取得强性能，同时大幅降低批选择的计算开销。
Motivation: 昂贵系统中只能负担少数几轮并行评估，批式黑盒优化需要同时锁定多个有希望的区域并避免冗余评估，而常规贝叶斯优化的批选择过程随批增大越来越难解。
Method: FMTR 以 Thompson 采样的 argmax 为训练目标，用 horizon-dependent 的 Langevin pushforward map 把样本向高值区域推，通过条件流匹配离线学习历史条件下的连续提议分布；测试时参数固定，可变大小批直接从该分布采样。
Result: 在合成与真实基准上相对批式 BO 与 in-context 基线取得强性能，并大幅降低批选择的计算成本；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把批选择摊销 (amortize) 成离线训练的流匹配提议分布，可以在不重拟合代理、不做采集优化的前提下替代在线批式 BO 的选择步骤。

papers.title: StreamErase: Towards Ultra-Fast Streaming Video Erasing
papers.abstract_en: Current video object removal methods suffer from prohibitive latency (minutes per video) and non-causal processing that prevents real-time interaction. We present StreamErase, enabling sub-second latency with up to 26 FPS streaming generation on a single GPU. Our approach first augments a text-to-video model with mask input to generate high-quality videos that erase target objects and synthesize coherent backgrounds, but does not perform inference on the fly. As such, we progressively transfer the erasing capability from a powerful bidirectional foundation model to an efficient unidirectional streaming eraser, enabling long-horizon erasing without sacrificing visual fidelity. Several key challenges arise when generating videos over long, potentially infinite horizons: (1) bridging the domain gap from training on finite length and extrapolating to long horizons, (2) sustaining high quality by preventing error accumulation, and (3) maintaining fast inference, without increasing computational cost as the context grows. To address these challenges, we carefully designed sliding-window causal attention with attention sinks. By incorporating self-rollout with attention sinks and KV cache rolling during training, we simulate inference-time extrapolations with a fixed context window, enabling constant-speed generation of arbitrarily long videos. Finally, we establish a dedicated benchmark, LongErase, for streaming long-video object removal. Our model achieves strong performance compared to existing video object erasing models and generalizes well to real-world video scenarios, uniquely enabling infinite-length streaming. With StreamErase, users can input a mask and see the erasing results unfold in real-time, delivering a truly interactive experience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StreamErase 把双向视频修复模型的擦除能力蒸馏给单向流式擦除器，配合带 attention sink 的滑窗因果注意力与 KV cache 滚动，实现单卡最高 26 FPS、亚秒级延迟的长视频目标擦除。训练时用 self-rollout 模拟定长上下文的外推，使任意长视频都能恒速生成，并建立 LongErase 基准。
Motivation: 现有视频目标移除方法延迟高达分钟级且非因果，无法实时交互；长乃至无限时域生成还面临训练长度有限、误差累积、上下文增长导致算力上升三重问题。
Method: 先给 text-to-video 模型加 mask 输入得到能擦除目标并补全背景的模型，再逐步把能力迁移到单向流式擦除器；训练中引入 self-rollout（配合 attention sinks）与 KV cache rolling，配合滑窗因果注意力模拟推理期外推，保持定长上下文与恒定算力。
Result: 单卡最高 26 FPS 流式生成、亚秒级延迟，对比现有视频擦除模型表现强，并可泛化到真实视频场景，支持无限长度流式擦除；同时提出专用基准 LongErase。
Conclusion: 视频擦除可以做到实时交互式、任意长时域恒速生成，前提是把双向模型的能力蒸馏进带定长因果上下文的单向流式架构。

papers.title: Seeing at the Edge: Energy Characterization of Vision-Language Model Inference on Edge Platforms
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are moving onto edge devices, but little is known about how much energy they draw on single-board computers with NPU or GPU accelerators, or where that energy goes. We measure total-system energy, latency, and thermal behavior of Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct and its text-only sibling on a Raspberry Pi 5 with a Hailo-10H NPU and on a Jetson Orin Nano Super, on both CPU and accelerator, and separate the fixed energy of each request from the energy that grows with output length. Because the accelerators use different quantization and serving software, we compare deployment stacks rather than silicon. Three findings stand out. First, NPU offloading makes the Pi a much more efficient VLM platform: it cuts energy per generated token by about two-thirds, leaves the host CPU largely free, and avoids the thermal throttling that the CPU backend reaches in sustained use. Second, an image adds both fixed and per-token energy, but at typical response lengths generating the answer costs far more than processing the image. Third, the Jetson GPU favors short responses through its lower fixed cost per request, whereas the Pi NPU favors longer ones through its lower cost per output token; their energy curves cross near 40 output tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Raspberry Pi 5 + Hailo-10H NPU 与 Jetson Orin Nano Super 上实测 Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct 及其纯文本同门模型的整机能耗、延迟与热行为，并把每次请求的固定能耗与随输出长度增长的能耗拆开。NPU 卸载使 Pi 每生成 token 能耗下降约三分之二、宿主 CPU 基本空闲且避免 CPU 后端持续运行时的热降频；Jetson GPU 因固定成本低适合短回答，Pi NPU 因单 token 成本低适合长回答，两条能耗曲线在约 40 个输出 token 处交叉。
Motivation: VLM 正在迁向边缘设备，但单板计算机上带 NPU 或 GPU 加速器的能耗构成几乎无人测过，也不知道能量具体花在哪里，且不同加速器的量化与服务软件栈各异，直接比芯片没有意义。
Method: 在 Raspberry Pi 5（Hailo-10N NPU）与 Jetson Orin Nano Super 上，分别用 CPU 与加速器运行 Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct 及其纯文本同门模型，测整机能耗、延迟与热行为，并把请求的固定能耗与随输出长度增长的能耗分离；由于量化与 serving 软件不同，比较对象是部署栈而非芯片。
Result: NPU 卸载让 Pi 每生成 token 能耗降低约三分之二，宿主 CPU 基本被释放，并避免 CPU 后端在持续使用中出现的热降频；图像同时增加固定能耗与每 token 能耗，但在典型回答长度下生成答案的开销远大于处理图像；Jetson GPU 因每次请求固定成本更低而偏向短回答，Pi NPU 因每输出 token 成本更低而偏向长回答，两者能耗曲线在约 40 个输出 token 处交叉。
Conclusion: 边缘 VLM 的能耗选择取决于回答长度：短回答选 Jetson GPU，长回答选 Pi NPU，而 NPU 卸载是让 Pi 成为高效 VLM 平台并避开热降频的关键。

papers.title: DreamHMR: From Video Generation to Human Motion Modeling via Structural Focusing
papers.abstract_en: Human mesh recovery (HMR) provides a geometric foundation for understanding human motion, but accurately reconstructing both body motion and fine hand articulation from videos remains challenging, especially in real-world scenes where occlusion and partial visibility are common. Video generation pretraining offers rich spatial and temporal priors for this task, but its focus on visual synthesis leaves a gap between these representations and explicit human geometry. We present DreamHMR, a general framework that adapts video generation priors for complete body-and-hand reconstruction. It follows a global-to-local strategy, first grounding video representations in human geometry and then refining body and hand detail with reliable local evidence. Global Body Representation Transfer trains the video backbone to predict complete human renderings, turning its native prediction task into a means of learning surface correspondence and posed geometry. Local Joint Feature Enhancement combines contextual estimates with reliable local evidence to recover fine body and hand detail, while limiting interference from occluders and background. Experiments on five datasets with four video backbones demonstrate strong reconstruction performance across backbone families. Under a unified evaluation protocol, our best model outperforms the best existing methods on all reported metrics of 3DPW, EMDB-1, and RICH, reducing body MPJPE by 4.2%, 4.7%, and 6.1%, respectively. In more challenging occlusion settings on held-out BEDLAM and EgoBody sequences, DreamHMR reduces overall body and hand MPJPE by 7.0% and 10.0%, respectively. Our code will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DreamHMR 把视频生成预训练的时空先验迁移到人体网格恢复 (HMR)，用全局到局部两步：先让视频 backbone 预测完整人体渲染来学表面对应与姿态几何，再用可靠局部证据细化身体与手部细节并抑制遮挡物干扰。在统一评测协议下，最佳模型在 3DPW、EMDB-1、RICH 上 body MPJPE 分别降低 4.2%、4.7%、6.1%，在 held-out BEDLAM 与 EgoBody 遮挡场景中整体 body 与 hand MPJPE 分别降低 7.0% 与 10.0%。
Motivation: 视频生成预训练提供丰富的时空先验，但其目标是视觉合成，与显式人体几何之间存在鸿沟；真实场景中遮挡与部分可见使身体运动和精细手部姿态的重建都很困难。
Method: Global Body Representation Transfer 训练视频 backbone 预测完整人体渲染，把原生预测任务转为学习表面对应与姿态几何；Local Joint Feature Enhancement 将上下文估计与可靠局部证据结合，恢复身体与手部细节并限制遮挡物与背景干扰。评测覆盖五个数据集与四种 video backbone。
Result: 在统一评测协议下，最佳模型在 3DPW、EMDB-1、RICH 上超越现有最佳方法的全部报告指标，body MPJPE 分别降低 4.2%、4.7%、6.1%；在 held-out BEDLAM 与 EgoBody 的困难遮挡设定上，整体 body 与 hand MPJPE 分别降低 7.0% 与 10.0%。
Conclusion: 视频生成先验经结构聚焦（先全局几何对齐、后局部证据细化）可跨 backbone 家族转化为强重建能力，且在遮挡场景下对手部细节的收益更大；代码将公开。

papers.title: A Bregman Proximal Viewpoint on Neural Operators
papers.abstract_en: We present several advances on neural operators by viewing the action of operator layers as the minimizers of Bregman regularized optimization problems over Banach function spaces. The proposed framework allows interpreting the activation operators as Bregman proximity operators from dual to primal space. This novel viewpoint is general enough to recover classical neural operators as well as a new variant, coined Bregman neural operators, which includes the inverse activation operator and features the same expressivity of standard neural operators. Numerical experiments support the added benefits of the Bregman variant of Fourier neural operators for training deeper and more accurate models.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 267:43965-43989, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把算子层的作用重写为 Banach 函数空间上 Bregman 正则优化问题的极小元，从而把激活算子解释为从对偶空间到原生空间的 Bregman proximity operator。该框架既能复现经典神经算子，又给出含逆激活算子、且与标准神经算子表达力相同的新变体 Bregman neural operator；数值实验支持其让 Fourier neural operator 训得更深、更准确。
Motivation: 神经算子各层的表达能力与训练行为缺少统一的优化论解释，深层 Fourier neural operator 训练困难。
Method: 将算子层视为 Banach 函数空间上 Bregman 正则优化问题的极小元，把激活算子解释为对偶到原生空间的 Bregman proximity operator；由此恢复经典神经算子并构造含逆激活算子的 Bregman neural operator，再在 Fourier neural operator 上实现该变体。
Result: 数值实验表明 Bregman 变体的 Fourier neural operator 能训练更深且更准确的模型，同时新变体保持与标准神经算子相同的表达力。
Conclusion: 以 Bregman 正则优化视角统一神经算子的构造是可行的，且该视角带来的 Bregman 变体在深度与精度上带来实际训练收益。

papers.title: KANLab: TensorFlow Playground for Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
papers.abstract_en: KANLab is a browser-based visualization tool designed to interactively teach the core concepts of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN), forked from the widely successful TensorFlow Playground. To maximize educational clarity, KANLab omits residual connections and learnable scaling parameters found in modern KAN implementations, ensuring that displayed B-spline activation curves directly correspond to their underlying trainable control points. Users can inspect and modify activation functions, initialization schemes and observe gradient descent correcting manual disruptions. Furthermore, user can explore phenomena such as activation variance, interactive pruning, and re\-/training within a compact 2D machine learning setting. KANLab is open-source and available at https://kanlab.app/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KANLab 是从 TensorFlow Playground 分叉的浏览器端 KAN 教学可视化工具，在紧凑的 2D 分类设置里让用户直接查看并改写 B-spline 激活函数、观察梯度下降修复人为扰动，以及激活方差、交互式剪枝与再训练。为保证显示的 B-spline 曲线与其可训练控制点一一对应，它刻意去掉了现代 KAN 实现中的残差连接与可学习缩放参数。
Motivation: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks 的 B-spline 激活与控制点关系抽象，现代实现叠加残差连接和缩放参数后更难在课堂上直观演示。
Method: 从 TensorFlow Playground 分叉出浏览器端工具，去掉残差连接与可学习缩放参数，使显示的 B-spline 激活曲线直接对应底层可训练控制点；用户可检查和修改激活函数、初始化方案，并在 2D 机器学习设定中做交互式剪枝与再训练，观察梯度下降纠正手动扰动。
Result: 开源并发布于 https://kanlab.app/，提供交互式 KAN 概念演示；摘要给出的是功能设定而非基准数字。
Conclusion: 去掉残差连接与缩放参数的简化 KAN 能让激活曲线与控制点一一对应，适合在 2D 环境中做交互式教学演示。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Maximising Transparency in Context Compaction Improves Retention of Facts and Commitments for Lightweight Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long coding agent sessions outgrow the model's context window, so agents compact: older history is replaced by something shorter, usually a model-written summary. A summary selects and rewords, and the agent cannot see what was lost. Existing work has explored a range of compaction techniques, but comparatively little attention has been paid to their effectiveness with lightweight models, including those deployed locally or used for high-volume workloads. Here, we present transparent-compact, a simple deterministic method for the open-source Pi coding agent, designed specifically for use with such models and with the purpose of maximising the transparency of the agent's view of its own compacted context. It guarantees that user and assistant prose in its context is unchanged by a model or algorithm, and explicitly flags where compaction has stripped information. We compare it with Pi's default model-written summary compaction and with pi-vcc, a popular deterministic method with similar methods but without verbatim retention of prose. Our benchmarks run on four models of varying performance levels, with emphasis on Qwen3.8-27B: a lightweight model at the top end of what consumer hardware can serve locally. On sets probing commitments (rules the user set which exist only in the conversation) and recall of facts, transparent-compact matched or outperformed both alternatives. In particular, it showed an advantage in avoiding confident blunders, i.e. assertion of false information as opposed to recognizing that something was not recalled. Even with a frontier model, its advantage was present but smaller. We argue that transparent-compact spares lightweight models from reasoning or searching their way around what compaction lost, and results in improved recall and application of information as a result, without the need for task or context-specific structuring of the session history.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 transparent-compact：为轻量级本地部署的编码智能体设计的确定性上下文压缩方法，保证对话中用户与助手的散文原文不被模型改写，并显式标记被压缩掉信息的位置。在四个不同性能档位模型（重点为 Qwen3.8-27B）上，针对只存在于对话中的用户承诺规则与事实回忆两类基准，它匹配或优于 Pi 默认的模型撰写摘要压缩和确定性方法 pi-vcc，优势尤其体现在避免把未回忆起的信息自信地断言为假（confident blunders）；换成前沿模型优势仍在但变小。
Motivation: 长编码智能体会话会超出上下文窗口，现有压缩多用模型撰写摘要，会重新措辞并让智能体看不到丢失了什么；已有工作较少关注轻量级模型（本地部署或高吞吐负载）上的压缩效果。
Method: transparent-compact 用于开源 Pi 编码智能体：确定性地保留用户与助手散文原文不被模型或算法改动，并显式标记压缩剥离信息的位置。对比对象为 Pi 默认的模型撰写摘要压缩与确定性方法 pi-vcc（同样确定性但不逐字保留散文）。基准在四个性能档位模型上运行，重点是 Qwen3.8-27B（消费级硬件可本地服务的上限）。
Result: 在探查承诺（用户设定、仅存在于对话中的规则）与事实回忆的基准集上，transparent-compact 匹配或优于两种替代方案；优势尤其体现在避免 confident blunders（把错误信息自信断言，而非承认未回忆起）。前沿模型上优势存在但更小。
Conclusion: 逐字保留散文并显式标记丢失位置，可让轻量级模型不必靠推理或搜索绕开压缩损失，从而提升信息回忆与应用，且无需针对任务或上下文专门组织会话历史。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ACR-Net: Mitigating Semantic Dominance via Contrastive Acoustic-Semantic Decoupling
papers.abstract_en: Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) models and Audio LLMs fail when vocal tone contradicts textual semantics. Extensive training on congruent data engenders a rigid semantic prior, causing "Semantic Dominance", a severe text bias during cross-modal conflicts. We introduce the ASPIRE benchmark of adversarial audio-text pairs across four conflict types, alongside two metrics: Semantic Overconfidence Penalty (SOP) and Latent Decoupling Degree (LDD). Unlike fusion methods that merely re-weight collapsed features, our Acoustic Conflict Resolution Network (ACR-Net) uses Cross-Modal Attention and Contrastive Decoupling Loss to disentangle contradictory representations into orthogonal latent spaces. Experiments show existing models fail under polarity conflicts due to extreme semantic overconfidence. Conversely, ACR-Net preserves acoustic fidelity, maintaining high LDD to drive SOP near zero, achieving superior Acoustic Accuracy (ACC) in both adversarial and standard scenarios.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Published in Interspeech 2026
papers.journal_ref: Proc. Interspeech 2026, pp. 1207-1211 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 语音情感识别 (SER) 与 Audio LLM 在声学语气与文本语义冲突时被语义先验压倒，出现 Semantic Dominance。提出 ASPIRE 对抗音文基准（四类冲突）与 ACR-Net：用 Cross-Modal Attention 和 Contrastive Decoupling Loss 把矛盾表征拆到正交隐空间，保持高 LDD 使 SOP 趋近零，在对抗与常规场景均取得更优 Acoustic Accuracy。
Motivation: 在一致数据上的大量训练让 SER 与 Audio LLM 形成僵硬的语义先验，音文冲突时文本偏置主导输出，极性冲突下现有模型因语义过度自信而失效。
Method: 构建 ASPIRE 基准，含四类音文冲突的对抗样本，并定义 Semantic Overconfidence Penalty (SOP) 与 Latent Decoupling Degree (LDD) 两个指标；ACR-Net 以 Cross-Modal Attention 配合 Contrastive Decoupling Loss，将矛盾的声学与语义表征解耦到正交隐空间，区别于仅对塌缩特征重加权的融合方法。
Result: 实验显示现有模型在极性冲突下因极端语义过度自信而失败；ACR-Net 保持声学保真度、维持高 LDD 并把 SOP 压到接近零，在对抗与常规两种场景下均取得更优的 Acoustic Accuracy (ACC)。
Conclusion: 把冲突表征显式解耦到正交隐空间，比事后重加权更能抑制 Semantic Dominance，同时兼顾对抗与常规输入。

papers.title: From Spectral to Frobenius: When Muon Loses Its Spectral Implicit Bias
papers.abstract_en: Prior work on implicit bias shows that gradient descent selects the Frobenius max-margin direction on linearly separable problems, whereas Fan et al. (2025) established spectral max-margin behavior for spectral-norm steepest descent methods, including idealized Muon with exact orthogonalization. In practice, however, Muon approximates orthogonalization using finite Newton-Schulz iterations and a positive stabilization constant. We prove that these implementation choices cause Muon to select the Frobenius rather than the spectral max-margin direction in linear classification with separable data. We also establish this behavior for both exponential moving average and Nesterov-style momentum. The key technical ingredient is a summable perturbation argument showing that the resulting parameter trajectories remain at bounded distance from those of gradient descent. We then disentangle the roles of Newton-Schulz iteration count, the stabilization constant, and the Newton-Schulz polynomial, revealing distinct asymptotic behaviors, including directions that achieve neither Frobenius nor spectral max-margin. Finally, we show that Muon can recover its spectral max-margin bias with Newton-Schulz iterations growing logarithmically over training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明实用版 Muon（有限次 Newton-Schulz 迭代加正稳定常数）在可分线性分类中不再选谱最大间隔方向，而是退化为与梯度下降一致的 Frobenius 最大间隔方向，EMA 与 Nesterov 动量下同样成立。关键机制是可和扰动论证：参数轨迹与梯度下降保持有界距离。让 Newton-Schulz 迭代次数随训练对数增长，可恢复谱隐式偏置。
Motivation: Fan et al. (2025) 证明理想化 Muon（精确正交化）具有谱最大间隔行为，但实际 Muon 用有限 Newton-Schulz 迭代与稳定常数近似正交化，其隐式偏置是否仍为谱方向并无理论保证。
Method: 用可和扰动 (summable perturbation) 论证证明近似正交化带来的扰动使参数轨迹与梯度下降保持有界距离，从而继承 Frobenius 最大间隔方向；再分解 Newton-Schulz 迭代次数、稳定常数与 Newton-Schulz 多项式三者各自的作用，并覆盖 EMA 与 Nesterov 式动量。
Result: 证明有限 Newton-Schulz 迭代加正稳定常数使 Muon 在可分线性分类中选 Frobenius 而非谱最大间隔方向，EMA 与 Nesterov 动量下同样成立；分解显示存在既非 Frobenius 也非谱最大间隔的渐近方向；Newton-Schulz 迭代次数按训练对数增长时可恢复谱偏置。
Conclusion: Muon 的谱隐式偏置是精确正交化的产物，实践中被有限迭代与稳定常数破坏而退化为 Frobenius 方向；对数增长的迭代次数是恢复该偏置的充分条件。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RepForcing: Representation-Space Initialization for Autoregressive Video Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Distilling pretrained video diffusion models into few-step autoregressive (AR) generators typically combines student initialization with distribution matching distillation (DMD). An intermediate AR teacher can provide causally compatible targets for ODE initialization. However, causally compatible targets alone do not ensure high-quality generation under a short sampling schedule. We analyze the posterior-mean predictions favored by direct latent regression and empirically find that causal ODE initialization alleviates blur but still leaves fine detail unresolved. To address this limitation, we propose Representation Forcing, which learns few-step causal initialization through representation-space supervision rather than intermediate-teacher trajectory regression. The student is trained with teacher forcing by comparing clean predictions and training targets through normalized features of a frozen video diffusion transformer. This phase reuses the synthetic videos generated by a bidirectional model for AR teacher training and replaces both teacher training and causal ODE distillation, without generating additional causal ODE trajectories. The subsequent asymmetric DMD procedure remains unchanged. Empirical results show that, at four sampling steps, RepForcing better preserves generation quality than intermediate-teacher-based initialization before DMD. After DMD, our four-step chunk-wise model improves VBench Total from 84.04 to 84.66 (+0.62 points) and VisionReward from 6.326 to 10.074 (+59.25%) over the reported causal-ODE-based baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RepForcing 用冻结视频 diffusion transformer 的归一化特征做表征空间监督，直接学习少步因果自回归初始化，取代中间教师轨迹回归与因果 ODE 蒸馏。四步采样下，DMD 之后 VBench Total 从 84.04 升到 84.66（+0.62），VisionReward 从 6.326 升到 10.074（+59.25%），优于已报告的因果 ODE 基线。
Motivation: 把预训练视频 diffusion 蒸馏成少步 AR 生成器时，直接 latent 回归偏好的后验均值预测会让画面变糊；即便用中间 AR 教师做因果 ODE 初始化缓解了模糊，短采样步数下细节仍不充分。
Method: 提出 Representation Forcing：学生用 teacher forcing 训练，把干净预测与训练目标在冻结视频 diffusion transformer 的归一化特征上比较，从而学习少步因果初始化。该阶段复用双向模型为 AR 教师训练生成的合成视频，同时省掉教师训练与因果 ODE 轨迹生成；后续非对称 DMD (Distribution Matching Distillation) 流程保持不变。
Result: 四步采样下，DMD 之前 RepForcing 的生成质量优于基于中间教师的初始化；DMD 之后四步 chunk-wise 模型相对已报告的因果 ODE 基线，VBench Total 由 84.04 提升至 84.66（+0.62 点），VisionReward 由 6.326 提升至 10.074（+59.25%）。
Conclusion: 少步因果 AR 初始化用表征空间监督而非中间教师轨迹回归即可学成，且能替代教师训练与因果 ODE 蒸馏，同时保留后续 DMD 带来的质量收益。

papers.title: Exhaustive Canonical Skeletons Generation: A Formal Dataset for Decomposable Symbolic Regression
papers.abstract_en: Neural symbolic regression (SR) models require diverse datasets of mathematical expressions for robust training. However, existing datasets rely predominantly on stochastic sampling methods, which suffer from high structural redundancy and incomplete functional coverage. To address this, we introduce an exhaustive dataset of univariate canonical skeletons generated via a deterministic constrained context-free grammar. A canonical skeleton acts as a generic structural representation that subsumes more specific functional forms, eliminating redundant expressions and avoiding repeated computational efforts. Although our dataset consists of univariate skeletons, it is designed to support the decomposable SR paradigm to solve multivariate SR problems without assuming linear separability. Furthermore, we pair this dataset with a sampling strategy that generates clean numerical data without triggering numerical instabilities or relying on artificial protected operators. Canonicalizing two existing neural SR datasets reveals that our dataset is substantially more compact, eliminates structural repetitions, and achieves a uniform operator distribution free of simplicity bias. Finally, we establish a benchmark of 150 SR problems across three tiers, on which state-of-the-art SR methods are shown to struggle significantly.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE Computational Intelligence Letters
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用确定性约束上下文无关文法穷举生成一元规范骨架 (canonical skeleton) 数据集，替代随机采样表达式，消除结构冗余并实现均匀算子分布；配套的采样策略生成不触发数值不稳定、无需 protected operators 的干净数值数据。对两个现有神经 SR 数据集做规范化后，本文数据集显著更紧凑、无结构重复、无简单性偏置；建立的 150 题三档 SR 基准上，当前 SOTA SR 方法仍显著吃力。
Motivation: 神经符号回归 (neural SR) 训练需要多样的数学表达式数据集，但现有数据集主要靠随机采样，结构冗余高、功能覆盖不全。
Method: 用确定性约束上下文无关文法 (deterministic constrained context-free grammar) 穷举生成一元规范骨架，骨架作为可涵盖更具体函数形式的通用结构表示；数据集设计用于支撑 decomposable SR 范式以求解多变量 SR（不假设线性可分）；配对一个生成干净数值数据的采样策略。
Result: 规范化两个现有神经 SR 数据集后，本文数据集显著更紧凑、消除结构重复、算子分布均匀且无简单性偏置；建立 150 个 SR 问题、分三个层级的基准，SOTA SR 方法在该基准上显著吃力。
Conclusion: 穷举规范骨架加无数值不稳定的采样，可替代随机采样作为 SR 训练数据来源；现有 SOTA SR 方法在结构多样性充分的基准上仍不足。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Do Foundation Models for Market Microstructure Learn? A Controlled Study with Synthetic Limit Order Books
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive transformers trained on limit order book (LOB) message streams are increasingly proposed as foundation models for market microstructure. Because the generative process of real markets is unknown, these models can be judged only by the realism of their output, leaving open what they actually learn. We make the question answerable by inverting the setup: we train GPT-style models on order flow from simulators whose latent parameters are known, so that the Bayes-optimal predictor, the generating state, and the exact data entropy serve as references. Measured against them, next-token pretraining on order flow implements amortized Bayesian inference over market regimes. The learned predictive matches the exact Bayes optimum to within a millinat per token and approaches the oracle floor even on a nonstationary family whose latent state drifts within an episode, a regime that requires filtering. The latent regime is linearly decodable from frozen activations, well above baselines, so a frozen-model read-out calibrates simulator parameters more accurately than windowed maximum likelihood at a fraction of the cost. In our experiments these capabilities are not produced by scale: capacity and token volume saturate early, and it is the diversity of training regimes, not the token count, that determines generalization to unseen markets. On real NASDAQ data, zero-shot transfer is set by how well the simulator prior covers real flow: an enriched mixture nearly closes the gap to an in-domain baseline, and pretraining beats from-scratch training at every budget across held-out tickers. Known ground truth turns average next-token loss, which is uninformative near the entropy floor, into an exact comparison against the Bayes-optimal and oracle predictors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在潜参数已知的合成限价单 (LOB) 模拟器上训练 GPT 式自回归模型，把 next-token 预训练当作摊销贝叶斯推断来检验：预测分布与精确 Bayes 最优相差不到 1 millinat/token，潜市场状态可从冻结激活线性解码，且泛化由训练状态多样性而非 token 量决定。
Motivation: 真实市场生成过程未知，LOB 基础模型只能靠输出真实感评判，无法知道它究竟学到了什么；作者把设定反过来，用潜参数已知的模拟器提供 Bayes 最优、生成状态与精确熵作为参照。
Method: 在已知潜参数的订单流模拟器上训练 GPT 式自回归 Transformer，以 Bayes-optimal predictor、生成状态和精确数据熵为参照评估；潜状态从冻结激活做线性解码，并用冻结模型读出校准模拟器参数，与窗口化最大似然对比；另在含状态漂移的非平稳族（需 filtering）与真实 NASDAQ 数据上做 zero-shot 迁移。
Result: 学到的预测与精确 Bayes 最优相差在 1 millinat/token 以内，并在潜状态于 episode 内漂移的非平稳族上逼近 oracle floor；潜状态线性可解码且明显高于基线，冻结模型读出校准模拟器参数比窗口化最大似然更准、成本只是其一小部分；容量与 token 量早期即饱和，决定对未见市场泛化的是训练状态多样性而非 token 数；NASDAQ 上 enriched mixture 的 simulator prior 几乎补平与 in-domain 基线的差距，且在所有预算下 held-out tickers 上预训练都优于 from-scratch 训练。
Conclusion: 已知 ground truth 能把在熵 floor 附近失去信息量的平均 next-token loss 变成与 Bayes-optimal 和 oracle 预测器的精确比较；LOB 基础模型的预训练实现的是摊销贝叶斯推断，其迁移能力取决于模拟器先验对真实订单流的覆盖而非规模。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Task-State Governance: A Virtual Machine for Verifiable and Recoverable GUI Agent Execution
papers.abstract_en: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents now execute workflows across real applications, but when execution drifts, users must determine what changed, what should have remained untouched, and what can still be recovered. Plan-centric interfaces leave users supervising procedure, but users live with changes to application state. We introduce task-state governance, an interaction paradigm that represents a task as an editable contract linking desired outcomes, facts that must be preserved, and observed application state. We instantiate this paradigm in TaskVM, which projects live state into editable task controls, executes user edits as genuine interface actions, verifies outcomes through independent observation, and marks each action as reversible, compensatable, or irreversible. Across an automated contract benchmark, a controlled user study, and an open live-model exploration, the paradigm strengthened contract compliance and users' recovery control and trust, while execution outcomes were held constant. Task contracts open a design space for governable agent interfaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TaskVM 把 GUI agent 的一次任务表示为可编辑契约（task contract），链接期望结果、必须保留的事实与观测到的应用状态，并把每个动作标记为可逆、可补偿或不可逆。在自动契约基准、受控用户研究与开放实机探索中，该范式在执行结果保持不变的前提下提升了契约遵守度以及用户的恢复控制感与信任。
Motivation: GUI agent 在真实应用上执行流程时一旦发生状态漂移，用户难以判断哪些状态变了、哪些本不该动、哪些还能恢复；以计划为中心的界面只让用户监督步骤，而用户真正承担的是应用状态的改动。
Method: 提出 task-state governance 交互范式并落地为 TaskVM：把任务投影为可编辑的任务控件，把用户编辑作为真实界面动作执行，通过独立观测验证结果，并按可逆 (reversible)、可补偿 (compensatable)、不可逆 (irreversible) 给每个动作打标。
Result: 在自动契约基准、受控用户研究和开放 live-model 探索三类设置下，该范式增强了契约遵守 (contract compliance) 与用户的恢复控制和信任，同时执行结果保持不变。
Conclusion: 把任务建模为可编辑契约、并对动作做可恢复性分级，能在不改变执行结果的情况下让 agent 界面变得可治理，任务契约由此打开一个可治理 agent 界面的设计空间。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 把任务建模为可编辑契约、并对动作做可恢复性分级，能在不改变执行结果的情况下让 agent 界面变得可治理，任务契约由此打开一个可治理 agent 界面的设计空间。

papers.title: EvalBuilder: Can LLMs Build Efficient Benchmarks?
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used for long-horizon research and engineering, yet evaluating these capabilities remains expensive, time-consuming, and heavily dependent on human expertise. This motivates a natural question: can LLM agents themselves construct efficient benchmarks that preserve the conclusions of costly reference evaluations? We study this capability by formulating automatic benchmark development as a meta-evaluation problem, where an agent is given a task and an expensive reference benchmark and requested to construct a lower-cost proxy benchmark that faithfully distinguishes among candidate models and solutions. Based on this formulation, we introduce EvalBuilder, a framework for evaluating such benchmark-generation capabilities along three key dimensions: fidelity, efficiency, and robustness. Specifically, we assess whether generated benchmarks preserve model rankings, generalize to held-out models and freshly collected responses, and provide well-calibrated and discriminative scores while substantially reducing evaluation cost. We further provide an iterative environment in which agents can refine their benchmarks under a fixed time budget. Our framework provides a systematic testbed and benchmark for understanding when current LLM agents can develop useful evaluators and how benchmark construction itself can be increasingly automated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvalBuilder 把「LLM agent 能否自建高效 benchmark」形式化为 meta-evaluation 问题：给定任务与昂贵参考评测，让 agent 构造更低成本的 proxy benchmark，并从 fidelity、efficiency、robustness 三个维度度量其是否保持模型排序与结论。框架还提供固定时间预算下的迭代环境，让 agent 反复打磨 benchmark。
Motivation: LLM agent 正被用于长周期研究与工程任务，但对这类能力的评测昂贵、耗时且高度依赖人工专家经验，需要低成本替代评测同时保住原结论。
Method: 提出 EvalBuilder 框架，把自动 benchmark 开发形式化为 meta-evaluation：agent 输入任务与昂贵参考 benchmark，输出低成本 proxy benchmark；沿 fidelity（保持模型排序、泛化到 held-out 模型与新采集回答）、efficiency（大幅降低评测成本）、robustness（分数校准且有区分度）三维度度量，并提供固定时间预算下的迭代精炼环境。
Result: 产出一套系统性 testbed 与 benchmark，用于判定当前 LLM agent 何时能造出有用 evaluator；评测维度包括模型排序保持、对 held-out 模型与新采集回答的泛化、分数校准与区分度，以及评测成本的降低幅度。
Conclusion: benchmark 构建本身可以逐步自动化，但是否有用取决于生成的 proxy 能否在降本的同时保真、稳健地复现参考评测的结论。

papers.title: RTAformer: Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer for Video Scene Graph Generation
papers.abstract_en: Video scene graph generation (VidSGG) aims to capture objects and their evolving relationships in videos. This requires accounting for both the persistence of object identities and abrupt changes in relationships. Existing methods aggregate information across frames to exploit temporal context, but an emphasis on consistency can obscure these changes. As a result, a model may retain its previous prediction even after the underlying relation has changed. We refer to this failure mode as relational semantic inertia. To address this issue, we propose Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer (RTAformer), a one-stage framework that separately models entity persistence and relation changes. It injects calibrated differences between adjacent-frame relation queries to guide predicate updates, while cross-frame instance alignment during training helps reduce cross-frame representational drift. Experiments on Action Genome show improvements in recall and mean recall over existing methods, with ablation studies supporting the contributions of the proposed components and comparisons using matched backbones showing larger gains on relation-transition frames than on non-transition frames.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RTAformer 把视频场景图生成 (VidSGG) 中的实体持续性与关系突变拆开建模，用相邻帧关系 query 的校准差值引导谓词更新，并在训练中加入跨帧实例对齐以抑制表征漂移。在 Action Genome 上 recall 与 mean recall 相对现有方法提升，且用匹配 backbone 对比时增益集中在关系发生转变的帧上。
Motivation: 现有 VidSGG 方法跨帧聚合时过度强调一致性，导致关系已经改变模型仍沿用旧预测，作者称之为关系语义惯性 (relational semantic inertia)。
Method: 提出单阶段 (one-stage) 的 Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer (RTAformer)，分别建模实体持续性与关系变化：注入相邻帧关系 query 之间的校准差值来引导谓词更新，训练时用跨帧实例对齐 (cross-frame instance alignment) 减少跨帧表征漂移。
Result: 在 Action Genome 上，recall 与 mean recall 相对现有方法均有提升；消融实验支持各组件的贡献；使用匹配 backbone 的对比显示，增益在关系转变帧 (relation-transition frames) 上大于非转变帧。
Conclusion: 把关系变化与实体持续性分开建模、并显式利用相邻帧关系差异，可以缓解关系语义惯性，收益主要来自关系发生转变的那些帧。

papers.title: When Pairwise Preferences Cycle: A Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk for Video GRPO
papers.abstract_en: Pairwise preference feedback has become a widely adopted supervision signal for reinforcement learning in video generation models, as pairwise comparisons provide a more reliable alternative than pointwise scalar ratings for evaluating the quality of generated videos. Specifically, we define a preference graph for each GRPO group under a pairwise evaluator, where nodes represent sampled rollouts and edges encode pairwise preferences. Auditing 6,976 on-policy comparison graphs, we find that cyclic preferences are prevalent and persist throughout training. Naive pairwise reward aggregation based on average win rates discards the underlying comparison structures and treats each rollout independently, which may introduce unreliable advantage estimates for certain rollouts and consequently affect reinforcement learning optimization. Therefore, we propose the \emph{Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk} (\ours{}), a graph-aware advantage aggregation method that strengthens the global preference signal from win rates with reliable relational evidence from cyclic preference graphs through a reliability-guided preference walk. Under matched evaluator, comparison protocol, group size, prompt schedule, and query budget, \ours{} requires no additional evaluator queries beyond the observed comparisons within each rollout group and improves over Pairwise-GRPO across controlled comparisons, transfer settings, and blind human evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 视频生成 GRPO 中成对偏好图普遍存在环且贯穿训练，按平均胜率聚合会丢掉比较结构并给出不可靠的 advantage。提出 Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk：在每个 GRPO 组的偏好图上做可靠性引导的偏好游走，用环中的关系证据补强胜率信号，且不额外查询评测器。在受控对比、迁移设置与盲测人评中均优于 Pairwise-GRPO。
Motivation: 成对评测器给出的偏好图含环，平均胜率把每个 rollout 当作独立个体聚合，会污染部分 rollout 的 advantage 估计，进而影响 RL 优化。
Method: 为每个 GRPO 组在成对评测器下构建偏好图（节点为采样 rollout，边为成对偏好），审计 6,976 张 on-policy 比较图；提出 Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk，用可靠性引导的偏好游走从环状偏好图中提取关系证据，补强基于胜率的全局偏好信号，且只用组内已有比较、不增加评测器查询。
Result: 审计 6,976 张 on-policy 比较图发现环状偏好普遍存在并贯穿训练全程；在评测器、比较协议、组规模、prompt 调度与查询预算均匹配的受控对比、迁移设置和盲测人评中，该方法优于 Pairwise-GRPO。
Conclusion: 胜率聚合不足以表达成对比较的结构信息，把环状偏好图中的可靠性关系证据并入 advantage 聚合，可在不增加评测查询的前提下改善视频 GRPO 优化。

papers.title: AFCS: Atomic-Fact-Conditioned Synthesis for Factual Knowledge Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic data is increasingly used in language-model pretraining. Existing knowledge-corpus synthesis pipelines, including WRAP and Nemotron-CC, usually take a source passage or document segment as input and generate rewritten or QA-style samples from that text. This can improve surface form and prompt diversity, but it does not explicitly require fine-grained source facts -- especially secondary entities, list/table entries, and precise temporal attributes -- to appear in the synthesized corpus. We propose AFCS (Atomic-Fact-Conditioned Synthesis), a pipeline that first extracts source-supported atomic facts and then uses each retained fact to drive generation. AFCS uses structure-aware extraction over the document tree, source-grounded verification, local context expansion, and multi-format generation. In continued-pretraining experiments with OLMo-3-7B and a 32B base on the same FineWiki source corpus, AFCS outperforms WRAP and Nemotron-CC on SimpleQA, SimpleQA Verified, PopQA, and HotpotQA. Granularity ablations show that fact-level synthesis improves over chunk-level, paragraph-level, and entity-level synthesis; and a 100B-token mid-training integration improves factual benchmarks and raises the 12-task general benchmark average by +1.09.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AFCS 先从文档树中抽取源文支持的 atomic facts，再以每条事实为条件生成合成语料，使次级实体、列表/表格条目和精确时间属性被显式保留。在 OLMo-3-7B 与 32B、同一 FineWiki 源语料的持续预训练中，它在 SimpleQA、SimpleQA Verified、PopQA、HotpotQA 上超过 WRAP 与 Nemotron-CC；粒度消融显示事实级优于 chunk/段落/实体级，100B token 中期训练使 12 任务通用基准均值提升 +1.09。
Motivation: 现有知识语料合成管线（WRAP、Nemotron-CC）以源段落为输入改写或生成 QA，只改善表层形式与提示多样性，并不强制细粒度源事实（次级实体、列表/表格条目、精确时间属性）进入合成语料。
Method: AFCS 管线包含结构感知的文档树抽取 (structure-aware extraction)、源文接地校验 (source-grounded verification)、局部上下文扩展与多格式生成；以每条保留的 atomic fact 驱动生成，并在 FineWiki 源语料上对 OLMo-3-7B 与 32B base 做持续预训练，另做粒度消融与 100B token 中期训练整合。
Result: 在 OLMo-3-7B 与 32B、同一 FineWiki 语料的持续预训练中，AFCS 在 SimpleQA、SimpleQA Verified、PopQA、HotpotQA 上优于 WRAP 与 Nemotron-CC；粒度消融中 fact-level 合成优于 chunk-level、paragraph-level、entity-level；100B token 中期训练提升事实类基准并使 12 任务通用基准均值 +1.09。
Conclusion: 把合成粒度下沉到源文支持的 atomic fact 并逐条驱动生成，比按 chunk/段落/实体改写更能保住细粒度事实，从而提升语言模型的事实性基准表现。

papers.title: Designing Textual Interfaces To Enhance Llm Reasoning On Audio-Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) has shown strong effectiveness for text-based LLMs and LLM systems, but its application to audio-visual understanding systems requires suitable textual interfaces through which multimodal reasoning can be exposed to text-based optimizers. We investigate how the design of textual interfaces affects prompt optimization for multimodal reasoning, on the audio-visual question answering task. We compare three interface designs, including a direct inference system consisting of a single omni-modal large language model (OmniLLM), a captioner-reasoner system, and an agentic architecture in which a primary agent orchestrates subagent OmniLLMs. Experiments with Qwen3-Omni and Gemini show that direct prompt optimization provides model-dependent gains; the captioner-reasoner system and the agentic system expose more interpretable optimization interfaces but are harder to optimize, where error analysis of cases affected by optimization is conducted. Our study highlights textual interface design as an important factor in making prompt optimization effective for omni-modal reasoning systems. Our implementation details are specified in GitHub repo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在音频视觉问答 (AVQA) 上比较三种把多模态推理暴露给文本优化器的接口设计：单个 omni-modal LLM 直接推理、captioner-reasoner 两级系统、以及主 agent 编排子 agent OmniLLM 的 agentic 架构。用 Qwen3-Omni 与 Gemini 做自动提示优化 (APO) 后，直接优化带来依赖模型的增益，而更可解释的 captioner-reasoner 与 agentic 接口反而更难优化。
Motivation: 自动提示优化在纯文本 LLM 上有效，但多模态系统需要合适的文本接口才能把推理过程暴露给文本优化器，接口设计如何影响 APO 效果尚不清楚。
Method: 在 AVQA 任务上设计并对比三种文本接口：单个 OmniLLM 直接推理、captioner-reasoner、以及主 agent 编排子 agent OmniLLM 的 agentic 架构；在 Qwen3-Omni 与 Gemini 上运行提示优化，并对被优化改动影响的样例做错误分析。
Result: Qwen3-Omni 与 Gemini 上，直接推理接口的提示优化带来依赖模型的增益；captioner-reasoner 与 agentic 接口提供更可解释的优化界面但更难优化；对受优化影响的案例完成了错误分析。
Conclusion: 文本接口设计是决定提示优化能否在 omni-modal 推理系统上生效的关键因素，可解释性与可优化性在此存在权衡。

papers.title: VisualWorldBench: A Fine-Grained Multi-Task Benchmark for Evaluating Visual World Knowledge in MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Visual world knowledge is a core capability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), underpinning knowledge-intensive visual question answering and fine-grained visual reasoning. However, existing benchmarks remain limited in two key respects. First, their category coverage is narrow: most benchmarks span only a small number of categories across a few domains, falling far short of the open-ended scale of real-world visual entities. Second, their task construction is often insufficiently rigorous: models can answer correctly using coarse-grained cues, vague associations, or elimination strategies without truly mastering precise concepts, making it difficult to accurately assess their knowledge of fine-grained entities. We introduce VisualWorldBench, a taxonomy-grounded multi-task benchmark built on a hierarchical taxonomy of 21,291 leaf-node classes across 8 visual domains, with 32,541 evaluation instances whose ground-truth labels cover 15,479 categories across four complementary tasks: closed-set recognition, contrastive selection, precise localization, and open-world naming, covering different directions of knowledge retrieval and varying degrees of answer openness to comprehensively evaluate visual world knowledge. Most questions are constructed from taxonomically proximate categories, forcing precise discrimination among fine-grained entities. Experiments reveal that the strongest closed-source model achieves only 80.4% average accuracy, exposing capability gaps hidden under conventional benchmarks. We further construct VisualWorldBench-50K, a training resource covering 50K+ categories. Fine-tuning on VisualWorldBench-50K yields over 21 percentage points improvement on VisualWorldBench, with consistent transfer to public fine-grained recognition and visual knowledge benchmarks.

Motivation: 现有视觉知识基准类别覆盖窄、任务构造不严，模型可凭粗粒度线索、模糊联想或排除法答对，无法真实反映其对细粒度实体概念的掌握。

Result: 最强闭源模型平均准确率 80.4%；在 VisualWorldBench-50K 上微调使 VisualWorldBench 成绩提升超过 21 个百分点，并在公开细粒度识别与视觉知识基准上保持一致迁移。

papers.title: A Large-Dimensional Analysis of Least-Squares Federated Learning via Generalized Total Variation Minimization
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning over decentralized networks inherently trades off the suppression of local finite-sample noise through collaboration against the bias that collaboration introduces between heterogeneous nodes. We study this tension by performing a large-dimensional analysis of Generalized Total Variation Minimization with least-squares models. Using tools from random matrix theory, we show that Lipschitz observations of the global GTVMin solution concentrate in large dimensions, universally for any underlying network structure. We provide exact analytic expressions for the asymptotically precise performance under both i.i.d. and non-i.i.d. Gaussian mixture distributions on a fixed network. For the latter, these expressions quantify how regularization balances local adaptation against collaboration. Our theoretical results are confirmed by experiments on synthetic and real-world data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对联邦学习中的 Generalized Total Variation Minimization（GTVMin）最小二乘模型做高维渐近分析：随机矩阵理论给出全局 GTVMin 解的 Lipschitz 观测在大维度下普遍集中（与网络结构无关），并给出 i.i.d. 与非 i.i.d. 高斯混合分布下渐近精确的性能表达式，量化正则化如何在局部适应与协作之间取舍，合成与真实数据实验验证了理论。
Motivation: 联邦学习在协作抑制本地有限样本噪声与异质节点间引入偏差之间存在张力，缺少能对任意网络结构给出渐近精确性能刻画的分析工具。
Method: 用随机矩阵理论对 GTVMin 最小二乘做 large-dimensional 分析，证明全局 GTVMin 解的 Lipschitz 观测在大维度下集中且对底层网络结构普适；在固定网络上推导 i.i.d. 与非 i.i.d. 高斯混合分布的渐近精确性能表达式，并用合成与真实数据实验检验。
Result: 给出 i.i.d. 与非 i.i.d. 高斯混合分布下渐近精确的性能解析式，非 i.i.d. 情形量化了正则化对局部适应与协作的平衡；理论结果由合成与真实数据实验确认。
Conclusion: 高维下 GTVMin 的 Lipschitz 观测集中性对任意网络结构普适，正则化正是调节局部适应与协作偏差的旋钮。

papers.title: Feasibility of a Patient-Specific Digital Twin for Ventriculoperitoneal Shunt Trajectory Planning
papers.abstract_en: Catheter obstruction is the commonest cause of shunt failure; freehand insertion at Keen's point leaves the tip free in cerebrospinal fluid in only one case in ten. We built a digital twin that reconstructs skull, scalp, ear and ventricles from preoperative CT by deterministic geometry, searches every entry around Keen's point for the perpendicular trajectory with the longest intraventricular length under safety constraints, and returns the plan as two ruler measurements from the ear and two depths. Executed freehand in 11 consecutive adults (IDEAL Stage 2a), it achieved Hayhurst Grade 1 placement in 10 of 11 against 22 of 213 historically (p = 9 x 10^-9), median entry and angular deviations 2.5 mm and 5.9 degrees, 1.4 cm more intraventricular catheter than Keen's point, and no intraoperative complication. The technique was unchanged; the gain came from choosing entry and depth per patient. Whether it lowers revision is the next stage's hypothesis.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables; includes Supplementary Information
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对脑室腹腔分流 (VP shunt) 徒手穿刺成功率低，构建患者特异数字孪生：由术前 CT 确定性重建颅骨、头皮、耳与脑室，在 Keen 点周边穷举搜索满足安全约束、脑室内段最长的垂直轨迹，并输出以耳为基准的两条标尺测量与两个深度。在 11 例连续成人 (IDEAL Stage 2a) 中徒手执行，Hayhurst Grade 1 置入 10/11，对比历史 22/213 (p = 9×10⁻⁹)，入点与角度偏差中位数 2.5 mm 与 5.9°，脑室内导管比 Keen 点长 1.4 cm，无术中并发症。
Motivation: 导管梗阻是分流失败最常见原因，而按 Keen 点徒手穿刺时导管尖端真正游离于脑脊液中的比例仅约十分之一，缺乏按患者个体化选择入点与深度的手段。
Method: 数字孪生由术前 CT 以确定性几何重建颅骨、头皮、耳与脑室；在 Keen 点周围遍历候选入点，求满足安全约束下脑室内长度最长的垂直轨迹；计划以距耳两条标尺测量加两个深度输出，供徒手执行。
Result: 11 例连续成人 (IDEAL Stage 2a) 中 Hayhurst Grade 1 置入 10/11，历史对照 22/213，p = 9×10⁻⁹；入点偏差中位数 2.5 mm、角度偏差 5.9°；脑室内导管较 Keen 点多 1.4 cm；无术中并发症。
Conclusion: 手术技术不变、仅按患者个体化选择入点与深度即可显著提高尖端置入精度；是否降低翻修率是下一阶段的假设。

papers.title: GDBA-Net: A Gated Dual-Branch Adaptation of SAM2 for Robust Cross-Domain Nuclei Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate nuclei segmentation underpins quantitative computational pathology, yet remains challenging due to morphological variability, weak boundaries, nuclear crowding, and pronounced domain shifts arising from differences in tissue preparation, staining, and acquisition. While deep learning and recent foundation models have improved segmentation performance under matched distributions with the original training data, their generalization across heterogeneous histopathology domains remains limited. We introduce GDBA-Net, a parameter-efficient nuclei segmentation framework built around the proposed Gated Dual-Branch Adapter (GDBA). GDBA-Net adapts a frozen SAM2 encoder by integrating pretrained semantic representations with explicit frequency-derived structural priors. The complementary representations are independently transformed through Grid MLP branches and dynamically integrated using sample-adaptive channel-wise gating, selectively emphasizing structural cues relevant to nuclear delineation. Despite using only 4.3 million trainable parameters, GDBA-Net achieves state-of-the-art in-dataset performance and consistently superior cross-dataset generalization across six diverse nuclei segmentation benchmarks under fully supervised, cross-dataset, and five-shot adaptation protocols, outperforming competing CNN-, transformer-, and foundation model based methods. Comprehensive ablations confirm that these gains arise from the coordinated design of semantic-frequency complementarity and adaptive gating rather than increased model capacity. By uniting transferable semantic representations with explicit structural priors, GDBA-Net provides a robust, annotation-efficient solution to domain variability in nuclei segmentation. https://github.com/biplabpoudel25/GDBA_Net
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GDBA-Net 用参数高效的 Gated Dual-Branch Adapter (GDBA) 在冻结的 SAM2 encoder 上做细胞核分割域适应：语义特征与频率域结构先验分别过 Grid MLP 分支，再用样本自适应的通道级门控融合。仅 4.3M 可训练参数，在六个细胞核分割基准的 fully supervised、cross-dataset 与 five-shot 三种协议下均取得 SOTA 的同域性能与一致更优的跨域泛化。
Motivation: 细胞核分割受形态差异、弱边界、核拥挤以及制片、染色、成像带来的显著 domain shift 影响；基础模型在与训练数据同分布时表现好，但跨异质组织病理域的泛化仍然有限。
Method: 冻结 SAM2 encoder，接入 Gated Dual-Branch Adapter：一路取预训练语义表示，另一路取显式频率域结构先验，两路各自经 Grid MLP 分支独立变换，再由样本自适应的通道级门控动态加权融合，选择性强调与核轮廓相关的结构线索；整体为参数高效适配，可训练参数 4.3M。
Result: 在六个多样细胞核分割基准上，于 fully supervised、cross-dataset 和 five-shot adaptation 三种协议下均达到 SOTA 同域性能并一致优于跨数据集泛化基线，对手涵盖 CNN、transformer 与 foundation model 方法；可训练参数仅 4.3M；消融显示增益来自语义-频率互补与自适应门控的协同设计而非模型容量增大。
Conclusion: 把可迁移语义表示与显式结构先验在冻结基础模型上做门控互补融合，是应对细胞核分割域差异的标注高效方案，且增益不依赖扩大模型容量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Rethinking Prediction Horizons: Decoupling Model Queries from State Updates in Few-Step MeanFlow
papers.abstract_en: MeanFlow predicts interval-average velocities, but conventional few-step sampling ties the interval queried from the model to the duration of the state update. We separate these two quantities at inference, fixing the model, update grid, and number of queries while varying the prediction horizon. Our central finding is that the horizon response depends on both query position and the states entering that query. Across seven independently trained CIFAR-10 checkpoints at classifier-free guidance (CFG) scale 2, a longer horizon worsens FID at early steps but improves it at the midpoint. To probe whether query time alone determines this response, we fix the midpoint query and current/subsequent guidance while changing only earlier CFG. In held-out factorial outcomes on five previously studied checkpoints, the mean midpoint horizon benefit increases from 0.109 to 1.308 FID, indicating sensitivity to the incoming-state distribution. A frozen four-query rule reduces mean CIFAR-10 FID by 2.023 without retraining or extra queries, including gains on five checkpoints trained after rule selection. A milder rule also improves mean FID by 1.041 on a stronger frozen grid, with fixed-rule FID gains on the evaluated public ImageNet-256 and AFHQ checkpoints. However, matched-budget calibration favors query-start shifting in historical CIFAR tests, and the tested Horizon allocation adds no FID benefit beyond Grid+Start on two public ImageNet models. Thus, prediction horizon is a distinct, position- and state-sensitive inference control, but not a universally preferred one.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 MeanFlow 少步采样中把「模型查询的区间」与「状态更新时长」解耦，发现预测时程 (prediction horizon) 的效果取决于查询位置与进入该查询的状态分布：CIFAR-10 七个 checkpoint、CFG=2 下，加长时程在早期步恶化 FID、在中点改善 FID。冻结的四查询规则在不重训、不加查询的前提下把 CIFAR-10 平均 FID 再降 2.023，但作者明确指出时程并非普适更优的控制量。
Motivation: MeanFlow 常规少步采样把模型查询区间与状态更新时长绑死，无法单独考察时程这一推理控制量的作用及其依赖条件。
Method: 推理时分离查询区间与更新时长，固定模型、更新网格与查询次数、只改预测时程；用因子实验固定中点查询与当前/后续 guidance、只改更早的 CFG，以区分「查询时间」与「进入状态分布」两种解释；再提炼冻结的查询规则（四查询规则与更温和的规则），在规则选定后训练的 checkpoint 上检验。
Result: CIFAR-10 七个独立训练 checkpoint、CFG=2：更长时程在早期步抬高 FID、在中点降低 FID。固定中点查询只改早期 CFG 的 held-out 因子实验（五个既有 checkpoint）中，中点时程收益均值从 0.109 增至 1.308 FID，说明响应对进入状态分布敏感。冻结四查询规则使 CIFAR-10 平均 FID 降低 2.023（含五个规则选定后训练的 checkpoint 的收益）；更温和规则在更强冻结网格上平均 FID 改善 1.041，且在所评测的公开 ImageNet-256 与 AFHQ checkpoint 上固定规则 FID 亦有收益。但历史 CIFAR 测试的等预算校准更支持 query-start shifting，且在两个公开 ImageNet 模型上 Horizon 分配相对 Grid+Start 无额外 FID 收益。
Conclusion: 预测时程是一个独立于查询位置、且对状态分布敏感的推理控制量，但不是普适更优的选择：其收益依赖位置与状态，等预算下 query-start shifting 在历史 CIFAR 上更有利。
Relevance: 14

summary_sections.tldr: 在 MeanFlow 少步采样中把「模型查询的区间」与「状态更新时长」解耦，发现预测时程 (prediction horizon) 的效果取决于查询位置与进入该查询的状态分布：CIFAR-10 七个 checkpoint、CFG=2 下，加长时程在早期步恶化 FID、在中点改善 FID。冻结的四查询规则在不重训、不加查询的前提下把 CIFAR-10 平均 FID 再降 2.023，但作者明确指出时程并非普适更优的控制量。

summary_sections.method: 推理时分离查询区间与更新时长，固定模型、更新网格与查询次数、只改预测时程；用因子实验固定中点查询与当前/后续 guidance、只改更早的 CFG，以区分「查询时间」与「进入状态分布」两种解释；再提炼冻结的查询规则（四查询规则与更温和的规则），在规则选定后训练的 checkpoint 上检验。

papers.title: Trainable at Depth, Solvable at Small Size: What the Loss Surface of a Polynomial Activation Dictates for Designing, Initializing and Training Networks
papers.abstract_en: What makes a deep network train, and what shape is its loss surface? We answer both with one construction at two scales: a polynomial activation f (z) = z + λz 3 , clamped and projected onto the unit sphere, plus an unnormalized identity path. As a deep stack it trains to one hundred layers on MNIST with no normalization machinery; as a small model its square loss is a polynomial system we solve exactly. The small scale explains the large one: it prescribes how to design, initialize and train the stack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用多项式激活 f(z)=z+λz³（截断并投影到单位球面，加未归一化恒等路径）构造深网络：堆到一百层可在 MNIST 上训练而无需任何归一化机制；在小规模上其平方损失是可精确求解的多项式系统，反过来规定深栈的设计、初始化与训练方式。
Motivation: 深度网络为何可训练、其损失面形状如何，缺少一个在深栈与可解小模型之间自洽的统一解释。
Method: 构造多项式激活 f(z)=z+λz³，经截断并投影到单位球面，配未归一化恒等路径；深栈尺度用于训练，小尺度把平方损失写成多项式系统并精确求解，再由小尺度解反过来指导深栈的设计、初始化与训练。
Result: 深栈在 MNIST 上训练到一百层且不使用任何归一化机制；小规模下平方损失作为多项式系统被精确求解，其解被用来规定深栈的设计、初始化与训练。
Conclusion: 多项式激活的损失面在小规模上可精确求解，这一可解性足以解释并指导深栈的可训练性，无需归一化。

papers.title: Which Knowledge Should LLMs Trust? Uncovering a Generalizable Steering Direction Across Knowledge Conflicts
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently encounter conflicts between internal parametric knowledge and external contextual knowledge, yet the mechanisms governing this selection remain unclear. We show that the choice between context and parametric knowledge is linearly represented and can be controlled along a single direction in the model's residual stream. We first demonstrate that this direction generalizes across factual-conflict settings, including context formats, knowledge categories, and datasets, while consistently shifting behavior between parametric and contextual answers. We then transfer a direction learned from simple factual conflicts to three more complex task families: RAG, memory, and rule following, where models must acquire information from retrieved documents, interaction histories, or explicit rules. Across four model families and multiple transfer settings, steering consistently improves the use of prompt-provided information over the unsteered model. These results suggest that the direction captures a transferable preference for external knowledge rather than a mechanism specific to factual conflicts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 在参数化知识与上下文知识冲突时的选择沿残差流 (residual stream) 中单一方向线性可表征，且可被该方向直接操控。从简单事实冲突学到的 steering direction 能迁移到 RAG、记忆、规则跟随三类更复杂任务，在四个模型家族与多种迁移设置下，steering 后模型使用提示提供信息的比例持续高于未 steering 的对照。
Motivation: LLM 在内部参数知识与外部上下文冲突时如何取舍，其内部机制尚不清楚，且事实冲突上学到的控制信号能否迁移到需要外部信息的任务族未知。
Method: 在残差流中定位表征「选上下文还是选参数知识」的单一方向，检验其跨上下文格式、知识类别、数据集的泛化；再把从简单事实冲突学到的方向迁移到 RAG、memory、rule following 三类任务，比较 steering 与未 steering 模型对提示信息的使用。
Result: 该方向在事实冲突设置间泛化并一致地在参数答案与上下文答案之间切换行为；迁移到 RAG、memory、rule following 后，steering 在四个模型家族和多种迁移设置下均一致提升模型对 prompt 提供信息的使用，优于未 steering 模型。
Conclusion: 该方向捕捉的是对外部知识的可迁移偏好，而非事实冲突特有的机制，因此可作为跨任务族统一的知识来源控制手段。

papers.title: FoveaVLA: Foveation Actions Replace the Wrist Camera in VLAs
papers.abstract_en: We present FoveaVLA, a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model that replaces the wrist camera with learned foveation actions. Wrist cameras provide close-up detail but restrict the view to the end-effector's surroundings. External cameras see the whole scene, but the policy receives them at low resolution, so the fine detail needed for manipulation is lost. FoveaVLA recovers this detail by predicting, alongside each action chunk, the interaction region to observe at the next policy query. The policy then receives crops of these regions, taken from the original-resolution images, together with the full views. We build FoveaVLA on $π_{0.5}$ in two configurations, Single and Dual, using one or two external stereo cameras with full and foveal RGB and depth inputs, and post-train both on DROID with RoboInter interaction annotations. Across four real-world task suites, FoveaVLA-Single achieves 70.8% success with one external RGB-D view, and FoveaVLA-Dual achieves 77.1%, versus 52.1% for the wrist-equipped $π_{0.5}$. Both match the baseline on plain pick-and-place and improve success with distractors, cloth manipulation, and far-away objects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FoveaVLA 用可学习的中央凹注视动作 (foveation actions) 取代腕部相机：随每个 action chunk 预测下一步要细看的交互区域，再从原始分辨率图像裁剪该区域与全景一起喂给策略。在 DROID 上基于 π0.5 后训练并配 RoboInter 交互标注后，四套真实任务中 FoveaVLA-Single 单外置 RGB-D 视角成功率 70.8%、Dual 双视角 77.1%，均高于带腕部相机的 π0.5 的 52.1%。
Motivation: 腕部相机看得清但视野只限末端执行器周边，外置相机覆盖全场景却只能以低分辨率进策略，操作所需的细节因此丢失。
Method: 在 π0.5 上构建 Single 与 Dual 两种配置，各用一或两个外置立体相机，输入含全景与中央凹的 RGB 和深度；策略在输出 action chunk 的同时预测下一次策略查询要观测的交互区域，随后把该区域的原始分辨率裁剪连同全景一起输入，并在 DROID 上用 RoboInter 交互标注做后训练。
Result: 四套真实任务上，FoveaVLA-Single 用一个外置 RGB-D 视角达到 70.8% 成功率，FoveaVLA-Dual 达到 77.1%，带腕部相机的 π0.5 为 52.1%；两者在普通抓放任务上与基线持平，而在有干扰物、布料操作和远距离物体任务上成功率提升。
Conclusion: 用预测的注视裁剪替代腕部相机即可在操作任务上超过腕部相机基线，且额外视角（Dual 对 Single）继续抬高成功率。

papers.title: Beyond Correctness: Compute-Responsive Data Selection for Reasoning Model Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning language models increasingly rely on test-time compute scaling, yet most existing work studies how to allocate inference computation while treating the model itself as fixed. We ask a complementary question: can reasoning models be post-trained to make better use of a given amount of test-time compute, and which examples are most useful for this goal? Our key observation is that reasoning problems differ substantially in their response to additional computation. Some are already solved under limited compute, others remain unresolved even after further reasoning, while a distinct subset changes from complete initial failure to success when additional reasoning is provided. We call these compute-responsive (CR) examples and introduce Compute-Responsive Data Selection (CRDS), a post-training data-selection principle that prioritizes examples with empirically demonstrated marginal utility from additional reasoning. On Qwen3-8B, SFT on CR examples recovers 45.3\% of held-out low-compute failures, compared with 40.6\% when training on already-solved examples. The advantage extends beyond the selected CR split: SFT-CR reaches 51.8\% overall accuracy on an independently sampled test distribution, with the gain concentrated on compute-responsive problems. CR training also shifts the compute--accuracy frontier across inference budgets from 512 to 4,096 tokens, outperforming matched non-CR training throughout and reaching 48.1\% recovery at the largest budget. The same pattern is supported across multiple data sources, remains visible under on-policy distillation, and extends to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct when CR sets are reconstructed separately for that model. Better test-time compute utilization can therefore be learned through post-training, with recoverable responses to additional reasoning providing a particularly informative signal for selecting training examples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向推理模型后训练的数据选择原则 CRDS：把「有限算力下完全失败、追加推理后成功」的 compute-responsive (CR) 样本优先用于 SFT。Qwen3-8B 上用 CR 样本训练可恢复 45.3% 的 held-out 低算力失败，已解出样本仅 40.6%；独立采样测试分布整体准确率 51.8%，且在 512–4,096 token 推理预算全程优于匹配的非 CR 训练，最大预算处恢复率达 48.1%。
Motivation: 现有 test-time compute scaling 工作多假设模型固定、只调推理算力分配；但哪些训练样本能让模型更高效地用掉给定推理算力，此前没有选择标准。
Method: CRDS 按「追加推理带来的边际效用」给样本打分：先在不同推理预算下测每个问题的表现，筛出从完全失败翻转为成功的 CR 样本，再用它们做 SFT；同时在多个数据源上重建 CR 集，并测试 on-policy distillation 与 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上的迁移。
Result: Qwen3-8B 上，CR 样本 SFT 恢复 45.3% 的 held-out 低算力失败，已解出样本为 40.6%；SFT-CR 在独立采样测试分布上整体准确率 51.8%，增益集中在 compute-responsive 问题；推理预算 512 至 4,096 token 全程优于匹配的非 CR 训练，最大预算处恢复率 48.1%。该模式跨多个数据源成立，在 on-policy distillation 下仍可见，并在为 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 单独重建 CR 集后复现。
Conclusion: 更好的 test-time compute 利用率可以通过后训练学到，而「对追加推理有可恢复响应」本身就是筛选训练样本的高信息量信号。

papers.title: GeoCloak: An Agentic Framework for Semantics-Preserving Geolocation Privacy via Peripheral Clue Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of large vision language models (LVLMs) has made geolocation inference from images highly accurate and accessible. This poses serious privacy risks: a passive adversary with black-box LVLM access can infer a user's location from a single photo with no metadata. Existing protection methods rely almost exclusively on adversarial perturbation, which introduces perceptible visual artifacts and utility degradation. We identify the visual-geolocation asymmetry: geolocation-decisive clues, such as street signs, tend to be visually peripheral but dominate location inference. Exploiting this asymmetry, we propose GeoCloak, an agentic framework for semantics-preserving geolocation privacy protection. It acts as a clue-aware planner that analyzes each image to identify geolocation-relevant clues, dispatches targeted semantic edits to directly suppress peripheral clues, and autonomously configures adversarial perturbation to further suppress residual geolocation features, all under iterative utility-aware feedback. We evaluate GeoCloak on four diverse datasets spanning 108 countries and 576 cities against five LVLMs and three inference methods. GeoCloak reduces overall city-level accuracy from 41.2% to 9.9%, approximately half of the best-performing baseline, while achieving substantially superior utility preservation both qualitatively and quantitatively. We hope this work takes a meaningful step toward practical, semantics-preserving geolocation privacy protection, giving users greater control over the location information inadvertently embedded in their shared images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoCloak 用智能体框架做图像地理隐私保护：先识别决定位置的外围线索（如街牌），用定向语义编辑直接压制，再自动配置对抗扰动清除残余位置特征，并以效用反馈迭代。在覆盖 108 国、576 城的四个数据集上对五个 LVLM 与三种推理方法评测，城市级定位准确率从 41.2% 降到 9.9%，约为最优基线的一半，同时效用保持显著更好。
Motivation: LVLM 让单张无元数据照片即可高精度反推位置，而现有防护几乎全靠对抗扰动，带来可见伪影与效用损失；作者指出视觉-地理不对称：决定位置的线索在视觉上处于外围却主导定位。
Method: GeoCloak 作为 clue-aware planner：分析图像定位地理相关线索，派发定向语义编辑压制外围线索，再自主配置对抗扰动抑制残余地理特征，全程由迭代的效用感知反馈驱动。

papers.title: GBTSVR: Twin Support Vector Regression via Granular Ball Computing
papers.abstract_en: Regression models used in real-world applications are often challenged by noise, outliers, data heterogeneity, and asymmetric error characteristics, which severely limit the effectiveness of conventional point-wise learning models. While twin support vector regression (TSVR) partially addresses these issues through the use of nonparallel regression bounds, it still relies on individual samples as basic learning units. As a result, TSVR remains highly sensitive to noisy and contaminated observations and fails to leverage the underlying structural and regional information inherent in complex datasets, leading to suboptimal robustness and generalization performance. To address these limitations, we introduce granular ball twin support vector regression (GBTSVR) and its quantile extension, granular ball twin support vector quantile regression (GB-TSVQR). The proposed models integrate granular ball computing with TSVR, replacing individual data points with compact, structure-preserving granular balls as fundamental learning units. This region-level representation effectively suppresses noise and outliers while preserving intrinsic data geometry, thereby enhancing robustness, stability, and generalization. GBTSVR constructs nonparallel lower- and upper-bound regression functions over granular balls, significantly reducing sensitivity to sample-level perturbations. Building upon this framework, GB-TSVQR further incorporates quantile regression principles to simultaneously capture heterogeneous trends and asymmetric error distributions across different quantile levels. Extensive experiments on synthetic datasets, time-series benchmarks, and outlier-contaminated data demonstrate that the proposed GBTSVR and GB-TSVQR consistently outperform state-of-the-art regression models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GBTSVR 用 granular ball（粒球）替代单样本作为 TSVR 的学习单元，在粒球上构造非平行上下界回归函数，其分位数扩展 GB-TSVQR 同时拟合多个分位水平以刻画非对称误差。在合成数据、时间序列基准与含离群点数据上，两模型一致优于现有回归模型。
Motivation: TSVR 仍以单个样本为学习单元，对噪声与污染观测高度敏感，且无法利用数据的结构与区域信息，鲁棒性和泛化受限。
Method: 将 granular ball computing 与 TSVR 结合，用保持结构的紧致粒球替代数据点作为基本学习单元，在粒球上构建非平行下界与上界回归函数；GB-TSVQR 在此框架上引入 quantile regression，按不同分位水平同时捕捉异质趋势与非对称误差分布。
Result: 在合成数据集、时间序列基准和含离群点污染的数据上，GBTSVR 与 GB-TSVQR 一致优于 state-of-the-art 回归模型；区域级表示抑制噪声与离群点，降低对样本级扰动的敏感度。
Conclusion: 以区域（粒球）而非单样本为学习单元，可同时提升 TSVR 类模型对噪声、离群点与非对称误差的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
