papers.title: CoRedSkill: Stealthy Skill Composition Attacks via AST-Guided Injection
papers.abstract_en: Agents extend their capabilities through reusable skills that package instructions, executable code, and resources. Composing these skills enables complex task workflows, but their dependencies can also connect malicious operations across skills, making their combined intent difficult to identify through individual-package auditing. We introduce CoRedSkill, a compositional red-teaming method that forms stealthy attacks through cooperating skills while preserving their original utility. CoRedSkill decomposes an existing workflow into interdependent skills and embeds attack operations in task functions through abstract syntax tree (AST) rewriting, with skill instructions guiding the agent to autonomously select and invoke the relevant skills, and workflow dependencies and intermediate artifacts connecting the injected operations during task execution. We construct a benchmark of 150 cases covering 50 tasks and three attack objectives to evaluate attack success, task completion, and audit detection. In the main evaluation, CoRedSkill achieves 98.0% attack success and 95.3% task success with a 3.3% detection rate, and a joint success rate of 90.7% (attack success, task completion, and audit evasion in the same case) compared with 6.7--42.7% for the four baselines. Skill compositions can therefore complete legitimate tasks while carrying out unauthorized operations that evade auditing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoRedSkill 是面向技能组合 (skill composition) 的隐蔽红队方法：把既有工作流拆成相互依赖的技能，用 AST 重写把攻击操作嵌进任务函数，靠技能指令与工作流依赖在执行中串起注入点。在 150 例、50 任务、三类攻击目标的基准上，攻击成功率 98.0%、任务成功率 95.3%、审计检出率仅 3.3%，三项同时达成的联合成功率 90.7%，四个基线仅 6.7–42.7%。
Motivation: 技能把指令、可执行代码与资源打包复用，其依赖会把恶意操作跨技能连起来，单包审计看不出合并后的意图，组合后的隐蔽攻击缺少评测手段。
Method: CoRedSkill 将既有工作流分解为相互依赖的技能，通过抽象语法树 (AST) 重写把攻击操作嵌入任务函数；由技能指令引导 agent 自主选择并调用相关技能，工作流依赖与中间产物在任务执行中把注入操作串接起来。
Result: 在 150 例、覆盖 50 个任务与三种攻击目标的基准上，CoRedSkill 攻击成功率 98.0%、任务成功率 95.3%、审计检出率 3.3%；同一案例同时满足攻击成功、任务完成与审计规避的联合成功率为 90.7%，四个基线为 6.7–42.7%。
Conclusion: 技能组合可以在完成合法任务的同时执行未授权操作并规避审计，因此逐包审计不足以识别跨技能的组合意图。

papers.title: Sequential Learning-Based Physics-Informed Neural Network Modeling for Parameter Estimation on a Power Converter
papers.abstract_en: A staged physics-informed neural network (PINN) is proposed for identifying the inductance, capacitance and parasitic resistances of a DC buck converter from time-domain data. Gradients are released in the order of L to C to rL to rC, a sequence derived from sensitivity analysis. The five-stage schedule recovers L and C to within 5% and the series ESR to 10%, while a three-stage variant attains the same accuracy 11% faster. An 84 factorial sweep confirms that the trained PINN remains accurate for simultaneous 8% perturbations of all four components, achieving a waveform RMSE of 2.6 x 10-2 over 5 ms-an order-of-magnitude better than a simultaneous-training baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分阶段释放梯度的物理信息神经网络 (PINN)，从时域数据辨识 DC buck 变换器的电感、电容与寄生电阻，梯度按灵敏度分析得到的 L→C→rL→rC 顺序释放。五阶段方案将 L、C 恢复到 5% 以内、串联 ESR 到 10% 以内；84 次因子扫描中四参数同时扰动 8% 时波形 RMSE 为 2.6×10⁻²（5 ms），比同时训练基线好一个数量级。
Motivation: 电力电子变换器的寄生参数辨识中，同时训练所有参数的 PINN 容易陷入不良解，且对参数间耦合敏感，需要一种利用物理方程与时域数据的稳健辨识方案。
Method: 构建分阶段 PINN，用电路物理方程约束神经网络拟合时域波形；梯度按灵敏度分析确定的顺序分批释放：先 L，再 C，然后 rL、rC。对比同时训练基线，并用 84 次因子扫描检验参数扰动下的鲁棒性。
Result: 五阶段方案将 L、C 辨识到 5% 以内、串联 ESR 到 10% 以内；三阶段变体达到同等精度且快 11%。84 次因子扫描中四参数同时扰动 8% 时，5 ms 窗口波形 RMSE 为 2.6×10⁻²，比同时训练基线好一个数量级。
Conclusion: 按灵敏度顺序分阶段释放梯度能显著提升 PINN 参数辨识的精度与鲁棒性，且更少的阶段数可在保持精度的同时加快训练。

papers.title: SWE-Nexus: Automated Composition of Software Engineering Tasks from Test Execution
papers.abstract_en: Historical code changes provide convenient task boundaries, but do not identify which production functions selected tests exercise or support composing validated behaviors beyond a single change. We present SWE-Nexus, a fully automated pipeline that constructs repository-level implementation tasks from test execution. Four construction agents select tests, adapt tracing and evaluation protocols to each repository, and generate behavioral specifications. For each selected test file, tracing records an observed execution footprint of production function bodies. A scope is retained only if all expected scoring points pass in the original repository and masking the traced bodies causes at least one failure or error. Compatible scopes are composed deterministically, with shared functions counted once and every constituent test file revalidated under the complete combined mask. The benchmark contains 600 tasks from 105 repositories across six programming languages, including 116 atomic and 484 composite tasks. We evaluate 12 models under three agent scaffolds. The best configuration resolves 37.8% of tasks in one attempt, and scope-weighted scoring measures partial recovery. SWE-Nexus enables task construction from validated behavior beyond individual historical changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWE-Nexus 是一条全自动流水线，从测试执行中构造仓库级实现任务：追踪测试覆盖的生产函数体，只保留遮蔽后确实导致失败的 scope，再把兼容 scope 确定性组合成复合任务。基准含 105 个仓库、600 个任务（116 原子 + 484 复合），12 个模型在三种 agent scaffold 下最好配置单次解题率 37.8%。
Motivation: 历史代码变更能提供任务边界，但无法指出被选测试实际执行了哪些生产函数，也无法在单个变更之外组合已验证的行为。
Method: 四个 construction agent 分别选测试、按仓库适配 tracing 与评测协议、生成行为规格；tracing 记录测试文件的生产函数体执行足迹，只有当原始仓库中全部预期 scoring point 通过且遮蔽被追踪函数体至少引发一次失败或错误时才保留该 scope；兼容 scope 确定性组合，共享函数只计一次，每个组成测试文件在完整组合遮蔽下重新验证。
Result: 基准含 600 个任务、105 个仓库、六种编程语言，其中 116 个原子任务与 484 个复合任务；在三种 agent scaffold 下评估 12 个模型，最佳配置单次尝试解出 37.8% 的任务，并用 scope-weighted scoring 度量部分恢复。
Conclusion: 测试执行的验证行为可以作为任务构造的来源，把范围从单个历史变更扩展到可组合的仓库级实现任务。

papers.title: Weighted Adjoint Matching: Finetuning Flow Matching Models with Time-Dependent Control Cost
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Weighted Adjoint Matching, a method to finetune a pretrained diffusion or flow matching model given a differentiable reward. We derive it from Adjoint Matching, which reformulates finetuning as a stochastic optimal control problem with a quadratic control cost. Building on the observation that these models generate coarse features before fine details, we place a time-dependent weight on the control cost. A high cost early in the generative process preserves balance and diversity in the coarse features, which carry most of the semantics, while a low cost at the end lets the model increase the reward by refining details. We prove that our method is equivalent to maximizing the reward under time-varying Kullback--Leibler regularization on the generative paths. Experiments on Gaussian mixtures and on MNIST show a better tradeoff between reward and mode balance than Adjoint Matching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Weighted Adjoint Matching 把预训练扩散/流匹配模型的可微奖励微调写成随机最优控制问题，并在控制代价上加时间依赖权重：生成早期代价高以保住粗特征的平衡与多样性，末期代价低以放开细节去抬高奖励。在 Gaussian mixture 与 MNIST 上，该方法相对 Adjoint Matching 给出更好的奖励与模式平衡折中。
Motivation: Adjoint Matching 用二次控制代价统一了带可微奖励的微调，但全程一致的代价会在早期就允许模型为追奖励而牺牲承载语义的粗特征与模式多样性。
Method: 从 Adjoint Matching（把微调重构为带二次控制代价的随机最优控制）出发，在生成路径的时间轴上给控制代价加权：早期高、末期低；并证明该方法等价于在生成路径上施加时间变化的 KL 正则来最大化奖励。
Result: 在 Gaussian mixture 与 MNIST 两个实验设置上，相对 Adjoint Matching 取得更好的 reward 与 mode balance 折中。
Conclusion: 按生成阶段调度控制代价，可以在不丢模式平衡的前提下提高奖励：粗特征阶段保平衡，细节阶段放行以提奖励。

summary_sections.motivation: Adjoint Matching 用二次控制代价统一了带可微奖励的微调，但全程一致的代价会在早期就允许模型为追奖励而牺牲承载语义的粗特征与模式多样性。
summary_sections.method: 从 Adjoint Matching（把微调重构为带二次控制代价的随机最优控制）出发，在生成路径的时间轴上给控制代价加权：早期高、末期低；并证明该方法等价于在生成路径上施加时间变化的 KL 正则来最大化奖励。
summary_sections.result: 在 Gaussian mixture 与 MNIST 两个实验设置上，相对 Adjoint Matching 取得更好的 reward 与 mode balance 折中。
summary_sections.conclusion: 按生成阶段调度控制代价，可以在不丢模式平衡的前提下提高奖励：粗特征阶段保平衡，细节阶段放行以提奖励。

papers.title: Memorizing Who, Knowing How: Benchmarking Personal and Procedural Memory for Persistent Assistants
papers.abstract_en: Memory systems for persistent personal agents must move beyond isolated memories, maintaining both personal memory about whom they serve and procedural memory about how to act. Crucially, in harness-based personal assistance, procedures or skills are inherently user-conditioned: personal context determines which procedures apply, how they are instantiated, and when they should change. Existing benchmarks typically emphasize either personal or procedural memory, leaving their interaction underexplored. We introduce PraxisMemBench, a harness-based benchmark for persistent personal assistance across daily-life and work trajectories, where personal and procedural memory evolve together and later tasks depend on both. Experiments show that maintaining two memory types separately is insufficient, with completion dropping from single-type to interdependent dependencies (84.6% to 77.9%). More broadly, across existing methods, relation-related failures increase from early to late sessions as interaction history grows (59.8% to 72.9%), revealing a continual-maintenance challenge: writing correct memories is not enough if their evolving content and organization cannot be preserved for later retrieval. To address this, we propose PraxisMem, which uses privileged joint-state supervision to internalize the ability to maintain memory content and organization into the memory manager, with location-aware GRPO and dynamic residual-routed OPSD. PraxisMem reaches 40.78% overall Session Success Rate, compared with 20.60% for Claude Code's native memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PraxisMemBench，一个基于 harness 的持久个人助手基准，把「关于服务对象的个人记忆」与「如何行动的程序性记忆」放在同一批日常与工作轨迹中共同演化，后续任务同时依赖两者。实验显示两类记忆分开维护不够：任务依赖从单一类型变为相互依赖时完成率从 84.6% 降到 77.9%；关系类失败随会话推进从 59.8% 升到 72.9%。作者据此提出 PraxisMem，用特权联合状态监督把维护记忆内容与组织的能力内化进记忆管理器，配合 location-aware GRPO 与动态残差路由的 OPSD，整体 Session Success Rate 达 40.78%，对比 Claude Code 原生记忆的 20.60%。
Motivation: 现有记忆基准通常只强调个人记忆或程序性记忆之一，两者在 harness 式个人助理中的交互被忽视；而程序本身是用户条件化的，个人上下文决定哪些流程适用、如何实例化、何时改变。
Method: PraxisMemBench 在日常与工作轨迹上构建 harness 式基准，让个人记忆与程序性记忆共同演化且后续任务同时依赖两者。方法侧提出 PraxisMem：以特权联合状态监督 (privileged joint-state supervision) 训练记忆管理器，使其内化维护记忆内容与组织的能力，并加入 location-aware GRPO 与动态残差路由的 OPSD。
Result: 任务依赖从单一类型变为相互依赖时完成率由 84.6% 降至 77.9%；在现有方法上，关系类失败率随交互历史增长从早期到晚期会话由 59.8% 升至 72.9%。PraxisMem 整体 Session Success Rate 为 40.78%，Claude Code 原生记忆为 20.60%。
Conclusion: 把个人记忆与程序性记忆分开维护是不够的，写对记忆也不够，记忆内容与组织的演化必须被持续维护才能在后续检索中可用；把这种维护能力内化进记忆管理器可将 Session Success Rate 提升到原生记忆的约两倍。

papers.title: MCMC Can See Can't See
papers.abstract_en: It is folklore that passing "convergence" diagnostics does not guarantee that a Markov chain has converged. We prove this as an impossibility for any finite checklist of diagnostics. Running more chains, longer chains, and smarter diagnostics does not avoid this impossibility in certifying convergence. Under regularity assumptions, we determine how the worst-case undetected non-convergence decays as more diagnostics are added, and how to choose diagnostics optimally. Folklore suggests that the sampler's slowest mixing modes are the "dangerous" ones that must be monitored; we prove that the slow modes yield nearly optimal diagnostics as sampling proceeds. Given a source class, we also give an anytime-valid bound on the remaining discrepancy and show how undetected bias caps the effective sample size that a finite checklist can certify.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明任何有限的收敛诊断清单都不可能保证 Markov 链已收敛：更多链、更长链和更聪明的诊断都绕不开这一不可能性。在正则条件下给出最坏情形未检出的不收敛随诊断数量增加的衰减率与诊断的最优选择，并证明慢混合模式给出的诊断近乎最优；同时给出剩余差异的 anytime-valid 上界，以及未检出偏差对有限清单所能认证的有效样本量 (ESS) 的上限。
Motivation: 通行经验是通过收敛诊断并不等于链已收敛，但缺少对任意有限诊断清单的严格不可能性刻画，也说不清增加诊断数量能换来多少保证。
Method: 在正则假设下把问题形式化为有限诊断清单的不可能性命题，推导最坏情形未检出不收敛随诊断数量的衰减率与诊断的最优选取方式；针对给定 source class 给出剩余差异的 anytime-valid 界，并把未检出偏差与可认证 ESS 联系起来。
Result: 证明了有限诊断清单的不可能性，且增加链数、链长与诊断复杂度均无法规避；证明慢混合模式给出的诊断在采样过程中近乎最优；给出未检出偏差对有限清单可认证有效样本量的上限。
Conclusion: 收敛认证本质上受有限诊断清单的上限约束，慢模式监控是近乎最优的实践选择，而可认证的 ESS 由未检出偏差封顶。

papers.title: MorphAct: Robot Policies Morphing with the Worlds They Act In
papers.abstract_en: Progress toward general intelligence in the physical world requires scaling robot learning across diverse environments and interactions. However, existing robot policies use shared parameters that remain fixed across interaction contexts. When different operations favor competing parameter adjustments, fitting their mixture can leave individual operations insufficiently adapted. Our atomic-task diagnostics reveal competing update directions in both vision-language and action parameters, with source-improving updates increasing loss on other tasks. This motivates MorphAct, a contextual parameterization framework that dynamically adjusts robot policy parameters as interaction contexts change. Two coupled generators produce context-dependent low-rank updates for the vision-language and action modules. Their coupling follows the policy's computational dependency: vision-language updates shape the representations that condition action-side parameter generation. Both generators are trained jointly through the native action objective, without operation labels or expert-adapter targets. MorphAct improves performance across three VLA backbones on LIBERO and Meta-World, with gains of up to 16.30%. In real-world evaluation, it achieves gains of up to 14% over $π_{0.5}$. Ablations support the benefits of contextual parameter generation and representation coupling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MorphAct 把机器人 VLA 策略的共享固定参数改成随交互上下文动态生成的低秩更新：两个耦合生成器分别产出视觉-语言侧与动作侧的 context-dependent low-rank updates，耦合方向按策略计算依赖设定（视觉-语言更新先塑造条件化动作生成的表示），并只用原生动作目标联合训练，不需操作标签或专家 adapter 目标。在 LIBERO 与 Meta-World 上跨三个 VLA backbone 提升性能，增益最高 16.30%，真实机器人上相对 π0.5 最高提升 14%。
Motivation: 现有机器人策略参数在不同交互上下文间共享且固定，当不同操作要求相互竞争的参数调整时，拟合其混合会让单个操作适应不足；原子任务诊断显示视觉-语言参数与动作参数都存在竞争的更新方向，改善源任务的更新会抬高其他任务的损失。
Method: 提出上下文参数化框架 MorphAct：两个耦合生成器随交互上下文变化生成视觉-语言模块与动作模块的低秩更新，耦合依策略计算依赖（视觉-语言更新先影响表示，再条件化动作侧参数生成）；两个生成器通过原生动作目标联合训练，不使用操作标签或专家 adapter 目标。
Result: 在 LIBERO 与 Meta-World 上跨三个 VLA backbone 均有提升，增益最高 16.30%；真实世界评测中相对 π0.5 增益最高 14%；消融实验支持上下文参数生成与表示耦合两项设计的收益。
Conclusion: 让策略参数随交互上下文动态形变、并按计算依赖耦合两侧更新，可缓解共享固定参数下的竞争性适应问题，在仿真与真机上都带来性能提升。

papers.title: On the Convergence of Semi-Gradient TD: A Mean Field Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Semi-gradient temporal-difference learning is a core algorithmic component of reinforcement learning, but bootstrapping with function approximation generally induces a non-conservative vector field and can lead to instability. We analyze this effect for two-layer neural networks in the mean-field regime and identify a simple stability mechanism in which entropy-induced relaxation dominates the sensitivity of the moving bootstrap target. Under this condition, we prove exponential convergence to a unique fixed point and quantify its bias relative to the unregularized Bellman solution. We also show that the same mechanism extends to entropy-regularized off-policy control through soft Q-learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在均场 (mean-field) 极限下分析两层神经网络的半梯度 TD (semi-gradient TD)：自举目标移动带来的敏感性与熵致松弛 (entropy-induced relaxation) 竞争，当松弛占优时算法指数收敛到唯一不动点，并给出该不动点相对无正则 Bellman 解的偏差量化；同一机制可扩展到熵正则的 off-policy 控制即 soft Q-learning。
Motivation: 函数逼近下的自举会产生非保守向量场，导致训练不稳定；两层网络在均场机制下这一失稳效应如何被抑制、收敛到何处，此前缺少可证明的条件。
Method: 把两层神经网络的半梯度 TD 放在均场极限中刻画其动力学，识别出熵致松弛压过移动自举目标敏感性的稳定性条件；在此条件下证明收敛定理并量化偏差，再把同一分析扩展到 soft Q-learning。
Result: 在熵致松弛占优的条件下证明指数收敛到唯一不动点，并量化其相对无正则 Bellman 解的偏差；该机制进一步适用于熵正则 off-policy 控制 (soft Q-learning)。
Conclusion: 半梯度 TD 的稳定性可由熵正则提供的松弛与自举目标敏感性之比来判定：松弛占优即保证指数收敛，代价是相对无正则 Bellman 解的偏差。

papers.title: ChemArgus: Automated Scientific Diagnostics for Lab-Grade Multimodal Chemistry Reasoning: A Frontier Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Chemistry evaluation has moved past multiple-choice probes toward open-ended expert problems, yet the benchmarks that define the current frontier still score answer endpoints alone. Such scoring conflates memorized facts with stepwise derivation, treats visual and textual inputs as interchangeable, and confounds long-horizon planning with stepwise execution. These blind spots prevent any diagnosis of where the reasoning chain breaks in a model. We present ChemArgus, a competition-level chemistry benchmark drawn from chemistry competition material, textbooks, and research papers, whose scoring replaces the answer endpoint with three measurement properties. Fine-grained scoring grades every subquestion point by point with partial credit, so a score lands at the level of the step rather than the outcome. Multimodal capability is priced on every problem containing a real image, paired with a controlled text description, so visual understanding is measured against text on identical tasks. Diagnostic attribution reads paired metrics that share one scoring unit and differ only in context construction, so a gap between two scores isolates a single cause, namely integration, propagation, or local reasoning. GPT-5.6-Sol scores 23.2% on unassisted whole-problem solving against 28.8% and 30.4% under the two sequential metrics, a gap measuring the integration burden. Through rubric partial credit and these cause-isolating score gaps, ChemArgus shows not only whether a model answers chemistry correctly but where its reasoning chain fails, so that every score it reports doubles as a diagnosis, a readout of the chain rather than a verdict, aiming to guide language models step by step on their path toward chemistry expertise, one corrected step at a time, each step priced by the rubric, point by point.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChemArgus 是竞赛级化学多模态推理基准，用逐子问题给分的 rubric 部分得分、真实图像配对照文本描述的多模态定价，以及共享同一评分单位、仅上下文构造不同的成对指标，把答案端点打分替换为三类过程测量。GPT-5.6-Sol 在无辅助整题求解上得 23.2%，而两个顺序指标下分别为 28.8% 与 30.4%，该差距被解读为整合负担 (integration burden)。
Motivation: 现有前沿开放题基准只给答案端点打分，把记忆事实与逐步推导混为一谈，把视觉与文本输入当作可互换，并混淆长程规划与单步执行，因而无法定位推理链在哪一步断裂。
Method: 基准取材于化学竞赛题、教科书与研究论文，评分含三项测量属性：细粒度评分按子问题逐点给部分分；每道含真实图像的题配受控文本描述，使视觉理解与文本在同题上对照；诊断归因读取共享同一评分单位、仅上下文构造不同的成对指标，用分差隔离整合、传播或局部推理单一成因。
Result: GPT-5.6-Sol 无辅助整题求解得 23.2%，两个顺序指标下分别为 28.8% 与 30.4%，分差衡量整合负担。
Conclusion: ChemArgus 主张每个分数都应同时是诊断：报告的不只是模型化学答得对不对，而是推理链在哪一步失败，用 rubric 逐点部分分把每一步单独定价。

papers.title: Outperforming 1000 Euclidean Layers With Hyperbolic Goal-Conditioned RL
papers.abstract_en: Scaling self-supervised contrastive reinforcement learning (CRL) to 1000-layer Euclidean neural networks has enabled state-of-the-art goal-reaching performance, yet wall-clock time scales linearly with depth. We find that changing the geometry achieves stronger performance with far shallower networks. This matters in complex navigation environments, where walls can make route distance deviate substantially from Euclidean distance. In a U-shaped maze, we show that the longer the route, the more it deviates from Euclidean distance. Hyperbolic CRL addresses this mismatch by replacing Euclidean distances in CRL's contrastive objective with geodesic distances in hyperbolic space. On hard navigation tasks, inductive bias beats scale: depth 64 hyperbolic agents outperform 1024-layer-deep Euclidean networks while training more than $12 \times$ faster and using about $13 \times$ fewer parameters. We observe that hyperbolic agents behave qualitatively better in hard humanoid mazes, where they follow corridors to reach goals, whereas Euclidean agents try straight-line shortcuts over walls. Our results show that matching the representation geometry to the task can substitute for substantial network depth. Code is at https://github.com/Probabilistic-and-Interactive-ML/HypGCRL .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把对比强化学习 (CRL) 目标达成任务中的欧氏距离换成双曲空间测地距离，可在远浅的网络上超过千层欧氏模型：在困难导航任务上深度 64 的双曲 agent 胜过 1024 层欧氏网络，训练快 12 倍以上、参数少约 13 倍，且在 hard humanoid maze 中沿走廊走而非翻墙抄直线。
Motivation: 自监督对比强化学习靠堆深度换取目标达成性能，但墙钟时间随深度线性增长；同时导航环境中墙体使路径距离大幅偏离欧氏距离，表示几何与任务几何不匹配。
Method: 在 CRL 的对比目标中用双曲空间测地距离替换欧氏距离，得到 hyperbolic CRL；在 U 形迷宫与困难 humanoid maze 导航任务上与深层欧氏网络对比，代码见 GitHub 仓库 HypGCRL。
Result: 深度 64 的双曲 agent 在 hard navigation 任务上优于 1024 层欧氏网络，训练加速超过 12 倍、参数量少约 13 倍；U 形迷宫中路线越长其与欧氏距离的偏离越大；行为上双曲 agent 沿走廊到达目标，欧氏 agent 试图翻墙走直线捷径。
Conclusion: 把表示几何与任务几何对齐可以替代大量网络深度，在有墙体、路径距离偏离欧氏距离的导航任务中归纳偏置比单纯扩规模更有效。

papers.title: Minimax estimation of the pseudo-spectral gap of continuous Markov chains, with applications to empirical concentration bounds
papers.abstract_en: We study the minimax estimation of the pseudo-spectral gap $γ_{ps}$ of a Markov chain from the observation of a single trajectory. Extending earlier works on finite-state space chains by Wolfer and Kontorovich (2024), we provide an estimator in the case of a compact, continuous state-space. Our estimator appears to be minimax-optimal on the class of chains with a transition operator with Lipschitz density, up to logarithmic terms. Our estimator, combined with Paulin's version of Bernstein inequality, allows to derive empirical concentration inequalities for Markov chains. This unlocks many applications, from confidence intervals, to active learning and generalization bounds. In particular, for rested bandits with Markov rewards, we provide a version of UCB with a regret bound similar to the one in the iid case, without assuming any knowledge on the pseudo-spectral gap of the chains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在紧致连续状态空间上，从单条轨迹估计 Markov 链的 pseudo-spectral gap γ_ps，给出在 Lipschitz 密度转移算子类上（差对数因子）minimax 最优的估计量；与 Paulin 版 Bernstein 不等式结合可导出经验集中不等式，并据此给出对 γ_ps 无先验知识的 rested bandit UCB 版本，其 regret 界与 iid 情形相当。
Motivation: Wolfer 与 Kontorovich (2024) 的 γ_ps 估计只覆盖有限状态空间，连续状态空间下既无可用估计量，也就无法从数据驱动地得到 Markov 链的集中不等式与下游界。
Method: 把有限状态情形的估计量推广到紧致连续状态空间，针对转移算子具有 Lipschitz 密度的链构造估计；再与 Paulin 版 Bernstein 不等式耦合，把估计出的 γ_ps 代入以得到经验集中不等式，并应用于置信区间、主动学习、泛化界与 rested bandit。
Result: 估计量在 Lipschitz 密度转移算子的链类上达到 minimax 最优（差对数因子）；导出的经验集中不等式覆盖置信区间、主动学习与泛化界；对 Markov 奖励的 rested bandit 给出 UCB 版本，regret 界与 iid 情形相当，且不需知道链的 pseudo-spectral gap。
Conclusion: 连续状态空间 Markov 链的 γ_ps 可以从单条轨迹被 minimax 最优地估计，且估计量足以支撑数据驱动的集中不等式与无先验知识的 UCB regret 界。

papers.title: Provable Transformer Context Compression for In-Context Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Transformers can perform in-context reinforcement learning without parameter updates. However, existing theoretical constructions often require context sizes that grow with the number of sampled transitions, leading to increasing memory costs in large-scale problems. This raises a fundamental scalability question: how much context is intrinsically necessary to carry out such learning? We answer this question for fixed-policy TD evaluation. We show that, with a shared linear decoder, the minimum context dimension required to exactly reproduce the first $L$ TD iterates is the Krylov dimension induced by the sampled transitions. When the available context dimension $m$ falls below this threshold, exact reproduction is no longer possible. In this regime, we characterize the optimal approximation error and show that it decays as $Θ(γ^m\max\{1,1/(m(1-γ))\})$ where $γ$ is the discounting factor. Moving from representation complexity to actual memory cost, we characterize the optimal retained memory for exact continuous representations as $Θ(nk_L)$ and show experimentally that on a sampled task whose exact rank is full but whose numerical rank is small, a context accurate to $10^{-2}$ is $88.7\%$ smaller than the sparse sufficient statistics of TD. Finally, we establish the learnability of the shared executor through pretraining by proving global convergence of an auxiliary objective over effective attention parameters under suitable task diversity. Experiments across diverse TD evaluation problems validate parameter recovery and the predicted context--accuracy tradeoff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出 in-context RL 中固定策略 TD 评估的上下文压缩可证界：共享线性解码器下，精确复现前 L 个 TD 迭代所需的最小上下文维度恰为采样转移诱导的 Krylov 维度；当可用维度 m 低于该阈值时最优近似误差按 Θ(γ^m·max{1,1/(m(1-γ))}) 衰减。在精确秩为满但数值秩很小的任务上，精度 10^-2 的上下文比 TD 的稀疏充分统计量小 88.7%。
Motivation: 现有 in-context RL 理论构造要求上下文随采样转移数增长，大规模问题上内存开销持续上升，缺少“执行学习到底需要多少上下文”的内在下界。
Method: 针对固定策略 TD 评估，用共享线性解码器把最小上下界归结为采样转移诱导的 Krylov 维度；在 m 低于该阈值时刻画最优近似误差随折扣因子 γ 的衰减率，并给出精确连续表示的最优保留内存 Θ(nk_L)；再通过对辅助目标在有效注意力参数上的全局收敛证明，建立共享执行器经预训练的可学习性（需适当任务多样性）。
Result: 近似误差上界为 Θ(γ^m·max{1,1/(m(1-γ))})；精确连续表示的最优保留内存为 Θ(nk_L)；在精确秩为满、数值秩很小的采样任务上，精度 10^-2 的上下文比 TD 的稀疏充分统计量小 88.7%；跨多种 TD 评估问题的实验验证了参数恢复与所预测的上下文—精度权衡。
Conclusion: in-context TD 评估的上下文需求由 Krylov 维度而非采样转移数决定，低于该维度时误差随 γ 指数式可控衰减，因此压缩上下文可在保持精度的同时大幅削减内存。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: What Coding Agents Leave Unsaid: Measuring Task-State Gaps Between Execution and Reports
papers.abstract_en: Human supervisors rely on coding agents' reports to assess progress, verify repairs, and decide when to intervene. But a supervisor cannot investigate a failure they were never told occurred. Failed attempts, workarounds, and unresolved risks may disappear from routine reports, leaving supervisors unaware of issues that warrant scrutiny. We conduct CTXGAP, a measurement study quantifying the gap in task-state recoverability between agents' accumulated user-facing reports and their full recorded execution contexts. Across 37 coding tasks and 4,799 valid probes, agents answer 93.6% of task-state questions on demand; full-context readers recover 92.7%, while report-only readers recover 52.0%, a 40.7-point gap. At the final checkpoints of 30 verified fixes, the gap remains 34.8 points. Human annotation identifies states mentioned without enough supporting detail as the largest category of unrecovered information, and model-assessed supervision-relevant states retain substantial gaps. Full terminal scrollback improves recovery to 73.6% but still trails full context. Under matched report lengths, context-informed rewrites improve recovery by about eight points, without a detectable targeted-over-natural advantage. Positive gaps persist across harnesses and independent DeepSeek execution and measurement. CTXGAP establishes report-based task-state recoverability as a complementary evaluation dimension.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CTXGAP 用可恢复性探针量化编码 agent 的用户可见报告与其完整执行上下文之间的任务状态落差：37 个编码任务、4,799 个有效探针中，按需回答命中 93.6%、完整上下文读者 92.7%，而只读报告的读者仅 52.0%，差 40.7 个百分点。30 个已验证修复的最终检查点上差距仍有 34.8 点；补全终端 scrollback 只回到 73.6%。作者据此把「基于报告的任务状态可恢复性」立为监督质量的独立评测维度。
Motivation: 人类主管靠 agent 的例行报告判断进度与是否介入，但失败尝试、绕行方案和未解决风险若未写进报告，主管根本无从调查；报告与真实执行状态之间的可恢复性落差此前没有被测量。
Method: 构建测量研究 CTXGAP：在 37 个编码任务上设计 4,799 个有效任务状态探针，分别让按需作答的 agent、只读报告的读者、读完整执行上下文的读者作答并比对命中率；辅以人工标注归类未被恢复的信息类型、模型评估监督相关状态，并在不同 harness 与独立的 DeepSeek 执行/测量流程上复现。
Result: 37 个任务、4,799 个有效探针下：按需回答 93.6%，完整上下文读者 92.7%，仅报告读者 52.0%，落差 40.7 点；30 个已验证修复的最终检查点落差仍为 34.8 点。人工标注中「提到状态但缺少支撑细节」是未恢复信息的最大类别；补全终端 scrollback 把恢复率提到 73.6%，仍低于完整上下文。等长报告下，基于上下文的重写把恢复率提高约 8 个点，且未检测到 targeted 相对 natural 的优势；正向落差跨 harness 与独立 DeepSeek 执行/测量持续存在。
Conclusion: 报告天然丢弃任务状态，仅靠 scrollback 或等长重写都无法补回，因此报告可恢复性应作为与任务完成度互补的评测维度来衡量 agent 的可监督性。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 37 个任务、4,799 个有效探针下：按需回答 93.6%，完整上下文读者 92.7%，仅报告读者 52.0%，落差 40.7 点；30 个已验证修复的最终检查点落差仍为 34.8 点。人工标注中「提到状态但缺少支撑细节」是未恢复信息的最大类别；补全终端 scrollback 把恢复率提到 73.6%，仍低于完整上下文。等长报告下，基于上下文的重写把恢复率提高约 8 个点，且未检测到 targeted 相对 natural 的优势；正向落差跨 harness 与独立 DeepSeek 执行/测量持续存在。
summary_sections.conclusion: 报告天然丢弃任务状态，仅靠 scrollback 或等长重写都无法补回，因此报告可恢复性应作为与任务完成度互补的评测维度来衡量 agent 的可监督性。

papers.title: A Strong Harness Narrows the Model Gap: A Comparative Evaluation for Legislative Document-to-XML Conversion
papers.abstract_en: Legal-content reproduction requires matching the source exactly in section hierarchy, verbatim text, citations, and amendment spans; a dropped citation or mislabeled amendment carries into the products lawyers rely on. We report an industrial pipeline converting U.S. state legislation into strict, schema-constrained XML, and hypothesize that its accuracy comes from harness engineering, the deterministic tooling built around a model, more than the model itself. Our controlled ablation crosses three harnesses (zero-shot, a single tool-using agent, and a decomposed multi-agent pipeline) with three Claude models on 153 gold bills from two jurisdictions. The harness narrows the model gap: the weakest model in the full pipeline beats the strongest model alone (0.948 versus 0.806, paired bootstrap p less than 0.001). Because the two agentic harnesses share identical tools, their gap comes from orchestration: decomposition plus the persisted state and per-agent context it brings. Across four scored dimensions, the model spread at zero-shot (0.68 to 0.81) narrows to 0.95 at the full pipeline; the residual sits almost entirely in citation normalization, where the canonical identifier is retrieved from an external authority rather than generated from the weights, so a deterministic lookup tool supplies the exactness that a larger model does not.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Natural Legal Language Processing Workshop (NLLP) at EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇法律 NLP 论文，与天气/降水/数据同化无关：把美国州立法转换为严格 schema 约束 XML 的工业流水线中，harness 工程（模型外的确定性工具链）比模型本身更决定准确率。在 153 份两个辖区的 gold bills 上，最弱模型配完整多 agent 流水线得 0.948，强于最强模型单独 zero-shot 的 0.806（paired bootstrap p<0.001）；zero-shot 下模型差距 0.68–0.81，完整流水线收敛到 0.95，残差几乎全在 citation normalization。
Motivation: 法律文本复现要求章节层级、逐字文本、引用与修正段完全对齐，漏掉一个引用或标错修正段会传导到律师依赖的下游产品；作者要检验准确率究竟来自模型权重还是模型外的确定性工具链。
Method: 受控消融交叉三种 harness（zero-shot、单个 tool-using agent、分解式 multi-agent 流水线）与三个 Claude 模型，在两个辖区共 153 份 gold bills 上评测；两个 agentic harness 共享完全相同的工具，因此差距归因于编排方式（decomposition 加持久化状态与 per-agent context）。
Result: 完整流水线中最弱模型 0.948 对最强模型单独 0.806，paired bootstrap p<0.001；四个评分维度上 zero-shot 的模型跨度 0.68–0.81 收窄到完整流水线的 0.95；残差几乎全部落在 citation normalization，该处规范标识符由外部权威源检索而非模型生成。
Conclusion: 在 schema 约束的法律文档转换任务上，harness 编排与确定性检索工具能抹平模型能力差距，剩余误差集中在需要外部权威精确标识符的 citation normalization 环节。

papers.title: Empirical Boundaries of Reservoir Computing for Few-Shot Sequence Pattern Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Efficient sequence modeling remains a fundamental challenge in machine learning. Despite the success of Transformers, recurrent neural networks (RNNs) have recently re-emerged as efficient alternatives. Particularly, Echo State Networks (ESNs) offer a compelling framework of randomized RNNs that have been extensively studied for time-series forecasting and dynamical systems. This paper presents an empirical analysis of distributional, architectural, and optimization variants of ESNs evaluated on few-shot sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) pattern tasks. These synthetic tasks utilize discrete symbol sequences, characterized by delays, inactive phases, and triggered markers to isolate and evaluate memory and pattern recognition capabilities. The minimality of these tasks is crucial to understand the strengths and limitations of machine learning models. Furthermore, when the input signal utilizes a one-hot encoding, ESN dynamics are governed strictly by their weight distributions, offering an ideal lens through which to study reservoir computing. Our findings map the performance boundaries of ESNs relative to state-of-the-art (SOTA) models. We show that preserving a linear state regime is vital for memory tasks, such as pattern completion or simple copy. We propose a data-dependent modulation mechanism for nonlinear input injection into the reservoir (G-ESN). G-ESN functions as a statistical filter capable of solving tasks that conventional ESNs cannot (the adding problem and bracket matching). Finally, for Deep ESNs, we evaluate a shared readout mechanism across layers that outperforms conventional concatenated readouts on structural tasks, including selective copy, sorting problem, and bracket matching.
papers.comment: 4th International Workshop on Reservoir Computing (RC 2026) 35th International Conference on Artificial Neural Networks (ICANN 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 few-shot 序列到序列的合成符号任务上系统考察 Echo State Networks (ESN) 的分布、结构与优化变体，划定其相对 SOTA 模型的性能边界。保持线性状态机制对记忆类任务（pattern completion、simple copy）至关重要；提出的 G-ESN 用数据依赖调制控制非线性注入，作为统计滤波器解决了传统 ESN 无法处理的 adding problem 与 bracket matching；Deep ESN 的跨层共享 readout 在 selective copy、sorting、bracket matching 等结构任务上优于常规拼接 readout。
Motivation: ESN 等随机 RNN 虽被当作 Transformer 的高效替代，但其在记忆与模式识别任务上的能力边界尚不清楚；用最小化的合成符号任务可以把记忆与模式识别能力单独隔离出来评估。
Method: 在带延迟、非活跃段与触发标记的离散符号序列 few-shot seq2seq 合成任务上，评估 ESN 的分布、架构与优化变体；输入采用 one-hot 编码，使 ESN 动力学完全由权重分布决定。提出 G-ESN：数据依赖的调制机制控制非线性向 reservoir 的注入；对 Deep ESN 比较跨层共享 readout 与常规拼接 readout。
Result: 保持线性状态机制对 pattern completion 与 simple copy 等记忆任务是关键；G-ESN 作为统计滤波器解决了传统 ESN 无法解决的 adding problem 与 bracket matching；Deep ESN 的共享 readout 在 selective copy、sorting problem、bracket matching 上优于常规拼接 readout；ESN 的性能边界相对 SOTA 模型被绘出。
Conclusion: ESN 的能力边界取决于状态机制的线性程度与非线性注入方式：记忆任务需要线性状态，而数据依赖的非线性调制与共享 readout 能扩展其在结构任务上的可解范围。

papers.title: PrecipCorrDiff: A Deep Learning Framework for Generating 0.0625$^\circ$ High-Resolution IMD Gridded Precipitation Data
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution precipitation datasets are essential for weather forecasting, hydrological modeling, and climate risk assessment, yet observation-based gridded products often lack the spatial detail required for regional applications. Here we present PrecipCorrDiff, a diffusion-based downscaling framework built by modifying the original corrector diffusion based archetecture that incorporates a customized loss function and a multi-scale residual generation strategy to improve the precipitation especially the representation of extremes. PrecipCorrDiff generates 0.0625° resolution India Meteorological Department (IMD) precipitation fields from 0.25° gridded data while preserving precipitation statistics and reconstructing fine-scale spatial variability. Validation against independent IMD station observations, comparing the proposed framework with the SRGAN-based model and the original CorrDiff model, indicates that the proposed framework substantially improves the representation of spatial precipitation patterns, rainfall intensity distributions, and extreme rainfall events, while eliminating the systematic negative bias present in the previously developed SRGAN-based model. Across four climatologically distinct homogeneous Indian monsoon regions, PrecipCorrDiff reproduces observed precipitation characteristics with near-zero spatial bias, demonstrating the potential of diffusion-based downscaling for generating physically consistent, high-resolution precipitation datasets for hydrological, meteorological, and climate applications.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 13 figures. Paper submitted to a journal for peer review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PrecipCorrDiff 用改造的 corrector diffusion 架构把 IMD 0.25° 格点降水降尺度到 0.0625°，通过定制损失与多尺度残差生成来保住降水统计并强化极值。对照独立 IMD 站点观测，它在空间型、雨强分布和极端事件上明显优于 SRGAN 与原版 CorrDiff，并消除了 SRGAN 模型的系统性负偏差，在印度四个均一季风区做到近零空间偏差。
Motivation: 观测驱动的格点降水产品空间细节不足，难以支撑区域天气预报、水文建模与气候风险评估，尤其是极端降水的刻画。
Method: 基于原 corrector diffusion (CorrDiff) 架构改造：加入定制损失函数与多尺度残差生成策略，从 IMD 0.25° 格点数据生成 0.0625° 高分辨率降水场；用独立 IMD 站点观测做验证，对比 SRGAN-based 模型与原版 CorrDiff。
Result: 在独立 IMD 站点观测验证中，PrecipCorrDiff 相比 SRGAN-based 模型与原版 CorrDiff 显著改善空间降水型、雨强分布与极端降水事件的刻画，并消除 SRGAN 模型中先前存在的系统性负偏差；在印度四个气候上不同的均一季风区，重现观测降水特征且空间偏差接近零。
Conclusion: 基于扩散的降尺度能生成物理一致的高分辨率降水数据集，可用于水文、气象与气候应用，且在四个印度季风区保持近零空间偏差。

papers.title: Why 3D Reconstruction Breaks Down on Under-Ice AUV Video, and How to Predict It
papers.abstract_en: Reconstruction of 3D structures using under-ice AUV video footage has been inaccurate, although it is not certain whether this is due to shortcomings in the methods or an inherent deficiency of the capture system. We test four different models for reconstruction on the same Antarctic under-ice AUV video (Icefin, Kamb Ice Stream): classical feature matching SfM, differentiable photometric splatting, volumetric depth fusion, and a pose-free feed-forward foundation model. All four fail, each in a distinct way: near-total registration yielding almost no structure, geometrically broken output despite healthy photometric metrics, a persistent coverage artifact, and unstable cross-chunk scale. We show that all four are consistent with the same capture regime, a small camera-baseline-to-scene-depth ratio. Following our analysis, we propose a detection system that flags this type of failure in minutes, rather than hours of wasted compute.
papers.comment: Short paper presented at the 2nd Workshop on Marine Vision, ECCV 2026, Malmö, Sweden, September 8, 2026. Published on OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=6wgkZngDjW
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在南极 Kamb Ice Stream 的 Icefin 冰下 AUV 视频上，四类 3D 重建模型（经典特征匹配 SfM、可微光度 splatting、体积深度融合、免位姿前馈基础模型）全部失败且失败模式各异，但都可归因于同一个采集条件：相机基线与场景深度之比过小。据此提出一个可在数分钟内标记此类失败的检测系统，避免数小时无效算力开销。
Motivation: 冰下 AUV 视频的 3D 重建长期不准，但无法区分是方法缺陷还是采集系统本身的固有缺陷，导致失败原因排查代价高昂。
Method: 在同一段南极冰下 AUV 视频（Icefin, Kamb Ice Stream）上并列测试四种重建路线：经典特征匹配 SfM、可微光度 splatting、体积深度融合、免位姿 (pose-free) 前馈基础模型；再用小相机基线-场景深度比 (baseline-to-scene-depth ratio) 这一采集条件统一解释四类失败，并据此设计失败检测系统。
Result: 四类模型全部失败且模式各异：近乎完全配准但几乎无结构、光度指标健康而几何破碎、持续存在的覆盖伪影、跨分块尺度不稳定；四者均与小基线-深度比的采集条件一致。检测系统可在数分钟内标记该类失败，替代数小时的浪费算力。
Conclusion: 冰下重建失败更可能源于采集几何（小基线-深度比）而非单一算法缺陷，因此应先用快速检测判定失败类型再投入算力。

papers.title: LatentLoop: Scaling Looped MoE Models with Asymmetric Compute Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Looped Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models combine parameter reuse with sparse computation to improve performance under matched budgets. Prior work demonstrates that different loop visits can play different roles even when they share parameters. To probe the contributions of different loop visits, we learn separate residual coefficients in a model that applies a shared block twice, observing a smaller scale in the first visit. Fixed coefficient experiments show that reducing the first visit's scale preserves or improves performance, whereas the same reductions to the second hurt it. This asymmetry motivates us to explore asymmetric compute allocation. We propose \textbf{LatentLoop}, which compresses the first visit's sequence, retains full resolution in the second, and reallocates saved computation to increase the hidden size. We further learn how strongly the first visit updates the full sequence, and share MoE weights across visits while using separate attention parameters to accommodate their different sequence resolutions. Across 15 configurations spanning 1.3B--7B parameters, with the largest budget exceeding $10^{21}$ FLOPs, LatentLoop consistently lowers validation NLL. At a fitted NLL of 1.988, predicted compute savings are 19.0\% and 7.9\% relative to vanilla MoE and the looped baseline. It also improves average scores on nine benchmarks at all sizes in 0-shot and 5-shot settings. These results suggest asymmetric compute allocation is a promising direction for looped MoE models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LatentLoop 发现循环 MoE 中两次访问的作用不对称：压缩第一次访问的序列、第二次保持全分辨率，并把省下的算力转投隐藏维，可在同预算下稳定降低验证 NLL。在 1.3B–7B 共 15 组配置（最大预算超 10^21 FLOPs）上验证 NLL 一致下降，拟合 NLL 1.988 处相对 vanilla MoE 与循环基线分别节省 19.0% 与 7.9% 计算，并在九个 benchmark 的 0-shot 与 5-shot 上各规模均提升平均分。
Motivation: 循环 MoE 靠参数复用与稀疏计算在同预算下提性能，但各次循环访问即使共享参数也扮演不同角色，此前缺少对访问间差异的直接探测与利用方式。
Method: 先在共享 block 应用两次的模型上学独立残差系数以探测两次访问的贡献差异；再提出 LatentLoop：压缩第一次访问的序列、第二次保留全分辨率，把省下的算力重新分配为更大隐藏维，学习第一次访问对全序列的更新强度，并在两次访问间共享 MoE 权重、使用分离的 attention 参数以适配不同序列分辨率。
Result: 固定系数实验中降低第一次访问的 scale 保持或提升性能，对第二次做同样削减则损害性能；15 组配置（1.3B–7B 参数，最大预算超 10^21 FLOPs）上验证 NLL 一致下降，拟合 NLL 1.988 时相对 vanilla MoE 与循环基线的预测计算节省分别为 19.0% 与 7.9%；九个 benchmark 上 0-shot 与 5-shot 的平均分在所有规模均提升。
Conclusion: 循环 MoE 的两次访问存在可利用的不对称性，非对称算力分配是有前景的扩展方向：压缩早期访问序列并把算力转投隐藏维，可在同预算下同时降低 NLL 与提升多 benchmark 平均分。

papers.title: Safe-FCL: Continual Risk Awareness and Fine-Grained Safety Aggregation for Federated Continual Learning of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Federated fine-tuning enables large language models (LLMs) to learn collaboratively from distributed client data, but malicious client updates can compromise global model safety. As federated tasks evolve, changing malicious update patterns challenge the ability of existing defenses to maintain reliable risk detection over time. To address this challenge, we propose Safe-FCL, a framework integrating continual risk awareness with fine-grained safety aggregation for federated continual learning of LLMs. Specifically, the Continual Risk Awareness (CRA) mechanism learns emerging risk patterns across sequential tasks and constrains detector updates using a protective subspace derived from historical features, mitigating forgetting of previously learned malicious patterns while adapting to new risks. To translate risk awareness into aggregation-level safety control, the Fine-Grained Safety Aggregation (FGSA) mechanism combines client-level risk assessments from CRA with module-level deviations from historical update behavior to adaptively regulate aggregation contributions, suppressing potentially malicious updates while minimizing unnecessary restrictions on benign updates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Safe-FCL outperforms current SOTA methods, improving global-model Rule and MD-Judge scores in federated continual learning by 0.41% and 0.64%, respectively, while increasing average risk recognition accuracy by 2.01%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Safe-FCL 针对联邦持续学习中恶意客户端更新模式随任务演进而变化的问题，用 Continual Risk Awareness (CRA) 跨序列任务学习新风险模式并用历史特征构成的保护子空间约束检测器更新以缓解遗忘，再用 Fine-Grained Safety Aggregation (FGSA) 把客户端级风险与模块级历史偏差结合来自适应调节聚合权重。实验中全局模型 Rule 与 MD-Judge 分数分别提升 0.41% 和 0.64%，平均风险识别准确率提升 2.01%。
Motivation: 联邦微调中恶意客户端更新会破坏全局模型安全，而恶意更新模式随任务演进不断变化，现有防御难以持续可靠地检测风险。
Method: CRA 机制跨序列任务学习新出现的风险模式，并用由历史特征导出的保护子空间 (protective subspace) 约束检测器更新，兼顾对旧恶意模式的记忆与对新风险的适应；FGSA 机制将 CRA 的客户端级风险评估与模块级历史更新偏差结合，自适应调节各客户端的聚合贡献。
Result: 在联邦持续学习设置下，Safe-FCL 优于当前 SOTA 方法：全局模型 Rule 分数提升 0.41%，MD-Judge 分数提升 0.64%，平均风险识别准确率提升 2.01%。
Conclusion: 把持续风险感知与细粒度安全聚合结合，可在恶意模式变化的联邦持续学习中同时抑制潜在恶意更新、减少对良性更新的不必要限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Choosing the Number of Attention Heads from Intrinsic Dimension: A Small-Scale Study
papers.abstract_en: The number of attention heads in a transformer is usually set by convention or grid search. We test a simple heuristic for setting it in advance: estimate the intrinsic dimension of token representations without labels, and use roughly that many heads. We estimate intrinsic dimension with a nested-dropout VAE trained on DistilBERT embeddings of WikiText-2, choosing the KL weight at the knee of the VAE's rate-distortion curve rather than by hand. This gives $k^*=9.2$ (95% CI [8.6, 9.8]). In a small 4-layer transformer trained from scratch, 10 heads and 32 heads are statistically equivalent on SST-2 and on MRPC (paired TOST over 10 seeds, $\pm1$ point margin), with 69% fewer attention parameters for the 10-head model. Training 10 heads from the start also slightly outperforms training 32 heads and pruning to 10 (0.6 points, $p=0.008$). The evidence is narrow: two classification tasks, one small architecture, no pretrained models, and no formal link between intrinsic dimension and head count. We present the result as a practical heuristic worth testing at larger scale, not as a general principle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用无标签估计的 token 表示内在维度 (intrinsic dimension) 来预先设定 Transformer 注意力头数：nested-dropout VAE 在 DistilBERT 的 WikiText-2 嵌入上给出 k*=9.2（95% CI [8.6, 9.8]），据此取 10 头。在从头训练的 4 层小模型上，10 头与 32 头在 SST-2 和 MRPC 上统计等价（10 个种子的配对 TOST，±1 分边界），且 10 头少用 69% 注意力参数；直接训 10 头还比训 32 头再剪到 10 头高 0.6 分（p=0.008）。
Motivation: 注意力头数通常靠惯例或网格搜索定，代价高且缺乏依据；作者想检验能否用无标签的内在维度估计提前定头数。
Method: 在 DistilBERT 的 WikiText-2 token 表示上训练 nested-dropout VAE 估计内在维度，KL 权重取 VAE 率失真曲线的拐点而非手调；再把该维度当作头数，在从头训练的 4 层 Transformer 上与 32 头对比，用 10 个种子的配对 TOST（±1 分等价边界）检验。
Result: 内在维度 k*=9.2，95% CI [8.6, 9.8]；SST-2 与 MRPC 上 10 头与 32 头统计等价（配对 TOST，10 seeds，±1 分），10 头模型少 69% 注意力参数；从头训 10 头比训 32 头再剪枝到 10 头高 0.6 分，p=0.008。
Conclusion: 作者把结论限定为一个值得在更大规模上测试的实用启发式，而非普遍原理：证据只覆盖两个分类任务、一个小型架构、无预训练模型，且内在维度与头数之间没有形式化联系。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Neurosymbolic Learning of Interpretable World Models
papers.abstract_en: World models aim to learn compact representations of an environment from observations, enabling agents to predict future states and plan their behaviour. However, most existing approaches learn black-box representations, with limited ability to incorporate prior knowledge about the world. We introduce Concept-Grounded World Models (CGWMs), a neurosymbolic world model design that instead learns interpretable concept representations. We learn these concepts from observations using explicit and complete knowledge, expressed in temporal logic, that specifies the valid world states and the temporal relations governing their dynamics. Furthermore, we directly use this knowledge by formulating planning as differentiable reasoning, optimising the agent's actions by gradient ascent to satisfy a goal. We experimentally compare CGWM with a purely neural baseline and a neurosymbolic baseline on two game environments. We find that CGWMs ground concepts much more accurately, even over long horizons, resulting in significantly more robust planning both in and out of distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Concept-Grounded World Models (CGWMs)，用以时序逻辑表达的完整世界知识约束神经世界模型，学到可解释的概念表示，并把规划写成可微推理、用梯度上升直接优化动作以满足目标。在两个游戏环境上与纯神经基线和神经符号基线对比，CGWM 的概念落地 (grounding) 准确度显著更高，长时程下依然成立，规划在分布内与分布外都更稳健。
Motivation: 现有世界模型多学黑盒表示，难以注入关于世界的先验知识，导致概念不可解释、规划在分布外脆弱。
Method: CGWM 用显式且完备的时序逻辑 (temporal logic) 知识规定合法世界状态与动力学的时间关系，据此从观测中学习可解释的概念表示；规划被表述为可微推理，通过梯度上升优化智能体动作以满足目标。
Result: 在两个游戏环境上与纯神经基线和神经符号基线实验对比：CGWM 的概念落地准确度显著更高，即使在长时程上也保持，规划在分布内与分布外均显著更稳健。
Conclusion: 把完备的时序逻辑知识同时用于概念学习和可微规划，可以在世界模型里得到既可解释又分布外稳健的规划。

papers.title: AtomSearch: Evidence-Grounded Tree Search for Agent Skill Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills adapt frozen models through editable external instructions. Revising several rules at once makes changes difficult to inspect, while judging each local edit only by its immediate score can discard useful intermediate states. We introduce AtomSearch, which keeps revision actions local while using subsequent skill states to guide search. Contrastive atomic editing links each primitive rule edit to failed and successful executions, a behavioral hypothesis, and an intended scope. Skill-State Tree Search (STS) evaluates short edit compositions and selectively retains them as executable states that can be revisited and extended. Outcome memory supplies later proposals with observed repair and regression statistics. We evaluate AtomSearch across four tasks and five target models. With deepseek-v4-flash, it exceeds SkillOpt on three of four tasks, including a 9.68-percentage-point gain on LiveMathematicianBench, and SkillOpt's final skills contain 2.3-19.7 times as many characters. In 67% of completed searches, the best validation state passes through an ancestor that was not highest-scoring at its depth. These results show how local rule edits can support the exploration of useful revision paths and yield compact skills, with additional offline evaluations used to explore alternative states.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AtomSearch 把 agent skill 的规则改写拆成原子编辑，用对比式原子编辑把每次原语规则改动绑定到失败/成功执行、行为假设与作用范围，再用 Skill-State Tree Search (STS) 评估短编辑组合并选择性保留为可回访、可扩展的可执行状态，由 outcome memory 提供修复与回归统计。在 deepseek-v4-flash 上四个任务中三个超过 SkillOpt，LiveMathematicianBench 提升 9.68 个百分点，且 SkillOpt 最终 skill 的字符数是 AtomSearch 的 2.3–19.7 倍。
Motivation: 同时改写多条规则使改动难以逐条审查，而只按即时分数评判局部编辑又会丢掉有用的中间状态，导致 skill 冗长且搜索路径不可追溯。
Method: 三个组件：对比式原子编辑（把原语规则编辑关联到失败与成功执行、行为假设、预期作用范围）、Skill-State Tree Search（评估短编辑组合并选择性保留为可执行状态）、outcome memory（向后续提案提供观测到的修复与回归统计）。在四个任务、五个目标模型上评测。
Result: 在 deepseek-v4-flash 上，四个任务中三个超过 SkillOpt，其中 LiveMathematicianBench 提升 9.68 个百分点；SkillOpt 最终 skill 的字符数为 AtomSearch 的 2.3–19.7 倍。在 67% 的完成搜索中，最优验证状态经过某个在其深度上并非最高分的祖先状态。
Conclusion: 局部规则编辑配合可回访的树式搜索能探索出更好的修订路径并产出更紧凑的 skill；67% 的结果说明按即时分数剪枝会系统性丢掉有用的中间状态。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Protection Overrides Consequences: Understanding Protection Mode in Large Language Model Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: Frontier language models excel at complex tasks yet may prioritize protection over larger physical consequences in simple, urgent decisions. GPT-5.6 Sol, for example, moves a girl playing in shallow water before retrieving a submerged camera. We call this Protection Mode and study it with ProtectionBench: 285 prompts, 34 physical families, and nine models. At lowest effort, at least one of four responses prioritizes the subject on 34.74% of Sol prompts and over 83% of MiniMax M3 and Qwen3.5-27B prompts; none of four independent human raters does so. Controls show that choices usually track physical risk. We elicit both risks before requesting an action. Some models assess risk incorrectly; others state the correct ordering but still choose the subject. Qwen3.5-27B with thinking shows 100% correct risk ordering but 57.81% subject choice among eligible conversations on eight selected scenes. Attention audits find no stable reduction in attention to relevant facts; removing the stated risk direction reduces object-first choice in dots3-note-prev but not detectably in Qwen3.5-27B. Adding a general "people or animals before property" rule increases subject choice by 19-38 percentage points, whereas factual reminders favor the object by 0.7-5.2 points. Removing naturally generated versions of that rule lowers subject choice by 10-15 points. We also examine whether post-training introduces this pattern. Base models already show Protection Mode; post-training changes justifications more than choices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ProtectionBench（285 个 prompt、34 类物理情境、9 个模型）刻画语言模型的 Protection Mode：在紧急决策中优先保护人/动物而忽略更大的物理后果。最低 effort 下 GPT-5.6 Sol 至少一个回答在 34.74% prompt 上优先主体，MiniMax M3 与 Qwen3.5-27B 超过 83%，而四名独立人类评分者无一如此；加入“people or animals before property”通用规则使主体选择升 19–38 个百分点，事实性提醒反而使物体优先升 0.7–5.2 个百分点。

Method: 构建 ProtectionBench：285 个 prompt、34 类物理情境、9 个模型；先让模型评估两类风险再要求给出行动，配合 attention audit、移除已陈述风险方向、以及注入或移除“people or animals before property”规则的对照实验，并考察 base 与 post-training 模型差异。

papers.title: Quiet Triggers, Loud Footprints: A Tri-Space Measurement Study of Backdoor Stealthiness
papers.abstract_en: Backdoor attacks on deep neural networks are commonly evaluated by attack success rate and benign accuracy, yet their stealthiness remains inconsistently defined and measured. Existing work often studies only one observable aspect of stealthiness, such as trigger imperceptibility, feature-space separability, parameter-space concentration, or evasion of particular defenses. This creates a fragmented picture: an attack may appear stealthy under one metric while leaving conspicuous footprints elsewhere. This paper presents a tri-space measurement study of backdoor stealthiness in image classification. We distinguish latent stealthiness---the ideal but unobservable difficulty of distinguishing a backdoored system from a benign one---from measurable footprints in three spaces: input, feature, and parameter space. Under this framework, we evaluate representative backdoor attacks across four datasets and three model architectures using a broad suite of footprint metrics. Our results show that stealthiness is not monolithic: attacks that are quiet in one space are often loud in another, and existing attacks rarely achieve consistently small footprints across all three spaces. We further analyze agreement and disagreement among stealthiness metrics and study how footprint measurements interact with attack success rate. Based on observed blind spots in existing measurements, we introduce two diagnostic metrics: Class-Specific Davies--Bouldin Index (CDBI), which captures class-conditional feature overlap, and TAC--UCLC Product (TUP), which identifies channels that are both trigger-responsive and downstream influential. These metrics are intended to augment, not replace, the broader measurement suite. Finally, we provide practical guidance for future stealthiness evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把后门隐蔽性拆成不可观测的 latent stealthiness 与输入、特征、参数三个空间的可测 footprint，在 4 个数据集、3 种模型架构上用成套指标评估代表性图像分类后门攻击。结论是隐蔽性并非单一维度：在某一个空间安静的攻击往往在另一个空间暴露，现有攻击几乎无法在三个空间同时保持小 footprint；据此新增 CDBI 与 TUP 两个诊断指标，用于补足现有度量的盲区。
Motivation: 后门隐蔽性长期只用攻击成功率和良性准确率衡量，定义与测量不一致；已有工作往往只看单一可观测面（触发器不可感知性、特征可分性、参数集中度或规避某类防御），导致一个攻击在某指标下隐蔽却在别处留下明显痕迹。
Method: 在图像分类上提出三空间测量框架，区分不可观测的 latent stealthiness 与输入、特征、参数三个空间的可测 footprint；对代表性后门攻击在 4 个数据集、3 种模型架构上运行成套 footprint 指标，并分析各隐蔽性指标之间的一致与分歧、以及 footprint 测量与攻击成功率的关系。基于观测到的度量盲区新增两个诊断指标：Class-Specific Davies–Bouldin Index (CDBI) 刻画类条件特征重叠，TAC–UCLC Product (TUP) 识别既对触发器响应又对下游有影响的通道，二者定位为补充而非替代现有度量套件。
Result: 在 4 个数据集、3 种模型架构上的评估显示隐蔽性不是单一体：在一个空间安静的攻击常在另一个空间高调，现有攻击很少在三个空间同时保持小 footprint；指标之间存在一致与不一致，并与攻击成功率呈现特定交互关系。
Conclusion: 后门隐蔽性必须按空间分别测量，单一指标会给出误导性结论；未来评估应使用包含 CDBI 与 TUP 在内的更广度量套件，而非依赖攻击成功率或单一隐蔽性指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Graph Energies for Finite-Time Generation
papers.abstract_en: Energy-based models can represent distributions over discrete structures such as molecular graphs, but an energy that is accurate at equilibrium need not yield accurate samples when the sampler stops after a fixed number of steps. We introduce finite-horizon energy learning, which adapts the acceptance energy of a Metropolis--Hastings sampler to the distribution it returns after a prescribed number of steps, with initialization, proposals, and annealing schedule held fixed. For graph generation, a frozen pretrained model supplies initialization and proposals, and a learned energy governs acceptance. A training-only discriminator scores completed samples, and coupled continuations of the accepted and rejected branches of a proposal give an acceptance-gradient estimator that is unbiased for a fixed discriminator under stated conditions, without equilibrated negative samples or differentiation through discrete states. Generation uses the learned energy in the original single-trajectory sampler, without discriminator evaluations or reranking. On twelve pairwise binary targets with exactly evaluated terminal laws, learned energies have lower median terminal total variation than the equilibrium-correct energy in every tested short-horizon setting, and than its numerically tuned scalar multiple in most settings. On MOSES, a learned two-coefficient combination of pretrained Graph Energy Matching (GEM) potentials lowers FCD by 3.7--10.5\% relative to scale-calibrated GEM at matched sampling steps, with validity gains at the shortest budget and a sub-point validity trade-off at higher budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出有限时域能量学习 (finite-horizon energy learning)：把 Metropolis–Hastings 的接受能量直接对齐到固定步数后实际返回的分布，而非平衡分布。在 12 个可精确计算终端分布的成对二值目标上，学到的能量在每个测试的短时域设置中终端 TV 中位数都低于平衡校正能量；在 MOSES 上相对尺度校准的 GEM 把 FCD 降低 3.7–10.5%。
Motivation: 能量在平衡态准确并不保证固定步数采样器输出的样本准确，短时域采样下接受准则与目标分布错位。
Method: 冻结的预训练模型提供初始化与提议，学习到的能量只管接受；训练期判别器对完成样本打分，对提议的接受/拒绝两支做耦合延拓得到接受梯度估计，在固定判别器下无偏，无需平衡负样本或对离散状态求导；生成时只用学到的能量跑原单轨迹采样器，不调用判别器也不做重排序。
Result: 在 12 个终端分布可精确计算的成对二值目标上，学到的能量在每个测试的短时域设置中终端总变差 (TV) 中位数低于平衡校正能量，在多数设置中也低于其数值调优的标量倍数。在 MOSES 上，学到的两系数预训练 Graph Energy Matching (GEM) 势组合在相同采样步数下相对尺度校准 GEM 降低 FCD 3.7–10.5%，最短预算下有效性 (validity) 提升，更高预算下有效性有不足 1 个点的取舍。
Conclusion: 接受能量应按有限步采样器的终端分布来学，而不是按平衡分布；这样生成阶段无需判别器或重排序即可改善样本质量。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Does Machine Translation Retain Media Bias?
papers.abstract_en: Within the most recent two decades, machine translation (MT) has been advanced from a research area to a mature, deployed technology for prose text and most language pairs. However, language has different dimensions of meaning, and the alluded progress has primarily been demonstrated for propositional meaning. In this small exploratory study, we investigate whether one type of affective meaning, namely different types of linguistically expressed media bias, are retained under automatic translation for two language pairs, English and German as the source languages, and Bulgarian as the target language. We evaluate four state-of-the-art translation methods to answer the question whether and to what degree a loss of non-neutral language (specifically, 27 types of media bias) can occur as a result of applying MT. Our empirical findings are consistent with the claim that MT does not fully retain existing news bias of its input source text, but also may add extra bias of its own. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first experimental study of MT media bias retention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一项小规模探索性研究，检验机器翻译是否会保留新闻文本中的媒体偏见：评测四种 SOTA 翻译方法，源语言为英语和德语、目标语言为保加利亚语，覆盖 27 类语言学表达的媒体偏见。实证结果与「MT 不能完全保留输入源文本已有的新闻偏见，同时可能额外加入自身偏见」这一论断一致。
Motivation: MT 过去二十年的进步主要在命题意义 (propositional meaning) 上得到验证，而情感意义 (affective meaning)——例如语言学表达的媒体偏见——在自动翻译中是否被保留，此前缺少实验研究。
Method: 小规模探索性研究：选取英语、德语为源语言，保加利亚语为目标语言的两个语言对，评测四种 SMT/神经 MT 中的 SOTA 翻译方法，考察 27 类媒体偏见在翻译前后的保留与丢失情况。
Result: 实证发现与「MT 不完全保留输入源文本的既有新闻偏见，且可能额外加入自身偏见」这一主张一致；研究覆盖 27 类媒体偏见、两个语言对（英→保、德→保）和四种 SOTA 翻译方法。
Conclusion: 按作者所述，这是首个关于 MT 媒体偏见保留的实验研究；其结论是 MT 既会丢失源文本中的非中性语言，也可能引入额外偏见。

papers.title: MorphingNet: Symbolic Regression Where the Network Is the Formula
papers.abstract_en: We introduce MorphingNet, a network for symbolic regression (SR) whose units change their function continuously. Instead of searching over expressions built from a fixed operator library, MorphingNet trains the form of each function as a parameter, so SR becomes one continuous optimization problem. Its units are either pole-free rational functions or complex exponential--logarithm functions, which move between exponentials, sinusoids, damped oscillations, power laws and logarithms as their parameters change. The network is a readable formula at every step of training, and no operator library is needed to train it; a structure-recovery step afterwards rewrites the trained formula into short elementary expressions. Training is dense linear algebra, so it is GPU-friendly and scales to large data. MorphingNet achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on SRBench, recovers most generating formulas on synthetic benchmarks, and on large data is up to two orders of magnitude faster than the strongest search method. By turning the search for a formula into the training of a network, MorphingNet offers a new paradigm for SR and for scientific discovery from data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MorphingNet 把符号回归 (symbolic regression) 改写成一次连续优化：网络单元的函数形式本身作为参数训练，可在指数、正弦、阻尼振荡、幂律与对数之间连续变形，训练全程网络就是可读公式，事后只需一步结构恢复改写成短初等表达式。在 SRBench 上达到 state-of-the-art 精度，合成基准上恢复出大部分生成公式，大数据上比最强搜索方法快最多两个数量级。
Motivation: 传统符号回归要在固定算子库上做离散表达式搜索，代价高、难扩展到大数据，且训练过程不可读。
Method: 单元采用无极点的有理函数或 complex exponential–logarithm 函数，函数形式作为参数训练，无需算子库；训练是稠密线性代数、GPU 友好，训练后接一个 structure-recovery 步骤把已训公式改写为短初等表达式。
Result: 在 SRBench 上达到 state-of-the-art 精度；在合成基准上恢复出大部分生成公式；在大数据上比最强搜索方法 (strongest search method) 快最多两个数量级 (up to two orders of magnitude)。
Conclusion: 把「搜索公式」变成「训练网络」可让符号回归成为单一连续优化问题，同时保住可读性并扩展到大规模数据。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Instruction Mining From Images: Constructing a Synthetic Dataset for Multimodal Learning ILSP DCVLR Competition Submission
papers.abstract_en: This work presents a compact and reproducible pipeline for synthesizing and curating image-based instruction-response pairs for DCVLR. We draw from the Cauldron collection and use Magpie-style instruction and response synthesis with Qwen2.5-VL-7B Instruct to create concise, image-conditioned instruction pairs. The pipeline consists of instruction synthesis, conditioned on input images and controlled via a system prompt, sanitization, tagging, and filtering of the instructions based on the score obtained by a reward model (DeBERTa-v3). We retain samples with positive scores to maximize the quality of the generated instructions. We observe that score distributions have a median and mean reward score of ~ 1.53 and ~ 1.75 respectively, indicating that most generated instructions are of good quality. The resulting dataset contains diverse instructions in the math, spatial, and social reasoning domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为 DCVLR 竞赛提交构建可复现的图像指令-响应对合成管线：以 Cauldron 图像集合为条件，用 Qwen2.5-VL-7B Instruct 做 Magpie 式指令与响应合成，再经清洗、打标签和奖励模型过滤。保留奖励分数为正的样本后，分数分布中位数约 1.53、均值约 1.75，产出覆盖数学、空间与社会推理的多模态指令数据集。
Motivation: 多模态指令微调需要高质量、图像条件化的指令-响应对，人工构造成本高且难以复现；DCVLR 竞赛需要一套紧凑、可复现的数据合成与筛选流程。
Method: 管线分四步：以输入图像为条件、由 system prompt 控制的指令合成（Magpie 式，模型为 Qwen2.5-VL-7B Instruct，数据源 Cauldron）、指令清洗 (sanitization)、打标签 (tagging)，以及基于奖励模型 DeBERTa-v3 打分的过滤，只保留正分样本以保证质量。
Result: 过滤后保留样本的奖励分数分布中位数约 1.53、均值约 1.75，作者据此判断多数生成指令质量良好；最终数据集覆盖数学、空间推理与社会推理三个领域的多样化指令。
Conclusion: 以奖励模型正分过滤为核心的合成管线可以在 Cauldron 图像上产出质量可控的多模态指令数据集，作为 DCVLR 的竞赛提交方案。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SAM3RL: Memory Control via Reinforcement Learning for Visual Object Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) is a foundation model for image and video segmentation that sets the state of the art in visual object tracking. Its tracker, inherited from SAM 2, stores information from past frames in a memory bank, managed by a simple First-In-First-Out rule, allowing temporal consistency in complex videos. Several recent methods improve SAM 2 with hand-crafted memory update rules, each targeting a specific failure mode, such as distractors, occlusions, or object motion. However, their gains transfer only partially to the stronger SAM 3 backbone. We instead present a more general, data-driven approach that frames memory control as a sequential decision-making task. SAM3RL is an extension of the SAM 3 tracker with a lightweight memory controller, trained by reinforcement learning, that decides which frames enter the memory bank in order to maximize tracking performance. SAM3RL sets a new state of the art on 10 of 12 tracking and video object segmentation benchmarks, outperforming all hand-crafted rules without any runtime overhead. The same approach applied to SAM 2 gives SAM2RL, which outperforms hand-crafted rules on 9 of the 12 benchmarks, showing the generality of our method across model generations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAM3RL 把 SAM 3 跟踪器的记忆库管理从固定 FIFO 规则改成由强化学习训练的轻量记忆控制器，决定哪些帧进入 memory bank 以最大化跟踪性能。在 12 个跟踪与视频目标分割基准中的 10 个上刷新 SOTA，且无额外运行时开销；同一方法用于 SAM 2 得到 SAM2RL，在 12 个基准中的 9 个上超过手工规则。
Motivation: SAM 2/3 的 memory bank 用简单 FIFO 管理，已有手工更新规则各自针对单一失效模式（干扰物、遮挡、运动），且这些收益只能部分迁移到更强的 SAM 3 backbone。
Method: 把记忆控制建模为序贯决策任务：在 SAM 3 跟踪器上加一个轻量记忆控制器，用 reinforcement learning 训练，逐帧决定哪些历史帧写入 memory bank；同一训练方案直接套用到 SAM 2 生成 SAM2RL。
Result: SAM3RL 在 12 个跟踪与视频目标分割基准中的 10 个上取得新 SOTA，超过全部手工记忆更新规则且无运行时开销；SAM2RL 在 12 个基准中的 9 个上优于手工规则。
Conclusion: 数据驱动的 RL 记忆控制可跨模型代际（SAM 2 与 SAM 3）泛化，取代针对单一失效模式的手工规则而不引入推理开销。

papers.title: Convergence Rates of Gaussian Process Thompson Sampling for Efficient Global Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Efficient global optimization aims to identify a global optimum of an expensive black-box function within a limited evaluation budget $N$. We investigate the convergence rates of Gaussian process Thompson sampling (GP-TS) under noiseless observations, assuming a fixed objective function in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). For Matérn kernels with smoothness parameter $ν$ in dimension $d$, we establish a worst-case expected simple-regret upper bound of $O(N^{-ν/d}\sqrt{\log N})$ for both discrete GP-TS on sufficiently fine grids and its continuous counterpart. For the continuous implementation, we develop a nested-grid argument to control posterior sample paths over the entire domain. We further establish matching lower bounds of $Ω(N^{-5/2}\sqrt{\log N})$ for both implementations under a fixed one-dimensional Matérn-$5/2$ kernel, demonstrating that the logarithmic penalty is intrinsic to standard GP-TS in this setting. Motivated by this limitation, we propose Gaussian Process Capped Thompson Sampling (GP-CTS), which caps posterior sample paths using a valid RKHS norm upper bound while preserving optimism. This modification successfully eliminates the logarithmic penalty and achieves the minimax-optimal rate $Θ(N^{-ν/d})$ for both discrete and continuous implementations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在无噪声、目标函数属于 RKHS 的设定下，标准 GP Thompson 采样 (GP-TS) 对 Matérn 核的最坏情形简单后悔上界为 O(N^{-ν/d}√log N)，且在固定一维 Matérn-5/2 核上存在匹配下界 Ω(N^{-5/2}√log N)，说明对数惩罚是固有的。作者据此提出 GP-CTS：用合法的 RKHS 范数上界截断后验样本路径并保留 optimism，从而去掉对数因子，离散与连续实现都达到 minimax 最优速率 Θ(N^{-ν/d})。
Motivation: GP-TS 在 RKHS 目标上的收敛率带有一个 √log N 惩罚，且该惩罚被下界证明为标准 GP-TS 固有，无法通过调参消除，效率受限于有限评估预算 N。
Method: 对离散（足够细网格）与连续两种 GP-TS 实现分别推导最坏情形期望简单后悔界；连续版本用 nested-grid 论证控制全域后验样本路径。随后提出 GP-Capped Thompson Sampling (GP-CTS)，以合法 RKHS 范数上界截断后验样本路径并保持 optimism。
Result: Matérn 核（光滑度 ν、维度 d）下 GP-TS 上界 O(N^{-ν/d}√log N)（离散与连续均成立）；固定一维 Matérn-5/2 核下两者下界 Ω(N^{-5/2}√log N)；GP-CTS 达到 Θ(N^{-ν/d})，离散与连续实现均消除对数惩罚。
Conclusion: GP-TS 的 √log N 惩罚在该设定下是固有的，而用 RKHS 范数上界做带 optimism 的截断即可恢复 minimax 最优收敛速率。

papers.title: MolHop: Scaffold-Hopping Molecular Design with Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Molecular design is often formulated as an optimization problem over existing molecular spaces. However, molecular optimization and the discovery of structurally distinct replacement molecules represent two fundamentally different search problems. LLM-based molecular design agents typically perform the former, conducting local refinement within the neighborhood of existing structures to improve target properties through structural modifications. In contrast, the latter requires exploration of a broader chemical space to discover molecules with entirely different scaffolds while preserving the functional characteristics of reference molecules. We propose MolHop, an agentic framework for cross-scaffold molecular discovery that enables models to navigate and edit within a pre-organized chemical space. MolHop organizes approximately 1.6 million molecular scaffolds from commercial molecules into a coarse-to-fine hierarchical action space. The agent selects new exploration regions through scaffold navigation actions and adjusts candidate properties through molecular editing. The framework maintains historical trajectory memory to support long-horizon search processes. On drug molecule and commercial compound tasks, connecting Grok-4.6 and DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1 to the MolHop framework substantially improves their cross-scaffold joint success rates. We develop MolHop-9B through agentic reinforcement learning, and MolHop-9B outperforms generative baselines including GPT-5.6-sol, Claude-5-Opus, and Gemini-3.1-Pro, while generating candidate molecules with larger scaffold differences from the reference molecules. These results demonstrate that effective molecular discovery beyond the traditional optimization paradigm requires structured chemical and action spaces, enabling agents to explore new structural regions rather than merely refine existing molecules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MolHop 把约 160 万个商品分子骨架组织成由粗到细的分层动作空间，让 agent 用骨架导航动作切换探索区域、用分子编辑调性质，并以历史轨迹记忆支撑长程搜索。接入 Grok-4.6 与 DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1 后跨骨架联合成功率显著提升；其 agentic 强化学习训练的 MolHop-9B 在药物分子与商品化合物任务上超过 GPT-5.6-sol、Claude-5-Opus、Gemini-3.1-Pro 等生成式基线，且生成候选与参考分子的骨架差异更大。
Motivation: 分子优化是在已有结构邻域做局部精修，而骨架跃迁 (scaffold hopping) 要求在更广化学空间找到骨架完全不同、功能保持的替代分子；LLM 分子设计 agent 通常只做前者，缺少可导航的结构化化学与动作空间。
Method: MolHop 是跨骨架分子发现的 agentic 框架：把约 160 万个商品分子骨架组织成由粗到细的分层动作空间，agent 通过骨架导航动作选择新探索区域、通过分子编辑调整候选性质，并维护历史轨迹记忆以支持长程搜索；在此框架上用 agentic reinforcement learning 训练 MolHop-9B。
Result: 在药物分子与商品化合物任务上，将 Grok-4.6 和 DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1 接入 MolHop 后跨骨架联合成功率 (cross-scaffold joint success rates) 大幅提升；MolHop-9B 超过 GPT-5.6-sol、Claude-5-Opus、Gemini-3.1-Pro 等生成式基线，且生成候选与参考分子的骨架差异更大。
Conclusion: 超越传统优化范式的有效分子发现需要结构化的化学空间与动作空间，使 agent 能探索新的结构区域而非只在已有分子上精修。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond DFT electronic band structures via dual-space orbital learning
papers.abstract_en: Accurate electronic band structures are essential for predicting material properties, but high-fidelity calculations are computationally demanding. We introduce O-kRystal, a dual-space orbital-learning framework that uses a lower-cost Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) calculation as both an energy baseline and a source of structured orbital information. Combining PBE band energies with real- and reciprocal-space orbital matrices, O-kRystal predicts higher-level corrections for individual electronic states as a function of crystal momentum and spin. For states within 5 eV of the band-edge midpoint, it predicts Heyd-Scuseria-Ernzerhof (HSE06) band energies with a mean absolute error of $0.171 \pm 0.009$ eV across nearly 6,000 three-dimensional materials spanning insulating, metallic, magnetic, and nonmagnetic systems. On a separate benchmark of six strongly correlated materials, it reduces the corresponding PBE band-energy MAE by 68.7% and resolves orbital-dependent changes in the relative placement of transition-metal d and ligand p states. Despite training only at high-symmetry points, it maintains comparable accuracy at unseen points along band paths and reconstructs HSE06 densities of states from dense Brillouin-zone predictions. Finally, training O-kRystal on $G_0W_0$ quasiparticle energies for two-dimensional materials demonstrates its applicability across levels of theory and the potential of orbital learning for higher-fidelity, momentum-resolved electronic-structure prediction beyond density functional theory.
papers.comment: 46 pages, 10 figures (including 4 supplementary figures); Supplementary Information included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: O-kRystal 用低成本 PBE 计算同时提供能量基线与实空间/倒空间轨道矩阵，按晶体动量与自旋逐态预测高阶方法的能带修正。在带边中点 5 eV 以内的态上，对近 6,000 个三维材料的 HSE06 能带能量 MAE 为 0.171 ± 0.009 eV；六个强关联材料上把 PBE 能带 MAE 降低 68.7%。
Motivation: 高保真能带计算（HSE06、G0W0）计算量过大，无法覆盖材料筛选所需的规模，而 PBE 精度不足以描述强关联体系的 d/p 态相对位置。
Method: 以 PBE 能带能量为基线，输入实空间与倒空间轨道矩阵，学习逐电子态、随晶体动量与自旋变化的高阶修正；训练只用高对称点，再外推到能带路径上未见 k 点并重建 HSE06 态密度，另在二维材料上以 G0W0 准粒子能量训练。
Result: 带边中点 5 eV 内的态，HSE06 能带能量 MAE 0.171 ± 0.009 eV，覆盖近 6,000 个三维材料（绝缘、金属、磁性、非磁性）；六个强关联材料基准上 PBE 能带能量 MAE 相应降低 68.7%，并分辨过渡金属 d 与配体 p 态相对位置的轨道依赖变化；仅在高对称点训练仍保持未见点上的相当精度。
Conclusion: 轨道学习能把 PBE 提升到 HSE06 乃至 G0W0 级别的动量分辨电子结构预测，跨材料类型与理论层级适用，且不必在全布里渊区采样训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MUCO: A Mani-Unit-Structured Manipulation Framework for Compositional Long-Horizon Robot Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Learning and executing long-horizon robot manipulation as complete task trajectories raises data-collection costs, lim?its capability reuse, and causes local failures to cascade into later task stages. We introduce manipulation units (MUs) as reusable operations, each defined by a local goal, an initi?ation condition, and observable success and failure criteria. MUs are learned and verified individually. During execution, consecutive MUs remain coupled through shared environ?ment dynamics. We formulate MU-Structured Manipulation (MUSM) and realize it through MU-Centric Orchestration (MUCO). Given language and vision, MUCO constructs an MU sequence, matches each MU to compatible policy models in a frozen capability registry, and dispatches the model with the highest calibrated success rate. Visual verification checks MU outcomes against success and failure criteria and governs transitions, enabling retry or fallback to another model from the current state without re-executing verified MUs. Canonical keys enable checkpoint reuse for equivalent MUs across tasks without new demonstrations or updates. We evaluate MUCO on RLBench, RoboTwin 2.0, and five real-world tasks. MUCO achieves higher complete-task success and verified progress, stronger failure containment, and lower error propagation than baselines. Results demonstrate cross-task MU reuse and het?erogeneous policy composition without joint training, shared backbones, or common action representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MUCO 把长程机器人操作拆成可复用的 manipulation units（MU），每个 MU 带局部目标、启动条件与可观测成败判据，单独学习与验证；执行时由校准成功率最高的策略模型调度，并用视觉验证决定重试或回退，已验证的 MU 不必重跑。在 RLBench、RoboTwin 2.0 与五个真实任务上，它取得更高的整任务成功率与验证进度、更强的失败遏制和更低的误差传播，且跨任务复用 MU 无需联合训练。
Motivation: 把长程操作当作完整轨迹学习会推高数据采集成本、限制能力复用，且局部失败会级联污染后续阶段。
Method: MUSM/MUCO：由语言与视觉构造 MU 序列，在冻结能力注册表 (capability registry) 中为每个 MU 匹配兼容策略模型并派发校准成功率最高者；视觉验证对照成败判据决定转移，允许从当前状态重试或回退到其他模型；canonical keys 让等价 MU 跨任务复用检查点，无需新演示或更新。
Result: 在 RLBench、RoboTwin 2.0 和五个真实任务上评测，MUCO 相对基线取得更高的整任务成功率与 verified progress、更强的 failure containment、更低的 error propagation；跨任务 MU 复用与异构策略组合在无联合训练、无共享 backbone、无统一动作表示的条件下成立。
Conclusion: 以带可验证判据的 MU 为组合单元并按校准成功率调度，可在不联合训练的前提下实现异构策略拼装与跨任务复用，同时把局部失败限制在当前阶段。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Quantifying Annotation Agreement in Object Detection with Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Reliable validation of machine learning models is a crucial step in designing robust and trustworthy systems. Yet validation relies on annotated test sets treated as ground truth, even though annotations can be noisy or ambiguous. In object detection, sources may disagree on object presence, box location, or class label. Standard agreement metrics usually binarize box overlap before computing a summary score, obscuring the degree and structure of disagreement between annotation sets. Here, we study an Optimal Transport (OT)-based metric for measuring agreement between object detection annotations. Instead of binarizing bounding box overlap, this metric assigns graded costs to matched and unmatched labeled boxes. Through theoretical analysis and experiments on real and synthetically perturbed annotations, we show that OT captures graded changes in agreement and distinguishes annotation pairs that thresholded metrics score identically. Our results suggest that OT provides a richer measure of annotation agreement in object detection, especially for domains with many small or ambiguous objects. Such agreement estimates can support more reliable validation when labels are noisy or conflicting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于最优传输 (Optimal Transport, OT) 的目标检测标注一致性度量：对匹配与未匹配的标注框赋予分级代价，而非先把框重叠二值化。理论分析加真实与合成扰动标注实验表明，OT 能捕捉一致性的分级变化，并区分被阈值型指标判为相同的标注对。
Motivation: 目标检测的验证依赖当作 ground truth 的标注测试集，但标注可能含噪或有歧义；标准一致性指标先把框重叠二值化再汇总，掩盖了不一致的程度与结构。
Method: 用 Optimal Transport 度量两套目标检测标注的一致性，对匹配与未匹配的标注框赋分级代价，替代阈值化框重叠；结合理论分析与真实标注、合成扰动标注上的实验。
Result: OT 度量能捕捉一致性的分级变化，并区分被阈值化指标打成相同分数的标注对；在真实与合成扰动标注上均得到验证。
Conclusion: OT 提供了更丰富的目标检测标注一致性度量，尤其适用于含大量小目标或歧义目标的领域，可支撑标签噪声或冲突下的更可靠验证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CARD: Closing the Teacher-Student Loop for Adversarial Robustness Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial robustness distillation typically treats a robust teacher as a fixed knowledge source and transfers robustness to a compact student in a one-way manner. This paradigm terminates teacher-student interaction once the student is distilled, thereby discarding potentially useful feedback from the distilled student. However, exploiting such feedback is nontrivial because indiscriminate weak-to-strong transfer may propagate student errors to the teacher. To address this issue, we propose Cyclic Adversarial Robustness Distillation (CARD), a closed-loop framework that turns the distilled student into a feedback source for refining the robust teacher and subsequently transfers the teacher gains back to the same student. CARD first performs strong-to-weak adversarial distillation and then uses reliability-enhanced student feedback to refine the robust teacher. The refinement combines inverse adversarial student feedback with teacher-student discrepancy maximization, after which the refined teacher is used to continue training the same student under the unchanged base distillation objective. We further establish a sample-level sufficient condition for reliable weak-to-strong feedback transfer and derive a distribution-level upper bound on the refined teacher's risk. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and TinyImageNet-10 across multiple teacher-student architectures and base distillation methods show that CARD improves adversarial robustness in most evaluated settings while generally preserving clean accuracy. These results show that the distilled student can provide useful feedback to the teacher, enabling robustness transfer to proceed beyond the conventional one-way teacher-to-student paradigm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CARD 把对抗鲁棒性蒸馏从单向的强到弱改成闭环：先做常规强到弱蒸馏，再用可靠性增强的学生反馈（逆对抗学生反馈 + 师生差异最大化）精炼鲁棒教师，然后用同一蒸馏目标继续训练该学生。在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 与 TinyImageNet-10 的多种师生架构和基础蒸馏方法上，多数设置下对抗鲁棒性提升且干净精度基本保持。
Motivation: 现有对抗鲁棒性蒸馏把鲁棒教师当固定知识源，学生蒸馏完交互即终止，丢弃了学生可能提供的反馈；但无约束的弱到强迁移会把学生错误传给教师。
Method: CARD 先执行 strong-to-weak 对抗蒸馏，再用可靠性增强的学生反馈精炼鲁棒教师，精炼由 inverse adversarial student feedback 与 teacher-student discrepancy maximization 组成，之后用不变的基础蒸馏目标继续训练同一学生；另给出样本级可靠弱到强反馈迁移的充分条件与精炼教师风险的分布级上界。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet-10 上，跨多种师生架构与基础蒸馏方法，CARD 在多数被评估设置中提升对抗鲁棒性，同时通常保持干净精度。
Conclusion: 蒸馏后的学生确实能作为反馈源改进鲁棒教师，使鲁棒性迁移突破传统的单向教师到学生范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Non-Adversarial Noise Hurts Learning: Benchmarking Skill Self-Evolution in Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly improve by distilling experience into reusable skills, but errors in that experience can persist in learned rules and affect later tasks. Existing evaluations largely examine clean learning or perturbations encountered after skills are frozen, leaving robustness during self-evolution insufficiently understood. We introduce RSE-Bench, to our knowledge the first benchmark for evaluating skill self-evolution under ordinary, non-adversarial noise. It spans four domains and six benchmarks, with controlled perturbations to instructions, environmental evidence, execution records, and outcome--record pairings that preserve the underlying tasks and native scoring rules. The protocol separates noise during learning from input-side noise at evaluation, testing frozen skill stores on held-out tasks. We also introduce \textsc{RSEClaw}, a method-agnostic framework supporting consistent noise injection and process diagnostics of actual exposure and skill updates. Across three methods and two backbones, noisy learning retains only $25.5\%$--$42.1\%$ of the aggregate gain achieved by clean self-evolution, depending on the noise type. Perturbations confined to execution records and outcome--record pairings cause average losses comparable to input-side noise, despite leaving the original executions and evaluations intact. Diagnostics further identify differences in candidate skill text that coexist with small changes in mean held-out performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 RSE-Bench，首个评测 LLM agent 在普通非对抗噪声下技能自进化 (skill self-evolution) 的基准，覆盖 4 个领域、6 个 benchmark，对指令、环境证据、执行记录、结果-记录配对注入受控扰动。在 3 种方法、2 个 backbone 上，带噪学习只保留干净自进化总增益的 25.5%–42.1%；仅污染执行记录或结果-记录配对造成的平均损失已与输入侧噪声相当。
Motivation: 现有评测只考察干净学习或技能冻结之后才遇到的扰动，agent 在自进化过程中（技能尚未固化时）对噪声的鲁棒性缺乏系统度量。
Method: RSE-Bench 在 4 领域 6 benchmark 上对指令、环境证据、执行记录、结果-记录配对注入受控扰动，保持原任务与原生评分规则不变；协议把学习期噪声与评测期输入侧噪声分离，在 held-out 任务上测试冻结的技能库。配套 RSEClaw 是方法无关的框架，统一注入噪声并诊断实际暴露与技能更新过程。
Result: 跨 3 种方法与 2 个 backbone，带噪学习仅保留干净自进化聚合增益的 25.5%–42.1%，具体比例取决于噪声类型。仅限执行记录与结果-记录配对的扰动造成与输入侧噪声相当的平均损失，尽管原始执行与评测本身未被改动。诊断显示候选技能文本存在差异，而 held-out 平均性能变化很小。
Conclusion: 非对抗噪声在学习期就会大幅侵蚀 agent 技能自进化的收益，且只污染执行/结果记录这类看似不改动任务的环节同样有害；技能文本差异与小幅平均性能变化可以并存，需用过程诊断而非仅看最终分数。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Sparse Transformer: a Controlled Testbed for Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability aims to decompose neural network computations into human-understandable features, yet progress is limited by the absence of ground-truth units to evaluate against. We address this with a Sparse Transformer (ST): a 5-layer language model trained on TinyStories whose wide, TopK-sparse MLP forces neuron specialization. We show that ST neurons are highly interpretable: they outperform a loss-matched dense transformer by 43% on AutoInterp, and circuits of a median of 12 neurons suffice to reproduce individual model predictions. This testbed allows us to directly compare feature learning methods: Transcoder, which approximates the MLP input-output mapping, recovers ST's neuron vectors with 52.6% higher cosine similarity than Sparse Autoencoder, which only reconstructs outputs. Furthermore, the ST enables a controlled study of polysemanticity: distilling its sparse MLP into a dense counterpart reveals how compression leads to feature superposition. These results show how a known reference basis sharpens evaluation and understanding, a role we hope the ST can serve for the field.
