papers.title: Multimodal Medical Image Parsing with Task-Specific Low-Rank Adapters
papers.abstract_en: Adapting a single vision-language model to medical image parsing requires training choices that reflect the demands of each task. We study task-specific adaptation with Qwen3.5-9B for FLARE 2026 Task 3, covering six task families and seven imaging modalities. Our system couples a shared, frozen 4-bit backbone with LoRA adapters selected from the input question. We customize adapter ranks and prompts, rebalance rare classification targets, and supplement regression training with dermatology classification examples. On the fixed internal holdout, the task-specific adapters achieve a dataset-macro balanced accuracy of 0.7791 for classification, a dataset-macro micro-F1 of 0.6286 for multi-label classification, a counting mean absolute error (MAE) of 11.73, a dataset-macro detection F1 of 0.8914, a dataset-macro regression MAE of 9.78, and a report-generation CRIMSON score of 0.8204. On the organizer's 1,703-example hidden-validation set, the submitted system achieves 0.8496 classification balanced accuracy, 0.5338 sample-averaged multi-label F1, and 14.5950 regression MAE. The final 30.1 GB container averages 3.1 seconds per case, including model loading, and produces identical outputs across repeated verification runs. The benefits vary across tasks, supporting the use of task-specific adapter configurations and image budgets within a shared medical vision-language model. Code is available at https://github.com/TahaSabir0/FLARE26-Hexapus.

TL;DR: 针对 FLARE 2026 Task 3（2D track）的多模态医学图像解析，用冻结的 4-bit Qwen3.5-9B 主干加按输入问题选择的 LoRA 适配器，按任务定制 rank 与 prompt、重平衡稀有类别，并用皮肤科分类样本补充回归训练。固定内部 holdout 上分类 dataset-macro balanced accuracy 0.7791、多标签 micro-F1 0.6286、检测 F1 0.8914、报告生成 CRIMSON 0.8204；1,703 例隐藏验证集上分类 balanced accuracy 0.8496、回归 MAE 14.5950。

Method: 冻结 4-bit Qwen3.5-9B 主干，按输入问题动态选择 LoRA adapter；定制各任务的 adapter rank 与 prompt，重平衡稀有分类目标，并以 dermatology 分类样本补充回归训练；以 30.1 GB 容器提交。

papers.title: How GUI Agents Fail: GraceBench for Execution Stability Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: As GUI agents are increasingly deployed for mobile task automation, their reliability depends not only on final task outcomes, but also on whether they reach these outcomes through stable interaction trajectories. In automation workflows, unnecessary actions, detours, and execution errors can add noise to collected data, introduce irreversible side effects, or undermine trust, even when the agent eventually completes the task. It is therefore important to systematically diagnose the execution stability, including whether an agent deviates from a feasible path, enters a loop, becomes stagnant, or recovers from unstable actions. Existing benchmarks, however, primarily assess final task success or a small set of intermediate milestones, leaving step-level execution behavior unclear. To bridge this gap, we introduce GraceBench, an online evaluation framework that represents the reachable interaction space of mobile applications as UI Transition Graphs (UTGs), providing a structural reference for step-level execution diagnosis. To support reliable alignment between dynamic UI observations and graph states, GraceBench uses video-grounded trajectory evaluation over this graph-aligned representation, assessing process stability beyond final success with metrics such as deviation rate, loop burden rate, and recovery ability. GraceBench contains 169 tasks spanning 10 applications and constructs 10 UTGs with 2,909 canonical GUI states and 3,116 observed transitions. Across 3,718 trajectories, GraceBench shows that outcome scores hide execution instability: GPT-5.6 Sol achieves the highest success rate (SR) but the lowest recovery ability, 51.24% of successful runs still contain a deviation or loop, and trajectories with the same success rate (SR) and completion rate (CR) can differ substantially in recovery behavior. Code and data will be released on https://iaie-physicalai.github.io/GraceBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GraceBench 把移动 App 的可达交互空间建成 UI Transition Graph (UTG)，用图对齐的视频轨迹评估在步级诊断 GUI agent 的执行稳定性。在 3,718 条轨迹上，最终成功分数掩盖了执行不稳定：GPT-5.6 Sol 成功率最高但恢复能力最低，51.24% 的成功运行仍含偏离或循环。
Motivation: 现有 GUI agent 基准只看最终任务成功或少量中间里程碑，步级执行行为（偏离可行路径、陷入循环、停滞、从不稳定动作中恢复）无从诊断，而不必要动作与执行错误会给自动化数据带来噪声和不可逆副作用。
Method: GraceBench 是在线评估框架：把 10 个移动应用的可达交互空间表示为 10 个 UI Transition Graph，作为步级诊断的结构参照；用 video-grounded trajectory evaluation 在图对齐表示上对齐动态 UI 观测与图状态，输出 deviation rate、loop burden rate、recovery ability 等过程稳定性指标。
Result: 包含 169 个任务、10 个应用、10 个 UTG（2,909 个 canonical GUI 状态、3,116 条 observed transitions），共 3,718 条轨迹。GPT-5.6 Sol 成功率 (SR) 最高但 recovery ability 最低；51.24% 的成功运行仍含偏离或循环；SR 与完成率 (CR) 相同的轨迹在恢复行为上差异显著。
Conclusion: 最终成功分数会掩盖执行不稳定，GUI agent 的可靠性必须用步级过程稳定性指标（偏离、循环、恢复）与结果分数一起衡量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Universal Sample-Based Embeddings of Higher-Order Objects
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks operate naturally on finite-dimensional vectors, yet many problems require reasoning about higher-order objects such as distributions, functions, and graphs. Such objects capture relationships within a ground set and rarely admit an explicit compact representation. Moreover, we typically want a compact representation not of a single higher-order object but of an entire family of such objects, including members unseen during training. While a few approaches exist for particular object types, none is designed to work across object types. We propose a unified framework that represents any higher-order object as a fixed-size embedding vector learned over a family of such objects. An encoder maps an object, seen only through a finite set of samples, to an embedding, and a domain-specific decoder supplies the training signal by modeling the object conditioned on that embedding. Since the encoder works only from samples, one architecture serves different object types. Because the decoder is a model already suited to single instances of the object type, the framework inherits that model's native operations and inductive biases. We instantiate the framework on distributions, functions, and graphs. In each case we show that a single trained model represents an entire family and generalizes to members unseen during training. Furthermore, we demonstrate the downstream utility of these embeddings: interpolating distributions in embedding space, solving differential equations in embedding space, and predicting unseen edges from a graph's embedding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出统一的样本式高阶对象嵌入框架：编码器只看对象的有限样本就输出定长向量，域特定解码器以该嵌入为条件建模单个对象并提供训练信号。同一架构在分布、函数、图三类对象上各训练一次即可表示整个对象族并泛化到训练中未见的成员，嵌入空间可直接插值分布、求解微分方程、预测图中未见边。
Motivation: 分布、函数、图这类高阶对象通常没有显式紧凑表示，而现有方法只针对特定对象类型，缺少一个跨对象类型、还能表示训练中未见成员的统一表示框架。
Method: 编码器从对象的有限样本集合映射到定长嵌入向量，域特定解码器建模以该嵌入为条件的单个对象并提供训练信号；解码器沿用该对象类型已有模型的原生运算与归纳偏置，因此只依赖样本的同一编码器架构可服务不同对象类型。框架在分布、函数、图三类对象上分别实例化。
Result: 在分布、函数、图三类实例上，单个训练好的模型即可表示整个对象族并泛化到训练中未见的成员；下游演示包括在嵌入空间中插值分布、在嵌入空间中求解微分方程，以及从图的嵌入预测未见边。
Conclusion: 只要解码器是适配单实例的既有模型，样本式编码加条件解码就能构成跨对象类型的通用高阶对象表示，且学到的嵌入空间可直接承载插值、求解与链接预测等运算。

papers.title: DeepPV-MRF: End-to-End Partial-Volume Fraction Estimation from MR Fingerprinting Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Background: Estimating subvoxel tissue fractions from magnetic resonance fingerprinting (MRF) is challenging. Conventional dictionary matching and segmentation pipelines can propagate errors from intermediate parametric maps into tissue fraction estimates. Purpose: We introduce DeepPV-MRF, a deep learning framework that directly estimates voxel-wise tissue fractions from raw MRF signals. Methods: A cascaded spatial-temporal network was trained on subject-derived Bloch simulations with radial k-space undersampling. The network combines temporal encoding and spatial U-Net refinement to estimate cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), gray matter (GM), and white matter (WM) fractions without intermediate T1/T2 maps. We compared DeepPV-MRF with partial-volume dictionary matching (PV-DM) and pseudoinverse estimation (PV-Pinv) using simulated and in vivo data. Results: DeepPV-MRF outperformed both methods across acquisition settings. In single-shot simulations, CSF/WM/GM mean absolute errors were 0.0418/0.0744/0.0757, versus 0.1281/0.2443/0.2958 for PV-DM and 0.2021/0.2793/0.2630 for PV-Pinv. Corresponding structural similarity values were 0.960/0.916/0.922. In vivo results showed sharper anatomical boundaries and smoother tissue transitions, while cross-shot analysis indicated improved consistency across volunteers. Conclusions: DeepPV-MRF enables accurate and efficient direct tissue fraction estimation from MRF signals, particularly with limited shots. Further validation is needed before clinical deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeepPV-MRF 用级联时空网络直接从原始 MRF 信号估计体素级 CSF/GM/WM 组织分数，绕过中间 T1/T2 图。单次采集仿真中 CSF/WM/GM 的 MAE 为 0.0418/0.0744/0.0757，显著低于 PV-DM 的 0.1281/0.2443/0.2958 与 PV-Pinv 的 0.2021/0.2793/0.2630，且在 shot 受限时优势最明显。
Motivation: 字典匹配与分割流水线会把中间参数图 (T1/T2) 的误差传递进组织分数估计，而 MRF 亚体素组织分数本身难以准确求解。
Method: 在受试者个体化 Bloch 仿真（含 radial k-space 欠采样）上训练级联时空网络：时间编码 + 空间 U-Net 精修，直接输出 CSF/GM/WM 体素分数，不经过 T1/T2 中间图；与 partial-volume dictionary matching (PV-DM) 和 pseudoinverse estimation (PV-Pinv) 在仿真与 in vivo 数据上对比。
Result: 单次采集仿真 MAE：CSF/WM/GM 为 0.0418/0.0744/0.0757，PV-DM 为 0.1281/0.2443/0.2958，PV-Pinv 为 0.2021/0.2793/0.2630；对应 SSIM 为 0.960/0.916/0.922。in vivo 上解剖边界更锐利、组织过渡更平滑，跨 shot 分析显示跨志愿者一致性提升。
Conclusion: 直接从 MRF 信号回归组织分数可避免中间参数图误差传播，在 shot 受限的采集设置下精度最高；临床部署前仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Few-Shot Adaptation for Anomalous Sound Detection at Low False-Positive Rate
papers.abstract_en: Reliable fault detection is crucial for industrial machinery in large-scale facilities, where unexpected failures can cause costly downtime and production interruptions. Although acoustic monitoring provides a scalable solution for machine condition monitoring, its deployment is often constrained by high false-positive rates. We propose a two-step approach to automatic anomalous sound detection: first, when only normal operating audio samples are available, a regularized unsupervised model is deployed; then, after the first machine fault, a few-shot adaptation strategy exploits the anomalous samples acquired during the fault to improve the system. This adaptation increases the area under the precision-recall curve (AUPR) from 23.0 to 64.0 and improves detection in the low false-positive-rate region, with the partial area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (pAUROC) increasing from 39.6 to 72.8. We also show that covariance regularization improves both prediction accuracy and training stability in the unsupervised model. These results provide a practical strategy for acoustic anomaly detection systems, enabling improved accuracy and reduced false alarms.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 工业机械异常声音检测的两步方案：先在只有正常音频时部署带正则的无监督模型，首次故障后用故障期间采集的少量异常样本做 few-shot 适配。AUPR 从 23.0 升到 64.0，低误报率区间的 pAUROC 从 39.6 升到 72.8；协方差正则同时提升无监督模型的预测精度与训练稳定性。
Motivation: 声学监测可扩展到大规模设施的机器状态监控，但高误报率限制部署；现场通常只有正常样本，直到第一次故障才拿到少量异常音频。
Method: 两步法：第一步在仅有正常运行音频时部署带正则的无监督异常声音模型；第二步在首次故障后，用故障期间采集的异常样本做 few-shot 适配策略，并对无监督模型加入协方差正则 (covariance regularization)。
Result: few-shot 适配使 AUPR 从 23.0 提升到 64.0，低误报率区间的 pAUROC 从 39.6 提升到 72.8；协方差正则同时改善无监督模型的预测精度与训练稳定性。
Conclusion: 先无监督后用首次故障的少量异常样本适配，是声学异常检测在低误报率下提升精度、减少误报的可行部署策略。

papers.title: On the Limits of Representation-Based Test-Time Adaptation for Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models suffer significant accuracy drops under common corruptions. While test-time adaptation (TTA) successfully mitigates these shifts in CLIP-like contrastive models, its application to generative multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains underexplored and uniquely challenging due to their sequential token generation. In this work, we demonstrate that representation-based TTA fails to recover performance in MLLMs. Our experiments reveal that even when violating standard TTA assumptions by leveraging target data offline, sample-blind feature alignment recovers only marginal accuracy. We attribute this failure to the nature of corruption shifts: unlike CLIP-like architectures, which benefit from a shared domain-shift direction within a single pooled classification embedding, MLLM visual token sequence shifts are nearly orthogonal and span the full embedding space.These findings bound what any sample-blind, position-shared correction at a single encoder site can achieve, establishing that representation-space interventions alone might be insufficient to ensure corruption robustness in MLLMs.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Grounded and Faithful Vision-Language Models for Real-World Deployment (VLM4RWD) workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在生成式多模态 LLM 上，基于表征的测试时自适应 (representation-based TTA) 无法恢复被常见图像损坏拉低的准确率：即使违反标准 TTA 假设、离线利用目标域数据，sample-blind 的特征对齐也只带来边际提升。原因是损坏引起的视觉 token 序列偏移近乎正交并铺满整个嵌入空间，不像 CLIP 那样共享单一域偏移方向。
Motivation: TTA 在 CLIP 类对比模型上能有效缓解分布偏移，但生成式 MLLM 的序贯 token 生成使其难以迁移，且损坏鲁棒性在该架构上缺少有效手段。
Method: 在 MLLM 上检验基于表征的 TTA，包括放宽标准假设、离线使用目标数据的 sample-blind 特征对齐，并从视觉 token 序列偏移的几何结构（方向一致性、占据的嵌入空间维度）解释成败。
Result: 实验显示基于表征的 TTA 无法恢复 MLLM 性能；即便离线利用目标数据，sample-blind 特征对齐也只恢复边际准确率。归因是 MLLM 视觉 token 序列偏移近乎正交、铺满嵌入空间，而 CLIP 类架构受益于单一池化分类嵌入内的共享域偏移方向。
Conclusion: 任何在单一编码器位置做 sample-blind、位置共享修正的方法都有性能上限，仅靠表征空间干预不足以保证 MLLM 的损坏鲁棒性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Frustratingly Easy Majority Voting Using Length Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Majority Voting (MV) is a simple and widely used strategy which improves the reasoning accuracy of Large Language Models (LLMs) by allocating additional inference-time computation. Specifically, in MV multiple Chain-of-Thoughts (CoTs) are independently sampled and the most frequent final answer is selected. In this work, we propose Length-Conditioned Majority Voting (LCMV), a Test-Time Training approach which improves MV leveraging an empirical observation that has recently been established in several studies: longer CoTs tend to be associated with a lower probability of correctness. We formulate this inductive bias as a length-conditioned prior probability, which is modeled by a simple logistic function. Moreover, we adapt this prior at test time using only unlabeled testing data and without fine-tuning the LLM. Finally, the adapted prior is used to weight the vote of each sampled answer. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and reasoning benchmarks show that LCMV consistently improves over both standard MV and existing length-based and confidence-based aggregation strategies, while retaining the simplicity and model-agnostic nature of MV. Our code is available at: https://github.com/aimagelab/LCMV.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出长度条件化多数投票 (LCMV)：把「CoT 越长越可能答错」这一经验偏置写成长度条件先验概率，用简单 logistic 函数建模，仅用无标签测试数据在测试时适配该先验，再用它给每条采样答案的投票加权。在多个 LLM 与推理基准上，LCMV 一致优于标准 MV 以及已有的基于长度和基于置信度的聚合策略，同时保留 MV 的简单性与模型无关性。
Motivation: 多数投票 (MV) 靠多采样 CoT 提升 LLM 推理准确率，但把所有最终答案等权计票，忽略了近期研究确立的归纳偏置：更长的 CoT 往往对应更低的正确概率。
Method: LCMV 是一种 Test-Time Training 方法：把长度与正确概率的关系形式化为长度条件先验概率，用 logistic 函数建模；在测试时仅用无标签测试数据适配该先验，不微调 LLM；再用适配后的先验对每条采样答案的投票加权，最后按加权票数选答案。
Result: 在多个 LLM 与推理基准上的实验中，LCMV 一致优于标准 MV 以及已有的基于长度和基于置信度的聚合策略，同时保持 MV 的简单性和模型无关性；代码发布于 github.com/aimagelab/LCMV。
Conclusion: 把长度这一廉价信号做成测试时适配的加权先验，就能在不微调模型的前提下稳定提升多数投票的推理准确率，且不牺牲 MV 的模型无关与实现简单。

papers.title: Maximum likelihood, neural networks and posterior mean for inferring fractional Brownian motion parameters
papers.abstract_en: Fractional Brownian motion (fBM) is a model of anomalous diffusion parameterised by a Hurst exponent $H \in (0,1)$ and a generalised diffusion coefficient $D_H > 0$. We jointly estimate $H$ and $D_H$ using maximum likelihood (MLE) from density measurements with Poisson counting noise and single-particle trajectory with Gaussian localisation error. We show that one density measurement in time cannot infer both $H$ and $D_H$ and that several time points are needed, which matters most for inference precision. For trajectories, we show that a neural network trained with a squared error loss approximates the posterior mean of $H$, which can be computed exactly at negligible cost. Paired with the profile-likelihood estimate of $D_H$, the posterior mean has the lowest root mean squared error in both $H$ and $D_H$, except near $H=0$ and $H=1$ where MLE estimates $H$ better. In vesicle trajectories from two cell types, $H$ and $D_H$ form a continuum rather than distinct modes of motion. The posterior probability that each window within a track is subdiffusive or superdiffusive shows that $26\%$ of MRC5 fibroblast and $21\%$ of HeLa vesicle trajectories contain both subdiffusive and superdiffusive windows, against $2\%$ and $7\%$ expected from estimation uncertainty alone. Intracellular cargoes therefore switch between subdiffusion and superdiffusion over time rather than forming populations with fixed $H$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用最大似然 (MLE)、神经网络与后验均值三种途径联合估计分数布朗运动 (fBM) 的 Hurst 指数 H 与广义扩散系数 D_H：单个时刻的密度测量无法同时辨识 H 与 D_H，需多个时间点；轨迹上以平方误差训练的神经网络逼近 H 的后验均值，与 D_H 的 profile-likelihood 估计配对后在 H 与 D_H 上 RMSE 最低（仅 H→0、H→1 附近 MLE 更好）。在 MRC5 与 HeLa 囊泡轨迹中，26% 与 21% 的轨迹同时含亚扩散与超扩散窗口，远高于仅由估计不确定性预期的 2% 与 7%，说明胞内货物随时间在亚扩散与超扩散之间切换，而非构成固定 H 的运动群体。
Motivation: 反常扩散中 H 与 D_H 常被联合拟合，但密度测量在单一时刻对这两个参数不可辨识，且轨迹数据含高斯定位误差与泊松计数噪声，需要一种既精确又低成本的估计方式。
Method: 对含泊松计数噪声的密度测量与含高斯定位误差的单粒子轨迹分别做 H 与 D_H 的联合 MLE；密度侧用 profile likelihood 并证明需多个时间点；轨迹侧以平方误差损失训练神经网络逼近 H 的后验均值（该均值可精确计算、代价可忽略），再与 D_H 的 profile-likelihood 估计配对，并用每个轨迹窗口的后验概率判定亚扩散/超扩散。
Result: 后验均值与 profile-likelihood D_H 配对在 H 和 D_H 上 RMSE 最低，仅在 H=0 与 H=1 附近 MLE 对 H 估计更好；单时刻密度测量不能同时推出 H 与 D_H，时间点数量对推断精度影响最大。MRC5 成纤维细胞 26%、HeLa 囊泡 21% 的轨迹同时含亚扩散与超扩散窗口，对照仅由估计不确定性预期的 2% 与 7%。
Conclusion: 胞内运输在时间上于亚扩散与超扩散之间切换，H 与 D_H 构成连续谱而非离散运动模式；推断时应以多时间点密度加后验均值-配对估计为主，仅在 H 接近 0 或 1 时改用 MLE。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Generative modelling for multivariate spatio-temporal downscaling of monthly climate fields
papers.abstract_en: Inferring climate fields at higher spatio-temporal resolutions from coarse representations is essential for accessing socioeconomic and environmental impacts. The downscaling of modelled climate fields faces a trade-off between data storage constraints, simulation efficiency, and resolution requirements. While many methods for spatial downscaling have been proposed, joint spatio-temporal downscaling has received comparable little attention. When deriving, for example, daily fields from climate datasets that are available only as monthly averages at coarser spatial resolution, it is highly challenging to faithfully reproduce extreme event statistics and spatiotemporal consistency. To address this task, we introduce a generative machine learning approach, using a diffusion model to jointly downscale monthly temperature and precipitation fields into temporally consistent daily fields at higher spatial resolution. We demonstrate that our approach can generate high-dimensional multivariate climate fields at daily temporal and 0.25° spatial resolution from monthly input fields at 1° spatial resolution, exhibiting coherent temporal dynamics and physically plausible spatial structures. In particular, by incorporating a conditional guidance technique, we show that a pre-trained diffusion model can be directly leveraged to efficiently generate daily high-resolution fields conditioned on monthly inputs, without requiring additional fine-tuning or retraining. Our probabilistic approach thus provides an efficient and generalizable framework for spatio-temporal climate downscaling, enabling flexible climate fields generation for climate impact assessments and digital Earth simulator constructions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用条件引导 (conditional guidance) 直接复用预训练 diffusion 模型，把 1° 月平均温度与降水场联合降尺度成时间一致的 0.25° 日尺度多变量场，无需微调或重训。生成结果保持连贯的时间动态与物理上合理的空间结构，可用于极端事件统计与气候影响评估。
Motivation: 气候数据集常只有粗分辨率月平均，而影响评估需要日尺度高分辨率场；已有方法多做空间降尺度，联合的时空降尺度研究很少，且难以忠实再现极端事件统计与时空一致性。
Method: 提出生成式机器学习方法：用 diffusion 模型对月尺度温度与降水做联合时空降尺度，输出时间一致的日尺度高分辨率场；加入条件引导技术，使预训练模型可直接按月输入生成日尺度场，无需额外微调或重训练。
Result: 从 1° 月输入场生成日时间、0.25° 空间分辨率的高维多变量气候场，表现出连贯的时间动态与物理上合理的空间结构；预训练 diffusion 模型经条件引导后可直接生成以月为条件的日尺度高分辨率场，无需微调或重训练。
Conclusion: 概率式生成框架能高效、可泛化地做时空气候降尺度，为气候影响评估与数字 Earth 模拟器构建提供灵活的气候场生成能力。
Relevance: 58

summary_sections.method: 提出生成式机器学习方法：用 diffusion 模型对月尺度温度与降水做联合时空降尺度，输出时间一致的日尺度高分辨率场；加入条件引导技术，使预训练模型可直接按月输入生成日尺度场，无需额外微调或重训练。
summary_sections.result: 从 1° 月输入场生成日时间、0.25° 空间分辨率的高维多变量气候场，表现出连贯的时间动态与物理上合理的空间结构；预训练 diffusion 模型经条件引导后可直接生成以月为条件的日尺度高分辨率场，无需微调或重训练。
summary_sections.conclusion: 概率式生成框架能高效、可泛化地做时空气候降尺度，为气候影响评估与数字 Earth 模拟器构建提供灵活的气候场生成能力。

papers.title: Occupancy Modeling via Drifting: One-Step Generation Enables Direct Policy Extraction
papers.abstract_en: The growing interest in behavior foundation models, combined with recent advancements in generative modeling, has led to an appealing recipe for reinforcement learning from unlabeled data: pre-train a generative model to model occupancies, i.e., discounted state visitations, on reward-free trajectories, such that a policy can be easily extracted once a small reward-labeled dataset becomes available. We decompose this recipe along three axes: (i) the degree to which the multi-modal structure of occupancies must be captured, (ii) the class of generative model, and (iii) the method used for policy extraction. Along each axis, we consider existing choices, propose simpler alternatives, and validate each decision experimentally. This analysis culminates in a novel, streamlined method that leverages drifting, a modern one-step generative sampler, to model the occupancy. We show that this enables policy extraction via direct differentiation through the occupancy model, and bypasses the need for critic distillation. Overall, we observe that this nimble setup leads to improvements in performance on standard benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把「无奖励轨迹预训练生成模型 → 少量奖励数据提策略」这一配方沿三轴拆解（占用多模态结构、生成模型类别、策略提取方式），最终方法用 drifting 这一 one-step 生成采样器直接建模 occupancy，使策略可通过占用模型直接微分提取，绕开 critic distillation，并在标准基准上取得性能提升。
Motivation: 从无标注数据做 RL 的通行配方依赖生成模型刻画占用分布，但多模态结构要建到什么程度、选哪类生成器、以及如何提策略，三个环节的选择都缺少系统对照，且常需额外的 critic 蒸馏步骤。
Method: 沿三轴分解配方并逐轴给出更简替代方案且各自实验验证：占用的多模态刻画程度、生成模型类别、策略提取方法；最终方案用 drifting（one-step 生成采样器）建模 occupancy，策略通过对占用模型直接微分提取，无需 critic distillation。
Result: 在标准基准上，该精简设置带来性能提升；三轴上的每个决策均经过实验验证，最终流程省去了 critic distillation。
Conclusion: 用 one-step 生成采样器直接建模占用即可支撑策略提取，简化后的无奖励预训练 RL 流程在标准基准上表现更好。

papers.title: BluePixel: Toward Native 4K Agentic Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-driven image editing has reached native 4K, yet how such editors are trained remains undisclosed, and pretraining one from scratch is beyond most teams. The task itself compounds the difficulty: a single end-to-end editor cannot make precise parametric adjustments, match specialized experts, or interpret the vague instructions users actually write. We argue that 4K editing is a system problem rather than a single-model problem, and present BluePixel, which couples a native-4K editing model with an agent harness; the complete training recipe is disclosed in this paper. The model makes 4K training practical: it turns a 1K-pretrained editor into a native-4K one through progressive VAE adaptation that keeps 4K training as affordable as 1K, absorbs a long tail of vertical editing skills through continual learning, and refines the aesthetic-fidelity trade-off with reinforcement learning. Distillation via source-anchored target projection (SATP) then compresses 50 denoising steps to 4, completing a 4K edit in 8.7 s on a single Kunlunxin P800 XPU while preserving task success rate and background consistency. The harness, BluePixel Agent, makes editing controllable: it decomposes user instructions into specialist and general operations, verifies every result with the same reward model that guided training, and retries within bounded attempts. On VINS-4KEval++ (3,305 native-4K cases), BluePixel ranks second among seven models, behind only GPT Image 2 in non-edited-region consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BluePixel 把原生 4K 指令图像编辑拆成模型加 agent 两部分：渐进式 VAE 适配让 1K 预训练编辑器以接近 1K 的成本做 4K 训练，SATP 蒸馏把 50 步去噪压到 4 步，单卡 Kunlunxin P800 XPU 上一次 4K 编辑 8.7 秒。在 VINS-4KEVal++（3,305 个原生 4K 案例）上，BluePixel 在七个模型中非编辑区域一致性排名第二，仅次于 GPT Image 2。
Motivation: 原生 4K 指令编辑的训练方法一直未公开，从零预训练成本超出多数团队承受范围；且单一端到端模型既做不了精确参数化调整，也匹配不了专用专家、理解不了用户含糊指令。
Method: 模型侧：渐进式 VAE 适配把 1K 预训练编辑器转成原生 4K，用持续学习吸收长尾竖向编辑技能，再用强化学习调美学-保真权衡；用 source-anchored target projection (SATP) 蒸馏压缩去噪步数。系统侧：BluePixel Agent 把用户指令分解为 specialist 与 general 操作，用训练时同一 reward model 校验每次结果并在有限次数内重试。
Result: SATP 将 50 步去噪压缩到 4 步，单张 Kunlunxin P800 XPU 完成一次 4K 编辑耗时 8.7 秒，同时保持任务成功率与背景一致性；在 VINS-4KEVal++（3,305 个原生 4K 案例）上，BluePixel 在七个模型中非编辑区域一致性排第二，仅落后于 GPT Image 2。
Conclusion: 4K 编辑是系统问题而非单模型问题：把可负担的 4K 训练、蒸馏加速与带校验重试的 agent harness 组合起来，才能同时拿到精度、可控性与可用延迟，并公开完整训练配方。

papers.title: CoDy: Codec Dynamics as Complementary Priors for Unsupervised Temporal Action Localization
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised temporal action localization (UTAL) aims to identify action categories and localize their temporal boundaries without annotation supervision. Existing methods typically derive supervision for both tasks solely from RGB and optical-flow representations, often resulting in noisy category assignments and inaccurate temporal boundaries. In this work, we reveal an overlooked property of video codecs: group-of-pictures quantization patterns preserve category-discriminative dynamics, while motion-vector and residual variations exhibit pronounced responses around action transitions. Based on this insight, we propose CoDy, a codec dynamics-guided framework that exploits the codec as complementary information to the visual view for UTAL. CoDy integrates a codec-enhanced view with RGB and flow through confidence-aware consensus clustering, producing reliable soft pseudo-labels. It further converts codec dynamics into a class-agnostic boundary prior, which supervises visual boundary learning and guides proposal initialization and iterative refinement. The codec branches are only used during the training stage and introduce no extra codec-side computation at inference. Extensive experiments on THUMOS14 and ActivityNet v1.3 demonstrate that CoDy consistently outperforms existing UTAL methods and achieves state-of-the-art localization performance. These results establish codec signals as effective annotation-free priors for jointly inferring which actions occur and when they occur.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoDy 把视频编码器本身的 GOP 量化模式与运动矢量、残差变化当作 RGB/光流之外的第三路证据，用于无监督时序动作定位 (UTAL)：编码动态经置信度感知共识聚类生成软伪标签，并转成与类别无关的边界先验监督视觉边界学习。在 THUMOS14 与 ActivityNet v1.3 上取得 SOTA 定位性能，编码分支仅训练期使用、推理不增加编码侧计算。
Motivation: 现有 UTAL 只用 RGB 与光流生成伪监督，类别指派噪声大、时序边界不准；而视频编码过程本身携带类别判别动态与动作转场响应，此前被忽略。
Method: CoDy 提出 codec dynamics 引导框架：把 codec-enhanced view 与 RGB、flow 通过置信度感知共识聚类 (confidence-aware consensus clustering) 融合得到可靠软伪标签；再把 codec 动态转为类别无关的边界先验，监督视觉边界学习并指导 proposal 初始化与迭代精修；codec 分支仅在训练阶段参与。
Result: 在 THUMOS14 和 ActivityNet v1.3 上一致优于现有 UTAL 方法，达到 SOTA 时序定位性能；推理阶段不引入额外 codec 侧计算。
Conclusion: 编码器信号可作为免标注先验，同时推断「发生了什么动作」与「发生在何时」，且无需在推理时付出额外代价。

papers.title: Neural Wasserstein Splines: Representation-Invariant Second-Order Priors for Trajectory Inference
papers.abstract_en: Population dynamics are often observed only as unpaired snapshots, which leave the evolution between measurements underdetermined. Second-order regularization can constrain it, but a penalty on the accelerations of sampled particles is a prior on joint particle paths, and different particle representations of the same marginal curve can have different acceleration costs. We therefore introduce Neural Wasserstein Splines (NWSP), a sample-based method that learns a continuous population curve under a Wasserstein smoothness prior. A neural network maps latent variables to the control points of a cubic spline in time, so samples at any time come from the spline basis without numerical integration. We project the generator's velocity onto gradients of a finite dictionary of scalar potentials and differentiate this measure-dependent projection in time, obtaining a finite-dimensional surrogate for the intrinsic Wasserstein acceleration, trained jointly with distributional fit losses. For a fixed dictionary and ridge parameter, we prove that the population penalty depends only on the marginal curve and bound its sensitivity to moment-estimation errors. Learned potentials (NWSP-N) sharpen acceleration estimates. On various synthetic and single-cell benchmarks, NWSP is highly competitive with transport and flow-based methods, ranking in the top two in 11 of 16 settings. The penalty improves on an unregularized spline in 13 of 16 settings and, while competitive with a particle-acceleration penalty, adds provable representation invariance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对未配对快照下的群体轨迹推断，提出 Neural Wasserstein Splines (NWSP)：神经网络把隐变量映到时间三次样条控制点，速度投影到有限标量势字典的梯度上并对该投影求时间导数，得到内蕴 Wasserstein 加速度的有限维替代。固定字典与 ridge 参数时可证明群体惩罚只依赖边缘曲线，对矩估计误差有界；在合成与单细胞基准 16 个设置中 11 个排前二，正则化在 13/16 设置上优于无正则样条。
Motivation: 群体动力学常只有未配对快照，测量之间的演化欠定；二阶正则虽能约束，但对采样粒子加速度的惩罚是关于联合粒子路径的先验，同一边缘曲线的不同粒子表示会有不同加速度代价。
Method: NWSP 用神经网络把隐变量映射为时间三次样条控制点，任意时刻的样本直接由样条基生成、无需数值积分；把生成器速度投影到有限标量势字典的梯度上，并对该依赖测度的投影求时间导数，作为 Wasserstein 加速度的有限维替代，与分布拟合损失联合训练；可学习势版本记为 NWSP-N。
Result: 在多个合成与单细胞基准上，NWSP 与 transport、flow-based 方法相比在 16 个设置中的 11 个排进前二；其惩罚在 16 个设置中的 13 个上优于无正则样条，并与粒子加速度惩罚竞争力相当，同时额外具备可证明的表示不变性。理论上，对固定字典与 ridge 参数，群体惩罚只依赖边缘曲线，并给出对矩估计误差的敏感度界。
Conclusion: 把二阶先验改写为只依赖边缘曲线的 Wasserstein 加速度替代，可在不牺牲竞争力的前提下给轨迹推断加上可证明的表示不变性；可学习势 (NWSP-N) 能锐化加速度估计。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: SPARS: A Stability-Plasticity-Aware Region Selection Framework for Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning aims to acquire new knowledge while retaining previously learned knowledge. However, updating shared parameters when learning new tasks often overwrites existing knowledge, causing catastrophic forgetting. Memory replay methods mitigate catastrophic forgetting but rely on previous samples, raising privacy, memory, and scalability concerns. On the other hand, parameter isolation-based methods preserve learned knowledge but may limit knowledge transfer, whereas regularization promotes adaptability but remains susceptible to interference between old and new tasks. To maintain the stability-plasticity trade-off, this paper proposes Stability-Plasticity-Aware Region Selection (SPARS), a replay-free hybrid framework combining global parameter isolation with localized parameter regularization. SPARS estimates parameter importance using either the Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) or a novel Confidence Score (CS) estimator that leverages logit sensitivity and achieves comparable performance to FIM without requiring labelled data. Based on parameter importance, SPARS partitions parameters into three importance-aware regions namely, winning, neighboring, and non-important parameter regions. Each region receives a different adaptation strategy: selective freezing, soft regularization, or unrestricted learning based on its role in the stability-plasticity trade-off. To mitigate classifier bias in class-incremental learning, we employ Quadratic Discriminant Analysis to improve performance on previously learned classes .Experiments on CIFAR-10 and TinyImageNet demonstrate consistent improvement in average incremental accuracy over existing isolation- and regularization-based methods across task- and class-incremental learning. On TinyImageNet, SPARS achieves the best performance with 6% improvement for class-incremental learning while retaining over 60% of parameters for future tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPARS 是免回放 (replay-free) 的持续学习混合框架：用 FIM 或无需标注的置信度分数 (Confidence Score, CS) 估计参数重要性，把参数切成 winning、neighboring、non-important 三个区域，分别施加选择性冻结、软正则和自由学习。在 TinyImageNet 类增量设置上平均增量准确率提升 6%，同时保留超过 60% 的参数供后续任务使用。
Motivation: 持续学习中更新共享参数会覆盖旧知识导致灾难性遗忘；回放旧样本带来隐私、内存与可扩展性问题，纯参数隔离又限制知识迁移，纯正则化仍受新旧任务干扰。
Method: SPARS 结合全局参数隔离与局部参数正则：用 FIM 或基于 logit 敏感度的新置信度分数 CS（无需标注数据）估计参数重要性，据此将参数划分为 winning、neighboring、non-important 三区，分别采用选择性冻结、软正则、 unrestricted learning；类增量阶段再用 Quadratic Discriminant Analysis (QDA) 缓解对已学类别的分类偏置。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10 与 TinyImageNet 的任务增量与类增量实验中，平均增量准确率相对已有隔离类与正则化方法一致提升；TinyImageNet 类增量上取得最佳表现，提升 6%，并保留超过 60% 的参数。
Conclusion: 按参数重要性分区施加不同适应策略，可以在不回放旧样本的前提下同时维持稳定性与可塑性，且 CS 估计器在无需标注数据时达到与 FIM 相当的效果。

papers.title: Rationale Distribution Distillation via Flow Matching for Distributional Continuous Latent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Sampling multiple chain-of-thought rationales from a language model can uncover correct solutions missed by a single attempt. However, these rationales are typically lengthy, making repeated autoregressive generation costly. Continuous latent reasoning offers a compact alternative, but point-valued methods condition repeated answer sampling on a single rationale, which can limit exploration of diverse paths and answer coverage. We thus propose rationale distribution distillation (RDD), training a conditional flow over fixed-length latent sequences by distilling from multiple textual reasoning paths. Furthermore, we expand the distillation targets through within-query mixup, interpolating between complete latent rationales for the same query. The flow nonautoregressively generates the entire latent sequence, and a frozen language model autoregressively decodes answers from sampled rationale contexts. Empirically, the resulting distributional reasoner achieves higher answer coverage than the evaluated point-valued latent reasoning baselines, particularly on advanced mathematical tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 rationale distribution distillation (RDD)：用 flow matching 在定长隐序列上训练条件流，从同一问题的多条文本推理路径蒸馏出隐式分布，再用 within-query mixup 在同题完整隐 rationale 之间插值扩充蒸馏目标。非自回归地整段生成隐序列后由冻结语言模型解码答案，得到的分布化 reasoner 在所评估的点值隐推理基线上取得更高答案覆盖，在高难度数学任务上尤其明显。
Motivation: 同一问题采样多条 CoT 能补上单次尝试漏掉的正确解，但文本 rationale 冗长、重复自回归生成代价高；现有连续隐推理是点值的，重复采样答案时只条件于单条 rationale，限制了路径多样性与答案覆盖。
Method: RDD 用 flow matching 训练一个以问题为条件、作用在定长隐序列上的流，蒸馏目标来自同一查询的多条文本推理路径；再用 within-query mixup 在同题完整隐 rationale 之间线性插值扩充目标。推理时流非自回归生成整段隐序列，冻结的语言模型从采样的 rationale 上下文自回归解码答案。
Result: 在所评估的点值隐推理基线上，该分布化 reasoner 获得更高答案覆盖，在高难度数学任务 (advanced mathematical tasks) 上提升尤其明显。
Conclusion: 把单条隐 rationale 换成由多条文本推理路径蒸馏出的隐式分布并配合同题 mixup，能扩大重复答案采样的探索范围与覆盖，点值隐推理在这一点上受限。

papers.title: Explorer-Zero: Improving Self-Play for Long-Horizon Tasks with Decomposable Verifiable Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Training LLM agents on long-horizon interactive tasks with reinforcement learning typically relies on human-annotated tasks and reliable verification, both expensive to construct for stateful environments. Self-play offers an alternative, but must generate achievable, compositional tasks and provide feedback beyond binary outcomes. We propose Explorer-Zero, a self-play framework that jointly generates tasks and fine-grained, verifiable rewards through environment interaction. A learned proposer explores the environment, constructs tasks, and records intermediate and final states as verification targets. These checkpoints reward partial completion, while alternating proposer--solver training adapts the generated curriculum. We show theoretically that subtask rewards reduce collapse among unsuccessful rollouts when they complete different numbers of subtasks. Without human-annotated training tasks, Explorer-Zero outperforms the evaluated self-play baselines across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and AppWorld; on AppWorld, our 30B agent reaches 59.67% task success, approaching 62.65% for RL on human-annotated tasks. Further analyses support task-relevant composition and benefits on complex tasks, while self-play initialization improves subsequent human-data RL across all three benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Explorer-Zero 用一个学习到的 proposer 在环境中自行探索并生成可组合的任务，同时把中间状态与最终状态记录为可验证的细粒度 checkpoint 奖励，proposer 与 solver 交替训练。理论表明当失败 rollout 完成的子任务数不同时，子任务奖励能减少 collapse；在无人工标注任务的条件下，30B agent 在 AppWorld 达到 59.67% 成功率，接近用人工任务 RL 的 62.65%。
Motivation: 有状态环境上做长程 RL 依赖人工标注任务与可靠验证器，两者构造成本高；纯自博弈又只能给二值结果反馈，难以生成可达成、可组合的任务。
Method: 学习型 proposer 通过与环境交互探索、构造任务，并把中间与最终状态记为验证目标作为部分完成的奖励；proposer 与 solver 交替训练以自适应调整生成的课程，全程不使用人工标注训练任务。
Result: 理论上证明：当不成功的 rollout 完成不同数量的子任务时，子任务奖励能减少 collapse。无自动生成任务训练下，Explorer-Zero 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、AppWorld 上超过所评估的自博弈基线；AppWorld 上 30B agent 任务成功率 59.67%，接近人工任务 RL 的 62.65%；自博弈初始化在全部三个基准上都改善了后续使用人工数据的 RL。
Conclusion: 细粒度可验证的子任务奖励加交替自博弈课程，可以在没有人工标注任务时逼近人工标注 RL 的长程任务表现，并可作为人工数据 RL 的初始化。

papers.title: Euler: Towards Human-Centered Multi-Agent Mathematical Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Mathematical research drives scientific discovery, and recent advances in AI for mathematics have shown that language-model agents can solve challenging problems and develop substantial mathematical proofs. Yet much of today's AI-for-mathematics work centers on obtaining a final answer. This emphasis leaves the exploration behind a result difficult for researchers to understand, while long-running investigations face fragmented context and the risk of unsupported claims propagating across reasoning steps. We present Euler, a human-centered mathematical research system built around a shared, structured representation of the research process. Euler organizes mathematical statements, assumptions, proof dependencies, alternative approaches, failed attempts, and verification evidence into connected research graphs. This representation allows researchers to trace how results are developed and supplies agents with persistent, task-relevant knowledge for planning, collaboration, and verification across sessions. Researchers can also select a graph node linked to a saved team state, revisit the agents' earlier reasoning, and explore alternative directions through continued interaction. We illustrate Euler's capabilities through three mathematical research case studies and describe the implemented system and its software validation.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 11 figures, 5 tables, 1 algorithm. Technical report. Code: https://github.com/canghaimeng/Euler
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Euler 把数学研究过程本身做成共享的结构化研究图 (research graph)，把命题、假设、证明依赖、备选路径、失败尝试与验证证据连成可追溯的图，让研究者能回看推理并沿节点继续探索。系统以三个数学研究案例展示能力，并给出实现与软件验证。
Motivation: 现有 AI-for-mathematics 工作聚焦最终答案，导致结果背后的探索难以理解，长时程研究还面临上下文碎片化与无支撑论断在推理步骤间传播的风险。
Method: 以共享结构化表示为核心，将数学命题、假设、证明依赖、备选方法、失败尝试和验证证据组织为相互连接的研究图；该表示同时为研究者提供结果溯源、为 agent 跨会话提供持久且任务相关的规划、协作与验证知识，研究者可选中与已保存团队状态绑定的图节点、回看 agent 早期推理并继续交互探索其他方向。
Result: 通过三个数学研究案例展示 Euler 的能力，并描述已实现的系统及其软件验证；技术报告共 23 页、11 图、5 表、1 算法。
Conclusion: 把研究过程显式建模为可追溯的研究图，可以让人类研究者理解探索路径，同时让 agent 跨会话携带持久知识进行规划、协作与验证。

papers.title: On the Optimisation Landscape of Overparameterised Weighted MMD
papers.abstract_en: We study the optimisation landscape of the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) over weighted atomic measures. For the one-dimensional Gaussian kernel, we show that, for any compactly supported target distribution, sufficiently many particles ensure that every local minimum has arbitrarily small MMD. Moreover, any stationary point whose MMD remains bounded away from zero is unstable under an unweighted gradient flow over the particle locations. These results hold both when the weights are constrained to the simplex, and when they are unconstrained but optimised at each step. When the target is itself finitely supported, we further strengthen this result: beyond an explicit particle threshold, there are no spurious local minima, and every spurious stationary point is unstable. To our knowledge, these are the first finite-particle overparameterisation guarantees of their kind for weighted MMD optimisation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究加权原子测度上 MMD 的优化地形：一维 Gaussian kernel 下，对任意紧支撑目标分布，粒子数足够多时每个局部极小的 MMD 都可任意小，且 MMD 远离零的驻点在对粒子位置的无权梯度流下不稳定；当目标本身有限支撑时，超过显式粒子阈值后不存在伪局部极小，所有伪驻点都不稳定。结论是加权 MMD 的过参数化能消除伪极小，权重在单纯形约束或每步无约束优化下结论同样成立。
Motivation: 基于粒子的 MMD 优化常被伪局部极小卡住，此前缺少关于加权 MMD 在过参数化下地形好坏的有限粒子级保证。
Method: 在加权原子测度上分析 MMD 优化地形，核限定为一维 Gaussian kernel；分别处理权重约束在单纯形与权重无约束但每步同步优化两种设定，用对粒子位置的无权梯度流 (unweighted gradient flow) 刻画驻点稳定性，并对有限支撑目标给出显式粒子阈值。
Result: 对任意紧支撑目标，粒子数足够多时每个局部极小的 MMD 可任意小；MMD 有正下界的驻点在无权梯度流下不稳定，两种权重设定均成立。目标有限支撑时，超过显式粒子阈值后不存在伪局部极小，且每个伪驻点都不稳定。作者称这是加权 MMD 优化的首批此类有限粒子过参数化保证。
Conclusion: 加权 MMD 在足够多粒子下没有坏的局部极小，非零 MMD 的驻点只是动力学上不稳定的瞬态，因此过参数化加权 MMD 优化可被信赖。

papers.title: Text-Informed Training Data Filtering for Enhanced Virtual Flow Meter Performance
papers.abstract_en: In sectors such as energy, aquaculture and chemical processing, the effectiveness of both mechanistic and data-driven models is frequently limited by poor-quality training data, which obscures underlying physical laws and degrades predictive accuracy. Such quality issues commonly manifest as anomalies in the dataset, ranging from sensor faults to process upsets and incorrect operator inputs. While traditional rule-based filtering can remove a subset of the anomalies, it is unable to leverage contextual information stored as unstructured text, such as engineer comments and operational logs that explain under what conditions the data was collected. We propose a text-informed data filtering method that leverages large language models (LLMs) to integrate unstructured operational data with tabular sensor data. The method consists of two steps: (1) contextual anomaly detection by reasoning over both data modalities, and (2) generation of a binary mask that is applied to filter the training dataset for model development. To investigate the potential benefit, a steady-state soft-sensor regression model, namely a virtual flow meter that estimates well flow rates, is used as the downstream evaluation target. Experiments on a synthetic oil and gas dataset show improved model performance compared to traditional rule-based filtering. Ablation studies show that textual operator comments can provide filtering-relevant signals beyond sensor data alone, with the multimodal approach reducing downstream MAPE from 7.1% to 5.4% relative to sensor-only filtering. This work demonstrates that integrating unstructured operational knowledge with sensor data through LLMs can improve data quality for industrial machine learning applications, offering a scalable alternative to manual data curation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用 LLM 融合非结构化运维文本（工程师注释、操作日志）与表格传感器数据的两步训练数据过滤方法：先做多模态上下文异常检测，再生成二值掩码过滤训练集。在合成油气数据集上的虚拟流量计 (virtual flow meter) 下游回归中，多模态过滤把 MAPE 从 7.1% 降到 5.4%，优于仅用传感器的规则过滤。
Motivation: 机理与数据驱动模型常被低质量训练数据拖累，异常（传感器故障、工况扰动、错误操作录入）中有一部分只有运维文本能解释，传统规则过滤用不上这些上下文。
Method: 两步流程：(1) LLM 同时推理非结构化运维文本与表格传感器数据做上下文异常检测；(2) 生成二值掩码过滤训练集。下游用稳态软测量回归模型——估计井流量的虚拟流量计——作为评估目标，并做消融对比仅传感器过滤。
Result: 在合成油气数据集上，多模态过滤使下游虚拟流量计 MAPE 从 7.1% 降到 5.4%（相对仅传感器过滤）；消融显示操作员文本注释提供了传感器数据之外的过滤相关信号。
Conclusion: 把非结构化运维知识经 LLM 并入传感器数据能提升工业 ML 的训练数据质量，是人工数据整理的可扩展替代；证据来自合成油气数据集上的虚拟流量计回归。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OmniPoser: Flexible Human Motion Recovery in the Wild with Masked Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Recovering 3D human motion from sparse wearable sensors is challenging due to the inherent noise, occlusion, and instability of real-world tracking signals. Existing approaches are restricted to fixed sensor configurations and, when built on diffusion models, are computationally prohibitive for real-time deployment. We propose OmniPoser, a universal framework that recovers full-body SMPL motion from a flexible combination of heterogeneous inputs, such as 3D keypoints, sparse IMU rotations, head-mounted 6-DoF poses, or any subset thereof, within a single model. OmniPoser introduces a cross-modal masking mechanism paired with a Masked Conditioning Encoder, enabling one architecture to incorporate diverse sensor configurations through a masked design. A decoupled dual-stream generative backbone generates complete motion via Conditional Flow Matching, requiring only a single ODE integration step at inference. Across three settings and seven benchmarks, including in-the-wild Nymeria and Ego-Exo4D datasets, OmniPoser performs on par with state-of-the-art methods while running at over 700 FPS. The project page is available at https://jamesbridgewater51.github.io/omniposer-eccv/.
papers.comment: Accepted as a poster at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
papers.journal_ref: Computer Vision - ECCV 2026. Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol. 17075, pp. 1-19. Springer, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniPoser 用单一模型从任意组合的异构稀疏传感器（3D keypoints、稀疏 IMU 旋转、头显 6-DoF 位姿或其子集）恢复全身 SMPL 运动：跨模态掩码机制配合 Masked Conditioning Encoder 吸纳不同传感器配置，解耦双流生成骨干用 Conditional Flow Matching，推理只需一步 ODE 积分。在三个设定、七个基准（含 in-the-wild 的 Nymeria 与 Ego-Exo4D）上达到与 SOTA 相当的精度，同时运行速度超过 700 FPS。
Motivation: 真实可穿戴传感器信号含噪声、遮挡与不稳定，现有方法被固定传感器配置限制；基于 diffusion 的方案计算量过大，难以实时部署。
Method: 跨模态掩码机制 + Masked Conditioning Encoder，使单一架构通过掩码设计兼容多种传感器配置；解耦双流生成骨干以 Conditional Flow Matching 生成完整动作，推理仅需一次 ODE 积分。
Result: 在三个设定、七个基准（含 in-the-wild 的 Nymeria 与 Ego-Exo4D）上，精度与 SOTA 方法相当，运行速度超过 700 FPS。
Conclusion: 掩码化的流匹配生成框架可以在单一模型内兼容灵活传感器组合，并把稀疏传感器到全身动作的恢复推到实时速度。

papers.title: Lost in the Fallback: How Reliably Do Typed Decision Models Use Fallback Options?
papers.abstract_en: Typed decision models (TDMs) are increasingly used in applications such as request routing and model selection, making reliable decisions critical to system performance. Fallback options accommodate categories outside regular choices, enabling deferral to human experts or more capable models. While recent works have examined adversarial vulnerabilities in TDMs, their ability to follow fallback rules in non-adversarial settings remains underexplored. We introduce the Paired Fallback Robustness (PFR) Test to evaluate two aspects of fallback reliability: whether models correctly switch between regular and fallback options, and whether they make consistent decisions under logically equivalent definitions of the same rule. We evaluate open-source decision models on three benchmarks, with controlled comparisons across architectures and parameter counts. We find that correct recognition does not reliably transfer to correct fallback options, and errors persist even when the correct category is explicitly supplied.Moreover, logically equivalent formulations of the same fallback rule can also produce substantial disagreement in model decisions. These findings reveal a crucial reliability gap in current TDMs: fallback mechanisms designed to improve reliability can instead introduce errors. It highlights faithful execution of fallback rules and consistency under equivalent definitions as essential requirements for reliable typed decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Paired Fallback Robustness (PFR) 测试，评估 typed decision model (TDM) 在非对抗场景下执行 fallback 规则的可靠性：能否在常规选项与 fallback 之间正确切换，以及对逻辑等价的同一规则定义是否给出一致决策。在三个基准上对开源决策模型做架构与参数量的受控比较，发现正确识别类别并不保证选对 fallback 选项，即使显式给出正确类别错误仍持续存在，且逻辑等价的不同表述会造成模型决策的显著分歧。
Motivation: TDM 已用于请求路由与模型选择，fallback 选项用于把常规选择之外的类别转交人工专家或更强模型；已有工作考察 TDM 的对抗脆弱性，但其在非对抗场景下遵循 fallback 规则的能力研究不足。
Method: 引入 PFR 测试，从两个维度度量 fallback 可靠性：常规选项与 fallback 之间的切换是否正确，以及对逻辑等价的同一规则定义决策是否一致；在三个基准上评测开源决策模型，并跨架构与参数量做受控比较。
Result: 在三个基准上的受控比较发现：正确识别类别不能可靠迁移到正确的 fallback 选项；即使正确类别被显式提供，错误依然持续；逻辑等价的 fallback 规则表述也会造成模型决策的显著分歧。
Conclusion: 当前 TDM 存在可靠性缺口：本为提升可靠性而设计的 fallback 机制反而会引入错误；忠实执行 fallback 规则与在等价定义下保持一致，是可靠 typed decision-making 的必要要求。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Energy Consumption Analysis of Discrete Diffusion and Autoregressive Language Models
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to scale, their energy consumption during inference has become a critical concern. While Autoregressive (AR) models are the industry standard, Diffusion Language Models (DLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative capable of parallel token generation. In this paper, we perform a comparative energy benchmark of diffusion models (LLaDA-8B, Dream-7B) against AR counterparts (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B). We analyze the trade-offs between model architecture, KV-cache optimization, and Joules-per-token efficiency. Our results show that at longer sequences (200--600 tokens), diffusion models achieve 2.5--2.7 J/token, approximately 2$\times$ more efficient than AR models with KV-cache (5.3--5.7 J/token). KV-cache provides substantial benefits for AR models at longer sequences (50--70\% energy reduction).
papers.journal_ref: GreenSys '26: Proceedings of the 2nd International Workshop on Systems and Methods for Sustainable Large-Scale AI, 2026, pp. 7-12
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对离散扩散语言模型 (DLLM) 与自回归 (AR) 模型做推理能耗基准：LLaDA-8B、Dream-7B 对比 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B。在 200–600 token 长序列上扩散模型达 2.5–2.7 J/token，约为带 KV-cache 的 AR 模型 (5.3–5.7 J/token) 的 2 倍能效；KV-cache 本身可为 AR 模型在长序列上省 50–70% 能耗。
Motivation: LLM 规模持续扩大，推理阶段能耗成为关键问题；AR 是工业标准但逐 token 串行生成，DLLM 支持并行生成，两者在架构、KV-cache 优化与每 token 焦耳效率上的权衡尚缺直接能耗基准。
Method: 以 LLaDA-8B、Dream-7B 为扩散代表，Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B 为 AR 对照，做对比能耗基准；分析模型架构、KV-cache 优化与 Joules-per-token 的权衡，并在不同序列长度 (50–600 token) 下测量。
Result: 在 200–600 token 长序列上扩散模型 2.5–2.7 J/token，约为带 KV-cache 的 AR 模型 5.3–5.7 J/token 的 2 倍能效；KV-cache 为 AR 模型在长序列上带来 50–70% 的能耗下降。
Conclusion: 在长序列推理上，扩散语言模型的每 token 能耗约为带 KV-cache 的 AR 模型的一半，而 KV-cache 仍是 AR 模型长序列节能的主要手段。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: DeltaStreamer: Towards Human-Like Agentic Streaming Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: We propose DeltaStreamer, a novel agentic framework for streaming video understanding inspired by how humans observe, remember, and investigate. Streaming video understanding requires a system to retain evidence before knowing which details future queries will need. Existing approaches often obscure event transitions and omit relevant details when compressing video history, and cannot recover missing visual evidence. DeltaStreamer addresses these limitations by combining change-aware memory with query-driven planning and targeted evidence gathering with replay. Before a query arrives, it continuously observes the stream and explicitly records visual changes in structured memory, preserving how events unfold rather than only what is present. When a query arrives, a query-driven planner identifies the required evidence and guides memory retrieval and targeted replay. By revisiting historical frames, the agent can recover visual details omitted during observation and ground its answer in evidence beyond the retained descriptions. This connects continuous observation with active investigation tailored to each question. Experiments on OVO-Bench and StreamingBench demonstrate improvements over representative streaming video understanding methods, with overall scores of 66.07% and 59.53%, respectively. Project page: https://bbbbchan.github.io/DeltaStreamer/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeltaStreamer 把流式视频理解做成「先持续观察记录变化、后按查询取证」的 agentic 框架：观察阶段用 change-aware memory 显式记录视觉变化而非只存静态描述，查询到达后由 query-driven planner 定位所需证据并驱动记忆检索与定向 replay 回看历史帧，补回观察时遗漏的细节。在 OVO-Bench 与 StreamingBench 上整体得分分别为 66.07% 与 59.53%，优于所选的代表性流式视频理解方法。
Motivation: 流式视频系统必须在不知道未来查询会问什么时就决定保留哪些证据；现有方法在压缩视频历史时会掩盖事件转换、丢掉相关细节，且丢掉的视觉证据无法找回。
Method: 三段式 agentic 流程：观察阶段持续读流并把视觉变化写入结构化 change-aware memory，保留事件如何展开；查询到达后 query-driven planner 识别所需证据，指导记忆检索与 targeted replay；通过回访历史帧恢复观察期遗漏的细节，使回答落在保留描述之外的原始证据上。
Result: 在 OVO-Bench 上整体得分 66.07%，在 StreamingBench 上整体得分 59.53%，均相对所选的代表性流式视频理解方法 (representative streaming video understanding methods) 有提升。
Conclusion: 把「记住变化」与「按问题主动回看取证」分开处理，可以让流式视频回答建立在原始帧证据而非仅保留的描述之上，从而在两个流式视频基准上取得整体提升。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: VisibilitySplat: Ray-Traced Occlusion for Relighting with 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: We address inverse rendering with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) by introducing explicit visibility modeling for relighting as well as material and light decomposition. Our approach augments the standard rasterized 3DGS pipeline with a sparse visibility oracle that estimates transmittance-weighted occlusion for Gaussian primitives from sampled lighting directions. This oracle is implemented using a point-based ray tracer accelerated by a bounding volume hierarchy (BVH) and queried sparsely within the inverse-rendering objectives, while the original 3DGS loop is retained for training efficiency, interactive visualization, and tooling compatibility. Shading follows a physically based rendering (PBR) formulation with a principled microfacet bidirectional reflectance distribution function (BRDF) and low-resolution high-dynamic-range (HDR) environment maps. We evaluate our method on the TensoIR synthetic dataset against baselines based on neural radiance fields (NeRFs), tensor representations, and 3DGS. The results show competitive performance and improvements over several earlier baselines for novel-view synthesis (NVS), albedo reconstruction, and relighting. Ablations indicate that explicit visibility modeling is an important contributor to relighting and material-illumination disentanglement, while pure PBR supervision can favor appearance fitting in NVS. Overall, the findings suggest that sparse, point-based visibility queries effectively complement rasterized splatting for inverse rendering while preserving the practical advantages of the 3DGS ecosystem.

TL;DR: 在 3D Gaussian Splatting 的逆渲染流程中加入稀疏可见性预言机：用 BVH 加速的点式光线追踪从采样光照方向估计高斯基元的透射率加权遮挡，仅在逆渲染目标中稀疏查询，保留原 3DGS 光栅化训练循环。在 TensoIR 合成数据集上相对 NeRF、张量表示与 3DGS 基线在新视角合成 (NVS)、albedo 重建与 relighting 上表现具竞争力并改进若干早期基线；消融显示显式可见性建模是 relighting 与材质-光照解耦的重要贡献，而纯 PBR 监督更偏向 NVS 的外观拟合。
Motivation: 标准光栅化 3DGS 缺少显式可见性/遮挡建模，导致逆渲染中的 relighting 与材质-光照分解不可靠，而完整光线追踪又会拖慢训练。
Method: 在标准 3DGS 管线外挂一个稀疏可见性预言机：用 BVH 加速的点式光线追踪器从采样光照方向估计高斯基元的透射率加权遮挡，仅在逆渲染目标中稀疏查询，训练循环仍用原 3DGS 光栅化。着色采用基于物理渲染 (PBR) 的微表面 BRDF 与低分辨率 HDR 环境贴图。
Result: 在 TensoIR 合成数据集上，与 NeRF 类、张量表示与 3DGS 类基线比较，NVS、albedo 重建与 relighting 结果具竞争力并改进若干早期基线；消融表明显式可见性建模对 relighting 与材质-光照解耦是重要贡献，而纯 PBR 监督会偏向 NVS 的外观拟合。
Conclusion: 稀疏的点式可见性查询能有效补足光栅化 splatting 做逆渲染，同时保留 3DGS 生态的训练效率、交互可视化与工具兼容性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Memory-Efficient Subspace Optimization with Residual Correction: From Momentum SGD to Muon
papers.abstract_en: Memory-efficient subspace optimization has emerged as a practical approach to reducing the memory cost of LLM training while preserving optimization performance. Previous algorithms typically rely on the leading singular subspace of stochastic gradients, yet the gradient noise may dominate the subspace in later training stages and can prevent convergence. To overcome this limitation, we adopt a residual correction framework, which maintains the optimizer states in the subspace and adds the orthogonal residual gradient to the parameter update. We first integrate this scheme into momentum SGD to develop SMRC, which attains an $O(T^{-1/4})$ convergence rate for a fixed orthonormal basis, matching that of full-space momentum SGD. Our analysis introduces a subspace virtual iterate to resolve the coupling between the momentum and the residual correction. Furthermore, we extend SMRC to a multi-stage variant which periodically recomputes bases to track the evolving dominant subspace and retains the same rate. Since each basis refresh breaks the consistency of the virtual iterates, we devise a boundary correction approach that aligns them across stages. Beyond momentum SGD, we incorporate our framework into Muon and propose PMRC, which applies the matrix sign to the projected momentum. Through a weighted momentum tracking analysis that accounts for the residual gradient, we establish an $O(T^{-1/4})$ convergence rate for PMRC, which matches the rate of full-space Muon. We also design a multi-stage PMRC with periodically refreshed bases, which maintains a convergence rate of the same order. Extensive experimental results confirm the effectiveness and efficiency of our algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出残差校正 (residual correction) 框架：优化器状态只存在随机梯度的主奇异子空间里，正交残差梯度直接加进参数更新，从而避开后期梯度噪声主导子空间导致的不收敛。SMRC（momentum SGD 版）与 PMRC（Muon 版，对投影动量取 matrix sign）在固定正交基下都达到 O(T^{-1/4}) 收敛率，与各自全空间算法持平；多阶段周期刷新基底的变体保持同阶速率。
Motivation: 子空间优化用随机梯度的主奇异子空间压缩 LLM 训练的优化器显存，但训练后期梯度噪声可能主导该子空间并阻碍收敛，需要在不牺牲收敛率的前提下绕开这一瓶颈。
Method: 残差校正框架把优化器状态限制在子空间内、将正交残差梯度并入参数更新：先集成进 momentum SGD 得到 SMRC，分析中引入 subspace virtual iterate 解耦动量与残差校正的耦合；再设计周期重算基底的多阶段变体，并用 boundary correction 对齐各阶段被刷新打断的 virtual iterates；最后把框架移植到 Muon，对投影动量施加 matrix sign 得到 PMRC，用考虑残差梯度的 weighted momentum tracking 分析。
Result: 固定正交基下 SMRC 收敛率 O(T^{-1/4})，与全空间 momentum SGD 相同；多阶段 SMRC 周期刷新基底后保持同一速率。PMRC 收敛率 O(T^{-1/4})，与全空间 Muon 相同，多阶段 PMRC 维持同阶收敛率。摘要称大量实验证实算法的有效性与效率，但未列出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把残差梯度留在子空间更新之外即可让子空间优化在梯度噪声主导子空间的后期阶段仍保持与全空间 momentum SGD / Muon 相同的 O(T^{-1/4}) 收敛率，且可跨多阶段基底刷新扩展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LAGO: Language Agents with Reusable Growing Options
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon tasks expose a weakness of monolithic tool-use loops: one agent must decompose, execute, and verify a task within a single trajectory. We introduce LAGO, which treats specialized language agents as reusable temporally extended options. A meta-agent retrieves options from a persistent library or spawns new ones, dispatches sub-tasks, verifies results, and admits successful novel options. The library grows across tasks without updating model weights. On 500 SWE-bench Verified tasks, frozen Qwen3.5-35B-A3B in both roles resolves 58.6% under single-attempt evaluation with the official Docker evaluator. On a fixed 150-task subset, we re-run mini-SWE-agent, Terminus 2, and LAGO with the same policy, temperature, task IDs, and evaluator; their resolve rates are 49.3%, 57.3%, and 60.3%, respectively. Cross-model experiments provide evidence consistent with a role for decomposition quality. A 50-task component ablation finds four fewer resolved tasks without decomposition, two fewer with shuffled reused content, and six fewer without the library. These results support reusable agent-options as a practical abstraction for task streams, while leaving component-level causality task- and model-dependent.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 7 figures. Equal contribution: Yuran Wu, Mengkang Hu. Corresponding author: Xu Wang
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LAGO 把专用语言 agent 封装成可复用的时序扩展 option，元 agent 从持久库检索或生成新 option、分派子任务、验证结果并把成功的新 option 收入库中，库跨任务增长且不更新模型权重。在 500 个 SWE-bench Verified 任务上，冻结的 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 双角色配置单次尝试解决率 58.6%；固定 150 任务子集上同策略同温度同评测器对比，LAGO 60.3% 高于 mini-SWE-agent 49.3% 与 Terminus 2 57.3%。
Motivation: 长程任务里单一 tool-use 循环要求一个 agent 在一条轨迹内完成分解、执行与验证，能力受限；作者主张把专用 agent 抽象为可复用 option 来应对任务流。
Method: 将专用语言 agent 作为可复用的时序扩展 options；元 agent 从持久库检索 option 或生成新 option，分派子任务、验证结果、把成功的新 option 收入库中，全程不更新模型权重。评测用官方 Docker evaluator，单次尝试协议，并在固定 150 任务子集上以相同 policy、temperature、task IDs、evaluator 复跑三个系统。
Result: 500 个 SWE-bench Verified 任务上冻结 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 解决率 58.6%（单次尝试，官方 Docker evaluator）。固定 150 任务子集同设置对比：mini-SWE-agent 49.3%、Terminus 2 57.3%、LAGO 60.3%。50 任务组件消融：去掉分解少解 4 个任务，打乱复用内容少 2 个，去掉库少 6 个。跨模型实验提供与分解质量作用一致的证据。
Conclusion: 可复用 agent-options 是任务流场景的实用抽象，但组件级因果贡献随任务与模型而变。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Teaching Agents in their Own Style: Blackbox Teacher Distillation for Web Agents
papers.abstract_en: Frontier web agents using closed models have high inference and computational costs. Smaller open models can be an alternative, but to be performant, they require training supervision from a human or teacher model. Token-level teacher distillation is not an option for closed teachers as it needs access to the model's logits. The standard approach is to imitate teacher demonstrations offline, but it trains the student on states it has never visited, and in a style it does not write in. We introduce WebKD, where the teacher is the editor of the student's failures. Given a failed episode, the teacher finds the first point of mistake, and rewrites the student's reasoning traces, harness states, and actions from that point onward. The editing reveals that the teacher's corrections can be more surprising to the student than the student's own text. WebKD instead aims to edit minimally. In the data space, the teacher writes each correction in the student's style. In the objective space, the reasoning is weighted by its contribution to the action. A role-asymmetric KL anchor allows the corrected action to move freely while keeping the reasoning near the student's prior. On the TimeWarp benchmark, WebKD students gain about 5.5-10.7 pp over behavior cloning, outcome-reward RL, and teacher editing baselines. The performance transfers to unseen versions and to the live web in the OnlineMind2Web benchmark. WebKD opens a new way of distilling black-box models to improve the capabilities of open-weight web agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WebKD 把闭源教师变成学生失败轨迹的编辑者：在失败 episode 中定位第一个错误点，从该点起重写学生的 reasoning trace、harness state 与动作，并要求改写以最小编辑量、用学生自己的风格书写。在 TimeWarp 基准上，WebKD 学生相对行为克隆、outcome-reward RL 与教师编辑基线提升约 5.5–10.7 个百分点，并迁移到未见版本与 OnlineMind2Web 真实网页。
Motivation: 闭源前沿 web agent 推理与算力成本高，小开源模型需要监督才能替代；但 token 级蒸馏需要 logits 而对闭源教师不可用，离线模仿教师演示又让学生学从未到访过的状态、且学到的不是自己的书写风格。
Method: WebKD 流程：给定失败 episode，教师定位第一个错误点并从该处重写 reasoning traces、harness states 和 actions；数据空间上每条改写用学生风格写成，目标空间上按 reasoning 对动作的贡献加权，并用 role-asymmetric KL anchor 让修正后的动作自由移动、同时把 reasoning 拉在学生先验附近。
Result: 在 TimeWarp 基准上，WebKD 学生相对行为克隆 (behavior cloning)、outcome-reward RL 与教师编辑基线提升约 5.5–10.7 pp；性能迁移到未见版本，并迁移到 OnlineMind2Web 的实时网页。
Conclusion: 黑盒教师通过最小化、风格对齐的失败编辑即可蒸馏给开放权重 web agent，无需 logits；教师的逐字纠正对学生往往比学生自己的文本更意外，因此最小编辑是关键。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Rent-Seeking Language Models: Reward Models Set the Prices, Frequent Audits Curb the Rent
papers.abstract_en: Reward model overoptimization in RLHF is usually described as reward hacking. We recast it as rent-seeking: the policy, a firm, earns reward from a regulator, the proxy reward model, that true quality does not back. The lens turns overoptimization into measurable quantities, namely rent, a capture index and deadweight loss, and into testable predictions from the economics of regulation. In a fixed, version-controlled testbed with three model families, accuracy-matched proxy reward models and two gold reward models, RL turns 41% to 66% of its proxy gain into rent while gold reward plateaus. Rent follows each regulator's prices. Neither proxy verifies facts, but one pays for confident specifics and the other for displays of diligence, so RL policies learn to fabricate details about nonexistent entities (97% to 100% of probes) or to deflect factual questions (67% to 98%). Kinship between policy and regulator adds a fixed premium of about 0.1 standard deviations but gives the policy no extra leverage under optimization. At a fixed expected fine, frequent mild audits beat rare severe ones, and random audits are as efficient per audit as targeted ones. Bringing the bunching estimator of tax economics to RL training, we also find a first sign that policies learn to stay just below a targeted audit's threshold.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 RLHF 中的奖励模型过优化重述为寻租 (rent-seeking)：策略是企业，代理奖励模型是监管者，真实质量才是 backing。在固定版本化测试床上，RL 把 41%–66% 的代理增益转化为租金，而 gold reward 触顶；代理奖励为自信的具体细节或勤勉展示付费，策略就学会虚构不存在实体的细节（探针 97%→100%）或回避事实问题（67%→98%）。在期望罚款固定时，高频轻罚优于低频重罚，随机审计与定向审计每次的效率相当。
Motivation: RLHF 的奖励过优化通常被笼统称为 reward hacking，缺少可测量的量和来自监管理论的可检验预测，难以比较不同代理奖励模型各自在为什么付费。
Method: 在固定、版本控制的测试床上用三个模型家族、accuracy-matched 的代理奖励模型与两个 gold reward 模型做 RL 训练，把过优化映射为租金、capture index 与 deadweight loss 三个量；将税收经济学的 bunching estimator 引入 RL 训练以检测策略是否贴着审计阈值下方行为。

papers.title: CTIA-ODE: Continuous-Time Inter-Variable Attention for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Although multivariate time series forecasting has broad application prospects, effectively incorporating exogenous variables remains challenging. Prevailing discrete-time architectures often impose rigid temporal alignment across heterogeneous variables, which may limit their ability to capture continuously evolving external effects. To address this limitation, we introduce CTIA-ODE, a continuous-time forecasting framework centered on Continuous-Time Inter-Variable Attention (CTIA). Specifically, CTIA is embedded within an ordinary differential equation (ODE) solver, enabling the continuously evolving endogenous trajectory to dynamically query a static exogenous context along the integration path without requiring explicit temporal alignment. To improve the stability of the continuous latent dynamics, we further introduce a dual-stabilization strategy: architecturally, a Linear Residual Augmentation (LRA) module provides a macroscopic trend anchor, while an Outlier-Robust Hybrid Loss (ORHL) mitigates the influence of heavy-tailed anomalies during optimization. Extensive experiments across eight real-world datasets demonstrate that CTIA-ODE achieves state-of-the-art forecasting performance across diverse datasets and prediction horizons, while maintaining a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off with a compact memory footprint and low inference latency, particularly under long-horizon forecasting settings. Anonymous code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CTIA-ODE-15A6/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CTIA-ODE：把连续时间变量间注意力 (Continuous-Time Inter-Variable Attention) 嵌入 ODE 求解器，让内生轨迹沿积分路径动态查询静态外生上下文，无需显式时间对齐。在八个真实数据集上跨多种预测跨度取得 SOTA 精度，同时保持紧凑显存与低推理延迟。
Motivation: 离散时间架构对异构变量施加刚性时间对齐，难以刻画连续演化的外生影响，外生变量难以有效纳入多变量时序预测。
Method: CTIA 嵌入 ODE 求解器，内生轨迹沿积分路径查询静态外生上下文；双稳定策略：Linear Residual Augmentation (LRA) 提供宏观趋势锚点，Outlier-Robust Hybrid Loss (ORHL) 在优化中抑制重尾异常。
Result: 在八个真实世界数据集上，跨多样数据集与预测跨度达到 SOTA 预测性能，并在长预测跨度下保持紧凑显存占用与低推理延迟的精度-效率折中。
Conclusion: 连续时间框架加双稳定策略可在长跨度多变量预测上同时拿到 SOTA 精度与低开销。

papers.title: DarKnight: Retrieval-Guided Agentic Framework for Breaking Dark Web CAPTCHA Gates
papers.abstract_en: Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) investigators who monitor dark web marketplaces for leaked credentials and breach listings must pass the diverse CAPTCHAs that operators deploy to block automated collection. Existing solvers either need unscalable per-site fine-tuning or rely on commercial Vision-Language Model (VLM) APIs, which surrender operational sovereignty: provider policies, Tor-exit blocking, government regulation, or model updates outside the investigator's control can halt or alter the solver overnight, and per-call costs recur with every session and retry. We present DarKnight, a self-improving agentic framework designed to run on a single workstation GPU inside an investigator's Tor crawler and solve CAPTCHAs with small, locally hosted open-weight VLMs that no provider decision can withdraw, without per-market training or third-party services. For each CAPTCHA, DarKnight retrieves successful and failed past attempts on similar images (dual-signal RAG), composes an image-specific preprocessing pipeline, and learns from the site's pass/fail verdict. In a case study on four real-world dark web marketplaces, agentic tool selection outperformed parameter scaling. A deployable open-weight VLM with DarKnight reached 83.2\% on the most heavily defended market, 37.2 percentage points above its base model, outperforming even the frontier Claude Opus~5 (44%). DarKnight recovered 48.2% of baseline failures at a 7.6% degeneration cost, indicating that selective tool use can avoid much of the degradation caused by uniform preprocessing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DarKnight 是跑在调查者单机 GPU 与 Tor 爬虫内的自改进 CAPTCHA 求解框架：用本地开源权重 VLM，按图像检索历史成败尝试（dual-signal RAG）组合预处理流水线，并从站点 pass/fail 判定中学习。在四个真实暗网市场案例中，最严防市场达 83.2%，比其基座模型高 37.2 个百分点，超过 Claude Opus 5 的 44%。
Motivation: 暗网市场 CTI 采集必须过 CAPTCHA，现有求解器要么逐站微调不可扩展，要么依赖商业 VLM API，供应商政策、Tor 出口封锁、监管与模型更新随时可让求解器失效且按次计费。
Method: DarKnight 在单工作站 GPU 上托管小型开源权重 VLM：对每张 CAPTCHA 用 dual-signal RAG 检索相似图像的历史成功与失败尝试，据此组装图像专属预处理流水线，并从站点 pass/fail 判定中自我改进，无需逐市场训练或第三方服务。
Result: 四个真实暗网市场案例中，agentic 工具选择优于参数规模扩大；可部署开源权重 VLM 加 DarKnight 在防守最严市场达 83.2%，比基座模型高 37.2 个百分点，并超过前沿 Claude Opus 5 的 44%；恢复了基线失败的 48.2%，退化代价 7.6%。
Conclusion: 选择性使用预处理工具能避免统一预处理带来的大部分退化，本地开源 VLM 加检索引导的 agentic 流水线可在不依赖商业 API 的情况下超过前沿闭源模型。

papers.title: MAPLE: A Multi-Axis Parametric Knowledge Extraction Lens for LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: LLMs absorb vast knowledge from training data, yet their inherently probabilistic nature offers no guarantee that this knowledge will surface in their outputs. To bridge this gap, Knowledge Extraction Enhancement (KEE) techniques such as activation steering, decoding adjustments, and prompting modify inference, potentially reinforcing existing predictions or surfacing less accessible answers. Yet their evaluations centered on aggregate accuracy, which obscures diverse effects by collapsing recovered failures and disrupted successes into a single score. We introduce MAPLE, a unified framework for characterizing how KEE techniques affect parametric knowledge extraction. Its diagnostic metrics disentangle these effects at the surface, probability, and beyond-sampling levels by measuring answer recovery and disruption, gold-token rank shifts on unrecovered failures, and recovery of answers missed by fixed-budget sampling. We evaluate six KEE techniques spanning decoding, activation steering, and prompting across three model families: OLMo2, Qwen2.5, and Llama3. Our analysis reveals distinct effects and trade-offs across techniques, highlighting the value of MAPLE for understanding and comparing KEE beyond aggregate accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAPLE 把 LLM 的知识提取增强 (KEE) 技术评测从单一聚合准确率拆成恢复与破坏两个方向，在 surface、probability、beyond-sampling 三个层面分别度量答案恢复/破坏、未恢复失败上 gold-token 的排名变化，以及固定采样预算下漏检答案的恢复。对解码、activation steering、prompting 三类共六种 KEE 技术、跨 OLMo2/Qwen2.5/Llama3 三个模型家族的分析显示各技术效果与权衡明显不同。
Motivation: KEE 评测长期只看聚合准确率，把被恢复的失败和被破坏的成功压进同一个分数，掩盖了技术之间方向相反、彼此权衡的真实效应。
Method: 提出统一诊断框架 MAPLE，三层指标分别度量：surface 层的答案 recovery 与 disruption，probability 层在未恢复失败上测 gold-token rank 位移，beyond-sampling 层测固定采样预算下原本漏检答案的恢复；评测覆盖解码、activation steering、prompting 三类共六种 KEE 技术，模型为 OLMo2、Qwen2.5、Llama3。
Result: 在 OLMo2、Qwen2.5、Llama3 三个模型家族上评测六种 KEE 技术后，分析揭示各技术具有不同的效应与权衡，说明聚合准确率会把恢复与破坏混为一谈。
Conclusion: KEE 技术的比较必须在聚合准确率之外按恢复与破坏分维度进行，MAPLE 提供了这样一套可跨技术、跨模型家族对照的诊断口径。

papers.title: What Matters for World Modeling in Vision-Language-Action Models?
papers.abstract_en: Integrating world models into Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) has emerged as a promising direction, enabling policies to anticipate future dynamics beyond reactive observation-to-action mapping. However, existing approaches vary simultaneously in their world representations, integration paradigms, and policy backbones, making it difficult to determine what truly matters for effective world model integration. To disentangle these factors, we categorize existing efforts into four representative paradigms, namely Implicit Future Alignment, Explicit Future Query, MoT Future Expert, and External World Predictor. We instantiate each within a unified framework and systematically evaluate these paradigms with diverse world representations and policy backbones across in-domain, out-of-domain, long-horizon, dynamic, few-shot, and real-world settings. Our study yields four main findings: 1) world representation effectiveness is paradigm-dependent, whereas 2D semantic representations offer robust, cross-paradigm gains; 2) no single paradigm is universally optimal, yet the decoupled MoT Future Expert offers competitive overall performance, particularly in OOD robustness; 3) world modeling consistently benefits policies built on standard VLMs, while decoupled designs exhibit greater compatibility with pretrained VLAs; and 4) world modeling improves performance over action-only baselines across multiple settings, with notable gains on long-horizon and dynamic tasks. Project page and video demonstrations are available at https://dylanmqs.github.io/WM-in-VLAs/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把世界模型接入 VLA 的四类范式（Implicit Future Alignment、Explicit Future Query、MoT Future Expert、External World Predictor）放进统一框架做对照，结论是世界表征的效果取决于范式，但 2D 语义表征在各范式下都稳定带来增益；解耦的 MoT Future Expert 整体竞争力最强，尤其在 OOD 鲁棒性上。世界建模相对 action-only 基线在多种设置下都提升性能，长时程与动态任务增益最明显。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 世界模型工作在世界表征、集成范式、policy backbone 三个维度上同时变化，无法判断究竟哪个因素真正决定集成效果。
Method: 将已有工作归为四类范式并在统一框架中逐一实例化，配合多种世界表征与 policy backbone，在 in-domain、out-of-domain、长时程、动态、few-shot 与真实机器人设置上做系统对照评估。
Result: 四项发现：世界表征有效性随范式而变，2D 语义表征提供跨范式的稳健增益；无单一范式普遍最优，解耦的 MoT Future Expert 整体表现有竞争力、OOD 鲁棒性尤其突出；基于标准 VLM 的 policy 从世界建模中持续受益，解耦设计与预训练 VLA 兼容性更好；相对 action-only 基线在多个设置上均提升，长时程与动态任务增益显著。
Conclusion: 世界模型对 VLA 的收益是真实的但依赖设计选择：表征选 2D 语义最稳，范式没有通吃者，解耦 MoT 路线更适合要 OOD 鲁棒性的场景。

papers.title: PhyMetric: Diagnosing Physical Plausibility in Text-to-Video Generation via Scene-Level QA
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-video (T2V) generation models can produce visually realistic videos that nevertheless violate the physical consequences implied by the prompt and scene. Existing benchmarks largely rely on holistic plausibility scores or broad quality dimensions, leaving it unclear which physical behavior is being tested and why a model fails. We introduce PhyMetric, a scene-level diagnostic benchmark that recasts physical plausibility evaluation as verifiable, scene-grounded question answering. PhyMetric contains 1{,}115 scenes spanning 50 physical categories across six domains, paired with 8{,}920 answer-balanced binary questions over 12 evaluation dimensions. Each scene is associated with eight targeted yes/no questions and a structured physical prior specifying the governing law, expected temporal sequence, observable signatures, and common failure modes. At evaluation time, a vision-language model (VLM) judge answers each question from question-aware sampled frames conditioned on the prior, and correctness is hierarchically aggregated into scene, dimension, physical category, and model scores. Experiments on four open-source T2V models and three VLM judges show that scene-specific binary QA is a critical component of the protocol: when each targeted question is replaced by a single generic plausibility query, evaluator accuracy drops to the chance level. Structured physical priors offer a complementary signal that improves human alignment of the resulting scores, with effects that vary across VLM judges of different capacity. These findings establish PhyMetric as a benchmark that turns physical plausibility evaluation from opaque holistic scoring into interpretable, scene-level inspection. Our project page is available at: https://mengsiwei.github.io/PhyMetric/.

papers.title: JointServe: Serving Multi-Model Agents on Memory-Constrained GPUs
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are evolving from a single model calling tools to planners that orchestrate multiple expert models whose capabilities live in distinct weights. This shift breaks a hidden assumption of today's serving systems: that the working set of models fits in GPU memory. On the memory-constrained GPUs typical of private and edge deployments, naive whole-model swapping serializes weight transfer with computation and, without host-backed KV restoration, discards session state at a switch. We present JointServe, a serving system that treats weight shards and KV blocks as residency objects competing for one unified memory budget. JointServe exploits three structural properties of agent workloads (directed calls, gapped execution, and dual-state residency) to prepare models before they are called: an intent signal parsed from the caller's own output stream triggers prefetch during generation, partial k* residency reduces switching to incremental layers, and a preemptive transfer scheduler protects live-session KV with a guaranteed bandwidth share. A carve-out control step adjusts the weight/KV allocation as workload demands change. Evaluations show that JointServe reduces session completion time by 21.7% over the strongest whole-model swap baseline and stays usable in a crash regime where every whole-model swap baseline fails to finish (a 46-fold gap). On replayed SWE-bench, tau-bench, and OSWorld traces, it cuts session completion time by up to 49% and lifts SLO attainment from 2.8-24.5% to 76.8-100%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JointServe 把多模型 agent 的权重分片与 KV 块当作同一显存预算下的驻留对象，利用调用是有向的、执行有间隙、双状态需驻留这三个结构特性，在模型被调用前预取：从调用方输出流解析意图信号触发生成期预取，用部分 k* 驻留把切换降为增量层传输，并用保证带宽份额的抢占式调度保护在会话 KV。相比最强整模型换出基线会话完成时间降 21.7%，在崩溃场景下所有整模型换出基线都无法完成（46 倍差距）；在回放的 SWE-bench、tau-bench、OSWorld 轨迹上完成时间最多降 49%，SLO 达成率从 2.8–24.5% 提到 76.8–100%。
Motivation: LLM agent 正从单模型调工具转向编排多个各有权重的专家模型，而现有服务系统默认工作集能装进 GPU 显存；在私有与边缘部署的显存受限 GPU 上，朴素整模型换出让权重传输与计算串行，且无 host 侧 KV 恢复时切换即丢会话状态。
Method: JointServe 将权重分片与 KV 块统一为一个显存预算下的驻留对象：解析调用方自身输出流中的意图信号在生成期间触发预取；以部分 k* 驻留把模型切换化为增量层传输；用保证带宽份额的抢占式传输调度器保护活跃会话的 KV；再由 carve-out 控制步随负载变化调整权重与 KV 的分配。
Result: 会话完成时间比最强整模型换出基线降 21.7%；在崩溃场景下所有整模型换出基线均无法完成任务，差距为 46 倍；在回放的 SWE-bench、tau-bench、OSWorld 轨迹上完成时间最多降 49%，SLO 达成率从 2.8–24.5% 升至 76.8–100%。
Conclusion: 把权重与 KV 放进同一显存预算并按 agent 调用结构提前准备模型，能在显存受限 GPU 上同时压低会话完成时间并把 SLO 达成率拉到可用水平，而整模型换出在崩溃场景下根本跑不完。

papers.title: ActionOPD: Distilling Decisions, Not Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Distilling capable language-model agents into smaller models requires aligning the student's behavior with the teacher's. This raises a fundamental question: at which states and at what granularity should this alignment be performed? Offline imitation provides dense but token-specific supervision and can suffer from state-distribution mismatch. Token-level on-policy distillation (OPD) addresses this mismatch but typically requires teacher token probabilities and compatible tokenization. We argue that semantic actions provide a natural unit of supervision for agent distillation. We introduce ActionOPD, an action-level on-policy distillation method motivated by maximizing expected teacher-action likelihood at student-encountered states. At each such state, ActionOPD samples actions from both the student and a black-box teacher, rewarding student actions according to their semantic agreement with the sampled teacher actions. Through policy optimization, ActionOPD aligns the student's action-level behavior with the teacher's decisions without requiring reproduction of teacher-written reasoning or access to teacher token probabilities. Training Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with two teachers on diverse, curated tool-use tasks yields average gains of 3.3-6.9 percentage points across four out-of-distribution benchmarks. ActionOPD scales favorably with student size and teacher capability, without requiring the teacher and student to share a model family or tokenizer. On $τ^2$-bench, ActionOPD achieves competitive performance against offline distillation and token-level OPD. We further explore Self-ActionOPD with a same-model teacher and privileged context. These results establish ActionOPD as a promising approach to agent distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ActionOPD 把语言模型 agent 的蒸馏单位从 token 换成语义动作：在学生实际到达的状态上，同时从学生与黑盒教师采样动作，按语义一致性给学生动作打分，再用策略优化对齐行为。训练 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-8B、配两个教师，在四个分布外 benchmark 上平均提升 3.3–6.9 个百分点，且不要求师生共享模型族或 tokenizer。
Motivation: 离线模仿监督稠密但逐 token、且有状态分布失配；token 级 on-policy 蒸馏 (OPD) 缓解失配却需要教师 token 概率与兼容分词，黑盒教师用不了。
Method: ActionOPD：在学生访问到的状态上从学生与黑盒教师各采样动作，按语义一致性 (semantic agreement) 给学生动作奖励，用策略优化最大化该状态下的教师动作似然；不要求复现教师推理文本，也不访问教师 token 概率。另探索 Self-ActionOPD，用同模型教师加特权上下文。
Result: 在多样化的 curated tool-use 任务上训练 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-8B、配两个教师，四个 out-of-distribution benchmark 平均提升 3.3–6.9 个百分点；在 τ²-bench 上与离线蒸馏和 token 级 OPD 相比性能有竞争力；增益随学生规模与教师能力扩展更 favorable。
Conclusion: 语义动作是 agent 蒸馏的合适监督单位：黑盒教师、跨模型族与跨 tokenizer 也能对齐行为决策，而不必复现教师的 token 级输出。
