papers.title: One Monitor Does Not Fit All: Formalism-Agnostic Runtime Verification for Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems combine model decisions, mutable state, tool calls, and delegation to external agents. Monitoring them requires observations from different execution boundaries, while prevention requires control before an operation produces its effect. We present AgenticRV, a runtime-verification architecture that separates these boundaries from the monitoring formalism. Adapters emit canonical events; each monitor receives its own projection and abstraction; and a decision policy uses normalised verdicts to select a reaction supported by the responsible adapter. We formalise when observations suffice, monitor replacement preserves decisions, and blocking prevents unsafe effects. We also distinguish rejected attempts from completed effects, avoiding the assumption that a blocked request must leave every monitor in a permanent violation state. The Python implementation supports LangGraph, MCP, and A2A. A controlled LangGraph experiment combines an external Reelay temporal monitor with a programmatic report monitor; ablations show why both are needed for the selected requirements. Differential checks and cross-adapter tests provide further integration evidence. An LLM-driven incident-response example illustrates the same enforcement path, while existing microbenchmarks isolate framework costs. The results support reuse of monitoring methods at explicit control boundaries, subject to the stated observation and deployment assumptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AgenticRV：把 Agentic AI 的执行边界观测与监控形式化解耦，适配器发规范事件、各监控器取自己的投影与抽象、决策策略用归一化裁决选择反应。形式化给出观测充分性、监控器替换保持决策、阻塞防止不安全效果的条件，并区分被拒绝的尝试与已完成的效果。
Motivation: Agentic AI 混合模型决策、可变状态、工具调用与外部代理委派，观测来自不同执行边界，而防护要求在操作产生效果之前完成控制；现有监控与具体形式化和边界绑定，难以复用。
Method: AgenticRV 架构：适配器发出规范事件，每个监控器接收自己的投影与抽象，决策策略用归一化裁决选择由责任适配器支持的反应；形式化证明观测充分性、监控器替换保持决策、阻塞防止不安全效果，并区分被拒绝尝试与已完成效果。Python 实现支持 LangGraph、MCP 与 A2A。
Result: 受控 LangGraph 实验组合外部 Reelay 时序监控器与程序化报告监控器，消融显示对所选需求两者都必需；差分检查与跨适配器测试提供集成证据；LLM 驱动的事件响应示例演示同一执行路径，既有微基准用于隔离框架开销。
Conclusion: 在显式控制边界上监控方法可以复用，前提是满足所声明的观测与部署假设；阻塞不应让所有监控器停留在永久违规状态。

papers.title: When Does Depth Help? Understanding Layerwise Inference in Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on small to medium-sized tabular prediction tasks while processing diverse inputs through a shared stack of layers. Recent layerwise analyses identify strong predictive performance in early TFM representations and substantial overlap in computation across layers. However, early predictive accessibility alone does not establish whether later layers are dispensable for every input, and aggregate accuracy can obscure which inputs benefit from additional computation. We study all 24 in-context-learning layers of TabPFN-3 across 272 classification datasets, combining representation geometry, prediction trajectories, truncation, and structural interventions, while also examining related representation dynamics in four additional TFMs. We uncover a pronounced expansion-compression trajectory, with stronger late dimensional contraction associated with larger increases in class-prototype separation. A targeted analysis of early-stabilizing samples shows that substantial representational changes persist after predicted classes stabilize, while locally ambiguous queries obtain larger accuracy gains from shallow to late layers than well-separated queries. Repeating a single pretrained block or perturbing layer order reduces predictive performance on average, constraining simple post-hoc substitutions in the frozen model. These findings distinguish predictive accessibility, class stability, and the benefits of continuing computation, supporting an input-dependent assessment of depthwise redundancy in TFMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 TabPFN-3 全部 24 个 in-context-learning 层、272 个分类数据集做逐层剖析，发现表征沿“先扩张后压缩”轨迹演化，晚期维度收缩越强、类原型分离度提升越大；局部模糊查询从浅层到深层的准确率增益显著高于已良好分离的查询，因此深度冗余是输入相关的，不能按聚合准确率一刀切。
Motivation: 近期逐层分析显示 TFM 早期表征已具强预测力且各层计算高度重叠，但早期可预测性不能证明后续层对所有输入都可省，聚合准确率也会掩盖哪些输入真正受益于额外计算。
Method: 在 TabPFN-3 的 24 个 ICL 层上组合四种手段：表征几何分析、预测轨迹追踪、逐层截断 (truncation)、结构干预（重复单个预训练 block、扰动层序），覆盖 272 个分类数据集，并在另外四个 TFM 上考察相关表征动力学。
Result: 发现显著的 expansion-compression 轨迹，晚期维度收缩越强对应类原型分离度增幅越大；早期即稳定的样本在预测类别稳定后仍持续发生大幅表征变化；局部模糊查询从浅层到深层的准确率增益大于良好分离查询；重复单个预训练 block 或打乱层序会平均降低预测性能。

papers.title: VaryST: Generalizable Spatio-Temporal Forecasting Beyond the Closed-World Setting
papers.abstract_en: Spatio-temporal forecasting is fundamental to many real-world systems, yet deployment environments are inherently varying: temporal distributions may evolve, spatial domains may change, and observation availability may shift from training conditions. Existing models are often tightly coupled to their training environments through node-specific representations, predefined spatial support sets, and reliance on consistently available observations, limiting generalization to changing environments. To this end, we propose VaryST, a compact spatio-temporal forecasting model trained from scratch that achieves strong generalization by dynamically constructing predictive context from available long-term observations. To accommodate temporal changes, VaryST derives node representations from long-term histories, capturing current behavior in the context of longer-term patterns. To adapt to spatial changes, it dynamically selects functionally relevant support nodes beyond predefined neighborhoods and integrates their information with recent and long-term target states and global context. To handle varying observation availability, VaryST selectively masks historical patches on which the model relies most during training, encouraging it to exploit alternative temporal and spatial dependencies for accurate forecasting when key observations become unavailable. Extensive experiments on six real-world datasets against seventeen baselines show that VaryST achieves strong in-domain forecasting accuracy, substantially improves zero- and few-shot generalization under spatial and temporal changes, and remains robust to varying observation availability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VaryST 是一个从零训练的紧凑时空预测模型，靠长期历史推导节点表征、动态挑选功能相关的 support 节点、并在训练中有选择地屏蔽模型最依赖的历史 patch，从而脱离训练环境的节点与邻域绑定。在六个真实数据集、十七个基线上，它保持强的 in-domain 精度，并在空间与时间分布变化下显著提升 zero-shot 与 few-shot 泛化，对观测缺失保持稳健。
Motivation: 部署环境的时间分布会漂移、空间域会变化、观测可用性也会偏离训练条件，而现有模型通过节点专属表征、预定义空间支撑集和固定观测依赖与训练环境强耦合，泛化受限。
Method: VaryST 从长期历史推导节点表征以捕捉当前行为在长周期模式中的位置；动态选择超出预定义邻域的功能相关 support 节点，与近期、长期目标状态及全局上下文融合；训练时对模型最依赖的历史 patch 做选择性掩码 (selective masking)，逼迫模型改用替代的时间与空间依赖。
Result: 在六个真实世界数据集上对比十七个基线：in-domain 预测精度强；在空间与时间变化下 zero-shot 与 few-shot 泛化显著提升；在观测可用性变化时保持稳健。
Conclusion: 把节点表征、支撑节点选择和观测依赖都做成由可用长期观测动态构造的预测上下文，是时空预测走出 closed-world 设定、适应环境变化的可行路径。

papers.title: Calibration and Risk-Budgeted Decisions with System One Models
papers.abstract_en: LLM workflows and agents rely on a set of binary decisions like allow/block an input, or discard/retain a retrieved document. When human deferral is unavailable, uncertain cases must still receive an action. We study System One decision scores in this setting by defaulting to a conservative fallback when uncertain, and controlling the false omission risk within the subset of inputs assigned the utility-maximizing action. Across six datasets covering moderation, safety, and reranking, we compare general System One models with task baselines and a local open-weights fine-tuned System One model. We show that naive baselines for threshold selection exceed the target risk in roughly half of settings with defined test risk, compared with 7.8\% for Learn Then Test (LTT), which leverages finite-sample statistical guarantees. Our results show why relying on a probability-like interface is insufficient for deployment decisions and how risk-budgeted selection trades useful action against observed error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 工作流中 allow/block、丢弃/保留检索文档这类二元决策，在无人工兜底时用保守回退处理不确定样本，并把被指派效用最大化动作的子集的 false omission risk 控制在预算内。在覆盖内容审核、安全与重排序的六个数据集上，朴素阈值选择在约一半有定义测试风险的设定中超出目标风险，而 Learn Then Test (LTT) 仅 7.8%。
Motivation: LLM agent 的部署决策需要在没有人工兜底时对不确定输入仍给出动作，同时保证错误风险不超预算；仅凭概率式接口选阈值无法提供有限样本保证。
Method: 研究 System One 决策分数：不确定时默认保守回退，并对获得效用最大化动作的子集控制 false omission risk；对比通用 System One 模型、任务基线与本地开源权重微调的 System One 模型，阈值选择用 Learn Then Test (LTT) 的有限样本统计保证。
Result: 在六个覆盖 moderation、safety、reranking 的数据集上，朴素阈值选择在约一半有定义测试风险的设定中超出目标风险，LTT 为 7.8%。
Conclusion: 概率式接口不足以支撑部署决策，风险预算化的阈值选择才能在有用动作与观测错误之间做可保证的权衡。

papers.title: ReproBAIT: Can coding agents build their own biological AI tools?
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly competent at leveraging scientific knowledge and existing computational tools to execute complex workflows. At present, little information exists on their ability to reconstruct tools when given limited descriptions of such tools. We introduce an evaluation titled ReproBAIT (Reproducing Biological AI Tools), which measures the ability of coding agents to design, implement, and train biological AI tools taken from published research across a range of information access conditions. The coding agent is securely sandboxed without internet access and receives training data, a fixed time and compute budget, and limited information about the tool to replicate. We then score the reproduced biological AI tool based on its performance (tool-specific metrics) on held-out data. We evaluated a set of biological AI tools of varying complexities: ProteinMPNN, an inverse protein folding tool, RFdiffusion3, an all-atom generative diffusion tool, and a closed-source molecular design tool. We institute a methodology to check for memorisation, as the open source tools are likely to be included in models' pretraining corpus. Across a range of leading closed- and open-source coding agents, we find substantial reproduction capability for some selected tools, though limited capability for a highly complex tool. We find moderate evidence consistent with memorisation, varying across coding agents. These results suggest that tool developers need to be increasingly cautious when releasing information about the tools publicly; re-creation of the tool based on such information could undermine a tool's commercial value or invalidate dual-use managed access strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ReproBAIT 评测：让无联网、被沙箱化的 coding agent 在固定时间与算力预算下，仅凭有限描述重新设计、实现并训练已发表的生物 AI 工具，再用留出数据上的工具专属指标打分。结果发现部分工具可被较好复现，而高度复杂的工具复现能力有限，并存在随 agent 而异的中等程度记忆化证据。
Motivation: 大模型已能利用科学知识和现有计算工具执行复杂流程，但在描述受限时能否重建工具本身几乎没有证据；这直接关系到公开发布工具信息是否会削弱其商业价值或使双用途受控访问策略失效。
Method: 构建 ReproBAIT 评测：coding agent 在无互联网的安全沙箱中运行，获得训练数据、固定时间与算力预算以及关于目标工具的有限信息，随后在留出数据上按工具专属指标评分；被测工具包括逆向蛋白折叠工具 ProteinMPNN、全原子生成式扩散工具 RFdiffusion3 和一个闭源分子设计工具，并专门设计了记忆化检查方法，因为开源工具很可能出现在模型预训练语料中。
Result: 在多个领先的闭源与开源 coding agent 上，对部分所选工具表现出可观的复现能力，但对一个高度复杂的工具能力有限；记忆化证据为中等程度，且在不同 coding agent 之间存在差异。
Conclusion: coding agent 已能在受限信息下重建相当一部分已发表的生物 AI 工具，因此工具开发者公开发布信息时需更加谨慎，否则复现可能侵蚀商业价值或使双用途受控访问策略失效。

papers.title: Efficient contextual partial monitoring with general function approximation
papers.abstract_en: We study finite stochastic partial monitoring (PM) games with side information, a paradigm of sequential learning with partial feedback. On each round $t \in [T]$, both player and environment observe a context and player chooses an action and environment simultaneously chooses an outcome. The player neither observes the outcome nor the loss; instead, they only observe a feedback symbol which is partially informative about the outcome. We utilize the Estimation-to-Decisions (E2D) meta-algorithm of Foster et al.(2021) to design E2D.PMSide, a computationally efficient framework for contextual partial monitoring, which uses an online regression oracle to efficiently estimate the outcome distributions based on historical (context, action, feedback symbol) tuples. Since the exploration rule given by the original E2D algorithm is intractable to compute, we propose two computationally efficient exploration rules that achieve optimal regret orders in $T$: in the globally observable setting, our exploration rule is based on $ε$-greedy, while in the locally observable setting, our exploration rule uses inverse gap weighting (Foster & Rakhlin, 2020), which was previously only known to be effective in the bandit setting. We show that a variant of E2D.PMSide named OE2D.PMSide can be combined with offline regression oracles to give an efficient algorithm with optimal regret when the contexts are drawn independently from a fixed distribution. We evaluate our algorithm on a synthetic label-efficient prediction game and an LLM routing task, in which a learner decides from prompt, uncertainty, and internal state features whether to escalate a query from a weak model to a strong one. We show that our method has superior performance to prior approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在带上下文的有限随机 partial monitoring (PM) 中，E2D.PMSide 用在线回归 oracle 从历史 (context, action, feedback symbol) 三元组估计结果分布，并提出两条可计算的探索规则：全局可观测用 ε-greedy，局部可观测用 inverse gap weighting，两者都达到 T 的最优 regret 阶。上下文独立同分布时，OE2D.PMSide 配离线回归 oracle 同样给出高效最优 regret；在合成 label-efficient prediction game 与 LLM routing 任务上性能优于已有方法。
Motivation: 带上下文的 partial monitoring 中，原始 E2D 的探索规则不可计算，而局部可观测情形此前只有 bandit 场景下的 inverse gap weighting 可用，缺少既高效又保序的通用算法。
Method: 基于 Foster et al. (2021) 的 Estimation-to-Decisions (E2D) 元算法构造 E2D.PMSide：用在线回归 oracle 估计结果分布，替换不可计算的探索规则为 ε-greedy（全局可观测）与 inverse gap weighting（局部可观测，Foster & Rakhlin 2020）；另给出变体 OE2D.PMSide，改用离线回归 oracle 处理上下文来自固定分布的情形。
Result: 两条探索规则在 T 上达到最优 regret 阶；OE2D.PMSide 在上下文独立同分布时以离线回归 oracle 给出高效最优 regret。在合成 label-efficient prediction game 与 LLM routing 任务（依据 prompt、uncertainty、internal state 特征决定是否把查询从弱模型升级到强模型）上，性能优于先前方法。
Conclusion: 可计算的探索规则足以在带上下文的 partial monitoring 中保住最优 regret 阶，inverse gap weighting 的有效性可从 bandit 推广到局部可观测 PM；上下文同分布时离线回归 oracle 即可。

papers.title: Improving Category-Aware Active Domain Adaptation via Uncertainty-Guided Region Coverage
papers.abstract_en: Active domain adaptation researches focus on alleviating the annotation cost, which comprises source data and target data labelling, as well as enhancing the performance of unsupervised domain adaptation. However, optimizing the adaptation model based on the average accuracy can lead to the drop in performance of some difficult categories. To overcome this issue, a point-wise selection strategy built upon the influence function can be used to improve domain adaptation performance. In our work, we first address the sensitive and redundant aspects of point-wise selection, which can lead to overfitting of the acquisition function. We thus introduce a region-based approach that ensures the improvement of the adaptation model by maximizing a positive manifold coverage. An uncertainty score is further introduced to the selection mechanism to learn a better decision boundary for the target domain. In comprehensive experiments, our proposed method surpasses the first category-aware active domain adaptation baseline as well as existing active domain adaptation methods across multiple domain adaptation benchmarks. Our implementation is available at: https://github.com/nhtm2702/WHO IS NEXT.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对类别感知主动域适应中逐点选择易敏感、冗余并使采集函数过拟合的问题，提出基于区域的正流形覆盖 (positive manifold coverage) 最大化策略，并在选择机制中加入不确定性分数以学习目标域更好的决策边界。在多个域适应基准上超过首个类别感知主动域适应基线及已有主动域适应方法。
Motivation: 按平均精度优化适应模型会让困难类别性能下降；基于影响函数的逐点选择又敏感且冗余，容易使采集函数过拟合。
Method: 用基于区域的选择替代逐点选择，通过最大化正流形覆盖保证适应模型改进；在选择机制中引入不确定性分数辅助学习目标域决策边界，出发点是影响函数驱动的逐点选择策略。
Result: 在多个域适应基准 (domain adaptation benchmarks) 的综合实验中，超过首个类别感知主动域适应基线以及已有主动域适应方法；实现见 github.com/nhtm2702/WHO IS NEXT。
Conclusion: 以区域覆盖加不确定性引导的样本选择能缓解逐点选择的敏感与冗余，改善类别感知的主动域适应表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Asymptotically Exact Negative Guidance of Diffusion Models via Positive-Unlabeled Learning
papers.abstract_en: Negative guidance of diffusion models generates samples that avoid an undesired condition, specified either by reference samples or by a conditional score alongside an unconditional model. Existing methods inject repulsive terms derived from local information at each sample, so the resulting sampler does not target an explicit density, and its bias cannot be systematically reduced by increasing computation. We instead present a negative-guidance method that samples from an explicit target density, which uniformly handles both reference-sample and score-based specifications and suppresses probability mass near the undesired condition with an avoidance strength that parametrizes the target density itself. Realizing this target requires estimating, at each diffusion timestep, how likely each sample is to belong to the undesired condition. We cast this estimation as a Positive-Unlabeled learning problem that admits lightweight online training along the diffusion trajectory, using condition samples as positives and diffusion particles as unlabeled data. Because the guided particles drift from the unconditional marginal, we further correct the residual mismatch via Sequential Monte Carlo, yielding a sampler that is asymptotically exact in the particle limit and that turns any existing negative-guidance method into its proposal kernel. Empirically, our method approaches the ground-truth target on Gaussian mixtures and Pareto-dominates existing methods on trade-offs between avoidance and generation quality, distributional bias, and diversity, including in an image-generation setting with a pretrained score network.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 现有扩散模型负向引导 (negative guidance) 在每个采样点注入基于局部信息的排斥项，采样器不对应任何显式密度，偏差无法靠增加计算量系统性削减。本文把目标写成带回避强度参数的显式密度，用 Positive-Unlabeled learning 在扩散轨迹上在线估计样本属于不期望条件的概率，再用 Sequential Monte Carlo 校正粒子漂移，在粒子数极限下渐近精确，并可把任意已有负向引导方法当作提议核。
Motivation: 负向引导的排斥项只用局部信息，采样器不针对显式密度，其偏差不随计算量增加而系统性减小；参考样本式与条件分数式两种不期望条件设定也缺少统一处理。
Method: 构造以回避强度参数化的显式目标密度，统一处理参考样本与条件分数两种设定；把「样本属于不期望条件的可能性」估计建模为 Positive-Unlabeled learning，用条件样本作正例、扩散粒子作无标签数据，沿扩散轨迹做轻量在线训练；再用 Sequential Monte Carlo 校正引导粒子相对无条件边缘的残余失配，使任意已有负向引导方法成为提议核。
Result: 在 Gaussian mixture 上方法逼近真实目标密度；在回避强度与生成质量、分布偏差、多样性之间的权衡上 Pareto 优于已有方法，包括使用预训练 score network 的图像生成设定。
Conclusion: 把负向引导改写为显式目标密度加 PU 估计与 SMC 校正，可以在粒子数极限下实现渐近精确采样，并把任意已有负向引导方法复用为提议核。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Perception to Action Rules through Reinforcement Learning for Theory-of-Mind Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: In Theory-of-Mind (ToM) reasoning, large language models may correctly infer the agent's mental state but fail to use that inference when predicting or judging the agent's subsequent actions. In this work, we investigate whether explicitly connecting perception, belief, and action with rules improves ToM reasoning. We generate concise \textit{if--then} rules that express relations between perception to action and use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to train Qwen2.5 and Llama3 models across four ToM benchmarks. GRPO with rule generation outperforms prompting, supervised fine-tuning, and think reasoning. Moreover, rules generated by larger models ($\geq$3B) provide transferable knowledge that improves downstream performance of GPT-4o-mini. These findings suggest that explicit rules help models bridge the reasoning gap in ToM and support knowledge transfer across models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Theory-of-Mind (ToM) 推理中，用 GRPO 训练 Qwen2.5 与 Llama3 显式生成连接感知、信念与行动的 if–then 规则，使模型在四个 ToM benchmark 上优于 prompting、监督微调与 think reasoning；≥3B 模型生成的规则还能迁移并提升 GPT-4o-mini 的下游表现。
Motivation: LLM 常能正确推断智能体的心理状态，却在用该推断预测或评判其后续行动时失败，即感知—信念—行动之间存在推理断层。
Method: 生成简洁的 if–then 规则表达 perception 到 action 的关系，并用 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 训练 Qwen2.5 与 Llama3，覆盖四个 ToM benchmark，对照 prompting、监督微调与 think reasoning。
Result: GRPO 加规则生成在四个 ToM benchmark 上胜过 prompting、监督微调与 think reasoning；由 ≥3B 模型生成的规则作为可迁移知识提升了 GPT-4o-mini 的下游性能。
Conclusion: 显式规则能弥合 ToM 中推断与行动预测之间的推理缺口，并支持跨模型的知识迁移。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: StateCraft: Augmenting Video World Models with Abstract-State Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Video world models aim to simulate complex environments with realistic appearance and dynamics. Maintaining consistency over long interactions requires tracking past actions and understanding how those actions affect the environment. Video world models can only generate partial observations of the entire world at a time. Remembering past observations alone may not be sufficient in every scenario, as they may no longer reflect the world after a sequence of actions. We introduce a paradigm that decouples a persistent, updatable abstract state from the visual state. The abstract state keeps track of the entities' changes as the world evolves, and is used to condition the visual state, which represents the current view. We propose StateCraft, a novel architecture that pairs a language model with a video diffusion model to evolve the dynamic world. We evaluate our approach on generative interfaces, which pose a substantial challenge because a single action may change parts of the state that are not currently visible. To support training and evaluation, we develop a data collection pipeline that produces informative, densely annotated trajectories at scale without human or agent supervision, together with a benchmark measuring generation quality, memory, and controllability. On this benchmark, our approach improves surpasses the state-of-the-art baselines. We demonstrate that StateCraft maintains high self-consistency and strong generation quality over long trajectories. Because the abstract state is explicit, it can be edited directly, and generation follows edits to states never observed in the data. Finally, a proof-of-concept 3D experiment, in which actions change the illumination of an unobserved room, shows that the paradigm can also be applied to spatial environments. Project page: https://insait-institute.github.io/StateCraft/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StateCraft 把可持久更新的抽象状态 (abstract state) 与视觉状态解耦：抽象状态记录实体随动作发生的变化并条件化当前视角的视觉生成，由语言模型与视频扩散模型配对演化世界。在生成式界面 (generative interfaces) 基准上超越 SOTA 基线，长轨迹上保持高自一致性与生成质量，且抽象状态可直接编辑、生成会跟随数据中从未观测过的状态编辑。
Motivation: 视频世界模型一次只能生成世界的部分观测，仅靠记忆历史观测不足以应对动作序列之后世界已改变的情形，长交互的一致性因此难以维持。
Method: 提出 StateCraft 架构：语言模型维护并演化持久、可更新的抽象状态，视频扩散模型以该状态为条件生成当前视觉状态；配套开发无需人工或智能体监督的数据采集流水线，产出大规模密集标注轨迹，并构建衡量生成质量、记忆与可控性的基准。
Result: 在生成式界面基准上，该方法超越 state-of-the-art 基线（摘要未给出具体数值），并在长轨迹上维持高自一致性与强生成质量；抽象状态可直接编辑，生成跟随对数据中从未观测过的状态的编辑；概念验证 3D 实验中动作改变一个未被观测房间的照明，说明该范式可迁移到空间环境。
Conclusion: 把世界建模为显式、可编辑的抽象状态加条件化视觉状态，是维持长时程一致性并支持状态编辑的可行范式，且可从 2D 界面扩展到 3D 空间环境。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: One Agent per Zone: Decentralised Active Inference under Partial Observability for Multi-Zone HVAC Control on Edge Hardware
papers.abstract_en: Multi-zone HVAC control is a shared-resource problem: zones on a floor share one fan and cooling coil, so each zone's demand affects its neighbours and the building's peak power. One controller per zone scales well and isolates faults, but each controller then observes only its own zone, not the shared air loop. In this work, we present a decentralised controller that assigns each zone an independent active-inference agent, which plans by minimising expected free energy and learns its zone dynamics online. The agents exchange no messages, so none depends on peers or a coordinator; each accounts for the unobserved coupling through a latent disturbance and a congestion signal derived from the metered power of the other floors. Fifteen agents are evaluated in EnergyPlus on a Sinergym office building against three rule-based controllers and three MADDPG fleets, one given the same floor meters. On five noisy weather years unseen during training, the fleet attains the lowest mean building peak (88.3 kW, 3 to 17 % below the baselines) and staggers the floor peaks better than any baseline, with a coincidence factor (building peak over the sum of the floor peaks) of 0.929 versus 0.936 to 0.994. Compared with a reactive rule at similar comfort (0.912 versus 0.916), it lowers the sum of monthly peaks, on which demand charges are billed, by 33 kW (4 %) in every year, at the cost of about 10 % more energy. It costs 9% less per year than the proactive rule (at lower comfort) and 1% less than the MADDPG fleet given the same floor meters, in every test year. The whole fleet runs on a single low-cost Raspberry Pi 5, closing the observation-to-action loop over MQTT in 442 ms at p95, far below the 15-minute control step.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, accepted in European Conference on EDGE AI Technologies and Applications, EEAI 2026, Malta
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多区域 HVAC 控制中，每个区域配一个独立 active-inference agent，各自最小化期望自由能 (expected free energy) 并在线学习本区动态，不交换消息，用隐变量扰动和来自其他楼层电表的拥堵信号 (congestion signal) 处理未观测耦合。在 EnergyPlus/Sinergym 办公楼上 15 个 agent 对比 3 个规则控制器与 3 支 MADDPG 船队，在训练未见的 5 个含噪天气年上取得最低建筑峰值 88.3 kW（低于基线 3–17%），coincidence factor 0.929 对 0.936–0.994。
Motivation: 多区域楼层共享同一风机与盘管，单区控制器只看得到本区、看不到共享风环路，区域需求互相影响并推高建筑峰值功率；需要在不引入协调器的前提下处理这种部分可观测耦合。
Method: 每个区域一个独立 active-inference agent，通过最小化期望自由能规划并在线学习本区动力学；agent 之间零消息传递，未观测耦合用一个隐扰动变量加由其他楼层计量功率导出的拥堵信号来补偿。评估用 EnergyPlus 仿真、Sinergym 办公楼，15 个 agent 对比 3 个规则控制器与 3 支 MADDPG 船队（其中一支获得同样的楼层电表输入），整队部署在单个 Raspberry Pi 5 上经 MQTT 闭环。
Result: 在训练未见的 5 个含噪天气年上，船队平均建筑峰值最低 88.3 kW，比基线低 3–17%；coincidence factor（建筑峰值/各楼层峰值之和）0.929，优于基线的 0.936–0.994。与舒适度相近的反应式规则（0.912 对 0.916）相比，每月峰值之和（需量电费计费对象）每年各年均降 33 kW（4%），代价是能耗多约 10%；比主动式规则每年省 9%（舒适度更低），比同输入的 MADDPG 船队省 1%。整队在单个 Raspberry Pi 5 上以 MQTT 闭环 p95 延迟 442 ms，远低于 15 分钟控制步长。
Conclusion: 不通信的分区 active-inference 船队在部分可观测下既能压低建筑峰值与需量电费，又能跑在低成本边缘硬件上；代价是相对反应式规则多约 10% 能耗，且相对主动式规则舒适度更低。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.conclusion: 不通信的分区 active-inference 船队在部分可观测下既能压低建筑峰值与需量电费，又能跑在低成本边缘硬件上；代价是相对反应式规则多约 10% 能耗，且相对主动式规则舒适度更低。

papers.title: More Methods, Better Agents? A Reality Check on Self-Distillation in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Self-distillation in agentic reinforcement learning has produced a growing number of methods. However, existing evaluations often reuse published baseline scores under differing experimental conditions, provide few direct comparisons among contemporaneous methods, and give limited attention to training stability and computational cost. These limitations obscure the source of reported gains and the practical strengths and weaknesses of competing methods. Costly agent training further motivates a common basis for comparison. To address these gaps, we compare ten representative methods against GRPO on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, Search-QA, and WebShop across three model sizes. Our study comprises 132 training runs totaling 12,124.4 recorded H800 GPU-hours, with repeated evaluations over eight rollout seeds for the pretrained backbones and all eleven trained methods. Beyond final task performance, we examine training progress, stability, and measured computational cost. Our evaluation yields three key findings. First, gains over GRPO remain limited in scope, with no method consistently outperforming it across settings. Second, strong final performance can mask unstable training. Third, additional training cost does not consistently translate into better performance. We establish this benchmark to support fair, comprehensive comparison and guide future research toward reliable and cost-effective improvements in agent training. Project page: https://aim-uofa.github.io/Self-Distillation-AgentRL/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 agentic RL 中自蒸馏方法做统一实测对比：十种代表性方法在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、Search-QA、WebShop 上以 GRPO 为基线、跨三种模型规模共跑 132 次训练（12,124.4 H800 GPU 小时）。结论是相对 GRPO 的增益范围有限、无方法跨设置稳定胜出，强最终成绩可能掩盖训练不稳定，且额外训练开销不必然换来更好性能。
Motivation: 现有评测复用不同实验条件下的已发表基线分数，同期方法之间缺少直接比较，训练稳定性与计算成本也很少被考察，导致报告增益的来源不清、方法优劣难判。
Method: 选取十种代表性自蒸馏方法与 GRPO 在四个任务（ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、Search-QA、WebShop）上统一比较，覆盖三种模型规模；共 132 次训练运行，对预训练 backbone 与全部十一个训练方法在八个 rollout seed 上重复评测，除最终任务性能外还记录训练进程、稳定性与实测计算成本。
Result: 132 次训练运行、12,124.4 记录的 H800 GPU 小时、八个 rollout seed 重复评测；三项发现：相对 GRPO 的增益范围有限，无方法在所有设置中稳定胜出；强最终性能可能掩盖不稳定训练；额外训练成本不一致地转化为更好性能。
Conclusion: 自蒸馏在 agentic RL 中的收益并不稳健，方法选择应同时看稳定性与实测成本，作者据此建立该 benchmark 以支持公平比较并引导后续研究走向可靠且成本有效的 agent 训练改进。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LiFi: LiDAR Generation from Multi-View Images via Geometric and Semantic Collaborative Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Generating LiDAR point clouds from multi-view camera images is a valuable task with applications in controllable data synthesis, cross-modal simulation and various perception tasks. However, most existing methods are not specifically designed for this task, and the quality of their generated LiDAR remains limited. Moreover, these methods typically focus only on semantic cues in images or generate LiDAR from a monocular camera image. In this work, we introduce LiFi (LiDAR From images), a dedicated framework for generating visually and geometrically aligned LiDAR scenes from multi-view camera images. LiFi guides the latent diffusion process through two complementary branches: geometry and semantics. The geometry branch constructs scene features from images through a reverse sampling algorithm and an uncertainty-aware geometric encoder combined with DepthAnything3, whereas the semantic branch provides high-level semantic representations via a cross-view interaction module. We further introduce a dual-branch balanced classifier-free guidance (CFG) strategy, which enhances the model's conditional generation capability while preserving the independent learning and collaborative controllability of the two branches. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LiFi outperforms state-of-the-art methods in generating high-fidelity LiDAR scenes. The code will be publicly available at: https://github.com/szzhou88/LiFi.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiFi 用几何与语义双分支协同引导的 latent diffusion，从多视角相机图像生成视觉与几何对齐的 LiDAR 点云：几何分支经反向采样算法与不确定性感知几何编码器（结合 DepthAnything3）构建场景特征，语义分支经跨视角交互模块提供高层语义，并用双分支平衡 CFG 同时增强条件生成与两分支的独立学习和协同可控性。在生成高保真 LiDAR 场景上超过现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 从多视角图像生成 LiDAR 对可控数据合成、跨模态仿真和感知任务有用，但现有方法多非为此任务专门设计，只用图像语义线索或仅从单目图像生成，生成质量有限。
Method: LiFi 框架以 latent diffusion 为核心，几何分支用反向采样算法加不确定性感知几何编码器（结合 DepthAnything3）从图像构建场景特征，语义分支用跨视角交互模块提供高层语义表示；再引入双分支平衡 classifier-free guidance (CFG) 策略，在增强条件生成能力的同时保持两分支独立学习与协同可控。
Result: 大量实验表明 LiFi 在生成高保真 LiDAR 场景上优于 state-of-the-art 方法；代码将开源至 github.com/szzhou88/LiFi。
Conclusion: 把几何与语义作为互补分支共同引导扩散过程，是从多视角图像生成高质量 LiDAR 场景的有效路径，且两分支可保持独立学习与协同可控。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FPV-CRASH: A Dataset for Offline Crash Moment Localization in Drone First-Person-View Videos
papers.abstract_en: Crash Moment Localization aims to localize the major physical impact that interrupts controlled flight in an onboard first-person-view (FPV) video recorded by a drone, thereby providing a temporal reference for retrospective crash analysis in aerial robotics. However, existing crash-video datasets predominantly target surveillance or dash-camera footage, and their annotation schemes and task formulations are not designed for temporal localization of the major physical impact in UAV onboard FPV videos. To address this gap, we present FPV-CRASH, a dataset and fixed-protocol reference evaluation for offline Crash Moment Localization in drone FPV videos. FPV-CRASH contains 1,052 drone FPV clips (526 Crash and 526 Normal); each Crash clip has a single-frame reference annotation for the Crash Moment, and every clip is paired with four English captions automatically generated from sampled frames and the known Crash/Normal label. Normal clips carry no timestamp target and provide training-time background supervision. The captions support an auxiliary Text-to-Video Retrieval task, whereas localization inference remains video-only. We further provide a heatmap-based reference model that estimates a continuous Crash Moment timestamp from sparsely sampled frames. Under the fixed, non-source-disjoint clip-level protocol, the reference model reduces MAE from 1.12 s for the strongest fixed timing-prior baseline to 0.56 s (a 50% relative reduction) and achieves a median absolute error (MedAE) of 0.33 s; the fraction of clips localized within 0.5 s rises from 37.14% to 65.71%. The release includes annotations, available source video identifiers and URLs, clipping metadata, fixed split lists, and preprocessing code so that the reportable portion can be reconstructed without redistributing source footage. At submission time, all source-compilation URLs remained accessible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FPV-CRASH 提出无人机第一人称视频 (FPV) 的离线撞击时刻定位 (Crash Moment Localization) 数据集与固定协议评测：1,052 个片段（526 Crash / 526 Normal），每个 Crash 片段带单帧撞击时刻参考标注。其 heatmap 参考模型从稀疏采样帧回归连续时间戳，把 MAE 从最强固定时序先验基线的 1.12 s 降到 0.56 s（相对下降 50%），0.5 s 内命中率从 37.14% 升到 65.71%。
Motivation: 现有撞击视频数据集面向监控与行车记录仪，其标注方案和任务形式不适配无人机机载 FPV 视频中主撞击时刻的时间定位，缺少可用的数据集与固定评测协议。
Method: 发布 FPV-CRASH 数据集：1,052 个 FPV 片段（526 Crash、526 Normal），Crash 片段各含单帧撞击时刻参考标注，Normal 片段无时间戳目标、仅作训练期背景监督；每片段配四条由采样帧与 Crash/Normal 标签自动生成的英文描述，支撑辅助的 Text-to-Video Retrieval 任务，而定位推理仅用视频。另给出 heatmap 参考模型，从稀疏采样帧估计连续撞击时间戳，并在固定、非源不相交的 clip-level 协议下评测。
Result: 在固定 clip-level 协议下，参考模型 MAE 从最强固定时序先验基线的 1.12 s 降至 0.56 s（相对下降 50%），MedAE 为 0.33 s；0.5 s 内定位成功的片段比例从 37.14% 升至 65.71%。发布物含标注、源视频标识与 URL、剪辑元数据、固定划分列表与预处理代码，提交时全部源编译 URL 均可访问。
Conclusion: 无人机 FPV 撞击时刻定位可以作为独立的离线时间定位任务并用固定协议复现，heatmap 回归相对固定时序先基线把误差减半；评测采用固定、非源不相交的 clip-level 协议。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning via Advantage Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) holds the promise of learning a policy that can outperform what is shown in the data. However, in practice, such systems suffer from instability and hyperparameter sensitivity. In contrast, supervised learning provides a stable and scalable training objective, but is fundamentally limited by the quality of the demonstrated behavior. In this paper, we ask whether we can perform policy optimization with something as simple and stable as supervised learning but as performant as RL. Unfortunately, naively training the policy with supervised learning and conditioning on future rewards or advantages typically underperform dedicated RL methods. We introduce a new policy extraction method, Advantage Guidance, that retains the simple supervised learning structure with advantage conditioning while outperforming prior RL methods through effective conditional training and contrastive diffusion guidance during sampling. We show that Advantage Guidance can significantly improve a model's ability to respond to conditional advantage signals, and the contrastive guidance during sampling can use the learned advantage-conditioned policy to target the KL-regularized optimal policy. Empirically, we find that Advantage Guidance significantly outperforms prior state-of-the-art RL methods on 26 long-horizon, sparse reward tasks across datasets with varying degrees of optimality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Advantage Guidance：保留监督学习式训练结构、以 advantage 为条件训练策略，并在采样时用对比式 diffusion guidance 指向 KL 正则最优策略，从而在简单稳定的训练目标下拿到 RL 级性能。在 26 个长时程稀疏奖励任务上显著超越先前 SOTA RL 方法，覆盖不同最优程度的数据集。
Motivation: RL 策略优化性能强但训练不稳定、对超参敏感；监督学习稳定可扩展却受示范质量上限约束，而朴素地以未来 reward/advantage 为条件做监督训练通常不如专用 RL 方法。
Method: Advantage Guidance 是一种策略提取方法：以 advantage 为条件做监督式条件训练，使模型能响应条件 advantage 信号；采样阶段叠加对比式 diffusion guidance (contrastive diffusion guidance)，利用学到的 advantage 条件策略逼近 KL 正则最优策略。
Result: 在 26 个长时程、稀疏奖励任务上显著优于先前 state-of-the-art RL 方法，且这些任务的数据集覆盖不同程度的最优性 (varying degrees of optimality)。
Conclusion: 带 advantage 条件的监督式训练加上采样期对比引导，可以同时拿到监督学习的稳定性与 RL 的性能，取代直接的 RL 目标优化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Who Benefits Most: Multi-Treatment Causal Ranking for Population Health Stratification
papers.abstract_en: Population health stratification frameworks, such as the Italian DM77, organize patients by clinical need and care pathways but offer limited guidance on which care changes to prioritize under constrained resources. We present PROMETHEUS (Proactive Resource Optimization through Multi-treatment Effect-based Targeting in Healthcare Environments Using Stratification), a framework that formulates population health stratification as a multi-treatment causal ranking problem. Its objective is to order eligible patient-treatment opportunities by expected incremental benefit rather than obtain perfectly calibrated individual treatment-effect estimates. Each clinically admissible care intensification is compared with maintaining the patient's current pathway. Treatments are learned jointly to produce a globally comparable ranking across patients and care profiles, within domains sharing a reference condition, outcome, follow-up horizon, and benefit scale. This separates clinical need, treatment benefit, and resource-constrained allocation. PROMETHEUS combines doubly robust causal signals with a Siamese neural ranking model and contrastive representation pretraining. The shared representation captures similarities across care transitions, supporting prioritization under capacity constraints. Synthetic experiments and semi-synthetic experiments using real administrative covariates from ASL Benevento evaluate ranking quality, allocation value, robustness, and failure modes. The results support the framework's ability to recover generated benefit orderings and prioritize care opportunities in the evaluated settings. PROMETHEUS provides a preclinical approach to actionable stratification; validation with observed treatment-outcome data is required before clinical use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PROMETHEUS 把人群健康分层（如意大利 DM77）改写成多治疗因果排序问题：按预期增量获益给患者-治疗机会排序，而非估计校准良好的个体治疗效应。它用 doubly robust 因果信号配合 Siamese 神经排序模型与对比表示预训练，在共享参考条件、结局、随访期与获益尺度的域内产生跨患者全局可比的排序。在合成实验与使用 ASL Benevento 真实行政协变量的半合成实验中，该框架能恢复生成的获益顺序，并在所评估设定下按容量约束排定照护机会。
Motivation: DM77 等人群健康分层框架按临床需求组织患者与照护路径，但在资源受限时几乎不指导应优先改变哪些照护；完美校准的个体治疗效应估计既难得到也非排序所需。
Method: PROMETHEUS 将每个临床上可接受的照护强化与维持当前路径作对比，联合学习多种治疗以产生跨患者、跨照护画像的全局可比排序；核心组合是 doubly robust 因果信号、Siamese 神经排序模型与对比表示预训练，共享表示刻画照护转移间的相似性以支持容量约束下的优先级排序。
Result: 在合成实验与使用 ASL Benevento 真实行政协变量的半合成实验中，评估了排序质量、分配价值、稳健性与失败模式；结果支持框架在所评估设定下恢复生成的获益顺序并优先排定照护机会。
Conclusion: 因果排序可把临床需求、治疗获益与资源受限分配三者分开处理，得到可操作的分层；作者明确这是临床前方法，临床使用前必须用真实观测到的治疗-结局数据验证。

papers.title: SNACK: A Sequential Notation Framework for Probabilistic Graph Generation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce SNACK, a string representation for probabilistic graph generation that enables sequence models to generate and model graphs with discrete node and edge features. SNACK linearizes graphs by encoding the nonzero entries of the lower-triangular adjacency matrix, establishing a bijective correspondence between valid sequences and ordered adjacency matrices. This design enables invalid logit masking to enforce structural constraints--such as chemical valence and ordering rules--guaranteeing 100% valid generated sequences. SNACK also enables principled string-based GFlowNet training by explicitly accounting for node-ordering symmetries. Across standard graph-generation tasks and molecular distribution-learning benchmarks, SNACK achieves competitive sample quality, while substantially improving the throughput of GFlowNet training relative to graph-based generation. Probing analyses further show that models trained on SNACK encode meaningful local and global graph structure despite receiving only sequential supervision. These results position SNACK as a practical framework for probabilistic graph generation with deep sequence models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SNACK 把带离散节点/边特征的图线性化为下三角邻接矩阵非零项的字符串，与有序邻接矩阵建立双射，从而可用无效 logit 掩码强制化学价、顺序等结构约束，生成序列 100% 合法。它还显式处理节点顺序对称性以支持基于字符串的 GFlowNet 训练，在图生成与分子分布学习基准上样本质量有竞争力，且训练吞吐相比基于图的生成显著提升。
Motivation: 序列模型难以直接生成带离散特征的图并满足结构约束，而图基 GFlowNet 训练吞吐受限；需要一种既保证合法性又能高效训练的表示。
Method: SNACK 将下三角邻接矩阵非零项线性化为字符串，与有序邻接矩阵双射；用无效 logit 掩码强制化学价与顺序规则；训练采用显式计入节点顺序对称性的字符串式 GFlowNet 目标，并做 probing 分析检验模型学到的局部与全局图结构。
Result: 生成序列合法率 100%；在标准图生成任务与分子分布学习基准上样本质量有竞争力；相比基于图的生成，GFlowNet 训练吞吐显著提升（摘要未给具体数值）；probing 显示仅用序列监督训练的模型编码了有意义的局部与全局图结构。
Conclusion: SNACK 用字符串表示把结构合法性与 GFlowNet 训练效率同时拿到，可作为深度序列模型做概率图生成的实用框架。

papers.title: LabOPBench: A Multimodal Benchmark for Evidence-Grounded Laboratory Decision Making
papers.abstract_en: Laboratory experiments involve more than following predefined protocols; they require adaptive decision-making as the experimental state changes. Existing scientific benchmarks rarely assess such evidence-based decisions in laboratory settings. Here we present LabOPBench, a multimodal benchmark of 756 expert-authored, independently reviewed questions in organic synthesis and materials science. Each item pairs laboratory evidence with procedural context and an open-ended judgment, evaluated using a question-specific scoring rubric. Eight multimodal models obtain overall normalized scores of 28.8-45.8%, leaving substantial room for improvement. On a controlled 100-question subset, the strongest models outperform undergraduate participants on average but remain below the average performance of PhD participants. Expert analysis of responses from the three leading models identifies Evidence Misreading and Evidence-Decision Conflict as the dominant error patterns. These results reveal that current models still struggle to turn multimodal perception into reliable laboratory decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LabOPBench 是面向实验室自适应决策的多模态基准，含 756 道有机合成与材料科学专家撰写、独立评审的题目，每题把实验证据与流程语境配成开放式判断并按题目专属 rubric 打分。八个多模态模型整体归一化得分仅 28.8–45.8%；在受控 100 题子集上最强模型平均超过本科生但低于博士生平均，主导错误模式为 Evidence MisReading 与 Evidence-Decision Conflict。
Motivation: 现有科学基准很少评估实验室场景中随实验状态变化的证据驱动决策，而这类自适应判断正是实验过程的核心能力。
Method: 构建 756 道专家撰写并独立评审的多模态题目，每题将实验室证据与程序语境配对，要求开放式判断，用题目专属评分 rubric 评分；另设受控 100 题子集与本科生、博士生对照，并对三个领先模型的回答做专家错误模式分析。
Result: 八个多模态模型整体归一化得分 28.8–45.8%；受控 100 题子集上最强模型平均优于本科生参与者、但低于博士生平均；三个领先模型的主导错误模式为 Evidence Misreading 与 Evidence-Decision Conflict。
Conclusion: 当前多模态模型仍难以把多模态感知转化为可靠的实验室决策，与人类专家（尤其博士水平）之间存在明显差距。

papers.title: Computational compressive imaging reconstruction with a simulated-annealing-based Ising solver
papers.abstract_en: Computational compressive imaging, such as single-pixel imaging and lensless imaging, is a promising imaging technique, enabling the reconstruction of objects from under-sampled measurements through compressed sensing algorithms or deep learning methods. However, the demand for electronic computational resources grows rapidly when recovering high-resolution and multi-dimensional images and training neural networks with numerous parameters, which has become a bottleneck for the widespread adoption of this technique. Here, we propose a physics-driven reconstruction framework that formulates imaging inverse problems as Ising models and directly recovers target objects through the self-evolution of non-von Neumann Ising machines toward the ground state of the Hamiltonian. We employ a simulated-annealing-based Ising solver to demonstrate this proof-of-concept by reconstructing objects in both single-pixel imaging and a lensless diffuser camera at sampling rates ranging from 1% to 25%. By further incorporating a foreground-sparsity constraint and a smoothness constraint, the reconstruction quality of our method is comparable to or even better than that of mainstream algorithms. This approach has the potential to substantially reduce the electronic computational burden of inverse reconstruction, paving the way for real-time, low-power computational imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把计算压缩成像（单像素成像、无透镜漫射相机）的逆问题写成 Ising 模型的哈密顿量，用模拟退火 (simulated annealing) 的 Ising 求解器让非冯·诺依曼 Ising 机自演化到基态直接恢复目标。在 1%–25% 采样率下重建质量与主流算法相当甚至更好，加入前景稀疏约束与平滑约束后进一步提升，有望大幅降低逆重建的电子计算负担。
Motivation: 高分辨率与多维图像重建、以及参数量巨大的神经网络训练使电子计算资源需求急剧上升，成为压缩成像技术广泛落地的瓶颈。
Method: 提出物理驱动重建框架：将成像逆问题表述为 Ising 模型，用基于模拟退火的 Ising 求解器作为概念验证，在单像素成像与无透镜漫射相机 (lensless diffuser camera) 上直接恢复目标；再叠加前景稀疏约束与平滑约束改进重建。
Result: 在采样率 1% 到 25% 范围内完成单像素成像与漫射相机重建；加入前景稀疏与平滑约束后，重建质量与主流算法相当甚至更好。
Conclusion: 把逆重建映射为 Ising 基态求解可绕开部分电子计算开销，作者认为该路线有潜力支撑实时、低功耗的计算成像。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Q-MAGIC: Quad-only Mesh Autoregressive Generation via Singularity-Aware Circular Relative Offset Tokenization
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive models have proven effective for triangular mesh generation by transforming it into predicting the next face, converting the non-differentiable connectivity prediction into a sequence of token predictions. However, generating quad-only meshes remains challenging because quad faces impose stricter topological constraints than triangles. The model must not only serialize quad faces into a valid token sequence, but also support unambiguous connectivity reconstruction during de-serialization. To address this, we propose Q-MAGIC, a novel autoregressive model for quad mesh generation. We first introduce a tailored serialization scheme for quad meshes, which requires at least two new vertices for the next face and is less flexible than triangles due to strict wiring constraints. To meet these requirements and reduce serialization length, we propose a singularity-aware serialization that prioritizes wiring from singular points, leading to more coherent traversals. Additionally, we propose a circular relative offset tokenization that encodes geometry mainly via local relative offsets. Built upon this representation, an autoregressive Transformer learns the underlying distribution of quad meshes via next-token prediction, enabling effective quad mesh generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Q-MAGIC produces more compact sequences while consistently improving geometric fidelity and mesh quality compared to state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Q-MAGIC 把四边形网格生成转成 next-token 预测：面向四边形的序列化方案要求下一个面至少引入两个新顶点，并从奇异点 (singularity) 优先布线以缩短序列，几何用 circular relative offset 局部偏移编码。实验显示其序列更紧凑，几何保真度与网格质量持续优于现有方法。
Motivation: 三角网格自回归生成已成熟，但四边形面施加更严格的拓扑约束：既要序列化成合法 token 序列，又要在反序列化时无歧义地重建连接关系，三角形那套灵活序列化不再适用。
Method: 三件套：面向四边形的定制序列化（下一面至少需两个新顶点，布线约束严格）、singularity-aware serialization（从奇异点优先布线得到更连贯遍历并缩短序列长度）、circular relative offset tokenization（主要用局部相对偏移编码几何）；其上用自回归 Transformer 做 next-token 预测学习四边形网格分布。
Result: 实验表明 Q-MAGIC 生成的 token 序列更紧凑，并在几何保真度 (geometric fidelity) 与网格质量上持续优于 state-of-the-art 方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 四边形网格的自回归生成可行，前提是序列化服从严格布线约束并从奇异点出发，几何改用局部相对偏移编码。

papers.title: From Global to Tail Convergence: Dynamics of $α$-Stable Score-Based Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Score-based generative models driven by $α$-stable L{é}vy processes have been proposed as an alternative to Brownian diffusion models, with empirical evidence suggesting improved sampling and better modeling of heavy-tailed data. Yet theoretical guarantees for these models remain limited. We develop a non-asymptotic convergence analysis for scale-preserving $α$-stable generative dynamics, covering both compactly supported and power-law targets. In p-Wasserstein distance, we quantify the effects of early stopping, initialization, score approximation, and time discretization, and show exponential decay of the initialization error. A comparison with Brownian dynamics reveals that global Wasserstein convergence alone does not fundamentally distinguish the two models: both initialization errors decay exponentially with the forward horizon on the common class of heavy-tailed targets. A sharp separation emerges instead in the tails. At any positive generation time, stable dynamics produces power-law tails with index $α$, whereas Brownian dynamics remains light-tailed. For a target with tail index $ν$, asymptotically correct extreme-quantile scaling is possible precisely when $α$=$ν$. These results identify tail-index matching as a principled mechanism behind the ability of stable generative models to capture extreme events.

TL;DR: 对由 α-stable Lévy 过程驱动的 score-based 生成模型给出非渐近收敛分析：在 p-Wasserstein 距离下量化早停、初始化、score 近似与时间离散化的影响，并证明初始化误差指数衰减。与 Brownian 动力学对比发现全局 Wasserstein 收敛无法区分二者（重尾目标上初始化误差都随前向时程指数衰减），真正的分离在尾部：任意正生成时刻 stable 动力学产生指数为 α 的幂律尾，Brownian 仍为轻尾；对尾指数 ν 的目标，只有 α=ν 时极值分位数标度才渐近正确。
Motivation: α-stable score 生成模型被提出作为 Brownian diffusion 的重尾替代并有经验性优势，但理论保证不足；且仅凭全局 Wasserstein 收敛无法解释其对极端事件的建模能力。
Method: 针对 scale-preserving α-stable 生成动力学做非渐近收敛分析，覆盖紧支撑与 power-law 两类目标；在 p-Wasserstein 距离下分解早停、初始化、score 近似误差与时间离散化误差，并证明初始化误差指数衰减；再与 Brownian 动力学在共同的重尾目标类上做全局与尾部两层对比。
Result: 初始化误差随前向时程指数衰减，且 stable 与 Brownian 在共同重尾目标类上都呈该指数衰减，全局 p-Wasserstein 收敛因此不区分二者；任意正生成时刻 stable 动力学输出指数为 α 的幂律尾而 Brownian 为轻尾；对尾指数 ν 的目标，极值分位数标度渐近正确当且仅当 α=ν。
Conclusion: 尾指数匹配 (tail-index matching) 是 stable 生成模型能捕捉极端事件的原则性机制，而全局 Wasserstein 收敛本身不是区分两类动力学的判据。

papers.title: Unmasking Compensating Errors in Numerical Weather Models: A Process-Additive Neural Network Approach
papers.abstract_en: This work introduces a Process Additive Neural Network (PANN) framework to disentangle compensating biases in atmospheric models, where errors in different physical processes can offset each other and obscure their origins. Using a single-column model, each PANN branch represents the tendency error associated with a separate physical process, and the summed branch outputs approximate the total error relative to a reference tendency. Once trained successfully, the branch outputs are expected to provide process-level error attributions and, when averaged, estimates of process-level bias. Initial experiments focus on cloud-related processes in OpenIFS SCM case studies, where cloud and convection tendencies are strongly coupled and compensation is difficult to diagnose using standard approaches. The aim is not to replace human interpretation of physical processes, but to extend it to regimes where model complexity, process interaction, and compensating errors make direct diagnosis difficult. By providing a physically structured form of machine-learning interpretability, PANN can help connect complex model behaviour with process-level explanations. This work supports both improved understanding of compensating errors and the development of more physically consistent weather and climate models.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning (TCCML). Corresponding author: yuiko.ichikawa@ouce.ox.ac.uk
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Process Additive Neural Network (PANN)：在单柱模式 (SCM) 中让每个分支对应一个物理过程的倾向误差，分支输出求和逼近相对参考倾向的总误差，训练后分支输出即过程级误差归因，平均后得到过程级偏差估计。初始实验聚焦 OpenIFS SCM 个例中强耦合、难以用常规方法诊断的云与对流补偿误差。
Motivation: 大气模式中不同物理过程的误差互相抵消，掩盖误差来源；云与对流倾向强耦合的个例里，标准方法难以诊断这种补偿。
Method: PANN 框架用单柱模型，每个分支表示一个物理过程的倾向误差，分支输出之和逼近相对参考倾向的总误差；训练成功后分支输出提供过程级误差归因与过程级偏差估计。初始实验针对 OpenIFS SCM 个例中的云相关过程（云与对流）。
Result: 初始实验聚焦 OpenIFS SCM 个例中云与对流倾向强耦合、补偿难以用标准方法诊断的场景；摘要给出的是框架设计与预期输出（过程级误差归因、平均后的过程级偏差），未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: PANN 提供一种物理结构化的机器学习可解释性形式，把复杂模式行为连接到过程级解释，用于扩展而非取代人工物理过程判读，服务于理解补偿误差与构建更物理一致的天气气候模式。

papers.title: When Does the Dependency Graph Help Code-to-Architecture Mapping?
papers.abstract_en: Architectural technical debt arises when a system's implementation drifts from its inten ded modular decomposition, while the mapping between source files and architectural modu les is missing, incomplete, or costly to maintain manually. We formulate code-to-archite cture mapping as semi-supervised node classification over a directed multi-relational de pendency graph, with files as nodes, typed dependencies as edges, and lexical features d erived from code identifiers and directory layout. Starting from a small labeled sample, an iterative self-training procedure expands the mapping to the remaining files. We com pare a graph convolutional network (GCN), a graph attention network (GAT), and a graph-f ree multi-layer perceptron (MLP), using identical features and training procedures for t he learned models, against a Naive Bayes reference. Across 100 runs on ten open-source J ava and C/C++ systems, all three neural models outperform the reference on both F1 metri cs. GAT achieves the highest averages of system-level median macro and micro F1, at 83.5 and 92.2, respectively, whereas MLP remains competitive or superior on several systems. On Chrome, the largest system with 18,343 files, GAT and GCN exceed MLP by 22 and 19 ma cro-F1 points, respectively, and have substantially fewer persistently misclassified fil es. Connectivity and homophily are associated with where neural message passing helps, w hile multi-relational aggregation outperforms a single merged edge type on every system for both GCN and GAT. A follow-up study finds that several model rankings depend on the training seed, qualifying smaller advantages without removing the large graph benefit ob served on Chrome.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把源文件到架构模块的映射写成有向多关系依赖图上的半监督节点分类，用自训练从少量标注扩展到全部文件。在十个开源 Java 与 C/C++ 系统上 100 次运行中，GAT 的系统级中位 macro/micro F1 平均达 83.5 与 92.2，均高于 Naive Bayes 参考；在 18,343 个文件的 Chrome 上 GAT、GCN 分别比无图 MLP 高 22 与 19 个 macro-F1 点，且多关系聚合在每个系统上都优于合并单一边类型。
Motivation: 实现与预期模块分解漂移会积累架构技术债，而源文件到架构模块的映射缺失、不完整或人工维护成本高，需要低成本的方式把映射补齐。
Method: 将映射建模为有向多关系依赖图上的半监督节点分类：文件为节点、带类型的依赖为边、特征来自代码标识符与目录布局的词法信息；从少量标注样本出发用迭代自训练扩展到其余文件。对比 GCN、GAT 与无图 MLP（特征与训练流程一致）以及 Naive Bayes 参考。
Result: 在十个开源 Java 与 C/C++ 系统上 100 次运行中，三个神经模型在两个 F1 指标上都超过 Naive Bayes；GAT 的系统级中位 macro-F1 与 micro-F1 平均最高，分别为 83.5 与 92.2，MLP 在若干系统上仍有竞争力或更优。Chrome（18,343 个文件，最大系统）上 GAT 与 GCN 分别比 MLP 高 22 与 19 个 macro-F1 点，持续误分类文件明显更少。连通性与同质性 (homophily) 与消息传递何时有帮助相关；对 GCN 与 GAT，多关系聚合在每个系统上都优于合并为单一边类型。后续研究发现若干模型排名依赖训练种子，削弱了较小的优势，但不改变 Chrome 上的大幅图结构收益。
Conclusion: 依赖图上的消息传递在大而连通、同质性高的系统里带来实质收益，多关系边类型应保留而非合并；但小幅度的模型间优势对训练种子敏感，报告排名时需考虑随机性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning to Compute Is Not Learning to Retain or Reuse in Looped Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Looped transformers compute by applying one block repeatedly, so they can run for more loops than they were trained with. Recurrent reasoners are known to overthink: iterating past the trained depth can turn a correct answer into a wrong one. Such a late error can reflect failed computation, loss of retention, or a state that later computation cannot reuse. We separate these cases in in-context Mealy-machine execution, where a simulator supplies intermediate targets and exact counterfactuals for hidden-state interventions. Models trained to answer at loop 32 are fully correct there but keep only 22% of these answers at loop 64. Retention depends on what training asks for: supervising one randomly chosen position per example, instead of always the last, keeps 99.8%, and randomizing the number of training loops also helps; truncating gradients, as in progressive training against overthinking, does not. The computation itself is exact: position $k$ is computed at loop $k$, and swapping its loop-$k$ hidden vector for the one from another input redirects every later position to that input's exact continuation (237/237 pairs in each of ten models). Retention, however, is not reuse. Even in models that keep nearly all answers, holding each position $k$ fixed from loop $k$ drops accuracy to 4--6%, whereas holding it from loop $k+4$ is harmless. A released recurrent maze network trained to avoid overthinking behaves the same way. Learning to compute is thus not learning to retain, and avoiding overthinking does not make a state reusable when its answer first appears.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 in-context Mealy 机执行任务上，looped transformer 在 loop 32 训练后到 loop 64 只保留 22% 的正确答案；改为每例随机监督一个位置可保留 99.8%，随机化训练循环数同样有效，而截断梯度（progressive training）无效。计算本身是精确的：位置 k 在 loop k 被算出，替换其隐状态会把后续位置精确重定向到另一输入的续写（十个模型各 237/237 对）。但保留不等于可复用：把位置 k 从 loop k 起固定会把准确率打到 4–6%，从 loop k+4 起固定则无害。
Motivation: 循环式推理模型（looped transformer）可以运行超过训练深度的循环数，但超过训练深度后正确答案可能被破坏；这种晚期错误可能来自计算失败、保持失败或状态不可复用，此前未被区分开。
Method: 在 in-context Mealy 机执行任务上用模拟器提供中间目标与隐状态干预的精确反事实；比较不同训练监督策略（固定最后位置 vs 随机位置、随机化循环数、截断梯度），并用隐状态交换与固定实验区分计算、保持与复用。
Result: loop 32 训练的模型在 loop 32 完全正确，但 loop 64 只保留 22%；每例随机监督一个位置保留 99.8%，随机化训练循环数也有帮助，截断梯度无效。隐状态交换实验中十个模型各 237/237 对精确重定向。保留良好的模型中，从 loop k 起固定位置 k 使准确率降至 4–6%，从 loop k+4 起固定无害。一个公开的、为避免 overthinking 训练的循环迷宫网络表现相同。
Conclusion: 学会计算不等于学会保持或复用：监督位置的随机化能解决保持问题，但即使答案被完整保留，答案首次出现时的状态也不可被后续计算复用；避免 overthinking 并不会让该状态变得可复用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Analyzing and Mitigating Poisoning Attacks on Flow-Based Intrusion Detection
papers.abstract_en: Although Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs) are increasingly deployed in operational networks, their dependence on large-scale training data introduces a critical vulnerability to stealthy poisoning attacks. We demonstrate that latent backdoors can be successfully implanted in flow-based IDS models by poisoning as little as 0.001% of the training data, maintaining near-nominal performance on clean inputs while ensuring high attack success rates. To address this threat, we propose a diagnostic-first methodology that localizes trigger-relevant features through constrained perturbation analysis and detects poisoning-induced behavioral drift by comparison with a distilled baseline model. The proposed methodology further enables targeted mitigation via automated data sanitization or neuron pruning. Our findings expose the operational risks of near-undetectable backdoors and provide a scalable approach to analyzing, quantifying, and mitigating backdoor exposure in AI-based IDS.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Cyber Security and Resilience
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对基于流量的 AI 入侵检测系统 (flow-based IDS)，证明仅投毒 0.001% 训练数据即可植入潜在后门，在干净输入上保持近乎正常性能同时获得高攻击成功率。提出先诊断后缓解的方法：用受约束扰动分析定位触发器相关特征，用蒸馏基线模型检测投毒引起的行为漂移，再自动做数据清洗或神经元剪枝。
Motivation: AI 入侵检测系统依赖大规模训练数据，容易被隐蔽的投毒攻击植入后门，且在干净流量上几乎不可察觉，构成运营网络的实际风险。
Method: 诊断优先方法：受约束扰动分析 (constrained perturbation analysis) 定位触发器相关特征；与蒸馏基线模型 (distilled baseline) 比较检测投毒导致的行为漂移；随后通过自动数据清洗 (data sanitization) 或神经元剪枝 (neuron pruning) 做定向缓解。
Result: 在基于流量的 IDS 模型上，投毒低至 0.001% 训练数据即可成功植入潜在后门，干净输入上性能接近正常，同时保持高攻击成功率。

papers.title: Physics-Shaped, Not Physical: Auditing Physics-Guided Underwater Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Physics-guided networks for underwater image restoration predict transmission and backscatter and invert the image-formation model, yet rarely test whether this physics does any work. We audit one representative design, PhysGuide-Net, with four controlled experiments: five-seed ablations on UIEB with zero-shot evaluation on the complete LSUI (4279 pairs) and AUIED3K (3000 pairs) sets; a data-efficiency study with a capacity-matched control that removes the formation model; and a validation of the predicted maps against measured range on Sea-thru. With all 800 training images the physics module gives no zero-shot gain (mean PSNR differences of at most 0.16 dB; all 95% intervals include zero) at 3.4x the FLOPs. With 80 images it helps more (+0.65 dB on UIEB, +1.48 dB on AUIED3K; seed-to-seed s.d. on AUIED3K from 1.3 to 0.5 dB), although not individually significant after correction, and the control does not reproduce this (0.8-1.0 dB lower). Yet the predicted transmission does not behave like a physical quantity: its correlation with range is no stronger than for the range map of a different image (pooled difference +0.02, versus -0.06 for the dark-channel prior), and a Beer-Lambert fit explains 0.4% of its variance. The effect of the module also changes sign with degradation severity between datasets. The benefit thus comes from a physics-shaped inductive bias, not from physics. We further show that single-run ablations can reverse sign and document implementation defects that invalidate loss ablations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对物理引导水下图像恢复网络 PhysGuide-Net 做受控审计：在 800 张训练图上物理模块零样本增益至多 0.16 dB（95% 区间含零）却付出 3.4 倍 FLOPs，而预测的 transmission 与实测距离的相关性并不强于另一张图的距离图（pooled difference +0.02，暗通道先验为 -0.06），Beer-Lambert 拟合仅解释 0.4% 方差。收益来自 physics-shaped 归纳偏置而非真实物理，且单次运行的消融会翻转符号。
Motivation: 物理引导网络靠预测 transmission/backscatter 并反演成像模型来恢复水下图像，但很少检验这套物理是否真的在起作用；审计需要区分物理本身与仅仅是物理形状的归纳偏置。
Method: 以 PhysGuide-Net 为代表设计做四组受控实验：UIEB 上五种子消融并在完整 LSUI（4279 对）与 AUIED3K（3000 对）做零样本评估；数据效率研究配一个容量匹配、移除成像模型的对照；在 Sea-thru 上用实测距离校验预测的 transmission 图；并检查单次运行消融与实现缺陷。
Result: 800 张训练图时物理模块零样本 PSNR 差异至多 0.16 dB、95% 区间全含零，而 FLOPs 为 3.4 倍；80 张时 UIEB +0.65 dB、AUIED3K +1.48 dB（AUIED3K 种子间标准差从 1.3 降到 0.5 dB），但多重校正后均不单独显著，容量匹配对照低 0.8–1.0 dB 且无法复现该效应。transmission 与距离的相关性 pooled difference +0.02（暗通道先验 -0.06），Beer-Lambert 拟合只解释 0.4% 方差；模块效应随退化严重度在数据集间变号。
Conclusion: 该物理模块的收益来自 physics-shaped 归纳偏置而非物理本身；单次运行的消融足以翻转符号，且存在使损失消融失效的实现缺陷，因此物理引导恢复的消融结论需要多种子与容量匹配对照。

papers.title: PRISMATIC : Prescription Risk Inspection System for Multi-Agent Treatment Interaction in Clinical Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: Medical prescribing errors for multimorbid patients, who require complex drug regimens, are a major patient safety concern. These errors often stem from fragmented decision-making across medical specialties, a critical coordination failure that leads to adverse drug events and rehospitalizations. To address this coordination challenge, we introduce PRISMATIC, a multi-agent architecture where specialized agents, each representing a workflow role, collaboratively generate and refine treatment plans. Operating on a blackboard architecture, the system first structures patient information from clinical notes, then iteratively develops safe, rational, and interpretable drug regimens. The agents' collaboration is governed by two novel adaptive coordination mechanisms: (1) Dynamic Self-Updating Weight Adjustment (DSWA), a long-term mechanism that adjusts the influence weights of agents based on historical case outcomes, enabling the system to adapt and trust more reliable specialists over time. (2) Discrepancy Feedback Precise Calibration (DFPC), a short-term mechanism where agents provide iterative feedback to resolve disagreements and eliminate prescription conflicts for the current patient. Experiments on patient records from the MIMIC-IV database show that PRISMATIC significantly reduces drug conflicts, improves prescription coverage, and enhances treatment consistency compared to strong LLM baselines. Our work demonstrates that structuring clinical co-treatment as a multi-agent coordination problem offers a promising path toward safer and more coherent multidisease management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRISMATIC 把多病共存患者的处方决策建模为多智能体协调问题：黑板架构上各角色智能体先从临床记录结构化患者信息，再迭代生成并修订用药方案，由 DSWA 按历史病例结局长期调整信任权重、DFPC 用迭代反馈消解当前患者的处方冲突。在 MIMIC-IV 患者记录上，相比强 LLM 基线显著减少药物冲突、提高处方覆盖度与治疗一致性。
Motivation: 多病共存患者用药方案复杂，处方错误多源于跨专科决策碎片化这一协调失效，进而导致不良药物事件与再住院。
Method: 黑板架构 (blackboard architecture) 的多智能体系统：专职智能体对应不同工作流角色，先从临床笔记结构化患者信息，再迭代生成安全、合理、可解释的用药方案；协调由两个机制控制——DSWA 依据历史病例结局长期调整各智能体影响力权重，DFPC 让智能体就当前患者迭代反馈、消除处方冲突。
Result: 在 MIMIC-IV 数据库患者记录上，PRISMATIC 相比强 LLM 基线显著降低药物冲突 (drug conflicts)、提升处方覆盖度 (prescription coverage) 与治疗一致性 (treatment consistency)。
Conclusion: 把临床协同诊疗形式化为多智能体协调问题，是实现更安全、更连贯的多疾病管理的一条可行路径。

papers.title: CAST: History-Adaptive Spectral Clipping for LLM Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Soft spectral clipping (SSC) reduces gradient singular values, but its effect depends on the gradient scale and clipping threshold. We introduce CAST (Clipping with Adaptive Scales and Thresholds), a history-adaptive extension of SSC. AdamW's previous second moment sets row and column scales. An exponential moving average of the clipped output's estimated spectral norm sets each matrix's threshold. CAST restores the original coordinates before the AdamW update. We train a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model with 19.08B total parameters for 83.89B tokens. CAST achieves lower training and mean validation losses than nine gradient-processing baselines, with the fewest relative gradient spikes. It reaches the best baseline's final smoothed training loss in 7.2\% fewer steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAST 用 AdamW 的二阶矩给每个矩阵定行/列尺度、用被裁剪输出的谱范数指数滑动平均定阈值，并在 AdamW 更新前还原原始坐标，把软谱裁剪 (SSC) 改成随训练历史自适应的形式。在 19.08B 总参数、83.89B token 的 MoE 预训练上，CAST 的训练与平均验证损失低于九个梯度处理基线，相对梯度尖峰最少，用少 7.2% 的步数达到最优基线的最终平滑训练损失。
Motivation: 软谱裁剪 (SSC) 削减梯度奇异值的效果取决于梯度尺度与裁剪阈值，而这两个量在预训练过程中是变化的，固定设置无法自适应。
Method: CAST (Clipping with Adaptive Scales and Thresholds) 是 SSC 的历史自适应扩展：用 AdamW 上一步的二阶矩确定每个矩阵的行、列尺度，用被裁剪输出的估计谱范数的指数滑动平均 (EMA) 设定该矩阵的阈值，并在执行 AdamW 更新之前把张量还原回原始坐标；在一个 19.08B 总参数的 mixture-of-experts (MoE) 模型上训练 83.89B tokens。
Result: 在 19.08B 参数、83.89B token 的 MoE 训练中，CAST 的训练损失与平均验证损失均低于九个梯度处理基线，且相对梯度尖峰 (relative gradient spikes) 数量最少；达到最优基线最终平滑训练损失所需步数少 7.2%。
Conclusion: 把谱裁剪的尺度与阈值绑定到优化器历史并还原坐标，可以在 MoE 大模型预训练中同时压低损失与梯度尖峰，比固定设定的梯度处理基线更省步数。

papers.title: Discriminative Score Function: Turning Pretrained Models into Functional Generative Priors
papers.abstract_en: Discriminative models are trained with task-specific objectives such as classification, detection, or representation learning, yet their practical utility depends on generalizing beyond the training task to unseen samples from the same domain. This suggests that a discriminative model may retain an implicit trace of the data manifold beyond its task labels. We ask whether this trace can be exposed as a generative signal without task-specific guidance. We introduce the Discriminative Score Function (DSF), which extracts an image-space generative field from the loss-gradient geometry of a pretrained discriminative model. DSF provides a training-free update rule that moves images toward model-consistent visual regions without retraining or task-specific targets. We apply DSF to diverse pretrained discriminative models, including ResNet classifiers, DETR detectors, and DINOv2 ViT encoders. DSF generates unconditional images from noise and supports conditional guidance, editing, inpainting, and explanation through the same field. DSF-generated samples also provide effective zero-shot quantization calibration when real images or labels are unavailable, preserving feature geometry better than data-free calibration baselines. These results show that discriminative training leaves a generative functional signal for synthesis and calibration. Project page: https://junhoo.me/dsf.
papers.comment: 20 pages. Accepted at the Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DSF 从预训练判别模型的损失梯度几何中提取图像空间生成场，给出免训练的更新规则把噪声图像推向模型一致的视觉区域，无需重训练或任务目标。该场同时支持无条件生成、条件引导、编辑、修复与解释，并在无真实图像/标签时用于零样本量化校准，比 data-free 校准基线更好地保持特征几何。
Motivation: 判别模型只按分类、检测等任务目标训练，其是否在任务标签之外保留数据流形的隐式痕迹、能否在不做任务特定引导的情况下暴露为生成信号，是一个未解问题。
Method: DSF 从预训练判别模型的损失梯度几何提取图像空间生成场，作为免训练更新规则迭代移动图像；应用于 ResNet 分类器、DETR 检测器与 DINOv2 ViT 编码器等不同预训练模型，同一场同时承担生成、引导、编辑、修复与解释，并用于零样本量化校准。
Result: DSF 可从噪声生成无条件图像并支持条件引导、编辑、修复与解释；生成样本在无真实图像或标签可用时提供有效的零样本量化校准，比 data-free 校准基线更好地保持特征几何。
Conclusion: 判别训练会留下可用于合成与校准的生成性功能信号，因此预训练判别模型本身即可充当生成先验，无需重训练或任务特定目标。

papers.title: HyperLoop: Hyperspectral-Assisted Loop Closure Detection in 3D-SLAM for Planetary Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous navigation of planetary rovers is challenged by visually repetitive, featureless terrain. SLAM systems based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) offer dense mapping but rely on RGB appearance descriptors that degrade under perceptual aliasing - a common failure mode in extraterrestrial environments where physically distinct locations appear visually identical. This paper presents HyperLoop, the first framework integrating hyperspectral imaging (HSI) into the loop closure module of a 3DGS-based SLAM system. Hyperspectral descriptors encode material-level spectral signatures complementing RGB features, providing robustness to illumination changes and visual repetitiveness. Two HSI descriptor families are introduced: Bag-of-Spectral-Words (BoSW), encoding spectral material distributions via TF-IDF weighted histograms, and PCA-K VLAD (PCAK-VLAD), capturing first-order residual statistics of PCA-compressed spectral signatures. Both are evaluated with SIFT-VLAD and NetVLAD RGB descriptors under Strict-AND and Weighted fusion strategies on a custom dataset from the Moon-Mars Outdoor Test Site (MMOTS) at DLR, comprising synchronized RGB-D and hyperspectral sequences across four planetary analog traverses (65.5 m total). A key finding is that the sensor's Red-NIR range (600-860 nm) provides limited discriminability for rock terrain: the best HSI fusion (SIFT-VLAD + BoSW, Strict-AND) achieves 5.04 cm ATE RMSE, within 1.8% of SIFT-VLAD alone (4.95 cm). The gain over NetVLAD (8.81 cm) is attributable to SIFT-VLAD, not HSI fusion. This motivates future adoption of SWIR sensors capturing diagnostic mineral absorption features absent from the 600-860 nm range for planetary SLAM missions.
papers.comment: Paper accepted at International Astronautical Congress 2026, IAC-26,A3,IP,163,x107111
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HyperLoop 把高光谱成像 (HSI) 首次接入基于 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 的 SLAM 回环检测模块，提出 BoSW 与 PCAK-VLAD 两种光谱描述子并与 RGB 描述子做 Strict-AND / Weighted 融合。在 DLR Moon-Mars Outdoor Test Site 的四段行星类比行程（共 65.5 m）上，最佳融合 (SIFT-VLAD + BoSW, Strict-AND) ATE RMSE 5.04 cm，仅比纯 SIFT-VLAD 的 4.95 cm 差 1.8%，增益来自 SIFT-VLAD 而非 HSI；作者据此建议改用 SWIR 传感器。
Motivation: 行星车在视觉重复、无特征地形中遭遇感知混叠 (perceptual aliasing)，物理上不同的位置看起来相同，导致依赖 RGB 外观描述子的 3DGS-SLAM 回环检测失效。
Method: 提出 HyperLoop：在 3DGS-SLAM 的回环模块中引入 HSI 描述子，两类为 Bag-of-Spectral-Words (BoSW，TF-IDF 加权直方图编码光谱材料分布) 与 PCAK-VLAD (对 PCA 压缩光谱签名的一阶残差统计)；与 SIFT-VLAD、NetVLAD RGB 描述子按 Strict-AND 与 Weighted 两种策略融合，在 DLR MMOTS 自建数据集（同步 RGB-D 与高光谱序列，四段行星类比行程，65.5 m）上评测。
Result: 最佳 HSI 融合 (SIFT-VLAD + BoSW, Strict-AND) ATE RMSE 5.04 cm，与 SIFT-VLAD 单独的 4.95 cm 相差 1.8%；相对 NetVLAD 的 8.81 cm 的优势归因于 SIFT-VLAD 而非 HSI 融合。传感器 600–860 nm Red-NIR 波段对岩石地形判别力有限。
Conclusion: 600–860 nm 高光谱对行星岩石地形的回环判别贡献有限，行星 SLAM 任务应改用能捕捉诊断性矿物吸收特征的 SWIR 传感器。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Does the Linguistic Register of Thinking Matter? Wenyan as a Compact Reasoning Register for Chinese LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Visible reasoning traces of Chinese reasoning-oriented LLMs are typically written in modern vernacular Chinese, which may be verbose under limited decoding budgets. We ask whether the linguistic register of reasoning can be used to improve efficiency. We propose Wenyan Thinking, which emits intermediate reasoning in Classical Chinese (wenyanwen) while retaining a short direct-answer output. Starting from modern-Chinese reasoning traces, we rewrite only the reasoning field into wenyan and fine-tune Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 on the rewritten supervision. To distinguish register shift from generic compression, we construct a compact modern-Chinese control using the same source data, teacher family, base model, and SFT recipe. Across budget-sensitive evaluations on MMLU-ProX-Lite-ZH, CEVAL, and AGIEval-CN, Wenyan Thinking substantially reduces reasoning length and missing-answer rates under constrained decoding. Compact rewriting explains much of the efficiency gain, while wenyan consistently outperforms the compact modern-Chinese control on the primary benchmark and remains competitive across the additional benchmarks. These results identify linguistic register as a practical design axis for efficient visible reasoning in Chinese LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把中文推理模型的可见推理段改写成文言文 (wenyan) 并微调，可在受限解码预算下显著缩短推理长度、降低漏答率；与同源同配方的紧凑现代汉语对照相比，文言在主基准上仍更优，说明语域 (register) 本身是独立于压缩的设计轴。
Motivation: 中文推理型 LLM 的可见推理多用现代白话，在有限解码预算下冗长、易漏答；需要区分效率收益究竟来自压缩还是来自语域本身。
Method: 提出 Wenyan Thinking：仅把现有现代汉语推理轨迹的 reasoning 字段改写为文言，保留简短直接答案，再用改写后监督对 Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 做 SFT；同时用相同源数据、teacher 家族、基座模型和 SFT 配方构造紧凑现代汉语对照，以分离语域迁移与一般压缩。
Result: 在 MMLU-ProX-Lite-ZH、CEVAL、AGIEval-CN 三个预算敏感评测上，Wenyan Thinking 在受限解码下显著降低推理长度与漏答率；紧凑改写解释了大部分效率增益，但文言在主基准上持续优于紧凑现代汉语对照，并在其余基准保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 语言语域是中文 LLM 高效可见推理的一个实用设计轴，其收益不完全等同于压缩。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ProtModernBERT: Compute-Efficient Protein Language Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Large protein language models provide a powerful framework for learning sequence-function relationships and guiding experimental design. However, architectural improvements are underexplored, especially in low-compute regimes of relevance for resource-constrained research laboratories. We show that the training cost for encoder-only transformer architectures can be reduced by leveraging modern architectural refinements, offering an encouraging performance / compute-efficiency trade-off. We introduce ProtModernBERT, a modernized BERT-style model pre-trained on amino acid sequences, and compare it with ProtBert, Amplify, and ESM2 across a set of supervised structural tasks -encompassing secondary structure prediction, disorder prediction, and subcellular localization- and ProteinGym's zero-shot functional benchmark. We find that ProtModernBERT matches or closely tracks the performance of Amplify-120M and ProtBert with up to 80-90\% reduction in pre-training FLOPs, and narrows the gap to ESM2 when controlling for pre-training. Our analysis using a cluster-based validation protocol for hyperparameter selection and randomly initialized models disentangles the contributions of architecture and data, showing that modern components provide stronger inductive biases that are more consequential than parameter count in low-compute regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProtModernBERT 把现代 BERT 架构改进搬到氨基酸序列预训练上，在低算力预算下以更少 FLOPs 追平大模型：相对 Amplify-120M 与 ProtBert，预训练 FLOPs 最多减少 80-90% 仍匹配或紧贴其性能，并在控制预训练条件后缩小与 ESM2 的差距。结论是在低算力体制下架构带来的归纳偏置比参数量更关键。
Motivation: 资源受限实验室难以承担大蛋白语言模型的预训练开销，而 encoder-only 架构的现代改进在该低算力区间基本未被系统探索。
Method: 提出 ProtModernBERT：在氨基酸序列上预训练的现代化 BERT 式 encoder-only 模型，与 ProtBert、Amplify、ESM2 对比；评测覆盖二级结构预测、无序预测、亚细胞定位等监督结构任务与 ProteinGym 零样本功能基准，并用基于聚类的验证协议做超参选择、以随机初始化模型分离架构与数据的贡献。
Result: 在控制预训练的条件下，ProtModernBERT 以最多 80-90% 的预训练 FLOPs 削减匹配或紧贴 Amplify-120M 与 ProtBert 的表现，并缩小与 ESM2 的差距；分析显示现代组件提供的归纳偏置在低算力体制下比参数量更具决定性。
Conclusion: 低算力预算下，架构现代化带来的归纳偏置比堆参数更划算，encoder-only 蛋白模型可以用显著更少的预训练 FLOPs 达到同等水平。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Object Pose from 2-D to 3-D Point and Line Correspondences
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we present a method for optimally estimating the rotation and translation between a camera and a 3-D object from point and/or line correspondences. First we devise an error function and second we show how to minimize this error function. The quadratic nature of this function is made possible by representing rotation and translation with a dual number quaternion. We provide a detailed account of the computational aspects of a trust-region optimization method. This method compares favourably with Newton's method which has extensively been used to solve the problem at hand, with Faugeras-Toscani linear method [6] for calibrating a camera, and with the Levenberg-Marquardt non-linear optimization method. Finally we present some experimental results which demonstrate the robustness of our method with respect to image noise and matching errors.
papers.journal_ref: International Journal of Computer Vision. vol. 15, pp. 225-243, July 1995
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 dual number quaternion 表示旋转与平移，使由点和/或线对应构造的误差函数成为二次型，再用 trust-region 方法最小化，得到相机相对 3-D 物体位姿的最优估计。该方法在计算上与 Newton 法、Faugeras-Toscani 线性标定法及 Levenberg-Marquardt 相比表现更优，并在实验中对图像噪声与匹配误差表现出稳健性。
Motivation: 从点线对应估计相机位姿时，旋转的非线性参数化使误差函数非二次，Newton 法等通用优化器在噪声与误匹配下稳定性不足。
Method: 以 dual number quaternion 联合参数化旋转与平移，构造二次型误差函数；给出 trust-region 优化方法的完整计算流程，并与 Newton 法、Faugeras-Toscani 线性相机标定法、Levenberg-Marquardt 非线性优化作对比。
Result: trust-region 方法与 Newton 法、Faugeras-Toscani 线性法、Levenberg-Marquardt 相比比较结果有利；实验结果表明该方法对图像噪声和匹配误差具有稳健性。
Conclusion: dual number quaternion 参数化能把位姿估计误差函数变成二次型，从而让 trust-region 优化在点线对应位姿求解上比通用非线性优化更稳健。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exact Cut Complexity of Equal-Length Proportional Cake Cutting
papers.abstract_en: We study proportional cake cutting under an equal-length constraint, where each of $n$ agents must receive a bundle of length exactly $1/n$ that is worth at least $1/n$ to that agent. Our main result determines the exact worst-case number of cuts needed to guarantee such an allocation, namely $2n-2$ for every $n$. This improves on the previously known quadratic upper bound. The proof combines the constrained necklace-splitting theorem with a recursive assignment argument based on Hall's theorem. The same bound extends to the stronger requirement of envy-freeness when $n$ is a prime power, and an $O(n^{1.525})$ upper bound holds for arbitrary $n$. We then ask whether such allocations can be computed. We first show that no deterministic protocol in the Robertson--Webb model terminates after finitely many queries on every instance and always returns an exact equal-length proportional allocation, even for two agents with identical valuations. For every $\varepsilon>0$, however, $O(n^2/\varepsilon)$ queries suffice to produce an allocation in which every agent receives a bundle of length exactly $1/n$ and value at least $1/n-\varepsilon$, again using at most $2n-2$ cuts. Finally, we augment the Robertson--Webb model with two-knife queries. We show that recursive balanced halving attains the optimal bound of $2n-2$ cuts when $n$ is a power of two. For arbitrary $n$, we give a procedure using $O(n\log n)$ cuts.
papers.comment: A preliminary version of this paper appeared in the proceedings of the 51st International Symposium on Mathematical Foundations of Computer Science (MFCS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在等长约束的比例蛋糕切割中，证明保证存在每个 agent 长度恰为 1/n、价值至少 1/n 的分配所需的最坏情形切割数恰为 2n-2，把此前的二次上界降到线性。该界在 n 为素数幂时同样适用于 envy-freeness，一般 n 时有 O(n^1.525) 上界；Robertson–Webb 模型下不存在有限查询内总返回精确解的确定性协议，但 O(n^2/ε) 查询可给出价值至少 1/n−ε 的近似解且仍只用 2n−2 刀。
Motivation: 等长约束下的比例切割此前只有二次切割数上界，且精确可计算性未知：需要确定保证存在所需的最坏切割数，并弄清在标准 Robertson–Webb 查询模型中能否有限步算出精确分配。
Method: 证明结合受限 necklace-splitting 定理与基于 Hall 定理的递归指派论证；计算性部分在 Robertson–Webb 模型中给出否定结果，再引入 two-knife 查询扩展模型，用递归均衡对半 (recursive balanced halving) 求解。
Result: 保证存在的最坏切割数恰为 2n−2（对每个 n），改进此前二次上界；n 为素数幂时同一界适用于 envy-freeness，任意 n 有 O(n^1.525) 上界。Robertson–Webb 模型中无确定性协议在所有实例上有限查询终止并返回精确等长比例分配（即使两 agent 价值相同）；对任意 ε>0，O(n^2/ε) 查询可得长度恰为 1/n、价值至少 1/n−ε 的分配且至多 2n−2 刀。two-knife 模型下递归均衡对半在 n 为 2 的幂时达到最优 2n−2 刀，任意 n 用 O(n log n) 刀。
Conclusion: 等长约束把比例切割的最坏切割复杂度定在 2n−2 这一线性精确界，而精确可计算性在 Robertson–Webb 模型中不可达，需借助 two-knife 查询或允许 ε 近似。
Relevance: 0
