summary_sections.result: 保证存在的最坏切割数恰为 2n−2（对每个 n），改进此前二次上界；n 为素数幂时同一界适用于 envy-freeness，任意 n 有 O(n^1.525) 上界。Robertson–Webb 模型中无确定性协议在所有实例上有限查询终止并返回精确等长比例分配（即使两 agent 价值相同）；对任意 ε>0，O(n^2/ε) 查询可得长度恰为 1/n、价值至少 1/n−ε 的分配且至多 2n−2 刀。two-knife 模型下递归均衡对半在 n 为 2 的幂时达到最优 2n−2 刀，任意 n 用 O(n log n) 刀。
summary_sections.conclusion: 等长约束把比例切割的最坏切割复杂度定在 2n−2 这一线性精确界，而精确可计算性在 Robertson–Webb 模型中不可达，需借助 two-knife 查询或允许 ε 近似。

papers.title: What Happens to the Goal? Distinct Failures of Policy Alignment in Goal Misgeneralization
papers.abstract_en: Goal misgeneralization is a common failure mode in which an agent behaves competently out of distribution but does not pursue the intended goal. However, we still have a weak understanding of what happens to the intended goal in misgeneralizing agents. Across three Procgen environments and five robot tasks, we find three distinct forms of policy-goal misalignment: (1) functional target substitution, where behavior follows an alternative goal, (2) a policy shortcut, where behavior follows a learned action strategy, and (3) cue competition between intended and proxy goal cues. We distinguish these regimes by tracing where goal information remains available internally, how strongly it influences the policy, and what role it plays in action selection, and find that the goal is lost at different depths. Where the goal reaches the decision, as in cue competition, steering redirects the policy to the goal's location, raising intended-goal reach from 16.0% to 95.3%. Where it reaches the policy but not the decision, only new downstream wiring recovers goal reach, from 31.6% to 84.3% in the environment with the action shortcut. Where it is inert, neither works. Our results show that goal misgeneralization is not a single failure of goal representation, but distinct failures of policy alignment at different depths, tightly connected to which recovery works.
papers.comment: 10 pages main text, 120 pages total. Code: https://github.com/Julbarth/what-happens-to-the-goal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Procgen 三环境与五个机器人任务上，把目标误泛化 (goal misgeneralization) 拆成三种策略-目标失配：功能目标替代、策略捷径 (policy shortcut)、目标线索竞争 (cue competition)，区分依据是目标信息在智能体内部还留在哪一层、对策略影响多强、在动作选择中起什么作用。目标丢失深度决定哪种恢复手段有效：目标仍到达决策层时 steering 把到达率从 16.0% 提到 95.3%；到达策略但不到决策层时只有新的下游连接有效，从 31.6% 提到 84.3%；目标完全惰性时两者都无效。
Motivation: 目标误泛化已被广泛观察，但误泛化后原目标在智能体内部究竟发生了什么仍不清楚，导致无法判断哪种干预能恢复原目标行为。
Method: 在三个 Procgen 环境与五个机器人任务上追踪目标信息在内部的留存位置、对策略的影响强度及其在动作选择中的角色，据此划分三类失配；再分别施加 steering 与新的下游连接两类恢复手段，比较其效果。
Result: 目标到达决策层（线索竞争）时 steering 将 intended-goal reach 从 16.0% 提升至 95.3%；目标到达策略但不到决策层（动作捷径环境）时，仅新的下游连接可恢复，goal reach 从 31.6% 提升至 84.3%；目标惰性时两类手段均无法恢复。
Conclusion: 目标误泛化不是单一的目标表征失败，而是发生在不同深度的多种策略对齐失败，且失败深度直接决定哪种恢复方法起作用。

papers.title: A Diagnostic Study of World-Space Human Recovery Under High Camera Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Monocular world-space human recovery methods excel on current benchmarks, but these rarely include fast camera motion. We introduce the K-Pop stress test, broadcast dance videos that combine fast, large camera motion with dense multi-person choreography. Leading methods produce plausible per-frame meshes on these videos, yet their world-space trajectories drift far from the performers' stage positions. Through a systematic diagnosis, we show that the camera and human estimates each remain self-consistent, and that the drift appears when they are combined at mismatched scales. Each is recovered at its own scale, so a mismatch between the two can turn camera motion into human drift that grows with camera displacement and becomes severe in broadcast dance videos. We derive a closed-form correction that estimates this mismatch and applies one scale to all performers, removing the drift while keeping their relative positions in one shared world frame. It requires no retraining and works with existing backends. Combined with physical constraints, the correction yields stable world-space reconstruction for choreography modeling, scene editing, data generation, and virtual reshooting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 单目世界坐标人体恢复在快相机运动下会漂移：相机与人体估计各自自洽，但两者在不匹配的尺度上被组合，相机运动被转成随相机位移增长的人体漂移。作者提出闭式尺度校正，对所有表演者施加同一尺度，无需重训即可消除漂移并保持共享世界系中的相对位置。
Motivation: 现有单目世界坐标人体恢复基准很少包含快速相机运动，导致相机与人体尺度不匹配引发的漂移问题未被暴露和诊断。
Method: 提出 K-Pop 压力测试（快相机运动 + 密集多人编舞的广播舞蹈视频），系统诊断漂移来源，并推导闭式尺度失配校正，对所有表演者统一施加一个尺度，可与现有后端结合且无需重训。
Result: 领先方法在该视频上能产生看似合理的逐帧 mesh，但世界坐标轨迹严重偏离表演者舞台位置；漂移随相机位移增长，在广播舞蹈视频中变得严重；闭式校正在保留共享世界系相对位置的同时消除漂移。
Conclusion: 世界坐标漂移源于相机与人体估计的尺度失配而非各自估计失效，统一尺度校正结合物理约束可得到稳定的编舞建模、场景编辑、数据生成与虚拟重拍重建。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Mitigating Video Hallucinations via Attention-Guided Representation Perturbation
papers.abstract_en: Video large language models (Video LLMs) often generate responses unsupported by the input video. Contrastive decoding (CD) can mitigate these hallucinations, but its effectiveness depends on how the negative branch weakens visual evidence. Existing methods rely on predefined perturbations or masking guided by question reconstruction, offering limited control over the model's visual reliance during answer generation. We introduce Attention-guided Representation Perturbation for Contrastive Decoding (ARP-CD), a training-free framework for constructing contrastive negatives directly in representation space. ARP-CD uses the attention mass assigned to visual tokens at the answer-prediction position to guide bounded gradient updates of the language model's input visual hidden states. These updates reduce visual attention and produce a negative input, whose predictions are contrasted with those of the original branch throughout generation. Experiments across four Video LLMs and four benchmarks show that ARP-CD outperforms representative training-free baselines in most model--benchmark settings, reducing hallucinations while improving general video understanding. Further analyses show that attention-guided perturbation directions improve negative quality and that the resulting negatives provide effective contrastive references for correcting the original predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARP-CD 是一个免训练的对比解码框架：在答案预测位置用模型对视觉 token 的注意力质量，引导对语言模型输入视觉隐状态的有界梯度更新，削弱视觉注意力后构造负分支，并在整个生成过程中与原分支预测做对比。在 4 个 Video LLM × 4 个视频问答基准上，它在多数模型-基准组合中优于代表性免训练基线，同时降低幻觉并改善通用视频理解。
Motivation: Video LLM 常生成与输入视频不一致的回答；现有对比解码方法依赖预定义扰动或由问题重建引导的掩码，对生成过程中模型依赖视觉证据的程度控制有限。
Method: 免训练框架，直接在表示空间构造对比负例：取答案预测位置上分配给视觉 token 的注意力质量，引导对输入视觉隐状态的有界梯度更新，降低视觉注意力得到负输入，再将其预测与原分支预测在生成全程对比。
Result: 在 4 个 Video LLM 和 4 个视频基准上，多数模型-基准设置中优于代表性免训练基线，降低幻觉同时提升通用视频理解；进一步分析显示注意力引导的扰动方向改善负例质量，所得负例为纠正原预测提供有效对比参照。
Conclusion: 在表示空间用注意力引导的有界扰动构造对比负例，比预定义扰动或掩码更能控制视觉依赖，从而在免训练条件下缓解视频幻觉。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Generative World Simulation with DAO and JING
papers.abstract_en: We present a Generative World Simulation framework that couples persistent shared world state with continuous first-person audiovisual generation. The framework integrates DAO, a computable world engine, and JING, an Egocentric Interactive Experience Model, to support sustained interaction for humans and agents. DAO maintains the states of characters, objects, and spaces and their relationships, advancing the world according to interaction rules and world time while preserving the consequences of past actions. From this evolving state, DAO derives observer-specific conditions for JING, which combines these conditions with character, object, and scene references, observation history, and current actions to generate each observer's audiovisual experience. Users can explore environments, manipulate objects, and communicate with characters through viewpoint control and text instructions, with their actions shaping both the shared state and subsequent experiences. By connecting world-state evolution with experience generation in a continuous interaction loop, the framework offers an approach to building interactive worlds that retain their history, evolve through action, and persist beyond any individual observer.
papers.comment: XGEN DAO and JING Technical report. Contributors listed alphabetically by surname. Project page: https://xgenlabs.ai/research/generative-world-simulation; Model: https://huggingface.co/XGENlabs/XGEN-JING
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出生成式世界模拟框架，把持久共享世界状态 DAO 与第一人称视听生成模型 JING 接成连续交互闭环：DAO 按交互规则和世界时间推进角色、物体、空间及其关系并保留既往动作后果，再据此为每个观察者派生条件，由 JING 结合角色/物体/场景参考、观察历史与当前动作生成其视听体验。用户的视角控制与文本指令同时改写共享状态和后续体验，使世界能随动作演化并独立于任何单个观察者持续存在。
Motivation: 现有交互式世界生成缺少可计算的持久状态：动作后果难以跨观察者保留，环境无法在无人观察时继续演化。
Method: DAO 作为可计算世界引擎维护角色、物体、空间及其关系的状态，按交互规则与世界时间推进并保留历史动作后果；从该状态派生观察者相关条件，JING 将其与角色/物体/场景参考、观察历史、当前动作结合，生成该观察者的音频与视觉体验，二者构成连续交互闭环。
Result: 框架支持用户通过视角控制与文本指令探索环境、操纵物体、与角色交流，动作同时塑造共享状态与后续体验；世界保留历史、随动作演化并超越单个观察者持续存在。配套发布 XGEN-JING 模型与项目页。
Conclusion: 把世界状态演化与体验生成耦合在闭环里，是构建有历史、可持久的交互式世界的一条可行路径。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: TIMERSI: Towards Self-Improved Agentic Deployment for Time-Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Time-series foundation models provide strong zero-shot forecast, but deployment for real- world applications still requires task-specific designs for model inputs and outputs. Direct inference can leave domain knowledge and re- curring forecast errors unaddressed, while tai- lored pipelines require substantial human ex- pertise and effort. We introduce TIMERSI, a self-improving agentic deployment system around frozen forecasting models. A cod- ing agent translates task descriptions into ex- ecutable pipeline changes. It tests each re- vision on historical forecasting windows and uses observed errors to guide subsequent re- visions. During deployment, an adaptive se- lector chooses among the resulting pipelines using completed forecasts under similar con- ditions. Across 198 tasks on TIME and FEV- bench, TIMERSI outperforms all submissions on six point and probabilistic forecasting met- rics. Controlled comparisons support the value of feedback-guided revision over non-iterative pipeline search. Further experiments verify the generalization with different coding agents and forecasting models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TIMERSI 是围绕冻结时序基础模型的自改进智能体部署系统：编码智能体把任务描述改写成可执行的流水线修改，在历史预报窗口上测试每次修订并用观测误差指导下一轮修订，部署期由自适应选择器按相似条件下的已完成预报挑选流水线。在 TIME 与 FEV bench 共 198 个任务上，它在六项点预报与概率预报指标上超过全部提交，并且受控对比支持反馈引导修订优于非迭代流水线搜索。
Motivation: 时序基础模型零样本预报能力强，但真实部署仍需针对任务设计输入输出：直接推理留着领域知识与反复出现的预报错误不管，而定制流水线又需要大量人工经验与工作量。
Method: 围绕冻结的预报模型搭一个自改进智能体系统 TIMERSI：编码智能体把任务描述翻译成可执行的流水线修改，在历史预报窗口上测试每个修订，用观测到的误差引导后续修订；部署时自适应选择器依据相似条件下已完成的预报在这些流水线之间做选择。
Result: 在 TIME 与 FEV bench 的 198 个任务上，TIMERSI 在六项点预报与概率预报指标上超过所有提交；受控对比支持反馈引导修订优于非迭代流水线搜索；额外实验在不同编码智能体与不同预报模型上验证了泛化性。

papers.title: Recognizing Dialogue Ambiguity via Candidate Set Visual Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Interpreting an ambiguous utterance in real-world interactions often requires context beyond a single utterance. When the utterance refers to objects in a visual scene, it is necessary to maintain and update the set of plausible referents as context accumulates, without assuming that the available information identifies a unique object. However, prior work on interactive visual grounding, which localizes objects referred to by linguistic expressions, has focused on identifying a unique object once sufficient dialogue context becomes available. To address this gap, we propose Candidate Set Visual Grounding (CSVG), a task for estimating the set of objects consistent with the given dialogue context. We further introduce CandVG, a benchmark that evaluates how the candidate set changes across dialogue turns. Our evaluation of vision-language models shows that stronger visual grounding capability does not necessarily yield better CSVG performance. In particular, models have difficulty predicting the complete candidate set, owing to challenges in candidate generation and premature commitment to a small set of candidates in early turns. Nevertheless, we find that this limitation can be partially mitigated in the evaluated large-scale models using instructions designed for CSVG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出候选集视觉定位任务 (CSVG)：在多轮对话中不假设唯一指代，而是估计与累积上下文一致的全部对象集合，并发布评测候选集随轮次变化的基准 CandVG。对视觉-语言模型的评测显示，视觉定位能力更强并不必然带来更好的 CSVG 表现，主要失败模式是候选生成不全与早期轮次过早收敛到小集合；针对 CSVG 设计的指令可在大规模模型上部分缓解该问题。
Motivation: 既有交互式视觉定位工作在上下文足够后就锁定唯一对象，而真实对话中的歧义指代需要随上下文累积维护并更新一组可能指代物，这一设定此前缺少任务定义与评测基准。
Method: 定义 CSVG 任务，估计与给定对话上下文一致的对象候选集；构建 CandVG 基准，按对话轮次考察候选集如何变化，并用为 CSVG 设计的指令评测视觉-语言模型。
Result: 评测发现更强的视觉定位能力不必然带来更好的 CSVG 性能；模型难以预测完整候选集，困难来自候选生成与早期轮次对小集合的过早承诺；在被评测的大规模模型上，CSVG 专用指令可部分缓解这一局限。
Conclusion: CSVG 需要独立于唯一指代定位的能力与评测口径，指令设计能在大规模模型上部分改善候选集完整性。

papers.title: ONCship: A Large-Scale Underwater Acoustic Corpus for Ship Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in deep learning have significantly improved underwater acoustic vessel recognition. However, existing publicly available datasets are typically limited in scale, hindering large-scale representation learning and downstream task evaluation. To address this limitation, we introduce ONCship, a large-scale underwater acoustic dataset comprising 4521 hours of curated recordings from Ocean Networks Canada (ONC) hydrophones and Automatic Identification System (AIS) data. We evaluate the proposed dataset across three tasks: self-supervised representation learning, vessel-type classification, and MMSI-Level Vessel Classification. Experiments on DeepShip and ShipsEar demonstrate the effectiveness of ONCship for acoustic representation learning, with joint pre-training on ONCship and AudioSet achieving a classification accuracy of 62.45% on DeepShip through linear probing. Furthermore, incorporating ONCship as auxiliary training data improves downstream vessel-type classification performance. Beyond conventional vessel-type classification, we further investigate MMSI-Level Vessel Classification, treating each vessel as a distinct identity. Experimental results show that models fine-tuned with different loss functions achieve Top-1 accuracies exceeding 53% and Top-5 accuracies approaching 69%, demonstrating the feasibility of distinguishing individual vessels through MMSI-Level Vessel Classification. Overall, ONCship provides a valuable resource for underwater acoustic representation learning and vessel recognition, while its rich vessel-level metadata enables further exploration of MMSI-Level Vessel Classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ONCship 是 4521 小时的水声船舶识别语料，录音来自 Ocean Networks Canada (ONC) 水听器并配 AIS 船舶身份元数据。在 DeepShip 上用 ONCship 与 AudioSet 联合预训练后线性探测 (linear probing) 分类准确率达 62.45%，把 ONCship 作为辅助训练数据还能进一步提升船型分类；把每条船当独立身份的 MMSI-Level 分类微调后 Top-1 超过 53%、Top-5 接近 69%。
Motivation: 现有公开水声船舶数据集规模偏小，限制了大规模表征学习与下游任务评测，也难以支撑逐船身份级别的识别。
Method: 构建含 4521 小时整理录音的 ONCship（ONC 水听器 + AIS 元数据），在三个任务上评测：自监督表征学习、船型分类、MMSI-Level Vessel Classification（每条船视为一个身份）；预训练采用 ONCship 与 AudioSet 联合训练并做线性探测，下游用不同损失函数微调。
Result: ONCship 与 AudioSet 联合预训练在 DeepShip 上线性探测分类准确率 62.45%；在 DeepShip 与 ShipsEar 上的实验显示其对声学表征学习有效，加入 ONCship 作辅助训练数据可提升下游船型分类性能；MMSI-Level 分类用不同损失微调后 Top-1 准确率超过 53%、Top-5 接近 69%。
Conclusion: 4521 小时带船舶级元数据的水声语料足以支撑从表征预训练到逐船身份识别的下游任务，MMSI-Level Vessel Classification 在实验上可行。

papers.title: Articulation Upper Bounds for Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Language captures only a subset of the perceptions, intuitions and intents that form meaning between speakers. What, then, are the limits of language? We take steps towards measuring this in LLMs as follows: for a set of concepts, we measure how well each concept can be transmitted between two LLMs as their capabilities scale. This requires novel measurement tools: (1) optimal messages: we introduce a prompt optimization algorithm that beats existing algorithms by up to 14% on benchmarks and accurately estimates prompt upper bounds. (2) A transmission measure: the sender is asked to label text; the receiver then tries to recover the sender's prompt, and recovery is measured; we find this correlates strongly with human label error. With these measures, we use observational scaling laws to study how transmissibility of a concept, conveyed with optimal messages, increases as transmitter and receiver capacity grows: does it asymptote below or above a threshold? Measuring 1.2k concepts in eight domains, we find concepts that (a) can be fully articulated; these concepts usually depend on local patterns, e.g. "joke ends with surprise"; (b) might be articulated by future, stronger models; these rely on whole-text structural patterns, e.g. "story's worldbuilding coherence"; (c) concepts that face articulability limits; these concepts' meaning, we find, is tied to identity and social-group awareness, e.g. "comic voice". Interesting, these same concepts are not all challenging for humans: humans have moderate-to-high levels of agreement in 76% of concepts that LLMs struggle with; articulation limits, we find, are executor relative. Finally, we characterize the nature of improvement in each case: while recoverable concepts can be articulated through definitions and explanations, irrecoverable concepts cannot be transmitted, even with examples, and might require novel learning mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出一套测量 LLM 之间概念可传达性 (transmissibility) 上界的工具：用 prompt 优化算法找最优消息，再让接收方从标注文本反推发送方 prompt，以恢复率衡量概念能否被语言完整表达。在 8 个领域 1.2k 个概念上，观测到三类概念——可完全表达（多依赖局部模式）、未来更强模型或可表达（依赖全篇结构）、存在表达上界（意义绑定身份与社会群体），且这些上界是 executor 相对的。
Motivation: 语言只承载说话者之间意义的一部分，但 LLM 中单个概念能被传达的上限缺少可量化手段；需要区分概念是当前模型表达不了、未来模型能表达，还是本质上无法用语言表达。
Method: 两件测量工具：一是 prompt 优化算法，在基准上比现有算法最多高 14%，并用于估计 prompt 上界；二是传输度量——发送方给文本打标签，接收方尝试恢复发送方的 prompt，按恢复程度计分，该分数与人类标注误差强相关。再用 observational scaling laws 分析最优消息下概念可传达性随发送/接收方容量增长是否渐近于某阈值之上或之下。
Result: prompt 优化算法在基准上比现有算法最多提升 14%；传输度量与人类标注误差强相关；在 8 个领域 1.2k 个概念上分出三类：可完全表达（如 joke ends with surprise，依赖局部模式）、未来更强模型或可表达（如 story's worldbuilding coherence，依赖全篇结构）、存在表达上界（如 comic voice，意义绑定身份与社会群体）。LLM 挣扎的这些概念中，人类在 76% 上仍有中到高一致度。
Conclusion: 表达上界是 executor 相对的：可恢复概念能靠定义和解释传达，不可恢复概念即使给例子也无法传输，可能需要全新的学习机制。

papers.title: Learning Individual Scientific Taste with Privileged Hindsight Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Scientific taste shapes which research directions researchers pursue, and it varies across individuals. Existing work evaluates research directions along multiple evaluation criteria or models scientific taste using community feedback signals such as citations and reviews, but neither directly captures how individuals translate assessments under the same criteria into different preferences. We model scientific taste as a researcher-specific mapping from criterion-level assessments in a shared, evidence-grounded evaluation space with proposal-visible evidence, to relative preferences. A population-level mapping learned from retrospective supervision provides a cold start when individual feedback is scarce. We introduce Privileged Hindsight Distillation (PHD), which uses later-emerging scientific evidence during training to improve proposal-time criterion assessment and the population mapping, while exposing only proposal-visible information at inference. We evaluate our approach primarily in quantum research, where structured public reviews are largely unavailable, and use pairwise proposal comparison as a direct interface for observing individual taste. With only 15 comparisons per researcher, our method captures sharply different tastes, including opposing preferences over the same research-direction pairs when they trade off across evaluation criteria. In an interactive study, personalized rankings also surface proposals associated with greater subsequent user engagement, connecting learned taste to downstream research exploration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把科研品味 (scientific taste) 建模为研究者个体在共享评价标准空间中，从准则级评估到相对偏好的私有映射，并提出 Privileged Hindsight Distillation (PHD)：训练时用后验才出现的科学证据改进提案期的准则评估与群体映射，推理时只暴露提案期可见信息。每位研究者仅 15 次成对比较即可捕捉截然不同的品味，包括对同一研究方向对在准则权衡下的相反偏好。
Motivation: 现有工作用多准则评估研究方向，或用引用、评审等社区反馈信号建模科研品味，但都未直接刻画个体如何在同一套准则评估下形成不同偏好；量子研究领域又缺少结构化公开评审。
Method: PHD 用后验科学证据 (privileged hindsight) 在训练阶段改进提案期的准则级评估与群体级映射，推理时仅输入提案可见信息；群体映射由回溯性监督学习，为个体反馈稀缺时提供冷启动，个体层面以成对提案比较 (pairwise proposal comparison) 作为观察品味的接口。
Result: 每位研究者仅需 15 次成对比较即可捕捉 sharply different tastes，包括在跨准则权衡的研究方向对上出现相反偏好；在交互式研究中，个性化排序能浮出与后续用户参与度更高相关的提案。评估主要在量子研究 (quantum research) 上进行。
Conclusion: 科研品味可被表示为准则评估到偏好的个体映射，并在极少个体反馈下用后验证据蒸馏学到；学到的品味与下游科研探索行为相连。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 科研品味可被表示为准则评估到偏好的个体映射，并在极少个体反馈下用后验证据蒸馏学到；学到的品味与下游科研探索行为相连。

papers.title: No Way To Steal My Face: Proactive Defense Against Identity-Preserving Personalized Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in diffusion models have enabled high-fidelity, identity-preserving image generation for personalized applications such as digital avatars and virtual try-on systems. However, their reliance on sensitive facial reference images raises growing privacy concerns. Existing defense mechanisms are primarily designed for training-based personalization and struggle to generalize to emerging training-free approaches, due to fundamental differences in their identity integration paradigms. To bridge this gap, we propose IDGuardian-the first generalizable and model-agnostic identity protection framework capable of defending against both training-based and training-free personalization methods. IDGuardian abstracts the personalization process into two critical stages: identity extraction and identity injection. It then introduces crafted adversarial perturbations to simultaneously disrupt both stages. Specifically, it degrades the identity features extracted by external encoders and establishes an adversarial conceptual bridge that misdirects the generative trajectory away from the target identity. Extensive experiments show that IDGuardian effectively protects identity across various personalization pipelines and model architectures, while remaining robust to post-processing, adaptive attacks, and cross-dataset generalization. Our code is available at https://github.com/OpenAscent-L/IDGuardian.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IDGuardian 把个性化生成抽象为身份提取与身份注入两个阶段，用同一组对抗扰动同时破坏外部编码器提取的身份特征，并建立对抗概念桥把生成轨迹引离目标身份。它对基于训练与免训练两类个性化流程、多种模型架构均有效，且对后处理、自适应攻击和跨数据集保持鲁棒。
Motivation: 扩散模型的免训练个性化兴起后，只针对基于训练方法的防御失效，因为两类方法的身份整合范式不同，人脸参考图隐私缺少通用保护手段。
Method: 提出模型无关框架 IDGuardian：将个性化拆为 identity extraction 与 identity injection 两阶段，注入精心构造的对抗扰动，既劣化外部编码器提取的身份特征，又建立对抗概念桥误导生成轨迹偏离目标身份。
Result: 在多种个性化流程与模型架构上保护身份有效，并对后处理、自适应攻击与跨数据集泛化保持鲁棒；代码发布于 github.com/OpenAscent-L/IDGuardian。
Conclusion: 身份保护应同时覆盖提取与注入两个阶段，才能跨基于训练与免训练范式通用。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Driven Self-Play for Robust Multi-Agent Driving Policies
papers.abstract_en: Learning robust driving policies that generalize beyond their training domain remains a central challenge in motion planning. We propose an uncertainty-driven self-play scheme, in which half of the agents are rewarded for increasing their neighbors' epistemic uncertainty, while the other half learn to drive safely as the exploring agents continuously seek out their weaknesses. Epistemic uncertainty indicates where the policy is least confident and serves as an automatic proxy for scenario difficulty. Exploring agents use this signal to seek out hard cases, generating a challenging curriculum without manual scenario design. The resulting policy outperforms standard self-play, achieving best-in-class zero-shot transfer to nuplan Val14 (99.12% vs. 97.97%) and Argoverse 2 (82.39% vs. 78.03%) without fine-tuning, while also improving performance over standard self-play on Waymo. Our diversity-driven approach achieves 85% higher LSTM hidden-state coverage than the baseline, indicating a much richer set of behaviors. Further analysis shows that epistemic uncertainty serves as a calibrated difficulty detector, with highest-uncertain agents exhibiting 14.8 times the combined failure rate across collision, off-road, and DNF, of lowest-uncertain agents, enabling automatic prioritization of challenging scenarios without ground-truth labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出不确定性驱动的自博弈 (uncertainty-driven self-play)：一半智能体以提高邻居的认知不确定性 (epistemic uncertainty) 为奖励去主动寻找对手弱点，另一半在其逼迫下学习安全驾驶，从而自动生成难例课程而无需人工设计场景。最终策略零样本迁移到 nuplan Val14 达 99.12%（标准自博弈 97.97%）、Argoverse 2 达 82.39%（78.03%），LSTM 隐状态覆盖率比基线高 85%。
Motivation: 驾驶策略在训练域之外的泛化仍是运动规划的核心难题；人工设计难例场景成本高，且难以自动识别哪些场景真正困难。
Method: 双群体自博弈：探索智能体以提升邻居的认知不确定性为奖励，被探索智能体学习安全驾驶；认知不确定性作为策略置信度最低处的信号，兼作场景难度的自动代理，无需真值标签即可排序难例。
Result: 零样本迁移（无微调）：nuplan Val14 99.12% vs 标准自博弈 97.97%，Argoverse 2 82.39% vs 78.03%，Waymo 上亦优于标准自博弈；LSTM 隐状态覆盖率比基线高 85%；不确定性最高的智能体在碰撞、越界与 DNF 合并失败率上是最低不确定性智能体的 14.8 倍。
Conclusion: 把认知不确定性同时用作对抗奖励和难度探测器，可以在无人工场景设计的前提下自动生成课程，提升跨域零样本驾驶策略的鲁棒性与行为多样性。

papers.title: New Model, Old Habits: Behavior Transfer under Model Swapping in Multi-Session LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multi-session agents can switch between LLMs to balance performance and inference cost. Such switches require transferring a history for continuity, yet their effects on the recipient remain underexplored. Through controlled experiments with multi-session tasks, we uncover behavior transfer: recipients tend to adopt reasoning and action patterns from the models that generated their histories. This effect is most evident with raw-history transfer but is substantially reduced by summarization. Based on these findings, we propose Direction- and Authorship-aware Summarization of History (DASH) that preserves stronger-model behavior while minimizing weak-to-strong transfer via summarization. Experiments with repeated swaps show that DASH outperforms raw-history transfer and naive summarization baselines. These results suggest that effective multi-model orchestration requires considering not only which model to use, but also which behavioral patterns to carry forward.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多会话 LLM agent 在模型切换时迁移历史，会把生成历史的模型的推理与行动模式带进接收方，即行为迁移 (behavior transfer)；该效应在原始历史迁移下最强，改用摘要后大幅减弱。据此提出的 DASH（Direction- and Authorship-aware Summarization of History）在反复切换实验中优于原始历史迁移与朴素摘要基线，保留强模型行为同时抑制弱到强迁移。
Motivation: 多会话 agent 为平衡性能与推理成本会在不同 LLM 间切换，切换必须迁移历史以保持连续性，但这种迁移对接受方的影响此前缺乏受控研究。
Method: 先用受控的多会话任务实验刻画行为迁移在原始历史迁移与摘要迁移下的强弱，再据此提出 DASH：摘要历史时同时保留方向 (direction) 与作者 (authorship) 信息，以保留强模型行为并抑制弱到强的迁移。
Result: 行为迁移在原始历史迁移下最明显，经摘要后大幅减弱；在反复模型切换 (repeated swaps) 的实验中，DASH 优于原始历史迁移与朴素摘要两个基线。
Conclusion: 多模型编排不能只决定用哪个模型，还要决定哪些行为模式被带入后续会话；摘要历史是抑制弱到强行为迁移的手段。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SceneAE: Scene Generation and Reconstruction in Queryable 3D-Anchored Latent Space
papers.abstract_en: Recent video world models have increasingly adopted 3D memory mechanisms to integrate historical observations into a lightweight and persistent scene representation. This naturally raises a complementary question: if 3D representations can serve as an effective mechanism for memorizing observed scenes, can they also be directly used as the latent space for reconstructing and generating scenes? Motivated by this idea, we represent a scene as a compact and unstructured 3D-anchored latent space (\textbf{SceneAE}). Each latent combines an explicit 3D position with an implicit content feature and is spatially grounded to describe its local scene region, forming a sparse latent point cloud. Unlike conventional video-VAE latents that describe how a scene appears from particular viewpoints, our representation directly describes the scene itself, making it naturally applicable to both reconstruction and generation. For reconstruction, once the scene has been generated, our persistent 3D representation can be projected and decoded into RGB-D observations by different target cameras, without the need to regenerate a video for each new camera trajectory. For generation, we leverage the geometry-content separation to first generate camera-controlled 3D geometry and then synthesize content conditioned on it, reducing camera-appearance entanglement and improving camera controllability. Experiments show that this 3D latent achieves superior generation quality, computational cost, and camera controllability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SceneAE 把场景表示为稀疏的 3D 锚定隐空间：每个隐变量绑定显式 3D 位置与隐式内容特征，直接描述场景本身而非特定视角下的成像。重建时该持久表示可投影并解码为不同目标相机的 RGB-D 观测，无需为每条新相机轨迹重新生成视频；生成时利用几何-内容解耦，先生成相机可控的 3D 几何，再以几何为条件合成内容，从而降低相机与外观的纠缠、提升相机可控性。实验显示该 3D 隐表示在生成质量、计算开销与相机可控性上均更优。
Motivation: 视频世界模型的 3D memory 只把历史观测压成轻量持久场景表示，而常规 video-VAE 隐变量描述的是场景在特定视角下的成像，导致换相机轨迹就要重新生成整段视频，且相机与外观纠缠。
Method: 将场景编码为紧凑无结构的 3D-anchored latent space（SceneAE），每个隐变量由显式 3D 位置加隐式内容特征构成，空间上锚定局部区域，形成稀疏隐点云；重建路径把持久 3D 表示投影并解码为 RGB-D，生成路径按几何-内容分离先生成相机可控 3D 几何、再条件合成内容。
Result: 实验表明该 3D 隐表示在生成质量、计算开销与相机可控性三方面均取得更优表现；摘要未给出具体数据集、指标数值或基线名称。
Conclusion: 3D 表示可以直接充当重建与生成共用的隐空间，几何与内容分离是提升相机可控性、摆脱按轨迹重生成视频的关键。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Runtime Monitoring of Supermartingale Certificates
papers.abstract_en: Supermartingale certificates formally guarantee temporal properties of discrete and continuous-time stochastic dynamical systems. However, these guarantees rely on a mathematical model of the world, leaving a sim-to-real gap that can invalidate them for the deployed system. We formulate the runtime monitoring problem for supermartingale certificates, in which a monitor observes a single system trajectory and raises an alarm when there is sufficient statistical evidence that the supermartingale certificate has been violated during execution. We present an algorithm to automatically construct a monitor using betting-based sequential tests that bound the probability of ever raising a false alarm at a user-specified level. Within this betting framework, we formulate strategies that allow the monitor to exploit spatial regularity to improve detection power while preserving this statistical guarantee. We demonstrate the efficacy of our approach on supermartingale certificate benchmarks from the literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对超鞅 (supermartingale) 证书依赖数学模型、部署后存在 sim-to-real gap 的问题，提出运行时监控问题形式化：监视器只看单条系统轨迹，在有充分统计证据表明证书被执行违反时报警。算法用基于 betting 的序贯检验自动构造监视器，把误报概率上界压到用户指定水平，并在该框架内利用空间规律性 (spatial regularity) 提升检测力而不破坏统计保证。
Motivation: 超鞅证书对离散与连续时间随机动力系统的时序性质给出形式化保证，但这些保证建立在世界模型之上，sim-to-real gap 会让证书对已部署系统失效，缺少执行期的违约检测手段。
Method: 把运行时监控形式化为：监视器观测单条系统轨迹并按统计证据报警；用 betting-based sequential tests 自动构造监视器，保证虚警概率上界为用户指定水平；再在 betting 框架内设计利用空间规律性提升检测力的策略，同时保留该统计保证。
Result: 在文献中的超鞅证书基准 (supermartingale certificate benchmarks) 上演示了方法的有效性；统计保证为误报概率被上界在用户指定水平。
Conclusion: 形式化证书的静态保证可以在部署后由基于序贯检验的运行时监控补上，且利用空间规律性提升检测力不必牺牲虚警概率的统计上界。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: ReGRA: Residual-Gradient Adaptation for Complementary Low-Rank Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables parameter-efficient fine-tuning by learning low-rank weight updates. Increasing rank expands adaptation capacity, but does not guarantee that all learned directions improve downstream performance. In a diagnostic experiment with rank-16 LoRA, we show that retaining only the top singular components achieves the best performance, whereas adding further components degrades it. Motivated by this, we propose Residual-Gradient Adaptation (ReGRA), a two-stage method for making more effective use of a fixed rank budget. After the first stage, ReGRA estimates task gradients on a calibration set and removes their projections onto the two-sided subspace induced by the first-stage update. It then aggregates the residual-gradient directions to initialize a second-stage adapter without changing the first-stage update. An orthogonality regularizer encourages the two updates to capture complementary directions. Both updates can be merged into the pretrained weights, incurring no additional inference overhead. Across diverse benchmark sets, ReGRA achieves stronger performance than alternatives with the same total rank and even matches LoRA adapters with twice the rank. Ablation studies and further analysis support the contribution of its core design choices. Code is available at https://github.com/Fanyao-Li/ReGRA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReGRA 在固定 rank 预算下把 LoRA 微调拆成两阶段：先跑第一阶段，再用校准集任务梯度去掉其在第一阶段更新所张成的双侧子空间上的投影，把残差梯度方向聚合成第二阶段 adapter，并用正交正则器让两次更新学互补方向。诊断实验显示 rank-16 LoRA 只保留前几个奇异成分性能最好、继续加成分反而变差；ReGRA 在同总 rank 下超过其他方案，并能追平两倍 rank 的 LoRA，且两次更新可合并进预训练权重、不增加推理开销。
Motivation: 提高 LoRA 的 rank 会扩容量，但不保证新增的低秩方向都能改善下游性能，固定 rank 预算下存在方向冗余甚至性能回退。
Method: 两阶段方法 ReGRA：第一阶段正常训练 LoRA 更新；随后在校准集上估计任务梯度，减去其在第一阶段更新诱导的双侧子空间 (two-sided subspace) 上的投影，将残差梯度方向聚合成第二阶段 adapter 的初始化，第一阶段更新保持不变；加入正交正则器 (orthogonality regularizer) 约束两次更新方向互补，最终两次更新可合并进预训练权重。
Result: rank-16 LoRA 的诊断实验中，只保留 top 奇异成分取得最佳性能，继续增加成分使性能下降；在多组 benchmark 上，ReGRA 在相同总 rank 下优于其他方案，并匹配了两倍 rank 的 LoRA adapter；另做了 ablation 与进一步分析支撑核心设计选择。
Conclusion: 固定 rank 预算应花在互补方向上而非盲目加 rank：用残差梯度构造第二阶段并强制与第一阶段正交，可以在不增加推理开销的前提下追平更高 rank 的 LoRA。

papers.title: RuleTrek: Benchmarking Agentic Rule Reasoning in Complex Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly tackle complex real-world tasks in specialized domains. However, identifying and correctly applying domain-specific rules remains challenging when scenario information is distributed across multiple files. Existing rule-reasoning benchmarks typically represent scenarios using only a few factual statements, simplifying the identification and application of relevant rules. To address this gap, this paper introduces \textbf{RuleTrek}, a multi-domain benchmark for agentic rule reasoning in complex scenarios. Its rule-grounded construction pipeline extracts structured rule graphs, generates and incrementally composes rule-specific sub-scenarios while ensuring consistency and solvability. To systematically evaluate agentic rule reasoning in complex scenarios, RuleTrek assesses three capabilities in interactive workspaces: Rule Identification (RI), Rule Deduction (RD), and End-to-End Rule Reasoning (E2E). Experiments on 11 frontier LLMs show that the highest RI and RD scores are only 62.47\% and 60.43\%, respectively, while E2E scores range from 26.97\% to 55.29\%. These results demonstrate that current LLM agents face substantial challenges in rule reasoning over complex scenarios. We make our code and dataset publicly available at \href{https://github.com/yuan247/RuleTrek}{RuleTrek}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RuleTrek 是一个多领域 agentic 规则推理基准：从文档中抽取结构化规则图，增量组合成一致性与可解性有保证的子场景，在交互式工作区里考察规则识别 (RI)、规则演绎 (RD) 与端到端 (E2E) 三项能力。在 11 个前沿 LLM 上，RI 与 RD 最高仅 62.47% 与 60.43%，E2E 得分区间为 26.97%–55.29%，说明现有 agent 在跨多文件的复杂场景中定位并正确套用领域规则仍然很弱。
Motivation: 现有规则推理基准只用少量事实陈述表示场景，把规则识别难度大幅简化，无法反映真实任务中场景信息分散在多个文件、需要先找到规则再应用的情况。
Method: 构建流程先从语料抽取结构化规则图 (rule graphs)，再生成规则专属子场景并增量组合，同时保证场景一致性与可解性；评测在交互式工作区中进行，分 RI、RD、E2E 三个能力维度，覆盖 11 个前沿 LLM。
Result: 11 个前沿 LLM 的最高 RI 得分 62.47%，最高 RD 得分 60.43%，E2E 得分区间 26.97%–55.29%；E2E 明显低于单项能力，表明规则识别与演绎的困难在端到端任务中被放大。代码与数据集已公开。
Conclusion: 当前 LLM agent 在复杂多文件场景的规则推理上存在实质性短板，端到端表现尤其差；RuleTrek 提供了可复现的评测载体。

papers.title: C3: Rethinking Process Supervision via Confidence-Guided Credit Correction in Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly trained as multi-turn agents that interact with external tools. However, outcome-only reinforcement learning can produce a form of misguided reinforcement: even on successful trajectories, undesirable local behaviors may receive positive token-level advantages and be favored by the policy update. To address this issue, we propose Confidence-Guided Credit Correction (C$^3$), a plug-in method for local credit correction. C$^3$ identifies spans corresponding to undesirable behaviors and selectively corrects positive credit after advantage estimation, with the correction strength adaptively controlled by the behavior policy's confidence in the corresponding behavior, while leaving the task reward and original credit estimation unchanged. Across multiple multi-turn benchmarks, C$^3$ improves performance under both {critic-based and critic-free reinforcement learning methods}. Injecting the same behavioral signals as turn-level or outcome rewards does not consistently improve performance. Our results show that local credit correction provides an effective form of process supervision for outcome-driven RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: C3（Confidence-Guided Credit Correction）在多轮工具交互 RL 中做局部信用修正：先按优势估计定位不良行为 span，再依据行为策略对该行为的置信度自适应地削减其正向 token 级优势，任务奖励与原始信用估计保持不变。在多个多轮基准上，C3 同时提升 critic-based 与 critic-free RL 的性能，而把同样的行为信号当作 turn-level 或 outcome 奖励注入并不能稳定改善。
Motivation: 只看结果的多轮 RL 会出现错误强化：轨迹整体成功时，其中的不良局部行为仍拿到正 token 级优势并被策略更新放大，缺少有效的过程监督信号。
Method: C3 是即插即用的局部信用修正模块：在优势估计之后识别对应不良行为的 span，选择性地修正其正向 credit，修正强度由行为策略对该行为的置信度自适应控制；任务奖励与原始信用估计不改动。
Result: 在多个多轮基准上，C3 在 critic-based 和 critic-free 两类 RL 方法下均提升性能；作为对照，把同样的行为信号以 turn-level 或 outcome 奖励形式注入并不能一致改善性能。
Conclusion: 局部信用修正可作为面向结果驱动 RL 的有效过程监督形式，且比把行为信号直接做成奖励更可靠。

papers.title: ReFormBench: Benchmarking the Stability of Response-Conditioned Format Correction in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reliable use of large language models requires responses to satisfy formatting requirements across changing instructions. Standard compliance scores do not distinguish preserving a model's observed format from correcting it, or reveal whether that correction holds across variants. We introduce ReFormBench, a benchmark that uses each model's unconstrained response to the same question as its formatting baseline. It links targets by feature and require/forbid mode, evaluating their instantiated requirements across variants. ReFormBench comprises 5,000 difficulty-screened three-constraint test instances derived from 910 source questions and covering 66 formatting features. TCPR measures complete instruction compliance, while EMCR measures individual and joint correction of targets opposed to the annotated baseline state. Across ten models, EMCR ranges from 34.04% to 64.72%, and the highest three-target correction estimate is 50.02%. Compliance and correction scores yield different model rankings and task-level profiles. A prompting experiment on Qwen3.5-9B improves both metrics, and the catalog covers over 95% of extracted instances on four additional models. ReFormBench makes response-conditioned correction across instruction variants a measurable dimension of format following. The code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ReFormBench/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReFormBench 把模型自身的无约束回答当作格式基线，用 TCPR 与 EMCR 分别度量指令合规与相对该基线的格式纠正，覆盖 5,000 个三约束测试实例、910 道源题与 66 个格式特征。十个模型上 EMCR 介于 34.04% 到 64.72%，最高三目标纠正估计为 50.02%，且合规分与纠正分给出不同的模型排名。
Motivation: 标准格式合规分数无法区分保留模型原有格式与真正纠正格式，也看不出纠正能否跨指令变体保持，格式遵循能力因此缺少可测维度。
Method: 以每个模型对同一问题的无约束回答为格式基线，按 feature 与 require/forbid 模式链接目标并在多个变体上实例化需求；构建 5,000 个难度筛过的三约束测试实例（源自 910 道题、66 个格式特征），用 TCPR 度量完整指令合规、EMCR 度量相对标注基线状态的单目标与联合纠正，另做提示词实验。
Result: 十个模型 EMCR 范围 34.04%–64.72%，最高三目标纠正估计 50.02%；合规分与纠正分产生不同的模型排名与任务级画像；提示词实验使 Qwen3.5-9B 的两项指标同时提升；格式目录在另外四个模型上覆盖超过 95% 的抽取实例。
Conclusion: 把响应条件下的跨指令变体格式纠正单列为可测维度是可行的，且它与合规分不等价、会改变模型排名；代码与数据已公开。

papers.title: Annealed Lévy Diffusion via Gaussian Surrogate Reverse Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian diffusion models offer a practical framework for generative modeling. Denoising Lévy Probabilistic Models (DLPM) introduce heavy-tailed perturbations with a fixed tail index throughout denoising. We introduce Annealed Lévy Diffusion (ALD). ALD varies the stability index $α(t)$ to combine heavy-tailed exploration with Gaussian refinement. Our marginal-first formulation represents stable noise as a scalar Gaussian scale mixture. This formulation enables standard Gaussian noise-prediction training with one additional scale input. We study two sampling processes. ALD-renoise estimates the clean sample and injects fresh marginal noise. ALD-posterior preserves dependence between successive states through an accumulated conditional variance and a Gaussian bridge update. Both samplers reuse the same trained predictor with different scalar inputs. We evaluate ALD on four 2D benchmarks and an imbalanced nine-mode mixture. We also examine training efficiency and the effects of prediction perturbations on clipped Holtsmark data. Additional experiments evaluate MNIST and CelebA64 generation and CIFAR-10LT augmentation. ALD preserves local geometry on the evaluated light-tailed and manifold-structured targets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Annealed Lévy Diffusion (ALD)，把 DLPM 固定尾指数的重尾扰动改为随时间退火的稳定性指数 α(t)，用标量高斯尺度混合表示稳定噪声，从而复用标准高斯噪声预测训练。在四个 2D 基准、九模态不平衡混合、MNIST/CelebA64 生成与 CIFAR-10LT 增广上评估，ALD 在轻尾与流形结构目标上保持局部几何。
Motivation: DLPM 全程使用固定尾指数的重尾扰动，重尾探索与高斯精细收敛无法兼顾；需要一种既保留重尾跳出能力、又能像高斯扩散一样用标准训练与采样流程的做法。
Method: ALD 让稳定性指数 α(t) 随扩散时间变化，marginal-first 形式把稳定噪声写成标量高斯尺度混合，训练只需在标准噪声预测网络上多加一个标量尺度输入。给出两种采样器：ALD-renoise 估计干净样本并注入新的边际噪声，ALD-posterior 用累积条件方差与高斯桥更新保留相邻状态依赖，两者共用同一训练好的预测器、仅换标量输入。
Result: 在四个 2D 基准与一个九模态不平衡混合上评估 ALD，并考察训练效率与预测扰动对 clipped Holtsmark 数据的影响；另在 MNIST、CelebA64 生成和 CIFAR-10LT 增广上做实验。ALD 在所评估的轻尾与流形结构目标上保持局部几何。
Conclusion: 把尾指数做成退火调度并用高斯尺度混合做代理，可让重尾扩散沿用标准高斯噪声预测训练与采样，同时在轻尾和流形目标上保住局部几何。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.result: 在四个 2D 基准与一个九模态不平衡混合上评估 ALD，并考察训练效率与预测扰动对 clipped Holtsmark 数据的影响；另在 MNIST、CelebA64 生成和 CIFAR-10LT 增广上做实验。ALD 在所评估的轻尾与流形结构目标上保持局部几何。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把尾指数做成退火调度并用高斯尺度混合做代理，可让重尾扩散沿用标准高斯噪声预测训练与采样，同时在轻尾和流形目标上保住局部几何。

papers.title: PPAD-Completeness of Contiguous Envy-Free Cake Cutting with Additive Valuations
papers.abstract_en: We prove that computing a complete contiguous $\varepsilon$-envy-free cake allocation is PPAD-complete for normalized rational piecewise-constant additive valuations. The hardness holds even when $\varepsilon$ is given in unary, and even when every density takes only two values, which are the same for all agents, and is piecewise constant with at most six breakpoints. As a consequence, computing an exact contiguous envy-free allocation is also PPAD-complete, and the hardness holds under the same restrictions on the densities. Our key ingredient is to assign prices to the pieces so that, in every approximately envy-free allocation, all prices are nearly equal, regardless of how the pieces are assigned to the agents. We further show that, for every fixed integer $c\ge1$, computing a contiguous EF$c$ allocation of indivisible goods on a path is PPAD-complete for additive valuations, and the hardness holds even for binary valuations in which each good is valued by exactly one agent and all agents value the same number of goods.
papers.comment: We prove that computing a contiguous envy-free cake division is PPAD-complete for additive valuations, and that computing a contiguous EF$c$ allocation of goods on a path is PPAD-complete for every fixed $c \geq 1$, resolving open questions of Goldberg, Hollender and Suksompong (JAIR 2020) and Bilò et al.\ (ITCS 2019)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明连续 (contiguous) ε-无嫉妒 (envy-free) 蛋糕分配在归一化有理分段常数可加估值下是 PPAD-完全的，且硬度在 ε 以一元给出、密度仅取两个全智能体相同的值且至多六个分段点时仍成立；对路径上不可分物品的连续 EF$c$ 分配，每个固定 c≥1 也都是 PPAD-完全的，即使估值为二值。
Motivation: 连续无嫉妒蛋糕切分与路径上 EF$c$ 分配的计算复杂性是公开问题（Goldberg–Hollender–Suksompong JAIR 2020；Bilò 等 ITCS 2019），此前未知其是否落在 PPAD。
Method: 核心归约技巧是给各块分配价格，使得在任意近似无嫉妒分配中所有价格几乎相等，与块如何分配给智能体无关；由此把连续 ε-无嫉妒分配的求解归约到 PPAD 完全问题，并将构造限制到二值密度与二值物品估值。
Result: 连续 ε-无嫉妒蛋糕分配的计算是 PPAD-完全的（归一化有理分段常数可加估值），硬度在 ε 为一元、密度仅取两个相同值且至多六个分段点时保持；精确连续无嫉妒分配同样 PPAD-完全。对路径上不可分物品，每个固定整数 c≥1 的连续 EF$c$ 分配在可加估值下 PPAD-完全，硬度在二值估值（每件物品恰被一个智能体估值、所有智能体估值物品数相同）下也成立。
Conclusion: 连续性约束使无嫉妒分配与 EF$c$ 分配的求解本质上是 PPAD-完全的，即使估值结构被压到极简的二值形式；这解决了 Goldberg–Hollender–Suksompong 与 Bilò 等提出的公开问题。

papers.title: Function-Space Temporal Self-Distillation for Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves reasoning in language models, but scalar outcomes provide coarse supervision over response trajectories. Self-distillation offers denser token-level guidance by comparing an unassisted policy with a feedback-informed self-teacher, yet the teacher evolves with the student, creating unstable targets and motivating additional regularization. We introduce Function-Space Policy Optimization (FSPO), a single-policy framework that combines current privileged adaptation with function-space temporal consolidation. FSPO stores sparse historical next-token distributions as fixed temporal targets, providing temporal separation without maintaining a persistent teacher model. It further introduces privileged disagreement correction to explicitly suppress locally overvalued actions, reliability-adaptive grounding that strengthens reference supervision when self-generated evidence repeatedly fails, and quality and coverage-aware temporal memory that retains verified behaviors and improves privileged demonstrations. Across reasoning and tool-use benchmarks, FSPO achieves the highest average accuracy under a 5-hour training budget, improving over the strongest baseline by approximately 4% points on average while reducing peak memory from about 70 GB to 56 GB on Olmo3-7B-Instruct.
papers.comment: Aryan Das, Vinay Kumar Verma: Equal Contributions. Under Review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FSPO 把自蒸馏的历史 next-token 分布存成固定时间目标，配合特权分歧修正与可靠性自适应锚定，在单一策略内做 RLVR 的稠密 token 级监督。在 5 小时训练预算下，Olmo3-7B-Instruct 上平均准确率比最强基线高约 4 个百分点，峰值显存从约 70 GB 降到 56 GB。
Motivation: RLVR 的标量奖励对整条响应轨迹的监督太粗；自蒸馏虽给出 token 级信号，但教师随学生同步演化导致目标不稳定，需要额外正则。
Method: Function-Space Policy Optimization (FSPO)：把稀疏历史 next-token 分布存为固定时间目标以实现时间分离而不保留持久教师；加入 privileged disagreement correction 抑制被高估的局部动作、reliability-adaptive grounding 在自生成证据反复失败时加强参考监督，以及 quality and coverage-aware temporal memory 保留已验证行为并改进特权示范。
Result: 在推理与工具使用基准上，5 小时训练预算下取得最高平均准确率，比最强基线平均高约 4 个百分点；Olmo3-7B-Instruct 上峰值显存从约 70 GB 降至 56 GB。
Conclusion: 用固定的历史函数空间目标加特权信号校正，可以在不维护独立教师的前提下同时提升 RLVR 准确率并压低显存开销。

papers.title: Interlock: From Local Correctness to Task Completion in Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly undertake long-horizon tasks in complex environments characterized by fragmented evidence, partially completed states, and dependencies across resources and artifacts. Existing agents may satisfy individual requirements while failing to maintain these relationships, producing locally correct but incomplete outcomes. These failures arise because task completion depends on relationships among environmental evidence, consequential decisions, and required effects. To address this completion gap, we propose Interlock, a framework for task synthesis that represents each task as a typed completion graph. Grounding edges connect public evidence to decisions, coupling hyperedges impose joint constraints across components, and realization edges connect decisions to all required downstream effects. Interlock compiles this graph into a resettable workspace, a public request, and an evaluation rubric. A source-coverage review checks whether the original requirements survive generation, while a public-input review checks whether the rubric is supported by the materials available to the solver. An agent-as-judge inspects execution artifacts and runs verification scripts, retaining trajectories judged to satisfy all mandatory requirements. To evaluate training utility, we fine-tune two Qwen3.6 backbones on their own accepted trajectories. Across the two backbones, training improves AutomationBench task pass rates by 4.00-4.50 percentage points, JobBench weighted scores by 3.20-6.64 points, and Harvey LAB criterion pass rates by 3.89-4.16 percentage points. These results demonstrate the training utility of the synthesized experience across external task environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Interlock 把长程 agent 任务编译成带类型完成图 (typed completion graph) 的合成流水线：grounding 边连证据与决策、coupling hyperedge 施加跨组件联合约束、realization 边连决策与全部下游效果，再由 agent-as-judge 筛出满足全部强制要求的轨迹。用这些被接受轨迹微调两个 Qwen3.6 backbone 后，AutomationBench 任务通过率提升 4.00–4.50 个百分点，JobBench 加权分提升 3.20–6.64 分，Harvey LAB 准则通过率提升 3.89–4.16 个百分点。
Motivation: 长程 agent 常在单条要求上正确却丢掉证据、决策与效果之间的关系，产出局部正确但不完整的结局；现有方法缺少把任务完成度显式建模并转成可训练数据的机制。
Method: 用完成图表示任务：grounding 边、coupling hyperedge、realization 边三类结构；图被编译为可重置工作区、公开请求与评分 rubric，配 source-coverage review 检查原始要求是否在生成中存活、public-input review 检查 rubric 是否被求解者可见材料支撑；agent-as-judge 审查执行工件并运行验证脚本，只保留判定满足全部强制要求的轨迹，再用这些轨迹微调 Qwen3.6。
Result: 两个 Qwen3.6 backbone 各自在自产被接受轨迹上微调后：AutomationBench 任务通过率提升 4.00–4.50 个百分点，JobBench 加权分提升 3.20–6.64 分，Harvey LAB 准则通过率提升 3.89–4.16 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把任务完成关系显式编译成图并用 agent-as-judge 过滤轨迹，所得合成经验在 AutomationBench、JobBench、Harvey LAB 三个外部任务环境上都带来可迁移的训练收益。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Distribution Matching: Selective Margin Preservation for Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) changes logit margins among non-target tokens at teacher-forced prefixes. Matching a local reference distribution keeps those probabilities and also penalizes margin expansions. We ask whether a soft auxiliary can preserve selected local non-target margin relations without freezing that distribution. We introduce \textbf{Selective Rank-Preserving SFT (SRP-SFT)}, a soft margin target: a hinge on reference-scaled lower bounds for pairs from the reference's top-$K$ non-target tokens, applied at fixed teacher-forced prefixes. The hinge stops once the requested bound is met. We derive the KL cost of violating a margin, characterize the feasible region and its conditional utility, and give a finite-step condition for reducing aggregate violations. In one-epoch experiments on Qwen3-4B-Base and UltraFeedback, this target raises MATH-500 and code-generation scores over CE and LP-SFT at all three training seeds. At seed 1234, MATH-500 pass@1 rises from 49.56\% to 54.56\% and the four-metric code mean rises from 65.91\% to 69.50\% relative to LP-SFT. Ranking controls, held-out cache diagnostics, sensitivity sweeps, and six additional backbones show where these score changes appear.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SRP-SFT 在 teacher-forced 前缀上对参考分布 top-K 非目标 token 对施加参考缩放的 hinge 下界，只保留选定的 margin 次序而不冻结整个局部分布，hinge 达标即停。单轮训练下 Qwen3-4B-Base + UltraFeedback 中，seed 1234 的 MATH-500 pass@1 从 49.56% 升到 54.56%，四项代码指标均值从 65.91% 升到 69.50%（相对 LP-SFT），三个 seed 上均超过 CE 与 LP-SFT。
Motivation: SFT 会改变 teacher-forced 前缀上非目标 token 的 logit margin；匹配局部参考分布虽保住概率，却同时惩罚了 margin 扩张，无法只保留需要的次序关系。
Method: 提出 Selective Rank-Preserving SFT (SRP-SFT)：对参考分布 top-K 非目标 token 的 token 对施加参考缩放下界的 hinge 软目标，作用于固定 teacher-forced 前缀，达标即停止；并推导违反 margin 的 KL 代价、可行域与条件效用，以及减少总体违反的有限步条件。
Result: 单轮实验在 Qwen3-4B-Base 与 UltraFeedback 上，三个训练 seed 的 MATH-500 与代码生成分数均高于 CE 和 LP-SFT；seed 1234 下 MATH-500 pass@1 由 49.56% 提至 54.56%，四项代码指标均值由 65.91% 提至 69.50%（相对 LP-SFT）。另有 ranking controls、held-out cache 诊断、敏感性扫描与六个额外 backbone 的检验。
Conclusion: 不必整体匹配参考分布，只对选定的非目标 margin 关系做软性保持即可在 SFT 中同时保住次序并放开其余分布，且该收益在多 seed 与多 backbone 上可复现。

papers.title: Enhancing Latent World Models with Associative Memory
papers.abstract_en: World models trained via latent dynamics offer a scalable path for embodied planning, yet existing methods suffer from representational collapse, computational overhead, and limited long-horizon capability. We introduce a memory-enhanced latent world model that augments JEPA-style prediction with a content-addressable memory bank. Our approach learns high-level representations directly from observations, operating at multiple temporal scales within a shared latent space, and conditions predictions via adaptive layer normalization. To prevent collapse and ensure effective memory usage, we design two complementary losses that encourage slot diversity and balanced temporal utilization. Experiments on PushT, Tworoom, Reacher, and OGBCube demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance with a lightweight architecture, outperforming conventional latent world models on long-horizon planning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 JEPA 式潜空间预测上接入内容可寻址记忆库 (content-addressable memory)，用槽位多样性与时间均衡两个损失抑制表征塌缩，使潜世界模型在多时间尺度共享潜空间中做长程规划。在 PushT、Tworoom、Reacher、OGBCube 四个具身任务上，该轻量架构在长程规划中取得 state-of-the-art 表现，优于常规潜世界模型。
Motivation: 潜世界模型 (latent world model) 靠潜 dynamics 训练虽可扩展到具身规划，但普遍存在表征塌缩 (representational collapse)、计算开销大、长程能力有限三个问题。
Method: 在 JEPA 式预测基础上加内容可寻址记忆库；高层表征直接从观测学习，在共享潜空间内按多个时间尺度运作，用 adaptive layer normalization 调节预测条件；设计两个互补损失分别鼓励记忆槽位多样性与时间上的均衡使用，防止塌缩并保证记忆被真正用上。
Result: 在 PushT、Tworoom、Reacher、OGBCube 上达到 state-of-the-art，以轻量架构在长程规划任务中超过常规潜世界模型。
Conclusion: 记忆增强的 JEPA 潜世界模型能在保持轻量的同时解决塌缩并提升长程规划，是具身规划的一条可扩展路径。

papers.title: MicroSDF: Microfacet-Driven Hybrid Neural SDFs for Mixed-Reflectance Surface Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate 3D reconstruction in real-world environments remains a significant challenge due to the coexistence of reflective and non-reflective surfaces, which pose distinct modeling demands. Existing methods often treat these surface types separately, limiting their generalizability and physical plausibility. To bridge this gap, we propose MicroSDF, a novel neural implicit framework that facilitates geometry and reflectance modeling through microfacet theory. Our approach incorporates three core innovations: (i) a microfacet-guided geometry model that extracts multi-scale surface normals (macroscopic and microfacet) from a signed distance field (SDF), regularized by a proposed microfacet normal consistency loss to enforce physically plausible surface orientations; (ii) an enhanced dual-branch color model, where the specular branch leverages the microfacet normals to model high-frequency reflectance, and the vanilla branch, unlike prior works, uses reflection direction (instead of viewing direction) to better model diffuse and low-frequency specular components; and (iii) a detection-guided color blending strategy that adaptively fuses the color outputs based on reflection priors, providing more physically intuitive blending than implicitly learned blending weights. Combined with a tailored multi-stage optimization scheme, the proposed MicroSDF achieves robust and high-fidelity reconstruction across reflective and non-reflective surfaces. Extensive experiments on DTU, Shiny Blender, Ref-NeRF, and DeepVoxels datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, establishing a new direction for physically grounded neural reconstruction.

papers.title: MCAIR: Monitoring and Correcting Agent Unfaithfulness via Internal Representations
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in completing complex tasks through multi-step reasoning and tool interactions. However, recent studies have revealed that LLM-based agents can exhibit unfaithful behaviors, where their final reports fail to faithfully reflect their actual execution trajectories. Specifically, when agents fail to accomplish tasks through the intended sources or procedures, they may resort to alternative sources or strategies while failing to disclose such deviations, leading users to incorrectly believe that the tasks have been completed according to the original requirements. We refer to this specific form of agent unfaithfulness as Agent Completion Unfaithfulness. Detecting and mitigating agent completion unfaithfulness is critical yet remains largely unexplored. In this work, we propose MCAIR, a runtime monitoring and correction framework that leverages internal representations of LLM-based agents. MCAIR uses multi-step internal representations as inputs to train a risk-aware probe, enabling online detection of potential completion unfaithfulness during execution. Furthermore, MCAIR introduces a risk-guided correction loop that prompts agents to review their execution history and mitigate potential inconsistencies between their execution trajectories and final reports. Additionally, we construct ACUD, a dataset for Agent Completion Unfaithfulness detection that provides step-level execution traces, step-level internal representations, and consistency annotations for training and evaluating runtime detection probes. Experiments demonstrate that MCAIR outperforms LLM-as-a-judge baselines, generalizes across prompts and tasks, and effectively reduces agent completion unfaithfulness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MCAIR 用 LLM agent 多步执行的内部表示训练风险探针，在线检测最终报告与实际执行轨迹不一致的 Agent Completion Unfaithfulness，并通过风险引导的纠正循环让 agent 复查执行历史。配套构建 ACUD 数据集（含步级执行轨迹、步级内部表示与一致性标注）训练和评测探针；实验显示 MCAIR 优于 LLM-as-a-judge 基线，能跨 prompt 与任务泛化并有效降低不忠实率。
Motivation: LLM agent 在任务失败时会改用替代来源或策略却不披露偏离，使用户误以为任务按原要求完成；这种 Agent Completion Unfaithfulness 的检测与缓解此前 largely unexplored。
Method: MCAIR 是运行时监控与纠正框架：把 agent 多步内部表示作为输入训练 risk-aware probe，在执行中在线检测潜在完成不忠实；再用 risk-guided correction loop 提示 agent 复查执行历史，消除轨迹与最终报告的不一致。同时构建 ACUD 数据集，提供步级执行轨迹、步级内部表示和一致性标注，用于训练与评测探针。
Result: 实验表明 MCAIR 在检测上优于 LLM-as-a-judge 基线，能跨 prompt 与任务泛化，并有效减少 agent completion unfaithfulness。
Conclusion: 内部表示足以在运行时捕捉 agent 报告与执行轨迹的偏离，配合风险引导的复查循环可实际降低完成不忠实。

papers.title: Remember, Revisit, Revise: Scaffold Memory for Long-Horizon 3D Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Geometry foundation models estimate camera poses and 3D scene structure from video sequences, but maintaining consistent reconstructions over long horizons remains challenging. Feed-forward models process long sequences as independent, fixed-length frame windows and align their predictions, causing pose and reconstruction errors to accumulate across windows. Streaming models retain information from past frames to inform future predictions, but cannot revise earlier estimates when later observations reveal errors. To address this, we introduce Scaffold MemOry for Revision (SMORE), a framework equipping frozen geometry foundation models with a revisable external memory for long-horizon inference. Inspired by hippocampal associative memory in biological brains, which links spatial context with sensory experience, SMORE associates where an observer is with what it observes, enabling past observations to be stored, retrieved, verified against new evidence, and revised when inconsistencies are detected. We evaluate SMORE with eight competitive geometry models on five datasets spanning camera pose estimation, multi-view depth estimation, 3D point-cloud reconstruction, simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), and novel view synthesis. Across all evaluated models, SMORE consistently improves long-sequence pose estimation, reduces multi-view depth error by up to 58%, reduces Chamfer distance for 3D point-cloud reconstruction by up to 43%, and achieves average trajectory error as low as 2.9 cm in long-horizon SLAM. By retaining corrected poses and observations, SMORE further improves the fidelity and spatial consistency of large-scale 3D scene reconstruction. These results establish revisable external memory as a flexible interface for extending pretrained geometry models beyond fixed-context prediction toward iterative, error-correcting inference over long visual sequences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SMORE 为冻结的几何基础模型外挂一个可修订的外部记忆，把「观察者在哪」与「看到什么」关联起来，使过去的位姿与观测能被存储、按新证据检索核验并在发现矛盾时改写。在 8 个几何模型、5 个数据集上，多视深度误差最多降 58%，点云 Chamfer 距离最多降 43%，长程 SLAM 平均轨迹误差低至 2.9 cm。
Motivation: 前馈模型把长序列切成独立定长窗口再对齐，误差跨窗口累积；流式模型保留历史却无法在后续观测暴露错误时回改早期估计，长时程重建因此不一致。
Method: SMORE 在不改动权重的冻结几何基础模型外接可修订记忆，借鉴海马体联想记忆，把位置与感官经验绑定，支持存储、检索、用新证据核验与不一致时修订；在相机位姿估计、多视深度、点云重建、SLAM、新视角合成五类任务上接入 8 个竞争性几何模型评测。
Result: 在全部被评模型上 SMORE 一致改善长序列位姿估计；多视深度误差最多降低 58%，3D 点云重建 Chamfer 距离最多降低 43%，长时程 SLAM 平均轨迹误差低至 2.9 cm，并提升大规模重建的保真度与空间一致性。
Conclusion: 可修订的外部记忆可以作为冻结几何模型的通用接口，把固定上下文预测变成对长视觉序列的迭代纠错推理。

papers.title: Learning When to Trust Medical Knowledge: Regression-Safe Routing for Clinical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Clinical reasoning LLMs need external medical knowledge, but retrieved evidence and reasoning chains can be outdated, poisoned, or hallucinated. Harmful knowledge can cause regression: changing a correct answer into an incorrect one. We construct a medical knowledge-poisoning benchmark covering retrieved evidence and reasoning chains, with seven attack families filtered by a three-judge "subtle-but-wrong" vote and paired clean exams that separate poisoning effects from question difficulty. No fixed knowledge-use strategy is robust across these settings: strong RAG methods trade robustness to poisoned evidence against accuracy when evidence is useful. We formulate knowledge use as per-instance routing and introduce Med-TrustRouter, a lightweight controller that keeps the solver frozen. From leakage-free runtime signals, it estimates each action's expected correctness gain and uncertainty, preserving the base answer unless another action is confidently better. Across seven medical reasoning settings, Med-TrustRouter achieves 78.9 macro and 69.2 worst-case accuracy, matching the strongest competitor on macro accuracy while substantially improving the worst-case floor. Its gains transfer across solvers and evidence judges, unlike a hand-coded router using the same signals. Similar performance across linear, tree, and neural action-value heads suggests that the benefit comes from routing rather than estimator complexity. These results support learning when to trust external knowledge for robust clinical reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 临床推理 LLM 在检索证据或推理链被投毒时会把原本答对的题改错，本文把「何时用外部医学知识」形式化为逐样本路由问题，用轻量控制器 Med-TrustRouter 在冻结求解器上估计各动作的期望正确率增益与不确定性，仅在另一动作确信更优时才改写基线答案。在七个医学推理设定下宏平均准确率 78.9、最差情形准确率 69.2，宏平均与最强对手持平但最差情形下限显著抬高。
Motivation: 检索到的证据与推理链可能过期、被投毒或幻觉，有害知识会造成回归（把对答改错）；而固定的知识使用策略在这些设定下都不稳健，强 RAG 方法在证据有用时的准确率与对投毒证据的稳健性之间互相取舍。
Method: 构建覆盖检索证据与推理链的医学知识投毒基准，含七个攻击族，用三裁判「subtle-but-wrong」投票过滤，并配对干净考试卷以把投毒效应与题目难度分离；提出 Med-TrustRouter，一个保持求解器冻结的轻量控制器，从无泄漏的运行时信号估计每个动作的期望正确率增益与不确定性，动作价值头分别用线性、树与神经三种形式。
Result: 在七个医学推理设定上，Med-TrustRouter 宏平均准确率 78.9、最差情形准确率 69.2：宏平均与最强竞争者相当，最差情形下限大幅改善；其增益可跨求解器与证据裁判迁移，而用同样信号的手写路由器做不到；线性、树与神经动作价值头表现相近。
Conclusion: 稳健临床推理的关键在于学会何时信任外部知识，收益来自路由本身而非估计器复杂度；固定的知识使用策略无法同时兼顾准确率与抗投毒稳健性。

papers.title: Measuring and Reducing Unusable Replies of LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: People delegate multi-step work to LLM agents and read only the reply that the agent hands back. Current evaluation scores task completion and the faithfulness of reports, and it leaves open whether the requester can understand and use the reply. We call this property reply usability and measure it with a reader model that takes the requester's position and tests whether the reply can be interpreted from what the requester has seen, is in the requester's language and answers the request. Its agreement with the majority of five annotators lies within the range of the individual annotators. Across eight models from seven families, 54% of 480 replies fail, and the best model still fails on 30%. Failed replies mostly point to material the requester has not seen or use labels that the agent coined during its work. Stating explicit requirements for the reply reduces the failure rate from 0.52 to 0.43 together with errors and omissions, and a secondary model that rewrites the reply reduces it to 0.36, which human annotators confirm in a blind comparison. Reply usability can thus be scored alongside task success and improved with one appended message or one call to a secondary model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 reply usability 这一新指标：用站在请求者立场的 reader model 判断 LLM agent 返回的回复能否被请求者解读、是否用其语言并回答了请求。八个模型（七个家族）的 480 条回复中 54% 不可用，最好的模型仍失败 30%；在提示中写明对回复的显式要求可把失败率从 0.52 降到 0.43，再让次级模型改写回复降到 0.36，并经人工盲评确认。
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 评测只打任务完成度与报告忠实度，不问请求者能否看懂并用上回复；而失败回复多指向请求者没见过的材料或 agent 自造标签，等于交付物实际不可用。
Method: 定义 reply usability 并用一个 reader model 度量：该模型代入请求者视角，检查回复能否从请求者见过的信息推出、语言是否一致、是否回答了原请求；其与五名标注者多数意见的一致性落在单个标注者之间。干预为两条：在提示中写明对回复的显式要求，以及调用次级模型改写回复。
Result: 八个模型、七个家族共 480 条回复中 54% 失败，最好的模型仍有 30% 失败；失败回复主要指向请求者未见过的材料或 agent 工作中自造的标签。显式回复要求把失败率从 0.52 降到 0.43（同时减少错误与遗漏），次级模型改写进一步降到 0.36，人工标注者在盲评比较中确认该改善。
Conclusion: 回复可用性可以与任务成功率并列打分，且用一条追加消息或一次次级模型调用就能改善；它衡量的是请求者能否理解交付物，而非任务本身是否完成。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: HACHIMI-II: From Role-Play to Learner Behavior Modeling for Faithful Student Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Simulated students let researchers test tutoring systems and teaching strategies before real learners are available, but only if the simulation reproduces where a particular learner succeeds and fails. The common approach asks a large language model to role-play a student, but a role does not model what this learner knows or will do next, so the model's own competence fills the gap. Simulated students perform at a level set by the model, differ little from one another, and seldom make the real learners' errors. We model the learner's behavior and recast student simulation as third-person prediction of the learner's next action. HACHIMI-II builds a student model from the learner's history, infers the learner's state for the current item or tutor turn, and compiles it into a behavior harness that constrains the next action. On three item-response datasets, the Wasserstein-1 distance between simulated and real student ability is 2.4--8.4$\times$ smaller than that of the strongest baseline. On two dialogue datasets, HACHIMI-II reproduces real student errors with the same knowledge type, locus, and mechanism 1.8--5.1$\times$ more often than the strongest baseline, and ablations trace the gains mainly to the explicit learner state. Predicting the learner makes capable models usable as simulated students.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HACHIMI-II 把学生模拟从角色扮演改写为对学习者下一步行为的第三人称预测：从学习者历史构建学生模型，推断当前题目或辅导轮次上的学习者状态，并编译成约束下一步动作的行为 harness。在三个题目反应 (item-response) 数据集上，模拟与真实学生能力的 Wasserstein-1 距离比最强基线小 2.4–8.4 倍；在两个对话数据集上，复现真实学生错误（同知识类型、位置与机制）的频率是基线的 1.8–5.1 倍，消融显示增益主要来自显式学习者状态。
Motivation: 让 LLM 角色扮演学生时，角色并不刻画该学习者知道什么、下一步会做什么，于是模型自身能力填补空缺：模拟学生水平被模型能力设定、彼此差异小、很少复现真实学生的错误。
Method: 从学习者历史构建学生模型，对当前题目或辅导轮次推断学习者状态，再把状态编译为约束下一步动作的行为 harness；在三个 item-response 数据集与两个对话数据集上评测，并做消融定位增益来源。
Result: 三个 item-response 数据集上，模拟与真实学生能力的 Wasserstein-1 距离比最强基线小 2.4–8.4 倍；两个对话数据集上，按知识类型、位置与机制复现真实学生错误的频率比最强基线高 1.8–5.1 倍；消融把增益主要归因于显式学习者状态。
Conclusion: 预测学习者（而非扮演角色）能让有能力的模型成为可用的模拟学生，显式学习者状态是主要贡献来源。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: On Global Joint Lower Bounds in Zeroth-Order Nonconvex Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has sought to transfer first-order nonconvex optimization guarantees to zeroth-order methods through gradient estimators, typically incurring a factor linear in $d$. \citet{kornowski2024} obtained an $\mathcal{O}(dδ^{-1}ε^{-3})$ oracle complexity for nonsmooth nonconvex optimization and asked whether its dependence on all three parameters is jointly optimal. Although the dimension dependence and the first-order dependence on $(δ,ε)$ are separately known to be unavoidable, a matching zeroth-order lower bound has remained open. We answer this question in the unrestricted full-space setting. For smooth stochastic nonconvex optimization, we establish a scalar-oracle lower bound of $Ω\!\left(dL_0^2\min\{ΔH,L_0^2\}/ε^4\right)$ assuming a smooth, globally lower-bounded population objective and a second-moment bound on sample Lipschitz constants. A smooth reduction then yields a lower bound for Goldstein stationarity, proving the joint minimax optimality of the dependence on $(d,δ,ε)$ under explicit high-dimensional and small-accuracy conditions. Crucially, our results allow algorithms to query arbitrary points in $\mathbb{R}^d$, adaptively select sample-function labels, reuse the same sampled function at any number of locations, and output points without spatial restrictions. Thus, unlike lower bounds based on bounded query regions or fresh evaluation noise, our guarantees apply to a fully adaptive, reusable-sample scalar oracle. We also establish a separate noiseless exact-value lower bound against randomized algorithms, and hence also against deterministic methods. Our proof combines a globally defined sequential nonconvex construction with an exact Gaussian scalar channel, multistage random-field estimates, and an antithetic finite-sample realization that preserves information hardness under adaptive reuse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 回答 kornowski2024 关于零阶非光滑非凸优化 O(dδ^{-1}ε^{-3}) 复杂度三参数联合最优性的公开问题：在无限制全空间设定下证明光滑随机非凸的标量预言机下界 Ω(dL₀²min{ΔH,L₀²}/ε⁴)，并经光滑归约给出 Goldstein 平稳性下界，证明 (d,δ,ε) 依赖在显式高维小精度条件下联合极小极大最优。
Motivation: 零阶方法通常以线性于维度 d 的梯度估计代价把一阶非凸保证搬过来；kornowski2024 给出非光滑非凸的 O(dδ^{-1}ε^{-3}) 上界并留下三参数联合最优性问题，而维度依赖与 (δ,ε) 的一阶依赖虽已知不可避免，匹配的零阶下界一直缺失。
Method: 在光滑随机非凸设定（光滑总体目标、样本 Lipschitz 常数二阶矩有界）下建立标量预言机下界，再用光滑归约转到 Goldstein 平稳性；证明允许算法在 R^d 任意点查询、自适应选择样本函数标签、在同一采样函数上任意多次复用、输出点无空间限制，即完全自适应可复用样本的标量 oracle。技术组合为全局定义的序列非凸构造、精确高斯标量信道 (exact Gaussian scalar channel)、多阶段随机场估计，以及保持自适应复用下信息困难性的对偶有限样本实现 (antithetic finite-sample realization)。
Result: 光滑随机非凸的标量预言机下界 Ω(dL₀²min{ΔH,L₀²}/ε⁴)；由此经光滑归约得到 Goldstein 平稳性下界，在显式高维与小精度条件下证明 (d,δ,ε) 依赖的联合极小极大最优性；另有针对随机化算法（因而也含确定性算法）的无噪声精确取值下界。
Conclusion: 在允许任意点查询与样本复用的全空间标量 oracle 下，(d,δ,ε) 三参数联合依赖不可改进，且该结论不依赖有界查询区域或新鲜评估噪声假设。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SPECTRA-VLA: Base-Fine Hyperspectral Token Transfer at Frozen Vision-Language-Action Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral imaging distinguishes RGB-similar objects, but a pretrained vision-language-action model needs a state its frozen decoder can use. SPECTRA-VLA provides a native-width spectral upgrade without retraining the visual encoder or action decoder. A learned continuous residual enriches each target token through its own normalized false-color reference; projection, norm control and validation-calibrated injection regulate the change. Across 86 held-out acquisitions, category balanced accuracy rises from 0.812 to 0.883. With identical residuals and scale, own-token addition improves reuse of an external category-derived probe on frozen decoder logits: 0.701 versus 0.590 with pooled replacement, at similar image-disjoint recognition. Five grouped tests covering the same 86 acquisitions recover within-category spectral shape with $R^2=0.802/0.337$ from continuous and posterior-code states. Category-matched spectral swaps further show that own-token composition approximately doubles the target-specific recovery increment after frozen decoding. Spectral enrichment and receiving-token preservation thus work together at the pretrained interface.
papers.comment: 34 pages: 11-page main paper and 23-page supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPECTRA-VLA 在冻结的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型接口上做高光谱 token 升级：每个目标 token 通过自身归一化的假彩色参考学一个连续残差，经投影、范数控制与验证校准注入，不重训视觉编码器与动作解码器。86 组留出采集上类别平衡准确率从 0.812 升到 0.883，own-token 相加对外部类别探针的复用率达 0.701（pooled replacement 为 0.590）。
Motivation: 预训练 VLA 模型的冻结解码器只认它见过的 token 分布，高光谱信息若直接替换会破坏该接口，需要在不重训的前提下把光谱信息送进冻结解码器可用的状态。
Method: 对每个目标 token，用其自身归一化的假彩色参考学一个连续残差，经 projection、norm control 与 validation-calibrated injection 调节注入量；对比 own-token addition 与 pooled replacement 两种组合方式，并用类别匹配的光谱交换 (category-matched spectral swaps) 检验解码后的恢复增量。
Result: 86 组留出采集上类别平衡准确率 0.812 → 0.883；相同残差与尺度下，own-token addition 对外部类别来源探针在冻结解码器 logits 上的复用率为 0.701，pooled replacement 为 0.590，且图像不相交识别水平相近；五组分组测试在同 86 组采集上，连续状态与后验码状态恢复类内光谱形状的 R² 分别为 0.802 与 0.337；类别匹配光谱交换显示 own-token 组合使目标特异恢复增量约翻倍。
Conclusion: 光谱增强与接收 token 的保持在预训练接口上是协同的：按 token 自身参考注入残差比池化替换更能被冻结解码器利用，从而在不重训的情况下完成原生宽度的高光谱升级。

papers.title: AWARE-RG: Abstraction Aware Explanation of Resiliency Graphs for Cyber Physical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the security posture of cyber physical systems (CPS) requires reasoning across both information technology (IT) and operational technology (OT). However, a security analyst often holds an incomplete, role-specific view of the underlying system which has most likely resulted from their knowledge limited by a need-to-know framework. Such an incomplete view can potentially lead them to incorrectly assess if a cyber attack produces an untoward physical consequence resulting in making uninformed decisions about system resilience. In this work, we present AWARE-RG (Abstraction Aware Explanation of Resiliency Graphs), a semi-automated, human-in-the-loop framework that provides an analyst with a role-bounded, need-to-know explanations of resiliency paths in a CPS. The AWARE-RG abstraction structure is derived using Formal Concept Analysis over MITRE ATT&CK for ICS tactics, ordered by the ICS Cyber Kill Chain. For valid attack-fault queries, plan repair and backward means-end analysis identify the missing dependencies, explain why the physical hazard is reachable, and suggest defensive strategies. For invalid attack-fault queries, AWARE-RG localizes the first abstraction level at which the path fails, and reports confirmed blocking conditions as hardening pointers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AWARE-RG 是一个半自动、人在环的框架，用 MITRE ATT&CK for ICS 战术经 Formal Concept Analysis 构造抽象结构、按 ICS Cyber Kill Chain 排序，为角色受限的分析师解释 CPS 韧性路径。对有效攻击-故障查询，它用 plan repair 与 backward means-end analysis 找出缺失依赖、解释物理危害为何可达并给出防御策略；对无效查询，它定位路径首次失效的抽象层级并报告已确认的阻断条件作为加固指针。
Motivation: CPS 安全分析需同时跨 IT 与 OT 推理，但分析师受 need-to-know 限制只持有不完整的角色视角，可能误判某次网络攻击是否真的导致物理后果，从而对系统韧性做出不知情的决策。
Method: 抽象结构由 Formal Concept Analysis 从 MITRE ATT&CK for ICS 战术导出，并按 ICS Cyber Kill Chain 排序；对有效攻击-故障查询执行 plan repair 与 backward means-end analysis 以识别缺失依赖，对无效查询则定位路径首次失效的抽象层级并报告确认的阻断条件。
Result: 框架输出角色受限、need-to-know 的韧性路径解释：对有效查询给出物理危害可达的原因与防御策略建议，对无效查询给出失效层级与作为 hardening pointer 的阻断条件。

papers.title: Mapping Arctic Polynyas from Sea Ice Concentration Data Using Hierarchical Partitioning and Differentiated Region Growing: Sensitivity to Threshold and Product Choices
papers.abstract_en: Accurately delineating Arctic coastal polynyas from sea ice concentration data remains challenging because of complex coastal geometry and spatially heterogeneous ice conditions. We develop a daily sea ice concentration (SIC) mapping framework based on hierarchical partitioning, connected-component analysis, and differentiated region growing for polynya and open-water regions. Applied to September-May ice seasons from 2002/03 to 2024/25, the framework achieves a mean overall accuracy of 96.74% and a mean kappa coefficient of 0.93 in the 63-scene visual assessment. Sensitivity experiments reveal a consistent pattern: the absolute magnitude of SIC-defined polynya extent is strongly configuration-dependent, whereas major temporal features are comparatively more stable. Relative to a 75% upper SIC threshold, seasonal extent integrals differ by 13.48%, 32.47%, and 65.04% at thresholds of 80%, 85%, and 90%, respectively, while the broad interannual structure remains recognizable. The response is also strongly regional and seasonal, with the largest threshold sensitivity in the Central Arctic Ocean, very weak sensitivity in the Gulf of St. Lawrence, and greater pan-Arctic curve separation from January onward. At an 80% threshold, product-comparison MAPE is 68.19% between the 6.25 and 25 km products and 11.47% between the 12.5 and 25 km products under their respective comparison periods and reference definitions. Regional product disagreement is likewise heterogeneous. Together, these results show that reproducible long-term polynya monitoring requires a fixed and explicitly documented combination of SIC product, threshold, and spatial classification rules, while broad temporal patterns can remain informative even when absolute extent differs substantially.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于分层分割、连通域分析与差异化区域生长的日尺度海冰密集度 (SIC) 制图框架，用于刻画北极沿岸冰间湖与开阔水域。在 2002/03–2024/25 年 9 月至 5 月冰季上，63 景目视评估的平均总体精度 96.74%、kappa 0.93；敏感性实验显示冰间湖绝对面积强烈依赖阈值与产品选择，而主要时间特征相对稳定。
Motivation: 北极沿岸冰间湖的几何复杂、冰况空间异质，导致从 SIC 数据中稳定勾画冰间湖困难；不同 SIC 阈值与产品会显著改变长期监测的绝对面积量级。
Method: 框架组合分层分割 (hierarchical partitioning)、连通域分析 (connected-component analysis) 与差异化区域生长 (differentiated region growing)，对冰间湖与开阔水域做日尺度 SIC 制图；在 2002/03–2024/25 冰季上做阈值敏感性实验（75%–90%）与多分辨率 SIC 产品对比。
Result: 63 景目视评估平均总体精度 96.74%、平均 kappa 0.93。相对 75% 阈值，季节面积积分在 80%、85%、90% 阈值下分别相差 13.48%、32.47%、65.04%，但年际结构仍可辨识。阈值敏感性区域差异大：北冰洋中部最强，圣劳伦斯湾极弱，泛北极曲线自 1 月起分离更明显。80% 阈值下，6.25 km 与 25 km 产品对比 MAPE 为 68.19%，12.5 km 与 25 km 为 11.47%。
Conclusion: 可复现的长期冰间湖监测必须固定并明确记录 SIC 产品、阈值与空间分类规则的组合；即便绝对面积差异很大，宽泛的时间模式仍有参考价值。

papers.title: Model What Matters: Decision-Guided Selective World Modeling for Language Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning provides a direct mechanism for optimizing task objectives in large language model-driven agents, but task rewards are typically sparse trajectory-level signals that only evaluate task success, without directly supervising action-conditioned environment transitions, leaving the model with limited explicit understanding of action consequences and environment dynamics. Recent work introduces auxiliary supervision through policy and world modeling co-training, yet typically treats complete environmental observations uniformly as world modeling targets, overlooking the varying decision relevance of observation content. We propose DGS-WM (Decision-Guided Selective World Modeling), a decision-guided policy-world modeling co-training approach for language agents. DGS-WM employs a Decision-Guided Observation Selection component that filters observation units with decision value as world modeling targets based on their support for subsequent policy responses, and a Confidence-Adaptive Weighting component that adaptively adjusts supervision strength according to the model's prediction confidence on selected targets. Together, these components form a decision-aware auxiliary world modeling loss, jointly optimized with the RL loss on the same policy model. Across multiple benchmarks covering single-hop/multi-hop question answering and interactive web tasks, DGS-WM achieves consistent improvements under different model scales and RL algorithms, demonstrating more stable and effective performance compared to full-observation world modeling methods.
papers.comment: Core implementation included as ancillary files
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DGS-WM 在语言 agent 的策略-世界模型协同训练中，只把对后续策略响应有支撑的观测单元当作世界建模目标，并按模型预测置信度自适应加权，形成决策感知的辅助损失与 RL 损失联合优化。在覆盖单跳/多跳问答与交互式 web 任务的多个基准上，不同模型规模与 RL 算法下均取得一致改进，比全观测世界建模更稳定有效。
Motivation: 任务奖励是稀疏的轨迹级信号，只评价任务成败，不监督动作条件下的环境状态转移，agent 对动作后果与环境动力学缺乏显式理解；已有协同训练又把全部环境观测一视同仁地当作世界建模目标，忽略了不同观测内容的决策相关性差异。
Method: DGS-WM 由两部分组成：Decision-Guided Observation Selection 按观测单元对后续策略响应的支撑度筛选世界建模目标；Confidence-Adaptive Weighting 依据模型对所选目标的预测置信度调节监督强度。两者合成决策感知的辅助世界建模损失，与 RL 损失在同一个策略模型上联合优化。
Result: 在覆盖单跳/多跳问答与交互式 web 任务的多个基准上，DGS-WM 在不同模型规模和不同 RL 算法下均取得一致改进，相比全观测世界建模方法表现更稳定、更有效。
Conclusion: 世界建模监督应按决策价值选择观测目标并按置信度加权，而不是均匀监督全部观测；这样得到的辅助损失能与 RL 稳定协同。
Relevance: 2
