papers.title: Synthetic reaction data from transformation rules for graph-to-sequence pretraining in biodegradation pathway prediction
papers.abstract_en: The scarcity of observed biodegradation reactions constrains the training of product and pathway predictors. We present enviGraph, a framework that generates and curates synthetic reaction data, uses these data to pretrain a graph-to-sequence predictor, and fine-tunes the predictor on observed environmental reactions for product and recursive pathway prediction. Applying inherited environmental transformation rules to structures from PubChem, NORMAN SusDat and EPA DSSTox, followed by curation, produces 776,851 canonical parent-product pairs for pretraining. We compare this dataset with three United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) reaction datasets: USPTO-50K, USPTO-MIT and USPTO-Stereo. We evaluate enviGraph and the sequence-based enviFormer using ten folds split by pathway on the EAWAG Biocatalysis/Biodegradation Database (BBD), regulatory pesticide biodegradation data (Soil) and activated-sludge biodegradation data (Sludge). For both predictors, synthetic pretraining gives the highest BBD mean precision-recall area under the curve (PR-AUC) among the evaluated pretraining datasets for single-generation and multi-generation prediction. enviGraph achieves BBD single-generation PR-AUC of $0.202 \pm 0.050$ with synthetic pretraining, compared with $0.169 \pm 0.065$ for the retrospectively selected strongest USPTO condition, USPTO-Stereo (mean $\pm$ sample standard deviation across folds). Its exact BBD top-1 and top-5 accuracies with synthetic pretraining are 0.355 and 0.594. The strongest USPTO conditions give higher PR-AUC means than synthetic pretraining in most Soil and Sludge comparisons. enviGraph has higher Soil multi-generation PR-AUC means than enviFormer under each of the four main pretraining datasets, and with synthetic pretraining it also leads enviFormer on BBD single-generation PR-AUC and exact top-1 and top-5 accuracy.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Additional file 1 is provided as an ancillary file
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: enviGraph 用继承的环境转化规则把 PubChem、NORMAN SusDat、EPA DSSTox 结构转成合成反应数据，预训练图到序列的产物与通路预测器，再在实测环境反应上微调。合成预训练在 EAWAG BBD 上给出最高 PR-AUC：单代 0.202±0.050，高于最强 USPTO-Stero 条件的 0.169±0.065，top-1/top-5 精确准确率 0.355/0.594；但在 Soil 与 Sludge 上多数比较中 USPTO 条件的 PR-AUC 均值更高。
Motivation: 实测生物降解反应数量稀少，直接训练产物与通路预测器数据不足；通用 USPTO 反应数据与环境转化场景存在分布差距。
Method: enviGraph 框架：将继承的环境转化规则作用于 PubChem、NORMAN SusDat、EPA DSSTox 结构并做筛选，得到 776,851 组规范化母体-产物对用于预训练；据此预训练图到序列预测器 enviGraph 与序列模型 enviFormer，再在实测环境反应上微调，做单代与多代递归通路预测。与 USPTO-50K、USPTO-MIT、USPTO-Stereo 三种预训练数据对比，按通路划分十折，在 BBD、Soil（监管农药数据）、Sludge（活性污泥数据）上评测。
Result: 合成预训练在 BBD 上给出所评测预训练数据中最高的单代与多代 PR-AUC：enviGraph 单代 0.202±0.050，对比回溯选出的最强条件 USPTO-Stereo 0.169±0.065（十折均值±样本标准差）；BBD 精确 top-1 与 top-5 准确率分别为 0.355 与 0.594。多数 Soil 与 Sludge 比较中最强 USPTO 条件的 PR-AUC 均值高于合成预训练；在四种主要预训练数据下 enviGraph 的 Soil 多代 PR-AUC 均值均高于 enviFormer，且合成预训练时 enviGraph 在 BBD 单代 PR-AUC 与 top-1/top-5 准确率上领先 enviFormer。
Conclusion: 合成环境反应数据对 BBD 上的通路预测最有效，但对 Soil、Sludge 这类监管与污泥数据，回溯选择的 USPTO 条件通常更强，预训练数据选择需按目标数据集定。

papers.title: Sparse Autoencoders Are a Shared Coordinate System for Symbolic Matching
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) hold broad knowledge in one set of weights, but lack interpretability and trustworthy reasoning, especially in high-stakes use cases. A neuro-symbolic model, with its interpretable architecture and System 2 reasoning capacity, is a promising alternative if built at the scale of LLMs; however, its symbolic backbone is usually constructed with human effort, so existing neuro-symbolic models are bottlenecked by the scope of the symbol component and usually domain-specific. A data-driven method could instead build a larger symbolic system by aligning and merging existing ones. We target its first, foundational step: matching units across these heterogeneous systems. Our method, SAE-IDF, encodes a symbol in its native context into a sparse code with a sparse autoencoder (SAE), re-weights each dimension by its rarity and matches across systems. On 12 tasks across 6 kinds of symbolic system, SAE-IDF outperforms the same LLM's dense baseline on all tasks with Gemma-2-9B and all but one with Llama-3.1-8B, by up to 45 points, consistently across SAE layers and configurations. SAE-IDF is also interpretable: every dimension of the sparse code has a human-readable meaning, so each match decomposes into named concepts (features). Our work paves the way to a universal symbolic backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SAE-IDF：用 sparse autoencoder 把符号系统中的符号在其原生上下文里编码成稀疏码，按维度稀有度加权后跨异构符号系统做匹配。在 6 类符号系统共 12 个任务上，Gemma-2-9B 全部任务胜过同一 LLM 的 dense 基线，Llama-3.1-8B 除一个任务外全部胜出，最高领先 45 个百分点，且稀疏码每个维度都有可读含义。
Motivation: 神经符号模型的符号骨架靠人工构建，规模和领域覆盖受限；要靠对齐合并已有符号系统来扩展，先得解决异构系统之间单元匹配这一基础问题。
Method: SAE-IDF 将符号在原生上下文中用 sparse autoencoder (SAE) 编码为稀疏码，对每个维度按其稀有度 (IDF 式) 重新加权，再在系统间匹配；结果在不同 SAE 层与配置下检验一致性。
Result: 在 6 类符号系统的 12 个任务上，Gemma-2-9B 全部任务优于同一 LLM 的 dense 基线，Llama-3.1-8B 除一个任务外全部优于，最高领先 45 个百分点，跨 SAE 层与配置表现一致；每个稀疏维度对应可读概念，匹配可分解为命名特征。
Conclusion: 稀疏自编码器可作为跨异构符号系统的共享坐标系，为构建通用符号骨架 (universal symbolic backbone) 提供第一步。

summary_sections.motivation: 神经符号模型的符号骨架靠人工构建，规模和领域覆盖受限；要靠对齐合并已有符号系统来扩展，先得解决异构系统之间单元匹配这一基础问题。
summary_sections.method: SAE-IDF 将符号在原生上下文中用 sparse autoencoder (SAE) 编码为稀疏码，对每个维度按其稀有度 (IDF 式) 重新加权，再在系统间匹配；结果在不同 SAE 层与配置下检验一致性。
summary_sections.result: 在 6 类符号系统的 12 个任务上，Gemma-2-9B 全部任务优于同一 LLM 的 dense 基线，Llama-3.1-8B 除一个任务外全部优于，最高领先 45 个百分点，跨 SAE 层与配置表现一致；每个稀疏维度对应可读概念，匹配可分解为命名特征。
summary_sections.conclusion: 稀疏自编码器可作为跨异构符号系统的共享坐标系，为构建通用符号骨架 (universal symbolic backbone) 提供第一步。

papers.title: Eye, Robot: Learning Expressive Gaze Dynamics via a VLM-Guided Transformer-VAE
papers.abstract_en: Gaze coordinates attention in human interaction through coupled eye, head, and eyelid motion. A humanoid robot must choose where to look while generating a suitable movement toward that target; fixed tracking rules alone do not model the temporal structure of human gaze. We separate these tasks with an asynchronous vision-language model that selects a scene referent, a reactive perception module that maintains fixation, and a Realistic Gaze Transformer (RGT) that generates target-conditioned motion. RGT is a Transformer-VAE trained on markerless human recordings retargeted to the robot's 11-DoF joint space: self-supervised pretraining encodes recent full-head history, and autoregressive fine-tuning exposes the model to its own predictions during rollout. At inference, a four-dimensional binocular-eye trajectory conditions coordinated neck and eye motion; an auxiliary blink predictor triggers eyelid templates during playback. On a two-second benchmark in which all controllers receive the same ground-truth target, RGT-Base obtains the lowest reported overall seven-joint MSE, and physical demonstrations show the integrated targeting and control pipeline. The evidence establishes robot-space kinematic fidelity and real-time RGT inference; perceived naturalness and open-vocabulary target-selection accuracy remain questions for controlled evaluation.

TL;DR: 把人眼注视拆成异步 VLM 选目标、反应式感知维持注视、Realistic Gaze Transformer (RGT) 生成眼-头-眼睑协同运动三层，RGT 是在无标记人体记录重定向到机器人 11-DoF 空间上训练的 Transformer-VAE。两秒基准上 RGT-Base 取得七关节整体 MSE 最低，实机演示跑通了从选目标到控制的整条链路。
Motivation: 固定跟踪规则无法表达人注视的时间结构，人形机器人又必须在选定看哪里的同时生成朝向该目标的运动，这两个任务耦合在一起难以直接学。
Method: 异步 VLM 选场景指称对象，反应式感知模块维持注视，RGT（Transformer-VAE）生成目标条件运动：自监督预编码近期全头历史，自回归微调让模型在 rollout 中暴露于自身预测；推理时用四维双眼轨迹条件化颈部与眼球协同运动，辅助眨眼预测器触发眼睑模板。
Result: 在所有控制器拿到同一 ground-truth 目标的两秒基准上，RGT-Base 取得最低的已报告七关节整体 MSE；物理演示展示了完整的定位与控制流水线，并确立了机器人空间运动学保真度与 RGT 实时推理。
Conclusion: 注视的选目标与运动生成可以解耦后仍保持机器人空间的运动学保真与实时推理，但感知自然度与开放词表目标选择精度仍需受控评估。

papers.title: Risk-Controlled DFT Selection for Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
papers.abstract_en: Automated materials discovery requires evaluating large pools of candidate configurations, with density functional theory (DFT) as a major throughput bottleneck. Pretrained machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) approximate DFT cheaply, but their errors vary by orders of magnitude across configurations, making it difficult to decide when to trust the MLIP predictions and when to fall back to DFT. We frame this decision as a risk-controlled selection problem and solve it within a conformal risk control (CRC) framework. Each configuration is mapped from atomic numbers and Cartesian coordinates to a fixed geometric descriptor, which a lightweight predictor uses to estimate an MLIP-DFT disagreement score in energy, average force, and maximum force. CRC then calibrates this score into a selection threshold for DFT labeling such that the MLIP error on the unselected configurations, which keep their MLIP labels, stays below a user-chosen fraction $α$ of the expected error. Under an identical guarantee across eight dataset-MLIP pairs, our predictor routes 7% and 14% fewer configurations to DFT at $α=0.3$ than committee baselines. Because committee disagreement overlooks errors the MLIPs share, our gains are largest when the DFT labels and MLIP training data differ in DFT functional and basis set, and narrow when the two agree. Without model access, the structure-only predictor also ranks errors as well as the target MLIP's latent representation and outperforms widely used descriptors such as Smooth Overlap of Atomic Positions (SOAP) and Atom-Centered Symmetry Functions (ACSF).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把「哪些构型该回退到 DFT」形式化为 conformal risk control (CRC) 选择问题：用原子序数与笛卡尔坐标得到的几何描述符预测 MLIP 与 DFT 的能量、平均力、最大力分歧，CRC 将其校准为阈值，保证未被选中构型上 MLIP 误差不超过期望误差的 α。在八个 dataset-MLIP 对上，α=0.3 时比 committee 基线少送 7% 和 14% 的构型去算 DFT。
Motivation: 自动化材料发现要筛大量候选构型，DFT 是吞吐瓶颈；预训练 MLIP 便宜但误差跨构型差几个数量级，无法判断何时可信任其标签、何时必须回退 DFT。
Method: 结构-only 预测器把原子序数与笛卡尔坐标映射为固定几何描述符，输出能量、平均力、最大力三个 MLIP-DFT 分歧分数；CRC 把该分数校准成 DFT 选择阈值，使保留 MLIP 标签的未选构型误差不超过用户设定的 α 比例。
Result: 在八个 dataset-MLIP 对上、α=0.3 时，比 committee 基线分别少 7% 和 14% 的构型送 DFT，且保证相同；当 DFT 标签与 MLIP 训练数据的泛函和基组不一致时增益最大，两者一致时增益收窄。无需模型访问的结构-only 预测器对误差的排序与目标 MLIP 潜表示相当，并优于 SOAP 与 ACSF 描述符。
Conclusion: committee 分歧会漏掉 MLIP 共有的误差，用结构描述符加 conformal risk control 做选择能在同等风险保证下减少 DFT 调用，且泛函/基组不匹配时收益最大。

papers.title: Self-Conditioning Enables Deep Sequential Reasoning in Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has explored visual reasoning through image generation, where models solve visual-reasoning problems by directly generating solution images. Intuitively, iterative samplers such as flow matching are well suited to this task, since each sampling step may resemble one reasoning step. However, in this work, from a circuit complexity perspective, we show that this intuition is misleading. We prove that as long as the model outputs satisfy certain mild regularity conditions, the trajectory of the vanilla flow-matching sampler can be simulated by a constant number of sequential rounds of parallel model evaluations. Consequently, additional sampling steps cannot increase the expressive power of a constant-depth backbone model under the standard complexity-theoretic model of transformers. We then reveal that self-conditioning, which conditions the model on the previous step's estimate of the final image, plays a previously unrecognized role in removing this bottleneck. Controlled experiments on diverse visual-reasoning tasks show that flow matching with self-conditioning achieves higher accuracy and greater reasoning depth than vanilla flow matching, and its performance improves with more sampling steps. Theoretically, we prove that with self-conditioning, a constant-depth backbone can achieve expressive power equivalent to that of space-bounded Turing machines. Our study suggests a design principle for future visual reasoning research: carry more information between sampling steps, so that additional steps translate into deeper reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从电路复杂度证明：vanilla flow matching 的采样轨迹在温和正则条件下可被常数轮并行模型评估模拟，因此增加采样步数无法提升常数深度 Transformer 的表达力；而 self-conditioning（以上一步对最终图像的估计作为条件）能解除该瓶颈，使常数深度骨干达到空间受限 Turing 机的表达力。在多种视觉推理任务的受控实验中，带 self-conditioning 的 flow matching 比 vanilla 取得更高准确率与更深推理，且性能随采样步数增加而提升。
Motivation: 直觉认为 flow matching 的迭代采样每步对应一次推理，但该直觉在标准 Transformer 复杂度模型下不成立：采样步数增加并不增加常数深度骨干的表达力，视觉推理的深度因此被卡住。
Method: 从电路复杂度视角给出证明：在模型输出满足温和正则条件时，vanilla flow matching 轨迹可由常数轮并行模型评估模拟；再引入 self-conditioning，把上一步对最终图像的估计喂回模型，并证明其表达力等价于空间受限 Turing 机；在多样视觉推理任务上做受控实验对比。
Result: 受控实验覆盖多种视觉推理任务：flow matching 加 self-conditioning 相对 vanilla flow matching 达到更高准确率与更大推理深度，且性能随采样步数增加而改善。理论结果为：vanilla 采样轨迹可被常数轮并行评估模拟，额外采样步不增加常数深度骨干表达力；带 self-conditioning 时表达力等价于空间受限 Turing 机。
Conclusion: 设计原则是在采样步之间携带更多信息（如 self-conditioning），使额外采样步真正转化为更深的推理；仅靠增加 vanilla flow matching 的步数无效。

papers.title: DAGFormer: Global Topology Prediction for Transformer Cross-Layer Connections
papers.abstract_en: We propose DAGFormer, a Transformer language model whose cross-layer connections are planned by a jointly trained topology predictor. Beyond the residual connections in a standard Transformer, DAGFormer adds direct connections from earlier layers to later ones, and the predictor controls the strength of every connection based on input tokens. Unlike existing cross-layer routing architectures, which set each layer's connections separately, DAGFormer plans the routing of the whole model at once. On matched OLMo-2 pairs from 75M to 1B parameters, DAGFormer lowers WikiText-2 perplexity by 17% to 25% over the vanilla Transformer, and a 1B DAGFormer trained on 5B tokens outperforms the vanilla model trained on 10B. Against four routing baselines with the same data and budget, it reaches the lowest perplexity at 75M, 300M and 1B. The gain carries over to 13 commonsense, science, reading and math evaluation tasks (2.0 to 2.5 points higher mean accuracy at 300M and 1B) and to instruction finetuning (63% to 70% AlpacaEval win rate against the vanilla Transformer, leading every routing baseline), and under structured pruning DAGFormer degrades the least in five of six settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DAGFormer 用一个联合训练的拓扑预测器为整个 Transformer 一次性规划跨层连接，除残差外还加入前层到后层的直连，并按输入 token 调节每条连接强度。在 75M–1B 的 OLMo-2 配对训练上，WikiText-2 困惑度比 vanilla Transformer 低 17%–25%，1B 模型用 5B token 即超过用 10B token 的 vanilla 模型。
Motivation: 现有跨层路由架构逐层独立设定连接，无法整体规划全模型的路由；作者主张联合规划能带来更好的困惑度与下游表现。
Method: 在标准 Transformer 残差之外加入前层到后层的直连，由一个与语言模型联合训练的 topology predictor 依据输入 token 决定每条连接强度；在 75M 到 1B 的 OLMo-2 配对上与 vanilla Transformer 及四个 routing 基线在相同数据与预算下对比，并考察指令微调与结构化剪枝。
Result: WikiText-2 困惑度比 vanilla Transformer 低 17%–25%（75M–1B）；1B DAGFormer 用 5B token 训练胜过用 10B token 的 vanilla 模型；在相同数据与预算下对四个 routing 基线于 75M、300M、1B 均取得最低困惑度；13 项常识、科学、阅读与数学评测上 300M 与 1B 平均准确率高 2.0–2.5 分；指令微调后对 vanilla 的 AlpacaEval 胜率 63%–70%，领先全部 routing 基线；结构化剪枝下六个设置中五个退化最小。
Conclusion: 对全模型跨层连接做联合拓扑规划，比逐层独立路由与标准残差连接更省训练预算并迁移到下游任务与剪枝场景。

papers.title: Adaptive Observation Control for Active Visual Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Visual recognition models usually process a fixed view under a fixed computation budget, although images often benefit from different scales and amounts of spatial evidence. Active vision can adapt by observing a coarse scene and then selecting informative fixations, but the public AdaptiveNN-DeiT-S pipeline still fixes both field of view and observation count. We extend this fixed-step recognizer with a controllable observation interface that adapts both the field of view and the number of fixations to the input. Specifically, the model predicts a per-fixation scale that sets its field of view, refines each selected crop with optional scale-gated foveation and a residual high-resolution detail-token branch, and uses label-grounded stop heads for input-dependent early termination. Experiments across fine-grained benchmarks, full ImageNet-1K, and ImageNet-A/R-derived classification splits show that the interface remains competitive with fixed-step references while exposing a controllable observation budget. The same checkpoint enables threshold-controlled accuracy-compute trade-offs without per-threshold retraining. On sequential ImageNet-1K, the learned stop rule outperforms fixed-step truncation of the same checkpoint, sustaining 81.9% top-1 using 2.45 of the four focus steps and exceeding three-step truncation at lower cost. On each benchmark, a variant combining scale control and detail-token fusion achieves the highest accuracy among the tested component-added non-exit variants. Our code is available at https://github.com/GZHU-DVL/LI-Dikai.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation in ACCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把固定视角、固定步数的主动视觉识别器 AdaptiveNN-DeiT-S 扩展为可同时自适应视野与注视次数的接口：每次注视预测尺度、用 scale-gated foveation 与残差 detail-token 分支细化裁剪，并用 label-grounded stop heads 提前终止。在 sequential ImageNet-1K 上，学到的停止规则用四个 focus 步中的 2.45 步维持 81.9% top-1，优于同一 checkpoint 的三步截断且成本更低。
Motivation: 主动视觉本可按输入调节观察量，但公开的 AdaptiveNN-DeiT-S 管线把视野和观察次数都写死，无法在精度与计算量之间按输入权衡。
Method: 模型为每次注视预测一个尺度以设定视野，用可选的 scale-gated foveation 加残差高分辨率 detail-token 分支细化所选裁剪，并以 label-grounded stop heads 实现输入依赖的提前终止；同一 checkpoint 支持阈值控制的精度-计算权衡而无需按阈值重训。
Result: 在细粒度基准、完整 ImageNet-1K 与由 ImageNet-A/R 派生的分类划分上，接口与固定步数参考相当并暴露可控观察预算；sequential ImageNet-1K 上学到的停止规则用 2.45/4 个 focus 步维持 81.9% top-1，超过三步截断且成本更低；每个基准上尺度控制与 detail-token 融合的组合变体在所测组件叠加非退出变体中精度最高。
Conclusion: 把视野与注视次数都做成输入依赖的可变量，可在同一 checkpoint 上得到阈值化的精度-计算权衡，且学习到的停止规则比固定步数截断更省步数。

papers.title: MagicGarment: Benchmarking Single-Image Standalone 3D Garment Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Single-image 3D reconstruction has advanced rapidly, yet standalone garments remain challenging due to thin-shell geometry, open boundaries, and layered structures. Existing datasets and evaluation protocols provide limited support for systematic evaluation in this setting. We introduce MagicGarment, a benchmark for single-image standalone 3D garment reconstruction with 1,518 professionally constructed assets across 17 composite garment types, aligned multimodal annotations, and a unified evaluation protocol. We further establish a garment-aware reference baseline by adapting a pretrained image-to-3D backbone at two levels: Grounded Semantic Refinement (GSR) provides garment-focused visual conditioning, while Flow-Time-Route LoRA (FTR-LoRA) adapts the frozen 3D generative backbone using flow-timestep, token-routing, and expert-load information. Experiments demonstrate MagicGarment's benchmark utility and the effectiveness of garment-aware adaptation. Project page: https://1019538157.github.io/MagicGarment/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MagicGarment 是单图独立 3D 服装重建基准，含 1,518 个专业制作资产、17 类复合服装与统一评测协议，并给出服装感知参考基线：Grounded Semantic Refinement (GSR) 提供服装聚焦的视觉条件，Flow-Time-Route LoRA (FTR-LoRA) 用 flow-timestep、token-routing 与 expert-load 信息适配冻结的 3D 生成骨干。实验显示该基准具备评测效用，服装感知适配有效。
Motivation: 独立服装因薄壳几何、开放边界与层叠结构在单图 3D 重建中困难，而现有数据集与评测协议对这一设定支持不足，难以系统评估。
Method: 构建 1,518 个专业制作资产、17 类复合服装、多模态对齐标注与统一评测协议的基准；参考基线在预训练 image-to-3D 骨干上做两级适配：GSR 提供服装聚焦视觉条件，FTR-LoRA 在冻结的 3D 生成骨干上按 flow-timestep、token-routing 与 expert-load 信息做 LoRA 适配。
Result: 实验展示 MagicGarment 的基准效用与服装感知适配的有效性；基准规模为 1,518 个资产、17 类复合服装类型。
Conclusion: 单图独立 3D 服装重建需要专门的基准与服装感知的骨干适配，两级适配（视觉条件 + 冻结骨干 LoRA）是可行的参考路径。

papers.title: Are AI Decision Models Biased? A Case Study of Jev
papers.abstract_en: Do AI models designed for fast, structured decisions exhibit the cognitive and social biases observed in human judgment? We evaluate Jev, a model described as a System One decision-maker, using 41,500 responses across cognitive reflection tasks, five classical cognitive-bias paradigms, and a pricing experiment testing ethnic and gender bias. At the level of selected answers, the results are largely encouraging. We confirm previous findings that Jev performs extremely well on cognitive reflection problems. We also observe that it generally avoids the characteristic choice patterns associated with several well-documented human biases, and exhibits only small differences among demographic groups in the tested pricing scenario. However, this apparent robustness conceals important vulnerabilities. Its judgments are sensitive to irrelevant numerical information and the ordering of response options. Moreover, several cognitive-bias manipulations substantially affect returned probabilities even when selected answers remain unchanged. Most strikingly, Jev answers a well-known probability problem correctly in every response but violates the same underlying probability rule in every response to an adapted version. We investigate this discrepancy using 15,000 additional responses across 30 conjunction tasks. Jev violates the rule in 54\% of responses, with accuracy varying dramatically across formulations and answer orders. These findings suggest that evaluating decision models solely on familiar benchmarks and selected answers may substantially overstate their reliability in practical applications. They also identify vulnerabilities for developers to address and practical considerations for users integrating such models into automated decision-making systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对自称 System One 决策器的模型 Jev 做认知偏差压力测试：41,500 条回答覆盖认知反思、五类经典认知偏差范式与含族裔/性别变量的定价实验，另加 15,000 条回答、30 个合取任务。选中答案层面表现稳健，但概率输出对无关数字与选项顺序敏感，且在改编版概率题上 54% 的回答违反同一概率规则。
Motivation: 只用熟悉基准和最终选中答案评估决策模型，会高估其在自动化决策系统中的可靠性；需要检验其输出概率是否真正遵守所声称的规则。
Method: 以 Jev 为被试模型，收集 41,500 条回答，横跨认知反思任务、五个经典认知偏差范式、以及测试族裔与性别偏差的定价实验；再用 15,000 条额外回答、30 个 conjunction 任务追踪同一概率规则在不同表述与答案顺序下的违反情况，同时比较选中答案与返回概率两个层面。
Result: 认知反思题上 Jev 表现极佳，多个已知人类偏差的典型选择模式基本未出现，定价场景中不同人群组间差异很小；但其判断对无关数值信息和选项顺序敏感，若干认知偏差操纵即使不改变选中答案也显著改变返回概率。经典概率题每次回答都答对，改编版每次回答都违反同一规则；30 个合取任务、15,000 条回答中违反率 54%，准确率随表述与答案顺序剧烈波动。
Conclusion: 选中答案层面的稳健性会掩盖概率层面的规则违反，评估决策模型必须同时检查返回概率与答案顺序敏感性，否则会高估其实际可靠性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Instruction-Conditioned Motion Control for Robotic Arms: Language-to-Code Decomposition and Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-Conditioned Motion Control (ICMC) separates parameter specification, instruction generation, and code synthesis for language-driven robot control, making execution outcomes traceable to instructions and programs. We compare one-shot generation with ICMC under o1 and o4-mini on cube pick-and-place and letter-reshaping tasks for a UR5e arm in MuJoCo. We then train an open-weight instruction policy by GRPO through a frozen code generator on cube placement onto two- and five-cube letter layouts, averaging the rewards of five programs per instruction. The logged positive-reward rate rose from 31.6% to 35.3% (253/800 to 282/800) between the first and last five training steps. A log audit identifies positive binary labels associated with geometric-failure messages: at least 19 in that run, 18 in the dense-reward run, and 5 in the run with one program per instruction. In one case, all five rewards were 1.0 while the log reports a 0.9515 m miss against a 0.05 m tolerance; the verdict came from the program's own output stream. We distinguish logged reward rates from independently verified task success and report descriptive results for each configuration's single training trajectory. We introduce an independent evaluation protocol that checks task completion against fixed specifications, separating robot control from success assessment to support reproducible evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ICMC：把语言驱动的机械臂控制拆成参数指定、指令生成、代码合成三段，使执行结果可追溯到指令与程序。GRPO 训练开放权重指令策略时，日志正奖励率从 31.6% 升到 35.3%（253/800 → 282/800），但日志审计发现几何失败消息仍被判正：该次运行至少 19 例、稠密奖励运行 18 例、每指令单程序运行 5 例；极端案例中五个奖励全为 1.0，而日志记录 0.9515 m 偏差对 0.05 m 容差，判定来自程序自身输出流。作者据此提出独立评测协议，把机器人控制与成功判定分离。
Motivation: 语言到代码的机器人控制把成功判定交给程序自身输出，奖励信号可能与真实任务完成脱钩，使训练指标不可复现、不可审计。
Method: ICMC 分离参数指定、指令生成、代码合成三段；在 MuJoCo 的 UR5e 上做立方体抓放与字母重塑任务，比较 one-shot 生成与 ICMC（o1 与 o4-mini）；用 GRPO 穿过冻结的代码生成器训练开放权重指令策略，立方体摆放覆盖两块与五块字母布局，每条指令对五个程序的奖励取平均；再做日志审计并提出按固定规格核验任务完成的独立评测协议。
Result: 日志正奖励率从训练前五步到最后五步由 31.6% 升至 35.3%（253/800 → 282/800）。日志审计发现与几何失败消息关联的正二元标签：该次运行至少 19 例，稠密奖励运行 18 例，每指令单程序运行 5 例。一个案例中五个奖励均为 1.0，而日志报告 0.9515 m 偏差对 0.05 m 容差，判定来自程序自身输出流。各配置仅报告单条训练轨迹的描述性结果。
Conclusion: 日志奖励率不等于经独立核验的任务成功率；把成功判定从机器人控制中分离出来的独立评测协议是可复现评估的前提。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Divergent Paths: Learning an Outcome-Predictive Representation of LLM Agent Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we reframe agentic trajectories as paths through a shared embedding space of actions and environmental observations. We show that successful and failed rollouts of the same task separate in this space, with simple per-task discriminators predicting held-out rollout outcomes at up to 0.95 AUROC across three agent benchmarks and three policy models. To exploit this signal across tasks, we introduce Precog-RM, a transformer-based model that meta-learns a representation in which outcome prediction can be performed in a few-shot setting. We show that Precog-RM generalizes to unseen tasks and models, and gives confident predictions of trajectory success long before termination. Deployed as an early stopping controller for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on Tau2-Bench, Precog-RM cuts training FLOPs by up to 47.3\% while maintaining performance comparable to baseline GRPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM agent 轨迹重述为动作与环境观测共享嵌入空间中的路径，成功与失败 rollout 在该空间可分；据此提出 transformer 元学习模型 Precog-RM，用少样本预测轨迹结局并作为 GRPO 的早停控制器，在 Tau2-Bench 上最多削减 47.3% 训练 FLOPs 而性能与基线 GRPO 相当。
Motivation: LLM agent 强化学习训练要跑完整条 rollout 才知道成败，浪费大量算力；不同任务间缺少可迁移的结局预测信号，无法提前终止注定失败或已成功的轨迹。
Method: 先将轨迹表示为共享嵌入空间中的路径，用每任务的简单判别器验证成功/失败可分；再提出 Precog-RM，一个 transformer 结构的元学习模型，在少样本设定下学习可跨任务、跨策略模型的结局预测表示，并部署为 GRPO 的早停控制器。
Result: 每任务判别器在三个 agent benchmark、三个 policy model 上对留出 rollout 结局预测最高达 0.95 AUROC；Precog-RM 泛化到未见任务与模型，并在轨迹终止前很早给出高置信的成功预测；作为 Tau2-Bench 上 GRPO 的早停控制器，最多削减 47.3% 训练 FLOPs，性能与基线 GRPO 相当。
Conclusion: 结局信息在轨迹早期就已线性可分地编码在动作-观测嵌入中，因此用元学习的结局预测表示做早停可以在不损失性能的前提下大幅降低 LLM agent RL 训练成本。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 先将轨迹表示为共享嵌入空间中的路径，用每任务的简单判别器验证成功/失败可分；再提出 Precog-RM，一个 transformer 结构的元学习模型，在少样本设定下学习可跨任务、跨策略模型的结局预测表示，并部署为 GRPO 的早停控制器。
summary_sections.result: 每任务判别器在三个 agent benchmark、三个 policy model 上对留出 rollout 结局预测最高达 0.95 AUROC；Precog-RM 泛化到未见任务与模型，并在轨迹终止前很早给出高置信的成功预测；作为 Tau2-Bench 上 GRPO 的早停控制器，最多削减 47.3% 训练 FLOPs，性能与基线 GRPO 相当。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结局信息在轨迹早期就已线性可分地编码在动作-观测嵌入中，因此用元学习的结局预测表示做早停可以在不损失性能的前提下大幅降低 LLM agent RL 训练成本。

papers.title: What Breaks in Multi-Image Schema Application? Factorial Oracle Interventions Reveal an Instance-Information Bottleneck
papers.abstract_en: Modern vision-language models can accept multi-image contexts, but aggregate accuracy rarely reveals where a multi-image reasoning pipeline fails. We study a controlled schema-application task in which a model must locate two target characters in a 16-image sequence, identify their visual attributes, consult an item-specific visual codebook, and compose two ordered nonce code names. We introduce a within-item 2-by-2 factorial Oracle design: Oracle-A supplies a verified textual schema, Oracle-B supplies a verified ordered target-appearance representation, and both interventions retain the original images and final question. Across 72 new items and 1,188 analyzed model responses, Oracle-B increased strict exact accuracy by 54.6 percentage points (95% confidence interval: 46.3 to 63.0) and outperformed Oracle-A by 60.6 points (Holm-adjusted p-value no greater than .0002). An auxiliary retrieval diagnostic reached only 49.1% ordered-appearance accuracy even after removing code-name generation. Providing both Oracle sources yielded 100% accuracy across all models. These results localize the dominant recoverable deficit to upstream ordered instance recovery rather than primarily to downstream schema use and composition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 16 图序列的受控 schema 应用任务上做 2×2 factorial Oracle 干预，发现主要可恢复缺陷在上游的有序实例信息恢复，而非下游 schema 使用与组合：Oracle-B（提供已验证的有序目标外观表示）使严格精确率提高 54.6 个百分点，同时给出两个 Oracle 源时所有模型达 100% 准确率。
Motivation: 多图推理的总体准确率掩盖了失败位置：模型答错时无法区分是没找回目标实例信息，还是不会用 schema 做组合，需要可控干预把瓶颈定位到具体环节。
Method: 构造受控 schema 应用任务：模型须在 16 图序列中定位两个目标角色、识别其视觉属性、查 item 级视觉 codebook 并组合出两个有序 nonce 代码名；采用 within-item 2×2 factorial Oracle 设计，Oracle-A 给出已验证的文本 schema，Oracle-B 给出已验证的有序目标外观表示，两种干预都保留原图与最终问题。
Result: 在 72 个新条目、1,188 条模型响应上，Oracle-B 使严格 exact accuracy 提升 54.6 个百分点（95% CI 46.3–63.0），并比 Oracle-A 高 60.6 个百分点（Holm 校正 p ≤ .0002）；辅助检索诊断在去掉代码名生成后有序外观准确率仍只有 49.1%；同时提供两个 Oracle 源时所有模型准确率 100%。
Conclusion: 多图 schema 应用的主要可恢复瓶颈在上游有序实例恢复（ordered instance recovery），而非下游的 schema 使用与组合；补上实例信息即可把准确率推到满分。

papers.title: CORE: Contrast-and-Reflect for Self-Supervised Prompt Optimization in Anomaly Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Industrial anomaly detection (AD) is bottlenecked by the scarcity of anomalous samples, making high-fidelity anomaly synthesis crucial for improving downstream performance. However, existing methods either rely on scarce real anomaly references or auxiliary data, while lacking complex reasoning and iterative optimization capabilities for generating realistic defects in open-set scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose CORE, a cost-efficient and training-free prompt optimization framework based on Large Multimodal Models (LMMs), which unifies zero-shot and one-shot anomaly synthesis. CORE first introduces an Anomaly Context Grounding module to transform sparse user context into defect-aware generation context, which is subsequently instantiated as structured anomaly prompts that disentangle normal-region preservation from anomaly-specific variation, enabling controllable and faithful defect generation. Furthermore, CORE autonomously refines prompts through a self-supervised contrast-and-reflect mechanism. This design empowers general-purpose LMMs to synthesize realistic anomalies under both zero-shot and one-shot settings without task-specific training. Extensive experiments on MVTec-AD and VisA demonstrate that CORE synthesizes realistic and diverse anomalies, yielding superior improvements in downstream AD performance. Furthermore, its model-agnostic and plug-and-play paradigm enables effortless integration with diverse LMMs, facilitating adaptation to unseen open-set scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CORE 是面向工业异常检测的免训练提示优化框架，用 Anomaly Context Grounding 把稀疏用户上下文转成结构化异常提示（分离正常区域保持与异常变化），再用自监督 contrast-and-reflect 机制自主迭代精炼提示。在 MVTec-AD 与 VisA 上合成真实多样的异常，并在下游 AD 性能上取得提升，统一了 zero-shot 与 one-shot 两种异常合成设定。
Motivation: 工业异常检测受异常样本稀缺制约，现有合成方法依赖稀少的真实异常参考或辅助数据，且在开放集场景下缺少复杂推理与迭代优化能力来生成逼真缺陷。
Method: 基于 Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) 的免训练提示优化框架 CORE：先用 Anomaly Context Grounding 模块把稀疏用户上下文转为缺陷感知的生成上下文，实例化为结构化异常提示，将正常区域保持与异常特有变化解耦；随后通过自监督的 contrast-and-reflect 机制自主精炼提示，模型无关、即插即用，可接入不同 LMM。
Result: 在 MVTec-AD 与 VisA 上的实验表明 CORE 合成的异常真实且多样，并在下游异常检测性能上带来显著提升（superior improvements）；框架统一 zero-shot 与 one-shot 异常合成，无需任务特定训练。
Conclusion: 免训练的提示优化加自监督对比反思，足以让通用 LMM 在开放集场景下生成可控、忠实的工业缺陷，且可即插即用地适配未见过的场景。

papers.title: A Graph-Based Analysis of Comparability, Scale, and Attribution in Private Transformer Inference
papers.abstract_en: Rising privacy concerns around large language models have accelerated research in private Transformer inference (PTI). Synthesizing the empirical claims in this line of research, however, is hindered by multi-dimensional cryptographic progress and inconsistent evaluation contracts. In this work, we systematize the field by constructing an empirical graph of 62 PTI systems, mapping system attributes to node features and evaluation compatibility to edges. A three-tiered analysis of this graph illuminates the state of private inference. Node-level attribution shows that cryptographic progress drives performance gains across most systems, yet always co-occurs with other factors (model fidelity, hardware, cost accounting). Edge-level auditing shows that only 1 of 1891 candidate system pairs is directly comparable under shared assumptions. Finally, graph-level analysis shows that the scaling frontier of private inference has plateaued at 13B parameters and projects the cost of deploying current PTI techniques on production-scale Transformers. Overall, this graph-based framework equips the community to evaluate PTI claims transparently and channel technical speedups into deployment-scale private inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 62 个私有 Transformer 推理 (PTI) 系统建成经验图：系统属性作节点特征、评估兼容性作边，三层分析显示密码学进步驱动多数系统的性能提升但总与模型保真度、硬件、成本口径等因素共现；1891 个候选系统对中仅 1 对在共享假设下可直接比较，私有推理的 scaling frontier 在 13B 参数处停滞。
Motivation: PTI 领域密码学进展是多维度的，评估契约又不一致，导致各论文的经验声明无法横向比较与汇总。
Method: 构建 62 个 PTI 系统的经验图，节点特征映射系统属性、边表示评估兼容性；做三层分析：节点级归因、边级可比性审计、图级 scaling frontier 与部署成本投影。
Result: 节点级归因显示密码学进步在多数系统上驱动性能增益，但总是与其他因素（模型保真度、硬件、成本口径）共现；1891 个候选系统对中仅 1 对在共享假设下直接可比；图级分析显示私有推理的 scaling frontier 停滞在 13B 参数，并投影了在生产级 Transformer 上部署现有 PTI 技术的成本。
Conclusion: 该图框架让社区能透明评估 PTI 声明，并把技术加速导向部署规模的私有推理。

papers.title: PN-Mix: Pair-Norm Guided Mixed-Precision Key Cache Quantization for Efficient Long-Output LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Long-output inference in large language models suffers from severe KV cache memory and bandwidth bottlenecks. While KV cache quantization alleviates this issue, low-bit quantization (e.g., 2-bit) severely degrades model accuracy. Recent mixed-precision key-cache quantization methods mitigate this degradation by allocating higher precision to important key channels, but estimate channel saliency using only key statistics. Through attention logit perturbation analysis at the RoPE channel-pair level, we show that quantization errors in channel pairs with large query--key pair-norm products contribute significantly to logit variation. Based on this insight, we propose PN-Mix, a mixed-precision key-cache quantization method for RoPE-based decoder-only LLMs, which allocates higher precision to salient channel pairs identified once during the prefill stage and reused throughout decoding. Across standard reasoning, code-generation, and AIME benchmarks, PN-Mix with 2.26-bit average precision achieves comparable or better average accuracy than prior mixed-precision methods using 2.32--2.39 bits. Furthermore, in our Pareto sweep, PN-Mix degrades gracefully down to 1.5 bits, whereas the compared baselines exhibit sharper performance drops below 2.25 bits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PN-Mix 在 RoPE 通道对层面用 query–key pair-norm 乘积判定 key cache 量化显著通道，prefill 阶段一次识别后全程复用，把高精度分配给这些通道对。平均 2.26-bit 精度下在标准推理、代码生成与 AIME 上达到或优于用 2.32–2.39 bits 的既有混合精度方法的平均精度，且 Pareto 扫描中可平缓退化到 1.5 bits，而基线在 2.25 bits 以下明显掉点。
Motivation: 长输出推理受 KV cache 显存与带宽瓶颈制约，2-bit 等低位量化会严重掉精度；现有混合精度 key cache 方法只用 key 自身统计量估计通道显著性，忽略了量化误差经 attention logit 的传播路径。
Method: 对 RoPE decoder-only LLM 做 attention logit 扰动分析，定位到 query–key pair-norm 乘积大的通道对是 logit 波动的主要来源；据此在 prefill 阶段一次性识别显著通道对并分配高精度，解码全程复用该分配，形成 PN-Mix 混合精度 key cache 量化。
Result: 在标准推理、代码生成与 AIME 基准上，PN-Mix 平均 2.26-bit 精度取得与既有混合精度方法相当或更好的平均精度，而后者需 2.32–2.39 bits；Pareto 扫描中 PN-Mix 可平缓退化到 1.5 bits，对比基线在 2.25 bits 以下出现更陡的性能下降。
Conclusion: key cache 量化的重要性判据应放在 RoPE 通道对的 query–key pair-norm 上而非 key 统计量上，这样能在更低平均比特数下守住长输出推理精度并把可接受下限推到 1.5 bits。

papers.title: Beyond Static Positional Encoding: Bayesian Time-aware Attention for Non-Stationary Long-term Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Transformers have demonstrated strong performance in long-term time series forecasting (LTSF), yet modeling non-stationary temporal dependencies remains challenging. In this paper, we interpret self-attention as a Bayesian posterior over attended positions, combining a content-based prior induced by scaled dot-product similarity with a temporal-evidence likelihood induced by positional encoding. This formulation provides a probabilistic interpretation of how positional encoding shapes the temporal dependencies captured by self-attention. Building on this perspective, we derive a population-level evidence lower bound (ELBO) that characterizes the role of positional encoding in forecasting weakly stationary time series. Our analysis further highlights a limitation of static positional encoding: when temporal dependence structures vary across input windows, a fixed temporal bias must accommodate heterogeneous dynamics and can therefore be suboptimal for non-stationary forecasting. Motivated by this analysis, we propose Bayesian Time-aware Attention (BTA), which employs a mixture-of-experts (MoE) router to adaptively combine temporal kernels and generate input-conditioned, head-specific positional biases. Extensive experiments on standard LTSF benchmarks demonstrate that BTA consistently improves forecasting performance across multiple Transformer backbones and achieves competitive overall performance with modest computational overhead and stable training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 self-attention 解释为被注意位置上的 Bayesian 后验（内容先验 + 位置编码似然），并据此指出静态位置编码在跨窗口时变的非平稳序列上必然次优。提出 Bayesian Time-aware Attention (BTA)：用 MoE 路由器按输入自适应组合时间核，生成逐 head 的位置偏置，在多个 Transformer 主干上一致提升 LTSF 精度且开销温和。
Motivation: 长时序预报 (LTSF) 中非平稳时间依赖难以建模：当依赖结构随输入窗口变化时，固定的静态位置偏置必须同时迁就异质动态，因而对非平稳预报次优。
Method: 先将 self-attention 形式化为被注意位置上的 Bayesian 后验，其中 scaled dot-product 相似度给出内容先验、位置编码给出时间证据似然；再对弱平稳时间序列导出刻画位置编码作用的 population-level ELBO。基于该分析提出 BTA：MoE 路由器自适应组合多个时间核，生成输入条件化、逐 head 的位置偏置，接入多个 Transformer 主干。
Result: 在标准 LTSF benchmark 上，BTA 在多个 Transformer 主干上一致改善预报性能，整体表现具竞争力，计算开销 modest 且训练稳定；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 静态位置编码对非平稳 LTSF 结构性不足，用 MoE 路由的输入条件化时间核偏置可以在低开销下稳定地跨主干提升长时序预报。

summary_sections.motivation: 长时序预报 (LTSF) 中非平稳时间依赖难以建模：当依赖结构随输入窗口变化时，固定的静态位置偏置必须同时迁就异质动态，因而对非平稳预报次优。

papers.title: JevCoder: When Does Decision Delegation Pay Off in Code Repair?
papers.abstract_en: A coding agent repeatedly makes decisions as it repairs code. These decisions shape repair trajectories and affect the token cost of successive model requests. We ask which repair decisions can be delegated to a low-cost probabilistic judge to reduce token use while maintaining repair quality. The judges answer questions with probabilities over predefined answers, without generating explanations. We evaluate judgment quality across repair stages and test how individual interventions change subsequent repair work. We compare these interventions with unguided repair, which uses no judge, and with the same workflow using the repair model itself as the judge. The benefit depends on the work an intervention changes, rather than the cost of the judgment alone. Based on these studies, we propose JevCoder, a workflow built around Jev, a low-cost probabilistic judge. It combines code-snippet recommendations with action-type guidance and uses judgments to determine when to submit. We evaluate three repair models, each on the same 400 tasks: 200 from SWE-bench Verified and 200 from SWE-Bench Pro Verified. Compared to unguided repair, JevCoder reduces mean repair-model token use by 21.6%-50.6%, with higher observed repair rates across all three models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JevCoder 把代码修复中可委派的决策交给低成本概率判官 Jev：判官只对预定义答案输出概率、不生成解释，用于给出代码片段建议、动作类型指导并决定何时提交。在三个修复模型各 400 个任务（SWE-bench Verified 200 + SWE-Bench Pro Verified 200）上，相比无引导修复，平均修复模型 token 用量下降 21.6%–50.6%，且三个模型的观测修复率均更高。
Motivation: 编码代理在修复过程中反复做决策，这些决策决定修复轨迹并推高后续模型请求的 token 成本；需要弄清哪些决策可以委派给低成本判官，在省 token 的同时保住修复质量。
Method: 构建 JevCoder 工作流，围绕低成本概率判官 Jev：判官以预定义答案上的概率作答、不生成解释；先评估各修复阶段的判断质量并测试单个干预如何改变后续修复工作，再与无引导修复、以及用修复模型自身当判官的同流程对比；干预组合代码片段建议、动作类型指导与提交时机判断。
Result: 在三个修复模型上各跑 400 个任务（200 个 SWE-bench Verified + 200 个 SWE-Bench Pro Verified），相比无引导修复，JevCoder 使修复模型平均 token 用量下降 21.6%–50.6%，且三个模型的观测修复率均更高；收益取决于干预所改变的工作量，而非判断本身的成本。
Conclusion: 把修复决策委派给低成本概率判官能否回本，取决于该干预改变了多少后续工作，而不只是判断有多便宜；JevCoder 据此在降 token 的同时保持并抬高修复率。

papers.title: InstructPro2: Natural Language and Biological Grounding Guided De Novo Protein Design
papers.abstract_en: The ability to generate proteins with desired functions is a central goal of computational biology. Although natural language can express diverse design objectives, existing protein generation methods often support only narrow tasks or make limited use of biological constraints. We develop InstructPro2 to translate natural-language design objectives into protein sequences while incorporating task-specific biological context. A text encoder captures the design instructions, while dedicated ligand and antigen encoders provide biological context to the sequence-generating decoder. For pretraining, we assemble InstructPro2Bench, comprising 205.7 million <function description, protein> pairs from UniProtKB. We subsequently adapt the model to ligand-binding protein and antibody design. On functional protein generation benchmarks, InstructPro2 outperforms Pinal, the strongest baseline, achieving a functional recovery F1 of 74.8 versus 62.2 and lowering global RMSD from 5.33A to 3.04A. For antibody design, the model obtains a DockQ score of 0.39, while ligand-binding protein design reaches a docking success rate of 72.6%. These findings highlight how integrating language-based instructions with biological conditioning can extend protein generation to distinct design settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InstructPro2 把自然语言设计指令与配体、抗原生物上下文一起喂给序列生成解码器，实现从文本目标到蛋白质序列的 de novo 设计。在功能蛋白生成基准上，功能恢复 F1 达 74.8（最强基线 Pinal 为 62.2），全局 RMSD 从 5.33Å 降到 3.04Å；抗体设计 DockQ 为 0.39，配体结合蛋白设计对接成功率 72.6%。
Motivation: 现有蛋白质生成方法只支持狭窄任务、对生物约束利用有限，而自然语言能表达多样的设计目标，需要把语言指令与生物上下文统一进一个生成框架。
Method: 文本编码器读取设计指令，专用 ligand encoder 与 antigen encoder 提供生物上下文，共同条件化序列生成解码器；预训练用 InstructPro2Bench，含来自 UniProtKB 的 205.7 百万 <功能描述, 蛋白质> 对，随后适配到配体结合蛋白与抗体设计。
Result: 功能蛋白生成基准上功能恢复 F1 为 74.8，对比 Pinal 的 62.2；全局 RMSD 从 5.33Å 降至 3.04Å。抗体设计 DockQ 为 0.39，配体结合蛋白设计对接成功率 72.6%。
Conclusion: 把语言指令与生物条件化结合，可把蛋白质生成扩展到功能蛋白、抗体、配体结合蛋白等不同设计场景，并在功能恢复与结构精度上超过最强基线 Pinal。

papers.title: L3M: A Verifiable Harness and Runtime for Self-Extending and Self-Improving Agents
papers.abstract_en: The lasting gains in AI have come from methods that absorb more computation, and language models already scale computation within a call. Useful work, though, happens across calls: over hours or days, through tools and external systems, among many agents and the humans they work for, and increasingly through code the agents write themselves. Whether that work compounds is enabled by the harness around it, and the harness faces a constraint the model does not: of the three participants in such a computation, the human, the model and code, only the human's attention does not scale, so the computation can grow only if the human is not in every loop. L3M is a runtime built on that premise, written in Lean 4 so that one language implements the harness, states its invariants, and is the language agents extend it in. One computation spans humans, agents, models and code, and all of its state lives in Git: a rich state trajectory -- rather than a chat conversation -- is an object the runtime can resume, rewind, fork, compare and merge. Waiting, communication, delegation and undo are primitives, not patterns the model reasons through each time. When an agent works out a procedure, it can write it once as a sealed Lean program whose type is its permission request, and the harness offers it back as a tool -- machinery for the model to use. To take the human out of the loop, L3M uses reversibility to decide where that is safe: a tool's review tier follows from how far its effects can be undone, so agents act freely where the runtime can recover. Because the machinery can change, the properties that make this safe are stated as kernel-checked theorems about the code that runs. On Terminal-Bench, an untuned L3M reaches about two thirds of its (unsafe) shell-equipped pass rate using only safe (not needing human review) tools.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: L3M 是一个用 Lean 4 写的 agent 运行时：把 harness、其不变量和 agent 扩展 harness 的语言统一到同一门语言，全部状态存 Git，使一次计算可恢复、回退、分叉、比较与合并。安全放行靠可逆性判定——工具的审核等级由其效果能回退多远决定，可逆处 agent 自主行动；在 Terminal-Bench 上，未调优的 L3M 仅用安全（无需人工审核）工具即达到其配备不安全 shell 工具时通过率的约三分之二。
Motivation: 跨小时、跨工具、多 agent 的工作能否复利取决于 harness，而三方参与者（人、模型、代码）中只有人的注意力不可扩展：计算要增长，人就不能留在每个回路里。
Method: 以 Lean 4 单语言实现 harness、陈述其不变量并供 agent 扩展；一次计算的全部状态存于 Git，形成可 resume/rewind/fork/compare/merge 的富状态轨迹；等待、通信、委派、撤销作为运行时原语；agent 学到的流程写成类型即权限请求的 sealed Lean 程序，harness 将其作为工具回供；安全属性以 kernel-checked 定理形式陈述。
Result: 在 Terminal-Bench 上，未调优的 L3M 仅使用安全（无需人工审核）工具，达到其配备不安全 shell 工具时通过率的约三分之二。
Conclusion: 把可逆性作为放行判据、把权限写进类型并用内核检查定理，可以在不把人放回每个回路的前提下让 agent 自扩展、自改进。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: JockeyBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Horse-Racing Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: Repeated event forecasting requires extracting predictive signals from noisy evidence and evaluating their value across successive decisions. We introduce JockeyBench, a benchmark and evaluation protocol that studies this problem through historical Japanese horse racing. The protocol combines time-gated evidence, priced tools, paired frozen-program controls, and two workflows: executing an LLM-written predictor or acquiring evidence for a fresh per-race LLM forecast. Evaluation separates forecast quality, benchmark-specific net utility, and retrospective betting returns and risk under fixed decision rules. Across 28 model--scaffold configurations on 324 races, paired tests identify seven revision gains and two declines after multiple-testing correction. Yet every configuration has negative mean profit under capped-Kelly settlement. In a four-model comparison, the reusable-program workflow has higher mean betting profit and lower research fees, although both workflows lose on average. Further diagnostics reveal that mean probability bias reverses on selected bets and that profitable individual runs can depend on concentrated returns. These findings motivate evaluating predictive competence, adaptation, resource use, and decision value separately when assessing agents for repeated event forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JockeyBench 用历史日本赛马做重复事件预报基准，把时间门控证据、付费工具、冻结程序对照与两种工作流（执行 LLM 写的预测程序 vs. 每场重新让 LLM 预测）结合，分开度量预报质量、净效用与投注收益。在 28 个模型-脚手架配置、324 场比赛上，配对检验在校正多重比较后只找到 7 项改进和 2 项下降，且所有配置在 capped-Kelly 结算下平均利润都为负。
Motivation: 重复事件预报需要从含噪证据中提取预测信号并在连续决策中评估其价值，但现有 agent 评测把预测能力、适应性、资源消耗和决策价值混在一起，无法判断 agent 在真实下注式决策中是否真的创造价值。
Method: 以历史日本赛马为载体构建基准与评测协议：时间门控证据防止信息泄漏，付费工具引入成本，配对冻结程序 (paired frozen-program controls) 做对照；两种工作流分别为执行 LLM 生成的预测程序、以及为每场比赛付费获取证据后由 LLM 重新预报。评测分离预报质量、基准特定净效用、以及固定决策规则下的回溯投注收益与风险。
Result: 在 28 个模型-脚手架配置、324 场比赛上，配对检验经多重比较校正后识别出 7 项改进与 2 项下降；所有配置在 capped-Kelly 结算下平均利润均为负。四模型对比中，可复用程序工作流的平均投注利润更高、研究费用更低，但两种工作流平均都亏损。诊断显示平均概率偏差在被选中的投注上发生反转，个别盈利运行依赖收益集中。
Conclusion: 评估重复事件预报 agent 时必须把预测能力、适应性、资源使用和决策价值分开度量；在该赛马设定下，即使预测层面出现改进，固定决策规则下的投注收益仍系统性为负。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Projected Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao Flows for Hawkes Background-Intensity Estimation
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of estimating the background intensity of a Hawkes process when the triggering mechanism is known, treating the background as an unknown finite positive measure with a regular density. We propose a likelihood-based variational approach based on the Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao geometry. In this setting, the relevant first variations are naturally distribution-valued and therefore fall outside the classical gradient-flow formulation. We develop a distributional framework for the resulting dynamics and give them a finite-dimensional meaning through projections onto statistical manifolds. We identify the true background as the unique zero of a limiting generalized gradient and, under suitable stability, compactness, integrability and approximation conditions, establish a conditional consistency theorem for measurable estimators satisfying the empirical projected equations on events whose probabilities tend to one. Finally, we specialize the construction to Gaussian-mixture manifolds and obtain an explicit finite-dimensional scheme.

papers.title: Who's Behind the Text? Robust Model Authorship Attribution
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate text, their misuse has become a growing societal problem, with implications for academic misconduct, model distillation, and cyberattacks. For these reasons, Model Authorship Attribution (MAA), which identifies the source model of a given text, is important for promoting the responsible use of LLMs and improving AI safety. In practice, attribution systems must remain reliable beyond the distributions observed during training. They may encounter texts from unseen domains and writing settings, as well as generations from future versions of model families that were not available when the system was trained. However, existing MAA methods often exhibit substantial performance degradation under such distribution shifts. To address this challenge, we propose Authorship Tracing via Likelihood-based Attribution of Sources (ATLAS), which formulates MAA through source-conditioned text modeling rather than direct source prediction. ATLAS learns how text from each source family is generated and attributes a given text by comparing its likelihood under each learned source condition. We aggregate this likelihood evidence at the token level with clipping so that no single token dominates the decision. We further introduce MAABench, a broad MAA benchmark for evaluating practical OOD settings such as domain and version. Our experiments show that ATLAS consistently outperforms existing baselines across MAABench and OpenTuringBench. In particular, when both the generation domain and the model version change on MAABench, ATLAS achieves 74.27% accuracy, 9.00pp higher than the strongest baseline. Beyond MAA, ATLAS can also help identify distillation source models by measuring which source model a target LLM most closely resembles. Our extended experiments show that ATLAS recovers the known teacher of every distilled model we evaluate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ATLAS：把模型作者归属 (MAA) 写成源条件文本建模而非直接分类，按各源模型条件下的似然给文本归因，并在 token 级做带截断 (clipping) 的证据聚合以避免单 token 主导。在 MAABench 与 OpenTuringBench 上一致超过既有基线，当生成域与模型版本同时变化时 ATLAS 达到 74.27% 准确率，比最强基线高 9.00pp。
Motivation: LLM 生成文本被用于学术不端、模型蒸馏与网络攻击，但现有 MAA 方法在训练分布之外（未见域、未见写作设定、未来版本模型）性能大幅下降，归属系统无法在分布漂移下保持可靠。
Method: ATLAS 不直接预测源，而是学习每个源模型家族如何生成文本，再比较待判文本在各源条件下的似然；似然证据在 token 级聚合时加 clipping，使单个 token 不能主导判决。同时提出 MAABench，覆盖域与版本两类实际 OOD 设定。
Result: 在 MAABench 与 OpenTuringBench 上 ATLAS 一致优于现有基线；MAABench 上生成域与模型版本同时改变时准确率 74.27%，比最强基线高 9.00pp。扩展实验中，ATLAS 找出了所评测每一个蒸馏模型的已知 teacher。
Conclusion: 把归属改写为源条件似然比较，可在域与版本双重分布漂移下保持归属精度，并可复用为蒸馏源模型的识别手段。

papers.title: XferAgent: Cross-Agent Experience Transfer for Self-Improving LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can reuse experience from prior task executions to improve performance on subsequent tasks. Although existing methods enable cross-agent experience sharing, differences in agents' execution histories and task requirements make shared experiences difficult to reuse effectively. We propose XferAgent, a framework for cross-agent experience transfer that organizes reusable experience in local and shared experience graphs. XferAgent reconciles compatible contributions from heterogeneous agents while avoiding unreliable merges. For each new task, it selects shared experiences and integrates them with the target agent's local experience to support task execution. Experiments across diverse task domains show improvements over representative memory-based methods and effective experience transfer between heterogeneous agent frameworks. Cumulative task success also increases over successive task passes as agents update and reuse their experiences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: XferAgent 用本地经验图与共享经验图组织可复用经验，调和异构 agent 的兼容贡献并规避不可靠合并，为每个新任务挑选共享经验并与目标 agent 的本地经验整合。在多领域任务上超过代表性基于记忆的方法，且随任务轮次推进、agent 更新并复用经验，累计任务成功率持续上升。
Motivation: 已有跨 agent 经验共享方法受执行历史与任务需求差异影响，共享经验难以有效复用。
Method: 将可复用经验组织为本地经验图与共享经验图；调和异构 agent 的兼容贡献、避免不可靠合并；对每个新任务选取共享经验并与目标 agent 本地经验整合以支持执行。
Result: 在多样任务领域上优于代表性基于记忆的方法，并实现异构 agent 框架间的有效经验传递；随着 agent 更新并复用经验，跨连续任务轮次的累计任务成功率上升。
Conclusion: 把经验分成可调和的本地与共享两层图结构，能让异构 LLM agent 之间可靠传递经验并随轮次自我改进。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Bridging the Topological Divide: Dual-Branch Graph Distillation with Semantic Priors for Robust Cold-Start Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Graph Collaborative Filtering models have achieved remarkable success in recommendation systems. However, they inherently suffer from a catastrophic representation collapse in strict cold-start scenarios due to the topological isolation of unobserved items. While integrating multi-modal semantic features offers a potential remedy, directly mapping isolated semantic attributes into a globally topology-driven collaborative space frequently precipitates representation degradation and optimization conflicts. To bridge this fundamental structural divide, we propose DualGCN, an innovative Dual-Branch Graph Knowledge Distillation Framework. Operating under a decoupled two-stage training paradigm, DualGCN first constructs a robust collaborative teacher network where item representations are anchored by a topology-smoothed semantic prior, effectively reshaping the latent manifold. Subsequently, a semantic student branch employs a residual mapping mechanism and a magnitude-agnostic cosine distillation objective to achieve high-fidelity cross-modal alignment without disrupting established collaborative signals. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic norm reconstruction mechanism to rigorously calibrate the physical scales of novel and warm items during global retrieval. Extensive experiments across three real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that DualGCN significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in strict cold-start scenarios while comprehensively preserving recommendation accuracy for highly active items.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DualGCN 用双分支图知识蒸馏解决严格冷启动推荐中未观测物品的拓扑孤立导致的表示坍缩：先以拓扑平滑的语义先验锚定协同教师网络重塑潜流形，再用残差映射与幅度无关的余弦蒸馏对齐语义学生分支，并以动态范数重建校准新物品与活跃物品的检索尺度。在三个真实基准数据集上，严格冷启动场景显著优于 SOTA 基线，同时保持高活跃物品的推荐精度。
Motivation: 严格冷启动下未观测物品在协同图上拓扑孤立，图协同过滤出现灾难性表示坍缩；直接把孤立语义属性映射进全局拓扑驱动的协同空间会引发表示退化与优化冲突。
Method: DualGCN 采用解耦两阶段训练：第一阶段构建协同教师网络，物品表示由拓扑平滑的语义先验锚定以重塑潜流形；第二阶段语义学生分支用残差映射机制与幅度无关的余弦蒸馏目标做跨模态对齐，另加动态范数重建机制在全局检索时校准新物品与活跃物品的物理尺度。
Result: 在三个真实世界基准数据集上，DualGCN 在严格冷启动场景显著优于 state-of-the-art 基线，同时全面保持对高活跃物品的推荐精度。
Conclusion: 把语义先验作为拓扑平滑的锚点并用幅度无关的余弦蒸馏做跨模态对齐，可以在不破坏既有协同信号的前提下弥合冷启动物品的拓扑鸿沟。

papers.title: Learning Across Temporal Graph Representation Silos
papers.abstract_en: Temporal graph data are recorded in different representations, but whether these differences also determine the scope of learned knowledge reuse remains unclear. This study investigates whether predictive structure learned from relational histories can be reused between continuous-time dynamic graphs (CTDGs) and temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs). Bidirectional reuse emerges while retaining distinct input and prediction interfaces and independent vocabularies, and sources with the same representation are not always more useful. Controlled reorganizations of source histories show that the organization contributing to reuse varies across source-target conditions. We show that learned aspects of Relational Dynamics, the predictive structure present in relational histories, can be reused across conventional representation boundaries. Independently pretrained TKG and CTDG learners can also be fused at the score level to improve prediction on a third dataset without entity or relation-semantic alignment. Two proofs of concept in recommendation and security detection illustrate that external temporal sources without direct alignment can also become useful pretraining resources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文检验关系历史中学到的预测结构（Relational Dynamics）能否跨表示边界复用：CTDG 与 TKG 之间出现双向复用，且同表示的源并不总是更有用。独立预训练的 TKG 与 CTDG 学习器可在 score 级融合，在第三个数据集上提升预测，无需实体或关系语义对齐。
Motivation: 时序图数据以不同表示记录，但这些差异是否限定已学知识的复用范围尚不清楚；若表示边界即知识边界，跨库预训练就无从谈起。
Method: 在 CTDG 与 TKG 之间做双向复用实验，保持各自输入、预测接口与独立词表；对源历史做受控重组以分离组织方式的作用；再将独立预训练的 TKG 与 CTDG 学习器在 score 级融合，并以推荐和安全检测两个概念验证说明无直接对齐的外部时序源可作预训练资源。
Result: 复用在保留独立接口与词表的条件下双向出现，同表示的源并不总是更有用，且贡献复用的历史组织方式随源-目标条件变化；score 级融合在第三个数据集上改善预测，无需实体或关系语义对齐；推荐与安全检测两个概念验证表明无直接对齐的外部时序源也能成为有用的预训练资源。
Conclusion: 关系历史中的预测结构可以跨越 CTDG 与 TKG 这类表示边界被复用，源的价值取决于源-目标条件而非表示是否相同。

papers.title: On Inherent Privacy of Posterior Sampling: A Unified Rényi-Divergence Framework
papers.abstract_en: Differential Privacy (DP) provides a rigorous framework for quantifying privacy guarantees. While most methods achieve DP by injecting calibrated random noise, the intrinsic randomness of certain procedures such as sampling can yield DP guarantees ``for free''. In this work, we develop a unified Rényi divergence framework to characterize the inherent DP guarantees of sampling from a Bayesian posterior distribution. We show that the privacy loss incurred by One-Posterior-Sampling (OPS) is governed by posterior exponential moments of the single-record log-likelihood ratio, and establish explicit DP guarantees under uniformly bounded, sub-Gaussian, or sub-exponential tail regimes. We apply the framework to representative Bayesian models, including categorical likelihoods with arbitrary priors, Gaussian-Gaussian conjugate pair, generalized linear models from the exponential family and linear regression with Gaussian likelihood, both with Gaussian priors on the regression coefficients. Our results elucidate sample size, model structure, neighboring relations in DP (bounded or unbounded), and how prior if applicable, jointly determine the inherent DP guarantees of OPS. Furthermore, our results recover the existing DP guarantees for OPS as special cases -- often with tighter privacy loss bounds -- and substantially broaden the class of Bayesian models for which the inherent DP guarantees of OPS can be rigorously characterized.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Divergence-Routed On-Policy Distillation for Language Models
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers knowledge from a teacher model to a student along student-generated trajectories, typically by minimizing the reverse Kullback-Leibler (RKL) divergence. However, RKL can provide weak corrective signals for teacher-supported tokens to which the student assigns very low probability. This raises two questions: which positions are most consequential for the behavioral gap between the student and teacher, and what additional supervision is needed at these positions? Through cross-sampling, we find that divergence-based routing more effectively pinpoints positions contributing to the teacher-student performance gap than entropy-based routing. Further analysis reveals teacher-mode under-coverage at high Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence positions, where standard OPD increases the large teacher-student probability gaps. Motivated by these findings, we propose Divergence-Routed On-Policy Distillation (DrOPD). DrOPD retains RKL supervision at all positions and selectively adds forward Kullback-Leibler (FKL) divergence supervision at positions with high JS divergence. Experiments across six math benchmarks show that DrOPD improves over standard OPD and entropy-based routing. DrOPD also reduces severe under-coverage cases by 37.9 percent relative to OPD, supporting targeted FKL as an effective complement to OPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 on-policy 蒸馏 (OPD) 中 reverse KL 对低概率 token 纠正信号弱的问题，提出 DrOPD：在全部位置保留 RKL，仅在 Jensen-Shannon 散度高的位置追加 forward KL 监督。在六个数学基准上优于标准 OPD 与基于熵的路由，严重 under-coverage 情形相对 OPD 减少 37.9%。
Motivation: 标准 OPD 用 RKL 沿学生自生成轨迹蒸馏，但学生给低概率的 token 上 RKL 纠正信号弱，导致教师模式 under-coverage；需要确定哪些位置真正贡献师生行为差距。
Method: 通过 cross-sampling 比较基于散度与基于熵的路由定位关键位置；DrOPD 在所有位置保留 RKL，仅在高 JS 散度位置选择性加入 FKL 监督。
Result: 在六个数学基准上 DrOPD 优于标准 OPD 与熵路由；严重 under-coverage 案例相对 OPD 减少 37.9%。
Conclusion: 基于散度的路由比熵路由更能定位师生差距位置，针对性 FKL 是 OPD 的有效补充。

papers.title: LED-BENCH: A Benchmark for Large-format Engineering Drawing Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Real-world engineering drawings are often large-format and information-dense. Answering practical engineering questions therefore requires both fine-grained understanding of engineering information and complex reasoning over objects, relations, and evidence distributed across different regions or views. Existing benchmarks cover a range of engineering-drawing understanding tasks involving local regions, individual views, specific elements, or more constrained visual settings. However, systematic evaluation of understanding over realistic, large-format engineering drawings remains limited. To address this gap, we introduce LED-BENCH, a multidisciplinary benchmark designed to evaluate fine-grained understanding and complex reasoning over large-format engineering drawings, spanning the mechanical, architectural, and transportation domains. Extensive evaluation of 11 representative multimodal large language models, including 8 proprietary models and 3 open-source models, reveals substantial remaining difficulty: GPT-5.6 Sol achieves 52.65% average accuracy, performance varies across engineering domains, and all evaluated models perform worse on questions requiring broader evidence integration. These results highlight fine-grained understanding, evidence integration, and complex reasoning over large-format engineering drawings as persistent challenges for current multimodal models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LED-BENCH 是面向大幅面、信息密集工程图纸的多学科基准，覆盖机械、建筑、交通三个领域，评测 11 个多模态大模型（8 个闭源、3 个开源）的细粒度理解与跨区域证据整合推理。GPT-5.6 Sol 平均准确率 52.65%，各工程领域表现不一，且所有模型在需要更大范围证据整合的问题上都更差。
Motivation: 现有工程图纸基准多局限于局部区域、单视图或特定元素等受限场景，对真实大幅面工程图纸的系统性理解评测不足。
Method: 构建跨机械、建筑、交通领域的 LED-BENCH 基准，评测 11 个代表性多模态大模型（8 个闭源 + 3 个开源），考察细粒度理解与跨区域、跨视图的复杂推理。
Result: GPT-5.6 Sol 平均准确率 52.65%；性能随工程领域变化；所有被测模型在需要更大范围证据整合的问题上表现更差。
Conclusion: 细粒度理解、证据整合与大幅面工程图纸上的复杂推理，仍是当前多模态模型的持续性难题。

papers.title: Geometric Kernel Diversity: An Axiomatic Diversity Measure in Euclidean Space
papers.abstract_en: Quantifying the diversity of a set of objects is a fundamental problem in machine learning and statistics. Mironov and Prokhorenkova (2025) recently showed that three axioms-monotonicity, uniqueness, and continuity-are crucial for a reliable diversity measure and that none of the standard metrics in the literature satisfy all three. They also constructed two measures that do satisfy the axioms, but both are NP-hard to compute, leaving open the question of whether efficient axiomatic diversity measures can exist. We study a Euclidean-restricted version of this question. We introduce Geometric Kernel Diversity (GKD), which associates a radial kernel solid with each point and measures the volume of their union. We show that canonical GKD satisfies all three Mironov-Prokhorenkova axioms on Euclidean-realizable inputs. For canonical GKD, we give exact polynomial-time algorithms in dimensions $d \le 3$. In arbitrary dimensions, we give a randomized algorithm that returns a $(1 \pm \varepsilon)$-approximation with probability at least $1-δ$ in time $O \left(\frac{nd}{\varepsilon^2}\log\frac{2}δ\right)$ for $n$ points. The axiomatic guarantee applies to exact canonical GKD; the randomized algorithm approximates this deterministic quantity. We further show that the two diversity measures of Mironov and Prokhorenkova (2025) remain NP-hard on Euclidean-realizable inputs and, unless $\mathrm{NP} = \mathrm{RP}$, admit no FPRAS even on this restricted domain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Geometric Kernel Diversity (GKD)：给每个点配一个 radial kernel solid，用这些 solid 并集的体积度量集合多样性。canonical GKD 在 Euclidean-realizable 输入上同时满足 Mironov-Prokhorenkova 的三条公理（monotonicity、uniqueness、continuity），且 d≤3 时可精确多项式时间计算，任意维度有 (1±ε) 近似随机算法，运行时间 O((nd/ε²)log(2/δ))；而 Mironov-Prokhorenkova 的两个公理化度量即使限制在 Euclidean 输入上仍 NP-hard 且除非 NP=RP 否则无 FPRAS。
Motivation: Mironov 与 Prokhorenkova (2025) 指出可靠多样性度量需同时满足三条公理而现有标准度量均不满足，他们构造的两个满足公理的度量却都是 NP-hard，高效公理化多样性度量是否存在仍是开放问题。
Method: 在 Euclidean-restricted 设定下引入 GKD：为每个点关联一个 radial kernel solid，以并集体积作为多样性；证明 canonical GKD 在 Euclidean-realizable 输入上满足三条公理；对 d≤3 给出精确多项式时间算法，对任意维度给出返回 (1±ε) 近似、成功概率至少 1−δ 的随机算法；并证明 Mironov-Prokhorenkova 两个度量在 Euclidean-realizable 输入上仍 NP-hard。
Result: canonical GKD 在 Euclidean-realizable 输入上满足全部三条 Mironov-Prokhorenkova 公理；d≤3 时存在精确多项式时间算法；任意维度随机算法以至少 1−δ 概率返回 (1±ε) 近似，耗时 O((nd/ε²)log(2/δ))（n 个点）；Mironov-Prokhorenkova (2025) 的两个度量在 Euclidean-realizable 输入上仍 NP-hard，且除非 NP=RP 否则在该受限域上无 FPRAS。
Conclusion: 在 Euclidean 可实现输入上，满足三条公理的多样性度量确实可以高效计算，而先前两个公理化度量的难解性并非来自输入表示。

papers.title: INTACT: Inducing Latent Reasoning on a Frozen Backbone
papers.abstract_en: Latent reasoning replaces natural-language chains of thought with compact continuous "soft-token" representations, reducing the number of intermediate tokens that must be decoded autoregressively. We use a small external encoder to induce latent reasoning in a frozen backbone model. The encoder iteratively maps the backbone's hidden states to new latent blocks, constructing a latent reasoning prefix, after which the frozen model writes its remaining reasoning and its answer as text. Our method, INTACT, trains this encoder through distillation to reproduce the effect of written reasoning steps while keeping the model's behavior close to that of the frozen backbone, and then reinforces it on answer correctness. Across four frozen backbones from 1B to 8B, INTACT improves both GSM8K and average out-of-domain accuracy, including GSM8K gains from 75.8% to 79.3% on Llama-3.2-3B and from 77.6% to 79.7% on Qwen2.5-3B. It also reduces end-to-end latency per problem by 19% on Llama-3.2-3B and outperforms the evaluated latent-reasoning baselines at the 3B and 8B scales. Beyond the mathematics setting, the same recipe trained on a multi-domain corpus improves the frozen backbone on twelve evaluation benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and commonsense, without task-specific adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: INTACT 用一个小型外部编码器在冻结的 backbone 上诱导潜在推理 (latent reasoning)：编码器迭代地把 backbone 隐状态映射成新的 latent block，构成潜在推理前缀，再由冻结模型直接写出剩余推理与答案。训练分两步——先用蒸馏让编码器复现写出推理步骤的效果并保持行为贴近冻结 backbone，再按答案正确性做强化。在 1B–8B 的四个冻结 backbone 上同时提升 GSM8K 与域外平均准确率，Llama-3.2-3B 上 GSM8K 从 75.8% 升到 79.3%、每题端到端延迟降 19%。
Motivation: 自然语言思维链要求逐步自回归解码大量中间 token，推理慢且开销高；潜在推理用连续 soft token 替代文字推理，但如何在不改动 backbone 的前提下诱导出有效潜在推理仍是问题。
Method: 小型外部编码器迭代地把冻结 backbone 的隐状态转成新的 latent block，拼成潜在推理前缀；先以蒸馏训练编码器复现书写式推理步骤的效果并约束行为接近冻结 backbone，再以答案正确性做强化。
Result: 在四个 1B–8B 冻结 backbone 上，GSM8K 与域外平均准确率均提升：Llama-3.2-3B 的 GSM8K 从 75.8% 到 79.3%，Qwen2.5-3B 从 77.6% 到 79.7%；Llama-3.2-3B 每题端到端延迟降低 19%；在 3B 与 8B 规模上超过所评估的潜在推理基线。同一配方在多领域语料上训练后，在覆盖数学、科学与常识的十二个评测基准上提升冻结 backbone，无需任务特定适配。
Conclusion: 在冻结 backbone 外挂一个经蒸馏加正确性强化训练的编码器，就能同时拿到潜在推理的延迟收益与跨领域准确率提升，不必微调 backbone 本身。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Frame Evidence:A Benchmark for Reference Frames and Visual Evidence in Multi-Image Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: A spatial answer depends on the reference frame specified in language and its supporting visual evidence. Item accuracy alone obscures whether correctness persists when either changes. We introduce Frame Evidence, a benchmark of 320 matched triplets and 960 Chinese multiple-choice questions from captured and rendered scenes. One family compares three grounded reference frames over fixed images. The other pairs image deletion annotated as insufficient with answer-preserving addition. Joint metrics require correct answers across all three frames and paired evidence variants. Across 20 configurations on 288 held-out questions, GPT three-shot reaches 50.00\% item accuracy, but the best three-frame group accuracy is 5/48 (10.42\%), reached by GPT two-shot. Few-shot prompting and task-specific adaptation improve item accuracy without consistently improving joint correctness. Input controls show where images support matched success, while repeated executions reveal answer instability beneath similar scores.

papers.title: SaTPO: Text-to-Image Safety Alignment via Transition Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Safety alignment of text-to-image diffusion models aims to suppress harmful content without compromising useful generation capabilities. However, preferences over completed images compress multidimensional generation factors into a coarse signal, potentially driving changes beyond those required for safety. To address this, we propose Safety Transition Preference Optimization (SaTPO), which enforces step-wise alignment during denoising. SaTPO leverages the insight that an unsafe prompt and its safe rewrite naturally form a tightly coupled preference pair when conditioned on a shared parent state and noise realization. By anchoring optimization on identical parent states, SaTPO eliminates historical trajectory divergence, confining safety adaptation to an incremental alignment while preserving task-relevant semantics. Multi-scale drift constraints and benign replay further limit behavioral deviation and preserve ordinary generation. We additionally construct CoProPV, a refined dataset ensuring visually verified contrasts. Experiments on Stable Diffusion v1.5 and SDXL demonstrate improved safety-quality trade-offs. Compared with AlignGuard, PerspectiveVision unsafe-detection rates on Inappropriate Image Prompts decrease from 12.70% to 6.00% and from 15.04% to 9.30%, respectively, while FID improves from 32.28 to 25.95 and from 36.50 to 27.51. Warning: this paper includes potentially offensive content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SaTPO 把文生图安全对齐从整图偏好压到去噪逐步偏好：不安全提示与其安全改写在同一父状态与同一噪声下构成偏好对，锚定相同父状态消除轨迹分歧，再用多尺度漂移约束与良性回放限制行为偏移。在 Stable Diffusion v1.5 与 SDXL 上，相对 AlignGuard，PerspectiveVision 在 Inappropriate Image Prompts 上的不安全检出率从 12.70% 降到 6.00%、从 15.04% 降到 9.30%，同时 FID 从 32.28 改善到 25.95、从 36.50 改善到 27.51。
Motivation: 对完整图像的偏好信号把多维生成因子压成一个粗粒度标量，安全对齐的改动会溢出到安全所需之外，损害正常生成能力。
Method: 提出 Safety Transition Preference Optimization (SaTPO)：在去噪过程中逐步对齐，把不安全提示与安全改写在共享父状态和相同噪声实现下配成偏好对，锚定同一父状态做增量式优化；配合多尺度漂移约束 (multi-scale drift constraints) 与良性回放 (benign replay) 限制行为偏移，并构建经视觉核验对比的 CoProPV 数据集。
Result: 在 Stable Diffusion v1.5 上，相对 AlignGuard，PerspectiveVision 在 Inappropriate Image Prompts 的不安全检出率 12.70% → 6.00%，FID 32.28 → 25.95；在 SDXL 上检出率 15.04% → 9.30%，FID 36.50 → 27.51。
Conclusion: 逐步、锚定父状态的偏好优化能在压低不安全检出率的同时改善图像质量，即安全-质量权衡优于整图偏好对齐的 AlignGuard。

papers.title: REWIND: Uncertainty-Guided Trajectory Repair for Test-Time Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: An early mistake in the generated reasoning can constrain all subsequent reasoning. Repeated-generation methods, like MCMC-based approaches, attempt to improve output quality by sampling multiple generations, but their effectiveness can be limited by randomly selecting where to regenerate. On MATH500 with Qwen2.5-Math-7B, we find that incorrect responses have substantially higher mean token entropy than correct responses, with an average within-question relative increase of approximately 112%, suggesting that entropy can signal reasoning errors. Motivated by this finding, we introduce REWIND, a training-free controller that uses entropy dynamics to propose targeted suffix regenerations. Across three model families and five benchmarks, REWIND outperforms all baselines, with gains of 0.51-10.00 percentage points over the strongest baseline. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of targeted, uncertainty-guided trajectory repair across models and tasks. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rewind-D310.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REWIND 是一个免训练的测试时推理控制器：用 token 熵动态定位错误推理的起点，只对后缀做定向重生成，而不是像 MCMC 类重复生成那样随机选重生成位置。在 MATH500/Qwen2.5-Math-7B 上，错误回答的平均 token 熵比正确回答高约 112%（题内相对增幅），跨三个模型家族、五个基准上比最强基线高 0.51–10.00 个百分点。
Motivation: 推理早期的一个错误会约束后续全部推理；重复生成方法靠多次采样提升质量，但随机选择重生成位置，效率受限，缺少能指示错误位置的信号。
Method: 训练-free 控制器 REWIND：先用 MATH500 上 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 统计正确与错误回答的 token 熵差异，再以熵动态作为不确定性信号提出定向后缀重生成 (targeted suffix regeneration)，替代随机位置重采样。
Result: MATH500 上错误回答的平均 token 熵显著高于正确回答，题内相对增幅约 112%；跨三个模型家族与五个基准，REWIND 相对最强基线提升 0.51–10.00 个百分点，优于全部基线。
Conclusion: token 熵可以作为推理错误的信号，据此做定向、不确定性引导的轨迹修复 (uncertainty-guided trajectory repair) 在多模型多任务上有效。

papers.title: $τ$-Emotion-Bench: Exposing the Interaction Fragility of LLM Agents through Real-World User Emotions
papers.abstract_en: In long-horizon tool-calling tasks, LLM agents can fail not only because of tool-use errors, but also because of ineffective interaction with users. Yet existing benchmarks largely assume cooperative and behaviorally stable users, leaving the effect of emotional variation on agent reliability underexplored. We introduce $τ$-Emotion-Bench, a ten-domain benchmark for evaluating tool-calling agents under controlled emotion-conditioned user interactions while preserving the underlying task objective. To scale both benchmark construction and agent training, we introduce Tracer, a scalable agentic data-generation pipeline that constructs grounded, policy-valid tasks and collects trajectories through an interactive agent--user--environment harness. By allowing dissatisfied users to terminate inefficient interactions, the harness provides an interaction-aware signal that filters trajectories with excessive user dependence and favors effective tool use. Experiments with two user simulators show that frontier agents remain unreliable, with substantial gaps between average task success and consistent task completion. Tracer-generated supervision consistently improves Qwen3 models across scales, generalizes to unseen domains, and transfers to $τ$-Bench and $τ$-Trait. Behavioral analyses further show that higher task success is associated with a better balance between tool execution and necessary user follow-up. Overall, $τ$-Emotion-Bench and Tracer provide a scalable framework for evaluating agent reliability under diverse user behaviors and improving tool-calling agents through interaction-aware supervision.
papers.comment: Accepted to the UserSim Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: τ-Emotion-Bench 是一个十域工具调用 (tool-calling) 基准，在保持任务目标不变的前提下对用户情绪做受控变化，用以暴露 LLM agent 与真实情绪用户交互时的脆弱性；配套提出 Tracer 数据生成管线，通过可终止低效交互的 agent–user–environment harness 筛掉过度依赖用户的轨迹。实验显示前沿 agent 仍不可靠，平均任务成功率与持续完成率之间存在明显差距，而 Tracer 生成的监督信号在多个规模上稳定提升 Qwen3，并迁移到 τ-Bench 与 τ-Trait。
Motivation: 现有工具调用基准大多假设用户合作且行为稳定，长程任务中情绪变化对 agent 可靠性的影响基本未被检验，而失败往往来自交互而非工具使用本身。
Method: 构建十域基准 τ-Emotion-Bench，在受控情绪条件化的用户交互下评测工具调用 agent；同时提出 Tracer agentic 数据生成管线，用交互式 agent–user–environment harness 生成有依据、符合策略的任务并收集轨迹，允许不满的用户终止低效交互，从而过滤过度依赖用户的轨迹、偏好有效工具使用。
Result: 在两个 user simulator 下实验显示前沿 agent 仍不可靠，平均任务成功率与一致的任务完成率之间存在显著差距；Tracer 生成的监督在多个规模上一致提升 Qwen3 系列，泛化到未见域并迁移到 τ-Bench 与 τ-Trait；行为分析显示更高任务成功率与工具执行和必要用户跟进之间的更好平衡相关。
Conclusion: agent 可靠性必须在情绪化、可终止交互的用户下评估，交互感知 (interaction-aware) 的监督信号能同时改善工具调用表现与跨域迁移。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning Visual Speech Representations via Cross-Modal Distillation and Joint Face-Lip Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Lipreading remains challenging due to the inherent ambiguity of visual speech cues and their sensitivity to head pose and video resolution. In this work, we propose FLARE, a framework for robust visual speech representation learning via cross-modal distillation and joint face-lip modeling. FLARE leverages semantically rich Whisper representations as the acoustic teacher signal, converting them into discrete distillation targets through a random-projection quantizer and pretraining the model with a masked prediction objective. To capture complementary visual information, FLARE employs a dual-stream architecture that jointly processes lip region-of-interest (ROI) and full-face inputs, where the lip stream captures finegrained articulatory motion and the face stream encodes broader facial dynamics. During pretraining, auxiliary audio input is incorporated to facilitate cross-modal alignment, and modality dropout is applied to encourage robust visual-only representations. For downstream lipreading, FLARE serves as a visual encoder coupled with either a lightweight Transformer decoder or an LLM-based decoder. Evaluated on LRS2, LRS3, and the out-of-domain WildVSR benchmark, FLARE achieves strong lipreading performance, with word error rates of 11.7%, 13.2%, and 34.3%, respectively. A progressive design study confirms the contribution of each major component. Further analyses demonstrate that joint face-lip modeling improves robustness under degraded video resolution and large head pose variation, while yielding more phoneme-discriminative visual representations. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/jxzhanggg/FLARE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLARE 用 Whisper 声学表征做教师信号，经随机投影量化器 (random-projection quantizer) 转成离散蒸馏目标，配合唇部 ROI 与全脸双流联合建模做视觉语音预训练。在 LRS2、LRS3 与域外 WildVSR 上词错误率 (WER) 分别为 11.7%、13.2%、34.3%，且联合脸-唇建模在低分辨率与大头姿变化下更稳健。
Motivation: 唇读 (lipreading) 的视觉语音线索本身含糊，且对头姿和视频分辨率敏感，单一唇部输入在退化条件下表征不稳。
Method: 以 Whisper 表征为声学教师，用随机投影量化器转为离散目标并以掩码预测 (masked prediction) 预训练；双流架构并行处理唇部 ROI 与全脸输入，预训练时加入辅助音频做跨模态对齐并施加 modality dropout；下游作为视觉编码器接轻量 Transformer 解码器或 LLM 解码器。
Result: 在 LRS2、LRS3、域外 WildVSR 上 WER 分别为 11.7%、13.2%、34.3%；渐进设计研究确认各主要组件均有贡献；进一步分析显示联合脸-唇建模在视频分辨率退化与大头姿变化下提升稳健性，并给出更具音素判别力的视觉表征。
Conclusion: 跨模态蒸馏加脸-唇联合建模能学到对分辨率与头姿退化更稳健、音素判别力更强的视觉语音表征，代码与预训练模型已开源。

papers.title: TEX-MEX: Similarity-Guided Temporal Contrastive Learning for Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive learning for time series depends on deciding which pairs of inputs should be treated as similar and dissimilar. Because few augmentations reliably preserve meaning in time series, prior methods have relied on two disjoint notions of similarity between windows: structural similarity, which relates windows with similar morphology, and temporal similarity, which relates windows that occur close together in time. We introduce TEX-MEX, to our knowledge the first approach to unify the two into a single relationship. Given a random batch of windows drawn across the dataset, TEX-MEX uses the encoder to identify which windows are structurally similar or dissimilar to each other. It then pulls each window toward the temporally shifted versions of similar windows and pushes it away from those of dissimilar ones, learning what typically accompanies similar windows in time. Across PPG, EEG, ECG, accelerometry, and continuous glucose monitoring, TEX-MEX broadly achieves state-of-the-art performance against contrastive, reconstructive, JEPA-based, and modality-specific approaches, establishing it as a strong general SSL objective. We further train a 560K-parameter PPG foundation model that achieves state-of-the-art performance across a broad range of downstream benchmarks while being roughly 50x smaller than the next-best unimodally pretrained PPG foundation model in our evaluation. We will release this foundation model open-source and open-weight to the community to support future work and practical applications.
