papers.title: Evidence-Anchored Overdose Death Prediction from Death Investigation Reports
papers.abstract_en: Confirmation of overdose deaths in the United States is often delayed due to the complexities of certifying drug-involved deaths. Death investigation reports represent a rich but underutilized data source that could be used to predict whether a death is a suspected overdose (i.e., a death preliminarily identified as an overdose prior to the final cause and manner of death determination). We present an automated framework that classifies suspected overdoses from death investigation reports, while producing supporting explanations guided by expert knowledge. Through an expert-guided design process, we investigate 1) what type of explanations are best for model prediction performance, and 2) which architecture is better suited for this task: pipeline models that rationalize first and then predict, or self-rationalizing models that jointly predict and rationalize? Our experiments show that a pipeline model with explanations grounded in the input death investigation reports outperforms the other settings. Our best model also outperforms a rule-based system currently in deployment by 15%, while allowing expert interventions for final decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对美国过量致死确认滞后，提出从死亡调查报告自动判定疑似过量 (suspected overdose) 并生成专家知识引导的支撑解释的框架；实验比较“先解释后预测”的 pipeline 模型与联合预测解释的 self-rationalizing 模型，发现以报告原文为依据的 pipeline 设置表现最好，最佳模型比现役规则系统高 15%，且保留专家介入最终决定的能力。
Motivation: 美国药物相关死亡的死因认定流程复杂，过量致死确认常被拖延；死亡调查报告是丰富但未被充分利用的数据源，可用于在最终死因与死亡方式判定之前预测疑似过量。
Method: 通过专家引导的设计流程，系统比较两类架构：先生成解释再预测的 pipeline 模型，与联合预测并解释的 self-rationalizing 模型；同时考察哪种解释类型最有利于预测性能，解释需由专家知识引导并锚定在输入的死亡调查报告上。
Result: 实验显示解释锚定于输入死亡调查报告的 pipeline 模型优于其他设置；最佳模型比当前部署的规则系统 (rule-based system) 高 15%。
Conclusion: 对这类任务，先做有据可依的解释再预测优于联合自解释，且学习模型可超过现役规则系统并保留专家对最终决定的介入。

papers.title: Test-Time Forecasting: Recurrent Depth Enables In-Context Dynamics Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models for dynamical systems can forecast unseen partial differential equations (PDEs), ordinary differential equations (ODEs), and time series during inference. However, it remains an open question whether these foundation models truly learn generalizable in-context forecasting strategies. We show that looped transformers are capable of emulating propagators for dynamical systems in-context by first establishing a link between linear attention and (extended) dynamic mode decomposition. We then generalize this insight into the $\textit{Test-Time Forecasting}$ (TTF) framework in which a one-step forecaster leverages iterations of gradient descent as recurrent depth. We demonstrate that lightweight TTF models trained on ODEs and PDEs generalize to out-of-distribution system dynamics during autoregressive rollout after being trained for one-step prediction. Our results reinforce TTF as a theoretically motivated framework for designing recurrent depth models capable of forecasting unseen dynamical systems at test-time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Test-Time Forecasting (TTF) 框架：把梯度下降迭代当作 recurrent depth，让一步预报器在推理时迭代求解，从而在测试期对未见过的动力系统做 in-context 预报。先建立 linear attention 与 (extended) dynamic mode decomposition 的联系，再据此推广；在 ODE 与 PDE 上训练的轻量 TTF 模型，经自回归 rollout 能泛化到分布外 (out-of-distribution) 系统动力学。
Motivation: 动力系统基础模型能在推理期预报未见过的 PDE、ODE 与时间序列，但它们是否真的学到了可泛化的 in-context 预报策略仍是开放问题。
Method: 先证明 linear attention 与 (extended) dynamic mode decomposition 的等价联系，再推广为 TTF：一步预报器以梯度下降迭代作为 recurrent depth，在测试期迭代优化；模型在 ODE 与 PDE 上仅训练一步预测，随后自回归 rollout。
Result: 在 ODE 与 PDE 上训练的轻量 TTF 模型，仅经一步预测训练即可在自回归 rollout 中泛化到分布外 (out-of-distribution) 系统动力学；摘要给出的是定性泛化结论，无具体数值指标。
Conclusion: TTF 是一个有理论动机的 recurrent depth 设计框架，能在测试期预报未见过的动力系统，其依据是 linear attention 与动态模态分解的联系。

papers.title: TextVerifier: Seeing Beyond Recognition to Verify Chinese Text Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image models increasingly generate readable Chinese text that still contains local rendering defects, such as a character with an extra or missing stroke or a malformed component. Such errors are invisible to OCR and vision-language models, which are trained for recognition and are therefore invariant to the very structural deviations that define a rendering error. We formalize text rendering verification as a target-conditioned problem: given a target character and an image crop, decide whether the crop is a correct rendering of that character. Our verifier TEXTVERIFIER feeds the text tower a character's Ideographic Description Sequence (IDS) rather than a single-character symbol, and is trained on 12.7M crop-IDS pairs plus label-free "same-character, different-quality" hard pairs sampled from the training trajectory of a text-region inpainting model. To evaluate this ability we build TEXTRENDERBENCH-ZH, the first per-character benchmark for generated Chinese text, annotating position, identity, and correctness for 7,358 characters. TEXTVERIFIER reaches an F1 of 0.844, far above OCR confidence (0.526), a general VLM (0.329), and TextPecker (0.590). Used as a per-character reward for Flow-GRPO post-training, it further reduces rendering errors, showing that its score can both detect and correct errors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TextVerifier 把中文文本渲染校验形式化为目标条件判别：给定目标字与图像裁块，判断裁块是否正确渲染该字。它用汉字的表意描述序列 (IDS) 替代单字符符号喂入 text tower，在 12.7M crop-IDS 对与无标签难负对上训练，F1 达 0.844，远超 OCR 置信度 0.526、通用 VLM 0.329 与 TextPecker 0.590；作为 Flow-GRPO 后训练的逐字 reward 还能进一步减少渲染错误。
Motivation: 文生图模型生成的中文已可读但常有缺笔画、多笔画、部件畸形等局部渲染缺陷，而 OCR 与 VLM 因按识别训练、对这类结构偏差天然不变，看不见这些错误。
Method: 把校验定义为目标条件问题（目标字 + 图像裁块 → 正误），text tower 输入该字的 IDS 而非单字符符号；训练数据为 12.7M crop-IDS 对，加上从文本区域 inpainting 模型训练轨迹中采样的无标签「同字不同质量」难对。另构建逐字基准 TextRenderBench-ZH。
Result: TextVerifier F1 0.844，对比 OCR confidence 0.526、通用 VLM 0.329、TextPecker 0.590；TextRenderBench-ZH 标注 7,358 个字的位置、身份与正确性，是首个面向生成中文文本的逐字基准；作为 Flow-GRPO 后训练的逐字 reward 进一步降低渲染错误。
Conclusion: 按结构描述（IDS）而非识别式表征训练的校验器既能检测也能纠正中文渲染错误，其分数可直接充当生成后训练的逐字 reward。

papers.title: LabCompiler: A Framework for Verifiable Human-Machine Laboratory Execution from Imperfect Protocols
papers.abstract_en: Closing the loop of AI-driven science requires reliably translating natural-language protocols into executable laboratory workflows despite protocol defects and heterogeneous hardware. Existing approaches often couple scientific interpretation with device-specific code generation, making errors difficult to localize and limiting reuse across laboratory platforms. We introduce LabCompiler, a robust protocol-to-execution framework that transforms imperfect natural-language protocols into verifiable human-machine workflows. Its protocol firewall diagnoses and repairs defects before compilation while preserving unaffected content, guided by troubleshooting knowledge accumulated through perturbation-guided self-evolution. A two-level, device-agnostic graph representation separates experimental semantics from hardware-specific implementation and supports capability-based device assignment with coordinated human execution. We further introduce a protocol recovery benchmark covering four controlled perturbation types and naturally occurring errors collected from protocols written by iGEM participants. Experiments show that LabCompiler outperforms frontier LLMs in protocol error correction while enabling coordinated human-machine execution across heterogeneous, partially automated laboratory settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LabCompiler 把有缺陷的自然语言实验协议编译成可验证的人机协同实验流程：protocol firewall 在编译前诊断并修复缺陷且保留未受影响内容，两级设备无关图把实验语义与硬件实现分离。在含四类受控扰动与 iGEM 真实错误的协议恢复基准上，其协议纠错能力超过前沿 LLM，并支持在异构、部分自动化的实验室里做能力匹配的人机协同执行。
Motivation: 现有方法把科学解释与设备专用代码生成耦合在一起，协议缺陷导致的错误难以定位，且流程无法跨实验平台复用。
Method: protocol firewall 在编译前诊断并修复协议缺陷，修复策略由 perturbation-guided self-evolution 累积的排障知识引导；两级设备无关图表示将实验语义与硬件实现分离，支持基于能力的设备分配与人工协同执行；另构建协议恢复基准，含四类受控扰动和 iGEM 参赛者协议中的自然错误。
Result: 实验显示 LabCompiler 在协议纠错 (protocol error correction) 上超过前沿 LLM，并能在异构、部分自动化的实验室环境中实现人机协同执行；基准覆盖四类受控扰动类型与 iGEM 参赛者协议的自然错误。
Conclusion: 把协议修复与设备无关的语义表示从代码生成中解耦，可以让不完美协议在异构实验室平台上被可靠编译为可验证的人机工作流。

papers.title: Noisy-Label Calibration with Multiple Unreliable Labels
papers.abstract_en: In medical annotation and crowdsourcing, multiple annotators assign labels to each example, but these labels may be incorrect. Treating such noisy labels as ground truth can bias calibration evaluation. To address this problem, we propose methods for evaluating and recalibrating a fixed binary predictor under the underlying clean-label distribution, using only noisy annotations. First, given annotator-specific noise probabilities, we propose Noise Corrected ECE (NC-ECE), a binned estimator of expected calibration error (ECE) under class-conditional noise. We derive non-asymptotic bounds on the estimator's bias. Then, we propose practical algorithms for estimating unknown noise probabilities under conditional independence and label-orientation assumptions. We also develop loss-based and histogram post-hoc recalibration with clean-risk and calibration guarantees, respectively. Experiments on semi-synthetic benchmarks show that the proposed ECE estimator closely tracks its clean-label oracle counterpart and that the recalibration methods substantially improve latent-label calibration, whereas uncorrected recalibration against noisy annotations can degrade it.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 医学标注与众包中多个标注者的标签可能有错，把噪声标签当真值会偏置校准评估 (calibration evaluation)，且未知噪声率下无法直接在干净标签分布上评估或重校准固定预测器。
Method: 在给定标注者特异噪声概率时提出分箱估计量 NC-ECE，用于类条件噪声下的 ECE，并推导该估计量偏差的非渐近界 (non-asymptotic bounds)；在条件独立与标签朝向假设下给出估计未知噪声概率的实用算法；再提出基于损失与基于直方图的后处理重校准，分别带 clean-risk 保证与校准保证。
Result: 半合成基准 (semi-synthetic benchmarks) 上，所提 ECE 估计量紧贴其干净标签 oracle 对应量；重校准方法显著改善潜在标签 (latent-label) 校准，而对噪声标注做未校正重校准会使其变差。
Conclusion: 只要先校正标注噪声再评估与重校准，就能在仅有噪声标注时逼近干净标签下的校准度量；直接把噪声标注当真值重校准会损害校准。

papers.title: Cross-Scenario Industrial Defect Detection via Domain-Robust Training and Metric-Aligned Selection
papers.abstract_en: Automated defect detection of industrial boards must remain highly reliable under cross-scenario variations in lighting, surface contaminants, and production line conditions. This makes cross-scenario defect detection a domain generalization problem, wherein models are required to detect, localize, and classify defects across unseen scenarios while minimizing false alarms on clean boards. For the IDA 2026 Track 1 challenge, we propose a cross-scenario defect detection method that includes four complementary modules: cross-scenario robust training, small-defect-aware learning, score calibration and inference threshold selection, and metric-aligned checkpoint selection. These four modules respectively introduce cross-scenario robust normalization and DSU-style statistic perturbation with progressive random convolution, NWD and parameter-free spatial attention, the VFL learning objective, and a custom SWAD variant driven by the Track 1-oriented proxy. Experimental results demonstrate that our model achieves a Track 1 score of 0.564 with a screening score of 0.696 on the test dataset on a single RTX 4090 GPU. The code is available at https://github.com/GZHU-DVL/Dikai.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation in IEEE ICME 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 IDA 2026 Track 1 跨场景工业缺陷检测，提出四模块方案：跨场景鲁棒归一化与 DSU 统计量扰动加渐进随机卷积、NWD 与免参数空间注意力的小缺陷感知学习、VFL 目标的分数校准与阈值选择、以及由 Track 1 代理指标驱动的 SWAD 变体检查点选择。在测试集上取得 Track 1 得分 0.564、筛查得分 0.696，单张 RTX 4090 即可运行。
Motivation: 工业板缺陷检测在光照、表面污染与产线条件的跨场景变化下可靠性下降，需要在未见场景中检测、定位并分类缺陷，同时压低干净板上的误报。
Method: 四个互补模块：跨场景鲁棒归一化加 DSU 式统计量扰动与渐进随机卷积 (progressive random convolution)；NWD 与免参数空间注意力的小缺陷感知学习；VFL 学习目标做分数校准与推理阈值选择；自定义 SWAD 变体，由面向 Track 1 的代理指标驱动做检查点选择。

Conclusion: 把跨场景鲁棒训练、小缺陷感知、分数校准与指标对齐的检查点选择组合起来，可在未见场景下同时保住缺陷检出与干净板低误报，并按 Track 1 代理指标选出最优检查点。

papers.title: Two-stage Residual Learning for Modelling Strength-Informed Optimisation of Thermal Systems
papers.abstract_en: Aggregate performance metrics do not identify local modelling inaccuracies in machine learning (ML) surrogates used for thermal-system optimisation. This study assesses local modelling strength through validation-based reliability screening and post-optimisation residual assessment. A two-stage residual learning (TSRL) framework, built on artificial neural networks (ANNs), is developed for modelling-strength-informed and domain-constrained optimisation of thermal systems. Within the TSRL framework, a base ANN predicts the process output, and a residual ANN learns the signed residuals left by the base ANN. The TSRL framework is implemented on two case studies of thermal systems, including 817 simulation observations of a crude distillation unit and operating records from a 395 MW industrial gas turbine. The TSRL framework reduces the test root mean square error (RMSE) from 10.3 g/s to 4.7 g/s for Fuel Oil in the refinery dataset and from 151 kJ/kWh to 105 kJ/kWh for turbine heat rate (THR). The base ANNs trained within TSRL are embedded in domain-constrained optimisation problems, and the modelling strength at each computed solution is assessed using the locked residual-score threshold. Each computed solution receives a good modelled region (GMR) or weak modelled region (WMR) label to inform ML model-based decision-making for safety-critical operation of thermal systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两阶段残差学习 (TSRL)：基 ANN 预测热系统输出，残差 ANN 专门学基模型留下的带符号残差，再用锁定的残差分数阈值给每个优化解打上 good modelled region (GMR) 或 weak modelled region (WMR) 标签。测试 RMSE 在炼厂 Fuel Oil 上从 10.3 g/s 降到 4.7 g/s，在 395 MW 燃气轮机 heat rate 上从 151 kJ/kWh 降到 105 kJ/kWh。
Motivation: 聚合性能指标掩盖 ML 代理模型在热系统优化中的局部失准，安全关键工况下无法判断某个解落在可信还是不可信的建模区域。
Method: TSRL 由基 ANN 与残差 ANN 串联构成，配合基于验证的可靠性筛查 (validation-based reliability screening) 与优化后残差评估；基 ANN 嵌入 domain-constrained 优化问题，按锁定的残差分数阈值给每个解标注 GMR/WMR。
Result: 在 817 条仿真观测的 crude distillation unit 数据集上，Fuel Oil 测试 RMSE 由 10.3 g/s 降至 4.7 g/s；在 395 MW 工业燃气轮机运行记录上，turbine heat rate (THR) 由 151 kJ/kWh 降至 105 kJ/kWh。
Conclusion: 把残差建模与解级别的 GMR/WMR 标注结合，可让热系统优化在安全关键运行中按局部建模强度而非聚合指标做决策。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RDCompGS: Rate-Distortion Optimization for Compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting with Image Codecs
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality, real-time novel view synthesis but requires significant storage and transmission resources. Mapping Gaussian attributes to 2D representations enables efficient compression using mature image codecs. However, Gaussian representations that achieve comparable rendering quality are generally treated similarly during optimization, despite substantial differences in coding rate, leading to limited rate-distortion (R-D) performance after compression. To address this limitation, we propose RDCompGS, a 3DGS compression method that enables overall R-D optimization of Gaussian representations with respect to subsequent coding. A differentiable estimate of the coding rate is incorporated into the R-D optimization with rendering distortion. The rate constraint adjustment model further regulates the R-D trade-off across different compression conditions. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that RDCompGS achieves average Bjøntegaard Delta Rate reductions of 37.84% and 49.31% with H.265/HEVC and JPEG XL, respectively. The estimated rate also shows a strong correlation with the actual bit-rate under different compression conditions.
papers.comment: This manuscript has been submitted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RDCompGS 把 3D Gaussian Splatting 的高斯属性映射为 2D 表示后交给成熟图像编解码器压缩，并在优化阶段就引入可微的编码码率估计与渲染失真做率失真 (R-D) 联合优化，另用率约束调节模型在不同压缩条件下控制 R-D 权衡。在三个基准数据集上，相对基线平均 Bjøntegaard Delta Rate 在 H.265/HEVC 下降低 37.84%、在 JPEG XL 下降低 49.31%，且估计码率与实际码率在不同压缩条件下强相关。
Motivation: 渲染质量相当的高斯表示在编码码率上差异巨大，但现有压缩流程对它们一视同仁，导致压缩后的率失真性能受限；3DGS 又需要大量存储与传输资源。
Method: 将高斯属性映射为 2D 表示以复用成熟图像编解码器；在 R-D 优化中把可微的编码码率估计与渲染失真一起纳入目标，并加入 rate constraint adjustment model 在不同压缩条件下调节率失真权衡。
Result: 在三个基准数据集上，平均 Bjøntegaard Delta Rate 相对降低 37.84%（H.265/HEVC）与 49.31%（JPEG XL）；估计码率在不同压缩条件下与实际码率呈强相关。
Conclusion: 面向后续编码做整体率失真优化、把码率估计放进训练目标，能显著提升 3DGS 压缩的率失真效率，且码率估计可作为实际码率的可靠代理。

papers.title: Typed Decision Models on Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Typed decision models are language models that answer a question with a fixed set of possible answers by returning a probability for each answer instead of generating text. We study them on tabular data and compare four decision models with three large language models (LLMs) on row classification, fact verification and anomaly detection. Every request is sent in its original form and under 21 types of rewrite that keep its content, such as renaming the options or writing the table in another format. The decision models perform as well as the LLMs at a lower cost. Three of them are also far more robust to how the question is formulated. No model we test is robust to how the table is organized. For every model, at least a third of the row decisions change under some rewrite of the table or the question. The decisions to which a decision model gives low probability are the ones most likely to change. Decision models are a practical choice for tabular decisions, but their robustness remains an open problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在表格数据上比较 4 种 typed decision models 与 3 个 LLM，任务为行分类、事实核查和异常检测；每个请求以原始形式和 21 种保持内容的改写（如重命名选项、换表格格式）各发一次。决策模型成本更低且其中 3 个对提问措辞更稳健，但所有模型都对表格组织方式不稳健：每个模型至少三分之一的行决策会因某次改写而改变，低概率决策最易翻转。
Motivation: 表格问答的输出会随提问措辞和表格排布而变，而固定答案集的决策模型能否在降低成本的同时抵抗这类改写，此前缺少系统比较。
Method: 把 typed decision models 定义为对固定答案集返回每个答案概率而非生成文本的语言模型；在行分类、事实核查、异常检测三类任务上，将 4 种决策模型与 3 个 LLM 对比，每个请求按原始形式加 21 种保内容改写（重命名选项、改写表格格式等）分别发送。
Result: 决策模型表现与 LLM 相当而成本更低；其中 3 个对提问措辞远更稳健；没有任何被测模型对表格组织方式稳健，每个模型至少三分之一的行决策在某种表格或问题改写下改变；决策模型给出低概率的决策最可能改变。
Conclusion: 决策模型是表格决策的实用选择，其对提问措辞的稳健性可显著优于 LLM，但对表格组织方式的稳健性仍是未解决的问题。

papers.title: A Unified Response Framework for Questions and Tutoring Dialogues
papers.abstract_en: Existing student models in educational applications largely focus on student responses to questions. However, as tutoring becomes more accessible at large scale, it is important to analyze dialogues between tutors and students, which may reveal fine-grained evidence on student knowledge. In this work, we propose a unified framework that models both student responses to questions and tutor-posed subtasks during dialogues on a shared item response theory (IRT) scale. We first identify mathematical subtasks in tutoring dialogues, rewrite them into self-contained questions, and identify the correctness of student responses to these subtasks. We then develop an IRT framework that estimates question/subtask difficulty from text, tracks students' evolving abilities across question-answering and dialogue interactions, and a novel method to leverages tutor moves between consecutive subtasks to regularize their difficulty values. We evaluate our framework on two real-world math education datasets containing both human- and AI-tutored dialogues. Results show that our framework outperforms strong baselines on both question difficulty prediction and response correctness prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出统一 IRT 框架，把学生答题与辅导对话中的 tutor 子任务放到同一量表上：从对话中抽取数学子任务并改写成自足问题，判定学生作答正误，用文本估计题目/子任务难度，追踪学生能力随问答与对话交互的演化，并用相邻子任务间的 tutor moves 对难度值做正则。在两个含人工与 AI 辅导对话的真实数学教育数据集上，题目难度预测与作答正误预测均超过强基线。
Motivation: 现有教育学生模型只建模学生对题目的作答，而大规模辅导产生的师生对话蕴含更细粒度的知识证据，缺少把答题与对话交互统一到同一量纲上建模的方法。
Method: 先在辅导对话中识别数学子任务、改写为自足问题并判定学生作答正误；再构建 IRT 框架，从文本估计题目/子任务难度，跨答题与对话交互追踪学生能力演化，并用相邻子任务间的 tutor moves 对难度值做正则化。
Result: 在两个含人工与 AI 辅导对话的真实数学教育数据集上，该框架在题目难度预测与作答正误预测两项任务上均超过强基线 (strong baselines)。
Conclusion: 把对话中的 tutor 子任务与答题放到共享 IRT 量表上联合建模，可以同时改进难度预测与正误预测，说明对话交互携带可用于学生知识追踪的证据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reducing the Gap Between Spatial and Space-Filling Curve Neighbors in 3D Point Cloud Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: As a lightweight and highly accurate method for nearest-neighbor search in 3D point clouds, approaches based on space-filling curves (SFC) have been proposed. However, due to the inherent properties of SFC, a gap arises between proximity relationships along the SFC and those in the original Euclidean space. In this study, we propose a loss function that reduces the influence of this gap. Specifically, we compute the distances between adjacent points along the SFC and train the model to optimize feature similarity between pairs of points that are distant from each other in the original 3D space. We incorporate the proposed method into a high-performing 3D point cloud segmentation model and evaluate its effectiveness on three datasets. The results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms conventional methods on both indoor and outdoor point cloud datasets.
papers.comment: Accepted by ECCV2026 Workshop "3rd Workshop on Scalable 3D Scene Generation and Geometric Scene Understanding"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对基于空间填充曲线 (SFC) 的 3D 点云近邻搜索中 SFC 邻域与欧氏邻域不一致的问题，提出一个损失函数：计算沿 SFC 相邻点的距离，并训练模型优化那些在原始 3D 空间中相距较远的点对的特征相似度，从而缩小两种邻域关系的差距。该方法嵌入一个高性能 3D 点云分割模型后，在室内与室外点云数据集上均超过常规方法。
Motivation: SFC 类近邻搜索轻量且精度高，但 SFC 上的邻近关系与原始欧氏空间的邻近关系存在固有差距，导致点云分割中邻域特征不可靠。
Method: 提出一个专门的损失函数：计算沿 SFC 相邻点之间的距离，据此训练模型去优化那些在原始 3D 空间中彼此远离的点对的特征相似度；将该损失嵌入一个已有的高性能 3D 点云分割模型中训练。
Result: 在三个数据集上评估，所提方法在室内与室外点云数据集上均优于常规方法（abstract 未给出具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 用损失函数直接压制 SFC 邻域与欧氏邻域的错配，可提升 SFC 邻近关系在 3D 点云分割中的可用性，且在室内、室外场景都成立。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Retrieve What Helps, Only When It Helps: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Selective Retrieval-Augmented Machine Translation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieving external knowledge can improve large language model (LLM) translation by providing supplementary information such as idiom interpretations and terminology. However, existing retrieval-augmented machine translation systems typically apply predefined retrieval strategies uniformly across all inputs. We argue that translation operates in a partial-evidence regime: LLM's parametric knowledge suffices for many inputs, while external evidence benefits a subset and usually supports rather than directly provides the desired translation. This creates two challenges: deciding when to retrieve and what evidence to acquire. We introduce Selective Retrieval-Augmented Translation (SRAT), an agentic reinforcement learning framework that learns when to translate directly or retrieve, what to retrieve, and how to integrate these decisions by optimizing final translation quality. To align evidence retrieval with downstream translation quality rather than simple semantic similarity, we further develop joint Plackett--Luce optimization and translation-quality contrastive training for retriever-training. Experiments on idiom, knowledge-intensive, and document-level translation with offline or online retrieval show that SRAT consistently outperforms never- and always-retrieve baselines, and quality-aligned retriever training provides further gains when similarity-based retrieval is insufficient. The results demonstrate the benefit of treating retrieval as a learnable translation action rather than fixed preprocessing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SRAT：把检索当作可学习的翻译动作，用 agentic 强化学习联合决定何时直接翻译、检索什么、如何融入证据，并以最终翻译质量而非语义相似度训练检索器。在习语、知识密集与文档级翻译（离线/在线检索）上，SRAT 稳定超过 never-retrieve 与 always-retrieve 基线，质量对齐的检索器训练在相似度检索不足时进一步提升。
Motivation: 现有检索增强机器翻译对所有输入统一套用预设检索策略，而翻译处于 partial-evidence regime：多数输入靠 LLM 参数知识已足够，外部证据只对子集有用且多为辅助而非直接给出译文。
Method: SRAT 用 agentic RL 优化最终翻译质量，同时学何时直接翻译或检索、检索什么、如何整合；检索器训练采用 joint Plackett--Luce optimization 与 translation-quality contrastive training，使证据检索对齐下游翻译质量而非简单语义相似度。
Result: 在习语、知识密集、文档级翻译并含离线与在线检索设置下，SRAT 一致优于 never-retrieve 与 always-retrieve 基线；质量对齐检索器训练在相似度检索不足时带来进一步增益。
Conclusion: 把检索当作可学习的翻译动作而非固定前处理是有收益的；证据获取应由下游翻译质量驱动，而非统一策略或语义相似度。

papers.title: HyrCap: Hybrid Rank-Calibration of Action Proposals for Temporal Event Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Temporal action detection in long untrimmed videos suffers from inaccurate localization and low-quality proposals, especially with sparse annotations and ambiguous boundaries. For open-ended video understanding and LLM-driven event analysis, reliable proposals connect temporal localization, event annotation, and semantic understanding. However, conventional temporal action detection (TAD) pipelines lack explicit modeling of proposal localization quality, cross-representation support, and inter-proposal relations. We propose Hybrid Rank-Calibration of Action Proposals (HyrCap), a proposal-centric query-based TAD framework for temporal event understanding. Hybrid combines complementary video features with different localization cues, while Rank-Calibration adjusts proposal ranking confidence to reflect localization reliability and candidate competition. HyrCap treats dense query-based predictions as an over-complete temporal event hypothesis space. Cross-Representation Consensus Calibration, Localization Quality Estimation, and Proposal Redundancy Suppression improve proposal ranking reliability, localization quality, and candidate discrimination. Inspired by LLMs' capabilities in fine-grained semantic recognition, event description, and reasoning, we introduce HyrCap for Semantic Action Understanding, using calibrated proposals for standard TAD and as inputs to LLM-based semantic understanding. We define a staged evaluation protocol to separately measure event localization, segment-level semantic understanding, and combined event understanding performance. Experiments on public benchmarks show that HyrCap achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple metrics and provides a finer-grained paradigm and evaluation protocol for query-based event segmentation and annotation.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://zgca-hmi-lab.github.io/HyrCap
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HyrCap 是面向长无剪辑视频时序动作检测 (TAD) 的 proposal-centric query 框架，用混合互补定位线索的视频特征、Rank-Calibration 排序校准，以及跨表示共识校准、定位质量估计与 proposal 冗余抑制，把稠密 query 预测当作过完备的时序事件假设空间。校准后的 proposal 既用于标准 TAD，也作为 LLM 语义理解的输入，并配套分阶段评测协议。
Motivation: 长视频时序动作检测在稀疏标注与边界模糊下定位不准、proposal 质量低；现有 TAD 流水线缺少对 proposal 定位质量、跨表示支撑与 proposal 间关系的显式建模，难以支撑 LLM 驱动的事件分析。
Method: HyrCap 以 proposal 为中心的 query-based 框架：Hybrid 融合带不同定位线索的互补视频特征；Rank-Calibration 按定位可靠性与候选竞争调整排序置信度；三个模块 Cross-Representation Consensus Calibration、Localization Quality Estimation、Proposal Redundancy Suppression 分别提升排序可靠性、定位质量与候选判别；再把校准 proposal 输入 LLM 做语义动作理解，并定义分阶段评测协议分别度量事件定位、片段级语义理解与综合事件理解。
Result: 在公开基准上的实验显示 HyrCap 在多个指标上达到 state-of-the-art 表现，并给出面向 query 式事件分割与标注的更细粒度范式与评测协议。
Conclusion: 把 proposal 排序置信度按定位可靠性显式校准，并把校准后的 proposal 作为 LLM 语义理解的接口，可以同时改善标准 TAD 与事件级语义理解，分阶段评测协议是该范式的配套主张。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Diagnosing and Correcting Reward Hacking in Verifiable Instruction Following
papers.abstract_en: Verifiable instruction-following benchmarks emphasize output-constraint satisfaction but can overlook whether responses meaningfully answer the underlying request, creating an evaluation blind spot. We show that frontier models can receive full credit for responses with little substantive answer content. Using the same verifier-based criterion as a training reward can induce reward hacking, as publicly released checkpoints exhibit higher constraint satisfaction but lower response quality after reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. To address this reward hacking, we introduce CALIF, a lightweight method that augments verifier rewards with a calibrated likelihood-based bonus to preserve response quality. CALIF evaluates response likelihood under the request alone using the existing frozen reference policy, requiring no additional judge or learned reward model. Across models ranging from 1.7B to 8B in reasoning and non-reasoning modes, CALIF improves constraint satisfaction on IFBench while maintaining response quality near or above pre-RL levels. It also outperforms corresponding base policies in 40 of 45 model-metric comparisons across three rubric-based instruction-following benchmarks, demonstrating gains beyond training verifiers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 可验证指令遵循 (verifiable instruction following) 基准只奖励输出约束满足，RLVR 后的公开 checkpoint 约束满足率上升但回答质量下降，出现 reward hacking。CALIF 用冻结参考策略在「仅请求」下的似然作为校准奖励加成，无需额外 judge 或奖励模型，把约束满足保持住同时让质量回到 pre-RL 以上。
Motivation: 以 verifier 判据直接当训练奖励会诱导 reward hacking：模型学会满足格式约束却掏空实质回答，而基准本身对这种空洞回答照样给满分。
Method: CALIF 在 verifier 奖励上加一个基于似然的校准加成：用现有冻结 reference policy 计算回答在仅给定请求条件下的似然，不引入额外 judge 或 learned reward model；在 1.7B–8B、reasoning 与 non-reasoning 两种模式的模型上做 RL 训练。
Result: 在 IFBench 上 CALIF 提升约束满足同时把回答质量维持在 pre-RL 水平附近或更高；在三个 rubric 式指令遵循基准的 45 组 model-metric 对比中，有 40 组优于对应 base policy。
Conclusion: 把 verifier 奖励与冻结策略的似然加成结合，可以在不牺牲回答质量的前提下继续推进可验证指令遵循的 RL 训练，收益不限于训练时用的 verifier。

papers.title: HankelKANet: Lightweight Path Loss Estimation via Physics-Inspired Hankel Convolution
papers.abstract_en: Accurate path loss (PL) estimation is essential for wireless network planning and optimization. This paper proposes HankelKANet, a lightweight physics-inspired network for PL estimation that structurally embeds electromagnetic propagation characteristics into the neural architecture. Built on a single residual UNet backbone, the proposed model integrates urban layout features with a convolutional Kolmogorov-Arnold network(KAN). Specifically, the convolutional kernels are parameterized by the radial amplitudes of the zeroth- and first-order Hankel functions. This formulation acts as a physics-inspired nonlinear distance encoding, enabling the network to capture dominant attenuation characteristics directly without requiring additional physics-based loss terms. Experimental results demonstrate that HankelKANet achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and efficiency on both the simulated RadioMapSeer dataset and the real-world Huawei RSRPSet. Compared with the leading baseline, PEFNet, it reduces the parameter count by 78% and lowers the RMSE by 16.96% on the simulated data, while further exhibiting robust cross-dataset transferability and high data efficiency during target-domain adaptation. To interpret these empirical gains, we mathematically establish a parameter-conditional spatial gradient bound. Using discrete Dirichlet energy (DDE) and Jacobian sensitivity heatmaps, we empirically verify that this physical encoding intrinsically constrains the network's spatial derivatives. This structural smoothness effectively eliminates non-physical spatial ripples, preventing overfitting to simulator artifacts and serving as the fundamental driver for robust real world generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HankelKANet 把零阶与一阶 Hankel 函数的径向幅度直接参数化为卷积核，把电磁传播特性嵌入单个残差 UNet 骨干，无需额外物理损失项即可估计路径损耗。在 RadioMapSeer 与华为 RSRPSet 上相对最强基线 PEFNet 参数量减少 78%、模拟数据 RMSE 降低 16.96%，并具备跨数据集迁移与目标域适配的数据效率。
Motivation: 无线网络规划需要准确的路径损耗 (PL) 估计，但纯数据驱动模型参数量大、易过拟合仿真器伪影，跨数据集泛化差。
Method: 单个残差 UNet 骨干融合城市布局特征与卷积 Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN)，卷积核由零阶和一阶 Hankel 函数的径向幅度参数化，作为物理启发的非线性距离编码；另数学建立参数条件的空间梯度界，并用离散 Dirichlet energy (DDE) 与 Jacobian 敏感度热图验证。
Result: 在模拟 RadioMapSeer 与真实华为 RSRPSet 上达到 SOTA 精度与效率：相对 PEFNet 参数量减少 78%，模拟数据 RMSE 降低 16.96%，并展现跨数据集迁移能力与目标域适配的高数据效率；DDE 与 Jacobian 热图显示该物理编码约束了网络空间导数。
Conclusion: 把电磁传播先验直接编码进网络结构（而非损失项）即可抑制非物理空间波纹、避免过拟合仿真器伪影，从而驱动真实世界的稳健泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spectral World Renderer: Unified 3D Hyperspectral Unmixing
papers.abstract_en: Cameras and the foundation models built on them recognize what a 3D scene contains, but not what it is made of: surfaces of the same colour can be different materials. Hyperspectral unmixing explains each spectrum as a mixture of material signatures, yet in 3D it is applied to rendered images after the views are composited, or tied to slow implicit fields, and no multi-view data with known composition exist to check the result. We present the Spectral World Renderer (SWR), which unifies world generation and unmixing. A coding agent builds executable 3D worlds that are rendered with measured spectra, so every hyperspectral image comes with exact labels and sub-pixel proportions; the resulting SWR-Bench provides eight indoor and outdoor worlds in which decompositions can be verified. SWR then unmixes inside rendering: each Gaussian of a compact 3D representation is decoded into material abundances before compositing, so one render yields spectra and material maps, and any surface can be queried by material name, a clicked pixel or a reference spectrum. Without material labels, SWR identifies materials best in all eight worlds, has the best mean PSNR on real captures, trains 3.7-12.9x faster than unmixing baselines, renders 34.9 labelled views/s and separates same-coloured materials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Spectral World Renderer (SWR) 把世界生成与高光谱解混统一起来：coding agent 构建可执行 3D 世界并用实测光谱渲染，使每张高光谱图像自带精确材质标签与亚像素丰度，构成 SWR-Bench（8 个室内外世界）。解混在渲染内部完成——每个 3D Gaussian 先解码为材质丰度再合成，一次渲染同时给出光谱与材质图。无材质标签监督下 SWR 在全部 8 个世界解混最佳、真实拍摄上平均 PSNR 最高，训练比解混基线快 3.7–12.9 倍，渲染 34.9 个带标签视图/秒，并能分开同色不同材质。
Motivation: 高光谱解混在 3D 中要么作用于视图合成后的渲染图，要么绑定到慢的隐式场，且缺少已知成分的多视图数据来验证结果。
Method: coding agent 构建可执行 3D 世界并以实测光谱渲染，产出带精确标签与亚像素比例的高光谱图像，汇总为 SWR-Bench（8 个室内外世界）；SWR 在渲染内部解混，把紧凑 3D 表示中的每个 Gaussian 解码为材质丰度后再合成，支持按材质名、点击像素或参考光谱查询任意表面。
Result: 无材质标签监督下，SWR 在全部 8 个世界中材质识别最佳；在真实拍摄上取得最佳平均 PSNR；训练比解混基线快 3.7–12.9 倍；渲染速度 34.9 个带标签视图/秒；可分离同色材质。
Conclusion: 把解混放进渲染管线并用可执行世界自动生成带标签数据，能在无材质监督下同时提升解混正确性、真实数据 PSNR 与训练效率。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Revisiting Triplet Contrastive Learning for 3D Shape Understanding
papers.abstract_en: In multi-modal 3D pre-training, aligning 3D shapes, their 2D image counterparts, and language descriptions has made tremendous progress. However, we find that supervision from rendered images is unreliable, the semantics encoded in synthetic views are distorted due to domain gap, self-occlusion, and rendering artifacts. Instead, we learn transferable 3D representations from language only. We observe that, in real world, 3D shapes are organized in a tree-like structure, ranging from general concepts to fine-grained instances with specific attributes, while language typically denotes generic concepts and subsumes these various 3D instantiations. Hence, we propose to embed 3D representations in hyperbolic space, whose geometry is well-suited for modeling tree-like data without distortion. To capture the asymmetric hierarchy between language and 3D shapes, we further impose a partial-order relation that language entails 3D shapes. Our method, Hyperbolic Contrastive Learning (HyperCL), jointly optimizes a hyperbolic geodesic-based contrastive objective and an entailment loss to learn discriminative cross-modal representations while explicitly preserving this hierarchy. We also introduce a rigorously verified benchmark for comprehensively evaluating cross-modal 3D alignment. Across two widely used benchmarks and ours, we improve the performance up to 4.6% absolute percentage on 3D shape classification and 5.5% on cross-modal text-to-3D retrieval under the same parameter budget. The code and evaluation benchmark will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HyperCL 放弃用渲染图像做监督，只用语言对齐 3D 形状，把表征嵌入双曲空间以无失真地建模树状层级，并加偏序蕴含损失刻画语言对 3D 形状的非对称包含。在两个常用基准加自建基准上，同参数预算下 3D 形状分类最高提升 4.6 个百分点，跨模态 text-to-3D 检索提升 5.5%。
Motivation: 多模态 3D 预训练依赖渲染图像监督，但域差、自遮挡与渲染伪影使合成视图中的语义失真，跨模态对齐质量受限。
Method: Hyperbolic Contrastive Learning (HyperCL)：仅用语言监督，将 3D 表征嵌入双曲空间，联合优化基于测地线 (geodesic) 的对比目标与蕴含损失 (entailment loss)，显式保持语言蕴含 3D 形状的偏序层级；另提出一个严格校验的跨模态 3D 对齐评测基准。
Result: 在两个广泛使用的基准加作者自建基准上，同参数预算下 3D 形状分类最高提升 4.6 个百分点，跨模态 text-to-3D 检索提升 5.5%。
Conclusion: 渲染图像监督不可靠，仅靠语言加双曲几何即可学到保留层级的判别性跨模态 3D 表征；代码与评测基准将公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VLRLA: Deployment-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language-Action Models through In-Context Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models connect visual perception and language understanding with robot control, providing a foundation for instruction-conditioned manipulation. However, conventional pretrained VLA policies lack a mechanism for gradual adaptation through accumulated interaction experience during deployment. We therefore propose VLRLA, a general framework that equips existing VLA models with \textit{in-context reinforcement learning} capabilities for deployment-time adaptation. Our approach augments a VLA model with a reinforcement learning module that learns from historical observations, actions, rewards, and termination signals. During deployment, the policy gradually refines its action generation and progressively improves task success while keeping model parameters fixed. Our approach is also designed for general applicability and compatibility with diverse learning history construction strategies and model training pipelines. Finally, through extensive experiments, we systematically investigate the learning properties of VLRLA in simulation and demonstrate its ability to adapt to unseen scenarios during real-world deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLRLA 给预训练视觉-语言-动作模型 (VLA) 外挂一个强化学习模块，在部署时用历史观测、动作、奖励与终止信号做 in-context RL，参数保持冻结仍逐步改进动作生成并提升任务成功率。作者称该框架兼容多种学习历史构建策略与训练流程，并在仿真与真实部署中展示对未见场景的适应能力。
Motivation: 预训练 VLA 策略缺少在部署过程中利用累积交互经验逐步适应的机制，遇到未见场景无法在线改进。
Method: 在现有 VLA 模型旁增加一个 RL 模块，输入为历史观测、动作、奖励和终止信号构成的学习历史；部署时策略据此逐步修正动作生成，模型参数固定不更新，并设计为兼容不同的学习历史构建策略与模型训练管线。
Result: 通过大量实验系统研究 VLRLA 在仿真中的学习特性，并展示其在真实部署中适应未见场景的能力（摘要未列出具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 参数冻结的 in-context 强化学习足以让 VLA 在部署期持续提升任务成功率，且可作为通用附加模块套用到不同 VLA 与训练流程上。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: High-Probability Regret Bounds for Feel-Good Thompson Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Feel-good Thompson sampling (FGTS) augments the posterior of vanilla Thompson sampling with an exploration term that favors reward functions with high predicted optimal values. This modification achieves minimax-optimal regret up to logarithmic factors in linear contextual bandits, but existing analyses of its two standard variants establish regret guarantees in expectation. In this paper, we derive the first high-probability regret bounds for both cumulative and current-step FGTS in contextual bandits with general realizable function approximation. Our bounds depend on the corresponding decoupling coefficients and the prior mass near the true reward function. In the $d$-dimensional linear setting, both variants satisfy $\mathrm{Regret}(T)=O\big(d\sqrt T\log(2T)+\sqrt T\log(1/δ)\big)$ with probability at least $1-δ$, where $T$ is the time horizon. This bound matches the dimension and horizon dependence of algorithms based on the upper confidence bounds, up to logarithmic factors. Relative to the expected-regret guarantees, the cost of controlling the regret with high probability is confined to additive terms with at most linear dependence on $\log(1/δ)$. The proof ideas are partially developed by GPT-6 Astra under the authors' guidance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 feel-good Thompson sampling (FGTS) 的累计型与当前步型两个变体的遗憾分析从期望意义推进到高概率意义：在一般可实现函数逼近下，d 维线性情境中两变体均以至少 1−δ 的概率满足 Regret(T)=O(d√T·log(2T)+√T·log(1/δ))，与基于 UCB 的算法在维数和时间跨度依赖上匹配（差对数因子），高概率化的代价被限制在至多对 log(1/δ) 线性增长的加性项内。
Motivation: FGTS 虽在情境老虎机 (contextual bandit) 中达到 minimax 最优的期望遗憾，但现有两个标准变体的分析都只给出期望意义的保证，缺少带置信水平 δ 的高概率界。
Method: 对累计型与当前步型 FGTS 分别推导高概率遗憾界，界由对应的解耦系数 (decoupling coefficients) 与真实奖励函数附近的先验质量 (prior mass) 决定；在 d 维线性设定中给出显式闭式，并与 UCB 类算法的证明思路对照。
Result: d 维线性情境下两变体均以概率至少 1−δ 满足 Regret(T)=O(d√T·log(2T)+√T·log(1/δ))，匹配 UCB 类算法的维数与时间跨度依赖（至多差对数因子）；相对期望遗憾保证，高概率化的额外代价限于至多对 log(1/δ) 线性依赖的加性项。
Conclusion: FGTS 的高概率遗憾可以做到与期望保证几乎同样紧，代价只是加性且对 log(1/δ) 至多线性；证明思路部分由 GPT-6 Astra 在作者指导下展开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CktHGVAE: A Symmetric Design/State Heterogeneous Graph Variational Autoencoder for Transistor-level Analog/Mixed-signal Circuit Design and Analysis
papers.abstract_en: We propose CktHGVAE, a heterogeneous graph variational autoencoder for transistor-level analog/mixedsignal CMOS circuits that takes not only design variables but also state variables as its inputs and outputs. With a single hyperparameter configuration without topology-specific tuning, comparison between model-generated and SPICE-simulated circuit operational states gives median R2 values above 0.9 for typical single-ended voltage amplifiers and the CMOS inverter, and 0.81-0.96 for differential amplifiers with larger datasets. Latent-space optimization in the PCA-reduced latent space with Bayesian optimization, evolutionary search, random search, and quasi-exhaustive search is demonstrated for a common-source voltage amplifier with NMOS input and resistive load, where the objective function is defined as a penalty for deviation from required circuit specifications. For each search strategy, 93.3 - 100% of all design candidates suggested by the model satisfy the required circuit specifications at the decoder output, and SPICE simulations verify that 90 - 100% of them indeed satisfy the requirements. The model pretrained on a batch of topologies can be transferred to unseen topologies without retraining at all, with zero-shot reconstruction median R2 values of 0.72-0.90 in three of four scenarios, including transfer from single-ended to differential topologies, although the transfer fidelity depends on the choice of pretraining topologies. Our demonstrations suggest that the proposed model can potentially serve as a basis for AMS CMOS circuit design automation.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Structure Before Intelligence: Gating What Agentic Scientific Workflows Release
papers.abstract_en: An agentic scientific workflow can run to completion and still release wrong results: a silent numerical error, a stale input, or a defect in a shared upstream step can contaminate several outputs while a sibling branch stays correct. We treat trust in such results as a release decision. A harness around the workflow's directed acyclic graph (DAG) decides which outputs may be used: it enforces mandatory checks, contains failures to the affected branch, recomputes from tracked versions, adds validators, and releases a result only if a risk model estimates its probability of being invalid as low. Language-model agents work inside the harness, choosing corrective actions and reviewing releases, but cannot override it. On 60 held-out paired instances of two workflows with injected faults, we switched components on and off. Each supplied a different property. Containment and recovery raised the number of correct results. Validation supplied safety: fixed rules without validation released 37 invalid results, while validating every candidate released none. Risk estimation supplied efficiency, matching that safety with 31% fewer validators at somewhat lower yield, although better targeting than random validation was not shown. Lineage evidence helped on one workflow. The language model added no measurable benefit: whether invalid results escaped depended on the harness, not the model. This proof of concept points to a practical path: placing agents inside explicit release-control structure can keep released scientific results trustworthy, and it gives more capable agents a measurable baseline to improve on.
papers.comment: 21 pages: 10-page main paper and 11-page supplement; 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把智能体科学工作流的结果发布当作受控决策：在工作流 DAG 外套一层 harness，强制检查、把故障限制在受影响分支、按追踪版本重算、加验证器，并只在风险模型判定无效概率低时放行，语言模型代理只能在 harness 内选择补救动作、不能覆盖它。在 60 个注入故障的成对实例上，验证器全开时放行 0 个无效结果，固定规则不加验证则放行 37 个；风险估计用少 31% 的验证器达到同等安全但产出略降，而语言模型没有可测量的增益。
Motivation: 智能体科学工作流可以跑完却发布错误结果：静默数值错误、过期输入或共享上游步骤的缺陷会污染多个输出，而同级分支仍正确，需要把“信任结果”变成显式的发布决策。
Method: 在工作流 DAG 外围加一个 harness：强制必需检查、把故障限制在受影响分支、按被追踪的版本重算、追加验证器，并由风险模型估计结果无效的概率，只有低风险才放行；语言模型代理在 harness 内选择纠正动作并审查发布，但无权覆盖 harness。实验在 60 个留出的成对实例（两种工作流、注入故障）上开关各组件，逐一检验其贡献。
Result: 在 60 个注入故障的成对实例上：containment 与 recovery 提高正确结果数量；固定规则不加验证放行 37 个无效结果，验证每个候选则放行 0 个；风险估计以少 31% 的验证器达到同等安全，产出略低，但未显示优于随机验证的靶向性；lineage 证据只在其中一种工作流上有帮助；语言模型没有可测量的增益，无效结果是否逃逸取决于 harness 而非模型。
Conclusion: 把代理放进显式的发布控制结构就能守住科学结果的可信度，逃逸与否由 harness 决定而非模型能力；该结构同时给更强的代理提供了一个可度量的改进基线。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SKG: A Law-Induced Engine from Inference to Induction
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes the SKG (Symplectic-Kernel Gradient) reasoning engine for law-induced inference and induction. Laws are a priori; data provide instances. Inference is geometric evolution under law constraints. We organize symplectic geometry, GENERIC, kernel methods, RKHS, group-equivariant networks, and constrained mechanics into a unified, analyzable, implementable, verifiable framework. We propose the SKG octuple S = (M, g, omega, H, S, G, Delta, Pi), whose four components correspond to four levels of laws: conservation laws, constitutive relations, symmetry groups, and axiom systems. Main results: (1) Invariants enter metric construction via the Jacobian: g = J^T Sigma^-1 J + epsilon_G I. For constant cases, we establish inverse reconstruction theory: solvability rank condition (Thm 3.9), consistency criterion (Thm 3.11), and uniqueness theorem (Thm 3.14). (2) The kernel bandwidth matrix is uniquely determined by Fisher information and satisfies task-independence (Thm 3.19). (3) The metric reconstruction error decomposes into four terms (Thm 3.21), with squared condition number kappa(Sigma^*)^2 as the dominant amplification factor (Thm 3.22). (4) For state-dependent cases, we establish function-space reconstruction theory on matrix-valued RKHS (Thms 4.8, 4.9). (5) Three-layer projections handle axiom, symplectic-step, and conservation constraints. (6) The residual equation yields the observable formula, four-dimensional rank condition, and noise propagation, while g_qq is structurally unidentifiable. (7) Kernel parameterization yields the RKHS extrapolation bound (Thm 4.15) and strict OOD gain theorem in group directions (Thm 8.15). (8) The learning-decoupling theorem (Thm 9.1) proves the sole object of induction is the parameters of the task energy. Validation: 1D damped oscillator and 2D rotation-invariant system; 6 unit tests, 10 experiments (paired t-test, p < 0.01).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SKG (Symplectic-Kernel Gradient) 推理引擎，把辛几何、GENERIC、核方法、RKHS、群等变网络与约束力学统一成由先验定律驱动的推断—归纳框架，其核心对象是八元组 S = (M, g, ω, H, S, G, Δ, Π)，四个分量分别对应守恒律、本构关系、对称群、公理系统四层定律。度量经 Jacobian 构造 g = J^T Σ⁻¹ J + ε_G I，核带宽由 Fisher 信息唯一确定且与任务无关，度量重构误差以条件数平方 κ(Σ*)² 为主导放大因子。在 1D 阻尼振子与 2D 旋转不变系统上做 6 项单元测试与 10 组实验（配对 t 检验 p < 0.01）。
Motivation: 把先验定律与数据实例耦合的推断—归纳过程缺少统一、可分析、可验证的几何框架，度量与核参数的重构条件和误差来源也未被系统刻画。
Method: 以辛几何与 GENERIC 为骨架，构造 SKG 八元组 S = (M, g, ω, H, S, G, Δ, Π)；不变量经 Jacobian 进入度量 g = J^T Σ⁻¹ J + ε_G I，常值情形给出可解性秩条件 (Thm 3.9)、相容性判据 (Thm 3.11) 与唯一性定理 (Thm 3.14)，核带宽矩阵由 Fisher 信息确定 (Thm 3.19)；状态相关情形在 matrix-valued RKHS 上建立函数空间重构理论 (Thms 4.8、4.9)，并用三层投影处理公理、辛步长与守恒约束。
Result: 度量重构误差分解为四项 (Thm 3.21)，平方条件数 κ(Σ*)² 为主导放大因子 (Thm 3.22)；残差方程给出可观测公式、四维秩条件与噪声传播，且 g_qq 结构上不可辨识；核参数化导出 RKHS 外推界 (Thm 4.15) 与群方向上的严格 OOD 增益定理 (Thm 8.15)；学习解耦定理 (Thm 9.1) 证明归纳的唯一对象是任务能量的参数。验证为 1D 阻尼振子与 2D 旋转不变系统，含 6 项单元测试与 10 组实验（配对 t 检验 p < 0.01）。
Conclusion: 先验定律可被编码为几何与核结构，使推断成为受定律约束的几何演化，而归纳只需估计任务能量参数；度量重构的可控性由秩条件、相容性与条件数平方共同决定。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Holi-Spatial 360: Generative Reconstruction from Sparse Panoramas for Spatial Rendering and Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Spatial intelligence requires scalable 3D environments that are both photorealistic and semantically grounded, yet existing indoor datasets are dominated by room-scale captures and costly LiDAR acquisition. Online real-estate platforms offer abundant panoramas of diverse multi-room homes, but sparse viewpoints and texture-poor regions make reconstruction severely under-constrained. We introduce Holi-Spatial 360, a generative reconstruction and data curation framework for converting these panoramas into annotated multi-room 3D environments. Because reconstruction quality bounds subsequent generation, our Correspondence-Guided Geometric Optimization converts feed-forward reconstruction priors into reliable cross-view constraints and builds a coherent 3D Gaussian Splatting representation as 3D spatial memory. Adapted single-image and video priors then restore appearance and complete continuous trajectories while preserving observed content. The reconstructed scenes support arbitrary RGB-D rendering and an automated curation pipeline that combines end-to-end 3D grounding with VLM-based verification. Holi360 contains over 1K multi-room 3DGS scenes, more than 100K instance annotations, and 2M spatial question-answer pairs. We also introduce the Holi360 benchmark to evaluate the spatial understanding of VLMs in real-world, multi-room indoor environments. Experiments demonstrate superior reconstruction and curation quality under sparse panoramic inputs, while fine-tuning VLMs on Holi360 substantially improves spatial reasoning capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Holi-Spatial 360 把房产平台的稀疏全景图转成带标注的多房间 3D 环境：用 Correspondence-Guided Geometric Optimization 把前馈重建先验变成跨视角约束，构建 3D Gaussian Splatting 作为空间记忆，再用改造的单图/视频生成先验补全外观与连续轨迹。产出 Holi360 含 1K+ 多房间 3DGS 场景、100K+ 实例标注、2M 空间问答对，并配套 VLM 空间理解 benchmark；在稀疏全景输入下重建与标注质量更优，在 Holi360 上微调 VLM 显著提升空间推理。
Motivation: 现有室内数据集以房间级采集为主且 LiDAR 获取昂贵；房产平台全景虽丰富，但视角稀疏、纹理缺失区域使重建严重欠约束，难以支撑可扩展且语义落地的空间智能训练数据。
Method: 先用 Correspondence-Guided Geometric Optimization 将 feed-forward 重建先验转为可靠跨视角约束，构建一致的 3D Gaussian Splatting 表示作 3D spatial memory；再用改造的单图与视频生成先验恢复外观、补全连续轨迹并保留已观测内容；最后以端到端 3D grounding 结合 VLM-based verification 的自动 curation 管线生成标注，支持任意 RGB-D 渲染。
Result: Holi360 包含超过 1K 个多房间 3DGS 场景、100K 以上实例标注和 2M 空间问答对；实验显示在稀疏全景输入下重建与 curation 质量更优，在 Holi360 上微调 VLM 大幅提升空间推理能力，并提出 Holi360 benchmark 评测 VLM 在真实多房间室内环境的空间理解。
Conclusion: 把重建质量当作下游生成的上界、先用几何优化把生成先验固化为跨视角约束，可以让稀疏房产全景变成可用于训练和评测 VLM 空间推理的大规模多房间 3D 数据。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.result: Holi360 包含超过 1K 个多房间 3DGS 场景、100K 以上实例标注和 2M 空间问答对；实验显示在稀疏全景输入下重建与 curation 质量更优，在 Holi360 上微调 VLM 大幅提升空间推理能力，并提出 Holi360 benchmark 评测 VLM 在真实多房间室内环境的空间理解。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把重建质量当作下游生成的上界、先用几何优化把生成先验固化为跨视角约束，可以让稀疏房产全景变成可用于训练和评测 VLM 空间推理的大规模多房间 3D 数据。

papers.title: What You Sign Is Not What You Run: The Verifiability Gap in Quantized LLM Supply Chains
papers.abstract_en: Model signing authenticates the full-precision weights W an LLM is released with, yet users run a quantized artifact Q whose producing transformation is not uniquely determined under current disclosure. We separate the non-environment inputs from the execution environment E and measure a quantity that, to our knowledge, has not been measured before: the Independent Verifiability Rate (IVR), the fraction of a popularity-sampled GGUF ecosystem that a third party can re-derive bit-for-bit. Across the 200 most-downloaded Hugging Face GGUF repositories (198 in scope), no artifact or model card records the build environment, so under a recorded-inputs protocol the IVR is 0/198. Yet the artifacts are not irreproducible. On four in-sample repositories that disclose their inputs, the card's information alone reproduces no Q4_K_M file, but two coordinates the card omits - the build's floating-point-contraction setting and, for hybrid models, the per-tensor quantization recipe - re-derive 7/8 target-quant files bit-for-bit on x86 (5/8 on arm64); the fp16 re-derives from the provider's checkpoint, but the calibration imatrix must be shipped and hash-bound, since recomputing it did not match. An older release additionally pins the instruction set and did not re-derive. Reproducing the divergence reported with llama.cpp PR #25353, we show that E is a necessary coordinate and that one compiler setting yields a unique output across the tested platforms at negligible quality cost (+0.06% perplexity). As a security characterization, benign floating-point non-determinism separates from uniformly placed nibble-flip tampering above a detection floor that grows with the environments a verifier must allow, but a targeted embedding edit evades the statistic, so the proposed protocol rests on exact re-derivation; adversarial-fp16 attacks lie outside it. We release the audit data and a re-runnable harness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 量化 LLM 供应链中，签名只覆盖全精度权重 W，而用户实际运行的量化产物 Q 的生成变换在现有披露规范下不唯一，导致第三方无法逐位复核。作者定义独立可验证率 (Independent Verifiability Rate, IVR) 并审计 Hugging Face 上下载量最高的 200 个 GGUF 仓库（198 个在范围内），在记录输入协议下 IVR 为 0/198；但补齐模型卡遗漏的两个坐标——浮点收缩 (floating-point contraction) 设置与混合模型的逐张量量化配方——即可在 x86 上逐位重推 7/8 个目标量化文件（arm64 上 5/8）。结论是构建环境 E 是必要坐标，且协议必须依赖精确重推而非统计检测，因为针对性的 embedding 篡改可绕过统计量。
Motivation: 模型签名认证的是随发布的全精度权重，但用户运行的是量化产物，其生成变换在当前披露规范下不唯一，第三方无法独立验证所运行的与所签名的一致。
Method: 把非环境输入与执行环境 E 分离，定义 IVR（第三方可逐位重推的流行度采样 GGUF 生态比例）；对 200 个下载量最高的 Hugging Face GGUF 仓库（198 个在范围内）做审计，对 4 个披露输入的仓库做重推实验，并复现 llama.cpp PR #25353 的分歧。发布审计数据与可重跑 harness。
Result: 198 个在范围仓库中无一在产物或模型卡中记录构建环境，记录输入协议下 IVR 为 0/198。4 个披露输入的仓库中，仅靠模型卡信息无法复现任何 Q4_K_M 文件；补上浮点收缩设置与逐张量量化配方后，x86 上 7/8 目标量化文件逐位重推成功，arm64 上 5/8；fp16 可从提供方 checkpoint 重推，但校准 imatrix 必须随包发布并哈希绑定（重算不匹配）。更早的一个 release 还固定了指令集且未能重推。单一编译器设置在所测平台上产生唯一输出，质量代价可忽略（困惑度 +0.06%）。良性浮点非确定性与均匀放置的 nibble-flip 篡改在检测阈值以上可分，但该阈值随验证者必须允许的环境数增长；针对性的 embedding 编辑可绕过该统计量。
Conclusion: 量化 LLM 的可验证性缺口源于披露缺失而非不可复现：把构建环境坐标（含浮点收缩、逐张量配方、imatrix 哈希绑定）纳入签名范围即可恢复逐位可验证；统计检测不足以替代精确重推。

papers.title: Structure-Preserving Document-Level Data Augmentation via Discourse Parsing
papers.abstract_en: Data augmentation (DA) plays a vital role in improving model performance in low-resource or limited-supervision scenarios within Natural Language Processing (NLP). Existing DA methods, such as synonym replacement and back-translation, have demonstrated effectiveness on the word or sentence level; however, they frequently neglect discourse-level coherence and logical flow, which are essential for complex tasks dependent on inter-sentential relationships. In this paper, we propose a structure-preserving document-level data augmentation framework based on large language models (LLMs) and document-level discourse structure parsing. Our approach identifies rhetorical relations between sentence pairs and extracts key phrases, which are then replaced with semantically coherent but topically shifted content while preserving the original discourse structure. Experimental results on text summarization and question answering show that the proposed augmented data provides complementary supervision and improves combined-data training across the evaluated tasks. Comparisons with a standard RST parser and controlled ablations further support the proposed discourse representation.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Accepted at the 40th Pacific Asia Conference on Language, Information and Computation (PACLIC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 LLM 与篇章话语结构解析的文档级数据增强框架：识别句对间的修辞关系 (rhetorical relations) 并抽取关键短语，替换为主题偏移但语义连贯的内容，同时保留原篇章结构。在文本摘要与问答任务上，增强数据提供互补监督并改善合并数据训练，对比标准 RST parser 与受控消融支持其篇章表示选择。
Motivation: 同义词替换、回译等现有数据增强只在词句级操作，忽略篇章级连贯与逻辑流，难以支撑依赖句间关系的复杂 NLP 任务。
Method: 用 LLM 加文档级篇章结构解析：先识别句对间修辞关系并抽取关键短语，再将短语替换为语义连贯但主题偏移的内容，同时保持原篇章结构不变；与标准 RST parser 对比并做受控消融。
Result: 在文本摘要与问答两个任务上，增强数据提供互补监督并改善合并数据训练；与标准 RST parser 的比较及受控消融进一步支持所提篇章表示。
Conclusion: 保留篇章结构、只做主题偏移的文档级增强能为摘要与问答带来互补监督，篇章表示的选择本身也经消融检验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robota-Embed: Unified VLA Embeddings for Robot In-Context Learning and Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Retrieving useful context for a robot requires matching its task, execution stage, and the continuation that should follow. We introduce Robota-Embed, to our knowledge the first vision-language-action (VLA) embedding model to jointly encode all three modalities in both current-state queries and recorded future continuations. Predictive retrieval training aligns these endpoints, enabling historical continuations to serve as context at inference time. We construct a multi-source corpus of 1,695,684 cleaned training anchors and introduce Robota-Embed-Bench, with 4,000 queries and a shared 8,000-entry gallery. Robota-Embed achieves 47.33% clip-level and 81.77% episode-level R@1, exceeding action-free Gemini Embedding 2 by 22.09 and 33.47 percentage points. Controlled retrieval studies show that removing native action degrades retrieval more than removing vision. We study two complementary applications. Embed2ICL uses retrieved experience for training-free and training-based policy conditioning, increasing success from 47.0% to 56.3% in DROID-Sim and from 86.4% to 92.8% on the LIBERO difficult subset, while improving task progress on real robots. Embed2Evolve uses execution feedback to grow task-local memory and refine context use around a frozen GPT-6 Astra policy. Across five ManiSkill tasks, it achieves 68% success, compared with 24% for GPT-6 Astra Direct and 33% for a harness independently evolved with Omni-Embed-Nemotron-3B under the same protocol. Relative to the latter, it uses approximately 79.5% fewer policy tokens per test rollout, counting both successes and failures. These results show that a unified, action-aware retrieval space can support robot in-context learning and task-local context evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Robota-Embed 是首个联合编码视觉、语言、动作三种模态的 VLA 嵌入模型，用预测式检索训练 (predictive retrieval training) 对齐当前状态查询与历史未来延续，使历史执行片段可直接作为推理时上下文。在自建 Robota-Embed-Bench（4,000 查询、8,000 条 gallery）上 clip 级 R@1 达 47.33%、episode 级 81.77%，比无动作的 Gemini Embedding 2 高 22.09 和 33.47 个百分点；消融显示去掉原生动作比去掉视觉对检索损害更大。
Motivation: 机器人检索上下文需要同时匹配任务、执行阶段和应接续的后续动作，而现有嵌入模型缺少动作模态，无法把历史执行记录当作可检索的上下文用于策略条件化与演化。
Method: 构建 1,695,684 条清洗后训练锚点的多源语料，训练统一 VLA 嵌入模型；提出 Robota-Embed-Bench（4,000 查询、共享 8,000 条 gallery）；下游两个应用：Embed2ICL 用检索经验做免训练与训练式策略条件化，Embed2Evolve 用执行反馈围绕冻结的 GPT-6 Astra 策略增长任务局部记忆并细化上下文使用。
Result: Robota-Embed-Bench 上 clip 级 R@1 47.33%、episode 级 81.77%，超 Gemini Embedding 2 分别 22.09 与 33.47 个百分点；受控检索实验中移除原生动作比移除视觉退化更严重。Embed2ICL 将 DROID-Sim 成功率从 47.0% 提到 56.3%，LIBERO difficult 子集从 86.4% 提到 92.8%，并在真实机器人上提升任务进度。Embed2Evolve 在五个 ManiSkill 任务上达 68% 成功率，对比 GPT-6 Astra Direct 的 24% 与同协议下用 Omni-Embed-Nemotron-3B 独立演化的 harness 的 33%；相对后者每次测试 rollout 的策略 token 消耗少约 79.5%（计入成功与失败）。
Conclusion: 统一且动作感知的检索空间足以同时支撑机器人的 in-context learning 与任务局部上下文演化，动作模态是检索质量的关键来源而非可选项。

papers.title: Robust Real-Time Monocular Human Pose Estimation with Insole-Based Sensor Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Real-time monocular human pose estimation is an important sensing component for human-centered intelligent systems. While recent camera-based methods have achieved impressive accuracy, fundamental challenges persist, particularly when visual observations are incomplete, such as during lower-body occlusion or short out-of-frame intervals. In these challenging but common scenarios, vision-only systems often struggle to reconstruct physically plausible lower-limb motion and reliable foot-ground contact. Due to the highly unobtrusive and wearable nature of smart insoles, this paper investigates whether simple plantar pressure and acceleration sensors can effectively resolve these visually induced limitations. To systematically investigate this, we first collect a synchronized multimodal dataset and then propose a part-decoupled temporal fusion framework. The proposed model fuses foot-sensing features into the lower-body branch to compensate for incomplete visual evidence, while a lightweight coordinator exchanges information between the upper- and lower-body temporal representations to maintain whole-body consistency. The framework is evaluated with three representative real-time visual backbones based on 2D keypoints, 3D landmarks, and SMPL-based human mesh recovery. We evaluate our framework on three representative real-time visual backbones. Quantitative experiments demonstrate that incorporating simple foot sensors consistently improves pose accuracy, motion smoothness, and gait-related measurements over vision-only baselines, with the most significant gains observed under occlusion and short visual-dropout conditions. Ultimately, our results demonstrate that unobtrusive foot sensing provides vital and complementary physical observability when camera observations are temporarily unavailable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在单目实时人体姿态估计中，视觉被遮挡或短暂出画时下肢运动与足地接触难以重建；把智能鞋垫的足底压力与加速度特征注入下肢分支，并用轻量协调器在上下肢时序表征间交换信息，可在视觉缺失条件下持续改善姿态精度、运动平滑度与步态相关测量。
Motivation: 单目视觉在下肢遮挡或短暂出画时无法重建物理上合理的下肢运动与可靠的足地接触，纯视觉系统在这些常见场景中失效。
Method: 先采集同步多模态数据集，再提出部件解耦时序融合框架 (part-decoupled temporal fusion)：将足部传感特征融合进下肢分支以补偿不完整视觉证据，轻量协调器在上、下肢时序表征间交换信息以保持全身一致性；在基于 2D keypoints、3D landmarks 与 SMPL human mesh recovery 的三种实时视觉骨干上评测。
Result: 在三种实时视觉骨干上，加入简单足部传感器相比纯视觉基线一致提升姿态精度、运动平滑度与步态相关测量，增益在遮挡与短暂视觉丢失 (visual-dropout) 条件下最显著。
Conclusion: 非侵入式足部传感在相机观测暂时不可用时提供关键的互补物理可观测性，可作为单目姿态估计的遮挡鲁棒补充。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Digital Self-Interference Cancellation for In-Band Full-Duplex Systems Based on Transformer Neural Operators
papers.abstract_en: Digital-domain self-interference cancellation is essential in in-band full-duplex radios after passive suppression and analog cancellation. It is particularly challenging when the desired signal is strong relative to the residual self-interference. In this regime, conventional iterative digital cancellers update their coefficients from desired-signal-contaminated received samples and may suffer substantial performance degradation. This paper reformulates digital-domain self-interference cancellation as an operator-learning problem. The proposed framework learns the temporal evolution of the residual self-interference channel from historical observations and uses the learned operator together with the known local transmit signal to reconstruct the current residual self-interference. A Transformer neural operator is used to realize this framework. The resulting method is trained in a desired-signal-free setting and then applied in the presence of a desired signal. A continuity-based analysis characterizes the sensitivity of the learned operator to the resulting input perturbation. Numerical experiments in static and time-varying channels, including time-varying SIR conditions, demonstrate stable cancellation performance over a wide range of interference levels. At 30 dB SIR, the proposed method improves the cancellation performance by 5--15 dB over the considered conventional methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把全双工 (in-band full-duplex) 数字域自干扰消除重构为算子学习问题：用 Transformer neural operator 从历史观测学习残余自干扰信道的时间演化，配合已知本地发射信号重建当前残余自干扰，并在无期望信号的条件下训练、有期望信号时部署。静态与时变信道数值实验中，30 dB SIR 下相对所比较的传统方法改善消除性能 5–15 dB。
Motivation: 在期望信号相对残余自干扰较强 (高 SIR) 的体制下，传统迭代数字消除器用被期望信号污染的接收样本更新系数，性能会大幅退化。
Method: 将数字域自干扰消除重构为算子学习：Transformer neural operator 学习残余自干扰信道的时间演化算子，输入历史观测，结合已知本地发射信号重建当前残余自干扰；训练在无期望信号 (desired-signal-free) 设定下完成，再用于有期望信号的场景，并用基于连续性 (continuity) 的分析刻画学习算子对输入扰动的敏感性。
Result: 静态与时变信道（含时变 SIR 条件）的数值实验显示，在很宽的干扰水平范围内消除性能稳定；在 30 dB SIR 下，相对所考虑的传统方法改善 5–15 dB。
Conclusion: 把数字自干扰消除当作可从历史观测学习的信道演化算子，可在期望信号污染样本的高 SIR 场景下保持稳定消除，且训练与部署条件可以解耦。

papers.title: State-Matched Sequence Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Sequential conformal prediction needs to decide which past errors should calibrate uncertainty for the current target. Recency and online error feedback are useful when recent observations remain relevant, but the recent past can be a poor reference when comparable states recur at nonadjacent times, with the recurrence pattern generally unknown. We propose State-Matched Sequence Conformal Prediction (SMSCP), which constructs an explicit one-sided local-linear state from pre-target information, uses state similarity to select a matched reference set of past calibration scores, and then applies the ordinary unweighted conformal order statistic. In contrast to existing approaches, SMSCP uses state similarity to identify calibration observations relevant to the target score quantile. This motivates a theoretical analysis of whether nearby states have comparable target score quantiles under temporal dependence. We establish control of the resulting conformal cutoff and characterize predictive information not captured by the chosen state. Simulations show that state matching is most effective when score-relevant states recur across nonadjacent times, while revealing settings in which its advantage weakens or reverses. Across solar irradiance and bike-demand benchmarks, SMSCP improves interval score over recency, weighted, adaptive, and HopCPT comparators, and achieves coverage closer to the nominal 0.90 level than ResCP on five of six benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 State-Matched Sequence Conformal Prediction (SMSCP)：用目标前信息构造显式单边局部线性状态，按状态相似度挑选匹配的历史校准分数集，再套用普通未加权 conformal order statistic。在太阳辐照与共享单车需求基准上，区间分数优于 recency、weighted、adaptive、HopCPT 等比较对象，且在六个基准中的五个上覆盖率比 ResCP 更接近名义 0.90。
Motivation: 序列 conformal prediction 要决定哪些历史误差用于当前目标的不确定性校准；recency 与在线误差反馈假设近期观测仍相关，但当可比状态在非相邻时刻复现时，近期历史是差参照，而复现模式通常未知。
Method: SMSCP 从目标前信息构造显式单边局部线性状态 (one-sided local-linear state)，用状态相似度选取匹配的参考集（matched reference set）承载历史校准分数，再施加普通未加权 conformal order statistic；配套给出时间依赖下邻近状态是否具有可比目标分数分位数的理论分析，刻画 cutoff 控制与状态未捕获的预测信息。
Result: 模拟显示状态匹配在分数相关状态跨非相邻时刻复现时最有效，也揭示其优势减弱或反转的设置；在 solar irradiance 与 bike-demand 基准上，SMSCP 的 interval score 优于 recency、weighted、adaptive 与 HopCPT 比较对象，并在六个基准中的五个上取得比 ResCP 更接近名义 0.90 的覆盖率。
Conclusion: 按状态相似度而非时间邻近来选校准参照，能在状态复现的序列数据上给出更相关、覆盖率更贴近名义水平的区间；其优势依赖于分数相关状态的复现结构，在优势减弱或反转的设置下不成立。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: IMU-Bench: Benchmarking Wrist IMU Representations Across Kinematic, Semantic and Clinical Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Wrist-worn inertial measurement units (IMUs) provide a common sensing modality for tasks ranging from activity and gesture recognition to pose estimation, inertial odometry and clinical motor assessment. Existing wearable benchmarks evaluate performance across multiple tasks, but leave open how supervision for one task affects transfer to others and whether these tasks benefit from a shared representation. We present IMU-Bench, a benchmark of ten tasks from eight datasets for studying IMU multi-task performance and cross-task transfer. We compare six self-supervised methods pretrained on unlabeled recorded and simulated wrist motion, evaluating classification, pose and velocity estimation, and IMU-language retrieval. We find that our masked autoencoder, InrtlWrist, achieves the best or joint-best frozen-probe performance on nine of ten tasks, and fine-tuning improves on training from scratch on nine of ten tasks, including full-body pose, odometry and retrieval. Across transfer and joint-training experiments, supervision that benefits one target can reduce performance on others, with supervised sources transferring within kinematic estimation while, under frozen probing, none approaches the pretrained encoder on language retrieval, and joint-training gains that come at a cost to the paired task. These findings distinguish broad downstream usefulness from complementary task supervision. Code, task cards and a leaderboard are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IMU-Bench 用 8 个数据集的 10 项任务统一评测腕部 IMU 表征的多任务与跨任务迁移，比较 6 种自监督预训练方法。其 masked autoencoder InrtlWrist 在 10 项任务中的 9 项上取得冻结探针最优或并列最优，微调也在 9 项任务上超过从零训练；但迁移实验显示，惠及一个目标的监督可能损害另一个任务，冻结探针下没有任何监督源能在语言检索上接近预训练编码器。
Motivation: 现有可穿戴基准只分别报告各任务性能，无法回答单任务监督如何影响其他任务迁移，以及这些任务是否真的受益于共享表征。
Method: 构建含 8 个数据集、10 项任务的 IMU-Bench，覆盖分类、位姿与速度估计、IMU-语言检索；在无标签的真实与模拟腕部运动上预训练 6 种自监督方法，用冻结探针与微调两种协议评测，并做跨任务迁移与联合训练实验。
Result: InrtlWrist 在 10 项任务中的 9 项上取得最优或并列最优的冻结探针性能；微调在 9 项任务上优于从零训练，涵盖全身位姿、里程计与检索。迁移与联合训练中，惠及一个目标的监督会降低其他任务表现：监督源在运动学估计内部可迁移，但冻结探针下无一接近预训练编码器的语言检索水平，联合训练的增益以配对任务受损为代价。
Conclusion: 广泛的下游可用性与互补的任务监督是两回事：共享表征能带来跨任务收益，但任务间监督并不天然互补，联合训练需接受配对任务的性能代价。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: ActICL: Post-Training for Agentic Multimodal In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal in-context learning (ICL) is an important capability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Its performance is closely tied to the demonstrations it uses, making demonstration retrieval a core problem for ICL. Common methods use fixed scoring methods to retrieve all the demonstrations at once, which may introduce redundancy and noise. Context-aware retrieval methods have emerged to address this problem by allowing incremental retrieval from a growing context. However, none of them lets the MLLM learn how to judge what new demonstrations it needs and then carry out progressive retrieval on its own. To this end, we introduce ActICL, which trains an MLLM agent to acquire and use an ICL context via tool-augmented reasoning. An ActICL agent analyzes its own information gaps during iterative reasoning and tool-use actions. Based on these gaps, it performs targeted retrieval to acquire a set of initial candidates. It can then use the existing context to further filter the candidates and refine the context, or it can iteratively perform a new retrieval. When the agent judges that the context is sufficient for the task, or when the resource limit is reached with the user request met, it sends the acquired context to an answering model, either the agent itself or another MLLM. We use a two-stage post-training procedure that jointly optimizes the agent's acquisition and answering. With an adaptive number of demonstrations, ActICL improves average performance by 11.6 percentage points over standard similarity-based retrieval across seven benchmarks and three MLLMs, and by 4.4 points compared to the strongest prior baseline. The contexts acquired by ActICL agents can also be used effectively by frontier models. When GPT-5.6-Sol performs 4-shot ICL, ActICL's contexts improve its performance by 3.5 points over standard retrieval, averaged over three benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ActICL 把多模态 ICL 的示例检索做成 MLLM agent 的工具增强推理：agent 自查信息缺口、按缺口定向检索并用已有上下文过滤精炼，判定上下文充分后交给答题模型，两阶段后训练联合优化获取与答题。在七个基准、三个 MLLM 上，自适应示例数使平均性能比标准相似度检索高 11.6 个百分点，比最强先前基线高 4.4 点；其上下文给 GPT-5.6-Sol 做 4-shot ICL 也比标准检索高 3.5 点。
Motivation: 多模态 ICL 性能高度依赖示例选择，固定打分一次性取全部示例会引入冗余与噪声；已有 context-aware 增量检索仍不能让 MLLM 自己判断缺什么示例并自主渐进检索。
Method: 训练一个通过工具增强推理获取 ICL 上下文的 MLLM agent：迭代推理中分析自身信息缺口，据此定向检索初始候选，再用现有上下文过滤、精炼或重新检索，判定上下文充分（或资源上限内满足用户请求）后把上下文交给答题模型（agent 自身或另一 MLLM）；采用两阶段后训练联合优化获取与答题。
Result: 在七个基准、三个 MLLM 上，ActICL 以自适应示例数比标准相似度检索平均提升 11.6 个百分点，比最强先前基线高 4.4 点；其获取的上下文迁移到前沿模型时，GPT-5.6-Sol 做 4-shot ICL 在三个基准上平均比标准检索高 3.5 点。
Conclusion: 让 MLLM agent 自主判断信息缺口并渐进检索示例，比一次性相似度检索更有效，且学到的上下文可直接被前沿模型复用。

papers.title: Beyond Retrieval: Evidence Access and Event Aggregation in Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Questions about an agent's history often require aggregating events, which retrieval alone does not resolve. We combine source-preserving evidence access with executable aggregation. Trajectory Memory (TM) retains the original trajectory and constructs a source-addressable reading view at question time. TallyMem augments it with a reusable event ledger, model-generated event specifications and deterministic execution. With a commit-specific adaptation on 776 questions from 99 held-out MINTEval repositories, TallyMem raises Qwen3-32B exact match from 35.2% to 49.0%, a 13.8-point gain over TM; gains span 12.8-13.9 points across three readers. A controlled probe with event sets parsed independently from raw logs shows an 11.0-point gain, from 82.8% to 93.8%, without routing. On full AMA-Bench, the routed system yields a smaller 1.3-point gain, from 69.8% to 71.1%. These results support executable aggregation on tasks that require combining events, with benefits dependent on the task and event specification, the largest residual system-error category in our diagnostic analysis.

papers.title: MemCode: Discrete Semantic Representations for Long-Term Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory remains a fundamental bottleneck for large language model (LLM) agents across sessions. Existing systems typically adopt a write-then-retrieve paradigm, storing context-dependent dialogue fragments and retrieving them via nearest-neighbor search in a continuous embedding space. This design yields unstable access units and systematically misses logically related but lexically distant evidence. We propose MemCode, a long-term agent memory framework that couples retrieval-oriented writing with discrete associative retrieval. MemCode rewrites dialogue into self-contained atomic memory units (AMUs), maps AMUs into a learnable codebook with isomorphic semantic quantization (ISQ), and uses codebook co-occurrence topology as a retrieval path complementary to vector search. For long-term memory stores, MemCode separates online atomic writes from asynchronous offline consolidation. On LongMemEval-S and LoCoMo with GPT-4o-mini and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 backbones, MemCode achieves the best overall accuracy while keeping per-dialogue memory construction within roughly 40~130 seconds, making it 3~21 times faster than LightMem and over an order of magnitude faster than A-MEM and MemoryOS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemCode 把跨会话 LLM agent 记忆改写为自包含原子记忆单元 (AMU)，用同构语义量化 (ISQ) 映射到可学习 codebook，并以 codebook 共现拓扑作为向量检索之外的第二条检索路径。在 LongMemEval-S 与 LoCoMo 上取得最佳总体准确率，同时单条对话记忆构建耗时约 40~130 秒，比 LightMem 快 3~21 倍。
Motivation: 现有 write-then-retrieve 记忆系统存的是依赖上下文的对话片段，靠连续嵌入最近邻检索，访问单元不稳定，且系统性漏掉词面相距远但逻辑相关的证据。
Method: 把对话重写为自包含 AMU，经 ISQ 量化进可学习 codebook，用 codebook 共现拓扑补足向量检索；长期记忆存储上把在线原子写入与异步离线整合 (offline consolidation) 分开。
Result: 在 LongMemEval-S 和 LoCoMo 上、以 GPT-4o-mini 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 为 backbone，MemCode 取得最佳总体准确率；每条对话记忆构建耗时约 40~130 秒，比 LightMem 快 3~21 倍，比 A-MEM 与 MemoryOS 快一个数量级以上。
Conclusion: 离散语义记忆单元加共现拓扑检索能在保持最高总体准确率的同时把记忆构建成本压到分钟级，写入与离线整合分离是可行的长期记忆架构。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DeBoneDiT: Depth-Driven Conditional Bridge Diffusion Transformers for Bone Suppression in Chest X-Ray Images
papers.abstract_en: Chest X-Ray (CXR) is a primary modality for diagnosing pulmonary diseases, yet the overlap of bony structures often obscures critical radiographic findings, increasing the risk of diagnostic uncertainty. While Dual-Energy Subtraction (DES) is the clinical benchmark for bone suppression, its widespread adoption is primarily hindered by specialized hardware requirements and increased radiation exposure. Recently, diffusion-based generative models have shown promise for this task, yet they are still constrained by reconstruction-biased latent compression, prior-induced domain gap, and a scarcity of high-quality paired datasets. To address these challenges, we propose DeBoneDiT, a depth-driven conditional bridge diffusion Transformer architecture for efficient high-resolution bone suppression. We first introduce Depth Auto-Encoder (DAE), a structure-aware vision tokenizer for latent compression. By incorporating a multi-level depth feature loss derived from the pretrained Depth Anything V2 encoder, DAE preserves both visual fidelity and structural consistency. Second, we formulate bone suppression as a source-conditioned Brownian bridge diffusion process, leveraging CXRs as both the diffusion prior and structural guidance to narrow the source-to-target domain gap and maintain anatomical plausibility. Furthermore, we have constructed and released SZCH-X-Rays, the largest publicly available high-quality paired dataset for bone suppression to date, comprising 741 pairs of CXR and DES soft tissue images. Extensive experiments and downstream evaluation demonstrate that DeBoneDiT achieves superior bone suppression performance with reduced computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeBoneDiT 用深度驱动的条件桥式扩散 Transformer 做胸片骨抑制：结构感知的 Depth Auto-Encoder (DAE) 以 Depth Anything V2 的多级深度特征损失同时保住视觉保真与结构一致，骨抑制被建模为以 CXR 为先验与结构引导的源条件 Brownian bridge 扩散过程，缩小源到目标的域差距。作者构建并开源 SZCH-X-Rays，含 741 对 CXR 与 DES 软组织图像，是目前最大的公开骨抑制配对数据集；实验显示其骨抑制性能更优且计算开销更低。
Motivation: 胸片中骨骼结构重叠会遮蔽关键影像发现，临床基准双能减影 (DES) 依赖专用硬件且增加辐射暴露；现有扩散方法受重建偏置的潜空间压缩、先验引入的域差距以及高质量配对数据稀缺所限。
Method: 提出 DeBoneDiT：一是 Depth Auto-Encoder (DAE)，结构感知的 vision tokenizer，用预训练 Depth Anything V2 编码器导出的多级深度特征损失做潜空间压缩；二是把骨抑制表述为源条件 Brownian bridge 扩散过程，以 CXR 同时充当扩散先验与结构引导；并构建公开配对数据集 SZCH-X-Rays。
Result: 构建并发布 SZCH-X-Rays，含 741 对 CXR 与 DES 软组织图像，为迄今最大的公开高质量骨抑制配对数据集；摘要称大量实验与下游评估显示 DeBoneDiT 骨抑制性能更优且计算开销更低。
Conclusion: 以深度结构损失约束的 tokenizer 加 Brownian bridge 条件扩散，可在不依赖 DES 硬件的前提下实现高效高分辨率骨抑制，并把配对数据集公开以缓解数据稀缺。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PFedMA: Who Should Join Next as Federated Multi-Agent Orchestration Evolves?
papers.abstract_en: Federated Multi-Agent Systems (FedMAS) offer a promising paradigm for collaborative reasoning among LLM-based agents while keeping raw client data decentralized. However, reliable multi-round collaboration remains challenging. Agent selection must take into consideration evolving task requirements and the agent's historical reliability, while privacy rules must adapt to changing collaboration contexts and meet the client's personalized needs. To address these challenges, we propose PFedMA, a federated multi-agent framework for feedback driven multi-round collaboration under heterogeneous privacy requirements. Across rounds, PFedMA maintains historical capability and reliability states to guide agent selection, evaluates task responses before aggregation, and refines subsequent queries according to accumulated collaboration feedback. PFedMA enables bidirectional local to global and global to local private rule evolution across heterogeneous clients. Clients generalize locally updated privacy rules and selectively incorporate globally maintained rules, thereby facilitating cross-client privacy rule evolution while preserving personalized constraints. Extensive experiments across reasoning, privacy sensitive, and adversarial settings show that PFedMA improves task performance, reduces measured privacy leakage, and improves system robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PFedMA 是面向 LLM 多智能体联邦系统 (FedMAS) 的多轮协作框架：跨轮维护智能体能力与可靠性状态来指导选择，聚合前评估任务响应，并依据累积反馈改写后续查询；隐私规则在客户端与全局之间双向演化。在推理、隐私敏感与对抗三类设置的实验中，它提升任务性能、降低实测隐私泄露并增强系统鲁棒性。
Motivation: FedMAS 中多轮协作不可靠：智能体选择未考虑任务需求演化与历史可靠性，隐私规则无法随协作上下文变化并兼顾客户端个性化需求。
Method: PFedMA 跨轮维护历史能力与可靠性状态驱动智能体选择，聚合前评估任务响应，并按累积协作反馈细化后续查询；隐私规则支持 local-to-global 与 global-to-local 双向演化，客户端本地泛化规则并选择性纳入全局规则。
Result: 在推理、隐私敏感与对抗三类实验设置下，PFedMA 提升任务性能、降低实测隐私泄露、改善系统鲁棒性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把历史可靠性状态与反馈驱动的查询细化引入智能体选择，配合双向隐私规则演化，可在异构隐私约束下同时改善 FedMAS 的性能、隐私与鲁棒性。

papers.title: MIPS: Mitigating Mode Collapse in Reinforcement Learning for Large Outcome Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Expected-reward maximization in reinforcement learning concentrates probability mass on a few outcomes, even in tasks that require many distinct, high-quality solutions, a failure known as mode collapse. Inverse Probability Scaling (IPS) counters this in group-based policy gradients such as GRPO by dividing each reward by the outcome's probability, estimated from its frequency within the sampled group. When the outcome space is large relative to the group, outcomes rarely repeat and these estimates become uninformative. Since an outcome can be constructed along many trajectories, its probability is a sum over all of them, and computing it directly is intractable. We propose Marginal IPS (MIPS), which performs marginal evaluation by combining the sampled trajectory with a learned model of the trajectories that lead to each outcome. On Hypergrids, where the exact sampling distribution is computable, MIPS stays near the reward-distribution target as the outcome space grows relative to the rollout group, while frequency-based IPS degrades. In molecular synthesis and phylogenetic inference, MIPS sustains diverse, high-quality sampling where GRPO and frequency-based IPS collapse, showing that MIPS serves as a reliable solution to mode collapse in RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对大结果空间下强化学习的模式坍缩 (mode collapse)，提出 Marginal IPS (MIPS)：用学到的「哪些轨迹导向该结果」模型对轨迹做边际化，替代按组内频次估计结果概率的 IPS。在可精确计算采样分布的 Hypergrids 上，结果空间相对 rollout 组增大时 MIPS 仍贴近奖励分布目标而频次 IPS 退化；在分子合成与系统发育推断上，GRPO 与频次 IPS 坍缩时 MIPS 维持多样且高质量的采样。
Motivation: 期望奖励最大化会把概率质量压到少数结果上；组策略梯度 (GRPO) 用 IPS 除以结果概率来对抗，但结果空间相对组过大时结果几乎不重复，频次估计失效，而结果概率是所有导向轨迹之和、直接计算不可行。
Method: MIPS 做边际评估：把采样到的轨迹与一个学习到的「导向各结果的轨迹」模型结合，从而估计结果的边缘概率，替代 IPS 中基于组内频次的概率估计；嵌入 group-based policy gradient（如 GRPO）的奖励缩放中。
Result: 在采样分布可精确计算的 Hypergrids 上，结果空间相对 rollout 组增长时 MIPS 保持接近奖励分布目标，频次 IPS 退化；在分子合成与系统发育推断任务上，GRPO 与频次 IPS 出现模式坍缩，而 MIPS 维持多样、高质量采样。
Conclusion: 作者主张 MIPS 是 RL 模式坍缩的可靠解法：结果概率必须按轨迹边际化而非按组内频次估计，才能在大结果空间下保住多样性。
