papers.title: One-Step Prediction Fidelity Is a Poor Proxy for Planning Performance in JEPA World Models
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models are routinely selected, checkpointed and ablated on one-step prediction loss, on the assumption that a model which predicts the next latent better is a better model. In model-based RL this assumption is known to be unreliable; we ask whether it also fails for latent world models, where the training target is the model's own embedding and the loss is not expressed in interpretable units. We introduce a frozen-decoder protocol reporting one-step error in physical units, decomposed into the part already present in the encoder's representation and the part the predictor adds. Applying it to a recent end-to-end JEPA world model across three continuous-control environments, we move the metric by fine-tuning and measure goal-conditioned planning on the same checkpoints, with three training seeds and paired planning seeds throughout. Within one environment, a per-epoch ladder shows the relationship saturating after a single epoch: the first epoch improves fidelity by 32% and planning by 4.4 pp, but across the fifteen checkpoints that follow -- a further 15% fidelity improvement, monotone in every training seed -- the correlation between one-step error and planning success is r = -0.010. This is not a task-ceiling artifact: stratifying by a model-independent measure of training-data support, planning in the lowest-support stratum starts at 80%, leaving ample headroom, and is nonetheless flat from epoch 1 onward. Across environments the exchange rate is equally unstable: a 93% fidelity reduction on TwoRoom yields -0.7 pp of planning, while a 40% reduction on PushT yields +4.9 pp [+1.1, +8.9]. All results replicate under a decoder-free measure, latent drift. We also show that a matched continued-training control absorbs the entire fidelity gain we had attributed to an auxiliary objective.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on World Models in Physical AI (WM-PAI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文质疑用一步预测损失挑选 JEPA 世界模型的做法：提出 frozen-decoder 协议，把一步误差换算成物理单位并拆成编码器已有误差与预测器新增误差，再在同一 checkpoint 上测目标条件规划。首个 epoch 使保真度提升 32%、规划提升 4.4 个百分点，但其后 15 个 checkpoint 再获 15% 保真度提升时，一步误差与规划成功率相关仅 r = -0.010；TwoRoom 上 93% 的保真度下降反而对应 -0.7 pp 规划，PushT 上 40% 下降对应 +4.9 pp [+1.1, +8.9]。结论是一步预测保真度不能作为规划性能的代理指标。
Motivation: latent world model 的训练目标是模型自身 embedding，损失不在可解释单位里，业界仍默认一步预测更好的模型就是更好的模型；该假设在 model-based RL 中已知不可靠，作者要检验它在 JEPA 类世界模型上是否同样失效。
Method: 提出 frozen-decoder 协议：用冻结解码器把一步误差报成物理单位，并分解为编码器表示中已存在的部分与预测器新增的部分；在一个近期端到端 JEPA 世界模型上跨三个连续控制环境，用微调移动该指标，在同一批 checkpoint 上测 goal-conditioned planning，全程使用三个训练种子与配对 planning 种子，并按模型无关的训练数据支撑度分层，另用 decoder-free 的 latent drift 复核。
Result: 单环境逐 epoch 阶梯显示关系在 1 个 epoch 后饱和：首个 epoch 保真度提升 32%、规划提升 4.4 pp；其后 15 个 checkpoint 再提升 15% 保真度（每个训练种子上单调），一步误差与规划成功率相关 r = -0.010。最低支撑度分层规划起点为 80%、仍有余量，却从 epoch 1 起持平。跨环境兑换率不稳：TwoRoom 保真度下降 93% 对应规划 -0.7 pp，PushT 下降 40% 对应 +4.9 pp [+1.1, +8.9]。全部结果在 latent drift 下复现；匹配的 continued-training 对照吸收了原本归于某辅助目标的全部保真度增益。
Conclusion: 一步预测保真度最多在第一个 epoch 内与规划相关，之后即与规划脱钩，因此不应再用它挑选或 checkpoint 世界模型；此前归因于辅助目标的保真度收益可由匹配的继续训练完全解释。

papers.title: Evaluating Compressed Memory: Dependence, Utility, and Content Benefit
papers.abstract_en: Does a language model answer better because its compressed memory contains useful document information? Replacing memory vectors with zeros can lower a trained model's score without showing that it outperforms a model trained without memory. We combine zeroing with separately trained models that cannot access stored text or receive the same constant input for every document. Across nine systems, some models rely on memory yet perform worse than the trained alternative. For example, in experiments that predict states in generated stories, zeroing memory worsens a model's prediction loss, yet a model trained without memory achieves lower loss than the original model with intact memory. On TriviaQA, giving xRAG memory from another question's passage raises F1, which measures word overlap with accepted answers, from 19.38 without a document to 24.78. Its effect on how often outputs contain an accepted answer is statistically uncertain. The question's retrieved passage scores higher still (29.88 F1). Thus a gain over no document alone does not establish that the gain requires the question's passage. Evaluations must therefore specify the comparison model, absolute performance, and generation and scoring conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文检验压缩记忆 (compressed memory) 是否真的因携带文档信息而提升语言模型表现：把记忆向量置零会降低已训练模型的分数，但这不等于优于一个从不访问存储文本、或对每篇文档都收到同一常量输入的独立训练模型。九个系统中存在依赖记忆却更差的情况；TriviaQA 上 xRAG 换用另一问题的 passage 仍把 F1 从 19.38（无文档）抬到 24.78，说明相对无文档的增益不能证明增益来自该问题自己的 passage。作者要求评测必须写明比较对象、绝对性能以及生成与打分条件。
Motivation: 置零记忆只能说明模型依赖记忆，无法区分增益来自文档内容还是记忆机制本身；现有评测常把相对无文档的提升误当作内容有效性的证据。
Method: 把置零消融与两类独立训练的对照模型结合：一类无法访问存储文本，另一类对每篇文档接收相同常量输入；跨九个系统比较，并在生成故事的状态预测任务与 TriviaQA 上用 F1（与标准答案的词重叠）及答案出现率的统计显著性共同衡量。
Result: 九个系统中部分模型依赖记忆却比训练出的替代模型更差；故事状态预测中置零记忆使预测损失升高，而无记忆训练的模型损失低于记忆完整的原模型。TriviaQA 上 xRAG 使用另一问题的 passage 时 F1 从 19.38（无文档）升至 24.78，该问题自己的 passage 得分更高为 29.88；输出包含标准答案的频率其效应在统计上不确定。
Conclusion: 相对无文档的增益不足以证明增益需要该问题的 passage，压缩记忆评测必须同时报告比较模型、绝对性能和生成与打分条件。

papers.title: Policy-Verified Self-Training: Learning Agent Compliance from Verifiable Policy Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Runtime policy verifiers can prevent agents from executing disallowed actions, but their decisions are typically used only for enforcement and discarded afterward. We ask whether these decisions can instead become verifiable policy rewards for training the agents they guard. We introduce Policy-Verified Self-Training (PVST), a post-training paradigm in which an agent generates its own interaction trajectories and an executable policy verifier, here a deterministic gate compiled from a written policy, evaluates whether each action complies. Compliant trajectories are reinforced, and violations become negatives for preference optimization; beyond the gate and the benchmark's task-success signal, PVST needs no stronger teacher model, no human preference labels and no attack-specific supervision, although rollouts are collected in the benchmark's attacked environment. On held-out AgentDojo tasks under prompt injection, policy-verified preference training of Qwen3-8B reduces violating trajectories from 37.2% to 10.3 $\pm$ 0.9% (three seeds) and successful attacks from 12.4% to 0.5% at equal or higher pooled task utility, although utility falls on travel, compared with 22.0% when negatives are selected by an attack oracle and 31.9 $\pm$ 0.9% with negatives that contain no violation. The learned behavior holds under an attack template never used in training (37.7% to 11.0%) and on a suite excluded from training (34.8% to 16.7%), and the retained verifier's intervention rate falls from 39.2% to 8.8% (seed 0). Our analysis identifies two conditions under which the verdict is most informative: success must not already imply compliance, and guarded actions must appear in both permitted and forbidden contexts.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 13 tables. Companion paper: arXiv:2610.11030
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把运行时策略验证器 (runtime policy verifier) 的判定当作可验证策略奖励，用它对智能体自身轨迹做偏好优化后训练：在 AgentDojo 提示注入场景下，Qwen3-8B 的违规轨迹从 37.2% 降到 10.3±0.9%（三个种子），成功攻击从 12.4% 降到 0.5%，且总体任务效用持平或更高（travel 任务除外）。验证器介入率从 39.2% 降至 8.8%，说明合规行为可由门控判定本身学出，无需更强教师、人工偏好标签或攻击特定监督。
Motivation: 运行时策略验证器的判定目前只用于拦截、事后即丢弃；而训练受守卫智能体通常需要更强教师模型、人工偏好标注或攻击特定监督，成本高且与部署时已有资源脱节。
Method: 提出 Policy-Verified Self-Training (PVST)：智能体在基准的受攻击环境中自行生成交互轨迹，由从书面策略编译出的确定性门控（executable policy verifier）逐动作判定合规性；合规轨迹被强化，违规轨迹作为负样本进入偏好优化，除门控与基准任务成功信号外不引入其他监督，对 Qwen3-8B 做后训练。
Result: 在 held-out AgentDojo 提示注入任务上，违规轨迹 37.2% → 10.3±0.9%（三个种子），成功攻击 12.4% → 0.5%，pooled 任务效用持平或更高但 travel 任务效用下降；对照组为攻击 oracle 选负样本时 22.0%、负样本不含违规时 31.9±0.9%。泛化到训练未用的攻击模板 37.7% → 11.0%，训练排除的套件 34.8% → 16.7%；保留的验证器介入率 39.2% → 8.8%（seed 0）。
Conclusion: 验证器判定在两个条件下最有信息量：任务成功本身不蕴含合规，且受守卫动作同时出现在允许与禁止语境中；据此，把已有运行时门控转成偏好优化的负样本来源即可在不加教师与人工标注的情况下学到合规行为。

papers.title: The Impact of Detector Architecture, Model Scale, and Scene Density on Multi-Pedestrian Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Pedestrian tracking in video is important for applications such as surveillance and scene analysis, but it becomes more challenging in crowded scenarios with frequent occlusions and rapid motion. This paper analyzes how detector architecture, model scale, scene density, and inference regime affect the tracking of multiple pedestrians. We compare the YOLO11, RT-DETR, and YOLO26 detector families with the ByteTrack and BoT-SORT trackers on sequences from the MOT17, MOT20, and SOMPT22 benchmarks. For YOLO26, we also compare traditional overlap filtering via Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) with end-to-end inference. The RT-DETR family achieved the highest mean scores on the HOTA tracking quality metric across all three benchmarks with both trackers, with a more pronounced advantage on MOT20, albeit at a higher computational cost. On MOT17 and SOMPT22, YOLO26 variants, especially YOLO26-L with NMS, offered favorable combinations of quality and speed compared with RT-DETR. In the YOLO26 inference comparison, the end-to-end mode did not yield consistent tracking gains over the NMS-based regime. Taken together, these results provide a practical guide for selecting detectors and trackers for this task based on application priorities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 MOT17、MOT20、SOMPT22 上系统比较 YOLO11、RT-DETR、YOLO26 检测器与 ByteTrack、BoT-SORT 跟踪器，RT-DETR 家族在三个基准上以两种跟踪器均取得最高 HOTA 平均分，且在人群最密的 MOT20 优势更明显，但计算代价更高；YOLO26-L 配 NMS 在 MOT17 与 SOMPT22 上给出质量与速度的较好折中，YOLO26 端到端推理相对 NMS 未带来一致跟踪增益。
Motivation: 多行人跟踪在密集遮挡与快速运动下退化，而检测器架构、模型规模、场景密度与推理方式如何共同影响跟踪质量缺少横向对照，选型只能靠零散经验。
Method: 在 MOT17、MOT20、SOMPT22 三个基准上，用 ByteTrack 与 BoT-SORT 两种跟踪器分别搭配 YOLO11、RT-DETR、YOLO26 三个检测器家族做对比；对 YOLO26 额外比较传统 NMS 重叠过滤与端到端推理两种推理方式，以 HOTA 作为跟踪质量指标并同时考察计算代价。
Result: RT-DETR 家族在全部三个基准、两种跟踪器下均取得最高 HOTA 平均分，在 MOT20 上优势更突出但计算代价更高；MOT17 与 SOMPT22 上 YOLO26 变体（尤其 YOLO26-L 配 NMS）在质量与速度上给出更优组合；YOLO26 端到端模式相对 NMS 未产生一致的跟踪增益。
Conclusion: 检测器选型应按应用优先级权衡：要最高跟踪质量选 RT-DETR（尤其密集场景），要速度与质量折中选 YOLO26-L 配 NMS，端到端推理在该任务上尚不能替代 NMS。

papers.title: Beyond Corrected Actions: Training LLM Agents on Textual Critiques
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for multi-turn agentic tasks that require interactions with users and environments over extended sequences of actions. A common approach to improving LLM agents is to use more capable expert models to provide training supervision, either by behavior cloning the expert's trajectories or by using the expert to correct the actions in trajectories generated by the weaker student model. However, expert LLMs can provide richer supervision than actions alone: they can directly generate textual critique that explain why specific actions are incorrect. We study whether training on such feedback benefits LLM agents and propose Critique-Augmented Agentic Fine-Tuning (CAFT), a framework that elicits textual expert feedback on student-generated trajectories. For each incorrect action, the expert yields both a corrected action and a textual critique explaining the student's mistake--which we then use as the training target for fine-tuning. Across four student models from the Nemotron 3 and Gemma 4 families on the agentic domains $τ^2$-Bench Airline+Retail and WebShop, adding critiques to action-level supervision improves performance by 8% on average over action-only distillation. Additionally, CAFT checkpoints can also provide a better warm start for reinforcement learning than expert-trajectory distillation. Our results demonstrate that textual critiques can strengthen supervision for multi-turn LLM agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Critique-Augmented Agentic Fine-Tuning (CAFT)：专家模型对学生产出的轨迹中每个错误动作同时给出纠正动作和解释错因的文本批评，二者一起作为微调目标。在 Nemotron 3 与 Gemma 4 系列四个学生模型、τ²-Bench Airline+Retail 与 WebShop 上，加入批评比仅动作蒸馏平均提升 8%，且 CAFT 检查点作为强化学习热启动优于专家轨迹蒸馏。
Motivation: 用专家模型改进 LLM agent 的常见做法只有行为克隆专家轨迹或纠正学生动作，监督信号停留在动作层面，丢掉了专家能说明“为什么错”的文本信息。
Method: CAFT 框架先让学生模型生成轨迹，再让专家模型对每个错误动作产出纠正动作与解释性文本批评，将两者拼成训练目标做微调；评测覆盖 Nemotron 3 与 Gemma 4 家族的四个学生模型，任务域为 τ²-Bench Airline+Retail 和 WebShop。
Result: 在四个学生模型与 τ²-Bench Airline+Retail、WebShop 上，动作级监督加文本批评相比仅动作蒸馏平均提升 8%；CAFT 检查点作为 RL 热启动优于专家轨迹蒸馏。
Conclusion: 文本批评是比单纯纠正动作更强的多轮 agent 监督信号，既能直接抬高微调性能，也能提供更好的强化学习起点。

papers.title: Seeing, Maintaining, and Learning: The Evolution of Multimodal Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal models and agents have emerged to enable AI systems to learn from and interact with the real world more like humans by integrating information across multiple modalities. However, enabling multimodal agents to continually acquire useful information from complex, heterogeneous multimodal data remains a significant challenge as they move toward long-horizon tasks and lifelong settings. Addressing this challenge requires effective memory mechanisms that can maintain continuity across sessions, adapt to changing users and environments, and refine memory-management policies through accumulated experience. We introduce a two-axis analytical framework for multimodal agent memory structured around two key questions: how multimodal information is formed and represented (Axis I, Formation and Representation), and how its management adapts with accumulated experience (Axis II, Memory Management). Axis I, Formation and Representation, characterizes what information is retained and how it is encoded (e.g., modality-specific embeddings, textual and structured records, latent and parametric representations) to support subsequent reasoning and action. Axis II, Memory Management, distinguishes three tiers: T1 Static Memory reuses fixed memory; T2 Dynamic Memory updates memory through a stable policy; and T3 Self-Evolving Memory updates memory through an evolving policy. Based on this framework, we synthesize recurring design patterns and derive principles for balancing source fidelity with abstraction, maintaining temporal validity and provenance, grounding memory use in recoverable evidence, and evolving memory policies over time. Furthermore, we discuss the challenges and potential future directions for the memory mechanism of multimodal agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多模态智能体记忆的两轴分析框架：Axis I 按信息如何形成与表示划分（模态嵌入、文本与结构化记录、隐式与参数化表示），Axis II 按记忆管理策略是否随经验演化分为 T1 静态记忆、T2 动态记忆、T3 自演化记忆。基于该框架归纳反复出现的设计模式，并导出在来源保真与抽象、时效与溯源、可恢复证据支撑的记忆使用、策略随时间演化之间做平衡的原则。
Motivation: 多模态智能体走向长时程与终身任务时，难以从复杂异构多模态数据中持续获取有用信息，需要跨会话保持连续性、适应变化的用户与环境的记忆机制。
Method: 构建两轴框架：Axis I 刻画保留什么信息、如何编码（modality-specific embeddings、textual/structured records、latent/parametric representations）；Axis II 将记忆管理分为 T1 Static（固定策略复用）、T2 Dynamic（稳定策略更新）、T3 Self-Evolving（演化策略更新），再据此综合设计模式并推导原则。
Result: 给出两轴框架与三层记忆管理分级（T1/T2/T3），并据此综合出四条设计原则：来源保真与抽象的平衡、时效性与溯源维护、以可恢复证据锚定记忆使用、记忆策略随时间演化。
Conclusion: 多模态智能体记忆可按形成表示与管理策略是否演化两个维度统一组织，策略能否随经验演化（T3）是区分静态与自演化记忆的关键轴。

papers.title: DANGERLENS: Probing Dangerous Representations Hidden by Safety Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Safety alignment teaches language models to refuse harmful requests, yet the internal accessibility of hazardous concepts can retain traces of earlier training. Can checkpoints with equally safe behavior differ in what remains accessible behind their refusals? In this work, we investigate this question through paired training histories and a direct audit of intermediate representations. We introduce DANGERLENS, a probe that maps hidden states into vocabulary space and uses blinded semantic judgments to distinguish harmful goals and operational means from hazard recognition and safety control. Experiments on three Qwen1.5 scales show that checkpoints with prior harmful exposure generally retain greater hazardous concept accessibility after the same safety alignment, with the strongest separation in intermediate and later layers. The same harmful update also produces different behavioral trajectories from closely matched starting points. Human relevance validation and readout ablations reinforce the measured accessibility contrast. Our findings show that training history remains visible inside behaviorally matched models and motivate internal accessibility audits alongside output safety evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DANGERLENS 是一个探针，把隐藏状态映射到词表空间并用盲评语义判断区分有害目标与操作手段、危险识别与安全控制。在三个 Qwen1.5 规模上，经历过有害暴露的 checkpoint 在同等安全对齐后仍保留更高的危险概念可及性，且在中间层与后层分离最强。
Motivation: 安全对齐让模型拒绝有害请求，但行为同样安全的 checkpoint 内部仍可能残留可及的危险概念，仅看输出安全评估无法发现这种训练历史差异。
Method: 提出 DANGERLENS 探针：将隐藏状态映射到词表空间，用盲评语义判断区分有害目标/操作手段与危险识别/安全控制；通过配对训练历史审计中间层表示，并做人类相关性验证与读出消融 (readout ablations)。
Result: 在三个 Qwen1.5 规模上，先前有害暴露的 checkpoint 在相同安全对齐后普遍保留更高的危险概念可及性，中间层与后层分离最强；同一有害更新从相近起点产生不同的行为轨迹；人类相关性验证与读出消融强化了可及性对比。
Conclusion: 训练历史在行为已匹配的模型内部仍然可见，输出安全评估之外还应加上内部可及性审计 (internal accessibility audits)。

papers.title: Dynamic Graph World Modelling: Learning Future Dynamics from Temporal Context
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic graph learning models how entities and their relations evolve from historical observations to predict future graph states. Existing methods do not fully address dynamic graph world modelling, which requires learning transitions from temporal context to future latent graph states. This is difficult for three reasons: nodes and relations rely on different historical evidence, structural evolution is path-dependent, and future snapshots provide sparse and realization-specific targets. We propose Dynamic Graph World Modelling (DyG-WM), the first framework to jointly predict future node and relation representations from temporal context by answering three questions: what has evolved, how it evolved, and what will evolve next. To capture what has evolved, a historical node-relation context encoder summarizes node-neighborhood trajectories and pair-specific histories. To characterize how it evolved, a node-relation path-signature encoder captures ordered structural changes. To predict what will evolve next, a dual-level joint-embedding objective predicts target-snapshot node and relation representations without reconstructing the raw graph. Experiments on 12 link-prediction and two node-classification datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of DyG-WM across both tasks.

papers.title: Tail Competition Explains Scaling in Best-of-N Sampling for Verifiable Problems
papers.abstract_en: Best-of-N sampling is a simple inference-time scaling strategy for large language models, yet its behavior under incomplete reward models remains poorly understood. We study Best-of-N as a competition between the extreme reward tails of correct and incorrect responses. This view shows that success depends not only on the probability of sampling a correct response, but also on whether correct responses dominate incorrect ones in the upper tail. Using extreme value theory, we characterize three asymptotic regimes: correct-tail-dominant, incorrect-tail-dominant, and critical explaining both monotonic gains and reward-hacking-induced degradation. We further derive finite-sample scaling laws for representative reward distributions, showing that, under Gaussian rewards, incorrect responses with sufficiently large variance can dominate selection even when their mean reward is lower. Unlike oracle selection, convergence with an incomplete selector can be polynomial rather than exponential. Finally, we propose a lightweight tail-tension criterion to estimate when additional sampling may become harmful. Experiments on synthetic data and real reward model scores are consistent with the theoretically predicted regimes, scaling laws, and diagnostic behavior, suggesting that tail competition provides a unified lens on Best-of-N sampling for verifiable problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Best-of-N 采样视为正确与错误回答极端奖励尾部的竞争：成功不仅取决于采到正确回答的概率，还取决于正确回答是否在上尾占优。用极值理论刻画 correct-tail-dominant、incorrect-tail-dominant、critical 三种渐近体制，解释单调增益与 reward hacking 导致的退化；并提出轻量的 tail-tension 准则，用于判断继续采样何时开始有害。
Motivation: Best-of-N 是常用推理时扩展策略，但在奖励模型不完整（incomplete reward model）时行为缺乏理解：错误回答可能因奖励方差大而在选择中胜出，导致采样越多越差。
Method: 将正确/错误回答的奖励建模为极端值竞争，用极值理论 (extreme value theory) 推导三种渐近体制与代表性奖励分布下的有限样本 scaling law；提出 tail-tension 准则估计额外采样何时有害，并在合成数据与真实 reward model 分数上做实验。
Result: 高斯奖励下，方差足够大的错误回答即使均值更低也能主导选择；不完整选择器下的收敛可能是多项式而非指数速度。合成数据与真实 reward model 分数实验与理论预测的体制、scaling law 及诊断行为一致。
Conclusion: 尾部竞争为可验证问题上的 Best-of-N 提供统一解释框架：决定成败的是奖励上尾的相对支配，而非单纯采到正确答案的概率；tail-tension 准则可预警继续采样的有害区间。

papers.title: VLX-Go: Robust Embodied Tracking through Multi-Stage Learning and On-Policy Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Embodied visual tracking requires a robot to identify a designated target from visual observations and control its own motion to follow that target through an environment. Following an isolated person is a comparatively simple demonstration of embodied visual tracking, but following the intended person among distractors remains challenging. Existing methods exhibit a substantial drop in success from single-target to distractor tracking, motivating a focus on the shared spaces that person-following robots must navigate. We present \method{}, a vision--language waypoint policy built around the hypothesis that visual and language representations should be aligned before tracking-specific motion is learned. The policy combines complementary frozen visual encoders, multiscale temporal context, a transformer backbone, and a lightweight head for robot-centric waypoint prediction. Its training progresses through vision--language alignment, multimodal reasoning mid-training, and tracking specialization on 19,532 oracle episodes. Compared with 41.54\% distractor-tracking success for our earlier OmTrackVLA model, the complete multi-stage recipe achieves 55.80\%. We then explore on-policy refinement using filtered oracle labels for states visited by the policy. This preliminary study adds 2.42 percentage points of distractor-tracking success, reaching 58.22\%, while reducing collision rate by 1.99 pts. The final policy records the highest distractor- and ambiguous-tracking success rates among the compared methods. These results support staged multimodal learning as a promising direction for tracking among distractors and motivate further study of on-policy refinement for person following in shared spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLX-Go 是一个视觉-语言 waypoint 策略，先对齐视觉与语言表征再学跟踪专用运动，在干扰人存在的场景下把 person-following 成功率从 OmTrackVLA 的 41.54% 提到 55.80%，on-policy refinement 再加 2.42 个百分点到 58.22%，同时碰撞率下降 1.99 个百分点。
Motivation: 具身视觉跟踪中，从单目标切换到有干扰者的场景时成功率大幅下降，而 person-following 机器人实际要面对的正是这种共享空间。
Method: 融合多个互补的冻结视觉编码器、多尺度时序上下文与 transformer 主干，接一个轻量头预测机器人中心坐标系下的 waypoint；训练分三阶段推进：视觉-语言对齐、多模态推理 mid-training、跟踪专用化，共用 19,532 条 oracle episodes；随后用过滤后的 oracle 标签对策略实际访问到的状态做 on-policy refinement。
Result: 干扰者场景跟踪成功率：OmTrackVLA 41.54% → 完整多阶段配方 55.80%；on-policy refinement 再提升 2.42 个百分点至 58.22%，碰撞率同时下降 1.99 个百分点；最终策略在所比较方法中取得最高的干扰者与歧义场景跟踪成功率。
Conclusion: 分阶段的多模态学习（先对齐再特化）是提升干扰者中 person-following 的有效方向，on-policy refinement 进一步带来成功率与碰撞率的双重改善。

papers.title: Steering Vectors for Competing Ethical Frameworks Are Interchangeable: A Competing-Target Test for Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering adds a vector to a model's hidden states to control a named behaviour. A gain on that behaviour, however, does not show that the vector controls it directly: it may act through a component shared with neighbouring behaviours, which unsteered and random baselines cannot separate. We introduce the competing-target test: a vector is compared with the vector built the same way for a competing target, and an equivalence test states when their difference is below a useful margin. We apply it in open-weight models to vectors for Kantian deontology, which judges an act by the rule it follows, and act utilitarianism, which judges it by the welfare it produces. On held-out situations, prompting a framework raises its score and lowers the other's, whereas vectors for either framework move both scores alike, and none reaches the margin. The two vectors share most of their direction, a request to apply some framework; the same construction separates an optimistic from a pessimistic tone, whose vectors share much less. What a vector shares with its competitors therefore sets what it controls: steering a perspective can deliver a mixture, and measuring a disposition can measure its neighbours, unless tested against the competing target.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 competing-target test：把针对某目标行为构造的 steering vector 与同一方式构造的竞争目标向量做等价性检验，判断二者差异是否落在有用裕度内。在开放权重模型上测试 Kantian deontology 与 act utilitarianism 两种伦理框架，prompt 能升一个降另一个，而任一框架的向量对两个分数的推动方向一致且都不达裕度；两向量共享大部分方向（都是「请应用某框架」），同法构造的乐观/悲观语气向量则共享少得多。结论是向量与竞争者共享的方向决定它实际控制什么。
Motivation: 激活引导 (activation steering) 在目标行为上的增益无法证明向量直接控制该行为：它可能通过与相邻行为共享的成分起作用，而未引导与随机基线无法把这两种机制分开。
Method: competing-target test：按同一构造方式为目标与竞争目标各建一个向量，用等价性检验 (equivalence test) 判定二者之差是否低于有用裕度；在开放权重模型上对 Kantian deontology（按规则判断行为）与 act utilitarianism（按福利结果判断）构造向量，并以乐观/悲观语气向量作对照构造。
Result: 在 held-out 情境上，prompt 某框架会提高该框架得分并压低另一框架，而任一框架的向量对两个得分的改变方向一致，且差异都不达到裕度；两伦理框架向量共享大部分方向，乐观与悲观语气的向量共享则少得多。
Conclusion: 向量与竞争目标共享的方向决定了它实际控制的对象：引导一种视角可能只交付混合效果，测量某种倾向时也可能连带测到它的邻居，因此必须对竞争目标做检验。

papers.title: Asymptotic Behavior of Transformers
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we study the behavior of transformer networks generating text over long periods of time. We show that even a three-token, single-layer attention-only transformer can fail to converge. We then study a rich class of transformers with arbitrary finite depth, layer normalization, MLPs, RoPE encodings, and an arbitrary mix of local and global layers. Every transformer in this class has a softmax temperature threshold above which its empirical cache distribution converges to a unique limit, independent of initial conditions. We show further that, while each transformer has a temperature threshold, the supremum of this set is infinite, so there is no global minimal temperature that forces all transformers to converge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明即使是三 token、单层、纯注意力的 transformer 也可能不收敛；但对含任意有限深度、LayerNorm、MLP、RoPE 及局部/全局层混合的广泛 transformer 类，每个模型都存在一个 softmax 温度阈值，超过该阈值其经验缓存分布收敛到与初始条件无关的唯一极限。同时该阈值集合的上确界为无穷，即不存在对所有 transformer 都强制收敛的全局最小温度。
Motivation: 长时段自回归生成中 transformer 的经验缓存分布是否收敛、能否摆脱初始条件依赖，缺少一般性刻画；需要区分单个模型的可收敛性与跨模型的统一收敛条件。
Method: 先构造三 token 单层 attention-only 反例说明不收敛可能发生，再对含任意有限深度、LayerNorm、MLP、RoPE、局部与全局层任意混合的 transformer 类逐个证明存在 softmax 温度阈值，并分析该阈值集合的上确界。
Result: 三 token 单层 attention-only transformer 可不收敛；该广泛类中每个 transformer 都有温度阈值，超过后经验缓存分布收敛到与初始条件无关的唯一极限；阈值集合的上确界为无穷，故不存在全局最小温度。
Conclusion: 收敛性是逐模型的温度阈值性质，而非可由统一常数保证的全局性质。

papers.title: BFHD: Bidirectional Feature Harmonization Decomposition for Heterogeneous Clinical Assessments
papers.abstract_en: Clinical assessments are often collected using heterogeneous assessment systems across centers and time, leading to records that mix different but related sets of measurements. This motivates harmonization beyond total-score linking. We formulate clinical harmonization at the measurement level as a bidirectional recoverability problem: given paired observations from two assessment systems, the goal is to identify which measurements can be reliably translated in both directions within an application-defined tolerance, while separating non-translatable components. We propose Bidirectional Feature Harmonization Decomposition (BFHD), a feasibility-driven framework that enforces bidirectionally coupled translation and uses feature-wise output gating to produce an explicit decomposition in the original measurement space. Experiments on synthetic data and real clinical assessment pairs show that BFHD achieves broader feasible harmonization coverage and improved subset stability compared to baselines.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BFHD 把临床量表协调 (harmonization) 写成测量级的双向可恢复性问题：给定两套评估系统的配对观测，在应用定义的容差内判定哪些测量可双向互译，并把不可译成分显式分离出来。方法用双向耦合翻译约束加逐特征输出门控，在原始测量空间给出分解；合成数据与真实临床评估配对实验显示其可行协调覆盖更广、子集稳定性优于基线。
Motivation: 跨中心、跨时间的临床记录混用不同但相关的测量系统，仅做总分链接 (total-score linking) 无法处理测量级差异，也无法区分哪些测量可互译、哪些不可译。
Method: 提出可行性驱动的 Bidirectional Feature Harmonization Decomposition (BFHD)：强制双向耦合的翻译约束，并用 feature-wise output gating 在原始测量空间产生显式分解，把可译与不可译成分分开；在合成数据与真实临床评估配对上与基线比较。
Result: 在合成数据和真实临床评估配对上，BFHD 相比基线取得更广的可行协调覆盖 (feasible harmonization coverage) 和更好的子集稳定性 (subset stability)。
Conclusion: 测量级协调应按双向可恢复性来判定并在原始测量空间显式分解，而非只做总分链接；BFHD 在覆盖与子集稳定性上优于所比较的基线。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Subdata Selection for Measurement-Constrained Linear Regression under Model Misspecification
papers.abstract_en: In many modern applications, obtaining response variables is costly, time-consuming, or technically challenging, making it impractical to measure outcomes for all available units. In such settings, covariates may be available for a large pool of candidates, but responses can only be collected for a small, carefully selected subset, making the choice of which units to measure a consequential decision. Most existing subsampling methods are developed for massive datasets, emphasizing the trade-off between statistical accuracy and computational cost, and typically relying on the assumption of a correctly specified model. These features limit their suitability in measurement-constrained settings, where statistical efficiency is paramount and model misspecification is often unavoidable. To address these challenges, we develop a new subset selection framework for linear regression that accommodates potential model misspecification. The proposed approach targets predictive expected loss and yields an A-optimality-type criterion that depends only on covariate information, requiring no response observations at the selection stage. We refer to this method as Expected Loss Optimal Selection (ELOS). By focusing on predictive risk rather than model-based optimality, ELOS remains well-defined and robust under misspecification. Simulation studies and real data applications demonstrate that ELOS achieves strong predictive performance and compares favorably with existing methods across a range of scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ELOS (Expected Loss Optimal Selection)：在响应变量测量成本高、只能对少量单元采样的场景下，用只依赖协变量的 A-optimality 型准则挑选要测量的子集，目标是预测期望损失而非模型正确设定下的最优性，因此在模型误设 (misspecification) 下仍有定义且稳健。模拟与真实数据应用中 ELOS 预测表现强，在多种场景下与已有子采样方法相比有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有子采样方法主要面向大规模数据、权衡精度与算力，且依赖模型正确设定的假设；在测量受限、统计效率优先且误设不可避免的场景下不适用。
Method: 为线性回归构建子集选择框架 ELOS：以预测期望损失为目标，推导出仅依赖协变量信息的 A-optimality 型准则，选择阶段无需任何响应观测；通过聚焦预测风险而非基于模型的最优性来应对误设。
Result: 模拟研究与真实数据应用显示 ELOS 取得强的预测性能，并在一系列场景下与已有方法比较表现有利；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 在测量受限的回归子采样中，按预测风险而非模型设定最优性来选点，可以在模型误设下保持准则良定义并取得有竞争力的预测精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Where to Start, How to Move: Analyzing Curricula under GRPO for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) provides no reward-relative learning signal when all rollouts receive identical rewards. In long-horizon tasks that require multiple interactions, rewards are given only upon successful task completion, making all-fail groups common early in training and limiting opportunities to practice later steps. Guide Assisted GRPO replays a successful reference prefix before the learner continues. We study how initial positions, handoff units, and movement rules affect unassisted task completion. Across three model sizes on BFCL, starting near completion is more effective under a fixed turn-level threshold rule. Finer handoffs alone do not consistently help, but outcome-informed tool-call selection outperforms GRPO on trained and untrained task categories. Guided starts also improve AppWorld success on both evaluation splits. These findings highlight where learning starts and how starting positions move as key curriculum choices.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Minchan Kim and Sungho Bae contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 长时程 LLM agent 训练中，全失败 rollout 组使 GRPO 拿不到相对学习信号；Guide Assisted GRPO 先回放成功参考前缀再让 learner 继续。在 BFCL 三个模型规模上，固定 turn 级阈值规则下从接近完成处起步更有效，outcome-informed 的工具调用选择在已训练与未训练任务类别上都优于 GRPO，引导起步也提升 AppWorld 两个评测 split 的成功率。
Motivation: 长时程多轮交互任务只在完成时给奖励，训练早期全失败组常见，GRPO 因组内奖励无差异而失去梯度，后续步骤得不到练习机会。
Method: Guide Assisted GRPO：回放成功参考前缀后由 learner 接续；系统考察三个课程维度——初始位置 (initial positions)、交接粒度 (handoff units)、移动规则 (movement rules)，并在 BFCL 与 AppWorld 上比较。
Result: 在 BFCL 三个模型规模上，固定 turn 级阈值规则时从接近完成处起步更有效；仅细化交接粒度并不稳定带来收益，而 outcome-informed 工具调用选择在已训练与未训练任务类别上均优于 GRPO；引导起步在 AppWorld 两个评测 split 上都提高成功率。
Conclusion: 学习从哪里开始以及起步位置如何移动，是长时程 agent 课程设计中两个独立且关键的选择，粒度细化本身不足以改善训练。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Integrated Novelty Detection Systems: From Sensor Networks to Multi-Novelty Computer Vision
papers.abstract_en: Novelty detection is crucial in various technological and scientific domains. Its importance spans from ensuring the reliability of sensor networks to enhancing the adaptability of computer vision systems. As AI systems become increasingly sophisticated and complex, effective anomaly detection is essential for maintaining reliability and accuracy. This work addresses novelty detection in weather sensor networks and computer vision. In weather sensor networks, particularly for monitoring rainfall, detecting blocked rain gauges can significantly impact data reliability, food security, and disaster management. This work evaluates four existing quality control methods for detecting blocked rain gauges and demonstrates their limitations, particularly in detecting clusters of faulty sensors. By comparing methods such as the Conditional Mixture Model (CMM), PSWQ (Fz-filter), Kernel Regression, and Gaussian Method, we identify their shortcomings and propose three novel quality control techniques that integrate probabilistic fault detection and consistency-based diagnosis framework to improve timely detection of blocked sensors, while reducing false alarms. In the realm of computer vision, current systems often fail to handle multiple types of novelty due to their focus on single-novelty scenarios. We highlight the need for integrated systems capable of handling multiple types of novelty. To support this, we introduce the Novel Snapshot Serengeti (NOVEL-SS) dataset, derived from the Snapshot Serengeti camera trap data, which includes various forms of novelty. We also present the DCA (Detect, Characterize, and Accommodate) baseline system, designed to handle multiple novelty by detecting, characterizing, and accommodating them. This work aims to advance the robustness and adaptability of novelty detection systems across both weather sensor networks and computer vision applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把新颖性检测 (novelty detection) 同时做到雨量传感器网络与计算机视觉两条线上：在雨量站上评估四种既有质控方法（CMM、PSWQ/Fz-filter、Kernel Regression、Gaussian Method），指出它们在成簇故障传感器上失效，进而提出三种融合概率故障检测与一致性诊断的质控技术，以更及时地发现堵塞雨量计并降低误报；在视觉侧则发布 NOVEL-SS 数据集（源自 Snapshot Serengeti 相机陷阱）与 DCA（Detect, Characterize, Accommodate）基线系统，用于检测、刻画并接纳多种类型的 novelty。
Motivation: 雨量计堵塞会直接损害降水数据可靠性，进而影响粮食安全与灾害管理，而现有质控方法主要针对单点故障，抓不住成簇的传感器故障；视觉侧的新颖性检测系统也基本只处理单一 novelty 类型，无法应对同时出现的多种新奇情形。
Method: 先对比评估 Conditional Mixture Model (CMM)、PSWQ (Fz-filter)、Kernel Regression 与 Gaussian Method 四种既有雨量站质控方法，再提出三种新技术，把概率故障检测与基于一致性的诊断框架 (consistency-based diagnosis) 结合起来；视觉侧构建从 Snapshot Serengeti 相机陷阱数据派生、含多种 novelty 形式的 Novel Snapshot Serengeti (NOVEL-SS) 数据集，并给出 DCA 基线系统，按检测、刻画、接纳三步处理多 novelty。
Result: 评估显示四种既有质控方法（CMM、PSWQ/Fz-filter、Kernel Regression、Gaussian Method）在检测成簇故障传感器时存在明显不足；提出的三种质控技术以更及时地检出堵塞雨量计并减少误报为目标。视觉侧产出 NOVEL-SS 多 novelty 数据集与 DCA 基线系统。
Conclusion: 新颖性检测系统要跨域稳健，需要把概率故障检测与一致性诊断整合进传感器质控，并在视觉侧从单 novelty 走向检测—刻画—接纳的多 novelty 框架。

papers.title: When Is Smaller Greener? Right-Sizing Language Models for Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: AI agents use large language models (LLMs) to plan and act over multiple steps, yet models are usually compared per call rather than per completed task. This paper asks: which model should an agent use to complete tasks reliably while minimising energy, cost and time? We show that per-call comparisons can be misleading for agentic AI. Because a task succeeds only if all required steps succeed, small differences in per-step reliability can produce large differences in overall task success. Failed attempts also consume resources. We therefore evaluate models using energy, cost and time per successfully completed task, treating the completed task as the functional unit. On this basis, we develop a decision model for choosing LLMs in agentic workflows. The model applies to tasks with binary or graded outcomes and to settings with or without retries. We show that each resource has a crossover task length at which a smaller, less reliable model ceases to be the greener, cheaper or faster option. These crossovers divide tasks into three regimes: for short tasks smaller models are preferred, for long tasks larger models are preferred, and only between these extremes do preferences among objectives matter. We embed these results in a two-stage framework that separates efficiency from preference. A Pareto screen first removes models that are never competitive; a weighted decision is required only when a genuine trade-off remains. A pilot study of 15 open-weight models from five developers, ranging from 0.6B to 27B parameters, on two multi-step agent tasks with measured GPU energy supports the predicted structure. The model with the lowest energy per completed task changes with task length and task type, and observed crossover points generally match those predicted from per-step measurements. These findings provide a practical framework for right-sizing language models in agentic AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出按单次调用比较 LLM 会误导智能体选型：任务只有全部步骤成功才算完成，单步可靠性的微小差异会被放大成任务成功率的巨大差异，且失败尝试同样消耗资源。以「每个成功完成任务的能耗/成本/时间」为功能单位后，每种资源都存在一个交叉任务长度，超过该长度后更小、更不可靠的模型不再是更绿色、更便宜或更快的选项。作者建议用两阶段框架选型：先用 Pareto 筛选剔除从不具竞争力的模型，仅在确有权衡时再做加权决策。
Motivation: 智能体的 LLM 通常按单次调用的能耗、成本、延迟比较，但智能体任务需多步连续成功，失败重试也消耗资源，单步指标无法反映「完成一个任务」的真实资源开销，导致选型可能出错。
Method: 把「成功完成的任务」定义为功能单位，建立按任务长度预测交叉点的决策模型，适用于二元或分级结果、含或不含重试的场景；再嵌入两阶段框架，先 Pareto 筛选、后加权决策。用 5 家开发者的 15 个开放权重模型（0.6B–27B 参数）在两个多步智能体任务上做试点，实测 GPU 能耗。
Result: 试点覆盖 15 个开放权重模型、5 家开发者、参数量 0.6B–27B、两个多步智能体任务并实测 GPU 能耗：单位完成任务能耗最低的模型随任务长度和任务类型变化，实测交叉点与由单步测量预测的交叉点大体一致。
Conclusion: 智能体的模型选型应以单位完成任务的资源开销为准，且最优模型随任务长度变化：短任务选小模型、长任务选大模型，只有中间区间才需要在能耗、成本、时间之间权衡。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 试点覆盖 15 个开放权重模型、5 家开发者、参数量 0.6B–27B、两个多步智能体任务并实测 GPU 能耗：单位完成任务能耗最低的模型随任务长度和任务类型变化，实测交叉点与由单步测量预测的交叉点大体一致。
summary_sections.conclusion: 智能体的模型选型应以单位完成任务的资源开销为准，且最优模型随任务长度变化：短任务选小模型、长任务选大模型，只有中间区间才需要在能耗、成本、时间之间权衡。

papers.title: Target-Token Asymmetry Can Masquerade As Depth Specialization
papers.abstract_en: Layer-ablation studies often perturb early or late layers of a language model, compare the damage to prediction on two corpora, and read a larger early-layer effect on one corpus as early-layer specialization for its task. Such a comparison averages over the tokens that each corpus asks the model to predict, and these target tokens differ: math solutions, for example, ask for far more whitespace and numbers than encyclopedia prose. We show that this difference can create the appearance of depth specialization. We split a cross-corpus early--late damage interaction by target-token type and recompute it under a target mixture shared by both corpora. Between GSM8K and Wikitext, a positive interaction replicates across five model instances. In the three fully decomposed models, only whitespace has a positive interaction. Removing whitespace reverses the pooled effect in all three, and matching the full target mixture reverses it in two. The diagnosis holds under position matching, adversarial reassignment of token types, and a continuous readout. The risk can also be anticipated from the tokenizer alone. A screen computed before any model runs places every held-out pair it scored in the region its label predicts, and on the pairs it rates at high or medium risk, removing whitespace reverses every positive pooled estimate. A smaller content-word effect one token ahead follows the share of content targets that the unablated model already predicts. A cross-corpus depth effect therefore supports an interpretation of task specialization only after the target-token mixture is reported, the effect is decomposed by token type, and a mixture-matched summary keeps its sign.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 跨语料层消融 (layer ablation) 中「早层对某语料损伤更大」的深度特化信号，可以完全由目标 token 类别构成差异伪造：GSM8K 与 Wikitext 之间正的早-晚层交互在五个模型实例上复现，但按 token 类型分解后只有 whitespace 呈正交互，去掉 whitespace 后三个完全分解模型的合并效应全部反号，匹配共同目标混合后两个反号。作者建议：只有在报告目标 token 混合并做类型分解、且混合匹配后的汇总保持符号时，跨语料深度效应才能解释为任务特化。
Motivation: 层消融研究把「早层损伤对某语料更大」读作该语料的深度特化，但这种比较在每个语料要求模型预测的 token 上取了平均，而目标 token 构成本身不同（数学解答比百科散文多得多的空白符和数字），该差异足以伪造出深度特化外观。
Method: 把跨语料早-晚层损伤交互按目标 token 类型分解，并在两个语料共享的目标混合下重算；在三个完全分解 (fully decomposed) 的模型上做检验，并用位置匹配、token 类型对抗重指派 (adversarial reassignment) 与连续读数 (continuous readout) 三种方式验证诊断；另用仅基于 tokenizer 的风险筛查在任何模型运行前预测风险区域。
Result: GSM8K 与 Wikitext 之间正的早-晚层交互在五个模型实例上复现；三个完全分解模型中只有 whitespace 有正交互，去掉 whitespace 后三个模型的合并效应全部反号，匹配完整目标混合后两个反号。仅凭 tokenizer 计算的筛查把每个被评分的留出对都放进其标签预测的区域，在其判为高/中风险的对上，去掉 whitespace 使每一个正的合并估计反号。内容词效应小一个量级，且其大小随未消融模型已正确预测的内容目标占比变化。
Conclusion: 跨语料深度效应只有在报告目标 token 混合、按 token 类型分解、且混合匹配后符号保持时才支持任务特化解释；该风险可在跑任何模型之前仅凭 tokenizer 提前预判。

papers.title: Counterfactual Gate-Support Decomposition: Separating Selection from Redistribution in Training-Data Filtering
papers.abstract_en: A training-data quality gate changes both which examples survive within regions of the input space and how training mass is distributed across those regions, so a gate-versus-random comparison does not isolate these mechanisms. We introduce Counterfactual Gate-Support Decomposition (CGSD), a four-arm, budget-matched design that crosses gate eligibility with support distribution and decomposes the observed gate effect into within-support selection, between-support redistribution, and their interaction. The practical constraint is finite-pool realizability: we characterize mass and token-assembly conditions under which the required arms can be constructed, together with a support-extinction case in which the ordinary design is undefined. On Korean-English and Korean-Japanese retrieval, the mean within-support selection component is the only one that exceeds its calibrated null band (+29.7 and +5.6 holdout items; 30/30 positive replicates), decisively in Korean-English and marginally in Korean-Japanese; redistribution and interaction remain unresolved at the available power. The same pattern holds for a second, unrelated gate family -- a model-confidence threshold rather than a deterministic verifier -- judged against its own null (+27.3 items, 9/9 positive), so the result is not a property of one gate's mechanism. On a mathematics gate, zero-eligibility supports leave the ordinary design undefined at every budget, while the extended design is constructible only inside narrow budget bands that an exhaustive scan locates and that the natural operating point misses -- the assembly condition separating a property of the pool from a limitation of the packer. CGSD therefore returns a decomposition, a constructible-but-underpowered design, or an explicit non-constructibility result, and says which; it prevents support redistribution from being silently interpreted as sample-level gate quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 训练数据质量门控同时改变区域内样本存活与区域间训练质量再分配，门控对随机的对比无法区分两者。CGSD 用四臂、预算匹配设计交叉门控资格与支撑分布，把门控效应拆成支撑内选择、支撑间再分配及其交互；在韩英与韩日检索中只有支撑内选择分量超出校准零带（+29.7 与 +5.6 个 holdout 条目，30/30 次重复为正），再分配与交互在当前功效下无法判定。
Motivation: 门控与随机的对比把支撑内选择和支撑间再分配混在一起，导致样本级门控质量被高估；同时四臂设计受有限数据池可实现性约束，普通设计在支撑灭绝时根本无定义。
Method: CGSD 采用四臂预算匹配设计，交叉门控资格 (gate eligibility) 与支撑分布 (support distribution)，把观测门控效应分解为支撑内选择、支撑间再分配与交互三个分量；刻画质量与 token 装配条件以判定各臂可构造性，并给出支撑灭绝时的扩展设计。评测覆盖韩英、韩日检索，第二个门族为模型置信度阈值（对照确定性验证器），数学门上做预算穷举扫描。
Result: 韩英检索支撑内选择分量 +29.7 个 holdout 条目、30/30 次重复为正，判定为决定性；韩日 +5.6 个条目、同为 30/30 正，判定为边缘；再分配与交互在当前功效下未解析。模型置信度阈值门族在其自身零带下 +27.3 个条目、9/9 次重复为正。数学门上零资格支撑使普通设计在所有预算下无定义，扩展设计仅在穷举扫描定位的狭窄预算带内可构造，而自然工作点落在带外。
Conclusion: 门控效应中可归因于样本级质量的只有支撑内选择分量，且该模式跨两个无关门族成立；CGSD 的第三种输出是显式的不可构造性结论，用于阻止把支撑再分配误读为样本级门控质量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Why Do Agent Teams Fail Across Boundaries? A Failure Taxonomy for Agent-to-Agent Systems with Private States
papers.abstract_en: Agents are increasingly interacting with other agents that act for different principals -- people or organizations on whose behalf they work -- e.g., a buyer's personal agent negotiating with an enterprise's seller agent. In such agent-to-agent (A2A) scenarios, each agent has its own environment and holds information and authority that the other cannot see. Moreover, the interests of each agent may be aligned (cooperative), partly aligned (mixed-motive), or opposed (competitive). Existing multi-agent system failure studies assume only one orchestrator, shared workspace, or principal. We ask how A2A systems fail when these assumptions are removed. We study more than 2,500 recorded runs of A2A systems built from different agent harnesses and models, spanning 488 scenarios across eight families (legal, CRM, security, commerce, etc.). From these traces, we derive $A^2$-Failures, a taxonomy of 20 A2A failure modes in four categories: (i) discovery and delegation, (ii) grounding and record consistency, (iii) verification, and (iv) conduct and fidelity. Three observations hold across the harnesses, models, and scenarios studied: (1) Agents match tasks to peer names mentioned in the prompt rather than actively searching for available peers; (2) Agents never fact-check each other unprompted; (3) Scoring only the final output rewards the lead agent while hiding internal coordination, verification, and behavioral breakdowns. Our study makes a case for comprehensive evaluations where agents are scored individually against their own objectives in addition to task outcome. We release the run logs behind the taxonomy at https://huggingface.co/datasets/a2a-salesforce/a2-failures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在各 agent 拥有私有状态、委托关系可为合作/混合动机/竞争的 agent-to-agent (A2A) 场景下，本文分析 2,500+ 次运行、488 个场景，归纳出 A²-Failures：四类共 20 种失败模式。三个跨 harness、模型、场景一致的发现是：agent 按 prompt 里提到的 peer 名字配任务而不主动搜索可用 peer；agent 从不主动互相核查事实；只给最终输出打分会奖励 lead agent，同时掩盖内部协调、验证与行为失范。
Motivation: 既有 MAS 失败研究都假设单一 orchestrator、共享工作区或同一 principal；去掉这些假设后，A2A 系统如何失败缺少系统刻画。
Method: 从不同 agent harness 与模型搭建的 A2A 系统中采集 2,500+ 次录制运行，覆盖 legal、CRM、security、commerce 等八类共 488 个场景，从 trace 中归纳 A²-Failures 分类法（四类：discovery and delegation、grounding and record consistency、verification、conduct and fidelity，共 20 种失败模式），并公开 run logs。
Result: 在所研究的 harness、模型与场景上三条观察一致成立：agent 按 prompt 中提及的 peer 名称匹配任务而非主动搜索可用 peer；agent 从不无提示地互相 fact-check；仅对最终输出打分会让 lead agent 获得奖励，同时掩盖内部协调、验证与行为层面的崩溃。
Conclusion: 作者主张做更全面的评估：除任务结果外，还要按各 agent 自身的目标分别打分；分类法背后的 run logs 已在 HuggingFace 上发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MMKG-R1: Constructing Multimodal Knowledge Graphs via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal knowledge graphs (MMKGs) organize information across different modalities to support multimodal Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), which aims to improve the performance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). The effectiveness of these multimodal Graph RAG methods largely depends on the quality of the constructed MMKGs. However, most existing methods construct MMKGs without explicit guidance on graph quality, while reinforcement learning (RL)-based methods that rely on final-answer correctness may provide only indirect feedback on MMKG quality. To address these limitations, we propose MMKG-R1, a novel MMKG-quality-driven RL framework for training an MLLM as a multimodal knowledge constructor. To be specific, MMKG-R1 introduces multiple quality-aware rewards to directly evaluate both the quality of information extracted from individual knowledge sources and the quality of the assembled MMKG. These rewards are then used to guide the RL training. Experiments across multiple datasets show that MMKG-R1 constructs MMKGs that improve downstream question-answering accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MMKG-R1：以多模态知识图谱 (MMKG) 质量为奖励信号、用强化学习训练 MLLM 充当多模态知识构建器，同时评价单个知识源的信息抽取质量与组装后整图的质量。在多个数据集上，这样构建出的 MMKG 提升了下游问答准确率。
Motivation: 多模态 Graph RAG 的效果取决于 MMKG 质量，但现有构建方法缺少对图质量的显式引导；依赖最终答案正确性的 RL 只能对 MMKG 质量提供间接反馈。
Method: 设计 MMKG-quality-driven RL 框架：构造多项 quality-aware rewards，分别评估从各知识源抽取的信息质量与组装后 MMKG 的整体质量，用这些奖励直接引导 RL 训练，把 MLLM 训练成多模态知识构建器。
Result: 在多个数据集上的实验显示，MMKG-R1 构建的 MMKG 提升了下游问答准确率（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把图质量本身做成奖励、而非只用最终答案正确性，能直接优化 MMKG 构建过程并转化为下游多模态问答的收益。

papers.title: Can We Believe AI Peer Review?
papers.abstract_en: As large language models become widely used in scientific review and manuscript revision, AI scores are increasingly serving as feedback for assessing paper quality and guiding edits. Yet whether a single AI score reliably reflects the reviewer's judgment, and whether revision gains based on that score are endorsed by other reviewers, remain understudied. Using 200 papers from ICLR 2025 and 2026 and approximately 14,000 AI reviews, we study score reliability, score-distribution estimation, and cross-model agreement on revision gains. Repeated reviews fluctuate even under identical conditions. Finer-grained scoring protocols reduce score variance but also systematically shift mean scores, while the gains assigned to manuscript revisions depend strongly on the reviewer.

TL;DR: 用 ICLR 2025 与 2026 共 200 篇论文、约 14,000 条 AI 评审，检验单一 AI 打分能否代表审稿人判断：同一条件下重复评审分数本身就在波动，更细粒度的打分协议虽降低分数方差却系统性抬移均值，而修改带来的增益高度依赖具体评审者。结论是 AI 分数不能当作可靠的论文质量反馈或修改指引。
Motivation: LLM 已广泛用于科学评审与稿件修改，AI 分数被当作质量评估和修改方向的反馈，但单一分数是否可靠反映审稿人判断、基于该分数的修改增益是否被其他审稿人认可，此前研究不足。
Method: 在 ICLR 2025 与 2026 的 200 篇论文上收集约 14,000 条 AI 评审，围绕三件事展开：分数可靠性 (score reliability)、分数分布估计 (score-distribution estimation)、以及跨模型对修改增益的一致性 (cross-model agreement on revision gains)。
Result: 相同条件下重复评审的分数仍会波动；更细粒度的打分协议降低分数方差，但同时系统性地移动均值分数；稿件修改所获增益强烈依赖于评审者身份。
Conclusion: 单一 AI 分数既不稳定也不跨评审者一致，用它驱动论文质量判断与修改方向不可靠。

papers.title: LLM-jp-4 Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents LLM-jp-4, a family of Japanese sovereign large language models (LLMs) developed with an emphasis on transparency, reproducibility, and practical usability. LLM-jp-4 comprises an 8B dense model and a 32B-A3B mixture-of-experts model, both trained from scratch on approximately 12 trillion tokens. To support independent verification and reproduction, we establish explicit criteria for selecting training data, external models, and software, and make the development process publicly available. Evaluation results demonstrate substantial improvements over previous LLM-jp models and competitive performance against open-weight models of similar scale. By documenting the development principles, training procedures, and empirical findings of LLM-jp-4, we aim to provide a reference for future sovereign AI development.
papers.comment: Results for the LLM-jp-4 33B dense model are not included in this version and will be added in a future revision
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM-jp-4 是面向日语的主权 LLM 家族，含 8B dense 与 32B-A3B MoE 两个从零训练的模型，各用约 12 万亿 token。作者公开训练数据、外部模型与软件的选取标准和开发流程，评测显示相对前代 LLM-jp 大幅提升、与同规模开源权重模型相当。
Motivation: 日语主权 LLM 缺少可独立核验的开发记录，外部难以复现其数据选取与训练过程，也缺少与同规模开源模型的可比参照。
Method: 从零训练 8B dense 与 32B-A3B mixture-of-experts 两个模型，各约 12 万亿 token；为训练数据、外部模型和软件建立明确选取标准，并把开发过程与训练流程、经验发现全部公开以支持复现。
Result: 评测显示 LLM-jp-4 相对先前 LLM-jp 模型有显著提升，与同规模开源权重模型 (open-weight models) 表现相当；本版不含 33B dense 模型的结果。
Conclusion: 把数据与软件选取标准和开发流程文档化，可让主权 AI 开发成为可复现的参考范式；33B dense 结果留待后续版本。

papers.title: NavAble: A Large-Scale Dataset and Synthetic Data Generation Pipeline for Blind Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable recognition of accessibility-critical objects (e.g., audible pedestrian signals, door-activation buttons, and handrails) is essential for assistive navigation technologies that support safe, independent mobility for blind and low-vision (BLV) users. Yet these categories are underrepresented in existing large-scale vision datasets, and the few datasets that include them suffer from limited class coverage, inconsistent annotations, and poor diversity. We introduce NavAble, a large-scale dataset spanning 11 accessibility-critical object classes, combining 41K curated open-source images with 8K newly collected, densely annotated real-world images. To extend scale and diversity, we develop a synthetic data generation pipeline that renders high-fidelity 3D assets across 37 environments under diverse styles and viewpoints, yielding 452K frames with rich ground-truth annotations from 565 assets. The pipeline minimizes manual effort by combining automated web image crawling, VLM-based filtering, SAM 3D-based asset generation, and convenient camera trajectory configuration, enabling large-scale data generation at a diversity unattainable through manual collection. Experiments show that fine-tuning existing segmentation models on the NavAble Dataset achieves reliable accessibility-object segmentation (>80% mIoU on our held-out test set). We also demonstrate the effectiveness of synthetic data augmentation, which yields up to +3.5 mIoU over real-world-only fine-tuning. Beyond benchmark evaluation, validation on egocentric data from two mobility-assistive robots demonstrates improved perception reliability in real-world navigation scenarios. Together, NavAble establishes a scalable foundation for BLV navigation perception, directly addressing the data scarcity and embodiment gaps. The dataset and pipeline are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/NavAble/NeurIPS_2026_BLV.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NavAble 针对盲人/低视力 (BLV) 导航中无障碍关键物体的稀缺，构建 11 类、含 41K 开源图 + 8K 新采集密集标注图的数据集，并用合成管线在 37 个环境、565 个 3D 资产上渲染 452K 帧。在 NavAble 留出测试集上微调分割模型可得 >80% mIoU，合成数据增广比仅用真实数据微调最高再提 +3.5 mIoU，并在两台移动辅助机器人的第一视角数据上提升感知可靠性。
Motivation: 发声行人信号、门按钮、扶手等无障碍关键物体在现有大规模视觉数据集中代表性不足，已有少量数据集类别覆盖窄、标注不一致、多样性差，制约 BLV 导航感知。
Method: 数据集含 11 类、41K 策展开源图像与 8K 新采集密集标注真实图像；合成管线组合自动网络图像爬取、VLM 过滤、SAM 3D 资产生成与相机轨迹配置，在 37 个环境下渲染 565 个资产共 452K 帧并附带真值标注；随后微调现有分割模型并做合成数据增广。
Result: 在 NavAble 留出测试集上微调现有分割模型达到 >80% mIoU；合成数据增广相对仅真实数据微调最高带来 +3.5 mIoU；在两台移动辅助机器人的第一视角数据上验证了真实导航场景中的感知可靠性提升。数据集与管线公开于 Hugging Face。
Conclusion: 合成数据生成管线可把无障碍物体分割扩展到人工采集达不到的规模与多样性，为 BLV 导航感知提供可公开复用的基础数据与生成流程。

papers.title: SonoWorld: Towards Interactive Pose-Controllable Ultrasound World Models
papers.abstract_en: Robotic ultrasound can standardize image acquisition and reduce operator workload and variability, but policy learning remains limited by the lack of realistic, controllable simulation environments. While controllable world models have advanced rapidly in natural-image domains, ultrasound world modeling remains challenging because each frame captures only a cross-section of unobserved 3D anatomy, causing small probe motions to induce large appearance changes. Existing approaches rely on robot-tracked poses and latent-space prediction, but do not directly generate the observations required for interactive control. We propose SonoWorld, a causal ultrasound world model that learns video dynamics from unlabeled clinical videos and grounds them to 6-DoF control using a small set of freehand clinical scans tracked with an EM sensor. SonoWorld is trained in three stages: pretraining a latent-action-conditioned video diffusion model on around 6.9 million unlabeled multi-organ ultrasound frames; grounding the learned video dynamics to metric probe poses with a small EM-tracked thyroid dataset; and applying distribution matching distillation to enable causal, long-horizon autoregressive generation with selectively caching eviction tokens at inference time. We evaluate controllability through pose-following fidelity, round-trip consistency, and axis-specific control under synthetic actions on held-out tracked scans, and further validate it with a user study. In model-based action discrimination, SonoWorld correctly ranks the target-directed probe motion over an equal-magnitude opposite motion in up to 74.8% of trials. To our knowledge, SonoWorld is the first causal, pose-controllable ultrasound world model learned primarily from freehand clinical videos, providing a data-driven interactive environment for robotic ultrasound data acquisition and policy evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SonoWorld 是首个主要从自由手临床超声视频学习、可按 6-DoF 探头位姿控制的因果超声世界模型：三阶段训练把潜动作条件视频扩散模型对齐到度量位姿，并用分布匹配蒸馏实现长时程自回归生成与推理时缓存 eviction token。在基于模型的动作判别中，它在最多 74.8% 的试验里把目标方向的探头运动排在等幅反向运动之前。
Motivation: 机器人超声的策略学习受限于缺少真实可控的仿真环境：每帧只捕捉未观测 3D 解剖的一个截面，微小探头位姿变化就引起剧烈外观变化，而现有方法依赖机器人跟踪位姿与潜空间预测，不能直接生成交互控制所需的观测。
Method: 三阶段训练：先在约 690 万张无标注多器官超声帧上预训练潜动作条件视频扩散模型，再用一小套 EM 传感器跟踪的甲状腺自由手扫描把学到的视频动力学对齐到度量探头位姿，最后用分布匹配蒸馏 (distribution matching distillation) 支持因果长时程自回归生成，推理时选择性缓存 eviction token。
Result: 在留出的已跟踪扫描上以合成动作评估位姿跟随保真度、往返一致性和分轴控制，并做用户研究；在基于模型的动作判别中，SonoWorld 在最多 74.8% 的试验里把目标方向探头运动排在等幅反向运动之前。
Conclusion: 作者称 SonoWorld 是首个主要从自由手临床视频学到的因果、位姿可控超声世界模型，可作为机器人超声数据采集与策略评估的数据驱动交互环境。

papers.title: Why don't Graph Transformers attend to the same token?
papers.abstract_en: In large language models (LLMs), attention concentrates heavily on the first token. This 'attention sink' is believed to protect deep models against over-mixing. Even though graph transformers face a related pressure, we find that a SoTA graph transformer, GRIT, rarely forms sinks on molecules, and that it sinks less when trained on larger graphs, the opposite of the trend in LLMs. In principle, a graph can prevent sinks: we prove and show empirically that its symmetry and locality limit the attention any node can receive. On molecules, however, with distinguishable atoms and global attention, neither limit prevents sinks; what stops them lies in the model. We find that the attention scoring function is the main cause. Replacing GRIT's gated logit with a dot product raises its sink rate from 0.09 to 0.68 on identical graphs. In Graph Transformers using dot-product attention, removing the sink gives about the same error as removing a random node, while GRIT's most-attended nodes matter to its predictions. Attention sinks are therefore a property of dot-product attention rather than of Transformers. In our experiments, they form when dot-product scoring has a distinguishable node to concentrate on.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Geometric Distributional Deep Learning (GDDL) workshop at NeurIPS 2026. 8 pages, 1 figure. Code: https://github.com/alexandre-bismuth/graph-transformer-sinks
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 图 Transformer 中的 attention sink 并非 Transformer 架构本身所致，而是打分函数的性质：分子图上把 GRIT 的 gated logit 换成点积，sink rate 从 0.09 升到 0.68（同一批图）。对称性与局部性在理论上限制单个节点能获得的注意力，但在原子可区分、使用全局注意力的分子上这两条都不起作用，真正决定 sink 是否形成的是打分函数。
Motivation: LLM 中注意力大量集中在首 token 的 attention sink 被认为用于防止深层过度混合 (over-mixing)，图 Transformer 面临类似压力，但 sink 在图上是否出现、由什么决定尚不清楚。
Method: 以 SoTA 图 Transformer GRIT 为对象，先证明并实证图的对称性与局部性对单节点注意力的上界，再通过替换注意力打分函数（gated logit 对比 dot product）做受控比较，并做移除 sink 节点与移除随机节点的对照消融。
Result: GRIT 在分子上很少形成 sink，且在更图上训练时 sink 更少，与 LLM 趋势相反；把 GRIT 的 gated logit 换成 dot product 后 sink rate 从 0.09 升到 0.68（同一批图）；在使用 dot-product attention 的图 Transformer 中，移除 sink 节点带来的误差与移除随机节点大致相同，而 GRIT 中被最关注的节点对预测确实重要。
Conclusion: Attention sink 是 dot-product attention 的属性而非 Transformer 的属性：只要 dot-product 打分存在可区分的节点可集中，sink 就会形成。

papers.title: TopicMerge: A Divide and Conquer Approach to Topic Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in topic modeling have split into two main paths: efficient embedding-based methods that offer scalability but are often outperformed on standard clustering metrics, and Large Language Model (LLM) approaches that achieve state-of-the-art clustering performance but at the cost of prohibitive computational expense and poor scalability. This paper introduces TopicMerge, a novel multi-stage pipeline that bridges these approaches to achieve both state-of-the-art clustering performance and computational efficiency. TopicMerge first employs an efficient clustering pipeline to deliberately over-segment a document corpus into a large set of fine-grained, semantically pure micro-clusters, which are then given initial semantic labels. It then introduces a novel, iterative merging algorithm where an LLM, guided by local neighborhood context, arbitrates on consolidating candidate pairs. These approved merges are then selectively executed and semantically relabeled by the LLM, hierarchically building broader, more coherent topics. Extensive experiments on the Bills and Wiki datasets show that TopicMerge achieves state-of-the-art clustering performance while reducing required LLM calls by over 92% compared to document-level methods, offering a practical and scalable solution.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Generalization Analysis of Biased Stochastic Gradient Methods for Minimax Problems
papers.abstract_en: Minimax optimization refers to a class of optimization problems with some variables to minimize and other variables to maximize. Biased stochastic gradient methods have shown practical success in solving minimax problems to either improve robustness, enhance communication efficiency, or decrease computational costs. These successes motivate a lot of theoretical works to study the convergence of biased stochastic gradient methods, while their generalization analysis remains untouched. In this paper, we present the first framework to study the stability and generalization of biased stochastic gradient methods for minimax problems. We establish a connection between stability and generalization for minimax problems by relaxing the existing bounded gradient assumption to a bounded second moment condition. We then introduce a generalized Lipschitz-type condition on bias and gradient estimators, and derive a general stability bound to clarify the connection among bias, gradient estimators, and stability. We apply our general analysis to Zeroth-order and Clipped stochastic gradient descent ascent (SGDA), and derive stability bounds that match those of SGDA under appropriate smoothing/clipping parameters. We combine stability and convergence analyses together, and derive optimal excess risk bounds of order $1/\sqrt{n}$, where $n$ is the sample size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首个针对 minimax 问题上有偏随机梯度方法 (biased stochastic gradient methods) 的稳定性与泛化分析框架：把有界梯度假设放松为有界二阶矩条件，并对 bias 与梯度估计量引入广义 Lipschitz 条件，得到联系 bias、梯度估计量与稳定性的通用稳定性界。应用到 Zeroth-order SGDA 与 Clipped SGDA 后，稳定性界在合适平滑/裁剪参数下与 SGDA 相当，结合收敛分析得到 1/√n 量级的最优 excess risk 界。
Motivation: 有偏随机梯度方法在 minimax 问题上因提升鲁棒性、通信效率或降低计算成本而实践成功，但已有理论只研究收敛性，泛化分析一直空白。
Method: 建立 minimax 问题上稳定性与泛化的联系，将有界梯度假设放宽为有界二阶矩条件；对 bias 与梯度估计量施加广义 Lipschitz 型条件，推导通用稳定性界；再将该分析应用于 Zeroth-order SGDA 与 Clipped SGDA。
Result: Zeroth-order 与 Clipped SGDA 的稳定性界在适当平滑/裁剪参数下与 SGDA 的界匹配；结合稳定性与收敛分析，得到样本量 n 下 1/√n 量级的最优 excess risk 界。
Conclusion: 有偏随机梯度方法在 minimax 问题上的泛化可由统一的稳定性框架刻画，且在合适参数选择下有偏变体不劣于标准 SGDA，excess risk 达到 1/√n 最优阶。

papers.title: MiniDog: Dog-Breed Text-to-image Flow Matching from Pretraining to Fine-Tuning on 4 Consumer GPUs
papers.abstract_en: We generally perceive that training text-to-image diffusion models requires heavy compute: it is true if we aim at a comprehensive frontier model. This understanding prevents people from training their own models when getting started in the field. We develop MiniDog, a framework that enables pretraining diffusion transformers in 55 minutes and fine-tuning in another 15 minutes on four 3090 GPUs. For data, we use 26k dog images from ImageNet and caption them for pretraining and use 2k images generated by FLUX.1-schnell for fine-tuning. We precompute the image and text features and cache them for efficiency. For architecture, we use E2E-INVAE for its semantic latent space, a small transformer with 22M parameters, a small Qwen model for text encoding, and in-context conditioning. For training, we use iREPA and an EUPE perception encoder for acceleration. For evaluation, our repository supports FID, HPSv2 score, PickScore, and various VAE reconstruction metrics. The project is open-sourced at https://github.com/Reyhaneesmailizadeh/MiniDog. We do not claim technical novelty.
papers.comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Education Track. Project Page: https://reyhaneesmailizadeh.github.io/MiniDog. Code: https://github.com/Reyhaneesmailizadeh/MiniDog
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MiniDog 把文本到图像 diffusion transformer 的训练成本压到消费级硬件：四张 RTX 3090 上预训练 55 分钟、微调 15 分钟，用 26k 张 ImageNet 狗图像做预训练、2k 张 FLUX.1-schnell 生成图像做微调。作者明确声明不主张技术新颖性，定位是让入门者能自己训起模型的教育性开源框架。
Motivation: 「训练文本到图像模型需要大量算力」这一普遍认知把初学者挡在门外，而该认知只对前沿综合模型成立；教学场景需要一个在四张消费级 GPU 上就能跑通的完整预训练加微调流程。
Method: 架构上用 E2E-INVAE 提供语义 latent space、22M 参数的小型 transformer、小型 Qwen 做文本编码与 in-context conditioning；训练上用 iREPA 与 EUPE perception encoder 加速，并预计算、缓存图像与文本特征。数据为 26k 张 ImageNet 狗图像（预训练，配 caption）与 2k 张 FLUX.1-schnell 生成图像（微调）。
Result: 四张 3090 GPU 上预训练 55 分钟、微调再 15 分钟；模型 22M 参数；数据规模 26k 预训练图像与 2k 微调图像。评测侧仓库支持 FID、HPSv2 score、PickScore 及多种 VAE 重建指标，摘要未给出这些指标的具体数值。
Conclusion: 在狗这一窄域上，消费级四卡配合特征缓存与加速训练技巧足以完成 diffusion transformer 的预训练加微调全流程；作者自陈不主张技术新颖性，贡献在于可复现的教学级开源管线。

papers.title: Plan-Bench: Can Existing VLMs Go Well Beyond Perception to Reason and Plan in Embodied Worlds?
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in visual perception and spatial reasoning, leading to growing interest in using them as high-level planners for embodied AI. However, physical tasks require models to integrate spatial information, reason over temporal states, and generate multi-step plans under various constraints, raising the question of whether current VLMs can reliably support such reasoning and planning independently of execution. We introduce Plan-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating the high-level reasoning and multi-step planning capabilities of VLMs relevant to embodied worlds, while isolating the influence of action execution. It covers three complementary dimensions, spanning 16 subclasses and 699 curated samples. Extensive evaluation of 28 VLMs reveals room for improvement, with even the strongest model achieving only 75.0% accuracy. We further find that model scaling generally improves these capabilities. Ablation studies also indicate larger models show increasing potential as high-level planners. Overall, Plan-Bench provides a lightweight probe for evaluating VLMs' reasoning and planning capabilities relevant to embodied environments and assessing their potential as decision makers for physical tasks. Our benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/MinneFeng/Plan-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Plan-Bench：一个把动作执行剥离出去、只测 VLM 在具身世界中高层推理与多步规划能力的轻量基准，覆盖三个互补维度、16 个子类、699 个精选样本。对 28 个 VLM 的评测显示普遍有提升空间，最强模型准确率仅 75.0%；模型规模扩大总体上能改善这些能力。
Motivation: VLM 在视觉感知与空间推理上已很强，被当作具身 AI 的高层规划器，但物理任务要求整合空间信息、跨时间状态推理并在约束下生成多步计划，现有评测无法区分规划能力与动作执行的影响。
Method: 构建 Plan-Bench，覆盖三个互补维度、16 个子类、699 个精选样本，把动作执行的影响隔离在外，只考察高层推理与多步规划；对 28 个 VLM 做广泛评测，并做规模与消融研究。
Result: 评测 28 个 VLM，最强模型准确率仅 75.0%，显示明显提升空间；模型规模扩大总体上提升这些能力，消融研究显示更大模型作为高层规划器的潜力更高。
Conclusion: 现有 VLM 作为物理任务的高层决策者仍不可靠，规模扩大是改善路径之一；Plan-Bench 可作为评估该能力的轻量探针。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RoboSimStudio: An Interactive Toolkit for Human and Agent Rapid Real2Sim of Robot Manipulation Tasks
papers.abstract_en: It has been difficult to accurately model the physics of the interaction between a robot and the objects it manipulates, including contact mechanics, coupled contact dynamics, deformations, stiffness and friction. We present RoboSimStudio (RSS), an interactive toolkit that makes choices of solver, contact model, and physical parameters explicit and editable, allowing both humans and coding agents to quickly create and iteratively refine simulations based on observed physical behavior. We implement RSS with the open Newton physics simulation system and describe experiments with human-guided real2sim using (1) visual evaluation, (2) force-feedback and (3) agentic Real2Sim2Real. Code, video and additional information can be found on the project website: https://robosimstudio.github.io
papers.comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Project website: https://robosimstudio.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoboSimStudio (RSS) 把仿真求解器、接触模型与物理参数做成显式可编辑的交互工具包，让人类与 coding agent 对照真实观察到的物理行为快速搭建并迭代 real2sim 仿真。基于开源 Newton 物理仿真系统实现，并给出三种人引导 real2sim 实验路径：视觉评估、力反馈、以及 agentic Real2Sim2Real。
Motivation: 机器人与被操作物体之间的接触力学、耦合接触动力学、形变、刚度与摩擦难以准确建模，仿真参数选择往往不透明，人和 agent 都难以快速对齐真实物理行为。
Method: RSS 基于开源 Newton 物理仿真系统实现，把求解器选择、接触模型与物理参数暴露为可编辑项；围绕人引导 real2sim 描述三条实验路径：视觉评估、力反馈、agentic Real2Sim2Real。
Result: 描述了基于 Newton 的 RSS 实现，以及人引导 real2sim 的三种实验方式（视觉评估、力反馈、agentic Real2Sim2Real），并公开代码与视频。
Conclusion: 把求解器、接触模型与物理参数显式化并可编辑，是让人和 coding agent 依据真实物理表现快速迭代机器人操作仿真的可行路径。

papers.title: Read the Room Before Your Model Generates
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) generally rely on sampling temperature to regulate the amount of randomness in their outputs. Mainstream methods for selecting temperature typically involve fixed, heuristic global settings and context or token-level calibration, rather than a geometrically interpretable representation of the communicative scenario. In this work, we introduce a simple and interpretable temperature selection framework, the Scenario-Actor, which adapts decoding to the inferred situational characteristics. Scenario-Actor extracts scenario-relevant structures from Transformer hidden states and determines the temperature from scenario embedding, a structured geometric representation of the communicative setting. Empirical results show that on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Scenario-Actor achieves strong goal-completion performance in interactive social scenarios, significant gains on open-ended instruction following, and competitive performance on multi-turn conversation compared to multiple baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Scenario-Actor：从 Transformer 隐状态抽取场景相关结构，构造可几何解释的 scenario embedding，据此逐例决定采样温度，而非沿用固定或启发式的全局温度。在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，该方法在交互式社会场景的目标完成、开放式指令跟随上取得显著提升，多轮对话表现与多个基线相当。
Motivation: 主流温度选择依赖固定启发式全局设置或上下文/token 级校准，缺少对交际场景本身的几何可解释表示，导致解码随机性与实际沟通情境脱节。
Method: Scenario-Actor 框架从 Transformer 隐状态中提取场景相关结构，编码为结构化的 scenario embedding（交际情境的几何表示），再由该嵌入直接决定采样温度，实现随情境自适应的解码。
Result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上：交互式社会场景目标完成表现强，开放式指令跟随有显著提升，多轮对话与多个基线相比具竞争力。
Conclusion: 把交际场景编码成几何可解释的嵌入并据此选温度，可替代固定全局温度启发式，在指令跟随类任务上带来可见收益。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上：交互式社会场景目标完成表现强，开放式指令跟随有显著提升，多轮对话与多个基线相比具竞争力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把交际场景编码成几何可解释的嵌入并据此选温度，可替代固定全局温度启发式，在指令跟随类任务上带来可见收益。

papers.title: Back-Translation Still Matters: Leveraging Monolingual Data for Low-Resource Machine Translation with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained Large Language Model (LLMs) are effective on many tasks in zero-shot and few-shot settings. For machine translation of low-resource languages, the obvious options are few-shot prompting and fine-tuning on a small parallel set. We ask: what if moderate amounts of low-resource monolingual data are also available? We argue that, rather than continued pretraining, a more effective use of this data is the pre-LLM era technique of back-translation (BT). The current fine-tuned LLM translates monolingual sentences in each language, and the resulting pairs train it in the reverse direction. Updates on the parallel set are interleaved for stable learning. With 1K parallel pairs on Odia and Swahili, BT beats continued pretraining into the low-resource language by 7.7 to 16.4 XCOMET-XXL points in domain. With beam-decoded intermediate translations, it also beats a model with 10 time more parallel data. In-context examples retrieved from the parallel data further improve BT. We also analyze the source, quality and amount of monolingual text. Across five low-resource languages, with Hindi as a high-resource control, and two 3B backbones, BT improves translation into the low-resource language by 16 to 173% XCOMET-XXL over parallel-only fine-tuning. Blind human evaluation on Odia and Sanskrit agrees with the automatic metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在低资源机器翻译中，把中等规模单语数据用于回译 (back-translation, BT) 比继续预训练 (continued pretraining) 更有效：当前微调 LLM 先译单语句得到反向平行对，再与原平行集交替更新。在 Odia 和 Swahili 上仅 1K 平行句对时，BT 在域内比继续预训练高 7.7 至 16.4 XCOMET-XXL 分；跨五种低资源语言、以 Hindi 作高资源对照、两种 3B backbone，BT 相对仅用平行数据微调把译入低资源语言的质量提升 16% 至 173%。
Motivation: 低资源语言通常只有少量平行句对，但可能有中等规模单语数据；常见做法是 few-shot 提示、小平行集微调或继续预训练，作者质疑继续预训练是否是这类单语数据的最佳用法。
Method: 用当前微调 LLM 对各语言单语句做翻译，生成的句对用于训练反方向；与原平行集上的更新交替进行以稳定学习；可选 beam 解码中间译文，并从平行集中检索 in-context 示例进一步增强 BT；分析单语文本的来源、质量与数量，覆盖五种低资源语言（Hindi 作高资源对照）与两种 3B backbone。
Result: Odia 与 Swahili 上 1K 平行句对时，BT 在域内比继续预训练高 7.7 至 16.4 XCOMET-XXL 分；用 beam 解码的中间译文时，BT 还胜过使用 10 倍平行数据的模型；检索式 in-context 示例进一步提升 BT；跨五种低资源语言与两种 3B backbone，BT 相对仅平行微调把译入低资源语言的 XCOMET-XXL 提升 16% 至 173%；Odia 与 Sanskrit 的盲评人工评价与自动指标一致。
Conclusion: 对中等规模低资源单语数据，回译比继续预训练更值得优先采用，且在平行数据极少时配合 beam 解码与检索式 in-context 示例仍能超过十倍平行数据的训练。

papers.title: Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents accumulate progress in persistent task state, yet repeatedly process interaction histories describing how that progress was achieved. This raises a natural question: can long-horizon context instead be organized around reusable progress rather than the history that produced it? In this paper, we introduce CarryOn, an object-oriented context runtime that organizes continuation around reusable task objects. Rather than treating compressed histories or reconstructed accounts of progress as the primary basis for continuation, CarryOn builds a context view from continuation carriers, complementary execution context, and a live tail of recent interactions. A core challenge is keeping this reusable basis valid after its surrounding history is retired: how can CarryOn update the basis without reconstructing the full representation at every fold? CarryOn maintains carrier records across folds, revising affected records against bound evidence and applicable environment checks while carrying forward unaffected records and jointly updating execution context. Experiments on OSWorld 2.0 and BrowseComp-Plus show improved gains of 5.8% and 7.0% while reducing total token usage by 51.9% and 22.9%, respectively. Project page: https://ethannju.github.io/carryon
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CarryOn 把长程 agent 的续跑上下文从交互历史改写成可复用的任务对象：由 continuation carriers、补充执行上下文和近期交互的 live tail 组成上下文视图，历史被折叠后只修订受影响的 carrier 记录而不重建全量表示。在 OSWorld 2.0 与 BrowseComp-Plus 上分别提升 5.8% 与 7.0%，同时总 token 用量下降 51.9% 与 22.9%。
Motivation: 长程 agent 把进度存在持久任务状态里，却每轮重新处理描述进度如何达成的完整交互历史，续跑成本随历史增长而膨胀。
Method: 提出对象化上下文运行时 CarryOn：上下文视图由 continuation carriers、complementary execution context 与近期交互 live tail 构成；跨 fold 保留 carrier 记录，只针对受影响记录结合绑定证据与环境检查做修订，未受影响的记录直接前传并同步更新执行上下文。
Result: 在 OSWorld 2.0 上提升 5.8%、总 token 用量减少 51.9%；在 BrowseComp-Plus 上提升 7.0%、token 用量减少 22.9%。
Conclusion: 长程续跑可以围绕可复用的任务对象而非产生它们的历史来组织，历史退役后仅增量修订 carrier 记录即可维持该基础有效。

papers.title: Does Pretraining Teach Chemical Language Models Chemistry?
papers.abstract_en: Chemical language models (CLMs) are pretrained on large corpora of molecules with the aim of learning representations that transfer to diverse downstream tasks. Here, we systematically study the effects of pretraining using a series of such CLMs across 64 molecular property prediction datasets. We find that the downstream gains of pretraining in CLMs do not scale and performance saturates below gradient-boosting baselines. Across the regimes evaluated, only supervised pretraining on traditional physico-chemical descriptors consistently improves downstream performance for the CLMs tested whereas some forms of pretraining result in models worse than a randomly initialized encoder. While models can resolve molecular structure well, they do so no better than a randomly initialized model, suggesting that, at best, CLMs learn descriptor-like properties in addition to low-level token statistics during pretraining, but surprisingly little chemistry beyond what classical molecular features already capture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 64 个分子性质预测数据集上系统检验化学语言模型 (CLM) 的预训练效果，发现下游增益不随预训练规模增长，性能饱和且低于梯度提升 (gradient-boosting) 基线；只有在传统物理化学描述符上做监督预训练才稳定提升下游表现，部分预训练方式反而不如随机初始化的编码器。
Motivation: CLM 预训练的假设是学到的分子表征能迁移到多样下游任务，但预训练收益是否随规模增长、能否超过经典描述符方法，此前缺少跨数据集的系统检验。
Method: 用一系列 CLM 在 64 个分子性质预测数据集上做受控的预训练效果研究，对比不同预训练方式（含描述符监督预训练）与随机初始化编码器、梯度提升基线，并检验模型对分子结构的分辨能力。
Result: 预训练的下游增益不随规模扩展，性能饱和在梯度提升基线之下；仅描述符监督预训练在所测 CLM 上稳定提升下游性能，部分预训练形式使模型差于随机初始化编码器；CLM 分子结构分辨能力不优于随机初始化模型。
Conclusion: CLM 预训练至多学到描述符式性质加低层 token 统计，几乎没有超出经典分子特征的化学知识，描述符监督预训练才是可靠有效的形式。

papers.title: A Global View of How LLMs Value Human Time
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act as personal assistants; however, little is known about how they capture national-level preferences on a global scale. Given that "time" is a universal and representative concept, we examine LLMs' time preferences by varying only users' country and measuring the compensation LLMs deem appropriate for a 60-minute appointment delay. We then compare LLMs' responses with GDP per capita on Purchasing Power Parity (GDP_PPP), Mean Income, and a literature-based index (Patience Score). Our results across 193 countries and 5 LLMs demonstrate that people's time across the world is evaluated in noticeably different ways among LLMs, as well as varying levels of robustness under prompt variations. LLMs consistently recommend the highest compensation for Europe, but mostly the lowest for Africa. Based on GDP_PPP, LLMs underestimate the value of time for users living in Asia and South America. These findings indicate that geographical patterns are embedded in LLMs and may translate in different treatment in agentic settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 通过只改变用户所在国家、测量 LLM 认为合理的 60 分钟约会延误补偿，发现 5 个 LLM 在 193 个国家上对时间价值的定价存在明显地理差异：欧洲补偿最高、非洲最低，且相对 GDP_PPP 低估亚洲与南美用户的时间价值。作者认为这种地理模式已嵌入 LLM，可能在 agentic 场景中转化为差别对待。
Motivation: LLM 作为个人助手日益普及，但其如何在全球尺度上体现各国偏好所知甚少；时间价值是通用且可量化的切入点，用于检验模型是否隐含地域性差别定价。
Method: 仅改变提示中的用户国家，让 LLM 输出对 60 分钟延误的合理补偿金额，再与 GDP_PPP、Mean Income 及文献构建的 Patience Score 对照；覆盖 193 个国家、5 个 LLM，并测试提示措辞变化下的稳健性。
Result: 在 193 个国家、5 个 LLM 上，时间价值被评估的方式差异明显，且提示变化下稳健性不一；欧洲补偿一致最高、非洲多为最低；相对 GDP_PPP，亚洲与南美用户的时间价值被低估。
Conclusion: LLM 内嵌了与经济发展水平不完全一致的地理性时间定价模式，这种模式可能在 agentic 场景中导致对不同地区用户的差异化对待。
Relevance: 2
