papers.title: Readout Scaling Shapes Sparse Feature Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Readout scaling changes what a sparse autoencoder (SAE) learns, but the benefit of removing it depends on the data. We use readout-canonicalized decision-space (RC-DS) coordinates to remove singular-value gains while preserving retained decision information. At a fixed readout condition number, changing the generating distribution reverses which training coordinates recover known factors best. In our controlled coordinate-matching study, recovery is highest when training restores the space in which the factors were generated. When factors are generated before readout scaling, RC-DS increases mean sparse-factor recovery from 0.506 to 0.913 at condition number 100, compared with centered-logit training under the same budget. An exact wrapper reproduces RC-DS training to numerical precision, isolating training geometry rather than additional information. In neural policies, RC-DS improves mean logit reconstruction under the tested budgets. On three fixed language-model checkpoints, RC-DS has higher mean gain-free reconstruction in all 18 tested task-sparsity settings, while centered-logit SAEs reconstruct output logits better in 17. Small-label-head controls show that longer training reduces the reconstruction gap from 0.0198 to 0.0016. Together, these results show how readout scaling, the data distribution, and training shape sparse learning. RC-DS provides an information-preserving method for studying and controlling the readout's contribution. Separate label-detection and steering tests distinguish these reconstruction effects from task-specific feature usefulness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 学到什么受 readout 缩放支配，而是否该去掉它取决于数据分布。提出 readout-canonicalized decision-space (RC-DS) 坐标，在保留决策信息的同时消掉奇异值增益：当因子在 readout 缩放之前生成、且训练恢复因子生成所处空间时，稀疏因子恢复最好，条件数 100 下平均恢复从 centered-logit 训练的 0.506 提到 0.913。
Motivation: SAE 训练坐标里的 readout 奇异值增益会污染学到的稀疏特征，但直接去掉它是否有益取决于数据分布；固定 readout 条件数时换生成分布甚至会反转哪种训练坐标恢复已知因子最好。
Method: 用 RC-DS 坐标消去奇异值增益并保留决策信息；做受控 coordinate-matching 研究，比较因子在 readout 缩放前后生成两种情形；配一个 exact wrapper 以数值精度复现 RC-DS 训练，把训练几何与额外信息隔离开；另在神经策略与三个固定语言模型 checkpoint 上测 logit 重建，并用 small-label-head 控制与 label-detection、steering 测试区分重建效应和任务特征有用性。
Result: 因子在 readout 缩放前生成时，条件数 100 下 RC-DS 平均稀疏因子恢复 0.913，同预算 centered-logit 训练为 0.506；exact wrapper 以数值精度复现 RC-DS 训练。神经策略上 RC-DS 在所测预算下提高平均 logit 重建。三个固定 LM checkpoint 上，18 个 task-sparsity 设置中 RC-DS 的 mean gain-free reconstruction 全部更高，而 centered-logit SAE 在 17 个设置里输出 logit 重建更好；small-label-head 控制中延长训练把重建差距从 0.0198 压到 0.0016。
Conclusion: readout 缩放、数据分布与训练坐标共同决定稀疏学习的结果，恢复因子生成所处空间时恢复度最高；RC-DS 是保留信息地研究和控制 readout 贡献的方法，但论重建更优不等于论任务特征更有用，后者要靠 label-detection 与 steering 测试单独判定。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.motivation: SAE 训练坐标里的 readout 奇异值增益会污染学到的稀疏特征，但直接去掉它是否有益取决于数据分布；固定 readout 条件数时换生成分布甚至会反转哪种训练坐标恢复已知因子最好。
summary_sections.method: 用 RC-DS 坐标消去奇异值增益并保留决策信息；做受控 coordinate-matching 研究，比较因子在 readout 缩放前后生成两种情形；配一个 exact wrapper 以数值精度复现 RC-DS 训练，把训练几何与额外信息隔离开；另在神经策略与三个固定语言模型 checkpoint 上测 logit 重建，并用 small-label-head 控制与 label-detection、steering 测试区分重建效应和任务特征有用性。
summary_sections.result: 因子在 readout 缩放前生成时，条件数 100 下 RC-DS 平均稀疏因子恢复 0.913，同预算 centered-logit 训练为 0.506；exact wrapper 以数值精度复现 RC-DS 训练。神经策略上 RC-DS 在所测预算下提高平均 logit 重建。三个固定 LM checkpoint 上，18 个 task-sparsity 设置中 RC-DS 的 mean gain-free reconstruction 全部更高，而 centered-logit SAE 在 17 个设置里输出 logit 重建更好；small-label-head 控制中延长训练把重建差距从 0.0198 压到 0.0016。

papers.title: Thinker-WM: A Unified World Model with Shared Multimodal Representations for Embodied Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: World models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied AI, yet existing systems often remain fragmented in the modalities they model and the functions they support. In particular, visual dynamics, geometric structure, and executable action are commonly coupled through separate interfaces or downstream modules rather than being jointly represented and evolved within a shared dynamics model. In this work, we present Thinker-WM, a unified multimodal world model that jointly models and generates RGB, metric depth, and robot action through a shared intermediate Unified Dynamics Transformer with modality-specific encoders and decoders. The model performs multimodal unification at the representation level: appearance, geometry, and action are transformed into a common dynamic representation and jointly evolved by shared parameters, while their distinct output structures are preserved. The same parameterization supports multiple functions, including joint video-action generation, world prediction, policy inference, action-conditioned generation, video-to-action generation, and inverse dynamics. To examine whether the shared representation captures action-related information, we introduce a lightweight motion probe that shows the frozen visual representation contains recoverable motion information. Thinker-WM is trained on a heterogeneous corpus comprising approximately 20K hours of egocentric video, 10K hours of real-robot data, and 1K hours of simulation data, including approximately 4K hours of real-robot data with aligned depth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong performance across embodied world-model evaluations. Thinker-WM ranks first on EWMBench, WorldOlympiad and WorldArena, while controlled studies further demonstrate the benefits of action conditioning, geometric interaction, and multi-function training within the shared representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Thinker-WM 用一个共享的 Unified Dynamics Transformer 把 RGB、metric depth 和机器人动作统一到同一动态表征中联合演化，同一套参数同时支持视频-动作联合生成、世界预测、策略推断、动作条件生成、视频到动作生成与逆动力学。在约 20K 小时第一人称视频、10K 小时真实机器人数据、1K 小时仿真数据（其中约 4K 小时带对齐深度监督）上训练后，在 EWMBench、WorldOlympiad、WorldArena 三个具身世界模型基准上均排名第一。
Motivation: 现有具身世界模型在建模模态与支持功能上割裂：视觉动态、几何结构与可执行动作通常由独立接口或下游模块耦合，而非在共享动态模型中联合表示与演化。
Method: 各模态专用编码器把外观、几何与动作映射到共享的 Unified Dynamics Transformer 中的统一动态表征，由共享参数联合演化，再经各模态解码器保留各自的输出结构；另引入轻量 motion probe，在冻结的视觉表征上检验动作相关信息是否可恢复。训练语料为异构混合：约 20K 小时第一人称视频、10K 小时真实机器人数据、1K 小时仿真数据，含约 4K 小时带对齐深度监督的真实机器人数据。
Result: 在 EWMBench、WorldOlympiad、WorldArena 三个具身世界模型评测上均排名第一；motion probe 显示冻结的视觉表征包含可恢复的运动信息；受控实验进一步显示动作条件化、几何交互与共享表征下的多功能训练各自带来收益。
Conclusion: 把外观、几何与动作在表征层面统一到共享参数的动态模型中，可以在单一参数化下同时支撑多种具身智能功能并取得领先评测表现。

papers.title: CoTL: Compact Token Learning for 3D Scene Representation
papers.abstract_en: We present CoTL, a framework that learns a compact set of tokens that preserves scene geometry and appearance from unposed multi-view images. Our encoder compresses the input images into small per-view sets of latent tokens that aggregate information across views to form a view-consistent scene representation. Each additional view expands the representation with only a small, resolution-independent set of tokens, allowing its capacity to grow with the available observations. To force this compact bottleneck to retain sufficient scene information, a query-based Gaussian decoder uses scene-independent queries to attend to the learned tokens and recover an explicit, renderable set of 3D Gaussian primitives. Novel-view rendering supervision trains the compact representation end to end through the reconstructed Gaussian scene. Experiments on RealEstate10K and ACID show that the resulting compact, unstructured token set supports competitive novel-view synthesis and can serve as the latent space of a generative model for 3D Gaussian scene generation. Together, these results show that 3D Gaussian reconstruction is an effective objective for compact scene representation learning and the learned token space provides a basis for broader downstream tasks in 3D vision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoTL 用编码器把未定位多视角图像压成每视角一小撮 latent token，跨视角聚合出视图一致的场景表示，再由基于场景无关 query 的 Gaussian decoder 把 token 解码成可渲染的 3D Gaussian 集合，并用新视角渲染监督端到端训练。在 RealEstate10K 与 ACID 上，该紧凑无结构 token 集支持有竞争力的新视角合成，并可作为生成式 3D Gaussian 场景生成的 latent space。
Motivation: 未定位多视角图像的 3D 场景表示通常随视角数线性膨胀，缺少一个容量随观测增长、又能保持视图一致且可解码为显式几何的紧凑瓶颈。
Method: 编码器将输入图像压缩为每视角的小规模 latent token 集，跨视角聚合形成视图一致表示；每新增一视角只增加与分辨率无关的少量 token。query-based Gaussian decoder 用场景无关 query 注意力读取这些 token，恢复显式可渲染的 3D Gaussian primitives，训练由经重建 Gaussian 场景的新视角渲染监督端到端完成。
Result: 在 RealEstate10K 与 ACID 上，紧凑无结构 token 集支持有竞争力的新视角合成，并可充当生成式模型的 latent space 用于 3D Gaussian 场景生成。
Conclusion: 3D Gaussian 重建是学习紧凑场景表示的有效目标，学到的 token 空间可作为 3D 视觉中更广下游任务的基础。

papers.title: Principled Design of Expected Improvement for Continuous Simulation Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Expected improvement based on stochastic kriging (SK) surrogate is widely used in continuous simulation optimization, but unknown heteroscedastic noise makes three basic design choices consequential: the incumbent to define improvement, replication allocation, and final recommendation. Existing methods typically either assume the noise levels are known or choose these components separately through heuristic rules or empirical calibration. We instead derive a high-probability upper bound on the simple regret and systematically choose the three components within general rule classes to tighten this bound. We first establish a finite-sample confidence bound for the SK predictor as a foundation for the three design choices. Within general posterior-quantile rule classes, tightening the regret certificate selects a lower-quantile incumbent and an upper-quantile recommendation among sampled designs. The opposing quantiles reflect the different roles of exploratory experiments and the final implemented decision. Under mild conditions satisfied by common kernels, minimizing a tractable kernel-specific bound yields a logarithmic replication order. Based on these design choices, the resulting simple regret matches the existing results under known homoscedastic noise up to logarithmic factors. To our knowledge, this is the first simple-regret guarantee of this form for a continuous-domain EI-type simulation optimization method that learns unknown heteroscedastic variances through replications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对连续仿真优化中 EI 结合 stochastic kriging (SK) 时未知异方差噪声使三个设计选择（incumbent、重复分配、最终推荐）变得关键的问题，作者先给出 SK 预测器的有限样本置信界，再在后验分位数规则类内以收紧简单遗憾上界为准绳统一选择三者：incumbent 取较低分位数、推荐取较高分位数，重复次数按核相关界的最小化得到对数阶。所得简单遗憾在仅差对数因子的意义下匹配已知同方差噪声下的既有结果，作者称这是首个针对连续域 EI 型仿真优化、通过重复学习未知异方差方差的此类简单遗憾保证。
Motivation: 连续仿真优化中仿真输出的异方差噪声未知，而 incumbent 定义、重复分配与最终推荐这三个基本设计选择通常靠启发式规则或经验校准分别决定，或直接假设噪声已知，缺少统一的理论依据。
Method: 先为 stochastic kriging 预测器建立有限样本置信界，作为三个设计选择的基础；在一般后验分位数规则类 (posterior-quantile rule classes) 内以收紧高概率简单遗憾上界为准则选择组件；在常见核满足的温和条件下最小化可处理的核相关界，导出重复次数的对数阶。
Result: 在温和条件下最小化核相关界给出对数阶 (logarithmic) 重复分配；据此得到的简单遗憾与已知同方差噪声下的既有结果至多相差对数因子；incumbent 取较低分位数、最终推荐取较高分位数，二者方向相反以对应探索性实验与最终实施决策的不同角色。
Conclusion: 把 EI 的三个设计选择放进统一规则类并以遗憾证书收紧为准，可在未知异方差方差下得到连续域 EI 型方法的简单遗憾保证，作者称这是该形式的首个结果。

papers.title: ABot-ER: Unified Embodied Reasoning through Agentic Data-Model Co-Evolution
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ABot Embodied Reasoning (ABot-ER), a unified embodied reasoning foundation model that breaks the tension between breadth and depth in embodied reasoning. Embodied intelligence demands the joint mastery of perception, planning, and execution, yet reconciling generality with specialization across this spectrum remains an open challenge. Within a single unified model, ABot-ER commands specialist-level depth across all three competencies, spanning spatial, scene, and temporal reasoning in perception; long-horizon action organization in planning; and point grounding and affordance in execution. The Agentic Data-Model Self-Evolution Engine continuously adapts data strategies to the model's evolving capability state. The Task-Conditioned Adaptive Training Strategy uses task tokens to activate lightweight low-rank residuals over a shared backbone, separating updates from heterogeneous output formats while retaining shared embodied knowledge. Across a systematic evaluation on twelve benchmarks covering three core competencies and five capability dimensions, ABot-ER achieves state-of-the-art overall performance across perception, planning, and execution within a unified parametric framework, demonstrating that breadth and depth can coexist in unified embodied reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ABot-ER 是统一具身推理基础模型，用 Agentic Data-Model Self-Evolution Engine 持续调整数据策略，并以任务 token 激活共享骨干上的低秩残差来隔离异构输出格式的更新。在覆盖感知、规划、执行三大能力与五个能力维度的 12 个 benchmark 上取得统一参数化框架下的整体 SOTA，说明广度与深度可以在单一模型中并存。
Motivation: 具身智能要求感知、规划、执行三方面同时达标，但在统一模型中兼顾通用性（广度）与专家级深度仍是开放难题，通常需要多个专用模型。
Method: 单一统一模型内覆盖感知（空间、场景、时序推理）、规划（长时程动作组织）、执行（point grounding 与 affordance）；Agentic Data-Model Self-Evolution Engine 依据模型能力状态持续适配数据策略；Task-Conditioned Adaptive Training Strategy 用任务 token 激活共享骨干上的轻量低秩残差 (low-rank residuals)，把异构输出格式的参数更新隔离开，同时保留共享具身知识。
Result: 在覆盖三大核心能力与五个能力维度的 12 个 benchmark 的系统评测中，ABot-ER 在感知、规划、执行上均取得统一参数化框架下的整体 state-of-the-art 表现。
Conclusion: 广度与深度可以在统一具身推理模型中并存，无需为每种能力单独建模；靠任务条件化的低秩残差与数据-模型协同演化实现专家级深度。

papers.title: ResearchFlow-Eval: Tracing the Execution Gap in End-to-End Multi-Claim Autoresearch
papers.abstract_en: Autoresearch systems increasingly undertake entire research projects. In practice, scientific research requires systems to pursue multiple interdependent claims through a continuous, multi-stage workflow and revise experiments as evidence accumulates. Existing evaluations of autoresearch systems, however, typically score isolated tasks or final artifacts, leaving these process-level capabilities largely unmeasured. We therefore introduce ResearchFlow-Eval, a fine-grained framework for assessing continuous scientific execution and iteration at both the stage and claim levels. Each evaluation is grounded in a published anchor paper, from which we derive stage-specific rubrics that decompose each research stage into dimensions and separately scored rubric items. Using these rubrics, we score each research stage and examine experimental execution in detail, focusing on multi-claim completion and revisions across attempts. We apply the evaluation framework to general-purpose agent harnesses, skill-augmented harnesses, and systems with research-specific orchestration. Across all evaluated systems, experimental execution consistently lags behind design and planning. Within execution, systems struggle to produce high-quality results and meet claim requirements, and repeated attempts rarely yield measurable improvements. Moreover, neither skill augmentation nor research-specific orchestration reliably yields higher scores. ResearchFlow-Eval thus extends autoresearch evaluation beyond isolated, single-objective runs to continuous workflows in which systems pursue multiple claims and refine their work across iterations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ResearchFlow-Eval 是面向 autoresearch 系统的细粒度评测框架，以已发表论文为锚点，把研究流程拆到 stage 与 claim 两级 rubric 打分，追踪多 claim 执行与跨轮修订。对通用 agent harness、技能增强 harness 与研究专用编排系统的评测显示：实验执行普遍落后于设计与规划，重复尝试几乎不带来可测提升，技能增强与研究专用编排也未稳定提高分数。
Motivation: 现有 autoresearch 评测只给孤立任务或最终产物打分，无法衡量系统在多阶段连续流程中推进相互依赖的多条 claim、并随证据累积修订实验的过程级能力。
Method: 以一篇已发表论文为 anchor，派生 stage-specific rubric，把每个研究阶段拆成维度与独立计分项；据此对各阶段打分并细查实验执行，重点考察 multi-claim 完成度与跨尝试的修订情况，评测对象包括通用 agent harness、技能增强 harness 和研究专用编排系统。
Result: 在全部被评系统中，实验执行得分持续低于设计与规划；执行环节里系统难以产出高质量结果并满足 claim 要求，重复尝试很少带来可测改进；技能增强与研究专用编排都没有可靠地提高分数。
Conclusion: autoresearch 评测应从孤立单目标运行扩展到多 claim、跨迭代的连续工作流，而当前系统的主要短板在执行而非规划，加技能或加编排并不能可靠补上这一差距。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving GNN Inference on Financial Transaction Graphs via Homomorphic Encryption
papers.abstract_en: Anti-money laundering (AML) in financial networks requires modeling transaction patterns that span multiple institutions. In practice, however, banks cannot share account and transaction features due to strict privacy regulations. We propose a privacy-preserving graph neural network (GNN) inference framework tailored to this multi-bank setting. A central server holds the graph connectivity and pretrained model weights in plaintext, while each bank keeps its transaction features encrypted. Inference is then carried out entirely on encrypted features under the CKKS homomorphic encryption scheme, so that no plaintext transaction features or predictions are exposed to the server. The key to making this practical is an edge-centric GNN architecture, wherein message passing is expressed through operations on node--edge incidence matrices. This formulation not only preserves the edge-attributed multigraph structure of transaction networks but also reduces every aggregation step to plaintext--ciphertext matrix products. Since CKKS can evaluate only polynomial circuits, we also approximate each nonlinearity with a composite polynomial of the sign function, which we calibrate per activation site. On the IBM AML benchmark, our model achieves performance competitive with plaintext baselines, and with a consumer-grade GPU, classifies each queried transaction end-to-end in as little as 5.31 seconds, while per-transaction latency can be amortized to 1.65 seconds when optimized for throughput.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向多银行反洗钱 (AML) 场景提出隐私保护 GNN 推理框架：中心服务器持明文图连通性与预训练权重，各银行的交易特征保持加密，全部推理在 CKKS 同态加密下完成，服务器看不到明文特征或预测。关键设计是 edge-centric GNN，把消息传递写成节点-边关联矩阵上的明文-密文矩阵乘，并用 sign 函数的复合多项式逐激活点标定近似非线性。在 IBM AML benchmark 上性能与明文基线相当，消费级 GPU 端到端分类单笔交易最快 5.31 秒，按吞吐优化时每笔延迟可摊薄到 1.65 秒。
Motivation: 反洗钱需要跨机构建模交易模式，但隐私法规禁止银行共享账户与交易特征，明文集中训练/推理不可行。
Method: 中心服务器持图连通性与预训练模型权重明文，各银行保留加密交易特征；推理全程在 CKKS 同态加密上执行。edge-centric GNN 架构把消息传递表达为节点-边关联矩阵运算，使每步聚合化为明文-密文矩阵乘；因 CKKS 只能算多项式电路，用 sign 函数的复合多项式近似每个非线性，并按激活点逐个标定。
Result: 在 IBM AML benchmark 上性能与明文基线相当；消费级 GPU 上端到端分类每笔查询交易最快 5.31 秒，按吞吐优化后每笔延迟可摊薄至 1.65 秒；服务器不暴露任何明文交易特征或预测。
Conclusion: 把聚合限制在明文-密文矩阵乘并逐点标定多项式非线性，可在 CKKS 上跑出与明文基线相当、延迟秒级的多银行 AML GNN 推理。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Scaling Vision Transformers Without Training: Prune-and-Merge Token Compression
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers achieve strong performance but incur high computational costs from quadratic token interactions. Training-free token reduction methods improve efficiency, but their robustness remains underexplored. We propose Prune-and Merge ViT, a training-free framework for off-the-shelf models. It combines class attention-based pruning with similarity-based merging to reduce redundancy while preserving semantic information. To evaluate robustness we introduce two metrics. Relative Accuracy Drop (RAD) measures relative accuracy degradation under transformations, and Prediction Flip Rate (PFR) quantifies prediction consistency. On pretrained ViT and DeiT, Prune-and-Merge reduces computation competitively while maintaining robustness and better accuracy than existing token reduction methods. Our analysis suggests that hybrid token reduction does not introduce hallucination-like behavior and preserves prediction stability for common image transformations.
papers.comment: Accepted at the GlobalSouthAI Workshop at NeurIPS 2026; 12 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Prune-and-Merge ViT：一种面向现成 Vision Transformer 的免训练 token 压缩框架，把基于 class attention 的剪枝与基于相似度的合并结合，在削减冗余的同时保留语义。作者提出 RAD（Relative Accuracy Drop）与 PFR（Prediction Flip Rate）两个鲁棒性指标，在预训练 ViT 与 DeiT 上显示该方法在压缩计算量的同时保持鲁棒性，且准确率优于已有 token reduction 方法。
Motivation: Vision Transformer 的 token 二次交互带来高计算开销，免训练 token reduction 能提效，但其对常见图像变换的鲁棒性一直缺少量化手段。
Method: Prune-and-Merge ViT 面向 off-the-shelf 模型，先用 class attention 判定并剪掉低信息 token，再对剩余 token 做相似度合并；鲁棒性用新提出的 RAD（变换下的相对精度下降）与 PFR（预测翻转率）两个指标度量。
Result: 在预训练 ViT 与 DeiT 上，Prune-and-Merge 以有竞争力的计算量削减保持鲁棒性，且准确率优于已有 token reduction 方法；分析显示该混合式 token reduction 不引入类幻觉行为，并在常见图像变换下保持预测稳定性。
Conclusion: 免训练的混合式 token 剪枝加合并可以在压缩 ViT 计算的同时保住预测稳定性，鲁棒性应作为 token reduction 的独立评价维度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Data-Free Continual Learning for World Action Model with Rectified Generative Replay
papers.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) built on pretrained video generation models adapt quickly to new robotic tasks, but they forget previously learned tasks under sequential fine-tuning. Experience replay (ER) mitigates such forgetting by rehearsing data of previous tasks, yet this data is often unavailable in robotics, where a policy is deployed as weights only and its training data is not shared along with it. In this work, we ask whether a WAM can achieve data-free continual learning by regenerating its own past. Our key observation is that a WAM can indeed autoregressively regenerate complete rollouts of previously learned tasks and replay them to mitigate forgetting. However, replaying such raw rollouts still lags far behind replaying real data, which we attribute to two issues. First, the WAM is unable to recognize task completion and keeps generating purposeless motion after the task is done. Second, under open-loop generation, the generated actions gradually drift away from the generated observations. To address both issues, we present rectified generative replay (R$^2$-WAM), which truncates generated rollouts at task completion with an agentic evaluator and filters out rollouts whose actions are physically inconsistent with the observations. On the four LIBERO suites and five real-world tasks, R$^2$-WAM reduces forgetting by over 90% relative to sequential fine-tuning and nearly matches ER without accessing any data from previous tasks. Our analysis further reveals that forgetting in WAMs concentrates in inverse dynamics modeling: a forgotten WAM still produces visually plausible observations of previous tasks while its generated actions fail. Project page: https://kaipengfang.github.io/r2-wam/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: R²-WAM 让世界动作模型 (world action model) 在不接触旧任务数据的前提下做持续学习：用模型自回归重生成旧任务完整 rollout，再用 agentic evaluator 在任务完成处截断、并过滤动作与观测物理不一致的 rollout。在 LIBERO 四个 suite 与五个真实任务上，相对顺序微调遗忘降低 90% 以上，接近使用真实数据的经验回放 (experience replay)。
Motivation: 世界动作模型顺序微调新机器人任务时会遗忘旧任务，而经验回放需要旧训练数据，机器人策略往往只以权重形式部署、数据不随策略分发。
Method: 让 WAM 自回归重生成旧任务 rollout 作为回放数据；R²-WAM 用 agentic evaluator 判定任务完成并在该点截断，同时过滤动作与生成观测物理不一致的 rollout，替代原始 rollout 回放。
Result: 在 LIBERO 四个 suite 与五个真实任务上，相对顺序微调遗忘减少 90% 以上，且不访问任何旧任务数据即可接近经验回放的效果；分析显示遗忘集中在逆动力学建模：被遗忘的 WAM 仍能生成旧任务视觉上合理的观测，但生成的动作失效。
Conclusion: 数据无关的生成式回放在机器人 WAM 上可行，前提是修掉任务完成判定与开环动作漂移两个问题；WAM 的遗忘主要发生在逆动力学而非观测生成。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Cumulus parameterization controls simulated rainfall more than microphysics, but not at heavy thresholds: a 3 * 2 factorial WRF study over the Western Himalaya
papers.abstract_en: Rainfall forecasts over the Western Himalaya remain poor, and the relative contributions of the cumulus and microphysics parameterizations to that error are not well constrained.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 3×2 因子 WRF 试验分离积云对流参数化与微物理方案对西喜马拉雅降水模拟误差的相对贡献，发现积云参数化对模拟降水的控制强于微物理，但在高降水阈值下这一主次关系不再成立。
Motivation: 西喜马拉雅降水预报偏差大，而积云与微物理两类参数化各自贡献多少误差一直没有被约束清楚。
Method: 在 WRF 中设计 3×2 因子试验，即 3 种积云参数化方案与 2 种微物理方案的组合，对西喜马拉雅区域做模拟，以因子设计分离两类方案的主效应与交互。
Result: 积云参数化对模拟降水的控制强于微物理方案；但在高降水阈值下，积云参数化的主导地位不再保持。
Conclusion: 改进西喜马拉雅降水模拟应优先处理积云参数化选择，而高降水阈值的偏差需另从微物理及二者交互入手。
Relevance: 62

papers.title: Interaction-as-a-Judge
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are tasked with producing sophisticated interactive applications such as websites, desktop applications, and games. While humans assess these applications interactively, current automated LLM evaluations primarily focus on code analysis and unit tests. This mismatch can cause LLM judges to miss failures that are immediately apparent to human users. We study Interaction-as-a-Judge, an evaluation paradigm where computer-use agents (CUAs) directly interact with an application. We demonstrate that Interaction-as-a-Judge can improve both evaluation and generation of interactive applications. To this end, we collect and release two complementary datasets: $6,858$ pairs of applications with human preferences and corresponding agent traces, and $222$ applications with human-verified requirement labels. Relative to standard non-interactive approaches, we find that Interaction-as-a-Judge improves evaluation in terms of predicting human preferences ($65.6\% \to 69.1\%$) and requirement verification ($77.0\% \to 81.6\%$). We also observe scaling benefits: across both preference alignment and requirement verification, higher-quality interactions improve performance. Finally, through both inference- and training-time experiments, we demonstrate that Interaction-as-a-Judge can also improve the quality of generated artifacts. At inference time, Interaction-as-a-Judge repairs $75.5\%$ of broken requirements within five attempts, compared to $55.4\%$ for code-only self-feedback. At training time, using Interaction-as-a-Judge as a reward signal improves win-rate over the base model by $6.7$pp while reducing both generated code length by $35.7\%$ and build failure rates by $7.2$pp compared to a code-only reward signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Interaction-as-a-Judge：让 computer-use agents (CUAs) 直接操作应用来评测交互式应用（网站、桌面应用、游戏），而非只读代码和跑单元测试。人类偏好预测从 65.6% 提到 69.1%，需求验证从 77.0% 提到 81.6%；作为奖励信号训练时胜率比基座模型高 6.7pp，代码长度降 35.7%，构建失败率降 7.2pp。
Motivation: 当前 LLM 自动评测只看代码和单元测试，而人类是通过实际操作来评估应用的，这种错配让评测漏掉用户一上手就能发现的失败。
Method: 定义 Interaction-as-a-Judge 评测范式，由 CUA 直接与应用交互；发布两个数据集：6,858 对带人类偏好标注的应用及对应 agent traces，以及 222 个带人工核验需求标签的应用；同时做推理时（自我反馈修复）与训练时（作为 reward signal）实验。
Result: 相对非交互评测：人类偏好预测 65.6% → 69.1%，需求验证 77.0% → 81.6%；交互质量越高性能越好（scaling benefits）。推理时 5 次尝试内修复 75.5% 的破损需求，代码-only 自我反馈为 55.4%。训练时作为 reward signal 胜率比基座模型高 6.7pp，代码长度减少 35.7%，构建失败率降低 7.2pp（对比 code-only reward）。
Conclusion: 让 agent 通过实际交互而非静态代码分析来评测，能同时提升交互式应用的评测准确性与生成质量，且在推理和训练两个阶段都有效。

papers.title: RT-J: Large-Scale Pretraining of Relational Transformers for Context-Efficient Predictions
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models for tables and relational databases are increasingly used for predictive tasks across various scientific and industrial domains. However, adapting existing models to unseen datasets requires tens of thousands of examples. Here we introduce RT-J, an 85M-parameter relational foundation model (RFM) that makes accurate predictions even with hundreds of in-context examples or fewer. To achieve this, we first assemble the Join, a large collection of 639 web-crawled databases with 6,023 LLM-generated forecasting tasks. We pretrain with long contexts of up to 8,192 database cells, using in-context examples from a novel lightweight random-walk retriever. Finally, we leverage context tuning and ensembling to scale up test-time compute. On in-context regression tasks from RelBench, RT-J requires 10x fewer examples on average to match strong feature engineering pipelines with LLM-agent or RDBLearn featurizers and TabICLv2 or LightGBM predictors. Overall, our work pushes the frontier for context-efficient predictions on relational data and highlights the importance of real-world semantics, context engineering and large-scale pretraining for RFMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RT-J 是一个 85M 参数的关系型基础模型 (relational foundation model)，在最多 8,192 个数据库单元的长上下文上预训练，配合轻量随机游走检索器选取上下文样例，用上下文调优与集成扩展测试时计算。在 RelBench 的上下文回归任务上，平均只需十分之一的样例即可追平由 LLM-agent 或 RDBLearn 特征化器加 TabICLv2 或 LightGBM 的强特征工程管线。
Motivation: 表格与关系数据库基础模型适配到未见过的数据集通常需要上万个样例，样例效率低限制了其在真实关系数据上的可用性。
Method: 构建 Join：639 个网络爬取数据库、含 6,023 个 LLM 生成的预测任务；预训练上下文最长 8,192 个数据库单元，上下文样例由新的轻量随机游走检索器 (random-walk retriever) 选取；再用 context tuning 与 ensembling 扩展测试时计算。
Result: 在 RelBench 的上下文回归任务上，RT-J 平均只需 1/10 的样例即可匹配强特征工程管线（LLM-agent 或 RDBLearn 特征化器 + TabICLv2 或 LightGBM 预测器）；模型参数量 85M，预训练语料含 639 个数据库与 6,023 个任务。
Conclusion: 真实语义、上下文工程与大规模预训练是把关系型基础模型的样例需求从上万降到数百以内的关键，上下文高效预测在关系数据上可行。

papers.title: MMTA: Benchmarking Multimodal Temporal Analysis with Time Series, Text, and Vision
papers.abstract_en: Time-series analysis is increasingly studied in multimodal settings, yet most benchmarks pair temporal signals with text or with visualizations derived from the same signal. This leaves open whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can integrate time series with real-world visual evidence. We introduce MMTA (multimodal temporal analysis), a benchmark of tri-modal tasks with diverse cross-modal complementarity patterns among time series, text, and vision. MMTA spans nine domains -- robotics, autonomous driving, human action, manufacturing, AR assistance, healthcare, recommendation, finance, and climate -- under video+TS and image+TS layouts, with a 3,524-sample test split covering classification and forecasting. The benchmark standardizes heterogeneous real-world sources into a shared schema with domain-specific prompts, provenance documentation, and success-weighted metrics that penalize both wrong answers and failed generations. Evaluating eight open-source and proprietary MLLMs reveals a shared bottleneck: representing time series as text creates very long token sequences and weakens fine-grained alignment with visual evidence, especially in long-video settings. We then introduce TimeOmni-v, a multimodal LLM extension with a dedicated time-series encoder, temporal positional alignment, modality-aware token layout, and a forecasting head. TimeOmni-v improves long-video classification and time-series inference efficiency, showing that MMTA not only exposes representation and grounding failures but also motivates targeted model design.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track. Project page: https://windowso.github.io/MMTA/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MMTA 是一个三模态（时间序列+文本+视觉）时序分析基准，覆盖 9 个领域、3,524 条测试样本，任务含分类与预测。评测 8 个 MLLM 暴露出共同瓶颈：把时间序列转成文本会产生超长 token 序列，削弱与视觉证据的细粒度对齐，长视频场景尤其严重；为此提出的 TimeOmni-v（专用时序编码器+时序位置对齐+模态感知 token 布局+预测头）改善了长视频分类与时序推理效率。
Motivation: 现有基准多把时序信号与文本配对，或与由同一信号派生的可视化配对，无法检验 MLLM 能否把真实世界视觉证据与时序信号整合。
Method: 构建 MMTA：在 robotics、autonomous driving、human action、manufacturing、AR assistance、healthcare、recommendation、finance、climate 九个领域下组织 video+TS 与 image+TS 两类布局，统一异构真实数据源到共享 schema，配领域特定 prompt、provenance 文档，以及同时惩罚错误答案与生成失败的 success-weighted 指标。另提出 TimeOmni-v：专用时序编码器、temporal positional alignment、modality-aware token layout 与 forecasting head。
Result: 测试集 3,524 条样本，覆盖分类与预测。评测 8 个开源与闭源 MLLM，发现共同瓶颈：时间序列表示为文本导致 token 序列过长、与视觉证据的细粒度对齐变弱，长视频设定下更明显。TimeOmni-v 改善了长视频分类与时序推理效率。
Conclusion: MMTA 不仅暴露了 MLLM 在时序表征与视觉 grounding 上的失败模式，也说明需要针对性的模型设计（专用时序编码与 token 布局）而非把时序转成文本。

papers.title: QK-Edit: Revisiting Attention-based Injection in MM-DiT for Image and Video Editing
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) have recently emerged as a powerful framework for unified text-vision synthesis, surpassing traditional U-Net architectures in generative tasks. One key innovation lies in its Multimodal Self-Attention (MM-SA) interaction, where image and text tokens are concatenated and processed via self-attention. However, this mechanism poses significant challenges for editing, rendering conventional U-Net-based attention manipulation methods ineffective. To address this limitation, we propose QK-Edit, a training-free framework that exploits the unique attention dynamics of MM-DiTs for precise text-guided image and video editing. By introducing a novel query-key manipulation strategy, our method isolates and adjusts critical attention components to achieve an optimal balance between prompt fidelity and structural consistency. This enables seamless edits across various tasks, including object addition, object removal, object replacement, changing background, changing material, changing color, and style transformation. Notably, it can be easily implemented with feature replacement in inference. QK-Edit demonstrates superior editing performance on state-of-the-art models, such as FLUX and HunyuanVideo, effectively bridging the gap between generative power and editable flexibility in MM-DiTs, and paving the way for scalable multimodal content creation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QK-Edit 是一个免训练的 MM-DiT 注意力编辑框架，通过操纵多模态自注意力 (MM-SA) 中的 query-key 分量，在图像与视频上实现文本引导编辑。它可在推理时以特征替换方式实现，覆盖物体增删换、背景/材质/颜色/风格变换等任务，并在 FLUX 与 HunyuanVideo 上展示优于现有方法的编辑效果。
Motivation: MM-DiT 把图像与文本 token 拼接后做自注意力，使传统基于 U-Net 的注意力操控方法失效，文本引导编辑难以同时保证 prompt 保真与结构一致。
Method: 提出免训练的 query-key 操控策略，隔离并调整 MM-SA 中的关键注意力分量，在推理阶段用特征替换实现，无需重新训练模型。
Result: 在 FLUX 与 HunyuanVideo 等 SOTA 模型上展示 superior 编辑性能，支持物体添加、移除、替换、换背景、换材质、换颜色与风格转换等任务；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 针对 MM-DiT 的 query-key 注意力操控能弥合生成能力与可编辑性之间的差距，使免训练的图像与视频编辑可扩展到多种任务。

papers.title: SkillScreen: High-Recall Screening of Malicious Agent Skills with Decision Models
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills turn natural-language instructions into actions, creating a security challenge: legitimate automation and malicious behaviour can look deceptively similar. A practical screen must catch nearly every attack while keeping the review load manageable. We present SkillScreen, a compact decision model trained to score skill maliciousness directly from SKILL$.$md in a single forward pass. On MaliciousSkillBench, SkillScreen flags 20-25% of benign skills at 99% recall on unseen attack families, substantially fewer than the word-level classifier and prompted LLM judges tested. Under the same training protocol, it also generalizes better than a fully fine-tuned encoder to unseen sources. Yet unfamiliar benign sources sharply increase false positives, showing that recognizing new attacks does not ensure reliable screening of new skill collections. Our results demonstrate the value of task-trained decision models for high-recall skill screening. Project page: https://jerroldh.github.io/SkillScreen-webpage/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillScreen 是一个紧凑的决策模型，单次前向直接对 SKILL.md 打恶意分，在 MaliciousSkillBench 上以 99% 召回（未见攻击家族）只误标 20–25% 的良性技能，明显少于词级分类器与 prompted LLM judge。但在同一训练协议下换成未见的良性来源，误报率会大幅上升，说明认得新攻击不等于能可靠筛查新技能集合。
Motivation: Agent skill 的自然语言指令与恶意行为表面相似，安全筛查要在抓住几乎全部攻击的同时把人工复核量压住，而现有词级分类器与 LLM judge 在未见攻击家族上召回与误报难以兼顾。
Method: 训练一个紧凑决策模型直接从 SKILL.md 文本打恶意程度分，单次前向完成打分；与词级分类器、prompted LLM judge 以及完全微调的 encoder 在同一训练协议下对比泛化。
Result: 在 MaliciousSkillBench 上，99% 召回（未见攻击家族）时误标 20–25% 良性技能，少于词级分类器与 prompted LLM judge；同协议下对未见来源的泛化优于完全微调的 encoder；但未见的良性来源会显著抬高误报。
Conclusion: 任务专用的决策模型适合高召回 skill 筛查，但识别新攻击与在新技能集合上保持低误报是两个独立问题，来源变化是当前瓶颈。

papers.title: RoTA-Bench: Evaluating 3D Spatial Reasoning through Interactive Projection Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Can vision-language models turn 2D observations into 3D understanding that supports precise action? This requires inferring object geometry, anticipating the effects of rotation, and refining actions through visual feedback. We introduce RoTA-Bench to evaluate these abilities through interactive 3D-to-2D projection alignment. Given a target silhouette, a model observes a rotated object and chooses successive rotations to recover the target projection within a limited action budget. Our automated pipeline constructs silhouette-preserving 3D objects from 2D icons and uses reversible initialization to guarantee solvability, yielding 674 tasks and a stratified 100-task test set. Empirically, we find that (i) a substantial human-model gap persists: GPT-5.6-Sol succeeds on only 17% of tasks, whereas 20 undergraduate participants collectively complete the test set four times with a 100% success rate; (ii) image-space and pose-space progress can diverge: at matched states, the model more often improves silhouette overlap while worsening pose alignment than humans (19.4% vs. 10.9%); and (iii) fine-grained control is sensitive to interaction history: removing it leaves 96.8% of the model's actions at a coarse 30-degree step size and sharply reduces observed task success. These findings highlight the challenge of converting visual evidence into precise 3D control, beyond recognizing or matching individual images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoTA-Bench 是一个评测视觉-语言模型 3D 空间推理的交互式基准：给定目标轮廓，模型对旋转后的物体连续选择旋转动作，在有限步数预算内恢复目标投影。结果发现人机差距显著——GPT-5.6-Sol 仅 17% 成功率，而 20 名本科生集体四遍完成测试集达 100%；模型倾向于改善轮廓重叠却恶化位姿对齐（19.4% vs 人类 10.9%），且去掉交互历史后 96.8% 的动作退化为粗粒度 30 度步长、成功率骤降。
Motivation: VLM 能识别和匹配单张图像，但能否把 2D 观测转化为支撑精确操作的 3D 理解（几何推断、旋转效果预判、基于视觉反馈的动作修正）缺乏专门评测。
Method: 构建交互式 3D-to-2D 投影对齐任务：从 2D 图标自动生成保持轮廓的 3D 物体，用可逆初始化保证任务可解；模型观察旋转后物体并连续选择旋转动作以匹配目标轮廓。共 674 个任务，含分层抽样的 100 题测试集。

papers.title: RELAY: Selective Self-Distillation with Adaptive Hand-off for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Rubric-based reinforcement learning grades a response against many written criteria but collapses them into one reward, which discards the detail the rubric carries and gives no GRPO reward gradient when a group's responses tie. A frozen teacher that reads the rubric as privileged context provides token-level supervision, but we observe an early plateau in the gains over GRPO. RELAY uses advantages and rewards to select positive-advantage and low-scoring zero-advantage rollouts, and monitors the distillation loss to decide when to retire the teacher. Stage 1 combines selective distillation from a frozen teacher with GRPO; a plateau detector then removes the teacher, and Stage 2 continues with GRPO alone. Calibrated on one model-domain pair and reused unchanged in three others, the plateau detector fires between steps 122 and 171. RELAY scores highest in-domain among the compared methods in all four settings, ahead of GRPO on RaR-Medicine by 4.62 points with Qwen3-1.7B and 6.02 with Qwen3-4B. On Qwen3-1.7B/Medicine, removing the teacher from a shared checkpoint outperforms keeping, weakening or refreshing it. Distilling selected rollouts covering about half the response tokens also outperforms distilling all rollouts at a matched average coefficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RELAY 针对 rubric-based RL 中多条评分标准被压成单一 reward、组内平局时 GRPO 无梯度的问题，用冻结 teacher 读 rubric 提供 token 级监督，并按 advantage 与 reward 选择性蒸馏、按蒸馏损失判定何时撤掉 teacher。在四个模型-领域设置上均为所比方法中 in-domain 最高，RaR-Medicine 上较 GRPO 高 4.62 分（Qwen3-1.7B）与 6.02 分（Qwen3-4B）。
Motivation: Rubric-based RL 把大量书面评分标准折叠成一个 reward，丢掉 rubric 携带的细节，且组内回答打平时 GRPO 拿不到 reward 梯度；直接用冻结 teacher 做蒸馏又会较早进入增益平台期。
Method: RELAY 用 advantage 与 reward 选出正 advantage 和低分的零 advantage rollout 做选择性蒸馏，并监控蒸馏损失决定何时退役 teacher：Stage 1 选择性蒸馏与 GRPO 联合训练，平台检测器 (plateau detector) 移除 teacher 后 Stage 2 只跑 GRPO。检测器在一个模型-领域对上标定，原样复用到其余三个设置。
Result: 在四个设置中 RELAY 的 in-domain 得分均为所比方法最高；RaR-Medicine 上较 GRPO 高 4.62 分（Qwen3-1.7B）与 6.02 分（Qwen3-4B）。平台检测器在第 122 至 171 步之间触发。Qwen3-1.7B/Medicine 上，从共享 checkpoint 撤掉 teacher 优于保留、削弱或刷新 teacher；只蒸馏覆盖约一半 response token 的所选 rollout，在匹配平均系数下也优于蒸馏全部 rollout。
Conclusion: 选择性蒸馏加按损失及时撤掉 teacher，比持续保留 teacher 更能延续 rubric-based RL 的增益；蒸馏只需覆盖约一半 response token。

papers.title: OpenDepth: Repurposing Image Editing Priors for Robust Open-World Monocular Depth Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Recently, the integration of generative priors has revolutionized Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE), achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with remarkably high data efficiency. However, although methods based on Text-to-Image (T2I) models excel in general scenes, their efficacy degrades sharply when confronted with open-world environmental perturbations, such as illumination variations and adverse weather. Since T2I priors are optimized for semantic synthesis rather than preserving pixel-level structure, they struggle to decouple geometry from appearance under severe visual shifts, easily triggering structural hallucinations. Therefore, our core insight is to model open-world depth estimation as consistent geometric inference across multi-style images, fully leveraging the powerful structure-preserving editing priors of Image-to-Image (I2I) models. Based on this, we propose OpenDepth, a robust open-world MDE framework that introduces "Intra-Domain Awareness" -- the capability to map diverse stylistic inputs sharing identical geometry into a unified latent space. To achieve this, we first align shallow features within the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) to anchor degraded observations to unified geometric representations. Additionally, we introduce a joint RGB latent reconstruction task, requiring the model to recover clean RGB information from degraded inputs. This multi-stage strategy effectively decouples environmental style interference, compelling the model to focus strictly on underlying geometric recovery. Extensive evaluations show that OpenDepth sets new SOTA records for robust zero-shot depth estimation across standard and extreme weather benchmarks, demonstrating exceptional structural integrity and adaptability.
papers.comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026. 18 pages, 9 figures, including supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpenDepth 把开放世界单目深度估计 (MDE) 重新表述为跨多风格图像的一致几何推理，借用 Image-to-Image (I2I) 模型的结构保持编辑先验来解耦外观与几何。它在 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 中对齐浅层特征，把退化观测锚定到统一几何表示，并加一个联合 RGB latent 重建任务从退化输入恢复干净 RGB，从而剥离环境风格干扰。在标准与极端天气基准上取得零样本鲁棒深度估计的新 SOTA 记录。
Motivation: 基于 Text-to-Image (T2I) 先验的深度方法在一般场景表现好，但遇到光照变化、恶劣天气等开放世界扰动时性能急剧退化：T2I 先验为语义合成而非像素级结构优化，严重视觉偏移下难以解耦几何与外观，容易产生结构性幻觉。
Method: 提出 OpenDepth 框架，核心是 Intra-Domain Awareness，即把共享同一几何的不同风格输入映射到统一 latent 空间。具体分两步：先在 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 内对齐浅层特征，把退化观测锚定到统一几何表示；再引入联合 RGB latent 重建任务，要求模型从退化输入恢复干净 RGB 信息，以多阶段策略剥离环境风格干扰。
Result: 在标准基准与极端天气基准上的大量评测中，OpenDepth 为鲁棒零样本 (zero-shot) 深度估计创下新的 SOTA 记录，展现出结构完整性与适应性。
Conclusion: 把开放世界深度估计当作跨风格的一致几何推理，并复用 I2I 结构保持先验而非 T2I 语义先验，可以在恶劣天气与光照扰动下同时保住零样本深度的结构完整性与鲁棒性。

papers.title: Cross-View Time-Frequency Diffusion for Extreme-Aware Time-Series Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating realistic time-series requires faithfully reproducing rare but high-impact extreme events. Existing approaches often rely on specialized representations or extreme-focused training objectives, which may restrict the diversity of captured extremes or compromise overall distributional fidelity. We propose Cross-View Time-Frequency Diffusion (CrossTF), a framework that exploits discrepancies between time- and frequency-view denoisers for extreme-aware time-series generation. Our key empirical finding is extreme-sensitive cross-view asymmetry: moving along the direction connecting the two views' clean-sample estimates substantially changes extreme fidelity while having limited effects on overall generation quality. We further identify a late-stage cross-view window in which this discrepancy stabilizes and cross-view adjustments have a particularly strong effect on extreme fidelity. These findings motivate a staged optimization strategy in CrossTF: after training and freezing both denoisers, it only needs to learn step-specific fusion parameters within this window using an Extreme Value Theory-based objective under an energy-distance constraint. This formulation supports interpolation between and extrapolation beyond the view-specific estimates while limiting degradation in overall generation quality. Extensive experiments on seven real-world datasets against 11 baselines show that CrossTF improves extreme fidelity by 26.1% and overall performance by 7.4% relative to the strongest baselines. These results highlight cross-view discrepancy as an effective basis for low-dimensional optimization in extreme-aware time-series generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CrossTF 用时间域与频率域两个去噪器的估计差异做极端事件感知的时间序列生成：沿两视图干净样本估计连线方向移动会显著改变极端保真度，而整体生成质量几乎不变。训练并冻结两个去噪器后，只在稳定的晚期 cross-view window 内学逐步融合参数，用极值理论 (EVT) 目标加能量距离约束。在 7 个真实数据集、11 个基线上，极端保真度较最强基线提升 26.1%，整体性能提升 7.4%。
Motivation: 现有极端时间序列生成依赖专门表示或极端聚焦的训练目标，会限制所捕获极端的多样性或损害整体分布保真度。
Method: CrossTF 利用时间视图与频率视图去噪器之间的差异：先训练并冻结两个去噪器，再在差异稳定的晚期 cross-view window 内学习 step-specific 融合参数，目标函数基于 Extreme Value Theory，并加 energy-distance 约束以限制整体生成质量退化，支持在视图估计之间插值与之外外推。
Result: 在 7 个真实世界数据集上对比 11 个基线，CrossTF 相对最强基线把极端保真度提高 26.1%，整体性能提高 7.4%；核心经验发现是 extreme-sensitive cross-view asymmetry，即沿两视图干净样本估计连线方向移动显著改变极端保真度而对整体生成质量影响有限。
Conclusion: 跨视图差异可作为极端感知时间序列生成中低维优化的有效依据：只需在晚期窗口内调融合参数即可同时改善极端保真度与整体分布质量。

papers.title: SonicWorld: Source-Centric Latent Dynamics for Spatial Audio Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic spatial audio reasoning requires a model to associate changing acoustic observations with the correct source and recover its spatial state at a queried time or interval, a challenge intensified by overlapping speech and source motion. To study this problem, we introduce Sonic-Bench, comprising 2.8K first-order Ambisonics clips and 28.8K target-specific question-answer pairs across 480 simulated indoor scenes. The benchmark covers localization, distance estimation, and motion reasoning in single- and dual-source settings. We further propose SonicWorld, which integrates physical, learned acoustic, and semantic features into persistent source states through learned transitions and recurrent updates, and projects them into an Omni LLM for spatial reasoning. Compared with Spatial-Omni on the Sonic-Bench test split, SonicWorld improves direction accuracy from 31.98% to 34.69% and reduces azimuth error from 57.22° to 48.01°. In zero-shot transfer to Spatial LibriSpeech, SonicWorld retains strong localization performance, achieving 73.98% direction accuracy and 19.29° azimuth error, compared with 27.14% and 70.74° for Spatial-Omni.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SonicWorld 把物理、可学习声学与语义特征融合进持久化的声源状态，经学习到的状态转移与循环更新后投影进 Omni LLM，用于动态空间音频推理。在自建 Sonic-Bench 测试集上方向准确率由 Spatial-Omni 的 31.98% 提到 34.69%，方位角误差由 57.22° 降到 48.01%；零样本迁移到 Spatial LibriSpeech 时方向准确率 73.98%、方位角误差 19.29°，对照 Spatial-Omni 的 27.14% 与 70.74°。
Motivation: 重叠语音与声源运动使动态空间音频推理更难：模型需把随时间变化的声学观测关联到正确声源，并在查询时刻或区间恢复其空间状态，现有基准与方法对此覆盖不足。
Method: 提出 Sonic-Bench：2.8K 段一阶 Ambisonics 片段、28.8K 条针对特定声源的问答对，覆盖 480 个模拟室内场景，含定位、距离估计与运动推理，单源与双源设定。方法 SonicWorld 将物理、学习得到的声学与语义特征融合为持久声源状态，通过学习到的转移与循环更新维护，再投影进 Omni LLM 做空间推理。
Result: Sonic-Bench 测试集上方向准确率 31.98% → 34.69%，方位角误差 57.22° → 48.01%（对比 Spatial-Omni）。零样本迁移到 Spatial LibriSpeech：方向准确率 73.98%、方位角误差 19.29%，对照 Spatial-Omni 的 27.14% 与 70.74°。
Conclusion: 以持久声源状态加学习转移来组织多源特征，能在模拟室内场景的动态空间音频问答上超过直接的 Omni 基线，并在真实语音基准上零样本保持强定位性能。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: EvoQuantLab: Training-Free Dual-Loop Evolution for Auditable Quantitative Research
papers.abstract_en: Automated alpha factor discovery is critical for modern quantitative research. While large language models (LLMs) have increasingly been integrated into quantitative workflows, existing agent-based approaches remain highly susceptible to severe backtest overfitting. To address this challenge, we propose EvoQuantLab, a training-free, dual-loop self-evolving framework for robust factor discovery. Instead of relying entirely on LLM generation, EvoQuantLab deploys an inner genetic-programming (GP) loop that dramatically improves token efficiency while evolving typed factor expressions under structural and diversity constraints. An outer diagnosis loop then systematically audits evidence across cycles to drive protocol-level improvements. Furthermore, our evaluation pipeline applies multi-metric validation to rigorously filter out spurious factors before deployment. Extensive out-of-sample experiments across both daily and hourly frequencies -- covering equities and cryptocurrency -- demonstrate the robustness of EvoQuantLab. Specifically, on daily CSI 500 and S&P 500 tasks, EvoQuantLab achieves leading annualized returns of 18.34% and 21.30%, consistently outperforming existing agent baselines. On high-turnover hourly cryptocurrency data, EvoQuantLab delivers a 37.91% annualized return while effectively avoiding execution collapse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoQuantLab 是一个免训练 (training-free) 的双环自演化因子挖掘框架：内环用遗传规划 (GP) 在结构与多样性约束下演化带类型因子表达式以省 token，外环跨周期审计证据改进协议，再用多指标验证过滤伪因子。在日频 CSI 500 与 S&P 500 上年化收益分别达 18.34% 与 21.30%，高换手小时级加密货币数据上达 37.91%，均超过现有 agent 基线。
Motivation: LLM 已进入量化研究流程，但现有 agent 式因子挖掘极易发生回测过拟合，且完全依赖 LLM 生成导致 token 效率低。
Method: 训练无关的双环框架：内环遗传规划在结构与多样性约束下演化 typed factor 表达式，替代纯 LLM 生成；外环诊断环跨周期系统审计证据以驱动协议级改进；评估管线用多指标验证在部署前剔除伪因子。
Result: 日频 CSI 500 年化收益 18.34%，日频 S&P 500 年化收益 21.30%，均持续超过现有 agent 基线；小时级高换手加密货币数据年化收益 37.91%，并有效避免执行崩溃 (execution collapse)；样本外实验覆盖日频与小时频、股票与加密货币两类资产。
Conclusion: 把演化搜索与跨周期审计放在 LLM 之外，可以在免训练条件下同时提升因子的样本外稳健性与 token 效率，避免回测过拟合与执行崩溃。

papers.title: Learning to Design Convex Relaxations for Nonconvex Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Convex relaxations make nonconvex optimization tractable by replacing hard nonconvex problems with convex surrogates that give valid bounds. Yet their design is still largely manual: a human expert must decide where to relax, which relaxation to use, and how much formulation growth is worth paying. We show that this design process can be learned. The method proposed in this paper, AutoConvexRelax, represents the symbolic formulation of a nonconvex problem as a tripartite graph linking variables, symbolic terms, and their objective or constraint positions. It then learns a policy that composes symbolic rewrites into problem-specific relaxation trajectories as the formulation evolves. We prove that finite action sequences generated by the learned policy preserve relaxation validity under explicit domain, occurrence-context, and representation-consistency conditions. We further establish computable error bounds for mixed relaxations and sufficient conditions for feasible recovery and global-optimality certification. As a first instantiation, we apply the method to nonconvex quadratic problems and fractional problems. On 241 benchmark quadratic instances, the learned policy strengthens McCormick lower bounds by 13.52%. Its mean lower bound is 3.70% below strengthened semidefinite relaxations on the normalized comparison metric, while it uses substantially smaller formulations. The learned policy retains this trade-off on fractional instances and reaches near-semidefinite bounds on beamforming and sensor-network localization instances. These results suggest that convex relaxation design can move from a fixed handcrafted choice to an automated learning process that adapts to problem structures. Code is available at https://github.com/auto4opt/AutoConvexRelax.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoConvexRelax 把非凸问题的符号化形式表示为连接变量、符号项及其目标/约束位置的三部图 (tripartite graph)，用学习到的策略把符号重写组合成随形式演化的问题特定凸松弛轨迹，并证明有限动作序列在显式域、出现上下文与表示一致性条件下保持松弛有效性。在 241 个基准二次问题实例上，学到的策略把 McCormick 下界平均加强 13.52%，归一化比较指标下其平均下界比加强的半定松弛低 3.70%，但形式规模明显更小。
Motivation: 凸松弛把非凸问题替换成给出有效界的凸代理，但松弛设计仍靠人工决定在哪里放松、用哪种放松、以及愿意为形式增长付出多少。
Method: 以三部图表示非凸问题的符号形式，学习一个在形式演化过程中组合符号重写、生成问题特定松弛轨迹的策略；证明有限动作序列在显式域、出现上下文 (occurrence-context) 与表示一致性条件下保持松弛有效性，并为混合松弛建立可计算误差界与可行恢复、全局最优性认证的充分条件；首个实例化面向非凸二次问题与分式问题。
Result: 在 241 个基准二次实例上，学到的策略使 McCormick 下界加强 13.52%；归一化比较指标下其平均下界比加强的半定 (semidefinite) 松弛低 3.70%，同时使用规模小得多的形式。在分式实例上保留这一权衡，并在 beamforming 与传感器网络定位实例上达到接近半定的下界。
Conclusion: 凸松弛设计可以从固定的手工选择转为随问题结构自适应的自动化学习过程，代价是下界略低于半定松弛但形式规模显著更小。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EvoSpatial: Experience-Driven Skill and Tool Evolution for Spatial Reasoning Agents
papers.abstract_en: Spatial reasoning agents can inspect tool outputs and repair errors, but reusing these lessons requires preserving both the computation and the conditions that make it valid. We introduce EvoSpatial, a framework that learns from execution experience by updating a library of linked skills and tools. Skills describe procedures, geometric assumptions, and verification steps; tools implement the operations those procedures require. When solving a task, the agent retrieves relevant skills and synthesizes reusable computational functions if existing tools are insufficient. After each task, execution feedback and evidence checks guide skill revision and tool consolidation, without ground-truth answers or benchmark scores. Across 20 benchmarks, EvoSpatial averages 63.9, 4.0 percentage points above the average reported by SpatialClaw. The evolved library also improves held-out and cross-benchmark performance when updates are disabled, and trajectories generated with evolved skills improve supervised fine-tuning, even without external skills at evaluation. Keeping checked procedures on record, together with the tools that support them, lets an agent carry spatial reasoning experience from one task to the next.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoSpatial 让空间推理 agent 把执行经验沉淀为「技能+工具」联动库：技能记录流程、几何假设与验证步骤，工具实现流程所需操作，任务后由执行反馈与证据检查驱动技能修订与工具合并，全程不用真值答案或榜单分数。在 20 个 benchmark 上平均 63.9，比 SpatialClaw 报告的平均值高 4.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 空间推理 agent 能看工具输出并修错，但复用教训需要同时保住计算本身和它成立的条件，现有做法难以把一次任务的经验迁移到下一次。
Method: 维护一个技能与工具相互链接的库：技能描述流程、几何假设与验证步骤，工具实现这些流程所需操作；解题时检索相关技能，若现有工具不足则合成可复用的计算函数；每个任务结束后用执行反馈与证据检查 (evidence checks) 指导技能修订和工具合并，不依赖真值答案或 benchmark 分数。
Result: 在 20 个 benchmark 上平均 63.9，比 SpatialClaw 报告的平均值高 4.0 个百分点；在禁用更新的条件下，演化后的库仍提升 held-out 与跨 benchmark 表现；用演化技能生成的轨迹可改善监督微调 (supervised fine-tuning)，且评测时不依赖外部技能。
Conclusion: 把经过检查的流程连同支撑它的工具一起留档，agent 就能把空间推理经验从一个任务带到下一个任务。

papers.title: DEFlow: Deep Equilibrium Flow Maximum-Entropy Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Expressive flow policies can represent multiple high-value actions, but sampling them with few integration steps while retaining tractable action densities remains challenging. We introduce DEFlow, a deep equilibrium flow policy that replaces explicit Euler sampling with implicit Euler integration and solves all intermediate actions jointly as an equilibrium system. We combine implicit differentiation with a discrete change-of-variables formula for the final-action density, enabling off-policy training within soft actor-critic without backpropagating through solver iterations. DEFlow achieves an average relative improvement of approximately 10% in mean successful coverage over the strongest baseline across four Multi-Goal docking variants. It also achieves the highest mean time-averaged return on four of five manipulation tasks, while remaining broadly competitive across five MuJoCo tasks. These results support implicit flow policies for tasks requiring both diversity and precision, at the cost of additional nonlinear and linear solves. Primary
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DEFlow 用隐式 Euler 积分把 flow policy 的中间动作整体作为平衡系统联立求解，配合隐式微分与最终动作密度的离散换元公式，在 soft actor-critic 内实现无需反传求解器迭代的 off-policy 训练。在四个 Multi-Goal docking 变体上，相对最强基线的 mean successful coverage 平均相对提升约 10%，并在五个 manipulation 任务中的四个取得最高 mean time-averaged return。
Motivation: 表达性强的 flow policy 能表示多个高价值动作，但用很少的积分步数采样同时保持可解的动作密度很困难，off-policy 训练还要避免对求解器迭代反向传播。
Method: 以 deep equilibrium flow policy 替代显式 Euler 采样，用隐式 Euler 积分把所有中间动作作为平衡系统联立求解；用隐式微分结合最终动作密度的离散换元 (discrete change-of-variables) 公式，在 soft actor-critic (SAC) 中做 off-policy 训练，不对求解器迭代反传。
Result: 在四个 Multi-Goal docking 变体上，mean successful coverage 相对最强基线的平均相对提升约 10%；在五个 manipulation 任务中的四个取得最高 mean time-averaged return；在五个 MuJoCo 任务上整体保持有竞争力。代价是额外的非线性与线性求解。
Conclusion: 隐式 flow policy 适合同时要求多样性与精度的任务，用额外的非线性和线性求解换取少积分步数下的可解动作密度与 off-policy 训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Modality-Agnostic Seizure Classification: A Unified Deep Learning Framework for Heterogeneous EEG and Intracranial EEG Signals
papers.abstract_en: Seizure prediction and detection, essential for clinical treatment of epilepsy, remain the crucial task of this neurological disease. EEG and iEEG are widely used to analyze epilepsy due to its capability of capturing discriminative brain activities at high time resolution. However, existing works generally analyze either EEG or iEEG seizure activity separately, where EEG analysis has been well-researched, while more and more works consider iEEG for its higher specificity at the spatial level and signal quality. Currently, most of the existing seizure prediction systems are single-modal in nature, which limits its application to a variety of clinical conditions. Therefore, a common framework to analyze seizures with both EEG and iEEG signals needs to be developed. This paper presents a new framework of multimodal seizure classification integrating the heterogeneous EEG and iEEG recordings from different subjects and sources. A specific framework, called Unified Multimodal Signal Harmonization (UMSH), is developed for harmonizing signals with varied sampling rates and recording conditions. Moreover, to handle the extremely class-imbalanced problem in the data sets, we use a Conditional Generative Adversarial Network (cGAN) based data augmentation technique to generate synthetic samples to balance the class distribution. The proposed framework uses the EEGNet-Vision Transformer (EEGNet-ViT) as the feature extraction and classification network to learn the local discriminative patterns as well as global contextual information in the multimodal seizure data. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework for robust seizure classification, emphasizing the potential of integrated EEG-iEEG multimodal learning in advancing next-generation epilepsy monitoring and clinical decision-support systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出统一多模态癫痫发作分类框架 UMSH，用信号协调层对齐不同采样率与记录条件的 EEG 与 iEEG，以 cGAN 合成样本缓解类别极不平衡，再由 EEGNet-ViT 同时提取局部判别模式与全局上下文。实验显示该框架能稳健分类跨被试、跨来源的异构 EEG/iEEG 记录，支持 EEG-iEEG 多模态融合用于下一代癫痫监测。
Motivation: 现有癫痫发作预测/检测系统多为单模态，只用 EEG 或只用 iEEG，难以覆盖多样临床条件；而 EEG 与 iEEG 在采样率、记录条件和类别分布上高度异构，直接合并困难。
Method: 框架名为 Unified Multimodal Signal Harmonization (UMSH)：先用专门的信号协调模块处理不同采样率与记录条件的 EEG/iEEG，再用 Conditional GAN (cGAN) 生成合成样本平衡类别分布，最后以 EEGNet-Vision Transformer (EEGNet-ViT) 作为特征提取与分类网络，兼顾局部判别模式与全局上下文。

Conclusion: 把信号协调、cGAN 类别平衡与 EEGNet-ViT 分类整合进一个框架，可以同时处理 EEG 与 iEEG，摆脱单模态癫痫发作预测系统的限制。

papers.title: REVEAL: Reverse Engineering Agentic Latents from Frontier-Model Traces
papers.abstract_en: Frontier LLM agents perform complex interactive tasks, but their inference costs motivate transferring their experience to smaller open-source agents. Distillation and latent communication typically require target-model training or access to source-model internals. We study how textual frontier-model trajectories can provide reusable local controls for a frozen agent. Inspired by protocol reverse engineering, we introduce $\textit{Agentic Latents}$, comprising anchored states and dynamic profiles of feedback--response cycles elicited by replay in the target model. Our training-free framework, $\textbf{REVEAL}$ ($\textbf{REV}$erse $\textbf{E}$ngineering $\textbf{A}$gentic $\textbf{L}$atents), uses these profiles and trajectory outcomes to match and select local events from successful and failed rollouts of the same task and source model. Their response-transition contrasts yield a target-specific steering direction, applied before each response. Within-benchmark evaluations on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and Humanity's Last Exam with tools report higher accuracy than unmodified agents across three targets. Representation analyses and behavioral case studies support reusing frontier-model experience as local activation control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REVEAL 从前沿模型的文本轨迹中反向工程出可复用的局部控制信号：在目标模型上回放轨迹得到 anchored states 与 feedback-response cycle 的动态 profile，用成功与失败 rollout 的响应转移对比合成目标特定的 steering direction，在每次响应前注入冻结的开源 agent。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 与带工具的 Humanity's Last Exam 上，对三个目标模型的评测准确率均高于未修改的 agent，全程无需训练目标模型或访问源模型内部。
Motivation: 前沿 LLM agent 推理成本高，经验难以迁移到小型开源 agent：现有蒸馏与 latent communication 都要求训练目标模型或拿到源模型内部表示。
Method: Agentic Latents 框架：在目标模型上回放文本轨迹，锚定状态并刻画 feedback-response cycle 的动态 profile；用轨迹结果对同一任务、同一源模型的成功与失败 rollout 做事件匹配与选择，取其响应转移对比 (response-transition contrasts) 得到目标特定 steering direction，在每次响应生成前施加于冻结 agent。
Result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 与带工具的 Humanity's Last Exam 上，within-benchmark 评测显示三个目标模型的准确率均高于未修改的 agent；另有表示分析与行为案例研究支撑该控制信号可复用。
Conclusion: 前沿模型经验可以不靠训练目标模型、只凭文本轨迹转成局部 activation control，直接提升冻结开源 agent 的任务准确率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Perfect Teammates: Multi-Agent Collaboration with Unreliable Colleagues
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based multi-agent collaboration is increasingly used to solve complex tasks by dividing work among specialized agents and integrating complementary expertise. Yet existing systems and evaluations largely rest on an implicit perfect-colleague assumption: collaborators provide correct and complete information and respond promptly to requests. In realistic teamwork, however, collaborators may return information that does not answer the intended question, provide insufficient detail to support a decision, or fail to respond to a request. To separate task-solving competence from the ability to recover an unreliable evidence-gathering process, we introduce the Unreliable Colleagues Benchmark (UnCoBench), which organizes behavioral failures through Misaligned, Incomplete, and Missed settings. The main agent need to verify contextual correctness, diagnose information gap and track unresolved dependencies in order to obtain the correct evidence for solving the task. We also introduce a verifiable and scalable automated generation pipeline that pairs LLM-based scenario generation with executable checks of answer uniqueness and role necessity. Results across ten models show that similar reliable-setting performance can result in different robustness to unreliable evidence. Trace analysis reveals frequent omissions of corrective follow-up, and the recovery behavior involves inefficient waiting and redundant queries. These findings show that robust collaboration requires not only sound reasoning, but also targeted action to diagnose evidence failures, recover relevant information, and integrate it into decisions. Our data and source code are available at https://github.com/iNLP-Lab/UnCoBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 UnCoBench，把 LLM 多智能体协作中的不可靠队友行为拆成 Misaligned、Incomplete、Missed 三类，用可执行的答案唯一性与角色必要性检查自动生成任务，迫使主智能体校验上下文正确性、诊断信息缺口并追踪未解决依赖。十个模型显示可靠设定下成绩相近但对不可靠证据的鲁棒性差异明显，轨迹分析发现纠正性追问频繁缺失，恢复行为伴随低效等待与冗余查询。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 多智能体系统与评测默认队友给出正确完整且及时的回复，无法区分任务求解能力与从不可靠证据收集过程中恢复的能力。
Method: 构建 Unreliable Colleagues Benchmark (UnCoBench)，按 Misaligned、Incomplete、Missed 三种失败组织场景；配套可扩展自动生成流水线，将 LLM 场景生成与答案唯一性、角色必要性的可执行检查配对，并对主智能体的恢复行为做 trace 分析。
Result: 在十个模型上，可靠设定下表现相近的模型对不可靠证据的鲁棒性不同；trace 分析显示纠正性追问频繁缺失，恢复行为表现为低效等待与冗余查询。
Conclusion: 稳健协作不仅需要推理，还需要针对证据失败的定向动作：诊断失败、恢复相关信息并整合进决策；数据与代码已在 GitHub 开源。

papers.title: Review Rarely Beats the Stronger Model: Separating Verification from Capability Transfer in LLM Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Qwen3-8B reviewing Llama-3.1-8B in math adds 33.2 points, yet Qwen3-8B alone is 6.4 points more accurate than the result. Reviewing another model's answer is usually judged by its gain over the generator. We show that this confuses verification, which adds accuracy beyond either model alone, with capability transfer, where a stronger reviewer supplies answers it could have given on its own. Measured against the stronger model alone, across 48 pairs of 12 open-weight models (3B to 72B) in math, knowledge, code and reasoning, review beats it in only 9 of 96 review directions, and does worse the larger the capability gap. The reason is anchoring: the reviewer mostly follows the generator, discarding its own correct answers. Review costs 2.6 to 2.8 times as much as the stronger model alone, while a selector using the same two calls is 2.7 to 4.2 points more accurate than review and cheaper. Studies of verification should report the stronger model alone, not only the gain over the generator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 48 个模型对、12 个开源模型（3B–72B）的数学/知识/代码/推理评测中，以更强模型单独作答为基准，review 只在 96 个 review 方向中的 9 个上真正提升准确率，且能力差距越大越差。原因是 anchoring：reviewer 大多跟随 generator、丢弃自己原本正确的答案；review 成本是更强模型单独的 2.6–2.8 倍，而同样两次调用的 selector 反而比 review 高 2.7–4.2 分且更便宜。作者主张验证类研究必须报告更强模型单独的成绩，而不只是相对 generator 的增益。
Motivation: 把 review 相对 generator 的增益当作验证能力，会把「更强模型把自己会的答案搬过去」（capability transfer）误判为真正的 verification；这种评测口径掩盖了 review 相对更强模型本身常常无效的事实。
Method: 在数学、知识、代码、推理四类任务上，对 12 个 3B–72B 开源模型组成 48 个模型对，双向共 96 个 review 方向，比较三种口径：generator 单独、review 结果、更强模型单独；并对照一个用同样两次调用的 selector，同时统计成本倍数。
Result: Qwen3-8B review Llama-3.1-8B 在数学上比 generator 高 33.2 分，但 Qwen3-8B 单独就比该 review 结果高 6.4 分；以更强模型单独为基准，96 个 review 方向中 review 只在 9 个上占优，且能力差距越大表现越差。review 成本是更强模型单独的 2.6–2.8 倍，selector 用同样两次调用比 review 高 2.7–4.2 分且更便宜。
Conclusion: review 的常见增益主要来自 anchoring 下的能力转移而非验证；验证研究应报告更强模型单独的成绩，并优先考虑同等调用预算下更准更省的 selector。

papers.title: Reference-Efficient Multimodal Bitstream-Corrupted Video Recovery via Depth-Conditioned Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Recovering visually faithful content from damaged video bitstreams is important for reliable multimedia communication and storage. Existing methods exploit local residuals and non-local RGB references of the input video sequence, but both sources can become unreliable after decoding, while processing additional references increases receiver computation and memory. This paper studies multimodal bitstream-corrupted video recovery (MBSCVR) using RGB and depth information, where pre-transmission depth-based geometry aids reconstruction when the received appearance is corrupted. We propose a novel MBSCVR framework that selects and effectively utilizes a single selected non-local RGB reference per recovery window to achieve higher performance. It integrates a reliability-aware multimodal selector that combines valid appearance with depth compatibility before reference encoding. Depth-Conditioned Reference Adaptation (DCRA) introduces selected RGB evidence into feature completion and content generation, while frame-aligned depth conditions completion queries. On the complete BSCV benchmark with oracle masks, MBSCVR uses one selected reference to achieve 32.30 dB on YouTube-VOS and 28.93 dB on DAVIS, surpassing full-reference B2SCVR by 0.27 and 0.33 dB and improving SSIM on both subsets. Matched receiver-forward measurements show 36.8\% lower latency and 40.8\% lower peak memory. These results demonstrate how compact geometric guidance and adapted appearance processing improve the quality--resource trade-off of multimedia recovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对码流损坏视频恢复 (MBSCVR) 中多参考带来的接收端算力与内存开销，提出只选一个非局部 RGB 参考的多模态框架：可靠性感知选择器先融合有效外观与深度相容性，再用 Depth-Conditioned Reference Adaptation 把选中 RGB 证据注入特征补全与内容生成，并用帧对齐深度条件补全查询。在 BSCV benchmark（oracle masks）上单参考达 YouTube-VOS 32.30 dB、DAVIS 28.93 dB，超全参考 B2SCVR 0.27/0.33 dB，同时接收端延迟降 36.8%、峰值内存降 40.8%。
Motivation: 解码后输入序列的局部残差与非局部 RGB 参考都可能不可靠，而堆更多参考又抬高接收端计算与内存，质量与资源开销互相拉扯。
Method: 以 RGB 与传输前深度几何为双模态输入，每个恢复窗口只选一个非局部 RGB 参考：可靠性感知多模态选择器在参考编码前合并有效外观与深度相容性；Depth-Conditioned Reference Adaptation (DCRA) 把选中 RGB 证据用于特征补全与内容生成，帧对齐的深度作为补全查询的条件。
Result: 在完整 BSCV benchmark（oracle masks）上，单参考 MBSCVR 在 YouTube-VOS 上 32.30 dB、DAVIS 上 28.93 dB，比全参考 B2SCVR 分别高 0.27 dB 与 0.33 dB，且两个子集 SSIM 均有提升；匹配的接收端-发送端测量显示延迟降低 36.8%、峰值内存降低 40.8%。
Conclusion: 紧凑的几何引导加适配的外观处理可以在少参考条件下同时改善多媒体恢复的质量-资源折中，即用一个选中参考即可超过全参考方案并显著压低接收端开销。

papers.title: Who Sets the Pace of Judge Hacking? Judge Capability versus the Policy-Judge Gap
papers.abstract_en: Under GRPO against a frozen, reference-free LLM judge, RL exploits the judge's false positives. Does the policy-judge capability gap or the judge itself set how fast and how far? We train 0.5B and 1.5B Qwen2.5 policies on GSM8K against four judges at least as large, and the 1.5B policy also against one smaller judge. In a post-hoc analysis, judge acceptance rose, but no cell of 12 gained more than 0.04 in seed-mean held-out greedy accuracy. For the pace, two pre-specified pairs contradict the gap account: the cell with the larger gap was fooled 3.5x sooner at the pre-specified threshold. papers.title: SkillMarker: A KGW-Based Watermarking Method for Agent Skill Ownership Verification
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills encode operational procedures and domain expertise as reusable knowledge assets, yet their distribution in plaintext exposes them to unauthorized copying and leakage. However, practical mechanisms for skill ownership verification and leakage tracing remain underdeveloped. Watermark embedding before distribution offers a potential solution, but structured, compact skill instructions impose stringent requirements for factual and procedural accuracy. To address these challenges, we introduce SkillMarker, a KGW-based watermarking method that jointly targets functionality preservation and strong watermark embedding. SkillMarker unifies quality-constrained rewriting with signal-oriented candidate search. The former separates essential knowledge from flexible expression to preserve instruction fidelity; the latter explores alternative expressions to obtain a stronger watermark signal under preservation constraints. We release an open-source toolkit that integrates watermark embedding, quality auditing, and detection to support the protection of agent skills. SkillMarker targets ownership verification and leakage tracing in distributed skill ecosystems, where content may be copied in whole or in part, or incorporated into other skills. Across four datasets, SkillMarker negligibly affects downstream task performance on average. In our copy-paste tests, window-based detection consistently identifies copied passages containing as few as 1,536 consecutive tokens. Even after merging with one or three background skills, SkillMarker retains watermark detection rates of 72.2--77.8\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillMarker 是面向 agent skill 所有权验证与泄露溯源的 KGW 水印方法，把质量受约束的改写与面向信号的候选搜索结合：前者分离关键知识与可变表达以保住指令保真度，后者在保真约束下搜索更强的水印信号。四个数据集上平均对下游任务性能影响可忽略；复制粘贴测试中窗口检测能识别低至 1,536 个连续 token 的复制片段，与 1 个或 3 个背景 skill 合并后检测率仍达 72.2–77.8%。
Motivation: agent skill 以明文分发易被未授权复制与泄露，但 skill 所有权验证与泄露溯源机制尚不成熟；结构化、紧凑的 skill 指令又对事实与流程准确性要求苛刻，普通水印改写容易破坏功能。
Method: 基于 KGW 水印框架，联合两个组件：质量受约束的改写 (quality-constrained rewriting) 把必要知识与可变表达分离以保持指令保真，面向信号的候选搜索 (signal-oriented candidate search) 在保真约束下探索替代表达以获得更强水印信号；开源工具集成了水印嵌入、质量审计与检测。
Result: 在四个数据集上，SkillMarker 平均对下游任务性能的影响可忽略；复制粘贴测试中基于窗口的检测一致识别出低至 1,536 个连续 token 的复制段落；与 1 个或 3 个背景 skill 合并后，水印检测率保持在 72.2–77.8%。
Conclusion: 在分发前嵌入水印可以在不损害 skill 功能的前提下支撑所有权验证与泄露溯源，且对部分复制和与其它 skill 合并这类混合场景仍保持可检出性。

papers.title: ProtoPur: Prototype-Purity Pseudo-Labeling for Weakly Supervised Instance Learning in Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Weak bag-level labels are widely available in computational pathology, whereas reliable instance-level annotations for whole-slide images remain expensive and ambiguous. Weakly supervised multiple instance learning (MIL) achieves strong bag-level classification, but instance-level supervision from attention scores, model predictions, negative bags, or spatial refinement may fail to identify class-specific local evidence. We propose ProtoPur, a prototype-purity pseudo-labeling method for weakly supervised instance-level learning in pathology whole-slide images. ProtoPur estimates class-balanced local purity over prototype regions constructed from frozen foundation-model features, and assigns pseudo-labels to high-purity regions strongly associated with a target class. This purity-first design separates class-specific evidence from negative or shared morphology, with coverage used only to ensure sufficient pseudo-label assignment. We provide a PAC-style analysis showing that the risk of an instance classifier trained with ProtoPur pseudo-labels can be decomposed into a standard uniform-convergence term and a ProtoPur-specific pseudo-label noise term, comprising selected-region mismatch and a coverage residual. Experiments on three public whole-slide image datasets with two pathology foundation encoders show that ProtoPur consistently improves instance-level performance across multiple MIL backbones while maintaining competitive bag-level performance. Pseudo-label quality comparisons on two public datasets further demonstrate that prototype-purity selection provides stronger instance supervision. These results suggest that the foundation-model features contain exploitable instance-level supervision signals, and ProtoPur is a way to reveal and use these signals from weak bag labels without requiring dense instance annotations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProtoPur 在病理全切片图像 (WSI) 的弱监督实例学习中，用冻结 foundation-model 特征构建原型区域，估计类平衡的局部纯度 (prototype-purity)，只给高纯度且与目标类强关联的区域赋伪标签，coverage 仅用于保证伪标签数量。在三个公开 WSI 数据集、两种病理 foundation encoder 上，它在多个 MIL backbone 上一致提升实例级性能并保持有竞争力的袋级性能；PAC 式分析把实例分类器风险分解为一致收敛项与含选区错配、coverage 残差的伪标签噪声项。
Motivation: 病理 WSI 的实例级标注昂贵且含糊，而弱袋级标签充足；现有从注意力分数、模型预测、负袋或空间细化导出的实例监督常抓不住类特异的局部证据。
Method: 在冻结 foundation-model 特征上构建原型区域，估计类平衡的局部纯度，把与目标类强关联的高纯度区域选为伪标签，coverage 只用于保证足够的伪标签分配；并给出 PAC 式风险分解（一致收敛项 + 伪标签噪声项，后者含 selected-region mismatch 与 coverage residual）。
Result: 在三个公开 WSI 数据集、两种病理 foundation encoder 上，ProtoPur 在多个 MIL backbone 上一致提升实例级性能且保持有竞争力的袋级性能；在两个公开数据集上的伪标签质量比较显示 prototype-purity 选择给出更强的实例监督。
Conclusion: foundation-model 特征本身含有可利用的实例级监督信号，无需稠密实例标注即可从弱袋标签中提取；纯度优先的伪标签选择比注意力或预测式实例监督更可靠。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Agent-Canary-Mas: End-to-End Evaluation of Protocol Risk in Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Agent-to-agent protocols allow LLM agents to discover peers, exchange results, and coordinate tool use. A locally successful protocol attack, however, may be rejected by a later agent or propagated into a consequential task decision. Measuring local exploitability alone leaves this difference unresolved and provides limited evidence about which participant caused the final outcome. We present Agent-Canary-Mas, an end-to-end evaluation system that follows protocol risk through long-horizon multi-agent tasks. It covers five risk classes and 13 subclasses across A2A, ANP, and BCS, with 975 matched malicious--benign task pairs in five business domains. A shared OpenClaw framework runs autonomous, tool-using agents under different underlying models while preserving the task and execution setup. Matched runs separate local protocol success from downstream consequences; retained evidence connects participant selection, message consumption, tool activity, and task-state changes. We further evaluate a protocol-context Guard that checks an object's authority at consequential handoffs. Across three model conditions, local attack success is frequently at or above 90%, while consequence conversion ranges from 7.1% to 100.0%. Cross-agent evidence raises macro-averaged Audit-F1 from 29.7% to 95.5%. On Finance tasks, the Guard lowers average ASR from 86.1% to 53.8% and PTCR from 65.5% to 31.2%, with a measurable completion tradeoff. These results show that protocol risk depends on how agents use exchanged objects throughout the task, and that evaluating this path supports more informative risk assessment, attribution, and defense.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Agent-Canary-Mas 是面向 LLM 多智能体协议风险的端到端评测系统：在 OpenClaw 框架下用 975 组恶意-良性配对任务追踪协议攻击从局部成功到下游后果的传播路径。局部攻击成功率常达 90% 以上，但后果转化率在 7.1% 到 100.0% 之间波动，说明局部可利用性不能代表真实风险。
Motivation: agent-to-agent 协议（A2A、ANP、BCS）中，一次局部成功的协议攻击可能被后续 agent 拒绝，也可能传播为关键任务决策；只测局部可利用性既掩盖了这一差异，也无法归因到具体参与者。
Method: 覆盖 5 大类 13 小类风险、跨 5 个业务领域构建 975 组恶意-良性配对任务；用共享 OpenClaw 框架在不同底层模型下运行自主工具调用 agent，保持任务与执行设置一致；保留证据链连接参与者选择、消息消费、工具活动与任务状态变化；另评估在关键交接处校验对象权限的协议上下文 Guard。
Result: 三种模型条件下局部攻击成功率常在 90% 或以上，而后果转化率介于 7.1% 与 100.0% 之间；跨 agent 证据使宏平均 Audit-F1 从 29.7% 提升到 95.5%；在 Finance 任务上 Guard 将平均 ASR 从 86.1% 降到 53.8%、PTCR 从 65.5% 降到 31.2%，但带来可测量的完成率折损。
Conclusion: 协议风险取决于 agent 在整个任务中如何使用交换的对象，沿这条路径评测能支持更有信息量的风险评估、归因与防御；在关键交接处校验对象权限可显著压低后果转化，但以完成率为代价。

papers.title: Hidden in Plain Sight: Advancing Harmful Content Understanding via Perception-Aware Adversarial Self-Play
papers.abstract_en: Despite significant advances in language understanding, Large Language Models (LLMs) can still miss meaning hidden in plain sight, failing to identify harmful intent in expressions readily understood by humans. Malicious users exploit this gap by strategically disguising harmful content to evade automated moderation, posing a serious threat to online platform safety. The vulnerability reflects a fundamental cognitive asymmetry between human readers, who integrate contextual, phonetic, and visual cues to decipher the intent behind deliberate obfuscation, and text-based LLMs, which rely primarily on token sequences and have limited exposure to evolving evasions. To bridge this asymmetry, we propose PASP (Perception-Aware Adversarial Self-Play), which combines multi-perceptual views with adversarial self-play to improve understanding of harmful intent as evasions evolve. Specifically, PASP constructs textual, phonetic, and visual views of each input, preserving its original context while exposing pronunciation and glyph cues obscured in token space. During adversarial self-play, an attacker uses defender feedback to generate intent-preserving evasions, while the defender is trained using an intent-invariance reward to understand harmful intent across changing surface forms. Extensive experiments show that PASP reduces adaptive attack success rates by up to 73.71% and 74.49% on ChineseHarm-Bench and EvoHarmBench, respectively, preserves model capabilities with minimal degradation, and effectively interprets real-world evasive expressions in e-commerce.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PASP（Perception-Aware Adversarial Self-Play）为 LLM 内容审核构建文本、语音、视觉三种感知视图，并让攻击者用防守方反馈生成保持意图的伪装，防守方以意图不变性奖励训练。在 ChineseHarm-Bench 与 EvoHarmBench 上自适应攻击成功率分别最多下降 73.71% 与 74.49%，模型能力基本无损。
Motivation: 人类读者能结合上下文、语音和字形线索识破刻意混淆的有害意图，而基于 token 序列的 LLM 训练中很少见过不断演化的规避表达，恶意用户利用这一认知不对称绕过自动审核。
Method: PASP 对每条输入构造 textual、phonetic、visual 三种视图，在保留原上下文的同时暴露 token 空间中被遮蔽的发音与字形线索；对抗自博弈中，攻击者依据防守方反馈生成保持意图的规避表达，防守方用 intent-invariance reward 训练，以跨表面形式理解有害意图。
Result: 在 ChineseHarm-Bench 上自适应攻击成功率最多降低 73.71%，在 EvoHarmBench 上最多降低 74.49%；模型原有能力仅轻微退化，并能解读电商场景中的真实规避表达。
Conclusion: 把多感知视图与对抗自博弈结合，可以让 LLM 在伪装形式持续演化时仍抓住有害意图，同时不明显牺牲通用能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SuperAI: Merging Capabilities Across Heterogeneous Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Enabling the reuse and composition of knowledge and capabilities distributed across foundation models is an important step toward building scalable artificial intelligence (AI) systems. However, architectural differences and incompatible representations make it difficult to transfer and integrate these capabilities through a unified cross-model interface. To address this challenge, we propose SuperAI, a cross-architecture multi-model fusion framework that integrates complementary capabilities from multiple source models into a host model through orthogonal alignment of low-dimensional task-relevant representations. Specifically, we first extract task-relevant representations from the source models and the host model using shared anchor samples, and apply principal component analysis (PCA) to construct low-dimensional functional subspaces with the same dimensionality. Next, we use orthogonal Procrustes mappings to align the source and host coordinate systems, establishing cross-model correspondences while preserving the internal geometry of each source subspace. Finally, we train a lightweight residual multilayer perceptron (MLP) with joint supervision on task outputs and source-model increments, learning input-dependent residual increments that are injected into the host model for multi-model capability fusion. Experiments on three host models across 15 capability domains show that SuperAI achieves higher average domain scores than the evaluated cross-architecture fusion methods and better preserves general capabilities as the number of source models increases. Ablation studies further support the effectiveness of orthogonal alignment, nonlinear residual mapping, and joint supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SuperAI 把多个异构基础模型的能力融合进一个 host 模型：用共享 anchor 样本抽取任务相关表示，经 PCA 降到同维功能子空间，再用 orthogonal Procrustes 对齐坐标系，最后训练轻量 residual MLP 学习输入相关的残差增量注入 host 模型。在 3 个 host 模型、15 个能力域上，其平均域得分高于所评估的跨架构融合方法，且随源模型数量增加更能保持通用能力。
Motivation: 异构基础模型之间架构不同、表示不兼容，缺少统一的跨模型接口来迁移和复用各自分布的能力，难以组合成可扩展的 AI 系统。
Method: 先用共享 anchor 样本从源模型与 host 模型抽取任务相关表示，用 PCA 构造同维度的低维功能子空间；再用 orthogonal Procrustes 映射对齐源与 host 坐标系，同时保留各源子空间内部几何；最后以任务输出与源模型增量的 joint supervision 训练轻量 residual MLP，把输入相关的残差增量注入 host 模型。
Result: 在 3 个 host 模型、15 个 capability domains 上，SuperAI 的平均域得分高于所评估的跨架构融合方法，且源模型数量增加时更好地保持通用能力；ablation 支持 orthogonal alignment、nonlinear residual mapping 与 joint supervision 各自有效。
Conclusion: 低维子空间上的正交对齐加残差注入，是跨架构多模型能力融合的有效路径，且随源模型增多仍能保住 host 的通用能力。
Relevance: 2
