papers.title: Use Of Convolutional Neural Networks In Detection Of Branch Dieback Disease In Pequi Trees
papers.abstract_en: This study evaluates and compares five convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures, AlexNet, Inception, LeNet, VGG16, and MobileNet, for diagnosing branch dieback (seca-dos-ponteiros) in pequi trees (Caryocar brasiliense). This phytopathology represents a severe threat to tree development and fruit yield, causing substantial economic and ecological losses across the Brazilian Cerrado. The methodology implements computer vision techniques using deep learning frameworks to process and evaluate a field dataset expanded to 6,272 multi-scale images, captured via UAV and handheld sensors under uncontrolled illumination. The models were trained to detect pathological visual patterns across leaves, branches, and canopies. The experimental initial results reveal that architectural complexity did not guarantee diagnostic reliability, heavily parameterized networks experienced optimization failures (VGG16 collapsed into majority-class prediction), whereas compact architectures achieved greater stability. MobileNet delivered the most competitive overall performance, obtaining the highest Precision (0.71) and ROC-AUC (0.63), closely followed by LeNet (AUC = 0.62). These findings indicate the viability of lightweight CNNs as foundational tools for automated phytosanitary surveillance of native flora in resource-constrained field environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在巴西 Cerrado 的 pequi 树 (Caryocar brasiliense) 枝枯病 (seca-dos-ponteiros) 诊断上，对比 AlexNet、Inception、LeNet、VGG16、MobileNet 五种 CNN，参数量最大的 VGG16 训练崩溃退化为多数类预测，而轻量的 MobileNet 最稳，Precision 0.71、ROC-AUC 0.63。结论是资源受限的野外植保监测应优先选紧凑 CNN，而非堆参数。
Motivation: 枝枯病严重威胁 pequi 树生长与产量，造成巴西 Cerrado 的经济与生态损失；野外无控制光照条件下需要自动化植保监测手段，但深层网络在小规模、多尺度田间数据上的可靠性未知。
Method: 用 UAV 与手持传感器在无控制光照下采集并扩充到 6,272 张多尺度图像的田间数据集，覆盖叶片、枝条与树冠；用深度学习框架训练并对比 AlexNet、Inception、LeNet、VGG16、MobileNet 五种 CNN 架构识别病理视觉模式。
Result: 架构复杂度不等于诊断可靠性：VGG16 训练崩溃、退化为多数类预测；MobileNet 取得最高 Precision 0.71 与 ROC-AUC 0.63，LeNet 紧随其后 (AUC 0.62)。
Conclusion: 轻量 CNN 可作为资源受限野外环境下原生植被自动化植保监测的基础工具，紧凑架构在稳定性上优于高参数量网络。

papers.title: AlphaRLM: Aligning Language Models for Literature-Grounded Symbolic Factor Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Formulaic alpha mining seeks to discover executable expressions that capture predictive market signals in a vast, noisy search space. Recent LLM-based approaches use prompting, iterative search, or seed-factor evolution, leaving direct factor construction through policy learning less explored. To address this, we introduce AlphaRLM, a reinforcement-learning framework that trains LLMs to construct executable symbolic factors from financial literature without input factor expressions. AlphaRLM incorporates Literature-Guided Operator Assembly (LEGO), which conditions factor construction on literature-derived ideas and executable operators, providing semantic priors for exploration. It further aligns the generation policy with market feedback through executable-validity and grouped-return-separation rewards that capture non-monotonic structures across factor quantiles. Extensive experiments on CSI 300, CSI 1000, and S&P 500 show that AlphaRLM outperforms strong factor-mining and LLM-based baselines in annualized excess return. Notably, the 8B model achieves strong cross-market performance, highlighting the promise of literature-conditioned, market-aligned factor generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AlphaRLM 用强化学习训练 LLM 直接从金融文献构造可执行的符号化 alpha 因子，不给输入因子表达式：LEGO 模块用文献来源的想法与可执行算子作语义先验，再用可执行有效性奖励和分组收益分离奖励（捕捉因子分位数上的非单调结构）对齐市场反馈。在 CSI 300、CSI 1000 与 S&P 500 上，其年化超额收益超过强因子挖掘与 LLM 基线，8B 模型即取得跨市场表现。
Motivation: 公式化 alpha 挖掘要在庞大且高噪的表达式空间里找可执行的市场信号，现有 LLM 方法依赖提示、迭代搜索或种子因子演化，通过策略学习直接构造因子的路径基本空白。
Method: 提出强化学习框架 AlphaRLM：Literature-Guided Operator Assembly (LEGO) 把文献提炼的想法与可执行算子作为条件注入因子构造过程；奖励由 executable-validity 与 grouped-return-separation 两部分组成，后者按因子分位数的非单调收益结构设计，用市场反馈对齐生成策略。
Result: 在 CSI 300、CSI 1000 和 S&P 500 上的实验中，AlphaRLM 的年化超额收益 (annualized excess return) 超过强因子挖掘基线与 LLM 基线；其中 8B 模型取得强跨市场表现。
Conclusion: 文献条件化加市场对齐的策略学习可以直接生成可执行符号因子，且 8B 规模即可跨市场迁移，说明因子构造不必依赖种子因子演化或迭代搜索。

papers.title: How Should a Camera-First AI Agent Work?
papers.abstract_en: Camera-first agents must act on the visual world as it unfolds. We argue that the central obstacle for future camera-first agents is not recognition ability - multimodal models (vision-language and live/streaming alike) generalize well through language and remain the right tool for semantic reasoning - but time. Many visual targets are ephemeral: they appear, are query-relevant, and leave within a short window. Binding memory to the same end-to-end path as reasoning means that by the time a monolithic pipeline completes, the evidence is gone. We formalize this as Ephemeral-Target Interaction (ETI) and a Perceptual Deadline Contract separating a hard memory deadline from a soft reasoning deadline, grounded in the bounded, passive nature of sensory and working memory. We propose a two-deadline architecture: an always-on, bounded, non-semantic fast path; an active remembering mechanism that commits a moment to durable memory before it is overwritten (event-driven in v1); and a deferred deliberation layer (multimodal model + tools). We instantiate the contract on real MOT17 track windows, a consistency check, and calibrate the single-path baseline from measured frontier-model latency: even a short answer takes 1.2-9.3 s, and an agentic identify-and-search longer. Answers can be late; evidence cannot be missed.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Position/contract paper on time-critical camera-first agents (systems/timing).Primary cs.AI;
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于相机优先 AI agent 的立场/契约论文：核心瓶颈不是识别能力而是时间，视觉目标往往在与查询相关的短窗口内出现又消失，把记忆和推理绑在同一条端到端路径上会导致证据在推理完成前就被覆盖。作者形式化 Ephemeral-Target Interaction (ETI) 与 Perceptual Deadline Contract（硬记忆截止期 + 软推理截止期），提出双截止期架构：常开有界非语义快速路径、在被覆盖前把瞬间写入持久记忆的 active remembering、以及延迟审议层（多模态模型 + 工具）。
Motivation: 相机优先 agent 必须在视觉世界展开时行动，但单体流水线把记忆与推理串在同一条路径上，等推理完成时短暂目标已经消失，即 ETI 问题。
Method: 提出双截止期架构：常开、有界、非语义的 fast path；event-driven（v1）的 active remembering 在瞬间被覆写前写入持久记忆；deferred deliberation 层由多模态模型与工具组成。契约在真实 MOT17 track 窗口上实例化，并用实测前沿模型延迟标定单路径基线。
Result: 实测前沿模型延迟显示即使很短的回答也要 1.2–9.3 秒，而 agentic identify-and-search 更长；在 MOT17 track 窗口上做了一致性检查并据此标定单路径基线。
Conclusion: 答案可以迟到，证据不能错过：把硬记忆截止期与软推理截止期分开，让记忆先于推理固化，是相机优先 agent 的设计主张。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: How to Build a Benchmark That Actually Measures Taste
papers.abstract_en: Expert-aligned "taste" benchmarks should reward craft judgment, not the ability to game the test. We introduce TasteBench, a pairwise good-vs-bad benchmark across visual, brand, book, and tech items under a frozen rubric with expert-only gold (panel n>=3; percent agreement >=0.60 primary gate; weak engagement labels train/analysis-only), together with a control protocol that separates craft judgment from test-gaming. Applying the protocol to a Round-1 pilot (primary_human_expert; three biological human experts; n=250 pairs) surfaces and quantifies three validity threats: two construction artifacts that inflate the trivial-baseline layer, and a difficulty ceiling that inflates every score. (1) Position: the preferred item is slot A with probability 0.956, so an always_item_a policy scores 0.956 (fair chance 0.5). (2) Lexical leakage: a filename token cue scores 0.912. (3) Difficulty ceiling: craft domains show near-ceiling human agreement (book/brand/tech 1.0), and even under A/B randomization (eval_assignment_seed7; gold_side_A ~0.47) all five VLM cards reach 1.0 on craft, with only visual separating (~0.84-0.91; a post-hoc hard subset, n=107, leaves craft at 1.0). The protocol (expert-only gold, a weak-label firewall, side randomization at construction, filename scrubbing, and hard filters) makes each artifact measurable and, for the two construction artifacts, correctable; we release a reference eval harness and a side-randomization tool, and show the tool removes the position skew (0.916 to 0.495/0.505). The result is a calibrated view of what the benchmark does and does not yet measure: position and leakage are fixable, whereas the craft-domain ceiling is a pair-difficulty limit that Round-2 must address. We do not evaluate engagement, era/circle conditioning, or calibration here, and we claim no general taste SOTA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TasteBench 是一个视觉、品牌、图书、科技四类条目的 pairwise 好坏判别基准，配一套把「工艺判断」与「应试作弊」分开的控制协议。Round-1 试点（n=250 对，三名人类专家）量化出三类效度威胁：位置偏置使 always_item_a 得 0.956（公平随机 0.5）、文件名词元泄漏得 0.912、craft 域难度天花板让五个 VLM 卡片全部打到 1.0。侧位随机化工具把位置偏斜从 0.916 纠正到 0.495/0.505。
Motivation: 专家对齐的「taste」基准容易被应试策略钻空子：构造缺陷会虚抬平凡基线，难度天花板会虚抬所有分数，导致基准测不出它声称要测的工艺判断。
Method: 冻结 rubric 下只用专家金标签（panel n>=3，percent agreement >=0.60 为主门槛），弱互动标签仅用于训练/分析；控制协议包含构造期侧位随机化 (eval_assignment_seed7)、文件名清洗、hard filters 与弱标签防火墙，并发布参考评测 harness 与侧位随机化工具。

papers.title: DexCast: Learning Real-World Dexterous Control from Human Videos
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D hand-object interaction (HOI) perception have opened new opportunities for learning dexterous robotic skills from human videos. However, existing dexterous imitation learning methods often rely on costly and manually teleoperated robot demonstrations, requiring substantial human effort. Therefore, we build DEXCAST, a framework that learns dexterous robotic hand control directly from monocular RGB-D videos by leveraging joint HOI reconstructions, without requiring any teleoperation. Furthermore, how to model high-dimensional robotic hand motion and extract temporal context to inform future action generation remains a key challenge. To this end, we propose a DexHand Motion Perception Module (DMPM) to capture inter-joint coordination and temporal dependencies in compact latent representations that condition our diffusion policy. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that DEXCAST achieves exceptional performance across diverse dexterous manipulation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DexCast 直接从单目 RGB-D 人手视频学灵巧机械手控制，靠 3D 手-物交互 (HOI) 重建替代遥操作示教，无需任何 teleoperation。DexHand Motion Perception Module (DMPM) 把关节间协调与时序依赖压进紧凑 latent 表示来条件化 diffusion policy，作者称在多样真实世界灵巧操作任务上表现优异。
Motivation: 现有灵巧模仿学习依赖昂贵的人工遥操作机器人示教，人力成本高；同时高维机械手运动建模与从历史中提取时序上下文来生成未来动作仍是关键难点。
Method: 框架从单目 RGB-D 视频出发，利用 joint HOI 重建得到手-物运动，不需遥操作；提出 DexHand Motion Perception Module (DMPM) 捕获关节间协调与时序依赖并压成紧凑 latent 表示，用该表示条件化 diffusion policy 生成动作。
Result: 在多样真实世界灵巧操作任务上进行了 extensive real-world experiments，作者称 DEXCAST 取得 exceptional performance；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 人手视频加 HOI 重建可以替代遥操作示教作为灵巧手控制的学习来源，时序 latent 条件化的 diffusion policy 是其动作生成路径。

papers.title: Strong Gaussian Approximation of Constant Learning Rate SGD: Bias and Trajectory Inference
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops strong Gaussian approximations (KMT type) for constant learning rate stochastic gradient descent (SGD). We work with heavy tailed noise and assume that the number of iterates grows and the learning rate shrinks simultaneously. Our work constructs simple Gaussian processes on the same space and bounds, in probability, the maximum difference between the SGD errors and their respective limits. While there exist central limit theorems for constant rate SGD centered at the optimum, these only provide individual iterate inference. By contrast, our quenched KMT approximations allow for finite sample, simultaneous, whole-trajectory-level inference and imply stochastic process convergence (Functional Central Limit Theorems (FCLTs)). For accumulated errors centered at the true optimum, we first obtain a KMT-type approximation bound when the learning rate scales as $γ_n=\frac{c}{\sqrt n}+o(n^{-1/2})$ for a constant $c \in \mathbb{R}^+$ and $n$ iterations. The result reveals a trade off between controlling the bias of SGD and the initialization effect, with no learning rate scaling generally making both contributions vanish in the accumulated error limit. To eliminate these contributions, we consider a Burn in scheme and Richardson-Romberg extrapolation and prove respective KMT and FCLT theorems. We also prove a finite-horizon KMT-type approximation and FCLT for the rescaled iterate trajectory to a stationary Ornstein--Uhlenbeck (OU) process. We consider applications in risk control and simultaneous inference and perform simulations to illustrate our results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为常学习率 SGD 建立 KMT 型强高斯逼近：在重尾噪声、迭代数增长与学习率同步收缩下，构造同空间高斯过程并以概率控制 SGD 误差与其极限的最大偏差，实现整条轨迹层面的同时推断。当 γ_n = c/√n + o(n^{-1/2}) 时，结果揭示控制 SGD 偏差与初始化效应之间的权衡，一般不存在让两者同时消失的学习率标度；用 Burn-in 与 Richardson-Romberg 外推可消除这两项贡献。
Motivation: 已有常学习率 SGD 中心极限定理只针对单个迭代点做推断，无法覆盖整条轨迹的有限样本同时推断；且以真最优点为中心的累积误差中，偏差与初始化效应难以用同一学习率标度同时压掉。
Method: 在重尾噪声、n 增长且学习率同步收缩的条件下构造 KMT 型高斯过程逼近，以概率界住 SGD 误差与极限过程的最大偏差；对累积误差在 γ_n = c/√n + o(n^{-1/2}) 下给出 KMT 界，再用 Burn-in 方案与 Richardson-Romberg 外推分别证明 KMT 与 FCLT 定理；另对重标度迭代轨迹到平稳 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck (OU) 过程给出有限时域 KMT 逼近与 FCLT，并做模拟说明。
Result: 得到 quenched KMT 逼近，蕴含随机过程收敛 (FCLT)，支持有限样本、同时的整轨迹推断；γ_n = c/√n + o(n^{-1/2})（c ∈ R⁺，n 次迭代）下的 KMT 型界显示 SGD 偏差与初始化效应的权衡，一般没有学习率标度能让两者都在累积误差极限中消失；Burn-in 与 Richardson-Romberg 外推分别给出消除这两项贡献的 KMT 与 FCLT 定理，并给出平稳 OU 过程的有限时域 KMT/FCLT；应用面向风险控制与同时推断，并辅以模拟。
Conclusion: 常学习率 SGD 的轨迹级不确定性可用 KMT 型高斯逼近做整条路径的同时推断，但偏差与初始化效应的权衡需靠 Burn-in 和 Richardson-Romberg 外推分别处理才能消除。

papers.title: A Self-Defining Operator for Distributed Applications
papers.abstract_en: To operate distributed applications with high availability, operators must rapidly diagnose and mitigate any incident. LLM-based agents can help, but unlike experienced human operators they do not improve as they handle more incidents. Each investigation starts from scratch, re-deriving likely causes and re-testing hypotheses even when a similar fault was resolved in the past. We present a self-defining operator (SDO) that improves with time by updating its operational behavior and memory. When SDO resolves an incident, it distills that experience into playbooks, which describe reusable diagnostic instructions for future incidents with similar faults, and detectors, scripts that take application telemetry as input and output relevant playbook(s). SDO continuously runs the detectors and invokes LLMs only when one fires, so its token cost scales with incident count rather than with operational time. Across 11 open-source microservice applications, SDO cuts resolution time by 52% on recurring faults while keeping per-incident cost low. SDO is open source at https://github.com/self-defining-systems/sdo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SDO（self-defining operator）把 LLM 运维智能体每次处置事故的经验蒸馏成可复用的 playbooks 与 detectors：detectors 持续吃应用遥测、只在触发时才调用 LLM，使 token 成本随事故数而非运行时间增长。在 11 个开源微服务应用上，重复故障的解决时间下降 52%，且单次事故成本保持低位。
Motivation: LLM 运维智能体不像资深人类 SRE 那样随处置事故增多而变强，每次调查都从零重推可能原因、重测假设，即使同类故障此前已解决过。
Method: SDO 在解决事故后把经验蒸馏为两类产物：描述可复用诊断指令的 playbooks，以及以应用遥测为输入、输出相关 playbook 的 detectors 脚本；系统持续运行 detectors，仅在其触发时调用 LLM。
Result: 在 11 个开源微服务应用上，重复故障的解决时间缩短 52%，同时保持每次事故成本较低；token 成本随事故数而非随运维时间扩展。
Conclusion: 让运维智能体把处置经验固化为触发式检测器与剧本，可以在不持续烧 token 的前提下随事故积累变快；代码已开源。

papers.title: RealityBench: Simulated Environments to Evaluate a Vision Language Model's Ability to Document Human Physical Work
papers.abstract_en: Augmenting worker capabilities in the physical world through guidance has been a decades-long goal for AI agents. One key supporting capability is to understand what the worker is doing, seeing through the human's camera or smart glasses, and assist them in documentation. Despite advances in vision language models, their capabilities in these settings remain uncertain and are challenging to benchmark because most physical work data is proprietary, and involves too much variability to study in a principled manner. Unlike structured settings such as kitchens and warehouses that have predictable lighting, geometry, and objects, field-facing tasks such as rooftop solar installation and vehicle repair are unconstrained and high variance. Here, we model real-world physical work in Blender across eleven environments, incorporating variants in both image acceptability and documentation. The acceptability task asks whether a particular view would be suitable proof-of-work and documentation asks whether an agent can understand the task-relevant state of the environment from that view. Across 26 vision-language models, we find that top models largely solve documentation when the answer is text in frame, but are weak at reading measurements and at judging small parts and spatial relations, such as whether a tape measure leans. Acceptability is harder to pin down because human raters disagree with each other. Measured against a scorer that agrees with the raters' majority about as often as a single rater does, the best models cannot be distinguished from a single non-author rater, at a cost within the range of a human pass. In the three environments where we can trace acceptability errors, most wrong rejections come from misreading the scene rather than the requirement. On the three documentation questions for which we have real images, model rankings on rendered frames transfer to real images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 RealityBench：用 Blender 在 11 个无约束现场作业环境（屋顶光伏安装、车辆维修等）中建模真实体力劳动，评测 VLM 的「工作凭证可接受性判断」与「文档理解」两项能力。在 26 个 VLM 上，顶尖模型在答案为画面内文字时基本解决文档任务，但读数、小零件与空间关系（如卷尺是否倾斜）仍弱；可接受性上最佳模型与单个人类评分者不可区分，成本在人类通过范围内。
Motivation: 现场体力作业数据多为专有且变异度大，难以系统评测 VLM 在工人视角相机/智能眼镜下理解作业并辅助文档记录的能力；厨房、仓库等结构化场景无法代表这类无约束任务。
Method: 用 Blender 构建 11 个环境的仿真场景，对图像可接受性与文档理解两个维度生成变体；评测 26 个 VLM，可接受性以与人类评分者多数意见的一致率对标单个人类评分者，并在 3 个环境上追溯可接受性错误来源，在 3 道有真实图像的文档题上检验渲染到真实的排名迁移。
Result: 答案为画面内文字时顶尖模型基本解决文档任务，但读测量值、判断小零件与空间关系（如卷尺是否倾斜）弱；可接受性因人类评分者互相分歧而难以界定，最佳模型与单个非作者评分者不可区分，成本在人类通过范围内；3 个可追溯环境中多数错误拒绝源于误读场景而非误解要求；3 道真实图像文档题上渲染帧的模型排名可迁移到真实图像。
Conclusion: VLM 在仿真建模的现场体力作业文档任务上已接近单个人类评分者水平，瓶颈在读数与空间关系判断，且可接受性判断的上限受人类评分者自身分歧制约。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 答案为画面内文字时顶尖模型基本解决文档任务，但读测量值、判断小零件与空间关系（如卷尺是否倾斜）弱；可接受性因人类评分者互相分歧而难以界定，最佳模型与单个非作者评分者不可区分，成本在人类通过范围内；3 个可追溯环境中多数错误拒绝源于误读场景而非误解要求；3 道真实图像文档题上渲染帧的模型排名可迁移到真实图像。
summary_sections.conclusion: VLM 在仿真建模的现场体力作业文档任务上已接近单个人类评分者水平，瓶颈在读数与空间关系判断，且可接受性判断的上限受人类评分者自身分歧制约。

papers.title: Natural Code Transformation Confuses Agents in Vulnerability Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Having demonstrated a strong potential for automating vulnerability discovery, AI agents can also be used to attack software systems at scale. Today's software systems need mechanisms to level the playing field by slowing down potential attacks, giving them time to patch vulnerabilities and strengthen software. Along this line, our study of agent trajectories in vulnerability analysis shows a surprising finding: agents produce dramatically different results across real-world code commits that carry the same functionality and the same vulnerability. This phenomenon appears consistently in multiple code domains and vulnerability categories. It motivates us to study natural and functionality-preserving code transformations derived from real-world software development, and their potential as a defense against attacker agents. We build a corpus of natural transformations by mining recurring development patterns from real-world code commits, and apply them to evaluate impact on agentic vulnerability analysis. Our results show that even a single form of transformation can effectively "confuse" frontier agents, e.g., Codex with GPT-6 Sol, reducing successes in vulnerability discovery. We also study different agent failures, whether transformations can be composed to provide stronger protection, and adaptive attackers who seek to reverse them. Overall, our study of natural code transformation significantly expands the research space of using code transformations to defend against malicious agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从真实代码提交中挖掘功能保持的自然代码变换语料，用作对攻击型 AI agent 的防御：功能与漏洞完全相同的提交会让 agent 产出剧烈不同的结果，而施加哪怕单一形式的变换就能有效“迷惑”前沿 agent（如搭载 GPT-6 Sol 的 Codex），降低漏洞发现成功率。
Motivation: AI agent 已能自动化漏洞发现，也可被用来大规模攻击软件系统；现有机制缺少能拖慢攻击、为修补争取时间的手段，而 agent 对同功能同漏洞代码的不稳定行为提示变换可充当防御。
Method: 先分析 agent 在漏洞分析中的轨迹，发现同功能同漏洞的真实提交导致结果剧烈差异且跨多个代码领域与漏洞类别复现；随后从真实软件开发提交中挖掘反复出现的开发模式，构建自然功能保持变换语料，并将其施加到代码上评估对 agentic 漏洞分析的影响，同时考察 agent 失败类型、变换组合能否叠加更强保护，以及试图逆转变换的自适应攻击者。
Result: 即使单一形式的变换也能有效迷惑前沿 agent（例如搭载 GPT-6 Sol 的 Codex），降低漏洞发现成功数；该不稳定现象在多个代码领域与漏洞类别中一致出现。
Conclusion: 自然代码变换可作为对抗恶意 agent 的防御手段，显著扩展了用代码变换保护软件的研究空间；变换可组合以求更强保护，且需面对试图逆转变换的自适应攻击者。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MvFFN: Multi-view Floor plan Feed-forward Network for Unposed Wide-Baseline Panorama Layout Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing accurate camera poses and floor-plan layouts from sparse, unposed, wide-baseline RGB panoramas remains a challenging open problem. Direct multi-room floor-plan prediction is especially difficult in this setting: pose, geometry, semantics, and global layout structure are tightly coupled, yet a complete floor-plan is hard to learn as a single global output. Our key insight is to keep the model's predictions strictly local. Multi-view Ordered Wall Instance Segmentation (MOIS) is designed around this concept. Each panorama column predicts only the wall it observes plus the next two adjacent walls in clockwise order. The global wall partition, room layouts, and shared coordinates emerge from deterministic aggregation of overlapping local predictions. Building on MOIS, we propose Multi-view floor-plan Feed-Forward Network (MvFFN), which jointly predicts coarse camera poses, dense global geometry, and per-wall semantic outputs. A downstream Layout Chaining (LC) post processing pipeline then assembles these predictions into multi-room floor-plans with shared global coordinates, consistent wall identities, and connected room structure. The dense MOIS predictions recover cross-view wall identity and local within-room connectivity more accurately than composed modular baselines, and the assembled layouts substantially outperform prior methods on wall and junction level accuracy. We also introduce the ZInD-CrossView dataset, which augments ZInD with globally unique wall instances and cross-view segmentation labels for this task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MvFFN 把未标定、宽基线 RGB 全景图的多房间户型重建拆成严格局部的预测：每列全景只预测自己看到的墙加顺时针相邻两堵墙 (MOIS)，全局墙划分与共享坐标由重叠局部预测的确定性聚合产生，再由 Layout Chaining 拼成多房间户型。密集 MOIS 预测在跨视角墙体身份与房间内连通性上比组合式模块基线更准，组装后的布局在墙级与节点级精度上大幅超越既有方法。
Motivation: 稀疏、未标定、宽基线的全景图同时耦合位姿、几何、语义与全局布局，而完整户型作为单一全局输出难以学习，多房间户型直接预测因此长期是开放难题。
Method: 提出 Multi-view Ordered Wall Instance Segmentation (MOIS)：每列全景只预测所见墙及顺时针相邻两堵墙，全局墙划分靠重叠局部预测的确定性聚合；其上的 MvFFN 联合预测粗相机位姿、稠密全局几何与逐墙语义，再用 Layout Chaining (LC) 后处理拼出共享全局坐标、墙体身份一致、房间连通的多房间户型。同时发布 ZInD-CrossView 数据集，在 ZInD 上补充全局唯一墙体实例与跨视角分割标签。
Result: 密集 MOIS 预测在跨视角墙体身份与房间内局部连通性上比组合式模块基线 (composed modular baselines) 更准确；经 LC 组装的布局在墙级与节点级 (wall and junction level) 精度上大幅优于既有方法。
Conclusion: 把预测严格限制在局部、再靠确定性聚合涌现全局结构，是未标定宽基线全景多房间户型重建的有效路径，配套的 ZInD-CrossView 为该任务提供跨视角标签。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SliderEdit++: Improved Slider Trajectories in Instruction-Based Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Slider-based control aims to give users continuous, fine-grained control over the intensity of individual edits in instruction-based image editing. However, existing approaches fail to deliver reliable continuous controllability: traversing a slider can produce abrupt visual jumps and non-monotonic changes, while jointly controlled sliders can interfere with one another. To systematically study these limitations, we introduce SlideBench, a comprehensive benchmark for continuous image editing spanning diverse editing categories and equipped with a unified suite of metrics quantifying monotonic progression, perceptual continuity, and inter-slider disentanglement. Building on these observations, we propose SliderEdit++, which explicitly regularizes the intermediate editing trajectory rather than supervising only its endpoints. Our method combines velocity- and semantic-space trajectory regularization with spectral control to encourage smooth, predictable slider traversal, together with a disentanglement objective that reduces interference between independently controlled edits. On SlideBench, SliderEdit++ achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving the overall score by 18.5% relative to the strongest baseline. At the same time, using a few-step editing backbone makes our method approximately 3x to 20x faster than existing slider-based approaches, enabling substantially more responsive interactive editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SliderEdit++ 对滑块控制的指令式图像编辑做中间轨迹正则化，用速度与语义空间轨迹正则加谱控制约束滑块遍历平滑单调，并加解耦目标减少多滑块互相干扰。在自建基准 SlideBench 上整体分数相对最强基线提升 18.5%，配合少步编辑骨干比现有滑块方法快约 3x 至 20x。
Motivation: 现有滑块控制在遍历时出现突跳与非单调变化，多个滑块联合控制时还会互相干扰，连续可控性不可靠，且缺少统一量化这些问题的评测。
Method: 提出 SlideBench 基准，覆盖多类编辑并统一给出单调递进、感知连续性、滑块间解耦三组指标；SliderEdit++ 显式正则化中间编辑轨迹而非只监督端点，组合速度与语义空间轨迹正则、谱控制以及降低独立编辑干扰的解耦目标。
Result: 在 SlideBench 上 SliderEdit++ 取得最佳表现，整体分数相对最强基线提升 18.5%；配合少步编辑骨干，速度约为现有滑块方法的 3x 至 20x。
Conclusion: 把监督从端点扩展到整条中间轨迹并同时约束平滑性与解耦，可同时改善滑块编辑的连续可控性与交互响应速度。

papers.title: Correction Training for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Iterative sampling in diffusion models can lead to error accumulation due to exposure bias. The denoiser is trained on real images interpolated with noise, but at inference its inputs are constructed from its own imperfect predictions from the earlier steps, something it has never seen at training time. This might be one reason diffusion models often struggle without additional help, such as CFG. We introduce a correction step for diffusion models which attempts to reduce this training-inference gap. The corrector takes the base model's prediction as input and is trained against the same ground-truth target. This makes correction an explicit learning task, with training inputs provided by the base model. During sampling, at each denoising step, we iteratively refine the denoiser's clean-sample prediction. This allows us to correct predictions at intermediate denoising steps, preventing early artifacts from persisting into the final sample. Although the corrector is trained only on predictions from the base denoiser, it can be applied repeatedly to its own outputs at inference for better results. This simple framework leads to substantial improvement in sample quality while largely preserving diversity. We evaluate our method across DiT, SiT, and JiT. Our method substantially improves upon previously reported FID scores for unguided generation and, notably, unconditional generation, where producing high-quality samples without guidance has been particularly challenging. Our method achieves performance competitive with classifier-free guidance (CFG), and combining correction with CFG further improves diversity and reduces oversaturation typical of CFG. Finally, we show that the additional inference cost of correction can be amortized by distilling the refined predictions back into the base diffusion model, retaining the quality gains without additional inference-time overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 扩散模型采样时去噪器只能看到自己此前不完美的预测，与训练分布不一致导致误差累积。作者给扩散模型加一个 corrector 步骤：以基座模型的预测为输入、以同一 ground-truth 为目标训练，在每个去噪步迭代细化干净样本预测，阻止早期伪影延续到最终样本。在 DiT、SiT、JiT 上无引导与无条件生成的 FID 相比此前报告值大幅提升，性能可与 CFG 竞争，且把细化预测蒸馏回基座模型即可免去额外推理开销。
Motivation: 扩散模型去噪器训练时输入是真实图像加噪，推理时输入却来自自身此前步骤的不完美预测，这一训练-推理落差 (exposure bias) 造成误差累积，也是无 CFG 等额外引导时生成质量不佳的一个原因。
Method: 引入 correction step：corrector 以基座模型的预测为输入、以与基座相同的 ground-truth 目标训练，使纠正成为显式学习任务；采样时每个去噪步迭代细化去噪器的 clean-sample 预测。corrector 虽只在基座去噪器的预测上训练，推理时可反复作用于自身输出；另可将细化后的预测蒸馏回基座扩散模型以摊销推理成本。
Result: 在 DiT、SiT、JiT 上评估：无引导 (unguided) 与无条件 (unconditional) 生成的 FID 相比此前报告值有大幅提升，性能与 classifier-free guidance (CFG) 竞争；纠正与 CFG 结合进一步提升多样性并减轻 CFG 常见的过饱和。蒸馏后保留质量增益且无额外推理时开销。
Conclusion: 把训练-推理落差做成一个显式的纠正学习任务，就能在基本不损失多样性的情况下显著提升扩散模型样本质量，无引导无条件生成尤其受益，且开销可通过蒸馏消除。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hide and Seek: HIDE Concepts to SEEK explanations for black box models
papers.abstract_en: Interpreting machine learning model predictions is a central challenge, particularly for black-box vision models. Concept-based attribution methods interpret models using human-understandable concepts. Existing concept-based methods can only interpret classification and regression models. They require access to model weights or large concept-annotated datasets, and most methods cannot provide image-level attribution. We propose Hide and Seek (HnS), a new method for concept-level attribution that does not require access to model weights or labeled concept datasets. HnS can interpret a wide range of vision models. Given a concept and image set, HnS retrieves concept-aligned images using a vision-language model, localizes the concept within each image, masks the localized region, and measures attribution from the change in the black-box model's output between the original and masked images. This enables faithful attribution by directly measuring the model's behavior and supporting local attributions. We validated HnS on CelebA and COCO-Stuff. Compared to existing methods, HnS showed better agreement with ground-truth attributions. We demonstrated the applicability of HnS on diverse tasks, including image captioning and satellite image segmentation, where no existing concept attribution method can be used. We provided our anonymous code in the supplementary material.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出黑盒视觉模型的概念归因方法 Hide and Seek (HnS)：用视觉-语言模型检索概念对齐图像并定位概念区域，遮蔽该区域后比较模型输出变化来度量归因，无需模型权重与概念标注数据集。在 CelebA 与 COCO-Stuff 上与现有方法相比更贴合 ground-truth 归因，并可用于图像描述与卫星图像分割等此前无概念归因方法可用的任务。
Motivation: 现有概念归因方法只能处理分类与回归模型，且依赖模型权重或大规模概念标注数据集，多数还无法给出图像级归因，覆盖不了描述、分割等黑盒视觉任务。
Method: 给定概念与图像集，HnS 先用 vision-language model 检索概念对齐图像，再在每张图内定位概念区域并遮蔽，通过原图与遮蔽图之间黑盒模型输出的差异度量归因，从而直接测量模型行为并支持局部归因。
Result: 在 CelebA 与 COCO-Stuff 上验证，与现有方法相比 HnS 与 ground-truth 归因的一致性更好；并在图像描述 (image captioning) 和卫星图像分割 (satellite image segmentation) 等任务上演示了可用性，这些任务此前没有可用的概念归因方法。
Conclusion: 不接触权重、不需概念标注的遮蔽式输出差分，就能把概念归因扩展到分类与回归之外的黑盒视觉模型，并给出更忠实的图像级局部归因。

papers.title: AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities
papers.abstract_en: Capability evaluations aim to surface dangerous model behaviors before deployment, but their reliability depends on the assumption that hidden capabilities can be elicited. We show this assumption does not hold under adversarial conditions by constructing backdoor attacks that embed encrypted neural networks within host model weights, decrypting and executing them only upon receiving a secret trigger. Using digital lockers, these hidden circuits remain provably hard to elicit and interpret under cryptographic assumptions, even given full access to model weights, extending prior work from hiding fixed strings to arbitrary computations. We implement our proof of concept constructions in PyTorch and evaluate elicitation through fine-tuning, weight noising, gradient-based trigger search, and latent adversarial training, using a small chemical reaction prediction task as a proxy for CBRN-relevant capabilities. Our results demonstrate resistance to these methods and, together with our cryptographic guarantees, reveal a limit of elicitation-based capability audits. We release our models to support the improvement of defenses.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文构造后门攻击，把加密的神经网络藏进宿主模型权重，只有收到秘密触发器才解密执行；在密码学假设下，即使攻击者拿到全部权重，这些隐藏回路也难以被引出或解释。用小分子化学反应预测任务作 CBRN 相关能力的代理，隐藏电路对微调、权重加噪、基于梯度的触发器搜索和 latent 对抗训练均表现出抵抗，说明基于引出 (elicitation) 的能力审计存在原理性上限。
Motivation: 能力评估的可靠性依赖于「隐藏能力终可被引出」这一假设，而对抗条件下该假设不成立，直接动摇部署前危险行为筛查的根基。
Method: 用 digital locker 把任意计算（而非先前工作的固定字符串）加密嵌入宿主模型权重，仅凭秘密触发器解密执行；在 PyTorch 中实现概念验证，并以小化学反应预测任务作为 CBRN 相关能力的代理，测试四类引出手段。
Result: 隐藏电路在微调、权重加噪、基于梯度的触发器搜索与 latent 对抗训练下均表现出抵抗，且有密码学保证支撑；论文为 22 页、6 图、3 表，被 NeurIPS 2026 接收。
Conclusion: 在密码学假设下，基于引出的能力审计对任意计算级别的隐藏能力存在原理性极限，防御方法需要另行改进；作者公开模型以支持防御研究。

papers.title: Human and LLM Facilitation in Collaborative Design Meetings: A Computational Behavioral Comparison
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored as facilitators of group discussion and collaborative work, but the behavioral differences between LLM-generated and human facilitation remain insufficiently characterized. We compare human Project Manager facilitation turns from scenario-based collaborative design meetings with Llama 3.1 8B Instruct responses across 199 paired contexts from the AMI Meeting Corpus. The analysis covers five confirmatory dimensions: contextual semantic distance, a lexical elaboration proxy, empathyand-hedge lexical density, topic divergence, and phase-vocabulary alignment. An exploratory directiveness measure failed domain validation and is not interpreted. The sampled human Project Manager turns were higher on contextual semantic distance (r = 0.644) and on empathyand-hedge lexical density (r = 0.203). The second contrast is carried mainly by hedge terms, so we read it as lexical hedging rather than psychological empathy. Llama-generated facilitation was higher on topic divergence (r = 0.703), the lexical elaboration proxy (r = 0.288; lengthconfounded), and instruction-conditioned phase-vocabulary alignment (r = 0.382). A secondary no-phase check left the Llama-higher phase contrast in place. The system prompt still requested a facilitation move, so that check is not evidence of spontaneous phase awareness. These differences should not be interpreted as a ranking of facilitation quality. The resulting behavioral profile provides a reference point for later comparisons of LLM facilitators, human facilitators, prompts, models, and collaborative settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 AMI Meeting Corpus 的 199 组配对情境，对比人类 Project Manager 的主持发言与 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 生成的主持回应，五个确认性维度上两者行为画像明显分叉：人类在上下文语义距离 (r=0.644) 与共情-对冲词密度 (r=0.203，主要由 hedge 词驱动) 更高，Llama 在话题发散 (r=0.703)、词汇细化代理 (r=0.288，受长度混淆) 与指令条件下的阶段词汇对齐 (r=0.382) 更高。作者明确说这不是主持质量排名，而是后续比较 LLM 主持人、提示与协作场景的参照基线。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多被用作讨论主持人，但 LLM 生成的主持行为与人类主持行为在可计算维度上的差异尚未被系统刻画，缺少可复用的对照画像。
Method: 从 AMI Meeting Corpus 的情境式协作设计会议中抽取人类 Project Manager 主持发言，与 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 在 199 组配对情境下的回应对比；分析覆盖五个确认性维度：上下文语义距离、词汇细化代理、共情与对冲词密度、话题发散、阶段词汇对齐；另有一个探索性的直接性 (directiveness) 度量因未通过领域验证而不解读。
Result: 人类侧：上下文语义距离 r=0.644，共情-对冲词密度 r=0.203（对比主要由 hedge 词承载，应读作词汇对冲而非心理共情）。Llama 侧：话题发散 r=0.703，词汇细化代理 r=0.288（受长度混淆），指令条件下的阶段词汇对齐 r=0.382；去掉阶段指令的次级检查中 Llama 更高的阶段对比仍然存在，但系统提示仍要求给出主持动作，故不构成自发阶段意识的证据。
Conclusion: 人类与 LLM 主持在语义贴合与对冲措辞上偏人类、在话题发散与阶段词汇对齐上偏 Llama，这组差异应作为行为画像而非质量排序来使用。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning via Fixed-point Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: In maximum entropy and behavior-constrained reinforcement learning (RL), the optimal policy is given by a Boltzmann distribution. Generating samples from this distribution can be challenging, as it is often complex and multimodal. While flow policies trained with flow matching provide a powerful framework for representing such distributions, they traditionally rely on access to training data, which is generally unavailable in online RL. To address this limitation, we propose fixed-point flow matching (FFM), a data-free procedure for training and fine-tuning flow policies in RL. FFM leverages the target flow identity to formulate the actor update as a fixed-point iteration, utilizing a flow-matching-style regression objective where the critic's action gradients serve as regression targets. We show that the optimal policy is a fixed point of this iteration. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that FFM effectively fine-tunes pretrained flow policies in the offline-to-online setting and enables efficient and accurate training of flow policies from scratch in online RL. These results establish fixed-point flow matching as a principled approach for learning expressive flow-based policies without requiring training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 fixed-point flow matching (FFM)：在最大熵与行为约束 RL 中，用目标流恒等式把 actor 更新写成不动点迭代，回归目标取 critic 的动作梯度，从而无需训练数据即可训练与微调 flow policy。实验证明 FFM 能在 offline-to-online 设定下有效微调预训练 flow policy，并支持从零开始的在线 RL 训练。
Motivation: 最大熵与行为约束 RL 的最优策略是 Boltzmann 分布，复杂且多模态；flow matching 训练的 flow policy 表达力强，但传统上依赖训练数据，而在线 RL 中通常拿不到这些数据。
Method: 利用目标流恒等式 (target flow identity) 将 actor 更新表述为不动点迭代，采用 flow-matching 风格的回归目标，以 critic 的动作梯度作为回归目标；证明最优策略是该迭代的不动点。
Result: 在 offline-to-online 设定下 FFM 能有效微调预训练 flow policy，并能在在线 RL 中从零高效、准确地训练 flow policy；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 固定点迭代加 critic 动作梯度作为回归目标，可以在完全无训练数据的情况下学习表达力强的 flow-based 策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neural networks are more modular than single neurons suggest
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks routinely develop representations in which individual neurons contribute to multiple distinct functions, leading to the widespread view that such networks lack modular organization. We challenge this conclusion by introducing a formally nested hierarchy of modularity: unit-level, which requires distinct computations to occupy disjoint neurons; orthogonal, which asks whether a rotation reveals functionally independent subspaces; and linear, which asks whether a bounded linear map can separate task-relevant computations into independent subspaces. We develop a unified framework for learning decompositions at each level and evaluating them causally through selective ablation. Across vision models, language models and multi-task Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), we find that networks which lack unit-level modularity nonetheless often exhibit clear functional modularity at the subspace level. In vision and language models, content versus style and syntax versus semantics respectively dissociate under subspace ablation despite sharing overlapping populations of neurons. These learned subspaces also align differentially with brain data, with content and style subspaces predicting higher and lower visual cortex respectively, and semantic subspaces outperforming syntactic ones in predicting language cortex activity. In RNNs trained on multiple cognitive tasks and previously shown to lack modular structure, our decomposition recovers sharp double dissociations between tasks. The absence of unit-level modularity frequently coexists with clear subspace-level modularity across domains, enabling targeted intervention on specific computations even in networks where no individual neuron is specialized, with broad implications for mechanistic interpretability and for understanding functional organization in both biological and artificial neural systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出嵌套的模块化层级（unit-level / orthogonal / linear），用可学习分解加选择性消融做因果检验，发现缺少单神经元模块化的网络在子空间层面往往仍有清晰的功能模块化：视觉模型中 content 与 style、语言模型中 syntax 与 semantics 在共享神经元群体下可被子空间消融分离，且这些子空间与脑数据差异性对齐。
Motivation: 单个多功能神经元被广泛当作网络缺乏模块化组织的证据，但这一结论可能只在最细的 unit-level 成立，掩盖了更高层级的功能分离。
Method: 定义三层嵌套模块化：unit-level 要求不同计算占据不相交神经元，orthogonal 层问是否存在旋转揭示功能独立子空间，linear 层问是否存在有界线性映射把任务相关计算分开；为每层给出统一的分解学习框架，并通过选择性消融 (selective ablation) 做因果评估。
Result: 在视觉模型、语言模型和多任务 RNN 上，缺少 unit-level 模块化的网络常在子空间层面表现出清晰功能模块化：视觉中 content/style、语言中 syntax/semantics 在子空间消融下可分离；子空间与脑数据差异性对齐，content 与 style 子空间分别预测高级与低级视觉皮层，语义子空间预测语言皮层活动优于句法子空间；在先前被证明缺乏模块结构的多认知任务 RNN 上，该分解恢复出任务间的清晰双重分离 (double dissociation)。
Conclusion: 缺少单神经元特化与存在功能模块化可以并存，模块化判断取决于所考察的层级；这使对特定计算的定向干预成为可能，并影响机制可解释性与对生物、人工系统功能组织的理解。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MIRAGE: Metric Inference and Reliability-Aware Gaussian Estimation from Feed-Forward Vision
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D priors enable high-quality reconstruction from image streams but often lack reliable metric scale and suffer from long-term trajectory drift. In contrast, LiDAR--inertial estimation provides metrically accurate motion but lacks the image-space consistency needed for high-fidelity reconstruction. We propose $MIRAGE$, which anchors feed-forward visual geometry to LiDAR--IMU metric motion and regulates online pose corrections according to correspondence support and cross-modal agreement, jointly enabling accurate metric pose estimation and high-fidelity Gaussian reconstruction. Experiments on Oxford Spires, M2DGR and INS show that MIRAGE achieves accurate metric trajectory estimation, outperforming COLMAP, a widely used but computationally expensive reference for vision-only benchmarks. Motivated by the scarcity of long-horizon monocular benchmarks for large-scale indoor reconstruction, we further build a multimodal data-collection platform and use MIRAGE to establish accurate 6-DoF reference trajectories for a new vision-only benchmark. We benchmark recent monocular large-scale reconstruction methods on this dataset, providing a systematic evaluation of their performance in long-horizon indoor scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIRAGE 把前馈视觉几何锚定到 LiDAR-IMU 的米制运动上，并按对应点支撑度与跨模态一致性在线调节位姿修正，从而同时得到米制位姿与高保真 Gaussian 重建。在 Oxford Spires、M2DGR 与 INS 上，其米制轨迹精度超过视觉-only 基准中常用但计算昂贵的 COLMAP。
Motivation: 前馈 3D 先验重建质量高却缺可靠米制尺度、长期轨迹漂移；LiDAR-惯性估计米制准但缺图像空间一致性，两者各自不足以支撑长时程高保真重建。
Method: MIRAGE 用 LiDAR-IMU 的米制运动锚定 feed-forward 视觉几何，并依据 correspondence support 与 cross-modal agreement 在线调节位姿修正，联合输出米制位姿与 Gaussian 重建；另搭建多模态采集平台，用 MIRAGE 生成 6-DoF 参考轨迹，构建纯视觉长时程室内基准。
Result: 在 Oxford Spires、M2DGR 和 INS 上实现准确的米制轨迹估计，性能超过 COLMAP 这一视觉-only 基准中广泛使用但计算昂贵的参考方法；并用该平台建立新视觉-only 基准的 6-DoF 参考轨迹，对近期单目大规模重建方法做系统评测。
Conclusion: 把视觉前馈几何与 LiDAR-IMU 米制约束结合、按跨模态一致性调节在线修正，可在长时程场景中同时拿到米制轨迹与高保真重建；该流程还可反过来充当新基准的参考轨迹生成器。

papers.title: HRIL: Learning Multimodal Synergy via Higher-Order Tensor Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised multimodal representation learning has achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet capturing synergistic information remains challenging due to the complexity of cross-modal interactions. Unlike the shared information across individual modalities, synergy arises when task-relevant signals emerge only from the joint configuration of multiple modalities and cannot be recovered from any modality in isolation. This work focuses on how to preserve the information capacity for such synergistic signals in multimodal representations. The key observation is that synergistic information is reflected in higher-order statistical dependence among modalities, which provides a principled target for explicitly modeling joint interactions. Motivated by this insight, we propose Higher-order Representation and Information Learning (HRIL), which constructs an empirical cross-moment tensor over modality embeddings to represent multi-way interactions. HRIL employs Tucker decomposition to obtain a core tensor, complemented by a synergy-aware regularizer that prevents energy concentration and preserves higher-order coupling capacity for synergistic information capture. Experiments on the controlled synergy task and real-world benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing multimodal contrastive methods, with notable gains on tasks dominated by synergistic interactions. Code is released at https://github.com/brightest66/HRIL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HRIL 把跨模态协同 (synergy) 定义为只能从多模态联合配置中恢复的高阶统计依赖，用模态嵌入上的经验跨矩张量 (cross-moment tensor) 显式建模多路交互，再用 Tucker 分解取 core tensor，并加一个防止能量集中、保持高阶耦合容量的协同感知正则。在受控协同任务与真实基准上，相比现有跨模态对比学习方法取得一致提升，在以协同交互为主导的任务上增益尤其明显。
Motivation: 自监督多模态表征学习擅长保留模态间共享信息，但跨模态交互复杂，只在多模态联合配置下才出现、任一单模态都无法恢复的协同信号容易在表示中丢失。
Method: HRIL (Higher-order Representation and Information Learning) 在模态嵌入上构造经验跨矩张量表示多路交互，用 Tucker 分解得到 core tensor，配合一个防止能量集中、保持高阶耦合容量的协同感知正则 (synergy-aware regularizer)，以自监督方式训练。
Result: 在受控协同任务 (controlled synergy task) 和真实世界基准上，HRIL 相比现有跨模态对比方法取得一致改进，在以协同交互主导的任务上增益显著；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把协同信息当作高阶统计依赖来显式建模（跨矩张量 + Tucker core + 协同感知正则），比只对齐共享成分的对比学习更能保留协同信号。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Automated Assembly Instruction Generation from CAD Models Using Grounded Large Language Models: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework
papers.abstract_en: Assembly documentation is a downstream manufacturing artifact that is still usually authored by interpreting CAD models by hand. Structured product data and large language models are both available, yet studies of CAD interpretation, assembly sequence planning, instruction writing, and human oversight have largely proceeded separately. This paper formulates CAD-grounded assembly instruction generation: the production of natural-language assembly procedures constrained by structured engineering information extracted from CAD models. The proposed framework maps a STEP assembly to a typed ProductGraph intermediate representation, derives a precedence order by deterministic topological sorting, realizes each step as language conditioned only on selected graph context, attaches per-step visual documentation, and applies rule-based and model-assisted checks. PDF export remains disabled until a human reviewer resolves every quality flag. The case study establishes endto-end feasibility on a built-in six-part reference assembly: the pipeline preserves a reported assembly order and carries quantity, material, and torque into an exported manual page. Generalization and geometric validation remain open empirical questions. The contribution is an architecture that separates engineering state, deterministic reasoning, grounded language realization, verification, and human release.
papers.comment: Withdrawal requested as one of the co-authors did not consent to the publication of the manuscript
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CAD 落地的装配说明书生成框架：把 STEP 装配体转成带类型的 ProductGraph 中间表示，用确定性拓扑排序得到装配先后顺序，再由 LLM 仅依据选定图上下文生成每步文字并附图，经规则与模型辅助检查后，必须由人工审核清掉全部质量标记才允许导出 PDF。在内置六件参考装配体的案例研究中，流程保住了报告的装配顺序，并把数量、材料、扭矩带进导出的手册页面。
Motivation: 装配文档至今多靠人工解读 CAD 模型撰写，而 CAD 解读、装配序列规划、说明书撰写与人工监督的研究各自推进，缺少把结构化工程信息约束到自然语言生成的统一架构。
Method: 框架将 STEP 装配体映射为 typed ProductGraph 中间表示，用确定性拓扑排序 (topological sorting) 推导 precedence order，每一步语言只由选定的图上下文条件化生成，并附带逐步视觉文档；随后施加规则式与模型辅助的质量检查，PDF 导出在人工审核解决全部质量标记前保持禁用。
Result: 在内置六件参考装配体 (six-part reference assembly) 的案例研究上建立端到端可行性：流水线保住了报告的装配顺序，并把数量、材料与扭矩 (quantity, material, torque) 带入导出的手册页面。
Conclusion: 作者主张贡献是一个把工程状态、确定性推理、落地语言生成、验证与人工放行分离开的架构；泛化能力与几何验证仍是待做的实证问题。

papers.title: Design Creativity Bench: Measuring creativity in LLM-Generated UI
papers.abstract_en: As leading LLMs improve on capability evaluations, their limitations in producing creative outputs on design tasks remain insufficiently characterised. Our work introduces Design Creativity Bench, a benchmark that evaluates diversity and appropriateness in UI designs. It measures distinctiveness among models on the same prompt (originality), how much a model's designs change between two prompts for the same UI goal in different product domains (creative range), and the share of a brief's acceptance criteria each design meets (appropriateness). Originality is 0.592 for same-prompt design pairs from different models (95% CI [0.582, 0.602]), far below the 0.764 for same-prompt human-model pairs (95% CI [0.751, 0.778]). Creative range is 0.581 across models (95% CI [0.567, 0.597]), against 0.902 for human designs (95% CI [0.884, 0.919]). Appropriateness is above 90% for every model in our test set, and the best model reaches 99.2%, slightly above the 98.0% for human designs. Our work shows that the default output of LLMs, though generally appropriate, is substantially more repetitive than the human baseline. This calls for strong measures to address the issue. A live leaderboard with newer models is maintained at https://kombai.com/benchmark/.
papers.comment: v2: added link to live leaderboard (https://kombai.com/benchmark/); clarified that appropriateness results apply to the evaluated models. Results unchanged. 29 pages (11 pages main text), 9 figures, 10 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Design Creativity Bench 用 originality、creative range、appropriateness 三个维度量化 LLM 生成 UI 的创造性，发现模型默认输出在合格度上已接近甚至略超人类（最佳模型 99.2% vs 人类 98.0%），但同 prompt 下的区分度与跨领域创意跨度显著低于人类：originality 0.592 对人类-模型配对 0.764，creative range 0.581 对人类 0.902。结论是 LLM 默认输出合格但高度重复，需要强措施改善多样性。
Motivation: LLM 在能力评测上持续进步，但在设计任务上产出创造性输出的短板缺乏系统刻画，尤其是模型之间、以及模型与人类之间的重复程度没有可量化基准。
Method: 提出 Design Creativity Bench，对 UI 设计评测三个指标：同一 prompt 下不同模型设计的区分度 (originality)、同一 UI 目标在不同产品领域两个 prompt 间设计的变化幅度 (creative range)、以及每个设计满足 brief 验收标准的比例 (appropriateness)，并以人类设计作为对照基线，结果附 95% 置信区间。
Result: 同 prompt 不同模型配对 originality 0.592（95% CI [0.582, 0.602]），远低于同 prompt 人类-模型配对的 0.764（[0.751, 0.778]）；creative range 跨模型 0.581（[0.567, 0.597]）对人类 0.902（[0.884, 0.919]）；appropriateness 所有受测模型均高于 90%，最佳模型 99.2%，略高于人类设计的 98.0%。
Conclusion: LLM 默认 UI 输出普遍合格但比人类基线重复得多，需要强措施解决多样性不足；appropriateness 结论仅适用于受测模型，配套维护含更新模型的在线 leaderboard。

papers.title: Characterizing Statistical Separability in TP-CRIV for Probabilistic AI Models
papers.abstract_en: Third-party challenge-response identity verification (TP-CRIV) enables an independent verifier to assess whether a claimant possesses a model identical to a remotely deployed model without directly accessing the reference model. However, for probabilistic AI models, repeated executions of the same query may produce different outputs and therefore different verification observations. This raises the question of how such stochastic evidence should be accumulated and how much evidence is required for reliable verification. In this work, we characterize statistical separability in TP-CRIV of probabilistic AI models. Specifically, we relate challenge-wise behavior of matching and non-matching provers to verification-level separability. The characterization explicitly describes how the numbers of independent challenges and repeated responses affect detection performance and enables the verification budget required for a target AUC to be estimated. We instantiate the proposed characterization for LLMs using open-ended challenges. The experiments demonstrate matching-non-matching separation, close agreement between theoretical and empirical AUCs, and consistent estimates of the minimum verification budgets. These results provide a statistical basis for relating probabilistic model behavior to verification-level separability and the evidence required for third-party verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对概率型 AI 模型的第三方挑战-响应身份验证 (TP-CRIV)，把单次挑战下匹配/不匹配证明者的随机行为映射到验证级可分性，显式刻画独立挑战数与重复响应数如何决定检测性能，并据此估计达到目标 AUC 所需的最小验证预算。在 LLM 开放式挑战上的实验显示匹配与不匹配可分、理论 AUC 与经验 AUC 接近一致，且最小验证预算估计稳定。
Motivation: 概率模型对同一查询重复执行输出不同，验证观测因此是随机的；TP-CRIV 缺少刻画这种随机证据如何累积、需要多少次验证才能可靠判定的统计框架。
Method: 将挑战级匹配/不匹配证明者行为与验证级 separability 建立关系，显式纳入独立挑战数与重复响应数两个变量，推导出可估计目标 AUC 所需验证预算的刻画；并在 LLM 开放式挑战 (open-ended challenges) 上实例化该刻画。
Result: LLM 开放式挑战实验展示匹配-不匹配分离、理论 AUC 与经验 AUC 接近一致，以及最小验证预算估计的一致性；刻画给出达到目标 AUC 所需验证预算的可估计形式。
Conclusion: 概率模型的挑战级随机行为可以用一个统计刻画连接到验证级可分性，并给出第三方验证所需证据量的统计依据。

papers.title: Do LLMs Learn from Rewards in Context? : Rethinking the role of reward in In-Context RL
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly improve at inference time by accumulating experience in context rather than by updating parameters. This process is often described as in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL). Whether in-context learning (ICL) can actually play the role of RL, however, has not been tested. We study this question in its simplest form, direct ICRL, where the model conditions directly on raw trajectory-reward pairs, and ask whether the reward acts as a learning signal. Through controlled experiments on four benchmarks across six models, we find that the reward is read, but its effect is small: flipping, randomizing, or removing the reward leaves the improvement curve almost unchanged, and this holds even under meta-prompts that explicitly instruct the model to explore, exploit, or reason over rewards. Trajectories drive improvement, but not through their semantic content: shuffled or corrupted trajectories work as well as real ones. These patterns closely mirror those known in ICL, suggesting that direct ICRL is better understood as a special case of ICL than as inference-time RL. This reframing has implications for agent memory design: ICL factors such as input distribution and demonstrations may matter more than RL elements such as reward shaping and exploration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在四个基准、六个模型上做受控实验发现：直接式 in-context RL (direct ICRL) 中 reward 确实被读取，但翻转、随机化或移除 reward 几乎不改变改进曲线，即使 meta-prompt 明确要求探索、利用或推理 reward 也一样；轨迹打乱或损坏后效果不变，说明改进来自轨迹的存在而非语义内容。作者据此主张 direct ICRL 应被视为 ICL 的特例而非推理时 RL，agent memory 设计应更重视输入分布与示范而非 reward shaping。
Motivation: LLM agent 靠在上下文中累积经验而非更新参数来改进，常被称作 in-context RL (ICRL)，但 in-context learning 是否真能扮演 RL 中 reward 的学习信号角色此前未被检验。
Method: 研究最简形式的 direct ICRL：模型直接以原始 trajectory-reward 对为条件。在四个基准、六个模型上做受控干预实验，分别翻转、随机化、移除 reward，并加入明确指示探索、利用或对 reward 推理的 meta-prompt；另对轨迹做打乱与损坏以分离语义内容的作用。
Result: 四个基准、六个模型上，翻转/随机化/移除 reward 后改进曲线几乎不变，加探索、利用或 reward 推理的 meta-prompt 也不改变该模式；打乱或损坏的轨迹与真实轨迹效果相当。
Conclusion: direct ICRL 中 reward 被读取但作用很小，改进由轨迹驱动且不依赖其语义内容，因此它更像 ICL 的特例而非推理时 RL；agent memory 设计中输入分布与示范可能比 reward shaping 和探索更重要。

papers.title: NOMOS: Compiling Written Policies into Statically Verified Tool-Call Gates for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using LLM agents violate the policies they are deployed to enforce, often silently. Prior defenses hand-write rules, query an LLM verifier per action, or compile policies through heavyweight formal machinery. Naive compilation fails: extracted rules block the tool satisfying their own precondition, or read arguments their tool lacks. NOMOS, a four-pass compiler, turns a natural-language policy into a deterministic tool-call gate; static verification with tool-schema-level checks alone (no prover, solver, or LLM) repairs or rejects 37% (airline) and 13% (retail) of candidates, without which most shipped rules are inoperable. Replaying compiled rules over undefended transcripts flags bindings that refuse legitimate work (a development binding refused 95.9% of task-passing calls); no evaluation binding is flagged. On $τ^2$-bench the gate cuts violations of reference-encoded clauses among state-changing calls from 66.3% to 2.6% (airline) and 30.8% to 6.9% (retail), raising airline task success significantly for $2 \le k \le 4$; a 26B on-premise compilation is not significantly worse than hand-written or frontier-compiled rules. Unlike AgentDojo's shipped defenses, it reaches a zero attack success rate (ASR) on banking, where nine attack families collapse onto three structural rules. On the other three suites its ASR is at most 3.6%, from goals with no tool call to govern and one write admitted by a binding weaker than its clause; a second agent model, Llama-3.3-70B, reproduces the effect on both benchmarks. Decisions take microseconds without an LLM call, at a domain-dependent benign-utility cost; compilation runs on-premise on open-weight gemma-4-26B.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 5 figures, 19 tables. Submitted to IEEE Access
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NOMOS 把自然语言策略编译成确定性工具调用闸门，四遍编译加仅靠工具 schema 的静态校验（不用 prover、solver 或 LLM）修复或拒绝 37%（airline）与 13%（retail）的候选规则。在 τ²-bench 上，状态变更调用违反参考编码条款的比例从 66.3% 降到 2.6%（airline）、30.8% 降到 6.9%（retail），banking 达到零攻击成功率 (ASR)。
Motivation: 部署来执行策略的工具型 LLM agent 经常静默违反自身策略；现有防御要么手写规则、要么每个动作调一次 LLM 校验器、要么依赖重型形式化工具，朴素编译还会产出阻断自身前置条件或读取工具不存在参数的规则。
Method: 四遍编译器把自然语言策略转成确定性工具调用闸门，静态校验只做工具 schema 级检查（无 prover、solver、LLM）来修复或拒绝候选规则；再在无防御转录上回放编译规则以标记拒绝合法工作的绑定；编译在本地用开放权重 gemma-4-26B 运行，决策为微秒级且不调用 LLM。
Result: 静态校验修复或拒绝 37%（airline）与 13%（retail）候选；一个开发绑定拒绝了 95.9% 的通过任务调用，而评估绑定无一被标记。τ²-bench 上状态变更调用的条款违规从 66.3% 降至 2.6%（airline）、30.8% 降至 6.9%（retail），airline 任务成功率在 2≤k≤4 显著提升；26B 本地编译不显著劣于手写或前沿模型编译规则。banking 上 ASR 为 0（九类攻击收敛为三条结构性规则），其余三个套件 ASR ≤3.6%；Llama-3.3-70B 在两个基准上复现该效果。
Conclusion: 仅靠 schema 级静态校验即可让编译出的策略闸门可用且强安全，代价是领域相关的良性效用损失；无工具调用可管的目标与一条弱于其条款的绑定写入是残余违规来源。

papers.title: MultiFly: A Real-World Multimodal Aerial Dataset with Annotation-Efficient Label Transfer and Cross-Modal Semantic Consistency
papers.abstract_en: We introduce MultiFly, a real-world, low-altitude UAV dataset for semantic perception across RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar modalities. MultiFly provides 17,272 synchronized samples from four suburban scenes with frame-wise annotations for 15 semantic classes, together with calibration and GNSS-RTK/IMU measurements. To avoid costly and inconsistent modality-specific annotation, we propagate labels from only 115 manually annotated RGB images through shared geometric representations to all four modalities. This approach generates semantic labels for 17,157 additional RGB images, 17,272 thermal images, 840M LiDAR points, and 3.4M radar points. Transferred annotations achieve 89.93% average agreement with held-out manual annotations, and 90.94% average semantic consistency across all six modality pairs. We further establish semantic segmentation benchmarks for all four modalities, revealing distinct architectural behavior for dense LiDAR and sparse radar data. Taken together, MultiFly provides a scalable foundation for multimodal aerial perception and, to the best of our knowledge, the first public real-world low-altitude aerial benchmark that combines consistent frame-wise semantic annotations for RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar. Data at https://github.com/markus-42/multifly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MultiFly 是低空 UAV 多模态语义感知数据集，含 RGB、热成像、LiDAR、雷达四模态 17,272 个同步样本、4 个郊区场景、15 类逐帧标注。仅人工标注 115 张 RGB 图，经共享几何表示把标签传播到四模态，额外生成 17,157 张 RGB、17,272 张热图、8.4 亿 LiDAR 点与 340 万雷达点标注；与留出人工标注的平均一致率 89.93%，六个模态对的平均语义一致性 90.94%。
Motivation: 逐模态分别标注多模态 UAV 数据成本高且各模态标签不一致，制约跨模态语义感知基准的构建。
Method: 仅人工标注 115 张 RGB 图像，通过共享几何表示 (shared geometric representations) 把标签传播到 RGB、热成像、LiDAR、雷达四个模态；配套提供标定与 GNSS-RTK/IMU 测量，并为四个模态分别建立语义分割基准。
Result: 标签传播覆盖 17,157 张额外 RGB、17,272 张热成像、840M LiDAR 点与 3.4M 雷达点；与留出人工标注的平均一致率 89.93%，六个模态对的平均语义一致性 90.94%；分割基准显示稠密 LiDAR 与稀疏雷达数据上架构行为差异明显。
Conclusion: 用少量 RGB 标注经几何共享表示即可为四个模态生成一致的逐帧语义标签，MultiFly 成为首个公开的真实低空四模态逐帧语义标注基准。

papers.title: SkillForge: Co-Evolving Skills and Agents via Dynamic Skill Lifecycles
papers.abstract_en: Memory-augmented reinforcement learning strengthens LLM agents' ability to solve complex long-horizon tasks. Skills are one such form of memory, pairing instructions with an applicability condition over task types. However, retaining every skill indiscriminately as the policy improves lets obsolete or harmful entries accumulate and mislead the agent. We propose SkillForge, an agentic RL method that compiles and evolves the skill library through a fitness-driven skill lifecycle of trial, active, stable, and retired states, so that the skills and the model co-evolve throughout training. A pre-RL evaluation phase first uses the base model's own rollouts to pre-retire low-fitness skills, yielding a filtered library that then seeds supervised fine-tuning. Reinforcement learning takes over from this checkpoint, and at each iteration selective retirement, stabilization, and LLM-guided mutation continue to forge the skill library alongside policy optimization. Across multiple interactive agent benchmarks, SkillForge achieves the highest aggregate success rate, delivering up to 7.8% relative improvement over the strongest baseline while keeping the skill library compact throughout training. We introduce SkillFurnace, a dataset of 5k+ annotated records bundling retirement-filtered SFT trajectories, evolved skill libraries with fitness annotations, and retirement events with human-annotated failure categories to support research on skill quality and lifecycle management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillForge 用适应度驱动的技能生命周期（trial/active/stable/retired 四态）让 LLM agent 的技能库与策略在训练中共同演化：先用 base model 自身 rollout 预退役低适应度技能来过滤 SFT 种子库，RL 阶段再持续做选择性退役、稳定化与 LLM 引导变异。在多个交互式 agent benchmark 上取得最高综合成功率，相对最强基线最高提升 7.8%，同时全程保持技能库紧凑。
Motivation: 记忆增强 RL 中若无差别保留全部技能，过时或有害条目会累积并误导 agent，使技能库随策略改进反而退化。
Method: SkillForge 是一种 agentic RL 方法：预 RL 评估阶段用 base model 自己的 rollout 预退役低适应度技能，得到过滤后的技能库作为 SFT 种子；从该 checkpoint 接入 RL，每轮迭代执行选择性退役、稳定化和 LLM 引导变异，与策略优化同步演化技能库。
Result: 在多个交互式 agent benchmark 上取得最高综合成功率，相对最强基线最高 7.8% 的相对提升，且训练全程保持技能库紧凑。同时发布 SkillFurnace 数据集，含 5k+ 标注记录，涵盖退役过滤后的 SFT 轨迹、带适应度标注的演化技能库，以及带人工标注失败类别的退役事件。
Conclusion: 技能库不应只增不减：按适应度做生命周期管理并让技能与模型共同演化，可在保持库紧凑的同时提高长程任务成功率。

papers.title: Identity-Duplication Auditing in National-Scale Neuroimaging Repositories
authors: for the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
Aging Brain Study : Health Disparities (HABS-HD) Study Team
papers.abstract_en: National-scale magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) repositories increasingly integrate data from different studies and institutions. However, subject identifiers assigned to study participants are typically specific to individual datasets, so the same person may appear under different identifiers when these datasets are aggregated, a problem we define as identity duplication. Such duplication can create leakage between training and test data and inflate apparent performance in downstream biomedical studies. Existing methods do not provide an end-to-end, image-based workflow to address this problem. In this work, we present HAPPEN, a human-in-the-loop pipeline for auditing identity duplication in T1-weighted brain MRI repositories. It combines SHA-256 fingerprinting for exact-duplicate detection with embeddings learned through supervised contrastive learning to retrieve near-duplicate candidates: pairs of non-identical scans that may originate from the same person. Retrieved pairs are reviewed as candidates in a locally hosted interface rather than automatically classified as duplicates. We deployed the workflow in a national-scale aggregated repository containing 95,129 scans and assessed end-to-end recovery of 54 pairs of subject records identified as duplicates using genome-wide genotype data. Transferability was assessed by locally deploying the same workflow on 22,386 scans at an independent institution without model retraining or image transfer. Deployment in the study repository identified 1,316 exact-duplicate scan groups and 1,275 near-duplicate groups of subject records supported by human review. Of these groups, 56% and 82%, respectively, crossed dataset boundaries. All 54 genetic-reference pairs were recovered. The external team independently completed the full workflow using a locally selected operating threshold and review standard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HAPPEN：面向全国级 T1 加权脑 MRI 库的身份重复审计流水线，用 SHA-256 指纹抓精确重复、监督对比学习嵌入检索近重复候选，再由本地人工界面复核而非自动判定。在 95,129 例扫描的聚合库上识别出 1,316 个精确重复组与 1,275 个近重复受试者组（分别有 56% 与 82% 跨数据集边界），并全部找回 54 对基因型参考重复对；同一工作流在独立机构 22,386 例扫描上无需重训或传图即可本地部署。
Motivation: 多机构聚合的国家级 MRI 库中受试者 ID 各自独立，同一人可能以不同 ID 重复出现，造成训练/测试泄漏并虚高下游生物医学研究性能；现有方法缺少端到端的、基于图像的处理流程。
Method: HAPPEN 是人在环 (human-in-the-loop) 流水线：SHA-256 指纹检测精确重复，监督对比学习 (supervised contrastive learning) 训练的嵌入检索近重复候选（非同一 ID 但可能同一人的扫描对），候选对在本地托管界面中由人工复核而非自动分类；可移植性通过在独立机构本地部署同一工作流、不重训模型也不传输图像来检验。
Result: 在含 95,129 例扫描的全国级聚合库上，端到端找回了 54 对以全基因组基因型数据判定的重复受试者记录；识别出 1,316 个精确重复扫描组与 1,275 个经人工复核支持的近重复受试者组，其中跨数据集边界的比例分别为 56% 和 82%。外部团队在 22,386 例扫描上独立完成全流程，使用本地选定的操作阈值与复核标准。
Conclusion: 国家级 MRI 库中身份重复是跨数据集的普遍现象，指纹加对比嵌入加人工复核的组合能在不传图、不重训的条件下跨机构部署并完整找回基因型参考重复对。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Immiscible Diffusion Policy: Preserving Multimodal Robot Actions through Label-Free Noise Assignment
papers.abstract_en: When diffusion policies were first introduced, they were expected to recover multi-modal action distributions. However, we find this expectation does not always hold, as diffusion policies often collapse to a single modality even when we guarantee the balance of dataset modalities and exact within-batch symmetry. Our analysis indicates that independent action-noise pairing contributes to this failure by increasing mixing and crossing among diffusion paths, which can produce averaged denoising responses and suppress modality-specific behavior. This issue is especially severe in robot planning, where action spaces are dense and low-dimensional, significantly increasing such mixing and crossing. To alleviate this problem, we propose Immiscible Diffusion Policy, a label-free training-time add-on to diffusion policy that uses action-noise assignment to preserve relatively distinct noise-to-action routes without modifying the policy architecture or inference procedure. Across five simulated and two real-world humanoid manipulation tasks spanning state, RGB, and point-cloud observations, our method significantly improves the policy's preservation of action modalities while maintaining strong task performance. It increases the proportion of the non-dominant modality by 6.0x-14.6x across three two-modality tasks and recovers demonstrated modalities that are entirely absent from vanilla policy rollouts on both four-modality tasks. These results demonstrate that Immiscible Diffusion Policy provides a simple yet robust approach to preserving action multi-modality in general robot learning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 扩散策略 (diffusion policy) 即使数据模态均衡、batch 内严格对称，仍常塌缩到单一动作模态；作者把原因归到动作-噪声独立配对造成的扩散路径交叉，产生平均化的去噪响应。提出的 Immiscible Diffusion Policy 在训练时按动作-噪声指派保留相对分离的噪声到动作路径，不改架构与推理流程；在三个双模态任务上把非主导模态占比提升 6.0x–14.6x，并在两个四模态任务上找回 vanilla rollout 中完全缺失的模态。
Motivation: 扩散策略本被期待恢复多模态动作分布，但在稠密低维的机器人动作空间里路径混合与交叉更严重，导致模态塌缩，示范中较少的模态在 rollout 中直接消失。
Method: 提出 Immiscible Diffusion Policy：一种免标签 (label-free) 的训练期附加模块，通过 action-noise assignment 让不同动作对应相对分离的噪声到动作路径，不修改策略架构，也不改推理过程；评测覆盖 state、RGB、点云三类观测。
Result: 在五个仿真与两个真实人形机器人操作任务上，三个双模态任务的非主导模态占比提升 6.0x–14.6x；两个四模态任务中找回了 vanilla 策略 rollout 里完全不存在的示范模态，同时保持较强任务性能。
Conclusion: 动作-噪声的独立配对是扩散策略模态塌缩的成因，训练期的噪声指派即可在不改架构的前提下稳健保留动作多模态，适用于一般机器人学习任务。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Self-Retrospection Distillation: Turning Post-hoc Experiences into Prior Foresight
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) turns agent experience into learning signals primarily through scalar outcome rewards after interaction. For group-relative objectives, however, this signal vanishes when all rollouts receive the same reward, even though their trajectories may reveal useful information about what the task requires and how the agent fails. We ask a complementary question: can hindsight teach an agent what it could have anticipated before acting? We introduce prospective learning, which uses post-hoc experience to supervise foresight predictions from the pre-interaction view, and instantiate it with Self-Retrospection Distillation (SRD). Intuitively, a completed trajectory reveals knowledge that would have been useful and pitfalls that should be avoided; SRD distills this privileged hindsight into trajectory-blind foresight of the same policy. Foresight serves only as a training target and need not be explicitly generated at inference time. Across 10 tool-integrated reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks, SRD complements RLVR and self-distillation baselines with gains of up to 24.2 pp. Its advantage is especially pronounced when reward contrast is scarce: when 37--98% of rollout groups are reward-uniform across model scales, yet SRD can still exploit learning signal from sampled trajectories. In the 2B setting, where 98% of groups are all-failure, the RLVR training ends up at 0.0% success, while adding SRD reaches 60.6% under the same rollout budget. Our results suggest that post-hoc agent experience is useful not only for evaluating or improving behavior, but also for shaping predictive representations before available interaction. Training code can be found at https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/SRD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Self-Retrospection Distillation (SRD)：把交互后轨迹中的事后知识蒸馏成策略在交互前的 foresight 预测，作为 RLVR 的补充训练目标（推理时无需生成 foresight）。在 10 个工具集成推理与长程 agentic 任务上，SRD 相对 RLVR 与 self-distillation 基线最高提升 24.2 pp；当 37–98% 的 rollout 组奖励全同、2B 模型 98% 组全失败时，纯 RLVR 训练收敛到 0.0% 成功率，加 SRD 在相同 rollout 预算下达到 60.6%。
Motivation: RLVR 依赖标量结果奖励，而 group-relative 目标在一组 rollout 奖励全同时学习信号消失，尽管这些轨迹本身仍包含任务要求与失败方式的信息。
Method: 提出 prospective learning，用事后完整轨迹监督同一策略在交互前视角的 foresight 预测，实例化为 Self-Retrospection Distillation (SRD)：把特权 hindsight 蒸馏为 trajectory-blind foresight，foresight 仅作训练目标，推理时不显式生成；与 RLVR 及 self-distillation 基线组合训练。
Result: 在 10 个工具集成推理与长程 agentic 任务上，SRD 相对 RLVR 与 self-distillation 基线最高提升 24.2 pp；跨模型规模有 37–98% 的 rollout 组奖励全同，SRD 仍能从采样轨迹中提取学习信号；2B 设置下 98% 的组全失败，纯 RLVR 训练最终 0.0% 成功率，加入 SRD 在相同 rollout 预算下达 60.6%。
Conclusion: 事后 agent 经验不只用于评估或改进行为，还能在交互发生前塑造预测性表征；奖励对比稀缺时，从轨迹蒸馏 foresight 可以救回 group-relative RLVR 的零信号训练。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Lost in the bf16 Cast: Exporting Ternary Language Models Can Revert Most Low-Learning-Rate Code Changes
papers.abstract_en: Ternary language models such as BitNet b1.58, Falcon-E and BitCPM are fine-tuned with higher-precision latent weights and deployed as ternary codes produced by an export step that, in the labs' documented pipelines, first casts the latents to bf16. We audit those pipelines across three labs. In released checkpoints, fp32 quantization of the shipped latents disagrees with the deployed codes on 0.83-1.77% of codes in Falcon-E and BitCPM and on 1.530% in BitNet 2B-4T; for Falcon-E and BitCPM most disagreements are products that bf16 rounding lands exactly on the threshold, which ties-to-even maps to zero, and the unmodified onebitllms exporter reproduces all four Falcon-E releases byte for byte. At fine-tuned endpoints, with learning rates selected to match a nominal learning-rate-to-bf16-ULP ratio, the documented export lowers greedy GSM8K strict accuracy from 58.79% to 0.78% for Falcon-E-1B-Base and from 36.13% to 0.39% for BitCPM-CANN-0.5B, and a bf16 save and reload lowers BitNet 2B-4T's strict accuracy by 27.54 points while its last-number accuracy rises. Two compatibility remedies, writing the training quantizer's codes directly or adjusting the bf16 inputs until the unchanged tools emit them, each met a 4-point strict-accuracy non-inferiority criterion against online evaluation in all three models. In a prospectively frozen study of bf16 latents during fine-tuning (one task, one recipe and trajectory per arm), native bf16 writes left 2B-4T's codes unchanged at the endpoint and changed one Falcon-E code, while emulated stochastic-rounding and compensated writers changed codes and were non-inferior to fp32 training at the same margin in both models. In two model families, randomized interventions on the initial distance from the threshold support distance-dependent selection of the codes that fine-tuning changes.
papers.comment: v2: adds Section 6, a pre-registered study of bf16 latent writes during fine-tuning (native bf16, and stochastic-rounding and compensated-write emulations, on BitNet 2B-4T and Falcon-E), and an updated audit of public fine-tuned checkpoints. 18 pages, 4 figures, 20 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 三元语言模型 (BitNet b1.58、Falcon-E、BitCPM) 的导出管线先把高精度 latent 权重 cast 到 bf16 再量化成三元码，bf16 舍入落在阈值上会被 ties-to-even 映射为 0，从而改写微调学到的码。在按 learning-rate-to-bf16-ULP 比率选定学习率的端点上，文档化导出使 Falcon-E-1B-Base 的 GSM8K greedy 严格准确率从 58.79% 跌到 0.78%，BitCPM-CANN-0.5B 从 36.13% 跌到 0.39%；直接写训练量化器的码或调整 bf16 输入两种补救在三个模型上都满足相对在线评估的 4 个百分点非劣界限。
Motivation: 实验室公开的三元模型导出流程在量化前插入 bf16 cast，这一步会静默覆盖微调写入的低学习率权重改动，导致发布 checkpoint 的码与训练端点不一致，且现有导出工具链未被审计过。
Method: 跨三家实验室审计公开管线与发布 checkpoint：用 fp32 量化 shipped latents 与部署码逐位比对，并用未修改的 onebitllms exporter 复现 Falcon-E 发布物；在匹配 learning-rate-to-bf16-ULP 比率的学习率下比较文档化导出与两种兼容性补救（直接写训练量化器的码、调整 bf16 输入使原工具输出目标码）；另做预注册的 bf16 latent 写入研究，比较 native bf16、stochastic-rounding 与 compensated-write 仿真（BitNet 2B-4T 与 Falcon-E，每臂单一任务、配方与轨迹），并随机干预初始到阈值的距离。
Result: fp32 量化与部署码的不一致占比：Falcon-E 与 BitCPM 为 0.83–1.77%，BitNet 2B-4T 为 1.530%；Falcon-E 与 BitCPM 的多数不一致来自 bf16 舍入恰好落在阈值上被 ties-to-even 归零，未修改的 onebitllms exporter 逐字节复现全部四个 Falcon-E 发布物。文档化导出使 GSM8K greedy 严格准确率 Falcon-E-1B-Base 58.79% → 0.78%，BitCPM-CANN-0.5B 36.13% → 0.39%；bf16 存盘再重载使 BitNet 2B-4T 严格准确率下降 27.54 点而末位数字准确率上升。两种补救在三个模型上全部满足 4 点严格准确率非劣界限。预注册研究中 native bf16 写入在 2B-4T 端点未改变码、在 Falcon-E 只改变一个码，仿真 stochastic-rounding 与 compensated 写入改变了码且在两个模型上同幅度非劣于 fp32 训练。
Conclusion: 低学习率微调的收益会被导出时的 bf16 cast 抹掉，因为阈值附近的码选择由到阈值的距离决定；要保住这些改动，应直接写训练量化器的码或调整 bf16 输入，而不是沿用先 cast 再量化的导出。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 低学习率微调的收益会被导出时的 bf16 cast 抹掉，因为阈值附近的码选择由到阈值的距离决定；要保住这些改动，应直接写训练量化器的码或调整 bf16 输入，而不是沿用先 cast 再量化的导出。

papers.title: Monte Carlo Estimation for KV Cache Eviction
papers.abstract_en: Most KV-cache eviction methods ask, in effect, which memory appeared important while reading the prompt? We instead ask which memory will matter while answering? Since decoding queries are unavailable at eviction time, prior future-aware methods rely on pseudo-responses or synthetic future-query estimates. We cast fixed-budget future-aware eviction as distributional estimation over plausible model-conditional query trajectories and introduce LORE-KV (Lookahead Output-perturbation with Reliability-weighted Ensembles for Key-Value caches), a training-free method that samples short autoregressive continuations from the frozen target model and uses their response-side query states to estimate prompt-token utility. Tokens are scored by projected leave-one-out attention-output deletion cost and aggregated across sampled futures with optional trajectory weighting. The temporary continuations are discarded before final decoding, requiring no auxiliary model or training. Ablations isolate the mechanism: at B=128, a single response-side continuation recovers about 89% of the gain over the prompt-window control, while additional futures provide smaller improvements. At B=128, LORE-KV raises the LongBench average on Qwen2.5-14B from 45.49 to 48.24 (+2.75) and the 16K RULER average on Mistral-7B from 45.20 to 51.05 (+5.85); on Llama-3.1-8B, the RULER margin over AnDPro widens to +8.13 and +11.65 points at 64K and 128K contexts. Gains diminish at larger cache budgets and coexist with task-level regressions. LORE-KV incurs 1.46-2.77x AnDPro's per-sample wall-clock time as a one-time compression overhead across six dense and hybrid-attention backbones. Project webpage: https://ahsanbilal7.github.io/train_free_kv/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LORE-KV 把固定预算的未来感知 KV cache 淘汰改写成对模型条件查询轨迹的分布估计：训练无关地从冻结目标模型采样短自回归续写，用其 response-side 查询状态经投影的 leave-one-out 注意力输出删除代价给 prompt token 打分，再跨采样未来聚合。B=128 时 Qwen2.5-14B 的 LongBench 均值从 45.49 升到 48.24（+2.75），Mistral-7B 的 16K RULER 均值从 45.20 升到 51.05（+5.85）；代价是 1.46–2.77 倍 AnDPro 的单样本墙钟时间。
Motivation: 现有 KV cache 淘汰方法实际在问“读 prompt 时哪些记忆重要”，而解码时真正起作用的是未来查询；既有的 future-aware 方法只能靠伪响应或合成未来查询估计，缺少对查询轨迹本身的分布刻画。
Method: LORE-KV（Lookahead Output-perturbation with Reliability-weighted Ensembles）：从冻结目标模型采样若干短自回归续写，取其 response-side 查询状态估计 prompt token 效用；打分用投影的 leave-one-out 注意力输出删除代价，跨采样未来聚合并可选轨迹加权；临时续写在正式解码前丢弃，无需辅助模型或训练。
Result: B=128 消融中单条 response-side 续写即可回收约 89% 的相对 prompt-window 对照的增益，更多未来带来递减改进；B=128 时 LongBench 均值 Qwen2.5-14B 45.49→48.24（+2.75），16K RULER 均值 Mistral-7B 45.20→51.05（+5.85）；Llama-3.1-8B 上相对 AnDPro 的 RULER 优势在 64K、128K 上下文分别扩大到 +8.13 与 +11.65 点。增益随 cache 预算变大而减弱并伴随任务级回退，单样本耗时为 AnDPro 的 1.46–2.77 倍，覆盖六个 dense 与 hybrid-attention backbone。
Conclusion: 用采样未来的真实 response-side 查询替代伪响应，可以在训练无关的前提下显著抬高长上下文 KV 淘汰质量，但收益在大预算下饱和且需付一次性压缩开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Vine Copula VAR:From Recursive Margins to Joint Forecast Inference
papers.abstract_en: Joint-event forecasts combine an estimated dependence model with current marginal forecasts. Retaining historical transforms at the marginal fits available when each outcome arrived creates overlapping estimation errors. We derive their joint influence with the terminal estimates in a stable Vine Copula VAR with normal innovation margins and a fixed, correctly specified Gaussian or positive Clayton vine. An intercept identity and the stable VAR filter reduce the historical correction to harmonically weighted innovation moments. Terminal slope uncertainty remains in the forecast gradient. A feasible covariance estimator yields asymptotically valid repeated-sample intervals for fixed one-sided event probabilities at the realized forecast state. A same-family terminal refit provides the efficiency comparison. Retaining dated transforms adds a positive semidefinite limiting covariance term, whose event-level cost depends on dependence sensitivity and forecast-state leverage. Monte Carlo comparisons show a small accuracy cost of retaining the transforms and a larger inferential role for current marginal estimation. Allowing Clayton dependence improves downside forecasts relative to Gaussian dependence under each transform rule. A fourteen-variable U.S. real-time forecasting application and simulations with twenty and fifty variables illustrate feasible joint-event estimation and analytic inference for fixed-depth vines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Vine Copula VAR 中保留历史边际变换（retaining dated transforms）会引入重叠估计误差，但其极限协方差项为半正定，事件层面的代价取决于依赖敏感度与预报状态杠杆。Monte Carlo 显示保留变换只带来小的精度损失，而当前边际估计对推断影响更大；允许 Clayton 依赖相比 Gaussian 依赖改善下行事件预报。
Motivation: 联合事件预报把估计的依赖模型与当前边际预报结合，但每个结果到达时可用的边际拟合若被保留，会产生重叠的估计误差，其对联合推断的影响此前未被解析刻画。
Method: 在正态新息边际与固定正确设定的 Gaussian 或正 Clayton vine 下，用截距恒等式与稳定 VAR 滤波把历史修正化简为调和加权的新息矩；提出可行协方差估计量，为固定单侧事件概率给出渐近有效的重复样本区间，并以同族终端重拟合作效率对照。
Result: Monte Carlo 显示保留变换的精度代价小，而当前边际估计的推断作用更大；在两种变换规则下，Clayin 依赖相对 Gaussian 依赖均改善下行事件预报。应用与仿真规模为十四变量美国实时预报应用，以及二十与五十变量模拟。
Conclusion: 保留带日期的边际变换代价可控且协方差项半正定，联合事件推断的关键在当前边际估计；下行事件预报应允许 Clayton 依赖而非仅用 Gaussian。

papers.title: Langevin Flow Maps: Efficient Molecular Dynamics and Transition Path Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Molecular dynamics simulations proceed by integrating the Langevin equations over many small femtosecond timesteps. This poses a challenge for estimating ensemble properties and transition dynamics that occur on much longer timescales. We introduce Langevin Flow Maps, which extend machine-learned force-fields to additionally learn the stochastic Langevin integrator. We show that Langevin Flow Maps enable large-timestep molecular dynamics and recover accurate dynamical properties of the system, while running an order of magnitude faster than current machine-learned force fields. Further, by training on a diverse molecular dataset, we demonstrate a path towards transferable Langevin Flow Maps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Langevin Flow Maps：在机器学习力场之上再学一个随机 Langevin 积分器，使分子动力学可以用大时间步长推进并仍恢复体系的正确动力学性质，速度比现有机器学习力场快一个数量级。在多样化分子数据集上训练后，作者展示了走向可迁移 Langevin Flow Maps 的路径。
Motivation: 分子动力学需按飞秒级小步长积分 Langevin 方程，估计发生在长得多的时间尺度上的系综性质与转变动力学代价极高。
Method: 将机器学习力场扩展为同时学习随机 Langevin 积分器（Langevin Flow Maps），支持大时间步长积分；在多样分子数据集上训练以获得跨体系迁移能力。
Result: 可进行大时间步长分子动力学并恢复准确的动力学性质，运行速度比当前机器学习力场快一个数量级；在多样化分子数据集上训练展示了可迁移的路径。
Conclusion: 把随机积分器与学习力场一起学习，是让分子动力学跨过飞秒步长瓶颈、同时保住动力学正确性与速度的可行路线。
Relevance: 2
