papers.title: RRM-GPT: A Framework and Vision for Radio Resource Management Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based models for radio resource management (RRM) are typically built for a single function and deployment, so each new setting repeats the development pipeline. RRM decisions, however, share a common structure: each is assembled from interdependent fields, defined by the standard, whose values are selected in view of the network state. We propose RRM-GPT, an autoregressive framework for RRM foundation models that generate these decisions as a language model generates text. An encoder maps heterogeneous network observations into a common token representation, and a decoder emits the decision one field at a time, each conditioned on the network state and the fields already committed. Pretraining on unannotated network logs teaches the model what makes a decision valid and how controllers choose among valid decisions; post-training then adapts it to deployment-specific operator objectives through imitation or reinforcement learning. The framework targets two forms of reuse: a function-specific model reused across deployments, and a model shared across RRM functions that generates their interdependent decisions as one sequence. In a 5G New Radio (NR) case study, we demonstrate that a single model generates complete scheduling grants spanning user selection, timing, link adaptation, resource allocation, and control signaling. The model captures dependencies among grant fields and transfers learned behavior to an unseen scenario without adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RRM-GPT 把无线资源管理 (RRM) 决策当作文本生成：编码器把异构网络观测压成统一 token，解码器按字段逐个生成决策，每个字段以网络状态和已提交字段为条件。在 5G NR 案例中，单一模型生成覆盖用户选择、时序、链路自适应、资源分配与控制信令的完整调度授权，捕捉字段间依赖，并在未见过的场景上零适应迁移。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的 RRM 模型绑定单一功能与单一部署，每换一个场景都要重跑整条开发流水线；而各 RRM 决策共享同一结构——由标准定义、相互依赖的字段按网络状态取值。
Method: 自回归 (autoregressive) 框架：编码器将异构网络观测映射为统一 token 表示，解码器逐字段输出决策，每个字段以网络状态和已提交字段为条件。先用无标注网络日志做预训练，学习决策有效性与控制器的选择偏好，再通过模仿学习或强化学习做部署侧后训练，适配运营商目标。
Result: 在 5G New Radio (NR) 案例研究中，单一模型生成完整调度授权，涵盖用户选择、时序、链路自适应、资源分配与控制信令；模型捕捉授权各字段之间的依赖关系，并将学到的行为迁移到未见过的场景且无需适应。
Conclusion: RRM 决策可按语言生成的方式统一建模，实现两类复用：同一功能的模型跨部署复用，以及跨 RRM 功能共享一个模型、把相互依赖的决策作为单一序列生成。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Agentic AI with Structured CoT for Enhancing AI's Spatial Intelligence: Visualization and Reasoning of Rotation
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies show that artificial intelligence (AI) with language and vision capabilities still experiences limitations in spatial reasoning. In this paper, we have studied the spatial capabilities of advanced generative AI to understand the rotations of objects in 3D space, utilizing AI's image processing and language processing features. We trained and examined the spatial intelligence of a generative Agentic AI model (GPT-5.6) to understand the spatial rotation process with rotation diagrams based on the revised Purdue Spatial Visualization Test: Visualization of Rotations (Revised PSVT:R). We improvised the Revised PSVT:R by superimposing additional graphical and contextual features to evaluate how different Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning strategies influence model performance. The results indicate that structured CoT reasoning improves the spatial reasoning performance of the base GPT-5.6 model in both datasets (PSVT:R and PSVT:R with coordinate system). We used three CoT approaches - (1) Structured CoT, (2) few-shot Structured CoT, and Structured CoT with Self-optimized Prompt. The three CoT approaches evaluated in this study showed no significant performance difference. Results showed that combining structured CoT reasoning with relevant contextual information leads to considerable improvements in VLM performance on 3D rotation tasks, demonstrating the potential of agentic AI for more effective spatial reasoning. However, when contextual information is removed, structured CoT reasoning alone provides limited improvement, and the models continue to exhibit notable difficulties in understanding spatial transformations. These findings suggest that effective spatial reasoning in VLMs relies on the integration of visual, textual, and reasoning-based information in future agentic AI systems for spatial intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Model Decision-Making for Autonomous Driving Guided by Chinese Philosophical Wisdom
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving decision systems must balance safety, efficiency, and social norms in complex traffic interactions. Philosophical and ethical considerations have received limited attention in existing autonomous driving decision-making approaches based on numerical optimization, sequence prediction, and large language models (LLMs). We propose Chinese Philosophical Wisdom-Guided Driving (CPW-Drive), a closed-loop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework that incorporates value guidance derived from Chinese philosophy into autonomous driving decision-making. Using Chinese Confucian thought as its knowledge source, CPW-Drive consolidates LLM-extracted keywords from relevant classical texts into driving-relevant value principles through manual screening and validation. It then contextualizes these principles through scenario-specific cases to form retrievable and reusable value guidance. We further propose Physics-aware Spatial Similarity Retrieval (PSSR), which compares vehicle layouts and velocity-extrapolated states to retrieve physically relevant historical cases. On Highway-env's multilane highway-driving task, CPW-Drive achieves success rates of 93.0%, 86.0%, and 72.0% across three traffic configurations. These results outperform the strongest baseline by 8.0, 22.5, and 25.0 percentage points, respectively. Across all configurations, CPW-Drive achieves the highest collision-free step count and maintains a low lane-change frequency. The results suggest that structured value guidance can improve simulated closed-loop safety and stability while introducing efficiency and latency trade-offs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CPW-Drive：把儒家经典文本经 LLM 抽取关键词、人工筛选成驾驶价值原则，再用物理感知空间相似度检索 (PSSR) 匹配历史场景案例，为 LLM 自动驾驶决策提供闭环 RAG 式价值引导。在 Highway-env 多车道任务的三种交通配置下成功率分别为 93.0%、86.0%、72.0%，比最强基线高 8.0、22.5、25.0 个百分点，且无碰撞步数最高、变道频率低。
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶决策方法基于数值优化、序列预测和 LLM，普遍缺少哲学与伦理层面的考量，难以在复杂交通交互中同时兼顾安全、效率与社会规范。
Method: CPW-Drive 是闭环 RAG 框架：以儒家思想为知识源，用 LLM 从古典文本抽取关键词并经人工筛选验证为驾驶相关价值原则，再通过场景案例将其情境化为可检索复用的价值引导；同时提出 PSSR，比较车辆布局与速度外推状态来检索物理相关的历史案例。
Result: 在 Highway-env 多车道高速任务的三种交通配置下，成功率分别为 93.0%、86.0%、72.0%，超出最强基线 8.0、22.5、25.0 个百分点；全部配置下无碰撞步数最高、变道频率保持较低水平。
Conclusion: 结构化的价值引导能提升模拟闭环驾驶的安全性与稳定性，但引入了效率与延迟上的权衡。

papers.title: From Mixing to Tearing: Graph Decomposition in Decentralized Optimization via Message Passing
papers.abstract_en: We study decentralized minimization of sums of smooth strongly convex functions, one per agent, with communication restricted to neighbors in a graph. Existing decentralized algorithms typically emulate a {\it centralized} method; {\it the network serves only to exchange information}, from which agents approximate the global quantities that the method needs. This paper breaks with this paradigm. We introduce a {\it graph decomposition framework} that uses the network to design the method, not merely execute it. It jointly determines how agreement is imposed, which variables are optimized jointly (blocks), and which connected subgraphs host the agents solving each block. The convergence analysis quantifies the trade-offs among these choices. GATE (Graph-Tearing message passing) instantiates the framework by assigning one dual variable per edge and partitioning the edges into trees. Agents interleave edge updates with local message passing recursions that summarize optimization within each tree (block). Its surrogate variant, GATE-S, uses tractable local models and compact messages to reduce computation and communication. We establish linear convergence and show that the topology-aware design acts as a \emph{preconditioner}: the rate depends {\it jointly} on topology and function geometry through the coupling between subproblems defined on the selected subgraphs, whereas consensus-based optimization methods pay the worst case of each separately, the centralized condition number times the inverse spectral gap. On tree-dominant graphs, convergence is provably faster: the rate scales with the tree {\it diameter}, linearly in the number of agents on rings and barbells against quadratically for non-accelerated consensus-optimization methods. Experiments support the predicted scaling and savings in iterations and communication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出去中心化优化的图分解框架：用网络本身来设计算法而非仅执行中心化方法，联合决定一致性施加方式、变量分块与承载各分块的连通子图。实例化算法 GATE（每条边一个对偶变量、边集划分为树，边更新与树内消息传递递归交错），其代理变体 GATE-S 用可处理的局部模型与紧凑消息降低计算与通信；建立线性收敛，速率由拓扑与函数几何共同决定，在树主导图上随树直径缩放——环与 barbell 图上线性于智能体数，而非加速共识优化方法的二次。
Motivation: 现有去中心化算法只是模拟中心化方法，网络仅用于交换信息，导致收敛速率付出中心化条件数与逆谱隙各自最坏情况的乘积，无法利用具体拓扑结构。
Method: 图分解框架联合选择一致性施加方式、联合优化的变量块与求解各块的连通子图；GATE 每条边分配一个对偶变量并把边划分为树，智能体交错执行边更新与树内消息传递递归；GATE-S 用可处理的局部模型与紧凑消息降低计算与通信开销。
Result: 建立线性收敛；拓扑感知设计充当预条件器，速率由拓扑与函数几何通过所选子图上子问题的耦合共同决定，而共识方法付出中心化条件数乘逆谱隙的最坏情况。树主导图上收敛可证明更快：速率随树直径缩放，环与 barbell 图上线性于智能体数，非加速共识优化方法为二次；实验支持所预测的缩放以及迭代与通信次数的节省。
Conclusion: 把网络结构直接编入算法设计（而非仅用于模拟中心化方法）可充当预条件器，在树主导拓扑上把去中心化优化的收敛速率从按智能体数二次改善为线性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Neuro-Physical Inverter: A Modular Framework for Magnetotelluric Inversion Coupling Ensemble Conditioning with Residual Learning
papers.abstract_en: We present the Neuro-Physical Inverter (NPI), a modular, uncertainty-aware framework for geophysical inversion that couples ensemble-based conditioning with constrained residual learning, demonstrated in the 1D magnetotelluric (MT) setting as a controlled testbed. The framework operates in two stages. An Ensemble-Conditional Gaussian Process (EnsCGP) conditions a prior ensemble of resistivity models on the observed response, producing a physically admissible reference ensemble. A residual-learning neural network then predicts targeted corrections to this reference, trained on synthetic data and fine-tuned per station for field application through a physics-coupled objective. Because an ensemble is conditioned, refined, and propagated through both stages, every estimate carries an associated ensemble spread. Synthetic experiments show that NPI systematically reduces ensemble-mean error without destabilizing the ensemble. Applied to broadband MT data from the Gabbs Valley geothermal region (Nevada, USA), NPI reduces the across-station mean misfit over the mid-period band while retaining comparable ensemble spread. The propagated ensemble yields a factor of uncertainty that serves as an operational measure of constraint within the assumed model class. Both stages are dimension-agnostic in formulation, and the design principles established here are intended to scale to higher-dimensional parameterizations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Neuro-Physical Inverter (NPI)：先用 Ensemble-Conditional Gaussian Process (EnsCGP) 把先验电阻率集合条件化到观测响应，再用残差学习网络在物理耦合目标下预测针对性修正，两阶段都传播集合，因此每个估计都带集合离散度。合成实验中 NPI 系统性降低集合均值误差且不破坏集合稳定性；在内华达 Gabbs Valley 地热区宽带 MT 数据上，中周期段跨台站平均失配下降且集合离散度相当。
Motivation: 地球物理反演需要给出可操作的不确定性度量，而单纯集合条件化或单纯神经网络修正都难以同时保证物理可容许性与逐台站的场数据适配。
Method: 两阶段模块化框架：EnsCGP 以观测响应条件化先验电阻率集合，产出物理可容许参考集合；残差学习神经网络在合成数据上训练、再按台站用物理耦合目标微调，只预测对参考集合的针对性修正。两阶段在形式上均与维度无关。
Result: 合成实验中 NPI 系统性降低集合均值误差且不使集合失稳；应用于 Gabbs Valley (Nevada, USA) 宽带 MT 数据时，中周期段跨台站平均失配 (mean misfit) 下降，同时保持相当的集合离散度；传播后的集合给出一个不确定性因子，作为给定模型类内约束程度的可操作度量。
Conclusion: 把集合条件化与约束残差学习耦合，可以在不牺牲集合稳定性的前提下降低反演误差并保留可解释的不确定性；作者认为该设计原则可扩展到更高维参数化。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Predictively Oriented Gaussian Process Posteriors
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian Processes (GPs) are a powerful tool for modelling and quantifying uncertainty in functional relationships. However, they require practitioners to make a number of design decisions, such as the choice of the kernel and the observation model. Suboptimal choices can produce misspecified models that do not capture the underlying data generating process. We introduce Predictively Oriented Gaussian Processes (PrO-GPs), which treat predictive uncertainty as the primary inferential target and provide a robust alternative to standard GPs. Although direct computation of a PrO posterior for nonparametric models is intractable, we derive a reduced formulation and practical sampling scheme for efficient computation. Through synthetic and real data experiments, we show that PrO-GPs produce better calibrated predictive distributions under model misspecification compared to standard GP approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Predictively Oriented Gaussian Process (PrO-GP)，把预测不确定性本身当作首要推断目标，绕开核函数与观测模型的设计选择；针对非参数模型下 PrO 后验直接计算不可行的问题，推导出降维形式与实用采样方案。合成与真实数据实验显示，在模型误设 (misspecification) 下 PrO-GP 的预测分布校准优于标准 GP。
Motivation: GP 使用者必须先选核与观测模型，选错会得到误设模型、无法捕捉真实数据生成过程，预测不确定性随之失真。
Method: PrO-GP 将预测不确定性设为主要推断目标，替代标准 GP 的先验式构造；由于非参数模型下 PrO 后验直接计算不可行，作者推导降维后验形式 (reduced formulation) 并给出实用采样方案以高效计算。
Result: 在合成数据与真实数据实验中，模型误设条件下 PrO-GP 的预测分布校准优于标准 GP 方法。
Conclusion: 以预测为导向构造后验，是在核与观测模型可能选错时获得更可靠不确定性量化的可行路径，且计算上可通过降维采样方案落地。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Efficient Memory Crystallization for Graph Learning under Non-Stationary Distribution Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Deep graph learning models deployed in real-world systems often need to cope with non-stationary environments, where the underlying graph distribution drifts continually over time. Prevailing solutions rely on training auxiliary generative modules to synthesize memory graphs for cross-domain adaptation, which incurs substantial computational overhead and scales poorly under prolonged distribution shifts. We argue that a more economical path exists: rather than generating memory, one can crystallize it. To this end, we propose Efficient Memory Crystallization (EMC), a training-free test-time framework that distills each incoming graph domain into a compact, semantically faithful memory through a closed-form solution to a memory-oriented distribution-matching objective, thereby eliminating redundant domain information under continual covariate shifts. To preserve both generalizability and adaptability as the model traverses a long sequence of target domains, EMC further models inter-domain dependencies through state-evolving memories and admits a theoretically grounded, tighter generalization error bound than direct adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of EMC over state-of-the-art baselines on graphs under non-stationary distribution shifts, while reducing average runtime by 87.4% and GPU memory consumption by 92.4% relative to the recent competitor, making continual graph adaptation practical at scale.
papers.comment: Accepted by the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 EMC：在图分布持续漂移下，不训练生成模块合成记忆图，而是用面向记忆的分布匹配目标的闭式解把每个新图域蒸馏成紧凑记忆，训练-free 的测试时即可完成跨域适配。相比最近的生成式记忆基线，平均运行时间降低 87.4%、GPU 显存降低 92.4%，且在非平稳图上取得更优性能。
Motivation: 图部署在真实系统中会持续漂移，现有方法靠训练辅助生成模块合成记忆图，计算开销大且在长期分布漂移下扩展性差。
Method: EMC 是训练-free 的测试时框架：用记忆导向的分布匹配目标的闭式解把每个到达的图域蒸馏为紧凑且语义忠实的记忆，消除冗余域信息；再用状态演化记忆 (state-evolving memories) 建模域间依赖，以支撑长序列目标域上的泛化。
Result: 在非平稳分布漂移的图上，EMC 性能优于 SOTA 基线；相对最近的竞争对手，平均运行时间减少 87.4%，GPU 显存消耗减少 92.4%。作者给出理论上更有依据、更紧的泛化误差界，优于直接适配。

papers.title: Participation-Sensitive Convergence and the Fragment First, Converge Later Pattern in Asynchronous Online Learning: A Topological Analysis Across 22 OULAD Courses
papers.abstract_en: Asynchronous online learning offers temporal flexibility at a structural cost: learning communities tend to fragment rather than cohere. $β_0$, the number of disconnected behavioral clusters from Zigzag Persistent Homology, serves as a cohort-level indicator of this structure. Two questions remained unverified at scale: (1) does apparent $β_0$ convergence reflect genuine behavioral alignment or learner dropout? and (2) do assessment deadlines produce reproducible fragmentation-convergence cycles? We address both across all 22 OULAD courses (N > 22,000; 857 week-pairs). Changes in $β_0$ strongly co-vary with active learner changes (pooled r = 0.387; median per-course r_delta = 0.459, 20/22 courses), identifying $β_0$ as a participation-sensitive indicator: $β_0$ and active learner counts co-respond to deadline events rather than one causing the other. Deadlines produced fragmentation in 82.6% of assessments and the full Fragment First, Converge Later (FFCL) cycle in 60.2%. 3-phase analysis confirmed structural fragmentation as the dominant long-term trajectory (90.9% of courses), moderated by curriculum structure. These findings establish $β_0$ as a participation-sensitive structural indicator with direct implications for AI-augmented learning analytics design.

Results unchanged

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Zigzag Persistent Homology 的 β0（不连通行为簇数）刻画异步在线学习社群结构，发现 β0 收敛主要是参与度变化而非行为对齐：β0 与活跃学习者数强共变（pooled r = 0.387，22 门课里 20 门的 r_delta 中位数 0.459）。考核截止日触发碎片化占 82.6%，完整 FFCL（Fragment First, Converge Later）周期占 60.2%，长期以结构性碎片化为主（90.9% 的课程）。
Motivation: 异步在线学习社群倾向碎片化而非凝聚，但 β0 收敛究竟反映真实行为对齐还是学习者流失、以及考核截止日能否产生可复现的碎片化-收敛周期，此前缺少大规模验证。
Method: 在全部 22 门 OULAD 课程（N > 22,000，857 个 week-pairs）上用 Zigzag Persistent Homology 计算 β0（v2 更正：epsilon = 1.5，直接计算连通分支而非依赖持久同调库，β0 统计对象为每周活跃学习者），与活跃学习者数变化做相关分析，并对截止日事件做 3-phase 分析。
Result: β0 变化与活跃学习者变化强共变：pooled r = 0.387，逐课 r_delta 中位数 0.459（20/22 门课）；考核截止日导致碎片化的比例为 82.6%，完整 FFCL 周期为 60.2%；3-phase 分析显示结构性碎片化是主导长期轨迹（90.9% 的课程），并受课程结构调节。
Conclusion: β0 应被当作参与度敏感的结构指标而非纯行为对齐指标，其升降与活跃学习者数共同响应截止日事件；结构性碎片化是异步在线学习的主导长期轨迹。

papers.title: Amortized ratio-estimation importance sampling and localized simulation-based calibration for intractable likelihoods
papers.abstract_en: We consider simulation-based Bayesian inference (SBI) for the parameters of models with intractable likelihoods but tractable forward simulation. Building on Gaussian mixtures-of-experts surrogates, as a first contribution we develop a sequential procedure to estimate the posterior, incorporating an importance sampling step that introduces a locally amortized likelihood-to-evidence ratio estimator. The local amortization allows the ratio estimator to be evaluated at new parameter--data pairs from a local (data-dependent) design, without re-estimation, which is particularly convenient for our second contribution. The second contribution is localized simulation-based calibration (SBC). Localized SBC provides a graphical diagnostic of calibration over neighborhoods that are deliberately broader than the available posterior, at low additional computational cost. Rather than repeatedly running the full inference procedure for each simulated pseudo-observation, localized SBC fits the local surrogate and ratio estimator only once for each local design, and reuses them across all pseudo-observations. This approach is particularly appealing for SBI applications. We evaluate both contributions on three case studies, including a real-data epidemiological application.
papers.comment: github repo for the code is now included; text of the main paper has been reduced and some text moved to supplementary
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对似然不可解析但前向模拟可行的模型，提出局部摊销 (local amortization) 的似然-证据比值估计器与局部化模拟校准 (localized SBC)：在高斯混合专家 (Gaussian mixtures-of-experts) 代理上做序贯推断并插入重要性采样，比值估计器可在新的参数-数据对上直接复用而无需重估；SBC 诊断只需对每个局部设计拟合一次代理与比值估计器，即可跨全部伪观测复用，以很低的额外计算成本给出邻域上的校准图形诊断。
Motivation: 似然不可解析 (intractable likelihood) 的模型无法直接做贝叶斯推断，而标准 SBC 需对每个伪观测重复运行完整推断流程，计算代价过高。
Method: 以高斯混合专家代理为基础构建序贯后验估计流程，其中插入重要性采样步骤，得到局部摊销的似然-证据比值估计器，使其能在数据依赖的局部设计上对新参数-数据对直接求值；局部化 SBC 对每个局部设计只拟合一次局部代理与比值估计器，再在所有伪观测上复用。
Result: 两项贡献在三个案例研究上评估，其中包括一个真实数据的流行病学应用；摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: 局部摊销使比值估计器可跨新参数-数据对复用，从而让 SBC 校准诊断以低额外计算成本在邻域上实现，特别适合 SBI 应用。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: From Given to Gathered Evidence: Agentic Learning for Longitudinal Medical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models can serve as clinical agents through tool-use harnesses. However, conventional medical benchmarks assess reasoning over preselected evidence rather than the ability to seek it across clinical records and longitudinal imaging. We propose CASE: a series of role-specific Clinical Agents for Seeking Evidence, together with a tool-use harness and an agentic post-training framework for compact vision-language policy models. We further introduce a longitudinal multimodal benchmark built on UK Biobank, comprising 50,401 clinical questions derived from real-world ICD-10-coded diagnoses of 4,739 participants. Each question links to a patient-specific environment containing clinical context and multi-sequence MRI from baseline and follow-up visits, where agents autonomously select which visits, organs, modalities, slices, and specialist tools to inspect and compare. Supervised fine-tuning transfers evidence-seeking workflows from 147,434 frontier-model interaction trajectories, followed by agentic reinforcement learning on the learner's own environment interactions. Privileged on-policy self-distillation and rubric-based LLM feedback refine evidence-to-conclusion reasoning without prescribing tool sequences. Experiments show that CASE moves beyond question-answer imitation toward transferable investigation policies, strengthening evidence-grounded longitudinal reasoning. Under matched evaluation conditions, our Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct based agent achieves over 16% and 10% relative improvements in answer accuracy over GPT-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.8. Project page available at: https://vinyehshaw.github.io/case-project/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CASE：一组按角色分工的临床证据搜寻 agent（Clinical Agents for Seeking Evidence）加 tool-use harness，用 SFT 迁移 147,434 条前沿模型交互轨迹，再在自身环境交互上做 agentic RL 与 on-policy 自蒸馏，让紧凑 VLM 自主选择就诊、器官、模态、切片与专科工具。在基于 UK Biobank 的 50,401 题纵向多模态基准上，Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 版 agent 相对 GPT-5.4 与 Claude Opus 4.8 的答案准确率分别提升超过 16% 与 10%。
Motivation: 常规医学基准只在预先给定的证据上考推理，不考跨临床记录与纵向影像主动取证的能力，因而无法衡量 foundation model 作为临床 agent 的真实调查行为。
Method: CASE 由角色化 Clinical Agents、tool-use harness 与面向紧凑 VLM 的 agentic post-training 框架组成：先用监督微调从 147,434 条前沿模型交互轨迹迁移取证工作流，再在学习者自身的环境交互上做 agentic 强化学习，配合 privileged on-policy 自蒸馏与 rubric-based LLM 反馈优化证据到结论的推理，且不规定工具序列。
Result: 基准含 50,401 道题，源自 4,739 名 UK Biobank 参与者的真实 ICD-10 编码诊断，每题绑定含临床背景与基线/随访多序列 MRI 的患者环境。在匹配评测条件下，基于 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 的 agent 答案准确率相对 GPT-5.4 提升超过 16%、相对 Claude Opus 4.8 提升超过 10%。
Conclusion: CASE 把医学问答从模仿答案推向可迁移的调查策略，强化了基于证据的纵向推理；紧凑 VLM 经 agentic post-training 可在该基准上超过更大的前沿模型。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Scale and Selection: What Makes Automatic Harness Evolution Work for Visual-Interface Robot Agents
papers.abstract_en: When an off-the-shelf coding agent is used directly as a robot policy, observing a browser-based 3D interface through screenshots and acting by posing a virtual target gripper through a few tools, the agent's harness, its prompts, tools, and control rules, largely determines success, and until now it has been written by hand. We show that this harness can be improved automatically by another coding agent, the optimizer agent, and report two findings about what makes it work. First, the number of rollouts the optimizer agent sees per round governs whether the evolved harness generalizes: with rounds fixed, held-out success rises as the training batch grows from 5 to 100 rollouts, while small batches overfit the training tasks. Second, the optimizer agent must not be given free rein. Accepting every revision it proposes degrades the harness within a few rounds; a simple Champion-Challenger rule that promotes a revision only if it beats the incumbent on the same fixed cases turns the same loop into one that raises held-out success on LIBERO tasks from 51% to 67% over 30 rounds. Combining the evolved harness with a pretrained policy, through one tool that hands it control, reaches 71.2% on the RoboCasa365 leaderboard benchmark, 13.1 points above the best published entry. Automatic harness evolution for visual-interface robot agents is thus feasible, but its gains hinge on the rollout scale behind each decision and on how the optimizer agent's revisions are selected.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把浏览器 3D 界面截图操作的 coding agent 当机器人策略时，其 harness（提示、工具、控制规则）可由另一个 optimizer agent 自动进化，成败取决于每轮 rollout 规模与修订筛选规则。轮数固定时训练 batch 从 5 增到 100，held-out 成功率随之上升，小 batch 会过拟合训练任务；无约束接受全部修订会让 harness 几轮内退化，而 Champion-Challenger 规则（修订须在同一固定用例上胜过现任才晋升）使 LIBERO held-out 成功率 30 轮内从 51% 升到 67%。
Motivation: 现成 coding agent 直接当机器人策略时，决定成败的 harness 一直靠手写，缺少自动改进手段，也说不清自动进化在什么条件下才有效。
Method: 由 optimizer agent 对 harness（prompts、tools、控制规则）提出修订并自动迭代；每轮给它固定数量的 rollouts，用 Champion-Challenger 规则只在与现任相同的固定用例上胜出才晋升；进化后的 harness 通过一个交接控制的工具与预训练策略组合。
Result: 轮数固定时 held-out 成功率随训练 batch 从 5 增至 100 而上升，小 batch 过拟合训练任务；无筛选地接受全部修订使 harness 在几轮内退化；Champion-Challenger 下 LIBERO held-out 成功率 30 轮内 51% → 67%；与预训练策略组合后在 RoboCasa365 leaderboard 上达 71.2%，高出已发表最佳条目 13.1 个百分点。
Conclusion: 视觉界面机器人 agent 的自动 harness 进化可行，但收益取决于每个决策背后的 rollout 规模以及对 optimizer 修订的筛选方式：batch 要够大，修订必须经 Champion-Challenger 择优。

summary_sections.motivation: 现成 coding agent 直接当机器人策略时，决定成败的 harness 一直靠手写，缺少自动改进手段，也说不清自动进化在什么条件下才有效。
summary_sections.method: 由 optimizer agent 对 harness（prompts、tools、控制规则）提出修订并自动迭代；每轮给它固定数量的 rollouts，用 Champion-Challenger 规则只在与现任相同的固定用例上胜出才晋升；进化后的 harness 通过一个交接控制的工具与预训练策略组合。
summary_sections.result: 轮数固定时 held-out 成功率随训练 batch 从 5 增至 100 而上升，小 batch 过拟合训练任务；无筛选地接受全部修订使 harness 在几轮内退化；Champion-Challenger 下 LIBERO held-out 成功率 30 轮内 51% → 67%；与预训练策略组合后在 RoboCasa365 leaderboard 上达 71.2%，高出已发表最佳条目 13.1 个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 视觉界面机器人 agent 的自动 harness 进化可行，但收益取决于每个决策背后的 rollout 规模以及对 optimizer 修订的筛选方式：batch 要够大，修订必须经 Champion-Challenger 择优。

papers.title: More Choices, Fewer Decisions: Ordinal-Scale Bias in JEV-like Direct-Decision Models
papers.abstract_en: Direct-decision models enable efficient classification and evaluation by selecting from predefined candidates, but their reliability depends on more than prediction accuracy. Across 40 datasets and nine models from the JEV, KEV, and StartLux Decision families, we identify a systematic tendency to underuse ordinal rating scales. We call this phenomenon ordinal scale-utilization bias: final decisions concentrate on fewer effective labels than the gold distribution. The bias is substantially weaker on tasks with unordered semantic categories. Evaluating the same items on finer ordinal scales strengthens compression despite controls for gold imbalance and candidate position. Randomizing candidate order reduces but does not eliminate compression, while widening ordinal gaps at fixed candidate count can improve accuracy without restoring utilization. For most models, concentrated decisions coexist with broad average candidate probabilities. Greater model size improves accuracy without consistently restoring scale utilization. Together, these findings characterize compression as strongly associated with ordinal structure and intensified by scale refinement, rather than fully explained by presentation position or local spacing. This bias can be effectively mitigated through targeted training, making scale utilization an actionable reliability target alongside accuracy. The code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/jev_ordinal_scale_bia/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 40 个数据集、JEV/KEV/StartLux Decision 三族共九个直接决策模型上，发现系统性的序数尺度利用不足 (ordinal scale-utilization bias)：最终决策集中在比金标准分布更少的有效标签上。该压缩在无序语义类别任务上明显更弱，在更细的序数尺度上反而加剧；随机化候选顺序只能减轻、不能消除，扩大序数间距可在候选数固定时提升准确率但不恢复利用率。作者主张把尺度利用率 (scale utilization) 作为与准确率并列的可靠性目标，并通过针对性训练加以缓解。
Motivation: 直接决策模型从预定义候选中选择，可靠性不只取决于预测准确率；决策集中于过少标签会使其输出分布偏离金标准，而现有评估只看准确率，无法暴露这种压缩。
Method: 在 40 个数据集上评测 JEV、KEV、StartLux Decision 三族共九个模型，统计决策对金标准分布的偏离；对照手段包括无序语义类别任务、同一题目改用更细序数尺度、候选顺序随机化、固定候选数下改变序数间距，以及模型规模变化。
Result: 九个模型在 40 个数据集上一致出现决策压缩，且在无序类别任务上显著更弱；更细的序数尺度在控制金标准不平衡与候选位置后仍加剧压缩；随机化候选顺序减轻但不消除压缩；固定候选数下扩大序数间距可提高准确率却不恢复利用率；多数模型决策集中与宽泛的平均候选概率并存；模型规模增大提升准确率但不一致地恢复尺度利用。
Conclusion: 压缩与序数结构强相关并被尺度细化放大，不能由呈现位置或局部间距完全解释；尺度利用率可通过针对性训练缓解，应作为与准确率并列的可操作可靠性指标。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: The Teacher Is a Direction, Not a Destination: Extrapolating RL-Induced Representation Residuals in On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student to match the teacher's next-token distributions on the student's own trajectories and has yielded substantial empirical gains. Generalized variants allow the student to surpass the teacher by extrapolating an implicit reward in output space. The language-model head, however, attenuates this change anisotropically: much of the change encoded in the teacher's hidden states reaches the logits at a small fraction of its weight, and the sampled-token log-probability ratios on which output-space extrapolation relies inject noise that the extrapolation amplifies, making training unstable. We observe that reinforcement learning (RL) shifts a model's internal representations relative to its base checkpoint, and that the direction of this shift can be measured at every layer. Motivated by this observation, we propose RIDE (RL-Induced Direction Extrapolation), which extrapolates the RL-induced change directly in representation space: at every layer and token position, RIDE computes the residual between the teacher and its pre-RL checkpoint and regresses the student's hidden states toward targets displaced beyond the teacher along this residual. Conditioned on a sampled trajectory, this regression is equivalent to maximizing a linear directional reward defined by the residual under a quadratic penalty centered at the teacher, which makes explicit how the objective moves the student along the RL-induced direction while limiting its deviation from the teacher. Across four base/RL-teacher pairs spanning different scales, architectures, and pre-training lineages, RIDE approaches or exceeds the RL-trained teacher on every pair and is the only method whose mean does so, and it consistently outperforms output-space extrapolation, which degrades the student whenever the teacher is close to its base. Project page: https://github.com/xixixixixxxx/RIDE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RIDE 把 RL 相对其 base checkpoint 的表示位移方向直接用于 on-policy 蒸馏：在每层每 token 位置计算 RL 教师与其 pre-RL checkpoint 的残差，把学生隐状态回归到沿该残差越过教师的外推目标。在四组不同规模、架构与预训练谱系的 base/RL 教师配对上，RIDE 在每一对上都接近或超过 RL 教师（且是唯一均值做到这一点的方法），并稳定优于输出空间外推——后者在教师接近其 base 时反而损害学生。
Motivation: 输出空间外推依赖采样 token 的对数概率比，噪声被外推放大导致训练不稳；语言模型头还各向异性地衰减教师隐状态中的变化，使大部分变化只以很小权重到达 logits。
Method: RIDE (RL-Induced Direction Extrapolation)：在每层与每个 token 位置计算教师与其 pre-RL checkpoint 的残差，把学生隐状态向沿该残差越过教师的位移目标做回归。该回归在给定采样轨迹下等价于最大化由残差定义的线性方向奖励，并以教师为中心的二次罚项限制偏离。
Result: 在四组跨不同规模、架构与预训练谱系的 base/RL 教师配对上，RIDE 在每一对上都接近或超过 RL 训练的教师，且是唯一均值超过教师的方法；相对输出空间外推一致更优，而后者在教师接近其 base checkpoint 时会损害学生。
Conclusion: 把 RL 诱导的方向放在表示空间而非输出空间外推，可以在限制对教师偏离的同时让学生沿该方向前进，从而稳定地逼近或超过 RL 教师。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: NeuronSifter: An Agent-in-Twin for Prioritizing Central Nervous System Interventions with World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Effective central nervous system (CNS) intervention requires more than predicting biological responses: a scientific system must determine which intervention, observation, or additional evidence can improve a decision under uncertainty. However, in partially observed neuronal microenvironments, identical predicted outcomes may correspond to different exposure states, biological mechanisms, and intervention risks. We propose NeuronSifter, a decision-centric Agent-in-Twin framework, where an AI agent operates with an evolving biological digital twin rather than a fixed predictive model. NeuronSifter compiles interventions into state-conditional target-occupancy representations, propagates them through a mechanism-grounded World Action Model (WAM), and selects informative measurements based on their expected reduction in decision uncertainty. A shared probabilistic belief state couples intervention simulation, observation selection, and outcome assimilation, enabling the digital twin to continuously refine its decision-relevant representations through externally verified evidence. We evaluate NeuronSifter in Alzheimer's disease intervention scenarios using mechanistic neuronal microenvironment simulations and retrospective clinical endpoint references. The evaluation framework examines adaptive evidence acquisition, uncertainty-aware intervention planning, and robustness under model discrepancy through controlled environments and independent comparisons. NeuronSifter demonstrates how an AI system can actively identify missing evidence, refine biological hypotheses, and optimize intervention decisions under limited experimental budgets. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/NeuronSifter.
papers.comment: The submission was made without obtaining authorization from all co-authors
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuronSifter 把中枢神经系统干预决策做成 Agent-in-Twin：AI 智能体与持续演化的生物数字孪生协作，用机制约束的 World Action Model (WAM) 传播状态条件下的靶点占据表征，并按预期决策不确定性下降挑选最有信息量的测量。共享的概率信念状态耦合干预仿真、观测选择与结果同化 (assimilation)，使孪生体靠外部验证证据不断修正决策相关表征，在有限实验预算下优化干预决策。
Motivation: 部分观测的神经微环境里，相同的预测结局可能对应不同的暴露状态、生物机制与干预风险，仅做响应预测不足以支撑干预选择，需要判断哪种干预、观测或补充证据能改善不确定性下的决策。
Method: 将干预编译为状态条件的 target-occupancy 表征，经机制约束的 World Action Model (WAM) 传播；以共享概率信念状态耦合干预仿真、观测选择与结果同化，按测量对决策不确定性的预期削减量选择证据；在阿尔茨海默病干预场景中用机制性神经元微环境仿真与回顾性临床终点参考进行受控环境评估与独立比较，考察自适应证据获取、不确定性感知规划与模型偏差下的鲁棒性。
Result: 在阿尔茨海默病干预场景的机制性神经元微环境仿真与回顾性临床终点参考下，评估自适应证据获取、不确定性感知干预规划以及模型偏差下的鲁棒性；NeuronSifter 展示了 AI 系统在有限实验预算内主动识别缺失证据、修正生物假设并优化干预决策的能力。
Conclusion: 中枢神经系统干预应由决策中心的数字孪生驱动：以概率信念状态持续同化外部验证证据，比固定预测模型更能在部分观测条件下选出有信息量的测量与更优干预。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: NeuronDiscover: Agent-in-Twin for Mechanistic Discovery in Neuronal Microenvironments with World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic discovery in neuronal microenvironments requires interventions and measurements that separate competing explanations of solute transport and neuronal response. Predictive accuracy cannot settle the question: a real mechanistic change and an error in the computational twin leave the same signature in sparse observations. We formalize this twin confounding and reason over a joint mechanism--discrepancy belief, designing experiments that separate the two. NeuronDiscover is an Agent-in-Twin framework whose shared, mechanism-grounded World Action Model (WAM) couples prediction, intervention proposals, and observation design; independently adjudicated outcomes revise a scoped Mechanism--Intervention--Observation--Outcome (MIOY) graph, whose supported relations compile into executable programs carrying discrepancy-adjusted acceptance bounds. We evaluate on simulated brain-fluid tracer-transport worlds adjudicated by an independently frozen finer-mesh reference solver, and on donor-disjoint public current-clamp recordings of cortical neurons. Counting only relations that reach a certified terminal status, and scoring abstentions as unresolved for every method, at a matched budget of 16 experiments over 32 source units NeuronDiscover resolves 4.0 relations per assigned world against 3.4 for the strongest baseline and 3.2 without graph revision, at 5% false support and 82% scope accuracy. Joint mechanism--discrepancy acquisition resolves 3.8 relations versus 2.9 for plug-in expected information gain; discrepancy-adjusted verification lowers accepted-program failure from 15% to 9% at 60% acceptance coverage; and transfer to the recordings yields 1.94 versus 1.53 relations per assigned world. Correctness is adjudicated within declared model worlds and archival recordings.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuronDiscover 把「真实机制变化」与「计算孪生误差」在稀疏观测下同签名的问题形式化为 twin confounding，用共享的 World Action Model (WAM) 联合生成预测、干预与观测设计，经独立裁决结果修订 MIOY 图并编译为带 discrepancy 校正接受界的可执行程序。在 16 次实验、32 个源单元的匹配预算下，每世界解析 4.0 条关系（最强基线 3.4、无图修订 3.2），5% false support、82% scope accuracy；接受程序失败率从 15% 降到 9%。
Motivation: 稀疏观测下，真实机制改变与计算孪生误差留下相同签名，单靠预测精度无法区分，导致溶质输运与神经元响应的机制结论不可信。
Method: Agent-in-Twin 框架：机制奠基的 WAM 耦合预测、干预提议与观测设计；独立裁决的结果修订带作用域的 Mechanism–Intervention–Observation–Outcome (MIOY) 图，图中被支持的关系编译成携带 discrepancy 校正接受界的可执行程序。评测用独立冻结的更细网格参考求解器裁决的模拟脑液示踪剂输运世界，以及 donor-disjoint 的公开皮层神经元 current-clamp 记录。
Result: 匹配预算 16 次实验、32 个源单元下，NeuronDiscover 每世界解析 4.0 条关系，最强基线 3.4、去掉图修订为 3.2，5% false support、82% scope accuracy（弃权对所有方法计为 unresolved）。联合 mechanism–discrepancy acquisition 解析 3.8 条 vs plug-in expected information gain 的 2.9；discrepancy 校正验证把接受程序失败率从 15% 降到 9%（60% 接受覆盖）；迁移到神经元记录为 1.94 vs 1.53。
Conclusion: 把机制与孪生误差作为联合信念来设计实验并做校正验证，能在固定实验预算下多解析机制关系、且降低接受程序的失败率；正确性只在声明的模型世界与存档记录内裁决。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TULIP: Targeted LLM Unlearning at Layers Identified Per-input
papers.abstract_en: Representation-level unlearning modifies the intermediate hidden states of LLMs. Although knowledge is distributed across layers, existing methods operate at a single fixed layer for the entire forget set. We ask whether such a fixed layer is sufficient for unlearning. To answer this, we design a hijacking experiment that grafts hidden states of the target model into an oracle model. The oracle cannot produce the forget answer on its own, yet it produces the answer from the grafted state. This indicates the answer is already formed at an intermediate layer and read out afterward. Moreover, the layer where formation ends varies widely across inputs. Motivated by these findings, we propose Targeted Unlearning at Layers Identified Per-input (TULIP). For each input, TULIP uses the logit lens to locate the formation-readout boundary and removes the hidden state's alignment with the forget answer's unembedding vector at that layer. TULIP outperforms output- and representation-level baselines on TOFU, PISTOL, and WMDP across Llama, Qwen, and Zephyr models. It also remains robust to paraphrase and quantization attacks. Beyond standalone use, its per-input layer selection serves as a plug-and-play component that further improves existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TULIP 指出 LLM 表征级遗忘 (representation-level unlearning) 用单一固定层处理整个 forget set 不够：hijacking 实验显示答案在中间某层已形成、之后被读出，且形成结束的层随输入差异很大。它对每个输入用 logit lens 定位 formation-readout boundary，在该层移除隐状态与 forget 答案 unembedding vector 的对齐，在 TOFU、PISTOL、WMDP 上跨 Llama、Qwen、Zephyr 优于输出级与表征级基线，并对 paraphrase 与 quantization 攻击保持稳健。
Motivation: 知识分布在各层，而现有表征级遗忘方法对整个 forget set 固定在同一层操作；固定层是否足以完成遗忘本身未经检验，且不同输入的答案形成层位置差异很大。
Method: 先做 hijacking 实验：把目标模型的隐状态嫁接到一个自身无法产出 forget 答案的 oracle 模型上，观察答案被读出，以确定答案形成层；再提出 TULIP，对每个输入用 logit lens 找到 formation-readout boundary，并在该层移除隐状态与 forget 答案 unembedding vector 的对齐。per-input 层选择还可作为 plug-and-play 组件接入既有方法。
Result: 在 TOFU、PISTOL、WMDP 上，跨 Llama、Qwen、Zephyr 模型，TULIP 优于输出级与表征级基线；对 paraphrase 攻击与 quantization 攻击保持稳健；作为即插即用组件进一步提升既有方法的效果。
Conclusion: 固定层不是表征级遗忘的正确粒度：按每个输入定位答案形成-读出边界再做对齐移除，遗忘效果更强且更抗攻击，层选择本身可复用为通用增强模块。

papers.title: Deep kernel hedging
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a deep kernel hedging framework that combines the flexibility of deep learning with the structural inductive bias of kernel methods. The hedging functional is restricted to a reproducing kernel Hilbert space whose kernel is parameterized through a neural network embedding of the input features. The framework minimizes a regularized empirical risk under convex loss functions and can accommodate path-dependent information through truncated time-augmented signature features. We derive a generalized representer theorem for the joint hedging problem, reducing the empirical optimization to a finite-dimensional problem. To further reduce the computational cost associated with large kernel matrices, we develop a scalable random Fourier feature approximation and establish convergence guarantees. The random Fourier parameters are sampled once and remain fixed throughout training, while the deep kernel adapts to market data through the learned neural representation. We evaluate the performance of the proposed deep kernel approach on both synthetic and real data and compare it with standard kernel methods and classical deep hedging architectures. Numerical results indicate competitive and robust hedging performance, particularly in low-data regimes, which highlights the benefits of combining expressive neural representations with the inductive bias of kernel methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 deep kernel hedging：把对冲泛函限制在由神经网络参数化核的 RKHS 中，用广义 representer 定理把经验风险最小化化为有限维问题，再用固定采样的 random Fourier feature 近似降低大核矩阵开销。在合成与真实数据上对比标准核方法与经典 deep hedging 架构，低数据量场景下对冲表现稳健且有竞争力。
Motivation: deep hedging 的纯神经网络表示在数据稀缺时容易过拟合，而传统核方法表达能力受限；需要在保留核方法归纳偏置的同时引入深度学习的灵活性。
Method: 对冲泛函限制在 RKHS，核由输入特征的神经网络嵌入参数化；在凸损失下最小化正则化经验风险，并通过截断的 time-augmented signature features 纳入路径依赖信息；推导联合对冲问题的广义 representer 定理，将优化降为有限维；用 random Fourier feature 近似大核矩阵，参数采样一次后训练中固定，deep kernel 随市场数据学习。
Result: 在合成数据与真实数据上与标准核方法及经典 deep hedging 架构比较，数值结果显示对冲表现稳健且有竞争力，尤其在低数据量 regime 下优势明显；摘要给出 random Fourier 近似的收敛保证，但未列具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把神经表示的表达力与核方法的归纳偏置结合，可在数据稀缺时改善对冲稳健性，且计算上通过固定随机特征保持可扩展。

papers.title: SAGE: Structured Strategic Reasoning for Efficient LLM Game Playing
papers.abstract_en: A strong LLM strategic agent should reason prospectively over uncertain futures, adapt its strategy to opponents' behavioral tendencies, and continuously recalibrate its decision process from interaction experience. However, incorporating these sources in free-form reasoning could lead to unsupported strategic assumptions, inconsistent opponent estimates, and harmful interference from irrelevant historical interactions. To address these issues, we propose SAGE, a training-free inference-time framework that structures LLM strategic reasoning around three coordinated operations: anchor, adapt, and recalibrate. SAGE first anchors reasoning to an equilibrium policy that provides a strategically valid prior. It then conditions deviations from this anchor on a soft belief over opponent behavioral tendencies, enabling opponent-specific exploitation. Finally, SAGE distills strategically related interactions into counterfactual hypotheses about previously missing considerations, allowing past experience to recalibrate the model's reasoning. We evaluate SAGE on three repeated imperfect-information games: Leduc Hold'em, Liar's Dice, and Goofspiel, against various opponent types in each game. Compared with reasoning-intensive LLM agents, including Suspicion-Agent, ReTA, Agent-Pro, EMO, and Hypothetical Minds, SAGE achieves up to a 127.6% payoff improvement in Liar's Dice while reducing input and output token usage by up to 80% and 90%, respectively. In direct match-up play, it attains non-negative mean payoff against 5/10, 8/10, and 8/10 evaluated opponents in Leduc Hold'em, Liar's Dice, and Goofspiel, respectively, while using relatively fewer tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/chenzhwsysu57/SAGE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGE 是一个免训练的 LLM 推理时策略推理框架，把博弈推理组织成 anchor、adapt、recalibrate 三个协同操作：先锚定到均衡策略作为策略上有效的先验，再用对手行为倾向的软信念调节偏离，最后把相关历史交互蒸馏成反事实假设来校准推理。在 Liar's Dice 上相对推理密集型 LLM 代理最高带来 127.6% 收益提升，同时输入与输出 token 分别最多减少 80% 与 90%。
Motivation: 在自由形式推理中引入不确定未来、对手倾向与历史经验，会产生无依据的策略假设、不一致的对手估计，以及无关历史交互的有害干扰。
Method: SAGE 为免训练推理时框架，含三个操作：anchor 将推理锚定到均衡策略先验；adapt 以对手行为倾向的软信念 (soft belief) 条件化对该锚点的偏离，实现对手针对性利用；recalibrate 把策略相关交互蒸馏为针对缺失考量的反事实假设 (counterfactual hypotheses)。
Result: 在 Leduc Hold'em、Liar's Dice、Goofspiel 三个重复不完全信息博弈上，对比 Suspicion-Agent、ReTA、Agent-Pro、EMO、Hypothetical Minds：Liar's Dice 收益最高提升 127.6%，输入 token 最多减少 80%、输出 token 最多减少 90%；直接对抗中对 5/10、8/10、8/10 个被评估对手取得非负平均收益（依次对应 Leduc Hold'em、Liar's Dice、Goofspiel）。
Conclusion: 以均衡策略为锚、以对手软信念调偏、以反事实假设校准，可在不训练的情况下让 LLM 在重复不完全信息博弈中以更少 token 换取更高收益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evolving Support Priorities in Empathetic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We identify a fundamental mismatch in empathetic reinforcement learning: support priorities evolve with the dialogue state, yet existing methods typically optimize predefined reward specifications that remain fixed across turns. To model these evolving support priorities, we organize empathetic support along cognitive, affective, and proactive empathy, and propose Context-Adaptive Rubric Evolution (CARE). At each turn, CARE generates a context-adaptive rubric by adjusting both the weights of these three empathy dimensions and their fine-grained evaluation criteria. The rubric generator is trained with turn-level rubric supervision and human preference data through supervised fine-tuning followed by preference-based reinforcement learning, and then serves as an adaptive reward interface for online empathetic RL. Integrated with both RLVER and MICA, CARE achieves state-of-the-art performance across SentientBench, EQBench3, and EMPA under three independent LLM judges. Notably, on EMPA, CARE improves EPM-Idx over the strongest baseline by at least 13 points under all three judges, including an increase from 28.11 to 83.54 under Gemini-2.5-Pro. Further analyses show that learned rubric priorities systematically vary across dialogue stages and user emotions, demonstrating that CARE adapts what is rewarded as support needs evolve. Code is available at https://asa13opp.github.io/CARE-project-page.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CARE 让共情强化学习的奖励评分标准随对话状态演化：按认知、情感、主动三类共情组织支持，每轮动态调整三维权重与细粒度评分准则，作为在线 RL 的自适应奖励接口。接入 RLVER 与 MICA 后在 SentientBench、EQBench3、EMPA 上取得 SOTA，EMPA 上 EPM-Idx 相对最强基线至少提升 13 点，Gemini-2.5-Pro 判分下从 28.11 升到 83.54。
Motivation: 共情 RL 中支持优先级随对话状态演化，但现有方法优化的奖励规格跨轮固定，奖励对象与真实需求脱节。
Method: 提出 Context-Adaptive Rubric Evolution (CARE)：每轮生成上下文自适应 rubric，同时调整认知/情感/主动三类共情维度的权重与细粒度评分准则；rubric 生成器先用轮级 rubric 监督数据做监督微调，再用人类偏好数据做偏好强化学习，之后作为在线共情 RL 的自适应奖励接口，与 RLVER 和 MICA 集成。
Result: 在 SentientBench、EQBench3、EMPA 三个基准、三个独立 LLM judge 下均达到 state-of-the-art；EMPA 上 EPM-Idx 相对最强基线至少提高 13 点，Gemini-2.5-Pro 判分下从 28.11 提升到 83.54。分析显示学到的 rubric 优先级随对话阶段与用户情绪系统性变化。
Conclusion: 把奖励评分标准本身做成随对话阶段和用户情绪演化的对象，比固定奖励规格更能匹配共情支持需求的变化。

papers.title: VGGT-Diff: Visual Geometry Meets Diffusion for Sparse-View Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: We present VGGT-Diff, a geometry-routed multi-view diffusion model for sparse-view novel view synthesis. Existing novel view synthesis (NVS) methods face a fundamental trade-off: reconstruction-based approaches preserve observed geometry but struggle to synthesize unseen regions, while diffusion-based methods provide strong generative priors yet rely on implicit source-to-query correspondence. VGGT-Diff bridges these regimes by routing visual geometry latents from VGGT-Ω into a pretrained video diffusion model. Each visual token is associated with a 3D point and confidence, then transformed into query-aligned latent conditions through a confidence-aware Visual Geometry Router (VGR) that preserves front and back surface evidence. These conditions guide joint target-view denoising, while Point-Track Residual Consistency (PTRC) regularizes predicted-clean residuals along reliable 3D tracks, improving multi-view stability. We further introduce robust geometry conditioning, combining training-time regularization with inference-time guidance for improved robustness. Experiments show competitive or state-of-the-art performance across interpolation and extrapolation under different viewpoint difficulties. Our code is available at https://github.com/chenkangjie1123/VGGT-Diff.

Result: 在插值与外推、不同视角难度的设定上取得 competitive 或 state-of-the-art 表现；代码已开源。

papers.title: PrismQuant: Optimal Null-Space Rotations for Grouped Quantizers
papers.abstract_en: Smaller activation outliers do not necessarily imply better low-bit quantization: their alignment with the quantizer matters. We introduce PrismQuant, a quantizer-aware rotation framework that aligns the leading activation eigenspace with the constant group subspace of asymmetric grouped INT4. The affine offsets represent the energy in this subspace without widening the range within the group. We formulate rotation design as a Ky Fan trace maximization and derive a closed-form solution that is provably optimal for this alignment objective. Compact Householder transformations and their compact-WY representation enable gradient-free construction and efficient application at both foldable and online sites. A predictive range law further connects unaligned activation energy and group size to quantization-relevant variation. Experiments on Llama, Qwen, and Mistral span dense models up to 70B parameters and a 30B mixture-of-experts model. Under W4A4KV4, PrismQuant sets the state of the art on Llama-3.2-3B among the compared methods in both perplexity and accuracy. On Llama-3.1-70B, it attains 3.85 perplexity and 72.46% average zero-shot accuracy, only 0.22 percentage points below full precision. In the deployment study on Llama-3.1-8B, our optimized implementation achieves 1.51x prefill and 1.22x CUDA Graph decode speedups over matched FP16 baselines, with 56.34% lower decode peak memory and only 2.35% additional Graph decode latency over Hadamard. Code and models are available at https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/PrismQuant and https://huggingface.co/collections/ForeverBlue/prsimquant.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PrismQuant 是一个量化器感知的旋转框架，把激活主特征子空间对齐到非对称分组 INT4 的常数子空间，旋转设计写成 Ky Fan 迹最大化并给出闭式最优解，用紧凑 Householder 变换实现免梯度构造。在 Llama-3.1-70B 的 W4A4KV4 设置下达到 3.85 perplexity 与 72.46% 平均零样本准确率，仅比全精度低 0.22 个百分点。
Motivation: 激活离群值变小并不等于低比特量化更好，关键在于离群值与量化器的对齐程度；分组 INT4 中常数子空间的能量表示需要在不扩大组内范围的前提下处理。
Method: 将旋转设计表述为 Ky Fan 迹最大化问题，推导对该对齐目标可证最优的闭式解；用紧凑 Householder 变换及其 compact-WY 表示实现免梯度构造，支持可折叠与在线两种放置位置；另给出把未对齐激活能量与分组大小同量化相关变化联系起来的预测性范围定律。
Result: 在 Llama、Qwen、Mistral 上实验，覆盖最大 70B 稠密模型与 30B MoE 模型。W4A4KV4 下，PrismQuant 在 Llama-3.2-3B 上于 perplexity 与准确率两方面均为所比较方法中的最优；Llama-3.1-70B 上取得 3.85 perplexity 与 72.46% 平均零样本准确率，仅比全精度低 0.22 个百分点。Llama-3.1-8B 部署实验中，相对匹配的 FP16 基线实现 1.51x prefill 与 1.22x CUDA Graph decode 加速，decode 峰值内存降低 56.34%，相对 Hadamard 的 Graph decode 额外延迟仅 2.35%。
Conclusion: 对齐激活主特征子空间到量化器常数子空间，比单纯压小离群值更能决定低比特量化质量，且该旋转可用闭式最优解免梯度构造并带来实际部署加速。

papers.title: TimeES: Probabilistic and Deterministic Time Series Forecasting via Evolutionary Spectra
papers.abstract_en: Real-world time series are inherently non-stationary, with trends, periodic patterns, and uncertainty evolving over time. While the Fourier domain offers a natural lens to model time series, current deep learning approaches do not explicitly model evolution and randomness in the Fourier spectra, which limits their ability to accurately predict both the expected trajectory and its uncertainty in non-stationary time series. Motivated by Evolutionary Spectra (ES) theory, we propose TimeES, a general framework that enables probabilistic and deterministic forecasting via the evolutionary spectra theory. Specifically, we derive a parameterizable evolutionary spectra formulation, recasting non-stationary random process modeling as learning an evolving representation modulated by random variables. Furthermore, we reduce the complexity of the estimated spectra from O(NM) to O(NK), where K << M/2, by exploiting Hermitian symmetry and spectral energy sparsity for frequency selection. Based on a simple linear backbone, our proposed TimeES achieves consistent state-of-the-art performance across both deterministic and probabilistic forecasting tasks, with high efficiency and interpretability. Code is available at: https://github.com/wwy155/TimeES.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TimeES 把非平稳时间序列的确定性与概率预报统一到 Evolutionary Spectra (ES) 理论框架下：将非平稳随机过程建模为由随机变量调制的演化谱表示，并利用 Hermitian 对称性与谱能量稀疏性做频率选择，把谱估计复杂度从 O(NM) 降到 O(NK)（K << M/2）。在简单线性骨干上，该框架在确定性与概率预报任务上均取得一致的 state-of-the-art 表现，同时保持高效率与可解释性。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法在 Fourier 域中没有显式刻画谱的演化与随机性，因而在非平稳时间序列上难以同时准确预测期望轨迹及其不确定性。
Method: 由 Evolutionary Spectra 理论推导出可参数化的演化谱形式，把非平稳随机过程建模转化为学习一个由随机变量调制的演化表示；再借助 Hermitian 对称性与谱能量稀疏性做频率选择，将谱估计复杂度由 O(NM) 降至 O(NK)，K << M/2；建模建立在一个简单的线性骨干之上，同时支持确定性与概率预报。
Result: 在确定性与概率预报任务上均取得一致的 state-of-the-art 性能，并具备高效率与可解释性；谱估计复杂度由 O(NM) 降至 O(NK)，其中 K << M/2。
Conclusion: 把非平稳时间序列显式建模为随机变量调制的演化谱，可以在简单线性骨干上同时实现高质量的确定性与概率预报，并显著降低谱估计开销。

papers.title: DiffPTS: Rethinking Diffusion ELBO for Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic time series forecasting requires modeling and predicting complex and time-varying distributions. Recently, Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM)-based approaches have shown promise by equipping the dif- fusion process with pretrained mean and variance estimators to accommodate distributional shift. However, these methods typically follow the standard DDPM framework and consider only partial components of the evidence lower bound (ELBO), treating the training of estimators as designed regression tasks separate from the variational inference framework. To address this, we rethink the ELBO under the Location-Scale Noise Model (LSNM) and find that it naturally induces a Gaussian negative log likelihood objective for the estimators and inherently defines a joint training objective that unifies recent diffusion paradigms for probabilistic forecasting. Building on this principled ELBO reformulation, we propose Diff- PTS, a general framework that enables end-to-end optimization of all components within the ELBO. Across multiple benchmarks, DiffPTS consistently outperforms recent models, achieving state-of-the-art performance with an average CRPS/MSE reduction of over 14.53%/16.55% compared to existing diffusion-based methods. The code is available at https://github.com/wwy155/DiffPTS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiffPTS 重新推导 Location-Scale Noise Model (LSNM) 下的扩散 ELBO，发现它自然诱导估计器的高斯 NLL 目标，并把此前只优化部分 ELBO 项、把均值/方差估计器当独立回归任务训练的做法统一成一个联合目标，从而支持端到端优化。在多个概率时间序列预测基准上，相比现有扩散方法平均 CRPS 降低超过 14.53%、MSE 降低超过 16.55%。
Motivation: 基于 DDPM 的概率时间序列预测方法只优化 ELBO 的部分分量，且把预训练均值/方差估计器的训练当作与变分推断框架割裂的回归任务，难以应对时变分布与分布漂移。
Method: 在 LSNM 下重新推导 ELBO，得到估计器的高斯负对数似然目标与统一的联合训练目标；据此构建 DiffPTS 框架，对 ELBO 内全部组件做端到端优化，代码开源在 GitHub。
Result: 在多个概率时间序列预测基准上，DiffPTS 相比现有扩散类方法平均 CRPS 降低超过 14.53%、MSE 降低超过 16.55%，达到 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 把估计器训练纳入 ELBO 变分框架并端到端联合优化，是扩散概率时间序列预测优于只优化部分 ELBO 分量的做法的原因。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Learning Provable Neural Network Observer for Uncertain Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: In many safety-critical applications, control of uncertain dynamical systems relies on observers that estimate states and external disturbances. Neural network observers can improve estimation accuracy, but certifying their Lyapunov stability via Linear Matrix Inequality (LMI) constraints leads to large-scale semidefinite programs (SDPs) that are difficult to solve for large networks. To overcome this scalability bottleneck, we propose a novel two-stage training framework for provably stable neural network observers. Our approach decouples the optimization into a point-guided Lyapunov pre-training phase, which rapidly achieves high estimation accuracy and local stability over sampled states, followed by an LMI fine-tuning phase that efficiently satisfies a strict global Lyapunov stability certificate. We provide formal theoretical guarantees for local stability radii and probabilistic coverage over a prescribed compact error-state domain under specified regularity and sampling assumptions. Experiments on nonlinear control benchmarks and X-29 aircraft ablations show that our LMI-certified neural network observers train significantly faster than direct LMI-based methods and generalize robustly across diverse systems, achieving improved tracking accuracy over a range of observer baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/Berry-Myon/LearningNeuralNetworkObserver.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两阶段训练框架，先用点引导的 Lyapunov 预训练快速获得高估计精度与采样态上的局部稳定，再用 LMI 微调满足严格的全局 Lyapunov 稳定证书，绕开大规模半定规划 (SDP) 的求解瓶颈。在非线性控制基准与 X-29 飞机消融实验中，训练速度显著快于直接 LMI 方法，并在多个观测器基线上取得更好的跟踪精度。
Motivation: 安全攸关的不确定动态系统控制依赖观测器同时估计状态与外部扰动，但用 LMI 约束认证神经网络观测器的 Lyapunov 稳定性会生成大规模 SDP，网络一大就难以求解。
Method: 两阶段训练：点引导 Lyapunov 预训练阶段在采样状态上快速达到高估计精度与局部稳定，随后 LMI 微调阶段满足严格的全局 Lyapunov 稳定证书；在指定正则性与采样假设下给出局部稳定半径与规定紧致误差态域上概率覆盖的形式化理论保证。
Result: 在非线性控制基准与 X-29 飞机消融实验中，LMI 认证的神经网络观测器训练速度显著快于直接 LMI 方法，并在一系列观测器基线上取得改进的跟踪精度，跨多种系统泛化稳健。
Conclusion: 把稳定性认证拆成预训练加 LMI 微调两步，可以在保留全局 Lyapunov 证书的同时解决大规模网络的 SDP 可扩展性问题。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Memory Attention
papers.abstract_en: Language models typically construct attention values from contextual hidden states, even when some of their content may be reusable across contexts. We investigate whether token-indexed memory can replace the dedicated value projection when complemented by contextual information. We propose Memory Attention (MA), which forms values by combining layer-specific token memory with contextual keys. The memory supplies token-specific representations, while the keys preserve context dependence. At inference, normalization can be folded into the memory tables, reducing value construction to lookup and addition. Token-indexed retrieval also enables CPU offloading with prefetching, reducing GPU parameter storage. Under matched training token budgets and with additional memory parameters, experiments across attention configurations show improved language modeling and average downstream performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Memory Attention (MA)：用层专属的 token 索引记忆表替代注意力中专门的 value 投影，value 由记忆查表与上下文 key 组合而成，推理时归一化可折叠进记忆表，使 value 构造退化为查表加法。在匹配训练 token 预算、且记忆参数更多的条件下，多种注意力配置下语言建模与下游平均性能均提升；token 索引检索还支持带预取的 CPU offload，降低 GPU 参数显存占用。
Motivation: 标准注意力的 value 由上下文 hidden state 线性投影得到，但其中部分内容可跨上下文复用，专门的 value 投影在参数与显存上都是重复开销。
Method: MA 将 value 表示为层专属 token 记忆 (layer-specific token memory) 与 contextual key 的组合：记忆提供 token 专属表征，key 保留上下文依赖；推理阶段把归一化折叠进记忆表，value 构造变成查表与加法；token 索引检索配合预取实现 CPU offload。
Result: 在匹配训练 token 预算、并额外增加记忆参数的设置下，跨多种 attention 配置的实验显示语言建模性能与下游平均性能提升；CPU offload 方案降低 GPU 参数存储。
Conclusion: token 索引记忆可以替代专用 value 投影，在同等训练预算下换取更好的语言建模与下游表现，同时把 value 构造简化为查表并允许参数卸到 CPU。

papers.title: VGM-VS: Rethinking Visual Geometry Model for High-Precision Visual Servoing
papers.abstract_en: We present VGM-VS, a visual servoing method built on a pretrained feed-forward visual geometry model. Given the current view and a reference image captured at the target configuration, we estimate the relative camera pose with a visual geometry model and apply it iteratively as the pose increment of a closed-loop pose-based visual servoing (PBVS) scheme. The geometry-aware representation acquired from large-scale pretraining keeps this estimate reliable when the target is occluded, weakly textured, or covers only a small part of the image. However, the scale ambiguity inherent to these models leaves the predicted translation defined up to an unknown scale, while the pose increment must be metric for robot control. We close this gap with a scene-specific metric adaptation: the robot autonomously records image--pose pairs along a predefined motion starting from the target pose, and we fine-tune the camera head on these data, jointly learning the hand--eye transform and thus removing the need for a dedicated calibration process. We evaluate our method on three real-world assembly tasks with demanding tolerances: USB-C cable picking, cable insertion, and RAM insertion. Running in real time at 30Hz, VGM-VS converges to submillimeter terminal accuracy on the cable tasks, and reaches success rates of 90--100\% when the target is moved during servoing. It converges in all trials under initial displacements of up to 30cm from the reference pose and with 50\% of the target object occluded, outperforming the compared visual servoing baselines.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Corresponding author: Sen Wang. Project page: https://yimin-pan.github.io/vgm-vs/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VGM-VS 把预训练前馈视觉几何模型接入闭环位姿视觉伺服 (PBVS)：用当前视图与目标位姿参考图估计相对相机位姿，作为位姿增量迭代执行；针对模型固有的尺度歧义，用机器人沿预定义运动自主采集图像-位姿对、微调相机头并联合学习 hand-eye 变换，从而得到公制增量且免去专门标定。在 USB-C 拾取、插线、RAM 插入三项装配任务上以 30Hz 实时运行，线缆任务达到亚毫米末端精度，伺服过程中移动目标时成功率 90–100%，初始位移达 30cm、目标被遮挡 50% 时全部试次收敛，优于所比较的视觉伺服基线。
Motivation: 前馈视觉几何模型的相对位姿预测存在固有尺度歧义，而机器人控制需要公制位姿增量；同时目标被遮挡、弱纹理或只占画面一小部分时，传统视觉伺服难以稳定收敛。
Method: 以预训练前馈视觉几何模型估计当前视图与目标参考图之间的相对相机位姿，作为闭环 PBVS 的迭代位姿增量；场景专属公制适配阶段让机器人从目标位姿出发沿预定义运动自主记录图像-位姿对，微调相机头并联合学习 hand-eye 变换，替代专门标定流程。
Result: 在 USB-C cable picking、cable insertion、RAM insertion 三项真实装配任务上以 30Hz 实时运行；线缆任务末端精度达亚毫米；伺服过程中移动目标时成功率 90–100%；初始位移最大 30cm、目标遮挡 50% 的条件下全部试次收敛，优于所比较的视觉伺服基线。
Conclusion: 大规模预训练带来的几何感知表征配合场景专属公制适配，可以在遮挡、弱纹理和大初始偏差下实现高精度实时视觉伺服，并免除独立手眼标定步骤。

papers.title: hyperbolix: Hyperbolic Deep Learning in JAX
papers.abstract_en: We present hyperbolix, an open-source library for hyperbolic deep learning in JAX, built on Flax NNX. To our knowledge, it is the first comprehensive, general-purpose hyperbolic deep learning library in JAX. It includes six manifolds with a common interface: Euclidean space, the Poincaré ball, the hyperboloid, the $κ$-stereographic model, mixed-curvature product spaces, and the proper velocity space. We implement layer families that cover linear layers, convolutions, attention, normalization, positional encoding, regression, and vector quantization. These building blocks span methods ranging from Ganea's original hyperbolic neural networks to recent fully hyperbolic architectures such as Hypformer and Lorentzian ResNet. Additionally, hyperbolix contains Riemannian optimizers implemented as optax transformations, wrapped distributions, and hyperbolic dimensionality-reduction techniques. Its API uses idiomatic JAX: Manifolds are stateless, with curvature being passed at call time, while manifold operations act on single points, with vmap enabling batch operations. The precision of every checked operation is tested against a closed-form NumPy/SciPy transcription from the source paper or a finite difference, for both float32 and float64. On the hyperboloid, standard formulas for two-point operations, such as the distance, lose precision far from the origin, because they subtract two large, nearly equal terms. hyperbolix replaces these subtractions with cancellation-free formulas that stay accurate in float32 at distances where prior implementations return NaN. hyperbolix is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/timoklein/hyperbolix .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: hyperbolix 是基于 Flax NNX 的 JAX 双曲深度学习开源库，提供六种流形统一接口、覆盖线性层到注意力与向量量化的层族、optax 形式的 Riemannian 优化器与包装分布。其关键实现贡献是把双曲体上两点距离等公式的相减改写为无抵消 (cancellation-free) 形式，在先前实现返回 NaN 的距离上仍保持 float32 精度。
Motivation: 双曲表示学习缺少 JAX 生态的通用库，且双曲体上两点运算的标准公式在远离原点时因两个大数相减而损失精度，float32 下直接失效。
Method: 在 Flax NNX 上实现六种流形（Euclidean、Poincaré ball、hyperboloid、κ-stereographic、mixed-curvature product space、proper velocity space）的统一接口，流形无状态、曲率在调用时传入，单点运算配合 vmap 批量化；层族覆盖 linear、convolution、attention、normalization、positional encoding、regression、vector quantization，兼容 Ganea 原始超bolic 网络到 Hypformer、Lorentzian ResNet；每个运算的精度对照源论文的闭式 NumPy/SciPy 实现或有限差分，在 float32 与 float64 下测试。
Result: 所有被检验运算在 float32 与 float64 下均对照闭式 NumPy/SciPy 转写或有限差分测精度；hyperboloid 上两点距离等公式改用无抵消形式后，在先前实现返回 NaN 的距离处仍保持 float32 精度。
Conclusion: JAX 上可以做出接口统一且数值可靠的双曲深度学习库，精度问题的根源是公式中的相减抵消，改写公式即可在 float32 下扩展可用距离范围。

papers.title: Video-HopChain: Multi-Hop Questions and Confidence-Gated Exploration for Video Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: HopChain has shown on still images that multi-hop data synthesis improves vision-language reasoning, because long chain-of-thought reasoning exposes errors that compound across steps, while most data used for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) rarely demands a chain of visual evidence, so these weaknesses are likely to stay unexposed. We observe the same problem in video, where this framework has not yet been explored. We therefore build Video-HopChain, a dataset of 22,550 multi-hop video questions over 13,378 videos, together with a held-out benchmark of 1,000 questions. Each question chains three to six yes/no questions about moments in one video, and each yields one of two integers depending on its answer. The final answer is the sum of these integers, so an exact match on that sum gives the verifiable reward that RLVR needs. We first train Qwen3-VL-8B with GRPO on a standard video dataset, and a second stage on Video-HopChain then raises the mean over eight video understanding and reasoning benchmarks from 55.4 to 57.9 and improves every one of them. Training on such a dataset, however, exposes a known limitation of GRPO: its learning signal comes from the reward variance within a group, so hard questions whose rollouts are all incorrect and easy questions whose rollouts are all correct both leave the group with no gradient. To recover these groups at the same compute budget, we introduce Confidence-Gated Exploration (CGE). With 8 rollouts per question, CGE samples the first 4 as usual. If these 4 are either all correct or all incorrect, it samples the last 4 with the policy's most confident token masked inside the reasoning span, and removes the masked positions from the loss while all 8 rollouts enter the advantage. With CGE, the mean rises further to 59.3. We release the dataset, the checkpoint, and the data generation and training code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Video-HopChain 构造 22,550 条多跳视频问答（13,378 个视频，另有 1,000 题留出基准），每题把 3–6 个 yes/no 子问题的整数答案求和作为可验证奖励，供 RLVR 训练。在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上先用 GRPO 训标准视频数据、再训 Video-HopChain，八个视频理解与推理基准均值从 55.4 升到 57.9；加入 Confidence-Gated Exploration（CGE）后进一步升到 59.3。
Motivation: RLVR 所用数据很少要求成链的视觉证据，长链推理中的跨步错误因此不被暴露；GRPO 的学习信号来自组内奖励方差，全对或全错的题组没有梯度，难易两端的样本在同等算力下被浪费。
Method: 数据侧：每题在同一个视频内串联 3–6 个 yes/no 时刻问题，各子答案对应一个整数，最终答案为整数之和，精确匹配该和即得可验证奖励。训练侧：Qwen3-VL-8B 先用 GRPO 在标准视频数据上训练，再在 Video-HopChain 上二阶段训练。CGE：每题 8 次 rollout，前 4 次正常采样；若这 4 次全对或全错，则后 4 次采样时遮蔽策略在推理片段内置信度最高的 token，并把被遮位置从损失中剔除，而全部 8 次 rollout 都进入 advantage 计算。
Result: 二阶段训练使八个视频理解与推理基准的均值从 55.4 升至 57.9，且每个基准都有提升；加入 CGE 后均值进一步升至 59.3。数据集规模为 22,550 条多跳问题、13,378 个视频，留出基准 1,000 题，每题 3–6 个子问题，CGE 每题 8 次 rollout（前 4 常规、后 4 遮蔽最高置信 token）。
Conclusion: 多跳可验证数据加针对 GRPO 零梯度组的置信度门控探索，能在同等算力下持续抬升视频推理模型；作者公开数据集、checkpoint 以及数据生成与训练代码。

papers.title: GAE: Learning a Geometry-Native Latent Space for 3D-Consistent World Generation
papers.abstract_en: We present a compact geometry-native latent space as a shared foundation for perception and generation. Visual generators can produce photorealistic frames without preserving a consistent 3D scene. We argue that this is not only a modeling problem but also a representation problem: generators typically evolve appearance-centric latents, while perception models recover geometry in a semantically rich space that encodes cross-view structure. Rather than adding geometry as another output, we reparameterize a geometry foundation model's features into a compact latent space for generation. We realize this shift with the geometry-native autoencoder (GAE), whose latent is jointly decodable to appearance, depth, cameras, and point maps. With this state, a standard conditional flow supports diverse generation tasks. In controlled comparisons that hold the generator and training protocol fixed, replacing the latent with GAE improves both visual quality and independently measured 3D coherence: FVD falls by $12.7\%$ and $23.1\%$ on RealEstate10K and DL3DV, and camera-trajectory error is halved on RealEstate10K. Together, these results show that the latent space is central to geometry-consistent generation and can serve as a shared interface between perception and generation.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Colon3R: Cross-Domain 3D Reconstruction from Monocular Colonoscopic Video
papers.abstract_en: Monocular colonoscopic 3D reconstruction is important for surgical robotic colonoscopy, but remains challenging due to weak texture, specular reflections, limited view overlap, and non-rigid tissue motion. Conventional multi-view 3D reconstruction methods rely on stable correspondences and approximate rigidity, which are often violated in colonoscopy. Existing endoscopic methods often rely on domain-specific supervision, whereas there are not enough in-vivo labeled data available to adapt geometry foundation models to clinical colonoscopy. We present Colon3R, a cross-domain semi-supervised framework built on pretrained VGGT that transfers coupled camera, depth, and pointmap geometry from labeled phantom and simulated data to unlabeled in-vivo colonoscopy without requiring target-domain geometric annotations. Unlike source-only fine-tuning, which learns only from phantom and simulated data, Colon3R directly exploits unlabeled in-vivo video through teacher-derived cross-view supervision. Our proposed hierarchical quasi-rigid reliability selects reliable supervision at the sequence, directed-pair, and pixel levels, while source-preserving adaptation retains the learned coupled geometry during target-domain adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior overall performance over state-of-the-art approaches in depth, pointmap, and camera pose estimation. Qualitative comparisons on real in-vivo colonoscopy further show substantially more complete and geometrically consistent reconstructions than competing methods under clinical domain shift. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/vglx/Colon3R.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Colon3R 是跨域半监督的单目肠镜 3D 重建框架，基于预训练 VGGT，把带标注的 phantom 与仿真数据上的相机、深度、pointmap 耦合几何迁移到无标注在体 (in-vivo) 肠镜视频，无需目标域几何标注。它用教师模型的跨视角监督直接利用无标注在体视频，并以分层准刚性可靠性 (hierarchical quasi-rigid reliability) 在序列、有向对、像素三级筛选可靠监督。实验显示其在深度、pointmap、相机位姿估计上整体优于 SOTA，真实在体肠镜的定性重建更完整、几何更一致。
Motivation: 肠镜视野弱纹理、镜面反射、重叠有限且组织非刚性运动，多视角重建依赖的稳定对应与近似刚性假设失效；在体标注数据又不足以把几何基础模型适配到临床肠镜。
Method: 以预训练 VGGT 为骨干的跨域半监督框架：源域用带标注 phantom 与仿真数据学习耦合的相机、深度、pointmap 几何，目标域用教师模型对无标注在体视频产生跨视角监督；分层准刚性可靠性在序列、有向对、像素三级挑选可靠监督，source-preserving adaptation 在目标域适配时保留已学到的耦合几何。
Result: 在深度、pointmap 与相机位姿估计上整体性能优于 SOTA 方法；真实在体肠镜的定性对比显示重建比竞争方法更完整、几何更一致，且无需目标域几何标注。
Conclusion: 借助教师跨视角监督与分层准刚性可靠性筛选，几何基础模型可以在缺少临床标注的情况下跨域适配到在体肠镜，得到更完整一致的重建。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: An Iterative LangGraph Agent for Text-to-SQL: Natural Language Access to the Chicago Crime Database
papers.abstract_en: Non-technical stakeholders frequently cannot write the SQL needed to extract insights from operational databases. We built and evaluated a Text-to-SQL agent that closes this gap end to end: a six-node LangGraph StateGraph checks question relevance, fetches the live schema, generates PostgreSQL, validates it with a dry run, retries on failure, executes the query, and narrates the result set in plain English. The agent uses prompt engineering only; no model was fine-tuned. We evaluated it on the Chicago Crime dataset (approximately 8.5 million records, 22 attributes) against a hand-built benchmark of 100 natural language questions with ground-truth SQL, stratified into 30 Easy, 40 Medium and 30 Hard items. Comparing two prompt revisions of the same agent, the revised system (V2) reached a Valid SQL Rate of 93% (from 87%), an Execution Accuracy of 60% under a hybrid relational equivalence metric (from 47%; 19% from 12% under strict JSON matching), and a mean Synthesis Quality of 4.34 out of 5 (from 3.91). The single largest driver was removing a LIMIT 10 instruction from the system prompt, which had been truncating multi-row answers. Error analysis attributes the residual failures to relevance-checker false rejections, ambiguous question semantics, and free-tier API rate limits rather than to the language generation step. We report no comparison against an external baseline system or a public benchmark; the study is a single-model engineering evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对非技术用户难以直接查询业务数据库的问题，构建了一个六节点 LangGraph StateGraph 的 Text-to-SQL 智能体，仅用提示工程（无微调）完成问题相关性检查、拉取实时 schema、生成 PostgreSQL、dry-run 校验、失败重试、执行并用自然语言叙述结果。在 Chicago Crime 数据集（约 850 万条记录、22 个属性）上以 100 道带标准 SQL 的自然语言问题（30 Easy / 40 Medium / 30 Hard）评测，V2 相比 V1 的 Valid SQL Rate 从 87% 升至 93%，混合关系等价指标下的 Execution Accuracy 从 47% 升至 60%（严格 JSON 匹配下从 12% 升至 19%），Synthesis Quality 均分从 3.91 升至 4.34（满分 5）。最大单项改进来自从系统提示中移除 LIMIT 10 指令，此前该指令会截断多行答案。
Motivation: 非技术干系人无法编写 SQL 从运营数据库中提取洞察，需要端到端的自然语言到数据库访问链路。
Method: 六节点 LangGraph StateGraph：问题相关性检查、拉取实时 schema、生成 PostgreSQL、dry-run 校验、失败重试、执行并叙述结果集；仅用提示工程，未微调任何模型。评测基于自建的 100 题基准（含标准 SQL），分 30 Easy / 40 Medium / 30 Hard 三层，比较同一智能体的两版提示（V1 与 V2）。
Result: 在 Chicago Crime 数据集（约 850 万条记录、22 个属性）上：Valid SQL Rate 87% → 93%；混合关系等价指标下 Execution Accuracy 47% → 60%，严格 JSON 匹配下 12% → 19%；Synthesis Quality 均分 3.91 → 4.34（满分 5）。最大驱动因素是移除系统提示中的 LIMIT 10 指令。残余失败归因于相关性检查器误拒、问题语义歧义、免费档 API 速率限制，而非语言生成步骤。
Conclusion: 这是一项单模型工程评测，未与外部基线系统或公开基准对比；提示层面的微小改动（如去掉 LIMIT 10）可显著提升多行答案的执行准确率，残余瓶颈在相关性检查与语义歧义而非 SQL 生成。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: TEAR: Table Extraction with Attribute Recommendation from Texts via Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Table extraction from texts is an important task for information systems, and recent approaches that prompt large language models (LLMs) with instructions have drawn great attention for their strong performance. Existing works have assumed the input texts to be table descriptions or specialized documents. However, these efforts have largely overlooked another prevalent category of texts, commonly found in news reports and social media: naturally occurring texts. Extracting tabular information from such texts poses two distinct challenges. First, high variability and the absence of explicit structural cues make fixed heuristic LLM prompts limited in precisely delineating extraction boundaries. Second, manually predefined schemas cannot capture open-ended, unseen attributes in naturally occurring text. In this paper, we propose a framework, TEAR, to address these challenges. It comprises two synergistic workflows: a Table Extraction Workflow that dynamically adapts instructions to overcome the limitation of heuristic instructions, and an Attribute Recommendation Workflow that discovers new attributes from texts to complement the heuristic schema. To our knowledge, TEAR is the first framework that supports automated text-driven attribute recommendation, enabling exploratory schema design for table extraction. To evaluate TEAR, we establish the benchmark for table extraction and attribute recommendation on naturally occurring texts, including two real-world datasets, manual annotations, appropriate metrics, and baseline comparisons. Experiments show that TEAR achieves state-of-the-art performance on both tasks, and the recommended attributes effectively enhance extraction performance in exploratory scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TEAR 针对新闻与社交媒体等自然文本中的表格抽取，提出双工作流框架：Table Extraction Workflow 动态调整指令以界定抽取边界，Attribute Recommendation Workflow 从文本中发现新属性补足启发式 schema。作者建立了含两个真实数据集、人工标注、指标与基线的基准，实验显示 TEAR 在两项任务上均达到 SOTA，推荐属性在探索性场景下有效提升抽取性能。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 表格抽取工作假设输入是表描述或专业文档，而新闻与社交媒体中的自然文本结构线索缺失、属性开放且未见，固定启发式 prompt 与人工预定义 schema 都失效。
Method: TEAR 框架含两个协同工作流：Table Extraction Workflow 动态自适应指令以克服启发式指令的边界界定局限；Attribute Recommendation Workflow 从文本中发现新属性以补充启发式 schema，支持文本驱动的自动属性推荐与探索性 schema 设计。
Result: 在作者建立的自然文本表格抽取与属性推荐基准（含两个真实世界数据集、人工标注、指标与基线对比）上，TEAR 在两项任务上均取得 SOTA 性能，且推荐属性在探索性场景下有效增强抽取性能。
Conclusion: 自然文本的表格抽取需要把动态指令适配与自动属性发现结合，探索性 schema 设计可由文本驱动的属性推荐实现。

papers.title: T-LoopFormer: Token-Level Elastic-Depth Looped Transformers with Dynamic Routing
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers have recently demonstrated strong performance in both reasoning and language tasks by reusing a shared set of parameters across multiple iterations, achieving parameter efficiency without sacrificing representational power. Besides, looped Transformers perform inference directly in the latent space (latent reasoning) to reduce the number of tokens consumed during inference, thereby achieving improved sample efficiency. However, these models typically apply a fixed recursion depth uniformly to every token, leading to suboptimal compute allocation and leaving significant efficiency gains on the table. In this work, we propose \textbf{t}oken-level elastic-depth \textbf{looped transformers}: T-LoopFormer. T-LoopFormer uses \textbf{dynamic token-choice routing}, which enables each token to adaptively determine its own number of loop iterations based on its hidden state, which could improve the token generation accuracy. Moreover, we further introduce recursion-wise KV cache, which maintains an independent key-value cache for each recursion loop of active tokens; this design ensures that tokens at different depths only attend to their corresponding cached states, effectively enabling faster autoregressive decoding. Extensive experiments show that T-LoopFormer achieves robust performance on a wide range of language modeling and zero-shot reasoning tasks, and our model could reach the lowest decoding latency, which validates the effectiveness of token-choice router and recursion-wise KV cache. Code is available at https://github.com/YuMingQian1234/T-LoopFormer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: T-LoopFormer 让每个 token 按自身 hidden state 自适应决定循环迭代次数（dynamic token-choice routing），并为每个递归层维护独立 KV cache（recursion-wise KV cache），使不同深度的 token 只关注对应缓存状态。作者称该模型在语言建模与 zero-shot reasoning 任务上表现稳健，并达到最低解码延迟。
Motivation: Looped Transformer 对所有 token 施加统一的固定递归深度，导致计算分配次优，效率提升空间被浪费。
Method: 在 looped Transformer 基础上引入 dynamic token-choice routing，由每个 token 的 hidden state 决定自身循环次数；并加入 recursion-wise KV cache，为每个递归循环的活跃 token 维护独立 key-value cache，使不同深度 token 只注意对应缓存状态以加速自回归解码。
Result: 在语言建模与 zero-shot reasoning 任务上取得稳健表现，并达到最低解码延迟；作者将该结果归因于 token-choice router 与 recursion-wise KV cache。
Conclusion: 按 token 粒度分配循环深度并按递归层隔离 KV cache，可在保持 looped Transformer 参数效率的同时加快自回归解码。

papers.title: Neural-Network Solutions to Real-Space Charge Density and Generalization
papers.abstract_en: The Hohenberg-Kohn theorem establishes that, in principle, the ground state (GS) charge density contains all GS information of a many-electron system, such that all GS observables can be expressed as functionals of the GS charge density. Conventional Kohn-Sham density functional theory requires iterative solution of the self-consistent-field equations at substantial computational cost, motivating the development of deep learning surrogates for electronic structure calculations and, in turn, accelerating computer-aided materials design. Here, we propose AIDEN, an Atomic-Interaction Density Equivariant Network for solving real-space charge density. AIDEN separates the element-dependent one-center density from environment-induced density redistribution and represents the latter through complementary atom- and edge-centered tensor correlations. A continuous low-rank Gaussian decoder then reconstructs the density at arbitrary spatial coordinates while reusing atomic encodings independently of the evaluation grid. AIDEN achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on periodic crystal benchmarks while remaining competitive for molecular systems, and further demonstrates zero-shot transferability across several structurally distinct out-of-distribution case studies. Furthermore, AIDEN provides substantially faster inference than both baseline models and full SCF calculations, enabling efficient charge density reconstruction for large-scale electronic structure calculations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AIDEN（Atomic-Interaction Density Equivariant Network），把元素相关的一中心密度与环境诱导的密度重分配分开，后者用原子中心与边中心的张量相关表示，再由连续低秩高斯解码器在任意空间坐标重建实空间电荷密度。在周期性晶体基准上达到 state-of-the-art 精度，分子体系保持竞争力，并在多个结构差异明显的分布外案例上展示零样本迁移，推理速度显著快于基线模型与完整 SCF 计算。
Motivation: Kohn-Sham DFT 需要迭代求解自洽场 (SCF) 方程，计算代价高，制约了计算机辅助材料设计的规模；Hohenberg-Kohn 定理说明基态电荷密度已包含全部基态信息，为直接学习实空间密度提供了出发点。
Method: AIDEN 用等变网络分离元素依赖的一中心密度与环境诱导的密度重分配，后者以互补的原子中心和边中心张量相关表示；连续低秩高斯解码器在任意空间坐标重建密度，且原子编码可独立于评估网格复用。
Result: 在周期性晶体基准上达到 state-of-the-art 精度，分子体系上保持竞争力；在多个结构不同的分布外 (OOD) 案例上展示零样本可迁移性；推理速度显著快于基线模型与完整 SCF 计算，可支持大规模电子结构计算的电荷密度重建。
Conclusion: 把密度拆成一中心项加环境重分配、再用与网格无关的解码器重建，可以在保持精度的同时大幅加速电荷密度求解，并对结构不同的体系做零样本迁移。
