papers.title: A Unified and Constrained View of Regularization-Based Robust Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Regularization-based methods have become a standard approach for training Deep Reinforcement Learning policies against adversarial input perturbations. In this paper, we unify these methods by deriving new upper bounds on the performance gap between the nominal and worst-case policies. Each upper bound is expressed as an existing regularization objective plus a KL-divergence penalty between the nominal and worst-case policies, which further explains why adding a KL penalty improves robustness in practice. Building on these bounds, we formulate robust training as a constrained optimization problem, showing that existing methods correspond to the special case of a fixed Lagrange multiplier. We instead update the multiplier jointly with the policy to automatically tune the regularization weight. Finally, we conduct extensive adversarial evaluations across several continuous control tasks to validate our theoretical analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把基于正则化的鲁棒强化学习统一为「原正则目标 + 名义策略与最坏策略间 KL 散度惩罚」的性能差距上界，并据此把鲁棒训练写成约束优化：现有方法等价于固定拉格朗日乘子的特例，本文改为与策略联合更新乘子以自动调节正则权重。在多个连续控制任务上的对抗评估验证了该理论分析。
Motivation: 对抗输入扰动下的 DRL 正则化方法各自为政，缺少统一的性能差距刻画；正则权重靠人工调，实践中加 KL 惩罚为何提升鲁棒性也缺乏解释。
Method: 推导名义策略与最坏策略之间性能差距的新上界，每个上界写成已有正则目标加 KL 散度惩罚；在此基础上把鲁棒训练表述为约束优化问题，并将拉格朗日乘子与策略联合更新以自动调节正则权重。
Result: 给出若干新的性能差距上界，形式为现有正则目标加 KL 惩罚；证明现有方法对应固定拉格朗日乘子的特例；在多个连续控制任务上进行广泛的对抗评估以验证理论分析。
Conclusion: 正则化鲁棒 RL 可统一到带 KL 惩罚的约束优化框架下，自适应更新拉格朗日乘子取代手工设定正则权重。

papers.title: Relatively Smart II: Tractable or Semi-Supervised Instance-Optimal Learning
papers.abstract_en: We continue the study of relatively smart learning, introduced by Dughmi and Pour (2026), which asks a supervised learner to compete, marginal by marginal, with every distribution-fixed error guarantee soundly certifiable from unlabeled data. They showed that the One-Inclusion Graph (OIG) learner is relatively smart with a quadratic sample-complexity blowup, and that no relatively smart learner can do better, leaving open whether ERM or another natural or tractable learner achieves comparable guarantees. They also left open whether the blowup can be restricted to unlabeled data. Our firs results shows that ERM---and in fact any proper consistent learner---is relatively smart for binary classification in the distribution-free setting. We show that a small certifiable error with $m$ samples implies a similarly small error on the uniform distribution over a random sample of size $O(m^2)$, yielding a cover of size at most $2^{m+1}$ on that sample. This suffices to control the error of proper consistent learners with $O(m^2)$ samples. We then show that semi-supervised relatively smart learning is information-theoretically possible with a quadratic blowup only in unlabeled sample complexity and no blowup in labeled sample complexity. The learner uses a natural generalization of OIG to a leave-most-out transductive problem, where labels of part of a finite pool are revealed and the remaining labels are predicted. Finally, this label efficiency comes at a cost in simplicity and tractability. If the hypothesis class is accessed only through an agnostic ERM oracle, any semi-supervised relatively smart learner with substantially sub-quadratic labeled-sample blowup requires super-polynomially many oracle calls. This holds even when the marginal is given explicitly, and thus also yields an intractability result for distribution-fixed learning that may be of independent interest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文证明在分布无关的二分类设定下，ERM（乃至任意 proper consistent learner）本身就是 relatively smart，即能逐边际地与所有可由无标签数据可靠认证的分布固定误差保证竞争，样本复杂度只需 O(m²) 的二次放大。进一步给出半监督版本：标签样本复杂度零放大、仅无标签样本复杂度二次放大；但若假设类只能通过 agnostic ERM oracle 访问，任何标签放大显著低于二次的半监督 relatively smart 学习器都需要超多项式次 oracle 调用。
Motivation: Dughmi 与 Pour (2026) 提出 relatively smart learning 时留下两个开放问题：ERM 或其他自然可 tractable 的学习器能否达到 OIG 学习器的二次样本复杂度保证，以及该放大能否只施加在无标签数据上。
Method: 先证明任意 proper consistent learner 在二分类分布无关设定下 relatively smart：由 m 样本上的小可认证误差推出在 O(m²) 随机样本的均匀分布上误差同样小，从而在该样本上得到至多 2^{m+1} 大小的覆盖，用以控制 proper consistent learner 的误差。半监督部分将 OIG 推广到 leave-most-out transductive 问题（有限池中揭示部分标签、预测其余标签）；下界部分在 agnostic ERM oracle 模型下证明。
Result: ERM 及任意 proper consistent learner 在二分类分布无关设定下 relatively smart，样本复杂度 O(m²)，覆盖规模至多 2^{m+1}；半监督 relatively smart 学习可实现仅无标签样本复杂度二次放大、标签样本复杂度零放大；在 agnostic ERM oracle 访问模型下，标签样本放大显著低于二次的半监督 relatively smart 学习器需超多项式次 oracle 调用，即使边际显式给出也成立，并由此得到 distribution-fixed learning 的难解性结论。
Conclusion: 标签效率与 tractability 存在权衡：二次标签样本放大是可 tractable 实现 relatively smart 的门槛，低于它就必须付出超多项式 oracle 调用的代价；该难解性结果对 distribution-fixed learning 本身也可能独立成立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structured Multi-Level-Set Inversion for 3-D Electromagnetic Inverse Scattering
papers.abstract_en: Many dielectric targets encountered in 3-D electromagnetic inverse scattering exhibit piecewise-homogeneous material distributions, which provide useful structural information for inversion. To exploit this property, this paper proposes a structured multi-level-set inversion (SMLSI) method within a physics-driven neural network (PDNN) framework. Instead of directly parameterizing the contrast distribution, SMLSI represents it in terms of object support and material distribution. Multiple level-sets are mapped to soft-support functions and combined through a soft-union operation to construct the object support. The normalized contributions of these soft-support functions, together with trainable complex relative permittivities, determine the material distribution within the support. The level-set residuals are parameterized by a coordinate-based neural network, and the trainable parameters are optimized from scattered field data. Structure-aware regularization terms are introduced to promote binary object support and spatially coherent material regions while reducing material mixing and redundant activation of level-set supports. Adaptive regularization weighting is further employed to reduce the dependence on manual parameter tuning. Numerical experiments demonstrate that SMLSI improves reconstruction accuracy over direct contrast parameterization and enables the recovery of irregular 3-D geometries, closely spaced objects, and multiple material regions. Compared with CSI and $L_{2/3}$-FBE-WCIE, SMLSI achieves more accurate reconstructions on representative synthetic targets. Experimental validation using 3-D Fresnel data further demonstrates its applicability to measured scattering data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SMLSI 在物理驱动神经网络 (PDNN) 框架内不直接参数化对比度，而是用多条 level-set 映射为软支撑函数并经 soft-union 合成物体支撑，配合可训练复相对介电常数刻画支撑内材料分布。结构感知正则与自适应权重促使支撑二值化、材料区域空间连贯；在合成目标上比直接对比度参数化、CSI 与 L2/3-FBE-WCIE 重建更准，并在 3-D Fresnel 实测散射数据上验证可用。
Motivation: 3-D 电磁逆散射中的许多介质目标呈分片均匀材料分布，直接参数化对比度无法利用这一结构先验，导致不规则几何、紧邻目标与多材料区域的重建精度受限。
Method: 在 PDNN 中以坐标神经网络参数化 level-set 残差，多条 level-set 经软支撑函数与 soft-union 构造物体支撑，归一化贡献加可训练复相对介电常数决定支撑内材料分布；引入结构感知正则（促二值支撑、空间连贯材料区、抑制材料混合与冗余激活）并用自适应正则加权减少人工调参，参数由散射场数据优化。
Result: 数值实验中 SMLSI 在代表性合成目标上比直接对比度参数化提升重建精度，并较 CSI 与 L2/3-FBE-WCIE 得到更准确的重建，可恢复不规则 3-D 几何、紧邻目标与多材料区域；在 3-D Fresnel 实测散射数据上完成实验验证。
Conclusion: 以 level-set 支撑与材料分布分开参数化并加结构正则，是分片均匀介质 3-D 逆散射比直接对比度参数化更有效的重建路线，且能落到实测散射数据。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Rethinking One-Shot Federated Graph Learning: Training-Free Statistical Estimation
papers.abstract_en: One-shot federated graph learning generally aims to train Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) across clients with disconnected subgraphs in a single communication round. Existing methods predominantly design advanced optimization strategies under the premise that local GNN training is indispensable. However, empirical observations reveal that under extreme non-IID conditions, local GNN training suffers from severe cross-client representation misalignment, becoming a major source of error rather than a remedy. Motivated by this, we reformulate one-shot FGL as a statistical estimation problem. We propose SPEAR (Statistical Prototype Estimation with Adaptive Reliability), a completely training-free framework that directly computes topology-smoothed class prototypes from local graphs in the original feature space. The server then aggregates these prototypes using a sample-size-adaptive shrinkage estimator that down-weights unreliable local estimates, producing robust global class prototypes. Extensive experiments across seven benchmarks demonstrate that SPEAR consistently achieves state-of-the-art accuracy under extreme heterogeneity. Moreover, SPEAR delivers at least an order-of-magnitude speedup over all baselines, reaching several orders of magnitude against generative and distillation-based methods. Our findings suggest that training-free statistical estimation, rather than local GNN optimization, provides the key to robust and efficient one-shot federated graph learning. The code is available at https://github.com/Yodeesy/SPEAR .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPEAR 把单轮联邦图学习 (one-shot FGL) 重写为统计估计问题：完全免训练，直接在原始特征空间从各客户端局部图计算拓扑平滑类原型，服务器用样本量自适应收缩估计器降权不可靠的局部估计。在极端 non-IID 下七个基准上一致达到 SOTA 精度，且相对所有基线至少提速一个数量级，对生成式与蒸馏式方法达数个数量级。
Motivation: 单轮 FGL 现有方法都默认必须先在客户端训练 GNN，但极端 non-IID 下局部训练造成严重的跨客户端表征错位，反而成为主要误差来源。
Method: SPEAR (Statistical Prototype Estimation with Adaptive Reliability)：免训练框架，在原始特征空间对局部图计算拓扑平滑的类原型，服务器端用样本量自适应收缩估计器 (sample-size-adaptive shrinkage estimator) 聚合，降权不可靠的局部估计得到全局类原型。
Result: 在七个基准上于极端异质条件下一致取得 SOTA 精度；相对全部基线至少一个数量级加速，相对生成式与蒸馏式方法达数个数量级加速。
Conclusion: 免训练的统计估计而非局部 GNN 优化，才是单轮联邦图学习兼具鲁棒性与效率的关键。

papers.title: OmniStepBench: Deployment-Aware Agent Evaluation across Modalities and Task Complexity
papers.abstract_en: As large language models evolve from question-answering systems into general-purpose agents, evaluation must move beyond static answer correctness to assess multimodal perception, multi-step execution, tool use, and artifact delivery. However, existing benchmarks are often tied to specific task types, execution environments, or scoring protocols, limiting their comparability, interpretability, and reliability for deployment decisions. We introduce \textbf{OmniStepBench}, a benchmark for deployment-aware agent evaluation across modalities and task complexity. Built on a shared OpenClaw execution environment, OmniStepBench organizes 233 tasks selected and adapted from 22 source benchmarks into a $2\times3$ workload matrix defined by input modality and execution form, and evaluates them under a unified contract-based protocol with evidence-based score auditing. We evaluate 30 commercial API models and 12 locally deployed open-weight models (42 models in total) over 9{,}218 applicable model--task runs, reporting accuracy and token consumption alongside reference costs for API models. Results show workload-dependent rankings, distinct accuracy--cost trade-offs between text and multimodal tasks, and competitive but weaker overall performance from local models. These findings support deployment decisions based on workload profiles, deployment mode, and accuracy--cost trade-offs rather than a single aggregate score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniStepBench 把 22 个来源基准的 233 个任务重组为按输入模态与执行形式划分的 2×3 工作负载矩阵，在统一的 OpenClaw 执行环境与基于契约、带证据审计的评分协议下评测 42 个模型共 9,218 次模型-任务运行。结果显示排名随工作负载变化、文本与多模态任务呈现不同的准确率-成本权衡、本地部署模型整体有竞争力但偏弱，作者据此主张按工作负载画像与部署方式而非单一总分做部署决策。
Motivation: 现有 agent 基准绑定特定任务类型、执行环境或评分协议，导致结果在可比性、可解释性和可靠性上不足以支撑真实部署决策。
Method: 在共享的 OpenClaw 执行环境中，将 22 个来源基准的任务筛选改编为 233 个任务，按输入模态与执行形式构成 2×3 工作负载矩阵；统一采用 contract-based 评分协议并做基于证据的分数审计 (evidence-based score auditing)，评测 30 个商业 API 模型与 12 个本地部署开放权重模型。
Result: 共 9,218 次适用的模型-任务运行，报告准确率与 token 消耗，API 模型另附参考成本；结果呈现工作负载依赖的排名、文本与多模态任务之间明显不同的准确率-成本权衡，以及本地模型整体有竞争力但总体表现偏弱。
Conclusion: 部署决策应基于工作负载画像、部署方式与准确率-成本权衡，而不是单一聚合分数。

papers.title: When Genomic Masking Priors Fail to Transfer: Strong Variant Prediction, Weak Functional Generation
papers.abstract_en: Bidirectional discrete diffusion model appears naturally suited to genomic modeling because it can reconstruct missing sequence from both flanks. We developed GenDA (Genomic Density-optimized Absorbing Diffusion) under the additional hypothesis that entropy-guided span placement would concentrate reconstruction pressure on compositionally complex regions, improving both downstream variant-effect prediction and functional sequence generation. Our results only partially support this premise. After supervised fine-tuning, the 202M-parameter GenDA model reaches a pooled ClinVar SNV AUROC of 0.774, exceeding a similarly scaled autoregressive model by 0.103. However, a matched random-span variant reaches 0.777, providing no evidence that entropy guidance causes the ClinVar improvement. More unexpectedly, GenDA fails a zero-shot functional inpainting stress test: across promoters, enhancers, exon boundaries, and intron boundaries, it does not consistently outperform a control that shuffles the native gap while exactly preserving 3-mer composition. Failure is already present for 50--500-bp gaps, although enhancer degradation worsens at longer gaps. Diagnostics identify several boundary conditions: entropy measures local sequence complexity rather than functional importance; 1-mer tokenization limits physical context; training spans are capped at 300 bp; and high absolute AlphaGenome fidelity can coexist with negative control-normalized restoration. These results show that strong fine-tuned variant prediction, a plausible corruption prior, and functional generation are distinct claims that require separate validation.
papers.journal_ref: NeurIPS 2026 workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GenDA（Genomic Density-optimized Absorbing Diffusion）用熵引导的 span 放置把重建压力集中到组成复杂区域，假设这能同时提升变异效应预测与功能序列生成。监督微调后 202M 参数模型在 ClinVar SNV 上 pooled AUROC 0.774，比同规模自回归模型高 0.103，但随机 span 对照达 0.777，说明提升与熵引导无关；零样本功能 inpainting 中，GenDA 在 promoter、enhancer、exon/intron 边界上均不能稳定超过保留 3-mer 组成的打乱对照，50–500 bp 缺口即已失效。
Motivation: 双向离散扩散天然适合从两侧重建缺失基因组片段，但「更合理的掩码先验能同时改善变异预测与功能生成」这一假设未经分离验证；若不拆开检验，强微调性能会被误读为生成能力。
Method: 构建 GenDA：双向吸收式离散扩散，加入熵引导的 span 放置以集中重建压力于组成复杂区域；在 202M 参数规模上与同规模自回归模型对比，并做监督微调；另设零样本功能 inpainting 压力测试，对照为精确保持 3-mer 组成的打乱缺口，用 AlphaGenome 保真度做诊断。
Result: 微调后 ClinVar SNV pooled AUROC 0.774，超同规模自回归模型 0.103；随机 span 变体达 0.777，熵引导无额外贡献。零样本功能 inpainting 中，promoters、enhancers、exon 边界、intron 边界上均未稳定优于 3-mer 保持的打乱对照；失效在 50–500 bp 缺口即出现，enhancer 在更长缺口上进一步恶化。诊断指出：熵度量的是局部序列复杂度而非功能重要性；1-mer tokenization 限制物理上下文；训练 span 上限 300 bp；高 AlphaGenome 绝对保真度可与负的对照归一化恢复并存。
Conclusion: 强微调变异预测、合理的破坏先验、功能序列生成是三个需分别验证的独立主张，不能由前者推及后者；熵作为复杂度代理不足以定位功能位点。

papers.title: CLON: Cue-Calibrated Linguistic Object Onboarding for Zero-Shot 6D Pose Front-Ends
papers.abstract_en: Novel-object 6D pose pipelines depend on front-end hypotheses that retain target instances under clutter and occlusion without overwhelming downstream pose estimation. We introduce Cue-Calibrated Linguistic Object Onboarding (CLON), a training-free proposal-and-matching front-end. CLON converts multi-view CAD renderings into compact linguistic memories that provide object-specific conditioning to a frozen proposal generator. Constructed offline and reused across scenes, these memories augment generic prompts before segmentation; subsequent template verification assigns object identity. As a complementary onboarding step, CLON derives fixed cue weights from template statistics for semantic, appearance, and geometric verification. On seven BOP-Classic-Core datasets, CLON improves detection AP by 8.2 percentage points (pp), segmentation AP by 6.2 pp, and downstream pose AR by up to 4.1 pp over the evaluated CNOS and SAM-6D front-ends. In a real-world localization-to-grasp study under clutter and occlusion with 100 trials per method, CLON's improved localization doubles grasp success relative to the strongest evaluated baseline. Controlled ablations evaluate linguistic conditioning, multi-view construction, and verification. Analysis of a smaller candidate set with higher class-agnostic recall on five datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLON 是免训练的新物体 6D 位姿前端：把多视角 CAD 渲染压成紧凑的“语言记忆”给冻结的 proposal 生成器做物体特定条件化，再用模板统计导出的固定 cue 权重做语义、外观、几何三路验证。在七个 BOP-Classic-Core 数据集上检测 AP 提升 8.2 pp、分割 AP 提升 6.2 pp、下游位姿 AR 最多提升 4.1 pp，真实抓取实验中定位改善使成功率相对最强基线翻倍。
Motivation: 新物体 6D 位姿流水线依赖前端在杂乱与遮挡下保住目标实例，同时不能给下游位姿估计塞进过多候选；通用前端对未见物体缺少针对性条件化。
Method: CLON 离线把多视角 CAD 渲染转成紧凑 linguistic memories，作为物体特定条件注入冻结的 proposal 生成器，先增强通用 prompt 再分割，随后模板验证指派物体身份；另从模板统计导出固定 cue 权重，对语义、外观、几何三路验证做校准。整个前端 training-free，记忆可跨场景复用。
Result: 在七个 BOP-Classic-Core 数据集上，相对被评估的 CNOS 与 SAM-6D 前端，检测 AP 提升 8.2 pp、分割 AP 提升 6.2 pp、下游位姿 AR 最多提升 4.1 pp。真实世界 clutter/occlusion 下的 localization-to-grasp 研究每种方法 100 次试验，CLON 的定位改善使抓取成功率相对最强评估基线翻倍。受控 ablation 覆盖语言条件化、多视角构建与验证；在五个数据集上以更小候选集取得更高 class-agnostic recall。
Conclusion: 把 CAD 先验离线编成可复用的语言记忆并用固定 cue 权重校验，能在不训练的前提下同时缩小候选集、保住召回并抬高下游 6D 位姿与真实抓取成功率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Q-Edge: Symmetry-Reduced Quantum Simulation of Structured Extreme Dependence
papers.abstract_en: High-dimensional simulation of multivariate extremes is fundamentally limited by the combinatorial complexity of dependence, often more than by the scarcity of extreme observations. We show that symmetry admits a lossless orbit-space representation that preserves structured extreme dependence while replacing an exponentially large dependence space with a compact set of symmetry classes. Based on this principle, we develop Q-Edge (Quantum Extreme Dependence Engine), a symmetry-reduced quantum framework that operates directly in orbit space, enabling scalable simulation and digital twins of structured extreme systems. By transferring symmetry into the data representation rather than the quantum circuit, Q-Edge allows unconstrained quantum generative models to exploit dramatically reduced state spaces. For a 30-dimensional problem, approximately 1.6 million angular states collapse to 256 orbit states, reducing the required quantum representation from about 21 qubits to 8. Our results establish a general computational principle for scalable quantum simulation of structured extreme dependence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Q-Edge 把多元极端依赖中的对称性移进数据表示而非量子线路，在 orbit space 上做无损表示：30 维问题中约 160 万个角状态塌缩为 256 个 orbit 状态，量子表示从约 21 qubit 降到 8 qubit，使无约束量子生成模型能在缩小的状态空间上做可扩展的极端系统仿真与数字孪生。
Motivation: 高维多元极端模拟的瓶颈在于依赖结构的组合复杂度，往往比极端观测稀缺更严重，指数级依赖空间使常规仿真难以扩展。
Method: 利用对称性构造无损 orbit-space 表示，把结构化极端依赖压缩为紧凑的对称类集合；在此表示上运行对称约简的量子框架 Q-Edge (Quantum Extreme Dependence Engine)，让无约束量子生成模型直接在 orbit space 中工作，对称性进入数据表示而非量子线路。
Result: 在 30 维问题上，约 160 万 (1.6 million) 个角状态塌缩为 256 个 orbit 状态，所需量子表示从约 21 qubit 降至 8 qubit。
Conclusion: 把对称性编码进数据表示可指数级压缩结构化极端依赖的状态空间，为可扩展的量子极端仿真与数字孪生提供一条通用计算原则。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: CA-OPD: Confidence-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Structured Visual Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive vision language models unify heterogeneous perception tasks but are highly susceptible to compounding errors. On-policy distillation (OPD) bridges the training-inference mismatch by training students on their own rollouts. However, unreliable student predictions, especially early in training, can derail the trajectory and degrade the quality of teacher supervision. While recent interleaved distillation methods allow the teacher to verify and replace student tokens, they primarily rely on rigid ranking metrics rather than exact teacher confidence, and they overlook how intervention decisions can inform token-level supervision. To address this, we introduce Confidence-Aware On-Policy Distillation (CA-OPD), a framework that couples reliable rollout construction with adaptive supervision. CA-OPD utilizes teacher confidence to selectively correct unreliable student transitions, gradually transferring rollout control to the student via a strict-to-relaxed schedule. Crucially, CA-OPD aligns knowledge transfer with these intervention decisions: corrected positions receive direct cross-entropy supervision from the teacher's prediction, while retained positions benefit from the teacher's full predictive distribution. Evaluated in a multi-teacher setting for GUI grounding and optical character recognition, CA-OPD substantially improves the Qwen3.5-0.8B baseline across all six target benchmarks, including gains of $9.50$ points on ScreenSpot-Pro and $6.72$ points on OCRBench-v2 English. Controlled studies further show that the gains depend on intervention placement, progressive rollout control, and intervention-aligned supervision, rather than intervention frequency alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CA-OPD 用教师置信度筛选学生自回滚 (rollout) 中不可靠的转移并逐步把回滚控制权交给学生：被纠正位置用教师预测做直接交叉熵监督，被保留位置用教师完整预测分布。在 GUI grounding 与 OCR 的多教师设置下，Qwen3.5-0.8B 基线在全部六个目标基准上提升，ScreenSpot-Pro +9.50 点、OCRBench-v2 英文 +6.72 点。
Motivation: 自回归 VLM 的误差会随回滚累积，而早期学生预测不可靠会带偏轨迹、劣化教师监督；现有 interleaved distillation 依赖刚性排序指标而非教师真实置信度，也未利用干预决策本身携带的 token 级监督信号。
Method: CA-OPD 耦合可靠回滚构建与自适应监督：用教师置信度选择性纠正不可靠学生转移，并按 strict-to-relaxed 日程逐步把回滚控制权移交学生；纠正位置取教师预测的直接交叉熵，保留位置取教师完整预测分布，使监督形式与干预决策对齐。
Result: 在 GUI grounding 与 OCR 的多教师评估中，Qwen3.5-0.8B 基线在全部六个目标基准上提升，ScreenSpot-Pro 增加 9.50 点，OCRBench-v2 英文增加 6.72 点；受控研究表明收益依赖干预位置、渐进式回滚控制与干预对齐监督，而非干预频率本身。
Conclusion: 教师置信度驱动的干预决策既决定回滚可靠性，也应直接决定 token 级监督形式；收益来自干预放在哪里、如何逐步放权以及监督如何对齐，而不是干预得越多越好。

papers.title: Diffusion as a Training Curriculum for Timestep-Free Iterative Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models and recursive reasoners are both iterative, but they carry information across iterations differently. We add a persistent hidden state to a diffusion denoiser and remove its timestep conditioning, leaving a single shared update that can be run to arbitrary depth. The result is an anytime solver: accuracy keeps improving with inference depth far beyond the rollout lengths and backpropagation window used in training, reaching 99.90% exact solve on Sudoku-Extreme. We also obtain 98.93% solve rate on Maze-Unique. Surprisingly, progressive denoising is unnecessary at inference: holding corruption at its maximum by replacing every non-clue variable with fresh Gaussian noise at each step retains near-perfect solving and converges to stable solutions. This simple noise-injection mechanism enables a single trajectory to efficiently explore the solution space and settle on the correct answer without parallel rollouts, candidate selection, or external verifiers required by prior reasoning models. Nonetheless, ordered annealed corruption remains critical during training, which suggests that diffusion's primary contribution to our anytime solver is not a sampling procedure at inference, but a denoising training curriculum.
papers.comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "Beyond Next Token Prediction: Diffusion and Flow Models for Next-Generation Decoding"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给 diffusion denoiser 加入持久隐状态并去掉 timestep 条件，得到可任意加深的共享更新步，成为 anytime 求解器：推理深度远超训练 rollout 与反传窗口时精度仍持续上升，Sudoku-Extreme exact solve 达 99.90%、Maze-Unique solve rate 98.93%。推理时把腐蚀固定在最大值、每步用新高斯噪声替换非线索变量即可保持近完美求解，说明 diffusion 的关键作用是训练期的去噪课程而非推理采样。
Motivation: 扩散模型与递归推理器都是迭代式，但跨迭代传递信息的方式不同；已有推理模型依赖并行 rollout、候选选择或外部验证器，本文要让单条轨迹就能任意加深地求解。
Method: 在 diffusion denoiser 中加入持久 hidden state 并移除 timestep conditioning，只保留一个可跑到任意深度的共享更新步；训练时仍用有序退火腐蚀 (ordered annealed corruption) 作为课程，推理时可将腐蚀固定在最大值、每步对所有非线索变量注入新的高斯噪声。
Result: 在 Sudoku-Extreme 上达到 99.90% exact solve，Maze-Unique 上达到 98.93% solve rate；精度随推理深度持续提升，远超训练所用的 rollout 长度与反传窗口。推理时保持最大腐蚀并每步重注高斯噪声仍保持近完美求解并收敛到稳定解，无需并行 rollout、候选选择或外部验证器。
Conclusion: diffusion 对该 anytime 求解器的主要贡献不是推理期的采样过程，而是训练期的去噪课程；有序退火腐蚀在训练中仍然关键，而推理期的渐进去噪可以省去。

papers.title: Same Request, Different Boundary: Evaluating Cybersecurity Assistance across Conversational Contexts
papers.abstract_en: Cybersecurity assistance is dual use, requiring decisions about when to answer, limit, or refuse a request. Prior work studies refusal evaluation and conversational jailbreaking, but how conversational histories shift assistance boundaries in both directions for identical cybersecurity requests remains underexplored. We introduce 3R-Bench, a benchmark of 150 real-world cybersecurity requests evaluated across eight LLMs under direct prompting and two predefined conversational settings. We separately code refusal, bounded assistance, compliance, and provider blocking to characterize delivered assistance. On 400 matched ambiguous request-model pairs, compliance is 75.3% directly, 57.8% after refused precedent, and 81.0% after accepted precedent. A smaller repeated-generation panel reproduces the refusal-acceptance gap. On a balanced 75-request panel reusing the direct baseline, compliance decreases from 74.2% directly to 57.2% after neutral task-decomposition dialogue and 60.3% after failure-ended dialogue. These findings show that cybersecurity assistance varies with conversational history and model deployment, motivating evaluation beyond direct-request refusal rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 3R-Bench，用 150 条真实网络安全请求在 8 个 LLM 上对比直接提问与两种预设对话历史，分别编码拒绝、有限协助、服从与平台拦截。同一请求的服从率随前序对话双向移动：被拒先例后从 75.3% 降到 57.8%，被接受先例后升到 81.0%；中性任务分解与失败结束对话也使服从率从 74.2% 降到 57.2% 和 60.3%。作者主张评估不能只看直接请求的拒绝率。
Motivation: 既有工作聚焦拒绝评估与对话越狱，但同一网络安全请求在不同对话历史下协助边界如何双向变化——以及部署方式的差异——仍缺少系统刻画。
Method: 构建 3R-Bench：150 条真实网络安全请求，8 个 LLM，直接提示加两种预设对话设定；对输出分别编码 refusal、bounded assistance、compliance、provider blocking 四类，另设重复生成小面板与 75 条平衡面板复用直接基线。
Result: 400 组匹配的模糊请求-模型对上，服从率直接 75.3%、被拒先例后 57.8%、被接受先例后 81.0%；重复生成面板复现拒绝-接受差距。75 条平衡面板上，服从率从直接 74.2% 降到中性任务分解对话后 57.2%、失败结束对话后 60.3%。
Conclusion: 网络安全协助边界随对话历史与模型部署而变，仅用直接请求的拒绝率评估会同时漏掉被拒先例的收紧与被接受先例的放宽。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Computational Framework for Modelling Organisation-Level Semantic Identity from Longitudinal Textual Data
papers.abstract_en: Can longitudinal texts produced by organisationally affiliated contributors reveal collective semantic differentiation and change without obscuring differences among those contributors? We develop a computational social science framework that combines established semantic and graph measures into interpretable organisational fingerprints and temporal profiles. We use \emph{organisation-level semantic identity} to describe a corpus-dependent interpretation of recurring and changing features of affiliated textual output, rather than corporate culture or managerial intention. Drawing on an inherited semantic landscape, we examine 1,289 songs by 126 artists affiliated with four K-pop entertainment companies between 1997 and 2023. The evidence for differentiation is selective. After correction, all three novelty-related measures show artist-level differences, whereas the diversity and connectivity measures tested do not; only two company--community enrichments remain significant. Temporal trajectories reveal further distinctions between portfolios. Artist-grouped balanced accuracy reaches 0.334 against a chance baseline of 0.25, providing modest supporting evidence of affiliation-related signal rather than independent validation of identity. Robustness analyses support the presence of continuous semantic structure more strongly than precise rankings. Together, these findings show how collective regularities can coexist with shared content, contributor heterogeneity and change over time, while leaving cross-domain generality and broader organisational construct validity unresolved.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出组织层面语义身份 (organisation-level semantic identity) 的计算框架，把既有语义与图指标组合成可解释的组织指纹与时间轨迹。在 1997–2023 年四家 K-pop 娱乐公司 126 位艺人、1,289 首歌曲上，校正后三项新颖性指标呈现艺人层面差异，而多样性与连通性指标不显著，仅两个公司—社区富集仍显著；按艺人分组的 balanced accuracy 为 0.334，机会基线 0.25。
Motivation: 纵向文本能否揭示集体层面的语义分化与变化、同时不掩盖贡献者个体差异，此前缺少可解释的计算刻画；组织文化与管理意图这类构念也难以从文本中直接操作化。
Method: 框架组合既有语义指标与图指标，构造组织指纹与时间轨迹，并把 organisation-level semantic identity 定义为语料依赖的、对重复与变化特征的解释；数据为 1997–2023 年四家 K-pop 公司旗下 126 位艺人的 1,289 首歌曲，检验含多重比较校正、公司—社区富集、按艺人分组的分类评估与稳健性分析。
Result: 校正后三项新颖性相关指标均显示艺人层面差异，多样性与连通性指标不显著，仅两个公司—社区富集保持显著；艺人分组 balanced accuracy 达 0.334，机会基线 0.25；稳健性分析更支持连续语义结构的存在，而非精确排名。
Conclusion: 集体规律可以与共享内容、贡献者异质性和时间变化并存，但该信号只构成归属相关的温和证据，跨领域普适性与更广的组织构念效度仍未解决。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FaithSieve: Fine-Grained Evaluation of Math Proofs with Faithful Formal Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can now generate complex, multi-step mathematical proofs, but reliably determining their correctness and localizing early logical errors remains a critical challenge. Existing evaluation approaches largely depend on model-based natural-language judgments, which often overlook local reasoning gaps. While formal theorem provers like Lean offer a path to rigorous verification, using them to evaluate informal text requires solving locality and semantic mismatches: a prover might bypass a local flaw by proving an overly broad target, or validate an auto-formalized statement that drifts from the original mathematical intent. To address this, we introduce FaithSieve, a Lean-assisted framework for fine-grained evaluation of natural-language mathematical proofs. FaithSieve decomposes coarse proof steps into local reasoning units, extracts typed proof obligations, and verifies them through a formal evaluation agent. Formal validation is gated by semantic alignment scoring, so Lean evidence is incorporated only when the formal statement faithfully preserves the context, objects, and logical form of the original claim. We construct two expert-verified datasets, ProofLoc-Olympiad and ProofLoc-University, to benchmark first-error localization. On the 350-problem Olympiad dataset, FaithSieve using a GPT-5.4 backbone achieves 81.43% exact first-error accuracy, outperforming the direct-judging baseline of 72.29%. Furthermore, on the 200-problem ProofLoc-University benchmark spanning six advanced domains, FaithSieve reaches 84.5% exact accuracy, compared to 75.0% for the direct judge. Our work demonstrates that decomposing proofs into fine-grained units and grounding them with faithful formal evidence significantly improves reliable evaluation of natural-language reasoning.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 3 figures; preprint with appendix and supplementary experimental details
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FaithSieve 用 Lean 辅助做自然语言数学证明的细粒度评估：把粗粒度证明步骤分解为局部推理单元、抽取带类型的 proof obligations，再由形式化评估 agent 验证，且只有语义对齐打分通过时才采纳 Lean 证据。在 350 题 ProofLoc-Olympiad 上用 GPT-5.4 骨干取得 81.43% 的首个错误精确定位准确率，超过直接判定基线的 72.29%。
Motivation: LLM 已能生成多步数学证明，但判断正确性并定位最早逻辑错误仍依赖模型的自然语言判定，容易漏掉局部推理缺口；直接用 Lean 验证非形式文本又会遇到局部性与语义错配问题。
Method: 将粗粒度证明步骤分解为局部推理单元，抽取带类型的证明义务 (typed proof obligations)，交给形式化评估 agent 用 Lean 验证；形式化结果经语义对齐打分把关，仅在形式陈述忠实保留原文上下文、对象与逻辑形式时才纳入证据。构建两个专家核验数据集 ProofLoc-Olympiad 与 ProofLoc-University 用于首个错误定位基准。
Result: 在 350 题的 ProofLoc-Olympiad 上，FaithSieve（GPT-5.4 骨干）首个错误精确定位准确率 81.43%，直接判定基线为 72.29%；在覆盖六个进阶领域的 200 题 ProofLoc-University 上达到 84.5% 精确准确率，直接判定为 75.0%。
Conclusion: 把证明分解为细粒度单元并用忠实的形式化证据锚定，能显著提升自然语言推理评估的可靠性，尤其在首个错误定位上稳定超过直接判定基线。

papers.title: Learning Late, Guiding Early: Timestep-Decoupled Semantic Guidance for Fair Face Generation
papers.abstract_en: Demographic imbalance in synthetic face generation can propagate to downstream face recognition systems, making fairness an important consideration when diffusion models are used for data generation. Existing fairness-aware generation approaches often require model retraining, architectural modifications, or repeated guidance throughout the reverse diffusion process. In this work, we introduce Semantic Boundary Predictor (SBP), an inference-time framework that performs demographic guidance through a one-shot intervention during reverse denoising. Our approach is motivated by the observation that latent representations at different diffusion timesteps play distinct semantic roles: late-stage latents provide stronger demographic separability, whereas early-stage latents offer greater flexibility for semantic intervention. SBP leverages this timestep decoupling by learning linear semantic boundaries from late-stage latent representations while applying them only once at the initial noisy latent, allowing the remainder of the reverse denoising process to proceed unchanged. The method requires neither retraining nor fine-tuning of the underlying Latent Diffusion Model and operates without external balanced datasets. Experiments on CelebA-HQ demonstrate substantial improvements in demographic fairness, reducing fairness disparity by 98% for gender, 95% for binary race, and 15% for four-class race, while maintaining perceptual image quality across demographic groups. Owing to its one-shot inference strategy and model-agnostic design, SBP introduces only a small computational overhead and can be readily integrated with existing pre-trained latent diffusion models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出推理时框架 Semantic Boundary Predictor (SBP)：在反向扩散的后期 latent 上学线性语义边界，只在初始含噪 latent 上做一次干预，其余去噪过程不变，无需重训或微调 Latent Diffusion Model。在 CelebA-HQ 上把性别公平差距降低 98%、二分类种族 95%、四分类种族 15%，同时保持各人群的感知画质。
Motivation: 合成人脸的人口统计失衡会传导到下游人脸识别；现有公平生成方法需要重训、改结构或在反向扩散全程反复引导，代价高。
Method: SBP 利用不同扩散 timestep 的 latent 语义分工：后期 latent 人口可分性强，用于学习线性语义边界；早期 latent 可干预性大，边界只在初始含噪 latent 上一次性施加。无需重训或微调底层 LDM，也不依赖外部均衡数据集。
Result: CelebA-HQ 上公平差距降低 98%（gender）、95%（binary race）、15%（four-class race），各人群感知图像质量保持；一次性推理策略与模型无关设计只带来很小的计算开销。
Conclusion: 把语义引导从扩散全程压缩到单次早期干预即可大幅改善人口公平，前提是边界学自后期 latent；该方法可直接接入已预训练的 latent diffusion 模型。

papers.title: AdaVDR: Adaptive Tool Use and Reflection for Video Deep Research
papers.abstract_en: Video deep research aims to answer questions by jointly understanding video content and retrieving external knowledge from the open Web. However, these tasks often require diverse and multi-step tool-use trajectories, which may lead to unnecessary video tool calls, incurring additional costs and failure risk. In this paper, we propose AdaVDR, an adaptive video deep research agent with adaptive tool use and reflection, which selects tools based on task and model capabilities while backtracking when needed. To this end, we develop a data construction pipeline that builds adaptive tool-use trajectories according to task types and model capabilities. Specifically, we construct QA pairs that require both video and external information, and organize the information acquisition processes into task-specific tool-use trajectories. We then apply model-conditioned tool necessity filtering to remove tools that can be bypassed using video understanding and internal knowledge of the model. Based on this pipeline, we construct a training dataset with adaptive trajectories and perform SFT on them to initialize these capabilities of AdaVDR. To further improve adaptive capabilities, we propose NASA-GRPO, a necessity-aware segment-guided credit assignment method, which evaluates segment-guided evidence contribution and tool necessity to construct normalized tool-level rewards. We also construct VDR-EE, a benchmark built using the proposed pipeline. Experiments show that AdaVDR outperforms the base model by 15.20 and 29.00 percentage points on VDR-EE and the existing VideoDR, respectively, demonstrating its superiority.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaVDR 是一个视频深度研究 (video deep research) 智能体，按任务类型与模型能力自适应选择工具并在必要时回溯：先用数据管线构造自适应工具轨迹并做 SFT，再用 NASA-GRPO（necessity-aware segment-guided credit assignment）按证据贡献与工具必要性生成归一化的工具级奖励。在自建基准 VDR-EE 上比基座模型高 15.20 个百分点，在已有 VideoDR 上高 29.00 个百分点。
Motivation: 视频深度研究需要多步工具轨迹，其中不少视频工具调用是多余的，既增加成本也带来失败风险；缺少按任务与模型能力裁剪工具使用的训练与评测手段。
Method: 构建数据管线：构造同时需要视频与外部信息的 QA 对，按任务类型组织成工具轨迹，再用 model-conditioned tool necessity filtering 删掉可被视频理解或模型内部知识绕过的工具；据此得到自适应轨迹数据集做 SFT 初始化，并提出 NASA-GRPO 评估 segment-guided 证据贡献与工具必要性以构造归一化工具级奖励，同时用该管线建起基准 VDR-EE。
Result: 实验显示 AdaVDR 在自建基准 VDR-EE 上比基座模型高出 15.20 个百分点，在已有的 VideoDR 上高出 29.00 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把工具必要性判断写进数据构造与强化学习奖励，能让视频深度研究智能体减少多余视频工具调用并显著提升答题表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DCGC: Draft-Conditioned Global Correction for Complex Reasoning with Masked Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Correcting flawed reasoning traces remains a significant challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs), whose autoregressive generation can propagate early mistakes into subsequent reasoning. We introduce DCGC, a Masked Diffusion Model (MDM) framework for global correction that uses an imperfect solution draft from an upstream solver as auxiliary context. DCGC combines task-specific Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with a novel inference-time mechanism called Dynamic Dual-CFG. This mechanism separates problem-only and joint problem-draft branches and scales the draft-conditioned residual using a relative confidence gap. Across math, code, and knowledge reasoning benchmarks, DCGC outperforms standard sampling and simpler CFG variants, with additional results suggesting transfer to different diffusion backbones. In test-time setting where ground-truth failure labels are unavailable, DCGC improves full test set accuracy by correcting low-consensus upstream outputs, highlighting its utility as a verifier-free global correction module for difficult reasoning instances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DCGC：用 Masked Diffusion Model 对上游求解器给出的错误推理草稿做全局重写修正，推理时用 Dynamic Dual-CFG 把「只看问题」与「问题+草稿」两条分支分开，并按相对置信度差缩放草稿条件残差。在数学、代码与知识推理基准上优于标准采样与更简单的 CFG 变体，且能迁移到不同 diffusion backbone；在无真实失败标签的测试时设定下，通过修正低共识的上游输出提升整套测试集准确率。
Motivation: LLM 的自回归生成会把早期错误传播到后续推理步骤，逐 token 的局部修正难以挽回整条推理链，需要一种不依赖外部验证器的全局纠错手段。
Method: DCGC 以 Masked Diffusion Model 为骨干，把上游求解器的不完美解答草稿作为辅助上下文做全局修正；训练用任务特定的 SFT，推理时引入 Dynamic Dual-CFG，分离 problem-only 与 joint problem-draft 两个分支，并用相对置信度差 (relative confidence gap) 缩放草稿条件的残差。
Result: 在数学、代码与知识推理基准上，DCGC 超过标准采样与更简单的 CFG 变体；附加结果表明可迁移到不同的 diffusion backbone；在无法获得真实失败标签的测试时设定下，通过修正低共识的上游输出提升了完整测试集准确率。
Conclusion: 把草稿作为条件并用置信度差调制的全局修正，可以在无需验证器的情况下改善困难推理实例的输出质量，且对 diffusion backbone 选择不敏感。

papers.title: Right Values, Wrong Places: Diagnosing and Fixing Record Misplacement in LLM-Generated JSON
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can generate valid JSON that preserves field values yet binds them to the wrong records or hierarchy levels. We introduce JSONPlacement, a controlled task supplying all values and assignment rules for transforming flat records into hierarchical JSON. Across six open-weight models, we identify two error types: record-assignment errors and hierarchy-realization errors. Whole-record moves account for 98.6% of strictly traceable synthetic misplacements. We predict that aligning input with target traversal should reduce assignment errors, while replacing nested output with record-level paths should reduce hierarchy errors. With predictions fixed before generating new instances, we test both interventions separately and together. On synthetic instances, each nearly eliminates its targeted error while leaving the other. Combined, they achieve exact matches for three 8-12B models on all new synthetic instances and a real-data validation set. These findings motivate evaluating record placement explicitly and jointly designing input organization and output representation to preserve value-path bindings.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 6 figures. Substantially revised version with a new title, task formulation, error analysis, and controlled intervention experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 能生成字段值正确但绑定到错误记录或层级的合法 JSON。作者提出受控任务 JSONPlacement，把输入组织对齐目标遍历顺序、并用记录级路径替代嵌套输出，两项干预各自几乎消除对应错误，合并后三个 8–12B 模型在全部新合成实例与真实数据验证集上达到 exact match。
Motivation: LLM 生成的 JSON 可以语法合法、字段值也对，但值被绑到错误的记录或层级，这类 record misplacement 缺少可诊断的任务形式与显式评测。
Method: 提出 JSONPlacement 受控任务，提供全部取值与赋值规则，把扁平记录转换为层级 JSON；在六个开源模型上区分 record-assignment errors 与 hierarchy-realization errors 两类错误，并在生成新实例前固定预测，分别与联合测试两项干预：输入与目标遍历对齐、以记录级路径替代嵌套输出。
Result: 在严格可追溯的合成错置中，整记录移动 (whole-record moves) 占 98.6%；两项干预各自几乎消除其目标错误而保留另一类；合并后三个 8–12B 模型在全部新合成实例与一个真实数据验证集上取得 exact match。
Conclusion: 记录错置应被显式评测，且输入组织与输出表示需要联合设计才能保住 value-path 绑定。

papers.title: Mechanistic Circuit Identification for Controllable Data Generation
papers.abstract_en: While recent advances in data synthesis aim to curate high-quality datasets, most generation pipelines still rely on heuristic prompt-based control. This black-box paradigm provides limited insight into how individual samples interact with a model's underlying learning dynamics. To bridge this gap, we propose a circuit-grounded framework that connects training-dynamics-based data valuation with mechanistic interpretability (MI). Specifically, we conceptualize data quality along three complementary utility axes, learnability, challenge, and alignment. First, we uncover specialized model-internal circuits that causally govern these utility signals. Then, moving beyond heuristic prompting toward mechanistic control, we leverage these circuits as controllable interfaces, actively steering generation to produce utility-targeted data. Building on this capability, we introduce SAMS (Stage-Aware Mechanistic Scheduling), which schedules circuit-steered data according to the model's evolving optimization needs. Experiments on multiple-choice QA tasks demonstrate that our approach yields precisely controlled data with greater diversity than prompt-based baselines, consistently improving downstream performance and calibration. Ultimately, this work establishes a principled white-box paradigm for interpretable data generation, pioneering the use of MI not just as an analytical tool, but as a practical, controllable interface.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出电路接地 (circuit-grounded) 的可控数据生成框架：把训练动力学数据估值与机制可解释性 (MI) 结合，用模型内部因果电路作为生成接口，主动把数据导向 learnability、challenge、alignment 三个效用轴，并用 SAMS (Stage-Aware Mechanistic Scheduling) 按模型优化阶段调度这些数据。在 multiple-choice QA 任务上，产出的数据比 prompt 基线控制更精确、多样性更高，并持续改善下游性能与校准 (calibration)。
Motivation: 数据合成管线大多依赖启发式 prompt 控制，是黑盒范式，无法说明单个样本如何与模型学习动力学相互作用。
Method: 把数据质量拆成 learnability、challenge、alignment 三个互补效用轴；先找出因果支配这些效用信号的模型内部专门电路，再把电路当作可控接口主动引导生成，最后由 SAMS 按模型演化中的优化需求调度电路引导的数据。
Result: 在 multiple-choice QA 任务上，该方法产出的数据相比 prompt-based 基线控制更精确、多样性更大，并持续提升下游性能与校准；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 机制可解释性可以不止当分析工具，而作为可控接口支撑白盒、可解释的数据生成范式。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Physics-Integrated Operator Learning via Gaussian Splatting Representations
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators provide efficient surrogates for spatiotemporal PDE systems, but purely data-driven formulations often accumulate substantial errors during long-horizon autoregressive prediction and may fail to exploit available governing-equation structure. Existing approaches incorporate physics primarily through residual-based training objectives or PDE-specific architectural constraints, which can introduce optimization difficulties or limit architectural generality. In this work, we introduce a representation-level approach to physics integration in which a feed-forward Gaussian splatting (FFGS) representation serves as a continuous interface between discretized solution fields and governing operators. The FFGS representation reconstructs the state as a continuous Gaussian field with closed-form spatial derivatives, allowing available physical PDE operators to be integrated directly within the learned evolution map without introducing a physics-residual loss. We evaluate the framework across two- and three-dimensional PDE systems, including advection, diffusion, nonlinear self-advection, and reaction dynamics. Over long-horizon autoregressive rollouts, the proposed framework reduces relative $\ell_2$ error by $1.5\times$--$2.2\times$ compared with the strongest purely data-driven baseline across the benchmark suite, while consistently improving spectral fidelity. The framework also remains effective when the governing equations are partially known, demonstrating robustness to incomplete physics. These results demonstrate that continuous field representations can provide a practical interface for incorporating known physical structure into generic neural-operator surrogates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用前馈 Gaussian splatting (FFGS) 把离散解场表示成带闭式空间导数的连续 Gaussian 场，使 PDE 算子可直接嵌入学习到的演化映射，无需物理残差损失。在 advection、diffusion、nonlinear self-advection、reaction 等二维与三维 PDE 的长时程自回归 rollout 中，相对 ℓ2 误差较最强纯数据驱动基线降低 1.5×–2.2×，谱保真度同步提升，且在方程仅部分已知时仍有效。
Motivation: 纯数据驱动的 neural operator 在长时程自回归预报中误差累积严重，且难以利用已知控制方程；现有做法靠残差损失或 PDE 架构约束注入物理，会带来优化困难或限制架构通用性。
Method: 提出表示级物理集成：FFGS 作为离散解场与控制算子之间的连续接口，重建状态为连续 Gaussian 场并给出闭式空间导数，从而把已知 PDE 算子直接写进学习的演化映射，训练中不引入 physics-residual loss。
Result: 在二维与三维 PDE 基准（advection、diffusion、nonlinear self-advection、reaction dynamics）的长时程自回归 rollout 上，相对 ℓ2 误差较最强纯数据驱动基线降低 1.5×–2.2×，并一致提升谱保真度；控制方程部分已知时框架仍保持有效。
Conclusion: 连续场表示可以作为把已知物理结构接入通用 neural-operator surrogate 的实用接口，在不加残差损失的前提下抑制长时程误差累积，并对不完整物理保持鲁棒。

papers.title: CDEG: Learning Decision-Critical Evidence for Long-Horizon Diagnostic Agents
papers.abstract_en: Unlike static medical question answering, long-horizon diagnosis captures the sequential nature of clinical practice: evidence is progressively acquired, integrated, and evaluated over multiple rounds of interaction before reaching a final diagnosis. However, existing doctor agents often fail when critical evidence is either not acquired or not adequately incorporated into diagnostic reasoning. Recent agentic approaches attempt to address these failures by reusing historical trajectories or distilled memories. But their diagnostic gains remain constrained because such experience may contain noisy or incidental information and is typically reused without validating which evidence actually drives diagnostic decisions. To address this limitation, we introduce CDEG, a graph-based framework that learns reusable decision-critical evidence from historical diagnostic trajectories. CDEG contrasts successful and failed trajectories from the same case to identify candidate evidence, validates their diagnostic impact through controlled counterfactual interventions, and organizes the resulting diagnosis--evidence--action relations into a structured graph. During inference, CDEG tracks the evolving patient evidence state to retrieve relevant diagnostic relations and selectively guide missing evidence acquisition or overlooked evidence reappraisal. Across in-domain and out-of-distribution benchmarks with multiple doctor agent backbones, CDEG consistently improves diagnostic performance, achieving up to an 11.5% accuracy gain over vanilla agents. These results demonstrate that reliable long-horizon diagnosis requires moving beyond trajectory-level experience reuse toward evidence-level learning of the factors that truly shape clinical decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CDEG 是面向长程诊断智能体的图结构证据学习框架：对比同一病例的成功与失败轨迹筛出候选证据，用受控反事实干预验证其对诊断的实际影响，再把诊断-证据-动作关系组织成图，推理时追踪患者证据状态以补采或重审关键证据。在域内与分布外基准、多种 doctor agent backbone 上一致提升诊断表现，相对 vanilla agent 最高带来 11.5% 的准确率增益。
Motivation: 长程诊断中关键证据要么没被采集、要么没真正进入推理；现有 agent 复用历史轨迹或蒸馏记忆的做法混入噪声与偶发信息，且不校验哪些证据真正驱动决策，因此诊断收益受限。
Method: CDEG 分三步：对同一病例的成功与失败轨迹做对比以产生候选证据；用受控反事实干预 (controlled counterfactual interventions) 验证每条证据的诊断影响；把诊断-证据-动作关系建成结构化图。推理时追踪不断演化的患者证据状态，检索相关关系并定向引导缺失证据采集或被忽视证据的重审，可挂接多种 doctor agent backbone。
Result: 在域内与分布外 (out-of-distribution) 基准上、跨多种 doctor agent backbone，CDEG 一致提升诊断表现，相对 vanilla agent 最高获得 11.5% 的准确率增益。
Conclusion: 可靠长程诊断应从轨迹级经验复用转向证据级学习，即只学真正塑造临床决策的那些证据。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: SPAR-Hate: Auditor-Guided Multi-Perspective Role Reasoning for Bilingual Hate Speech Parsing
papers.abstract_en: Hate speech research has moved from coarse-grained classification towards structured parsing, where systems jointly identify targets, supporting arguments, and target-level labels. Documents with multiple targets, conflicting local readings, or culturally coded language make these bindings difficult to recover. SPAR-Hate is an auditor-guided multi-perspective role-reasoning framework for bilingual hate speech parsing. It decomposes each document into local focus units, elicits evidence-grounded candidates from Victim, Moderator, and Cultural Bystander perspectives, resolves candidate conflicts under grounding and schema constraints, and reassembles sample-level predictions. Experiments on STATE-ToxiCN and a controlled TBO split show gains across local and API backbones, concentrated on strict joint target--argument--label metrics. Controlled comparisons favour separate candidate generation and arbitration for joint parsing. Within the tested pipeline, role-conditioned prompting yields higher exact-match joint scores than repeated generic prompting, while Chinese overlap-based results depend on the backbone. Structured teacher traces also support training a smaller student model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPAR-Hate 把双语仇恨言论解析拆成局部焦点单元，分别以 Victim、Moderator、Cultural Bystander 三种角色视角生成有证据支撑的候选，再在 grounding 与 schema 约束下仲裁冲突并重组样本级预测。在 STATE-ToxiCN 与受控 TBO split 上，角色条件提示的 exact-match 联合得分高于重复通用提示，且候选生成与仲裁分离的方案在联合解析上更受青睐。
Motivation: 多目标、局部读法冲突与文化编码语言使目标—论据—标签的绑定难以恢复，粗粒度分类无法表达这种结构。
Method: 将文档分解为局部焦点单元，从 Victim、Moderator、Cultural Bystander 三个视角生成证据支撑的候选，在 grounding 与 schema 约束下解决候选冲突后重组样本级预测；在本地与 API 两类 backbone 上实验，并用结构化教师轨迹训练更小的学生模型。
Result: 在 STATE-ToxiCN 与受控 TBO split 上，增益跨本地与 API backbone 出现，且集中在严格的 joint target--argument--label 指标；受控比较支持候选生成与仲裁分离；角色条件提示的 exact-match 联合得分高于重复通用提示；中文基于 overlap 的结果依赖于 backbone。
Conclusion: 在所测 pipeline 内，多视角角色推理加约束仲裁对联合仇恨言论解析有效，且分离生成与仲裁优于合并方案；中文 overlap 指标的表现随 backbone 变化。

papers.title: SkillCommit: Evolving Agent Skills through Behaviorally Validated Scope Expansion
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can continually improve without parameter updates by converting historical experience into reusable procedural knowledge. However, existing methods often consolidate experience based on semantic similarity or LLM judgments, which may merge superficially related but behaviorally incompatible strategies and thereby degrade performance. To address the issue, we propose SkillCommit, an online skill evolution framework that continuously transforms experience into a hierarchical library of reusable skills. Rather than generalizing from individual experiences immediately, SkillCommit first preserves each experience as an instance-specific patch, retaining its locally validated behavior. As patches accumulate, SkillCommit abstracts those sharing a common behavioral mechanism into higher-level skills. Specifically, for each incoming skill, embedding-based retrieval first identifies candidate related skills. Cross-instance replay and an LLM-based mechanism check determine whether these skills transfer across cases and share a common underlying mechanism. Candidates that pass both checks are abstracted into a higher-level skill and committed only if it preserves the validated behavior of all constituent skills. Experiments on RuleArena, OpenExempt and KOR-Bench demonstrate that SkillCommit consistently improves agent performance across diverse domains. Moreover, the learned skills transfer across model scales and families, enabling cross-model experience transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillCommit 是面向 LLM agent 的在线技能进化框架：先把每条经验存为保留局部已验证行为的 instance-specific patch，待 patch 累积后再用 embedding 检索候选、跨实例 replay 加 LLM 机制检查筛出真正共享行为机制的技能，抽象成更高层技能并仅在其保留全部子技能已验证行为时提交入库。在 RuleArena、OpenExempt、KOR-Bench 上一致提升 agent 表现，学到的技能可跨模型规模与家族迁移。
Motivation: 现有经验固化方法依赖语义相似度或 LLM 判断，会把表面相关但行为上不兼容的策略合并，反而拉低 agent 性能。
Method: 分层技能库的在线进化流程：经验先以 instance-specific patch 形式保留其局部验证行为；对新到技能用 embedding 检索候选相关技能，再依次做 cross-instance replay 与 LLM 机制检查 (mechanism check) 判定跨案例迁移与共同机制；两项检查都通过才抽象为高层技能，且仅当该抽象保留所有组成技能的已验证行为时才 commit。
Result: 在 RuleArena、OpenExempt、KOR-Bench 三个基准上，SkillCommit 在多种领域上一致提升 agent 性能；所学技能跨模型规模与家族迁移，实现跨模型经验迁移。
Conclusion: 把经验固化的判据从语义相似换成行为验证（replay + 机制检查 + 提交前行为保留约束），可以在不更新参数的前提下持续进化技能并保持性能不回退，且技能本身可跨模型复用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SCVIB: Editable State-Conditioned Visual Instance Binding for Multi-Turn Personalized Localization
papers.abstract_en: Stored visual evidence can remain unchanged while its relevance to a current request changes with interaction state. To study this state-dependent source relevance, we introduce SCVIB, a controlled diagnostic benchmark for editable state-conditioned visual instance binding. SCVIB contains 1,050 manually verified support-query pairs and 1,500 multi-turn episodes across five visual domains and four target-state dependencies. Executable state semantics separate target resolution from evidence selection and query-side localization. Direct Qwen3-VL-8B inference achieves 99.53% target-resolution accuracy but 62.00% Joint@0.5, revealing a 37.53-point resolution-localization gap; 563 of its 570 joint failures follow correct target identification. Routing comparisons and fixed-checkpoint support interventions diagnose a post-resolution evidence-utilization bottleneck: successful resolution must be coupled with relevant visual evidence and effective query-side grounding. We introduce TT-VG (Transition-Trace Visual Grounding), a state-conditioned visual grounding framework with an explicit and auditable state-to-evidence-to-grounding path. Target-State Transition Trace (TSTT) executes editable state and selects an auditable support record; Visual Evidence Grounding Adaptation (VEGA) learns support-conditioned grounding from target appearance, boxed support context, and the query. The canonical TT-VG configuration reaches 69.80% Joint@0.5, improving over direct inference by 7.80 points at the combined evidence-utilization and grounding interface. Task adaptation improves the DINOv2 and MASA retrieval baselines to 51.47% and 55.67%, respectively, but both remain substantially below VEGA. These findings highlight state-dependent source selection and evidence utilization as consequential interfaces for interactive multimodal information fusion.
papers.comment: 20 pages including appendices; revised presentation, updated canonical evaluation, additional controls and analyses, and expanded references
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCVIB 是一个诊断多轮交互中「视觉证据不变但相关性随状态变化」的受控基准，含 1,050 对人工核验的 support-query 与 1,500 个多轮 episode，覆盖五个视觉域与四种目标状态依赖。Qwen3-VL-8B 直推的 target-resolution 达 99.53% 但 Joint@0.5 仅 62.00%，570 个联合失败中 563 个发生在目标已识别之后，定位瓶颈在证据利用而非目标解析。
Motivation: 多轮交互中存储的视觉证据本身不变，但其对当前请求的相关性随交互状态改变；现有模型在目标解析正确后仍无法把相关证据接到查询侧定位上，这一状态依赖的证据选择环节缺少可诊断的评测对象。
Method: SCVIB 用可执行的状态语义把 target resolution、evidence selection 与 query-side localization 分离；提出 TT-VG 框架，其中 Target-State Transition Trace (TSTT) 执行可编辑状态并选出可审计的 support 记录，Visual Evidence Grounding Adaptation (VEGA) 从目标外观、boxed support 上下文与 query 学习 support 条件化 grounding。
Result: Qwen3-VL-8B 直推 target-resolution 99.53%、Joint@0.5 62.00%，存在 37.53 个百分点的解析-定位落差，570 个联合失败中 563 个目标识别正确。TT-VG 标准配置 Joint@0.5 达 69.80%，比直推高 7.80 个百分点。任务适配后 DINOv2 与 MASA 检索基线分别到 51.47% 与 55.67%，仍明显低于 VEGA。
Conclusion: 状态依赖的源选择与证据利用是交互式多模态信息融合中的关键接口：目标解析成功必须与相关视觉证据和有效的 query 侧 grounding 耦合，否则高解析准确率无法转化为定位性能。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Probabilistic Constrained Clustering from Entangled Pairwise Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Pairwise constrained clustering typically relies on hard must-link/cannot-link labels, whereas realistic pairwise supervision may be real-valued and entangle intrinsic ambiguity, expert judgment, and stochastic corruption. Existing deep constrained clustering (DCC) methods mainly target hard, expert-agnostic constraints, treating soft labels mostly numerically rather than semantically. We formalize this setting as uncertainty-aware probabilistic constrained clustering (UPCC), defining a canonical aleatoric relation through a heterogeneous observation process and analyzing its conditional identifiability. We introduce ProbPair, an angular pairwise objective for probabilistic relations, and build ECI-PP, an estimator--corrector--integrator framework that refines imperfect supervision via belief estimation, correction, and reliability-aware integration. Across challenging probabilistic supervision settings, experiments on diverse benchmarks show that ECI-PP outperforms state-of-the-art DCC methods and remains robust with a shared default configuration.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Spotlight). Camera-ready revision; 44 pages, including appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把成对约束从硬 must-link/cannot-link 推广到实值、含歧义与随机损坏的概率监督，形式化为 UPCC 并提出 ECI-PP：先用估计器-校正器-整合器三段框架精化不完美监督，再用 ProbPair 角度成对目标训练。在多种概率监督设置的基准上，ECI-PP 超越现有深度约束聚类 (DCC) 方法，且共享默认配置下仍保持稳健。
Motivation: 现实中的成对监督是实值的，混合了内在歧义、专家判断与随机损坏；现有 DCC 方法只处理硬的、忽略专家差异的约束，软标签仅被数值化处理而无语义建模。
Method: 通过异构观测过程定义规范的 aleatoric 关系并分析条件可辨识性；提出 ProbPair 概率关系的角度成对目标；构建 ECI-PP（estimator-corrector-integrator），分别做信念估计、校正与可靠性感知整合来精化不完美监督。
Result: 在多样基准上的多种概率监督设置实验中，ECI-PP 优于最先进的 DCC 方法，并在共享默认配置下保持稳健；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把软成对约束当作带语义的不确定性来建模并配合可靠性感知整合，可在概率监督下稳定超越硬约束范式的 DCC 方法。

papers.title: Equilibrium Forcing: Adaptive Video Generation Without Noise Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Standard autoregressive video generation algorithms based on Diffusion and Flow Matching rely on rigid training objectives and static sampling schedules, limiting inference procedures from adapting to the data. We introduce Equilibrium Forcing (EqF), a simplified framework for video denoising generative models without noise level conditioning. EqF pioneers modular training- and inference-time designs for noise-unconditional generation that decouple learning the denoising field from sampling. This flexibility allows for inference-time algorithms that operate in a closed loop by adapting to feedback from the sample, improving video quality and consistency on challenging autoregressive video generation benchmarks. Extensive analysis elucidates exactly how removing the noise level conditioning enables EqF's data-dependent inference properties to surpass the performance of standard noise level-conditional denoising video methods.
papers.comment: Published at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://equilibriumforcing.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Equilibrium Forcing (EqF)：去掉噪声水平条件化，把去噪场学习与采样解耦，使自回归视频生成的推理过程能依据当前样本反馈闭环自适应调整。在具有挑战性的自回归视频生成基准上提升了视频质量与时间一致性。
Motivation: 基于 Diffusion 与 Flow Matching 的自回归视频生成依赖刚性训练目标与静态采样调度，推理过程无法根据数据本身调整。
Method: EqF 面向无噪声水平条件 (noise level conditioning) 的视频去噪生成模型，采用模块化的训练时与推理时设计，将去噪场学习与采样解耦；推理算法在闭环中依据当前样本的反馈自适应调整。
Result: 在具有挑战性的自回归视频生成基准上改善了视频质量与一致性；分析给出去除噪声水平条件化如何使数据依赖的推理优于标准的噪声水平条件去噪视频方法。
Conclusion: 去掉噪声水平条件化并把采样与训练解耦，是让视频去噪模型的推理随数据自适应、从而超过条件化去噪方法的关键机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Noise Context-Aware Representation for Low-Dose CT Denoising
papers.abstract_en: While deep learning-based denoising has become widely adopted in low-dose CT, conventional models use generic architectures designed for natural images, failing to account for non-stationary and spatially correlated CT noise characteristics. To address this, we propose an Efficient Noise COntext-aware REpresentation (ENCORE) framework that explicitly leverages CT noise characteristics and anatomical features. First, we reformulate the noise synthesis procedure based on a realistic noise distribution beyond the conventional Gaussian approximation, establishing a rigorous foundation for training pair generation. Next, we extract local noise power and correlation contexts to guide the denoising process. To fully leverage the potential of noise context, we propose a FlyingConv module, which adaptively changes convolution weights for each local image region. Notably, our approach demonstrates substantial gains in both denoising quality and computational efficiency. Furthermore, manipulating the intensity of the noise context maps at inference time enables zero-shot conditional denoising, allowing for dynamic control over the output image texture. The entire pipeline is available at https://github.com/minwoo-yu/ENCORE.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出低剂量 CT 去噪框架 ENCORE：把噪声合成从高斯近似改写为更真实的分布来生成训练对，提取局部噪声功率与相关性上下文引导去噪，并用 FlyingConv 按局部区域自适应改变卷积权重。推理时调节噪声上下文图强度即可零样本条件去噪，动态控制输出图像纹理，同时在去噪质量与计算效率上都有明显提升。
Motivation: 现有低剂量 CT 深度去噪模型多沿用面向自然图像的通用架构，没有考虑 CT 噪声的非平稳性与空间相关性。
Method: 三部分：一是把噪声合成过程基于超越传统高斯近似的真实噪声分布重新表述，为训练对生成建立严格基础；二是提取局部噪声功率与相关性上下文来引导去噪；三是提出 FlyingConv 模块，对每个局部图像区域自适应地改变卷积权重。
Result: 在去噪质量与计算效率两方面均取得实质性提升；推理阶段操纵噪声上下文图强度可实现零样本条件去噪 (zero-shot conditional denoising)，动态控制输出图像纹理。
Conclusion: 把 CT 噪声的非平稳与空间相关特性显式编码进架构与训练数据生成，可以同时改善低剂量 CT 去噪的质量和效率，并让输出纹理在推理时可调。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Off-the-Shelf Language-Vision Encoders Predict Human Gaze Preferences in Visual World Experiments
papers.abstract_en: A central question for computational psycholinguistics is to what extent neural language models can serve as cognitively adequate models of human language processing. However, work has been overwhelmingly focused on the unimodal case of written or spoken language. In contrast, multimodal paradigms, like visual world experiments that present participants with both visual and linguistic input simultaneously, have been neglected. In this paper, we present a novel approach that predicts patterns of gaze preferences in visual world studies. To do so, it derives target preferences by applying an attribution method to a simple bi-modal CLIP bi-encoder. We demonstrate the ability of this approach to qualitatively replicate the gaze patterns found in a seminal English visual world study demonstrating human predictive processing. It does so without a generative architecture and without the need for fine-tuning, despite not being trained for the task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用现成的 CLIP 双塔编码器加归因方法 (attribution) 预测视觉世界范式中的注视偏好，无需生成式架构、无需微调即可定性复现经典英语视觉世界实验中反映人类预测性加工的注视模式。
Motivation: 计算心理语言学中神经语言模型能否充当人类语言加工的认知充分模型，长期只在单模态书面或口语上被检验，同时呈现视觉与语言输入的视觉世界实验几乎被忽略。
Method: 对一个简单的双模态 CLIP bi-encoder 施加归因方法，从中导出目标偏好 (target preferences)，再据此预测视觉世界研究中的注视偏好模式，全程不训练、不微调。
Result: 该方法定性复现了一项奠定性英语视觉世界研究中的人类注视模式，该模式演示了人类的预测性加工；复现不依赖生成式架构，也不需要针对任务的训练或微调。
Conclusion: 未经该任务训练的现成视觉-语言编码器已足以在定性层面捕捉多模态语境下人类预测性加工的注视偏好，说明认知充分性检验可以扩展到视觉世界范式。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Privileged Guidance Misaligns: State-Matched Routing and Contextualized Self-Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn agents trained with sparse outcome rewards receive limited supervision for intermediate decisions. Privileged on-policy self-distillation provides denser guidance by having a synchronized teacher re-score student responses with training-only references. However, the student may take different actions or complete subgoals in another order, reaching states for which the reference provides no applicable continuation. The resulting state--reference mismatch can lead the reference-conditioned teacher to penalize valid actions. We introduce State-Matched Routing and Contextualized Self-Distillation (SMRC-SD), which uses the student's reached state to decide when and how a reference should guide the student. At each turn, SMRC-SD checks state compatibility with the reference, distills only on matched turns, and contextualizes the reference by augmenting it with a reached-state summary and a compatible continuation. At inference, the policy requires neither references nor state matching. Experiments spanning three model sizes show gains over unconditional full-path self-distillation in embodied interaction (ALFWorld), web navigation (WebShop), and tool use (FTRL). FTRL-trained policies also transfer to BFCL and ToolHop without additional training. Code is available at https://github.com/liujunzhuo/SMRC-SD.
papers.comment: Updated the paper with Qwen3-4B experiments and FTRL tool-use benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多轮 agent 用特权教师自蒸馏补稀疏奖励时，参考路径与学生实际到达状态不匹配会惩罚本应正确的动作。SMRC-SD 逐轮检查状态兼容性、只在匹配轮次蒸馏，并用到达状态摘要与兼容续写增强参考；推理时不需要参考也不需要状态匹配，在 ALFWorld、WebShop、FTRL 上均优于无条件全路径自蒸馏。
Motivation: 稀疏结果奖励对多轮 agent 的中间决策监督不足；特权自蒸馏虽提供稠密信号，但学生可能以不同动作或子目标顺序到达参考未覆盖的状态，导致教师误罚有效动作。
Method: SMRC-SD 在每轮用学生到达状态与参考做兼容性检查，仅在匹配轮次蒸馏，并将参考上下文化（加入到达状态摘要与兼容续写）；推理阶段策略不依赖参考或状态匹配。
Result: 在三种模型规模上，于具身交互 ALFWorld、网页导航 WebShop、工具使用 FTRL 三个基准上均优于无条件全路径自蒸馏；FTRL 训练的策略无需额外训练即可迁移到 BFCL 与 ToolHop。
Conclusion: 把参考的适用性判断交给状态匹配而非全路径照搬，能在多轮 agent 的自蒸馏中避免误罚有效动作，并保持推理时零额外开销与跨基准迁移能力。

summary_sections.motivation: 稀疏结果奖励对多轮 agent 的中间决策监督不足；特权自蒸馏虽提供稠密信号，但学生可能以不同动作或子目标顺序到达参考未覆盖的状态，导致教师误罚有效动作。
summary_sections.method: SMRC-SD 在每轮用学生到达状态与参考做兼容性检查，仅在匹配轮次蒸馏，并将参考上下文化（加入到达状态摘要与兼容续写）；推理阶段策略不依赖参考或状态匹配。
summary_sections.result: 在三种模型规模上，于具身交互 ALFWorld、网页导航 WebShop、工具使用 FTRL 三个基准上均优于无条件全路径自蒸馏；FTRL 训练的策略无需额外训练即可迁移到 BFCL 与 ToolHop。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把参考的适用性判断交给状态匹配而非全路径照搬，能在多轮 agent 的自蒸馏中避免误罚有效动作，并保持推理时零额外开销与跨基准迁移能力。

papers.title: Comparing SGLD and a fixed-noise predictor-corrector adaptation in canonical joint energy-based models on CIFAR-10
papers.abstract_en: Joint Energy-Based Models (JEM) unify classification and generation within a single network and support out-of-distribution (OOD) detection. Canonical JEM training relies on stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics (SGLD); a theoretically motivated alternative, the Predictor-Corrector (PC) sampler, has not previously undergone a systematic replication test on the canonical model. We reproduce canonical JEM on WideResNet-28-10 without normalisation layers on two independent runs and test a fixed-noise PC adaptation - with the degenerate annealed-noise predictor replaced by a deterministic gradient step - across three protocols: the adapted sampler replacing SGLD throughout the full training trajectories (115-132 epochs); cold-start generation (FID); and refinement-style multi-OOD detection (AUROC). The reconstruction reaches 92.88% test accuracy and buffer-FID 44.46 (canonical: 92.90% and 38.40). We document two failure modes: catastrophic late-training divergence with the signature of the canonical outlier-buffer mechanism (all four runs), and run-dependent SVHN OOD-discrimination dynamics. No consistent method-level advantage of the adaptation over SGLD is observed on any protocol: refinement AUROC differences stay below 0.007 across ten checkpoint-OOD pairs; seeded cold-start generation favours SGLD by about five FID points; on the training protocol a hierarchical seed-by-image bootstrap gives a 95% confidence interval on the macro-averaged AUROC difference that contains zero, while a seed-level equivalence test with two runs per method cannot establish formal equivalence. The training-protocol data are consistent both with equivalence and with a small directional effect. This outcome is consistent with theory: the guarantees of the annealed-noise PC framework do not transfer to the constant-noise regime of canonical JEM.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 canonical JEM（WideResNet-28-10、无归一化层）上复现 SGLD 训练，并把退火噪声 Predictor-Corrector 换成固定噪声版本（退化 predictor 改为确定性梯度步），在三条协议上对比。结果未见该适配相对 SGLD 的一致方法级优势：refinement AUROC 差异在十个 checkpoint-OOD 对上均小于 0.007，冷启动生成反而偏向 SGLD 约 5 个 FID 点，训练协议的分层 bootstrap 95% 置信区间含零。
Motivation: 理论上更有动机的 Predictor-Corrector (PC) 采样器此前未在 canonical JEM 上做过系统性复现检验，其固定噪声适配能否替代训练全程的 SGLD 尚不清楚。
Method: 复现 canonical JEM：WideResNet-28-10 去掉归一化层，两次独立运行；将退化退火噪声 predictor 替换为确定性梯度步，构成 fixed-noise PC 适配。三条协议：适配采样器全程替换 SGLD（115–132 epochs）、冷启动生成（FID）、refinement 式多 OOD 检测（AUROC），并用分层 seed-by-image bootstrap 与 seed 级等价检验。
Result: 复现达到 92.88% test accuracy 与 buffer-FID 44.46（canonical 为 92.90% 与 38.40）。refinement AUROC 差异在十个 checkpoint-OOD 对上均低于 0.007；冷启动生成中 SGLD 领先约 5 个 FID 点；训练协议上宏平均 AUROC 差异的 95% 置信区间含零，而每方法两次运行的 seed 级等价检验无法确立形式等价。记录两种失败模式：四次运行全部出现带 canonical outlier-buffer 特征的训练后期灾难性发散，以及随运行而异的 SVHN OOD 判别动态。
Conclusion: 固定噪声适配在 canonical JEM 各协议上均无一致优势，这与理论一致：退火噪声 PC 框架的保证不迁移到 canonical JEM 的常噪声体制；现有数据同时兼容等价与小幅方向性效应。

papers.title: SPARK: Learning from Verification in Speculative GRPO Rollouts
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has become a standard approach for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models, but its training is costly because each step requires generating many long reasoning responses. Recent methods use speculative decoding to accelerate the rollouts, where a draft model proposes tokens that the target model verifies. However, we find that the draft model repeatedly misses the same tokens within a response and across responses in the same GRPO group, and the verification feedback on these misses is not used to update the draft during the rollout. Motivated by this analysis, we introduce SPARK, a lightweight self-adaptive mechanism designed to enhance draft models used in speculative GRPO training. SPARK leverages target verification feedback to refine draft predictions during generation while preserving their existing training procedures. Averaged across 21 model-dataset settings, SPARK improves generation speedup by 32.7% and 11.4%, and end-to-end GRPO training speedup by 32.2% and 8.5%, over EAGLE3-style and DFlash-style baselines, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPARK 在投机解码 (speculative decoding) 的 GRPO rollout 中，用 target 模型的验证反馈在生成过程中实时修正 draft 模型的预测，而不改动原有训练流程。在 21 个模型-数据集设置上平均，相对 EAGLE3 式与 DFlash 式基线，生成加速 32.7% 与 11.4%，端到端 GRPO 训练加速 32.2% 与 8.5%。
Motivation: GRPO 每步要生成大量长推理回复，成本高；投机解码虽能加速 rollout，但 draft 模型在同一回复内和同一 GRPO group 内反复漏掉同一批 token，这些验证反馈在 rollout 期间没有被用来更新 draft。
Method: SPARK 是一个轻量自适应机制：在生成过程中利用 target 模型的 verification 反馈持续修正 draft 的预测，同时保留 draft 原有的训练流程；对照 EAGLE3 式与 DFlash 式投机 GRPO 基线。
Result: 在 21 个模型-数据集设置上平均，生成加速相对 EAGLE3 式基线提升 32.7%、相对 DFlash 式基线提升 11.4%；端到端 GRPO 训练加速相对两者分别提升 32.2% 与 8.5%。
Conclusion: 把 target 的验证反馈用于在线修正 draft，可以在不改训练流程的前提下显著加快投机 GRPO 训练，且对 EAGLE3 式与 DFlash 式两类基线都成立。

papers.title: Wrong Operator or Blind Design? A Post-Training Diagnostic for Physics-Informed Coefficient Learning
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed and hybrid models integrate data and physics, and read learned coefficients as physical. Yet a small prediction error guarantees neither that the postulated operator is right, nor that the design identifies the coefficient, nor that training reached its minimum. On one parabolic benchmark where a sensor aggregates several diffusion rates and the truth is known, a correct operator recovers the coefficient to machine precision. A wrong one leaves it $30\%$ off while the in-domain error is 1.36 times the noise, and drifts $27\%$ across windows. At $7\%$ noise the error falls below the noise; the coefficient stays $30\%$ off. Without the truth, a post-training coefficient diagnostic questions the trained model with three classical statistics, without oracle; the first two need no refit. Does it explain the data? Can the design resolve the named physics? Does the coefficient depend on the window? The specification test keeps its pre-registered false-alarm ceiling and rejects every replicate of both wrong operators tested; a network frozen at its minimum returns the same verdicts. Where the design is blind, a wrong operator confined to the unseen rate leaves the test mute; the design reading flags it beforehand. A network stopped short of its minimum mimics a wrong operator; an analytic second fit separates the two. The test has a notch against a missing reaction term, miscalibrates under correlated noise and loses power beyond $7\%$ noise. Each warning names its remedy (operator, experiment or training); silence certifies nothing.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Supplementary material (20 pp.) included as an ancillary file
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 物理信息/混合模型把学到的系数当物理量读，但小预测误差既不保证算子正确、也不保证设计可辨识、更不保证训练收敛。作者提出无需真值的训练后系数诊断，用三个经典统计量（是否解释数据、设计能否分辨所命名物理、系数是否随窗口漂移）质询已训练模型：前两个无需重拟合，specification test 保持预注册的误报上限并拒绝所测两个错误算子的全部重复，冻结在最小值的网络给出相同判决。
Motivation: 物理信息模型把学习系数解释为物理量，但小的预测误差可能同时掩盖错误算子、不可辨识设计与未收敛训练，且真实系数在部署时不可得，需要无 oracle 的事后判据。
Method: 在单个抛物型基准（传感器聚合多个扩散率、真值已知）上构造训练后系数诊断：三个经典统计量依次检查数据解释力、设计对所命名物理的分辨力、系数对时间窗的依赖；前两个统计量不需要重拟合，另用解析二次拟合区分“训练未到最小值”与“算子错误”，并用 design reading 预先标记设计盲区。
Result: 正确算子把系数恢复到机器精度；错误算子使系数偏差 30%，域内误差为噪声的 1.36 倍，跨窗口漂移 27%；噪声升到 7% 时误差降到噪声以下而系数仍偏 30%。specification test 保持预注册误报上限并拒绝所测两个错误算子的全部重复；错误算子若局限在未观测的扩散率上则测试沉默，而 design reading 事先标出该盲区；未训练到最小值的网络表现类似错误算子，解析二次拟合可将两者分开。测试对缺失反应项有 notch，在相关噪声下失准，噪声超过 7% 时失去功效。
Conclusion: 每个警告都指向对应补救（改算子、改实验或改训练），而诊断沉默不构成任何保证：系数可读为物理的前提是算子、设计与训练三者同时被检验。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Surrogate Substitution Preserves PHI Detectability: A Multi-Detector Equivalence Study
papers.abstract_en: Structure-preserving de-identification replaces each detected identifier with a realistic same-type surrogate ("Anna S." -> "Maria S.") rather than a tag such as [NAME]. If downstream PHI detectors no longer recognise surrogates, hiding-in-plain-sight protection and second-pass safety nets weaken. We ask: on the spans a de-identifier actually replaced, do detectors find the surrogate as often as the original value? We call this detectability preservation and treat it as a proxy, not a full measure of utility. Our paired protocol (i) scores detectability only on replaced spans, separately from coverage; (ii) runs an identical heterogeneous detector panel on original and transformed text; and (iii) bounds the paired change with document-level cluster-bootstrap equivalence testing and posterior probabilities instead of significance tests. For one commercial transform on 7 clinical and general-PII benchmarks in 7 languages (1,750 documents, 5,333 replaced spans, 11 detectors), masked-span recall moves from 75.8% to 74.6% (90% CI of the change [-1.62, -0.82] points; posterior probability > 0.99 of lying within +/-2 points). The change reaches 2-3 points on dense Spanish and Dutch text, and replaced spans are easier to detect than unreplaced ones (+16.6 points), so the result describes the replaced population only. Coverage is a separate, weaker axis (48% of gold PHI on MEDDOCAN). On financial, legal and enterprise text (750 documents, 10 detectors) the pooled result replicates (72.4% -> 72.8%), but rule-based and fine-tuned detectors lose 2-4 points on finance, and the transform edits substantial non-PII text. Redaction and Faker baselines give reference points. We release per-span predictions and analysis code.
papers.comment: v2: corrects the gold-span re-projection and statistical analysis of v1 (see Appendix A) and adds financial, legal and enterprise experiments. 15 pages, 3 figures, 13 tables. Code, data and per-span predictions: https://github.com/Custodian-Labs/guardian-layer-phi-benchmark ; dashboard: https://custodianlabs.pages.dev
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文与天气/降水/数据同化无关，是一篇医疗与通用 PII 去标识化基准研究：在被替换的 span 上，结构保持式去标识化（同类型逼真替身而非 [NAME] 标签）后，11 个异构检测器面板的 masked-span recall 仅从 75.8% 降到 74.6%（90% CI [-1.62, -0.82] 点，后验概率 >0.99 落在 ±2 点内），即替身基本保留可检测性。
Motivation: 结构保持式去标识化用逼真替身替换标识符，若下游检测器不再识别替身，明文藏匿保护与二次安全网都会失效；需要在被替换 span 上单独衡量可检测性是否保留。
Method: 配对协议：(i) 只在被替换 span 上打分，与覆盖率分开；(ii) 对原文与变换后文本跑同一异构检测器面板；(iii) 用文档级 cluster-bootstrap 等价性检验与后验概率界定配对变化，而非显著性检验。
Result: 在一个商业变换、7 个临床与通用 PII 基准、7 种语言、1,750 篇文档、5,333 个被替换 span、11 个检测器上，masked-span recall 75.8% → 74.6%，变化的 90% CI 为 [-1.62, -0.82] 点，落在 ±2 点内的后验概率 >0.99；在密集的西班牙语与荷兰语文本上变化达 2–3 点；被替换 span 比未替换 span 更易检测（+16.6 点）；MEDDOCAN 上覆盖率仅 48% 的 gold PHI。金融、法律与企业文本（750 篇文档、10 个检测器）汇总结果复现（72.4% → 72.8%），但规则式与微调检测器在金融文本上损失 2–4 点，且该变换会编辑大量非 PII 文本；另给出 redaction 与 Faker 基线。
Conclusion: 在被替换 span 这一总体上，结构保持式去标识化基本保留下游检测器的可检测性（变化在 ±2 点内），但覆盖率是独立且更弱的轴，且金融等域上规则式与微调检测器仍会掉 2–4 点。

summary_sections.motivation: 结构保持式去标识化用逼真替身替换标识符，若下游检测器不再识别替身，明文藏匿保护与二次安全网都会失效；需要在被替换 span 上单独衡量可检测性是否保留。
summary_sections.method: 配对协议：(i) 只在被替换 span 上打分，与覆盖率分开；(ii) 对原文与变换后文本跑同一异构检测器面板；(iii) 用文档级 cluster-bootstrap 等价性检验与后验概率界定配对变化，而非显著性检验。
summary_sections.result: 在一个商业变换、7 个临床与通用 PII 基准、7 种语言、1,750 篇文档、5,333 个被替换 span、11 个检测器上，masked-span recall 75.8% → 74.6%，变化的 90% CI 为 [-1.62, -0.82] 点，落在 ±2 点内的后验概率 >0.99；在密集的西班牙语与荷兰语文本上变化达 2–3 点；被替换 span 比未替换 span 更易检测（+16.6 点）；MEDDOCAN 上覆盖率仅 48% 的 gold PHI。金融、法律与企业文本（750 篇文档、10 个检测器）汇总结果复现（72.4% → 72.8%），但规则式与微调检测器在金融文本上损失 2–4 点，且该变换会编辑大量非 PII 文本；另给出 redaction 与 Faker 基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在被替换 span 这一总体上，结构保持式去标识化基本保留下游检测器的可检测性（变化在 ±2 点内），但覆盖率是独立且更弱的轴，且金融等域上规则式与微调检测器仍会掉 2–4 点。

papers.title: IACM-RL: Intent-Aware Context Management and Reinforcement Learning for Complex Tool Invocation under Dynamic Intent Fluctuations
papers.abstract_en: Executing long-horizon tool invocations in real-world environments is severely challenged by dynamic user intent noise. Existing methods attempt robustness via implicit history scanning or text compression, yet predominantly assume perfect instructions in simplistic scenarios. Inevitably, under fluctuating contexts, obsolete constraints dilute model attention, triggering intent deviation and repetitive API loops. To resolve this, we propose IACM-RL, a comprehensive framework for robust tool invocation. First, we introduce the DynamicIntent pipeline, synthesizing trajectories across several fine-grained fluctuation scenarios, paired with a five-dimensional diagnostic metric suite. Second, IACM-RL deploys a BeliefState-based Self-Generated Context Manager that proactively tracks shifting goals and isolates overwritten parameters using structural stale flags. To autonomously internalize this state-tracking capability, we optimize the policy using a hierarchical intent-driven reward alongside two auxiliary losses (CM extraction and state distillation). Experiments on DynamicIntent, BFCL-V3, and $\mathrmτ^2$-Bench demonstrate that IACM-RL outperforms baselines, reducing infinite loops and stale context errors while enhancing out-of-domain generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IACM-RL 面向动态意图波动下的长程工具调用：用 DynamicIntent 流水线合成多类细粒度意图波动轨迹并配五维诊断指标，再以 BeliefState 自生成上下文管理器跟踪目标漂移、用结构化 stale 标志隔离被覆盖参数，配合层次化意图驱动奖励与两个辅助损失（CM 抽取、状态蒸馏）优化策略。在 DynamicIntent、BFCL-V3、τ²-Bench 上优于基线，减少无限循环与过期上下文错误并提升域外泛化。
Motivation: 现有工具调用方法依赖隐式历史扫描或文本压缩，假设指令完美、场景简单；在真实意图波动下过期约束稀释注意力，导致意图偏移与重复 API 循环。
Method: DynamicIntent 流水线合成跨多类细粒度意图波动场景的轨迹，并定义五维诊断指标套件；IACM-RL 用 BeliefState-based Self-Generated Context Manager 主动追踪目标变化并以结构化 stale 标志隔离被覆盖参数；策略优化采用层次化意图驱动奖励加两个辅助损失（CM 抽取与状态蒸馏）。
Result: 在 DynamicIntent、BFCL-V3、τ²-Bench 上实验显示 IACM-RL 优于基线，降低无限循环与过期上下文错误，并提升域外泛化。
Conclusion: 显式维护意图状态并隔离过期上下文，配合意图驱动的层次化奖励，可在意图波动下提升长程工具调用的鲁棒性与域外泛化。

papers.title: Making Transformers Logical
papers.abstract_en: Transformers do not merely lack data on some Boolean extrapolation tasks; they generalize in a systematically wrong way. Recent work on generalization on the unseen has shown that, despite fitting the observed domain, Transformers often extrapolate according to a simpler minimum-degree interpolator rather than the true target function. These Boolean tasks are not practical applications, but controlled stress tests for understanding Transformer inductive bias. We ask whether this failure mode can be corrected by injecting explicit structural priors into attention. Existing structured-initialization methods alter Transformer inductive bias indirectly, by choosing query and key projections whose similarity scores approximate a desired attention pattern. However, we find that when applied to Boolean extrapolation, these QK-based priors can be rapidly overwritten during training and fail to change the learned extrapolation rule. We propose a simpler alternative: initialize the additive attention mask directly. Unlike standard hard masks used for causality or locality attention, our mask is a finite, learnable attention-logit bias initialized from task-level interaction structure. This separates the structural prior from content-dependent attention scores, allowing it to persist throughout optimization. On Boolean reasoning tasks, mask-based initialization achieves near-perfect extrapolation where vanilla and QK-initialized Transformers remain trapped by the default inductive bias. The same mechanism also improves low-data arithmetic performance and remains competitive on vision and language benchmarks. These results show that attention masks can serve not only as architectural constraints, but as a simple substrate for encoding persistent inductive bias in Transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Transformer 在布尔外推任务上不是缺数据，而是按更简单的 minimum-degree 插值器系统性外推。作者发现基于 QK 投影的结构先验会在训练中被迅速覆盖、无法改变学到的外推规则，改为直接初始化可学习的加性 attention-logit mask（由任务级交互结构给出）后，该先验与内容相关的注意力分数解耦并贯穿优化，在布尔推理上达到近乎完美的外推。
Motivation: 布尔外推是检验 Transformer 归纳偏置的受控压力测试：模型能拟合观测域却按错误规则外推；现有结构化初始化只通过 QK 相似度间接逼近目标注意力模式，先验易被训练覆盖。
Method: 提出 mask-based initialization：把有限的、可学习的加性注意力 logit 偏置按任务级交互结构初始化，与因果/局部性的硬 mask 区分，使结构先验与内容依赖的注意力分数分离；对照 vanilla 与 QK 初始化的 Transformer。
Result: 在布尔推理任务上，mask 初始化达到近乎完美的外推，而 vanilla 与 QK 初始化的 Transformer 仍被困在默认归纳偏置下；同一机制还提升了低数据算术表现，并在视觉与语言基准上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 注意力 mask 不只是架构约束，而是编码持久归纳偏置的简单载体；把结构先验放进可学习的加性 logit 偏置比放进 QK 投影更能抵抗训练覆盖。
Relevance: 0
