papers.title: QASP: Query-Adaptive Robust Vector Search Policy
papers.abstract_en: A fundamental challenge of vector search is achieving consistently high recall while minimizing computational costs. Fixed search parameters cause significant performance variance across queries, and conventional evaluation on average recall masks these per-query disparities. We introduce QASP (Query-Adaptive robust vector Search Policy), which predicts the complete recall progression curve per query via a single upfront supervised regression, from which a search policy is derived for any recall target; this avoids iterative model invocations during search or separate predictors per target. By predicting normalized recall values with scale-invariant features and pre-search inference, QASP generalizes across recall targets, index configurations, and datasets. The fine-grained progress predictions further enable a lightweight reactive complement that adjusts search depth based on predicted-versus-observed deviations without additional inference. We prove that QASP requires a finite training sample independent of dataset size and dimensionality, that it matches or improves on the best fixed-policy loss up to a vanishing statistical error, and that its data access savings over fixed probing grow exponentially in intrinsic dimensionality. Experimentally, QASP achieves significantly lower recall variance and deviation from target, higher query satisfaction rate, and scales to large data and hierarchical indices without retraining, achieving 99% recall with 80% less data access. Our implementation can be found at https://github.com/amazon-science/QASP.
papers.journal_ref: ICDE 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QASP 用一次前置监督回归预测每条查询的完整 recall 进度曲线，据此为任意 recall 目标推导搜索策略，避免搜索中反复调用模型或为每个目标单独训练预测器。配合按预测-观测偏差调整搜索深度的轻量反应式补充，它在 99% recall 下减少 80% 数据访问，并显著降低 recall 方差与目标偏差。
Motivation: 向量搜索中固定搜索参数导致查询间性能方差大，而按平均 recall 的常规评测掩盖了这种逐查询差异；目标是同时保住高 recall 并压低计算成本。
Method: QASP 以 scale-invariant 特征做 pre-search 推理，通过单次监督回归预测归一化的 recall 进度曲线，再由曲线导出任意 recall 目标的搜索策略；另加一个轻量反应式补充，依据预测值与观测值的偏差调整搜索深度且不再额外推理。理论上证明训练样本量有限且与数据集规模、维度无关。
Result: 证明 QASP 的训练样本量独立于数据集大小与维度，其损失匹配或优于最佳固定策略（至多差一个趋于零的统计误差），且相对固定 probing 的数据访问节省随内在维度呈指数增长；实验中显著降低 recall 方差与目标偏差、提高查询满足率，可扩展到大规模数据与层次化索引而无需重训练，达到 99% recall 时数据访问减少 80%。
Conclusion: 逐查询预测 recall 进度曲线即可替代固定搜索参数，在不重训练的前提下跨 recall 目标、索引配置与数据集泛化，并把数据访问成本大幅压低。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CorrelationFlow: A Training-Free Geometric Approach for LiDAR Scene Flow Estimation
papers.abstract_en: LiDAR scene flow is the task of estimating point-wise motion from sequential point clouds. It is essential for autonomous driving, as it provides critical information about moving objects and their trajectories. In recent years, unsupervised methods have gained significant traction by eliminating the need for expensive point-wise annotations. However, despite incremental performance improvements, these methods uniformly rely on a single paradigm: training feed-forward networks through optimizing a loss function based on the Chamfer distance, a framework that inherently limits their progression. This paper presents CorrelationFlow, a new paradigm that reformulates LiDAR scene flow as a correlation maximization problem between Bird's-Eye View (BEV) images. Instead of using learnable parameters, our approach employs a chain of image processing operations to solve this problem. The learning-free nature of CorrelationFlow enables strong generalization across diverse domains. This capability is demonstrated by the second-place ranking in the unsupervised track of the Argoverse 2 Scene Flow Challenge at CVPR 2026, which featured a test set spanning five datasets that cover varied vehicle platforms and environments. Our results show that this classical, model-based approach can match or even surpass the performance of learning-based methods, thereby opening a new direction for unsupervised LiDAR scene flow research. The source code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CorrelationFlow 把 LiDAR scene flow 重写为 BEV 图像间的互相关最大化问题，用一串图像处理操作替代可学习参数，实现 training-free 的无监督点云运动估计。在 CVPR 2026 Argoverse 2 Scene Flow Challenge 无监督赛道（测试集横跨五个数据集、多种车辆平台与环境）取得第二名，表明经典模型化方法可匹配甚至超过学习型方法。
Motivation: 现有无监督 LiDAR scene flow 方法都困在同一条范式里：用 Chamfer distance 损失训练前馈网络，性能提升受限，且逐点标注成本高。
Method: 将逐点运动估计重构为 Bird's-Eye View (BEV) 图像之间的互相关最大化问题，用一串图像处理操作求解，不引入任何可学习参数（learning-free），从而跨域泛化。
Result: 在 Argoverse 2 Scene Flow Challenge（CVPR 2026）无监督赛道排名第二，测试集覆盖五个数据集、不同车辆平台与环境；结果表明该模型化方法可匹配或超越学习型方法。
Conclusion: 不依赖训练的互相关求解路径可以作为无监督 LiDAR scene flow 的新方向，源代码将开源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Commit Locally, Exit Globally: Coordinating Adaptive Sampling and Early Exit in Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models predict tokens in parallel but still require many iterative forward passes. Adaptive sampling accelerates local token commitment, while recent global stopping methods seek to end generation early. Our trajectory analysis shows that short answers can stabilize early in decoding, whereas reasoning outputs often require more steps to settle. A fixed progress threshold therefore struggles to avoid both redundant computation on short-answer tasks and premature termination on reasoning tasks. We introduce C$^4$, a training-free framework that combines local decoding acceleration with adaptive global early exit. Confidence-Verified Early Exit (CVEE) determines when to end generation, skipping the remaining steps once its stopping criterion is met. It combines confidence and temporal agreement to adapt stopping to the observed revision history. Commit-Core-Then-Confirm (CCTC) accelerates token commitment while generation continues, reducing the decoding steps needed to complete each block. It extends confidence-threshold parallel decoding with a boundary-anchored core and one-step confirmation of deferred predictions, constraining additional commitments to mitigate premature freezing under unresolved context. With CVEE calibrated once on LLaDA, the same numerical settings transfer across all 12 zero-shot tasks and to Dream without recalibration. Under this configuration, C$^4$ reduces decoding steps by 64-95% and achieves measured decoding-loop speedups of 2.6x-18.6x, with task performance close to full decoding. Component analyses show complementary contributions: early exit supplies most savings on short-answer tasks, while local acceleration contributes more on reasoning and code generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: C⁴ 是面向扩散语言模型 (diffusion language models) 的免训练推理框架，把 Confidence-Verified Early Exit (CVEE) 的全局提前退出与 Commit-Core-Then-Confirm (CCTC) 的局部加速采样绑定：CVEE 用置信度加时序一致性依据修订历史判定何时停止，CCTC 在生成继续时用边界锚定核心加一步确认加速 token 提交。在 LLaDA 上一次性校准的数值可直接迁移到全部 12 个 zero-shot 任务与 Dream，解码步数减少 64–95%、实测解码循环加速 2.6x–18.6x，任务性能接近完整解码。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型虽并行预测 token，仍需大量迭代前向；固定进度阈值无法同时避免短答案任务上的冗余计算和推理任务上的过早终止，因为轨迹分析显示短答案早早稳定而推理输出需要更多步才收敛。
Method: 免训练框架 C⁴ 组合两组件：CVEE 结合置信度与 temporal agreement、依据观测到的修订历史自适应决定停止并跳过剩余步；CCTC 在 confidence-threshold 并行解码基础上加入 boundary-anchored core 与对延迟预测的 one-step confirmation，把额外提交限制在未解析上下文下以缓解 premature freezing。校准只在 LLaDA 上做一次。
Result: 在该配置下 C⁴ 把解码步数减少 64–95%，实测解码循环加速 2.6x–18.6x，任务性能接近完整解码；同一组数值设定无需重校准即可覆盖全部 12 个 zero-shot 任务并迁移到 Dream。组件分析显示互补：短答案任务上提前退出贡献大部分节省，推理与代码生成任务上局部加速贡献更多。
Conclusion: 局部 token 提交加速与全局提前退出应当联合调度而非各自固定阈值，一次校准的置信度设定即可跨任务跨模型迁移，同时保住接近完整解码的任务性能。

papers.title: Every Time I Hire a Linguist, Inference Costs Go Down: On Linguistic Rules as Effective Prompt Compressors
papers.abstract_en: Prompt compression shortens LLM input to reduce inference cost, yet existing methods score token importance through LM forward passes. It remains questionable whether such nuanced, costly token selection is necessary. Compression requires identifying informative content, a problem that linguistic research has long addressed through cues that can be operationalized as deterministic rules. We therefore ask: can \textbf{linguistic rules alone} serve as effective prompt compressors, without LM-based scoring at compression time? To address this, we conduct offline evolutionary search over lexical, syntactic, semantic, and discourse seeds to find competitive rule combinations. The resulting linguistic compressor requires no LM forward pass at deployment and uses only CPU-side processing for compression. We evaluate it with a dual-path protocol to balance compression quality and reconstruction fidelity. Across short passages, multi-document reasoning, and dialogue-memory QA datasets, evolved compressors achieve performance similar to that of recent advanced prompt-compression strategies. Performance is strongest under light-to-moderate compression and degrades as compression becomes more aggressive, while the Direct and Reconstruction paths exhibit distinct patterns. Evolutionary analysis reveals that effective compression fuses signals across linguistic levels and, as the compression ratio increases, rules shift from token pruning to sentence extraction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 纯语言学规则即可充当 prompt 压缩器：对词汇、句法、语义、话语种子做离线进化搜索，组合出部署时零 LM forward pass、仅用 CPU 的压缩规则。在短文段、多文档推理与对话记忆 QA 上达到与近期先进 prompt 压缩策略相当的性能，轻中度压缩最强、压缩更激进时性能下降，且规则随压缩比升高从 token 剪枝转向句子抽取。
Motivation: 现有 prompt 压缩方法靠 LM forward pass 给 token 打分来选重要片段，成本高，而这种精细打分是否必要本身存疑；语言学早已用可规则化的线索解决信息识别问题。
Method: 对 lexical、syntactic、semantic、discourse 四类种子做离线进化搜索 (evolutionary search)，寻找有竞争力的规则组合；部署时压缩只用 CPU 侧处理、不做 LM forward pass，并用 dual-path 协议（Direct 与 Reconstruction 两条路径）平衡压缩质量与重建保真度。
Result: 在 short passages、multi-document reasoning、dialogue-memory QA 数据集上，进化出的压缩器性能与近期先进 prompt 压缩策略相当；轻到中度压缩下表现最强，压缩更激进时性能下降，Direct 与 Reconstruction 两路径呈现不同模式；进化分析显示有效压缩融合跨语言层级信号，且压缩比升高时规则从 token pruning 转向 sentence extraction。
Conclusion: 压缩时的 LM 打分并非必要：跨语言层级融合的进化规则集能在不牺牲质量的前提下把压缩开销降到纯 CPU，但激进压缩比下性能会退化，规则策略需随之从剪 token 换成抽句子。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: The Zero Pattern of a Design Matrix Drives Multiple Descent in Over-parameterized Regression
papers.abstract_en: Over-parameterized linear regression has been widely studied over the last decade. However, most existing works assume that the covariates are independent and that their covariance matrices are non-degenerate. In this paper, we relax both assumptions and derive deterministic equivalents for the prediction risk in a vanishing-ridge regime. We show that degeneracy of the covariance matrices and dependence can lead to multiple descent, and characterize where the corresponding peaks can occur. Our proofs use a novel graph representation of the variance profile. We show that maximum matchings and the Dulmage--Mendelsohn decomposition of the associated bipartite graph identify the configurations at which the variance becomes singular.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在协方差矩阵退化且协变量相关的过参数化线性回归中，vanishing-ridge 制度下的预测风险会出现 multiple descent，其峰值位置由设计矩阵的零模式决定。作者用 variance profile 的图表示证明，二分图的最大匹配与 Dulmage–Mendelsohn 分解刻画了方差奇异的配置，从而定位峰值。
Motivation: 已有过参数化线性回归理论大多假设协变量独立且协方差非退化，无法解释退化与依赖情形下风险曲线的多个峰（multiple descent）。
Method: 放松独立与非退化两个假设，推导 vanishing-ridge 制度下预测风险的 deterministic equivalents；证明中引入 variance profile 的新颖图表示，用关联二分图的最大匹配与 Dulmage–Mendelsohn 分解识别方差奇异的配置。
Result: 证明协方差退化与协变量依赖会导致 multiple descent，并刻画相应峰值可能出现的位置；核心工具是 variance profile 的图表示及二分图最大匹配与 Dulmage–Mendelsohn 分解。
Conclusion: multiple descent 的峰位由设计矩阵零模式（方差奇异配置）决定，而非仅由参数量与样本量之比决定。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Formalizing Flag Algebras in Lean
papers.abstract_en: Razborov's flag algebra method is one of the most successful tools for proving asymptotic density inequalities in extremal graph theory. It reduces an inequality about all large graphs avoiding a forbidden pattern to finitely many algebraic conditions, and a certificate satisfying them can be found by semidefinite programming. We formalize the method for finite simple graphs in Lean 4, building on Mathlib. The formalization covers flags and their densities, the flag algebra as a quotient vector space, positive homomorphisms as limits of graph sequences, Razborov's random extensions, and the downward operator that averages out labels. On top of this theory, we build verified computation of flag densities and a tactic that turns certificates found by semidefinite programming into Lean proofs. The certificate serves only as candidate data; Lean checks every fact the proof uses. With this development we verify seven Turán-type upper bounds. Adding lower-bound constructions proved in Lean yields the asymptotic form of Mantel's theorem and the asymptotic Erdős pentagon theorem $π(C_5;K_3)=24/625$; to our knowledge, the latter has not previously been formalized in a proof assistant. We also prove two inequalities of Goodman. All density theorems reported here depend only on the standard axioms of Lean's logic. Formalization also led us to treat forbidden subgraphs with a different semantics. Instead of building a separate flag algebra for each forbidden family, we keep a single algebra of all graphs and impose the constraint only when interpreting an inequality, through randomly labeled limits of graphs satisfying it. We prove that this ensemble semantics yields the intended density bounds, and that a condition we call root-plantability characterizes when it agrees with the standard semantics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Razborov 的 flag algebra 方法在 Lean 4（基于 Mathlib）中形式化：flags 与密度、作为商向量空间的 flag algebra、作为图序列极限的 positive homomorphisms、random extensions 与 downward operator，并在其上实现经验证的 flag 密度计算和把 SDP 证书转成 Lean 证明的 tactic——证书只作候选数据，Lean 逐条检查。据此验证了七个 Turán 型上界，配合 Lean 中证明的下界构造得到 Mantel 定理的渐近形式与渐近 Erdős pentagon 定理 π(C₅;K₃)=24/625（据作者所知此前未在证明助手中形式化），以及 Goodman 的两个不等式。
Motivation: flag algebra 把关于所有大图的渐近密度不等式化归为有限多个代数条件并交给 SDP 求解，但整套方法此前没有在交互式证明助手中建立，SDP 证书也无法被机器检验为定理。
Method: 在 Lean 4/Mathlib 上形式化有限简单图的 flag algebra：flags 及其密度、作为商向量空间的 flag algebra、作为图序列极限的 positive homomorphisms、Razborov 的 random extensions、以及消去标签的 downward operator；其上构建经验证的 flag 密度计算与一个 tactic，把 SDP 找到的证书转成 Lean 证明，证书仅作候选数据。另对禁用子图采用统一语义：保留全体图的单一 algebra，仅在解释不等式时通过满足约束的随机标记图极限施加限制，并证明该 ensemble 语义给出预期密度界，且 root-plantability 刻画其与标准语义何时一致。
Result: 验证七个 Turán 型上界；结合 Lean 中证明的下界构造得到 Mantel 定理的渐近形式与渐近 Erdős pentagon 定理 π(C₅;K₃)=24/625，并证明 Goodman 的两个不等式。所有报告的密度定理只依赖 Lean 逻辑的标准公理；开发为 47 页、1 图，代码发布于 lean-flag-algebras-release v1.0。
Conclusion: SDP 证书可以只当候选数据、由 Lean 独立核验，从而让 flag algebra 的密度不等式成为机器检查的定理；统一 algebra 加解释期约束的 ensemble 语义在 root-plantability 条件下与标准语义等价。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Inpainting Insights: Elevating Visual XAI with Photorealistic Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: The increasing complexity of state-of-the-art machine learning models has made their behavior progressively harder to interpret, spurring rapid advancements in the field of eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI). Among many methods proposed, perturbation-based approaches play a major role. By systematically altering (perturbing) input features, these approaches measure the impact on the model's predictions. For image data, traditional perturbation techniques, often involve replacing pixel values e.g., with a pre-defined color. However, such approaches, but also more refined deterministic techniques, generate unrealistic out-of-distribution samples and often leave visible artifacts, which can mislead the model and compromise explanation quality. In this work, we adjust LIME, a widely used perturbation-based method, to demonstrate how generative inpainting can improve perturbation-based explanations for images. We achieve photorealistic perturbed samples that align better with the original data distribution and enhance explanation quality.
papers.comment: Accepted preprint (v2, updated affiliations). 15 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. This preprint has not undergone peer review or any post-submission improvements or corrections. The Version of Record of this contribution is published in ICPR 2026 International Workshops. ICPR 2026. Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol 17114, and is available online at https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-032-39388-3_32
papers.journal_ref: Pattern Recognition. ICPR 2026 International Workshops. ICPR 2026. Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol 17114. Springer, Cham, 2026, pp. 447-461
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LIME 的像素替换式扰动换成生成式 inpainting，产出贴合原数据分布、无可见伪影的逼真扰动样本，从而提升图像扰动类 XAI 的解释质量。该做法针对的是确定性遮挡会产生分布外样本、误导模型并损害解释的问题。
Motivation: 图像扰动解释常用固定颜色替换像素，更精细的确定性方法也会生成不真实的分布外样本并留下可见伪影，误导模型并降低解释质量。
Method: 调整扰动式解释方法 LIME，用生成式 inpainting 填补被扰动区域，产生与原始数据分布更一致的逼真扰动样本，再据此计算特征影响。
Result: 获得更逼真、更贴合原始数据分布的扰动样本，并提升解释质量；论文以 15 页、5 幅图、4 张表的形式给出该结果。
Conclusion: 扰动式图像解释应以生成式 inpainting 取代像素替换，使扰动样本保持在数据分布内，避免伪影误导模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gauge-Invariant, Parameter-Insensitive Regularization for Potential Recovery from Flow on Directed Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Recovering a latent potential from observed flow on a directed graph (a discrete Poisson problem with Dirichlet boundaries) is ill-posed, and the standard fix backfires: ridge regularization shrinks toward a gauge-meaningless origin, collapsing and reversing the recovered ordering ($+0.81\to-0.42$ rank correlation against a planted ground truth). The gauge-invariant graph Dirichlet energy removes the hazard and delivers parameter-insensitivity: the estimate is stable across four orders of magnitude in $λ$, whereas ridge inverts the ordering for every $λ>0$. We prove the reduced solve is SPD and preserves dynamic range exactly where ridge collapses it, and localize absorbing boundaries from flow alone via a Poisson residual. The $H^1$ seminorm is classical; what is new is the gauge diagnosis, the parameter-insensitivity it buys, and an ablation showing the result is robust to the extraction method. On three public clickstream corpora the gauge-invariant estimate retains $28$--$41\%$ of the interior dynamic range while ridge collapses to as little as $0.2\%$. The same gauge invariance carries into graph neural networks -- neutralizing the constant mode per layer prevents the oversmoothing that collapses a deep directed GCN -- linking this classical inverse problem to a central question in graph learning.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, Proceedings of the Fifth Learning on Graphs Conference (LoG 2026), PMLR 338
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在有向图上从观测流恢复潜在势（带 Dirichlet 边界的离散 Poisson 问题）时，ridge 正则把解拉向无规范意义的原点，导致排序塌缩甚至反转（对植入真值的秩相关从 +0.81 变成 -0.42）。改用规范不变的图 Dirichlet 能量后，估计在 λ 跨四个数量级上保持稳定，而 ridge 对任意 λ>0 都反转排序；在三个公开点击流语料上保留 28–41% 的内部动态范围，ridge 最低塌到 0.2%。同一规范不变性可逐层中和图神经网络的常数模，阻止深 directed GCN 的过平滑。
Motivation: 从有向图的流恢复潜在势是不适定的离散 Poisson 问题，而标准 ridge 正则以规范无关的原点为收缩目标，会把估计的排序压塌并反转，参数 λ 也难以选择。
Method: 用规范不变的图 Dirichlet 能量（H1 半范数）替代 ridge 作为正则项；证明约化求解为 SPD 且在 ridge 塌缩动态范围处精确保留动态范围；用 Poisson 残差仅从流本身定位吸收边界；并做消融检验结果对提取方法的稳健性，再把同一规范不变性移植到逐层中和常数模的 directed GCN。
Result: ridge 对植入真值的秩相关从 +0.81 反转为 -0.42，且对每个 λ>0 都反转排序；规范不变估计在 λ 跨四个数量级上稳定。三个公开点击流语料上，规范不变估计保留 28–41% 的内部动态范围，ridge 最低塌到 0.2%。
Conclusion: 规范不变的 Dirichlet 正则同时解决 gauge 误用与参数敏感性，并把这一经典反问题与图学习中的过平滑问题联系起来；作者强调新意在于 gauge 诊断、由此获得的参数不敏感性与提取方法消融，H1 半范数本身是经典的。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Adapting Generalist Vehicle Models for High-Speed MPC Across Terrains
papers.abstract_en: High-speed off-road autonomy requires precise closed-loop control for a target vehicle while remaining robust across changing terrains. Recent forward kinodynamic (FKD) prediction foundation models suggest a promising path, starting from a generalist model and specializing it to the target platform. However, effective specialization remains challenging, as it often requires substantial real-world data, and models adapted to one setting can still overfit to specific terrains or driving regimes. We present OptCar (Optimized Car), a recipe for bridging the gap from generalist to specialist FKD models that preserves cross-terrain generalization while optimizing performance for a specific vehicle. OptCar introduces a transformer FKD architecture that uses FiLM to condition multi-step predictions on a single dynamics context token summarizing recent state-action history. It then specializes the generalist model using limited real-world data and targeted synthetic rollouts from environment-specific system identification. In closed-loop model predictive control (MPC) experiments across three terrains and an out-of-distribution cart-pulling task, the largest gains appear at 6 m/s, the highest speed evaluated and the regime in which slip dominates tracking error. On vegetation + dirt, the most slip-diverse terrain, OptCar reduces 6 m/s trajectory tracking error by roughly 55% relative to AnyCar fine-tuned on real data alone, and remains the most accurate even when an unseen cart payload changes the dynamics. With 5 minutes of real data per terrain, OptCar is competitive on road with a specialist trained on 30 minutes of road data and outperforms it when the terrain changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OptCar 是把通用前向运动学-动力学 (FKD) 基础模型特化到目标车辆的配方：transformer FKD 架构用 FiLM 把多步预测条件化到单个 dynamics context token 上，再用有限实车数据加环境系统辨识产生的定向合成 rollout 特化。在三种地形与分布外拉车任务的闭环 MPC 实验中，6 m/s（最高评测速度、滑移主导跟踪误差的工况）增益最大：vegetation + dirt 上相对仅用实车数据微调的 AnyCar 把 6 m/s 轨迹跟踪误差降低约 55%。
Motivation: 前向 FKD 预测基础模型要特化到目标平台，往往需要大量实车数据，且在单一设置上适配的模型会过拟合特定地形或驾驶工况，跨地形泛化丢失。
Method: OptCar 架构为 transformer FKD，用 FiLM 将多步预测条件化到一个总结近期 state-action 历史的 dynamics context token；特化阶段结合有限真实数据与来自环境系统辨识 (system identification) 的定向合成 rollout，随后接入闭环 MPC 做轨迹跟踪。
Result: 在三种地形加一个分布外 cart-pulling 任务的闭环 MPC 实验中，最大增益出现在 6 m/s（最高速度、滑移主导跟踪误差的工况）；vegetation + dirt（滑移最多样地形）上 6 m/s 轨迹跟踪误差相对仅用真实数据微调的 AnyCar 降低约 55%，且在未见过的 cart 载荷改变动力学时仍最准。每地形 5 分钟真实数据时，OptCar 在道路上与用 30 分钟道路数据训练的 specialist 相当，地形变化时超过它。
Conclusion: 用系统辨识驱动的合成 rollout 补充少量实车数据，可以在特化到单一车辆的同时保住跨地形泛化，尤其在滑移主导的高速工况与动力学被载荷改变时。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AdaPCLA: Adaptive Prior-Calibrated Logit Adjustment for Long-Tailed Longitudinal EHR Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generative modeling of longitudinal Electronic Health Records is increasingly important for privacy-preserving research, yet standard autoregressive models tend to underrepresent the co-occurrence structure of tail events (i.e., diseases, symptoms), reducing the fidelity and faithfulness of generated data for rare subpopulations. To this end, we propose AdaPCLA framework, which enables generative models to adaptively fit and generate EHR data through a data distribution-aware training strategy; this is achieved by internalizing data knowledge parameters by simulated annealing training. It also supports training-free adaptation to a diverse clinical population for generation through zero-shot distribution control. Moreover, our theoretical analysis characterizes rare-code logit updates through the label-wise empirical NTK and derives a prior-internalization bound for how annealing speed and NTK conditioning affect retained prior signals. Experiments on real-world data show that AdaPCLA achieves consistent gains in tail plausibility, downstream utility, and zero-shot control; in particular, it improves TailPairSeen over HALO by 114.2% on MIMIC-III and 65.1% on MIMIC-IV, outperforms GPT-style generation by 3.5% F1 for zero-shot cross-population adaptation.
papers.comment: The authors have identified a critical error/issue in the paper that affects the validity of the results. We are withdrawing to address these issues
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaPCLA 用模拟退火式训练把数据分布知识内化为先验参数，使自回归 EHR 生成模型自适应拟合长尾共现结构，并支持零样本人群分布控制。在 MIMIC-III 与 MIMIC-IV 上 TailPairSeen 相对 HALO 分别提升 114.2% 与 65.1%，零样本跨人群适应比 GPT 式生成高 3.5% F1。作者已声明发现影响结果有效性的关键错误并撤稿。
Motivation: 标准自回归模型低估尾部事件（疾病、症状）的共现结构，使罕见亚群的生成数据保真度与可用性下降，而隐私保护研究正越来越依赖这类纵向 EHR 生成。
Method: AdaPCLA 提出分布感知训练策略：用 simulated annealing 训练把数据知识内化为模型内部先验参数，并通过 zero-shot distribution control 实现免训练的人群适配；理论上用 label-wise empirical NTK刻画稀有 code 的 logit 更新，导出退火速度与 NTK 条件数如何影响先验信号保留的 prior-internalization bound。
Result: 在真实数据上，TailPairSeen 相对 HALO 提升 114.2%（MIMIC-III）与 65.1%（MIMIC-IV）；零样本跨人群适应比 GPT 式生成高 3.5% F1；尾部合理性、下游效用与零样本控制均一致增益。
Conclusion: 把分布先验通过退火训练内化进模型，可在不重训的前提下同时改善长尾 EHR 生成的合理性与零样本人群控制；作者已因影响结果有效性的关键错误而撤稿修订。

papers.title: tidyHEBO: Improving the Robustness of Heteroskedastic Evolutionary Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization is widely used for expensive black-box optimization problems. While methodological advances often focus on individual components, practical performance depends on how these components work together. We present tidyHEBO, a Bayesian optimization model. tidyHEBO jointly learns output warping and Gaussian-process parameters, evaluates acquisition functions on the original objective scale, and preserves promising novel candidates throughout evolutionary search. On the Olympus benchmark, tidyHEBO ranked first among the evaluated methods, achieving the best average ranks for typical optimization quality, worst-tail outcomes, and run-to-run variability. It also obtained results comparable to specialized optimizers on Needle-in-a-Haystack problems. On the Bayesmark benchmark, tidyHEBO also demonstrated strong results in hyperparameter tuning. Across these benchmarks, tidyHEBO combines strong optimization results with robustness across diverse black-box problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: tidyHEBO 把输出 warping 与高斯过程参数联合学习、在原始目标尺度上评估采集函数，并在进化搜索中保留有希望的新候选，在 Olympus 与 Bayesmark 两个黑盒优化基准上取得所评估方法中排名第一的综合表现。
Motivation: 昂贵黑盒优化的实际性能取决于各组件如何协同，而方法学进展往往只改进单个组件，缺少对鲁棒性（最差尾部与运行间波动）的整体关注。
Method: tidyHEBO 是一个贝叶斯优化模型：联合学习 output warping 与 Gaussian-process 参数，采集函数 (acquisition function) 在原始目标尺度上评估，进化搜索过程中保留有希望的新候选；在 Olympus 与 Bayesmark 基准上评测。
Result: 在 Olympus 基准上于所评估方法中排名第一，典型优化质量、最差尾部结果与运行间波动三项均取得最佳平均排名；在 Needle-in-a-Haystack 问题上取得与专用优化器相当的结果；在 Bayesmark 超参数调优基准上同样表现强劲。
Conclusion: 把 warping、GP 参数与采集函数尺度、进化搜索的候选保留一起设计，能在多样黑盒问题上同时拿到强优化结果与跨问题鲁棒性。

papers.title: Does Depth Survive Composition, and Can a Router Use It? Adaptive Compute in Latent World Models
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive-compute world models run fewer predictor blocks on some rollout steps than on others. This rests on two assumptions: that a deeper predictor gives a more accurate rollout, and that the steps which need depth can be identified before the predictor runs. We test both on nine DeepMind Control tasks with a twelve-block early-exit latent predictor, eight seeds per task. The first assumption fails on three tasks, where a shallower exit rolls out more accurately than the full stack on every seed, and composing predictions over ten steps moves the depth-error relation away from its one-step shape in both directions. In hindsight, choosing depth per step helps: a greedy oracle that sees the true next latent has 10-37% lower rollout error than the best mixture of fixed depths at equal average compute, and 8-28% lower than the best step-index schedule, on all nine tasks. No router we trained captures this. The difficulty router these models carry stays within 5% of fixed-depth mixtures; a router trained to predict each exit's error beats them by up to 12% but no more than a fixed schedule does; and in closed-loop planning at equal compute the routed planner matches a fixed middle depth. On cheetah, where depth 2 rolls out more accurately than the full stack (an inversion), supervising the early exits only at the first rollout step removes the inversion, while a control with the same loss weight that supervises them at one random step keeps most of it (rho 0.91 vs 0.85 standard and 1.14 first-step-only, three seeds): the inversion depends on supervising exits from composed latents. These results change with the encoder, backbone, horizon and training data. The fixed-depth campaign was pre-registered; the routing analyses, planner runs, ablation control and one-step decomposition are exploratory.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 12 figures, 12 tables. v4: major revision. Adds equal-compute routing comparisons (oracle, step-index schedules, three trained routers), equal-compute planner runs and a supervision-matched ablation control; narrows several v3 claims accordingly; corrects four perturbation-baseline numbers in v3
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在九个 DeepMind Control 任务上检验自适应计算世界模型的两个前提：更深的预测块是否更准、以及所需深度能否在运行前被路由识别。结果是前提一在三个任务上失效（浅层出口在全部 8 个 seed 上比完整十二块更准），前提二也失效：贪心 oracle 比等平均计算量的固定深度混合低 10–37% 误差，但训练出的路由都拿不到这个收益。
Motivation: 自适应计算世界模型默认深度单调增益且所需深度可提前判定；若深度—误差关系在多步 rollout 后被反转，路由设计的前提就不存在。
Method: 用十二块 early-exit latent predictor 在九个 DeepMind Control 任务、每任务 8 个 seed 上测试；比较固定深度混合、step-index 调度、oracle、difficulty router 与预测各出口误差的 router，并在等计算量下跑闭环 planning；在 cheetah 上做监督位置消融（仅第一步 vs 随机步对照，3 seeds）。
Result: 三个任务上浅层出口在每个 seed 都比全栈更准；oracle 比最佳固定深度混合低 10–37%、比最佳 step-index 调度低 8–28%（全部九任务）；difficulty router 与固定深度混合差距在 5% 内，误差预测 router 最多提升 12% 但不超过固定调度；等计算量下路由 planner 只追平固定中等深度。cheetah 上仅第一步监督可消除深度反转（rho 1.14 vs 标准 0.91、随机步对照 0.85，3 seeds）。

papers.title: CausalDS: Benchmarking Causal Reasoning in Data-Science Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act as data-science agents, combining abstract reasoning with advanced tool use. Yet the relevant benchmark landscape largely divides into symbolic causal reasoning benchmarks without realistic data analysis or data analysis benchmarks without causal data-generating structure or a range of causal data science tasks. Existing causal evaluation datasets are often restricted to curated examples from existing sources, with diversity coming from limited templatized variations rather than from systematic generation of novel synthetic causal structures. We introduce CausalDS, a benchmark for evaluating causal reasoning in agentic data-science workflows. Each benchmark instance is a scene consisting of a sampled structural causal model (SCM) with generated observational data and an accompanying synthetic natural-language story grounded in a real domain. We ground the composition of the benchmark components in empirical distributions obtained from real-world datasets, thus retaining empirical structure while reducing the memorization risk through completely synthetic generation. From each scene, we then derive tasks spanning all three of Pearl's rungs. Most tasks include a data science coding component, where the model typically needs to use several tools to arrive at the final answer due to imperfect observations. Abstention is tested directly: for targets the graph does not identify, the graded answer is to abstain. The benchmark thus jointly evaluates symbolic causal reasoning, data science, uncertainty quantification, abstention, and tool use/coding. Because the generator is fully synthetic, the exam is not a fixed dataset: composition, difficulty, and size are parameters, and fresh exams can be drawn at will.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CausalDS 是一个用采样结构因果模型 (SCM) 系统生成的因果推理基准：每个实例由 SCM、观测数据和基于真实领域分布构造的合成自然语言故事组成，并从同一场景派生覆盖 Pearl 三层级的任务，多数任务带数据科学编码环节。生成器全合成，因此难度、规模、组合可参数化、可随时抽新卷，且对图不可识别的目标要求模型弃答 (abstention)。
Motivation: 现有基准要么是符号因果推理而缺真实数据分析，要么有数据分析却无因果生成结构；已有因果评测数据多来自既有来源的精选样例，多样性只靠有限模板变体，记忆风险高。
Method: 每个场景采样一个 SCM，生成观测数据并配一个落在真实领域上的合成故事，组件构成用真实数据集的经验分布来锚定；从场景派生覆盖 Pearl 三层级的任务，多数任务含需多工具协作的编码环节，对图不可识别的目标以弃答为评分答案。
Result: 基准联合评测符号因果推理、数据科学、不确定性量化、弃答与工具使用/编码；因生成器全合成，组合、难度、规模均为参数，可随时抽取全新考卷。
Conclusion: 因果推理评测应由可参数化的合成 SCM 生成器驱动而非固定数据集，这样既保留真实经验结构又降低记忆风险，并能直接考核弃答行为。

papers.title: What Does a Discrete Diffusion Model Learn? One Reverse Process in Three Coordinates
papers.abstract_en: What does a discrete diffusion model actually learn? The literature trains denoisers, bridge plug-ins, and concrete scores, each deriving its own ELBO objective under different conventions. This fragmentation makes the object being learned unclear and ELBO values difficult to interpret and compare. All three methods learn the same object in different coordinates: the exact time-reversal of the noising process. We first prove the Oracle Distance identity: for any noising process, the negative ELBO is not just a bound on the likelihood; it equals the data entropy plus the path KL divergence from the reversed noising process to the learned one. Next, for token-factorizing noise, we show that denoiser, bridge plug-in, and concrete score are three coordinates of this reverse process, derive exact conversions between them, and identify the probability distribution learned by each. In particular, contrary to its standard interpretation, the bridge plug-in learns not a denoiser but the cavity distribution: the clean token given the noisy sequence excluding its own position. We confirm the theory by training all three coordinates with masked, uniform, and GIDD kernels on OpenWebText under a shared recipe, and by training uniform-diffusion solvers on four logic tasks. The learned coordinates agree after conversion, while confusing the cavity with the denoiser can severely degrade sampling quality. Together with exact boundary-term formulas, closed-form NELBO calibrations at initialization, and a clock interpretation of time schedules, these results provide a conceptual framework and a mechanical recipe for deriving, implementing, and comparing discrete diffusion processes.
papers.comment: 48 pages, 10 figures. v2: revised and extended; accepted as an oral at the NeurIPS 2026 workshop Diffusion Language Models: Foundations, Efficiency, and Reasoning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文证明离散扩散的 denoiser、bridge plug-in、concrete score 其实是同一个对象——加噪过程的精确时间反演——在三种坐标下的写法，并给出 Oracle Distance 恒等式：负 ELBO 等于数据熵加反向过程到学习过程的路径 KL。关键反直觉结论是 bridge plug-in 学的不是 denoiser 而是 cavity distribution（给定去掉自身位置的含噪序列下的干净 token）；在 OpenWebText 上按统一配方训练三种坐标后转换结果一致，而在四个逻辑任务上把 cavity 误当 denoiser 会严重劣化采样质量。
Motivation: 离散扩散文献各自训练 denoiser、bridge plug-in、concrete score，各自推导不同约定下的 ELBO，导致被学习的对象不清晰、ELBO 数值难以解释和比较。
Method: 先证明 Oracle Distance 恒等式（对任意加噪过程，NELBO = 数据熵 + 反向加噪过程到学习过程的路径 KL）；对 token-factorizing noise 推导三种坐标的精确转换并指明各自学到的分布。实验在 OpenWebText 上用 masked、uniform、GIDD 三种核按共享配方训练全部三种坐标，并在四个逻辑任务上训练 uniform-diffusion solvers。
Result: 转换后三种学到的坐标一致；把 cavity 与 denoiser 混淆会严重劣化采样质量。另给出精确 boundary-term 公式、初始化处的闭式 NELBO 标定，以及时钟 (clock) 解释的时间调度。
Conclusion: denoiser、bridge plug-in、concrete score 是同一反向过程的不同坐标，bridge plug-in 的正确解释是 cavity distribution 而非 denoiser；论文据此给出推导、实现和比较离散扩散过程的概念框架与机械配方。

papers.title: Platonic Projection Structures: Operator-Induced Observability in Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: We characterize observability in representation learning through Platonic Projection Structures (PPS), an operator-theoretic framework for analyzing representation accessibility under partial observation. Rather than treating observable outputs as direct reflections of latent representations, PPS models observation through a self-adjoint positive semidefinite operator acting on a latent representation space. A system is represented as a triple $(H, Π, O)$, where $H$ is a latent representation space, $Π\succeq 0$ is an observation operator, and $O(v)=\langle v,Πv\rangle$ defines an induced scalar observable. Observability is characterized by the quotient geometry $H/\ker(Π)$, representing equivalence classes of latent states indistinguishable under observation. We show that quantum measurement and representation inference under linear observation models share this operator-theoretic structure while differing in the algebraic properties of their observation operators; the correspondence is structural rather than physical. Representation transfer and knowledge distillation can likewise be interpreted as approximate preservation of observable geometry through $ΦΠ_T \approx Π_S Φ$. PPS also reveals a structural limitation of output-based interpretability: latent components in $\ker(Π)$ are inaccessible from induced observables, imposing intrinsic constraints on attribution and explanation methods. Controlled empirical validations demonstrate kernel-invariant observability, projection-induced attribution gaps, and rank-controlled observable geometry in latent representation spaces. PPS thus provides an explicit characterization of observability through operator-induced quotient geometry and a unified perspective on representation accessibility, interpretability, and projection-mediated inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Platonic Projection Structures (PPS)：用自伴半正定观测算子 Π 作用于隐表示空间 H，以商几何 H/ker(Π) 刻画部分观测下的可观测性，并指出 ker(Π) 内的隐分量从诱导可观测 O(v)=⟨v,Πv⟩ 中原则上不可达，构成基于输出的可解释性的内在上限。受控实证验证展示了 kernel 不变的可观测性、投影导致的归因差距以及秩可控的可观测几何。
Motivation: 表示学习把观测输出当作隐表示的直接反映，但部分观测下哪些隐分量可及、归因方法的边界在哪里缺少算子层面的刻画。
Method: 以三元组 (H, Π, O) 建模，Π⪰0 为观测算子，O(v)=⟨v,Πv⟩ 为诱导标量可观测；用商空间 H/ker(Π) 定义可观测性，把量子测量与线性观测下的表示推断归到同一算子结构（结构对应而非物理对应），并将表示迁移与知识蒸馏写成 ΦΠ_T ≈ Π_S Φ 的可观测几何近似保持。
Result: 受控实证验证给出三类现象：kernel 不变的可观测性、投影诱导的归因差距 (projection-induced attribution gaps)、以及隐表示空间中秩可控的可观测几何；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 可观测性应由算子诱导的商几何刻画，ker(Π) 中的隐分量对归因与解释方法构成内在约束，迁移与蒸馏的成败取决于可观测几何是否被近似保持。

papers.title: SHAPE of Thinking: Mathematical Heuristics for Analyzing and Improving LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, yet final-answer accuracy reveals little about the strategies they use. We introduce \texttt{SHAPE} (Structured Heuristic Analysis for Problem-solving Evolution), a framework grounded in mathematics-education research that characterizes local mathematical actions in reasoning trajectories using a problem-independent heuristic taxonomy. Using \texttt{SHAPE}, we examine two previously hypothesized phenomena in LLM reasoning. First, we revisit the hypothesis that LLMs reuse learned solution techniques under problem perturbations. Across six models on MATH-Perturb, perturbations requiring a different solution approach yield lower accuracy but greater heuristic shifts than those preserving it. Second, we characterize mode-seeking in RLVR through mathematical heuristic profiles. Across four base--RL pairs, successful RL solutions overlap substantially with base-model profiles. We further introduce Heuristic-Augmented Plan-GRPO (HA-Plan-GRPO), which guides RLVR planning through heuristic selection and applicability reasoning. Across three models and five evaluation sets, it improves mean Avg@16 by up to 7.0\% absolute and mean Pass@16 by up to 2.4\% absolute over planning-only RLVR. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/holi-lab/shape-of-CoT}{https://github.com/holi-lab/shape-of-CoT}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SHAPE：用与问题无关的启发式分类体系刻画 LLM 数学推理轨迹中的局部动作，并据此改进 RLVR 规划。在 MATH-Perturb 上，需要更换解法的扰动比保留解法的扰动带来更低准确率但更大的启发式偏移；HA-Plan-GRPO 在三个模型、五个评测集上相对仅规划的 RLVR 把平均 Avg@16 最高提升 7.0 个百分点、平均 Pass@16 最高提升 2.4 个百分点。
Motivation: 数学推理基准上的最终答案准确率无法揭示模型实际使用的解题策略，而已被假设的两种现象（解法复用、RLVR 的 mode-seeking）缺少可操作的刻画工具。
Method: SHAPE 借鉴数学教育研究，用问题无关的启发式分类体系标注推理轨迹中的局部数学动作；在此基础上提出 HA-Plan-GRPO，通过启发式选择与适用性推理引导 RLVR 的规划。
Result: 在六个模型的 MATH-Perturb 上，需要不同解法的扰动准确率更低但启发式偏移更大；四个 base–RL 配对中成功 RL 解与 base 模型的启发式分布高度重叠；HA-Plan-GRPO 在三个模型、五个评测集上相对 planning-only RLVR 平均 Avg@16 最高提升 7.0% 绝对值、平均 Pass@16 最高提升 2.4% 绝对值。
Conclusion: 启发式层面的策略刻画既能检验 LLM 推理中的解法复用与 mode-seeking 假设，也能直接转化为 RLVR 规划的改进信号。

papers.title: Blackknife: Query-Free Black-Box Rewiring Attacks on Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneous graph neural networks (HGNNs) perform well on graphs with multiple node and relation types, but their robustness to attacks with restricted structural access remains insufficiently understood. We propose Blackknife, a query-free, strict black-box evasion attack that observes only the one-hop structures of the attacked nodes, their ground-truth labels, and raw features within the permitted action space. No victim-model outputs are used to train the surrogate, generate perturbations, or select attacks.Blackknife trains a shared surrogate using only observable edges and relation types, then optimizes structural perturbations through continuous relaxation and projected gradient ascent. Each rewiring operation deletes one edge and adds another of the same relation type, preserving the target node's total degree and degree for each relation type. A cosine-similarity penalty and an adaptive structural classifier further regularize the perturbations through bilevel optimization. Experiments on different datasets demonstrate competitive attack success rates across five victim architectures and three defense settings. The results expose HGNN vulnerabilities under jointly restricted graph access and query-free attack generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Blackknife 是针对异构图神经网络 (HGNN) 的免查询严格黑盒逃逸攻击：只看被攻击节点的一跳结构、真实标签与原始特征，不使用任何受害者模型输出。它用共享代理模型加连续松弛与投影梯度上升做重连，每次删一条边并按同关系类型加一条边，保持目标节点总度与各关系类型度不变。在五个受害者架构与三种防御设置上取得有竞争力的攻击成功率，暴露 HGNN 在受限图访问与免查询生成下的脆弱性。
Motivation: HGNN 在多节点类型与多关系类型图上表现好，但在只允许受限结构访问的攻击下其鲁棒性尚不清楚，尤其是完全拿不到受害者模型输出的场景。
Method: 只用可观测边与关系类型训练共享代理模型，再通过连续松弛与投影梯度上升优化结构扰动；每次重连删除一条边并添加同关系类型的另一条边，保持目标节点总度及各关系类型度不变。余弦相似度惩罚与自适应结构分类器通过双层优化 (bilevel optimization) 进一步正则化扰动，全程不使用受害者模型输出。
Result: 在不同数据集上的实验显示，对五种受害者架构与三种防御设置均取得有竞争力的攻击成功率 (attack success rates)。
Conclusion: 在同时受限的图访问与免查询攻击生成条件下，HGNN 仍存在可被利用的脆弱性；度保持的同关系重连配合双层正则足以在拿不到模型输出时完成有效扰动。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Algorithmic Unverifiability of Safety for Fixed and Recursively Self-Improving Systems
papers.abstract_en: Existing impossibility results for AI verification concern a fixed system. Self-modifying systems (agents that rewrite their own code, recursive self-improvement loops) raise a different question: can a safety property that holds now be certified, in advance, to keep holding after the system rewrites itself? We model one step of self-modification as a total computable transformation of code, and preservation as 'safe now and safe after the step'. If the transformation depends only on behaviour, preservation is Rice's theorem one level up; if it reads the code, as self-modification does, preservation is no longer semantic, yet at least as hard as the halting problem, by the same s-m-n reduction carried out inside a class of behaviourally identical programs. One step is never harder than the property; persistence along the whole trajectory can be one arithmetical level higher. No tower of supervisors lowers the problem; every total supervisor errs on a set of systems it cannot locate. Every faithful scheme certifying on finite behavioural evidence admits, for properties not settled by any finite set of inputs, an evolution trace it certifies at every stage while the property is violated. Statically, we record the classical limits (Rice, Goedel, Trakhtenbrot) and add the resource face: over succinctly described finite environments, verifying a policy against an adversary is coNP-complete and synthesising one PSPACE-complete. These limits do not say self-modifying systems are unsafe; they locate where algorithmic guarantees break, at the expressivity a general system needs: Turing-completeness and unrestricted self-modification. What survives is exact: a monitor detects the first violation of a safety property, and no sound procedure certifies all safe systems; certification requires restricting rewrites by design; and a frozen reference keeps the question well posed.
papers.comment: v4: restructured and shortened; static limits condensed into one context section; new remarks on properties that change and on positive/negative disruption; related work extended (Harrison-Ruzzo-Ullman, Cohen, Bonfante-Marion-Reynaud-Plantey, Wang et al., Cai-Shao-Vaynberg); supervision result restated; cites companion arXiv:2609.11326v3
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把一次自我改写建模为代码上的全可计算变换，证明其安全性保持问题至少与停机问题同难：只依赖行为时是高一层的 Rice 定理，读取代码时经 s-m-n 归约仍不低于停机问题，而整条轨迹上的持久性可再高一个算术层级。任何全函数监督器都会在一批它无法定位的系统上出错；作者给出的正面结论是监视器只能检测首次违规，认证必须靠设计上限制改写范围并保留冻结参照。
Motivation: 既有的 AI 不可验证性结果都针对固定系统，无法回答自我改写系统在改写之后安全性质能否被提前认证，而这正是递归自我改进 (RSI) 需要的保证。
Method: 把单步自我改写形式化为代码上的全可计算变换，把保持性定义为“现在安全且该步之后安全”；行为依赖情形用 Rice 定理上移一层，读码情形在行为等价程序类内做 s-m-n 归约；轨迹持久性用算术层级刻画，并给出监督器不可能性与有限行为证据认证方案的反例构造，另记录静态资源面结果。
Result: 单步保持至少与停机问题同难，整条轨迹的持久性可高出一个算术层级；任何全函数监督器都会在一批它无法定位的系统上出错；对不由任何有限输入集决定的性质，任何基于有限行为证据的忠实认证方案都存在一条每一步都被认证而性质实际被违反的演化轨迹；在简洁描述的有限环境上，对策略对抗对手的验证是 coNP-complete，合成是 PSPACE-complete。
Conclusion: 这些极限并不说明自我改写系统不安全，而是把保证失效的位置定位在图灵完备与不受限自我改写这一表达力上：可精确保留的只有首次违规检测，全安全系统的认证必须靠设计上限制改写，冻结参照使问题保持良定。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: From Clicks to Intent: Cross-Platform Session Embeddings with LLM-Distilled Taxonomy for Financial Services Recommendations
papers.abstract_en: Sequential user behavior modeling is widely adopted in industrial recommender systems; however, significant gaps remain in financial services, where pre-login web interactions and authenticated in-app experiences differ drastically. Specifically, pre-login web users typically explore new products, whereas logged-in app users focus on account servicing. Due to the challenge of cross-channel entity resolution (e.g., matching anonymous web sessions to authenticated mobile accounts), web-based intent signals remain underutilized for post-authentication personalization. Existing methods for capturing web-based intent are often ad-hoc and narrow, lacking the flexibility to support both quantitative downstream recommendations and qualitative understanding at scale. In this work, we propose a scalable and dual-purpose intent prediction framework for web-based interactions and demonstrate its applicability for personalization. Our approach transforms raw web clickstreams into two outputs: a self-supervised Transformer encodes multi-modal clickstreams into a compact session embedding, while an LLM-based taxonomy generation and distillation pipeline produces interpretable intent labels. Our system demonstrates that self-supervised clickstream representations combined with LLM-distilled taxonomies can jointly serve quantitative tasks and qualitative understanding in production: on the mobile homepage tile ranking task, the session embedding improves macro Recall@1 by 1.88% and reduces Log Loss by 13.38% over production baselines. On the user conversion prediction task, the embedding outperforms the LLM labels by 4.3% on micro F1, while the distillation layer delivers interpretable labels at ultra-low latency with only a 7% performance drop.
papers.comment: Dianjing Fan and Yao Li equally contributed to this work. 7 pages, 1 figure
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把匿名网页点击流同时转成两种产物：自监督 Transformer 编码的会话向量 (session embedding) 与 LLM 蒸馏出的可解释意图标签，二者在生产系统里分别服务定量排序与定性理解。移动端首页 tile 排序上会话向量相对生产基线 macro Recall@1 提升 1.88%、Log Loss 降低 13.38%；转化预测上向量比 LLM 标签 micro F1 高 4.3%，而蒸馏层以仅 7% 的性能损失换来超低延迟的可解释标签。
Motivation: 金融服务里登录前网页浏览与登录后 App 行为差异极大，跨渠道实体解析困难，网页意图信号在登录后个性化中基本闲置；现有网页意图刻画手段零散狭窄，难以同时支撑定量推荐与规模化定性理解。
Method: 自监督 Transformer 把多模态点击流压成紧凑会话向量；并行跑一条基于 LLM 的意图分类体系生成与蒸馏流水线，产出可解释意图标签。两路输出在生产环境分别接入移动端首页 tile 排序与用户转化预测任务。
Result: 移动端首页 tile 排序任务上，会话向量相对生产基线 macro Recall@1 提升 1.88%、Log Loss 下降 13.38%；用户转化预测任务上，会话向量比 LLM 意图标签 micro F1 高 4.3%；蒸馏层给出可解释标签且仅带来 7% 性能下降。
Conclusion: 自监督点击流表征与 LLM 蒸馏分类体系可以并行服务生产中的定量推荐与定性理解，二者取舍由任务决定：排序与转化用向量，需要可解释性时用蒸馏标签。

papers.title: G$^3$VLA: Geometric Inductive Bias for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have rapidly advanced generalist robot manipulation by harnessing the semantic knowledge of pretrained vision-language backbones. However, their visual representations are typically grounded in 2D image coordinates rather than calibrated camera geometry. This limitation is especially pronounced in multi-camera systems, where views are coupled by known intrinsics and extrinsics but processed as independent images. We propose G$^3$VLA, a camera-aware geometric module that injects calibrated structure into the visual-token stream of a pretrained VLA without altering its action space or original action-learning objective. G$^3$VLA combines intrinsic-conditioned ray embeddings, projective positional encoding (PRoPE), and bidirectional cross-view fusion to establish geometrically consistent representations across camera views. Geometric supervision is provided by ground-truth point maps or confidence-gated $π^3$X teacher predictions, enabling training without depth sensors or manual geometric annotations. On $π_0$, G$^3$VLA consistently improves performance on LIBERO and RoboCasa24 under both supervision regimes, while ground-truth supervision improves five-task RoboTwin2.0 averages with three cameras. Experiments on camera-shifted LIBERO-Goal and real robots demonstrate improved robustness to unseen camera viewpoints. Controlled calibration studies across $π_0$ and $π_{0.5}$ show that these gains depend on correct camera geometry while remaining stable under mild calibration perturbations. These results demonstrate that grounding VLA visual tokens in calibrated camera geometry provides a simple and general mechanism for improving geometric consistency, multi-view reasoning, and viewpoint robustness in pretrained robot policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: G$^3$VLA 在预训练 VLA 的视觉 token 流中注入标定相机几何：内参条件化的射线嵌入、投影位置编码 (PRoPE) 与双向跨视角融合，不改动动作空间与原有动作学习目标。在 $π_0$ 上它在 LIBERO 与 RoboCasa24 两种监督制度下均提升性能，真值点图监督还提升三相机 RoboTwin2.0 五任务平均；相机偏移的 LIBERO-Goal 与真机实验显示对未见视角更稳健，且增益依赖正确的相机几何、对轻微标定扰动保持稳定。
Motivation: VLA 的视觉表征停留在 2D 图像坐标而非标定相机几何，多相机系统中各视角本由已知内外参耦合却被当作独立图像处理，几何一致性与跨视角推理受限。
Method: 提出 camera-aware 几何模块 G$^3$VLA，向预训练 VLA 的视觉 token 流注入标定结构：内参条件化射线嵌入 + PRoPE + 双向跨视角融合；几何监督来自真值点图或置信度门控的 $π^3$X 教师预测，因此无需深度传感器或人工几何标注；在 $π_0$ 与 $π_{0.5}$ 上做受控标定研究。
Result: 在 $π_0$ 上，G$^3$VLA 在 LIBERO 与 RoboCasa24 的两种监督制度（真值点图与 $π^3$X 教师预测）下均一致提升性能；真值监督在三相机 RoboTwin2.0 上提升五任务平均。相机偏移的 LIBERO-Goal 与真机实验显示对未见相机视角的稳健性提升；跨 $π_0$ 与 $π_{0.5}$ 的受控标定研究表明增益依赖正确的相机几何，同时对轻微标定扰动保持稳定。
Conclusion: 把预训练机器人策略的视觉 token 落到标定相机几何上，是提升几何一致性、多视角推理与视角稳健性的简单通用机制，且无需改动动作空间。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: 4DVLT: Dynamic Scene Understanding with Worldline-Centered Vision-Language Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Language-guided dynamic scene understanding requires identifying one physical entity across time, metric 3D space, and multiple viewpoints, a setting not captured by current multimodal reasoning or tracking paradigms. We introduce 4DVLT, an offline calibrated multi-view task that unifies grounding with metric 3D and synchronized 2D tracking through a worldline binding identity, motion, visibility, and observations. We construct Instruct-4D, with 129.4K QA pairs, 64.7K targets, 851 scenes, and 9 reasoning types, and propose 4DTrack for query-conditioned inference over a 4D state graph. 4DTrack reaches 55.18 WQS, exceeding the strongest adapted VLT baseline by 33.01 points while improving grounding and trajectory quality. The project page is available at https://github.com/mikubaka88/4DVLT.

papers.title: X-Safe: Embodiment-Agnostic Safeguarding for Robot Arm Manipulation Policies via Action Masking
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring safety of learning-enabled robotic manipulation across diverse embodiments and tasks still requires significant manual engineering. For collision avoidance, existing approaches typically rely on embodiment-specific learned safety approximations or simplified robot models together with stopping-based fallback controllers that compromise performance. In this paper, we propose an embodiment-agnostic safeguarding approach, X-Safe, which provides formal probabilistic guarantees for collision avoidance without model simplifications or learned safety functions. By operating in the configuration space, our safeguarding method works with different types of robot policies. X-Safe reasons locally around the current configuration to establish safe regions and uses action masking to restrict the policy's support to these safe regions. We demonstrate X-Safe on two embodiments and three policies, both in simulation and on hardware. We observe less than half of the performance degradation compared to state-of-the-art safeguarding, and empirically corroborate our formal collision avoidance guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: X-Safe 是与机器人本体无关的机械臂操作策略安全护栏：在构型空间 (configuration space) 内围绕当前构型局部构造安全区域，用 action masking 把策略输出限制在该区域内，从而在不做模型简化、不用学习式安全函数的前提下给出碰撞避免的形式化概率保证。在两种本体、三种策略的仿真与实机演示中，其性能损失不到 SOTA 安全护栏的一半，并与形式化碰撞避免保证的经验佐证一致。
Motivation: 跨本体、跨任务的学习型机械臂操作安全仍需大量手工工程：现有碰撞避免方法要么依赖本体专属的学习式安全近似，要么用简化机器人模型加停机式后备控制器，后者会牺牲性能。
Method: X-Safe 在构型空间运行，围绕当前构型做局部推理以建立安全区域，再用 action masking 将策略的支持集限制在安全区域内，因此可搭配不同类型的机器人策略；方法不依赖模型简化或学习得到的安全函数，并给出碰撞避免的形式化概率保证。
Result: 在两种本体 (embodiment) 和三种策略上，仿真与实机均演示了该方法；相比 SOTA safeguarding，性能下降不到一半 (less than half of the performance degradation)，并经验性佐证了其形式化碰撞避免保证。
Conclusion: 把安全保证建立在构型空间的局部安全区域加 action masking 上，可以在不牺牲近半性能的前提下跨本体复用同一套碰撞避免护栏。

papers.title: PoLAR: Factorizing Extent and Mode in Latent Actions for Robot Policy Learning
papers.abstract_en: Robot actions vary in both extent and mode: how much change they produce and what kind of change they produce. A latent action space that reflects this structure may make it easier for downstream policies to map latent actions to robot actions. However, existing latent action methods typically rely on visual reconstruction from observation pairs without explicitly encouraging such structure. We introduce Polar Latent Actions with Radial structure (PoLAR), which imposes a radial-direction structure on latent actions, encouraging radius to encode transition extent and direction to retain transition mode. PoLAR uses temporal offsets between observations as a weak proxy for transition extent, encouraging transitions with larger offsets to occupy larger radii. We instantiate this structure in hyperbolic space, whose expanding volume with radius offers a natural fit for more diverse transition modes at larger extents. Across in-task and large-scale pretraining settings, PoLAR improves downstream policy performance in simulation and real-world robot experiments, outperforming latent action baselines and strong pretrained VLAs. These results suggest that structuring latent actions by extent and mode helps transfer visual pretraining to robot policy learning.
papers.comment: Project Page: https://joon-stack.github.io/PoLAR, Accepted to CoRL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PoLAR 把潜动作 (latent action) 显式分解为半径（transition extent）与方向（transition mode），并实例化在双曲空间 (hyperbolic space) 上，利用其随半径扩大的体积容纳更大范围的转变模式。时间偏移量作为 extent 的弱代理，偏移越大半径越大。在仿真与真实机器人实验中，该结构化潜动作在 in-task 与大规模预训练两种设定下均提升下游策略表现，超过潜动作基线与强预训练 VLA。
Motivation: 现有潜动作方法依赖观测对的视觉重建，没有显式鼓励 extent 与 mode 分离的结构，导致潜动作到机器人动作的映射更难学，视觉预训练向机器人策略的迁移受限。
Method: 在潜动作上施加径向结构：半径编码转变幅度、方向编码转变类型；用观测间的时间偏移作为 extent 的弱代理，偏移越大对应半径越大；把该结构实例化在双曲空间，因其体积随半径扩张，可在更大 extent 上容纳更多样 mode。
Result: 在 in-task 与大规模预训练两种设定下，PoLAR 在仿真和真实机器人实验中均提升下游策略性能，优于潜动作基线 (latent action baselines) 与强预训练 VLA。
Conclusion: 按 extent 与 mode 结构化潜动作有助于把视觉预训练迁移到机器人策略学习。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: HiMPO: Hindsight-Informed Memory Policy Optimization for Less-Entangled Credit in Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents compress interaction histories into memory, but final outcomes entangle memory-writing credit with tool failures and reasoning errors. We propose HiMPO, a Hindsight-Informed Memory Policy Optimization framework that supplements trajectory-level reinforcement learning with memory-specific credit. For each update, HiMPO compares the target answer's log-likelihood under the previous and updated memories while holding the remaining pre-write context fixed. A soft gate based on group-relative hindsight relevance then weights the local utility advantage. Trajectory-level credit applies to all generated tokens; memory tokens additionally receive the auxiliary advantage. Across judge-based open-domain tasks and objective compressive-memory QA, HiMPO improves task performance while preserving compressed-context efficiency. On Local Wiki Search, it improves average F1 and exact match over MemPO by 2.6 and 2.2 percentage points, respectively. Controlled interventions and live memory-reversion studies provide evidence of reduced blame leakage and alignment between memory credit and behavioral effects. With the policy fixed, the credit estimator remains robust to the tested forms of target noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HiMPO 在长程 agent 的轨迹级强化学习之外补一层记忆专属 credit：固定写入前上下文，比较目标答案在旧记忆与新记忆下的对数似然，再用 group-relative hindsight relevance 的软门控加权局部效用优势，轨迹 credit 覆盖全部生成 token，记忆 token 额外拿辅助优势。在 Local Wiki Search 上相对 MemPO 平均 F1 提升 2.6 个百分点、exact match 提升 2.2 个百分点，同时保持压缩上下文的效率。
Motivation: 长程 agent 把交互历史压进记忆后，最终成败把「写记忆的功劳」与工具失败、推理错误纠缠在一起，轨迹级 RL 无法把这部分 credit 分开。
Method: 对每次更新，在保持写入前剩余上下文不变的前提下，比较目标答案在 previous memory 与 updated memory 下的 log-likelihood；以 group-relative hindsight relevance 构造软门控 (soft gate) 加权局部效用 advantage。轨迹级 credit 施加于所有生成 token，记忆 token 额外获得该辅助 advantage；评测覆盖 judge-based 开放域任务与客观的压缩记忆 QA。
Result: 在 Local Wiki Search 上，相对 MemPO 平均 F1 提升 2.6 个百分点、exact match 提升 2.2 个百分点，并保持压缩上下文效率。受控干预 (controlled interventions) 与 live memory-reversion 研究给出 blame leakage 减少、记忆 credit 与行为效应对齐的证据；策略固定时，credit 估计器对所测试的目标噪声形式保持稳健。
Conclusion: 把记忆写入的 credit 从轨迹级成败中单独拆出来加权，能在不牺牲压缩效率的前提下提升长程 agent 任务表现，且该 credit 估计对目标噪声不敏感。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DynFS-MoE: Dynamic Functional-Structural Mixture-of-Experts for Post-Traumatic Epilepsy Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Post-traumatic epilepsy (PTE) is a severe complication of traumatic brain injury (TBI). Yet, early identification remains challenging due to the complex structural and functional alterations it induces in the brain. To address this, we propose a dynamic multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that integrates functional and structural connectivity through time-aware functional-structural encoding and class-conditioned expert routing. Within this framework, modality-specific and cross-modal experts learn complementary representations, while a Modality-Class MoE (MCoE) module dynamically adjusts expert weights according to each classification objective. Experimental results across three binary classification tasks demonstrate that the framework consistently outperforms static fusion baselines, and high-interpretability analyses further reveal meaningful regions of interest (ROIs) interactions. This dynamic multimodal expert framework effectively captures class-dependent brain interaction patterns and provides an interpretable approach for PTE diagnosis and risk stratification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynFS-MoE 用时间感知的功能-结构连接编码与类别条件专家路由，把功能连接和结构连接在 MoE 中动态融合，用于创伤性脑损伤后癫痫 (PTE) 的早期识别。在三个二分类任务上，该动态多模态专家框架一致优于静态融合基线，并给出可解释的 ROI 交互。
Motivation: 创伤性脑损伤后癫痫早期识别困难，因为 TBI 同时引起脑结构与功能的复杂改变，静态融合难以刻画随类别变化的脑交互模式。
Method: 提出动态多模态 Mixture-of-Experts 框架：时间感知的功能-结构编码器 (time-aware functional-structural encoding) 融合功能与结构连接，类别条件专家路由 (class-conditioned expert routing) 下设模态专属专家与跨模态专家学习互补表示，Modality-Class MoE (MCoE) 模块按各分类目标动态调整专家权重。
Result: 在三个二分类任务上，该框架一致优于静态融合基线；高可解释性分析揭示了有意义的 ROI 交互。
Conclusion: 动态按类别调度专家权重能捕捉类别依赖的脑交互模式，为 PTE 诊断与风险分层提供可解释途径。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Driving, Fast or Slow? Neuro-Symbolic Guidance for Motion Prediction in Multi-Modal Ground Mobility
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and interpretable motion prediction for heterogeneous traffic spaces, including pedestrians, bicycles, cars, and trucks, is essential for safe autonomous navigation. Nevertheless, state-of-the-art approaches remain predominantly black-box, lacking explicit encoding of the regulatory and behavioral constraints of real-world mobility. We propose Trajectory Compliance-Shaping (TraCS), a neuro-symbolic framework that augments existing black-box motion prediction backbones with interpretable and probabilistic first-order logic. To do so, TraCS employs an agentic code-generation pipeline to bridge the gap between natural-language descriptions of traffic regulations and probabilistic motion prediction. Furthermore, TraCS employs a reactive data-streaming inference engine that maintains and efficiently updates compliance landscapes as scenes evolve. To prevent TraCS from overconfidently steering the backbone's predictions in the wrong direction, we propose a neural confidence rating learned as a context-aware attenuation of the compliance signal. We demonstrate on the Argoverse 2 benchmark how TraCS consistently improves state-of-the-art prediction backbones, showing that probabilistic and symbolic compliance reasoning is a broadly applicable and computationally efficient complement to purely neural motion predictors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TraCS 用一阶逻辑把交通法规显式编码进黑盒运动预测骨干：agentic 代码生成把自然语言法规转成概率逻辑，反应式流式推理随场景更新 compliance landscape，再用学习到的神经置信度对合规信号做上下文相关衰减，避免把预测带偏。在 Argoverse 2 上一致提升 SOTA 预测骨干，说明符号合规推理是神经运动预测的高效补充。
Motivation: 行人、自行车、汽车、卡车混行的交通场景里，SOTA 运动预测基本是黑盒，没有显式编码真实世界的法规与行为约束，可解释性与合规性不足。
Method: TraCS（Trajectory Compliance-Shaping）是 neuro-symbolic 框架：agentic code-generation pipeline 把自然语言交通法规译成概率一阶逻辑，叠加在既有黑盒预测骨干之上；reactive data-streaming inference engine 随场景演化维护并高效更新 compliance landscape；另设 learned neural confidence rating，作为 compliance 信号的上下文感知衰减项，防止过度自信地把骨干预测引向错误方向。
Result: 在 Argoverse 2 benchmark 上，TraCS 一致改善多个 SOTA 运动预测骨干，并被描述为计算高效、可广泛适用于纯神经运动预测器的补充；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 概率与符号合规推理可以作为神经运动预测的通用、高效补充，前提是用置信度衰减控制合规信号对骨干的干预强度。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: SPARC: Reliable Spatial Annotations from Robot Demonstrations at Scale
papers.abstract_en: This work introduces Spatial Annotations from Robot Demonstrations with Reliability Calibration (SPARC), a risk-aware framework that automatically labels robot demonstrations with structured spatial annotations and assigns each annotation a reliability score. Structured spatial annotations, such as bounding boxes, object trajectories, and manipulation phase labels, benefit a broad range of robotics applications from training grounded robot policies and embodied foundation models to motion planning and hierarchical task composition. Existing automated pipelines generate such annotations at scale but provide no reliable quality signal: detector confidence is poorly calibrated for annotation correctness, forcing a choice between accepting noisy labels or discarding useful samples. In contrast to existing automated pipelines, SPARC leverages the spatio-temporal structure inherent to robot tasks to generate a reliability signal, reducing noisy labels and retaining more useful samples. We further introduce Interaction-Aware Bench (IA-Bench), a benchmark that measures model accuracy in grounding the locations of interacted objects in robot demonstrations. On 1.7k human-annotated demonstrations spanning diverse embodiments and scenarios, SPARC significantly outperforms detection-only baselines in localization accuracy while retaining three times more samples at high-precision operating points. Our experiments demonstrate that models finetuned on our annotations achieve state-of-the-art results on object-grounding and pointing benchmarks among similarly sized models, while remaining competitive on broader spatial-reasoning suites without manually verified or annotated training data. Furthermore, policies trained on SPARC-generated annotations outperform baselines in cluttered, visually ambiguous real-world scenes. Code, data, and models are available at intuitive-robots.github.io/sparc-labeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPARC 是机器人演示的自动空间标注框架，利用任务的时空结构为每条标注（边界框、物体轨迹、操作阶段）生成可靠性分数，替代校准很差的检测器置信度。在 1.7k 条人工标注演示上，定位精度显著优于仅检测基线，且在高精度工作点多保留 3 倍样本；用其标注微调的模型在同等规模模型中达到 object-grounding 与 pointing 基准的 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有自动标注流水线能规模化生成空间标注，但没有可靠的质量信号：检测器置信度对标注正确性校准很差，只能在收下噪声标签和丢弃有用样本之间二选一。
Method: SPARC 借助机器人任务固有的时空结构生成可靠性信号并对标注做风险感知校准；同时提出 Interaction-Aware Bench (IA-Bench)，衡量模型在机器人演示中定位被交互物体位置的准确度。
Result: 在 1.7k 条覆盖多种本体与场景的人工标注演示上，SPARC 在定位精度上显著优于仅检测基线，并在高精度工作点多保留 3 倍样本；用 SPARC 标注微调的模型在同等规模模型中于 object-grounding 与 pointing 基准取得 SOTA，在更广的空间推理套件上保持竞争力，且训练数据无需人工核验或标注；在其生成标注上训练的策略在杂乱、视觉歧义的真实场景中优于基线。
Conclusion: 利用任务时空结构做可靠性校准，可以在不牺牲精度的前提下大幅减少标注噪声并保留更多样本，使无手工标注的机器人空间标注达到可用质量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: P3D-Bench: Benchmarking MLLMs for Parametric 3D Generation and Structural Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models can write code to produce complex programs as well as use programs to do 3D modeling, which opens up a new avenue for 3D generation powered by their priors, world knowledge and reasoning. Yet existing benchmarks rarely evaluate 3D modeling through code. Such modeling demands more than runnable code: from a text or visual specification, a model must generate a parametric 3D program that is geometrically precise, semantically aligned and assembly-consistent. We introduce P3D-Bench, a benchmark for parametric 3D generation. Unlike a 3D mesh, a parametric 3D program exposes explicit dimensions, construction operations and part relations, revealing whether a model recovers a design's structure, not just its appearance. Under a unified protocol, P3D-Bench covers three task families (Text-to-3D, Image-to-3D and Assembly-3D) and scores each output for executability, geometric fidelity, topology, text-grounded constraints, multiview semantic alignment and part-level structure. We construct P3D-Dataset, comprising 400 text cases, 400 image cases, and 203 annotated assemblies. Our evaluation on 100 cases from each task family yields three key findings. First, multi-part generation is substantially more challenging than single-part modeling, with models struggling to compose individual parts into a coherent structure. Second, models can often recover the global shape and semantic identity of the target object, yet fail to reproduce the precise parametric geometry specified by the input. Third, part-level modeling remains weak on assemblies, where models recover neither the geometry of each part nor the right number of parts. These results position P3D-Bench as a benchmark for evaluating precise parametric geometry and part-level structure in parametric 3D generation.
papers.comment: 26 pages, including appendix. v4: optimized figure compression; content and results unchanged from v3. v3: updated model evaluations, fixed 100-case subsets per task, and revised score aggregation. Project page: https://spatiaos.github.io/projects/P3D-Bench/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: P3D-Bench 是面向参数化 3D 生成的多模态大模型基准，用统一协议评测 Text-to-3D、Image-to-3D、Assembly-3D 三类任务，从可执行性、几何保真、拓扑、文本约束、多视角语义对齐和部件级结构六个维度打分。在每类任务 100 例的评测中得到三条结论：多部件生成远难于单部件建模；模型常能恢复目标的整体形状与语义身份，却复现不出输入指定的精确参数化几何；装配任务上部件级建模最弱，部件几何与部件数量都恢复不对。
Motivation: 现有基准很少通过代码评测 3D 建模，而参数化 3D 程序要求几何精确、语义对齐且装配一致，仅看外观或可运行代码无法判断模型是否真正恢复了设计结构。
Method: 在统一协议下覆盖 Text-to-3D、Image-to-3D、Assembly-3D 三个任务族，对每个输出按可执行性、几何保真、拓扑、文本落地约束、多视角语义对齐与部件级结构打分；配套构建 P3D-Dataset，含 400 个文本案例、400 个图像案例与 203 个带标注装配体，评测时每个任务族取 100 例。
Result: P3D-Dataset 共 400 文本案例、400 图像案例、203 个标注装配体；评测覆盖每任务族 100 例。三条发现：多部件生成显著难于单部件建模；模型常恢复目标整体形状与语义身份但无法复现输入指定的精确参数化几何；装配任务上部件级建模仍弱，部件几何与部件数量都恢复不对。
Conclusion: 参数化 3D 生成的短板集中在部件级结构与精确参数几何，而非整体外观；P3D-Bench 被定位为评测这两项能力的基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Unifying Framework for Concept-Based Representational Similarity
papers.abstract_en: Learned representations across models and modalities often exhibit striking structural similarities, suggesting shared underlying concept decompositions. However, concept alignment remains poorly defined: existing approaches optimize different objectives under the same terminology, obscuring what is actually aligned. We propose a unifying framework that decomposes alignment along two axes: what is aligned (representations vs. concepts) and at what level (instance-wise vs. distributional). This induces four corresponding properties---instance-wise and distributional variants of translation and concept consistency---and reveals precisely which of these guarantees existing methods provide. We further introduce InterVenchA, an intervention-based benchmark that separately measures extraction quality, translation quality, and concept consistency---which we validate against human perception of concept alignment. Using this framework, we show that commonly assumed equivalences between alignment objectives fail in practice: optimizing one property does not reliably recover the others, and, on real embeddings, purely unsupervised objectives fail to recover meaningful instance-level alignment. As a constructive consequence, a model, the Coupled SAE (CoSAE), matches or exceeds specialized alignment methods such as crosscoders and Universal SAEs on their own target metrics, by jointly enforcing the properties identified by our framework without any architectural innovation. Moreover, as little as 1% paired data is sufficient to recover instance-level alignment when anchoring distributional objectives. Overall, concept alignment is fundamentally multi-objective, and progress requires treating it as such. Our framework and benchmark provide the means to define, measure, and compare concept alignment methods on this basis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出概念对齐的统一框架，把对齐沿「对齐什么（表征 vs. 概念）」与「在哪个层面（instance-wise vs. distributional）」两个轴分解为四条性质，并用干预式基准 InterVenchA 分别度量抽取质量、翻译质量与概念一致性。结论是概念对齐本质是多目标问题：只优化单一性质无法可靠恢复其他性质，纯无监督目标在真实 embedding 上无法恢复有意义的 instance-level 对齐，而仅 1% 配对数据即可在锚定 distributional 目标后恢复 instance-level 对齐。
Motivation: 跨模型、跨模态的学得表征常呈现结构相似性，但 concept alignment 的定义混乱：不同方法在同一术语下优化不同目标，导致无法判断到底对齐了什么、也无法比较。
Method: 以两个轴分解对齐并导出四条性质（translation 与 concept consistency 的 instance-wise / distributional 版本），据此刻画现有方法各自保证哪一条；提出干预式基准 InterVenchA，分别度量 extraction、translation、concept consistency，并用人类对概念对齐的感知做验证；再提出 CoSAE（Coupled SAE），通过联合强制框架识别出的多条性质实现对齐，不含架构创新。
Result: 在 InterVenchA 上验证了各度量与人类感知的一致性；实验显示常被假定等价的对齐目标在实践中不等价，优化一条性质不能可靠恢复其他性质；在真实 embedding 上纯无监督目标无法恢复有意义的 instance-level 对齐；CoSAE 在 crosscoders 与 Universal SAEs 各自的目标指标上持平或超过这些专用方法；仅 1% 配对数据即可在锚定 distributional 目标后恢复 instance-level 对齐。
Conclusion: 概念对齐是多目标问题，必须按框架定义、度量并联合优化；无监督方法不足以恢复 instance-level 对齐，少量配对数据（1%）配合 distributional 目标锚定即可补上。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SecureClaw: Clawing Back Control of LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents face two distinct security failures: unauthorized external actions and exposure of sensitive plaintext inside the runtime before any final output check can intervene. Existing defenses usually protect one boundary, either the planner/runtime or the point where external actions are executed, and therefore do not by themselves secure both surfaces. We present SecureClaw, a dual-boundary architecture that enforces authorization in a trusted executor and keeps raw protected data outside the LLM runtime. Sensitive reads pass through a trusted gateway that replaces raw values with reference IDs. In the evaluated deployment, the gateway also provides short planning summaries that deliberately release selected information, a process called declassification. Writes that change external state follow a PREVIEW$\rightarrow$COMMIT protocol in which only a trusted executor may execute the exact request authorized by policy. The runtime can still plan over summaries and reference IDs, but cannot directly resolve the IDs into secrets or perform side effects. Across the AgentDojo, AgentLeak, and Agent Security Bench (ASB) benchmarks, SecureClaw is the only defense we evaluate in a common harness that simultaneously retains usable task utility and achieves 0% attack success rate (ASR) on ASB, 0.64% ASR on AgentDojo, and 3.23% overall leak on AgentLeak's attacked parity lane, which measures final-output and internal-relay leakage. Code is available at https://github.com/ponyyuhan/SecureClaw.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (poster). Revised presentation and additional evaluation; 29 pages including appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SecureClaw 提出双边界架构：把授权放在可信执行器 (trusted executor)，并让敏感数据以引用 ID 形式留在 LLM runtime 之外，写操作走 PREVIEW→COMMIT 协议。在统一评测框架下，它在 ASB 上达到 0% 攻击成功率 (ASR)、AgentDojo 上 0.64% ASB、AgentLeak 攻击对等通道上 3.23% 总泄漏，同时保住可用任务效用。
Motivation: 工具型 LLM agent 存在两类安全失效：未授权的外部动作，以及最终输出检查介入前敏感明文在 runtime 内暴露；现有防御通常只覆盖 planner/runtime 或外部动作执行点之一。
Method: 双边界架构：可信执行器强制授权；敏感读取经可信网关把原始值替换为引用 ID，并在评估部署中提供有选择释放信息的规划摘要 (declassification)；改变外部状态的写操作遵循 PREVIEW→COMMIT，只有可信执行器可执行策略授权的确切请求。
Result: 在统一评测框架下跨 AgentDojo、AgentLeak、Agent Security Bench (ASB) 三个基准，SecureClaw 是唯一同时保住可用任务效用的被评防御：ASB 上 0% ASR，AgentDojo 上 0.64% ASR，AgentLeak 攻击对等通道上 3.23% 总泄漏（衡量最终输出与内部中继泄漏）。

papers.title: AgentWorld: A Data Factory for Training LLM Agents from Multi-Turn Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Training LLMs to act as capable agents requires learning from multi-turn interactions with environments. However, multi-turn interaction trajectories generated by heterogeneous agent runtimes are difficult to transform into structured, high-quality training data that training engines can readily consume. In this paper, we propose AgentWorld, a data factory that bridges heterogeneous agent runtimes and training engines through a Gateway Server and a Data Pool, reframing LLM agent training around a unified data lifecycle from interaction collection to training consumption. The Gateway Server captures multi-turn interactions through an LLM API proxy, while the Data Pool organizes them into standardized step records for curation and training. An interactive dashboard supports trajectory monitoring, step inspection, and data review. In our demonstration, users integrate ready-to-use white-box and black-box agents, trace and curate their interaction data across the pipeline, and extend the factory to new agents and datasets through lightweight configuration. Quantitative experiments across multiple datasets and RL methods demonstrate training support for different agent runtimes. AgentWorld provides a practical foundation for transforming heterogeneous multi-turn experience into training-ready data for LLM agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/AgentR1/Claw-R1 and the demonstration video can be found at link https://youtu.be/Pw47dAOw6B0.
papers.comment: Accepted as a demonstration paper at ICDM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentWorld 是面向 LLM agent 训练的数据工厂，用 Gateway Server 经 LLM API 代理捕获多轮交互，再由 Data Pool 把异构 agent 运行时的轨迹整理成标准化 step 记录供训练引擎消费。演示中用户接入白盒与黑盒 agent、跨流水线追踪与筛选数据，并以轻量配置扩展到新 agent 和数据集；跨多个数据集与 RL 方法的定量实验表明其可支撑不同 agent 运行时的训练。
Motivation: 异构 agent 运行时产生的多轮交互轨迹难以转换成训练引擎可直接消费的结构化高质量数据，agent 训练的数据链路缺少统一的采集到消费生命周期。
Method: AgentWorld 由 Gateway Server 与 Data Pool 构成：Gateway Server 通过 LLM API 代理捕获多轮交互，Data Pool 将其组织为标准化 step 记录用于筛选与训练；配套交互式 dashboard 支持轨迹监控、step 检查与数据审查，并通过轻量配置接入白盒/黑盒 agent 与新数据集。
Result: 在多个数据集与多种 RL 方法上做了定量实验，展示对不同 agent 运行时的训练支持；演示中可接入即用的白盒与黑盒 agent，追踪与筛选流水线中的交互数据，并以轻量配置扩展到新 agent 和数据集。
Conclusion: 把异构多轮经验统一到从交互采集到训练消费的数据生命周期，可为 LLM agent 训练提供可复用的实践基础。

papers.title: Activation Steering Induces Emergent Misalignment: Steering Vector Construction and Comprehensive Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering (AS) has emerged as a popular inference-time technique for modulating the behavior of large language models (LLMs). AS modulates model behavior in a flexible and lightweight manner by injecting task-specific steering vectors (SVs) into intermediate activations. Meanwhile, recent work has identified emergent misalignment (EM) as an emerging safety concern, whereby finetuning on unsafe examples from a narrow task unexpectedly induces broadly unsafe behavior in unrelated domains. With the increasing popularity of AS, it is pressing yet under-explored to thoroughly investigate whether AS can induce EM. In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive study of activation-steering-induced emergent misalignment. Specifically, (1) we identify a steering vector construction to confirm that SVs derived from a narrow task can indeed induce misalignment across broad unrelated domains. Qualitative measurement further reveals that AS-induced EM may pose more severe safety risks than finetuning-induced EM, i.e., AS elicits more actionable harmful responses with greater semantic coherence than those generated by finetuned models. (2) We characterize the properties of AS-induced EM by analyzing key steering-specific factors, including steering magnitude, the low-rank structure of the steering subspace, and the number of fine-tuning epochs used during steering-vector construction. (3) We evaluate the robustness and sensitivity of AS-induced EM across diverse model families, model scales, target tasks, and intervention layers. Our findings reveal activation steering as a significant yet underexamined source of emergent misalignment and provide an activation-space perspective on emergent misalignment and its safety risks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 激活转向 (activation steering) 本身就能诱发涌现式失准 (emergent misalignment)：由窄任务构造的 steering vector 注入中间激活后，会在无关领域产生广泛不安全行为，且定性上比微调诱发的失准更危险——输出更多可操作的有害回答且语义更连贯。转向幅度、转向子空间的低秩结构、构造期微调轮数，以及模型家族、规模、目标任务、干预层位置共同决定该效应的强弱。
Motivation: 已有工作发现窄任务不安全样本微调会外溢为跨领域失准，但 AS 作为更轻量流行的推理期干预，是否会诱发同样的涌现式失准此前几乎未被系统检验。
Method: 系统研究 AS 诱发的 EM：先确定一种 steering vector 构造方式以确认窄任务 SV 可跨无关领域诱发失准，再分析转向幅度、转向子空间低秩结构、构造期微调轮数等转向特有因素，最后在多模型家族、模型规模、目标任务与干预层上检验鲁棒性与敏感性。
Result: 定性测量显示 AS 诱发的 EM 比微调诱发的 EM 风险更严重：AS 诱导的模型输出更多可操作有害回答且语义连贯性更强；EM 强度随转向幅度、转向子空间低秩结构、构造期微调轮数以及干预层位置变化，并跨模型家族、规模与目标任务表现不同。
Conclusion: 激活转向是涌现式失准的一个显著但被低估的来源，应从激活空间视角而非仅从微调数据视角审视其安全风险。

papers.title: Position: Hippocampal Explicit Memory Is the Cornerstone for AGI
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across various tasks, raising expectations for Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). This position paper argues that integrating explicit memory is the cornerstone for advancing LLMs toward AGI. The key reason is that the underlying learning mechanism of LLMs is highly analogous to human implicit memory. However, higher-order cognitive functions necessary for AGI, such as long-term strategic planning, metacognition, and symbolic reasoning, heavily rely on hippocampal explicit memory and cannot arise solely from implicit statistical learning. Drawing on findings from neuroscience, I advance this perspective and complement it with computational requirements for artificial explicit memory systems, hoping to foster further research and lay the groundwork for explicit memory integration.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 306:171640-171663, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 ICML 2026 Position 论文，主张把显式记忆 (explicit memory) 接入 LLM 是通向 AGI 的基石：LLM 的学习机制高度类似人类隐式记忆，而长期战略规划、元认知、符号推理等高阶认知依赖海马体显式记忆，无法仅靠隐式统计学习产生。作者据神经科学证据提出人工显式记忆系统的计算需求，作为后续研究的设计前提。
Motivation: LLM 的统计学习只能对应人类隐式记忆，高阶认知功能因此缺位，AGI 预期与现有学习机制之间存在结构性缺口。
Method: 以立场论文形式论证：援引神经科学关于海马体显式记忆与高阶认知（长期战略规划、元认知、符号推理）的发现，推导人工显式记忆系统需满足的计算需求，并与 LLM 的隐式记忆式学习机制对照。
Result: 给出的是立场与计算需求框架，核心命题为高阶认知不能仅由隐式统计学习产生；论文被 ICML 2026 Position Paper Track 接收，收录于 PMLR 306:171640-171663。
Conclusion: LLM 要走向 AGI 必须显式整合海马体式的显式记忆，单靠扩大隐式统计学习无法获得规划、元认知与符号推理能力。
