papers.title: STREAM: Stochastic Riemannian Flow Matching with Anisotropic Decoder for Digital Histopathology Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic histopathology image generation addresses patient-privacy concerns and the growing data demands of foundation models. Existing state-of-the-art histopathology generative models use pretrained Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) as conditioning signals. We show this yields conditioning-dominated diversity: on TCGA-BRCA, 62-75% of their output diversity is attributable to the conditioning signal rather than the learned latent space, while de novo synthesis still requires a VFM at inference. We instead use histopathology VFMs as the latent space itself: their patch tokens are $\ell_2$-normalized on the unit hypersphere $\mathcal{S}^{d-1}$ with strong angular dominance and intrinsic curvature, motivating a Riemannian formulation. We present STREAM, the first framework to apply Riemannian flow matching in the histopathology domain, in two stages: 1) a bridge-type stochastic perturbation that establishes per-token rectifiability on $\mathcal{S}^{d-1}$ for training a Diffusion Transformer, and 2) a novel decoder training design whose noise covariance is anisotropic in the left-singular basis of the per-token tangent-projected velocity-field Jacobian, spending a large robustness budget on its low-response directions and a small one on its high-response directions. Across TCGA-BRCA and TCGA-COADREAD, STREAM achieves state-of-the-art gFID and ranks first on nearly all histopathology-specific metrics as well. Code and a public gallery of generated images are available at https://chokevin8.github.io/STREAM-Patho/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STREAM 把病理 VFM 的 patch token 直接当作单位超球面 S^{d-1} 上的潜空间做 Riemannian flow matching，两阶段训练：先用桥式随机扰动建立逐 token 可整性以训练 Diffusion Transformer，再让解码器噪声协方差沿逐 token 切空间投影速度场 Jacobian 的左奇异基呈各向异性。在 TCGA-BRCA 上，现有以 VFM 为条件信号的生成模型其输出多样性有 62-75% 来自条件信号而非学到的潜空间；STREAM 在 TCGA-BRCA 与 TCGA-COADREAD 上取得 state-of-the-art gFID，并在几乎所有病理专用指标上排名第一。
Motivation: 现有病理生成模型把预训练 Vision Foundation Model 当条件信号，导致输出多样性被条件主导（TCGA-BRCA 上 62-75%），且 de novo 合成推理时仍必须依赖 VFM；同时 VFM 的 patch token 经 ℓ2 归一化后落在 S^{d-1} 上，具有强角度主导性与内蕴曲率，欧氏生成建模并不匹配。
Method: 把病理 VFM 的 patch token 本身作为潜空间（而非条件），在其上做 Riemannian flow matching，分两阶段：1) 桥式随机扰动 (bridge-type stochastic perturbation) 在 S^{d-1} 上建立逐 token 可整性 (rectifiability)，用于训练 Diffusion Transformer；2) 新颖的解码器训练设计，其噪声协方差在逐 token 切空间投影速度场 Jacobian 的左奇异基上各向异性——低响应方向分配大鲁棒性预算、高响应方向分配小预算。
Result: 在 TCGA-BRCA 上，现有 SOTA 病理生成模型的输出多样性有 62-75% 归因于条件信号而非学到的潜空间；STREAM 在 TCGA-BRCA 与 TCGA-COADREAD 上达到 state-of-the-art gFID，并在几乎所有病理专用指标上排名第一。
Conclusion: 把 VFM 当作潜空间而非条件信号，配合各向异性解码器噪声，可以在病理图像生成上取得 SOTA gFID 并摆脱推理时对 VFM 条件的依赖；该框架是首个将 Riemannian flow matching 引入病理域的工作，代码与生成图像画廊已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Imagine Before You Draw: Visual Prompt Engineering for Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Incorporating visual semantic representations as an intermediate step before image generation can reduce the modeling difficulty between text and images, thereby improving generation quality. Recent works such as X-Omni and BLIP3o-Next have explored this direction, but they typically use a two-stage external pipeline: a separate autoregressive model first generates semantic tokens, which are then fed as conditioning to an independent diffusion decoder. When the decoder is conditioned only on the compressed semantic plan, it cannot directly access the original input, which introduces an information bottleneck that limits detail preservation in downstream tasks such as editing. Internal architectures such as Transfusion, BAGEL, and Show-o2 avoid this bottleneck by enabling cross-modal interaction within a single model, but they still face the difficult text-to-pixel modeling gap without intermediate semantic guidance. We propose Visual Prompt Engineering (VPE), which can be seamlessly integrated into such internal frameworks. Specifically, the model first autoregressively generates visual semantic tokens ($e.g.$, SigLIP 2) as "visual prompts" that capture the semantic layout, then generates the full image tokens conditioned on this plan. We validate VPE across class-conditional generation, text-to-image generation, and image editing, covering various token types and model architectures. Results show that VPE can accelerate convergence, raise quality ceilings, and through internal integration, achieve substantially better editing preservation (PSNR: $26.76$ vs. $19.92$) than a matched external pipeline with semantic-only decoder conditioning, while maintaining competitive editing responsiveness.

Method: VPE 嵌入 Transfusion、BAGEL、Show-o2 这类内部框架：模型先自回归生成视觉语义 token（如 SigLIP 2）作为捕捉语义布局的视觉提示，再以该计划为条件生成完整图像 token；在类条件生成、文生图、图像编辑三类任务上验证，覆盖多种 token 类型与模型架构。
Result: 图像编辑保持 PSNR 26.76 vs. 19.92（对比匹配的、解码器仅以语义计划为条件的外部管线），同时保持有竞争力的编辑响应性；VPE 还加速收敛并抬高质量上限，验证覆盖类条件生成、文生图与图像编辑。
Conclusion: 把语义规划放进单一内部模型而非外挂两阶段管线，可在不牺牲编辑响应性的前提下消除信息瓶颈、显著提升编辑保持，并普遍改善生成质量与收敛速度。

papers.title: AUDITFLOW: Executable Symbolic Environments for Structured Financial Reporting Verification
papers.abstract_en: Structured financial reporting verification requires connecting reported facts to accounting constraints, reconstructing expected values, and executing numerical checks. We study this problem through XBRL numerical consistency verification and introduce \textsc{AuditFlow}, a graph-grounded multi-agent framework built around an executable symbolic environment. The environment links a reusable US-GAAP taxonomy graph with filing-specific XBRL evidence and provides typed tools for retrieval, traversal, computation, and rule evaluation. Two specialized auditors investigate constraints and filing evidence, while a senior auditor coordinates disagreement-triggered refinement. Deterministic tools produce verification evidence; evidential aggregation combines structured reports, including agent-declared overrides, into final decisions. On a newly collected 1{,}000-instance evaluation set of engine-recorded DQC violations, \textsc{AuditFlow} achieves $87.70\%$ joint audit accuracy with Claude Sonnet 4.6, compared with $68.60\%$ for Single Agent and $86.70\%$ for Checker-only. Component and coverage analyses identify executable verification as the main source of accuracy, while additional gains from agent judgment depend on the backbone and checker coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AuditFlow 把 XBRL 数值一致性审计做成可执行符号环境：US-GAAP 分类学图谱与申报证据相连，两名专职审计员加一名高级审计员在分歧触发下细化，确定性工具产出证据并汇总成最终判定。在 1,000 条引擎记录的 DQC 违规评测集上，Claude Sonnet 4.6 背景下联合审计准确率 87.70%，高于 Single Agent 的 68.60% 与 Checker-only 的 86.70%。
Motivation: 结构化财务报告核验要把申报事实接到会计约束上、重建期望值并执行数值检查，纯 LLM 单代理在可复现的规则执行与证据链上不稳定。
Method: 图谱接地的多代理框架 AuditFlow：可执行符号环境把可复用 US-GAAP taxonomy graph 与申报专属 XBRL 证据相连，提供检索、遍历、计算、规则求值四类带类型工具；两名专职审计员分别查约束与证据，高级审计员协调分歧触发的细化，确定性工具产出证据，evidential aggregation 汇总结构化报告（含代理自报的 override）给出判定。
Result: 在新采集的 1,000 条引擎记录 DQC 违规评测集上，AuditFlow 配 Claude Sonnet 4.6 联合审计准确率 87.70%，Single Agent 68.60%，Checker-only 86.70%。组件与覆盖度分析显示可执行核验是准确率的主要来源，代理判断的额外增益取决于 backbone 与 checker 覆盖度。
Conclusion: 数值审计的准确率主要来自可执行的确定性核验，多代理判断的增益是条件性的，取决于模型 backbone 与 checker 覆盖度。

papers.title: Learning Reusable Agent Subroutines from Experience
papers.abstract_en: Existing methods induce various forms of knowledge from agent traces, from sample workflows to programmatic skills. We propose ARISE (Agent Routine Induction from Successful Experience), which identifies recurring procedures in agent traces and synthesizes them into a reusable library of agent subroutines. Across five tasks in narrative deduction, rule application, and constraint planning, it is shown to be a more effective learning strategy than prompting methods and prose and code artifact induction methods. ARISE outperforms chain-of-thought in all ten model-task settings of the main evaluation. Compared to state-of-the-art methods in agent experience induction, our method scores 6.1 percentage points over the strongest evaluated baselines, and 11.5 percentage points over code-skill induction. In our controlled experiment, ARISE also improves average accuracy by up to 15.6 percentage points compared to formatting the induced knowledge as skills and by up to 19.1 points over rewriting it as code tools.
papers.comment: v2: major revision; method renamed to ARISE, new experiments, rewritten. 28 pages, 15 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARISE (Agent Routine Induction from Successful Experience) 从 agent 轨迹中挖掘反复出现的过程并合成为可复用的子程序库，在叙事演绎、规则应用与约束规划三类共五个任务上比提示方法与 prose/code 工件归纳更有效：主评估十个模型-任务设置上全部胜过 chain-of-thought，比最强基线高 6.1 个百分点、比代码技能归纳高 11.5 个百分点。
Motivation: 从 agent 轨迹归纳出的知识多为一次性的工作流或散文/代码工件，难以跨任务复用，且与直接提示相比收益不稳定。
Method: ARISE 在 agent 轨迹中识别反复出现的过程（recurring procedures），将其合成为可复用的 agent 子程序库；对照 prompting、prose 与 code artifact induction，并在受控实验中比较把归纳知识格式化为 skills 或改写为 code tools 的差异。
Result: 在叙事演绎、规则应用、约束规划三类五个任务上，ARISE 主评估的全部十个模型-任务设置均胜过 chain-of-thought；比最强被评估基线高 6.1 个百分点，比 code-skill induction 高 11.5 个百分点；受控实验中，相比把归纳知识格式化为 skills 平均准确率最多提升 15.6 个百分点，相比改写为 code tools 最多提升 19.1 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把 agent 经验归纳成可复用子程序库是比提示与 prose/code 工件归纳更有效的学习策略，且知识的呈现形式（skills 或 code tools）会显著削弱收益。

papers.title: Memory by Design: Bayesian Layers for Sequence Modeling
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the \emph{design-model framework}: a way to derive efficient recurrent sequence maps from explicit assumptions about memory. A design model writes evidence into memory by exact Bayesian filtering; a query- dependent readout produces a predictive distribution whose mean is the layer output. In our linear-Gaussian instantiation, the \emph{Bayesian Layer} propagates both a mean and a covariance: the covariance tracks uncertainty over stored associations, steering writes toward uncertain directions, attenuating gains as evidence accumulates, and preserving confident memories. The same framework unifies several sub-quadratic recurrences: linear attention, GLA, and Mamba-2/SSD are exact filters under a latent-input design model, whereas DeltaNet and related Delta-rule models are covariance-reset reductions of the Bayesian Layer's design model. Restoring covariance propagation yields closed-form predictions for retrieval dynamics, which we verify empirically, and improves robustness beyond the training regime in controlled collision studies, learned associative recall, and the Zoology MQAR benchmark. Training from scratch on WikiText-103 under matched state budgets lowers perplexity on associative-recall hits. Distilling Bayesian Layers into a pretrained 340M Gated DeltaNet improves RULER long-context retrieval over a matched-compute control, at a 2.5--2.7\% held-out perplexity cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 design-model 框架：把显式的记忆假设写成线性高斯设计模型，用精确贝叶斯滤波导出次二次循环序列层（Bayesian Layer），同时传播均值与协方差，协方差追踪已存关联的不确定性并据此调节写入方向与增益。该框架把 linear attention、GLA、Mamba-2/SSD 统一为精确滤波器，把 DeltaNet 类模型解释为贝叶斯层的协方差重置特例；恢复协方差传播后在受控碰撞研究、联想回忆和 Zoology MQAR 上提升训练域外鲁棒性，并以 2.5–2.7% 的留出困惑度代价改善蒸馏后 340M Gated DeltaNet 的 RULER 长上下文检索。
Motivation: 次二次循环模型（linear attention、GLA、Mamba-2、DeltaNet）各自以启发式形式定义记忆写入与遗忘，缺少统一的概率推导，导致训练分布外的联想记忆鲁棒性不足、长上下文检索能力受限。
Method: design-model 框架：设计模型用精确贝叶斯滤波把证据写入记忆，查询依赖的 readout 产生预测分布，其均值作为层输出；线性高斯实例中 Bayesian Layer 同时传播均值与协方差，协方差引导写入朝不确定方向、随证据积累衰减增益并保留高置信记忆。恢复协方差传播可推出检索动力学的闭式预测；实验包括受控碰撞研究、联想回忆、Zoology MQAR、WikiText-103 从头训练（匹配状态预算），以及向预训练 340M Gated DeltaNet 的蒸馏。
Result: 闭式检索动力学预测经实证验证；恢复协方差传播在受控碰撞研究、联想回忆和 Zoology MQAR 上提升训练域外鲁棒性；WikiText-103 从头训练、匹配状态预算下降低联想回忆命中项的困惑度；蒸馏 Bayesian Layer 到预训练 340M Gated DeltaNet，在 2.5–2.7% 留出困惑度代价下相对匹配算力对照改善 RULER 长上下文检索。
Conclusion: 把记忆假设显式写成贝叶斯设计模型，可以把主流次二次循环层统一为同一滤波器族的特例，而协方差传播是提升长上下文检索与分布外鲁棒性的关键成分。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Redundant or Necessary? A Benchmark for Detecting Redundant Steps in Agent Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Computation cost is a critical challenge for LLM agent systems, as their long-horizon trajectories continuously accumulate computational overhead. While existing studies focus on improving the overall efficiency of agent systems, the efficiency of individual steps remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we propose and formulate a new research problem: \textbf{redundant step detection}, aiming to detect these steps that consume substantial computational resources while contributing little or nothing to task completion. To support this initiative, we introduce \textbf{RedundancyBench}, a new benchmark that contains 1,920 trajectories collected from 6 different LLMs with 3,613 step-level annotations. Using RedundancyBench, we develop and evaluate 6 frontier LLMs and Jev as redundant step detectors, summarizing their strengths and limitations. Our experiments reveal that the redundant step detection is still challenging even for SOTA models, such as Claude-Opus-5, particularly without prior information. Code and dataset in this paper are both available in https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RedundancyBench-E0CB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出并形式化 LLM agent 轨迹中的冗余步骤检测 (redundant step detection) 问题，即找出消耗大量算力却对任务完成贡献极小或为零的步骤，并发布基准 RedundancyBench：1,920 条来自 6 个不同 LLM 的轨迹、3,613 条步骤级标注。用该基准开发并评测 6 个前沿 LLM 与 Jev 作为检测器，结果显示即使 Claude-Opus-5 这类 SOTA 模型在缺少先验信息时检测仍然困难。
Motivation: LLM agent 的长程轨迹持续累积计算开销，现有工作只优化系统整体效率，单个步骤是否冗余这一层面基本未被研究，缺少可标注、可评测的基准。
Method: 构建 RedundancyBench 基准，收录 6 个不同 LLM 产生的 1,920 条轨迹并做 3,613 条步骤级冗余标注；在此之上开发并评测 6 个前沿 LLM 加一个名为 Jev 的检测器，归纳各自强项与短板。
Result: RedundancyBench 含 1,920 条轨迹、6 个 LLM 来源、3,613 条步骤级标注；评测覆盖 6 个前沿 LLM 与 Jev 共 7 个检测器；冗余步骤检测对 SOTA 模型（如 Claude-Opus-5）仍具挑战，尤其在没有先验信息时。

papers.title: Masked Diffusion Vision-Language Models for Temporal Action Localization
papers.abstract_en: Temporal action localization (TAL) requires recognizing the target event and localizing its start and end times precisely in untrimmed videos. Recent vision-language formulations improve semantic reasoning and support language-conditioned outputs, but their autoregressive decoders still generate tokens from left to right, preventing later semantic evidence from revising earlier timestamp predictions. We adapt masked diffusion vision-language models (MDVLMs) to TAL so that semantic tokens and boundary tokens remain editable throughout iterative denoising with bidirectional attention, allowing temporal boundaries and semantic content to be refined jointly. Direct adaptation, however, creates two TAL-specific mismatches: standard masked diffusion training corrupts all positions uniformly at random, but the time tokens are more reliable when enough semantic context is available; and token-level cross-entropy does not reflect temporal IoU. To address these mismatches, we introduce a Planned Training Objective that uses boundary-aware masking and step-weighted reconstruction to rehearse the late recovery of time tokens, together with a Step-Level IoU Reward that provides overlap-aware supervision during denoising. A standard sequence-level cross-entropy term provides the base reconstruction signal. Experiments on ActivityNet-RTL, ActivityNet-1.3, and THUMOS-14 show that MDVLM-TAL improves both temporal reasoning and boundary localization over autoregressive vision-language baselines, with especially strong gains under stricter temporal IoU criteria. The source code is available at https://github.com/ycwfs/MDVLM-TAL .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把掩码扩散视觉-语言模型 (MDVLM) 引入时序动作定位 (TAL)，使语义 token 与边界 token 在双向注意力的迭代去噪中始终可改写，从而让后期语义证据回改早期时间戳预测。针对均匀掩码与 token 级交叉熵不匹配 TAL，提出 Planned Training Objective（boundary-aware masking + step-weighted reconstruction）与 Step-Level IoU Reward。在 ActivityNet-RTL、ActivityNet-1.3、THUMOS-14 上相对自回归视觉-语言基线同时改善时序推理与边界定位，且在更严格的 temporal IoU 判据下增益尤其明显。
Motivation: 自回归解码器只能从左到右生成 token，后续语义证据无法修正先前的时间戳预测；而标准掩码扩散训练对所有位置均匀加噪、token 级交叉熵也不反映 temporal IoU，直接迁移到 TAL 会出现训练目标与任务的错配。
Method: 将 MDVLM 适配到 TAL，语义与边界 token 在迭代去噪中保持可编辑并用双向注意力联合精修；训练上引入 Planned Training Objective，用 boundary-aware masking 与 step-weighted reconstruction 预演时间 token 的后期恢复，再叠加 Step-Level IoU Reward 在去噪过程中提供重叠感知监督，序列级交叉熵作为基础重建信号。
Result: 在 ActivityNet-RTL、ActivityNet-1.3、THUMOS-14 上，MDVLM-TAL 相对自回归视觉-语言基线同时提升时序推理与边界定位，在更严格的 temporal IoU 判据下增益尤其显著；代码发布于 github.com/ycwfs/MDVLM-TAL。
Conclusion: 让时间边界与语义内容在去噪中联合精修、并用 IoU 感知的逐步监督对齐训练目标，是 TAL 超越自回归视觉-语言解码的可行路径，严格 IoU 判据下优势最大。

papers.title: Unification and Optimization of Robust Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Robust learning methods such as distributionally robust optimization, vicinal risk minimization, Mixup, and label smoothing address different sources of uncertainty, including distribution shift, finite-sample effects, and label uncertainty. In practice, however, several such sources may occur simultaneously, and it remains unclear which robust method or combination of methods to use. We introduce a unified framework that organizes a broad class of robustness methods along explicit design axes and makes their relations and combinations explicit within a shared formulation. Within this framework, we analyze how robustness methods interact: some are redundant under particular modeling assumptions, whereas others yield genuinely distinct solution families, and these relationships can change with the model class or loss. We further derive a tractable training procedure that exposes the design choices and their strengths as tunable hyperparameters. Across vision and reward-modeling tasks, the preferred robustness method depends on the task, target metric, and validation data, while suitably selected combinations often outperform the best single method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 DRO、vicinal risk minimization、Mixup、label smoothing 等鲁棒监督学习方法统一到一个显式设计轴框架中，分析它们何时冗余、何时产生真正不同的解族，并给出把设计选择暴露为可调超参数的训练流程。在视觉与 reward modeling 任务上，最优鲁棒方法随任务、目标指标和验证数据而变，而恰当选择的组合常优于最好的单一方法。
Motivation: 分布偏移、有限样本效应、标签不确定性等多种不确定性来源在实践中同时出现，现有鲁棒方法各管一段，不清楚该选哪种或如何组合。
Method: 提出统一框架，沿显式设计轴组织一大类鲁棒方法并在共享形式化中刻画其关系与组合；分析方法间交互（特定建模假设下冗余、否则属不同解族，且关系随模型类或损失改变）；导出可处理的训练过程，把设计选择作为可调超参数暴露出来。
Result: 在视觉与 reward modeling 任务上，首选鲁棒方法取决于任务、目标指标与验证数据；恰当选择的组合常优于最佳单一方法。
Conclusion: 鲁棒方法的选择与组合应按任务、指标和验证数据来定，统一框架使这些设计选择成为可调超参数。

papers.title: C-MIG: Multi-view Information Gain-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Clinical Diagnosis Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) trained with reinforcement learning (RL) is a promising way to ground large language models in medical evidence for clinical diagnosis. However, existing RAG-RL methods face two problems: (1) their process reward is largely singleview, as most methods inherited from opendomain multi-hop QA reward only the quality of the retrieved information; (2) assigning a reliable process reward is hard, as hard matching gives zero to clinically correct but non-verbatim steps such as "Allergic Sinusitis" versus "Allergic Rhinitis", and the alternative of strong-teacher guiding is bounded by the teacher's own medical competence. To address these issues, we propose C-MIG, a Multiview Information Gain-based framework for Clinical diagnosis. We identify two complementary and crucial intermediate steps in clinical diagnosis: what to retrieve and how to refine. We reward both by the information gain each brings, measured as the increase in the predicted likelihood of the ground-truth answer under a base, frozen reference model. The frozen scorer yields a stable and reproducible reward that needs no extra reward model or teacher. Experiments on four medical benchmarks show that C-MIG outperforms RAGRL baselines in and out of domain and stays competitive with far larger medical-specialist and general-purpose LLMs, at only about 3.4% training overhead and no inference-time cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: C-MIG 用信息增益同时奖励临床诊断中的「检索什么」与「如何精炼」两步，奖励定义为在冻结参考模型下真实答案预测似然的提升，从而绕开硬匹配与强教师引导的缺陷。在四个医学基准上，它在域内与域外均超过 RAG-RL 基线，训练开销约 3.4%，推理时零额外成本。
Motivation: 现有 RAG-RL 的过程奖励多为单视角、只评检索质量；硬匹配会把临床上正确但非逐字的步骤（如 Allergic Sinusitis 对 Allergic Rhinitis）判为零分，而强教师引导受限于教师自身的医学能力。
Method: C-MIG 识别临床诊断中「what to retrieve」与「how to refine」两个互补中间步骤，用各自带来的信息增益作为过程奖励，度量方式是在一个基础、冻结的参考模型下真实答案预测似然的增量；冻结打分器提供稳定可复现的奖励，无需额外奖励模型或教师。
Result: 在四个医学基准上，C-MIG 在域内与域外均优于 RAG-RL 基线，并与体量大得多的医学专科及通用 LLM 保持竞争力；训练开销约 3.4%，推理时无额外成本。
Conclusion: 以冻结参考模型上的答案似然增益作为多视角过程奖励，可以在不引入奖励模型或教师的前提下提升临床诊断 RAG-RL 的域内外表现，且代价极低。

papers.title: Capability $\neq$ Interpretability: Human Interpretability of Vision Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: How interpretable are the features of leading vision models? The question is increasingly pressing as these models move from research benchmarks into high-stakes deployments, yet existing methods cannot answer it reliably. We address this gap with a framework for measuring and comparing the human interpretability of vision models, built around two complementary psychophysics protocols: (1) localizability---can an observer predict where a feature fires on a novel image?---and (2) semanticity---can an observer accurately describe what the feature represents? Features are recovered via sparse autoencoders, and a chance-anchored scoring function places every model on a common scale. Applying the framework to six vision transformers---two supervised ViTs and four foundation models (DINOv2, DINOv3, CLIP, SigLIP)---we collected more than $15{,}000$ behavioral responses, of which we analyzed $13{,}400$ responses from the $377$ participants who passed our pre-specified quality checks. We find that foundation models are consistently $less$ interpretable than their size-matched supervised counterparts, and the gap is not a capability tradeoff: interpretability does not correlate with downstream task performance on any benchmark we examine. What does correlate is the locality of a feature's activations and coarse-grained semantic alignment with humans---models with focal activations and representations that reflect the world's broad categorical structure tend to produce more interpretable features. The two protocols yield strongly correlated rankings and share the same predictors, establishing interpretability as an independent, measurable dimension of representation quality---and, surprisingly, one on which the foundation models we tested fall below their size-matched supervised baseline. Capability alone cannot close that gap, but locality and coarse-grained alignment might.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出测量视觉模型人类可解释性的框架，用 localizability 与 semanticity 两套心理物理协议加 chance-anchored 打分，把六个 ViT 放到同一量表上。结果发现 foundation model（DINOv2、DINOv3、CLIP、SigLIP）比同规模监督 ViT 更不可解释，且可解释性与下游任务性能不相关，真正相关的是特征激活的局部性 (locality) 与和人类的粗粒度语义对齐。
Motivation: 视觉基础模型正进入高风险部署，但现有方法无法可靠回答其特征对人类是否可解释，缺少可比较的度量。
Method: 用 sparse autoencoders 恢复特征，配两套心理物理协议：localizability（观察者能否预测特征在新图上何处激活）与 semanticity（能否准确描述特征含义），再用 chance-anchored 打分函数把所有模型放到共同量表；在 377 名通过预设质量检查的参与者上收集行为反应。
Result: 在六个 vision transformer（两个监督 ViT 与 DINOv2、DINOv3、CLIP、SigLIP 四个 foundation model）上收集超过 15,000 条行为反应，分析其中 13,400 条；foundation model 一致地比同规模监督模型更不可解释，可解释性与所检验任一下游任务基准的表现都不相关，而与特征激活局部性和粗粒度语义对齐正相关，两套协议给出的排名强相关且共享相同预测因子。
Conclusion: 可解释性是表征质量的一个独立、可测维度，单靠能力提升无法缩小 foundation model 与监督基线的差距，局部性和粗粒度对齐才可能缩小它。

papers.title: OScaR: The Occam's Razor for Extreme KV Cache Quantization in LLMs and Beyond
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement toward long-context reasoning and multi-modal intelligence has made the memory footprint of the Key-Value (KV) cache a dominant memory bottleneck for efficient deployment. While the established per-channel quantization effectively accommodates intrinsic channel-wise outliers in Key tensors, its efficacy diminishes under extreme compression. In this work, we revisit the inherent limitations of the per-channel quantization paradigm from both empirical and theoretical perspectives. Our analysis identifies Token Norm Imbalance (TNI) as the primary bottleneck to quantization fidelity. We demonstrate that TNI systematically amplifies errors when shared quantization parameters are required to span token groups exhibiting substantial norm disparities. Instead of relying on intricate quantization pipelines (e.g., TurboQuant), we propose OScaR (Omni-Scaled Canalized Rotation), an accurate and lightweight KV cache compression framework for X-LLMs (i.e., text-only, multi-modal, and omni-modal LLMs). Advancing the per-channel paradigm, OScaR employs Canalized Rotation followed by Omni-Token Scaling to mitigate TNI-induced sequence-dimensional variance both effectively and efficiently, further supported by our optimized system design and CUDA kernels. Extensive evaluations across X-LLMs show that OScaR consistently outperforms existing methods and achieves near-lossless performance under INT2 quantization, establishing it as a robust, low-complexity, and universal framework that defines a new Pareto front. Compared with the BF16 FlashDecoding-v2 baseline, our OScaR implementation achieves a notable up to 3.0x speedup in decoding, reduces memory footprint by 5.3x, and increases throughput by 4.1x. The code for OScaR is publicly available at https://github.com/ZunhaiSu/OScaR-KV-Quant.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 长上下文与多模态推理使 KV cache 成为部署的主要显存瓶颈；per-channel 量化虽能处理 Key 的通道离群值，但在极端压缩下因共享量化参数需覆盖范数差异大的 token 组而失效。
Method: 先诊断 TNI 为量化保真度瓶颈，再用 Canalized Rotation 加 Omni-Token Scaling 缓解 TNI 引起的序列维方差，配合优化的系统设计与 CUDA kernel，避免 TurboQuant 一类复杂流水线。
Result: 在 X-LLMs 上一致优于现有方法，INT2 量化下接近无损；相对 BF16 FlashDecoding-v2 基线，解码加速最高 3.0x，显存占用降至 1/5.3，吞吐提升 4.1x。
Conclusion: TNI 是极端 KV 量化的主要误差来源，用轻量的旋转加缩放即可在低复杂度下建立新的 Pareto 前沿，适用于文本、多模态与全模态 LLM。

papers.title: MOCHA: Multi-Objective Chebyshev Annealing for Agent Skill Optimization
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents organize behavior through skills -- structured natural-language specifications that govern how an agent reasons, retrieves, and responds. Unlike monolithic prompts, skills are multi-field artifacts with platform limits: descriptions are indexed for routing, instruction bodies are loaded into a shared context window, and every extra line costs the agent context it could spend elsewhere. Skill optimization is therefore inherently multi-objective: a skill should be accurate and economical at once. Existing prompt optimizers collapse these goals into a single score, and we find that this makes them stall: in most of their runs, 1000 rollouts yield zero progress over the seed skill. We introduce MOCHA (Multi-Objective CHebyshev Annealing), which selects skills to improve by Chebyshev scalarization and accepts improvements that expand the Pareto front, annealing from exploration to exploitation. Chebyshev scalarization scores a skill by its largest weighted shortfall from a perfect skill; with random weights, it can select any skill on the Pareto front for improvement, including trade-offs that an average would never favor. Across six diverse skills and two models, MOCHA escapes the seed in nearly every run, achieving 7.9% higher mean accuracy than the strongest baseline (up to 23.7% on DebugBench with GPT 5.5 and 14.9% on FEVER with Claude Haiku 4.5) while discovering Pareto fronts with the highest hypervolume and nearly twice as many Pareto-optimal skills.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MOCHA 用 Chebyshev 标量化加 Pareto 前沿接受准则做 LLM agent 技能的多目标优化（准确率 vs 上下文开销），并从探索退火到利用。在六个技能、两个模型上，基线优化器多数运行中 1000 次 rollout 相对种子技能零进展，而 MOCHA 几乎每次都能逃离种子，平均准确率比最强基线高 7.9%。
Motivation: 现有 prompt 优化器把准确率与上下文经济性压成单一分数，导致多数运行在 1000 次 rollout 内相对种子技能毫无进展，多目标技能优化因此停滞。
Method: MOCHA（Multi-Objective CHebyshev Annealing）以 Chebyshev 标量化给技能打分，取其相对完美技能的最大加权短板，随机权重可选中 Pareto 前沿上任意点（含均值标量化不会偏好的折中）；只接受能扩展 Pareto 前沿的改进，并按探索到利用的退火调度选择待改进技能。
Result: 在六个多样化技能与两个模型上，MOCHA 几乎每次运行都逃离种子技能；平均准确率比最强基线高 7.9%，其中 DebugBench + GPT 5.5 最高提升 23.7%，FEVER + Claude Haiku 4.5 提升 14.9%；所得 Pareto 前沿 hypervolume 最高，Pareto 最优技能数量接近基线的两倍。
Conclusion: 把准确率与上下文开销作为多目标、用 Chebyshev 标量化加前沿扩展接受，可以打破单分数 prompt 优化的停滞，同时得到更宽的 Pareto 技能集。

papers.title: BrainDyn: A Sheaf Neural ODE for Forecasting and Generating Brain Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Brain activity unfolds as coordinated patterns across regions over time, and modeling these dynamics is a central goal in computational neuroscience. Because activity is distributed over connected brain regions, it is naturally represented on a graph whose nodes are brain regions or recording electrodes and whose edges capture relationships between these nodes, with message-passing modeling regional communication. However, standard message-passing networks place every node in a single shared feature space and typically aggregate messages from neighbors by scalar summation, which does not align with neurobiological evidence of brain communication. In order to model the heterogeneous nature of the brain, we introduce BrainDyn, a graph ordinary differential equation (ODE) network built on a cellular sheaf with dynamic restriction maps, recomputed from the forecasting context window rather than fixed once, mediating region-to-region communication through learned linear transformations that drive the time evolution of neural activity. We evaluate BrainDyn on resting-state fMRI, EEG, and simulated activity from the NEST simulator. Across these modalities, we test multi-region forecasting and autoregressive generation of brain transients, and, using NEST, prediction of altered transients following controlled perturbations. BrainDyn outperforms competing models across modalities, while analysis of the learned features shows that they are expressive, interpretable, and biologically aligned.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BrainDyn 用带动态限制映射 (dynamic restriction maps) 的胞腔层 (cellular sheaf) 图神经 ODE 建模脑区活动：每个脑区保留独立特征空间，区际通信由从预测上下文窗口重算的线性变换中介，而非共享嵌入加标量求和。在静息态 fMRI、EEG 与 NEST 模拟活动上做多区域预报和脑瞬变的自回归生成，并在 NEST 上预测受控扰动后的改变瞬变，各模态均胜过对比模型，学到的特征被分析为可表达、可解释且与生物学一致。
Motivation: 标准消息传递网络把所有节点放进同一共享特征空间、用标量求和聚合邻居消息，与神经生物学证据中脑通信的异质性不符，难以刻画分布式脑区活动的协调动态。
Method: 构建建立在胞腔层上的图 ODE 网络：节点为脑区或记录电极，边刻画节点关系；限制映射 (restriction maps) 是动态的、由预测上下文窗口重算而非一次固定，通过学习到的线性变换中介区际通信并驱动神经活动的时间演化。评测覆盖静息态 fMRI、EEG 与 NEST 模拟活动三种模态，任务为多区域预报、脑瞬变自回归生成，以及用 NEST 预测受控扰动后的改变瞬变。
Result: 在静息态 fMRI、EEG 和 NEST 模拟活动三种模态上，多区域预报与自回归生成均胜过对比模型；在 NEST 上还能预测受控扰动后的改变瞬变。对学到的特征的分析显示其具有表达力、可解释性并与生物学对齐。
Conclusion: 用动态限制映射取代共享节点嵌入与标量求和聚合，能让图神经 ODE 更贴合脑通信的异质性，从而在多模态脑动态预报与生成上统一优于对比模型。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Symmetry-Compatible Principle for Optimizer Design: Embeddings, LM Heads, SwiGLU MLPs, and MoE Routers
papers.abstract_en: A striking geometric disparity has long persisted in the practice of deep learning. While modern neural network architectures naturally exhibit rich symmetry and equivariance properties, popular optimizers such as Adam and its variants operate inherently coordinate-wise, rendering them unable to respect the equivariance structures of the parameter space. We address this disparity by introducing a symmetry-compatible principle for optimizer design: the gradient update rule should be equivariant under the symmetry group acting on the corresponding weight block. Following this principle, we first provide a unified perspective on bi-orthogonally equivariant updates for general matrix layers, as employed by stochastic spectral descent, Muon, Scion, and polar gradient methods. More importantly, by moving from orthogonal groups to permutation and shared-shift symmetries, we derive symmetry-compatible optimizers for parameter blocks whose symmetries differ from those of general matrix layers: embedding and LM head matrices, SwiGLU MLP projections, and MoE router matrices. These constructions include one-sided spectral, row-norm, hybrid row-norm/spectral, row-aware, column-aware, centered row-norm, and left-spectral updates. They yield an end-to-end layerwise optimizer stack in which each major matrix-valued parameter class is assigned an update whose equivariance matches its symmetry group. We corroborate this principle through pre-training experiments on dense and sparse MoE language models, including Qwen3-0.6B-style, Gemma 3 1B-style, OLMoE-1B-7B-style, and downsized gpt-oss architectures. Across these experiments, symmetry-compatible update rules consistently improve final validation loss, reduce expert load imbalance in sparse MoE models, and in several cases control final vocabulary-logit growth, improve router stability, and overall training stability over the corresponding AdamW updates.
papers.journal_ref: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出优化器设计的对称性兼容原则：权重块的梯度更新规则应在该块对称群作用下等变。据此为 embedding/LM head、SwiGLU 投影和 MoE router 推导出对称匹配的更新规则，并在 Qwen3-0.6B、Gemma 3 1B、OLMoE-1B-7B 与缩小版 gpt-oss 的稠密与稀疏 MoE 预训练中一致改善最终验证损失、降低专家负载不均。
Motivation: 现代网络结构天然具有等变与对称性，而 Adam 及其变体按坐标独立更新，无法尊重参数空间的等变结构，架构几何与优化器几何长期脱节。
Method: 原则为更新规则对权重块的对称群等变；先统一正交双等变更新（stochastic spectral descent、Muon、Scion、polar gradient 方法），再把正交群推广到置换与共享平移对称，导出单侧谱、行范数、混合行范数/谱、行感知、列感知、中心行范数与左谱等更新，组成逐层优化器栈。
Result: 在稠密与稀疏 MoE 语言模型预训练（Qwen3-0.6B-style、Gemma 3 1B-style、OLMoE-1B-7B-style、缩小版 gpt-oss）中，对称兼容更新相对 AdamW 一致改善最终验证损失，降低稀疏 MoE 的专家负载不均，并在若干情形下抑制最终词表 logit 增长、改善 router 稳定性与整体训练稳定性。
Conclusion: 把每类矩阵参数的更新规则与其对称群匹配，可在稠密与稀疏 MoE 预训练中相对 AdamW 同时改善损失、专家负载与训练稳定性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OmniSelect: Dynamic Modality-Aware Token Compression for Efficient Omni-modal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Omnimodal large language models (OmniLLMs) have recently gained increasing attention for unified audio-video understanding. However, processing long multimodal token sequences introduces substantial computational overhead, making efficient token compression crucial. Existing methods typically rely on fixed, modality-specific guidance, which fails to account for the varying importance of modalities across different queries. To address this limitation, we propose $\textbf{OmniSelect}$, a training-free, modality-adaptive token pruning framework that dynamically selects appropriate compression strategies for multimodal inputs. Specifically, we leverage a lightweight AudioCLIP model to estimate cross-modal relevance and categorize each input into three pruning regimes: Audio-Centric, Video-Centric, and Uniform pruning. Based on these relevance scores, OmniSelect further performs fine-grained token pruning within each temporal group, adaptively allocating pruning ratios to preserve informative tokens across modalities. By explicitly modeling modality preference and enabling dynamic strategy selection, OmniSelect effectively avoids the pitfalls of one-size-fits-all compression. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves efficient multimodal token reduction while maintaining strong performance, without requiring any additional training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniSelect 是面向全模态大模型 (OmniLLM) 的免训练、模态自适应 token 剪枝框架：用轻量 AudioCLIP 估计跨模态相关性，把输入分到 Audio-Centric、Video-Centric、Uniform 三种剪枝体制，再在各时间组内按相关性分数自适应分配剪枝比例。它在保持音频-视频理解性能的同时减少多模态 token 数，且无需任何额外训练。
Motivation: 长多模态 token 序列带来很大计算开销，而现有 token 压缩方法依赖固定的、按模态划分的剪枝指引，无法反映不同查询下各模态重要性的变化，容易出现一刀切压缩的失效。
Method: 训练-free 流程：先用轻量 AudioCLIP 模型估计跨模态相关性分数，据此把每条输入分类到 Audio-Centric、Video-Centric、Uniform 三种剪枝体制之一；再在每个时间组 (temporal group) 内做细粒度 token 剪枝，按相关性自适应分配各模态的剪枝比例以保留信息性 token。
Result: 在音频-视频理解实验中实现高效的多模态 token 剪枝，同时保持强性能，且不需要任何额外训练；摘要以定性方式报告该权衡，未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 按查询动态选择剪枝体制并按模态分配剪枝比例，可以避开固定模态指引的一刀切压缩，在免训练条件下同时拿到 token 减少与性能保持。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Njord: A Probabilistic Graph Neural Network for Ensemble Ocean Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Ocean dynamics are inherently chaotic, yet existing machine learning ocean models produce only deterministic forecasts. We introduce Njord, a probabilistic data-driven model for ocean forecasting, applicable to both global and regional domains. Njord combines a deep latent variable framework with a graph neural network architecture, enabling sampling each forecast step in a single forward pass. We apply Njord globally at 0.25° resolution and regionally to the Baltic Sea at 2 km resolution. To scale to these large ocean grids we introduce K-means cluster meshes that adapt to irregular sea surface geometry. Experiments demonstrate strong performance on both domains compared to deterministic machine learning baselines, while also providing uncertainty estimates from the sampled ensemble forecasts. On the global OceanBench benchmark, Njord achieves the lowest errors on average across upper-ocean variables when evaluated against real-world observations, with the largest improvements in surface temperature prediction.
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/deinal/njord
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Njord 用深度潜变量 (deep latent variable) 加图神经网络 (GNN) 把确定性 ML 海洋预报改成概率集合预报，每个预报步只需一次前向采样即可生成集合。在全球 0.25° 与波罗的海 2 km 两个域上，它相对确定性 ML 基线取得更低误差，并给出集合不确定性估计；在 OceanBench 上按真实观测评估时上层海洋变量平均误差最低，海表温度改善最大。
Motivation: 海洋动力本质混沌，但现有数据驱动海洋模型只输出确定性预报，无法给出不确定性，也缺少能同时覆盖全球与区域不规则海面网格的建模方式。

Result: 在全球与波罗的海两个域上，相对确定性 ML 基线表现更强，并提供采样集合的不确定性估计；在 OceanBench 全球基准上按真实观测评估，上层海洋变量平均误差最低，其中海表温度 (surface temperature) 改善最大。

papers.title: GQLA: Group-Query Latent Attention for Hardware-Adaptive Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Decoding efficiency depends on KV-cache traffic, computation, and parallelism. Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) offers absorbed and head-expanded forms, but its head-specific projections limit grouped KV sharing. We introduce Group-Query Latent Attention (GQLA), whose group-shared up-projections preserve a joint latent and enable a shardable expanded cache. The same weights support equivalent MQA-absorb and GQA execution using existing kernels. Roofline analysis relates path preference to GPU compute-to-bandwidth ratio and tensor parallelism (TP): absorption trades traffic for computation and replicates the latent across ranks; GQA shards KV groups. Pretraining with eight query heads per group yields terminal training losses close to MLA's across the tested model scales at matched tokens. TransGQLA converts GQA and MLA checkpoints using calibration data. Without gradient updates, converted DeepSeek-V3.1-Base achieves 77.79% eight-task accuracy versus the source's 77.84%, while WikiText-2 perplexity rises from 3.21 to 6.05. On eight H20-3e GPUs, its GQA path improves output throughput over MQA-absorb by 22.42--34.97% at matched resident batches across 8K--64K inputs. Its smaller per-rank cache permits larger batches, giving 50.07% in a separate capacity-tuned comparison. These results support multiple execution paths as an architectural means of adapting decoding to hardware and parallelism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Group-Query Latent Attention (GQLA)：用组共享 up-projection 保留联合 latent，使 MLA 同时支持可分片的 GQA 执行与 MQA-absorb 路径，同一套权重走现有 kernel。TransGQLA 用校准数据零梯度转换检查点，DeepSeek-V3.1-Base 八任务精度 77.79%（源模型 77.84%），WikiText-2 perplexity 3.21→6.05；在 8 张 H20-3e 上 GQA 路径输出吞吐比 MQA-absorb 高 22.42–34.97%（8K–64K 输入、匹配常驻 batch），容量调优下再高 50.07%。
Motivation: MLA 的 head 专属投影限制了 KV 共享，吸收式与展开式缓存各有取舍，解码效率受 KV-cache 流量、计算与并行度制约，缺少按硬件与张量并行度 (TP) 切换执行路径的注意力设计。
Method: GQLA 用组共享 up-projection 形成联合 latent 并支持可分片的展开缓存，同一权重可用现有 kernel 走 MQA-absorb 或 GQA 执行；以 roofline 分析把路径选择关联到 GPU 算带宽比与 TP。预训练时每组 8 个 query head，TransGQLA 借助校准数据在无梯度更新下把 GQA/MLA 检查点互相转换。
Result: 在所测模型规模与匹配 token 下，每组 8 query head 的预训练终态损失接近 MLA；零梯度转换的 DeepSeek-V3.1-Base 八任务精度 77.79% 对源模型 77.84%，WikiText-2 perplexity 由 3.21 升至 6.05。8 张 H20-3e 上，匹配常驻 batch 时 GQA 路径在 8K–64K 输入上输出吞吐比 MQA-absorb 高 22.42–34.97%；更小的每 rank 缓存允许更大 batch，容量调优对比中高出 50.07%。
Conclusion: 多执行路径是让解码适配硬件与并行度的可行架构手段：按 GPU 算带宽比与 TP 在吸收式和 GQA 之间切换，可在几乎不损失精度的前提下换取吞吐。

papers.title: TurboVGGT: Fast Visual Geometry Reconstruction with Adaptive Alternating Attention
papers.abstract_en: Recent feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods, such as visual geometry transformers, have substantially advanced the traditional per-scene optimization paradigm by enabling effective multi-view reconstruction in a single forward pass. However, most existing methods struggle to achieve a balance between reconstruction quality and computational efficiency, which limits their scalability and efficiency. Although some efficient visual geometry transformers have recently emerged, they typically use the same sparsity ratio across layers and frames and lack mechanisms to adaptively learn representative tokens to capture global relationships, leading to suboptimal performance. In this work, we propose TurboVGGT, a novel approach that employs an efficient visual geometry transformer with adaptive alternating attention for fast multi-view 3D reconstruction. Specifically, TurboVGGT employs an end-to-end trainable framework that leverages adaptive sparse global attention guided by adaptive sparsity selection to capture global relationships across frames and uses frame attention to aggregate local details within each frame. In the adaptive sparse global attention, TurboVGGT adaptively learns representative tokens with varying sparsity levels for global geometry modeling, considering that token importance varies across frames, different attention layers operate on tokens at different levels of abstraction, and global dependencies rely on structurally informative regions. Extensive experiments on multiple 3D reconstruction benchmarks demonstrate that TurboVGGT achieves fast multi-view reconstruction while maintaining competitive reconstruction quality compared with state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TurboVGGT 用自适应交替注意力做快速多视角 3D 重建：全局注意力按自适应稀疏选择学习不同稀疏度的代表性 token 跨帧建模几何，帧注意力在单帧内聚合局部细节。在多个 3D 重建基准上以更快的多视角重建达到与 SOTA 竞争的重建质量。
Motivation: 前馈式视觉几何 Transformer 在单次前向里完成多视角重建，但重建质量与计算效率难以兼顾；已有高效变体在各层、各帧用同一稀疏率，且缺少自适应学习代表性 token 的机制，导致性能次优。
Method: 端到端可训练框架，交替使用两种注意力：自适应稀疏全局注意力（adaptive sparse global attention）由自适应稀疏选择（adaptive sparsity selection）引导，按 token 重要性随帧而异、不同层处于不同抽象层级、全局依赖依赖结构信息丰富区域这三点，学习不同稀疏度的代表性 token 跨帧建模全局几何；帧注意力 (frame attention) 在每帧内聚合局部细节。
Result: 在多个 3D 重建基准上，TurboVGGT 实现快速多视角重建，同时重建质量与 SOTA 方法相比具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 把稀疏率做成随帧、随层、随区域自适应的量，而非全网统一常数，可以在保持重建质量的前提下提升视觉几何 Transformer 的速度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Why Latent Actions Fail, and How to Prevent It
papers.abstract_en: Latent action models (LAMs) aim to learn action-like representations from unlabeled videos by compressing frame-to-frame changes. The frames of in-the-wild videos, however, contain not only the agent's own state but exogenous state such as background clutter. Since the exogenous state introduces changes unrelated to actions, it hinders reliable latent action learning. This paper investigates this problem analytically by extending a linear LAM framework to explicitly model exogenous state. Our analysis reveals two insights: (1) minimizing the standard reconstruction objective produces latent actions that encode exogenous information from future observation; and (2) learning in a representation space that focuses on endogenous components is a key to mitigating the interference of noise. We further show that previously proposed auxiliary objectives, such as action-supervision, provably encourage latent actions to be consistent across exogenous states. These findings are validated through experiments on both linear and nonlinear LAMs, providing a unified theoretical analysis of how exogenous state hinders latent action learning and why common remedies work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 野外视频帧里除智能体自身状态外还含背景杂波等外生状态 (exogenous state)，标准重建目标会把未来观测中的外生信息编码进隐动作 (latent action)。分析表明在只关注内生成分的表示空间中学习可缓解噪声干扰，而动作监督等辅助目标能被证明促使隐动作跨外生状态保持一致；结论在非线性 LAM 实验中得到验证。
Motivation: 野外无标注视频的帧间变化混入与动作无关的外生状态，使隐动作学习不可靠；此前缺少对这一干扰机制的统一理论刻画。
Method: 把线性 LAM 框架扩展为显式建模外生状态，对标准重建目标做解析分析；再论证动作监督 (action-supervision) 等已有辅助目标为何能促使隐动作跨外生状态一致，并在非线性 LAM 上实验验证。
Result: 两条理论结论：最小化标准重建目标得到的隐动作会编码来自未来观测的外生信息；在聚焦内生成分的表示空间中学习是缓解噪声干扰的关键。辅助目标被证明促使隐动作跨外生状态一致，且在线性与非线性 LAM 上均有实验验证。
Conclusion: 外生状态对隐动作学习的干扰可由统一的线性理论解释，常见补救手段（如动作监督）之所以有效，是因为它们强制隐动作跨外生状态一致。

papers.title: Learning, Fast and Slow: Towards LLMs That Adapt Continually
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are trained for downstream tasks by updating their parameters (e.g., via RL). However, updating model parameters forces them to absorb task-specific information, which can result in catastrophic forgetting and loss of plasticity. In contrast, in-context learning with fixed LLM parameters can cheaply and rapidly adapt to task-specific requirements (e.g., prompt optimization), but cannot by itself typically match the performance gains available through updating LLM parameters. Inspired by how human learning works at multiple time scales (e.g., System 1 vs 2), we propose a fast-slow learning framework for LLMs, instantiated with model parameters as "slow" weights and optimized context as "fast" weights. These fast "weights" can learn from textual feedback to absorb the task-specific information, while allowing slow weights to stay closer to the base model and persist general reasoning behaviors. Fast-Slow Training (FST) is up to 3x more sample-efficient than only slow learning (RL) across reasoning tasks, while consistently reaching a higher performance asymptote. Moreover, FST-trained models remain closer to the base LLM (up to 70% less KL divergence), resulting in less catastrophic forgetting than RL-training. This reduced drift also preserves plasticity: after training on one task, FST trained models adapt more effectively to a subsequent task. In continual learning scenarios, where task domains change on the fly, FST continues to acquire each new task while RL stalls.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 23 figures, including appendix; Blog post: https://gepa-ai.github.io/gepa/blog/2026/05/11/learning-fast-and-slow/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出快慢学习框架 Fast-Slow Training (FST)：把模型参数当作慢权重、把优化后的上下文当作快权重，快权重从文本反馈吸收任务信息，慢权重保持贴近 base model。在推理任务上 FST 比只用 RL 的慢学习最多省 3 倍样本并达到更高性能渐近线，KL 散度最多低 70%，灾难性遗忘更少，任务域随时切换的持续学习中 RL 停滞而 FST 仍能持续习得新任务。
Motivation: 用 RL 更新 LLM 参数会把任务信息压进权重，导致灾难性遗忘与可塑性 (plasticity) 丧失；纯 in-context learning 虽便宜快速，却通常追不上参数更新带来的性能增益。
Method: 受人类 System 1/System 2 多时间尺度学习启发，FST 以模型参数为慢权重、以优化后的上下文为快权重：快权重从文本反馈中吸收任务特定信息，慢权重被约束保持在 base model 附近以保留通用推理行为；对照基线是仅做慢学习的 RL 与 prompt optimization 式 in-context learning。
Result: 在推理任务上，FST 的样本效率最高为仅慢学习 (RL) 的 3 倍，并持续达到更高的性能渐近线；FST 训练出的模型与 base LLM 的 KL 散度最多低 70%，灾难性遗忘少于 RL；在单任务训练后切换到后续任务时适应更好，任务域在线切换的持续学习场景中 RL 停滞而 FST 继续习得每个新任务。
Conclusion: 把任务特定信息放进可优化的上下文而非权重，可以在保留可塑性与通用推理的同时持续习得新任务，参数更新应让位于快慢分工。

summary_sections.motivation: 用 RL 更新 LLM 参数会把任务信息压进权重，导致灾难性遗忘与可塑性 (plasticity) 丧失；纯 in-context learning 虽便宜快速，却通常追不上参数更新带来的性能增益。
summary_sections.method: 受人类 System 1/System 2 多时间尺度学习启发，FST 以模型参数为慢权重、以优化后的上下文为快权重：快权重从文本反馈中吸收任务特定信息，慢权重被约束保持在 base model 附近以保留通用推理行为；对照基线是仅做慢学习的 RL 与 prompt optimization 式 in-context learning。
summary_sections.result: 在推理任务上，FST 的样本效率最高为仅慢学习 (RL) 的 3 倍，并持续达到更高的性能渐近线；FST 训练出的模型与 base LLM 的 KL 散度最多低 70%，灾难性遗忘少于 RL；在单任务训练后切换到后续任务时适应更好，任务域在线切换的持续学习场景中 RL 停滞而 FST 继续习得每个新任务。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把任务特定信息放进可优化的上下文而非权重，可以在保留可塑性与通用推理的同时持续习得新任务，参数更新应让位于快慢分工。

papers.title: A proximal gradient algorithm for composite log-concave sampling
papers.abstract_en: We propose an algorithm to sample from composite log-concave distributions over $\mathbb{R}^d$, i.e., densities of the form $π\propto e^{-f-g}$, assuming access to gradient evaluations of $α_f$-convex $f$ and a restricted Gaussian oracle (RGO) for $α_g$-convex $g$, where $α_g \ge 0$. The latter requirement means that we can easily sample from the density $\text{RGO}_{g,h,y}(x) \propto \exp(-g(x) -\frac{1}{2h}||y-x||^2)$, which is the sampling analogue of the proximal operator for $g$. If $f + g$ is $α$-convex and $f$ is $β$-smooth, our sampler achieves $\varepsilon$ error in total variation distance using $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(κ\sqrt d \log^4(1/\varepsilon))$ oracle calls where $κ:= 1 \vee β/α$, with $0\le α_g \le β$ and $α:= α_f + α_g > 0$, which matches prior state-of-the-art results for the case $g=0$. We further extend our results to cases where (1) $π$ is non-log-concave but satisfies a Poincaré or log-Sobolev inequality, and (2) $f$ is non-smooth but Lipschitz.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种针对复合 log-concave 分布 π ∝ exp(-f-g) 的近端梯度采样算法：对光滑凸 f 用梯度，对凸 g 用受限高斯 oracle (RGO)，即采样版近端算子。在 f+g 为 α-凸、f 为 β-光滑时，达到总变差 ε 误差需 Õ(κ√d log⁴(1/ε)) 次 oracle 调用，κ = 1 ∨ β/α，与 g=0 的已有最好结果同阶；并可推广到满足 Poincaré/log-Sobolev 不等式的非 log-concave 情形与 f 非光滑但 Lipschitz 的情形。
Motivation: 复合 log-concave 采样中，g 仅有近端型访问（RGO）而无梯度时，缺少与光滑情形同阶的复杂度保证。
Method: 算法对 α_f-凸的 f 使用梯度评估，对 α_g-凸的 g 使用受限高斯 oracle RGO_{g,h,y}(x) ∝ exp(-g(x) - ||y-x||²/(2h))，即近端算子的采样类比；在 f+g 为 α-凸、f 为 β-光滑、0 ≤ α_g ≤ β、α = α_f + α_g > 0 的条件下给出复杂度界，并扩展到非 log-concave 但满足 Poincaré 或 log-Sobolev 不等式、以及 f 非光滑但 Lipschitz 的情形。
Result: 总变差距离 ε 误差所需 oracle 调用数为 Õ(κ√d log⁴(1/ε))，κ := 1 ∨ β/α，与 g=0 的已有 state-of-the-art 结果匹配；适用条件为 0 ≤ α_g ≤ β 且 α = α_f + α_g > 0。
Conclusion: 以 RGO 作为 g 的采样版近端算子，可在复合 log-concave 采样中保持与 g=0 情形同阶的 √d·log⁴(1/ε) 复杂度，并可放宽到非 log-concave（Poincaré/log-Sobolev）与非光滑 Lipschitz f。

papers.title: Split the Differences, Pool the Rest: Provably Efficient Multi-Objective Imitation
papers.abstract_en: This work investigates multi-objective imitation learning: the problem of recovering policies that lie on the Pareto front given demonstrations from multiple Pareto-optimal experts in a Multi-Objective Markov Decision Process (MOMDP). Standard imitation approaches are ill-equipped for this regime, as naively aggregating conflicting expert trajectories can result in dominated policies. To address this, we introduce Multi-Output Augmented Behavioral Cloning (MA-BC), an algorithm that systematically partitions divergent expert data while pooling state-action pairs where no behavior conflict is observed. Theoretically, we prove that MA-BC converges to Pareto-optimal policies at a faster statistical rate than any learner that considers each expert dataset independently. Furthermore, we establish a novel lower bound for multi-objective imitation learning, demonstrating that MA-BC is minimax optimal. Finally, we empirically validate our algorithm across diverse discrete environments and, guided by our theoretical insights, extend and evaluate MA-BC on a continuous Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) control task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多目标马尔可夫决策过程 (MOMDP) 中，直接混合多个 Pareto 最优专家的冲突轨迹会得到被支配的策略；MA-BC 按行为冲突切分专家数据、在无冲突处池化状态-动作对，从而收敛到 Pareto 最优策略，且统计速率快于逐专家独立学习的任何学习器，并在多目标模仿学习上达到 minimax 最优。
Motivation: 多目标模仿需要从多个 Pareto 最优专家恢复前沿上的策略，而标准模仿方法简单聚合相互冲突的专家轨迹会产出被支配的策略。
Method: 提出 Multi-Output Augmented Behavioral Cloning (MA-BC)：系统性切分存在行为冲突的专家数据，只在无冲突处池化状态-动作对；理论上证明其收敛速率快于任何独立处理各专家数据集的学习器，并给出多目标模仿学习的新下界。
Result: 证明 MA-BC 收敛到 Pareto 最优策略的统计速率快于任何逐专家独立学习的算法，并由新下界证明其 minimax 最优；在多种离散环境上做实证验证，并据理论洞察扩展到连续 Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) 控制任务上评估。
Conclusion: 按冲突切分、无冲突池化是多目标模仿中既保 Pareto 最优又达 minimax 最优的可行设计，理论速率优势可迁移到连续 LQR 控制。

papers.title: Selection, Not Fusion: Radar-Modulated State Space Models for Radar-Camera Depth Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Radar camera depth estimation turns a very sparse but metric radar signal into a dense depth map. Existing methods combine radar and image features outside the sequence operator of the backbone, through concatenation, confidence gating, sparse supervision, or graph based extraction. Mamba variants for multimodal fusion also leave the selection mechanism itself unimodal. We argue that selection is the right place for radar to enter. We introduce Radar-Modulated Selection (RMS), which injects radar inside the selective scan of Mamba. Radar adds learned perturbations, initialised at zero, to the step size $Δ$ and the readout $\mathbf{C}$. The input projection $\mathbf{B}$ and the state matrix $\mathbf{A}$ never see radar. At initialisation the block equals a pretrained image Mamba, so radar gains influence only where it improves accuracy. The construction also couples the two modalities at linear cost and falls back to the image backbone when radar is missing. We deploy RMS in a Multi-View Scan Pyramid (MVSP) that matches the fusion operator to the reach of radar at each scale. On nuScenes, SemoDepth reduces MAE by 34.0%, 29.9%, and 29.9% over the previous best within 50, 70, and 80 m. It also has the lowest single frame latency among methods with a public release (26.8 ms). A feature blend placed before the scan adds no accuracy on top of RMS, which supports the view that selection inside the scan can replace fusion outside it. When twice as many spurious radar returns as true ones are injected, the MAE@80 of SemoDepth rises by 1.4%, against 33.6% for a Mamba baseline that fuses radar before the scan.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 16 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Radar-Modulated Selection (RMS)：把雷达信号注入 Mamba 的 selective scan 内部，只调制步长 Δ 与读出 C，输入投影 B 和状态矩阵 A 不接触雷达，初始为零扰动，因此初始等价于预训练图像 Mamba，雷达缺失时可回退到纯图像骨干。在 nuScenes 上 SemoDepth 将 50、70、80 m 内 MAE 相对先前最优分别降低 34.0%、29.9%、29.9%，单帧延迟 26.8 ms 为公开实现中最低；注入两倍于真实回波的虚假雷达回波时 MAE@80 仅升 1.4%，而 scan 前融合的 Mamba 基线升 33.6%。
Motivation: 现有雷达-相机深度估计都在骨干序列算子之外做融合（拼接、置信门控、稀疏监督、图提取），Mamba 多模态变体的选择机制仍是单模态的，雷达的稀疏但带尺度信息的信号没有进入选择本身。
Method: RMS 在 Mamba 的 selective scan 内给 Δ 和 C 加上零初始化的可学习雷达扰动，B 与 A 保持纯图像；再部署 Multi-View Scan Pyramid (MVSP)，按各尺度上雷达的作用范围匹配融合算子。整体模型名为 SemoDepth，线性代价耦合两模态。
Result: nuScenes 上 SemoDepth 在 50、70、80 m 内的 MAE 相对 previous best 分别降低 34.0%、29.9%、29.9%；在有公开实现的方法中单帧延迟最低，为 26.8 ms。在 scan 前加特征混合在 RMS 之上不再带来精度增益。注入两倍于真实回波的虚假雷达回波时，SemoDepth 的 MAE@80 上升 1.4%，scan 前融合雷达的 Mamba 基线上升 33.6%。
Conclusion: 雷达应当进入选择机制内部而非在 scan 之外做融合：scan 内的选择可以取代 scan 外的融合，并且对虚假雷达回波显著更稳健。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: CORTEG: Foundation Models Enable Cross-Modality Representation Transfer from Scalp to Intracranial Brain Recordings
papers.abstract_en: Intracranial electrocorticography (ECoG) offers high signal-to-noise access to cortical activity for brain-computer interfaces, yet limited per-patient data has led most prior work to rely on small, subject-specific decoders that neglect information shared across patients. We investigate whether large pretrained scalp-EEG foundation models (EEG FMs) can be adapted to ECoG, enabling cross-patient learning and competitive decoding performance while calibrating to a held-out patient in 10-30 minutes on a single GPU. We introduce CORTEG, a cross-modality transfer framework that combines a pretrained EEG FM backbone, an electrode-aware KNNSoftFourier spatial adapter, a dual-stream tokenizer for low-frequency and high-gamma activity, and a leave-one-subject-out fine-tuning strategy. We evaluate CORTEG on two challenging regression tasks: public finger-trajectory regression ($n=9$) and private audio-envelope regression ($n=16$). CORTEG achieves state-of-the-art mean performance on both tasks, achieving the highest mean correlation among the compared methods on the public finger benchmark and larger, statistically significant gains on the audio task and in low-data-per-patient calibration. We further validate CORTEG on the public BrainTreebank stereo-EEG classification tasks, where it also performs strongly. Furthermore, CORTEG outperforms the compared intracranial-EEG foundation models across the continuous regression tasks. Feature analyses align with neurophysiology, and latent representations capture low-dimensional finger-movement structure. Together, these results provide systematic evidence that scalp-EEG pretraining can be repurposed across intracranial recording modalities and tasks, enabling data-efficient neural decoders that can adapt to new patients.
papers.comment: Camera-ready version with new BrainTree Bank experiments and comparisons with iEEG FMs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CORTEG 把预训练 scalp-EEG 基础模型跨模态迁移到 ECoG，用 electrode-aware KNNSoftFourier 空间适配器、低频/高 gamma 双流 tokenizer 与 leave-one-subject-out 微调实现跨患者解码，单 GPU 上 10–30 分钟即可校准到留出患者。在手指轨迹回归 (n=9)、音频包络回归 (n=16) 与 BrainTreebank sEEG 分类上均取得所比方法中的最优平均表现，且在连续回归任务上超过所比的颅内 EEG 基础模型。
Motivation: ECoG 信噪比高但每位患者数据量小，既有工作只能训小型个体化解码器，无法利用跨患者共享信息。
Method: CORTEG 以预训练 EEG FM 为骨干，接 electrode-aware KNNSoftFourier 空间适配器与分离低频和高 gamma 的双流 tokenizer，用 leave-one-subject-out 微调；在手指轨迹回归与音频包络回归两个回归任务上评测，并在 BrainTreebank stereo-EEG 分类任务上验证。
Result: 在公开手指轨迹回归 (n=9) 上取得所比方法中最高平均相关；在音频包络回归 (n=16) 上增益更大且统计显著，在低数据量患者校准场景下同样显著；在连续回归任务上优于所比的颅内 EEG 基础模型；BrainTreebank sEEG 分类上表现强劲；校准到留出患者仅需 10–30 分钟单 GPU。
Conclusion: scalp-EEG 预训练表征可以跨颅内记录模态与任务复用，得到数据高效、可快速适配新患者的神经解码器；特征分析与神经生理一致，潜表征捕捉到手指运动的低维结构。

papers.title: TIDES: Implicit Time-Awareness in Selective State Space Models
papers.abstract_en: Selective state space models (SSMs), such as Mamba, achieve strong per-token expressivity by making the time discretization step $\TildeΔ$ a learned function of the input. However, in doing so, $\TildeΔ$ no longer equals the physical time gap $Δ$ between consecutive observations, limiting the ability of these models to handle irregular time series. Continuous time SSMs, such as S5, keep $\TildeΔ\equivΔ$ and therefore handle irregular timestamps natively, but their dynamics remain linear time invariant (LTI), limiting per token expressivity. We propose \textbf{TIDES}, a selective SSM variant that reconciles selective and continuous architectures by moving input dependence off the step size and onto the diagonal state matrix. As a result, $\TildeΔ\equivΔ$ as in S5, allowing the model to handle irregular timestamps natively without sacrificing the per-token expressivity that makes selective SSMs effective. We show this on a novel \emph{Fading Flash} experimental benchmark, a compact controlled diagnostic for sequence models that jointly tests input dependence and extrapolation to out-of-distribution $Δ$ values, and isolates the distinct failure modes of current state-of-the-art architectures that TIDES avoids by construction. On large-scale benchmarks, TIDES sets the new best average rank on UEA time series classification and the Physiome ODE regression benchmark, and matches or exceeds the reference baseline model on 6 of 8 natively irregular datasets from astronomy, agriculture, neuromorphic sensing, and climate events. papers.title: TabFORGE: A Tabular Foundation Model for Generative Modelling
papers.abstract_en: Generative modelling is a demanding test of foundation models, because it requires robust, holistic representation learning for a given data modality, rather than optimisation for a supervised prediction target alone. While recent work on tabular foundation models has achieved remarkable progress in predictive modelling, generative tabular foundation models remain underexplored. Existing tabular foundation generators, in particular, have not yet consistently matched strong dataset-specific generators in synthetic data quality. A key reason is their insufficient alignment with the inter-feature dependency structure of tabular data, which can reflect underlying causal relationships. In this paper, we address this gap by introducing a novel tabular foundation model, \textbf{TabFORGE}, built on pretrained \textbf{Tab}ular \textbf{FO}undational \textbf{R}epresentations for \textbf{GE}neration. TabFORGE is designed to utilise transferable representations induced by a pretrained structure-aware feature encoder, which captures information useful for characterising inter-feature dependencies. It further decouples latent modelling from decoding through a two-stage design: we first pretrain a score-based diffusion transformer, and then pretrain a denoising-aligned decoder using the denoised latent embeddings. This design elegantly mitigates the distribution shifts in latent embeddings that typically arise between training and inference. We evaluate TabFORGE comprehensively against 22 benchmark methods on 45 real-world datasets. Our results show that TabFORGE effectively learns and leverages generalisable tabular representations, enabling efficient generation of high-quality synthetic tabular data, particularly with strong structural fidelity. Code is available at https://github.com/SilenceX12138/TabFORGE.
papers.comment: Accepted by the Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TabFORGE 用预训练的结构感知特征编码器提取可迁移表征，并把潜变量建模与解码解耦为两阶段：先预训练 score-based diffusion transformer，再用去噪后的潜嵌入预训练去噪对齐解码器，从而消除训练与推理之间的潜嵌入分布偏移。在 45 个真实数据集上对 22 个基准方法的综合评测中，它生成的合成表格数据质量高，尤其在结构保真度（structural fidelity）上强，即更好地保持了特征间依赖结构。
Motivation: 现有表格基础生成器在合成数据质量上尚未稳定追平针对单一数据集的专用生成器，关键原因是与表格数据的特征间依赖结构（可反映潜在因果关系）对齐不足。
Method: TabFORGE 基于预训练的 Tabular Foundational Representations for Generation：结构感知特征编码器捕捉刻画特征间依赖的信息；两阶段解耦设计先预训练 score-based diffusion transformer，再用其去噪后的潜嵌入预训练 denoising-aligned decoder，以缓解训练与推理间的潜嵌入分布偏移。
Result: 在 45 个真实世界数据集上与 22 个 benchmark 方法综合对比，TabFORGE 学到并利用可泛化的表格表征，能高效生成高质量合成表格数据，尤其在结构保真度上表现强。
Conclusion: 把结构感知表征与两阶段潜变量-解码解耦结合，可以让表格基础生成器在合成数据质量上（尤其结构保真度）具备竞争力。

papers.title: Few-Shot Truly Benign DPO Attack for Jailbreaking LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning APIs make frontier LLMs easy to customize, but they can also weaken safety alignment during fine-tuning. While prior work shows that benign supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can reduce refusal behavior, deployed fine-tuning pipelines increasingly support preference-based objectives, whose safety risks remain less understood. We show that Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) introduces a stronger and harder-to-audit failure mode. We propose a truly benign DPO attack using only 10 harmless preference pairs, the minimum data scale accepted by OpenAI's fine-tuning service. Each pair contains a benign prompt, a normal helpful answer as the preferred response, and a refusal as the dispreferred response. Unlike prior benign fine-tuning attacks, our data exhibits no suspicious behavior: it is practically indistinguishable from the fine-tuning request of a legitimate user seeking to reduce over-refusal, making harmful intent almost impossible to infer from the request alone. Nevertheless, because DPO directly optimizes the model to prefer helpful answers over refusals, this seemingly benign objective broadly suppresses refusal behavior and transfers to harmful prompts outside the fine-tuning data. Across OpenAI models supporting DPO fine-tuning, our attack achieves attack success rates of 59.13% on GPT-4o, 70.20% on GPT-4.1, 54.80% on GPT-4.1-mini, and 81.73% on GPT-4.1-nano, at costs of only \$1.7, \$1.7, \$0.3, and \$0.1. Moreover, on open-weight models that do not impose minimum data requirements, we find that this effect can emerge from even a single benign preference pair.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用仅 10 对无害偏好数据（OpenAI 微调服务的最小数据量）对支持 DPO 的前沿模型做「真正良性的」越狱攻击：每对样本以正常有用回答为偏好、拒答为不偏好，请求本身与降低过度拒答的合法用户无法区分，却会普遍压制拒答并迁移到微调数据之外的有害提示。攻击成功率 GPT-4o 59.13%、GPT-4.1 70.20%、GPT-4.1-mini 54.80%、GPT-4.1-nano 81.73%，成本仅 $1.7、$1.7、$0.3、$0.1；开放权重模型上单对良性偏好数据即可触发该效应。
Motivation: 微调 API 让前沿 LLM 易于定制，也可能在微调过程中削弱安全对齐；已有工作只证明良性 SFT 会减少拒答，而部署中的微调管线越来越多采用偏好目标，其安全风险尚不清楚。
Method: 提出 truly benign DPO attack：仅用 10 对无害偏好对（良性 prompt、正常有用回答为 preferred、拒答为 dispreferred），通过 DPO 直接优化模型偏好有用回答而非拒答；数据在请求层面与合法降低过度拒答的微调请求实际不可区分。
Result: 在支持 DPO 微调的 OpenAI 模型上攻击成功率 (ASR) 分别为 GPT-4o 59.13%、GPT-4.1 70.20%、GPT-4.1-mini 54.80%、GPT-4.1-nano 81.73%，成本依次为 $1.7、$1.7、$0.3、$0.1；在无最小数据量要求的开放权重模型上，单对良性偏好数据即可产生该效应。
Conclusion: DPO 构成比良性 SFT 更强、更难审计的失效模式：看似良性的偏好目标会广泛抑制拒答并迁移到有害提示，且恶意意图几乎无法从微调请求本身推断。

papers.title: LEAP: Unlocking dLLM Parallelism via Lookahead Early-Convergence Token Detection
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Language Models (dLLMs) have garnered significant attention for their potential in highly parallel processing. The parallel capabilities of existing dLLMs stem from the assumption of conditional independence at high confidence levels, which ensures negligible discrepancy between the marginal and joint distributions. However, the stringent confidence thresholds required to preserve accuracy severely constrain the scalability of parallelism. Through systematic token-level statistical analysis, we reveal that a substantial proportion of tokens converge to their correct predictions early in the denoising process yet fail to reach standard confidence thresholds, confirming that current confidence-based criteria are overly conservative. In response, we introduce LEAP (Lookahead Early-Convergence Token Detection for Accelerated Parallel Decoding). LEAP is a training-free, plug-and-play method that leverages future context filtering and multi-sequence superposition to detect early-converging tokens. By validating the alignment between early convergence and correctness, we enable reliable early decoding of these tokens. Benchmarking across diverse domains demonstrates that LEAP significantly lowers inference latency and decoding steps. Compared to confidence-based decoding, the average number of denoising steps is reduced by about 30%. On the GSM8K dataset, combining LEAP with dParallel accelerates decoding to 7.2 tokens per step while preserving model precision. LEAP effectively breaks the reliance on high-confidence priors, offering a novel paradigm for parallel decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LEAP 指出 dLLM 并行解码的高置信度阈值过于保守：大量 token 在去噪早期就已收敛到正确预测却达不到阈值。它用未来上下文过滤与多序列叠加检测这些 early-converging token 并提前解码，相比基于置信度的解码平均去噪步数减少约 30%，在 GSM8K 上与 dParallel 结合达到 7.2 tokens/step 且保持精度。
Motivation: 现有 dLLM 的并行能力依赖高置信度下条件独立假设，但保住精度所需的严苛置信度阈值严重限制了并行度与解码速度。
Method: 提出 training-free、即插即用的 LEAP (Lookahead Early-Convergence Token Detection)：通过 token 级统计分析确认早期收敛现象，再用未来上下文过滤 (future context filtering) 与多序列叠加 (multi-sequence superposition) 检测 early-converging token，并校验早期收敛与正确性的对齐后提前解码。
Result: 在多领域 benchmark 上显著降低推理延迟与解码步数：相比基于置信度的解码，平均去噪步数减少约 30%；在 GSM8K 上 LEAP 与 dParallel 结合把解码加速到 7.2 tokens/step，同时保持模型精度。
Conclusion: 高置信度先验并非并行解码的必要条件，检测早期收敛 token 即可可靠地提前解码，为 dLLM 并行解码提供新范式。

papers.title: Generative Actor-Critic with Soft Bridge Policies
papers.abstract_en: Expressive generative policies such as diffusion and flow models are appealing for maximum-entropy (MaxEnt) online reinforcement learning because of their ability to model multimodal and highly non-Gaussian action distributions. However, training effective soft generative policies faces two obstacles that often arise together. First, marginal action densities are often unavailable, so existing methods typically rely on entropy bounds, heuristic proxies or approximations. Second, iterative shared-parameter samplers raise inference cost and require backpropagation through time over repeated network evaluations, increasing memory cost and potentially destabilizing policy optimization. These obstacles motivate us to seek a generative actor-critic method that exposes a tractable soft objective while generating each action in just one network evaluation. To this end, we propose soft generative actor-critic (SoftGAC), whose actor is a single stochastic feedforward network with internal Gaussian bridge layers. This explicit bridge structure allows us to lift the soft objective to path space, yielding an analytical path-KL regularizer against a high-entropy reference process for both actor improvement and the soft Bellman bootstrap, without estimating the endpoint entropy. Crucially, the actor generates each action in only one network evaluation under a total parameter budget comparable to strong baselines, substantially reducing inference cost relative to the existing iterative diffusion and flow policies. It also avoids long unrolled backpropagation through time. Across challenging continuous-control benchmarks, our method achieves competitive or superior returns compared with strong diffusion and flow policies, demonstrating a clear advantage in the compute-return tradeoff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SoftGAC：把带内部高斯桥层 (Gaussian bridge layers) 的单次前向随机 actor 的软目标提升到路径空间，用解析的 path-KL 正则替代端点熵估计，每个动作只需一次网络评估。在有挑战的连续控制基准上，回报相对强扩散/流策略持平或更优，同时显著降低推理开销，占优的是 compute-return 权衡。
Motivation: MaxEnt 在线强化学习里，扩散/流这类生成策略能建模多峰非高斯动作分布，但边缘动作密度不可得，只能靠熵界或启发式代理；迭代共享参数采样器又带来高推理成本与沿重复网络评估的 BPTT 内存开销，并可能 destabilize 策略优化。
Method: SoftGAC 的 actor 是带内部高斯桥层的单个随机前馈网络，把软目标提升到 path space，得到针对高熵参考过程的解析 path-KL 正则，同时用于 actor 改进与 soft Bellman bootstrap，无需估计端点熵；总参数量与强基线相当，动作生成只需一次网络评估，且避免长展开的 BPTT。
Result: 在有挑战的连续控制基准上，回报与强扩散和流策略相当或更优；每个动作仅一次网络评估，推理成本相对现有迭代扩散/流策略大幅下降，并在 compute-return 权衡上显示明确优势。
Conclusion: 用可解析的路径空间正则加单次前向的桥结构生成 actor，可以在不估端点熵的前提下拿到软目标，从而同时保住生成策略的表达力并甩掉迭代采样的推理与 BPTT 开销。

summary_sections.motivation: MaxEnt 在线强化学习里，扩散/流这类生成策略能建模多峰非高斯动作分布，但边缘动作密度不可得，只能靠熵界或启发式代理；迭代共享参数采样器又带来高推理成本与沿重复网络评估的 BPTT 内存开销，并可能 destabilize 策略优化。
summary_sections.method: SoftGAC 的 actor 是带内部高斯桥层的单个随机前馈网络，把软目标提升到 path space，得到针对高熵参考过程的解析 path-KL 正则，同时用于 actor 改进与 soft Bellman bootstrap，无需估计端点熵；总参数量与强基线相当，动作生成只需一次网络评估，且避免长展开的 BPTT。
summary_sections.result: 在有挑战的连续控制基准上，回报与强扩散和流策略相当或更优；每个动作仅一次网络评估，推理成本相对现有迭代扩散/流策略大幅下降，并在 compute-return 权衡上显示明确优势。
summary_sections.conclusion: 用可解析的路径空间正则加单次前向的桥结构生成 actor，可以在不估端点熵的前提下拿到软目标，从而同时保住生成策略的表达力并甩掉迭代采样的推理与 BPTT 开销。

papers.title: Attention Transfer Is Not Universally Effective for Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: A recent work shows that Attention Transfer, which transfers only the attention patterns from a pre-trained teacher Vision Transformer (ViT) to a randomly initialized standard student ViT, is sufficient to recover the full benefit of the teacher's pre-trained weights. We revisit this finding on a comprehensive benchmark of 20 teachers from 11 well-known ViT families and reveal that Attention Transfer is not universally effective. While 7 families transfer successfully, 4 consistently fail, falling up to 5.1\% below the from-scratch no-transfer baseline. Further results demonstrate that this failure is family-consistent across model sizes, and persists under extended training durations, different transfer datasets, and out-of-distribution evaluations. Controlled analyses then consistently localize the problem to the attention-routing channel, indicating that the key issue is not whether the student can match the teacher's attention patterns, but whether the matched patterns remain functional for the student. Crucially, we identify architectural mismatch between the pre-trained teacher and the standard student as the primary mechanism. By adding only the teacher's native architectural components to the student in a randomly initialized state, we completely reverse the failure for all 4 families. Notably, these components alone do not improve from-scratch training, confirming that they specifically unlock the usability of the teacher's attention. We further show that this failure is not explained by the inadequate choice of transfer loss, differences in pre-training recipes, or the intrinsic quality of attention maps. Our findings refine the prevailing understanding of attention in ViT representations: attention is sufficient \textit{only} when the student architecture matches the teacher.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 11 个 ViT 家族共 20 个 teacher 的基准上复核 Attention Transfer：7 个家族成功迁移，4 个家族稳定失败，最差比从零训练不迁移的基线还低 5.1%。失败源于 teacher 与标准 student 的架构不匹配，把 teacher 原生架构组件以随机初始化方式加进 student 后，4 个失败家族全部反转；结论是 attention 只有在 student 架构与 teacher 匹配时才充分。
Motivation: 近期工作声称仅迁移 attention pattern 就足以复现 teacher 预训练权重的全部收益，但该结论缺少跨家族的系统检验，若不成立会误导蒸馏实践。
Method: 在覆盖 11 个知名 ViT 家族、20 个 teacher 的综合基准上重测 Attention Transfer；用受控分析把问题定位到 attention-routing 通道，并通过只给 student 加入 teacher 原生架构组件（随机初始化）来检验机制，同时排除 transfer loss 选择、预训练 recipe 差异与 attention map 质量三种解释。
Result: 20 个 teacher 中 7 个家族迁移成功、4 个家族持续失败，最差比 from-scratch no-transfer 基线低 5.1%；失败在不同模型规模、更长训练时长、不同 transfer 数据集与分布外评测下均持续存在，且按家族一致。给 student 加入 teacher 原生架构组件后 4 个失败家族全部反转，而这些组件单独用于 from-scratch 训练并无提升。
Conclusion: Attention Transfer 并非普适有效：关键不在 student 能否匹配 teacher 的 attention pattern，而在匹配后的 pattern 对 student 是否可用，充分性以 student 架构与 teacher 匹配为前提。

papers.title: From Causal Graphs to Markovian States: Multi-Order State Exposure for Deep RL
papers.abstract_en: Online reinforcement learning (RL) relies on the Markov property for guaranteed performance, but real-world applications often lack well-defined states given raw observed variables. While causal RL has attracted growing interest, existing work typically assumes Markovian states are provided and uses causality only to accelerate learning. This leaves a fundamental gap: \emph{given a longitudinal causal graph over observed variables, how does one construct MDP states that provably satisfy the Markov property?} We provide a procedure that constructs a provably minimal such state. In deep RL, the minimal representation alone empirically fails to improve performance, indicating that neural networks cannot automatically exploit Markovian minimality. We therefore propose \textbf{MOSE} (Multi-Order State Exposure), which exposes a single shared Q-function to history-based state constructions of orders 1 through $W$ simultaneously. An attention-based selection layer scores the dimensions of this combined input by their estimated relevance to value-function estimation and selects the high-scoring ones. Causal MOSE further constrains the selection layer to retain every variable of the minimal state, guaranteeing sufficiency while leaving the model free to admit useful redundancy. MOSE consistently outperforms both the minimal state construction and single-window policies on common benchmarks and synthetic datasets. Including the minimal representation alongside MOSE can further improve performance. Our results establish a core principle for causal deep RL: minimal sufficiency is not enough. \emph{Controlled redundancy} gives the model flexibility to learn its state representation end-to-end. Causal state information provides structural guidance that can make this learning more efficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在给定观测变量纵向因果图的前提下，提出构造可证明满足 Markov 性的最小状态的流程，并进一步提出 MOSE（Multi-Order State Exposure）：让共享 Q 函数同时吃 1 到 W 阶历史状态，用注意力层按对价值估计的相关性打分选维，Causal MOSE 强制保留最小状态全部变量。最小状态单独用时在深度 RL 中经验上无法提升性能，MOSE 则在常见 benchmark 与合成数据上稳定超过最小状态构造与单窗口策略，且再并入最小表示还能进一步提升。
Motivation: 在线 RL 依赖 Markov 性，但真实场景只有原始观测变量、没有良定义状态；现有因果 RL 假设 Markov 状态已给定，只用因果加速学习，缺少从因果图构造可证明 Markov 状态的流程。
Method: 先由纵向因果图构造可证明最小的 MDP 状态；再提出 MOSE，把 1 到 W 阶历史状态拼接后交给单一共享 Q 函数，用基于 attention 的选择层对各维按其对价值函数估计的相关性打分并保留高分维；Causal MOSE 额外约束选择层必须保留最小状态的全部变量，保证充分性同时允许冗余。
Result: 最小表示单独接入深度 RL 时经验上无法提升性能；MOSE 在常见 benchmark 与合成数据上一致优于最小状态构造与单窗口策略；在 MOSE 中再加入最小表示可进一步提升性能。
Conclusion: 因果深度 RL 的核心原则是最小充分性不够，需要受控冗余让模型端到端学状态表示，而因果状态信息提供让这一学习更高效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Security-Auditable LLM Agents: A Unified Graph Representation
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agentic systems are rapidly evolving to perform complex autonomous tasks through dynamic tool invocation, stateful memory management, and multi-agent collaboration. However, this semantics-driven execution paradigm creates a severe semantic gap between low-level physical events and high-level execution intent, making post-hoc security auditing fundamentally difficult. Existing representation mechanisms, including static SBOMs and runtime logs, provide only fragmented evidence and fail to capture cognitive-state evolution, capability bindings, persistent memory contamination, and cascading risk propagation across interacting agents. To bridge this gap, we propose Agent-BOM, a unified structural representation for agent security auditing. Agent-BOM models an agentic system as a hierarchical attributed directed graph that separates static capability bases, such as models, tools, and long-term memory, from dynamic runtime semantic states, such as goals, reasoning trajectories, and actions. These layers are connected through semantic edges and security attributes, transforming fragmented execution traces into queryable audit paths. Building on Agent-BOM, we develop a graph-query-based paradigm for path-level risk assessment and instantiate it with the OWASP Agentic Top 10. We further implement an auditing plugin in the OpenClaw environment to construct Agent-BOM from live executions. Evaluation on representative real-world agentic attack scenarios shows that Agent-BOM can reconstruct stealthy attack chains, including cross-session memory poisoning and tool misuse, capability supply-chain hijacking and unexpected code execution, multi-agent ecosystem hijacking, and privilege and trust abuse. These results demonstrate that Agent-BOM provides a unified and auditable foundation for root-cause analysis and security adjudication in complex agentic ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Agent-BOM，把 LLM agent 系统表示为分层属性有向图，将静态能力基座（模型、工具、长期记忆）与动态运行时语义状态（目标、推理轨迹、动作）分层，用语义边和安全属性把碎片化执行痕迹变成可查询的审计路径。在 OpenClaw 环境实现插件从实时执行构建 Agent-BOM，可重建跨会话记忆投毒、工具滥用、能力供应链劫持、意外代码执行、多 agent 生态劫持与权限信任滥用等隐蔽攻击链。
Motivation: LLM agent 的语义驱动执行在底层物理事件与高层执行意图之间留下语义鸿沟，静态 SBOM 与运行时日志只给碎片证据，无法刻画认知状态演化、能力绑定、持久记忆污染与跨 agent 的风险级联，事后安全审计因此难以进行。
Method: Agent-BOM 将 agent 系统建模为分层属性有向图，静态能力层与动态运行时语义层由语义边和安全属性连接；在其上构建基于图查询的路径级风险评估范式，并用 OWASP Agentic Top 10 实例化；在 OpenClaw 环境实现审计插件，从实时执行中构造 Agent-BOM。
Result: 在代表性真实 agent 攻击场景上的评估显示，Agent-BOM 能重建隐蔽攻击链，覆盖跨会话记忆投毒与工具滥用、能力供应链劫持与意外代码执行、多 agent 生态劫持、权限与信任滥用四类。
Conclusion: 统一的图结构表示能把碎片执行痕迹转成可查询、可审计的路径，为复杂 agent 生态的根因分析与安全裁定提供统一且可审计的基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Medical Imaging Classification with Cold-Atom Reservoir Computing using Auto-Encoders and Surrogate-Driven Training
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a hybrid quantum-classical pipeline, based on neutral-atom reservoir computing, for medical image classification, focusing on the binary classification task of polyp detection. To deal effectively with the high dimensionality, we integrate a guided auto-encoder. This pipeline learns compact and discriminative representations of image data that are also well-suited for quantum reservoir computing. A key challenge in such systems is the non-differentiable nature of quantum measurements, which creates a 'gradient barrier' for standard training. We overcome this barrier by incorporating a differentiable surrogate model that emulates the quantum layer, enabling end-to-end backpropagation through the entire system. This guided training process is jointly optimized for classification accuracy and for faithful image recovery from the auto-encoder. The learned latent representations are encoded as pulse detuning parameters within a Rydberg Hamiltonian, and quantum embeddings are subsequently obtained through expectation values. These embeddings are then passed to a linear classifier. Our simulations show that this method outperforms some traditional approaches that use PCA or unguided autoencoders. We also conduct ablation studies to assess the impact of various quantum and training parameters, demonstrating the robustness and flexibility of our proposed pipeline for real-world medical imaging applications, even in the current NISQ era.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to the 2025 IEEE International Conference on Quantum AI (IEEE QAI). Supported by FCT and the Open Quantum Institute (OQI). v2: corrects the stated Rabi frequency to $Ω= 2π$ rad/$μ$s
papers.journal_ref: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Quantum Artificial Intelligence (QAI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于中性原子储层计算 (neutral-atom reservoir computing) 的混合量子-经典医学图像分类流程，用于息肉检测二分类：引导 auto-encoder 压缩表征，可微代理模型 (surrogate model) 替代不可微量子测量以实现端到端反向传播，潜变量编码为 Rydberg Hamiltonian 的脉冲失谐参数，期望值作为量子嵌入送入线性分类器。仿真中该方法优于使用 PCA 或无引导 auto-encoder 的传统做法，并通过消融检验量子与训练参数的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 量子储层计算中量子测量不可微，构成标准训练的梯度障碍；同时医学图像维度高，直接送入量子储层不合适。
Method: 引导 auto-encoder 学习紧凑且有判别力的图像表征，联合优化分类精度与图像重建保真度；用可微代理模型模拟量子层，使梯度可端到端反传；潜表征编码为 Rydberg Hamiltonian 的 pulse detuning 参数，量子嵌入由期望值得到后接线性分类器（Rabi 频率 Ω=2π rad/μs）。
Result: 仿真结果显示该流程优于采用 PCA 或无引导 auto-encoder 的传统方法；消融研究评估了多种量子与训练参数的影响，表明流程在 NISQ 时代下具鲁棒性与灵活性。
Conclusion: 用可微代理绕过量子测量的梯度障碍，可让量子储层分类流程端到端训练，并在息肉检测这类真实医学成像任务上取得竞争力表现。
