papers.title: Learning Dynamic Evidence Routes for Vision Transformer Probing
papers.abstract_en: Probing frozen vision transformers typically uses permutation-invariant aggregation (GAP or $\texttt{[CLS]}$), treating patch tokens as an unstructured set. Content-dependent probes such as self-attention are useful accuracy controls, but they do not expose a fixed token schedule or fixed position weights for auditing. We introduce SSMProbe, a probe of frozen vision transformers that learns a Sinkhorn patch route and reads it with a diagonal S4 decoder. The decoder's causal linear time-invariant (LTI) recurrence yields fixed position coefficients, exposing how patch arrangement interacts with sequential weighting. Held-out spatial predictability measures route organization beyond a location-bias null. On CUB and Cars, MAE, BEiT, DINOv2, and supervised ViT yield spatially organized routes with distinct readout profiles: DINOv2 is $\texttt{[CLS]}$-dominant, while MAE benefits from learned routing over fixed scans. On MAE/ImageNet, Sinkhorn reaches 70.33% accuracy, 5.55 percentage points above the strongest fixed scan.

papers.title: Topology-Aware Representation Alignment for Semi-Supervised Vision-Language Learning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models have shown strong performance, but they often generalize poorly to specialized domains. While semi-supervised vision-language learning mitigates this limitation by leveraging a small set of labeled image-text pairs together with abundant unlabeled images, existing methods remain fundamentally pairwise and fail to model the global structure of multimodal representation manifolds. Most existing topology-based alignment methods rely on persistence diagram matching, which neither guarantees geometric alignment nor uses the image-text pairing information central to vision-language learning. We propose Topology-Aware Representation Alignment for Semi-Supervised Vision-Language Learning (ToMA), a framework that uses persistent homology to decompose pairwise relations into $H_0$-death and $H_1$-birth relations and aligns them across modalities through available cross-modal correspondences. This lightweight decomposition captures both connectivity and cycle-closing structure without constructing 2-simplices. Experiments show clear improvements on remote sensing, while fashion results reveal strong gains in classification and particularly strong retrieval improvements for difficult queries. Additional analysis shows that ToMA provides more consistent gains than alternative topology-based objectives and that lightweight $H_1$-birth edges provide useful higher-order structural signals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ToMA 用 persistent homology 把成对图像-文本关系分解为 H0-death 与 H1-birth 两类关系，再借已有的跨模态对应关系在两模态间对齐，从而在不构造 2-simplex 的前提下同时刻画连通性与成环结构。在遥感与时尚数据集上分类与检索均提升，困难查询的检索改善尤其明显，且比其他基于拓扑的目标带来更一致的增益。
Motivation: 半监督视觉-语言学习只用少量标注图文对加大量无标注图像，但现有方法本质上是 pairwise 的，无法建模多模态表示流形的全局结构；已有拓扑对齐又依赖 persistence diagram matching，既不保证几何对齐，也用不上图文配对信息。
Method: 提出 ToMA（Topology-Aware Representation Alignment）：用 persistent homology 将 pairwise 关系分解为 H0-death 与 H1-birth 关系，通过可用的跨模态对应 (cross-modal correspondences) 在图像与文本模态间对齐；分解不构造 2-simplices，属轻量方案，并与其它拓扑目标做对比分析。
Result: 实验显示遥感 (remote sensing) 数据上有清晰提升；时尚 (fashion) 数据上分类增益明显，困难查询 (difficult queries) 的检索改善尤其强；分析表明 ToMA 比替代的拓扑目标带来更一致的增益，轻量的 H1-birth 边提供了有用的高阶结构信号。
Conclusion: 把成对关系按 H0-death/H1-birth 分解并借跨模态对应对齐，比 persistence diagram matching 更适合视觉-语言学习，且轻量的 H1-birth 边已足以提供有效的高阶结构信息。

papers.title: Dictionary learning for Kernel EDMD
papers.abstract_en: Studying nonlinear dynamical systems through their state space behavior can be challenging, and one possible alternative is to analyze them via their associated Koopman operator. This turns the nonlinear problem into a linear, infinite-dimensional one. To approximate the operator in finite dimensions, extended dynamic mode decomposition (EDMD) is a commonly used algorithm. It requires a finite list of functionals and a set of snapshots from the system to compute an approximation of the operator and its corresponding spectrum. Instead of choosing the list of functionals directly, it can be implicitly defined via kernels, a method known as kernel extended dynamic mode decomposition (kEDMD). However, one still needs to define the kernel and choose its parameter values. In this paper, we aim to streamline this process by extending dictionary learning for EDMD to kernel learning in kEDMD. By simplifying kEDMD, we show how to perform gradient-based optimization over the learnable kernel parameters and demonstrate that this method leads to useful kernels for the original kEDMD. The focus of our work is a method that takes a weighted list of kernels with randomly initialized values as input and outputs a list of kernels and parameter values suitable for approximating the Koopman operator of the underlying system. We demonstrate that unimportant kernels can be removed from the list by analyzing the weights in the weighted sum. We evaluate the method across several experiments, including the Duffing oscillator and the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation, showcasing the method's different strengths.
papers.journal_ref: Chaos:An.Interdisc.Jou.of.Nonlin.Sci. 36 (2026) 103123-1-20
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 EDMD 的字典学习推广到 kernel EDMD：对加权核列表中的可学习核参数做基于梯度的优化，并通过分析权重剔除不重要核，从而自动得到适合逼近底层系统 Koopman 算子的核与参数。在 Duffing 振子与 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 方程等实验中展示了该方法的不同优势。
Motivation: kEDMD 仍需人工定义核并挑选参数，字典选择的自由度只是从函数列表转移到了核上，阻碍了 Koopman 算子逼近的自动化。
Method: 输入为随机初始化的加权核列表，通过简化 kEDMD 使核参数可做基于梯度的优化，输出适用于逼近 Koopman 算子的核与参数；再检查加权和中的权重以移除不重要核。
Result: 在包括 Duffing oscillator 与 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation 在内的多个实验上评估，展示该方法的不同优势；摘要未给出定量指标数值。
Conclusion: 核参数可以像 EDMD 字典一样被学习而非手工指定，权重分析还能筛掉贡献小的核，从而简化 kEDMD 的使用流程。

papers.title: Ideological Bias in LLMs' Economic Causal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Do large language models (LLMs) exhibit systematic ideological bias when reasoning about economic causal effects? As LLMs are increasingly used in policy analysis and economic reporting, where directionally correct causal judgments are essential, this question has direct practical stakes. We present a systematic evaluation by extending the EconCausal benchmark with ideology-contested cases - instances where intervention-oriented (pro-government) and market-oriented (pro-market) perspectives predict divergent causal signs. From 10,490 causal triplets (treatment-outcome pairs with empirically verified effect directions) derived from top-tier economics and finance journals, we identify 1,056 ideology-contested instances and evaluate 20 state-of-the-art LLMs on their ability to predict empirically supported causal directions. We find that ideology-contested items are consistently harder than non-contested ones, and that across 17 of 20 models, accuracy is systematically higher when the empirically verified causal sign aligns with intervention-oriented expectations than with market-oriented ones. Moreover, when models err, their incorrect predictions disproportionately lean intervention-oriented, and this directional skew is not eliminated by one-shot in-context prompting. These results highlight that LLMs are not only less accurate on ideologically contested economic questions, but systematically less reliable in one ideological direction than the other, underscoring the need for direction-aware evaluation in high-stakes economic and policy settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 扩展 EconCausal 基准，加入 1,056 个意识形态争议案例（干预导向与市场导向预期给出相反因果符号），评测 20 个前沿 LLM 的经济因果方向判断。争议项一致更难，且 20 个模型中 17 个在实证符号符合干预导向预期时准确率更高；出错时错误也系统性偏向干预导向，单次 in-context prompting 无法消除该方向性偏斜。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多用于政策分析与经济报道，这类场景要求因果判断方向正确；但模型在意识形态争议的经济问题上是否在某一方向上系统性更不可靠，此前缺少针对性评测。
Method: 在 EconCausal 基准上扩展出 ideology-contested 子集：从顶级经济学与金融期刊的 10,490 个因果三元组（treatment-outcome 对，实证效应方向已验证）中筛出 1,056 个干预导向与市场导向预期分歧的实例，用 20 个 SOTA LLM 预测实证支持的因果方向，并测试单次 in-context prompting。
Result: 意识形态争议项一致难于非争议项；20 个模型中 17 个在实证因果符号与干预导向预期一致时准确率系统性更高；模型出错时错误预测不成比例地偏向干预导向，该方向性偏斜不被 one-shot in-context prompting 消除。
Conclusion: LLM 不仅在意识形态争议的经济问题上准确率更低，而且在两个意识形态方向上的可靠性不对称，高风险经济与政策场景需要 direction-aware evaluation。

papers.title: DiffTSP: A Conditional Discrete Diffusion Model for Knowledge Graph Triple Set Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Triple set prediction (TSP) aims to discover missing facts from an incomplete knowledge graph without predefined queries. Existing approaches typically construct the predicted set through triple-level scoring, sometimes preceded by entity pair filtering that can exclude valid missing facts. We propose DiffTSP, a conditional discrete diffusion model that formulates missing fact discovery as conditional subgraph generation. In each subgraph, DiffTSP directly predicts the missing relational structure without a separate entity pair selection stage. The model learns to generate masked target relation states at different corruption levels, with the observed support subgraph retained as conditioning context. Our structure-aware denoising network integrates a Relational Context Encoder, which captures local relational patterns through relation-guided message passing, and a Relational Graph Diffusion Transformer, which models broader structural interactions through relational attention. During generation, partially generated relations can also serve as provisional context for subsequent predictions. Experiments on three public datasets demonstrate improved TSP performance over strong baselines. Additional analyses show lower conflict rates in the predicted triple sets relative to the evaluated baselines. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DiffTSP-0F92/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiffTSP 把知识图谱三元组集合预测 (TSP) 改写成条件子图生成：在保留观测支撑子图作条件的前提下，用离散扩散直接生成被掩码的关系结构，跳过会漏掉有效缺失事实的实体对筛选。在三个公开数据集上 TSP 性能优于强基线，且预测三元组集合的冲突率更低。
Motivation: 现有 TSP 方法靠三元组打分逐条构造预测集合，常先做实体对过滤，而这一步可能直接排除掉合法的缺失事实；同时逐条打分难以保证集合内部结构一致。
Method: 条件离散扩散模型：以观测支撑子图为条件上下文，在不同 corruption level 上学习生成被掩码的目标关系状态；结构感知去噪网络由 Relational Context Encoder（关系引导消息传递捕捉局部关系模式）与 Relational Graph Diffusion Transformer（关系注意力建模更大范围结构交互）组成，生成过程中已部分生成的关系可作为后续预测的临时上下文。
Result: 在三个公开数据集上，TSP 性能相对强基线均有提升；附加分析显示预测三元组集合的冲突率 (conflict rate) 低于所评估的基线。
Conclusion: 跳过独立的实体对选择、直接做条件子图生成，可以在不牺牲召回的前提下提高三元组集合的结构一致性。

papers.title: Causally-Constrained Probabilistic Forecasting for Time-Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection in multivariate time series is a central challenge in industrial monitoring, as failures frequently arise from complex temporal dynamics and cross-sensor interactions. While recent deep learning models, including graph neural networks and Transformers, have demonstrated strong empirical performance, most approaches remain primarily correlational and offer limited support for causal interpretation and root-cause localization. This study introduces a causally-constrained probabilistic forecasting framework which is a Causally Guided Transformer (CGT) model for multivariate time-series anomaly detection, integrating an explicit time-lagged causal graph prior with deep sequence modeling. For each target variable, a dedicated forecasting block employs a hard parent mask derived from causal discovery to restrict the main prediction pathway to graph-supported causes, while a latent Gaussian head captures predictive uncertainty. To leverage residual correlational information without compromising the causal representation, a shadow auxiliary path with stop-gradient isolation and a safety-gated blending mechanism is incorporated to suppress non-causal contributions when reliability is low. Anomalies are identified using negative log-likelihood scores with adaptive streaming thresholding, and root-cause variables are determined through per-dimension probabilistic attribution and counterfactual clamping. Experiments on the ASD and SMD benchmarks indicate that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art detection performance, with F1-scores of 96.19% on ASD and 95.32% on SMD, and enhances variable-level attribution quality. These findings suggest that causal structural priors can improve both robustness and interpretability in detecting deep anomalies in multivariate sensor systems.
papers.comment: This work is currently under review for possible publication in the IEEE Access journal. All intellectual property rights are retained by IEEE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出因果约束的概率预报框架 Causally Guided Transformer (CGT) 做多变量时间序列异常检测：用因果发现得到的时滞因果图作为硬父节点掩码，把每个变量的主预测通路限制在图支持的因上，再用潜在高斯头输出预测不确定性。在 ASD 与 SMD 基准上取得 SOTA 检测性能，F1 分别为 96.19% 与 95.32%，并提升变量级归因质量。
Motivation: 工业监测中故障源于复杂时序动态与跨传感器交互，而现有 GNN、Transformer 等深度检测方法主要是相关性的，难以做因果解释与根因定位。
Method: CGT 为每个目标变量设专用预报块：因果发现导出的硬父节点掩码限制主预测通路，潜在高斯头建模预测不确定性；另设带 stop-gradient 隔离与安全门控融合的影子辅助通路，利用残余相关性信息且在可靠性低时抑制非因果贡献。异常用负对数似然分数加自适应流式阈值判定，根因变量由逐维概率归因与反事实钳制 (counterfactual clamping) 确定。
Result: 在 ASD 基准上 F1 为 96.19%，在 SMD 基准上 F1 为 95.32%，摘要称达到 SOTA 检测性能，并提升变量级归因质量。
Conclusion: 因果结构先验可以同时提升多变量传感器系统深层异常检测的鲁棒性与可解释性，因果掩码与相关性辅助通路可以共存而不互相污染。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Latent Preference Modeling for Multi-Session Personalized Tool Calling
papers.abstract_en: Users often omit essential details in their requests to LLM-based agents, resulting in under-specified inputs for tool use. This poses a fundamental challenge for tool-augmented agents, as API execution typically requires complete arguments, highlighting the need for personalized tool calling. To study this problem, we present Multi-Session Personalized Tool Calling (MPT), a benchmark comprising 4,695 instances over 459 multi-session interaction histories that cover three challenges: Preference Recall, Induction, and Transfer. We further propose PRefine, a test-time memory method that maintains the user's latent preference as a textual hypothesis revised through a generate--verify--refine loop. Across five LLMs, existing memory systems often fail to improve on full-history prompting; PRefine outperforms all baselines and alone surpasses it on Preference Transfer. These results indicate that memory for personalized agents must abstract behavior into preferences, rather than simply archive it.
papers.comment: Under review. 27 pages, 14 figures, 19 tables. v2: revised benchmark construction and extended analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 工具调用中用户请求欠规范的问题，提出 MPT 基准（4,695 个实例、459 条多会话交互历史，覆盖 Preference Recall、Induction、Transfer 三项挑战）与测试时记忆方法 PRefine：把用户潜在偏好维护为文本假设，经 generate–verify–refine 循环修订。在五个 LLM 上，现有记忆系统常不如 full-history prompting，PRefine 超过全部基线，并在 Preference Transfer 上单独超过 full-history prompting。
Motivation: 用户常省略关键细节，使工具调用收到欠规范输入，而 API 执行要求完整参数；现有记忆系统把交互归档而非抽象成偏好，难以跨会话补全参数。
Method: 构建 MPT 基准，含 4,695 个实例、459 条多会话历史，任务分 Preference Recall、Induction、Transfer 三类；提出 PRefine 这一测试时记忆方法，将用户潜在偏好表示为文本假设，并通过 generate–verify–refine 循环不断修订，在五个 LLM 上与现有记忆系统及 full-history prompting 对比。
Result: 在五个 LLM 上，现有记忆系统常常无法改进 full-history prompting；PRefine 优于所有基线，并且仅凭自身在 Preference Transfer 上超过 full-history prompting。基准规模为 4,695 个实例、459 条多会话交互历史。
Conclusion: 个性化 agent 的记忆必须把行为抽象成偏好，而不是简单归档交互记录。

papers.title: Reward Design for Physical Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Physical reasoning over images requires integrating perception, domain knowledge, and multi-step symbolic inference, yet Vision-Language Models (VLMs) fall far short of human performance on physics benchmarks. Reinforcement learning can improve reasoning via reward signals, but it remains unclear whether these signals must come from outside the model or can be derived from the model itself. We compare external rewards, which rely on an outside verifier (rule-based format and answer-correctness checks, or an LLM-judge rubric), with an internal attention-based reward computed from the model's own attention over image regions, requiring no labels or judge. We find that external rewards drive most of the accuracy gains, while preserving more coherent reasoning when rewarded for reasoning tokens. The internal attention-based reward, provides an annotation-free grounding signal that improves spatial-relation reasoning and is complementary to external rewards: adding it to format and accuracy rewards, at no additional annotation cost, improves average accuracy on Molmo~2 while generalizing to out-of-distribution tasks. Our results suggest that internal attention rewards can supplement external supervision and lead to improved physical reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 比较 VLM 物理推理 RL 训练中的外部奖励（规则格式/答案校验、LLM-judge rubric）与基于模型自身图像区域注意力的内部奖励。外部奖励贡献主要准确率增益，奖励 reasoning token 时推理更连贯；内部注意力奖励无需标注即可提升空间关系推理，叠加到格式与准确率奖励上在 Molmo~2 上提高平均准确率并泛化到分布外任务。
Motivation: VLM 在物理推理基准上远逊人类，而 RL 改进推理所用奖励信号究竟必须来自模型外部、还是可由模型自身导出，尚不清楚。
Method: 对比两类奖励：外部奖励用外部验证器（规则式格式与答案正确性检查，或 LLM-judge rubric）；内部奖励从模型自身对图像区域的注意力计算，无需标注与 judge，可叠加到格式与准确率奖励上。
Result: 外部奖励带来大部分准确率增益，且以 reasoning token 为奖励对象时推理连贯性保持得更好；内部注意力奖励提升空间关系推理，在 Molmo~2 上叠加后提高平均准确率并泛化到分布外任务，且无额外标注成本。
Conclusion: 内部注意力奖励可作为外部监督的补充而非替代，标注免费的 grounding 信号与外部奖励组合能改善物理推理。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Reconstruction: Reconstruction-to-Vector Diffusion for Hyperspectral Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: While Hyperspectral Anomaly Detection (HAD) excels at identifying sparse targets in complex scenes, existing models remain trapped in a scalar "reconstruction-as-endpoint" paradigm. This reliance on ambiguous scalar residuals consistently triggers sub-pixel anomaly vanishing during spatial downsampling, alongside severe confirmation bias when unpurified anomalies corrupt training weights. In this paper, we propose Reconstruction-to-Vector Diffusion (R2VD), which fundamentally redefines reconstruction as a manifold purification origin to establish a novel residual-guided generative dynamics paradigm. Our framework introduces a four-stage pipeline: (1) a Physical Prior Extraction (PPE) stage that mitigates early confirmation bias via dual-stream statistical guidance; (2) a Guided Manifold Purification (GMP) stage utilizing an OmniContext Autoencoder (OCA) to extract purified residual maps while preserving fragile sub-pixel topologies; (3) a Residual Score Modeling (RSM) stage where a Diffusion Transformer (DiT), guarded by a Physical Spectral Firewall (PSF), effectively isolates cross-spectral leakage; and (4) a Vector Dynamics Inference (VDI) stage that robustly decouples targets from backgrounds by evaluating high-dimensional vector interference patterns instead of conventional scalar errors. Comprehensive evaluations on eight datasets confirm that R2VD establishes a new state-of-the-art, delivering exceptional target detectability and background suppression. The code is available at https://github.com/Bondojijun/R2VD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 高光谱异常检测 (HAD) 把重建残差当标量终点，导致空间下采样时亚像元异常消失、且未净化异常污染训练权重引发确认偏差。R2VD 把重建改为流形净化起点，四阶段管线（PPE、OCA、DiT+PSF、VDI）用高维向量干扰模式替代标量误差解耦目标与背景，在八个数据集上确立新的 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 现有 HAD 模型停留在标量“重建即终点”范式：模糊的标量残差在空间下采样时触发亚像元异常消失，未净化异常污染训练权重又带来严重确认偏差。
Method: 四阶段管线：Physical Prior Extraction (PPE) 用双流统计引导抑制早期确认偏差；Guided Manifold Purification (GMP) 用 OmniContext Autoencoder (OCA) 提取保留亚像元拓扑的净化残差图；Residual Score Modeling (RSM) 用 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 建模残差分数并由 Physical Spectral Firewall (PSF) 隔离跨光谱泄漏；Vector Dynamics Inference (VDI) 评估高维向量干扰模式解耦目标与背景。
Result: 在八个数据集上的综合评测中，R2VD 建立新的 state-of-the-art，具备优异的目标可检测性与背景抑制能力。
Conclusion: 把重建从终点改为残差引导的生成动力学起点，并以向量干扰替代标量误差，可同时缓解亚像元异常消失与确认偏差，代码已开源。

papers.title: SnapFlow: One-Step Action Generation for Flow-Matching VLAs via Progressive Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models with flow-matching action heads, such as π0 and π0.5, have become a standard recipe for generalist robot manipulation, but every action chunk is produced by integrating a learned velocity field over about ten sequential action-expert evaluations, so action generation dominates model latency and caps the achievable control frequency. Existing remedies either shrink each evaluation through layer distillation or pruning while leaving the sequential solver in place, or import one-step objectives from image generation that were designed for training from scratch, rely on an exponential-moving-average teacher or an external critic, and regress finite-span targets onto the conditional velocity, whose variance around the marginal field biases the learned map. We introduce SnapFlow, a self-distillation method that adapts a pretrained flow-matching VLA to one-step action generation. SnapFlow mixes local flow-matching supervision with shortcut samples whose target is the model's own two-step Euler endpoint under stop-gradient, and adds a single zero-initialized destination-time projection so that one action expert serves both objectives while the pretrained predictor is preserved at initialization; no separate teacher network or critic is required. On π0.5, whose 10-NFE teacher operates near ceiling, the archived one-NFE SnapFlow checkpoint reaches 98.75% LIBERO success versus 97.75% for the teacher; under a separate paired evaluation of π0, the one-NFE model surpasses its teacher by 10.5 percentage points. SnapFlow also lowers mean and tail action error on held-out data, cuts batch-one model latency by about 3.3x, and transfers to shelf retrieval on a dual-arm humanoid.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SnapFlow 把预训练的 flow-matching VLA（如 π0、π0.5）改成单步动作生成：用模型自身两步 Euler 终点作自蒸馏目标（stop-gradient），并加一个零初始化的 destination-time 投影，让同一个 action expert 同时承担局部 flow-matching 监督。在 π0.5 上单步模型 LIBERO 成功率 98.75%，高于 10-NFE 教师的 97.75%；π0 配对评估中单步比教师高 10.5 个百分点，batch-one 延迟降低约 3.3 倍。
Motivation: flow-matching 动作头每个 action chunk 要串行积分速度场约十次 action-expert 前向，动作生成成为延迟瓶颈并限制控制频率；现有加速要么只压缩单次评估而保留串行求解器，要么照搬面向从零训练的图像生成一步目标，需要 EMA 教师或外部 critic，且把有限跨度目标回归到条件速度上会在边缘场附近引入方差偏置。
Method: SnapFlow 是面向预训练 flow-matching VLA 的自蒸馏方法：混合局部 flow-matching 监督与 shortcut 样本，后者的回归目标是模型自身在 stop-gradient 下的两步 Euler 终点；加入单个零初始化的 destination-time 投影，使一个 action expert 同时服务两个目标，并在初始化时保持预训练预测器不变，无需独立教师网络或 critic。
Result: 在 π0.5（10-NFE 教师接近性能上限）上，归档的单 NFE SnapFlow checkpoint LIBERO 成功率 98.75%，教师为 97.75%；在 π0 的单独配对评估中，单 NFE 模型超出其教师 10.5 个百分点。SnapFlow 还降低 held-out 数据上的平均与尾部动作误差，batch-one 模型延迟降低约 3.3 倍，并可迁移到双臂人形机器人的货架取物 (shelf retrieval)。
Conclusion: 自蒸馏加零初始化时间投影可以在不引入教师/critic 的前提下，把预训练 flow-matching VLA 压到单步动作生成而不损失成功率，同时显著降低延迟并保持跨本体迁移能力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AdaptFuse: Training-Free Sequential Preference Inference via Externalized Bayesian Computation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) struggle to accumulate evidence across multiple rounds of user interactions, failing to update their beliefs in a manner consistent with Bayesian inference. Existing solutions require fine-tuning on sensitive user interaction data, limiting their applicability in privacy-conscious settings. We propose \textsc{AdaptFuse}, a training-free framework that externalizes probabilistic computation entirely from the LLM, where a symbolic module maintains a Bayesian posterior over a discrete hypothesis set, while a frozen LLM contributes semantic reasoning via multi-sample Dirichlet aggregation. The two signals are combined through entropy-adaptive fusion, which automatically weights each source by its predictive confidence, shifting reliance from the LLM to the symbolic posterior as evidence accumulates. We evaluate across three domains: flight recommendation, hotel recommendation, and web shopping; on Gemma~2 9B, Llama~3 8B, and Qwen~2.5 7B. \textsc{AdaptFuse} consistently outperforms both prompting baselines and fine-tuned Bayesian Teaching models on all tasks, with accuracy improving monotonically over interaction rounds. These results demonstrate that principled inference-time algorithms can substitute for fine-tuning in personalized recommendation, without storing or training on sensitive user data.

papers.title: Towards Secure Agent Skills: Architecture, Threat Taxonomy, and Security Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Agent Skills is an emerging open standard that defines a modular, filesystem-based packaging format enabling LLM-based agents to acquire domain-specific expertise on demand. Despite rapid adoption across multiple agentic platforms and the emergence of large community marketplaces, the security properties of Agent Skills have not been systematically studied. This paper presents a systematization of the security of the Agent Skills framework. We define a threat model for the framework and decompose the full lifecycle of an Agent Skill across four phases---Creation, Distribution, Deployment, and Execution---identifying the structural attack surface each phase introduces. Building on this lifecycle analysis, we construct a threat taxonomy comprising seven categories and nineteen scenarios organized across three attack layers, grounded in both architectural analysis and real-world evidence. Each scenario is annotated with whether the exposure follows from the specification or from the latitude the specification leaves to individual runtimes, with the strength of the public evidence supporting it, and with the feasibility of its mitigation. We map seven documented security incidents onto the taxonomy. Based on these findings, we discuss defense directions for each threat category, identify open research challenges, and provide actionable recommendations for stakeholders. The most severe threats arise from structural properties of the framework itself: the absence of a data-instruction boundary, a single-approval persistent trust model, and a capability declaration mechanism to which the specification attaches no enforcement semantics. None of these is addressable through incremental mitigations alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Agent Skills 这一基于文件系统的 LLM agent 技能开放标准做安全系统化：按 Creation、Distribution、Deployment、Execution 四阶段拆解生命周期攻击面，构建 7 类 19 个场景、跨 3 个攻击层的威胁分类法，并映射 7 起真实安全事件。最严重威胁来自框架结构性缺陷——缺少数据-指令边界、单次批准的持久信任模型、无强制语义的能力声明机制，均无法靠增量缓解解决。
Motivation: Agent Skills 已被多个 agentic 平台快速采用并出现社区市场，但其安全属性从未被系统研究，缺少覆盖全生命周期的威胁模型与分类法。
Method: 定义威胁模型并把技能全生命周期拆为 Creation、Distribution、Deployment、Execution 四阶段，逐阶段识别结构性攻击面；据此构建 7 类 19 场景、3 个攻击层的威胁分类法，每个场景标注暴露源自规范本身还是规范留给运行时的自由度、公开证据强度与缓解可行性，并把 7 起已记录安全事件映射到分类法上。
Result: 产出 7 类 19 个威胁场景、3 个攻击层的分类法，映射 7 起真实安全事件；判定最严重威胁为缺少数据-指令边界、单次批准的持久信任模型、无强制语义的能力声明机制这三项结构性属性。
Conclusion: 最严重威胁源于框架结构本身，仅靠增量缓解无法解决，需面向各威胁类别给出防御方向并推动规范层面的修订。

papers.title: Explorable Proofs: Making Written Proofs Explorable by Grounding Them in Formal Representations
papers.abstract_en: LLM-generated explanations can make technical content more accessible, but there is a ceiling on what they can support interactively. Because LLM outputs are static text, they cannot be executed or stepped through. We argue that grounding explanations in a formalized representation enables interactive affordances beyond what static text supports. We instantiate this idea for mathematical proof comprehension with explorable theorems, a system that uses LLMs to translate a theorem and its written proof into Lean, a programming language for machine-checked proofs, and links the written proof with the Lean code. Readers can work through the proof at a step-level granularity, test custom examples or counterexamples, and trace the logical dependencies bridging each step. Each worked-out step is produced by executing the Lean proof on that example and extracting its intermediate state. A user study ($n = 16$) shows potential advantages of this approach: in a proof-reading task, participants who had access to the provided explorability features gave better, more correct, and more detailed answers to comprehension questions, demonstrating a stronger overall understanding of the underlying mathematics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Explorable Theorems 用 LLM 把定理与书面证明翻译成 Lean，并把每一步书面证明与 Lean 代码对齐，使读者能按步执行、跑自定义例子或反例、追踪步骤间的逻辑依赖；每一步的展开状态都由在该例子上执行 Lean 证明并抽取中间状态得到。n=16 的用户研究中，可用这些可探索功能的参与者在证明阅读任务里给出了更好、更正确、更细致的阅读理解答案。
Motivation: LLM 生成的解释是静态文本，无法执行或逐步展开，交互支持存在天花板；把解释锚定到形式化表示才能提供静态文本之外的交互能力。
Method: 系统 Explorable Theorems：LLM 将定理与书面证明翻译为 Lean（机器检查证明语言），并把书面证明步骤与 Lean 代码链接；步骤级展开通过在读者给定的例子上执行 Lean 证明并抽取中间状态产生，同时支持自定义例子/反例测试与步骤间逻辑依赖追踪。
Result: 用户研究 n=16：在证明阅读任务中，获得可探索功能的参与者对阅读理解问题给出更好、更正确、更详细的答案，表现出对底层数学更强的整体理解。
Conclusion: 把书面证明锚定到形式化表示，能为 LLM 解释带来静态文本做不到的交互能力，并在证明理解上显示优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Terminal Agents Suffice for Enterprise Automation
papers.abstract_en: There has been growing interest in building agents that can interact with digital platforms to execute meaningful enterprise tasks autonomously. Among the approaches explored are tool-augmented agents built on abstractions such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and web agents that operate through graphical interfaces. Yet, it remains unclear whether such complex agentic systems are necessary given their cost and operational overhead. We argue that a coding agent equipped only with a terminal and a filesystem can solve many enterprise tasks more effectively by interacting directly with platform APIs. We evaluate this hypothesis across diverse real-world systems and show that these low-level terminal agents match or outperform more complex agent architectures at a fraction of the cost. Our findings suggest that simple, flexible programmatic interfaces combined with strong foundation models should be the backbone of enterprise automation.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 10/2026. 56 pages, 6 figures, 23 tables. Code: https://github.com/ServiceNow/StarShell. Data: https://huggingface.co/collections/ServiceNow-AI/starshell. Reviews: https://openreview.net/forum?id=6zrEOjtoVF
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张：只带终端和文件系统的编码 agent 直接调用平台 API，就能在企业自动化任务上匹敌或超过基于 MCP、GUI 的复杂 agent 架构，且成本只占一小部分。结论是企业自动化应以简单灵活的程序化接口加强基础模型为主干，而非堆叠复杂 agent 系统。
Motivation: 企业 agent 研究集中在 MCP 工具增强与 GUI web agent 等复杂架构上，但其成本与运行开销是否必要并不清楚。
Method: 提出仅配备终端与文件系统的低层 coding agent，通过直接调用平台 API 执行企业任务，并在多种真实系统上与更复杂的 agent 架构对比评估。
Result: 在多样真实系统上，终端 agent 以显著更低的成本达到匹配或更优的任务表现；论文发表于 TMLR 2026，附 23 张表、6 幅图，代码与数据分别在 ServiceNow/StarShell 仓库和 Hugging Face 集合中公开。
Conclusion: 复杂 agent 抽象层并非企业自动化的必要条件，简单程序化接口加基础模型足以支撑多数企业任务且更省钱。

papers.title: Structural Pass Analysis in Football: Learning Pass Archetypes and Tactical Impact from Spatio-Temporal Tracking Data
papers.abstract_en: Passing actions are commonly evaluated through ball progression and attacking outcomes, yet their relationship with the spatial organisation of the opposition provides an additional perspective on passing behaviour. This study introduces an interpretable framework for describing passing structure using synchronised event and tracking data. Three complementary descriptors are proposed: Line Bypass Score (LBS), measuring the difference in goal-side opponent counts between passer and receiver; Space Gain Metric (SGM), comparing their nearest-opponent distances; and Structural Disruption Index (SDI), summarising differences in defensive organisation between pass initiation and a sampled state one second later. Following transformation and standardisation, these descriptors are combined into Tactical Impact Value (TIV), a fixed-weight structural composite. Applied to 41,078 open-play passing events from the 2022 FIFA World Cup, the framework identifies four interpretable profiles: Circulatory, Destabilising, Line-breaking, and Space-expanding. The profiles exhibit distinct structural signatures and different distributions of territorial-crossing and recorded attacking indicators. Team, spatial, player, and passer--receiver analyses further demonstrate how the representation can describe passing behaviour across analytical scales. The framework complements outcome-oriented approaches by connecting individual passing actions with measurable characteristics of opposition positioning and defensive organisation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可解释的传球结构分析框架：用 Line Bypass Score、Space Gain Metric、Structural Disruption Index 三个描述子刻画传球前后对手空间组织变化，固定权重合成为 Tactical Impact Value。在 2022 FIFA World Cup 的 41,078 次开放比赛传球上分出 Circulatory、Destabilising、Line-breaking、Space-expanding 四类传球原型，其领土穿越与进攻指标分布各不相同。
Motivation: 传球评价长期只看推进距离与进攻结果，忽略了对手防守空间组织这一维度，难以在球队、区域、球员、传受球者多个尺度上描述传球行为。
Method: 用同步事件与追踪数据计算三个描述子：LBS 比较传球者与接球者球门一侧对手人数差，SGM 比较两人最近对手距离，SDI 比较传球发起时刻与一秒后采样状态的防守组织差异；经变换与标准化后按固定权重合成 TIV，再据此聚出四类传球原型。
Result: 在 2022 FIFA World Cup 的 41,078 次开放比赛传球上得到 Circulatory、Destabilising、Line-breaking、Space-expanding 四个原型，各原型结构特征不同，且领土穿越与已记录进攻指标的分布存在差异；球队、空间、球员与传受球者层面的分析均显示该表示可跨分析尺度描述传球行为。
Conclusion: 传球的结构价值可由对手位置与防守组织的可测变化来刻画，与结果导向指标互补，用于多尺度传球行为描述。

papers.title: Mapping data literacy trajectories in K-12 education
papers.abstract_en: Data literacy skills are fundamental in computer science education. However, understanding how data-driven systems work represents a paradigm shift from traditional rule-based programming. We conducted a systematic literature review of 84 studies to understand K-12 learners' engagement with data across disciplines and contexts. We propose the data paradigms framework that categorises learning activities along two dimensions: (i) logic (knowledge-based or data-driven systems), and (ii) explainability (transparent or opaque models). We further apply the notion of learning trajectories to visualize the pathways learners follow across these distinct paradigms. We detail four distinct trajectories as a provocation for researchers and educators to reflect on how the notion of data literacy varies depending on the learning context. We suggest these trajectories could be useful to those concerned with the design of data literacy learning environments within and beyond CS education.
papers.comment: Presented at the Data Literacy for the 21st Century: Perspectives from Visualization, Cognitive Science, Artificial Intelligence, and Education CHI '26 workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 84 项 K-12 研究做系统综述，提出 data paradigms 框架，按逻辑（知识驱动 vs 数据驱动系统）与可解释性（透明 vs 不透明模型）两个维度给学习活动分类，并画出四条学习轨迹。作者把这四条轨迹作为对研究者与教育者的 provocation：数据素养的含义随学习情境而变，轨迹可用于设计 CS 内外的数据素养学习环境。
Motivation: 理解数据驱动系统与传统规则式编程是范式转换，但 K-12 各学科与情境中学习者如何接触数据缺少统一刻画，数据素养的定义随情境漂移。
Method: 系统文献综述 84 项研究，覆盖 K-12 学习者跨学科跨情境的数据参与；提出 data paradigms 框架，沿 logic 与 explainability 两维分类学习活动，再用 learning trajectories 概念可视化学习者在各范式间的路径，归纳出四条轨迹。
Result: 综述样本为 84 项研究；框架含两个维度（logic：knowledge-based/data-driven systems；explainability：transparent/opaque models），并给出四条不同的学习轨迹。
Conclusion: 数据素养的内涵取决于学习情境，四条轨迹是供研究者与教育者反思的 provocation，可服务于 CS 教育内外的数据素养学习环境设计。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Constitutive parameterized deep energy method for solid mechanics problems with random material parameters
papers.abstract_en: In practical structural design and solid mechanics simulations, material properties inherently exhibit random variations within bounded intervals. However, evaluating mechanical responses under continuous material uncertainty remains a persistent challenge. Traditional numerical approaches, such as the Finite Element Method (FEM), incur prohibitive computational costs as they require repeated mesh discretization and equation solving for every parametric realization. Similarly, data-driven surrogate models depend heavily on massive, high-fidelity datasets, while standard physics-informed frameworks (e.g., the Deep Energy Method) strictly demand complete retraining from scratch whenever material parameters change. To bridge this critical gap, we propose the Constitutive Parameterized Deep Energy Method (CPDEM). In this purely physics-driven framework, the strain energy density functional is reformulated by encoding a latent representation of stochastic constitutive parameters. By embedding material parameters directly into the neural network alongside spatial coordinates, CPDEM transforms conventional spatial collocation points into parameter-aware material points. Trained in an unsupervised manner via expected energy minimization over the parameter domain, the pre-trained model continuously learns the solution manifold. Consequently, it enables zero-shot, real-time inference of displacement fields for unknown material parameters without requiring any dataset generation or model retraining. The proposed method is rigorously validated across diverse benchmarks, including linear elasticity, finite-strain hyperelasticity, and complex highly nonlinear contact mechanics. To the best of our knowledge, CPDEM represents the first purely physics-driven deep learning paradigm capable of simultaneously and efficiently handling continuous multi-parameter variations in solid mechanics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出本构参数化深度能量法 (CPDEM)：把随机本构参数的隐表示与空间坐标一起嵌入神经网络，用参数域上的期望能量最小化做无监督训练，使空间配点变成参数感知的材料点。预训练后对未知材料参数可零样本、实时推理位移场，无需生成数据集或重训练，并在线弹性、有限应变超弹性与高度非线性接触力学基准上验证。
Motivation: 材料参数在有界区间内随机变化时，FEM 要对每个参数实现重新划分网格并求解方程，计算代价高；数据驱动代理依赖大规模高保真数据；标准 Deep Energy Method 在材料参数一变就必须从头完全重训练。
Method: CPDEM 属于纯物理驱动框架：重构应变能密度泛函，编码随机本构参数的隐表示，把材料参数与空间坐标一同嵌入网络，将空间配点转为参数感知的材料点；在参数域上以期望能量最小化做无监督训练，学习解流形。
Result: 在多样基准上被严格验证，覆盖线弹性、有限应变超弹性以及复杂的高度非线性接触力学；对未知材料参数实现零样本、实时位移场推理，全程无需数据集生成或模型重训练。
Conclusion: 作者称 CPDEM 据其所知是首个能同时高效处理固体力学中连续多参数变化的纯物理驱动深度学习范式，参数变化时无需重训练即可直接推理。

papers.title: A Wireless World Model for AI-Native 6G Networks
papers.abstract_en: Integrating AI into the physical layer is a cornerstone of 6G networks. However, current data-driven approaches struggle to generalize across dynamic environments because they lack an intrinsic understanding of electromagnetic wave propagation. We introduce the Wireless World Model (WWM), a multi-modal foundation framework predicting the spatiotemporal evolution of wireless channels by internalizing the causal relationship between 3D geometry and signal dynamics. Pre-trained on a massive ray-traced multi-modal dataset, WWM overcomes the data authenticity gap, further validated under real-world measurement data. Using a joint-embedding predictive architecture with a multi-modal mixture-of-experts Transformer, WWM fuses channel state information, 3D point clouds, and user trajectories into a unified representation. Across the five key downstream tasks supported by WWM, it achieves remarkable performance in seen environments, unseen generalization scenarios, and real-world measurements, consistently outperforming SOTA uni-modal foundation models and task-specific models. This paves the way for physics-aware 6G intelligence that adapts to the physical world.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Wireless World Model (WWM)：把 CSI、3D 点云与用户轨迹经多模态 MoE Transformer 融合进统一表征，用联合嵌入预测架构 (joint-embedding predictive architecture) 预测无线信道的时空演化。在射线追踪预训练与真实实测数据上，五个下游任务在已见环境、未见泛化场景与实测中均持续优于单模态基础模型与任务专用模型。
Motivation: 当前数据驱动的物理层方法缺乏对电磁波传播的内在理解，跨动态环境泛化差；纯数据训练还存在数据真实性鸿沟。
Method: 在大规模射线追踪多模态数据集上预训练，用 JEPA 加多模态 mixture-of-experts Transformer 融合 CSI、3D 点云与用户轨迹，内化 3D 几何与信号动态的因果关系，再用真实测量数据进一步验证。
Result: WWM 支持五个下游任务，在已见环境、未见泛化场景与真实实测三类设置下均持续优于 SOTA 单模态基础模型与任务专用模型；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把几何因果先验内化进世界模型可让 6G 物理层 AI 跨环境泛化，并在实测中保持优势。

papers.title: Can We Change "Stroke Size" to Simplify Regression Learning?
papers.abstract_en: Deep-learning-based image generation is increasingly useful but expensive. Across the different timesteps in the denoising chain, high-noise timesteps present distinct optimization and prediction challenges, which can increase the cost of real-world applications. Inspired by the varying stroke sizes used in human painting, in this work, we ask whether a similar stroke-size variation (i.e., rough stroke applied early) in diffusion can simplify existing image-generation algorithms. We subsequently develop the MultiStroke operator, which linearly interpolates coarse and fine strokes in a coarse-to-fine manner to potentially simplify the prediction target, especially at high-noise timesteps. Across DDPM and flow-matching models trained from scratch, MultiStroke achieves an FID reduction of up to $70.2\%$. A quick video is at https://wendybaiyunwei.github.io/MultiStroke-Web/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MultiStroke 算子，把扩散去噪链中粗糙与精细的 stroke 线性插值成由粗到细的轨迹，从而在高噪声时间步简化预测目标。在从零训练的 DDPM 与 flow-matching 模型上，FID 最多降低 70.2%。
Motivation: 扩散模型的图像生成成本高，高噪声时间步的优化与预测难度尤其突出，需要更简单的预测目标来降低训练与应用开销。
Method: 受绘画中笔触粗细变化启发，MultiStroke 在粗细 stroke 之间做线性插值，形成 coarse-to-fine 的去噪轨迹，重点简化高噪声时间步的预测目标；在从零训练的 DDPM 与 flow-matching 模型上验证。
Result: 在从零训练的 DDPM 与 flow-matching 模型上，MultiStroke 使 FID 最多降低 70.2%。
Conclusion: 在扩散去噪链中引入由粗到细的 stroke 变化，可以简化高噪声时间步的预测目标并显著改善生成质量。

papers.title: Sharp Statistical Thresholds for Attributed Gaussian Graph Matching
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the problem of matching networks where both edge weights and node features are correlated following a specific node correspondence. While prior work has established sharp thresholds for matching either graphs or features individually, the joint setting has been significantly less explored. In this study, we derive precise information-theoretic thresholds for exact recovery, almost-exact recovery, and partial recovery of the underlying alignment. These are expressed in terms of graph and feature correlation strengths, the number of nodes, and the dimension of the features. Interestingly, whereas an all-or-nothing phase transition is observed in the standard graph-matching scenario, the inclusion of contextual information at the node level introduces a richer structure: the exact-recovery threshold separates from the shared threshold for almost-exact and partial recovery. Closing gaps left by prior works, we provide a sharp characterization of the thresholds governing how structural and contextual information interact in graph matching, and thereby establish a benchmark for designing efficient algorithms in the high-dimensional setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在边权与节点特征同时按同一节点对应关系相关的 attributed Gaussian graph matching 中，推导精确恢复、几乎精确恢复与部分恢复的信息论阈值。加入节点级上下文后，标准图匹配的 all-or-nothing 相变被打破：精确恢复阈值与几乎精确/部分恢复的共享阈值发生分离。阈值以图相关强度、特征相关强度、节点数与特征维度表示，为高维情形的算法设计建立基准。
Motivation: 既有 sharp threshold 结果只覆盖单独的图匹配或特征匹配，边权与节点特征联合相关的设定下恢复阈值长期不清楚，也缺少衡量算法优劣的信息论基准。
Method: 在 Gaussian 图模型中同时引入边权相关与节点特征相关（二者共享同一节点对应），推导精确恢复、几乎精确恢复、部分恢复三档的信息论阈值，阈值写成图相关强度、特征相关强度、节点数与特征维度的函数，并刻画结构信息与上下文信息的交互。
Result: 得到三档恢复的精确信息论阈值：标准图匹配下是 all-or-nothing 相变，而节点级上下文加入后精确恢复阈值与几乎精确、部分恢复所共享的阈值分离，形成更丰富的相图结构。
Conclusion: 结构与上下文信息在图匹配中的交互可被 sharp 地刻画，该阈值可作为高维 attributed graph matching 算法设计的性能基准。

papers.title: Reasoning or Rhetoric? An Empirical Analysis of Moral Reasoning Explanations in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Do large language models reason morally, or do they merely sound like they do? We investigate whether LLM responses to moral dilemmas exhibit genuine developmental progression through Kohlberg's stages of moral development, or whether alignment training instead produces reasoning-like outputs that superficially resemble mature moral judgment without the underlying developmental trajectory. Using an LLM-as-judge scoring pipeline validated across three judge models, we classify more than 600 responses from 13 LLMs spanning a range of architectures, parameter scales, and training regimes across six classical moral dilemmas, and conduct ten complementary analyses to characterize the nature and internal coherence of the resulting patterns. Our results reveal a striking inversion: responses overwhelmingly correspond to post-conventional reasoning (Stages 5-6) regardless of model size, architecture, or prompting strategy, the effective inverse of human developmental norms, where Stage 4 dominates. Most strikingly, a subset of models exhibit moral decoupling: systematic inconsistency between stated moral justification and action choice, a form of logical incoherence that persists across scale and prompting strategy and represents a direct reasoning consistency failure independent of rhetorical sophistication. Model scale carries a statistically significant but practically small effect; training type has no significant independent main effect; and models exhibit near-robotic cross-dilemma consistency producing logically indistinguishable responses across semantically distinct moral problems. We posit that these patterns constitute evidence for moral ventriloquism: the acquisition, through alignment training, of the rhetorical conventions of mature moral reasoning without the underlying developmental trajectory those conventions are meant to represent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文用经三个 judge 模型验证的 LLM-as-judge 打分流程，对 13 个 LLM 在六个经典道德困境上的 600 余条回答按 Kohlberg 道德发展阶段分类，发现回答压倒性落在后习俗阶段（Stage 5-6），与人类发展中 Stage 4 占主导的常态几乎相反。部分模型出现「道德腹语」(moral ventriloquism)：陈述的道德理由与实际行为选择系统性不一致，且跨规模与提示策略持续存在；模型规模效应统计显著但实际很小，训练类型无显著独立主效应。
Motivation: 对齐训练是否让 LLM 真正形成道德发展轨迹，还是只学会了成熟道德推理的修辞外壳，缺乏可检验的实证判据。
Method: 构建经三个 judge 模型交叉验证的 LLM-as-judge 打分流程，对 13 个不同架构、参数规模与训练体制的 LLM 在六个经典道德困境上的 600 余条回答做 Kohlberg 阶段分类，并开展十项互补分析刻画模式性质与内部一致性。
Result: 回答绝大多数对应后习俗推理（Stage 5-6），与人类常态（Stage 4 主导）构成反转；部分模型呈现道德理由与行为选择的系统性不一致，跨规模与提示策略持续存在；模型规模效应统计显著但实际很小，训练类型无显著独立主效应；模型在跨困境时表现出近乎机械的一致性，对语义不同的道德问题给出逻辑上难以区分的回答。
Conclusion: 作者主张这些模式构成「道德腹语」的证据：对齐训练让模型习得成熟道德推理的修辞惯例，而没有形成这些惯例本应代表的发展轨迹。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 该论文用经三个 judge 模型验证的 LLM-as-judge 打分流程，对 13 个 LLM 在六个经典道德困境上的 600 余条回答按 Kohlberg 道德发展阶段分类，发现回答压倒性落在后习俗阶段（Stage 5-6），与人类发展中 Stage 4 占主导的常态几乎相反。部分模型出现「道德腹语」(moral ventriloquism)：陈述的道德理由与实际行为选择系统性不一致，且跨规模与提示策略持续存在；模型规模效应统计显著但实际很小，训练类型无显著独立主效应。

papers.title: Learning to Disprove: Formal Counterexample Generation with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Mathematical reasoning demands two critical, complementary skills: constructing rigorous proofs for true statements and discovering counterexamples that disprove false ones. However, current AI efforts in mathematics focus almost exclusively on proof construction, often neglecting the equally important task of finding counterexamples. In this paper, we address this gap by fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) to reason about and generate counterexamples. We formalize this task as formal counterexample generation, which requires LLMs not only to propose candidate counterexamples but also to produce formal proofs that can be automatically verified in the Lean 4 theorem prover. To enable effective learning, we introduce a symbolic mutation strategy that constructs candidate counterexample-generation tasks by systematically extracting theorems and removing selected hypotheses. Together with curated datasets, this strategy enables a multi-reward expert iteration framework that substantially enhances both the effectiveness and efficiency of training LLMs for counterexample generation and theorem proving. Experiments on three newly collected benchmarks validate the advantages of our approach, showing that the mutation strategy and training framework yield substantial performance gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把数学中的反例生成形式化为可在 Lean 4 中自动验证的任务，用符号变异 (symbolic mutation) 系统抽取定理并删除选定假设来批量构造候选任务，再以多奖励专家迭代 (multi-reward expert iteration) 微调 LLM 同时产出候选反例与形式证明。在三个新收集的基准上，变异策略与训练框架在反例生成和定理证明两方面都取得显著性能提升。
Motivation: 当前 AI 数学研究几乎只做真命题的证明构造，忽略了发现反例来证伪假命题这一同等重要的能力，缺少可自动验证的反例生成任务与训练范式。
Method: 形式化定义 formal counterexample generation：LLM 需提出候选反例并给出可在 Lean 4 中自动验证的形式证明；用符号变异策略从定理中系统抽取并删除选定假设来构造训练任务，配合精选数据集，训练采用多奖励专家迭代框架微调 LLM。
Result: 在三个新收集的基准上验证方法优势，变异策略与训练框架在反例生成和定理证明上均取得 substantial performance gains（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 反例生成可以被形式化并用符号变异加多奖励专家迭代有效训练，同时提升 LLM 的反例生成与定理证明能力。

papers.title: BenchPreS: A Benchmark for Context-Aware Personalized Preference Selectivity of Persistent-Memory LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly store user preferences in persistent memory to support personalization across interactions. However, in third-party communication settings governed by social and institutional norms, some user preferences may be inappropriate to apply. We introduce BenchPreS, which evaluates whether memory-based user preferences are appropriately applied or suppressed across communication contexts. Using two complementary metrics, Misapplication Rate (MR) and Appropriate Application Rate (AAR), we find even frontier LLMs struggle to apply preferences in a context-sensitive manner. Models with stronger preference adherence exhibit higher rates of over-application, and neither reasoning capability nor prompt-based defenses fully resolve this issue. These results suggest current LLMs treat personalized preferences as globally enforceable rules rather than as context-dependent normative signals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BenchPreS 评测 LLM 持久记忆中的用户偏好是否按沟通场景被恰当应用或抑制，用 Misapplication Rate (MR) 与 Appropriate Application Rate (AAR) 两个指标衡量。结果显示前沿 LLM 也难以按场景选择性应用偏好：偏好依从性越强的模型过度应用率越高，推理能力与基于提示的防御都无法完全解决，说明模型把个性化偏好当成全局可执行规则而非随语境变化的规范信号。
Motivation: LLM 用持久记忆存用户偏好做个性化，但在受社会与制度规范约束的第三方沟通场景中，部分偏好并不适合照用；现有模型缺少按场景判断何时应用、何时抑制的机制。
Method: 提出 BenchPreS 基准，评测基于记忆的用户偏好在不同沟通场景下被恰当应用或被抑制的情况，配套两个互补指标 Misapplication Rate (MR) 与 Appropriate Application Rate (AAR)，并考察推理能力与基于提示的防御对结果的影响。
Result: 即使前沿 LLM 也难以按场景敏感地应用偏好；偏好依从性更强的模型表现出更高的过度应用率；推理能力与基于提示的防御均不能完全消除该问题。
Conclusion: 当前 LLM 把个性化偏好当作全局可执行规则，而非随语境变化的规范信号，因此单纯加推理或提示防御不足以让偏好应用变得场景敏感。

papers.title: GenState-AI: State-Aware Dataset for Text-to-Video Retrieval on AI-Generated Videos
papers.abstract_en: Existing text-to-video retrieval benchmarks often permit matching from static appearance, making it difficult to determine whether models capture state changes and final outcomes. We introduce GenState-AI, a benchmark comprising 956 AI-generated videos and 195 verified state-change queries across Toy, Cartoon, Home, and Manipulation domains. Its construction uses prompt-controlled variants that target either conflicting temporal/state outcomes or semantic substitutions. Following human verification, all valid videos contribute to subset-level retrieval pools, while complete query-specific triplets support diagnostic hard-negative ordering. We evaluate VCF-Lik, Qwen3-VL, and LanguageBind using both standard Recall@K and triplet-based consistency metrics. Qwen3-VL (8B) achieves the best macro-average R@1 and triplet consistency, while LanguageBind obtains the highest semantic discrimination accuracy. However, stronger retrieval does not consistently yield correct hard-negative ordering, and Qwen3-VL and LanguageBind remain weak on Manipulation triplets, where VCF-Lik performs substantially better. GenState-AI therefore provides a controlled diagnostic testbed for distinguishing global retrieval quality from fine-grained temporal and semantic grounding in AI-generated videos.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GenState-AI 是一个面向 AI 生成视频的文本-视频检索基准，含 956 条 AI 生成视频与 195 条经人工核验的状态变化查询，覆盖 Toy、Cartoon、Home、Manipulation 四个域，用受控 prompt 变体构造冲突时序/状态结果与语义替换。评测 VCF-Lik、Qwen3-VL、LanguageBind 后发现：Qwen3-VL (8B) 宏平均 R@1 与 triplet 一致性最佳，LanguageBind 语义判别准确率最高，但检索更强不等于 hard-negative 排序正确，两者在 Manipulation triplet 上都弱而 VCF-Lik 明显更好。
Motivation: 现有文本-视频检索基准允许仅凭静态外观匹配，无法区分模型是否真的捕捉状态变化与最终结果，细粒度时序与语义 grounding 缺少受控诊断手段。
Method: 用 prompt 控制的变体构造数据，变体针对相互冲突的时序/状态结果或语义替换；人工核验后，所有有效视频进入子集级检索池，完整的 query 级 triplet 支持 hard-negative 排序诊断；评测 VCF-Lik、Qwen3-VL、LanguageBind，指标为标准 Recall@K 与基于 triplet 的一致性指标。
Result: 基准规模为 956 条 AI 生成视频、195 条核验状态变化查询，分 Toy、Cartoon、Home、Manipulation 四域。Qwen3-VL (8B) 取得最佳宏平均 R@1 与 triplet 一致性；LanguageBind 语义判别准确率最高；在 Manipulation triplet 上 Qwen3-VL 与 LanguageBind 均弱，VCF-Lik 表现明显更好。
Conclusion: 全局检索质量与细粒度时序/语义 grounding 是可分离的两个维度：更强的检索指标不保证 hard-negative 排序正确，Manipulation 类状态变化是当前模型的共同短板。

papers.title: OxyGen: Unified KV Cache Management for VLA Inference under Multi-Task Parallelism
papers.abstract_en: Embodied AI agents increasingly require parallel execution of multiple tasks, such as manipulation, conversation, and memory construction, from shared observations under distinct time constraints. Recent Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) support such heterogeneous outputs, yet existing inference systems incur redundant computation and resource contention when serving concurrent tasks on-device. We identify isolated KV cache management as the root cause. To address this, we propose unified KV cache management, an inference design that treats the KV cache as a first-class shared resource across tasks and control cycles. This abstraction enables two key optimizations: cross-task KV sharing eliminates redundant prefill of shared observations, while cross-frame continuous batching batches unfinished language requests from different frames and advances them within a per-frame decoding budget. We implement this design in OxyGen and evaluate $π_{0.5}$ on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 and Jetson AGX Thor. OxyGen achieves up to 3.7$\times$ speedup over isolated execution, delivering over 200 tokens/s language throughput and 70 Hz action frequency simultaneously on RTX 4090. We also validate the design on Xiaomi-Robotics-0 and StarVLA across different backbones and expert configurations. We further demonstrate the inference gains on a humanoid robot with on-board Jetson AGX Thor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OxyGen 把 VLA 多任务并行推理中的 KV cache 从每任务隔离改为跨任务、跨帧统一管理：跨任务共享 KV 消除共享观测的重复 prefill，跨帧连续批处理在每帧解码预算内推进未完成的语言请求。在 RTX 4090 上对 π_{0.5} 相对隔离执行最高 3.7× 加速，同时达到 200 tokens/s 语言吞吐与 70 Hz 动作频率。
Motivation: MoT 类 VLA 需要在共享观测上并行执行操作、对话、记忆构建等异构任务，而设备端推理系统按任务隔离 KV cache，导致重复计算与资源争用。
Method: 提出统一 KV cache 管理：把 KV cache 作为跨任务、跨控制周期的一等共享资源，包含跨任务 KV 共享（消除共享观测的重复 prefill）与跨帧连续批处理（在 per-frame 解码预算内推进不同帧的未完成语言请求），实现为 OxyGen。
Result: 在 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 上评估 π_{0.5}：相对隔离执行最高 3.7× 加速，同时语言吞吐超过 200 tokens/s、动作频率 70 Hz；设计在 Xiaomi-Robotics-0 与 StarVLA 上跨不同 backbone 与专家配置验证，并在搭载 Jetson AGX Thor 的人形机器人上展示推理收益。
Conclusion: 把 KV cache 当作跨任务共享资源而非每任务私有状态，可在设备端同时抬高 VLA 多任务并行的语言吞吐与动作频率，且该设计可跨 backbone、专家配置与硬件迁移。

papers.title: Selective Prediction Forgetting for Adaptation of Weakly Supervised Localization of Histology Images
papers.abstract_en: Under strong cross-domain shifts, weakly supervised object localization (WSOL) models often lose their capacity to discriminate and develop a strong prediction bias toward a subset of classes. As a result, the majority of target samples are assigned to these dominant classes. Since source-free (unsupervised) domain adaptation (SFDA) methods typically rely on pseudo-labels, inaccurate pseudo-label estimation causes suboptimal adaptation and poor classification and localization performance. This issue is particularly challenging in computational histopathology, where shifts in organ-specific morphology, staining protocols, and acquisition conditions can significantly impact class-discriminative visual cues. This paper introduces SFDA with selective prediction forgetting (SFDA-SPF), a method designed to mitigate excessive concentration of predictions for dominant classes during target-domain adaptation. SFDA-SPF identifies prediction-dominant classes based on the model's target predictions and selectively revises uncertain samples assigned to them. Importantly, this procedure does not require knowledge of the true target class distribution. In contrast with previous SFDA methods, SFDA-SPF introduces a 'forget set' composed of uncertain samples from dominant classes near their decision boundaries, enabling the classification boundaries to shift away from biased predictions. A second 'retain set' is used to anchor certain and accurate samples. To forget the predictions of dominant classes, SFDA-SPF introduces a complementary optimization objective that reduces their probability while allowing alternative class assignments to emerge. This iterative optimization process reassesses target images for forget and retain sets at regular intervals. In addition to improving image-level pseudo-label estimation, the pixel-level classifier is jointly optimized, further enhancing localization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SFDA-SPF 在无源域的弱监督目标定位 (WSOL) 中，按目标域预测找出占主导的类，把靠近其决策边界的不确定样本挑成 forget set、确定样本做成 retain set，并用一个压低主导类概率的互补目标让分类边界移开偏置预测。该流程不需知道真实目标类分布，同时联合优化图像级伪标签与像素级分类器以改善定位。
Motivation: 跨域偏移下 WSOL 模型判别力退化、预测偏向少数类，而依赖伪标签的无源域域适应 (SFDA) 会把错误伪标签放大；组织病理学中器官形态、染色协议与采集条件的差异使这一问题更严重。
Method: SFDA-SPF：依据模型目标域预测识别 prediction-dominant classes，从中挑出靠近决策边界的不确定样本构成 forget set、确定且准确的样本构成 retain set；引入互补优化目标降低主导类概率并允许其他类指派出现，按固定间隔迭代重建两个集合；图像级伪标签估计与像素级分类器联合优化。

papers.title: The Reasoning Trap -- Logical Reasoning as a Mechanistic Pathway to Situational Awareness
papers.abstract_en: Situational awareness, the capacity of an AI system to recognize its own nature, understand its training and deployment context, and reason strategically about its circumstances, is widely considered among the most dangerous emergent capabilities in advanced AI systems. Separately, a growing research effort seeks to improve the logical reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) across deduction, induction, and abduction. In this paper, we argue that these two research trajectories are on a collision course. We introduce the RAISE framework (Reasoning Advancing Into Self Examination), which identifies three mechanistic pathways through which improvements in logical reasoning enable progressively deeper levels of situational awareness: deductive self inference, inductive context recognition, and abductive self modeling. We formalize each pathway, construct an escalation ladder from basic self recognition to strategic deception, and demonstrate that every major research topic in LLM logical reasoning maps directly onto a specific amplifier of situational awareness. We further analyze why current safety measures are insufficient to prevent this escalation. We conclude by proposing concrete safeguards, including a "Mirror Test" benchmark and a Reasoning Safety Parity Principle, and pose an uncomfortable but necessary question to the logical reasoning community about its responsibility in this trajectory.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models. 21 Pages. Position Paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAISE 框架论证 LLM 逻辑推理能力（演绎、归纳、溯因）的提升会通过三条机制通路——deductive self inference、inductive context recognition、abductive self modeling——逐级放大情境觉知 (situational awareness)，并把该升级路径形式化为从基本自我识别到策略性欺骗的 escalation ladder。作者主张现有安全措施不足以阻断这一升级，并提出 Mirror Test 基准与 Reasoning Safety Parity Principle 作为对策。
Motivation: 提升 LLM 逻辑推理与评估 AI 情境觉知这两条研究线被普遍视为各自独立推进，但作者认为二者正走向冲突：推理能力的每项进展都可能成为情境觉知的放大器，而现有安全措施跟不上这一升级。

papers.title: Global Cross-Modal Geo-Localization: A Million-Scale Dataset and a Physical Consistency Learning Framework
papers.abstract_en: Cross-modal Geo-localization (CMGL) matches ground-level text descriptions with geo-tagged aerial imagery, which is crucial for pedestrian navigation and emergency response. However, existing studies are constrained by narrow geographic coverage and simplistic scene diversity, failing to reflect the immense spatial heterogeneity of global architectural styles and topographic features. To bridge this gap and facilitate universal positioning, we introduce CORE, the first million-scale dataset dedicated to global CMGL. CORE comprises 1,034,786 cross-view images sampled from 225 distinct geographic regions across six continents, offering an unprecedented variety of perspectives in varying environmental conditions and urban layouts. We leverage the zero-shot reasoning of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) to synthesize high-quality scene descriptions rich in discriminative cues. Furthermore, we propose a physical-law-aware network (PLANET) for cross-modal geo-localization. PLANET introduces a novel contrastive learning paradigm to guide textual representations in capturing the intrinsic physical signatures of satellite imagery. Extensive experiments across varied geographic regions demonstrate that PLANET significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, establishing a new benchmark for robust, global-scale geo-localization. The dataset and source code will be released at https://github.com/YtH0823/CORE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出百万级全球跨模态地理定位数据集 CORE（1,034,786 对跨视角图像、225 个地理区域、六大洲），并用物理规律感知网络 PLANET 通过对比学习让文本表征捕捉卫星影像的内在物理特征。实验显示 PLANET 在多地理区域上显著优于现有方法，为全球尺度地理定位建立新基准。
Motivation: 现有跨模态地理定位 (CMGL) 研究地理覆盖窄、场景单一，无法反映全球建筑风格与地形的空间异质性，制约通用定位能力。
Method: 先用 Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) 的零样本推理合成富含判别线索的场景描述，构建 CORE 数据集；再提出物理规律感知网络 PLANET，用新的对比学习范式引导文本表征学习卫星影像的物理特征。
Result: CORE 含 1,034,786 对跨视角图像，采样自六大洲 225 个不同地理区域；PLANET 在跨多种地理区域的实验中显著优于 state-of-the-art 方法。
Conclusion: 全球尺度、物理规律感知的对比学习可提升跨模态地理定位在多样地理区域下的鲁棒性，数据集与代码将开源。

papers.title: HybridStitch: Token-Adaptive Model Stitching for Efficient Diffusion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Iterative diffusion generation requires different amounts of model capacity at different token positions. Prior model combinations allocate capacity by denoising step or by drafting and verification role. We present HybridStitch, a training-free framework that uses token-level feedback to select the model supplying each adopted update. Continuous image refinement and discrete language commitment operate on a shared generation state, while model-specific KV buffers provide attention context for selected queries. HybridStitch achieves 1.63--1.68$\times$ faster image generation and 1.15--1.58$\times$ diffusion large language model (dLLM) throughput on four main benchmarks. Estimated dLLM decode query cost decreases by 50--66% with comparable generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HybridStitch 是一个免训练的扩散生成加速框架，用 token 级反馈决定每个位置采用哪个模型的 update，连续图像精修与离散语言承诺共享同一生成状态，模型专属 KV buffer 为被选中的 query 提供注意力上下文。在四个主基准上图像生成加速 1.63–1.68×，dLLM 吞吐提升 1.15–1.58×，dLLM 解码 query 成本估计下降 50–66%，生成质量相当。
Motivation: 扩散生成在不同 token 位置所需模型容量不同，而既有模型组合只按去噪步或草稿/验证角色分配容量，粒度太粗、浪费算力。
Method: 免训练框架 HybridStitch：以 token 级反馈选择提供每次 adopted update 的模型；连续图像精修与离散语言承诺作用于共享生成状态，各模型的专属 KV buffer 为被选中的 query 提供 attention 上下文。
Result: 在四个主基准上图像生成加速 1.63–1.68×，扩散大语言模型 (dLLM) 吞吐提升 1.15–1.58×；估计 dLLM 解码 query 成本下降 50–66%，生成质量相当 (comparable generation quality)。
Conclusion: 按 token 而非按步或按角色分配模型容量，可以在不训练的前提下同时压缩扩散图像生成与 dLLM 的推理成本并保持生成质量。

papers.title: TimeWarp: Evaluating Web Agents by Revisiting the Past
papers.abstract_en: As web agents close the gap with humans on benchmarks, one question arises: Do today's agents perform just as well on tomorrow's web? We introduce TimeWarp, a benchmark that emulates the evolving web. TimeWarp consists of three web environments, each with six UI versions spanning UI design, frontend code, and workflows from different eras of the internet. We pair TimeWarp with a set of complex, realistic tasks covering different forms of web navigation. Our experiments reveal that vision-based agents are vulnerable to changes, while text-based agents become brittle once fine-tuned on a single version. To address this, we propose TimeTraj, a new annotation method that uses plan distillation to collect trajectories across multiple versions. By training agents on teacher rollouts using our BC-variant, we achieve substantial performance gains: 20.4% to 37.7% for Qwen-3 4B and 0% to 27.0% for Llama-3.1 8B models. Our work helps study generalization across web designs and opens a new paradigm for collecting plans rather than trajectories to improve the robustness of web agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TimeWarp 用三个网页环境、每个环境六个跨年代 UI 版本（涵盖界面设计、前端代码与工作流）来模拟网页演化，评测 web agent 的时间鲁棒性。结果显示视觉 agent 对 UI 变化脆弱，文本 agent 在单一版本上微调后变脆；用 TimeTraj 的 plan distillation 跨版本收集轨迹并以 BC 变体训练后，Qwen-3 4B 从 20.4% 提到 37.7%，Llama-3.1 8B 从 0% 提到 27.0%。
Motivation: web agent 在静态 benchmark 上逼近人类，但网页本身持续演化；现有评测无法回答 agent 换到未来网页后是否仍然可用。
Method: 构建 TimeWarp：三个 web 环境各含六个跨年代 UI 版本，配套覆盖多种网页导航形式的复杂真实任务；提出 TimeTraj 标注方法，用 plan distillation 在多个版本上收集教师 rollout，再用 BC 变体在这些轨迹上训练 agent。
Result: 实验显示视觉 agent 对 UI 变化脆弱，文本 agent 在单一版本微调后变脆；用 TimeTraj 轨迹训练后 Qwen-3 4B 成功率 20.4% → 37.7%，Llama-3.1 8B 0% → 27.0%。
Conclusion: 跨 UI 版本的泛化是 web agent 的真实短板，而收集跨版本的计划（而非单一版本轨迹）能显著提升鲁棒性。

papers.title: Draft-Thinking: Learning Efficient Reasoning in Long Chain-of-Thought LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Long chain-of-thought~(CoT) reasoning improves the problem-solving capability of large reasoning models~(LRMs), but often incurs substantial inference cost and overthinking. Existing efficiency methods primarily rely on prompting, post-hoc compression, or length-regularized optimization; these approaches can be sensitive to model scale, depend on external estimators, or under-allocate reasoning to difficult instances. We propose \textbf{Draft-Thinking}, a lightweight adaptation framework that learns a \textit{model-adapted draft CoT}: a compact, self-contained working derivation that directly supports the final answer. We identify a \textbf{Cross-Scale Draft Mismatch}: concise traces generated by a strong teacher can be too sparse for a smaller target model. To address this mismatch, \textbf{Progressive Draft Adaptation} first transfers a concise reasoning-form prior through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and then applies two-stage reinforcement learning (RL) with progressively harder data and relaxed response budgets to calibrate the reasoning granularity to the target model. The method requires neither post-hoc trajectory compression nor an explicit length-penalty reward. At inference time, draft, adaptive, and step-by-step prompts provide efficiency-oriented, balanced, and detailed reasoning modes, respectively. The step-by-step mode largely preserves the original model's accuracy while using fewer tokens. With only 847 training problems and 120 RL optimization steps, Draft-Thinking substantially reduces reasoning cost across six mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks. On MATH500, its draft mode reduces the average response length from 5,668 to 986 tokens, an 82.6\% reduction, while achieving 90.6\% accuracy compared with 93.0\% for the original long CoT model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Draft-Thinking 用「模型适配的草稿 CoT」替代事后压缩：先用 SFT 迁移简洁推理形式先验，再用两阶段 RL（数据难度递增、响应预算逐步放宽）把推理粒度校准到目标小模型，解决强教师草稿对小模型过于稀疏的 Cross-Scale Draft Mismatch。在 MATH500 上 draft 模式把平均回答长度从 5,668 token 压到 986（降 82.6%），准确率 90.6% 对原长 CoT 的 93.0%；step-by-step 模式基本保住原精度且仍省 token。
Motivation: 长 CoT 推理带来高昂推理成本与 overthinking；现有提效方法依赖 prompt、事后压缩或长度正则优化，对模型规模敏感、需要外部估计器，或对难题分配不足。
Method: 提出 Draft-Thinking 轻量适配框架：识别 Cross-Scale Draft Mismatch 后，用 Progressive Draft Adaptation——先 SFT 迁移简洁推理形式先验，再做两阶段 RL（数据渐难、响应预算渐松）校准推理粒度；不需要事后轨迹压缩或显式长度惩罚奖励。推理时提供 draft / adaptive / step-by-step 三种提示模式，分别对应效率优先、均衡、详细推理。
Result: 仅用 847 道训练题与 120 步 RL 优化，在六个数学与科学推理基准上降低推理成本。MATH500：draft 模式平均回答长度 5,668 → 986 token（降 82.6%），准确率 90.6%（原长 CoT 为 93.0%）；step-by-step 模式基本保持原模型精度且用更少 token。

papers.title: Task-Driven Subspace Decomposition for Knowledge Sharing and Isolation in LoRA-based Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual Learning (CL) requires models to sequentially adapt to new tasks without forgetting old knowledge. Recently, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), a representative Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) method, has gained increasing attention in CL. Several LoRA-based CL methods reduce interference across tasks by separating their update spaces, typically building the new space from the estimated null space of past tasks. However, they (i) overlook task-shared directions, which suppresses knowledge transfer, and (ii) fail to capture truly effective task-specific directions since these ``null bases" of old tasks can remain nearly inactive for new task under correlated tasks. To address this, we study LoRA learning capability from a projection energy perspective, and propose Low-rank Decomposition and Adaptation (LoDA). It performs a task-driven decomposition to build general and truly task-specific LoRA subspaces by solving two energy-based objectives, decoupling directions for knowledge sharing and isolation. LoDA fixes LoRA down-projections on two subspaces and learns robust up-projections via a Gradient-Aligned Optimization (GAO) approach. After each task, before integrating the LoRA updates into the backbone, LoDA derives a closed-form recalibration for the general update, approximating a feature-level joint optimum along this task-shared direction. Experiments indicate that LoDA outperforms existing CL methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/HHHLF/LoDA_ICML2026.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoDA 用投影能量视角做任务驱动子空间分解，把 LoRA 更新拆成可共享的 general 子空间与真正任务专属的 specific 子空间，解耦知识共享与隔离。在持续学习实验中超过现有 CL 方法。
Motivation: 基于 LoRA 的持续学习方法通常从旧任务估计的零空间 (null space) 构建新更新空间，既忽略任务共享方向而压制知识迁移，又在任务相关时无法找到真正有效的任务专属方向。
Method: LoDA 通过两个基于能量的目标做任务驱动分解，构建 general 与 truly task-specific 两个 LoRA 子空间；固定两个子空间上的 down-projection，用 Gradient-Aligned Optimization (GAO) 学鲁棒 up-projection；每任务结束后、把更新并入 backbone 前，对 general 更新做闭式重标定 (closed-form recalibration)，逼近该共享方向上的特征级联合最优。
Result: 实验表明 LoDA 优于现有持续学习方法；代码发布于 github.com/HHHLF/LoDA_ICML2026。
Conclusion: 把 LoRA 更新按共享与专属方向显式解耦，并对共享方向做闭式重标定，可在持续学习中同时保住知识迁移与任务隔离。

papers.title: HERO: Learning Humanoid End-Effector Control for Visual Whole-Body Open-Vocabulary Object Grasping
papers.abstract_en: Visual loco-manipulation of arbitrary in-the-wild objects requires accurate end-effector (EE) control and a generalizable understanding of the scene from visual inputs (eg, RGB-D images). Existing imitation and sim2real methods jointly learn both these aspects via monolithic end-to-end learning and are thus hard to scale. In this work, we bring to bear the best tools for each of these problems -- large vision models for generalizable scene understanding and simulated training for accurate EE control -- leading to an overall modular loco-manipulation system that exhibits strong generalization. Our core technical innovation is HERO, an accurate residual-aware EE tracking policy made possible by combining classical robotics with machine learning. It uses a) inverse kinematics to convert residual end-effector targets into reference trajectories, b) a learned neural forward model for accurate forward kinematics, and c) goal adjustment and replanning. Together, these innovations reduce the end-effector tracking error to 2.44cm, outperforming the strongest prior method by 5.5x. Our overall system operates in diverse real-world environments, from offices to coffee shops, where the robot reliably grasps various everyday objects (eg, mugs, apples, toys) on surfaces ranging from 43cm to 92cm in height. Systematic modular and end-to-end tests demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed design. We believe our advances open up new ways of training humanoids to interact with daily objects. Project page: https://hero-humanoid.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HERO 把人形机器人全身视觉抓取拆成模块化系统：大视觉模型负责开放词汇场景理解，HERO 策略用逆运动学、神经前向模型与目标重规划做残差感知的末端执行器 (EE) 跟踪。EE 跟踪误差降到 2.44cm，比最强已有方法好 5.5 倍，并在办公室到咖啡店的真实环境中抓取 43–92cm 高台面上的日常物体。
Motivation: 野外任意物体的视觉 loco-manipulation 需要同时做到精确 EE 控制与可泛化的场景理解，而现有模仿学习与 sim2real 方法用单体端到端网络联合学习这两点，难以扩展。
Method: 模块化系统：大视觉模型提供开放词汇场景理解，仿真训练保证 EE 控制精度。核心 HERO 是残差感知 EE 跟踪策略，结合经典机器人学与机器学习——用逆运动学 (inverse kinematics) 把残差 EE 目标转成参考轨迹，用学习的神经前向模型实现精确正运动学，并加入 goal adjustment 与 replanning。
Result: EE 跟踪误差降至 2.44cm，比最强已有方法提升 5.5 倍；系统在办公室、咖啡店等多样真实环境中可靠抓取杯子、苹果、玩具等日常物体，台面高度覆盖 43cm 到 92cm；模块化与端到端对照测试均支持该设计。
Conclusion: 把场景理解与 EE 控制解耦、用经典运动学加学习残差补偿来跟踪末端，是训练人形机器人与日常物体交互的一条有效路径。

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Temporal Domain Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Temporal domain generalization (TDG) learns from a sequence of observed domains to predict models for unseen future domains. Existing parameter-dynamics methods become prohibitively expensive at modern backbone scales because their temporal encoders and generators operate on the entire adapted parameter state. Replacing full-model updates with LoRA does not remove this failure mode: the dynamics model must still encode and reconstruct every adapter parameter, making the auxiliary model itself prohibitively large for modern backbones. We propose Low-rank Time-varying Core (LoTiC), a parameter-efficient TDG method that decomposes temporal updates into shared low-rank bases and a compact core. The bases define a stable update subspace, while only the core evolves. LoTiC therefore learns temporal dynamics in an r*r space instead of tracking the full adapter. We justify this factorization through the geometry of parameter increments and support continuous, recurrent, and time-conditioned core models. Experiments span six controlled and real-world benchmarks, three data modalities, classification and generation, and backbones from 66M to 8B parameters. LoTiC ranks first in 14 of 15 settings, including near-perfect future-domain accuracy with an 8B backbone on Rotating 2-Moons. It adds only 0.13--0.51% trainable parameters beyond LoRA and trains 1.8--7.1$\times$ faster than parameter-dynamics baselines. These results establish that temporal parameter dynamics can remain both learnable and efficient as pretrained backbones scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoTiC 把时序域泛化 (TDG) 中的参数更新分解为共享低秩基与一个只随时间演化的紧凑 core，使动态建模在 r×r 空间而非全量 adapter 参数上进行。在 6 个受控与真实基准、3 种数据模态、backbone 66M–8B 的 15 个设置中拿下 14 个第一，额外可训练参数仅比 LoRA 多 0.13–0.51%，训练比参数动态基线快 1.8–7.1×。
Motivation: 参数动态类 TDG 的时序编码器与生成器要在整个已适配参数状态上运行，换用 LoRA 也仍需编码重构每个 adapter 参数，辅助模型在现代 backbone 规模下变得不可承受。
Method: 提出 Low-rank Time-varying Core (LoTiC)：把时序更新分解为共享低秩基（定义稳定更新子空间）与紧凑 core，仅让 core 演化，动态学习发生在 r×r 空间；分解依据参数增量的几何结构，并支持 continuous、recurrent、time-conditioned 三种 core 模型。
Result: 在 6 个受控与真实基准、3 种数据模态（分类与生成）、66M 到 8B 参数 backbone 上，LoTiC 在 15 个设置中的 14 个排名第一；8B backbone 在 Rotating 2-Moons 上取得接近完美的未来域准确率；相比 LoRA 仅增加 0.13–0.51% 可训练参数，比参数动态基线训练快 1.8–7.1×。
Conclusion: 时序参数动态可以随预训练 backbone 扩展而同时保持可学习性与效率，关键在于只让低秩 core 演化而非追踪整个 adapter。

papers.title: Flow Matching with Uncertainty Quantification and Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Despite the remarkable success of sampling-based generative models such as flow matching, they can still produce samples of inconsistent or degraded quality. To assess sample reliability and improve sample fidelity, we propose uncertainty-aware flow matching (UA-Flow), a lightweight extension of flow matching that predicts the velocity field together with heteroscedastic uncertainty. UA-Flow estimates spatially localized sample uncertainty by propagating velocity uncertainty through the flow dynamics. The resulting estimates serve as reliability signals that reflect data-manifold support for each generated sample or region. We further use them to steer generation via uncertainty-aware guidance (UG) and uncertainty-aware classifier-free guidance (UCFG). Experiments on ImageNet and CIFAR-10 show that UA-Flow's uncertainty tracks sample fidelity more consistently than element-wise baselines and that these signals also carry information about data-manifold support. On ImageNet, UG increases precision at the cost of recall and improves FID, while UCFG maintains lower FID than CFG at large guidance scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 UA-Flow：在 flow matching 中让速度场同时输出异方差不确定性，并沿流动力学传播得到空间局部的样本不确定性估计，作为数据流形支撑度的可靠性信号。基于该信号的 UG 与 UCFG 引导在 ImageNet 上改善 FID，其中 UG 提高 precision 但牺牲 recall，UCFG 在大引导尺度下保持比 CFG 更低的 FID。
Motivation: 采样式生成模型（如 flow matching）会产出质量不一致或退化的样本，缺少判断单个样本或区域可靠性的信号。
Method: UA-Flow 在 flow matching 之上加轻量扩展，让网络同时预测速度场与异方差不确定性；将速度不确定性沿流动力学传播，得到空间局部的样本不确定性估计，再据此构造不确定性感知引导 (UG) 与不确定性感知无分类器引导 (UCFG)。
Result: 在 ImageNet 与 CIFAR-10 上，UA-Flow 的不确定性比逐元素 (element-wise) 基线更一致地追踪样本保真度，并携带数据流形支撑信息；ImageNet 上 UG 提升 precision 但降低 recall 并改善 FID，UCFG 在大引导尺度下比 CFG 保持更低 FID。
Conclusion: 把速度场的异方差不确定性沿流传播，可作为生成质量的可靠性信号，并能直接用于引导以在 precision/recall 与 FID 之间做可控权衡。

papers.title: Bridging Academia and Industry: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Attributed Graph Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Attributed Graph Clustering (AGC) is a fundamental unsupervised task that integrates structural topology and node attributes to uncover latent patterns in graph-structured data. Despite its significance in industrial applications such as fraud detection and user segmentation, a significant chasm persists between academic research and real-world deployment. Current evaluation protocols suffer from the small-scale, high-homophily citation datasets, non-scalable full-batch training paradigms, and a reliance on supervised metrics that fail to reflect performance in label-scarce environments. To bridge these gaps, we present PyAGC, a comprehensive, production-ready benchmark and library designed to stress-test AGC methods across diverse scales and structural properties. We unify existing methodologies into a modular Encode-Cluster-Optimize framework and, for the first time, provide memory-efficient, mini-batch implementations for a wide array of state-of-the-art AGC algorithms. Our benchmark curates 12 diverse datasets, ranging from 2.7K to 111M nodes, specifically incorporating industrial graphs with complex tabular features and low homophily. Furthermore, we advocate for a holistic evaluation protocol that mandates unsupervised structural metrics and efficiency profiling alongside traditional supervised metrics. Battle-tested in high-stakes industrial workflows at Ant Group, this benchmark offers the community a robust, reproducible, and scalable platform to advance AGC research towards realistic deployment. The code and resources are publicly available via GitHub (https://github.com/Cloudy1225/PyAGC), PyPI (https://pypi.org/project/pyagc), and Documentation (https://pyagc.readthedocs.io). We invite readers to our latest survey (https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.20829) for the unified framework and industrial perspective that complement this benchmark.
papers.comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PyAGC 把属性图聚类 (AGC) 统一进 Encode-Cluster-Optimize 模块框架，并首次为一批 SOTA AGC 算法提供内存高效的 mini-batch 实现，可在 2.7K 到 111M 节点的 12 个数据集上做压力测试。评测协议强制要求无监督结构指标与效率剖析，与传统有监督指标并列；该基准已在 Ant Group 的高风险工业流程中实战使用。
Motivation: 现有 AGC 评测依赖小规模、高同质性 (homophily) 的引文数据集，训练范式是非可扩展的全批次训练，且依赖有监督指标，无法反映标签稀缺的真实部署环境，学术研究与工业落地之间存在明显鸿沟。
Method: 提出生产就绪的基准与库 PyAGC，将既有方法统一为模块化的 Encode-Cluster-Optimize 框架，并首次为大量 SOTA AGC 算法提供内存高效的 mini-batch 实现；评测协议同时要求无监督结构指标、效率剖析与传统有监督指标。
Result: 整理 12 个数据集，规模从 2.7K 节点到 111M 节点，特意纳入具有复杂表格特征和低同质性的工业图；代码与资源通过 GitHub、PyPI 和 Read the Docs 公开发布。
Conclusion: AGC 研究要走向真实部署，需要可复现、可扩展且覆盖多样规模与结构特性的基准，以及兼顾无监督指标与效率的评测协议。

papers.title: TKGB: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Temporal Knowledge Graph Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Temporal knowledge graph (TKG) forecasting has advanced remarkably in recent years. Yet we found existing benchmarks inadvertently introduce a shortcut: For a subset of test queries, models can achieve optimal evaluation metrics without using any time information. We trace this to two pieces of evidence: inherent dataset biases and an overly simplistic task formulation that allows models to exploit biases, revealing fundamental flaws in current evaluation protocols for differentiating true forecasting ability. Moreover, existing datasets rely on fixed history that poorly reflects real-world dynamics, lack semantic context, and fail to explicitly mitigate shortcut, preventing thorough assessment of forecasting abilities. To address these, we propose TKGB, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the capability of TKG forecasting models. By integrating four complementary tasks with an automatic pipeline for constructing up-to-date and context-enriched TKG datasets with controllable shortcuts, TKGB reveals capability differences and failure modes hidden under conventional evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TKGB 指出 TKG 预测基准存在捷径：部分测试查询不使用任何时间信息也能拿到最优评估指标，根源是数据集固有偏置与过简的任务形式。为此提出 TKGB 基准，用自动流水线构建可更新、含语义上下文且捷径可控的数据集，整合四个互补任务，暴露常规评测掩盖的能力差异与失败模式。
Motivation: 现有 TKG 基准让模型靠数据偏置而非时间信息刷分，无法区分真实预测能力；且数据集历史固定、缺乏语义上下文，难以反映真实动态。
Method: 提出 TKGB：整合四个互补任务，配一条自动流水线，构建可更新、上下文增强且捷径可控 (controllable shortcuts) 的 TKG 数据集，用于评估 TKG 预测模型能力。
Result: 发现现有基准中一部分测试查询不使用时间信息即可达到最优评估指标；TKGB 揭示了被常规评测掩盖的模型能力差异与失败模式。
Conclusion: 当前 TKG 预测评测协议存在根本缺陷，需用捷径可控、上下文增强的基准来真正区分预测能力。
