papers.title: Is Flow Matching Just Trajectory Replay for Sequential Data?
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching (FM) is increasingly used in scientific domains for time series generation and forecasting, where data often arise from underlying dynamical systems. However, it is not well-understood whether it learns transferable dynamical structure or simply performs an effective ''trajectory replay''. We study this question by deriving the optimal velocity field targeted by the empirical FM objective on sequential data. For the Gaussian conditional paths commonly used in practice, we show that the resulting sampler is an ODE whose dynamics describe a nonparametric, memory-augmented continuous-time dynamical system. The driving velocity field admits a closed-form expression as a weighted mixture of instantaneous velocities determined by observed transitions. This characterization provides an interpretable view of neural FM models as parametric estimation of an underlying nonparametric target and naturally leads to FreeFM: a closed-form, training-free realization of this target. FreeFM provides a transparent reference for studying sequential FM while yielding effective probabilistic forecasts directly from historical transitions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 推导了序列数据上 flow matching 经验目标所对齐的最优速度场：在常用的 Gaussian conditional path 下，采样器是一个带记忆增强的非参数连续时间动力系统，速度场是观测转移所决定的瞬时速度的加权混合。由此给出 FreeFM——该目标的闭式、免训练实现，可直接从历史转移产出概率预报，作为理解序列 FM 的透明参照。
Motivation: FM 被广泛用于时序生成与预报，但不清楚它学到的是可迁移的动力学结构，还是仅仅在做有效的轨迹回放 (trajectory replay)；缺少一个能对齐经验目标的可解释参照。
Method: 推导序列数据上经验 FM 目标所对准的最优速度场；对实践中常用的 Gaussian conditional path，证明所得采样器是描述非参数、记忆增强连续时间动力系统的 ODE，速度场有闭式表达（观测转移决定的瞬时速度的加权混合）；据此构造 FreeFM，一个闭式、免训练的目标实现。
Result: 给出最优速度场的闭式表达：作为由观测转移确定的瞬时速度的加权混合；证明 Gaussian conditional path 下的采样器等价于非参数、记忆增强的连续时间动力系统 ODE；FreeFM 以闭式、免训练方式直接从历史转移给出概率预报。
Conclusion: 序列 FM 可被刻画为对一个非参数记忆动力系统目标的参数化估计，因此可用 FreeFM 这一免训练闭式参照来判别模型学到的是动力学结构还是轨迹回放。

papers.title: On the Dynamics of Delayed Generalization in Linear Models
papers.abstract_en: Delayed generalization, where training accuracy becomes nearly perfect substantially before test accuracy, has often been studied in the context of the depth and compositional structure of deep networks. In this paper, we ask whether delayed generalization can occur in simpler settings. We show that it can arise in a linear model trained with gradient descent and an exponential-tail loss on linearly separable data. We characterize the finite-time hyperplane dynamics into three phases: a population phase, a support vector dominated unlearning phase and a generalization phase. The convergence of the residual beyond the maximum-margin direction is sufficient for the unlearning phase to begin. In the support vector dominated phase, we characterize the hyperplane dynamics. The time scale in these dynamics causes delayed generalization. We validate our theory through controlled experiments varying population and support-vector distributions, and further verify the predicted bias behavior in a deep model with a single output neuron on MNIST. Our results provide a unified characterization of the asymptotic and finite-time dynamics underlying delayed generalization in linear models.
papers.comment: v2: substantially revised and improved version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线性可分数据上用梯度下降训练带指数尾损失的线性模型，也会出现延迟泛化：训练精度早早接近完美而测试精度滞后。作者把有限时间超平面动力学分成 population 阶段、support vector 主导的 unlearning 阶段和 generalization 阶段，指出残差在最大间隔方向之外收敛即触发 unlearning，而该阶段的时间尺度正是延迟的来源。
Motivation: 延迟泛化此前主要在网络深度与复合结构的语境下研究，作者追问它能否在更简单的线性模型中出现，并需要一个统一刻画渐近与有限时间动力学的理论。
Method: 对线性可分数据上指数尾损失的线性模型，推导梯度下降下超平面的有限时间动力学，分为 population、support vector 主导的 unlearning、generalization 三阶段，并给出残差在最大间隔方向外收敛作为 unlearning 开始的充分条件；用改变 population 与 support-vector 分布的受控实验验证理论，再在单输出神经元的深度模型上于 MNIST 检验预测的 bias 行为。
Result: 受控实验中改变 population 与 support-vector 分布验证了三阶段理论，并在 MNIST 上单输出神经元的深度模型中验证了预测的 bias 行为；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 延迟泛化并非深度网络复合结构所独有，其根源是 support vector 主导阶段的时间尺度，可在线性模型中被统一刻画。

papers.title: Rational Transductors
papers.abstract_en: Standard Transformers excel at semantic modeling but struggle with rigid sequential logic and state tracking. Theoretical work establishes that self-attention is limited to $\AC^0$ (under hard attention) or $\TC^0$ (under soft attention), complexity classes that often fail to support robust length generalization on sequential problems without intermediate chain-of-thought \citep{hahn2020theoretical, hao2022formal, merrill2022saturated}. In this work, we introduce \emph{Rational Transductors}, a dual-stream architecture that augments the Transformer with a matrix-valued recurrence derived from Weighted Finite Automata (WFA). By injecting rational state information into the attention mechanism via a \emph{Deep Rational Injection} scheme, our framework strictly generalizes the expressive power of Transformers to capture all Regular Languages, $\NC^1$-complete languages (such as the word problem of $S_5$), and fundamental separations like Parity and Modular Counting, while preserving $O(\log T)$ parallel training efficiency. We ground the architecture in a rigorous learning theory: we prove that \emph{Random Rational Features} act as a universal basis for sequential dependencies, justifying our initialization strategy, while establishing that the \emph{Differentiable Rational Feature} regime is necessary to close the representational compactness gap. Theoretical analysis and empirical results demonstrate that Rational Transductors solve the ``Regular Gap,'' enabling robust length generalization on algorithmic tasks where standard Transformers fail, without the sequential computational bottlenecks of traditional RNNs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Rational Transductors：在 Transformer 上并联一条来自加权有限自动机 (WFA) 的矩阵值递归流，经 Deep Rational Injection 把有理状态注入注意力，使表达力严格覆盖全部正则语言与 NC^1-完备语言（如 S_5 词问题、Parity、Modular Counting），同时保持 O(log T) 并行训练。理论上证明 Random Rational Features 是序列依赖的通用基，并指出可微有理特征机制对弥合表示紧致性差距是必要的；作者称该架构在标准 Transformer 失败的算法任务上实现稳健的长度泛化，即解决 Regular Gap。
Motivation: 自注意力在硬注意力下限于 AC^0、软注意力下限于 TC^0，这类复杂度类在缺少中间思维链时难以在序列问题上稳健地做长度泛化，而传统 RNN 又有顺序计算瓶颈。
Method: 双流架构：主干为 Transformer，副流是源自 Weighted Finite Automata 的矩阵值递归，通过 Deep Rational Injection 方案把有理状态信息注入注意力机制；初始化策略由 Random Rational Features 作为序列依赖通用基的定理支撑，并采用 Differentiable Rational Feature 机制弥合表示紧致性差距。
Result: 表达力严格推广到全部 Regular Languages、NC^1-完备语言（如 S_5 的词问题）以及 Parity 与 Modular Counting 这类基本分离问题，同时保留 O(log T) 并行训练效率；理论分析与经验结果共同表明在标准 Transformer 失败的算法任务上实现稳健长度泛化。
Conclusion: 把 WFA 有理递归注入注意力可在不引入 RNN 顺序瓶颈的前提下补上 Transformer 的 Regular Gap，且该表达力提升有学习理论依据。

papers.title: Multimodal Latent Reasoning via Hierarchical Visual Cues Injection
papers.abstract_en: The advancement of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has enabled impressive perception capabilities. However, their reasoning process often remains a "fast thinking" paradigm, reliant on end-to-end generation or explicit, language-centric chains of thought (CoT), which can be inefficient, verbose, and prone to hallucination. This work posits that robust reasoning should evolve within a latent space, integrating multimodal signals seamlessly. We propose multimodal latent reasoning via HIerarchical Visual cuEs injection (\emph{HIVE}), a novel framework that instills deliberate, "slow thinking" without depending on superficial textual rationales. Our method recursively extends transformer blocks, creating an internal loop for iterative reasoning refinement. Crucially, it injectively grounds this process with hierarchical visual cues from global scene context to fine-grained regional details directly into the model's latent representations. This enables the model to perform grounded, multi-step inference entirely in the aligned latent space. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that test-time scaling is effective when incorporating vision knowledge, and that integrating hierarchical information significantly enhances the model's understanding of complex scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HIVE 在 MLLM 的潜空间里做多模态推理：递归扩展 transformer block 形成迭代精化的内部循环，并把从全局场景到细粒度区域的层级视觉线索直接注入潜表征，从而不依赖显式语言 CoT 也能完成多步推理。作者称评测显示引入视觉知识时 test-time scaling 有效，层级信息显著提升复杂场景理解。
Motivation: MLLM 的推理停留在依赖端到端生成或显式语言链 (CoT) 的“快思考”，既冗长低效又易产生幻觉，缺少在潜空间内整合多模态信号的机制。
Method: 提出 HIVE (HIerarchical Visual cuEs injection)：递归扩展 transformer blocks 造出迭代推理精化的内部循环，并把层级视觉线索（全局场景上下文到细粒度区域细节）注入式地 grounding 到模型潜表征，使多步推理完全在对齐的潜空间中进行。

papers.title: LingLanMedBench: A Unified Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Traditional Chinese Medicine
papers.abstract_en: Reliable evaluation of large language models in traditional Chinese medicine remains limited because existing benchmarks mainly focus on examination-style question answering or isolated generative tasks. We developed LingLanMedBench, a unified benchmark comprising 25,620 expert-verified items across 13 subtasks and five domains, covering knowledge, language understanding, information extraction, and diagnostic-therapeutic decision-making. LingLanMedBench standardizes task formats and evaluation metrics and further incorporates synonym-tolerant clinical-label matching, empirically derived hard subsets, and decision-recognition reformulations of open-ended clinical tasks. Fourteen open-source and proprietary models were evaluated under a standardized zero-shot protocol. Performance varied substantially across domains, model families, task formulations, and difficulty levels. The leading overall score decreased from 51.1 on the full benchmark to 31.9 on the hard subsets. Prescription performance also differed markedly between open-ended generation, with F1 scores of 32.7 and 20.3, and decision recognition, with accuracies of 90.6 and 56.8 on the full and hard subsets, respectively. These findings reveal a substantial gap between knowledge-oriented performance and clinically faithful reasoning. LingLanMedBench provides a standardized and reproducible framework for characterizing current capabilities, identifying systematic limitations, and tracking meaningful progress in large language models for traditional Chinese medicine.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LingLanMedBench 是面向中医药 LLM 的统一基准，含 25,620 条专家审核题目、13 个子任务、5 个领域，覆盖知识、语言理解、信息抽取与诊疗决策。14 个开源与闭源模型在统一 zero-shot 协议下评测：最佳总分从全集 51.1 降到难子集 31.9；处方任务上开放式生成 F1 仅 32.7（难子集 20.3），而决策识别准确率达 90.6（难子集 56.8），说明知识型得分与临床忠实推理之间存在明显落差。
Motivation: 现有中医药 LLM 基准多局限于考试式问答或孤立生成任务，缺少统一格式与指标，难以刻画模型在诊疗决策上的真实能力与系统性短板。
Method: 构建 LingLanMedBench：25,620 条专家审核题目、13 子任务、5 领域，统一任务格式与评测指标；引入同义词容忍的临床标签匹配、经验导出的难子集 (hard subsets)，以及把开放式临床任务改写为决策识别 (decision-recognition) 的形式；14 个开源与闭源模型按统一 zero-shot 协议评测。
Result: 最佳模型总分在全集为 51.1，难子集降至 31.9。处方任务在开放式生成下 F1 为 32.7（全集）与 20.3（难子集），改为决策识别后准确率为 90.6（全集）与 56.8（难子集）。表现随领域、模型家族、任务形式与难度显著变化。
Conclusion: 中医药 LLM 的知识型得分与临床忠实推理之间存在实质差距；任务形式（开放式生成 vs 决策识别）会极大改变结论，评测必须区分二者并使用难子集。

papers.title: Deep Time-series Forecasting Needs Kernelized Moment Balancing
papers.abstract_en: Deep time-series forecasting can be formulated as a distribution balancing problem aimed at aligning the distribution of the forecasts and ground truths. According to Imbens' criterion, balancing two distributions requires that their first moments be identical with respect to any balancing function. We demonstrate that existing objectives enforce moment matching only for one or two predefined balancing functions, thus failing to achieve full distribution balance. To address this limitation, we propose direct forecasting with kernelized moment balancing (KMB-DF). Unlike existing objectives, KMB-DF adaptively selects the most informative balancing functions from a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) to enforce sufficient distribution balancing. A tractable and differentiable formulation is derived to enable estimation from empirical samples and seamless integration into gradient-based training pipelines. Extensive experiments across multiple models and datasets show that KMB-DF consistently improves forecasting accuracy and achieves state-of-the-art performance. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/KMB-DF-403C.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把深度时序预测重写为分布对齐问题：按 Imbens 判据，两分布平衡要求对任意平衡函数一阶矩相同，而现有损失只对一两个预设平衡函数做矩匹配，无法实现完全分布平衡。KMB-DF 从再生核希尔伯特空间 (RKHS) 中自适应选取信息量最大的平衡函数，并推导出可微、可从经验样本估计的形式以接入梯度训练；在多个模型与数据集上一致提升预测精度并达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 现有预测目标只对少数预设平衡函数强制矩匹配，按 Imbens 判据不足以实现完整分布平衡，限制了预测精度。
Method: 提出 direct forecasting with kernelized moment balancing (KMB-DF)：在 RKHS 中自适应选择最具信息量的平衡函数来施加充分的分布平衡，并推导出可处理、可微的表达式，使其能从经验样本估计并无缝嵌入基于梯度的训练流程。
Result: 在多个模型与数据集上的广泛实验中，KMB-DF 一致提升预测精度并取得 state-of-the-art 性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 以 RKHS 自适应平衡函数替代预设矩匹配，是让深度时序预测目标满足 Imbens 判据、实现充分分布平衡的有效途径。

papers.title: Cosmic Rays as an Interdisciplinary Earth Observation Tool: From Particle Physics and Atmospheric Processes to Geosciences and Urban Science
papers.abstract_en: The exploration of cosmic rays, which are high-energy particles originating from space and the atmosphere, has historically been associated with particle physics and astrophysics. In the last 20 years, these particles have evolved into valuable tools for observing Earth's systems. This review compiles the use of cosmic rays in three primary areas: (1) particle physics and atmospheric processes, which include cosmic- ray-induced cascades, ionization, and their impact on atmospheric chemistry and radiation; (2) geosciences, where cosmogenic radionuclides assist in the dating of geological materials and cosmic-ray neutrons are used for large-scale monitoring of soil moisture and snow water equivalents; and (3) urban science, where cosmic- ray muons are employed for non-invasive subsurface imaging and, when paired with distributed sensors, serve as the basis for smart city monitoring. This review places particular emphasis on integrating these methods with remote sensing and geographic information systems (GIS), which helps close the persistent scale gap between point measurements and satellite observations, thereby enabling three-dimensional digital representations of subsurfaces. This review concludes by discussing data standards, their integration into operational Earth observation workflows, and future research directions.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. accepted by Springer Nature: Discover Earth Observation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 综述把宇宙线作为跨学科地球观测工具的三类用法归拢起来：宇宙线级联与电离影响大气化学和辐射，宇宙核素用于地质定年、宇宙线中子用于大尺度土壤湿度与雪水当量监测，μ子用于地下非侵入成像。核心主张是把这类原位测量与遥感和 GIS 融合，弥合点测量与卫星观测之间的尺度缺口，进而构建地下三维数字表达。
Motivation: 点尺度原位测量与卫星观测之间长期存在尺度缺口，宇宙线类方法分散在粒子物理、地球科学与城市科学多个领域，缺少统一梳理及其与遥感/GIS 的整合路径。
Method: 综述性工作，按三大领域归并文献：宇宙线诱导级联、电离及其对大气化学与辐射的影响；宇宙核素定年与宇宙线中子土壤湿度/雪水当量监测；μ子地下成像与分布式传感器智慧城市监测；重点讨论与遥感、GIS 的集成及数据标准。
Result: 覆盖近 20 年宇宙线从粒子物理对象演变为地球系统观测工具的进展，梳理三大应用领域与遥感/GIS 融合方式，并讨论数据标准、业务化地球观测工作流接入与未来方向；全文 19 页、2 图、2 表。
Conclusion: 宇宙线观测要进入业务化地球观测，关键在于数据标准统一并与遥感、GIS 打通，以此把点测量和卫星观测的尺度缺口闭合为地下三维数字表达。

papers.title: Beyond Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) Accelerators: Directed Evidence for Adaptive Sustainability Portfolios
papers.abstract_en: Governments and development partners often seek Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) "accelerators" whose progress can propagate gains across human well-being, institutions, resources, and environmental priorities. Such claims require evidence on direction, timing, robustness, and trade-offs, not only network connectivity. We map directed SDG interdependence using a balanced panel of 114 countries observed annually from 2000 to 2024. Because the goal series are persistent, trending, and cross-sectionally dependent, we combine Dumitrescu-Hurlin panel Granger non-causality tests on first-differenced series with false-discovery control across 272 directed goal pairs, and panel local projections with Driscoll-Kraay standard errors for 31 theory-derived indicator linkages. We find 84 directed linkages after correction: 40 synergies and 44 trade-offs. This dense structure does not support a universal accelerator. Driver-receiver rankings are fragile across lag orders, centrality metrics, bootstrap resampling, and alternative dependence controls; only peace and strong institutions as a net receiver and poverty reduction as an effect-size-weighted driver are distinguishable in the bootstrap screen. Two local-projection pathways are supported, both leading to lower child mortality, and the education-child-health association is corroborated in independent World Development Indicators data across 183 countries. The policy implication is not to abandon SDG integration, but to replace fixed global accelerator rankings with adaptive portfolios built around supported, time-lagged linkages and monitored constituent indicators.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 5 figures; supplementary information (Tables S1-S9, Figures S1-S2) included as ancillary file. Code and data: see Open Research statement in the paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 114 国 2000–2024 年平衡面板检验 SDG 加速器是否存在：Dumitrescu-Hurlin 面板 Granger 非因果检验加 FDR 校正后得到 84 条有向关联（40 协同、44 权衡），密度足以否定普适加速器。驱动-接收排名在滞后阶数、中心性指标、bootstrap 重抽样下都不稳定，只有和平与强制度作为净接收方、减贫作为效应量加权驱动因子在 bootstrap 筛选中可区分；作者主张用围绕已支持的时滞关联的自适应组合替代固定全球加速器排名。
Motivation: SDG 加速器主张常只凭网络连通性，缺少方向、时序、稳健性与权衡的证据；而目标序列持续、趋势且存在截面相关，普通因果检验会给出虚假的加速器排名。
Method: 在 114 国 2000–2024 年平衡面板上，对一阶差分序列做 Dumitrescu-Hurlin 面板 Granger 非因果检验，对 272 条有向目标对做错误发现率 (FDR) 校正；再对 31 条理论推导的指标关联做面板局部投影 (panel local projections)，标准误用 Driscoll-Kraay；稳健性靠滞后阶数、中心性指标、bootstrap 重抽样与替代依赖控制，并在 183 国 World Development Indicators 独立数据上做佐证。
Result: 校正后保留 84 条有向关联，其中 40 条协同、44 条权衡；驱动-接收排名在滞后阶数、中心性指标、bootstrap 与依赖控制下均脆弱，bootstrap 筛选中仅和平与强制度（净接收方）与减贫（效应量加权驱动）可区分；两条局部投影路径均指向儿童死亡率下降，教育-儿童健康关联在 183 国 WDI 独立数据中得到佐证。
Conclusion: SDG 之间存在密集但不支持普适加速器的有向结构，政策上应放弃固定全球加速器排名，改用围绕已获支持的时滞关联并监测其构成指标的自适应组合。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Tree-Structured Synergy of Large Language Models and Bayesian Optimization for Efficient CASH
papers.abstract_en: To lower the expertise barrier in machine learning, the AutoML community has focused on the CASH problem, which jointly automates algorithm selection and hyperparameter tuning. While traditional methods like Bayesian Optimization (BO) struggle with cold-start issues, Large Language Models (LLMs) can mitigate these through semantic priors. However, existing LLM-based optimizers generalize poorly to high-dimensional, structured CASH spaces. CASH requires coordinated exploration and exploitation both across candidate algorithms and within their algorithm-specific hyperparameter spaces. Yet existing approaches often rely on flat optimization histories that mix observations across algorithms and obscure configuration-refinement trajectories. In this paper, we propose LB-MCTS, a trajectory-structured optimization framework that uses a Monte Carlo Tree Search tree as a shared state for algorithm selection, hyperparameter refinement, and BO-LLM proposer synergy. Within this shared state, BO provides algorithm-specific surrogate modeling for quantitative search, while the LLM exploits path-aware selective memory to generate semantic proposals and reflections. As the surrogate model improves, a reliability-aware proposer policy adaptively shifts from LLM-driven to BO-driven proposals within a unified search trajectory. Experiments on 104 AMLB datasets demonstrate that LB-MCTS consistently outperforms BO-based, LLM-based, and hybrid baselines. Code: https://github.com/PKU-DAIR/open-box.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Extended version with full appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LB-MCTS：用 Monte Carlo Tree Search 树作为共享状态，把算法选择、算法内超参细化与 BO-LLM 提案协同放进同一条轨迹，随代理模型变可靠，提案策略自适应从 LLM 主导切到 BO 主导。在 104 个 AMLB 数据集上持续优于纯 BO、纯 LLM 与混合基线。
Motivation: CASH 需要跨候选算法与算法内超参空间协同探索与利用，但现有 LLM 优化器在高维结构化 CASH 空间上泛化差，且扁平优化历史把不同算法的观测混在一起、掩盖了配置细化轨迹，BO 又有冷启动问题。
Method: LB-MCTS 以 MCTS 树为共享状态，同时承载算法选择、超参细化与 BO-LLM 协同：BO 负责算法特定的代理模型做定量搜索，LLM 用路径感知选择性记忆 (path-aware selective memory) 生成语义提案与反思；提案策略按代理可靠性在 LLM 驱动与 BO 驱动之间自适应切换。
Result: 在 104 个 AMLB 数据集上的实验中，LB-MCTS 持续优于基于 BO、基于 LLM 以及混合基线；代码发布于 github.com/PKU-DAIR/open-box。
Conclusion: 把算法选择与超参细化放进同一条树结构轨迹、并按代理可靠性调度 LLM 与 BO 的分工，是让 LLM 优化器在结构化 CASH 空间上稳定起效的可行路径。

papers.title: Imaging-anchored Multiomics in Cardiovascular Disease: Integrating Cardiac Imaging, Bulk, Single-cell, and Spatial Transcriptomics
papers.abstract_en: Cardiovascular disease arises from interactions between inherited risk, molecular programmes, and tissue-scale remodelling that are observed clinically through imaging. Health systems now routinely generate large volumes of cardiac MRI, CT and echocardiography together with bulk, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, yet these data are still analysed in separate pipelines. This review examines joint representations that link cardiac imaging phenotypes to transcriptomic and spatially resolved molecular states. An imaging-anchored perspective is adopted in which echocardiography, cardiac MRI and CT define a spatial phenotype of the heart, and bulk, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics provide cell-type- and location-specific molecular context. The biological and technical characteristics of these modalities are first summarised, and representation-learning strategies for each are outlined. Multimodal fusion approaches are reviewed, with emphasis on handling missing data, limited sample size, and batch effects. Finally, integrative pipelines for radiogenomics, spatial molecular alignment, and image-based prediction of gene expression are discussed, together with common failure modes, practical considerations, and open challenges. Spatial multiomics of human myocardium and atherosclerotic plaque, single-cell and spatial foundation models, and multimodal medical foundation models are collectively bringing imaging-anchored multiomics closer to large-scale cardiovascular translation.
papers.comment: The authors are withdrawing this version of the preprint to incorporate extensive updates, refine the multi-modal fusion pipelines, and expand the evaluation benchmarks for cardiac imaging and spatial transcriptomics integration. A revised and updated version will be resubmitted shortly
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于心血管疾病影像锚定多组学 (imaging-anchored multiomics) 的综述：以超声、心脏 MRI、CT 定义心脏空间表型，再用 bulk、单细胞与空间转录组提供细胞类型和位置层面的分子语境，梳理各模态的表示学习与多模态融合方法。核心论断是影像与组学数据仍被分开分析，而联合表征正借助心肌与动脉粥样硬化斑块的空间多组学、单细胞/空间基础模型和多模态医学基础模型走向大规模心血管转化。
Motivation: 健康系统已常规产生大量心脏 MRI、CT、超声与 bulk/单细胞/空间转录组数据，但这些数据仍分散在各自独立的分析管线中，影像表型与分子状态之间缺少联合表示。
Method: 采用影像锚定视角：先综述各模态的生物学与技术特性及对应的表示学习策略，再系统梳理多模态融合方法，重点覆盖缺失数据、小样本量与批次效应 (batch effects) 三类问题，最后讨论 radiogenomics、空间分子对齐与基于影像预测基因表达的整合管线及其常见失效模式。
Result: 作为综述给出定性结论：影像锚定多组学在人心肌与动脉粥样硬化斑块的空间多组学、单细胞与空间基础模型、多模态医学基础模型共同推动下，正接近大规模心血管转化；文中同时整理了各整合管线的常见失败模式与开放挑战。
Conclusion: 把心脏影像作为空间表型锚点、转录组作分子语境的联合表示，是把心血管多组学推向规模化转化的可行路径，但需先解决缺失数据、小样本与批次效应。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Long-Range Distillation: Distilling 10,000 Years of Simulated Climate into Long Timestep AI Weather Models
papers.abstract_en: Accurate long-range weather forecasting remains a major challenge for AI models, both because errors accumulate over autoregressive rollouts and because reanalysis training datasets provide limited sampling of the slow modes of variability underpinning predictability. Most AI and all numerical weather prediction models are autoregressive, repeatedly applying short-lead forecasts to reach subseasonal-to-seasonal (S2S) or seasonal lead times, often causing instability and miscalibration. Long-timestep probabilistic models that generate long-range forecasts in a single step offer an alternative, but training on the 40-year reanalysis record leads to overfitting, suggesting orders of magnitude more data are required. We introduce long-range distillation, whereby a long-timestep probabilistic ``student'' model is trained to forecast directly at long-range using a huge synthetic dataset generated by an autoregressive ``teacher'' model. Using the Deep Learning Earth System Model (DLESyM) as teacher, we generate over 10,000 years of simulated climate to train student models across a range of timescales. In perfect-model experiments, the distilled models outperform climatology and approach their teacher's skill while replacing hundreds of autoregressive steps with a single timestep. In the real world, both a diffusion model student fine-tuned on ERA5 and a linear inverse model student with mixed DLESyM-ERA5 training achieve S2S forecast skill competitive with the ECMWF IFS ensemble, with synthetic pre-training providing improvements beyond ERA5-only training. This demonstrates the benefit of synthetic pre-training for both deep learning and classical data-driven methods, and represents the first demonstration that real-world skill can be improved by training on AI-generated synthetic data in volumes far exceeding the observational record.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出长时步蒸馏 (long-range distillation)：用自回归教师模型 DLESyM 生成逾 10,000 年合成气候，训练单步直接预报 S2S 时效的概率学生模型，替代数百步自回归滚动。完美模式实验中蒸馏学生超过气候态、逼近教师水平；真实世界中以 ERA5 微调的 diffusion 学生和混合 DLESyM-ERA5 训练的线性逆模式学生，S2S 技能与 ECMWF IFS 集合相当，且合成预训练带来超出仅用 ERA5 训练的改进。
Motivation: 自回归滚动使误差累积、S2S 时效上不稳定且失准；而 40 年再分析记录对慢变可预报性模态采样不足，长时步概率模型直接在再分析上训练会过拟合，暗示需要多出几个数量级的数据。
Method: 以 Deep Learning Earth System Model (DLESyM) 为自回归教师，生成逾 10,000 年合成气候数据，训练跨多个时标、单步直接输出长时效预报的概率学生模型；学生包括 diffusion 模型（在 ERA5 上微调）与线性逆模式 (linear inverse model)，后者用 DLESyM 与 ERA5 混合数据训练。
Result: 完美模式实验中，蒸馏学生优于气候态 (climatology) 并接近教师技能，同时用单一时步替代数百个自回归步。真实世界中，diffusion 学生与线性逆模式学生的 S2S 技能与 ECMWF IFS 集合相当；合成预训练相对仅用 ERA5 训练带来额外改进。
Conclusion: 合成数据预训练同时惠及深度学习与经典数据驱动方法；这是首次证明用远超观测记录体量的 AI 生成合成数据训练可以提升真实世界预报技能。
Relevance: 88

papers.title: Schrödinger's Navigator: Imagining an Ensemble of Futures for Zero-Shot Object Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot object navigation (ZSON) requires robots to find target objects in unseen environments without task-specific fine-tuning or pre-built maps, a key capability for general-purpose service robots. Yet methods that perform well in simulation often degrade in cluttered real-world scenes with severe occlusion and latent hazards, where large unseen regions make single-scene inference brittle and unsafe. We propose Schrödinger's Navigator, a belief-aware framework that reasons at inference time over multiple trajectory-conditioned imagined 3D futures. Given candidate paths, a trajectory-conditioned 3D world model predicts hypothetical observations and maintains a superposition of plausible scene realizations rather than committing to one map. An adaptive occluder-aware sampler directs imagination to uncertainty-critical regions, while a Future-Aware Value Map (FAVM) aggregates imagined futures for robust, proactive action selection. Experiments in simulation and on a physical Go2 quadruped show that Schrödinger's Navigator outperforms strong ZSON baselines, improving hidden-target discovery and risk-aware waypoint selection in occlusion-heavy navigation scenarios. These results highlight imagined 3D futures as a scalable and generalizable strategy for zero-shot navigation in uncertain real-world environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出信念感知的零样本物体导航 (ZSON) 框架 Schrödinger's Navigator：轨迹条件 3D 世界模型在推理时对多条候选路径生成想象中的 3D 未来，保持场景实现的叠加而非锁定单一地图，再由 Future-Aware Value Map (FAVM) 聚合这些未来做动作选择。仿真与实体 Go2 四足机器人实验显示，它在强 ZSON 基线之上提升了遮挡严重场景下的隐藏目标发现与风险感知路点选择。
Motivation: 在仿真中表现好的 ZSON 方法进入遮挡严重、含潜在危险的真实杂乱场景会退化：大片未观测区域使单场景推断既脆弱又不安全。
Method: 给定候选路径，轨迹条件 3D 世界模型预测假想观测并维持多种合理场景实现的叠加；occluder-aware 自适应采样器把想象导向不确定性关键区域；Future-Aware Value Map (FAVM) 聚合想象出的未来，实现稳健、前瞻的动作选择。
Result: 在仿真与实体 Go2 四足机器人上的实验中，该方法优于强 ZSON 基线，提升了遮挡密集导航场景下的隐藏目标发现与风险感知路点选择。
Conclusion: 想象出的 3D 未来是在不确定真实环境中做零样本导航的一种可扩展且可泛化的策略，优于锁定单一地图的推断方式。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Instability of Safety: How Random Seeds and Temperature Expose Inconsistent LLM Refusal Behavior
papers.abstract_en: Current safety evaluations of large language models rely on single-shot testing, implicitly assuming that model responses are deterministic and representative of the model's safety alignment. We challenge this assumption by investigating the stability of safety refusal decisions across random seeds and temperature settings. Testing four instruction-tuned models from three families (Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen 2.5 7B, Qwen 3 8B, Gemma 3 12B) on 876 harmful prompts across 20 sampling configurations (4 temperatures x 5 seeds), we find that 18-28% of prompts exhibit decision flips (the REFUSE/PARTIAL/COMPLY label changes across configurations), depending on the model. Our Safety Stability Index (SSI) reveals that higher temperatures significantly reduce decision stability (Friedman chi-squared = 396.81, p < 0.001), with mean within-temperature SSI dropping from 0.977 at temperature 0.0 to 0.942 at temperature 1.0. We validate findings across all model families using Claude 3.5 Haiku as a unified external judge, achieving 89.1% inter-judge agreement with the Llama 70B judge on the two models both judges labeled (Cohen's kappa = 0.62). Within each model, prompts with higher compliance rates exhibit lower stability (Spearman rho = -0.47 to -0.70, all p < 0.001), indicating that models "waver" more on borderline requests. These findings demonstrate that single-shot safety evaluations are insufficient for reliable safety assessment and that evaluation protocols must account for stochastic variation in model behavior. For Llama 3.1 8B, single-shot evaluation agrees with multi-sample ground truth only 92.5% of the time when pooling across temperatures (98.7% at greedy to 90.3% at temperature 1.0), and we recommend scaling samples with temperature--one at greedy, three at low temperature, more at higher temperatures (where three reach only ~95%), and ten when pooling--rather than a single flat threshold.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 7 figures, 9 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/erikl2/safety-refusal-stability . v4: no reported numbers change. The Claude 3.5 Haiku judge ran at temperature 1.0, not 0.0 (Table 9); at t=0.0, at least 9 of Qwen 2.5's 81 flips are judge noise, so t=0.0 flip rates include judge noise (Secs. 4.3.1, 5.2); a flip is now defined as any REFUSE/PARTIAL/COMPLY label change
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 4 个指令微调模型在 876 条有害提示上做 20 组采样（4 温度 × 5 随机种子），发现 18–28% 的提示出现 REFUSE/PARTIAL/COMPLY 决策翻转，温度升高显著降低稳定性（mean within-temperature SSI 从 0.977 降到 0.942）。作者据此建议按温度分配采样数：greedy 1 次、低温 3 次、高温更多、合并时 10 次，而非单一固定阈值。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 安全评估依赖单次采样，隐含假设模型输出确定且代表其安全对齐；若拒绝决策随种子和温度翻转，单次评测会系统性误判模型安全性。
Method: 在 Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen 2.5 7B、Qwen 3 8B、Gemma 3 12B 上以 4 温度 × 5 种子共 20 种采样配置测试 876 条有害提示，定义决策翻转为 REFUSE/PARTIAL/COMPLY 标签变化，提出 Safety Stability Index (SSI)；用 Claude 3.5 Haiku 与 Llama 70B 双 judge 交叉验证，并用 Friedman 检验与 Spearman 相关分析温度与合规率的关系。
Result: 18–28% 的提示出现决策翻转（因模型而异）；温度升高显著降低稳定性（Friedman chi-squared = 396.81, p < 0.001），mean within-temperature SSI 从温度 0.0 的 0.977 降至温度 1.0 的 0.942；双 judge 一致性 89.1%（Cohen's kappa = 0.62）；合规率更高的提示稳定性更低（Spearman rho = -0.47 到 -0.70，均 p < 0.001）；Llama 3.1 8B 单次评测与多样本 ground truth 一致率仅 92.5%（greedy 98.7%，温度 1.0 为 90.3%），高温下 3 次采样仅达约 95%。

papers.title: Tracking large chemical reaction networks and rare events by neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Chemical reaction networks are widely used to model stochastic dynamics in biophysical processes. Their exact probabilistic description via the chemical master equation becomes intractable for high-dimensional systems due to the exponential growth of the state space. This difficulty is further exacerbated when metastable transitions and rare events dominate the dynamics. Here, we present an advanced neural-network approach that effectively tackles large reaction networks and rare-event dynamics within a unified framework. Building on autoregressive representations of the full joint probability distribution, we achieve efficient training through second-order optimization methods, including natural gradient descent and the time-dependent variational principle. We leverage enhanced-sampling strategies that enable accurate resolution of low-probability regions governing rare transitions. We demonstrate the method on a multistable genetic toggle switch and a mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) cascade consisting of 16 species and 35 reactions with dense coupling. We further quantify rare events in spatially extended Schlögl models in both one- and two-dimensional lattices, reaching system sizes with extremely large state spaces up to $3\times10^{15}$. These results highlight the potential of neural modeling as a flexible and scalable framework for studying high-dimensional chemical reaction networks and rare events.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用自回归神经网络直接表示化学主方程的全联合概率分布，配合自然梯度下降与时间依赖变分原理 (TDVP) 二阶优化，并引入增强采样解析稀有跃迁的低概率区。在 16 物种 35 反应的 MAPK 级联与多稳态基因 toggle switch 上验证，并把空间扩展 Schlögl 模型推进到状态空间高达 3×10^15 的体系。
Motivation: 高维化学反应网络的化学主方程 (CME) 因状态空间指数增长而不可解，亚稳态跃迁与稀有事件主导动力学时这一困难更严重。

Result: 在多稳态基因 toggle switch 与含 16 个物种、35 个反应且强耦合的 MAPK 级联上演示方法；在 Schlögl 模型的一维与二维格点上量化稀有事件，达到状态空间高达 3×10^15 的体系规模。
Conclusion: 神经建模可作为研究高维化学反应网络与稀有事件的灵活可扩展框架，把增强采样与二阶优化统一进同一概率表示。

papers.title: ELVIS: Enhance Low-Light for Video Instance Segmentation in the Dark
papers.abstract_en: Video instance segmentation (VIS) for low-light content remains highly challenging for both humans and machines alike, due to noise, blur and other adverse conditions. The lack of large-scale annotated datasets and the limitations of current synthetic pipelines, particularly in modeling temporal degradations, further hinder progress. Moreover, existing VIS methods are not robust to the degradations found in low-light videos and, consequently, perform poorly even after finetuning. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{ELVIS} (\textbf{E}nhance \textbf{L}ow-Light for \textbf{V}ideo \textbf{I}nstance \textbf{S}egmentation), a framework that enables domain adaptation of state-of-the-art VIS models to low-light scenarios. ELVIS is comprised of an unsupervised synthetic low-light video pipeline that models both spatial and temporal degradations, a calibration-free degradation profile estimation network (VDP-Net) and an enhancement decoder head that disentangles degradations from content features. ELVIS improves performances by up to \textbf{+3.7AP} on the synthetic low-light YouTube-VIS 2019 dataset and beats two-stage baselines by at least \textbf{+2.8AP} on real low-light videos. Code and dataset available at: \href{https://joannelin168.github.io/research/ELVIS}{https://joannelin168.github.io/research/ELVIS}
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2026, pp. 25011-25021
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ELVIS 把 SOTA 视频实例分割 (VIS) 模型适配到低光视频：无监督合成管线同时建模空间与时间退化，VDP-Net 免标定估计退化剖面，增强解码头把退化与内容特征解耦。在合成低光 YouTube-VIS 2019 上最高提升 +3.7AP，真实低光视频上至少超过两阶段基线 +2.8AP。
Motivation: 低光视频受噪声、模糊等退化影响，缺少大规模标注数据集，现有合成管线难以建模时间退化，现有 VIS 方法即使微调后在低光下仍表现很差。
Method: ELVIS 由三部分组成：无监督合成低光视频管线（同时建模空间与时间退化）、免标定的退化剖面估计网络 VDP-Net、以及将退化与内容特征解耦的增强解码头，用于把 SOTA VIS 模型域适配到低光场景。
Result: 在合成低光 YouTube-VIS 2019 数据集上最高提升 +3.7AP；在真实低光视频上至少超过两阶段基线 +2.8AP。
Conclusion: 通过显式建模时空退化并解耦退化与内容特征，低光 VIS 可以在合成与真实场景上同时获得可测的 AP 提升，代码与数据集已公开。

papers.title: What If They Took the Shot? A Hierarchical Bayesian Framework for Counterfactual Expected Goals
papers.abstract_en: How would the probability of scoring change if a different player took the same shot? Although expected goals models describe the difficulty of scoring opportunities, comparing players on identical chances requires accounting for uncertainty in their estimated conversion probabilities. We address this question through a hierarchical Bayesian framework that evaluates alternative shooters under the same observed circumstances. Using 35,700 eligible shots from four leagues during the 2015/16 season, we compare a contextual benchmark with a primary player-intercept model and a provisional extension that allows player differences to vary with shooting conditions. Paired posterior draws preserve shared uncertainty when individual probability differences are aggregated across opportunities. Chronological validation demonstrates improved predictive performance relative to a constant-rate baseline, but introducing player effects provides negligible additional gains. Controlled single-seed experiments show that greater information per player improves estimation accuracy and narrows uncertainty intervals, although distinguishing small differences remains difficult and confident conclusions about near-null effects can become more frequent. Applications involving Giroud--Vardy and Berardi--Sansone similarly yield estimated differences that are small relative to their posterior uncertainty. These findings highlight an important distinction between predicting the outcome of a shot and establishing whether one player would be more likely to convert it. The proposed framework makes this distinction explicit by evaluating alternative shooters on fixed recorded opportunities while accounting for their contextual exposure. The resulting comparisons concern conditional conversion rather than the causal consequences of replacing a player in a match.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分层贝叶斯反事实 xG 框架：在同一批已记录射门机会上替换射手，用配对后验抽样 (paired posterior draws) 保留共享不确定性，从而区分「预测射门结果」与「判定某球员更可能进球」。在 2015/16 赛季四个联赛 35,700 次射门上，按时间顺序验证显示相对恒定进球率基线预测性能改善，但加入球员效应增益可忽略；Giroud–Vardy、Berardi–Sansone 的估计差异都远小于其后验不确定性。
Motivation: xG 只描述机会难度，直接比较球员需要处理各自转化概率估计的不确定性；小差异容易被噪声淹没，作者要区分预测射门结果与判定换人后谁更可能转化。
Method: 分层贝叶斯框架，比较情境基准模型、球员截距主模型，以及允许球员差异随射门条件变化的扩展模型；用配对后验抽样在机会集合上聚合概率差异并保留共享不确定性，配合按时间顺序的验证与单种子受控实验。
Result: 数据为 2015/16 赛季四个联赛 35,700 次合格射门；按时间顺序验证中相对恒定进球率基线预测性能提升，加入球员效应仅带来可忽略的额外增益；单种子实验显示每名球员信息量越大估计越准、不确定性区间越窄，但区分小差异仍困难，对近零效应的自信结论反而更频繁；Giroud–Vardy 与 Berardi–Sansone 的估计差异相对后验不确定性都很小。
Conclusion: 在固定机会上做条件转化比较是可行的，但小球员差异难以与后验不确定性区分；该比较是条件转化而非换人对比赛的因果后果。

papers.title: A Versatile Variational Quantum Kernel Framework for Non-Trivial Classification
papers.abstract_en: Quantum kernel methods are a promising branch of quantum machine learning, but their per- formance across data types and encoding choices remains incompletely understood. To address this gap, we developed an algorithmic framework for variational quantum kernels utilizing resource- efficient ansätze for complex classification tasks and introduced a parameter scaling technique to accelerate convergence. We conducted a comprehensive benchmark of this framework on eight chal- lenging, real-world and high-dimensional datasets covering tabular, image, time series, and graph data. Our results show that the proposed quantum kernel demonstrated competitive classification accuracy compared to standard classical kernels in classical simulation, such as the radial basis function (RBF) kernel. This work demonstrates that properly designed quantum kernels can func- tion as versatile, high-performance tools, laying a foundation for quantum-enhanced applications in machine learning. Further research is needed to fully assess the practical performance of quantum methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出变分量子核 (variational quantum kernel) 分类框架：用资源高效 ansatz 构造核，并引入参数缩放技术加速收敛。在八个真实高维数据集（表格、图像、时间序列、图）的经典模拟中，其分类精度与 RBF 等标准经典核相当。
Motivation: 量子核方法在不同数据类型与编码选择下的表现缺乏系统认识，需要一个可跨数据模态评估的算法框架。
Method: 构建基于资源高效 ansatz 的变分量子核算法框架，加入参数缩放 (parameter scaling) 技巧加速收敛，并在八个覆盖表格、图像、时间序列与图的高维数据集上做基准测试，与 RBF 等经典核对比。
Result: 在八个真实世界高维数据集的经典模拟中，所提量子核的分类精度与 RBF 等标准经典核相比具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 精心设计的量子核可作为跨数据类型的通用高性能工具，但实际性能仍需进一步研究评估。

papers.title: When is a System Discoverable from Data? Discovery Requires Chaos
papers.abstract_en: The deep learning revolution has enabled major AI advances in physical sciences, particularly in discovering dynamical systems from observational data. Yet the reliability of learned surrogates and symbolically discovered models is often undermined by non-uniqueness: models may fit observed trajectories perfectly, but lack genuine predictive power. We show that chaos, despite its association with unpredictability, is often what makes governing equations discoverable. We prove that the classical Lorenz system is analytically discoverable and verify experimentally that for many systems out-of-domain generalization emerges precisely at chaos onset. Conservative systems, by contrast, are inherently non-discoverable from data alone. The prevalence of chaotic systems in benchmarks may have inadvertently obscured this limitation. These findings help explain why AI excels at weather forecasting, yet struggles in many engineering applications: the systems most amenable to discovery (chaotic ones) are often least amenable to control.
papers.comment: Newest version contains complete discoverability classification
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从数据中发现动力系统方程的可行性取决于系统是否混沌：作者证明 Lorenz 系统是解析可发现的 (analytically discoverable)，实验上域外泛化恰好在混沌起始点 (chaos onset) 处出现，而保守系统仅凭数据本质上不可发现。结论是混沌虽不可预测却使控制方程可辨识，这解释了 AI 为何擅长天气预报却在许多工程系统上失效。
Motivation: 从观测数据学习的代理模型与符号发现模型常受非唯一性困扰：模型可以完美拟合已见轨迹却没有真正的预测能力，而现有基准中混沌系统的普遍性可能掩盖了这一局限。
Method: 对经典 Lorenz 系统给出解析可发现性证明，并通过实验检验域外泛化 (out-of-domain generalization) 与混沌起始点的对应关系；对保守系统论证仅凭数据不可发现，并给出完整的可发现性分类 (discoverability classification)。
Result: 证明 Lorenz 系统解析可发现；实验上许多系统的域外泛化恰在混沌起始处涌现；保守系统本质上不可从数据单独发现。
Conclusion: 可发现性与混沌绑定：最易被发现的系统（混沌系统）往往最难被控制，这解释了 AI 在天气预报与工程应用上的表现分化。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: VEDA: Generation of 3D Molecules via Variance-Exploding Diffusion with Annealing
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models show promise for 3D molecular generation, but face a fundamental trade-off between sampling efficiency and conformational accuracy. While flow-based models are fast, they often produce geometrically inaccurate structures, as they have difficulty capturing the multimodal distributions of molecular conformations. In contrast, denoising diffusion models are more accurate but suffer from slow sampling, a limitation attributed to sub-optimal integration between diffusion dynamics and SE(3)-equivariant architectures. To address this, we propose VEDA, a unified SE(3)-equivariant framework that combines variance-exploding diffusion with annealing to efficiently generate conformationally accurate 3D molecular structures. Specifically, our key technical contributions include: (1) a VE schedule that enables noise injection functionally analogous to simulated annealing, improving 3D accuracy and reducing relaxation energy; (2) a novel preconditioning scheme that reconciles the coordinate-predicting nature of SE(3)-equivariant networks with a residual-based diffusion objective, and (3) a new arcsin-based scheduler that concentrates sampling in critical intervals of the logarithmic signal-to-noise ratio. On the QM9 and GEOM-DRUGS datasets, VEDA matches the sampling efficiency of flow-based models, achieving state-of-the-art valency stability and validity with only 100 sampling steps. More importantly, VEDA's generated structures are remarkably stable, as measured by their relaxation energy during GFN2-xTB optimization. The median energy change is only 1.72 kcal/mol, significantly lower than the 32.3 kcal/mol from its architectural baseline, SemlaFlow. Our framework demonstrates that principled integration of VE diffusion with SE(3)-equivariant architectures can achieve both high chemical accuracy and computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VEDA 把 variance-exploding 扩散与类模拟退火的噪声调度结合到统一的 SE(3)-equivariant 框架中，用 preconditioning 协调坐标预测网络与残差扩散目标，并以 arcsin 调度把采样集中在对数信噪比的关键区间。在 QM9 与 GEOM-DRUGS 上仅用 100 步采样即达到 flow-based 模型的效率与 SOTA 级价键稳定性/有效性，GFN2-xTB 弛豫中位能量变化 1.72 kcal/mol，远低于架构基线 SemlaFlow 的 32.3 kcal/mol。
Motivation: flow-based 模型采样快但难以捕捉分子构象的多模态分布、几何精度差；denoising diffusion 精度高却采样慢，根源是扩散动力学与 SE(3)-equivariant 架构之间的积分不匹配。
Method: VEDA 由三部分组成：功能上类比模拟退火的 VE 噪声调度以提升 3D 精度并降低弛豫能；一种新的 preconditioning 方案，把 SE(3)-equivariant 网络的坐标预测性质与基于残差的扩散目标对齐；以及基于 arcsin 的 scheduler，把采样集中到对数信噪比的关键区间。
Result: 在 QM9 与 GEOM-DRUGS 上，VEDA 以仅 100 个采样步达到 flow-based 模型的采样效率，并取得 state-of-the-art 的 valency stability 与 validity；经 GFN2-xTB 优化测得的生成结构弛豫能量中位变化仅 1.72 kcal/mol，而架构基线 SemlaFlow 为 32.3 kcal/mol。
Conclusion: 作者主张，把 VE 扩散与 SE(3)-equivariant 架构做有原则的整合，可以同时拿到高化学精度与计算效率，无需在采样速度与构象准确性之间二选一。

papers.title: Ground-Truth Subgraphs for Better Training and Evaluation of Knowledge Graph Augmented LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval of information from graph-structured knowledge bases represents a promising direction for improving the factuality of LLMs. While various solutions have been proposed, a comparison of methods is difficult due to the lack of challenging QA datasets with ground-truth targets for graph retrieval. We present SynthKGQA, an LLM-powered framework for generating high-quality Knowledge Graph Question Answering datasets from any Knowledge Graph, providing the full set of ground-truth facts in the KG to reason over questions. To demonstrate its utility, we apply SynthKGQA to ogbl-wikikg2, a Wikidata-derived KG, and validate generated items against an up-to-date dump of Wikidata to create GTSQA. This new dataset is specifically designed to test zero-shot generalization with respect to unseen graph structures and relation types, enabling us to analyze the abilities and limitations of SOTA graph retrieval approaches at an unprecedented level of granularity. We also show that KG retrievers trained on GTSQA can transfer to a human-curated benchmark, and that the ground-truth subgraphs produced by SynthKGQA provide a better training supervision signal than previously-used heuristics.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 09/2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SynthKGQA：用 LLM 从任意知识图谱生成带完整 ground-truth 事实的 KGQA 数据集，并在 ogbl-wikikg2 上对照最新 Wikidata dump 校验，得到专测未见图结构与关系类型零样本泛化的 GTSQA。在 GTSQA 上训练的 KG retriever 能迁移到人工标注基准，且其 ground-truth 子图监督优于以往启发式信号。
Motivation: 图检索方法难以公平比较，因为缺少带 ground-truth 检索目标、且具挑战性的 QA 数据集，导致无法细粒度刻画 SOTA 图检索器的能力与局限。
Method: SynthKGQA 由 LLM 驱动，从任意 KG 生成 QA 样本并给出图中全部 ground-truth facts 作为推理依据；应用于 Wikidata 衍生的 ogbl-wikikg2，并用最新 Wikidata dump 校验生成条目，产出 GTSQA 数据集，专门面向未见图结构与关系类型的零样本泛化测试。
Result: 生成并校验得到 GTSQA 数据集，用于细粒度分析 SOTA 图检索方法的能力与局限；在 GTSQA 上训练的 KG retriever 可迁移到人工整理基准；SynthKGQA 产出的 ground-truth 子图作为训练监督优于此前使用的启发式信号。
Conclusion: 带 ground-truth 子图的合成 KGQA 数据既能作为更优训练监督，也能支撑对图检索方法的细粒度零样本评测。

papers.title: A Byzantine-Robust Federated Learning with Nesterov Momentum
papers.abstract_en: We investigate robust federated learning, where a group of workers collaboratively train a shared model under the orchestration of a central server in the presence of Byzantine adversaries capable of arbitrary and potentially malicious behaviors. To improve communication efficiency while retaining resilience against such adversaries, we propose a Byzantine-resilient Nesterov-augmented federated learning (Byrd-NAFL) algorithm. Byrd-NAFL applies Nesterov's momentum at the server to the output of any soft $γ$-Byzantine resilient aggregation rule, while each worker only computes and uploads a stochastic gradient, which keeps the workers stateless, as desired for intermittently participating Internet of Things devices. For smooth non-convex losses, we establish a finite-time convergence guarantee for all momentum factors $β\in[0,1)$ without requiring the aggregated gradient to be unbiased or bounded; the bound reduces to that of Byzantine-resilient stochastic gradient descent at $β=0$ and is tighter than that of server-side heavy-ball momentum. Experiments on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and Sentiment140 show that Byrd-NAFL converges faster and attains higher accuracy than existing benchmarks in most i.i.d. and non-i.i.d. setups under diverse attacks, while its resilience is bounded by that of the underlying aggregation rule.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Byrd-NAFL：在服务器端对任意软 γ-Byzantine 鲁棒聚合规则的输出施加 Nesterov 动量，每个 worker 只上传随机梯度、保持无状态。对光滑非凸损失在 β∈[0,1) 全区间给出有限时间收敛保证，无需聚合梯度无偏或有界；MNIST、CIFAR-10、Sentiment140 上在多数 i.i.d. 与 non-i.i.d. 设置和多种攻击下比现有基准收敛更快、准确率更高，但鲁棒上限受底层聚合规则约束。
Motivation: 联邦学习中 Byzantine 对手可任意恶意行为，服务器既要抗攻击又要通信高效，而 worker 端有状态的动量方案不适合间歇参与的 IoT 设备。
Method: Byrd-NAFL 在服务器端对任意软 γ-Byzantine 鲁棒聚合规则的输出叠加 Nesterov 动量，worker 仅计算并上传随机梯度从而保持无状态；理论部分针对光滑非凸损失推导有限时间收敛界。
Result: 对所有动量因子 β∈[0,1) 建立有限时间收敛保证，且不需聚合梯度无偏或有界；β=0 时退化为 Byzantine 鲁棒 SGD 的界，且比服务器端 heavy-ball 动量的界更紧。在 MNIST、CIFAR-10、Sentiment140 上，多数 i.i.d. 与 non-i.i.d. 设置、多种攻击下比现有基准收敛更快、准确率更高。
Conclusion: 服务器端 Nesterov 动量可叠加在任意软 γ-Byzantine 鲁棒聚合规则上以提升通信效率与收敛速度，但整体抗攻击能力上限由底层聚合规则决定。

papers.title: Chain of Time: In-Context Physical Simulation with Image Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel cognitively-inspired prompting method to stabilize and interpret the physical simulation produced by autoregressive image generation models, called Chain-of-Time. Chain-of-Time involves generating a series of intermediate images during a simulation, and it is motivated by mental simulation in humans, as well as in-context reasoning in LLMs. Chain-of-Time is used at inference time, and requires no additional fine-tuning. We apply this method to synthetic and real-world domains, including 2-D graphics simulations and natural 3-D videos. These domains cover various physical dynamics, ranging from rigid-body rolling to harmonic oscillation and pulley systems. We found that Chain-of-Time simulation stabilizes the physics simulated by the state-of-the-art image generation models. Beyond examining performance, we also analyzed the specific states of the world simulated by an image model at each time step, which sheds light on the dynamics underlying these simulations. This analysis reveals insights that are hidden from traditional evaluations of physical reasoning, highlighting cases where image generation models can simulate physical properties such as velocity, gravity, oscillations, and pulley systems. Like humans, image generation models are able to accurately predict future world states over short time periods. By providing a mechanism analogous to working memory, Chain-of-Time enables a model to stitch together a series of short-term predictions into an accurate long-term simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Chain-of-Time 是一种推理期提示方法：让自回归图像生成模型在模拟中先产出一系列中间图像，充当类工作记忆的中间状态，把多个短期预测拼成长时程物理模拟，无需微调。它稳定了 SOTA 图像生成模型模拟的物理过程，并揭示模型在单步中已编码速度、重力、振荡与滑轮系统等状态，且像人一样只在短时段内准确预测未来世界状态。
Motivation: 自回归图像生成模型做物理模拟时长时程会失稳，且传统物理推理评测看不到模型每一步内部到底模拟了哪些世界状态。
Method: 认知启发的 Chain-of-Time 提示：推理期在模拟中生成一系列中间图像作为中间状态，类比人类心理模拟与 LLM 的 in-context reasoning，无需额外微调；应用于合成与真实域，包括 2-D graphics 模拟与自然 3-D 视频，覆盖刚体滚动、简谐振荡、滑轮系统等动力学，并逐步分析图像模型在每个时间步模拟的世界状态。
Result: Chain-of-Time 稳定了 SOTA 图像生成模型所模拟的物理；逐步状态分析显示模型能模拟速度、重力、振荡与滑轮系统等物理性质，这类信息被传统物理推理评测掩盖；模型像人类一样能在短时段内准确预测未来世界状态。
Conclusion: 图像生成模型具备短时程物理预测能力，用类工作记忆的中间图像链即可把短期预测拼接为长时程模拟，而逐步状态分析能暴露传统评测看不到的动力学。

papers.title: Toward Agents That Reason About Their Computation
papers.abstract_en: While reinforcement learning agents can achieve superhuman performance in many complex tasks, they typically do not become more computationally efficient as they improve. In contrast, humans gradually require less cognitive effort as they become more proficient at a task. If agents could reason about their compute as they learn, could they similarly reduce their computation footprint? If they could, we could have more energy efficient agents or free up compute cycles for other processes like planning. In this paper, we experiment with showing agents the cost of their computation and giving them the ability to control when they use compute. We conduct our experiments on the Arcade Learning Environment, and our results demonstrate that with the same training compute budget, agents that reason about their compute perform better on 75% of games. Furthermore, these agents use three times less compute on average. We analyze individual games and show where agents gain these efficiencies. An interactive version of this paper is available at https://adrianorenstein.com/paper/toward-compute.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Reinforcement Learning Conference (RLC) 2026. Added interactive version: https://adrianorenstein.com/paper/toward-compute. Author name change
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 让 RL 智能体在训练中看到自身计算成本并能自主决定何时投入计算，在 Arcade Learning Environment 上可在相同训练算力预算下于 75% 的游戏取得更好表现，同时平均只用三分之一的计算量。
Motivation: RL 智能体在任务上达到超人水平时通常不会像人类那样随熟练度提升而降低认知/计算开销，导致能耗高、算力无法让给规划等其他过程。
Method: 在 Arcade Learning Environment 上向智能体显式暴露计算成本，并赋予其控制何时使用计算的能力，对比相同训练算力预算下的表现与计算用量，并逐游戏分析效率来源。
Result: 在相同训练算力预算下，具备计算推理能力的智能体在 75% 的游戏上表现更好，且平均只使用三分之一的计算量；作者对单个游戏做了分析以定位效率增益来源。
Conclusion: 把计算成本作为可感知、可控制的信号纳入训练，可以在不牺牲（甚至提升）任务表现的前提下大幅压缩 RL 智能体的计算足迹。

papers.title: LLMs Can Get "Brain Rot": A Pilot Study on Twitter/X
papers.abstract_en: We propose and test the LLM Brain Rot Hypothesis: continual exposure to junk web text induces lasting cognitive decline in large language models (LLMs). To unveil junk effects, we designed a novel controlled experiment on real Twitter/X corpora, by constructing junk and reverse-controlled datasets via two orthogonal operationalizations: M1 (engagement degree) and M2 (semantic quality), with matched token scale and training operations across conditions. Compared to the control group, continual pre-training of 4 LLMs on the junk dataset causes non-trivial declines (Hedges' g>0.3) on reasoning, long-context understanding, safety, and inflating "dark traits" (e.g., psychopathy, narcissism). The gradual mixtures of junk and control datasets also yield dose-response cognition decay: for example, under M1, ARC-Challenge with Chain-of-Thought drops 72.1 -> 57.2 and RULER-CWE 83.7 -> 52.3 as junk ratio rises from 0% to 100%. Error forensics reveal several key insights. First, we identify thought-skipping as the primary lesion in reasoning: models increasingly truncate or skip chains. Second, partial but incomplete healing is observed: scaling instruction tuning and clean continual pre-training improve the declined cognition, yet cannot restore baseline capability, suggesting persistent representational drift rather than format mismatch. Finally, we discover that the popularity, a non-semantic metric, of a tweet is a better indicator of the Brain Rot effect than the length in M1. Together, the results provide significant, multi-perspective evidence that social effects of data could be a causal driver of LLM capability decay in continual pre-training, thereby motivating routine "cognitive health checks" for deployed and evolving LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出并检验 LLM Brain Rot 假说：在 Twitter/X 语料上按互动度 (M1) 与语义质量 (M2) 两种正交口径构造垃圾文本与反向对照集，token 规模与训练操作匹配，对 4 个 LLM 做持续预训练。垃圾比例从 0% 升到 100% 时出现剂量-反应式认知衰退：M1 下 ARC-Challenge with CoT 从 72.1 跌到 57.2，RULER-CWE 从 83.7 跌到 52.3；指令微调与干净持续预训练只能部分修复，无法回到基线。
Motivation: 持续预训练的语料社会属性是否是 LLM 能力衰减的因果驱动因素，此前缺少受控实验证据；垃圾文本的效应也难以与 token 规模、训练操作等混杂因素分离。
Method: 在真实 Twitter/X 语料上构造垃圾集与反向对照集，两种正交操作化 M1（互动度）与 M2（语义质量），各条件 token 规模与训练操作匹配；对 4 个 LLM 做持续预训练，并设置垃圾/对照渐变混合做剂量-反应设计，随后做错误取证 (error forensics) 分析。
Result: 相比对照组，4 个 LLM 在垃圾集上持续预训练后，推理、长上下文理解、安全等维度出现非平凡下降（Hedges' g>0.3），并推高 psychopathy、narcissism 等 dark traits。剂量-反应上，M1 下垃圾比例 0%→100% 时 ARC-Challenge with CoT 72.1→57.2、RULER-CWE 83.7→52.3。主要病变是 thought-skipping（截断或跳过推理链）；扩大指令微调与干净持续预训练可部分改善但无法恢复基线；M1 中推文的 popularity（非语义指标）比长度更能指示 Brain Rot 效应。
Conclusion: 数据的社会效应可作为持续预训练中 LLM 能力衰减的因果驱动，且衰减源于持续的表征漂移 (representational drift) 而非格式错配，因此部署与演进中的 LLM 需要例行的“认知健康检查”。

papers.title: Don't Run with Scissors: Pruning Breaks VLA Models but They Can Be Recovered
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are a promising paradigm for field robotics, but their deployment is bottlenecked by strict edge SWaP-C constraints. Compression techniques such as quantization, distillation, and pruning are well-established for LLMs and VLMs. Pruning, however, remains particularly underexplored for VLA models. We surprisingly find that pruning VLA models yields drastic performance degradation and increased safety violations. Through spectral analysis, we identify structural properties of VLA weights that help explain this fragility. Based on this insight, we introduce GLUESTICK, a post-pruning recovery method that restores much of the original model's capability while preserving sparsity benefits. GLUESTICK computes a one-time corrective term by interpolating between the dense and pruned models in weight space. At inference, each pruned layer applies this correction to recover lost performance with minimal overhead. Our approach requires no additional training and is agnostic to the pruning algorithm. Across diverse VLA architectures and domains, GLUESTICK recovers up to 100% of the success rate and restores safety to near-dense levels, while saving up to 5 GB of memory and achieving up to 1.75x speedup. Additional material can be found at: https://gluestick-vla.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLA 模型剪枝后成功率骤降且安全违规增加，作者用谱分析定位权重结构上的脆弱性，并提出 GLUESTICK：在权重空间对稠密模型与剪枝模型做插值，一次性算出校正项，推理时逐层叠加。该方法无需额外训练、与剪枝算法无关，最多恢复 100% 成功率并把安全性拉回接近稠密模型的水平，同时省下最多 5 GB 内存、加速最高 1.75 倍。
Motivation: VLA 模型要部署到受严格 SWaP-C（尺寸、重量、功耗、成本）约束的边缘机器人上，量化、蒸馏、剪枝等压缩手段在 LLM/VLM 中已成熟，但剪枝在 VLA 上几乎未被研究，且实际会造成严重性能下降与安全违规。
Method: 先对 VLA 权重做谱分析，找出解释剪枝脆弱性的结构特征；据此提出 GLUESTICK，一种剪枝后恢复方法：在权重空间对稠密模型与剪枝模型插值，一次性计算校正项，推理时每个剪枝层应用该修正，开销极小，无需额外训练，且对剪枝算法不敏感。
Result: 在多种 VLA 架构与领域上，GLUESTICK 最多恢复 100% 的任务成功率，把安全性恢复到接近稠密模型的水平，同时最多节省 5 GB 内存、最高带来 1.75 倍加速。
Conclusion: VLA 权重的谱结构决定了剪枝脆弱性，而一个免训练、算法无关的权重空间校正项就能在保留稀疏收益的同时找回大部分能力与安全性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: EconCausal: A Context-Aware Economic Reasoning Benchmark for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Socio-economic causal effects depend heavily on their institutional and environmental contexts. The same intervention can produce different, even opposite, effects across regulatory regimes, market conditions, time periods, or populations. This poses a challenge for large language models (LLMs) in decision-support roles: can they infer the direction of a causal effect under a specified context, and revise that judgment when the context changes? To address this, we introduce EconCausal, a large-scale benchmark of 10,490 context-annotated causal triplets extracted from 2,595 high-quality empirical studies in top-tier economics and finance journals, constructed through a rigorous four-stage pipeline with multi-run consensus, context refinement, and multi-critic filtering. Across 19 models, we observe source-sign over-transfer in cross-context prediction. While top models reach ~84% accuracy in single-context prediction, mean accuracy is 74.75% overall but drops to 44.27% when source and target signs disagree. On these cases, accuracy is 11.54 percentage points (pp) lower with the signed source example than with the target input alone. Mean accuracy is below 60% under corrupted source signs. Models also struggle to predict study-reported nonsignificant effects (19.16% accuracy). The dataset and benchmark are publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/econcausal-benchmark-6F12.
papers.comment: 29 pages. Revised version with updated evaluation results, robustness analyses, expert validation, and references
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EconCausal 是面向 LLM 的经济学因果推理基准：从顶刊实证研究抽取 10,490 条带上下文标注的因果三元组，测试模型能否在给定制度/市场/时期/人群语境下判断因果效应方向，并在语境改变时修正判断。19 个模型上观察到 source-sign 过度迁移：单语境预测最强模型约 84%，总体均值 74.75%，但当源与目标符号相反时骤降至 44.27%。
Motivation: 同一项干预在不同监管制度、市场条件、时期或人群中可能产生相反效果，而 LLM 作为决策支持工具需要在指定语境下判断因果效应方向并在语境变化时修正判断，这一能力此前缺少针对性评测。
Method: 构建四阶段流水线，从经济学与金融顶刊的 2,595 篇高质量实证研究中抽取 10,490 条带语境标注的因果三元组，包含 multi-run consensus、context refinement 与 multi-critic filtering；在 19 个模型上评测单语境预测、跨语境符号迁移、源符号腐蚀鲁棒性与非显著效应预测。
Result: 19 个模型上，最强模型单语境预测准确率约 84%，总体均值 74.75%；源与目标符号不一致的样本上均值降至 44.27%，且带符号源示例比仅用目标输入低 11.54 个百分点；源符号被腐蚀时均值准确率低于 60%；对研究报告的非显著效应预测准确率仅 19.16%。
Conclusion: LLM 在经济学因果推理中会把源语境的效应符号过度迁移到目标语境，语境变化时难以修正方向判断，对非显著效应尤其无力；作者据此公开该数据集与基准。

papers.title: Context Value Informed In-Context Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: In-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) has emerged as an effective paradigm for test time adaptation to unseen tasks without parameter updates. However, existing ICRL methods can exhibit brittle and unstable adaptions, and the mechanisms underlying such adaptions remain poorly understood. We provide a policy-gradient view of ICRL and argue that relying on trajectory-level return feedback can lead to high-variance updates when test time rollout is limited. Motivated by the actor--critic principle, we propose Context Value Informed ICRL (CV-ICRL), which equips the in-context policy with an explicit context value: the expected discounted return conditioned on the current state and accumulated interaction context. CV-ICRL trains a value head and writes its prediction back into the context as a value token, enabling TD-style return targets for lower-variance policy updates. Experiments on the Dark Room, Minigrid, and Procgen testbeds show that CV-ICRL substantially improves the stability of test time adaptation and achieves higher returns across tasks and environments. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Bluixe/CV-ICRL .
papers.comment: 35 pages, 10 figures. Camera-ready version for NeurIPS 2026. Updated title, substantially revised presentation, and expanded experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在上下文强化学习 (ICRL) 中，仅用轨迹级回报反馈做测试时适应会因 rollout 有限而产生高方差策略更新。CV-ICRL 为上下文策略显式加入 context value（以当前状态与累积交互上下文为条件的期望折扣回报），训练 value head 并把预测写回上下文作为 value token，从而得到 TD 式回报目标、降低更新方差，在 Dark Room、Minigrid、Procgen 上提升测试时适应稳定性并取得更高回报。
Motivation: 现有 ICRL 方法在测试时适应未见任务时表现脆弱且不稳定，其适应机制缺乏理解；轨迹级回报反馈在测试时 rollout 受限时导致高方差更新。
Method: 从 policy-gradient 视角重新审视 ICRL，借鉴 actor-critic 原理：为上下文策略增加显式 context value（以当前状态和累积交互上下文为条件的期望折扣回报），训练一个 value head 并将其预测以 value token 形式写回上下文，从而构造 TD 式回报目标，实现低方差策略更新。
Result: 在 Dark Room、Minigrid、Procgen 三个测试平台上，CV-ICRL 显著提升测试时适应的稳定性，并在各任务与环境上取得更高回报；代码与数据发布于 github.com/Bluixe/CV-ICRL。
Conclusion: 把显式 context value 以 token 形式注入上下文、用 TD 式目标替代轨迹级回报，是让 ICRL 测试时适应更稳、回报更高的有效途径。

papers.title: Generalized Multi-agent Social Simulation Framework
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent social interaction has clearly benefited from Large Language Models. However, current simulation systems still face challenges such as difficulties in scaling to diverse scenarios and poor reusability due to a lack of modular design. To address these issues, we designed and developed a modular, object-oriented framework that organically integrates various base classes through a hierarchical structure, harvesting scalability and reusability. We inherited the framework to realize common derived classes. Additionally, a memory summarization mechanism is proposed to filter and distill relevant information from raw memory data, prioritizing contextually salient events and interactions. By selecting and combining some necessary derived classes, we customized a specific simulated environment. Utilizing this simulated environment, we successfully simulated human interactions on social media, replicating real-world online social behaviors. The source code for the project will be released and evolve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 LLM 多智能体社会模拟的模块化面向对象框架，用分层基类组织智能体与环境，并加入记忆摘要机制从原始记忆中筛选上下文显著的事件与交互。作者用该框架定制环境，复现了社交媒体上的人类在线互动行为。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 多智能体社会模拟系统难以扩展到多样场景、复用性差，根源是缺少模块化设计。
Method: 设计分层继承的面向对象框架，有机整合各类基类并派生常用子类；提出记忆摘要机制过滤蒸馏原始记忆数据，优先保留上下文显著的事件与交互；再按需组合派生类定制具体模拟环境。

papers.title: Eigen-Agent: Adaptive Multi-Agent Scientific Reasoning with Monitor-Based RAG
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown strong progress on scientific reasoning, yet two major bottlenecks remain. First, explicit retrieval fragments reasoning, imposing a hidden "tool tax" of extra tokens and steps. Second, multi-agent pipelines often dilute strong solutions by averaging across all candidates. We address these challenges with a unified framework that combines implicit retrieval and structured collaboration. At its foundation, a Monitor-based retrieval module operates at the token level, integrating external knowledge with minimal disruption to reasoning. On top of this substrate, Hierarchical Solution Refinement (HSR) iteratively designates each candidate as an anchor to be repaired by its peers, while Quality-Aware Iterative Reasoning (QAIR) adapts refinement to solution quality. On Humanity's Last Exam (HLE) Bio/Chem Gold, our framework achieves 48.3% accuracy - the highest reported to date, surpassing the strongest agent baseline by 13.4 points and leading frontier LLMs by up to 18.1 points, while simultaneously reducing token usage by 53.5% and agent steps by 43.7%. Results on SuperGPQA and TRQA confirm robustness across domains. Error analysis shows that reasoning failures and knowledge gaps co-occur in over 85% of cases, while diversity analysis reveals a clear dichotomy: retrieval tasks benefit from solution variety, whereas reasoning tasks favor consensus. Together, these findings demonstrate how implicit augmentation and structured refinement overcome the inefficiencies of explicit tool use and uniform aggregation. The code is available at https://github.com/tangxiangru/Eigen-1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Eigen-Agent 把检索和多智能体协作合到一个框架里：Monitor-based RAG 在 token 级隐式注入外部知识，避免显式检索打断推理；HSR 把每个候选轮流当 anchor 由同伴修复，QAIR 按解题质量调节精炼强度。在 HLE Bio/Chem Gold 上准确率 48.3%，比最强 agent 基线高 13.4 点、比前沿 LLM 高最多 18.1 点，同时 token 用量降 53.5%、agent 步数降 43.7%。
Motivation: 显式检索以额外 token 和步骤形成“工具税”并打断推理链；多智能体流水线对所有候选取平均，反而稀释掉强解。
Method: 底层是 token 级 Monitor-based 检索模块，把外部知识以最小干扰并入推理；其上叠加 Hierarchical Solution Refinement (HSR)，迭代地把每个候选指定为 anchor 由同伴修复，再用 Quality-Aware Iterative Reasoning (QAIR) 按解的质量自适应精炼。
Result: HLE Bio/Chem Gold 准确率 48.3%（摘要称为迄今最高），超最强 agent 基线 13.4 点、超前沿 LLM 最多 18.1 点，token 用量减少 53.5%、agent 步数减少 43.7%；SuperGPQA 与 TRQA 上结果确认跨领域稳健。误差分析显示推理失败与知识缺口在超过 85% 的案例中同时出现；多样性分析显示检索类任务受益于解的多样，推理类任务偏向共识。
Conclusion: 隐式增强加结构化精炼能同时压掉显式工具调用的开销和均匀聚合的稀释效应，且检索任务该保留多样性、推理任务该收敛共识。

papers.title: Align Where the Words Look: Cross-Attention-Guided Patch Alignment with Contrastive and Transport Regularization for Bengali Captioning
papers.abstract_en: Adapting vision-language models in low-resource languages remains challenging, as they often produce fluent text about the wrong objects. This stems from scarce paired data, translation pivots that break alignment, and English-centric pretraining that ignores target-language semantics. We address this with a compute-aware Bengali captioning pipeline trained on LaBSE-verified EN-BN pairs and 110k bilingual-prompted synthetic images. A frozen MaxViT yields stable visual patches, a Bengali-native mBART-50 decodes, and a lightweight bridge links the modalities. Our core novelty is a tri-loss objective: Patch-Alignment Loss (PAL) aligns real and synthetic patch descriptors using decoder cross-attention, InfoNCE enforces global real-synthetic separation, and Sinkhorn-based OT ensures balanced fine-grained patch correspondence. This PAL+InfoNCE+OT synergy tightens real-synthetic patch alignment, reduces spurious matches, and drives strong gains on Flickr30k-1k (BLEU-4 12.29, METEOR 27.98, BERTScore-F1 71.20) and MSCOCO-1k (BLEU-4 12.00, METEOR 28.14, BERTScore-F1 75.40), outperforming strong CE baselines and narrowing the real-synthetic centroid gap by 41%.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 23rd Pacific Rim International Conference on Artificial Intelligence (PRICAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对低资源孟加尔语图像描述中模型流畅却指错对象的问题，提出以解码器 cross-attention 驱动的 Patch-Alignment Loss（PAL）联合 InfoNCE 与 Sinkhorn OT 的三损失目标，对齐真实与合成图像的 patch 描述子。在 Flickr30k-1k 上取得 BLEU-4 12.29、METEOR 27.98、BERTScore-F1 71.20，MSCOCO-1k 上 BLEU-4 12.00、METEOR 28.14、BERTScore-F1 75.40，超过强 CE 基线并把真实-合成质心差距缩小 41%。
Motivation: 低资源语言的视觉-语言模型常输出流畅但指错对象的描述，源于配对数据稀缺、翻译中介破坏对齐，以及以英语为中心的预训练忽略目标语言语义。
Method: 在 LaBSE 校验的 EN-BN 双语对与 110k 双语提示合成图像上训练：冻结 MaxViT 提供稳定视觉 patch，Bengali 原生 mBART-50 解码，轻量 bridge 连接两模态；三损失 PAL（用解码器 cross-attention 对齐真实与合成 patch 描述子）+ InfoNCE（全局真实-合成分离）+ Sinkhorn-based OT（细粒度 patch 对应的均衡约束）。
Result: Flickr30k-1k：BLEU-4 12.29、METEOR 27.98、BERTScore-F1 71.20；MSCOCO-1k：BLEU-4 12.00、METEOR 28.14、BERTScore-F1 75.40；均超过强 CE 基线，真实-合成质心差距缩小 41%。
Conclusion: PAL+InfoNCE+OT 的协同能收紧真实-合成 patch 对齐、减少虚假匹配，从而在孟加尔语描述上带来显著提升。

papers.title: Measuring Epistemic Humility in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Hallucinations in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), where a model generates content inconsistent with the input image, pose significant risks in real-world applications. Existing hallucination benchmarks primarily test recognition, i.e., whether a model can select the correct answer among distractors. They overlook another capability that is essential for trustworthy AI: recognizing when none of the provided options is supported by the image and declining to commit to a false choice. We present HumbleBench, a hallucination benchmark that evaluates this false-option rejection behavior, a directly observable facet of epistemic humility, through multiple-choice questions that always include a "None of the above" (NOTA) option. HumbleBench is built from the Panoptic Scene Graph dataset: its object and relation annotations, together with candidate attribute cues, are used to prompt GPT-4-Turbo to generate questions, which are then manually verified, yielding 22,831 questions on object, relation, and attribute hallucinations. We evaluate 27 MLLMs, including general-purpose, reasoning-oriented, and proprietary models, and complement standard accuracy with NOTA-aware metrics, diagnostic stress tests, and a human evaluation. Even the strongest models select NOTA for only about half of the questions in which it is correct, cautious prompting shifts models toward NOTA without improving their ability to detect unsupported options, and humans reject unsupported options considerably more reliably than all evaluated models. These results show that recognition accuracy alone is insufficient for assessing hallucination robustness. Our code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/maifoundations/HumbleBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HumbleBench：在多选题中恒含 "None of the above" (NOTA) 选项，专门测多模态大模型 (MLLM) 拒绝无图像支撑选项的能力。基于 Panoptic Scene Graph 标注经 GPT-4-Turbo 生成并人工核验出 22,831 道题，评测 27 个 MLLM：最强模型在 NOTA 正确的题上也只约一半选对，谨慎提示只把模型推向 NOTA 而不提升检出能力，人类显著更可靠。
Motivation: 现有幻觉基准只测识别（在干扰项中选对答案），忽略另一项可信 AI 必备能力：当所有选项都无图像支撑时识别出来并拒绝作答。
Method: 从 Panoptic Scene Graph 数据集的对象与关系标注出发，结合候选属性线索提示 GPT-4-Turbo 生成题目，再人工核验，得到覆盖对象、关系、属性三类幻觉的 22,831 道含 NOTA 的多选题；评测 27 个 MLLM（通用、推理导向、闭源），在标准准确率之外补充 NOTA 感知指标、诊断性压力测试与人工评估。
Result: 22,831 道题，评测 27 个 MLLM；最强模型在 NOTA 正确的题上仅约一半选中 NOTA；谨慎提示使模型更多选 NOTA 但不提升其识别无支撑选项的能力；人类拒绝无支撑选项的可靠性明显高于所有被评模型。
Conclusion: 仅凭识别准确率不足以评估幻觉鲁棒性，必须单独考察模型拒绝无依据选项的倾向与能力；代码与数据集已公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SEDM: Selective Self-Evolving Distributed Memory for Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agents in a society can reuse each other's experience, but indiscriminate memory use increases processing cost and can reduce task success. We present SEDM (Selective Self-Evolving Distributed Memory), a framework that selects both what agents share and when recipients use it. On the sender side, SEDM admits memories through paired execution tests, ranks them by relevance and measured utility, and abstracts them for cross-domain reuse. On the recipient side, Calibrated Memory Gating (CMG) predicts success with and without memory in a single forward pass, learning from paired outcomes including ties. It injects memory only when the calibrated success gain outweighs a context-cost penalty. SEDM exceeds the strongest evaluated baseline on LoCoMo open-domain questions by 15.1 F1 points and outperforms G-Memory on FEVER and HotpotQA with 16-32% fewer prompt tokens. In a controlled HotpotQA study, CMG achieves success comparable to always using memory with 18% fewer agent input tokens. Within the full SEDM pipeline on LoCoMo, CMG outperforms both always-use and no-memory policies for two SEDM memories while using 19-31% fewer input tokens than always-use. These results show that selective use can recover value from shared memories that hurt performance when injected indiscriminately.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SEDM 在发送端用成对执行测试筛选并按相关性与实测效用排序记忆、抽象成可跨域复用的形式，在接收端用 Calibrated Memory Gating (CMG) 单次前向预测「用/不用记忆」的成功率，仅当校准增益超过上下文成本惩罚时才注入。在 LoCoMo 开放域问题上比最强基线高 15.1 F1，在 FEVER 与 HotpotQA 上以少 16–32% 的 prompt token 超过 G-Memory。
Motivation: 智能体之间无差别复用彼此经验会抬高处理成本并拉低任务成功率，需要同时决定共享什么以及接收方何时使用。
Method: 发送端通过成对执行测试 (paired execution tests) 准入记忆，按相关性与实测效用排序并抽象以支持跨域复用；接收端 CMG 在单次前向中预测使用与不使用记忆的成功率，学习包含平局 (ties) 的成对结果，仅在校准成功增益超过上下文成本惩罚时注入记忆。
Result: 在 LoCoMo 开放域问题上比最强评估基线高 15.1 F1；在 FEVER 与 HotpotQA 上以少 16–32% 的 prompt token 优于 G-Memory；受控 HotpotQA 研究中 CMG 以少 18% 的 agent input token 达到与始终使用记忆相当的成功率；在 LoCoMo 的完整 SEDM 管线中，针对两条 SEDM 记忆，CMG 同时优于 always-use 与 no-memory 策略，且比 always-use 少用 19–31% 输入 token。
Conclusion: 选择性使用能从无差别注入反而有害的共享记忆中收回价值，门控判据是校准成功增益对上下文成本的权衡。

summary_sections.conclusion: 选择性使用能从无差别注入反而有害的共享记忆中收回价值，门控判据是校准成功增益对上下文成本的权衡。

papers.title: The Invisible Leash: Why RLVR May or May Not Escape Its Origin
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances highlight Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) as a promising approach to enhancing LLM capabilities. However, it remains unclear whether the current practice of RLVR truly expands models' reasoning boundary or mainly amplifies high-reward outputs that base models already know. We introduce empirical support dynamics, a framework that quantifies how RLVR preserves, expands, and shrinks access to verified solutions. Applied across models, reasoning tasks, and training checkpoints, it matches verified successes question by question to reveal changes that aggregate accuracy can conceal. Across the evaluated model-level benchmark aggregates, \textit{the shrinkage of observed support outweighs its expansion}: more questions lose a verified success than gain one at the stated sampling budgets. These losses occur alongside gains in \texttt{pass@1}. Some RLVR models increase average token-level entropy while reducing final-answer entropy: their token choices become more uncertain on average even as their final answers become more concentrated. Together, these findings reveal an ``invisible leash'' in current RLVR practice: it can make existing successes more reliable while losing access to other verified solutions. Empirical support dynamics make this imbalance measurable and motivate exploration strategies that reach underrepresented solutions while retaining prior successes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 empirical support dynamics 框架，逐题把 RLVR 训练前后的 verified success 配对，量化模型对已验证解的保留、扩展与收缩。在所评估的模型级基准聚合上，观测支持的收缩超过扩展：在给定采样预算下，失去一个已验证成功的题目多于新增的题目，而 pass@1 同时上升；部分 RLVR 模型还出现 token 级平均熵上升、最终答案熵下降。
Motivation: RLVR 究竟是真正扩展了模型的推理边界，还是只放大了 base model 本就掌握的高奖励输出，此前不清楚；聚合准确率会掩盖逐题层面的得失。
Method: 以 empirical support dynamics 框架在多个模型、推理任务与训练 checkpoint 上逐题匹配 verified successes，记录支持的保留、扩展与收缩，并同时统计 pass@1、token 级熵与最终答案熵。
Result: 在所评估的模型级基准聚合中，观测支持的收缩超过扩展：在既定采样预算下，失去 verified success 的题目多于获得的题目；这些损失与 pass@1 的提升同时出现。部分 RLVR 模型的 token 级平均熵上升而最终答案熵下降，即 token 选择更不确定、最终答案更集中。
Conclusion: 当前 RLVR 实践存在 invisible leash：它让已有成功更可靠，却会失去对其他 verified solutions 的访问；因此需要在保留既有成功的同时探索被欠代表解的探索策略。

papers.title: State Space Models Naturally Produce Time Cell and Oscillatory Behaviors and Scale to Abstract Cognitive Functions
papers.abstract_en: A grand challenge in modern neuroscience is bridging the gap between the microscale neural circuits and cognitive functions. While extensive knowledge exists about neuronal connectivity and biophysics, how low-level phenomena give rise to abstract behaviors remains largely unresolved. Here, we propose that a mathematical framework based on State Space Models offers mathematical sufficiency and computational plausibility to generate response profiles that resemble time cells, ramping activity, and oscillatory responses. Our results suggest that such behaviors can emerge from a structured multi-timescale complex rotational basis, which enables optimized history compression and naturally generates structured temporal dynamics even prior to training, mirroring recent findings in biological circuits. Learning exploits and adapts to the pre-existing temporal basis for specific tasks. We show that the model can readily scale to abstract cognitive functions such as event counting, supporting its use as a computationally tractable framework for understanding neural activities.
papers.comment: Sen Lu and Xiaoyu Zhang contributed equally. Wei D. Lu is the corresponding author. 5 figures are included in 15 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出以 State Space Models 为数学框架，说明时间细胞 (time cells)、斜坡活动 (ramping activity) 与振荡响应等神经反应剖面可由结构化的多时间尺度复旋转基 (multi-timescale complex rotational basis) 自然产生：该基在训练前即完成优化的历史压缩并生成结构化时间动力学，学习随后在此预存时间基上适配。模型还能扩展到事件计数 (event counting) 这类抽象认知功能。
Motivation: 现代神经科学要打通微尺度神经环路与认知功能之间的鸿沟：已知连接与生物物理知识很多，但低层现象如何产生抽象行为仍基本未解。
Method: 以 State Space Models 为框架，构造结构化的多时间尺度复旋转基来生成时间细胞、斜坡与振荡型响应剖面；该基在训练前即提供优化的历史压缩与结构化时间动力学，学习过程再针对具体任务利用并适配这一预存时间基，并以事件计数任务检验其可扩展性。
Result: 模型在训练前即自然产生类时间细胞、斜坡与振荡的响应剖面，与近期生物环路发现相符；并可直接扩展到事件计数等抽象认知功能。
Conclusion: State Space Models 具备数学充分性与计算可行性，可作为理解神经活动的可计算框架：时间动力学先由时间基结构性地给出，学习只在其上做任务适配。

papers.title: Enabling Validation for Robust Few-Shot Recognition
papers.abstract_en: A key challenge in Few-Shot Recognition (FSR) is the scarcity of labeled task-specific data for training. Contemporary methods mitigate this challenge by exploiting pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for their learned transferable features. Some recent ones augment the scarce data by retrieving relevant yet out-of-distribution (OOD) examples from external data sources. However, they largely overlook an equally fundamental challenge: the absence of validation data for model selection and hyperparameter tuning. As a result, the adapted VLMs overfit the few-shot training data and generalize poorly to OOD test data. We show that retrieved data provide a natural source of validation, but their direct use creates a fundamental paradox. Since the retrieved samples are inherently OOD w.r.t the few-shot ID training data, adapting a VLM to the ID data constantly degrades its performance on the retrieved data. Consequently, conventional validation relying on the accuracy of retrieved data favors no adaptation and prevents improved generalization. To resolve this dilemma, we formulate validation as a multi-objective optimization (MOO) problem between performance gains on the few-shot ID data and the performance preservation on the retrieved data. We introduce a simple yet effective validation strategy by choosing an operating point on the Pareto front of the MOO problem. This strategy enables hyperparameter tuning, which had been unrealistically done by using test data, thereby mitigating overfitting and improving generalization. We integrate it into a stage-wise finetuning pipeline, termed Validation-Enabled Stage-wise Tuning (VEST). Extensive experiments on five established benchmarks show that VEST consistently outperforms existing approaches on both ID and OOD test data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VEST 把少样本识别 (FSR) 中缺失的验证集问题形式化为多目标优化 (MOO)：在少样本 ID 数据上的性能增益与在检索到的 OOD 数据上的性能保持之间取 Pareto 前沿上的操作点，用于超参选择。该策略接入分阶段微调流水线，在五个基准上一致优于现有方法，同时改善 ID 与 OOD 测试表现。
Motivation: 少样本识别只有极少任务相关标注，近期方法靠检索 OOD 样本扩充数据，却忽略同样根本的验证数据缺失：模型选择与超参调节无据可依，导致 VLM 过拟合少样本训练集、在 OOD 测试上泛化差。
Method: 把验证形式化为 ID 数据性能增益与检索数据性能保持之间的多目标优化问题，在 Pareto 前沿上选操作点做超参调节，替代以往用测试数据调参的做法；该策略集成进分阶段微调流水线 VEST (Validation-Enabled Stage-wise Tuning)。
Result: 直接用检索数据准确率做常规验证会因检索样本相对 ID 训练数据天然 OOD、适配后其性能持续下降而偏好不作适配；采用 Pareto 操作点后，VEST 在五个既有基准上一致优于现有方法，ID 与 OOD 测试数据均提升。
Conclusion: 检索数据可充当验证来源，但必须按多目标权衡而非单看其准确率来用，否则会锁死在不作适配的状态；据此做超参选择能缓解过拟合并改善泛化。
Relevance: 2
