papers.title: Score-Based Training for Energy-Based TTS Models
papers.abstract_en: Noise contrastive estimation (NCE) is a popular method for training energy-based models (EBM) with intractable normalisation terms. The key idea of NCE is to learn by comparing unnormalised log-likelihoods of the reference and noisy samples, thus avoiding explicitly computing normalisation terms. However, NCE critically relies on the quality of noisy samples. Recently, sliced score matching (SSM) has been popularised by closely related diffusion models (DM). Unlike NCE, SSM learns a gradient of log-likelihood, or score, by learning distribution of its projections on randomly chosen directions. However, both NCE and SSM disregard the form of log-likelihood function, which is problematic given that EBMs and DMs make use of first-order optimisation during inference. This paper proposes a new criterion that learns scores more suitable for first-order schemes. Experiments contrasts these approaches for training EBMs.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to Interspeech 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对能量模型 (EBM) 训练中 NCE 依赖噪声样本质量、SSM 学到的 score 不适配推理期一阶优化的问题，提出一种面向一阶优化方案的 score 学习准则，并在 EBM 训练上对比 NCE、SSM 与该准则。
Motivation: NCE 的训练效果关键依赖噪声样本质量，而 NCE 与 SSM 都忽略对数似然函数的具体形式；但 EBM 与扩散模型在推理时使用一阶优化，这使学到的 score 不够适用。
Method: 提出新的 score 学习准则，使其更适配一阶优化方案；实验中对比 NCE、sliced score matching (SSM) 与该准则在 EBM 训练上的表现。
Result: 实验对比了 NCE、SSM 与所提准则在训练 EBM 上的差异；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 训练 EBM 的 score 准则应考虑推理期所用的一阶优化形式，而不只是绕开归一化项或匹配投影分布。

papers.title: Stereographic Multiple-Try Metropolis
papers.abstract_en: Multiple-proposal MCMC algorithms have recently gained attention for their potential to improve performance, especially through parallel implementation on modern hardware. We introduce Stereographic Multiple-Try Metropolis (SMTM), a novel family of gradient-free algorithms designed for sampling high-dimensional distributions. By integrating multiple-try Metropolis (MTM) with the stereographic MCMC framework, SMTM overcomes the traditional limitations of MTM, particularly its pathological convergence behavior often observed in high dimensions. For both light-tailed and heavy-tailed targets, SMTM not only outperforms classical MTM and the existing stereographic random-walk Metropolis but also demonstrates strong robustness to tuning. These advantages are supported by high-dimensional scaling analysis and validated through extensive simulation studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Stereographic Multiple-Try Metropolis (SMTM)，把 multiple-try Metropolis (MTM) 与 stereographic MCMC 框架结合，构成面向高维分布采样的无梯度算法族，克服 MTM 在高维下的病态收敛行为。对轻尾与重尾目标，SMTM 均优于经典 MTM 与既有 stereographic random-walk Metropolis，且对调参稳健，结论由高维标度分析与大量模拟研究支撑。
Motivation: MTM 类多提议 MCMC 便于在现代硬件上并行以提升性能，但在高维下常出现病态收敛行为，限制了其在高维分布采样中的可用性。
Method: 将 MTM 的多提议机制嵌入 stereographic MCMC 框架，构造无梯度 (gradient-free) 的 SMTM 算法族；正确性与高维标度通过理论分析给出，并用大量模拟研究检验轻尾与重尾目标下的表现。
Result: 对轻尾和重尾目标分布，SMTM 在模拟研究中均超过经典 MTM 与既有 stereographic random-walk Metropolis，并表现出对调参的强稳健性；这些优势同时有高维标度分析支持。
Conclusion: 把多提议并行与 stereographic 变换结合，可以在无梯度前提下缓解 MTM 的高维病态收敛，得到更稳健的高维采样器。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Incentivize Contribution and Learn Parameters Too: Federated Learning with Strategic Data Owners
papers.abstract_en: In federated learning (FL), a center trains a shared model from updates that clients compute on their private data. Collecting and training on data is costly, so a strategic client may contribute little data and free-ride on the model trained by the others. We study mechanisms that incentivize data contribution and learn the model at the same time. Our first mechanism, UPBReD, updates the clients ' contributions and the model jointly, and converges at a geometric rate to a Nash equilibrium of the contribution game together with the welfare-maximizing model for those contributions. This equilibrium can involve under-contribution, so our second mechanism, 2P-UPBReD, adds budget-balanced transfers that make full contribution a dominant strategy, after which training converges to the optimal model; we also give conditions under which every client prefers to participate. Both mechanisms trust what clients report about the data they use and the gradients they compute. We show that no payment rule can reward unverifiable contributions unless something the center observes depends on the data actually used. Building on this, T-2P-UPBReD checks each client's reported contribution against the other clients ' realized valuations of the trained model, and prices gradient reports with a budget-balanced charge. It elicits truthful contribution reports, makes gradient reports approximately truthful, still reaches full contribution and the optimal model, and never runs a deficit. Experiments on CIFAR-10, FEMNIST, and Twitter show that 2P-UPBReD matches the welfare of FedAvg trained on all data, while strategic clients without incentives lower the welfare of the learned model.

papers.title: Synergistic Vision-Language Reinforcement Enables Scalable On-Demand Analysis across Diverse Clinical Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Accurate segmentation of tumors and organs-at-risk is essential for oncology but remains time-consuming and expertise-intensive. Existing AI systems often require manual spatial prompts or task-specific retraining, while generic class labels provide limited guidance for heterogeneous disease targets. Here we present SyRe, a text-prompted segmentation foundation model based on Synergistic vision-language Reinforcement, which strengthens bidirectional interaction between visual and linguistic representations. We introduce Color Region Description (CRD) to generate region-level semantic supervision and construct SyReData, comprising 20 million image-mask-description triplets across 9 modalities and 229 segmentation tasks. Training with diversified prompt formats enables single-target, multi-target and open-ended segmentation, together with invalid-prompt rejection. SyRe achieves accurate segmentation across diverse clinical scenarios, with strong gains on disease-related targets. Evaluation on 28 unseen external datasets, including 17 cancer types, 3 non-cancer diseases and multinational in-house cohorts, demonstrates generalization under distribution shift. Beyond spatial overlap, SyRe-generated masks preserve quantitative pathology information. Across five retrospective tumor imaging cohorts spanning CT and MRI, radiomics derived from these masks stratify survival and improve prognostic modeling over clinical baselines. Clinician-in-the-loop refinement further supports case-level correction. These results establish SyRe as a generalizable framework for scalable quantitative oncology analysis and clinician-guided segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出文本提示驱动的肿瘤分割基础模型 SyRe，用 Color Region Description (CRD) 生成区域级语义监督，并以 2000 万图文掩码三元组训练，实现单靶点、多靶点、开放式分割与无效提示拒绝。在 28 个未见外部数据集（17 种癌症、3 种非癌疾病）上验证分布偏移下的泛化，且其掩码导出的 radiomics 在 5 个 CT/MRI 回顾性队列中可分层生存并改进预后建模。
Motivation: 肿瘤与危及器官分割耗时且依赖专家，现有 AI 系统要么需要手动空间提示，要么需按任务重训练，通用类别标签对异质病灶指导不足。
Method: SyRe 以文本提示驱动，通过 Synergistic vision-language Reinforcement 强化视觉与语言表征的双向交互；引入 Color Region Description (CRD) 产生区域级语义监督，并用多样化提示格式训练，得到 SyReData（2000 万图像-掩码-描述三元组，覆盖 9 种模态、229 个分割任务）。
Result: 在 28 个未见外部数据集上展示分布偏移下的泛化，涵盖 17 种癌症、3 种非癌疾病与多国内部队列，病灶相关靶点提升明显；在 5 个横跨 CT 与 MRI 的回顾性肿瘤影像队列中，由 SyRe 掩码导出的 radiomics 可分层生存并相对临床基线改进预后建模。
Conclusion: SyRe 被确立为可扩展定量肿瘤分析与临床医生引导分割的通用框架，配合 clinician-in-the-loop 修正支持病例级校正。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: High-level, efficient ocean modeling at all scales with Oceananigans
papers.abstract_en: We describe the user interface, governing equations, and numerical methods underpinning the ocean modeling software called "Oceananigans". Oceananigans development has been led by the Climate Modeling Alliance as part of a larger effort to build a trainable climate model with quantifiable uncertainty. Notably, Oceananigans is written in the Julia programming language, is optimized for GPUs, and can efficiently simulate all scales of ocean motion ranging from millimeter-scale turbulence in a small box to planetary-scale ocean circulation. We argue that this combination of capabilities is enabled by a design that combines a basic, easy-to-optimize, GPU-friendly structured finite volume algorithm exposed behind a high-level, programmable user interface. This design negotiates a dual mandate for highest-possible performance (to support state-of-the-art applications) and enhanced accessibility (to facilitate adoption and development). The dual mandate aims ultimately to accelerate the progress of Earth system science.
papers.comment: 50 pages; revised exposition, updated examples and references, and corrections to equations and code listings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Oceananigans 是 Climate Modeling Alliance 推出的 Julia 海洋模式，以 GPU 优化的结构化有限体积算法配高层可编程接口，宣称可高效模拟从毫米尺度湍流到行星尺度环流的全尺度海洋运动。其设计同时追求极致性能与易用性，目标是加速地球系统科学发展。
Motivation: 海洋模式常在高性能与易用性之间二选一：底层高性能代码难改难扩展，高层接口又跑不快，阻碍模式被广泛采用与二次开发。
Method: 用 Julia 编写、面向 GPU 优化的结构化有限体积 (structured finite volume) 算法作为底层，外加高层可编程用户接口暴露控制方程与数值方法；该软件是更宏大目标（构建带可量化不确定性的可训练气候模式）的一部分。
Result: 软件被描述为可高效模拟从毫米尺度小箱湍流到行星尺度海洋环流的全尺度海洋运动，并在性能与可访问性之间取得兼顾；摘要为软件描述性论文，未给出基准测试数值。
Conclusion: 把易优化的 GPU 友好有限体积核心与高层可编程接口结合，可以同时满足高性能与易用性的双重目标，从而支撑可训练气候模式的开发。

papers.title: Uncertainty Propagation for Echocardiography Clinical Metric Estimation via Contour Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Echocardiography plays a fundamental role in the extraction of clinical parameters (e.g. left ventricular volume and ejection fraction) required to determine the presence and severity of heart-related conditions. When deploying automated techniques for computing these parameters, uncertainty estimation is highly valuable for assessing their utility. Since clinical parameters are usually derived from segmentation maps, there is no clear path for converting pixel-wise uncertainty values into uncertainty estimates in the downstream clinical metric calculation. In this work, we propose a novel uncertainty estimation method based on contouring rather than segmentation. Our method explicitly predicts contour location uncertainty from which contour samples can be drawn. Finally, the sampled contours can be used to propagate uncertainty to clinical metrics. Our proposed method not only provides accurate uncertainty estimations for the task of contouring but also for the downstream clinical metrics on one public and two private cardiac ultrasound datasets containing a total of 1264 patients. Code is available at: https://github.com/ThierryJudge/contouring-uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 超声心动图临床指标（左室容积、射血分数）由分割图导出，但像素级不确定性无法直接传到下游指标。本文改为直接预测轮廓位置不确定性，从轮廓分布中采样，再把采样轮廓传到临床指标，从而给出指标级不确定性估计；在 1 个公开加 2 个私有心脏超声数据集、共 1264 例患者上，该方法在轮廓任务和下游临床指标上都给出准确的不确定性估计。
Motivation: 自动计算的临床指标需要不确定性来判断可用性，但临床参数通常由分割图导出，像素级不确定性没有清晰路径转换成下游指标的不确定性估计。
Method: 提出基于轮廓 (contouring) 而非分割 (segmentation) 的不确定性估计方法：显式预测轮廓位置不确定性，从中采样轮廓，再用采样得到的轮廓把不确定性传播到临床指标计算。
Result: 在 1 个公开和 2 个私有心脏超声数据集（共 1264 例患者）上，该方法在轮廓任务与下游临床指标上都给出准确的不确定性估计；代码已开源。
Conclusion: 把不确定性建模放在轮廓层面而非像素分割层面，可以把不确定性显式传播到左室容积、射血分数等下游临床指标。

papers.title: Spectral structure learning for clinical time series
papers.abstract_en: We develop and evaluate a structure learning algorithm for clinical time series. Clinical time series are multivariate time series observed in multiple patients and irregularly sampled, challenging existing structure learning algorithms. We assume that our times series are realizations of StructGP, a k-dimensional multi-output or multi-task stationary Gaussian process (GP), with independent patients sharing the same covariance function. StructGP encodes ordered conditional relations between time series, represented in a directed acyclic graph. We implement an adapted NOTEARS algorithm, which based on a differentiable definition of acyclicity, recovers the graph by solving a series of continuous optimization problems. Simulation results show that up to mean degree 3 and 20 tasks, we reach a median recall of 0.93% [IQR, 0.86, 0.97] while keeping a median precision of 0.71% [0.57-0.84], for recovering directed edges. We further show that the regularization path is key to identifying the graph. With StructGP, we proposed a model of time series dependencies, that flexibly adapt to different time series regularity, while enabling us to learn these dependencies from observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 StructGP：把多患者、不规则采样的临床多变量时间序列建模为共享协方差函数的 k 维多输出平稳高斯过程，变量间的有序条件关系用有向无环图 (DAG) 表示，再用改造的 NOTEARS（基于可微无环性约束的连续优化）恢复该图。在平均度 3、20 个任务的模拟中，有向边恢复的中位 recall 为 0.93 [IQR 0.86, 0.77]、precision 为 0.71 [0.57–0.84]，并显示正则化路径 (regularization path) 对识别出正确图结构是关键。
Motivation: 临床时间序列是跨多个患者观测、且采样不规则的多变量序列，现有结构学习 (structure learning) 算法难以处理这种设定，无法从中恢复变量间的有向依赖结构。
Method: 假设时间序列是 StructGP 的实现：k 维多输出/多任务平稳 GP，各患者独立但共享同一协方差函数；图结构编码变量间的有序条件关系并约束为 DAG。求解用改造的 NOTEARS，借助可微的无环性定义把离散图搜索化为一系列连续优化问题，并沿正则化路径 (regularization path) 识别图。
Result: 模拟实验中，在平均度 (mean degree) 达 3、任务数 20 的条件下，恢复有向边的中位 recall 为 0.93 [IQR 0.86, 0.97]，中位 precision 为 0.71 [0.57–0.84]；并显示正则化路径对识别图结构是关键。
Conclusion: StructGP 提供了一个能灵活适应不同时间序列规律性、并可从观测中学习变量间依赖结构的模型；在该模拟设定下 NOTEARS 型连续优化能以较高 recall 恢复有向边，precision 相对偏低。

papers.title: Quantifying the Impact of Motion on 2D Gaze Estimation in Real-World Mobile Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Mobile gaze tracking on handheld devices commonly relies on \emph{appearance-based 2D gaze estimation} from the device's \emph{front-facing RGB camera}. Although this approach makes eye tracking more accessible by avoiding dedicated infrared hardware, maintaining accuracy remains difficult because the spatial relationship among the user's face, the camera, and the screen changes continuously during handheld use. This paper examines how motion-related geometry change affects a representative front-camera RGB 2D gaze-estimation pipeline. We report two complementary within-subject user studies (\(n=10\)) that capture handheld behaviour, calibration data, and gaze-estimation error during everyday-style mobile tasks across conditions ranging from lying and sitting to walking and maze navigation. Rather than treating motion as a single binary factor, we analyse within-task versus task-switch behaviour, calibration-test mismatch, and condition-specific motion signatures. Behavioural results show that head-to-camera distance is comparatively stable during sustained within-task use, while task switches introduce much larger geometry fluctuations, with head-distance standard deviations of approximately 7.42--10.10\,cm across conditions. In the gaze-evaluation study, one-off calibration reduced average RMSE from 4.49\,cm to 3.44\,cm; under this regime, the global effect of motion condition on RMSE was not statistically reliable, whereas clearer patterns appeared in task-specific and motion-specific calibration analyses, where better calibration-test match reduced error.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 手持设备前置 RGB 摄像头的 2D 视线估计中，任务切换比持续单一任务引入大得多的几何波动（头-相机距离标准差约 7.42–10.10 cm），而一次性标定把平均 RMSE 从 4.49 cm 降到 3.44 cm。在该标定制度下运动条件对 RMSE 的全局效应不具统计可靠性，但任务级与运动级的标定-测试匹配越好误差越低，说明应针对具体任务与运动状态分别标定。
Motivation: 手持使用时人脸、摄像头与屏幕的空间关系持续变化，外观式 2D 视线估计精度难以维持；而以往常把运动当作单一二元因素，掩盖了任务内与任务切换的差异。
Method: 两项被试内用户研究（n=10），覆盖躺卧、坐姿、行走与迷宫导航等日常移动任务，采集手持行为、标定数据与视线估计误差；分析区分任务内与任务切换行为、标定-测试不匹配以及各条件的运动特征。
Result: 持续任务内头-相机距离相对稳定，任务切换引起更大几何波动，各条件头距标准差约 7.42–10.10 cm；一次性标定使平均 RMSE 从 4.49 cm 降至 3.44 cm；此制度下运动条件对 RMSE 的全局效应不具统计可靠性，而任务级与运动级分析显示标定-测试匹配更好时误差更低。
Conclusion: 运动对 2D 视线估计的影响主要通过标定-测试几何不匹配起作用，全局运动条件不足以解释误差，按任务与运动状态匹配标定才是降低误差的关键。

papers.title: Video Depth Anything: Consistent Depth Estimation for Super-Long Videos
papers.abstract_en: Depth Anything has achieved remarkable success in monocular depth estimation with strong generalization ability. However, it suffers from temporal inconsistency in videos, hindering its practical applications. Various methods have been proposed to alleviate this issue by leveraging video generation models or introducing priors from optical flow and camera poses. Nonetheless, these methods are only applicable to short videos (< 10 seconds) and require a trade-off between quality and computational efficiency. We propose Video Depth Anything for high-quality, consistent depth estimation in super-long videos (over several minutes) without sacrificing efficiency. We base our model on Depth Anything V2 and replace its head with an efficient spatial-temporal head. We design a straightforward yet effective temporal consistency loss by constraining the temporal depth gradient, eliminating the need for additional geometric priors. The model is trained on a joint dataset of video depth and unlabeled images, similar to Depth Anything V2. Moreover, a novel key-frame-based strategy is developed for long video inference. Experiments show that our model can be applied to arbitrarily long videos without compromising quality, consistency, or generalization ability. Comprehensive evaluations on multiple video benchmarks demonstrate that our approach sets a new state-of-the-art in zero-shot video depth estimation. We offer models of different scales to support a range of scenarios, with our smallest model capable of real-time performance at 30 FPS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Video Depth Anything 把 Depth Anything V2 的头部换成高效时空 head，并用约束时间深度梯度的时序一致性损失，去掉光流与相机位姿先验，从而在数分钟以上的超长视频上做一致的零样本深度估计。在多个 video benchmark 上达到 zero-shot 视频深度估计的新 SOTA，最小模型可 30 FPS 实时运行。
Motivation: Depth Anything 单目深度泛化强但视频上时序不一致；现有借助视频生成模型或光流/位姿先验的方法只适用于 10 秒以内的短视频，且要在质量与计算效率之间取舍。
Method: 以 Depth Anything V2 为基座，把原有 head 替换为高效时空 head (spatial-temporal head)；设计直接约束时间深度梯度的时序一致性损失，无需额外几何先验；训练数据沿用 Depth Anything V2 式的视频深度与无标注图像联合数据集，推理采用新的 key-frame-based 策略处理长视频。
Result: 在多个 video benchmark 的综合评测中取得 zero-shot 视频深度估计的新 SOTA；可应用于任意长视频而不损失质量、一致性与泛化能力；提供多尺度模型，最小模型达 30 FPS 实时性能；现有可比方法受限于 10 秒以内的短视频。
Conclusion: 不依赖光流或相机位姿先验、仅靠时间深度梯度约束加时空 head，就足以在超长视频上同时拿到一致性与效率，把视频深度估计的可用时长从 10 秒级推到数分钟以上。

papers.title: Forget About It: Mitigating Forgetting Without Replay or Auxiliary Objectives
papers.abstract_en: Have we made mitigating catastrophic forgetting more complicated than it needs to be? Continual adaptation often degrades performance on earlier tasks, motivating rehearsal buffers, auxiliary objectives, and adaptive merging procedures. We investigate how far a simpler alternative-periodic parameter interpolation during fine-tuning-can go on its own. We introduce Sequential Fine-tuning with Averaging (SFA) and evaluate it alongside replay-free Lookahead, originally designed for optimization stability to find compelling results. In Qwen3-14B adapter continual learning, fixed configurations of both methods outperform the tested replay and adaptive-merging configurations in mean final accuracy using up to 36.3% less task training time. Furthermore, across language and vision tasks, our results compete with more complex continual-learning methods. Together, these findings suggest that simple in-training interpolation deserves consideration before introducing more elaborate forgetting-mitigation mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Qwen3-14B 的 adapter 持续学习中，仅靠训练期的周期性参数插值（SFA 与 replay-free Lookahead）即可缓解灾难性遗忘：固定配置在平均最终准确率上超过所测试的 replay 与 adaptive-merging 配置，同时最多节省 36.3% 的任务训练时间。作者主张在引入更复杂的遗忘缓解机制之前先试这种简单插值。
Motivation: 持续适应会拉低早期任务表现，常规做法要加 rehearsal buffer、辅助目标或自适应合并，复杂度高；本文追问仅靠周期性参数插值能走多远。
Method: 提出 Sequential Fine-tuning with Averaging (SFA)，并与原本为优化稳定性设计的 replay-free Lookahead 一同评测；在 Qwen3-14B 的 adapter 持续学习设定下，与 replay 和 adaptive-merging 的若干配置对比，并跨语言与视觉任务检验。
Result: 在 Qwen3-14B adapter 持续学习中，SFA 与 Lookahead 的固定配置在平均最终准确率上超过所测试的 replay 与 adaptive-merging 配置，且最多节省 36.3% 的任务训练时间；跨语言与视觉任务的结果与更复杂的持续学习方法相当。
Conclusion: 训练期的简单参数插值足以在所测设定下匹敌甚至优于更 elaborate 的遗忘缓解机制，应先试插值再上复杂方案。

papers.title: PRIMEdit: Probability Redistribution for Instance-Aware Multi-Object Video Editing With a New Benchmark Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Recent Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based video editing has enabled users to edit videos through simple text prompts, significantly simplifying the editing process. However, recent zero-shot video editing techniques focus on global or single-object edits, which can lead to unintended changes in other parts of the video. When editing multiple objects only within their localized regions, existing methods face challenges, such as unfaithful editing, editing leakage, and lack of suitable evaluation datasets and metrics. To overcome these limitations, we propose $\textbf{P}$robability $\textbf{R}$edistribution for $\textbf{I}$nstance-aware $\textbf{M}$ulti-object Video $\textbf{Edit}$ing ($\textbf{PRIMEdit}$). PRIMEdit is a zero-shot framework that introduces two key modules: (i) Instance-centric Probability Redistribution (IPR) to ensure precise localization and faithful editing and (ii) Disentangled Multi-instance Sampling (DMS) to prevent editing leakage. Additionally, we present the MIVE dataset for multi-instance video editing, including its subsets categorized by instance counts and sizes for controlled analysis across different levels of scene complexity. We also introduce the Cross-Instance Accuracy (CIA) Score that is firstly proposed to evaluate the editing leakage in multi-instance video editing tasks, which exhibits strong correlation with human evaluation as measured by Spearman's $ρ= 0.86$. Our extensive qualitative, quantitative, and user study evaluations demonstrate that PRIMEdit significantly outperforms recent state-of-the-art methods in terms of editing faithfulness, accuracy, and leakage prevention, setting a new benchmark for multi-instance video editing.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRIMEdit 是零样本文本驱动的多目标视频编辑框架，用 Instance-centric Probability Redistribution (IPR) 把编辑概率约束在目标实例区域内保证定位与编辑忠实性，用 Disentangled Multi-instance Sampling (DMS) 阻断跨实例的编辑泄漏。配套提出 MIVE 数据集与首个衡量编辑泄漏的 Cross-Instance Accuracy (CIA) Score，其与人工评价的 Spearman ρ=0.86。
Motivation: 现有零样本文本视频编辑面向全局或单目标，改多个目标时会出现不忠实编辑与编辑泄漏，且缺少合适的评测数据集与指标。
Method: 零样本框架含两个模块：Instance-centric Probability Redistribution (IPR) 负责精确定位与忠实编辑，Disentangled Multi-instance Sampling (DMS) 负责抑制编辑泄漏；同时发布按实例数量与尺寸分层的 MIVE 数据集，并提出 Cross-Instance Accuracy (CIA) Score 度量编辑泄漏，配合定量、定性与用户研究评测。
Result: CIA Score 与人工评价强相关，Spearman ρ=0.86；在编辑忠实性、准确性与泄漏抑制上显著优于近期 SOTA 方法（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把编辑概率按实例重分配并解耦多实例采样，可以在零样本设定下同时改善多目标视频编辑的忠实性与泄漏抑制，CIA Score 可作为该任务的泄漏度量。

papers.title: A LoRA is Worth a Thousand Pictures
papers.abstract_en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a standard approach for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of image diffusion models, with over 200K models trained to replicate artistic styles and shared in online communities. One way to analyze styles of LoRA models is to generate image samples and apply image-based features like CLIP. However, this generation requires additional computation and prompt selection. In this work, we propose analyzing styles directly in the LoRA weight space, bypassing these limitations while achieving better performance even on unseen LoRAs. Since in-the-wild LoRAs lack ground truth model details, we design an experimental setup and show that LoRA weights alone serve as effective feature representations of adapted styles, robust to variations in fine-tuning seeds and image selection. We extensively evaluate using SD1.5 (the most popular base model within online communities) across data domains (fine-art paintings, architectural photos) and diverse prompt settings, with a small-scale SDXL experiment further verifying generalization. These evaluations confirm that our approach, under the selected aspects of variability, preserves fine-grained styles and outperforms image-based methods in clustering and retrieval of unseen LoRAs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 直接在 LoRA 权重空间里表征图像扩散模型的风格，绕过生成采样与 CLIP 图像特征。在 SD1.5 上跨绘画与建筑照片域、多种 prompt 设置的评测中，对未见过的 LoRA 在聚类与检索上优于基于生成图像特征的方法，且对微调 seed 与图像选择的扰动更稳健。
Motivation: 分析社区里 20 万以上个艺术风格 LoRA 时，主流做法是生成图像样本再提 CLIP 特征，需要额外算力和 prompt 选择，且 in-the-wild LoRA 没有 ground truth 元信息。
Method: 提出在 LoRA 权重空间直接做风格表征，绕开生成环节；针对 in-the-wild LoRA 缺少真实模型细节的问题，设计可控实验设置，用 SD1.5 作为基座，覆盖细粒度绘画与建筑照片等数据域和多种 prompt 设置，并加一个小规模 SDXL 实验检验泛化。
Result: LoRA 权重本身即可作为所适配风格的有效特征表示，对微调 seed 与图像选择的变化稳健；在未见过的 LoRA 上，聚类与检索表现优于基于图像特征（如 CLIP）的方法，SD1.5 上的广泛评测加小规模 SDXL 实验进一步验证泛化。
Conclusion: 风格信息已经编码在 LoRA 权重里，权重空间分析可以替代生成采样加图像特征的流程，在未见 LoRA 的聚类与检索上更准也更省算力。

summary_sections.method: 提出在 LoRA 权重空间直接做风格表征，绕开生成环节；针对 in-the-wild LoRA 缺少真实模型细节的问题，设计可控实验设置，用 SD1.5 作为基座，覆盖细粒度绘画与建筑照片等数据域和多种 prompt 设置，并加一个小规模 SDXL 实验检验泛化。
summary_sections.result: LoRA 权重本身即可作为所适配风格的有效特征表示，对微调 seed 与图像选择的变化稳健；在未见过的 LoRA 上，聚类与检索表现优于基于图像特征（如 CLIP）的方法，SD1.5 上的广泛评测加小规模 SDXL 实验进一步验证泛化。
summary_sections.conclusion: 风格信息已经编码在 LoRA 权重里，权重空间分析可以替代生成采样加图像特征的流程，在未见 LoRA 的聚类与检索上更准也更省算力。

papers.title: GLL: A Differentiable Graph Learning Layer for Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Standard deep learning architectures used for classification generate label predictions with a projection head and softmax activation function. Although successful, these methods fail to leverage the relational information between samples for generating label predictions. In recent works, graph-based learning techniques, namely Laplace learning, have been heuristically combined with neural networks for both supervised and semi-supervised learning (SSL) tasks. However, prior works approximate the gradient of the loss function with respect to the graph learning algorithm or decouple the processes; end-to-end integration with neural networks is not achieved. In this work, we derive backpropagation equations, via the adjoint method, for inclusion of a general family of graph learning layers into a neural network. The resulting method, distinct from graph neural networks, allows us to precisely integrate similarity graph construction and graph Laplacian-based label propagation into a neural network layer, replacing a projection head and softmax activation function for general classification task. Our experimental results demonstrate smooth label transitions across data, improved generalization and robustness to adversarial attacks, and improved training dynamics compared to a standard softmax-based approach.
papers.comment: 58 pages, 12 figures. Preprint. Submitted to the Journal of Machine Learning Research. v2: several new experiments, improved exposition
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GLL 用伴随法 (adjoint method) 推导出可微的图学习层反向传播公式，把相似图构建与基于图 Laplacian 的标签传播端到端嵌入神经网络，替代分类网络末端的 projection head + softmax。实验显示标签在数据上平滑过渡、泛化与对抗鲁棒性提升，训练动态也优于标准 softmax 方案。
Motivation: 既有的 Laplace learning 与神经网络结合是启发式拼接：要么对图学习算法的损失梯度做近似，要么把两段解耦，无法端到端训练，样本间的关系信息也没被用于生成标签预测。
Method: 用伴随法推导一般图学习层族的反向传播方程，将相似图构建与图 Laplacian 标签传播作为一个可微层插入网络，取代 projection head 与 softmax，用于监督与半监督 (SSL) 分类；与 GNN 的做法相区分。
Result: 实验结果给出定性结论：标签在数据上平滑过渡，泛化与对抗攻击鲁棒性提升，训练动态优于标准 softmax 方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 图 Laplacian 标签传播可以作为可微层与神经网络端到端集成，替代 softmax 分类头，并在分类任务上带来更好的泛化、对抗鲁棒性与训练动态。

papers.title: Noise-Aware Differentially Private Variational Inference
papers.abstract_en: Differential privacy (DP) provides robust privacy guarantees for statistical inference, but this can lead to unreliable results and biases in downstream applications. While several noise-aware approaches have been proposed which integrate DP perturbation into the inference, they are limited to specific types of simple probabilistic models. In this work, we propose a novel method for noise-aware approximate Bayesian inference based on stochastic gradient variational inference which can also be applied to high-dimensional and non-conjugate models. We also propose a more accurate evaluation method for noise-aware posteriors. Empirically, our inference method has similar performance to existing methods in the domain where they are applicable. Outside this domain, we obtain accurate coverages on high-dimensional Bayesian linear regression and well-calibrated predictive probabilities on Bayesian logistic regression with the UCI Adult dataset.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 28th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics (AISTATS 2025), PMLR 258:4987-4995, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于随机梯度变分推断 (stochastic gradient variational inference) 的噪声感知近似贝叶斯推断方法，把 DP 扰动纳入变分推断，可扩展到高维与非共轭模型，并配套更准确的噪声感知后验评估方法。在已有方法适用的领域性能相当；在高维贝叶斯线性回归上获得准确覆盖率，在 UCI Adult 的贝叶斯逻辑回归上预测概率校准良好。
Motivation: 差分隐私 (DP) 的扰动会让统计推断产生偏差与不可靠结果，而已有噪声感知方法只适用于特定的简单概率模型，无法覆盖高维、非共轭场景。
Method: 以随机梯度变分推断 (SGVI) 为基础构建噪声感知近似贝叶斯推断，将 DP 噪声纳入推断过程，适用于高维与非共轭模型；同时提出一种更准确的噪声感知后验评估方法。
Result: 在已有噪声感知方法适用的领域，本方法性能与之相当；在该领域之外，高维贝叶斯线性回归上获得准确的覆盖率 (coverage)，UCI Adult 数据集上的贝叶斯逻辑回归得到校准良好的预测概率。
Conclusion: 噪声感知 DP 推断可以借随机梯度变分推断推广到高维非共轭模型，同时保持后验覆盖率与预测校准质量。

papers.title: Active Exploration in Bayesian Model-based Reinforcement Learning for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Efficiently tackling multiple tasks within complex environments, such as those found in robot manipulation, remains an ongoing challenge in robotics and an opportunity for data-driven solutions such as reinforcement learning (RL). The high cost of data gathering in robotics encourages data-efficient approaches such as model-based RL, which builds a dynamic model of the robot to conduct most policy learning on cheaper simulations, while enabling data reuse and transfer between tasks. In this work, we employ Bayesian deep learning (BDL) with a double purpose. First, we increase the model quality by improving its calibration. Second, we improve data efficiency by performing active learning of the dynamic model during a preliminary exploration phase, actively estimating the information gain of each transition and using it as the exploration reward. We compare several BDL methods in a realistic robot manipulation setup. Our experiments show that our approach matches the quality of relevant alternatives with much lower robot execution requirements and, unlike previous studies validated only on standard RL environments, we tackle robotic arm end-tasks on a complete manipulator simulator such as \texttt{CoppeliaSim}. Code is available at https://github.com/ropertunizar/BayesianActiveExploration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在基于模型的强化学习 (model-based RL) 中用贝叶斯深度学习 (BDL) 同时做模型校准与主动学习：预探索阶段逐条估计每个状态转移的信息增益 (information gain)，并把它直接当作探索奖励来采集数据。在 CoppeliaSim 完整机械臂仿真上，该方法以远低于对照方法的机器人执行次数达到相当的模型质量。
Motivation: 机器人数据采集成本高，模型式 RL 需要数据高效；此前相关主动探索研究只在标准 RL 环境上验证，未覆盖真实感机械臂末端任务。
Method: 用 BDL 学习机器人动力学模型并提升校准度；在预探索阶段对每个候选转移估计信息增益，将其作为探索奖励驱动主动学习，随后在仿真中完成大部分策略学习；对比多种 BDL 方法。
Result: 在 CoppeliaSim 机械臂末端任务上，该方法达到与相关替代方法相当的模型质量，而机器人执行需求显著更低；实验在完整 manipulator 仿真器中进行，而非仅标准 RL 环境。
Conclusion: 把信息增益当探索奖励的主动学习能让基于模型的 RL 在真实感机器人操作任务上以更少实机执行换取同等模型质量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Bellman Conformal Inference: Calibrating Prediction Intervals For Time Series
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Bellman Conformal Inference (BCI), a framework that wraps around any time series forecasting models and provides calibrated prediction intervals. Unlike the existing methods, BCI is able to leverage multi-step ahead forecasts and explicitly optimize the average interval lengths by solving a one-dimensional stochastic control problem (SCP) at each time step. In particular, we use the dynamic programming algorithm to find the optimal policy for the SCP. We prove that BCI achieves long-term coverage under arbitrary distribution shifts and temporal dependence, even with poor multi-step ahead forecasts. When the raw forecast intervals are approximately calibrated, we prove that BCI is near optimal for its surrogate model predictive control problem. We find empirically that BCI avoids uninformative intervals with infinite lengths under our main experimental configuration and generates substantially shorter prediction intervals when the raw forecast intervals are poorly calibrated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Bellman Conformal Inference (BCI) 是一个包裹任意时间序列预测模型的区间校准框架：每步求解一维随机控制问题 (SCP)，用动态规划找最优策略来显式压缩平均区间长度。理论上在任意分布漂移与时序依赖下保证长期覆盖，即使多步预报很差也成立；实验中它避免了无限长度的无信息区间，并在原始区间校准差时显著缩短区间。
Motivation: 现有 conformal 时间序列区间方法难以利用多步预报，也无法直接优化区间长度，在分布漂移与时序依赖下容易给出无信息的超长区间。
Method: BCI 包裹任意预测模型，每步把区间长度优化写成一维随机控制问题，用动态规划求解最优策略；并证明长期覆盖保证与针对代理模型预测控制问题的近最优性。
Result: 证明在任意分布漂移与时序依赖下达到长期覆盖，即使多步预报质量差；当原始区间近似校准时，对代理 MPC 问题近最优。实验中 BCI 在主实验配置下避免了无限长度的无信息区间，并在原始区间校准差时给出显著更短的预测区间。
Conclusion: 把区间长度作为随机控制问题来优化，可以在不牺牲长期覆盖的前提下压掉无信息的宽区间，即使底层多步预报不可靠。

papers.title: Beyond Size: How Gradients Shape Pruning Decisions in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) with billions of parameters are prime targets for network pruning, which removes some model weights without hurting performance. Prior approaches such as magnitude pruning, SparseGPT, and Wanda either concentrated solely on weights or integrated weights with activations for sparsity. However, they overlooked the informative gradients derived from pretrained LLMs. In this paper, we present a novel sparsity-centric pruning method for pretrained LLMs, termed Gradient-based Language Model Pruner (GBLM-Pruner). GBLM-Pruner leverages the first-order term of the Taylor expansion, operating in a training-free manner by harnessing properly normalized gradients from a few calibration samples to determine the pruning metric, and substantially outperforms competitive counterparts like SparseGPT and Wanda in multiple benchmarks. Intriguingly, by incorporating gradients, unstructured pruning with our method tends to reveal some structural patterns, which mirrors the geometric interdependence inherent in the LLMs' parameter structure. Additionally, GBLM-Pruner functions without any subsequent retraining or weight updates to maintain its simplicity as other counterparts. Extensive evaluations on LLaMA-series, Qwen-Series and Deepseek models across zero-shot, STEM-Reasoning and Coding benchmarks show that GBLM-Pruner surpasses magnitude pruning and Wanda by significant margins and performs competitively against SparseGPT which involves intensive weight updates. We further extend our approach on Vision Transformer and Vision Language Models. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/GBLM-Pruner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GBLM-Pruner 用预训练 LLM 在少量校准样本上的归一化一阶梯度（Taylor 展开一阶项）作为剪枝指标，训练-free、无需后续重训练，即在多个基准上显著超过 magnitude pruning 与 Wanda，并与需要大量权重更新的 SparseGPT 竞争。
Motivation: 现有剪枝方法（magnitude pruning、SparseGPT、Wanda）只看权重或权重加激活，丢弃了预训练 LLM 中信息量丰富的梯度信号，导致剪枝指标不完整。
Method: GBLM-Pruner 取 Taylor 展开一阶项，用少量校准样本上归一化的梯度构造剪枝度量，训练-free 且不做任何后续重训练或权重更新；方法同时扩展到 Vision Transformer 与 Vision Language Models。
Result: 在 LLaMA 系列、Qwen 系列与 DeepSeek 模型上的 zero-shot、STEM-Reasoning、Coding 基准评测中，GBLM-Pruner 显著超过 magnitude pruning 与 Wanda，并在需要大量权重更新的 SparseGPT 面前表现有竞争力；引入梯度后非结构化剪枝显现出结构化模式，反映 LLM 参数结构的几何相互依赖。
Conclusion: 梯度（而非仅权重或激活）是剪枝决策的关键信息源，可在不重训练的前提下达到与需权重更新方法相当的性能。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Energy-Based Models For Speech Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Recently there has been a lot of interest in non-autoregressive (non-AR) models for speech synthesis, such as FastSpeech 2 and diffusion models. Unlike AR models, these models do not have autoregressive dependencies among outputs which makes inference efficient. This paper expands the range of available non-AR models with another member called energy-based models (EBMs). The paper describes how noise contrastive estimation, which relies on the comparison between positive and negative samples, can be used to train EBMs. It proposes a number of strategies for generating effective negative samples, including using high-performing AR models. It also describes how sampling from EBMs can be performed using Langevin Markov Chain Monte-Carlo (MCMC). The use of Langevin MCMC enables to draw connections between EBMs and currently popular diffusion models. Experiments on LJSpeech dataset show that the proposed approach offers improvements over Tacotron 2.

papers.title: Generation of data on discontinuous manifolds via continuous stochastic non-invertible networks
papers.abstract_en: The generation of discontinuous distributions is a difficult task for most known frameworks such as generative autoencoders and generative adversarial networks. Generative non-invertible models are unable to accurately generate such distributions, require long training and often are subject to mode collapse. Variational autoencoders (VAEs), which are based on the idea of keeping the latent space to be Gaussian for the sake of a simple sampling, allow an accurate reconstruction, while they experience significant limitations at generation task. In this work, instead of trying to keep the latent space to be Gaussian, we use a pre-trained contrastive encoder to obtain a clustered latent space. Then, for each cluster, representing a unimodal submanifold, we train a dedicated low complexity network to generate this submanifold from the Gaussian distribution. The proposed framework is based on the information-theoretic formulation of mutual information maximization between the input data and latent space representation. We derive a link between the cost functions and the information-theoretic formulation. We apply our approach to synthetic 2D distributions to demonstrate both reconstruction and generation of discontinuous distributions using continuous stochastic networks.
papers.comment: presented at NeurIPS 2021 Workshop on Bayesian Deep Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对不连续分布生成难题，提出用预训练对比编码器把潜空间切成聚类（每个聚类对应一个单峰子流形），再为每个子流形训练低复杂度连续随机非可逆网络，从高斯分布生成该子流形。框架基于输入与潜表征之间互信息最大化的信息论形式化，并推导出代价函数与该形式化的联系；在合成 2D 分布上演示了不连续分布的重构与生成。
Motivation: 生成式自编码器、GAN 与非可逆生成模型难以准确生成不连续分布，训练长且常出现 mode collapse；VAE 为保高斯潜空间而牺牲生成能力。
Method: 放弃保持高斯潜空间，改用预训练对比编码器得到聚类潜空间；对每个代表单峰子流形的聚类训练一个专用低复杂度网络，从高斯分布生成该子流形；理论部分以互信息最大化形式化输入与潜表征的关系，并推导代价函数与之的对应。
Result: 在合成 2D 分布上演示了不连续分布的重构与生成，且生成用的是连续随机网络；摘要给出的是定性演示，无定量指标。
Conclusion: 把潜空间切成子流形并分别建模，可在保持连续随机网络的同时处理不连续分布的生成问题。

papers.title: Historical-Feature Residual Adaptation for Sequential Screening
papers.abstract_en: Sequential screening policies must use acquired feedback effectively under a fixed experiment budget. We study acquisition-time residual adaptation: a small ranking correction built from fixed historical features and anchored to base scores recorded before feedback is revealed. The interface accepts a history-conditioned scorer and a candidate feature table; its primary instantiation augments AssayFormer's ten-dimensional representation with 64 historical directions while retaining the pretrained model. In retrospective evaluation on 20 official-test screens from 15 recorded sources, a comparison fixed before target-outcome access increased source-macro fraction of hits recovered from 22.58% to 28.61%, exceeding all six prespecified comparators. A same-feature ordinary ranking head achieved 25.73%. Supplementary strong logistic, rank-fusion, and unprojected controls achieved 26.42%, 26.02%, and 26.78%, respectively. A separate model-independent pilot on 13 reused development screens reconstructs the features without AssayFormer assets. Across three seeds, residual adaptation improves random-forest hit recovery from 28.87% to 31.27%, while logistic recovery changes from 30.22% to 29.78%. The results show effective pretrained-policy adaptation and useful transfer to an independent nonlinear base, with gains that depend on the base model.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Agentic AI for Biological Discovery Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定实验预算的序贯筛选 (sequential screening) 中，用固定历史特征对反馈揭示前的基分数做小幅排序残差修正，可在不改动预训练模型的前提下提高命中回收率：AssayFormer 十维表征上加 64 个历史方向，20 个官方测试筛选的 source-macro 命中回收率从 22.58% 升到 28.61%，超过全部六个预设对照；但增益依赖基模型，随机森林从 28.87% 升到 31.27%，逻辑回归反而从 30.22% 降到 29.78%。
Motivation: 序贯筛选要在固定实验预算内用好已获得的反馈，而预训练打分模型在反馈到来后难以更新；需要一种不重训模型、只在采集时做小幅排序修正的适配方式。
Method: 接口接受历史条件打分器与候选特征表，主实例在 AssayFormer 的十维表征上追加 64 个历史方向并保留预训练模型，修正锚定在反馈揭示前记录的基分数上；对照包括同特征普通排序头、强逻辑回归、rank-fusion 与未投影控制，另有 13 个复用开发筛选上不依赖 AssayFormer 资产的模型无关 pilot（随机森林与逻辑回归基，三个随机种子）。
Result: 回顾性评估覆盖 15 个记录来源的 20 个官方测试筛选：残差适配把 source-macro 命中回收率从 22.58% 提到 28.61%，超过全部六个预设对照；同特征普通排序头 25.73%，强逻辑回归 26.42%、rank-fusion 26.02%、未投影控制 26.78%。在 13 个开发筛选的 pilot 上，三个种子下随机森林命中回收 28.87% → 31.27%，逻辑回归 30.22% → 29.78%。
Conclusion: 历史特征残差适配能有效适配预训练筛选策略并迁移到独立的非线性基模型，但收益取决于基模型：对随机森林为正、对逻辑回归为负。

papers.title: Did the LLM Answer the Question? A Semantic Reconstruction Game for Jailbreak Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Jailbreak attacks against large language models (LLMs) are evaluated using attack success rate (ASR), which depends on correctly identifying responses that fulfill prohibited requests. Existing evaluators can mistake refusals or topically related responses for successful attacks. We show that changing only the judge LLM can alter reported ASR by up to $82$ percentage points. We introduce the semantic reconstruction game, a training-free evaluator that decomposes compliance judgments into constrained semantic comparisons. Given only a response, an LLM reconstructs the request answered by its substantive content, excluding information merely repeated or refused. The game compares this reconstruction against similar decoy requests to determine whether it matches the original request, allowing abstention when neither candidate matches. Across three off-the-shelf LLM judges, the game achieves the lowest mean error against human labels among evaluated methods and reduces variation in reported ASR. It prioritizes avoiding false positives, even at the cost of missing some successful jailbreaks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对越狱评测中攻击成功率 (ASR) 依赖裁判 LLM 判断的问题，提出训练免费的语义重构博弈 (semantic reconstruction game)：只看回答，让 LLM 重构其实质内容所回答的请求（排除被复述或拒绝的信息），再与相似诱饵请求做受约束比较，允许弃权。仅更换裁判 LLM 就能让报告的 ASR 变动最多 82 个百分点；该方法在三个现成 LLM 裁判上取得对人工标注的最低平均误差并压低 ASR 波动，代价是偏向漏检部分成功越狱。
Motivation: ASR 依赖正确识别满足违规请求的回答，现有评测器会把拒绝或仅话题相关的回答误判为攻击成功，且裁判模型的选择本身就能大幅改变结论。
Method: 训练免费的评测器：给定回答，LLM 重构其被实质内容回答的请求并剔除仅被复述或拒绝的信息；将重构结果与相似诱饵请求比较，判断是否匹配原始请求，两者都不匹配时可弃权。在三个现成 LLM 裁判上与人工标注对比。
Result: 仅更换裁判 LLM 可使报告的 ASR 变动最多 82 个百分点；在三个 off-the-shelf LLM 裁判上，该博弈对人工标签的平均误差在被评测方法中最低，并降低 ASR 的报告波动。
Conclusion: 把合规判断拆成受约束的语义比较能减少裁判依赖与假阳性，其设计取向是优先避免假阳性，即使漏掉部分成功越狱。

papers.title: Data-free Multistep Diffusion Distillation
papers.abstract_en: One-step diffusion distillation achieves strong performance on small datasets but remains insufficient for high-resolution or complex text-to-image settings. Extending to multistep distillation often requires training data, suffers from early-step degradation, inconsistent outputs across sampling budgets, and incurs high computational cost. We identify that these limitations stem from simultaneous training, where a single adapted network approximates multiple score functions of different student distributions at once, causing biased distribution matching and unstable optimization. Therefore, we propose Progressive Multistep Data-free Distillation (PMDD), which assigns a dedicated adapted network per student distribution while avoiding the memory overhead of maintaining multiple adapted networks. Combined with a stage-wise unforget loss to preserve earlier-step generations, PMDD reduces optimization bias in the student, provides faster convergence, and a single unified model that supports multiple inference budgets. Extensive experiments show that PMDD matches or outperforms data-free few-step baselines at every multistep budget, reaches FID 1.99 on ImageNet 64x64 in two steps, below its 512-NFE teacher (2.32), and achieves FID 7.76 on zero-shot COCO 512x512, while requiring 4-5x less training compute than data-free DMDv2 to support three inference budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Progressive Multistep Data-free Distillation (PMDD)：为每个 student distribution 分配独立的 adapted network 并用 stage-wise unforget loss 保住前几步生成，从而在无需训练数据的多步蒸馏中降低分布匹配偏差。两步即在 ImageNet 64x64 上达到 FID 1.99，低于其 512-NFE teacher 的 2.32；零样本 COCO 512x512 达 FID 7.76，且支持三种推理预算的训练算力比 data-free DMDv2 少 4-5 倍。
Motivation: 一步扩散蒸馏在小数据集上够用，但高分辨率或复杂文生图场景不足；多步蒸馏又依赖训练数据、出现早期步退化、不同采样预算下输出不一致且算力开销高，根源是同时训练让单一网络同时逼近多个 student 分布的 score function。
Method: PMDD 为每个 student distribution 单独分配一个 adapted network，同时避免维护多份 adapted network 的显存开销；配合 stage-wise unforget loss 保留更早步骤的生成，得到支持多个推理预算的单一统一模型。
Result: 在 ImageNet 64x64 上两步达 FID 1.99，低于 512-NFE teacher 的 2.32；零样本 COCO 512x512 达 FID 7.76；在每个多步预算上匹配或超过 data-free few-step 基线，支持三种推理预算所需训练算力比 data-free DMDv2 少 4-5 倍。
Conclusion: 把多步蒸馏从同时训练改为按 student 分布逐步分配网络并防遗忘，可在完全 data-free 的前提下让少步学生逼近甚至超过高 NFE teacher，同时显著降低训练算力。

papers.title: DTDD: Divergence-Triggered Dynamic Distillation for Reliable On-Policy Supervision
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision on student rollouts, but this supervision can become unreliable when the student and teacher diverge, either because of a large initial policy gap or compounding errors in long-horizon reasoning and tool use. We introduce Divergence-Triggered Dynamic Distillation (DTDD), an adaptive OPD framework that uses segment-level student-teacher divergence to trigger teacher takeover during training. When divergence triggers an intervention during reasoning, the student prefix continues to receive standard OPD supervision. The teacher then generates a recovery suffix, which the student learns through behavior cloning, using cross-entropy on the teacher-generated tokens. We evaluate DTDD in three regimes: long-horizon reasoning, distillation from a base initialization without offline supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and multi-turn agents. We also compare alternative trigger designs and teacher-intervention rates. DTDD reduces the post-warmup peak gradient norm by $8.6\times$ and, from a base initialization, reaches $21.3\%$ held-out math accuracy in $2.6\times$ fewer optimizer updates than OPD; both methods finish near $22\%$. It improves best-observed performance by $4.8$ and $4.1$ percentage points on ALFWorld with LoRA and agentic code, respectively. Ablations show that segment-averaged triggers outperform token-spike triggers. Behavior cloning is also more effective than the tested OPD surrogate for training teacher-generated recoveries. Across 23 experimental arms, takeover tends to help when the teacher substantially outperforms the OPD-trained student, provided that the teacher can recover from student-visited states, the student can learn those recoveries, and teacher intervention is neither excessive nor insufficient.

papers.title: Beyond ICD Codes: Semantic IDs for Generative Medical Coding
papers.abstract_en: Generative approaches to automatic International Classification of Diseases (ICD) coding use large language models (LLMs) to predict ICD codes from clinical documents. However, original ICD code strings are not ideal generation targets because the ICD hierarchy does not always reflect clinical relationships, and LLMs struggle to interpret and generate these codes. We introduce SemICD, a framework that trains LLMs to generate Semantic IDs (SIDs) instead. SemICD constructs SIDs by hierarchically clustering embeddings of textual code profiles, allowing semantically related codes to share prefixes while each complete SID uniquely identifies one ICD code. To align the SID tokens with clinical semantics, we employ two auxiliary tasks for bidirectional generation between textual code profiles and SIDs. Experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV with four LLMs show that SemICD outperforms direct code generation, improving Micro-F1 by 1.34-8.00 points. Our code is available at https://github.com/youwillbethebest/SemICD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SemICD：不直接生成 ICD 码字符串，而是对文本化 code profile 的 embedding 做层次聚类得到 Semantic IDs (SIDs)，让语义相近的码共享前缀、每个完整 SID 唯一对应一个 ICD 码，并用两个辅助任务对齐 SID token 与临床语义。在 MIMIC-III 与 MIMIC-IV 上用四个 LLM 实验，Micro-F1 相对直接生成码提升 1.34–8.00 点。
Motivation: ICD 层级结构并不总反映临床语义关系，LLM 难以解读和生成原始 ICD 码字符串，直接把码串当生成目标效果受限。
Method: 对文本化 code profile 的 embedding 做层次聚类构造 SID，使相关码共享前缀且 SID 唯一标识每个 ICD 码；训练时加入两个辅助任务，实现文本 code profile 与 SID 的双向生成。
Result: 在 MIMIC-III 与 MIMIC-IV 上、四个 LLM 上实验，SemICD 相对直接生成 ICD 码提升 Micro-F1 1.34–8.00 点。
Conclusion: 把 ICD 码重编码为带语义前缀的离散 token，比直接生成原始码串更适合 LLM 做自动医疗编码。

papers.title: Verifier-Grounded Agentic RL for Provably Correct Code
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning for code usually rewards passing tests, which a model can do while remaining wrong on the inputs the tests do not cover. A program verifier instead decides whether a program satisfies a formal specification for all inputs. Language models are almost always paired with verifiers at inference time only, and turning a verifier into a reward raises two difficulties. It reports only acceptance or rejection, which gives no gradient when every attempt fails, and a policy can cheat it, most simply by telling it to assume what the proof was supposed to establish. We build an agentic environment and reward that address both. The reward reads the verifier's diagnostics rather than its verdict, scoring a candidate by the weighted fraction of proof obligations it discharges, extended with hidden probes from a reference proof's annotations. An integrity audit outranks the verifier, rejecting any candidate that alters the specification or assumes what it was meant to prove. The model works as an agent against a live verifier over many turns, with a separately trained proof specialist as a frozen collaborator. Across Qwen3 models from 1.7B to 14B and a 35B Qwen3.6 mixture-of-experts model, held-out verification on code generation rises from 66.1% to 93.5% on DafnyBench and from 56.3% to 100% on SWE-Proof. This reward leads every other training signal we compare, including a binary pass-or-fail reward trained under otherwise identical settings, with the widest margin on code generation. When the agent must also deliver the repository patch, graded by each project's withheld tests, the fraction of held-out issues it resolves rises from 59.6% to 72.5%. Evaluated unchanged on three verification suites withheld from training, the checkpoints improve on all of them, including one whose language and verifier are absent from training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把程序验证器 (program verifier) 从推理期判据变成 RL 训练奖励：奖励读取验证器诊断而非二值裁决，按已证成证明义务的加权比例打分，并加参考证明标注派生的隐藏探针；完整性审计优先级高于验证器，任何改动规范或假设待证结论的候选直接拒绝。在 Qwen3 1.7B–14B 与 35B Qwen3.6 MoE 上，DafnyBench 持出验证通过率从 66.1% 升到 93.5%，SWE-Proof 从 56.3% 升到 100%。
Motivation: 以通过测试为奖励的代码 RL 会让模型在测试未覆盖的输入上仍然出错；而验证器只给接受/拒绝，全失败时没有梯度，且策略可以靠让验证器假设待证结论来钻空子。
Method: 构建 agentic 环境：模型多轮对接在线验证器，另有一个单独训练的 proof specialist 作为冻结协作者。奖励读取验证器 diagnostics，按加权已证成证明义务比例计分，并用参考证明标注生成的 hidden probes 扩展；integrity audit 优先于验证器，拒绝改动规范或假设待证命题的候选。
Result: 持出验证 (held-out verification) 在代码生成上：DafnyBench 66.1% → 93.5%，SWE-Proof 56.3% → 100%（Qwen3 1.7B–14B 与 35B Qwen3.6 MoE）。该奖励胜过所有对比训练信号，包括同设置下的二值 pass-or-fail 奖励，代码生成上差距最大。需交付仓库 patch、按各项目持出测试评分时，解决的持出 issue 从 59.6% 升到 72.5%。在三个训练时未用的验证套件上原样评测均提升，其中一个的语言与验证器训练时未出现。
Conclusion: 把验证器的诊断信号与防作弊审计做成奖励，能在代码生成与仓库级修复上稳定超过二值测试奖励，并跨未见验证套件泛化。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Whose turn is it? Context-guided model routing for stateful agents
papers.abstract_en: Model routing can reduce the cost of LLM applications by assigning simpler requests to cheaper models without sacrificing the quality of the response. However, most routers treat requests as independent. Stateful agents do not operate under this assumption: a user turn may require multiple model and tool calls, its difficulty depends on the state produced by earlier turns, and changing models can sacrifice reuse of the conversational prompt cache. We study zero-shot, cost-aware routing at the user-turn boundary, systematically varying the routing rule, access to session history, candidate models that differ in size, reasoning effort, or model provider, and prompt-cache behavior. We evaluate on multi-turn versions of SheetCopilot and SpreadsheetBench 2, where persistent workbooks and cross-turn dependencies make isolated routing decisions especially brittle. At a matched offloading rate, giving the router session history improves task pass rate over the same router without history, with gains for every model pair; history-aware routing remains within one point of always using the expensive model. We also found that cost depends on execution dynamics rather than token prices alone: the cheaper model's per-task cost advantage narrows from 6.8x to 3.2x on longer sessions. A closed form cache analysis further shows that downward switches (expensive to cheap) recover their cache cost within two LLM calls, whereas upward switches do not break even under the evaluated conditions. Together, these results show that agent routing is a sequential decision problem: effective policies must account for what happened earlier in the session and for the asymmetric cost of switching models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在有状态多轮 agent 上做零样本、成本感知的模型路由，发现给路由器会话历史能在相同 offloading 率下提升任务 pass rate，且对每一对模型都成立，同时只比全程用贵模型低不到 1 个点。成本由执行动态而非 token 单价决定：长会话中便宜模型的单任务成本优势从 6.8x 收窄到 3.2x，且向下切换（贵→便宜）在 2 次 LLM 调用内收回缓存成本、向上切换在所评估条件下不回本。
Motivation: 多数 LLM 路由器把每次请求当独立事件，但 stateful agent 的一个用户轮次含多次模型与工具调用，难度取决于前几轮产生的状态，换模型还会丢掉对话 prompt cache 复用，孤立路由决策在持久工作簿场景下尤其脆弱。
Method: 在用户轮次边界做零样本、成本感知路由，系统改变路由规则、是否访问会话历史、候选模型（规模、reasoning effort、provider 不同）以及 prompt-cache 行为；评测用 SheetCopilot 与 SpreadsheetBench 2 的多轮版本，其中持久工作簿与跨轮依赖使孤立路由决策易碎；另给出闭式 cache 分析。
Result: 在匹配 offloading 率下，带会话历史的路由器比无历史版本任务 pass rate 更高，且每一对模型都有增益；历史感知路由与全程用贵模型的差距在 1 个点以内。便宜模型的单任务成本优势随会话变长从 6.8x 收窄到 3.2x。闭式 cache 分析显示向下切换在 2 次 LLM 调用内收回 cache 成本，向上切换在所评估条件下不回本。
Conclusion: agent 路由是一个序贯决策问题：有效策略必须纳入会话中先前发生了什么，以及切换模型的非对称成本（向下切换可快速回本、向上切换不回本）。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Kandinsky S2V 1.0: Audio-Driven Avatar Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: We present Kandinsky S2V 1.0, an open family of speech-to-video models for controllable audio-driven human animation, comprising Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Lite (2B parameters) and Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro (21B parameters). From a single reference image, a speech waveform, and a text prompt, the models generate long-form 25 FPS video in which lip motion, expression, pose, and gesture follow the speech. The architecture draws text and audio conditioning from one Qwen2.5-Omni model and adds a reference-aware three-scale visual memory. Training starts from the Kandinsky 5.0 Video foundation models [1] and combines mixed reference-memory layouts with an area-adaptive face loss. The training corpus contains 1.17M single-speaker clips selected by active-speaker detection, with captions generated directly in English and Russian. A side-by-side human evaluation against the strongest open-source baseline and two proprietary commercial models shows that Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro performs comparably to or better than these models on average and is also preferred for lip synchronization. On common speech to video benchmarks, Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Lite and Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro rank among the top performing models according to mean rank over five reported metrics. Beyond the base models, we provide π-Flow distilled variants of both Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Lite and Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro. The distilled Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro model generates video in 16 sampling steps without classifier-free guidance, achieving a 5.4 times end-to-end speedup over the base model, while matching or exceeding it on nearly all reported benchmark metrics. To accelerate open research and deployment in speech-to-video generation, we release the code, model checkpoints, and diffusers integration under the MIT license.
papers.comment: Technical report on the open-source S2V model
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 开源语音驱动数字人视频生成模型 Kandinsky S2V 1.0（Lite 2B / Pro 21B），由单张参考图、语音波形和文本提示生成 25 FPS 长视频，口型、表情、姿态与手势跟随语音。π-Flow 蒸馏版 Pro 用 16 步无 CFG 采样实现端到端 5.4 倍加速，同时在几乎所有报告指标上持平或超过原模型。
Motivation: 语音驱动人物动画需要在单参考图条件下同时保证口型同步、表情姿态与长视频一致性，开源模型与商业模型在该能力上仍有差距。
Method: 文本与音频条件统一取自 Qwen2.5-Omni，加入 reference-aware 三尺度视觉记忆；从 Kandinsky 5.0 Video 基础模型出发训练，混合 reference-memory 布局并使用 area-adaptive face loss；训练语料为 1.17M 单说话人片段（active-speaker detection 筛选），配英俄双语字幕；另提供 π-Flow 蒸馏变体。

papers.title: Exact Scaling Laws for a Random-Features Bigram Model
papers.abstract_en: Understanding neural scaling laws is increasingly important for theory and practice, yet first-principles explanations remain limited even in simple settings. In this work, we study capacity-limited scaling in a bottlenecked bigram model with power-law (Zipf) token statistics, viewed as an analytically tractable toy model of a large language model. Fixed random embeddings serve as a proxy for representational capacity and induce an explicit bottleneck of width, allowing us to derive scaling laws for prediction regret as a function of model width, vocabulary size, and the Zipf exponent. Our results complement recent theoretical accounts based on optimization dynamics by isolating scaling due purely to representational constraints. In the appropriate regime, the theory recovers the functional form of classical neural scaling laws and suggests that heavy-tailed language statistics may underlie both optimization- and capacity-driven scaling. Experiments natural language datasets (WikiText2, OpenWebText) closely match the predicted curves.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在带瓶颈的 bigram 模型中，用固定随机嵌入作为表征容量的代理，推导出预测 regret 随模型宽度、词表大小与 Zipf 指数变化的精确 scaling law。在适当机制下该理论复现经典神经 scaling law 的函数形式，并在 WikiText2 与 OpenWebText 上与预测曲线紧密吻合。
Motivation: 神经 scaling law 缺少第一性原理解释，已有理论多从优化动力学出发，表征容量约束单独导致的 scaling 尚未被隔离出来。
Method: 构造带瓶颈的 bigram 模型，token 统计服从幂律 (Zipf)，用固定随机嵌入 (fixed random embeddings) 表示有限表征容量并引入显式宽度瓶颈，据此解析推导预测 regret 关于模型宽度、词表大小与 Zipf 指数的 scaling law。
Result: 在适当机制下理论复现经典神经 scaling law 的函数形式；在 WikiText2 与 OpenWebText 上实验曲线与预测曲线紧密吻合。
Conclusion: 重尾语言统计可能同时支撑优化驱动与容量驱动两类 scaling，而容量约束本身即可产生 scaling law。

papers.title: Dimension-Free Scaling Laws for Size Generalization: An Exponential Separation
papers.abstract_en: Modern machine learning models increasingly operate on variable-size structured data, such as sets and graphs. A central requirement is \emph{size generalization}: the ability of a model trained on inputs of one size to generalize to inputs of a different, potentially much larger, size. Classical statistical learning theory, however, primarily considers fixed input domains, and its guarantees often deteriorate with input dimension. Although extensive work has established when models on sets and graphs can be transferred across input sizes, such results do not characterize the statistical cost of doing so: the sample complexity of size generalization, and its relationship to classical in-domain learning, remain largely unknown. We develop a statistical learning theory of size generalization and establish a sharp exponential separation in sample complexity. Letting $n$ denote the number of training samples, we show that polynomial source decay is insufficient for efficient size generalization: while it yields error $n^{-Θ(1)}$ and hence polynomial sample complexity for in-domain learning, size-generalization error decays only as $(\log n)^{-Θ(1)}$, yielding an exponential separation. Thus, polynomial in-domain sample complexity can become exponential across sizes. We then identify an exponential source condition under which size generalization achieves error $n^{-Θ(1)}$, recovering polynomial sample complexity. These guarantees are independent of input dimension and depend only on the number of training samples, yielding dimension-free scaling laws. We also provide matching minimax lower bounds, establishing optimality. To our knowledge, this work provides the first dimension-free minimax theory of size generalization and a rigorous characterization of when, and at what statistical cost, learning can transfer across input sizes.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 1 figure. An extended abstract of this paper appeared at the ICML 2026 HiLD Workshop (July 10, 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为变尺寸结构化数据（集合、图）上的 size generalization 建立统计学习理论，证明样本复杂度上存在尖锐的指数分离：多项式 source decay 下，域内学习误差为 n^{-Θ(1)}（多项式样本复杂度），而跨尺寸泛化误差只按 (log n)^{-Θ(1)} 衰减，多项式域内样本复杂度变成跨尺寸的指数复杂度。改用指数型 source condition 后，跨尺寸泛化恢复 n^{-Θ(1)} 误差与多项式样本复杂度；全部保证与输入维度无关，并给出匹配的 minimax 下界。
Motivation: 已有工作说明集合与图上的模型何时能跨输入尺寸迁移，但没有刻画迁移的统计代价：size generalization 的样本复杂度及其与经典域内学习的关系基本未知，而经典统计学习理论绑定固定输入域、保证随维度恶化。
Method: 构建 size generalization 的统计学习理论框架，以 source decay 条件刻画跨尺寸泛化误差的衰减率；对比多项式与指数两类 source condition，并给出匹配的 minimax 下界证明最优性。
Result: 多项式 source decay 下域内误差 n^{-Θ(1)}、size generalization 误差仅 (log n)^{-Θ(1)}，形成指数分离；指数 source condition 下跨尺寸误差恢复 n^{-Θ(1)}。所有保证只依赖训练样本数 n、与输入维度无关（dimension-free scaling laws），并有匹配 minimax 下界。
Conclusion: 跨尺寸迁移的统计代价可以是指数级的，但通过更强的指数 source condition 可恢复多项式样本复杂度；这是首个 dimension-free 的 size generalization minimax 理论。

papers.title: Deep Learning for Atmospheric Turbulence Mitigation: A Comparison Between GANs and Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Atmospheric turbulence creates complex spatial and temporal distortions that significantly reduce image quality. This work compares two deep learning methods for turbulence reduction: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Transformer-based models. Both methods are trained and tested on the SOTIS dataset, which includes multi-frame sequences under different turbulence conditions with ground truth references. Our results show an important finding: GAN-based models perform better in severely degraded, low-quality situations, while Transformer-based models achieve better results in moderate to high-quality settings, especially in correcting geometric distortions. We also enhance the Turbulence Mitigation Transformer (TMT) by introducing a refined training strategy, an augmented input design that includes a temporally averaged frame as prior structural information, and a modified loss function that incorporates the Structural Similarity Index (SSIM). These improvements lead to consistent performance gains across various turbulence conditions. Overall, this study provides an in-depth evaluation of deep learning methods for turbulence reduction and offers practical guidance for selecting models in different imaging environments.
papers.comment: Published in the Journal of Electronic Imaging
papers.journal_ref: J. S. Carrillo and J. Gilles, "Deep learning for atmospheric turbulence mitigation: A comparison between GANs and Transformers," Journal of Electronic Imaging, 35(5), 053014 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 SOTIS 多帧大气湍流数据集上对比 GAN 与 Transformer 两类去湍流模型：GAN 在严重退化的低质量图像上更好，Transformer 在中高质量设定下更好、尤其擅长纠正几何畸变。作者改进 Turbulence Mitigation Transformer (TMT)，加入时序平均帧作为结构先验输入与含 SSIM 的损失，在多种湍流条件下取得一致性能提升，据此按成像环境选模型。
Motivation: 大气湍流造成时空几何畸变、显著降低成像质量，不同退化程度下该选 GAN 还是 Transformer 缺少同数据集上的直接对照。
Method: 在含多帧序列与 ground truth 的 SOTIS 数据集上统一训练并测试 GAN 与 Transformer 模型；对 TMT 三点改造：改进训练策略、在输入中加入时序平均帧作为结构先验、把 Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) 写进损失函数。
Result: GAN 在严重退化、低质量情形下表现更好；Transformer 在中到高质量设定下更好，尤其在纠正几何畸变上；加入先验输入与 SSIM 损失的 TMT 在多种湍流条件下取得一致性能提升。
Conclusion: 去湍流模型应按成像环境的退化程度选择：严重退化用 GAN，中高质量、几何畸变为主用改进后的 Transformer。

papers.title: Outcome-Routed Distillation and Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation provides dense supervision on the student's own samples, but its targets still come from the teacher. Verifier reinforcement learning (RL) instead uses an outcome signal, but it provides no direct constraint on capabilities outside the verifier. Combining the two is difficult for diffusion language models (dLLMs), because bidirectional denoising makes the policy likelihoods required by ratio-based RL unreliable. We develop a likelihood-free pipeline for a mixture-of-experts dLLM. Each rollout group is routed by verifier outcome. Mixed groups use ratio-free, group-centred REINFORCE. If every student rollout fails but a teacher succeeds, the model receives dense KL supervision on the student's denoising canvases. All other groups are skipped. A KL term anchored to the distilled checkpoint limits changes outside the verifier reward. The tool-calling teacher succeeds on only 18.6% of the training prompts. At 24 denoising steps, distillation exceeds the teacher by 6.77 percentage points, and routing improves the distilled checkpoint by a further 18.31 points. Routing lowers reasoning-trace accuracy by 0.71 points but raises direct-answer accuracy on the same items by 13.21 points. The anchored arm restores trace accuracy. Its tool-calling score differs by -0.16 points, with a confidence interval that includes zero, although this comparison also removes a small fallback distillation route. A domain-conditional recipe retains a 16.37-point tool-calling gain; a second seed gives 18.23 points and reproduces both preservation results, but the math result is seed-dependent. We pre-registered every arm and evaluated each comparison on paired items in a single sweep on one machine.
papers.comment: V1: camera ready version for the diffulm@neurips 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 上 verifier RL 与 on-policy 蒸馏难以结合的问题，提出按 verifier 结果路由 rollout 组的免似然 (likelihood-free) 管线：混合组用无 ratio 的 group-centred REINFORCE，全败而教师成功的组给学生去噪画布加稠密 KL 监督，再用锚定蒸馏检查点的 KL 项限制 verifier 奖励之外的漂移。24 步去噪下蒸馏超教师 6.77 个百分点，路由再提 18.31 点；路由使推理轨迹准确率降 0.71 点但同题直接作答升 13.21 点，锚定臂恢复轨迹准确率。
Motivation: on-policy 蒸馏的监督稠密但目标来自教师，verifier RL 有结果信号却无法约束 verifier 之外的能力；而 dLLM 的双向去噪使 ratio-based RL 所需的策略似然不可靠，两者难以直接组合。
Method: 面向 mixture-of-experts dLLM 的免似然管线：每个 rollout 组按 verifier 结果路由——混合成败组用无 ratio 的 group-centred REINFORCE；学生全败而教师成功时，在学生去噪画布上施加稠密 KL 蒸馏监督；其余组跳过。另加一项锚定到蒸馏检查点的 KL 项，限制 verifier 奖励之外的参数改动；每个 arm 预注册，配对题目单轮单机评测。
Result: 工具调用教师在训练 prompt 上仅 18.6% 成功。24 步去噪时蒸馏超教师 6.77 个百分点，路由在蒸馏检查点上再提 18.31 点。路由使推理轨迹准确率降 0.71 点、同题直接作答升 13.21 点；锚定臂恢复轨迹准确率，其工具调用分差 -0.16 点且置信区间含零（该对比同时移除了一条小的 fallback 蒸馏通路）。domain-conditional 配方保留 16.37 点工具调用增益，第二个 seed 为 18.23 点并复现两项保持结果，但 math 结果依赖 seed。
Conclusion: 按 verifier 结果路由蒸馏与 RL 能在 dLLM 上同时拿到稠密监督与结果信号，且锚定 KL 可把能力改动限制在 verifier 奖励范围内；代价是轨迹准确率小幅下降，math 结果随 seed 变化。

papers.title: Exploring Interpretability in Deep Learning-Based Forest Classification - Separating Similar Forest Classes using Sentinel-2 Time Series
papers.abstract_en: The ecological insurance theory posits that diverse forests are more resilient and better able to adapt to changing environmental conditions. Increasing drought and heat stress in Central Europe promotes mixed forests for maintaining ecosystem services. However, a diverse species distribution complicates remote sensing-based species mapping, as distinguishing pure from mixed species compositions at the pixel level remains challenging. We evaluated the potential of recurrent neural networks (RNNs) for tree-species classification from Sentinel-2 time series and investigated the spectral-temporal features underlying class discrimination, with particular emphasis on separating pure from mixed Norway spruce pixels. We compared RNN classification models with Random Forest (RF) and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) and used Integrated Gradients (IG) to quantify feature attributions across spectral bands and time. The best-performing RNN achieved a Macro-F1 score of 0.851 on the test data, outperforming XGBoost by 0.012 and Random Forest by 0.103. Beyond classification performance, the attribution analysis revealed distinct spectral-temporal patterns associated with the separation of pure and mixed Norway spruce pixels. Attribution values increased particularly after approximately day of year (DOY) 125, while B11 showed the strongest contribution during periods of increasing spectral divergence between the two classes. These findings show that recurrent models can provide competitive classification performance while also revealing the phenological periods and spectral regions that are most relevant for distinguishing closely related forest compositions. Combining time-series classification with explainability therefore provides additional insight into the spectral-temporal mechanisms underlying tree-species discrimination and may support more detailed mapping of mixed forest structures.

papers.title: Whose Data, Whose Benchmark? A User-Centric Framework for Auditing Evaluation Resources
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarks shape how model capabilities are measured and interpreted, yet their scores can obscure whose conventions, contexts, and judgments define successful performance. We introduce a user-centric audit framework that distinguishes users who contribute benchmark content from those whose needs evaluation results are intended to represent. The framework operationalizes seven dimensions across benchmark content, metadata, documentation, and scoring procedures. Across 16 resources, we find that American-centered conventions account for 62.4-94.4% of matched signals in 11 text benchmarks, while geographic visibility in five image-text resources is concentrated and strongly associated with national GDP share (mean Pearson r = 0.780; Spearman p = 0.778). Documentation reveals a systematic source-target gap: all 16 resources operationalize source-user context, but none operationalize target-user context. Paired scoring experiments further show that meaning-preserving answer variants reduce DROP exact-match accuracy from 100.0% to 33.3%, while TruthfulQA exhibits metric-dependent reductions in reference similarity. Our framework and documentation checklist make user assumptions auditable, clarifying what benchmark scores represent and where evaluation claims are supported.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以用户为中心的基准审计框架，区分贡献基准内容的用户与评估结果本应代表其需求的用户，并把七个维度落到内容、元数据、文档与打分流程上。对 16 个资源审计发现：11 个文本基准中美国中心惯例占匹配信号的 62.4–94.4%，五个图文资源的地理可见性与各国 GDP 份额强相关（Pearson r = 0.780，Spearman 0.778）；DROP 上保持语义的答案变体使 exact-match 从 100.0% 降到 33.3%。
Motivation: 基准分数会掩盖究竟是谁的惯例、语境与判断在定义“表现好”，而现有文档只刻画内容来源方、不刻画结果所代表的目标用户，导致评测主张的适用对象不可审计。
Method: 框架区分 source user 与 target user，把七个维度操作化到基准内容、元数据、文档与打分流程四层；在 16 个资源上做信号匹配与地理可见性统计，并配对改写答案变体做打分实验，检验 DROP 的 exact-match 与 TruthfulQA 的参考相似度指标。
Result: 11 个文本基准中美国中心惯例占匹配信号的 62.4–94.4%；五个图文资源的地理可见性集中且与国家 GDP 份额强相关（mean Pearson r = 0.780，Spearman 0.778）。16 个资源全部落实 source-user 语境、无一落实 target-user 语境。配对打分实验中，保持语义的答案变体使 DROP exact-match 从 100.0% 降至 33.3%，TruthfulQA 则出现随指标而异的参考相似度下降。
Conclusion: 基准分数所代表的对象取决于文档中写明的用户假设，而这些假设当前系统性偏向内容来源方；用该框架与文档清单可把假设变成可审计项，从而明确评测主张在哪里有支撑。

papers.title: MemeTrace: A Multimodal LLM-Based Agent for Safety-Aware Meme Provenance Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Online memes are often carriers of unsafe content such as disinformation and propaganda. Their rapid evolution in response to news events and strong dependence on contextual information make it difficult for platforms and moderators to detect and moderate them effectively. Moreover, existing moderation studies typically classify memes as safe or unsafe based on individual images, lacking the ability to perform broader provenance analysis, i.e., where a meme originates, how it spreads, what cultural symbolism it represents, whether it poses potential risks to society, etc. To bridge this gap, we introduce MemeTrace, a multimodal LLM-based agent that automatically traces the provenance and potential risks of emerging memes. We evaluate MemeTrace on Meme100, a dataset of 100 real-world memes, using both human annotation and automatic metrics. The results demonstrate that MemeTrace substantially outperforms the VLM baseline. More importantly, MemeTrace achieves higher accuracy in detecting unsafe memes, especially those involving disinformation and sensitive content, and remains robust under visual perturbations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MemeTrace：基于多模态 LLM 的智能体，自动追溯网络迷因 (meme) 的来源、传播路径、文化象征与社会风险，而非只判断单图安全与否。在 Meme100（100 条真实迷因）上以人工标注与自动指标评测，结果显著优于 VLM 基线，在虚假信息与敏感内容类不安全迷因上检出准确率更高，且在视觉扰动下保持稳健。
Motivation: 迷因随新闻事件快速演化且高度依赖上下文，平台与审核员难以有效检测；现有审核研究多基于单张图片做安全/不安全二分类，缺少来源与风险的溯源分析 (provenance analysis)。
Method: 构建多模态 LLM 智能体 MemeTrace，自动追踪新兴迷因的来源、传播、文化象征与潜在社会风险；在 Meme100 上用人工标注与自动指标两种方式评测，并测试视觉扰动下的稳健性。
Result: 在 Meme100（100 条真实世界迷因）上，MemeTrace 显著优于 VLM 基线；在不安全迷因（尤其涉及虚假信息与敏感内容）上检出准确率更高，并在视觉扰动下保持稳健。
Conclusion: 迷因审核应从单图二分类转向结合上下文的溯源与风险分析，多模态 LLM 智能体在该任务上比通用 VLM 更有效且更抗视觉扰动。

papers.title: LAMP: 3D Source-Aware Lighting Estimation at Multiple Points
papers.abstract_en: Existing illumination estimation methods primarily recover lighting distributions for rendering, but typically leave the contributions of individual physical light sources at specific scene locations implicit. We address this gap by leveraging the scene understanding capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) to connect local illumination with its physical sources. We introduce LAMP, a framework for point-conditioned, source-aware illumination reasoning from a single RGB image with marked query points. LAMP constructs a shared inventory of active light sources, ranks contributing sources for each query, and predicts their 3D query-to-source directions. We supervise these relationships using procedurally controlled indoor scenes, reusing independently rendered source responses to derive contribution targets across lighting configurations and obtaining exact directions from source and query positions. On the Infinigen test set, fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B increases dominant-source 3D PCK@0.5m from 0% to 70.6%, with 94.5% of directions within 12.5 degrees of ground truth among correctly localized sources. Combined with a lightweight network predicting dense RGB irradiance, LAMP achieves probe-rendering quality comparable to prior lighting-estimation methods while additionally localizing individual physical sources in 3D and explicitly attributing local illumination to them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LAMP 让视觉-语言模型从单张 RGB 图和标记查询点出发，先建立场景活跃光源清单，再为每个查询点排序贡献光源并预测查询到光源的 3D 方向，从而把局部照明显式归因到具体物理光源。在 Infinigen 测试集上微调 Qwen3-VL-8B 后，主导光源 3D PCK@0.5m 从 0% 升到 70.6%，正确定位的光源中 94.5% 的方向误差在 12.5 度以内。
Motivation: 现有光照估计方法主要恢复用于渲染的光照分布，把各物理光源在具体场景位置上的贡献留作隐式量，无法回答某点的照明来自哪个光源。
Method: LAMP 以带查询点的单张 RGB 图为输入，用 VLM 构建共享活跃光源清单、为每个查询排序贡献源并预测 3D 查询到源方向；监督信号来自程序化控制的室内场景，复用独立渲染的各源响应得到不同光照配置下的贡献目标，并由光源与查询位置取得精确方向；再接一个轻量网络预测稠密 RGB 辐照度。
Result: 在 Infinigen 测试集上，微调 Qwen3-VL-8B 使主导光源 3D PCK@0.5m 从 0% 提升到 70.6%；在正确定位的光源中，94.5% 的方向落在真值 12.5 度以内。结合稠密 RGB 辐照度网络后，探针渲染质量与已有光照估计方法相当。
Conclusion: 把局部照明显式归因到具体物理光源是可行的：VLM 加程序化渲染监督既能定位光源又不牺牲渲染质量，同时给出可解释的点级照明来源。

papers.title: Beyond Maliciousness: Static and Runtime Attack-Surface Profiling of Agent Skills
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills are Markdown documents that a tool-using agent reads as instructions and then acts on with the privileges of the session that loaded them. Installing one grants authority (the standing to direct the agent, not new privilege), and the size of that grant is what we measure. We present a two-phase attack-surface profiling methodology that combines whole-bundle static analysis and dependency provenance checking with instrumented sandbox execution and separate model-based assessment of the resulting traces. We apply the methodology to 6,309 listings from two marketplaces, selecting listings for execution without conditioning that decision on a prior threat or risk signal. Half the corpus carries evidence of shell-execution capability; the corresponding shares are 35% for filesystem read, 31% each for filesystem write and network egress, and 13% for credential access; seven listings in ten carry at least one elevated capability. That is the surface a user accepts at install time, and almost none of it is visible then. A permission model exists but is close to inert. Authors may list the tools a skill pre-approves in its own frontmatter, which removes confirmation prompts rather than restricting what the skill can reach; of the 6,061 listings whose frontmatter parses, 770 declare anything at all, the vocabulary cannot express credential or environment access, and nothing checks what it does express against the bundle. Declaring is also not declaring accurately: 59% of declaring listings understate what their bundle can do. ClawHub declares roughly twice as often as skillsmp, yet under-declares on 88% of its declarations against 31%. Triage at the marketplace boundary therefore cannot rest on what a listing declares. It must rest on what the bundle can do. These results position capability-oriented attack-surface profiling as a necessary complement to maliciousness detection.
papers.comment: This paper has 13 pages, 9 figures, and 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两阶段 agent skill 攻击面画像方法：整包静态分析加依赖来源检查，配合插桩沙箱执行与独立的基于模型的轨迹评估，在 6,309 个市场上架条目上测量安装时被授予的能力。约 70% 条目至少携带一项提权能力，而 6,061 个 frontmatter 可解析的条目中仅 770 个做出声明、声明者中 59% 低报，因此市场上架边界的风险分诊必须依据包实际能做什么，而非作者声明了什么。
Motivation: Agent skill 以 Markdown 指令形式被工具型 agent 读取并以会话权限执行，安装即授予指挥权；但现有权限模型近乎失效，安装时用户看不到所接受的能力面，仅靠恶意性检测无法覆盖。
Method: 两阶段画像：整包静态分析加依赖来源检查 (dependency provenance checking)，再用插桩沙箱执行 (instrumented sandbox execution) 采集轨迹，并由独立的基于模型的评估解读这些轨迹；执行条目的选取不以先验威胁或风险信号为条件，语料来自两个 marketplace 共 6,309 个条目。
Result: 半数条目带 shell 执行能力证据，文件系统读为 35%，文件系统写与网络外发各 31%，凭据访问 13%，七个条目中有十个至少携带一项提权能力。6,061 个 frontmatter 可解析条目中仅 770 个声明任何内容，声明条目中 59% 低报其包的实际能力；ClawHub 的声明率约为 skillsmp 的两倍，但其声明中 88% 低报，skillsmp 为 31%。
Conclusion: 面向能力的攻击面画像必须作为恶意性检测的必要补充：市场上架边界的分诊不能建立在条目声明之上，只能建立在包实际能做什么之上。

summary_sections.motivation: Agent skill 以 Markdown 指令形式被工具型 agent 读取并以会话权限执行，安装即授予指挥权；但现有权限模型近乎失效，安装时用户看不到所接受的能力面，仅靠恶意性检测无法覆盖。
summary_sections.method: 两阶段画像：整包静态分析加依赖来源检查 (dependency provenance checking)，再用插桩沙箱执行 (instrumented sandbox execution) 采集轨迹，并由独立的基于模型的评估解读这些轨迹；执行条目的选取不以先验威胁或风险信号为条件，语料来自两个 marketplace 共 6,309 个条目。

papers.title: MIND: Instruction-Conditioned Incremental Grounding for Robots
papers.abstract_en: Robots following persistent language instructions must decide which cached room judgments remain valid as their environment changes. We present MIND (Maintenance via INstruction-conditioned Dependencies), a framework for maintaining target-room decisions without re-evaluating every room after each event. A language model compiles each instruction into dependencies for semantic qualification and target selection. The controller intersects semantic dependencies with event footprints, refreshes affected judgments, and updates reachability and selection separately. For fixed deterministic evaluation, planning, and selection, conservative dependency and footprint coverage preserves the decisions of full recomputation. On 240 five-event ProcTHOR sequences with an exact benchmark predicate, MIND reduces mean semantic evaluations from 30.6 to 11.2 while preserving all 1,200 post-event decisions. Frozen-evaluator experiments with Phi-4 and Qwen3-14B also preserve all 1,200 decisions, without improving the evaluators' underlying task accuracy. In 32 closed-loop AI2-THOR episodes using exact-predicate qualification and metadata-derived footprints, MIND matches the final target decision of full recomputation in every episode. Unitree G1 experiments demonstrate target reuse and reselection across room transitions without additional semantic evaluations under MIND, and abstention after a barrier and an object removal at 4 evaluations against 15 to 18. Additional materials are available at https://mind-icra27.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIND 把语言指令编译成语义资格与目标选择的依赖，事件发生后只重算被事件足迹覆盖的房间判断，而非全量重评。在 240 条 ProcTHOR 五事件序列上，平均语义评估从 30.6 降到 11.2，且 1,200 个事件后决策全部保持不变。
Motivation: 机器人在变化环境中执行持久语言指令时，每次事件后全量重评所有房间代价高，而缓存判断可能失效，需要在不牺牲决策一致性的前提下减少重复语义评估。
Method: MIND（Maintenance via INstruction-conditioned Dependencies）用语言模型把指令编译为语义资格与目标选择依赖；控制器将依赖与事件足迹求交，只刷新受影响判断，并把可达性更新与目标选择分开处理。评测覆盖 ProcTHOR 五事件序列、冻结的 Phi-4 与 Qwen3-14B 评估器、AI2-THOR 闭环以及 Unitree G1 实机。
Result: 在 240 条 ProcTHOR 五事件序列上，平均语义评估由 30.6 降至 11.2，全部 1,200 个事件后决策与全量重算一致；冻结 Phi-4 与 Qwen3-14B 评估器下同样保持 1,200 个决策不变，但不提升评估器本身的任务准确率。32 个 AI2-THOR 闭环 episode 中最终目标决策与全量重算逐一致；Unitree G1 实机在房间切换中复用与重选目标且不增加语义评估，遇障碍与物体移除时以 4 次评估完成弃权（对照 15–18 次）。
Conclusion: 在固定确定性评估、规划与选择下，保守的依赖与足迹覆盖可保持全量重算的决策，从而把语义评估成本压到约三分之一而不改变行为；该保证不提升底层评估器的准确率。
