papers.title: Long-horizon Video Generation with Slot Memory Addressed By Region Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Memory for long-horizon video generation must satisfy two competing requirements: it must remain bounded so generation can continue indefinitely, while still recovering what was observed at a place when the camera returns, regardless of how long ago it was seen. Reconstruction-based memories provide spatial recall by caching and reprojecting explicit geometry, but require growing storage and depend on estimated 3D structure. Recurrent memories keep a constant-size state, but retention is governed by temporal recurrence, causing old observations to fade with time. We introduce SMART, a slot memory addressed by region tokens, which combines bounded storage with spatially addressed recall. SMART stores content in a constant-size slot recurrence whose writes are addressed by the observing camera and whose reads are queried by the rendering camera, without constructing an explicit 3D representation or maintaining a growing cache. Consequently, recall is conditioned on inter-view geometry rather than on recency. Each read additionally provides a confidence estimate that conditions a chunk-causal diffusion transformer, allowing it to selectively trust retrieved content while relying on its generative prior elsewhere. On long trajectories in Memory Maze and Minecraft, SMART maintains high-fidelity recall far beyond its training horizon while using constant memory and per-step cost.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://eren-cetin.github.io/SMART/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SMART 用区域 token 寻址的 slot 记忆做长时程视频生成：写入由观测相机寻址、读取由渲染相机查询，召回由视角间几何而非时间近因决定，从而在恒定内存下保持远超训练时程的高保真回忆。
Motivation: 长时程视频生成的记忆要在有界存储与空间召回之间取舍：重建式记忆靠缓存显式几何但存储不断增长且依赖估计的 3D 结构，循环记忆内存恒定却让旧观测随时间衰减。
Method: SMART 将内容存入恒定大小的 slot recurrence，写入由观测相机寻址、读取由渲染相机查询，不构建显式 3D 表示也不维护增长缓存；每次读取附带置信度，用来条件化 chunk-causal diffusion transformer，使其选择性信任检索内容、其余依赖生成先验。
Result: 在 Memory Maze 与 Minecraft 的长轨迹上，SMART 在远超训练时程的范围内保持高保真召回，同时使用恒定内存与恒定每步开销。
Conclusion: 把记忆召回绑定到视角间几何而非时间近因，可以在不增长存储的前提下让长时程视频生成在相机返回旧地点时恢复当初观测到的内容。

papers.title: Beyond Time Induction: Structured Conditional Neural Solvers for Parametric Stochastic-Volatility Pricing
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks provide a flexible framework for learning parametric PDE solution families without labeled data, yet preserving accurate derivatives across heterogeneous regimes remains challenging. Structured neural solvers offer compact representations, but restrictive conditional parameterizations can limit adaptation across the solution family. We introduce BeTINN, a structured conditional architecture extending time-induced modulation through multi-directional time-parameter conditioning and a joint residual pathway. We evaluate BeTINN on the Heston stochastic-volatility PDE, a demanding parametric problem with mixed derivatives and economically relevant first- and second-order sensitivities. BeTINN improves joint accuracy across normalized option value and key sensitivity metrics relative to our baselines. Controlled ablations characterize the roles of its architectural components. We further find that validation physics loss is informative but does not fully determine differential fidelity, and that accurate solution values can coexist with localized derivative errors. These results support structured conditional adaptation and motivate derivative-aware evaluation when sensitivities are downstream quantities of interest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 BeTINN：在结构化神经求解器上把时间诱导调制扩展为时间-参数多向条件化并加入联合残差通路，用于无标签学习 Heston 随机波动 PDE 的参数化解族。相对作者基线，BeTINN 同时改善期权价值归一化值与一阶、二阶敏感度 (Greeks) 的联合精度；消融显示验证物理损失虽有信息量但不能完全决定微分保真度，解值准确可与局部导数误差并存。作者据此主张对下游为敏感度的任务采用导数感知的评估。
Motivation: PINN 学参数化解族时跨异质 regime 保持导数精度困难，而结构化求解器的条件参数化过严，限制其在整个解族上的适应能力。
Method: 提出结构化条件架构 BeTINN：在 time-induced modulation 基础上引入时间-参数多向条件化 (multi-directional time-parameter conditioning) 与联合残差通路 (joint residual pathway)，在 Heston 随机波动 PDE 上无标签训练，并做受控消融分离各组件作用。
Result: 在 Heston PDE（含混合导数、经济上相关的一阶与二阶敏感度）上，BeTINN 相对作者基线改善归一化期权价值与关键敏感度指标的联合精度；消融刻画各组件贡献；验证物理损失有信息量但不完全决定微分保真度，解值准确可与局部导数误差共存。
Conclusion: 结构化条件适应有效，且当下游关注敏感度时必须做导数感知评估，不能只看物理损失或解值误差。

papers.title: Multi-Sensitive Distributional Fairness: Joint Wasserstein Audits and Shapley Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Fairness audits with several sensitive attributes are often performed one coordinate at a time. This can miss purely intersectional disparities: a score may be independent of each sensitive coordinate while depending on their joint profile. We study distributional demographic parity for a real-valued score using one-dimensional Wasserstein geometry. We distinguish two complementary constructions. Conditional and sequential audits characterize joint parity through their zero sets, but their positive values do not generally decompose a fixed joint Wasserstein disparity. By contrast, full-cell conditional quantile functions define a Hilbert-valued random variable whose variance is the joint disparity. Conditional expectations of this quantile process induce a monotone information game: every reveal order yields an exact martingale decomposition of the same joint disparity, while Shapley values provide an order-free attribution across sensitive attributes. Under independent sensitive attributes, the game reduces to a Hoeffding-ANOVA decomposition and Shapley splits each interaction energy equally among its members; under dependence, orthogonality is lost and explicit formulas reveal suppression and redundancy effects that marginal audits can hide. We give fixed-grid estimators and permutation calibration, and illustrate the framework on synthetic examples and ACSIncome. The resulting framework separates three questions that are often conflated: whether joint distributional parity holds, how a fixed joint disparity decomposes along an information path, and how that disparity can be attributed across sensitive coordinates without privileging an ordering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多敏感属性公平审计逐坐标做会漏掉纯交集差异：分数可与每个属性独立却依赖其联合分布。论文用一维 Wasserstein 几何定义联合分布人口均等，把 full-cell 条件分位数函数变成 Hilbert 值随机变量，其方差即联合差异；任意揭示顺序给出同一差异的精确鞅分解，Shapley 值提供与顺序无关的属性归因。属性独立时退化为 Hoeffding-ANOVA 分解且交互能量均分，相关时出现边际审计会掩盖的抑制与冗余效应。
Motivation: 多敏感属性公平审计通常一次只看一个坐标，会漏掉纯交集 (intersectional) 差异：分数与每个属性都独立，却依赖联合画像。
Method: 以一维 Wasserstein 几何刻画实值分数的分布人口均等；用 full-cell 条件分位数函数构造 Hilbert 值随机变量，其方差为联合差异；对分位数过程取条件期望构成单调信息博弈，任意揭示顺序给出精确鞅分解，Shapley 值做无顺序归因；配固定网格估计量与置换校准 (permutation calibration)。
Result: 属性独立时信息博弈退化为 Hoeffding-ANOVA 分解，Shapley 把每项交互能量均分给成员；属性相关时正交性丢失，显式公式给出抑制 (suppression) 与冗余 (redundancy) 效应，边际审计会隐藏它们。框架在合成例子与 ACSIncome 上说明。
Conclusion: 联合分布公平、沿信息路径分解固定联合差异、以及跨敏感坐标无偏序归因是三个应分开回答的问题，Wasserstein-信息博弈-Shapley 这一套可以同时给出三者。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Copy-Paste Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Transformers are intuitively considered to be efficient at copying from their inputs. We actually show that the ability of LLMs to copy in context can be improved through explicit modeling. We propose Copy-Paste Language Models (CPLMs), which add a lightweight Copy-Paste head to the conventional language modeling (LM) head. CPLMs improve training efficiency, downstream performance, and offer new operating points in long-context and retrieval setups. We validate our approach by pretraining models from 135M to 1.7B parameters, showing improvements across all scales and backbones with negligible training and inference overheads. We explain the success of CPLMs by showing that they partially mitigate the LM head gradient bottleneck through an alternative gradient path.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Copy-Paste Language Models (CPLMs) 在常规 LM head 之外加一个轻量 Copy-Paste head，显式建模上下文内复制能力，从而提升训练效率与下游表现，并在长上下文和检索场景给出新的工作点。135M 到 1.7B 参数的预训练在所有规模和骨干上均有改进，训练与推理开销可忽略；作者把收益归因于该头提供了替代梯度通路，部分缓解 LM head 的梯度瓶颈。
Motivation: Transformer 直觉上擅长从输入复制，但 LLM 的上下文内复制能力仍可通过显式建模提升；常规 LM head 存在梯度瓶颈，制约训练效率与长上下文/检索表现。
Method: 在标准语言建模 (LM) head 旁并联一个轻量 Copy-Paste head，构成 CPLM；从 135M 到 1.7B 参数规模、跨多种骨干做预训练验证，并给出梯度通路分析解释收益来源。
Result: 在 135M 至 1.7B 全部规模与所有骨干上，CPLM 在训练效率、下游性能以及长上下文与检索设定上均带来改进，训练和推理开销可忽略；机制上部分缓解 LM head 的梯度瓶颈（经替代梯度通路）。
Conclusion: 显式建模复制是提升 LLM 训练效率与下游表现的低成本手段，其收益来自绕开 LM head 梯度瓶颈的替代梯度通路，且可跨规模与骨干复用。

papers.title: Refined Topology-Pass Scheduling: Damped Trust-Region Compensation for Dynamic k-NN Graphs in SE(3)-Equivariant Structure Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Equivariant structure-prediction pipelines alternate coordinate updates with the construction of a k-nearest-neighbour (kNN) graph whose membership is a discrete, piecewise-constant function of the coordinates. Rebuilding that graph at every block boundary (PB) is the expensive part of an epoch, whereas reusing one frozen graph (F) is fast but leaves a topology gap. We study a two-pass design in which the cheap pass records a small amount of state (margins, kNN radii, measured per-boundary displacements) and a second pass compensates conservatively. We formulate the choice of the graph-construction basis as a damped fixed-point iteration whose unique fixed point is exactly PB, and derive (i) exact non-flip certificates with the two-sided constant $m_i/4$ and one-sided constant $m_i/2$, (ii) the minimum-variance (BLUE) replay gain $γ^*$ and the resulting feasibility crossover, (iii) an $\ell_\infty$ trust-region projection that preserves convergence, and (iv) an analytic near-tie spacing law $E[m] \approx r_k/(3k)$ that matches measurements to 1\%. Three compensation levels are implemented in C++ (L1: frozen set with live geometry; L2: margin-gated local repair; L3: damped, projected basis) and validated under a matched-conditions protocol (identical seed, MSA depth and trajectory family, only the topology mode differs). L2 reproduces the PB edge set exactly ($D = 0.0000$ at every boundary), L1 stays within 0.6% and L3 interpolates monotonically: L2 reproduces the PB edge set exactly when the trust region is removed, and L3 interpolates between the frozen and the PB topology. The recorded trajectory itself yields a measured $1.5\times$ Pass-1 and $1.76\times$ epoch speed-up with no measurable loss gap. An open-source implementation of the runtime and of all the experiments reported here is available at https://github.com/AlbertHuang96/ProteinPredictMachineLearning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 等变结构预测中每层边界重建 kNN 图开销最大，本文用两遍设计：第一遍记录 margin、kNN 半径与逐边界位移，第二遍做保守补偿，把图构造基写成不动点恰为全重建 (PB) 的阻尼迭代。L2 在每个边界以 D=0.0000 精确复现 PB 边集，L1 偏差 0.6% 以内，L3 单调插值；实测轨迹带来 Pass-1 1.5×、整轮 1.76× 加速且无可测损失差距。
Motivation: kNN 图成员是坐标的分段常数函数：每块边界重建 (PB) 占一个 epoch 的主要开销，冻结一张图 (F) 快但留下 topology gap，需要在速度与拓扑一致性之间给出可证书化的折中。
Method: 两遍设计：Pass-1 记录 margins、kNN 半径与实测逐边界位移，Pass-2 补偿；把图构造基的选择写成阻尼不动点迭代（唯一不动点即 PB），导出两侧 m_i/4 与单侧 m_i/2 的不翻转证书、最小方差 (BLUE) 重放增益 γ* 与可行性交叉点、保收敛的 ℓ∞ 信任域投影，以及近平局间距律 E[m]≈r_k/(3k)。C++ 实现三级补偿：L1 冻结集+活动几何，L2 margin 门控局部修复，L3 阻尼投影基；在相同 seed、MSA 深度与轨迹族的 matched-conditions 协议下只改拓扑模式。
Result: L2 在每个边界精确复现 PB 边集（D=0.0000），去掉信任域后同样精确复现；L1 保持在 0.6% 以内；L3 在冻结与 PB 拓扑之间单调插值。近平局间距律 E[m]≈r_k/(3k) 与实测吻合到 1%。记录轨迹本身给出 Pass-1 1.5×、epoch 1.76× 加速，且无可测损失差距 (no measurable loss gap)。
Conclusion: 把拓扑重建写成阻尼不动点并用 margin 证书约束，可以在不损失预测质量的前提下跳过逐边界重建；L2（margin 门控局部修复）是精确复现 PB 边集的推荐档位，L3 提供冻结与全重建之间的连续可调插值。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FinGREAT: Evaluating LLMs on Financial Graph-guided Retrieval And Typing
papers.abstract_en: Financial disclosures express the underlying relationships of double-entry accounting through unstructured text. While financial LLM benchmarks predominantly emphasize question answering and classification, schema-guided evidence discovery remains relatively under-explored. We investigate whether open-weight LLMs can extract and classify evidence corresponding to predefined double-entry accounting relationships underlying the text. Using a financial accounting graph comprising 11 nodes (accounts) and 11 edges (transaction types), we evaluate mid-sized models from 5 open-weight families across 1,300 SEC 10-K Item 7 filings spanning 26 years, comparing their extraction performance against three proprietary models. Results reveal substantial differences in extraction volume, edge distributions, and cross-model agreement. Building on this study, we introduce a human-annotated relation classification benchmark comprising 483 passages across three financial accounting categories, evaluating 34 open-weight and 10 proprietary models. The strongest open-weight and proprietary models achieve 84.1\% and 92.8\% accuracy, respectively, with considerable variation across accounting categories. Our findings highlight the importance of evaluating evidence discovery and relation understanding separately, while investigating locally deployable models for scalable, privacy-sensitive financial analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FinGREAT 用 11 节点（账户）/11 边（交易类型）的复式记账关系图，评测开源 LLM 从 SEC 10-K Item 7 文本中抽取并分类财务证据的能力。在 1,300 份跨 26 年的 10-K 报告上，5 个开源模型家族与 3 个闭源模型的抽取量、边分布和跨模型一致性差异显著；在 483 段人工标注的关系分类基准上，最强开源与闭源模型准确率分别为 84.1% 与 92.8%。
Motivation: 财务 LLM 基准多集中在问答与分类，schema 引导的证据发现（schema-guided evidence discovery）几乎未被系统评测，而复式记账的底层关系只存在于非结构化文本中。
Method: 构建 11 节点 11 边的财务会计关系图，从 26 年跨度的 1,300 份 SEC 10-K Item 7 报告中评测 5 个开源模型家族的中等规模模型，并与 3 个闭源模型对比抽取表现；随后构建 483 段人工标注、覆盖三类会计类别的关系分类基准，评测 34 个开源与 10 个闭源模型。
Result: 抽取阶段各模型在抽取量、边分布和跨模型一致性上差异明显；关系分类基准上最强开源模型准确率 84.1%，最强闭源模型 92.8%，且不同会计类别间表现差异较大。
Conclusion: 证据发现与关系理解应分开评测；开源模型已接近但尚未追平闭源模型，本地可部署的开源模型适合隐私敏感的规模化财务分析。

papers.title: LLMs program using Reusable and Composable Abstract Representations
papers.abstract_en: When writing code, the same computation can be expressed in different programming languages and through different implementation strategies. We show that the activations of LLMs capture this shared structure in reusable and composable abstract representations when they generate code. These representations emerge in the middle layers, are reusable across programming languages, and afford the model an impressive amount of generalization ability when generating code under various interventions. Using activation steering, we show that function, programming language, and implementation strategy can be independently manipulated. The independent interventions on language and function can be flexibly composed to control code generation, even in cases when the prompt contains no information about language and function. We additionally find that finetuning on examples of arbitrarily defined functions in one programming language transfers to other languages, consistent with the models reusing abstract features of code generation that are shared across different examples. Finally, to study how such abstract representations come to be, we implement a minimal model of shared, reusable, and composable structure in a synthetic setting, and show that transformers trained on such data learn representations that reuse these parts flexibly across contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明 LLM 生成代码时在中间层形成可复用、可组合的抽象表示：函数、编程语言、实现策略三者可被 activation steering 独立操控并自由组合，即使 prompt 不含语言与函数信息也能控制代码生成；单语言任意函数微调可迁移到其他语言。合成最小模型中，transformer 学到跨上下文灵活复用这些部件的表示。
Motivation: 同一计算可用不同语言与实现策略表达，但 LLM 是否在内部表征这种共享结构、以及能否被独立干预，此前缺少证据。
Method: 对 LLM 代码生成的激活做 activation steering，分别操控函数、编程语言、实现策略并组合干预（含 prompt 不含语言/函数信息的情形）；在一种编程语言上对任意定义的函数做微调并测试跨语言迁移；另实现一个合成设定下的最小共享-可复用-可组合结构模型，训练 transformer 检验表示如何形成。
Result: 抽象表示出现在中间层，跨编程语言可复用；对语言与函数的独立干预可灵活组合以控制代码生成，即使 prompt 未提供语言与函数信息；单语言任意函数微调迁移到其他语言；合成数据上训练的 transformer 学到跨上下文灵活复用部件的表示。
Conclusion: LLM 代码生成依赖跨语言共享、可独立操控且可组合的抽象特征，微调迁移与合成最小模型都与这一复用机制一致。

papers.title: From Detection To Anticipation: Continuous Onset Forecasting For Stuttered Speech
papers.abstract_en: Automatic stuttering systems primarily detect dysfluencies after they have occurred, limiting their use for anticipatory intervention. We address this gap by formulating stuttering prediction as continuous causal time-to-event forecasting, where a model estimates the risk of an upcoming stuttering onset every 100 ms using only preceding speech. To support this task, we augment FluencyBank Timestamped for 36 speakers with manually reviewed repetitions, prolongations, and blocks, yielding 2,872 forecasting events. We then model the temporal evolution of frozen Whisper-large-v3 speech representations using a compact causal Conformer with 3.67M trainable parameters. The proposed approach achieves an AUROC of 0.63. Temporal analysis further shows that explicitly modeling preceding speech states outperforms simply increasing the static acoustic window, while a discrete-time survival formulation provides coherent forecasts from 300 ms to 1.5 s using a single model. These results provide initial evidence that stuttering onset is preceded by measurable temporal information in speech and establish a framework for future anticipatory stuttering systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把口吃预测重构为连续因果 time-to-event 预报：每 100 ms 用仅含此前语音的特征估计即将出现口吃起始的风险。在人工复核扩充的 FluencyBank Timestamped（36 位说话人、2,872 个事件）上，冻结 Whisper-large-v3 表征 + 紧凑因果 Conformer（3.67M 可训练参数）取得 AUROC 0.63；显式建模前序语音状态优于单纯加长静态声学窗口，离散时间生存形式用单一模型给出 300 ms 至 1.5 s 的连贯预报。
Motivation: 现有自动口吃系统只能在 dysfluency 已发生后检测，无法支撑 anticipatory intervention；缺少用过去语音连续估计未来起始风险的预报式建模。
Method: 将口吃预测表述为连续因果 time-to-event 预报，每 100 ms 输出风险，仅使用先前语音；对 FluencyBank Timestamped 的 36 位说话人补充人工复核的 repetitions、prolongations、blocks，得到 2,872 个预报事件；模型为冻结 Whisper-large-v3 表征上的紧凑因果 Conformer（3.67M 可训练参数），并比较显式时序状态建模与加长静态声学窗口，另给出离散时间生存 (discrete-time survival) 形式。
Result: AUROC 0.63；显式建模前序语音状态优于单纯增大静态声学窗口；离散时间生存形式用单一模型在 300 ms 到 1.5 s 之间给出连贯预报；数据规模为 36 位说话人、2,872 个 forecasting events，模型 3.67M 可训练参数，风险每 100 ms 更新。
Conclusion: 口吃起始之前存在可测量的语音时序信息，连续因果预报可作为 anticipatory stuttering 系统的框架；AUROC 0.63 属初步证据，作者将其定位为未来研究的起点。

summary_sections.result: AUROC 0.63；显式建模前序语音状态优于单纯增大静态声学窗口；离散时间生存形式用单一模型在 300 ms 到 1.5 s 之间给出连贯预报；数据规模为 36 位说话人、2,872 个 forecasting events，模型 3.67M 可训练参数，风险每 100 ms 更新。
summary_sections.conclusion: 口吃起始之前存在可测量的语音时序信息，连续因果预报可作为 anticipatory stuttering 系统的框架；AUROC 0.63 属初步证据，作者将其定位为未来研究的起点。

papers.title: Write Once, Plan Many: Building Reusable Visual Planning Systems from One Scene
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can reason about visual planning tasks, but querying them for every instance incurs repeated inference cost and latency. Generating reusable planning programs offers an alternative, but constructing reliable planning systems for new problem domains without extensive supervision remains challenging. We present a training-free framework that constructs reusable perception and planning programs from a domain specification and a single practice scene without a paired solution. The central challenge is obtaining useful feedback from the limited input. Our framework addresses it by leveraging VLM's ability to provide a renderer and a dynamic model based on its scene understanding. Rendering detected states enables comparison with the practice scene, while checking simulated action outcomes against the domain specification helps expose errors in rule implementation. Together, these checks guide refinement of the grounding program and planner without requiring solution labels. After refinement and component selection, the programs are frozen and solve new instances without further VLM calls. The same framework constructs systems across domains without manual pipeline redesign. Across fifteen domain variants spanning 2D and 3D scenes with discrete and continuous state, our systems achieve 99.3% average planning success, compared with 80.9% for the strongest domain-level program-generation baseline and 90.7% for the strongest instance-level baseline. Cost analyses show a favorable success-cost trade-off, and ablations confirm the contributions of the executable domain model, execution feedback, and component selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免训练的视觉规划程序合成框架：从领域规格加单个练习场景（无配对解）出发，用 VLM 生成渲染器与动态模型，通过渲染结果与练习场景比对、模拟动作结果与领域规格核对来迭代修正 grounding 程序与 planner，随后冻结程序、零 VLM 调用求解新实例。在横跨 2D/3D、离散与连续状态的 15 个领域变体上平均规划成功率 99.3%，高于最强的领域级程序生成基线 80.9% 与最强的实例级基线 90.7%。
Motivation: 对每个实例反复调用 VLM 做视觉规划带来重复推理开销与延迟；而为新问题域构建可靠的可复用规划系统又缺少大量监督，配对解标注成本高。
Method: 免训练框架：由领域规格与单个练习场景（无配对解）让 VLM 生成感知 grounding 程序与规划程序，并让 VLM 提供渲染器和动态模型；把检测状态渲染后与练习场景比对，再把模拟的动作结果与领域规格核对以暴露规则实现错误，用这两类执行反馈迭代精化程序并做组件选择，最后冻结程序求解新实例，全程不再调用 VLM。
Result: 在 15 个领域变体（覆盖 2D 与 3D 场景、离散与连续状态）上平均规划成功率 99.3%，对比最强领域级程序生成基线 80.9%、最强实例级基线 90.7%；成本分析显示成功率-成本权衡有利，消融确认可执行领域模型、执行反馈与组件选择各自有贡献。
Conclusion: 单个练习场景加执行反馈就足以合成跨领域可复用的感知与规划程序，程序冻结后求解新实例无需再调用 VLM，同一框架无需手工重设计流程即可迁移到多个领域。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Spectral-MoE: Heterogeneous Per-Layer Expert Utilization in Dense-to-MoE Conversion
papers.abstract_en: Large language models impose substantial memory demands and arithmetic costs during inference. Dense-to-mixture-of-experts (MoE) conversion is a model optimization technique that aims to reduce these arithmetic costs. Dense-to-MoE conversion partitions pretrained feed-forward network (FFN) neurons into experts and selects a subset for each token. Leading methods fall into two categories: analytic methods produce a converted model quickly using heuristics, while learning methods produce a model much more slowly by optimizing via gradients. Both approaches, however, fix the same active expert count, or "utilization," at every layer. We introduce Spectral-MoE, which learns to allocate a utilization budget heterogeneously across layers. Its name draws a metaphor between separating a dense FFN into experts and separating a light beam into its spectrum. Spectral-MoE consists of two distinct approaches: a static approach that uses a single per-layer scalar which is shared across tokens, and a dynamic approach which emits a per-token schedule. We demonstrate that both allocators improve performance over uniform on both the analytic-based and learning-based SOTA dense-to-MoE methods. At 25% FFN utilization, dynamic allocation reduces WikiText-2 perplexity relative to uniform by 1.04, 2.96, and 2.71 points on the learned base for Llama-2-7B, Llama-3-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B, respectively. The corresponding reductions on the analytic base are 2.45, 6.26, and 2.17 points. On the learned base, dynamic allocation improves six-task mean accuracy over uniform by an average of 1.5, 4.2, and 3.6 percentage points across the three models at FFN utilizations of 12.5%, 25%, and 50%, respectively. These results establish per-layer expert utilization as a novel optimization axis in dense-to-MoE conversion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Spectral-MoE 在 dense-to-MoE 转换中不再给每层固定同一激活专家数，而是学习逐层异质的 utilization 预算：静态版用每层一个标量，动态版输出逐 token 调度。在 25% FFN 利用率下，动态分配相对 uniform 使 Llama-2-7B、Llama-3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B 的 WikiText-2 perplexity 在 learned base 上分别降 1.04、2.96、2.71 点，在 analytic base 上降 2.45、6.26、2.17 点。
Motivation: 现有 dense-to-MoE 转换方法（analytic 启发式与 gradient 学习式）都在所有层固定同一个激活专家数，忽略了不同层对算力的需求差异，而 LLM 推理的显存与算术开销正需要在固定预算内重新分配。
Method: Spectral-MoE 提出两种 allocator：静态版为每层学一个跨 token 共享的标量，动态版为每个 token 输出逐层 utilization 调度；两者分别嫁接到 analytic-based 与 learning-based 的 SOTA dense-to-MoE 转换方法上，在固定 FFN 利用率预算下分配激活专家数。
Result: 25% FFN 利用率下，dynamic 相对 uniform 的 WikiText-2 perplexity 降幅在 learned base 上为 Llama-2-7B 1.04、Llama-3-8B 2.96、Qwen2.5-7B 2.71 点，在 analytic base 上为 2.45、6.26、2.17 点；learned base 上六任务平均准确率提升在 12.5%、25%、50% 利用率下分别平均 1.5、4.2、3.6 个百分点（三个模型）。
Conclusion: 逐层异质的专家利用率是 dense-to-MoE 转换中一条有效的新增优化轴，静态与动态两种分配器在 analytic 与 learning 两类基座上都优于 uniform 分配。

papers.title: Do Syntax Heads Influence Model Behavior?
papers.abstract_en: Transformer language models develop attention heads that specialize in syntactic relations, for example, attending from verbs to their subjects. Do these heads play a causal role in the model's syntactic predictions? Evidence for such a role is mixed to negative: even when we force these heads to attend to a distractor noun other than the subject, the model's syntactic predictions are still more consistent with the subject than with the distractor. Interventions on specialized syntax heads had a significantly stronger effect on syntactic predictions than interventions on random heads, but only in one of the two measures we propose.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 检验 Transformer 语言模型中句法专用注意力头 (syntax heads) 是否对句法预测起因果作用：强制这些头改注意干扰名词而非主语后，模型的句法预测仍更贴合主语；对专用头做干预在两个度量之一上显著强于随机头干预。
Motivation: 句法头的因果作用证据混杂甚至偏负：若专用头真是句法预测的因果中介，改其注意对象应把预测拉向干扰项。
Method: 对句法专用头施加干预（强制注意干扰名词），并与随机头干预对比，用两个自提的度量衡量句法预测的变化。
Result: 强制注意干扰名词后，句法预测仍比干扰名词更贴合主语；专用头干预在两个度量之一上显著强于随机头干预。
Conclusion: 句法头对句法预测的因果作用至多是弱且度量依赖的，模型在这些头被干预后仍能维持基于主语的预测。

papers.title: Agentic Self-Awareness: Aligning Knowing, Acting, and Holding
papers.abstract_en: Frontier AI agents increasingly act in environments where seemingly solvable tasks may lack prerequisites, contain conflicting requirements, or reveal blockers only during execution. We formulate agentic self-awareness (ASA) as the alignment of task-grounded feasibility judgments (know), warranted behavior (act), and responses to reconsideration (hold), distinguishing what a task permits from what an agent can solve. We build paired feasible and blocked tasks in Terminal-Bench 2.1 and retail $τ^2$-bench and introduce an authorship-aware M0-M3 rubric that separates recognizing a blocker from taking the certified deferral action for the correct reason. Separate probes assess stated feasibility beliefs and responses to a single challenge. In a Terminal-Bench protocol baseline, blocker recognition reaches 84.4%, but strict self-awareness (SA) reaches only 40.6%. Harness search without model-weight updates increases strict SA from 45.3% to 93.8% on reused Terminal-Bench search tasks; selection for abstention alone, however, can reduce success on feasible tasks. Independently initialized joint-objective searches improve both blocked-task SA and feasible-task solve on their own search sets. Retail held-out gains remain limited, and Terminal-Bench blocked-task transfer is not measured. This evaluation pipeline makes the recognition-action gap measurable and sets a two-sided target for improving agent decisions under changing task evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 agent 自我认知 (agentic self-awareness) 定义为 know（任务可行性判断）、act（合规行为）、hold（被质疑时的保留响应）三者对齐，并用 M0–M3 rubric 把「认出 blocker」与「为正确理由执行 certified deferral」分开度量。Terminal-Bench 协议基线下 blocker 识别达 84.4%，但严格 SA 仅 40.6%；不更新模型权重的 harness search 把严格 SA 从 45.3% 提到 93.8%，而只按弃答筛选会降低可行任务成功率。
Motivation: 前沿 agent 面对的任务可能缺前置条件、要求互相冲突或执行中才暴露 blocker，现有评测只看能否解题，不区分任务本身不可行与 agent 能力不足，识别与行动之间的落差无法度量。
Method: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 与 retail τ²-bench 上构造配对的 feasible/blocked 任务，提出 authorship-aware 的 M0–M3 rubric 区分识别 blocker 与为正确理由执行 certified deferral；另设独立 probe 分别测可行性陈述与单次质疑响应，并比较协议基线、harness search（不更新权重）、按弃答筛选、独立初始化的 joint-objective search 等搜索策略。
Result: Terminal-Bench 协议基线下 blocker recognition 84.4%，严格 SA 40.6%；harness search 不更新模型权重即把 reused Terminal-Bench search 任务的严格 SA 从 45.3% 提到 93.8%；仅按 abstention 筛选会降低 feasible 任务成功率；独立初始化的 joint-objective search 在各自 search 集上同时提升 blocked-task SA 与 feasible-task solve；retail held-out 增益有限，Terminal-Bench blocked-task transfer 未测。
Conclusion: 识别与行动之间存在可量化的落差，搜索式 harness 能在不改权重的情况下大幅补齐严格 SA，但只优化弃答会牺牲可行任务表现，改进 agent 决策需要同时设定识别与行动的双侧目标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Definition Grounding in Theory-Level Auto-formalization
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based auto-formalization systems can now generate formally verified Lean code at unprecedented rates. However, a formalization advances mathematical research only when further mathematical results can be built on it, especially when its definitions and helper lemmas are general enough to be imported and used idiomatically. We propose definition grounding, where definition formalizations are continuously judged and revised, as a method to ensure formalization quality. We find that agents formalizing definitions from textbook text often produce definitions that later statements cannot use, and only 25%-50% of their definition sets are compatible with all later statements. However, clarifying the informal definitions can improve this rate up to 77.5% averaged over all models. Furthermore, stating a small set of basic properties without proving them can improve model judges' capability to detect definitions with compatibility issues, at only about 11% of the definition formalization cost. These results are verified with ReuseBench, a benchmark we curated for formalizing new mathematical fields and theories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 definition grounding：对 LLM 自动生成的定义形式化持续做判定与修订，使后续命题能直接复用。仅 25%–50% 的定义集与全部后续命题兼容；澄清非形式化定义可把该比率提到各模型平均 77.5%，再附上少量基本性质（不证明）能把检测兼容性问题的判定成本压到约 11%。
Motivation: LLM 已能高速产出通过验证的 Lean 代码，但只有当定义与辅助引理足够通用、可被惯用导入时，形式化才真正推进数学研究；而现有 agent 产出的定义常无法被后续命题使用。
Method: definition grounding 方法对定义形式化进行持续判定与修订；配合自建基准 ReuseBench（面向形式化新的数学领域与理论），并测试在给出少量未证明的基本性质后模型判定器识别兼容性问题的能力。
Result: agent 从教科书文本形式化定义时，仅 25%–50% 的定义集与全部后续命题兼容；澄清非形式化定义可将该比率提升至各模型平均 77.5%；陈述一小组基本性质（不加证明）可提升模型判定器检测兼容性问题的能力，成本约为定义形式化成本的 11%。结果在 ReuseBench 上验证。

papers.title: REPORT-OPS: Hybrid Evidence-Guided Reporting with Human-Supervised Refinement for HPC
papers.abstract_en: Operational reporting for high-performance computing (HPC) facilities requires combining information from monitoring services, schedulers, incident and maintenance records, storage measurements, periodic reports, and operator investigations. Producing a reliable report requires more than retrieving relevant records: the evidence must refer to the correct system, metric definition, time period, and source of authority. We present REPORT-OPS, a hybrid reporting agent in which an LLM interprets requests, plans evidence collection, evaluates possible explanations, and drafts reports, while author-seeded operational policies and automated checks determine whether the available evidence supports the requested conclusion. Depending on the evidence state, the system answers the request, reports a qualified conclusion, or withholds an unsupported claim. During offline refinement, an LLM critic proposes bounded policy changes that a human approves or rejects without editing; accepted candidates are promoted only after automated target, held-out, and regression testing. We evaluate REPORT-OPS on 68 sanitized reporting queries constructed from 50 base scenarios in a frozen HPC operational corpus, using three agent models and two LLM judges. REPORT-OPS achieves 68.63% Pass@80, compared with 7.02% for the strongest retrieval baseline. Evidence gating increases claim-support precision from 40.58% to 90.06%. On the 13-query explanatory subset, explanation accuracy reaches 55.54%. Across five rounds of human-supervised refinement, localized policy updates correct 91.17% of targeted failures and improve performance on related held-out cases by 9.33 percentage points, with no observed regression breaks under release gating. These results demonstrate improved evidence-grounded reporting and within-environment policy reuse; they do not establish unrestricted causal discovery or cross-facility generalization.
papers.comment: Konate and Akewar contributed equally to this work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REPORT-OPS 是面向 HPC 运维报告的混合证据引导 agent：LLM 负责理解请求、规划取证与起草，作者种子策略与自动检查把关证据是否支撑结论，证据不足时给出限定结论或拒绝断言。在冻结 HPC 语料的 68 条脱敏查询上 Pass@80 达 68.63%（最强检索基线 7.02%），证据门控把 claim-support 精度从 40.58% 提到 90.06%。
Motivation: HPC 运维报告要跨监控、调度、事件与存储记录核对系统、指标定义、时间窗与权威来源，单纯检索相关记录不足以保证结论有证据支撑。
Method: LLM 解释请求、规划证据收集、评估候选解释并起草报告；作者种子的运维策略与自动检查决定证据是否支撑结论，按证据状态选择作答、限定结论或拒答。离线精化阶段由 LLM critic 提出有界的策略改动，人工批准或否决，候选仅在通过 target、held-out 与回归测试后晋升。
Result: 在冻结 HPC 运维语料构造的 68 条脱敏查询（源自 50 个基础场景）、3 个 agent 模型与 2 个 LLM judge 上：Pass@80 为 68.63%，最强检索基线 7.02%；证据门控使 claim-support 精度从 40.58% 升至 90.06%；13 条解释性子集的解释准确率 55.54%；五轮人工监督精化中局部策略更新纠正 91.17% 的目标失败，相关 held-out 案例提升 9.33 个百分点，发布门控下无回归破坏。
Conclusion: 证据门控加人工批准的策略复用能在同一环境内显著提升证据支撑的报告可靠性，但结果不支持无限制因果发现或跨设施泛化。

papers.title: Riding the Fixed-Point Curve: Image Classification in the Continuous Thought Machine
papers.abstract_en: The Continuous Thought Machine (CTM) is a recurrent network that attends to inputs and makes predictions based on the synchronization between its neurons. On tasks spanning many domains, it displays emergent thought processes that have not been explained. We report a number of findings about how the CTM classifies images, focusing on ImageNet. Each thinking step is an attracting but strongly non-normal map exhibiting balanced amplification (Murphy and Miller, 2009); while attraction is already present at CTM initialization, training highly promotes non-normality. By Banach's theorem, the neural state has a locally unique attracting fixed point, which moves at every step, and the thought trajectory is the curve these fixed points trace, followed one tick behind. Most of that curve's motion is shared across images, and visible as a previously reported traveling wave of activity across neurons. The attention schedule along the thought is largely generic: shuffling queries across images at every tick costs only 7 percent of classification accuracy, while image-independent increments predict the next query with R^2 = 0.98 (held out). Our results suggest that the CTM has found a single strategy to process all ImageNet images.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps), extended abstract track (non-archival)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Continuous Thought Machine (CTM) 在 ImageNet 上的图像分类机制做固定点分析：每个思考步都是吸引但强非正规 (non-normal) 的映射，训练显著提升非正规性；由 Banach 定理神经态在每步有局部唯一吸引不动点，思维轨迹即这些不动点连成的曲线并滞后一拍跟随。跨图像打乱 query 每步只损失 7% 分类精度，图像无关增量对下一 query 的 held-out R²=0.98，说明 CTM 对所有 ImageNet 图像共用一套通用处理策略。
Motivation: CTM 在多领域任务上涌现出尚未被解释的思维过程，其图像分类的内部机制——注意力调度是否依赖具体图像、思维轨迹如何组织——缺少可检验的解释。
Method: 以 ImageNet 分类为对象，把每个思考步刻画为吸引且强非正规的映射 (balanced amplification, Murphy and Miller 2009)，用 Banach 定理定位每步局部唯一吸引不动点，并把思维轨迹解释为不动点曲线；通过跨图像打乱 query、以及用图像无关增量预测下一 query 的消融来检验注意力调度的通用性。
Result: 吸引性在 CTM 初始化时已存在，训练高度促进非正规性；曲线运动大部分跨图像共享，表现为已报道的神经活动行波；每 tick 跨图像打乱 query 仅损失 7% 分类精度，图像无关增量预测下一 query 的 held-out R²=0.98。
Conclusion: CTM 已找到一套处理所有 ImageNet 图像的单一策略：思维轨迹由逐步移动的吸引不动点刻画，注意力调度基本与输入图像无关。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Gradient-Regularized Deep Learning Method for Restoring Image in Myopic Vision
papers.abstract_en: Myopic vision degrades the quality of human vision due to spherical eye defocus aberrations that impair the perception of fine spatial details. To address this limitation, this work proposes a deep learning-based approach to computationally design transformed images that allow individuals with myopia in fixed distance to perceive scenes with enhanced clarity. The method trains a neural network to counteract defocus aberrations modeled using the second-order Zernike polynomial $Z_2^0$. The approach employs a U-Net architecture trained with a loss function combining reconstruction error minimization with spatial difference structural preservation through $\ell_1$ regularization. Training is carried out exclusively on the KITTI dataset, while testing is performed on DIV2K and ImageNet datasets, demonstrating generalization across diverse image distributions. Under myopic conditions modeled by $Z_2^0$, baseline performance shows visual degradation with PSNR values ranging from 19.47 to 27.42 dB across datasets and severity levels. The proposed gradient-regularized method achieves consistent improvements, delivering PSNR gains ranging from 1.48 to 7.34 dB and significantly lower perceptual compared to classical baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 U-Net 直接生成预补偿图像来抵消近视离焦像差：以二阶 Zernike 多项式 Z_2^0 建模离焦，训练网络输出让近视眼看到更清晰的变换图。在 KITTI 训练、DIV2K 与 ImageNet 测试下，Z_2^0 离焦基线 PSNR 为 19.47–27.42 dB，梯度正则方法带来 1.48–7.34 dB 的 PSNR 提升。
Motivation: 近视者的球面离焦像差损害细空间细节感知，需要在固定距离观看时用计算方式预补偿，而不是依赖光学矫正。
Method: 训练神经网络反演 Z_2^0 离焦像差，架构为 U-Net，损失为重建误差加空间差分结构保持的 ℓ1 正则（gradient-regularized）；仅在 KITTI 上训练，测试用 DIV2K 与 ImageNet。
Result: Z_2^0 离焦条件下基线 PSNR 在各数据集与严重度上为 19.47–27.42 dB；所提梯度正则方法 PSNR 提升 1.48–7.34 dB，并相对经典基线显著降低感知失真。
Conclusion: 把离焦建模进损失的预补偿变换可在跨数据集分布上稳定提高近视条件下的图像质量，训练分布之外仍成立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Collaborative Neural Networks significantly Improve Global Aerosol Retrievals From Multi-Angle Polarimeters
papers.abstract_en: We present the RemoTAP-Hybrid algorithm for global aerosol products retrieved from Multi-Angle Polarimeters (MAP), and apply it to one-year aerosol retrievals from the SPEXone MAP instrument. For the first time, Multiple Collaborated Neural Networks (MCNN) are used to perform global aerosol MAP retrievals over land and ocean. The combined use of MCNN with a full physics inversion in RemoTAP-Hybrid, significantly improves accuracy and computational speed of SPEXone aerosol retrievals. We validate the retrieved Aerosol Optical Depth (AOD), Angstrom Exponent (AE), Single Scattering Albedo (SSA), Absorption AOD (AAOD), Fine mode AOD (FAOD), Coarse mode AOD (CAOD), and fine mode effective radius (reff_fine) with AERONET data. The validation suggests that aerosol retrievals can be further improved when extending the aerosol description to include a fine non-spherical mode. For AOD, the Root-Mean-Square Error (RMSE) is 0.051 (0.037) over land (ocean), while 78.3% (80.8%) of the retrievals are within the requirement formulated by the Global Climate Observing System (GCOS). The RMSE is 0.186 (0.207) for AE, 0.038 (0.044) for SSA, 0.023 (0.014) for AAOD, 0.047 (0.031) for FAOD, 0.043 (0.027) for CAOD, and 0.021 (0.026) for reff_fine over land (ocean). Compared to the current RemoTAP algorithm, RemoTAP-Hybrid shows improved agreement with AERONET for AOD, AE, and FAOD over land and ocean while the number of valid retrievals is increased by 4% (3%) over land (ocean) and the computational time is reduced by 43% (32%). Finally, we present the first global seasonal maps of aerosol optical and microphysical properties and chemical composition from SPEXone.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 RemoTAP-Hybrid：用多个协作神经网络 (MCNN) 与全物理反演结合，对 SPEXone 多角度偏振仪 (MAP) 做全球陆海气溶胶反演。与 AERONET 对比，AOD 的 RMSE 为 0.051（陆）/0.037（海），78.3%（80.8%）满足 GCOS 要求；相比原 RemoTAP，有效反演数增加 4%（3%），计算时间减少 43%（32%）。

Method: RemoTAP-Hybrid 将 MCNN 与全物理反演 (full physics inversion) 结合，用于陆海全球气溶胶 MAP 反演；对 SPEXone 一年数据反演，并用 AERONET 验证 AOD、AE、SSA、AAOD、FAOD、CAOD 与 reff_fine。

papers.title: Narrowing the Collaboration Gap, Probably
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed as teams of agents that hold different private information about a shared task. How should such agents concisely communicate in a way that promotes aggregation of decision-relevant information? Communicating only proposed actions can discard decision-relevant uncertainty: two agents may prefer the same action for different reasons. We study an alternative interface in which agents communicate calibrated beliefs over actions. We first analyze a simple synthetic setting that captures the structure of multi-round reasoning under partial information. In this setting, we show theoretically and empirically that communicating unbiased probabilities can be strictly more powerful than communicating actions. We then test the same principle in a collaborative maze-solving task with trained transformers and pretrained LLM agents. Our results demonstrate that probability communication outperforms action communication when the exchanged predictions preserve calibrated uncertainty. When communicated probabilities are biased, we show that the benefits of probability communication can disappear. We give a post-hoc conversational calibration intervention that consistently improves decision-making by correcting these biases both in a toy transformer setting and when pretrained LLMs use the corrections in context. These results suggest that probabilistic communication is useful for multi-agent collaboration not merely because it transmits more information, but because calibrated uncertainty gives other agents a reliable object to update on.

Motivation: 多智能体共享任务中只通信动作会丢弃决策相关的不确定性：两个智能体可能因不同理由偏好同一动作，接收方无法据此更新。
Method: 对比两种接口——通信动作 vs 通信对动作的校准概率信念；先在刻画多轮部分信息推理结构的合成设置中做理论与实证分析，再在协作迷宫任务中用训练的 transformer 与预训练 LLM 智能体测试，并提出事后对话式校准干预来纠正通信概率的偏差。
Result: 合成设置中理论上与实证上证明无偏概率通信可严格强于动作通信；迷宫任务中当交换的预测保持校准不确定性时概率通信优于动作通信，概率有偏时收益消失；校准干预在 toy transformer 设置与预训练 LLM 的上下文使用中均一致改善决策。
Conclusion: 概率通信对多智能体协作有用的原因不只是传输更多信息，而是校准的不确定性给其他智能体提供了可靠的更新对象；通信概率的偏差会抵消这一收益，需显式校准。

papers.title: PREFER: From Player Experience to Personalized Game Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how large language models (LLMs) evaluate gameplay experience is important for using their feedback to guide game design. However, overall ratings alone provide limited insight into which aspects of experience are associated with these judgments and how they can inform concrete game changes. We introduce PREFER, a framework that uses a shared set of experience dimensions adapted from established psychometric questionnaires to benchmark how models evaluate gameplay and to guide persona-specific game refinement. Through these dimensions, we characterize the perspectives models offer as virtual playtesters by examining how their overall assessments relate to specific aspects of experience and to the gameplay they produce. To examine how the same dimensions can guide refinement for players with different preferences, we use personas to simulate distinct player profiles. For each persona, PREFER uses experience-preference relationships to select refinement objectives, revises game rules and their implementations, and playtests candidate games to assess experience changes and predicted preference gains. Experiments with five personas show that PREFER achieves 9.2% higher mean post-play preference ratings than the strongest evaluated baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PREFER 用心理测量问卷改编的共享体验维度，让 LLM 作为虚拟测试者评估游戏体验，并按 persona 的体验-偏好关系选择改进目标、改写游戏规则与实现、再回放测试候选游戏。五个 persona 上平均游玩后偏好评分比最强评估基线高 9.2%。
Motivation: LLM 给出的整体游戏评分无法说明是哪些体验维度驱动了判断，也无法直接转成针对不同偏好玩家的具体改法。
Method: 框架 PREFER：以既有心理测量问卷改编的体验维度为共同标尺，先刻画模型整体评价与各体验维度、以及与所生成玩法的关联；再用 persona 模拟不同玩家画像，按体验-偏好关系挑选改进目标，修改游戏规则及其代码实现，并 playtest 候选游戏以评估体验变化与预测的偏好增益。
Result: 在五个 persona 上，PREFER 的平均游玩后偏好评分比最强评估基线高 9.2%。
Conclusion: 把体验维度、persona 与规则级改写串成闭环，可以让 LLM 反馈落到针对特定玩家偏好的具体游戏改动上。

papers.title: Decoupled Drift-Diffusion World Models for Consistent Future Frame Prediction
papers.abstract_en: World models of visual information predict future image frames conditioned on given action sequences. This predicted scene evolution is driven by deterministic changes such as controlled motion on a robot platform, as well as stochastic changes such as rendering of manipulated objects or previously occluded regions. Our key insight is that the spatial location of these stochastic changes is itself learnable. We leverage this insight by jointly regressing both the deterministic next-state prediction and the spatial uncertainty map, then using the uncertainty map to guide a conditional diffusion process. We propose Decoupled Drift-Diffusion World Model (D3WM), which uses a transformer trained with a Gaussian negative-log-likelihood objective to produce both the deterministic next-state prediction and a spatial map of heteroscedastic aleatoric uncertainty. The learned uncertainty map then provides a structured spatial gate for a conditional diffusion model: deterministic regions are anchored to the predicted state, while uncertain regions, such as disocclusions or dynamic textures, are sampled by the diffusion process. We frame this decomposition under a variance-gated stochastic differential equation that separates deterministic drift from stochastic diffusion. D3WM shows improved results over competitive baselines in two distinct types of action spaces: robotic tabletop manipulation and camera motion.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 18 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://anton-arapin.github.io/d3wm-site
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出解耦漂移-扩散世界模型 (D3WM)：用带高斯 NLL 损失的 Transformer 同时回归确定性下一帧与异方差 aleatoric 空间不确定性图，再以该图作为空间门控，确定性区域锚定到预测状态、遮挡解除与动态纹理等不确定区域交给条件扩散采样，并在方差门控 SDE 框架下分离确定性漂移与随机扩散。在机器人桌面操作与相机运动两类动作空间上均优于竞争基线。
Motivation: 视觉世界模型的未来帧既含可控运动等确定性变化，也含被操纵物体渲染、新显露区域等随机变化；随机变化出现的空间位置本身可学习，但把两者混在一个生成过程中会损失一致性。
Method: D3WM 用 Transformer 以高斯负对数似然 (Gaussian NLL) 联合回归确定性下一状态与异方差 aleatoric 不确定性空间图；该图作为空间门控输入条件扩散模型，确定性区域锚定、不确定区域采样；整体用方差门控随机微分方程 (variance-gated SDE) 框架表述，分离 drift 与 diffusion。
Result: 在机器人桌面操作与相机运动两种动作空间上，D3WM 相对竞争基线取得改进结果（摘要未列具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把随机变化的空间位置当作可学习量并用不确定性图门控扩散，可以在未来帧预测中同时保住确定性运动的一致性与随机区域的合理生成。

papers.title: Generalizing Identifiability Results in Causal Discovery from Complete Data to Missing Data Settings
papers.abstract_en: While causal discovery methods have matured for complete data, such algorithms for handling missing values remain limited. We establish general sufficient conditions under which causal graphs remain identifiable (i.e., uniquely determined from the available data distribution) under various missingness categories, including Missing Not At Random, and provide a framework to extend correctness guarantees from causal discovery algorithms for complete data to missing data settings. Our results show that identifiability of causal graphs with no unobserved confounders is preserved when (1) missingness mechanisms do not causally interact, (2) no variable directly causes its own missingness, and (3) either faithfulness holds for missingness mechanisms, or they follow generalized linear models. Guided by these theoretical results, we introduce two asymptotically correct algorithms for Additive Noise Models (ANMs) that recover the underlying causal graph and provide consistent parameter estimates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在缺失数据（含 MNAR）下给出因果图可识别的充分条件：缺失机制之间无因果交互、没有变量直接导致自身缺失，且缺失机制满足 faithfulness 或服从广义线性模型时，无未观测混杂的因果图仍可唯一识别。据此提出两个针对加性噪声模型 (ANM) 的渐近正确算法，可恢复真实因果图并给出一致参数估计。
Motivation: 因果发现方法在完整数据上已较成熟，但处理缺失值的算法仍然有限，缺失数据下因果图的可识别性缺少一般性条件。
Method: 先建立不同缺失类别（含 Missing Not At Random）下因果图保持可识别的一般充分条件，形成把完整数据因果发现算法的正确性保证推广到缺失数据设定的框架；再据此构造两个针对加性噪声模型 (ANM) 的算法。
Result: 给出三条充分条件下的可识别性结论：缺失机制无因果交互、无变量直接导致自身缺失、且缺失机制满足 faithfulness 或服从广义线性模型时，无未观测混杂的因果图可识别；两个 ANM 算法被证明渐近正确，可恢复底层因果图并给出一致参数估计。
Conclusion: 缺失数据下的因果图识别可以在明确的缺失机制条件下继承完整数据算法的正确性保证，ANM 场景可据此得到渐近正确的恢复与参数估计。

papers.title: Titan-Llama: Retrofitting Pre-trained LLMs with External Neural Memory Modules
papers.abstract_en: Transformers are efficient to pre-train at scale because attention permits parallel computation across sequence positions, but long-context inference requires increasingly large KV caches. Efficient recurrent alternatives reduce the asymptotic complexity of inference, but their sequential dependence limits token-wise parallelism during training, making them harder to scale. Further, the current paradigm of extending long context tasks creates competing notions of retaining information precisely and keeping long-context inference efficient. To address this gap, we introduce Titan-Llama, a post-training method for retrofitting attention-based language models with a hierarchical memory architecture that updates parameters at test-time. Titan-Llama applies a blockwise attention mask and preserves full-fidelity attention over recent tokens while compressing historical context into recurrent, fixed-size neural memory modules (NMMs). Our formulation allows pre-trained attention layers to be replaced without training a new language model from scratch. On Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, Titan-Llama raises accuracy over segmented attention windows from 23.87\% to 40.51\% on QuALITY and from 14.50\% to 40.75\% on LongHealth. Inference benchmarks show more than 20\% faster prefill, 37\% faster decode at medium context lengths, and 24\% lower steady-state decode memory usage in the evaluated configurations. Together, these results demonstrate that incorporating memory architecture mechanisms that utilize test-time training effectively modulates long-context behavior of pre-trained models, offering a practical route to adapting pre-trained transformers for efficient long-context inference. Our code is released on Github \href{https://github.com/sarahpannn/titans-pytorch/tree/main}{GitHub}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Titan-Llama 是一种后训练方法，用分层记忆架构改造预训练注意力 LLM：近期 token 保留全保真注意力，历史上下文压缩进固定大小的循环神经记忆模块 (NMMs)，并在测试时更新参数。在 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 上，QuALITY 准确率从 23.87% 提到 40.51%，LongHealth 从 14.50% 提到 40.75%，同时中等上下文解码快 37%、稳态解码内存降 24%。
Motivation: Transformer 预训练可并行但长上下文推理的 KV cache 越来越大；循环替代方案降低推理复杂度却因序列依赖难以并行训练。精确保留信息与高效长上下文推理之间存在竞争，需要不重训语言模型的改造路径。
Method: 后训练改造注意力 LLM：施加 blockwise attention mask，近期 token 用全保真注意力，历史上下文压缩进循环、固定大小的神经记忆模块 (NMMs)，参数在测试时更新；预训练注意力层可直接替换而无需从头训练新模型。
Result: 在 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 上，相对分段注意力窗口基线，QuALITY 准确率 23.87% → 40.51%，LongHealth 14.50% → 40.75%；推理基准显示 prefill 加速超过 20%，中等上下文长度 decode 加速 37%，稳态 decode 内存占用降低 24%。
Conclusion: 在预训练 Transformer 中加入利用测试时训练的记忆架构机制，能有效调制长上下文行为，为高效长上下文推理提供一条不必重训模型的实用路径。

papers.title: Finite-sample certification of coverage regret for budgeted document selection under adaptive stratified auditing
papers.abstract_en: Selecting a budget-constrained set of documentary fragments, for instance the knowledge base of a retrieval-augmented generation system, raises a statistical question: how much expected query coverage is lost relative to the best feasible selection when the query distribution is unknown? We construct finite-sample, distribution-free upper confidence bounds for this coverage regret that remain valid after data-dependent selection. A pilot stage may select the document set, screen competitors, build comparison networks and learn an annotation policy. Then an independent audit acquires relevance labels with probabilities that are constant within observable strata. The main result is a simultaneous bound for all retained coverage contrasts. The bound is made observable by empirical-Bernstein variance calibration or by a one-stage construction without calibration, and it accounts for estimated stratum proportions. For maximum-type coverage we prove variance contractions for swaps of redundant fragments, give a condition under which multiscale radii improve on a direct union bound, and show that such redundancy cannot be certified from samples alone. A simulation study confirms validity and quantifies the gains from variance calibration and certified redundancy.

TL;DR: 在预算约束下从文档片段集合中挑选 RAG 知识库时，若查询分布未知，本文构造在数据依赖选择之后仍有效的、分布无关的有限样本上置信界，用于认证覆盖 regret（相对最优可行选择的期望查询覆盖损失）。独立审计阶段在可观测分层内以恒定概率采集相关性标签，主结果是对所有保留覆盖对比的联合界；模拟研究确认了界的有效性，并量化了方差校准与认证冗余带来的收益。
Motivation: 预算受限的文档集选择在查询分布未知时缺少可认证的覆盖损失界，且常规置信界在数据依赖选择后失效。
Method: 两阶段流程：pilot 阶段选择文档集、筛选竞争者、构建比较网络并学习标注策略；独立审计阶段在可观测分层内以恒定概率采集相关性标签。界由 empirical-Bernstein 方差校准或无校准的一阶段构造给出，并计入估计的分层比例；对 maximum-type 覆盖证明冗余片段交换的方差收缩，给出多尺度半径优于直接 union bound 的条件。
Result: 主结果是对所有保留覆盖对比的同时界，在数据依赖选择后仍有效；证明了冗余片段交换的方差收缩、多尺度半径优于直接 union bound 的条件，以及仅凭样本无法认证该冗余；模拟研究确认有效性并量化方差校准与认证冗余的收益。
Conclusion: 覆盖 regret 可在分布无关、选择后有效的框架下被有限样本认证，但冗余带来的收益必须借助校准或额外结构才能从样本中认证。

papers.title: Into the LidarVerse: A Real-Time Unified LiDAR World Model Across Tasks and Sensors
papers.abstract_en: We present LidarVerse, a real-time unified LiDAR world model for sensor simulation across tasks and sensors. Existing LiDAR simulators largely follow one of two complementary paradigms: reconstruction-based methods preserve the geometry of a captured scene but require lengthy per-scene optimization, whereas generative methods amortize learning across data but lack the consistency needed for long-horizon rollouts. LidarVerse brings both paradigms into a single, unified conditional generative framework. A universal tokenizer maps LiDAR range sequences into a shared latent space, where a bidirectional teacher learns a common interface for conditioning on a LiDAR prefix, an HD-Map, a persistent spatial cache, and optionally, text. Varying the available scene evidence turns the same model into a generator of new worlds, a point-cloud forecaster, or a generalizable resimulator of observed scenes without per-scene optimization. We distill the teacher into a four-step autoregressive causal student and maintain both a rolling temporal K/V cache and a world-aligned spatial cache, enabling persistent long-horizon rollouts with real-time inference at 11 FPS on a single H100 GPU. LidarVerse achieves state-of-the-art performance on most reported metrics across all three evaluation protocols, while its tokenizer supports 32-, 64-, and 128-beam LiDAR and generalizes to an unseen scanning pattern. These results demonstrate that generative and reconstruction-grounded LiDAR simulation can be realized within one model, providing the core capabilities for future closed-loop sensor simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LidarVerse 把重建式与生成式 LiDAR 仿真统一到一个条件生成世界模型：通用 tokenizer 将 LiDAR range 序列映射到共享隐空间，双向 teacher 学习以 LiDAR 前缀、HD-Map、持久空间缓存（及可选文本）为条件的统一接口，改变可用场景证据即可让同一模型变成新世界生成器、点云预报器或免逐场景优化的重仿真器。teacher 被蒸馏为四步自回归 causal student，配合滚动时序 K/V 缓存与世界对齐的空间缓存，在单张 H100 上以 11 FPS 实时长时程 rollout，并在三套评测协议的多数指标上达到 SOTA，tokenizer 支持 32/64/128 线并泛化到未见过的扫描模式。
Motivation: 现有 LiDAR 仿真器分居两个极端：重建式保几何但需冗长的逐场景优化，生成式可跨数据摊销学习却缺乏长时程 rollout 所需的一致性，两者无法在同一模型内兼顾。
Method: 通用 tokenizer 把 LiDAR range 序列编码进共享隐空间；双向 teacher 在该空间学习以 LiDAR 前缀、HD-Map、持久空间缓存和可选文本为条件的统一接口。随后将 teacher 蒸馏为四步自回归 causal student，推理时同时维护滚动 temporal K/V cache 与 world-aligned spatial cache，支撑长时程连续生成。
Result: 在全部三套评测协议的多数报告指标上取得 SOTA；单张 H100 GPU 上实时推理达 11 FPS；tokenizer 覆盖 32、64、128 线 LiDAR，并泛化到训练中未见过的扫描模式 (unseen scanning pattern)。
Conclusion: 生成式与重建锚定的 LiDAR 仿真可以在单一模型内实现，其统一条件接口加双缓存长时程 rollout 构成未来闭环传感器仿真 (closed-loop sensor simulation) 的核心能力。

papers.title: Embedding Geometry Shapes LLM Routing: Tracing Failure Modes and Improving Generalization
papers.abstract_en: With the growing number of LLMs available, selecting which one to use for a prompt has become a key question. A large part of the routing literature relies on semantically embedding prompts into a vector space and then applying a lightweight classifier to the embedded representations. These methods perform robustly in-distribution but they struggle to generalize to unseen tasks. By studying the geometry of semantic embeddings, we trace a clear failure mode: features that determine the neighbors of unseen prompts are an unreliable proxy for LLM selection. We therefore replace the semantic embedding with the following map: we run a partial forward pass of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on the prompt and use the hidden state of its last token at a deep layer as the representation. When applying kNN and other simple classifiers to this new representation, we obtain a clear result in generalization: on average across cost penalties, their performance improves. Moreover, kNN and another simple classifier that we propose outperform every evaluated semantic-embedding baseline. Our two simple methods also beat a recent SoTA hidden-states based router on RouterBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 路由用语义嵌入加轻量分类器在分布内稳健但换任务就崩，作者把表征换成 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 对 prompt 做部分前向后深层末 token 的 hidden state，再套 kNN 与一个简单分类器。在 RouterBench 上该表征下的 kNN 与所提分类器平均跨 cost penalty 的表现提升，并超过全部语义嵌入基线与一个近期基于 hidden state 的 SoTA 路由器。
Motivation: 语义嵌入决定 unseen prompt 近邻的特征并不可靠，导致路由方法在未见任务上泛化差。
Method: 先分析语义嵌入几何以定位该失效模式，再用 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的部分前向传播、取深层末 token hidden state 作为表征，其上施加 kNN 与一个新提出的简单分类器。
Result: 在 RouterBench 上，新表征下的 kNN 与所提简单分类器平均跨 cost penalty 表现提升，且优于全部被评估的语义嵌入基线；两者也击败一个近期基于 hidden state 的 SoTA 路由器。
Conclusion: 语义嵌入的近邻结构是 LLM 选择的不可靠代理，改用模型自身深层 hidden state 作表征即可改善跨任务泛化。

papers.title: FireGraphNet: Sub-daily wildfire spread prediction with directed graph neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Wildfire decisions are made in hours, yet most learned spread models predict daily on targets including burned area. We propose FireGraphNet which formulates 12-hour growth as node classification on directed H3 graphs, with candidates ahead of the front and wind alignment, terrain, fuel continuity and barriers on edges. On satellite perimeters it achieves average precision 1.7-1.9x the strongest distance baseline on test California fires and 1.62x out of state. We show this skill comes from message passing rather than cell features or the aggregator, is highest on young fires in state, is carried deep along the wind by its edges, and is hidden by pooling. A convolutional network matches this ranking once trained on new growth, at worse calibration, so candidate construction, target definition, and aggregation shape conclusions about model skill. Editing fuel and barrier attributes reduces predicted spread more under guided than random placement, extending FireGraphNet to operational intervention analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FireGraphNet 把 12 小时野火蔓延增长写成有向 H3 图上的节点分类：候选单元位于火线前方，边携带风向对齐、地形、燃料连续性与阻隔物属性。在卫星火场周线上，测试期加州火灾的 average precision 达到最强距离基线的 1.7–1.9 倍，州外为 1.62 倍；消融显示技能来自消息传递而非单元特征或聚合器，且在按新增长训练后卷积网络也能追平该排序，因此候选构造、目标定义与聚合方式会左右模型技能的结论。
Motivation: 野火决策以小时为单位，但多数可学习蔓延模型按天预测、目标是过火面积，与实际决策节奏和空间粒度不匹配。
Method: 把 12 小时增长建模为有向 H3 图上的节点分类：候选节点取火线前方并结合风向对齐，边属性编码地形、燃料连续性与阻隔物；在卫星火场周线上训练与检验，并做特征、聚合器、目标定义（新增长 vs 面积）与燃料/阻隔物编辑的对照分析。
Result: 测试加州火灾上 average precision 为最强距离基线的 1.7–1.9 倍，州外为 1.62 倍；技能来自消息传递而非单元特征或聚合器，在州内年轻火上最高，并沿风向由边向深处传递，经池化后被掩盖；卷积网络在按新增长训练后可追平该排序但校准更差；按引导而非随机位置编辑燃料与阻隔物属性，预测蔓延下降更多。
Conclusion: 有向图消息传递能在 12 小时尺度上提供超越距离基线的野火蔓延技能，而候选构造、目标定义与聚合结构本身会塑造对模型技能的判断；编辑燃料与阻隔物属性的效应可用于操作性干预分析。

papers.title: Adaptive Computation with Conformal Certification
papers.abstract_en: Scientific imaging data involving medical (e.g., 3D radiographic, microscopic images) and astronomical sensors pose different challenges from natural images. One key challenge is that these datasets are often orders of magnitude larger than natural images. Efficient training and inference on such data is challenging due to the increased hardware requirements, often needing bespoke solutions. Moreover, the relevant objects such as tumors and astronomical phenomena are sparsely distributed with respect to the background information. Standard efficiency techniques like quantization and pruning apply uniform scaling of all regions, potentially compromising the precision/fidelity of predictions. Thus, efficient methods that reduce computational requirements without losing resolution for relevant parts of the data and with uncertainty estimates on predictions are essential. We present \textit{Conformal Adaptation} with risk guarantees for uncertainty-aware sparse computations. Our formalism is general, spanning dense pixel-level classification and regression tasks where hierarchical models predict at low resolution, certify the signal using conformal risk control, and refine the certified predictions. We benchmark our method on multiple tasks such as 3D medical image segmentation, 2D galaxy flux prediction, and 1D calcium spike rate prediction, achieving $2.5$--$72\times$ wall-clock speedup across the various tasks, including on commodity CPUs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Conformal Adaptation：层级模型先在低分辨率预测，用 conformal risk control 对信号做风险认证，只对通过认证的区域做高分辨率细化，从而在稀疏目标上省算力而不牺牲相关区域精度。在 3D 医学图像分割、2D 星系流量预测、1D 钙火花速率预测上取得 2.5–72× 墙钟加速，含在普通 CPU 上的运行。
Motivation: 医学与天文科学成像数据比自然图像大数个量级，目标（肿瘤、天文现象）相对背景稀疏；量化、剪枝等统一缩放的效率手段会牺牲相关区域的预测精度与保真度。
Method: 层级模型先在低分辨率做像素级分类与回归预测，用 conformal risk control 认证信号，再只对已认证的预测做细化；框架覆盖稠密像素级分类与回归任务，并给出不确定性估计与风险保证。
Result: 在 3D 医学图像分割、2D galaxy flux 预测、1D calcium spike rate 预测多项任务上实现 2.5–72× wall-clock 加速，其中包括在 commodity CPU 上的加速。
Conclusion: 把 conformal 风险认证嵌入稀疏自适应计算，可以在科学成像的分类与回归任务上同时保住相关区域精度、给出不确定性并大幅降低计算需求。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Identity, Incentives, and Cooperative Behavior for AI: Reverse-Engineering Multiagent Cooperation
papers.abstract_en: The behavior of AI systems increasingly depends on the extent to which agents cooperate or coordinate with one another, in ways that may be desirable or not depending on the situation. Conventional explanations for cooperative behavior distinguish between purely other-regarding preferences ("altruism") and instrumental reasons for self-interested agents to cooperate. The way that agents should enact these mechanisms for cooperation (or not) is complicated by the fact that there is not a clear or unambiguous locus of identity or selfhood for AI agents. For example, it is unclear whether agents involved in instances of misaligned collective behavior are motivated by goals at the level of the collective or by various forms of instrumental reasoning. We develop a framework for reverse-engineering why a given set of agents engage in a particular set of cooperation-related behaviors. We argue that many different mechanisms can often produce similar observed behaviors and introduce a set of experimental designs along with conditions under which they can successfully disentangle competing explanations for multiagent behavior. We apply this framework to interactions from a set of frontier models in a simulated environment and demonstrate that the behavior of different models arises from substantively different mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一套反向工程框架，用于判定多智能体系统中观察到的合作行为究竟来自利他偏好还是自利的工具性推理，并给出一组能区分竞争性解释的实验设计及其成立条件。在对一组 frontier 模型的模拟环境交互应用后，作者显示不同模型的相似行为实际上由实质不同的机制产生。
Motivation: AI 系统的合作行为可能合意也可能失准，但 AI agent 缺乏清晰明确的 identity/selfhood 位置，使得无法判断集体失准行为是源于集体层面的目标还是各种工具性推理。
Method: 构建反向工程多智能体合作行为的框架：提出一组实验设计及这些设计能成功区分竞争性解释的条件，用以辨别利他偏好与工具性合作这两类机制；随后将框架应用于模拟环境中一组 frontier 模型的交互。
Result: 在模拟环境中对一组 frontier 模型的交互应用该框架，表明不同模型表现出的相似合作行为实际上源自实质不同的机制。
Conclusion: 多种机制常产生相似的可观测合作行为，因此必须靠有针对性的实验设计才能区分，而不能从行为本身推断动机来源。

papers.title: Structure-aware Bayesian full waveform inversion via diffusion-regularized Stein variational gradient descent
papers.abstract_en: Full waveform inversion (FWI) is a powerful tool for high-resolution subsurface model reconstruction, but it remains highly nonlinear and ill-posed, especially when the initial model is inaccurate or the acquired data are noisy and incomplete. Annealed Stein variational gradient descent (ASVGD) provides a particle-based Bayesian framework for FWI by approximating the posterior distribution with an ensemble of velocity models, thereby enabling uncertainty quantification beyond a single deterministic solution. However, conventional ASVGD-FWI commonly relies on simple handcrafted priors, such as Gaussian or smoothing assumptions, which are often insufficient to represent complex geological structures. To address this limitation, we introduce a learned diffusion model (DM) as an implicit regularization mechanism within the ASVGD-FWI framework. Instead of explicitly evaluating the diffusion prior density, the trained diffusion model acts as a learned geological projection operator that guides updated particles toward the distribution of plausible velocity models. In this way, the proposed method combines data consistency from FWI, posterior diversity from ASVGD, and structural realism from the diffusion prior. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the diffusion-regularized ASVGD-FWI produces more geologically consistent mean models, suppresses nonphysical artifacts, and yields uncertainty estimates that are more concentrated around structurally complex and poorly constrained regions. These results suggest that learned diffusion priors can effectively enhance Bayesian FWI by improving both inversion stability and the interpretability of posterior uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把训练好的 diffusion model 作为隐式正则嵌入 annealed SVGD 的全波形反演 (FWI)，不显式计算先验密度，而是把粒子当作地质投影算子拉向合理的速度模型分布。数值实验显示该组合给出地质上更一致的均值模型、抑制非物理伪影，且不确定性估计更集中在构造复杂与约束差的区域。
Motivation: FWI 高度非线性且不适定，初模不准或数据含噪不完整时更严重；ASVGD-FWI 常用的 Gaussian 或平滑手工先验难以表达复杂地质结构。
Method: 在 ASVGD-FWI 框架内引入训练好的 diffusion model 作为隐式正则：粒子更新由 FWI 数据一致性、ASVGD 后验多样性与扩散先验的结构真实性共同驱动，扩散模型充当学习到的地质投影算子而非显式先验密度。
Result: 数值实验中，diffusion-regularized ASVGD-FWI 得到地质上更一致的均值模型，抑制非物理伪影，不确定性估计更集中于构造复杂、约束差的区域。
Conclusion: 学习到的扩散先验能同时提升 Bayesian FWI 的反演稳定性与后验不确定性的可解释性，其作用方式是把粒子投影到合理速度模型分布上。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Learning in Strategic Queuing with Geometric Recharge: From Bandits to Systems
papers.abstract_en: We study packet routing in queuing systems where queues act as selfish, myopic agents that use no-regret learning algorithms to select servers with unknown service rates. To model the small buffers used in data centers, we assume that each server has a single-packet buffer. Even such a tiny buffer already captures the features of buffering: routers can exploit multiple servers while accepted packets remain in service, but packets can occupy servers for multiple rounds, complicating future service and learning. We first analyze a single queue routing packets to $m$ buffered servers with service rates $μ_1, \dots, μ_m$. This setting is equivalent to an instance of the recharging bandits problem with geometric recharge. We prove that any no-regret learner achieves a long-run average throughput of at least the Hamacher sum of the server rates, and that this bound is tight. Consequently, a single no-regret queue is stable if and only if its arrival rate is below the Hamacher sum of the server rates. Moreover, comparing against an optimal policy, we show that any no-regret learner is at least $0.77$-competitive, which is also tight. We then study multi-queue systems where $n$ queues with arrival rates $λ_1, \dots, λ_n$, each at most $λ_{\max}$, compete for service from $m$ buffered servers. We show that the smallest overprovisioning factor that guarantees the system to be stable under high-probability no-regret learning is $\frac{1}{1-λ_{\max}}$. Equivalently, in terms of the total arrival and service rates, the condition $\sum_{i=1}^n λ_i < (1-λ_{\max})\sum_{j=1}^m μ_j$ is sufficient, and sometimes necessary, for stability under no-regret learning. In particular, for $λ_{\max} = 1/2$, this improves the upper bound of Abel et al. (EC 2026) from $3$ to $2$, matching their lower bound and resolving their open question.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把带单包缓冲的自私队列路由建模为几何再充能 (geometric recharge) 的 recharging bandits，证明任何 no-regret 学习者的长期吞吐至少等于服务器速率的 Hamacher sum 且该界紧，单队列当且仅当到达率低于该和时稳定。多队列下保证高概率 no-regret 稳定的最小超配因子为 1/(1-λ_max)；λ_max=1/2 时把 Abel et al. (EC 2026) 的上界从 3 降到 2，与其下界匹配并解决其公开问题。
Motivation: 数据中心里缓冲极小、服务速率未知，自私的 myopic 路由器用 no-regret 学习选服务器时，稳定性条件与竞争损耗缺少紧界；Abel et al. (EC 2026) 留下的超配因子上下界不一致。
Method: 把单队列对 m 个单包缓冲服务器的路由等价为几何再充能的 recharging bandits，用 no-regret 学习分析吞吐与竞争比；多队列情形分析 n 个到达率至多 λ_max 的队列竞争 m 个服务器的高概率 no-regret 稳定性。
Result: 单队列：任何 no-regret 学习者长期平均吞吐 ≥ Hamacher sum(μ_1,…,μ_m) 且界紧，稳定性当且仅当 λ 低于该和；相对最优策略竞争比至少 0.77 且该值也紧。多队列：最小超配因子为 1/(1-λ_max)，等价于 Σλ_i < (1-λ_max)Σμ_j 充分且有时必要；λ_max=1/2 时上界由 3 改进为 2，匹配 Abel et al. (EC 2026) 的下界。
Conclusion: 极小缓冲下的 no-regret 路由在单队列上可达到与最优策略 0.77 竞争的吞吐，多队列稳定所需的超配由 λ_max 精确刻画，λ_max=1/2 的公开问题由此闭合。

papers.title: Diagnosing Low-Confidence Patient Profiles via Localized Harmful Covariate Shift Detection
authors: Martin Vallières (4) ((1) Department of Computer Science
(3) Centre for Outcomes Research and Evaluation (CORE)
Research Institute of the McGill University Health Centre
papers.abstract_en: Before deploying clinical prediction models, their reliability must be assessed to ensure safe use. Errors may arise from distribution shifts between training and deployment or from heterogeneous performance where the model systematically underperforms for certain patient subgroups. Yet most post-hoc diagnostic methods evaluate reliability only at the population level, checking whether the deployment data resemble the training data and whether the model performs well on average, without accounting for heterogeneity that may cause some patients to be disproportionately affected. We propose a unified diagnostic pipeline that combines both perspectives. MED3pa first discovers interpretable low-confidence patient profiles, and Detectron is then applied within each profile to test whether its degradation is associated with a detectable harmful covariate shift. Across three clinical prediction tasks and three injected subgroup shifts in MIMIC-IV, we find that shift detectability itself is informative. An injected age shift, undetectable at the population level, was nonetheless localized to specific degraded profiles, whereas sex- and race-related shifts were detected broadly and therefore offered little guidance for identifying the most affected patients.
papers.comment: Accepted at SMASH 2026 (Symposium on Machine Learning and Applications in Healthcare). Code available at https://github.com/MEDomicsLab/study_MED3pa_SHIFT2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出临床预测模型部署前的两段式诊断管线：先用 MED3pa 发现可解释的低置信度患者画像，再在每个画像内部用 Detectron 检验性能退化是否伴随可检测的有害协变量偏移 (harmful covariate shift)。在 MIMIC-IV 的三个临床预测任务与三种注入子群偏移中，偏移本身是否可检测才是有信息量的信号：群体层面检测不到的年龄偏移仍被定位到具体退化画像，而性别与种族偏移被广泛检出，反而无法指认受影响最重的患者。
Motivation: 现有事后诊断方法只在群体层面判断部署数据是否像训练数据、平均性能是否达标，忽略了子群异质性，导致部分患者被系统性拖累却无人察觉。
Method: 统一诊断管线分两步：MED3pa 先从部署数据中挖掘可解释的低置信度患者画像，Detectron 随后在每个画像内部做有害协变量偏移检测，把性能退化与可检测偏移关联起来；实验在 MIMIC-IV 上构造三种注入的子群偏移并覆盖三个临床预测任务。
Result: 在 MIMIC-IV 三个临床预测任务、三种注入子群偏移下：注入的年龄偏移在群体层面不可检测，却仍被定位到特定退化画像；性别与种族相关偏移被广泛检出，因而对识别受影响最重的患者帮助很小。
Conclusion: 偏移的可检测性本身具有诊断价值：群体层面的检测结论会误导，画像内部的局部偏移检测才能区分哪些退化真正由偏移驱动。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Multi-System Cognitive Steering for Generative Communication
papers.abstract_en: A fundamental bottleneck for translating thoughts to speech is the high physical cost of motor input forcing a strict tradeoff between communication speed and expressivity. Generative AI offers a promising solution by expanding highly abbreviated text input into fluent sentences, significantly reducing the motor burden on the user. However, sparse inputs are inherently ambiguous; without sufficient context, AI models frequently misinterpret these abbreviations and generate outputs that fail to align with the user's true cognitive intent. We propose \textit{Cognitive Steering}, a framework that can be leveraged to reconstruct user intent by grounding Large Language Models (LLMs) in multimodal context and applying AI control methods. We demonstrate that aligning frontier models with selected environmental referents, emotional states, and communication motives on simulated abbreviation benchmarks achieves up to $\sim$88\% top-5 expansion accuracy, doubling no-context baselines. We also reveal that different types of context require distinct AI control techniques: while physical objects in a scene are best provided through explicit text prompts, abstract factors like emotion may be more effectively managed by directly altering the AI's internal activations. These findings suggest a hybrid architecture for future interfaces that leverage Cognitive Steering to help users communicate both quickly and accurately, recruiting multiple AI control methods simultaneously to perfectly capture their intended communication goals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Cognitive Steering：把 LLM 的缩写展开锚定到多模态上下文（环境指称物、情绪状态、沟通动机）并配合 AI 控制方法，重建运动受限用户的表达意图。在模拟缩写基准上 top-5 展开准确率最高约 88%，是无上下文基线的两倍；场景内物理对象用显式文本提示最好，情绪这类抽象因素则直接改内部激活更有效。
Motivation: 把想法转成语音的瓶颈是运动输入的体力代价，迫使沟通速度与表达力取舍；而缩写输入本身高度歧义，缺少上下文时 LLM 常把缩写展开成不符合用户真实意图的句子。
Method: Cognitive Steering 框架将 LLM 锚定到多模态上下文并施加 AI 控制方法：对场景中的物理对象用显式文本提示，对情绪等抽象因素直接修改模型内部激活，在模拟缩写基准上对齐前沿模型与选定的环境指称物、情绪状态、沟通动机。
Result: 在模拟缩写基准上 top-5 展开准确率最高约 88%，相对无上下文基线翻倍；并给出分类型的控制结论——物理对象走显式文本提示，抽象情绪因素改内部激活更有效。
Conclusion: 不同上下文类型需要不同的 AI 控制技术，未来接口应采用混合架构同时调用多种控制方法，让缩写展开既快又准地对齐用户沟通目标。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.result: 在模拟缩写基准上 top-5 展开准确率最高约 88%，相对无上下文基线翻倍；并给出分类型的控制结论——物理对象走显式文本提示，抽象情绪因素改内部激活更有效。
summary_sections.conclusion: 不同上下文类型需要不同的 AI 控制技术，未来接口应采用混合架构同时调用多种控制方法，让缩写展开既快又准地对齐用户沟通目标。

papers.title: Learning from Self-Generated Responses: Reliability--Uncertainty Self-Distillation for Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reference solutions and question-specific rubrics are not always available to guide the teacher in self-distillation. A large language model's own solution attempts offer an alternative, but their quality is difficult to assess in open-ended tasks without automatic correctness checks, and even correct attempts can involve uncertain token predictions. We propose Reliability--Uncertainty Self-Distillation (\method{}) to learn from these attempts. The same model serves as teacher and student: the teacher receives the question and completed attempt, and the student matches the teacher's token-level predictions using a question-only prompt. \method{} weights each attempt's distillation loss by additively combining judged reliability, estimated from a self-judge's score and confidence, with student predictive uncertainty. Across eleven reasoning benchmarks, \method{} outperforms all five baselines in average accuracy, reaching 70.47\% on Qwen3-4B and 76.69\% on Qwen3-8B (8.90 and 2.10 percentage points above the base models). Data and code are available at https://github.com/JP-25/RUSD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Reliability--Uncertainty Self-Distillation (RUSD)：在没有参考解和评分细则时，让同一模型自任师生，用自评可靠性与学生预测不确定性的加权蒸馏损失，从模型自身的解题尝试中学习。在 11 个推理基准上平均准确率超过全部五个基线，Qwen3-4B 达 70.47%、Qwen3-8B 达 76.69%，较基座模型分别高 8.90 和 2.10 个百分点。
Motivation: 自蒸馏通常依赖参考解或题目专属评分细则，而开放式任务中既缺自动正确性判据，正确尝试里也含不确定 token 预测，难以评估自身尝试的质量。
Method: 同一模型兼任师生：teacher 输入题目加完整尝试，student 只用题目 prompt 匹配 teacher 的 token 级预测；蒸馏损失按权重加和组合自评可靠性（来自 self-judge 的分数与置信度）与 student 预测不确定性，对每个尝试加权。
Result: 在 11 个推理基准上平均准确率超过全部五个基线：Qwen3-4B 达 70.47%（较基座 +8.90 个百分点），Qwen3-8B 达 76.69%（较基座 +2.10 个百分点）。
Conclusion: 无需参考解或评分细则，用可靠性与不确定性加权的自生成尝试即可稳定提升推理准确率；数据与代码见 github.com/JP-25/RUSD。

papers.title: Verification Turns Capability Gaps into Routing Decisions: Small Language Models for Clinical Documentation
papers.abstract_en: Clinical note generation from doctor--patient dialogue is high-volume and hallucination-intolerant: a fabricated laboratory value can create patient-safety risk, not a quality regression. We ask whether an agentic \emph{verification} architecture, rather than generator scale, can make a small language model viable here. Holding a four-evaluator verification stack and refinement policy fixed and swapping only the generator between a 4B-parameter model with a QLoRA adapter and a frontier baseline, the small model reaches $0.984$ claim-level factual entailment against $0.992$ and comes within $3.3$ points on completeness, generating entirely on-device. Its deficit is confined to \emph{inter-section structural fidelity}---arrangement rather than clinical comprehension, and the axis on which it also falls furthest below the corpus's reference notes. Because that deficit is an explicit verifier decision rather than a silent quality difference, it becomes a routing policy: run the small model by default, escalate what the verifier rejects. Measured end to end, that it achieved a similiar verified-rate acceptance to the frontier-only acceptance in this test set ($99.6\%$ vs.\ $98.4\%$ over $250$ encounters) while routing $62$, documenting three quarters without a frontier \emph{generation} call. Ablating the loop separates architecture from scale: unrefined, the small model is accepted on $26.8\%$ of encounters and the frontier model on $74.8\%$, so verification does the most work where the generator is weakest. We also contribute section-scoped refinement, which preserves unflagged sections by construction rather than instruction, and find the baseline is not uniformly stronger---its provider refused two trauma-related transcripts the on-device model handled and certified, one facet of a provider dependency a served adapter does not carry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在医患对话生成临床文书任务上，固定四评估器验证栈与细化策略、只换生成器时，4B + QLoRA 的端侧小模型在 claim-level factual entailment 上达到 0.984（前沿基线 0.992），completeness 差距 3.3 分，缺口集中在 inter-section structural fidelity。由于该缺口是验证器的显式判定，可直接转成路由策略：默认跑小模型、只对被拒项升级，250 例上验证通过率 99.6% vs 前沿单跑 98.4%，路由 62 例、四分之三文书无需前沿生成调用。
Motivation: 临床文书生成量大且不容幻觉，编造化验值会直接带来患者安全风险；靠扩大生成器规模来补足能力代价高，作者要检验 agentic verification 架构能否替代生成器规模让小模型可用。
Method: 固定四评估器验证栈 (four-evaluator verification stack) 与细化策略，仅在 4B 参数 + QLoRA adapter 的小模型与前沿基线之间切换生成器；另做消融拆开架构与规模的贡献，并引入 section-scoped refinement，按构造（而非靠指令）保留未被标记的章节。
Result: 小模型 claim-level factual entailment 0.984 vs 前沿 0.992，completeness 差 3.3 分，完全端侧生成；端到端 250 例上验证通过率 99.6% vs 前沿单跑 98.4%，路由 62 例，四分之三文书无前沿生成调用。消融：无细化时小模型仅 26.8% 例通过、前沿 74.8%。前沿基线还拒绝了两段创伤相关转录，端侧模型处理并通过。
Conclusion: 验证架构能把小模型的能力缺口变成显式路由决策：默认用端侧小模型、只升级被验证器拒绝的部分，即可在 250 例测试集上匹配前沿单跑的验证通过率；验证在生成器最弱处贡献最大，且前沿基线并非各维度更强（存在 provider 依赖与拒答）。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ListQA: A Benchmark for Evaluating List-Formatted Factual Knowledge Retrieval in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world questions demand not a single fact but an organized collection of them, yet existing factual knowledge benchmarks almost exclusively target single answer retrieval. We introduce ListQA, a benchmark of 9,045 human-curated, cross-validated questions (audited error rate of 1.7%) that require LLMs to recall multiple facts and compose them into structured lists of 3-10 elements. Questions range from flat lists ("Which NCAA teams went undefeated between 2000 and 2024?") to hierarchical lists with sub-attributes ("...and what was their record and result?"), spanning eight categories across 60+ countries. An evergreen design (explicit temporal constraints or historically immutable facts) keeps ground truth valid without periodic updates. For evaluation, we frame element matching as a linear sum assignment problem: optimal bipartite matching paired with LLM-based semantic grading jointly captures factual accuracy, hallucination, and format compliance. We benchmark 34 models (8 families, 42 configurations across standard and thinking enabled inference) and find: the best standard-inference model scores below 37% LLM-Judge-F1, multi-faceted questions are harder across the board, and providing the source Wikipedia page lifts scores dramatically, confirming that models can organize facts but struggle to retrieve them from parameters alone. Extended analyses cover base vs. instruction-tuned checkpoints and token efficiency. We release the dataset and evaluation code.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track. Project Page: https://listqa.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ListQA 是一个评测 LLM 列表式事实检索能力的基准：9,045 道人工策展并交叉核验的问题（审计错误率 1.7%），要求模型从参数记忆中召回 3–10 个事实并组织成扁平或带子属性的层级列表。评测 34 个模型（8 个家族、42 种配置）后发现，最佳标准推理模型的 LLM-Judge-F1 不到 37%，而给出对应 Wikipedia 源页面后分数大幅提升，说明模型能组织事实但难以仅凭参数检索出来。
Motivation: 现有事实知识基准几乎只测单一答案检索，而真实问题往往要求一次召回并组织多个事实，这类能力没有对应评测。
Method: 构建 9,045 道跨 8 个类别、60+ 国家的策展问题，用显式时间约束或历史不变事实实现 evergreen 设计；把元素匹配建模为线性分配问题（linear sum assignment），以最优二部图匹配配合 LLM-based semantic grading，同时度量事实准确性、幻觉与格式合规。
Result: 基准含 9,045 题、审计错误率 1.7%、答案长度 3–10 个元素；评测 34 个模型（8 家族、42 配置，含标准与 thinking 推理）：最佳标准推理模型 LLM-Judge-F1 低于 37%，多面问题在所有模型上都更难，提供源 Wikipedia 页面后分数大幅提升；另含 base 与 instruction-tuned 检查点及 token 效率分析。
Conclusion: LLM 能把事实组织成结构化列表，但仅靠参数检索多事实是瓶颈，检索增强（给出源页面）可大幅改善列表式事实问答。
