papers.title: Into the Unknown: Benchmarking AI agents on open scientific research problems
papers.abstract_en: Can AI agents carry out research on open scientific problems? We introduce Into the Unknown, a benchmark that provides an agent with a science paper along with a research direction to pursue and tasks it to write a follow-up paper. We work with scientists at US Department of Energy (DOE) national laboratories, who each contribute an unpublished follow-up direction from their own work together with the necessary conditions a submission must meet. While assessing the quality of a follow-up paper is challenging in general, using these conditions to form a rubric makes evaluation more tractable for research problems that have no reference answer. We have nine frontier agents write 15 follow-ups each, spanning quantum computing, plasma physics, computational chemistry, materials science, and scientific machine learning domains. None of the 135 submissions satisfies all the conditions, and 114 fail our integrity check, most often because the paper claims work that was never done or reports numbers that contradict the recorded evidence. Overall, agents readily produce papers that look like follow-ups, but none meets the standard of the domain scientist, leaving substantial headroom. Our code and data are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Into the Unknown 把 DOE 国家实验室科学家给出的未发表后续研究方向做成开放科学问题基准：给 agent 一篇论文和研究方向，要求写出后续论文，并用科学家提供的投稿条件组成 rubric 评分。九个前沿 agent 各写 15 篇、共 135 篇提交，无一满足全部条件，114 篇未通过诚信检查，最常见失败是声称做了没做的工作或报告与记录证据矛盾的数字。
Motivation: 评估 AI agent 能否在没有参考答案的开放科学问题上独立开展研究一直缺少可操作的评分方式，而现有基准无法判定 agent 产出的后续论文是否达到领域科学家标准。
Method: 与 US DOE 国家实验室科学家合作，每人贡献一个未发表的后续研究方向及投稿必须满足的条件，用这些条件构成 rubric 进行评分；让九个前沿 agent 各写 15 篇后续论文，覆盖 quantum computing、plasma physics、computational chemistry、materials science、scientific machine learning 五个领域，并对提交做 integrity check。
Result: 135 篇提交中无一满足全部条件，114 篇未通过 integrity check，失败原因最常见为声称从未做过的工作或报告与记录证据矛盾的数字；agent 能轻易产出形似后续论文的文本，但没有一篇达到领域科学家标准。
Conclusion: 当前前沿 agent 在开放科学问题上能生成表面合格的后续论文，却在研究诚信与领域标准上留下 substantial headroom；用科学家提供的条件做 rubric 是对无参考答案研究问题可行的评估路径。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: AgentCIScope: Grounded Contextual Integrity Evaluation for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are becoming increasingly capable of handling daily workspace tasks by interacting with application environments through tool calls. However, as agents read and write sensitive user data across email, documents, and other applications, a central privacy question is whether they preserve contextual integrity (CI), that is, whether the information flows they produce comply with context-specific disclosure constraints. Existing work either focuses on model-level privacy leakage or evaluates agents in limited application environments with manually constructed disclosure constraints. In this work, we introduce AgentCIScope, a unified platform and benchmark for evaluating agent-level contextual integrity through executable, multi-step tasks across diverse, realistic application environments. AgentCIScope transforms public and synthetic privacy cases into executable agent tasks, with disclosure constraints grounded in three criteria: governing privacy policies, persona-based agreement, and a predefined sensitive-attribute taxonomy. Based on AgentCIScope, we evaluate 12 agents on 936 tasks and find that strong task-completion capability does not guarantee contextual-integrity preservation: single-run leakage rates range from 32.5% to 94.4%, while repeating each task five times further increases leakage by 4-19 percentage points. Leakage varies substantially across attributes: personal preferences and booking details have average leakage rates of 84.7% and 76.5%, compared with 17.1% for credit-card information and 29.4% for SSNs; environments: calendar has the highest average leakage rate as an information source, while WhatsApp ranks highest as an information destination; and governing privacy policies. AgentCIScope provides deep insights into agent privacy leakage and serves as a unified testbed for developing privacy-preserving agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentCIScope 把公开与合成隐私案例改写成可执行的多步 agent 任务，用三类可执行披露约束（治理隐私政策、persona 协议、敏感属性分类）评测 LLM agent 的情境完整性 (contextual integrity)。在 936 个任务上评测 12 个 agent，单次运行泄漏率 32.5%–94.4%，同一任务重复五次再升 4–19 个百分点，说明任务完成能力强不等于守住披露约束。
Motivation: 现有工作要么只测模型级隐私泄露，要么在受限应用环境里手工构造披露约束，无法衡量 agent 在多步工具调用中跨 email、文档等应用读写敏感数据时是否遵守情境特定的披露规则。
Method: 提出统一平台与基准 AgentCIScope：把公开与合成隐私案例转成可执行多步 agent 任务，披露约束锚定三条准则——治理隐私政策、基于 persona 的协议、预定义敏感属性分类；据此构建 936 个任务并评测 12 个 agent，每任务重复运行五次以观察泄漏稳定性。
Result: 12 个 agent 在 936 个任务上单次泄漏率 32.5%–94.4%；重复五次使泄漏再增 4–19 个百分点。按属性：个人偏好 84.7%、预订详情 76.5%，而信用卡信息仅 17.1%、SSN 29.4%；按环境：calendar 作为信息源平均泄漏最高，WhatsApp 作为信息目的地排名最高；泄漏还随治理隐私政策变化。
Conclusion: 强任务完成能力并不保证情境完整性保持，agent 隐私泄漏在属性、环境与政策三个维度上高度不均；AgentCIScope 可作为开发隐私保护 agent 的统一测试床。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agronomic Characterization and Time-Series UAV Phenotyping to Support Field Pea Breeding in Iowa
papers.abstract_en: Field pea has gained interest in the Midwest U.S. and has the potential to benefit Iowa cropping systems. This study evaluated 17 accessions and 7 Canadian varieties for agronomic and seed yield performance. This study found that PI accession trials exhibit genetic diversity in phenology and canopy traits, whereas the Canadian elite varieties demonstrated great yield potential under Iowa conditions. The accession genotypes matured between 75 DAP (late June) and 95 DAP (late July) across six site-years. The top-yielding Canadian varieties averaged 1961 kg/ha across two site-years. To comprehensively assess field pea performance, this study extracted time-series Unmanned Aerial Vehicle(UAV)-derived traits, assessed UAV-derived traits, and evaluated their correlations with multiple agronomic traits and yield. The results found that UAV-derived time-series canopy area was the most yield-relevant trait (r = 0.63) among all UAV-derived canopy features, vegetation indices, and manually collected measurements. Compared with yield, UAV-derived canopy area showed higher selection reliability (H2 = 0.87, CV = 13.46%), making it suitable for phenotypic selection and accelerating Midwest field pea breeding programs. This study identifies useful UAV-derived features for pea breeding and demonstrates the value of integrating diverse germplasm, elite commercial varieties, and time-series UAV phenotyping. Combining genetic variation from the accession trial with the yield potential of high-performing commercial varieties provides valuable breeding materials and phenotyping strategies for developing locally adapted, high-yielding field pea varieties for future production in the Midwest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对爱荷华田间豌豆做 17 份 PI 材料与 7 个加拿大商业品种的农艺评估，并用时序 UAV 表型提取冠层特征。UAV 时序冠层面积与产量相关性最高（r = 0.63），且选择可靠性优于产量本身（H2 = 0.87，CV = 13.46%），可直接用于表型选择以加速中西部豌豆育种。
Motivation: 中西部豌豆育种缺少可靠的早期无损表型指标，人工测量耗时且与产量的相关性有限，制约选择效率。
Method: 在六个 site-year 上评估 17 份 PI 材料与 7 个加拿大商业品种；提取时序 UAV 冠层特征、植被指数并与人工测量的农艺性状和产量做相关分析，比较选择可靠性（H2、CV）。
Result: 材料成熟期在 75 DAP（6 月底）至 95 DAP（7 月底）之间，跨六个 site-year；表现最好的加拿大品种在两个 site-year 上平均产量 1961 kg/ha；UAV 时序冠层面积与产量相关系数 r = 0.63，为所有 UAV 冠层特征、植被指数和人工测量中最高；其选择可靠性 H2 = 0.87、CV = 13.46%，高于产量本身。
Conclusion: UAV 时序冠层面积是比产量本身更适合豌豆表型选择的指标；把材料试验的遗传变异与高产商业品种结合，可为中西部本地适应性品种提供育种材料与表型策略。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Compiling Expert Procedures into Verified Programs: When a Small Model Is Enough
papers.abstract_en: In procedural tool-use domains, how much of the gap between base models is procedure rather than capability? We build an explicit program from a teacher's traces and run it in front of unchanged small models, including an 8B model. The construction, PLVR , takes the reasoning traces of a teacher, Kimi-K3, clusters their segments to locate recurring operations, has a frontier model author one typed primitive per operation, each run by a small frozen model and assembles the program by A* search over a mined rule library, under a reference-action objective. At inference the program takes one of two forms: for troubleshooting and tool search it produces the chain of thought the student would otherwise generate for itself, and the student acts on it; for multi-turn tool matching the student proposes each action and the program checks, repairs, or retries it before it goes out. On the official tau2-Bench Retail and Telecom test sets and on LiveMCPBench, with three Nemotron base models and the same program for each, the answer depends on the domain. On Telecom, Granite-4.2-8B as the student goes from 43.0% to 91.2% under the program, and every Nemotron student reaches 93.3-94.4%, against at most 58.2% for fine-tuning on the same traces, prompt optimisation of the student, or two token-matched baselines. With Granite-4.2-8B as the student, the program is within 2 to 3 points of the Nemotron students on Telecom and within 3 on Retail, and 3 to 13 points below them on LiveMCPBench: where the domain is procedural an 8B student is enough, and on tool search the student still matters. On Retail and LiveMCPBench the program is competitive with the best baseline. The spread between base models shrinks from about 7 points to about 2, averaged over the suites, with no weights changed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PLVR 把教师 Kimi-K3 的推理轨迹编译成带类型原语的显式程序，插在未改动的小模型（含 8B）前面执行。在 tau2-Bench Telecom 上 Granite-4.2-8B 从 43.0% 升到 91.2%，Nemotron 系列达 93.3–94.4%，而同轨迹微调、提示优化与两个 token 匹配基线最多 58.2%；程序性领域里 8B 学生就够，工具搜索领域学生本身仍关键。
Motivation: 程序化工具使用领域中，基座模型之间的差距有多少来自流程而非能力尚不清楚；作者要判断把流程外置成程序后，小模型能否补上这段差距。
Method: PLVR 取教师 Kimi-K3 的推理轨迹，对轨迹片段聚类定位反复出现的操作，让前沿模型为每个操作写一个带类型的原语（各由一个小的冻结模型执行），再在挖掘出的规则库上以参考动作目标做 A* 搜索组装程序。推理时程序或生成学生本会自产的思维链供学生执行，或对学生提出的每个动作做检查、修复、重试。
Result: 在官方 tau2-Bench Retail 与 Telecom 测试集及 LiveMCPBench 上，用三个 Nemotron 基座配同一程序：Telecom 上 Granite-4.2-8B 由 43.0% 升至 91.2%，每个 Nemotron 学生达 93.3–94.4%，而同轨迹微调、学生提示优化或两个 token 匹配基线最多 58.2%。Granite-4.2-8B 在 Telecom 上距 Nemotron 学生 2–3 分、Retail 上 3 分以内、LiveMCPBench 上低 3–13 分；各套件平均的基座间差距由约 7 分缩到约 2 分，权重不变。
Conclusion: 领域是流程性的（如 Telecom）时 8B 学生配程序就够，工具搜索类任务上学生本身仍起作用；在 Retail 与 LiveMCPBench 上该程序与最强基线相当。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Demystifying On-Policy Distillation: Where Does the Teacher's Advantage Live?
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) is increasingly studied as a cheaper alternative to reinforcement learning, yet it remains a form of knowledge distillation (KD) that relies on teacher supervision. We revisit OPD from the KD perspective by asking where the teacher's advantage lies along student-generated trajectories. Controlled token flips at teacher-student disagreements directly measure the accuracy gained from teacher corrections. Single-token flips yield a modest average gain on selected failed trajectories, whereas repeated flips raise accuracy from 28.4% to 74.5%, close to the teacher's 76.9%. Gains continue to accumulate with more flips, but mass- and KL-based selection outperform random flips by 15-18 percentage points at counts of similar magnitude. Selective intervention remains useful after OPD, but greater argmax agreement does not consistently improve accuracy across model pairs. We advocate training schedules that learn more valuable teacher corrections while maintaining distributional stability. Controlled flips and fork-resolution analysis evaluate OPD beyond accuracy by measuring which teacher preferences the student acquires and what further correction can recover.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 on-policy distillation (OPD) 重新当作知识蒸馏问题，用受控 token 翻转在师生分歧处直接测量教师纠正带来的准确率增益：单次翻转在选定失败轨迹上只有温和提升，而重复翻转把准确率从 28.4% 抬到 74.5%，接近教师的 76.9%。按 mass 或 KL 选择翻转位置比随机翻转在相近翻转次数下高 15–18 个百分点；作者据此主张训练日程应学习更有价值的教师纠正并保持分布稳定性。
Motivation: OPD 被当作比强化学习更便宜的替代方案来研究，但它本质仍是依赖教师监督的知识蒸馏，教师优势究竟沿学生自生成轨迹分布在哪里并不清楚，仅看最终准确率无法区分学生学到了哪些教师偏好。
Method: 在师生分歧 token 处做受控 token 翻转 (controlled token flips)，直接测量教师纠正带来的准确率增益；配合 fork-resolution 分析，并比较 mass-based、KL-based 与 random 三种翻转位置选择策略，评估维度超出准确率本身。
Result: 单 token 翻转在选定失败轨迹上仅有温和的平均增益；重复翻转使准确率从 28.4% 升至 74.5%，接近教师的 76.9%；增益随翻转次数继续累积；在相近翻转次数下 mass 与 KL 选择比随机翻转高 15–18 个百分点；OPD 之后选择性干预仍有用，但更高的 argmax 一致率并不总带来跨模型对的准确率提升。
Conclusion: 教师优势集中在少数可累积、可按分布差异定位的纠正上，因此训练日程应优先学习更有价值的教师纠正并维持分布稳定性，而 argmax 一致率不能当作 OPD 效果的可靠代理。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Towards Training and Inference of Graph Neural Networks in Graph Databases
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks on large graphs commonly rely on in-memory graph storage with ad hoc data processing pipelines for both training and inference. Graph databases provide scalable storage and efficient traversal for graphs that can evolve over time, but their applicability in GNN training and inference are rarely studied. We show that graph DBs can be used in GNN training and inference directly, executing sampling, feature retrieval, and even the full forward pass. We show different GNN training pipelines can perform on-the-fly sampling and retrieval in graph DBs using Cypher. We further provide optimisations that speed up the training process by \~2.5x while maintaining the same accuracy. We illustrate that fully in-DB inference is possible, independent of how the GNNs are trained. Our inference setup can be >10x faster than cold loading the graph into RAM with no extra memory overhead on real-world graphs. Our work lays the foundation for in-graph-DB GNN training and inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明图数据库可以直接承担 GNN 的训练与推理：采样、特征检索乃至完整前向传播都在库内用 Cypher 执行。优化后训练提速约 2.5 倍且精度不变；完全在库内推理比把图冷加载进 RAM 快 10 倍以上，且不产生额外内存开销。
Motivation: 大图上的 GNN 训练与推理普遍依赖内存图存储加临时数据处理流水线，难以应对随时间演化的图；图数据库虽有可扩展存储与高效遍历能力，却很少被研究用于 GNN 训练与推理。
Method: 在图数据库内直接执行 GNN 的采样、特征检索与完整前向传播；多种 GNN 训练流水线用 Cypher 在库内完成在线采样与检索，并给出针对性优化；推理完全在库内进行，与训练方式无关。
Result: 优化使训练过程提速约 2.5 倍且保持相同精度；在真实世界图上，完全在库内推理比将图冷加载到 RAM 快 10 倍以上，且无额外内存开销。
Conclusion: 图数据库可以直接作为 GNN 训练与推理的执行引擎，为随时间演化的图提供免额外内存开销的训练与推理基础。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 在图数据库内直接执行 GNN 的采样、特征检索与完整前向传播；多种 GNN 训练流水线用 Cypher 在库内完成在线采样与检索，并给出针对性优化；推理完全在库内进行，与训练方式无关。
summary_sections.result: 优化使训练过程提速约 2.5 倍且保持相同精度；在真实世界图上，完全在库内推理比将图冷加载到 RAM 快 10 倍以上，且无额外内存开销。
summary_sections.conclusion: 图数据库可以直接作为 GNN 训练与推理的执行引擎，为随时间演化的图提供免额外内存开销的训练与推理基础。

papers.title: Online Tokenization with Optimal Delay in Linear Time
papers.abstract_en: Tokenization is an essential preprocessing step in almost all large language models (LLMs). One of the most popular frameworks is BPE tokenization, which consists of special token segmentation, pretokenization, and byte-pair encoding (BPE). However, existing algorithms are sequential, with each stage only processing complete output from the previous stage. In order to reduce latency and memory footprints, recent works (Jiang and Gong, ICML 2026) (Li, Yang and Mamouras, ASPLOS 2026) (Mamouras, Li and Yang, PLDI 2026) have initiated the study of online algorithms for subroutines such as pretokenization and BPE with a goal of streaming input to output as the input arrives online. However, the search for efficient online tokenization remains open. In this work, we formalize and resolve online tokenization. We introduce the notion of delay for online tokenization which characterizes the extent to which the algorithm output lags behind the (possibly computationally intractable) optimum. We give a near-linear time algorithm with optimal delay (up to constant factors). We complement this algorithm with a conditional lower bound: unless $\mathbf{P} = \mathbf{NP}$, there is no polynomial time algorithm that beats the delay of our algorithm by more than a constant factor. We implement a practical variant for tokenizers from OpenAI's tiktoken and HuggingFace's tokenizers. We obtain a $7.9\times$-$34.8\times$ latency advantage (measured as time to first token) over tiktoken (as well as the recent gigatoken tokenizer) and our implementation maintains approximately constant memory usage independent of input size. Our implementation also achieves a $2.4\times$-$7.0\times$ improvement in throughput over tiktoken and $15.8\times$-$38.1\times$ over tokenizers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 BPE 分词（含 special token segmentation、pretokenization、BPE）形式化为在线问题并定义 delay 指标，给出近线性时间、delay 达到常数因子最优的算法，且在 P≠NP 下不存在多项式时间算法把 delay 再压过常数因子。对 tiktoken 与 HuggingFace tokenizers 的实现取得 7.9×–34.8× 的首 token 延迟优势，内存近似恒定、与输入长度无关，吞吐提升 2.4×–7.0×（对 tiktoken）与 15.8×–38.1×（对 tokenizers）。
Motivation: 现有 BPE 分词算法是串行的，每个阶段必须等上一阶段完整输出，导致首 token 延迟高、内存随输入增长；已有在线化工作只覆盖 pretokenization、BPE 等子程序，整体在线分词仍未解决。
Method: 形式化在线分词并引入 delay 概念，刻画算法输出相对（可能计算上难解的）最优解的滞后程度；给出近线性时间算法使 delay 常数因子最优，并证明条件性下界（除非 P=NP，否则无多项式时间算法能超过该 delay 超过常数因子）；另实现面向 OpenAI tiktoken 与 HuggingFace tokenizers 的实用变体。
Result: 实现相对 tiktoken（以及近期的 gigatoken tokenizer）取得 7.9×–34.8× 的延迟优势（以 time to first token 计），内存近似恒定且与输入大小无关；吞吐相对 tiktoken 提升 2.4×–7.0×，相对 tokenizers 提升 15.8×–38.1×。理论侧给出常数因子最优 delay 的近线性时间算法与 P≠NP 条件下界。
Conclusion: 在线分词可以在近线性时间内做到常数因子最优 delay，且该最优性在 P≠NP 下不可被多项式时间算法突破；工程上在线化能同时把首 token 延迟降一个数量级并把内存压到与输入长度无关。

papers.title: MA-Bench: Measuring Operational Planning in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: How well can a language model turn a large, incomplete and partly contradictory body of documents into a plan when no single correct answer exists? We introduce Mission Analysis (MA)-Bench, built on mission analysis, the first step of military operational planning, in which a staff reads the full situation and states the problem before anyone proposes a solution. Its 10 expert-built scenarios pair synthetic packets of ten to twelve documents with 1,257 expert-written pass/fail requirements, each containing information on their source, question type, and importance level. A reasoning-model judge grades each brief against the requirements without seeing the documents; it grades like a fifth credentialed planner, leaving a four-planner panel's agreement unchanged (Fleiss $κ$ 0.42 to 0.41), and a judge from a second provider reproduces the model ranking (Spearman 0.94). Across twenty frontier and open-weights models the best gets 62% of the rubric items right. Models are strongest on facts stated in the documents (58%) and weakest on judgments that must be inferred (33%), and six failures in ten are omissions rather than errors. MA-Bench grades the determinations, not the prose. We release the packets, rubrics, prompts, scorer and every graded brief with item-level verdicts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MA-Bench 用军事作战规划第一步的「任务分析」评测语言模型：10 个专家场景、每场景 10–12 份文档、共 1,257 条专家撰写的通过/不通过评分项，由推理模型作为裁判逐项打分。20 个前沿与开放权重模型中最好的一个只答对 62% 的评分项，文档明示事实 58%、需推断的判断仅 33%，且十分之六的失败是遗漏而非错误。
Motivation: 当没有唯一正确答案、材料又大、不完整且互相矛盾时，语言模型能否像参谋一样先读全态势、界定问题再谈方案，此前缺少可复现的评测；军事任务分析正是这种「先陈述问题」的场景。
Method: 构建 MA-Bench：10 个专家搭建的场景，每个配 10–12 份合成文档包与专家撰写的通过/不通过评分项（共 1,257 条，标注来源、问题类型、重要性等级）；用推理模型当裁判，看不到文档、只对照评分项给每份简报逐项判定，评测对象是结论而非文笔。
Result: 裁判加入后四人专家组一致性基本不变（Fleiss κ 从 0.42 到 0.41），第二家供应商的裁判复现同一模型排名（Spearman 0.94）；20 个前沿与开放权重模型中最佳模型仅答对 62% 评分项，文档明示事实 58%、需推断判断 33%，失败中约六成是遗漏而非错误。
Conclusion: 语言模型在任务分析式规划上最缺的是主动补全需推断的判断，而非抄写文档事实；MA-Bench 以可审计的逐项判定和跨供应商可复现的排名，把这类「无唯一解」规划能力变成可测对象。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Graph-Based Orchestration of Heterogeneous AI Models: A Control Node Approach to Composite Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: We present a graph-based framework for Composite AI systems that integrate multiple AI techniques to address complex problems. We describe an architecture using specialized control nodes to orchestrate diverse models including planning, machine learning, constraint programming, and large language models. The system employs directed acyclic graphs and behavior trees to manage model relationships and execution sequencing. Our methodology encompasses data connectors, computational services, and a containerized deployment framework supporting hierarchical, sequential, and concurrent model composition patterns. Through case studies, we demonstrate how this architecture enables the creation of composite systems that leverage the strengths of multiple AI techniques within a unified operational schema, overcoming the limitations of single-model approaches.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, Citation: G. Michael Youngblood, Filip Dvořák, Slavo Švancár, Tomáš Balyo, Michal Ficek, and Martin Dousek. Graph-Based Orchestration of Heterogeneous AI Models: A Control Node Approach to Composite Intelligence. IJCAI Workshop on Composite AI (CompAI). 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于有向无环图 (DAG) 与行为树 (behavior tree) 的 Composite AI 编排框架，用专用控制节点 (control node) 调度规划、机器学习、约束规划与大语言模型等异构模型，支持层次、顺序、并发三种组合模式，并配套数据连接器、计算服务与容器化部署。作者通过案例研究展示该架构可在统一操作模式下组合多种 AI 技术，突破单模型方案的能力边界。
Motivation: 单一模型难以覆盖需要规划、约束求解与学习推理协同的复杂问题，异构 AI 技术之间缺少统一的模型关系管理与执行时序控制机制。
Method: 以专用控制节点作为编排核心，用 DAG 描述模型依赖、用行为树管理执行时序；框架包含数据连接器、计算服务与容器化部署，支持层次、顺序、并发三种组合模式，被调度的模型涵盖规划、机器学习、约束编程与 LLM。
Result: 通过案例研究 (case studies) 展示该架构能在统一操作模式下组合多种 AI 技术以发挥各自优势；摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: 控制节点加图结构的编排方式可把异构 AI 模型组织成复合系统，克服单模型方法的局限。

papers.title: Student Copula Markov Networks
papers.abstract_en: This paper extends the applicability of probabilistic graphical models to non Gaussian data. It establishes a characterization of the pairwise Markov property in undirected probabilistic graphical models in terms of copula densities. Building on this characterization, we derive a necessary condition for the pairwise Markov property in Student copula Markov networks. An Expectation-Conditional Maximization algorithm (ECM) is provided to facilitate the penalized maximum likelihood estimation and graph selection. The performance of the proposed algorithm is evaluated through simulation studies, which demonstrate its effectiveness in estimating model parameters and recovering the underlying graph structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把无向概率图模型的 pairwise Markov 性质改用 copula 密度刻画，从而推广到非高斯数据；据此推出 Student copula Markov 网络中 pairwise Markov 性质的必要条件，并给出 ECM 算法做惩罚极大似然估计与图结构选择。仿真研究表明该算法能有效估计模型参数并恢复真实图结构。
Motivation: 无向概率图模型的 Markov 性质刻画通常依赖高斯等特定分布假设，限制了其在非高斯数据上的可用性，也缺少相应的参数估计与图选择手段。
Method: 用 copula 密度重新表述无向图的 pairwise Markov 性质，并在 Student copula Markov 网络上推导该性质的必要条件；提供 Expectation-Conditional Maximization (ECM) 算法求解惩罚极大似然估计并进行图选择，评估方式为仿真研究。
Result: 仿真研究显示 ECM 算法在估计模型参数和恢复底层图结构上有效；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: copula 密度刻画可把无向图的 Markov 性质扩展到非高斯数据，且配对的 ECM 估计与图选择流程在仿真中可行。

papers.title: CAFE: Confining Feature Distillation to Language-Routed Adapters for Compact Multilingual Automatic Speech Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Feature distillation is usually expected to add to logit distillation. We find that this expectation does not hold for two common feature losses in compact multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR), and analyze why through their gradients. The gradient of a projection-based loss is orthogonal to the task gradient, while that of Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA), a similarity-based loss, is weakly aligned with it. CKA lowers the word error rate (WER) on non-English languages, but at the expense of data-rich English. Three loss-level remedies (one trained, two probed) all fall short, and the CKA gradient overlaps with the subspace English uses in the shared encoder by 97.5% to 99.5% (about 81% by chance). Guided by this diagnosis, we propose CAFE (Confined-Adapter Feature distillation), which confines the CKA gradient to adapters that English bypasses, addressing the trade-off in the parameters rather than in the loss. On the Open ASR Leaderboard, CAFE lowers the average WER from 8.55% to 8.02%, beats an adapter-only capacity control at 8.51%, and makes English more stable across checkpoints. At 254M parameters, it trails the 0.6B teacher by 2 WER points and is competitive with much larger models across 48 test sets in 24 languages. We use 564k hours of training data and state-of-the-art models to keep the findings relevant to practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAFE 把 CKA 特征蒸馏的梯度限制在英文绕过的 adapter 内，从而在多语言 ASR 压缩中同时保住非英语性能与英文稳定性：Open ASR Leaderboard 平均 WER 从 8.55% 降到 8.02%，优于仅控制 adapter 容量的 8.51%。
Motivation: 紧凑多语言 ASR 中，特征蒸馏常被默认能叠加在 logit 蒸馏之上，但投影类损失梯度与任务梯度正交、CKA 梯度虽与任务梯度弱对齐却以牺牲数据充足的英文为代价换取非英语 WER 下降，这一权衡在损失层面的三种补救（一个训练、两个探测）均告失败。
Method: 先对投影式特征损失与 CKA 相似度损失做梯度分析，量化 CKA 梯度与共享编码器中英文所用子空间的重叠；据此提出 CAFE (Confined-Adapter Feature distillation)，把 CKA 梯度限制在英文绕过的 adapter 参数中，而不是修改损失本身。训练使用 564k 小时数据与 state-of-the-art 模型。
Result: CKA 梯度与英文子空间重叠 97.5%–99.5%（随机水平约 81%）。Open ASR Leaderboard 上 CAFE 平均 WER 8.55% → 8.02%，优于 adapter-only 容量控制的 8.51%，且英文在 checkpoint 间更稳定。254M 参数模型落后 0.6B 教师 2 个 WER 点，在 24 种语言 48 个测试集上与更大模型相当。
Conclusion: 多语言 ASR 蒸馏中的英/非英语权衡应通过参数路由（把蒸馏梯度限制在英文绕过的 adapter）而非损失设计来解决，CAFE 在 254M 参数下逼近更大模型。

summary_sections.motivation: 紧凑多语言 ASR 中，特征蒸馏常被默认能叠加在 logit 蒸馏之上，但投影类损失梯度与任务梯度正交、CKA 梯度虽与任务梯度弱对齐却以牺牲数据充足的英文为代价换取非英语 WER 下降，这一权衡在损失层面的三种补救（一个训练、两个探测）均告失败。
summary_sections.method: 先对投影式特征损失与 CKA 相似度损失做梯度分析，量化 CKA 梯度与共享编码器中英文所用子空间的重叠；据此提出 CAFE (Confined-Adapter Feature distillation)，把 CKA 梯度限制在英文绕过的 adapter 参数中，而不是修改损失本身。训练使用 564k 小时数据与 state-of-the-art 模型。

summary_sections.conclusion: 多语言 ASR 蒸馏中的英/非英语权衡应通过参数路由（把蒸馏梯度限制在英文绕过的 adapter）而非损失设计来解决，CAFE 在 254M 参数下逼近更大模型。

papers.title: TRACER: Trace-Regularized Training Against Indirect Prompt Injection
papers.abstract_en: Indirect prompt injection uses untrusted retrieved content, tool outputs, or agent messages to override an LLM's intended behavior. We show that defense robustness is channel-conditioned: the same attack succeeds 18% of the time as a follow-up message but 53% when placed in retrieved context. We propose TRACER (Trace-Regularized Adversarial Channel Exposure with Reward-shaping), a channel-aware adversarial training method that samples presentation wrappers and combines an answer-anchored, evidence-gated reward with ATRC, which aligns attacked reasoning with clean evidence when an injection is invalid. On GSM8K with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, TRACER reduces RAG-framed ASR from 65.5% to 6.1% while preserving 78-82% clean accuracy. Joint RAG+tool training achieves 13.9% average ASR across framings at 3B scale, while a single epoch at 7B reaches 9.4%. These results demonstrate that robust defenses must explicitly train and evaluate across deployment channels.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 13 figures, 12 tables. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACER 用通道感知的对抗训练抵御间接提示注入：同一攻击作为后续消息只有 18% 成功率，放进检索上下文则达 53%，说明防御鲁棒性依赖呈现通道。在 GSM8K 与 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 上，TRACER 把 RAG 框定的 ASR 从 65.5% 降到 6.1%，同时保住 78–82% 干净准确率。
Motivation: 间接提示注入经检索内容、工具输出或 agent 消息劫持 LLM 行为，而现有防御的鲁棒性是通道条件化的：同一攻击换个呈现位置成功率相差近三倍，只在单一通道上训练和评测的防御会高估安全性。
Method: TRACER (Trace-Regularized Adversarial Channel Exposure with Reward-shaping) 在训练中采样不同的呈现 wrapper（presentation wrappers），把答案锚定、证据门控的奖励 (answer-anchored, evidence-gated reward) 与 ATRC 结合；ATRC 在注入无效时对齐被攻击的推理轨迹与干净证据。
Result: 同一攻击作为 follow-up 消息成功率 18%、置于检索上下文 53%；GSM8K 上 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 的 RAG 框定 ASR 由 65.5% 降至 6.1%，干净准确率保持 78–82%；RAG+tool 联合训练在 3B 规模跨框定平均 ASR 13.9%，7B 单 epoch 达 9.4%。
Conclusion: 鲁棒的提示注入防御必须显式跨部署通道训练并评测，通道感知的对抗训练加证据门控奖励能在压低 ASR 的同时保住干净准确率。

papers.title: Plant Memory: Technical Language Processing and a Verified Maintenance Ontology for Agent-Accessible Failure Knowledge from SAP PM Work Orders
papers.abstract_en: Maintenance work orders are the largest written record of how industrial equipment fails, yet in most plants they are close to unusable for analysis. Short texts are abbreviated and misspelt, asset identity is buried in free text, work-type labels contradict the work described, and the fields that matter most for reliability (symptom, root cause, action taken) are usually empty. As a result, diagnostic knowledge stays with senior technicians and leaves when they do. We present Plant Memory, a system that applies technical language processing (TLP) to SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) exports and builds an ISO 14224-aligned maintenance ontology in which every extracted statement is a reified fact carrying a confidence score, the evidence it was read from, and a verification state. Extraction is rule-first, with an optional large language model (LLM) acting as a second reader whose disagreements raise a fact's review priority rather than overwrite it. Technicians verify facts through a review queue, answer targeted knowledge-gap questions where failures repeat without a recorded cause, and approve or reject ontology drift proposals when new terms appear. The resulting graph is served to people through a web application and to AI agents through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, so both query the same verified knowledge and every answer cites the work orders behind it. On a synthetic 12-month export of 400 work orders from a parboiled-rice plant, rule-based extraction reaches 96.2% component accuracy, 88.9% failure-mode accuracy and 100% root-cause precision at 62% coverage; on 28 diagnostic questions, ranked root causes from the ontology are correct at top-1 in 82.1% of cases against 53.6% for the raw SAP root-cause column.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Plant Memory 把 SAP PM 工单经规则优先的技术语言处理 (TLP) 抽成带置信度、证据与验证状态的再具体化事实，构建对齐 ISO 14224 的维护本体，并通过 MCP server 同时供人和 AI agent 查询。在稻米加工厂 12 个月、400 条合成工单上，规则抽取组件准确率 96.2%、故障模式 88.9%、根因精确率 100%（覆盖率 62%）；28 个诊断问题上本体排序根因 top-1 正确率 82.1%，对照原始 SAP 根因列的 53.6%。
Motivation: 工厂工单文本缩写错拼、资产身份埋在自由文本、工单类型标签与实际工作矛盾，症状/根因/措施等可靠性关键字段常为空，诊断知识只留在资深技师脑中并随离职流失。
Method: 对 SAP Plant Maintenance 导出做规则优先的 TLP 抽取，可选 LLM 作为第二读者，其分歧只提高事实复核优先级而不覆盖；产出对齐 ISO 14224 的本体，每条陈述是带置信度、证据来源与验证状态的再具体化事实。技师通过 review queue 验证、回答知识缺口问题、审批或驳回本体漂移提案；图经 web 应用与 Model Context Protocol (MCP) server 同时服务人和 agent，答案均引用底层工单。
Result: 在某碾米厂 12 个月、400 条工单的合成导出上：规则抽取组件准确率 96.2%、故障模式准确率 88.9%、根因精确率 100%（覆盖率 62%）。28 个诊断问题上，本体排序根因 top-1 正确率 82.1%，对照原始 SAP 根因列 53.6%。
Conclusion: 规则优先加 LLM 二次读取加人工验证的抽取路径，能在字段残缺的工单上产出可追溯、可被 agent 直接查询的故障知识，且排序根因诊断显著好于直接读 SAP 根因列。

papers.title: Imagining Goals with Geometric Horizon Models for Policy Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Training from offline data has allowed for substantial progress in domains such as robotics, leading to general-purpose policies that can be easily applied zero-shot or efficiently finetuned for downstream tasks. However, these policies can still have poor generalization, both due to the choice of modeling objective and from learning from a static dataset. In this work, we focus on the challenging task of zero-shot goal generalization, where a policy is evaluated on unseen tasks that require combining its existing knowledge (compositional generalization). An avenue for improving a policy's generalization is by generating new experience with world models; however, such generation has proven difficult for longer horizons. Thus, to alleviate this issue, we propose TD-Aug, which samples from a geometric horizon model and allows for directly imagining novel outcomes that can be achieved by composing existing knowledge. We demonstrate that training on these future outcomes as goals for goal-conditioned BC policies significantly improves generalization in stitching-based OGBench tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TD-Aug 从几何 horizon model 中采样，让世界模型直接想象由已有知识组合出的新结果，并把这些结果作为 goal-conditioned BC 策略的目标进行训练，从而在 stitching 类 OGBench 任务上显著改善零样本目标泛化 (zero-shot goal generalization)。
Motivation: 离线训练的通用策略在未见任务上泛化差，原因既在建模目标也在静态数据集；用世界模型生成新经验虽可缓解，但长 horizon 生成一直很难。
Method: 提出 TD-Aug：从几何 horizon model 采样，直接想象可由已有知识组合达成的新结果，把这些未来结果当作目标训练 goal-conditioned BC 策略，用于 stitching-based OGBench 任务。
Result: 在 stitching-based OGBench 任务上，以想象出的未来结果为目标的训练显著改善了零样本目标泛化；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 通过几何 horizon model 想象组合式新目标，是提升离线策略在未见任务上组合泛化的一条有效路径，尤其针对长 horizon 生成困难的问题。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PairIT: Autoregressive Transformers for Low-Data Molecule Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Generating novel molecules with desired properties is a central challenge in drug discovery. Although foundational work focused on de novo generation, practical use cases require a more complex setting: conditioning on an initial seed molecule, optimizing multiple properties, and operating in data-sparse regimes. We introduce PairIT, a flexible training framework for autoregressive transformers over SMILES sequences that enables seeded generation by learning from pairs of structurally similar molecules. By leveraging matched pairs, the model learns to generate local, chemically meaningful edits that improve a property of the seed molecule. Prompt tokens extend this framework by specifying the target property, desired direction, and approximate magnitude of change. Multiple prompt tokens can be concatenated to enable multi-property optimization at inference time. For properties where pair supervision alone is insufficient, reinforcement learning post-training can further improve optimization, providing a tunable trade-off between proximity to the seed and the optimization objective. PairIT naturally supports pretraining on a large dataset and fine-tuning on a smaller dataset, which is critical for performance in data-sparse regimes. Surprisingly, we observe diminishing returns to the scale of the pretraining dataset. We demonstrate empirically on MoleculeNet and Therapeutics Data Commons datasets that, with appropriate paired-data curation, a standard transformer model of modest size (68M parameters) can achieve robust seeded molecular optimization in low-data regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PairIT 用结构相似分子对训练 SMILES 自回归 Transformer，使种子分子生成局部化学编辑并按 prompt token 指定的性质方向与幅度改进性质，可拼接多个 token 做多性质优化。在 MoleculeNet 与 Therapeutics Data Commons 上，68M 参数的标准 Transformer 配合适当配对数据整理即可在低数据 regime 实现稳健的种子式分子优化，且预训练数据规模存在收益递减。
Motivation: 药物发现的实际场景要求以种子分子为条件、同时优化多个性质且数据稀疏，而 de novo 生成范式与单纯扩大预训练规模都覆盖不了这一设定。
Method: 对 SMILES 序列的自回归 Transformer 采用 PairIT 训练框架，从结构相似分子对中学习对种子的局部性质改进编辑；加入 prompt token 指定目标性质、变化方向与近似幅度，多个 token 可拼接实现推理时多性质优化；配对监督不足的性质再用强化学习后训练，在贴近种子与优化目标之间做可调权衡；支持大数据预训练加小数据微调。
Result: 在 MoleculeNet 与 Therapeutics Data Commons 数据集上，68M 参数的标准 Transformer 配合配对数据整理实现了低数据 regime 下稳健的种子式分子优化；观察到预训练数据集规模收益递减；强化学习后训练提供贴近种子与优化目标之间的可调权衡。
Conclusion: 低数据分子优化的关键在配对数据整理而非模型规模或预训练数据量，配对监督加 prompt token 已足以支撑多性质种子式优化，RL 后训练只在配对监督不足时补位。

papers.title: Learning in Orbit: Onboard Training and Closed-Loop Attitude Control with a Thermal Segmentation Model on a Spacecraft
papers.abstract_en: Deep space missions increasingly require spacecraft capable of autonomously operating in environments with communication delays and bandwidth limitations. A key enabler of such autonomy is the ability to run learning-based algorithms directly onboard. In this work, we present a flight deployment on a 6U CubeSat that demonstrates (1) onboard training and inference of a thermal segmentation model on an NVIDIA Jetson TX2 NX GPU in space and (2) closed-loop attitude control using the segmentation model on a real-time, thermal image feed to track the Moon. In addition to this demonstration, we implement ROS 2 Foxy as a data transport middleware and integrate an open-source file system that provides strong data integrity guarantees and self-healing features. Over the course of approximately one year, we performed 12 experiments on the spacecraft, advancing the state of the art in autonomous spacecraft systems by showing how modern learning-based pipelines, commercially available hardware, and open-source software can operate reliably under the compute and environmental constraints of Low Earth Orbit (LEO).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 6U CubeSat 上完成在轨飞行部署：NVIDIA Jetson TX2 NX 上对热图像分割模型做机上训练与推理，并用分割输出闭环控制姿态实时跟踪月球。约一年内完成 12 次实验，证明学习流水线、商用硬件与开源软件可在低地球轨道 (LEO) 的算力与环境约束下可靠运行。
Motivation: 深空任务存在通信延迟与带宽限制，航天器必须在轨自主运行学习算法，而不是把数据下传后再训练。
Method: 在 6U CubeSat 的 NVIDIA Jetson TX2 NX GPU 上做热分割模型的机上训练与推理，分割结果接闭环姿态控制以跟踪月球；数据传输用 ROS 2 Foxy 中间件，并集成提供数据完整性保证与自愈能力的开源文件系统。
Result: 约一年内在轨完成 12 次实验，演示了机上训练+推理与基于实时热图像 feed 的闭环姿态控制，系统在 LEO 算力与环境约束下可靠运行。
Conclusion: 现代学习流水线、商用硬件与开源软件的组合足以支撑航天器在轨自主学习与闭环控制，可作为深空自主系统的可行路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Unlocking Structured Pruning for Reasoning Language Models via Attention-Preserving MLP Trimming
papers.abstract_en: Structured pruning reduces LLM inference costs by removing model components to produce smaller dense models. However, existing methods can cause reasoning performance to collapse on long-form reasoning tasks such as AIME. We propose \textit{LayerTrim}, a training-free structured pruning method that identifies redundant decoder layers and selectively trims their MLP features while preserving attention and decoder depth. LayerTrim is the first training-free structured pruning method designed to preserve long-form reasoning without gradients or recovery training. Across three reasoning language models and five benchmarks, LayerTrim outperforms existing structured pruning methods in most evaluated settings, improving average accuracy by up to 21.4 percentage points over RESP. On \texttt{Qwen3-14B}, LayerTrim achieves 1.24$\times$ faster prefill and 19.7\% lower peak GPU memory than the dense model, while better preserving reasoning ability. It also achieves the shortest average generation length among evaluated pruned models, while retaining the highest average accuracy. These results demonstrate that LayerTrim improves reasoning efficiency through both structural compression and reduced token generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LayerTrim 是免训练的结构化剪枝方法：定位冗余 decoder layer，只裁其 MLP 特征，保留 attention 与 decoder 深度，从而在不使用梯度和恢复训练的前提下保住长链推理能力。在三个推理模型、五个基准上，多数设置优于现有结构化剪枝，平均准确率较 RESP 最多高 21.4 个百分点；Qwen3-14B 上 prefill 加速 1.24×、峰值显存降 19.7%，且生成长度最短、平均准确率最高。
Motivation: 结构化剪枝能降低 LLM 推理成本，但现有方法在 AIME 这类长链推理任务上会让推理性能崩溃，需要在压缩与推理保持之间做取舍。
Method: LayerTrim 免训练、无梯度、无恢复训练：识别冗余 decoder layer 并选择性裁剪其 MLP 特征，同时保留 attention 结构与 decoder 深度，产出更小的稠密模型。
Result: 在三个推理语言模型、五个基准上，多数评估设置优于现有结构化剪枝方法，平均准确率较 RESP 最多提升 21.4 个百分点；Qwen3-14B 上 prefill 提速 1.24×、峰值 GPU 显存较稠密模型低 19.7%，在被剪枝模型中平均生成长度最短且平均准确率最高。
Conclusion: 只裁 MLP 而保 attention 与深度，可在免训练条件下同时换取结构压缩与更少 token 生成，从而提升推理效率而不牺牲长链推理。

papers.title: DoReMe: Dual optimization of Reconstruction and Motion estimation for self-navigated free-breathing abdominal MRI using Gaussian Splatting
authors: Thomas Kuestner (1) ((1) Medical Image and Data Analysis (MIDAS.lab)
Department of Diagnostic and Interventional Radiology
papers.abstract_en: Purpose: Free-breathing abdominal MRI is limited by respiratory motion, which introduces image artifacts and k-space inconsistencies. Existing reconstruction approaches often depend on pre-estimated motion fields or external respiratory surrogate signals. We propose a coupled reconstruction-motion estimation algorithm for self-navigated free-breathing acquisition, in which motion is represented by compact Gaussian primitives and jointly refined with the image estimates during iterative reconstruction. Methods: An iterative reconstruction that alternates between data consistency updates and motion modelling was proposed. Respiratory motion was represented using Gaussian primitives. A Gaussian splatting was integrated into the reconstruction algorithm. The method was evaluated on self-navigated free-breathing Cartesian gradient-echo (GRE) acquisition in four healthy volunteers, including retrospective scan shortening experiments, and was compared with regularized compressed sensing (CS) reconstruction. Results: Respiratory motion states were reconstructed in approximately 1.5 min. Compared with CS, the proposed method improved visual image quality, particularly in coronal liver views, and better preserved anatomical structures in retrospectively shortened acquisitions. These findings provide proof of concept for the proposed method. Conclusion: The proposed coupled reconstruction-motion estimation algorithm improved visual image quality compared with CS alone. Gaussian primitives provided a compact and sufficiently flexible representation of nonrigid respiratory motion with practical runtime, supporting further scanner integration and validation in larger cohorts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DoReMe 把自由呼吸腹部 MRI 的图像重建与呼吸运动估计耦合进同一迭代循环：运动用紧凑 Gaussian primitives 表示，Gaussian splatting 嵌入重建，交替做数据一致性更新与运动建模，不再依赖预估形变场或外部呼吸代理信号。在 4 名健康志愿者的自导航 Cartesian GRE 扫描上，呼吸运动状态约 1.5 分钟重建完成，冠状肝区视觉质量优于正则化压缩感知 (CS)，且在回顾性缩短扫描中更好地保留了解剖结构。
Motivation: 自由呼吸腹部 MRI 的呼吸运动会造成伪影与 k-space 不一致，现有重建多依赖预估运动场或外部呼吸代理信号，缺少把运动与图像同时求解的自导航方案。
Method: 提出耦合重建-运动估计算法：迭代交替执行数据一致性更新与运动建模，呼吸运动以 Gaussian primitives 参数化，并将 Gaussian splatting 集成进重建流程；在自导航自由呼吸 Cartesian GRE 采集上评估，含回顾性缩短扫描实验，与正则化压缩感知 (CS) 重建对比。
Result: 呼吸运动状态重建耗时约 1.5 分钟；相比 CS，方法提升视觉图像质量（冠状肝区尤其明显），并在回顾性缩短的采集上更好地保留解剖结构；实验对象为 4 名健康志愿者。
Conclusion: 作者将结果定位为 proof of concept：Gaussian primitives 是表示非刚性呼吸运动紧凑且足够灵活的形式，运行时间具备实用性，支持后续扫描仪集成与更大队列验证。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Genesis Steering: Better Activation Steering Through Training Data
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering controls large language models at inference time, but its effectiveness depends on the choice of reference data. We introduce genesis steering, which derives a genesis vector from contrastive examples in the model's own fine-tuning data. When these data are unavailable, we draw on the membership inference literature to identify likely training examples and construct a proxy dataset. We establish two theoretical results on optimal displacement to the decision boundary and reduced proxy-estimation bias. We evaluate genesis steering and membership-based proxy construction on Tülu-3-8B, whose fine-tuning data are publicly available, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct as a control. We find that safety data from Tülu-3-8B's training mixture yield stronger steering than external datasets on both models. On Tülu-3-8B, membership scores largely agree in identifying training examples, and vectors built from top-ranked examples achieve competitive performance against random subsets of the same size. In contrast, the results on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct hint that a MIA method will only have a positive effect if the mean direction shift with MIA-filtered in-distribution data is much less severe than the direction shift with OoD data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 genesis steering：从模型自身微调数据的对比样本中抽取 genesis vector 做推理期激活干预，数据不可得时用成员推断 (MIA) 找回疑似训练样本构造代理集。在 Tülu-3-8B 上，训练混合中的安全数据比外部数据集产生更强的转向效果，MIA 排序靠前的样本所建向量与同规模随机子集表现相当；Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上则提示只有当 MIA 过滤的分布内数据的均值方向偏移远小于分布外数据时，MIA 才有正向作用。
Motivation: 激活转向的效果高度依赖参考数据的选择，而模型的微调数据通常拿不到；外部或分布外数据会带来明显的均值方向偏移，削弱转向强度。
Method: genesis steering 从模型自身微调数据的对比样本推导 genesis vector；数据不可得时借助 membership inference 文献识别可能的训练样本构造代理数据集。给出两个理论结果：关于到决策边界的最优位移，以及代理估计偏差的降低。
Result: 在微调数据公开的 Tülu-3-8B 上，训练混合中的安全数据比外部数据集在两个模型上都产生更强的转向；Tülu-3-8B 上各 MIA 打分在识别训练样本上大体一致，由排名靠前所建向量对同规模随机子集达到有竞争力的表现。Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 作为对照，结果提示 MIA 方法仅在 MIA 过滤的分布内数据的均值方向偏移远小于分布外数据的方向偏移时才有正向效果。
Conclusion: 转向参考数据应优先取自模型自身的训练分布而非外部数据；拿不到训练数据时可用 MIA 构造代理集，但其收益取决于分布内方向偏移是否显著小于分布外。

papers.title: From Copying to Composition: How Language Models Develop In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) allows language models to adapt their behavior from instructions and demonstrations in a prompt, but accuracy alone does not reveal how contextual information controls their predictions. We study the acquisition and trainability of ICL with a controlled diagnostic that separates copying a nearby demonstration from integrating information across the prompt. Across 17 models, about a third prefer the copied answer, a few are undecided, and the rest prefer the rule-consistent answer, which goes with higher accuracy and with control by the requested value rather than the closest conflicting example. Checkpoint analyses show that models begin prioritizing task-relevant prompt tokens over conflicting examples long before their accuracy improves beyond chance level. In matched training experiments, synthetic documents that define endings and then query them shift models toward compositional responses on the controlled diagnostic, whereas fine-tuning on definition exercises built from rewritten real documents improves accuracy when prompts reassign label meanings. The results suggest that ICL is not acquired as a single, uniform capability. Instead, prompt control, answer preference, construction without candidates, and transfer can develop along distinct trajectories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用一个可区分「抄最近示范」与「跨 prompt 组合规则」的受控诊断任务考察 ICL 的获得过程：17 个模型中约三分之一偏好抄写答案、少数摇摆、其余偏好规则一致答案，且后者伴随更高准确率与「受请求值控制」而非受最近冲突样例控制。训练分析显示模型早在准确率超过随机水平之前就已开始优先关注任务相关 token；匹配训练实验中，先定义结尾再提问的合成文档把模型推向组合式回答，而用改写真实文档构造的定义练习只在标签含义被重分配的 prompt 上提升准确率。
Motivation: ICL 的准确率无法揭示上下文信息究竟如何控制模型预测，也无法区分「复制邻近示范」与「跨 prompt 整合信息」这两种机制，因而难以判断 ICL 是单一能力还是多条独立发展轨迹。
Method: 构造一个受控诊断任务，把复制最近示范与跨 prompt 组合信息分离；在 17 个模型上测量答案偏好（抄写 vs 规则一致）与受请求值控制的程度，并做 checkpoint 分析追踪训练中 token 优先级与准确率的先后；另设匹配训练实验，比较「先定义结尾再提问」的合成文档与「由改写真实文档构造的定义练习」两种训练数据。
Result: 17 个模型中约三分之一偏好抄写答案，少数未定，其余偏好规则一致答案；规则一致组准确率更高，且预测受请求值而非最近冲突样例控制。checkpoint 显示模型在准确率仍处随机水平之前就已优先关注任务相关 prompt token。合成定义-提问文档使模型在该诊断上转向组合式回答；定义练习微调在标签含义被重分配的 prompt 上提高准确率。
Conclusion: ICL 不是单一统一能力：prompt 控制、答案偏好、无候选构造与迁移沿各自不同的轨迹发展，且 token 级控制先于准确率提升出现。

papers.title: Towards a Data-Centric Understanding of Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been widely applied in embodied agents and robotics for vision tasks. However, MLLMs suffer from limitations in spatial reasoning and perception. Post-training techniques have shown promise for improving these capabilities; yet, there are limited data-driven surveys of such approaches. In this survey, we consider approaches to fine-tuning pretrained MLLMs for spatial reasoning tasks, ranging from supervised to reinforcement learning, with an emphasis on the datasets used. We investigate themes of dataset construction, data modality and annotation, and evaluation of the resulting models. Based on these themes, we categorize research into three groups: dataset design, dataset construction and evaluation. We find four main methods for constructing fixed spatial annotations: rules and templates, LLM prompting, procedural generation, and human-in-the-loop. We also observe substantial variation in evaluation approaches, including different scoring methods, tolerance metrics, and benchmark types. Finally, we identify opportunities for future research in unified dynamic annotation, efficient spatial reasoning, standardization of evaluation, expanded spatial range, and human-centered spatial interactions.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇以数据为中心的综述，系统梳理用监督学习与强化学习微调预训练 MLLM 做空间推理 (spatial reasoning) 的工作，按数据集设计、数据集构建、评估三类归档。归纳出四种固定空间标注的构建方法——规则与模板、LLM prompting、程序化生成、human-in-the-loop——并指出评估在打分方法、容差度量 (tolerance metrics) 与 benchmark 类型上差异很大。
Motivation: MLLM 在具身智能体与机器人视觉任务中已广泛使用，但空间推理与感知仍是短板；后训练 (post-training) 虽有改进潜力，却缺少以数据为视角的系统梳理。
Method: 综述按数据集设计、数据集构建、评估三个主题组织文献，重点考察数据集构建、数据模态与标注、以及模型评估；对固定空间标注归纳出规则与模板、LLM prompting、程序化生成、human-in-the-loop 四种构造方法。
Result: 识别出四种固定空间标注构造方法（规则与模板、LLM prompting、程序化生成、human-in-the-loop），并观察到评估做法在打分方法、容差度量与 benchmark 类型上存在显著差异；论文为 29 页、3 图、2 表。
Conclusion: 未来研究机会在于统一的动态标注、高效空间推理、评估标准化、扩展空间范围与以人为中心的空间交互。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Neural Supervised Clustering for Learning Individualized Treatment Rules with Many Treatments
papers.abstract_en: Learning an individualized treatment rule (ITR) with many treatments requires estimating treatment-specific effects from limited observations per arm. Treatments with similar conditional responses can share information, but linear contrast models may miss nonlinear heterogeneity. We propose nonlinear supervised clustering fusion (NSCF), a neural Q-learning framework with a shared nonlinear covariate representation and low-dimensional treatment embeddings. Pairwise fusion groups treatments with similar learned contrasts, yielding an ITR and an interpretable partition. An alternating algorithm combines neural training, embedding fusion, validation-based partition selection, and unpenalized grouped refitting. NSCF lowers regret relative to a strong neural reference in nonlinear exact-sharing simulations; perturbations characterize the limits of hard sharing. In a melanoma xenograft application, NSCF improves average policy value over the neural reference. These results support nonlinear representation learning with supervised treatment fusion when treatment effects exhibit shared structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NSCF 用共享非线性协变量表示加低维 treatment embedding 做神经 Q-learning，再按学到的成对对比 (pairwise fusion) 把响应相似的处理合并，同时输出个体化处理规则 (ITR) 和可解释的处理分组。在非线性精确共享的模拟中它相对强神经基线降低 regret，扰动实验刻画硬共享的失效边界；在 melanoma xenograft 应用上平均 policy value 高于神经参考方法。
Motivation: 多处理 (many treatments) 下每个 arm 观测有限，处理特异效应难以各自估准；线性 contrast 模型能借力但会漏掉非线性异质性，需要既共享信息又保留非线性结构的方案。
Method: 提出 nonlinear supervised clustering fusion (NSCF)：神经 Q-learning 框架共享非线性协变量表示并学习低维 treatment embeddings，按学到的对比做 pairwise fusion 分组；交替算法依次进行神经训练、embedding 融合、验证集选分组数、以及无惩罚的 grouped refitting，最终产出 ITR 与处理分区。
Result: 在非线性 exact-sharing 模拟中，NSCF 相对强神经参考方法 (neural reference) 降低 regret；扰动实验刻画了 hard sharing 的适用边界；在 melanoma xenograft 应用中 NSCF 提升平均 policy value。
Conclusion: 当处理效应存在共享结构时，非线性表示学习加监督式处理融合是有效的 ITR 学习路径，可同时给出规则与可解释的处理分区。

papers.title: Contextual Credit Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Group-based reinforcement learning enables large language model agents to learn from sparse outcome rewards in long-horizon tasks. Recent methods derive step-level credit by comparing observation-matched experiences across trajectories. However, identical observations can occur in different contexts, and matched peers are not equally informative for a given decision. Moreover, favorable terminal outcomes can obscure redundant actions or detours within successful trajectories. To address these two challenges, we propose Contextual Credit Policy Optimization (CCPO). For the first, CCPO weights observation-matched peers from other trajectories by contextual similarity, computed from frozen LLM representations and accumulated trajectory statistics, allowing peers from similar contexts to contribute more to a step's baseline. For the second, CCPO pairs historical credit, which compares the realized return against the weighted peer baseline, with future credit, which measures the change in contextual outcome value over a short realized continuation. A step is thus credited for the progress it makes, not only for its trajectory's eventual outcome. Both credits are computed in hindsight from rollouts already collected for training, enabling CCPO to address these challenges without an auxiliary value critic. Across two Qwen2.5-Instruct backbones (1.5B and 7B), CCPO achieves up to 97.4% success on ALFWorld and 79.4% on WebShop and outperforms GRPO by up to 21.6 and 18.5 points. Ablations show that contextual weighting outperforms uniform weighting, and that historical and future credit serve as complementary learning signals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CCPO 用上下文相似度给 observation-matched peers 加权，并把历史 credit（实际回报减加权基线）与未来 credit（短程延续中上下文结果价值的变化）配对，让每一步按其带来的进展而非最终结果获得信用，全程事后计算、无需额外 value critic。在 Qwen2.5-Instruct 1.5B/7B 上，ALFWorld 成功率最高 97.4%、WebShop 79.4%，比 GRPO 最多高 21.6 和 18.5 个点。
Motivation: 组强化学习里按相同观测配对同伴来分配 step-level credit 有两个漏洞：同一观测可能出现在不同上下文中，配对同伴对某步决策的信息量并不等价；而成功的终局结果会掩盖轨迹内的冗余动作与绕路。
Method: CCPO 用冻结 LLM 表示加累积轨迹统计计算上下文相似度，对其他轨迹中观测匹配的同伴加权形成基线；再把历史 credit（实际回报对加权基线）与未来 credit（短程已实现延续中上下文结果价值的变化）配对。两项 credit 都从训练已有 rollout 事后算出，不引入辅助 value critic。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-Instruct 1.5B 与 7B 两个 backbone 上，CCPO 在 ALFWorld 成功率最高 97.4%、WebShop 79.4%，相对 GRPO 最多高出 21.6 与 18.5 个点；消融显示上下文加权优于均匀加权，历史与未来 credit 互为补充的学习信号。
Conclusion: 按上下文相似度加权同伴并同时计入历史与未来 credit，能在无 value critic 的前提下改进 LLM agent 在长程稀疏奖励任务上的信用分配。

papers.title: The Gap Is in the Geometry: A Convergent Meta-Analysis of Multi-Facet Aerial and Remote Sensing Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Aerial and remote sensing video is increasingly evaluated like web video, by posing multiple-choice questions to multimodal large language models (MLLMs) over sampled frames and reporting accuracy. This paper argues that this recipe measures the wrong aspect, and supports the claim with a convergent meta-analysis of a broad set of published results, organized in four evidence tiers, in which a claim becomes a position only when collected evidence agrees. Parameter scale exhibits a median of +3.4 accuracy points per tenfold increase on aerial benchmarks, far below a human gap of at least 19 points, whereas acquisition conditions control perception, as 315 of 318 evaluations in 19 within-paper contrasts lose accuracy when conditions such as altitude, view, object size or time horizon become harder. No aerial benchmark in the corpus combines video input with per-task human and random baselines, competence collapses from answering to acting in closed-loop navigation, and the same MLLMs score higher on the aerial benchmark than on ground spatial ones, but lower on studies that test cross-view geometry. From these findings the current study derives five falsifiable principles and proposes the AVU-Card, a reporting card for aerial video benchmarks
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用汇聚式 meta-analysis 指出：把航拍/遥感视频当网页视频、对 MLLM 采样帧出多选题报 accuracy，测错了对象。参数规模每增十倍在航拍基准上中位仅 +3.4 accuracy points，而人类差距至少 19 points；318 个 within-paper contrasts 中有 315 个在高度、视角、目标尺寸或时间跨度变难时 accuracy 下降。作者据此提出 AVU-Card 报告卡与五条可证伪原则。
Motivation: 航拍与遥感视频理解目前沿用网页视频的评测配方（采样帧 + 多选题 + accuracy），无法区分模型能力与采集条件差异，也缺少统一的人类与随机基线。
Method: 对大量已发表结果做 convergent meta-analysis，按四个 evidence tier 组织，只有证据一致时才把 claim 升为 position；分析参数规模、采集条件对比、闭环导航、跨视角几何等维度，并从中推导五条可证伪原则与 AVU-Card 报告卡。
Result: 参数规模每十倍增长在航拍基准上 accuracy 中位提升 +3.4 points，远低于至少 19 points 的人类差距；19 组 within-paper contrasts 的 318 个评测中 315 个在条件变难时 accuracy 下降；语料中没有航拍基准同时提供视频输入与逐任务人类和随机基线；能力在闭环导航中从答题塌到行动；同一 MLLM 在航拍基准上得分高于地面空间基准，但在测试 cross-view geometry 的研究上更低。
Conclusion: 当前航拍视频评测主要度量采集条件而非模型能力，应改用带人类与随机基线、覆盖视频输入和跨视角几何的报告规范（AVU-Card）。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: GroundGUI: GUI Grounding by High-Quality Data and Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Constructing robust GUI agents relies on multimodal visual grounding: the ability to precisely map natural language intents to actionable on-screen components. Despite abundant desktop, web, and mobile benchmarks, high-fidelity resources tailored for diverse environments are surprisingly scarce. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Screen Referring Grounding Dataset (ScreenRef), a comprehensive GUI grounding dataset consisting of GUI screenshots paired with natural language referring expressions and box or point annotations. Spanning desktop, web, and mobile domains, ScreenRef comprises 586K screenshots and over 633K referring expression instances, covering tasks such as text recognition, visual matching, spatial understanding, and refusal scenarios. To boost the model's grounding performance, we propose the Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning (D2RL) method to address the limited generalization of supervised fine-tuning and the sparse reward problem in reinforcement learning. Utilizing ScreenRef, we train Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct via sequential SFT and D2RL training, yielding GroundGUI-8B. GroundGUI-8B achieves 95.2% on ScreenSpot-V2, 63.9% on ScreenSpot-Pro, 65.4% on OSWorld-G, 86.8% on MMBench-GUI L2, and 38.3% on UI-Vision. Among 8B-scale models, it produces substantial gains over models trained on open-source datasets, with performance comparable or even superior to models trained on closed-source data. Code, models, and datasets are available at https://github.com/PrentisAI/GroundGUI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ScreenRef（586K 截图、633K+ 指代表达，覆盖 desktop/web/mobile）与蒸馏到强化学习的 D2RL 训练法，缓解 SFT 泛化受限与 RL 稀疏奖励问题，训练出 GroundGUI-8B。该 8B 模型在 ScreenSpot-V2 达 95.2%、ScreenSpot-Pro 63.9%、OSWorld-G 65.4%、MMBench-GUI L2 86.8%、UI-Vision 38.3%。
Motivation: GUI agent 依赖把自然语言意图映射到屏幕组件的视觉 grounding，但面向多样环境的高保真标注资源稀缺；监督微调泛化有限，强化学习又受稀疏奖励困扰。
Method: 构建 ScreenRef 数据集（GUI 截图配指代表达与 box/point 标注，含文本识别、视觉匹配、空间理解与拒答任务），再以 D2RL 方法对 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 做顺序 SFT 与蒸馏到强化学习训练，得到 GroundGUI-8B。
Result: GroundGUI-8B 在 ScreenSpot-V2 95.2%、ScreenSpot-Pro 63.9%、OSWorld-G 65.4%、MMBench-GUI L2 86.8%、UI-Vision 38.3%；在 8B 规模上明显优于用开源数据训练的同类模型，与用闭源数据训练的模型相当甚至更优。
Conclusion: 高质量跨域 GUI grounding 数据配合 D2RL 顺序训练，能让 8B 模型在多项 GUI grounding 基准上接近或超过闭源数据训练的模型。

papers.title: Similar Models, Broken Odds: Where Luce's Axiom Fails in Chatbot Arena
papers.abstract_en: Chatbot Arena ranks language models with the Bradley-Terry model, which gives each model one score and so assumes Luce's choice axiom. Choice theory predicts where this fails: near-copies are told apart more decisively than their scores imply. On 1.8 million Arena votes, votes between versions of one model are 1.37 times as decisive as Bradley-Terry predicts, between sizes of one generation 1.26 times and between models of one lab 1.12 times; a release a year later gives consistent multipliers, and the effect survives alternative tie treatments, prompt subsets and topics, and timing checks. How alike two models' answers are worded and formatted tracks the effect. A correction with four to six parameters predicts held-out votes better than Bradley-Terry and than models with hundreds of parameters, mostly by modelling ties; frozen and carried to new releases in a test fixed in advance, its gains are concentrated in ties, and better head-to-head odds are not established. The leaderboard order barely moves. With language-model judges and three-answer menus, a near-copy takes votes mostly from its twin when choices are pooled over prompts (log-odds shift +0.10, 95% interval 0.05 to 0.16); within a prompt the shift is smaller and clear for two of four judges.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Chatbot Arena 用 Bradley-Terry 打分即默认 Luce 选择公理，而 180 万 Arena 投票显示近似同款模型被判得比分数隐含的更果断：同款模型不同版本间投票的果断度是 BT 预测的 1.37 倍，同代不同规模 1.26 倍，同实验室不同模型 1.12 倍。作者提出一个仅 4–6 参数的修正项（主要建模平局），在预先固定的 held-out 测试上优于 BT 和数百参数模型，但榜单排序几乎不动。
Motivation: Bradley-Terry 给每个模型单一分数，隐含 Luce 公理，即一个模型对另一模型的胜率不受第三方选项影响；近似复制的模型对被系统性地判得更果断，这一违背会扭曲竞技场式排名的胜率解释。
Method: 在 180 万 Chatbot Arena 投票上检验 Luce 公理的违背，按同款模型版本、同代规模、同实验室分组估计果断度倍数，并做平局处理、prompt 子集与主题、时间一致性检验；随后拟合一个 4–6 参数的修正模型，与 Bradley-Terry 及数百参数模型比较 held-out 投票预测，并在预先固定的测试上冻结后迁移到新版本。另用语言模型裁判与三选项菜单量化近似复制的分流效应。
Result: 同款模型版本间投票果断度为 BT 预测的 1.37 倍，同代不同规模 1.26 倍，同实验室不同模型 1.12 倍；一年后发布的模型给出一致倍数，效应在替代平局处理、prompt 子集与主题、时间检验下存活。4–6 参数修正的 held-out 投票预测优于 BT 和数百参数模型，增益主要来自平局建模；更好的 head-to-head 胜率未被确立，榜单排序几乎不变。三选项菜单下近似复制主要从其孪生处取票（log-odds 位移 +0.10，95% 区间 0.05–0.16），单 prompt 内位移更小，四个裁判中两个显著。

papers.title: DexMimic: A Generalist Dexterous Hand-Object Tracking Policy via Value-Guided Reset Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Achieving human-like dexterous manipulation remains a central challenge in robotics. Learning from human hand-object interaction (HOI) datasets offers a promising pathway to diverse dexterous skills, yet existing physics-based approaches train specialist policies for individual trajectories, thereby limiting skill reuse at scale. We introduce DexMimic, a generalist dexterous hand-object tracking policy jointly trained across diverse HOI trajectories. Efficient joint training requires allocating each rollout to both an undertrained phase and a starting state that supports continued tracking. DexMimic realizes this insight through Value-Guided Reset Allocation, which adapts the initialization distribution online to prioritize difficult phases and select reset states with higher expected tracking returns. We further introduce a benchmark spanning training, fine-tuning, and generalization. Experiments show improved tracking success and training efficiency, faster fine-tuning, and the potential for zero-shot generalization to unseen trajectories and objects; larger training sets further improve efficiency and generalization. Finally, we validate DexMimic on a real-world dexterous manipulation platform.
papers.comment: 13 pages, including 4 pages of supplementary material. Project page: https://zhexiluo.github.io/DexMimic/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DexMimic 把逐轨迹训练的专才策略换成跨多样人手-物体交互 (HOI) 轨迹联合训练的通才灵巧手跟踪策略，核心是 Value-Guided Reset Allocation：在线调整初始化分布，把 rollout 优先分到欠训练阶段，并挑选期望跟踪回报更高的重置状态。实验显示跟踪成功率与训练效率提升、微调更快，并在未见轨迹与物体上展现零样本泛化潜力，更大训练集进一步改善效率与泛化，最终在真实灵巧操作平台上验证。
Motivation: 基于物理的方法为单条轨迹各训一个专才策略，技能难以规模化复用；而联合训练多条轨迹时，若不控制 rollout 落在哪个阶段和哪个起始状态，跟踪训练效率受限。
Method: DexMimic 在多样 HOI 轨迹上联合训练一个通才跟踪策略，用 Value-Guided Reset Allocation 在线自适应初始化分布：优先采样困难阶段，并选择具有更高期望跟踪回报的 reset 状态；同时提出覆盖训练、微调与泛化的 benchmark，并在真实灵巧操作平台上做验证。
Result: 实验显示跟踪成功率与训练效率提升、微调更快，并在未见轨迹与物体上展现零样本泛化的潜力；更大的训练集进一步提升效率与泛化表现，并在真实灵巧操作平台上完成验证。
Conclusion: 把 rollout 的阶段与重置状态按价值引导来分配，是让通才灵巧手跟踪策略在多轨迹上高效联合训练并迁移到未见轨迹与物体的关键机制。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Aggregate Accuracy: Item-Level Transitions in Prompt Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) uses feedback from model responses to improve prompts automatically. However, its effectiveness is usually measured through overall scores, which do not reveal which questions become correct, which previously correct answers become wrong, or whether improvements extend to unseen questions. We introduce Reflective Feedback-Driven Prompt Optimization (RFDPO), a tool that tracks recoveries (incorrect to correct), regressions (correct to incorrect), and churn (all changed outcomes). RFDPO uses this feedback to guide subsequent revisions and records prompt changes throughout optimization. We evaluate RFDPO across five benchmarks covering law, knowledge, instruction following, mathematics, and privacy, using GPT-5 as the optimizer and GPT-4o-mini and GPT-4.1 Mini as solvers. Our results show that overall accuracy can hide substantial changes: in five of nine configurations, churn was at least five times the absolute net change, and a single-item net change concealed up to 17 changed outcomes. Average validation gains were 7.9 percentage points, compared with 5.2 points on held-out tests. In a controlled ablation on LegalBench-Hearsay, item-level feedback reduced churn by 40% ($p=0.024$) while maintaining similar net gains. These findings motivate reporting recovery, regression, churn, and performance on unseen data alongside overall accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 RFDPO，把 prompt 优化的逐题结果拆成 recoveries（错→对）、regressions（对→错）与 churn（所有变化），并用这些逐题反馈驱动后续改写。九个配置中五个的 churn 至少是净变化绝对值的 5 倍，单题净变化最多掩盖 17 个结果翻转；LegalBench-Hearsay 消融中逐题反馈把 churn 降低 40%（p=0.024）且净增益相当。
Motivation: APO 只报总体分数，看不出哪些题变对、哪些原本对的题变错，也看不出改进是否迁移到未见题目，总体准确率因此可能掩盖大量逐题翻转。
Method: RFDPO 记录每次 prompt 改动并统计 recoveries、regressions、churn，用逐题反馈指导下一轮改写；评测覆盖法律、知识、指令遵循、数学、隐私五类共五个 benchmark，GPT-5 作 optimizer，GPT-4o-mini 与 GPT-4.1 Mini 作 solver，并在 LegalBench-Hearsay 上做受控消融。
Result: 九个配置中五个的 churn ≥ 净变化绝对值的 5 倍，单题净变化最多掩盖 17 个变化结果；平均验证集增益 7.9 个百分点，held-out 测试集 5.2 个百分点；LegalBench-Hearsay 消融中逐题反馈使 churn 降低 40%（p=0.024），净增益相当。
Conclusion: 总体准确率会系统性掩盖逐题翻转，报告 recovery、regression、churn 与未见数据表现应与总体分数并列。

papers.title: Backpropagating Verifier Rewards Through Continuous Flow Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has substantially improved the reasoning of autoregressive and discrete-diffusion language models. Language models that generate continuous token embeddings are emerging as a strong alternative, but RL post-training for them remains understudied. We propose \method{}, a post-training framework for continuous flow language models. Such a model denoises token embeddings over multiple steps and decodes them into discrete tokens only at the last step. To obtain pathwise gradients, which backpropagate through continuous actions and have much lower variance than REINFORCE, we introduce a critic that estimates the value of intermediate token embeddings, bypassing the non-differentiable decoding step. The critic must also keep track of the value function as the policy changes; to this end, we design a critic that predicts a value from every token representation and improves policy optimization. Across four reasoning tasks, \method{} reliably improves a continuous flow language model through RL post-training and outperforms baseline methods of the same type.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为连续流语言模型（continuous flow language models）提出 RL 后训练框架：引入 critic 对中间 token embedding 估计价值，绕开不可微的解码步，从而获得可反传的 pathwise gradient，方差远低于 REINFORCE。在四个推理任务上可靠提升连续流语言模型，并优于同类基线方法。
Motivation: 生成连续 token embedding 的语言模型正在成为自回归与离散扩散模型的有力替代，但其 RL 后训练研究不足；离散解码步不可微，直接套用 REINFORCE 方差又过高。
Method: 连续流模型对 token embedding 多步去噪、仅在最后一步解码为离散 token；框架引入 critic 从每个 token 表征预测价值，绕过不可微解码以获得 pathwise gradient，并随策略更新跟踪价值函数以改进优化。
Result: 在四个推理任务上，该框架可靠提升连续流语言模型的 RL 后训练效果，并优于同类型基线方法；pathwise gradient 方差远低于 REINFORCE。
Conclusion: 用 critic 估计中间 embedding 价值可以把梯度穿过解码步回传，使连续流语言模型的 RL 后训练稳定可行且优于同类方法。

papers.title: Theoretical and Practical Advances in Hierarchical Bayesian Deep Learning Methodology
papers.abstract_en: Reliable uncertainty quantification remains an important challenge in AI. Hierarchical Bayesian methods provide a principled framework for this by representing unknown quantities through posterior distributions. Joint inference of neural-network parameters and prior hyperparameters is challenging for conventional Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods due to strong dependencies. In this work, we introduce the multilevel particle marginal Metropolis-Hastings (MLPMMH) method, which combines pseudo-marginal inference for the hyperparameters with coupled sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) across hierarchy of network-width truncations for conditional parameter inference. The hierarchy is induced by a trace-class neural network (TNN) prior with width-dependent decay, motivated empirically by the compressible structure observed in trained neural-network parameters. Under standard multilevel coupling assumptions, we establish that MLPMMH achieves mean-square error (MSE) $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^2)$ at expected computational cost $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$, and verify the predicted rate on a Bayesian regression problem. To address larger-scale applications, we further introduce S-MLPMMH, a practical approximation that replaces the exact sampling components with a PCA-based hierarchy and scalable Bayesian Monte Carlo. Experiments on MNIST demonstrate competitive predictive performance and uncertainty quantification while exploiting the parallel structure of the approximation. Software has been made publicly available at https://github.com/submission-code-anon/mlpmmh-anon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多层粒子边缘 Metropolis-Hastings (MLPMMH)，用超参数的伪边缘 (pseudo-marginal) 推断耦合网络宽度截断层级上的序贯蒙特卡洛 (SMC)，联合推断神经网络参数与先验超参数。在标准多层耦合假设下证明 MSE 为 O(ε²)、期望计算代价为 O(ε⁻²)，并在贝叶斯回归上验证该速率；面向大规模问题的 S-MLPMMH 用 PCA 层级与可扩展 Bayesian Monte Carlo 替换精确采样，在 MNIST 上取得有竞争力的预测与不确定性量化表现。
Motivation: 神经网络参数与先验超参数之间依赖强，常规 MCMC 联合推断困难，可靠的不确定性量化因此受限。
Method: MLPMMH 将超参数的伪边缘推断与跨网络宽度截断层级的耦合 SMC 结合，做条件参数推断；层级由带宽度相关衰减的 trace-class neural network (TNN) 先验诱导。大规模版本 S-MLPMMH 用 PCA 构造层级并以可扩展的 Bayesian Monte Carlo 替换精确采样组件，利用其并行结构。
Result: 在标准多层耦合假设下证明 MLPMMH 达到 MSE O(ε²)、期望计算代价 O(ε⁻²)，并在贝叶斯回归问题上验证了该预测速率；MNIST 实验显示 S-MLPMMH 在预测性能与不确定性量化上具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 借助宽度截断层级与多层耦合，联合推断网络参数和先验超参数可以达到最优的 MSE-代价标度，且 PCA 近似可把它扩展到更大规模问题。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.method: MLPMMH 将超参数的伪边缘推断与跨网络宽度截断层级的耦合 SMC 结合，做条件参数推断；层级由带宽度相关衰减的 trace-class neural network (TNN) 先验诱导。大规模版本 S-MLPMMH 用 PCA 构造层级并以可扩展的 Bayesian Monte Carlo 替换精确采样组件，利用其并行结构。
summary_sections.result: 在标准多层耦合假设下证明 MLPMMH 达到 MSE O(ε²)、期望计算代价 O(ε⁻²)，并在贝叶斯回归问题上验证了该预测速率；MNIST 实验显示 S-MLPMMH 在预测性能与不确定性量化上具有竞争力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 借助宽度截断层级与多层耦合，联合推断网络参数和先验超参数可以达到最优的 MSE-代价标度，且 PCA 近似可把它扩展到更大规模问题。

papers.title: MonoMIP: Multi-Height Inverse Perspective Mapping for Monocular 3D Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Monocular 3D object detection methods increasingly rely on depth-guided transformers, but they operate entirely in the perspective image plane where spatial relationships are distorted by foreshortening. We propose MonoMIP, a dual-decoder framework that adds complementary 3D geometric reasoning through Bird's-Eye View (BEV) features constructed via Multi-Height Inverse Perspective Mapping. We perform IPM at K elevation planes spanning ground to rooftop, producing an ordered stack of height-conditioned metric BEV features that reduces above-ground misprojection and exposes depth-dependent appearance variation across planes. A BEV decoder with multi-scale deformable attention aggregates this multi-height evidence per query, while a depth-guided 3D decoder provides complementary perspective-space predictions. Without extra training data, MonoMIP attains 25.84% Moderate AP3D|R40 on KITTI val and 21.66% on the official test set for Car, outperforming recent published monocular methods on both the KITTI and Waymo benchmarks.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. 18 pages main paper and 14 pages supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MonoMIP 是面向单目 3D 目标检测的双解码器框架：在从地面到屋顶的 K 个高度平面上做逆透视映射 (IPM)，得到按高度排序的度量 BEV 特征，再由 BEV 解码器与深度引导的 3D 解码器互补预测。不使用额外训练数据时，Car 类在 KITTI val 上取得 25.84% Moderate AP3D|R40，官方测试集 21.66%，并在 KITTI 与 Waymo 上超过近期已发表的单目方法。
Motivation: 深度引导的单目 3D 检测完全在透视图像平面上推理，前缩 (foreshortening) 使空间关系失真，缺少显式的度量 BEV 几何证据。
Method: 双解码器框架：在 K 个高度平面（地面到屋顶）上执行 IPM，生成有序的高度条件化度量 BEV 特征栈，以减少地面上方的错误投影并暴露跨平面的深度相关外观变化；BEV 解码器用多尺度可变形注意力 (multi-scale deformable attention) 按 query 聚合多高度证据，深度引导的 3D 解码器在透视空间给出互补预测。
Result: 不使用额外训练数据，Car 类 KITTI val Moderate AP3D|R40 为 25.84%，KITTI 官方测试集 21.66%；在 KITTI 与 Waymo 两个基准上均优于近期已发表的单目方法。
Conclusion: 把多高度 IPM 构成的度量 BEV 几何证据与透视空间深度引导预测互补结合，可以在不加额外数据的前提下提升单目 3D 检测精度。

papers.title: Plan or Retrieve First? A Scale Study of Tool Discovery Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Tool-augmented LLM agents discover relevant APIs from large registries before planning execution, yet finite context windows prohibit injecting all tool definitions into a single prompt. The dominant approach, which we term Retrieve-then-Plan (RtP), embeds the user query and retrieves similar tools via approximate nearest-neighbor search. We study an alternative Plan-then-Retrieve (PtR) paradigm in which the LLM first generates Abstract Tool Stubs (hypothesized function signatures describing needed capabilities) which then serve as retrieval queries against the registry. Evaluating on ToolBench (46,984 unique API endpoints, 50 categories) across single-tool (G1), intra-category multi-tool (G2), and cross-category multi-tool (G3) query subsets, we find a clear complexity-dependent crossover: RtP outperforms PtR on single-tool queries while PtR outperforms RtP on multi-tool queries. This crossover holds at every retrieval budget (k=1 to 20), is robust across registry sizes from 1k to 47k APIs, and is consistent across model families (Gemini 2.5 Flash and gpt-oss-120b). We characterize a stub-hallucination failure mode (the LLM invents plausible but non-existent API names) that acts as a double-edged sword: on simple queries PtR's stubs abstract away proper-noun signals that RtP matches directly, yet on complex queries the same mechanism decomposes multi-faceted intent into functional sub-needs. We further analyze token overhead and show that PtR's extra discovery call roughly doubles inference cost, which pays off on multi-tool queries but hurts on single-tool ones, motivating complexity-adaptive routing as a practical direction, one that can be driven by a zero-cost signal already present in the pipeline (RtP's top-1 retrieval score).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ToolBench（46,984 个 API、50 类）上对比两种工具发现架构：Retrieve-then-Plan (RtP) 用查询嵌入做近邻检索，Plan-then-Retrieve (PtR) 让 LLM 先生成 Abstract Tool Stubs 再检索。结论是复杂度依赖的交叉：单工具查询 RtP 更好，多工具查询 PtR 更好，且该交叉在 k=1–20、注册表 1k–47k、Gemini 2.5 Flash 与 gpt-oss-120b 上一致；作者据此建议用 RtP 的 top-1 检索分数这一零成本信号做复杂度自适应路由。
Motivation: 工具注册表规模远超上下文窗口，无法把全部工具定义塞进 prompt，因此 agent 必须先检索再规划；但主流的 Retrieve-then-Plan 在多工具、跨类查询上如何失效、替代范式是否划算，此前缺少系统刻画。
Method: 提出 Plan-then-Retrieve：LLM 先生成描述所需能力的 Abstract Tool Stubs（假设函数签名），以其作为检索查询对注册表做检索。在 ToolBench 上按单工具 (G1)、类内多工具 (G2)、跨类多工具 (G3) 划分查询子集，扫描检索预算 k=1 到 20、注册表规模 1k 到 47k，并跨 Gemini 2.5 Flash 与 gpt-oss-120b 两个模型族比较，另分析 token 开销与 stub 幻觉失败模式。
Result: 发现复杂度依赖的交叉：单工具查询上 RtP 优于 PtR，多工具查询上 PtR 优于 RtP；该交叉在每个检索预算 (k=1 到 20)、1k 到 47k 各注册表规模、两个模型族上均成立。stub 幻觉（LLM 编造看似合理但不存在的 API 名）是双刃剑：简单查询上 PtR 的 stub 抽象掉了 RtP 可直接匹配的专有名词信号，复杂查询上同一机制把多面意图分解为功能子需求。PtR 的额外发现调用使推理成本约翻倍，在多工具查询上回本、在单工具查询上吃亏。
Conclusion: 工具发现架构没有单一赢家，应按查询复杂度路由：用 RtP 已有的 top-1 检索分数这一零成本信号驱动 complexity-adaptive routing，简单查询走 RtP、多工具查询走 PtR。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Revisiting Generative vs. Dense Retrieval: A Static Value Prior Reverses the Gap
papers.abstract_en: Generative retrieval (GR) has emerged as a strong candidate generator for sequential recommendation as language models and semantic-item identifiers have improved. However, GR is not a uniformly stronger replacement of dense retrieval (DR) in online retail candidate generation. We examine their differences on two Amazon Toys datasets under different metrics. GR leads on best relevant item value among users both methods cover, while DR leads on exact-target recall and relevant value across the ranked list. With deep analysis, we find that popularity contributes the most to GR's measured value lead. Adding the same static item value to DR in one reranking step reverses this lead and keeps recall above GR. Finally, on an industrial-scale internal e-commerce dataset with LLM-judged relevance, we show that a 14B SID-LLM still underperforms a $47\times$ smaller dense encoder.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在序列推荐候选生成上，生成式检索 (GR) 的价值领先主要由商品热度驱动：在两个 Amazon Toys 数据集上 GR 在双方共同覆盖用户的最佳相关商品价值上领先，而稠密检索 (DR) 在精确目标召回与整条排序列表的相关价值上领先。给 DR 加一步静态商品价值重排后，GR 的领先被反转且召回仍高于 GR；工业级内部电商数据上，14B 的 SID-LLM 仍输给体积小 47 倍的稠密编码器。
Motivation: GR 被视为 DR 在线零售候选生成的替代者，但其优势并不一致，且现有对比未拆解领先来源（热度 vs 语义质量）。
Method: 在两个 Amazon Toys 数据集上按不同指标对比 GR 与 DR，做深入分析定位 GR 领先的来源（发现商品热度贡献最大），再在 DR 上加一步注入相同静态商品价值的重排；最后在工业级内部电商数据集上用 LLM 判定相关性，比较 14B SID-LLM 与稠密编码器。
Result: GR 在双方共同覆盖用户的最佳相关商品价值上领先，DR 在精确目标召回与整条排序列表的相关价值上领先；热度贡献了 GR 测得价值领先的大部分；加静态价值重排后 DR 反转该领先并保持召回高于 GR；工业级内部数据上 14B SID-LLM 仍不如体积小 47 倍的稠密编码器。
Conclusion: GR 的表面优势很大程度是热度先验而非检索质量，把同一静态价值先验移入 DR 的一步重排即可反转差距并保住召回优势。

papers.title: How Inner Optimizers Shape Replica Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Training large language models (LLMs) across geographically distributed and poorly interconnected compute pools or data centers has become a topic of significant interest. This has led to increased study of local optimization methods such as DiLoco for LLMs, especially those that use local (or inner) adaptive or preconditioned optimizers, which are critical for high-performance LLM training. However, a central challenge remains: it is well known that increasing the number of model replicas (replica scaling) while fixing the total training budget leads to monotonically decreasing performance. Existing work has empirically demonstrated that the choice of inner optimizer (Muon v.s. AdamW) can significantly improve this trend, but offers only limited explanation of the performance difference. In this work, we consider a range of inner-optimizers and identify two important factors that impact replica scaling: (1) the covariance structure of the pseudo-gradients and (2) the impact of batch size on the pseudogradient's noise scale. Based on these insights, we theoretically and empirically demonstrate that whitening-based pre-conditioning is a powerful inner-optimizer desideratum. Our empirical evaluation extends the results to reveal that whitening-based inner-optimizers achieve strong replica scaling (for 8-96 replicas), with performance relative to DP improving as parameters and data are scaled.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 DiLoco 这类分布式本地优化训练中，固定总训练预算时增加模型副本数会使 LLM 性能单调下降。作者指出决定 replica scaling 的两个因素是伪梯度 (pseudo-gradient) 的协方差结构与批大小对伪梯度噪声尺度的影响，并据此论证 whitening-based 预条件是内层优化器的关键设计要求：白化类内层优化器在 8–96 副本区间取得强 replica scaling，且随参数量与数据量扩大，相对 DP 的性能持续改善。
Motivation: 跨地理分散、互联较差的算力池训练 LLM 时，固定总预算下副本数增加导致性能单调下降；已有工作只经验性地显示内层优化器选择（Muon vs AdamW）能缓解这一趋势，对其成因解释有限。
Method: 考察一系列内层优化器（含 DiLoco 框架下的自适应/预条件方法，以及 Muon、AdamW），从伪梯度的协方差结构与批大小对噪声尺度的影响两个因素入手，理论上与实证上论证 whitening-based 预条件作为内层优化器的设计要求。
Result: 白化类内层优化器在 8–96 个副本区间实现强 replica scaling；相对数据并行 (DP) 的性能随参数量与数据量扩大而改善。副本数在固定总预算下增加时性能单调下降这一既有趋势，被内层优化器选择显著改变。
Conclusion: 内层优化器应以白化预条件为核心设计目标，才能在固定预算的副本扩展中抵消伪梯度协方差与噪声尺度带来的性能衰减。

papers.title: WorldMemBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Memory of Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: As video models enable longer and more realistic interactive experiences, maintaining a world consistent with its history becomes essential. This requires both preserving previously observed content and ensuring coherent world evolution over time. World memory is a critical capability to evaluate alongside visual fidelity and video duration. We introduce WorldMemBench, a benchmark for systematically evaluating world memory in video world models. Across 260 test cases, it assesses static memory through the retention of human identity and appearance, object appearance and geometry, and environmental content and geometry, and dynamic memory through event progression and state persistence. Using controlled camera departures and multi-revisit trajectories, the benchmark evaluates static content against fixed initial references and dynamic events against expected state transitions. It combines appearance and geometry metrics with event-specific assessments, and reports video quality and camera-following accuracy as complementary diagnostics. Evaluation of nine representative models shows that strong static retention does not imply reliable dynamic state evolution, while repeated revisits reveal memory degradation beyond the first return. Human studies support the alignment between our automatic evaluations and human judgments. WorldMemBench provides a systematic testbed for diagnosing memory failures and guiding the development of persistent, temporally coherent video worlds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorldMemBench 用 260 个测试案例系统评测视频世界模型的世界记忆：静态记忆看人物身份外观、物体外观几何、环境内容几何的保持，动态记忆看事件推进与状态持续，通过受控相机离开与多次重访轨迹，把静态内容对照初始参考、动态事件对照期望状态转移打分。对九个代表性模型的评测显示，静态保持强并不意味着动态状态演化可靠，且多次重访会暴露出第一次返回之后的记忆退化。
Motivation: 视频模型要支撑更长的交互式体验，必须同时保住已观测内容并让世界随时间连贯演化，但世界记忆此前缺少与视觉保真度、视频时长并列的系统化评测手段。
Method: 构建 260 个测试案例的基准，用受控相机离开与多重访轨迹采集视频；静态记忆对照固定初始参考、动态记忆对照期望状态转移，结合外观与几何指标和事件专项评估，并额外报告视频质量与相机跟随精度作为辅助诊断。
Result: 九个代表性模型的评测给出两条定性结论：静态保持强不保证动态状态演化可靠；重复重访暴露出第一次返回之后的记忆退化。自动评测与人类判断的一致性由 human studies 支持。
Conclusion: 世界记忆必须把静态保持与动态状态演化分开测，且重访次数是暴露记忆退化的关键变量；WorldMemBench 可作为诊断记忆失效、指导持久且时间连贯的视频世界开发的测试床。
