papers.title: RLPE: Teaching LLMs to Prompt with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Prompting is a widely used method for adapting general-purpose LLMs to domain-specific tasks. Effective prompts can be tedious to create manually, so prompt writing is increasingly handed to LLMs, with recent work training LLMs to write prompts for other models. These techniques either write prompts without observing how the task model behaves, blind to the failure modes the prompt should address, or must run alongside the task LLM at inference time, adding overhead to every query. Neither reflects how prompt engineering is often practiced. To close this gap, we introduce Reinforcement Learned Prompt Engineering (RLPE), which trains a model to analyze traces of a separate task model and write a prompt targeting the failures it observes. RLPE rewards the trained model strictly on prompt performance, so it learns the prompting strategies that improve the task model. The prompt is generated once and reused across the task, so inference does not require the trained model. Since RLPE needs only query access to the model it prompts, it is also compatible with closed-source models. We apply RLPE to Enigmata, BIG-Bench Extra Hard, and PlanBench. We train a 9B-parameter model that writes better prompts than state-of-the-art frontier models (gpt-5.6-sol and claude-opus-5) and prompt optimizers (GEPA and TextGrad) on 2/3 benchmarks. Although the model is never explicitly trained to iterate on prompts, this capability emerges at a level that matches or beats frontier models. The learned prompting capability also generalizes, with the trained model improving task models 6x larger than the one it trained with, including ones from entirely different model families, and matching claude-opus-5 on a fourth benchmark held out from training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RLPE 用强化学习训练一个 9B 模型去读取独立任务模型的执行 trace，并针对观察到的失败模式写出一次性复用的 prompt，奖励只来自 prompt 使任务模型的表现提升。在 Enigmata、BIG-Bench Extra Hard、PlanBench 三个基准中的 2/3 上，它写出的 prompt 优于 gpt-5.6-sol、claude-opus-5 以及 GEPA、TextGrad；prompt 迭代能力在未显式训练下涌现，且能迁移到比训练时大 6 倍、甚至不同模型家族的任务模型。
Motivation: 现有让 LLM 写 prompt 的方法要么看不到任务模型的失败模式，要么必须在推理时与任务模型并跑、给每次查询加开销，都不符合实际 prompt 工程的做法。
Method: RLPE (Reinforcement Learned Prompt Engineering) 训练模型分析单独任务模型的 trace 并生成针对其失败的 prompt，奖励严格来自 prompt 之后的任务表现；prompt 只生成一次并在任务内复用，推理阶段不需要训练模型，只需对目标任务模型有查询接口，因此兼容闭源模型。
Result: 训练出的 9B 参数模型在 2/3 基准（Enigmata、BIG-Bench Extra Hard、PlanBench）上写出的 prompt 优于前沿模型 gpt-5.6-sol、claude-opus-5 与 prompt 优化器 GEPA、TextGrad；prompt 迭代能力未经显式训练即涌现，水平持平或超过前沿模型；在训练中未见的第四个基准上匹配 claude-opus-5，并把任务模型提升到比训练时大 6 倍、含不同模型家族的规模。
Conclusion: 只用任务表现做奖励、离线分析 trace 写 prompt，就能训出可复用、可跨模型家族泛化的 prompt 能力，且推理时零额外开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Conformalized Physics-Informed Weak Regression for Parameter Estimation in Epidemic Models
papers.abstract_en: Compartment models of infectious diseases are often linear in coefficients that are physical parameters or products or ratios of them. We exploit this with closed-form least squares and equip the estimates with distribution-free uncertainty. Physics-informed regression (PIR) fits the parameters to finite-difference derivatives of the data; we introduce physics-informed weak regression (PIWR), which integrates the model in time instead, needs no derivatives of the data, estimates the initial state jointly and is high-order accurate. To quantify uncertainty we wrap both estimators in split conformal prediction, with a calibration population generated by the physics-based model itself, giving simultaneous intervals for all parameters with a finite-sample coverage guarantee. A residual-adaptive factor, computed without ground truth, scales the intervals to each data set (PIWR-RACC). On the eleven benchmark models of disease-informed neural networks (DINNs), PIWR or PIR-FD6 is one to four orders of magnitude more accurate than the reported DINN results wherever the sampling resolves the dynamics, in about a millisecond per fit instead of minutes to hours of training, and the 90% intervals achieve 87-92% coverage in all 88 settings. On the S3I3R model of the original PIR study, PIWR lowers the reported PIR errors by about three orders of magnitude. On real data from the 1978 boarding-school influenza outbreak, a variable-projection variant gives calibrated 95% intervals that overlap those of a Bayesian analysis. On a time-varying transmission benchmark, a B-spline expansion of beta(t) keeps PIR and PIWR linear; they are more accurate than physics-informed neural networks in three of four cases and comparable in the noisiest, with simultaneous bands for beta(t). The complete conformal calibration takes less than two minutes for every benchmark.
papers.comment: 30 pages (incl. appendix), 7 figures in total 20 tables (9 in main text and 11 in appendix)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把传染病房室模型对参数的线性结构用到底：闭式最小二乘拟合，配 split conformal prediction 给出带有限样本覆盖保证的同时置信区间。在 DINN 的 11 个基准模型上，PIWR 或 PIR-FD6 比已报告的 DINN 结果准 1–4 个数量级，单次拟合约 1 毫秒（对比分钟到小时的训练），90% 区间在全部 88 个设置中达到 87–92% 覆盖。
Motivation: DINN 一类物理信息神经网络用神经网络拟合房室模型参数，训练要几分钟到几小时且精度有限；同时参数估计缺少不依赖分布假设的不确定性量化。
Method: PIWR 用对数据在时间上积分的弱形式代替 PIR 的有限差分导数，无需数据导数，并联合估计初始状态；两个估计器都用闭式最小二乘，再外包 split conformal prediction，校准总体由物理模型自身生成，得到所有参数的同时区间；PIWR-RACC 用无需真值的残差自适应因子按数据集缩放区间，另有 variable-projection 变体处理时变传播率 beta(t) 的 B-spline 展开。
Result: 在 DINN 的 11 个基准模型上，PIWR 或 PIR-FD6 在采样能解析动力学处比已报告 DINN 结果准 1–4 个数量级，每次拟合约 1 毫秒（DINN 为分钟到小时），90% 区间在全部 88 个设置中覆盖 87–92%。在原 PIR 研究的 S3I3R 模型上，PIWR 把已报告 PIR 误差降低约三个数量级。1978 年寄宿学校流感暴发真实数据上，variable-projection 变体给出校准的 95% 区间，与 Bayesian 分析区间重叠。时变传播率基准上，PIR 与 PIWR 在四例中三例比物理信息神经网络更准、最嘈杂一例相当，并给出 beta(t) 的同时置信带。全部基准的 conformal 校准耗时不到两分钟。
Conclusion: 利用房室模型对参数的线性结构，闭式最小二乘加 conformal 校准就能在速度和精度上同时压过 DINN，且给出有限样本覆盖保证的参数区间。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Deep Generative Models for Phylogenetic Inference with Complex Evolutionary Processes
papers.abstract_en: Inference of phylogenetic trees from sequences plays a central role in understanding evolutionary relationships, with applications ranging from tracking pathogen spread to reconstructing the history of life. Conventionally, practitioners obtain posteriors over trees using likelihood-based methods like MCMC. However, likelihoods are only available for simple evolutionary models with restrictive assumptions. For realistic evolutionary models, inference using conventional methods is prohibitively expensive, inaccurate, or even impossible. In practice, practitioners settle for using as flexible a conventional method as possible, even though they expect it is misspecified. In principle, we could use simulation-based inference: simulate tree and sequence data from an evolutionary model and train a neural network to predict the posterior over trees given sequences. However it is a mathematical challenge to represent and train complex posterior distributions over trees. Here we present a flexible family of conditional generative models over trees. Our models iteratively build trees using three natural paradigms -- top-down, middle-out, or bottom-up -- and are trained using a discrete diffusion framework. For real and synthetic datasets of up to $65$ taxa and $>10^5$ tokens, our models recover MCMC posteriors much more accurately than the previous state-of-the-art simulation-based method Phyloformer 2. Finally, we compare to IQ-Tree, a popular flexible-but-misspecified conventional method. Our models match its tree estimates on simple data, but on more realistic data, our method is reliably more accurate.
papers.journal_ref: The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一族以离散扩散 (discrete diffusion) 训练的条件生成模型，按 top-down、middle-out、bottom-up 三种范式迭代构建系统发育树，用模拟推断绕开似然不可得的复杂进化模型。在最多 65 个 taxa、>10^5 tokens 的真实与合成数据上，其对 MCMC 后验的恢复精度显著优于先前 SOTA 模拟推断方法 Phyloformer 2；与 IQ-Tree 相比在简单数据上持平，在更真实的数据上稳定更准。
Motivation: 似然式方法 (MCMC) 只在假设受限的简单进化模型下可用，现实模型下推断代价过高、不准甚至不可行；而模拟推断需要在树这种复杂离散结构上表示并训练后验，本身是数学难题。
Method: 构建条件生成模型族，以 top-down、middle-out、bottom-up 三种范式迭代生成树结构，训练框架为离散扩散；通过从进化模型模拟树与序列数据做 simulation-based inference，由序列直接预测树的后验。
Result: 在真实与合成数据集、规模达 65 taxa 与 >10^5 tokens 的设定下，恢复 MCMC 后验的准确度大幅超过先前 SOTA 模拟推断方法 Phyloformer 2；与 IQ-Tree 在简单数据上给出一致的树估计，在更真实的数据上可靠地更准确。
Conclusion: 离散扩散条件生成模型可以在复杂进化模型下逼近 MCMC 后验，并在现实数据上胜过灵活但误设的传统方法 IQ-Tree，使模拟推断成为似然不可得时的可行路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Why Do VLMs Fail at Remote Physiological Measurement? Rethinking with Physiological Grounding and Numerical Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Video-based remote physiological measurement (RPM) has broad applications, while Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide a promising opportunity to enable end-to-end physiological monitoring for future human-aware intelligent systems. However, existing RPM methods rely on task-specific models and cannot be seamlessly integrated with the multimodal understanding and interaction capabilities of VLMs. We revisit RPM with VLMs and provide empirical evidence for two major bottlenecks: generic visual semantic representations fail to preserve fine-grained physiological cues; while discrete token prediction in autoregressive generation is inherently misaligned with continuous numerical measurement. To address these challenges, we propose VITAL (Visual-physiological Token Alignment for Language Models), a visual-physiological token alignment framework for RPM and preserving general vision tasks. VITAL retains the original visual pathway for semantic understanding and introduces an independent physiological pathway to jointly model semantic and physiological information. Moreover, we propose a structured numerical alignment approach to improve the reliability of generative heart rate estimation by enhancing numerical relationship modeling. Extensive experiments show that VITAL improves cross-domain estimation performance on multiple rPPG datasets while preserving the general visual understanding capability of VLMs, demonstrating its effectiveness as a unified visual-physiological model. Code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLM 做视频远程生理测量 (RPM) 时有两处失效：通用视觉语义表征保不住细粒度生理线索，自回归离散 token 预测与连续数值测量天然错位。VITAL 保留原视觉通路做语义理解，另加独立生理通路联合建模，并用结构化数值对齐提升生成式心率估计的数值关系可靠性。
Motivation: 现有 RPM 依赖任务专用模型，无法与 VLM 的多模态理解与交互能力无缝结合；直接用 VLM 又面临语义表征丢失生理线索、离散 token 与连续测量错位两大瓶颈。
Method: 提出 VITAL (Visual-physiological Token Alignment for Language Models)：保留原始视觉通路负责语义理解，引入独立生理通路联合建模语义与生理信息；再加结构化数值对齐 (structured numerical alignment) 改进生成式心率估计的数值关系建模。
Result: 在多个 rPPG 数据集上提升跨域心率估计性能，同时保持 VLM 的通用视觉理解能力；代码将开源。

papers.title: Smart Alone, Blind Together: Why Accuracy Fails to CertifyTheory of Mind in Multi-Agent Teams
papers.abstract_en: Coordinators that act on what they infer about teammates are usually certified by the accuracy of those inferences. We argue that accuracy is the wrong certificate, for two reasons. First, the accuracy needed to act depends on what a wrong action costs, so the bar belongs to the deployment, not the module. Second, a module's errors are rarely independent, and dependence has a sign: positively associated errors help where their damage overlaps and hurt where it compounds, so an accuracy threshold fails in a predictable direction, and once wrong beliefs interact and can do harm, no rule based on accuracy is right for every module. We test these predictions in task assignment, Level-Based Foraging and Hanabi, with injected errors, trained and Bayesian modules and five language models, and in human judgments. Accuracy fails in both directions, approving harmful language-model deployments in Hanabi, where shared errors compound, and rejecting beneficial ones in task assignment, where costly errors are rare. In our tasks it also buys far less redundancy than independence predicts: from GPT-5.4-mini to Claude Opus 5.5, error on teammates the models have evidence about falls from 32% to 11%, but the chance that all three observers misread one falls only from 16% to 9% (independence: 3.4% to 0.15%). We propose certifying the deployment, with a Blind-Spot Gate that prices error costs, pairwise interactions and measured dependence without deploying the module. On held-out data from the cells it was developed on, it makes no significant false approval in 20 splits (accuracy: 3.2 per split), and in preregistered tests on modules it was not developed on, it recovers what accuracy rejects (seven classifiers: regret 0.004 against 0.479) and catches what accuracy approves (a Bayesian module: significant false approvals in 17 of 20 splits for accuracy, 1 for the gate).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多智能体团队里用推断队友心智 (Theory of Mind) 模块的准确率做部署认证是错的：所需准确率取决于错误动作的代价，且模块误差相关、相关性有符号。在任务分配、Level-Based Foraging 和 Hanabi 中，准确率双向失效——批准了 Hanabi 中共享错误叠加的有害 LM 部署，也拒绝了任务分配中代价错误罕见的有益部署。作者主张改为认证部署本身，用 Blind-Spot Gate 在不部署模块的前提下计入错误代价、成对交互与实测依赖。
Motivation: 协调者靠推断队友来行动，但用推断准确率做认证有两个漏洞：所需准确率由部署中错误动作的代价决定而非模块本身；模块误差不独立，正相关错误在损害重叠处有益、在叠加处有害，使准确率阈值以可预测方向失效。
Method: 在任务分配、Level-Based Foraging 与 Hanabi 三类任务中注入误差，比较训练模块、Bayesian 模块与五个语言模型，并纳入人类判断。提出 Blind-Spot Gate：在不部署模块的情况下对错误代价、成对交互与实测依赖定价，用其开发所据 cell 的留出数据检验，并在未参与开发的模块上做预注册测试。
Result: 准确率双向失效：批准 Hanabi 中共享错误叠加的有害 LM 部署，拒绝任务分配中有益部署。冗余远低于独立性预测：从 GPT-5.4-mini 到 Claude Opus 5.5，对有证据的队友的错误率从 32% 降到 11%，但三名观察者同时误读同一对象的概率仅从 16% 降到 9%（独立性假设下应为 3.4% 到 0.15%）。Blind-Spot Gate 在其开发 cell 的留出数据上 20 个 split 无显著错误批准（准确率基线每 split 3.2 次）；在预注册的未见模块上，七个分类器 regret 0.004 对准确率的 0.479，并抓住一个 Bayesian 模块的错误批准（准确率 20 个 split 中 17 个显著错误批准，gate 仅 1 个）。
Conclusion: 准确率不是多智能体 ToM 模块的合格认证指标，因为它对误差依赖的符号和错误代价都不敏感；应改为认证部署，用 Blind-Spot Gate 在部署前定价错误代价、成对交互与实测依赖。

papers.title: Focus, Align, and Diffuse: Time-Series-Aware Keyframe Diffusion for Cardiac Dynamic Synthesis from Sparse Observations
papers.abstract_en: Dense cardiac dynamics are essential for assessing cardiac function, yet in practice clinicians often observe only extremely sparse measurements. However, recovering full dynamics from such sparsity is a highly ill-posed problem due to the lack of temporal cues. While auxiliary time-series signals like ECG provide physiological guidance, effectively exploiting them is challenging due to the cross-modal representation gap and phase misalignment. In this work, we present CardioFAD, a Focus--Align--Diffuse paradigm that reformulates sparse cardiac dynamic synthesis as a recoverability--alignability anchor discovery problem. Our core insight is that resolving extreme temporal ambiguity requires a compact set of anchor states that are both sufficient to recover the visual trajectory and reliable for ECG--visual alignment. We therefore learn motion-salient keyframes under two complementary principles: trajectory sufficiency, which preserves trajectory-critical intra-modal motion content, and anchor alignment, which promotes consistent inter-modal correspondence at these anchors. We implement the Focus and Align modules optimized by the two aspects. Diffuse then performs two-stage generation by first synthesizing keyframes and subsequently interpolating the remaining frames. Extensive experiments on cardiac MRI and echocardiography videos demonstrate superior visual quality, temporal coherence, and improved functional consistency under the extreme one-shot regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CardioFAD 把稀疏观测下的心脏动态合成重构为“可恢复性—可对齐性”的锚点发现问题：先学出既保住轨迹关键帧内运动、又能与 ECG 稳定对齐的关键帧，再由 Diffuse 两阶段先生成关键帧、后插值其余帧。在心脏 MRI 与超声视频的 extreme one-shot 设定下，生成结果在视觉质量、时间一致性与功能一致性上均表现更优。
Motivation: 临床只能拿到极稀疏的心脏影像测量，缺少时间线索使完整动态重建高度不适定；ECG 等辅助时序信号又存在跨模态表示鸿沟与相位错位，难以直接利用。
Method: 提出 Focus–Align–Diffuse 范式：Focus 模块按 trajectory sufficiency 原则学习运动显著关键帧、保留轨迹关键的模态内运动内容；Align 模块按 anchor alignment 原则促进锚点处 ECG 与视觉的跨模态一致对应；Diffuse 阶段先合成关键帧、再插值其余帧，实现两阶段生成。
Result: 在心脏 MRI 与超声心动图 (echocardiography) 视频上的大量实验显示，在 extreme one-shot（极稀疏单次观测）设定下，生成结果的视觉质量、时间一致性与功能一致性均更优。
Conclusion: 极端时间歧义下，用一组兼具可恢复性与 ECG 可对齐性的紧凑锚点关键帧，配合先关键帧后插值的两阶段扩散，能从稀疏观测恢复出连贯且功能一致的心脏动态。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: What Information Buys in Active Inference
papers.abstract_en: Information-theoretic exploration is of primary interest in methodological studies of reinforcement learning (RL) and computational cognitive neuroscience, while the established RL theory builds regret guarantees on confidence sets. This situation leaves open the conditions under which the information-driven exploration found in nature is more advantageous than the exploration of the established RL theory. We put the state-of-the-art methods of these two paradigms, Active Inference (AIF) and Bayes-UCBVI, on an equal footing: both act through the same state abstraction of a tabular MDP with $S$ states, and their greedy forms differ only in the exploration term. We find that AIF's information gain decays too fast to serve as a confidence width, locking greedy agents that explore by it out of the optimal action. Calibrating the information gain by a square root yields calibrated AIF, which attains regret of order $\sqrt T$ for an exact abstraction, but no better guarantee than Bayes-UCBVI for a fixed reward. When an adversary chooses rewards from the agent's data, Bayes-UCBVI's value-specific widths lock out, whereas calibrated AIF pays a factor $\sqrt S$, which no goal-memoryless agent avoids on some MDP whose start states the adversary also chooses. Calibrated information gain thus acts as a reward-agnostic $\ell_1$ confidence set, preferable to value-specific widths when rewards are chosen from the agent's data, not when they are fixed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在表格 MDP 上把 Active Inference (AIF) 与 Bayes-UCBVI 放到同一状态抽象下比较，发现 AIF 的信息增益衰减过快、无法充当置信宽度，会把纯贪心探索的智能体锁死在非最优动作上；对其开平方得到 calibrated AIF 后，精确抽象下遗憾为 √T 量级。奖励固定时它不优于 Bayes-UCBVI，但当对手从智能体数据中挑选奖励时 Bayes-UCBVI 的 value-specific 宽度失效，calibrated AIF 只付 √S 因子。
Motivation: 基于置信集的 RL 理论给出遗憾保证，而自然界的信息驱动探索缺少同等刻画，两者孰优的成立条件一直悬而未决。
Method: 把 AIF 与 Bayes-UCBVI 统一到同一个 S 状态表格 MDP 状态抽象上，其贪心形式仅在探索项上不同；对 AIF 的信息增益取平方根得到 calibrated AIF，并在固定奖励与对手从智能体数据选奖励两种设定下比较遗憾阶。
Result: calibrated AIF 在精确抽象下达到 √T 量级遗憾；固定奖励下不优于 Bayes-UCBVI 的保证；对手从智能体数据选奖励时 Bayes-UCBVI 的 value-specific 宽度被锁死，calibrated AIF 付出 √S 因子，且任何 goal-memoryless 智能体在对手连起始状态也选择的某些 MDP 上都无法避免该因子。
Conclusion: 校准后的信息增益等价于一个与奖励无关的 ℓ1 置信集：奖励由数据决定时它优于 value-specific 宽度，奖励固定时则不然。

papers.title: RingNav: Task-Shaped Circular Memory for Visual Heading
papers.abstract_en: Tiny robots have limited computation and memory, yet visual navigation systems often maintain more state than a task requires. We ask whether persistent memory can instead be shaped by the task. We present \textbf{RingNav}, a \(10.6\)k--parameter visual heading estimator that constrains its memory to the circular manifold \(S^1\). RingNav learns only the turn between consecutive images, while heading is composed directly on the circle. On the TartanAir Visual SLAM Challenge, RingNav reduces mean absolute turn error by \(27\%\) and accumulated heading error over $4$ sec by \(15\%\) relative to a similarly sized learned-memory model. The structured update also gives exactly zero turn for identical frames and exact cancellation under sequence reversal. Without fine-tuning, RingNav transfers to real-world drone experiments and continues estimating heading under severe visual degradation. RingNav runs at $27.3$Hz on Raspberry Pi Zero 2W and can be deployed on an ultra-low power GAP8 processor at $33.4$Hz.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RingNav 把视觉航向估计器的记忆约束在圆流形 S^1 上，只学习相邻帧之间的转角、航向直接在圆上合成，参数量 10.6k。在 TartanAir Visual SLAM Challenge 上相对同规模 learned-memory 模型平均绝对转角误差降低 27%、4 秒累积航向误差降低 15%，并在 Raspberry Pi Zero 2W 上以 27.3Hz 运行。
Motivation: 微型机器人算力与内存受限，而现有视觉导航系统维护的状态远超任务实际需要；航向本质上是圆周量，用一般记忆结构表示既浪费又不利用这一几何。
Method: RingNav 是 10.6k 参数的视觉航向估计器，把持久记忆约束在圆流形 S^1 上，只预测相邻图像间的转角，航向在圆上直接合成；结构化更新保证相同帧转角恰为零、序列反向时精确抵消。
Result: 在 TartanAir Visual SLAM Challenge 上，相对同规模 learned-memory 模型平均绝对转角误差降低 27%，4 秒累积航向误差降低 15%；相同帧转角恰为零、序列反向下精确抵消。无需微调即迁移到真实无人机实验，在严重视觉退化下继续估计航向；在 Raspberry Pi Zero 2W 上运行于 27.3Hz，超低功耗 GAP8 处理器上可达 33.4Hz。
Conclusion: 把记忆结构按任务几何（圆周航向）来塑造，可以在极小参数量下同时降低航向误差、给出可验证的更新性质，并保持跨仿真到实机的迁移与低功耗实时运行。

summary_sections.conclusion: 把记忆结构按任务几何（圆周航向）来塑造，可以在极小参数量下同时降低航向误差、给出可验证的更新性质，并保持跨仿真到实机的迁移与低功耗实时运行。

papers.title: Graph Coarsening Enables Escaping Local Optima in Compute-Constrained Nonconvex MAX-CUT
papers.abstract_en: Because its binary optimization landscape contains exponentially many local optima, MAX-CUT is highly sensitive to initialization. We study Particle Polynomial Relaxation (PPR), a moment-based nonconvex continuous reformulation possessing an advantageous optimization landscape. We warm-start PPR with Combinatorial Multigrid (CMG), a spectral graph-coarsening method that produces structure-aware initial solutions in near-linear time without training data. On \texttt{t2g20} ($n=400$), benchmark instance with known exact optimum, the combined CMG+PPR pipeline reaches $97.5\%$ of optimum on average and $98.4\%$ on the best run. An extended variant with discrete local-search refinement reaches the published optimum on all sixty Biq Mac instances evaluated by a recent neural branch-and-bound method. Using a sparse CSR representation, the same approach scales to G-set instances with up to $20{,}000$ vertices reducing memory requirements by up to $3333\times$ while maintaining a consistent improvement over the CMG warm start. Gains are largest on sparse weighted graphs; on dense graphs we complement the pipeline with spectral sparsification.
papers.journal_ref: OPT2026 (Neurips Workshop)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 MAX-CUT 因指数多局部最优而对初始化敏感的问题，用谱图粗化 (Combinatorial Multigrid, CMG) 为矩基非凸连续松弛 Particle Polynomial Relaxation (PPR) 提供结构感知热启动。在已知精确最优的 t2g20 (n=400) 上平均达到最优值的 97.5%、最好一次 98.4%；带离散局部搜索的扩展版在近期神经 branch-and-bound 方法评测的全部六十个 Biq Mac 实例上都达到已发表最优值。
Motivation: MAX-CUT 的二元优化景观含指数多个局部最优，对初始化高度敏感；计算受限下需要不依赖训练数据、又能给出结构感知初值的热启动手段。
Method: CMG 谱图粗化在近线性时间内产生结构感知初始解，作为 PPR（矩基非凸连续重构）的热启动；扩展变体再加离散局部搜索精化，稀疏图用 CSR 表示，稠密图补以谱稀疏化 (spectral sparsification)。
Result: t2g20 (n=400) 上 CMG+PPR 平均达到最优值 97.5%、最好一次 98.4%；扩展变体在近期神经 branch-and-bound 方法评测的全部 60 个 Biq Mac 实例上均达到已发表最优值；CSR 表示使方法扩展到最多 20,000 顶点的 G-set 实例，内存需求最多降低 3333×，并相对 CMG 热启动保持一致改进。

papers.title: Loss Curvature as a Sampling-Free Proxy for Memorization in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the mechanism behind why diffusion models memorize their training data remains an open question in generative modeling. In this paper, we examine this question from two perspectives: (a) the model-level perspective concerning the onset of memorization in a model during training, and (b) the sample-level perspective concerning the proclivity of an individual sample to be memorized by a given model. We show that the so-called input loss curvature, or the Frobenius norm of the Hessian of the diffusion model's training loss, is an effective metric for quantifying both perspectives on memorization. In particular, we empirically demonstrate that input curvatures averaged across training and validation samples can identify when a model is likely to start regurgitating its training data when tracked over training time. However, this metric is not sufficient for measuring an individual sample's likelihood of being memorized. To address this perspective, we introduce a counterfactual definition of memorization in diffusion models, extending the analogous notion from supervised learning proposed by [Feldman, 2019]. We prove that this counterfactual memorization is controlled by the input curvature of the leave-one-out model, thus establishing a direct theoretical link between a sample's local loss landscape and its generation likelihood. We validate our derived bounds through several empirical experiments and show that input-dependent curvature provides a proxy for memorization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用扩散模型训练损失的输入曲率（input loss curvature，即 Hessian 的 Frobenius 范数）作为免采样的记忆化 (memorization) 指标：跨训练集与验证集平均的曲率随训练过程追踪，可识别模型何时开始复现训练数据；但单个样本被记忆的概率由留一模型 (leave-one-out) 的输入曲率控制，作者据此给出反事实记忆化定义并证明相应界。
Motivation: 扩散模型记忆训练数据的机制尚不清楚，且现有记忆化度量依赖采样，成本高；需要区分模型层面的记忆化发生时点与样本层面的被记忆倾向。
Method: 以训练损失 Hessian 的 Frobenius 范数作为输入曲率度量，跨训练/验证样本平均后随训练时间追踪；将 Feldman (2019) 在监督学习中的反事实记忆化定义推广到扩散模型，并证明该量由留一模型的输入曲率控制，再通过多组实验验证推导出的界。
Result: 平均输入曲率能识别模型开始复现训练数据的时刻，但不足以度量单个样本被记忆的可能性；反事实记忆化被留一模型输入曲率所控制，推导出的界在多组实验中得到验证，输入依赖曲率可作为记忆化的代理指标。
Conclusion: 样本的局部损失地形与其生成似然之间存在直接理论联系，输入曲率因此可作为免采样的记忆化代理，但需用留一模型曲率而非平均曲率来刻画单样本层面。

papers.title: Tracing Morphology, Semantics, and Divergence in Language Acquisition
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the dynamics of language acquisition in Large Language Models (LLMs) is crucial for uncovering how statistical representations evolve into structured linguistic capabilities. However, most existing studies focus primarily on fully trained models, leaving the developmental trajectory across intermediate training stages largely underexplored. In this work, we leverage intermediate checkpoints from open-source models (e.g., Pythia and OLMo) under teacher-forcing evaluation to systematically investigate language acquisition across training steps and model scales. We focus on four core characteristics: morphological structure acquisition, embedding drift, repetition dominance, and co-occurrence effects. Our findings reveal that models acquire morphological structures well before semantic embeddings stabilize. Furthermore, we show that training dataset size has a positive impact on divergence recognition, while co-occurrence during pre-training and repetition during inference have a negative impact on divergence recognition and associative link generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 利用 Pythia 与 OLMo 的中间检查点在 teacher-forcing 评测下追踪 LLM 语言习得过程，发现模型习得形态结构的时间远早于语义嵌入稳定；训练数据规模对分歧识别 (divergence recognition) 有正向作用，而预训练期的共现与推理期的重复则对其和联想链接生成有负向作用。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 语言习得研究多集中在训练完成的模型上，训练过程中间阶段的演化轨迹基本未被系统考察。
Method: 取开源模型（Pythia、OLMo）的中间检查点，在 teacher-forcing 评测下沿训练步数与模型规模系统考察四个特征：形态结构习得、嵌入漂移 (embedding drift)、重复主导 (repetition dominance)、共现效应。
Result: 形态结构在语义嵌入稳定之前就已习得；训练数据规模对分歧识别有正向影响；预训练期共现与推理期重复对分歧识别和联想链接生成均有负向影响。
Conclusion: LLM 的语言习得是非同步的：形态层面先于语义层面成型，而数据规模、共现与重复分别从正负两侧塑造分歧识别能力。

papers.title: Lag: A Mean-Field Optimal Policy for Online Assignment with Reusable Resources
papers.abstract_en: We study online task assignment with reusable resources. This problem arises in peer reviewer assignment, skill-based call routing, rideshare matching, emergency dispatch, and crowdsourcing: Tasks arrive according to a geometric process and must be immediately assigned to servers that become temporarily busy, yielding rewards that depend on the task-server pair. The goal is to maximize long-run average reward. We cast the problem as a contextual restless multi-armed bandit (CRMAB). We derive an occupancy-measure LP (OCC-LP) that upper-bounds the reward of any work-conserving policy. From its dual we obtain Lag, a closed-form index policy. We introduce a scaling regime in which the number of copies of each server and the number of arrivals per step grow together. This regime yields the first deterministic fluid limit for a contextual bandit. In it, Lag is asymptotically optimal. Finally, we evaluate our algorithms on peer review datasets and call center routing. The Lagrangian index achieves 83-99% of the LP upper bound across all load levels. Moreover, the Lagrangian index policy significantly outperforms the natural greedy assignment scheme, improving reward by up to 12.3% on journal data and 36% on structured synthetic instances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把可复用资源的在线任务分配（评审指派、话务路由、拼车、应急调度）建模为 contextual restless multi-armed bandit，从占用测度 LP (OCC-LP) 的对偶导出闭式 index 策略 Lag。在服务器副本数与每步到达数同步增长的 scaling regime 下得到 contextual bandit 的首个确定性流体极限，Lag 在其中渐近最优；在同行评审与呼叫中心数据上达到 LP 上界的 83–99%，相对 greedy 最高提升 12.3%（期刊数据）与 36%（结构化合成实例）。
Motivation: 任务到达后必须立即指派给会临时变忙的服务器，任务-服务器配对决定收益；贪心指派在高负载下损失明显，而 restless bandit 的一般解法难以给出可计算的闭式策略。
Method: 将问题写成 contextual restless multi-armed bandit，推导占用测度线性规划 OCC-LP 作为任意 work-conserving 策略收益的上界，取其对偶得到闭式 index 策略 Lag；引入每种服务器副本数与每步到达数共同增长的 scaling regime，证明该 regime 下 Lag 渐近最优。
Result: 在同行评审数据集与呼叫中心路由上评测：Lagrangian index 在所有负载水平上达到 LP 上界的 83–99%；相对自然 greedy 指派，收益最高提升 12.3%（期刊数据）与 36%（结构化合成实例）。
Conclusion: OCC-LP 对偶导出的闭式 index 策略在 scaling regime 下渐近最优，且在真实评审与话务数据上接近 LP 上界并稳定超过 greedy。

papers.title: Who Should We Listen to More? Welfare-Aware Preference Acquisition for Pluralistic Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Pluralistic alignment needs to accommodate diverse preferences under limited human feedback. Using AI simulators to label preference comparisons reduces annotation costs, but variation in simulation accuracy across individuals can leave some people's preferences poorly represented in training. We study how to allocate human feedback across people to construct training data for pluralistic alignment, and how this allocation affects the trained policy. To make this allocation explicit and controllable, we define a social welfare objective over individual supervision utilities that measure label quality. Each query's marginal welfare gain depends on its expected supervision improvement, the recipient's current utility, and application-designated priority. Welfare-Aware Preference Acquisition (WAPA) uses auxiliary reference models to estimate query gains and individual utilities, then selects queries by estimated marginal welfare gain while updating recipient utilities. We prove exact optimality of the acquisition algorithm for the estimated welfare objective under a fixed query budget and model predictions. Experiments on six Roleplay collections and four OpinionQA regions demonstrate improved supervision and controllable allocation tradeoffs. Policy training on four Roleplay collections improves preference prediction for both seen and unseen individuals. When prioritizing a designated group and poorly represented individuals, acquiring human labels for 20% of comparisons recovers 75-86% of the average predictive utility gap between policies trained entirely on AI-generated labels and entirely on ground-truth labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WAPA 在 AI 模拟器标注偏好比较的场景下，用社会福利目标显式分配有限的人工反馈预算：按估计的边际福利增益选查询并同步更新接收者效用，在固定查询预算与模型预测下证明该采集算法对估计目标精确最优。在 20% 比较上采集人工标签，即可在优先照顾指定群体与代表性不足个体时，回收纯 AI 标签策略与纯真值标签策略之间平均预测效用差距的 75–86%。
Motivation: 用 AI 模拟器标注偏好比较虽省标注成本，但模拟精度因人而异，部分人的偏好在训练中被系统性代表不足；需要在有限人工反馈下决定把标签预算分给谁。
Method: 定义建立在个体监督效用之上的社会 welfare 目标，每条查询的边际福利增益由预期监督改进、接收者当前效用与应用指定优先级共同决定；WAPA 用辅助参考模型估计查询增益与个体效用，按估计边际福利增益选查询并随采集更新接收者效用。
Result: 在六个 Roleplay collections 与四个 OpinionQA regions 上展示监督改进与可控的分配权衡；在四个 Roleplay collections 上训练的策略对已见与未见个体的偏好预测均提升；当优先指定群体与代表性不足个体时，对 20% 比较采集人工标签可回收 75–86% 的平均预测效用差距（纯 AI 标签策略 vs 纯真值标签策略）。
Conclusion: 在固定查询预算下，按边际福利增益分配人工反馈对估计的 welfare 目标是精确最优的，且这种分配优先级可被外部指定并产生可控的权衡。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 定义建立在个体监督效用之上的社会 welfare 目标，每条查询的边际福利增益由预期监督改进、接收者当前效用与应用指定优先级共同决定；WAPA 用辅助参考模型估计查询增益与个体效用，按估计边际福利增益选查询并随采集更新接收者效用。
summary_sections.result: 在六个 Roleplay collections 与四个 OpinionQA regions 上展示监督改进与可控的分配权衡；在四个 Roleplay collections 上训练的策略对已见与未见个体的偏好预测均提升；当优先指定群体与代表性不足个体时，对 20% 比较采集人工标签可回收 75–86% 的平均预测效用差距（纯 AI 标签策略 vs 纯真值标签策略）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在固定查询预算下，按边际福利增益分配人工反馈对估计的 welfare 目标是精确最优的，且这种分配优先级可被外部指定并产生可控的权衡。

papers.title: How Many Ranks Does a Token Need? A Noise-Floor Squelch for Rank-One LoRA Experts
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) applies every rank-one component of its update to every token, and mixture-of-experts variants replace this with a learned router that activates a fixed number of components. We argue that the number of components a token needs is a detection question with a classical answer. A token's responses to the rank-one components of a trained LoRA consist of a few large values on a Gaussian noise floor whose width matches that of an untrained adapter, and the floor carries cross-talk rather than adaptation. We introduce SQUELCH, a router-free mixture of rank-one experts that (i) soft-thresholds each token's responses at a multiple of its own robust noise level, so the active rank varies per token; (ii) chooses that multiple for each module by Stein's unbiased risk estimate, so no rank budget is specified; and (iii) replaces the resulting marginal keep-or-drop decisions by one explaining-away step on the value Gram matrix, which suppresses redundant co-active components and recruits complementary ones. SQUELCH adds no trainable parameters to LoRA. We prove that the squelch is within a logarithmic factor of the oracle input-dependent allocation, that the selected threshold is risk-consistent, and that explaining away is a descent step toward the joint sparse code whose error is controlled by the coherence of co-active components. On commonsense reasoning, knowledge, math, code, and GLUE with LLaMA-3.1-8B, Qwen3, and DeBERTaV3, SQUELCH improves over LoRA by 2.2--3.2 points and over the strongest mixture baseline by 0.8--1.2 points while activating 8.6 of 32 components per token on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SQUELCH 把「一个 token 需要多少 rank」当作检测问题：对每个 token 自身的稳健噪声水平做软阈值，阈值倍数由 Stein 无偏风险估计 (SURE) 选出，再用 value Gram 矩阵上的一次 explaining-away 步替换逐分量的保留/丢弃决策，从而按 token 变化激活 rank 且不给定 rank 预算。在 LLaMA-3.1-8B、Qwen3、DeBERTaV3 上覆盖常识推理、知识、数学、代码与 GLUE，SQUELCH 比 LoRA 高 2.2–3.2 分、比最强 mixture 基线高 0.8–1.2 分，平均每 token 只激活 32 个分量中的 8.6 个。
Motivation: LoRA 把每个 rank-one 分量都作用到每个 token 上，MoE 变体则用学出来的 router 固定激活若干分量；作者认为一个 token 究竟需要几个分量本质是检测问题，而固定 rank 或固定激活数都无法按 token 分配。
Method: SQUELCH 是无 router 的 rank-one 专家混合：(i) 按每个 token 自己的稳健噪声水平的倍数对其响应做软阈值，使激活 rank 逐 token 变化；(ii) 该倍数按模块由 Stein 无偏风险估计 (SURE) 选定，无需指定 rank 预算；(iii) 用 value Gram 矩阵上一步 explaining-away 替代边际 keep-or-drop 决策，抑制冗余共激活分量并招募互补分量。该方法不向 LoRA 增加任何可训练参数。
Result: 在 commonsense reasoning、knowledge、math、code 与 GLUE 上，用 LLaMA-3.1-8B、Qwen3、DeBERTaV3 评测：SQUELCH 比 LoRA 提升 2.2–3.2 分，比最强 mixture 基线提升 0.8–1.2 分，平均每 token 激活 32 个分量中的 8.6 个。理论上证明 squelch 距离依赖输入的 oracle 分配只差一个对数因子、所选阈值风险一致，且 explaining-away 是朝向联合稀疏码的下降步，其误差由共激活分量的 coherence 控制。
Conclusion: token 所需的 rank 可以由数据自身噪声水平检测出来，无需给定 rank 预算或训练 router；在保持 LoRA 参数量不变的同时，逐 token 的稀疏激活即可在多类任务上超过固定 rank 的 LoRA 与 mixture 基线。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Optimization for One, Feasibility for Most: Decoupling Optimization from Feasibility in Chance-Constrained Programs
papers.abstract_en: Chance-constrained stochastic programs (CCSPs) require solutions that satisfy uncertain constraints with high probability. Standard approaches either embed scenarios directly into optimization by considering sample average approximation (SAA)-based reformulations, growing prohibitively expensive and often failing to find feasible solutions; or employ conservative reformulations that guarantee feasibility but sacrifice objective quality by design. We propose ACCESS (Adaptive Chance-Constrained Exploration via Structured Sampling), a structured sampling framework that decouples optimization from feasibility evaluation. First, high-quality candidate solutions are generated by solving many inexpensive single-scenario subproblems, avoiding sampling directly in the constrained high-dimensional solution space. Second, feasibility is assessed separately via large-scale batched simulation over a massive number of scenarios, which is naturally amenable to GPU parallelism. That reduces the search from a high-dimensional solution space to a two-dimensional parameter space controlling conservatism and scenario diversity; while concentrating on candidates near the feasibility boundary, where high-quality feasible solutions lie. We also introduce a variant, ACCESS($δ$), which provides certified feasibility guarantees with probability $1-δ$. Experiments across three benchmark classes and five scenario distributions show that ACCESS matches or exceeds the best objective found by any method in nearly every setting, while ACCESS($δ$) is empirically feasible on every instance. The conservative reformulations remain several percent worse in objective, and SAA is frequently infeasible while taking an order of magnitude longer on the harder benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ACCESS：把机会约束随机规划 (CCSP) 的优化与可行性评估解耦，用大量单场景子问题生成候选解，再用 GPU 批量仿真在海量场景上评估可行性，把搜索从高维解空间压缩到控制保守度与场景多样性的二维参数空间。在三类基准、五种场景分布上，ACCESS 的目标值在几乎所有设置中追平或超过所有方法的最优值，ACCESS(δ) 在每个实例上经验可行；保守重构目标差若干个百分点，SAA 在更难基准上常不可行且慢一个数量级。
Motivation: CCSP 的两类标准做法各有硬伤：SAA 直接把场景嵌入优化，代价急剧上升且常找不到可行解；保守重构保证可行却以设计方式牺牲目标质量。
Method: ACCESS 分两步解耦：先求解大量廉价的单场景子问题生成高质量候选解，避免在受约束的高维解空间中直接采样；再用大规模批量仿真在海量场景上单独评估可行性，天然适配 GPU 并行。搜索因此收缩到保守度与场景多样性两个参数上，并聚焦可行性边界附近的候选。变体 ACCESS(δ) 提供概率 1−δ 的认证可行性保证。
Result: 在三类基准与五种场景分布上，ACCESS 在几乎每个设置中追平或超过任何方法找到的最优目标值；ACCESS(δ) 在每个实例上经验可行。保守重构的目标值差若干个百分点；SAA 在更难的基准上常不可行，且耗时高出一个数量级。
Conclusion: 把可行性评估从优化循环中剥离并交给 GPU 批量仿真，可以在不牺牲目标质量的前提下解决 CCSP 的可行性与算力瓶颈；ACCESS(δ) 进一步给出可调的概率 1−δ 可行性认证。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: How Far Can Coding Agents Go in Visual Generation?
papers.abstract_en: Modern image generation largely relies on specialized generative models that leave the process of image construction implicit in learned parameters. We explore an alternative: general-purpose coding agents that construct images through executable programs. Our study of zero-shot drawing on AgentDrawBench, a 200-prompt benchmark, reveals a distinctive capability profile. Agents excel at preserving structure and satisfying precise visual constraints, achieving competitive results in domains where compositional accuracy matters more than photorealistic appearance, while remaining limited in perceptual richness. Their visual expressiveness varies with the drawing interface, and a qualitative study on reconstruction shows how procedural skills extracted from human demonstrations support different artistic media. We then examine code as an external visual language of thought: a structured, executable representation that agents can construct and inspect. We test it in visual question answering task and find reconstructed visual code retains substantial information for question answering and, in some domains, supports higher accuracy than the original image. These abilities raise a further question: do agents draw on a shared internal representation of scene content beyond a particular drawing program? We explore an internal visual language-of-thought hypothesis, in which a shared, compositionally structured representation supports visual operations across drawing languages. Cross-harness drawings and images assembled from independent single-pixel queries exhibit related layouts and tones. Agents also maintain self-generated room arrangements across viewpoints after visible drawings are removed. These results demonstrate that the coding agent would maintain a consistent and coherent world inside its imagine even before the harness gets involved and the generation starts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文考察通用 coding agent 能否通过生成可执行程序来作图：在 200 个 prompt 的 AgentDrawBench 上做 zero-shot drawing，发现 agent 擅长保持结构与满足精确视觉约束、在组合准确性重于照片真实感的领域有竞争力，但感知丰富度受限。把图像重写为可执行视觉代码后，VQA 精度在部分领域高于直接看原图；跨 harness 绘图与独立单像素查询拼出的图像在布局和色调上一致，支持 agent 内部存在跨绘图语言共享的、组合式结构化的内部表征。
Motivation: 现代图像生成依赖参数内隐含构图过程的专用生成模型，构图过程不可检查；论文要检验用可执行程序显式构图的通用 agent 能走多远，以及其视觉能力是否依赖某个特定绘图程序。
Method: 让通用 coding agent 以可执行程序方式作图，在 AgentDrawBench（200-prompt benchmark）上做 zero-shot drawing，评估结构保持与精确视觉约束满足情况；再把图像重写为结构化可执行的视觉代码并用于 VQA 任务；最后用跨 harness 绘图、独立单像素查询拼图、以及移除可见绘图后跨视角保持自生成房间布局的定性实验，检验内部 visual language-of-thought 假设，并配合从人类演示中提取 procedural skills 支持不同艺术媒介的定性研究。
Result: AgentDrawBench 200-prompt zero-shot drawing 显示 agent 在组合准确性重于照片真实感的领域达到有竞争力的结果，感知丰富度仍是短板，且视觉表达力随 drawing interface 变化；重写后的视觉代码在 VQA 上保留大量信息，并在部分领域精度高于原始图像；跨 harness 绘图与独立单像素查询得到的图像呈现相关布局与色调，agent 在可见绘图移除后仍能跨视角维持自生成的房间布置。
Conclusion: 作者主张 coding agent 在 harness 介入与生成开始之前，就在其想象中维持一个一致且连贯的内部世界，即存在跨绘图语言共享的组合式内部视觉表征；程序化构图路线的价值在于结构与约束可控，而非感知丰富度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Discrete Diffusion Models are Minimax Optimal Under Sparsity
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion models have emerged as a leading alternative to autoregressive models for generating text and other categorical data, yet their theoretical foundations remain less developed than those of their continuous counterparts. For continuous diffusion models, a prominent line of theory suggests that these models can adapt to low-dimensional structure in the data, thereby improving statistical efficiency and generalization. In this work, we investigate the discrete analogue of this phenomenon by studying the statistical rates of discrete diffusion models under sparsity assumptions. By analyzing a nonparametric estimator derived from a regularized score-entropy objective, we establish minimax-optimal rates in the sparse regime. The proposed regularization can be viewed as an adaptation of label smoothing techniques introduced for classification, and does not require the knowledge of the sparsity parameter. This shows that discrete diffusion models can adapt intrinsically to sparsity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在稀疏离散数据上，带正则化 score-entropy 目标的离散扩散模型非参数估计量达到 minimax 最优速率，且正则化形式借鉴分类中的 label smoothing，无需事先知道稀疏度参数。结论是离散扩散模型可以内在地自适应稀疏结构，从而在稀疏体制下获得统计效率与泛化上的改进。
Motivation: 离散扩散模型已成为文本等类别数据生成的主流自回归替代方案，但其理论基础弱于连续版本；连续扩散已有理论表明模型能自适应低维结构以提升统计效率，离散情形缺少对应刻画。
Method: 研究一个由正则化 score-entropy 目标导出的非参数估计量，分析其在稀疏假设下的统计速率；正则化设计改编自分类中的 label smoothing 技术，且不依赖稀疏度参数的先验知识。
Result: 在稀疏体制下建立 minimax 最优速率，表明离散扩散模型可内在自适应稀疏性；摘要未给出具体数值对比。
Conclusion: 离散扩散模型在稀疏数据上具备与连续版本类似的结构自适应能力，其正则化 score-entropy 估计量无需稀疏度先验即可达到 minimax 最优。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: IR-PRM+ with Previous-Utility Prediction: Constant Regret and Best-Iterate Convergence
papers.abstract_en: Regret matching (and its variants) and counterfactual regret minimization are central algorithms in practice for normal-form and extensive-form game solving. Yet these have historically lacked the stronger theoretical convergence guarantees available to optimistic and extra-gradient methods. Recent work introduced IREG-PRM+, a regret matching variant which does have strong theoretical convergence guarantees. However, it relies on a simultaneous, extra-gradient update. IREG-PRM+ is an instance of the more general IR-PRM framework, where empirically optimistic and alternating updates often have better performance. However, the prior extra-gradient analysis does not extend to these cases. We introduce a new approach that covers both settings. For simultaneous and alternating IR-PRM+ in finite two-player zero-sum matrix games, previous-utility prediction recovers the constant-regret and convergence-rate guarantees previously obtained with extra-gradient prediction: external regret bounded independently of T, an O(T^{-1}) average duality gap, and an O(T^{-1/2}) best-current-iterate gap. Moreover, the current duality gap vanishes and the current profile converges to the Nash equilibrium set. The key step bounds the component of consecutive strategy movement not controlled by the existing IR-PRM+ regret inequality using the relative growth of the nondecreasing regret-vector norm rho_t. Coupling this bound across the two players yields recurrences whose effective coefficient scales as 1/(rho_t^X rho_t^Y), preventing unbounded norm growth. We extend the analysis to finitely many simplex learners under a weighted Minty condition and, through the corresponding CFR variant IR-PCFR+, recover analogous guarantees for finite two-player zero-sum perfect-recall extensive-form games under the same full-reach condition as prior work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为 IR-PRM+ 的同时 (simultaneous) 与交替 (alternating) 更新补上此前只有 extra-gradient 预测才有的理论保证：在有限两人零和矩阵博弈中，previous-utility prediction 使外部后悔与迭代数 T 无关，平均对偶间隙为 O(T^{-1})，最优当前迭代间隙为 O(T^{-1/2})，且当前策略剖面收敛到 Nash 均衡集。
Motivation: Regret matching 与 CFR 是求解正规式/扩展式博弈的主力算法，但长期缺少 optimistic 与 extra-gradient 方法那样的强收敛保证；已有的 IREG-PRM+ 虽有保证，却依赖同时的 extra-gradient 更新，而实践中经验乐观与交替更新往往表现更好，其分析无法覆盖。
Method: 提出 previous-utility prediction，用非递减后悔向量范数 rho_t 的相对增长来控制 IR-PRM+ 既有后悔不等式管不住的相邻策略移动分量；把该界在两个玩家之间耦合，得到有效系数按 1/(rho_t^X rho_t^Y) 缩放的递推，从而阻止范数无界增长。分析先覆盖有限两人零和矩阵博弈中的同时与交替 IR-PRM+，再推广到满足 weighted Minty 条件的有限多个单纯形学习器，并通过对应 CFR 变体 IR-PCFR+ 覆盖有限两人零和完美回忆扩展式博弈。
Result: 同时与交替 IR-PRM+ 均获得：外部后悔与 T 无关（constant regret）、平均对偶间隙 O(T^{-1})、最优当前迭代间隙 O(T^{-1/2})，当前对偶间隙消失且当前剖面收敛到 Nash 均衡集；IR-PCFR+ 在与先前工作相同的 full-reach 条件下对有限两人零和完美回忆扩展式博弈恢复同类保证。
Conclusion: previous-utility prediction 把 extra-gradient 预测的常后悔与收敛速率保证扩展到实践中更常用的交替与经验乐观更新，说明 regret matching 类算法不必依赖同时 extra-gradient 更新也能有强理论保证。

papers.title: Scaling Cheap Synthetic Pretraining Improves Indoor Radio-Map Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Real measurements are too limited to train an accurate indoor pathloss predictor that works across a wide range of buildings. Large-scale synthetic pretraining offers a way forward, but real building layouts are also scarce, and accurate ray-tracing simulators are slow, expensive, and often proprietary. We address both problems by introducing a generator that automatically creates diverse indoor layouts and a fast, open-source approximate ray tracer that computes radio maps for them. Using this pipeline, we generate 128M synthetic samples, pretrain ResNet-101 and Swin-T encoder-decoders, and fine-tune them on high-quality benchmark data. Despite simulator mismatch, our ResNet-101 model reduces error by 15% on average relative to the best known methods across five indoor radio-map prediction tasks and improves transfer on a small real-measurement dataset. Both architectures show predictable data-scaling trends: power laws fitted on 2M-16M samples predict the mean normalized downstream RMSE at 32M-128M with 3.33% mean absolute percentage error for ResNet-101 and 7.10% for Swin-T. These results show that pretraining on large amounts of cheap simulated data can improve indoor radio-map prediction, even when real measurements and high-quality simulations are limited.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. This research was in part sponsored by the HESC MESCS RA grant No. 22rl-052 (DISTAL), and by the NATO Science for Peace and Security Programme under grant ID G9270 (OASIS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 室内无线电地图预测缺真实测量与高质量仿真，本文用自动生成的室内布局加快速开源近似射线追踪器造出 128M 合成样本，预训练 ResNet-101 与 Swin-T 编解码器再在高质量基准上微调。ResNet-101 在五个室内 radio-map 任务上相对最优已知方法平均降误差 15%，且 2M–16M 样本拟合的幂律能预测 32M–128M 的下游归一化 RMSE。
Motivation: 真实室内测量太少，真实建筑布局也稀缺，而精确射线追踪仿真慢、贵且多为专有，室内路径损耗预测难以跨建筑泛化。
Method: 提出两部分流水线：自动生成多样室内布局的生成器，加一个快速开源的近似射线追踪器计算 radio map；据此生成 128M 合成样本，预训练 ResNet-101 与 Swin-T 编解码器，再在高质量基准数据上微调，并在小规模真实测量数据集上检验迁移。
Result: ResNet-101 在五个室内 radio-map 预测任务上相对最优已知方法平均降低误差 15%，并在小规模真实测量数据集上改善迁移；2M–16M 样本拟合的幂律预测 32M–168M 区间下游平均归一化 RMSE，ResNet-101 平均绝对百分比误差 3.33%，Swin-T 为 7.10%。
Conclusion: 即便真实测量与高质量仿真都有限，用大量廉价模拟数据做预训练也能提升室内 radio-map 预测，且数据规模效应呈可外推的幂律。

papers.title: Data Density Scaling Laws for Image Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Current scaling law formulations suggest that increasing the number of unique samples in a dataset improves model performance, while repeated exposure to the same samples provides diminishing value. In this work, we examine this assumption for image self-distillation models. Through systematic experiments across diverse datasets, namely Maxar, SATLAS, Waymo, nuPlan, Ego4D, ImageNet, and YFCC15M, we demonstrate that the effects of sample repetition on downstream performance are non-trivial and dataset-dependent. We identify settings where repeatedly training on a smaller random subset can outperform training on a larger set of unique samples. This finding highlights a limitation of existing scaling laws. To address this gap, we propose a modified version of a Chinchilla-style scaling law that explicitly accounts for two factors: the number of unique samples and repetition per sample. This formulation provides a framework for understanding data-compute trade-offs and improves prediction in some regimes where repetition plays a central role, although its benefits are not consistent across datasets. Finally, we examine how subset selection and augmentation affect downstream performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在图像自蒸馏 (image self-distillation) 训练中，重复使用同一批样本并非总是收益递减：在 Maxar、SATLAS、Waymo、nuPlan、Ego4D、ImageNet、YFCC15M 上，反复训练一个较小随机子集在某些设置下反而超过使用更多唯一样本的训练。作者据此提出把唯一样本数与每样本重复次数同时写入的 Chinchilla 式修正 scaling law，但其收益在不同数据集上并不一致。
Motivation: 现行 scaling law 默认增加唯一样本数总能提升性能、重复曝光收益递减，这一假设在图像自蒸馏模型上并不成立，导致数据-计算权衡的预测在重复起主导作用的区间失准。
Method: 在七个数据集（Maxar、SATLAS、Waymo、nuPlan、Ego4D、ImageNet、YFCC15M）上做系统实验，比较唯一样本数与每样本重复次数的不同组合；据此提出显式包含这两个因子的 Chinchilla 式修正 scaling law，并考察子集选择 (subset selection) 与数据增广 (augmentation) 对下游性能的影响。
Result: 样本重复对下游性能的影响非平凡且依赖数据集；存在反复训练较小随机子集优于训练更大唯一样本集的设置；修正 scaling law 在重复起核心作用的部分区间改善预测，但收益在各数据集间不一致。
Conclusion: 唯一样本数不是唯一的数据规模轴，重复次数必须与之共同建模才能刻画数据-计算权衡；该修正的收益并非跨数据集普适。

papers.title: PMO-Dock: Benchmarking Docking, Specificity, and Generalization in Molecular Optimization
papers.abstract_en: The Practical Molecular Optimization (PMO) benchmark standardized evaluation in molecular optimization, but it is built on simple property-based oracles that do not capture structure-based drug design. As the field has moved to docking-based objectives, evaluation practice has become unstandardized, and different methods report results on different docking tasks, often without a shared protocol for fair comparison or sample-efficiency constraints. To address this, we introduce Practical Molecular Optimization for Docking (PMO-Dock), a benchmark and protocol for docking-based optimization consisting of 25 tasks covering hit generation, lead optimization, and a new specificity task requiring strong on-target binding while penalizing off-target interactions. The protocol separates model development from final evaluation: validation tasks are used for hyperparameter tuning, and test tasks are held out for final evaluation and are not used during development. Evaluation on the test tasks is done under a strict oracle budget to reflect realistic drug-discovery settings. We benchmark four diverse high-performing methods spanning different optimization paradigms, Saturn (reinforcement learning), GenMol (discrete diffusion), Genetic-guided GFlowNet, and ChemLlama (LLM-based evolutionary search). Our results show no universally best method across tasks, additional analyses of hyperparameter transfer (cross-task and cross-category) and sensitivity show that transfer is often limited and varies by method, motivating method-dependent selection strategies. This benchmark provides a concrete standard for evaluating generalization to unseen tasks and sample efficiency under a limited test-time oracle budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PMO-Dock 把基于对接 (docking) 的分子优化评测标准化为 25 个任务（命中生成、先导优化、以及需强靶向结合同时惩罚脱靶的新特异性任务），并用严格 oracle 预算与开发/评测分离的协议约束样本效率。对 Saturn（强化学习）、GenMol（离散扩散）、Genetic-guided GFlowNet、ChemLlama（LLM 进化搜索）四种方法的评测显示没有跨任务的普遍最优者，超参迁移（跨任务、跨类别）往往有限且随方法而异。
Motivation: PMO 基准建立在简单性质 oracle 上，无法反映基于结构的药物设计；转向 docking 目标后各家在不同任务、不同协议下报告结果，缺乏统一比较与样本效率约束。
Method: 提出 PMO-Dock 基准与协议：25 个任务覆盖 hit generation、lead optimization 和新的 specificity 任务（强 on-target 结合、惩罚 off-target）；验证任务用于调超参，测试任务留出且开发阶段不可用，最终评测在严格 oracle 预算下进行；对比 Saturn（RL）、GenMol（离散扩散）、Genetic-guided GFlowNet、ChemLlama（LLM 进化搜索）四种不同优化范式的方法。
Result: 四种方法在测试任务上没有普遍最优者；超参迁移分析（跨任务与跨类别）显示迁移往往有限且随方法不同而变化；评测在严格 oracle 预算下进行，覆盖 25 个任务与三类任务类别。
Conclusion: 对接优化的方法选择应依赖具体任务与方法特性，而非默认单一最优；PMO-Dock 提供了在有限测试时 oracle 预算下评估未见任务泛化与样本效率的统一标准。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Action Jets: Learning the Local Shape of the Action-conditioned Data Manifold
papers.abstract_en: World models are a powerful means of reasoning and planning, but many of these action-conditioned predictive models are high dimensional and computationally expensive. These challenges limit the number of action candidates that can be evaluated by a planner. We show that this cost is avoidable for planners over short horizons, which only require local information with respect to the current state. For a fixed state, the frames reachable by varying a low-dimensional action (a camera movement or an end-effector command) lie on a low-dimensional manifold. We estimate the local shape of that manifold directly via a network trained to estimate how each image region moves per unit of each action axis supervised by data collected from samples by the generator. A correction head fit to trajectory data estimates the shape of this manifold region up to a third-order Taylor polynomial. We call this network estimating the Taylor polynomial describing the manifold shape an Action Jet and compute its radius of validity in closed form. By traversing this approximation of the local manifold shape, we only have to perform inference once per state for any number of candidate actions. Scoring sixteen candidates from a single extraction is over 300x faster than with either source generator, and this gap widens with the number of candidates a planner evaluates. We measure against state-of-the-art action-conditioned generators, IRASim and WorldGym on BridgeData V2, a real 7-DoF manipulation benchmark, and FrameCrafter on DL3DV scenes, where we chart from the novel-view generators DepthSplat and LagerNVS. Because only the tangent comes from the generator and every other term from the data, the Action Jet also predicts held-out frames more accurately than IRASim, the generator that supplied its tangent, at short horizons and at over 100x less compute.

TL;DR: Action Jet 用一个网络直接估计动作条件世界模型在当前状态处的局部流形形状：以每个图像区域对各动作轴的单位位移为监督，再用轨迹数据拟合三阶 Taylor 多项式的修正头，并闭式给出有效半径。对 16 个候选动作只做一次提取即可打分，比源生成器快 300 倍以上；在短时域上预测 held-out 帧比提供其切向的 IRASim 更准，且计算量少 100 倍以上。
Motivation: 动作条件预测模型维度高、推理贵，规划器只能评估很少的动作候选；而短时域规划其实只需要当前状态附近的局部信息，这部分开销本可避免。
Method: 固定状态下，改变低维动作（相机运动或末端执行器指令）可达的帧落在低维流形上。网络估计每个图像区域对每个动作轴单位动作的位移（即流形的切向，由生成器采样数据监督），再由在轨迹数据上拟合的 correction head 把该局部区域补到三阶 Taylor 多项式，闭式计算有效半径；遍历该近似即可对任意数量候选动作只做一次推理。
Result: 单次提取对 16 个候选打分比 IRASim 与 WorldGym 两个源生成器快 300 倍以上，且候选越多差距越大。在 BridgeData V2（真实 7-DoF 操作基准）上对比 IRASim 与 WorldGym，在 DL3DV 场景上对比 FrameCrafter（其 novel-view 生成来自 DepthSplat 与 LagerNVS）；短时域上预测 held-out 帧比 IRASim 更准确，计算量少 100 倍以上。
Conclusion: 短时域动作条件规划只需每状态一次局部流形提取，动作候选的打分成本可与候选数量解耦；切向来自生成器、其余项来自数据的构造使精度反超提供切向的生成器本身。

papers.title: CyberArena: Benchmarking AI Agents in Live Symmetric Attack-and-Defense Combat
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are demonstrating increasingly strong offensive and defensive cybersecurity capabilities in the real world. Current benchmarks mostly evaluate agents in isolation against static targets. Real cyber operations, however, are dynamic and coupled: security postures constantly change as attackers and defenders adapt to each other in real time. Static benchmarks quickly saturate and miss an agent's ability to attack and defend simultaneously under live pressure. To address this gap, we present CyberArena, a dynamic, symmetric adversarial benchmark built around multi-round attack-and-defense combat. In isolated sandboxes, two agents compete under identical rules, acting concurrently as both attackers and defenders over continuously changing services. This converts static targets into evolving, semi-open challenges, directly testing an agent's speed and precision in discovering, exploiting, and patching vulnerabilities. To sustain the benchmark's longevity, an automated agentic pipeline continuously generates, reviews, and validates new environments. Furthermore, because pairwise contests are notoriously hard to quantify, we introduce a dynamical model that maps match dynamics into unified, multidimensional scores across offensive, defensive, and domain-specific capabilities. Evaluating 12 frontier LLM agents across 40 challenges in 466 matches, CyberArena separates model capabilities where single-agent baselines hit a ceiling. The trajectories read like a fight rather than an exam: defenders patch one hole and miss the next and certify repairs on stale evidence, while capable agents think a move ahead, planting backdoors for later rounds and, in one case, writing their own packet sniffer to watch the opponent. Beyond a benchmark, CyberArena serves as an adaptable, scalable experimental platform for future research on cybersecurity agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CyberArena 把静态单智能体网络安全评测换成沙箱内两方对称、攻防一体的多轮实时对抗，两个 agent 在持续变化的服务上同时当攻击者和防守者。用自动化 agentic pipeline 持续生成与校验新环境，并用动力学模型把对局映射为进攻、防守与领域能力的统一多维分数；在 12 个前沿 LLM agent、40 个挑战、466 场对局上拉开模型差距，而单智能体基线已触顶。
Motivation: 现有网络安全 benchmark 多是孤立评测静态目标，很快饱和，测不出 agent 在实时压力下同时攻防、随对手调整的能力。
Method: 在隔离沙箱中让两个 agent 按相同规则并发扮演攻防双方，进行多轮对抗，把静态目标变成持续演化的半开放挑战；自动化 agentic pipeline 不断生成、审查并验证新环境以维持寿命；再用一个 dynamical model 将对局动态映射为覆盖进攻、防守与领域能力的统一多维评分。
Result: 在 40 个挑战、466 场对局上评测 12 个前沿 LLM agent，CyberArena 能区分模型能力，而单智能体基线已到天花板；轨迹中防守方补一个洞漏下一个、凭过期证据宣告修复，强 agent 会预埋后门供后续回合使用，其中一例自行编写 packet sniffer 监视对手。
Conclusion: 静态单智能体评测会饱和并掩盖真实攻防差距，对称多轮实时对抗加统一多维评分才能把前沿模型的能力分开，且该平台可作为可扩展的网络安全 agent 实验场。

papers.title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Multilingual Abstractive Summarization: A Comprehensive Study of English and Bengali
papers.abstract_en: Abstractive summarization remains challenging across languages, where linguistic quality and factual consistency may diverge, particularly in low-resource settings. We present a standardized zero-shot benchmark of eight closed-source and open-weight LLMs on size-matched English and Bengali XL-Sum test sets. Our evaluation combines lexical and semantic metrics with reference-free factuality verification and multidimensional LLM-as-a-Judge assessment, providing a comprehensive analysis of both surface-level quality and factual reliability in multilingual summarization. Results reveal substantial cross-lingual variation: GPT-5.6 Luna leads several English lexical metrics but does not maintain the same advantage in Bengali, where LLaMA 3.3 70B achieves the highest ROUGE and BLEU scores. Gemini 2.5 Flash obtains the highest observed Bengali factuality score. Furthermore, evaluation methods produce different model rankings, highlighting the limitations of relying on a single metric for multilingual summarization assessment. These findings demonstrate that strong English summarization performance does not necessarily transfer to Bengali and emphasize the need for comprehensive evaluation frameworks for low-resource languages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在规模对齐的英文与孟加拉语 XL-Sum 测试集上，以零样本方式统一评测八个闭源与开源 LLM 的抽象摘要。GPT-5.6 Luna 在英文多项词汇指标领先，但优势不延续到孟加拉语——LLaMA 3.3 70B 拿下最高 ROUGE 与 BLEU，Gemini 2.5 Flash 拿下最高事实性分；不同评测方法给出的模型排名互不一致。
Motivation: 多语言抽象摘要中语言质量与事实一致性会脱节，低资源语言尤甚；单一指标排名掩盖了跨语言迁移的真实差异。
Method: 构建标准化零样本基准，评测八个闭源与开源 LLM，使用规模对齐的英文与孟加拉语 XL-Sum 测试集；指标组合为词汇指标、语义指标、无参考事实性校验，以及多维度 LLM-as-a-Judge 评分。
Result: GPT-5.6 Luna 在英文多项词汇指标领先，但在孟加拉语不保持优势；LLaMA 3.3 70B 在孟加拉语取得最高 ROUGE 与 BLEU；Gemini 2.5 Flash 获得观测到的最高孟加拉语事实性分；不同评测方法给出不同的模型排名。
Conclusion: 强英文摘要表现不必然迁移到孟加拉语，低资源语言的多语言摘要评估需要综合评测框架而非单一指标。

papers.title: Discovering Undisclosed Concepts in LoRA Adapters for Diffusion-Based AIGC Models
papers.abstract_en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has made diffusion model personalization affordable and widely shareable, but it also creates moderation risks when harmful or problematic content is not faithfully disclosed. Hence, it is desired to develop a mechanism that, given a LoRA adapter, discovers the concept it was trained to generate, so as to support downstream investigation. We characterize the target concept through the conditioning input that most clearly exposes what the LoRA has learned. Such an input should induce coherent LoRA outputs that are distinctive from those of the base model and strongly align with the learned LoRA subspace. We therefore formulate concept discovery as searching for the conditioning input that jointly maximizes output coherence, LoRA-induced distinctiveness, and subspace alignment. Even with a clear objective, however, optimizing it over an open-ended input space is prohibitively expensive, since reliable evaluation of coherence and distinctiveness requires repeated diffusion rendering. Crucially, we observe that an input need not be rendered to determine whether it is promising. Its alignment with the learned LoRA subspace provides a lightweight signal for localizing promising candidates before visual verification. Based on this insight, we develop a two-stage framework for text-to-image LoRAs. Subspace-Guided Evolutionary Search (SGES) uses render-free subspace alignment to explore candidate prompts and retain a compact shortlist, while Paired Visual Identification (PVI) renders only these candidates and compares the LoRA and base-model outputs to identify those exhibiting coherent and distinctive generation behavior. This design enables efficient and reliable discovery of previously unknown concepts encoded in LoRA adapters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对扩散模型 LoRA 适配器未如实披露训练概念的审核风险，提出两阶段框架：Subspace-Guided Evolutionary Search (SGES) 用免渲染的 LoRA 子空间对齐信号筛选候选 prompt，Paired Visual Identification (PVI) 只对短名单渲染并对比 LoRA 与 base model 输出，判定其是否产生连贯且有区分度的生成行为。
Motivation: LoRA 适配器廉价且广泛共享，但其中可能编码有害或未披露概念，下游审核需要在不读训练数据的情况下反推其训练目标概念。
Method: 把概念发现形式化为搜索 conditioning input，联合最大化输出连贯性、LoRA 引入的 distinctiveness 与对学习到的 LoRA 子空间的对齐度；SGES 阶段用免渲染的子空间对齐作为轻量信号探索 prompt 并保留紧凑候选表，PVI 阶段仅渲染这些候选并成对比较 LoRA 与 base model 输出。
Result: 提出并构建了 SGES + PVI 两阶段框架，用于文本到图像 LoRA 的概念发现，通过免渲染信号把昂贵的重复扩散渲染限制在短名单上，实现对 LoRA 中先前未知概念的高效可靠发现。
Conclusion: 子空间对齐可在不渲染的情况下预判候选 prompt 是否有希望，从而把开放输入空间上的昂贵扩散渲染搜索变成可扩展的两阶段流程。

papers.title: Non-Abelian quantum Hall states at strong Landau level mixing: finding anyons with first-principles AI
papers.abstract_en: Non-Abelian anyons, strange particles forming the basis of fault-tolerant topological quantum computing, are predicted to emerge in fractional quantum Hall states at even-denominator filling factors. Identifying which topological order is realized has proven to be a challenging problem that requires an accurate, non-perturbative treatment of realistic Landau level mixing, which has so far been missing from theoretical studies. Here we present the first complete solution of non-Abelian quantum Hall problem that includes all electrons and all Landau levels, for spin-polarized electrons at filling factor $ν= 3/2$. We develop a momentum-resolved neural-network variational wave function, optimized solely on the microscopic Hamiltonian, which gives direct access to the topologically degenerate ground states. Without any physics input about the expected outcome, it discovers a degenerate ground-state manifold whose entanglement reveals anyons with quantum dimension $\sqrt{2}$, the hallmark of Ising-type non-Abelian order. By directly computing the overlap with trial wave functions, we further show that Landau level mixing favors the anti-Pfaffian over other candidate states. Our results demonstrate the power of neural-network wave functions in finding and characterizing non-Abelian anyons from first principles, in regimes of strong Landau level mixing, relevant to many recent experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用动量分辨的神经网络变分波函数直接优化微观哈密顿量，首次在含全部电子与全部 Landau level 的强混合条件下求解 ν=3/2 自旋极化非阿贝尔量子霍尔问题。网络在无任何物理先验输入下找到简并基态流形，其纠缠揭示量子维数 √2 的任意子，即 Ising 型非阿贝尔序；与试探波函数的重叠进一步表明 Landau level mixing 偏好 anti-Pfaffian。
Motivation: 偶数分母填充因子处的非阿贝尔任意子决定拓扑量子计算的可行性，但判定实际实现哪种拓扑序需要非微扰地处理真实 Landau level mixing，此前理论研究一直缺少这一处理。
Method: 提出动量分辨的神经网络变分波函数 (momentum-resolved neural-network variational wave function)，仅以微观哈密顿量为优化目标，直接给出拓扑简并基态；再通过与试探波函数的重叠直接比较候选态。
Result: 在 ν=3/2、含全部电子与全部 Landau level 的强 Landau level mixing 情形下，无物理先验输入即发现简并基态流形，纠缠分析给出量子维数 √2 的任意子（Ising 型非阿贝尔序的标志）；重叠计算显示 Landau level mixing 偏好 anti-Pfaffian 而非其他候选态。
Conclusion: 神经网络波函数可以在强 Landau level mixing 这一与近期实验相关的体制下，从第一性原理发现并表征非阿贝尔任意子，而 Landau level mixing 使 anti-Pfaffian 成为优选候选态。

summary_sections.result: 在 ν=3/2、含全部电子与全部 Landau level 的强 Landau level mixing 情形下，无物理先验输入即发现简并基态流形，纠缠分析给出量子维数 √2 的任意子（Ising 型非阿贝尔序的标志）；重叠计算显示 Landau level mixing 偏好 anti-Pfaffian 而非其他候选态。
summary_sections.conclusion: 神经网络波函数可以在强 Landau level mixing 这一与近期实验相关的体制下，从第一性原理发现并表征非阿贝尔任意子，而 Landau level mixing 使 anti-Pfaffian 成为优选候选态。

papers.title: $λ_0$: Scaling Open-World Egocentric Human Data for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated whole-body interaction with the physical world, yet collecting robot demonstrations at scale remains costly. Human demonstrations offer a scalable alternative, but existing egocentric human supervision often omits locomotion and posture, while embodiment differences and controller dynamics hinder accurate end-effector execution. We introduce HumanVerse, a 500-hour dataset of open-world human loco-manipulation pairing egocentric video with synchronized body and hand motion. Our human-to-humanoid pipeline aligns camera viewpoints and arm appearance, and refines motion references and controller inputs offline to reduce end-effector errors while preserving whole-body coordination. We validate the pipeline through zero-shot transfer to Unitree G1 on representative whole-body manipulation and long-range loco-manipulation tasks, without target-task robot demonstrations. Building on this pipeline, we develop $λ_0$, a humanoid foundation model for whole-body loco-manipulation, with robot-aligned human demonstrations providing supervision for mid-training. Increasing whole-body human data consistently improves downstream task progress. $λ_0$ achieves 90.0% success on SIMPLE and 62.5% across real-world loco-manipulation tasks. We expect this study to guide scalable whole-body human data collection toward humanoid foundation models for richer interaction with the physical world. Homepage: https://lambdahumanoid.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HumanVerse：500 小时开放世界第一人称 (egocentric) 人类 loco-manipulation 数据，配同步身体与手部动作，经视角与手臂外观对齐、离线精修动作参考与控制器输入后，把人类演示零样本迁移到 Unitree G1 而无需目标任务机器人演示。基于该管线的人形基础模型 $λ_0$ 在 SIMPLE 上达到 90.0% 成功率、真实世界 loco-manipulation 任务 62.5%，且全身人类数据量增加持续提升下游任务进度。
Motivation: 人形机器人 loco-manipulation 的规模化演示采集成本高；现有人类第一人称监督常缺 locomotion 与姿态，且具身差异和控制器动力学妨碍末端执行器精确执行。
Method: HumanVerse 数据集把第一人称视频与同步身体、手部动作配对；human-to-humanoid 管线对齐相机视角与手臂外观，并离线精修动作参考与控制器输入以降低末端执行器误差、保留全身协调；$λ_0$ 基础模型用机器人对齐的人类演示做 mid-training 监督。
Result: HumanVerse 含 500 小时数据；管线在代表性全身操作与长距离 loco-manipulation 任务上零样本迁移到 Unitree G1，未用目标任务机器人演示；$λ_0$ 在 SIMPLE 上成功率 90.0%，真实世界 loco-manipulation 任务 62.5%；增加全身人类数据持续提升下游任务进度。
Conclusion: 用机器人对齐的人类第一人称全身演示做 mid-training，可以不依赖目标任务机器人演示就支撑人形 loco-manipulation 基础模型，且数据规模越大下游进度越高。

papers.title: Virtual-Alloy Physics-Aware Semantic System for extrapolative prediction of perovskite solar cells
papers.abstract_en: Existing machine-learning models for perovskite solar cells struggle to predict devices made from new materials. Most treat device layers as arbitrary categorical labels and represent perovskite absorbers either through featureless composition vectors or through rigid crystal graphs that require a pre-solved unit cell. As a result, they cannot generalize to unrecorded alloys or unfamiliar cell architectures. We present the Virtual-Alloy Physics-Aware Semantic System (V-PaSS), an architecture built around the physical continuity of perovskite solid solutions. V-PaSS represents arbitrary mixed-cation, mixed-halide absorbers by interpolating relaxed crystal graphs of 23 pure $ABX_3$ endpoint compounds via Vegard's law with learned bandgap bowing. For the device stack, it couples layer sequence and cell polarity (n-i-p or p-i-n) with interfacial band offsets and encodes chemical descriptions with a scientific language model. Evaluated under an institution-grouped protocol where test devices come exclusively from unseen laboratories, an untuned default configuration of V-PaSS achieves the lowest error among fourteen tested models (2.861% MAE, a 5.2% relative reduction over a gradient-boosted baseline at 3.017%, and outperforming the best tuned benchmark at 2.912%). V-PaSS pulls furthest ahead where test devices differ most from training: reducing error by 15.7-19.0% on unseen absorber alloys, by 16.1% on mixed absorbers from new laboratories, and widening its lead over the baseline by 3.6$\times$ on devices with unobserved transport layers. Combined with tree ensembles, V-PaSS sets a new state of the art across all five benchmark splits.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 4 figures, 16 tables; Supporting Information included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: V-PaSS 用 Vegard 定律插值 23 个纯 ABX3 端元的弛豫晶体图并引入可学习带隙 bowing 来表示任意混阳离子/混卤钙钛矿吸收层，器件层则把层序、n-i-p/p-i-n 极性与界面带阶耦合，并用科学语言模型编码化学描述。在机构分组协议（测试器件全部来自未见过的实验室）下，未调参默认配置在 14 个模型中 MAE 最低，为 2.861%，相对梯度提升基线 3.017% 降低 5.2%，并优于最佳调参基准 2.912%。
Motivation: 现有钙钛矿太阳能电池 ML 模型把器件各层当作任意类别标签，吸收层要么用无结构成分向量、要么用需要预先解出晶胞的刚性晶体图，因而无法泛化到未记录的合金或陌生电池结构。
Method: V-PaSS 通过 Vegard 定律插值 23 个纯 ABX3 端元的弛豫晶体图并加入可学习带隙 bowing 来表示混阳离子、混卤吸收层；器件堆叠侧把层序与电池极性（n-i-p 或 p-i-n）和界面带阶耦合，化学描述交给科学语言模型编码；评测采用机构分组协议，测试器件全部来自未见实验室。
Result: 未调参默认 V-PaSS 在 14 个受测模型中 MAE 最低，为 2.861%，相对梯度提升基线 3.017% 降低 5.2%，并优于最佳调参基准 2.912%。在与训练差异最大的子集上领先最多：未见吸收层合金误差降低 15.7–19.0%，来自新实验室的混合吸收层降低 16.1%，在含未观测传输层的器件上对基线的领先幅度扩大 3.6 倍。与树集成结合后，V-PaSS 在全部五个基准划分上取得新的最先进水平。
Conclusion: 把吸收层表示建立在固溶体物理连续性（端元插值 + 带隙 bowing）并显式编码层序、极性与带阶，是在未见合金、新实验室与未观测传输层上提升外推精度的关键；未调参配置即可超越调参基准。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Limits of Statistical Assurance for Embodied and Agentic AI under Adaptive Adversaries
papers.abstract_en: Finite safety assessments cannot exclude an adversary that preserves unattacked behavior until certification and activates afterward. We characterize this limitation for embodied and tool-use AI. An adversary that matches the complete observation law until observable, irrevocable certification and retains intervention access afterward attains $v\mathbb{E}[(n-S_0)_+]$ expected post-certification events over $n$ trials, where $v$ is the active event probability and $S_0$ the unattacked certification time. The result covers adaptive and privately randomized evaluators. Switching at certification is exactly optimal for a fixed likelihood-ratio test under memoryless, event-increasing interventions without a binding intervention budget. A positive clean-certification requirement forces linear worst-case expected excess when intervention raises event rates over an authorized deployment horizon, even if certification is deferred to the deadline. In simulated RoCo collaboration, switching yields commanded-separation violations in 34 of 36 post-certification episodes. Preregistered randomized AgentDojo trials estimate 1.98 additional security violations per four-task continuation (95% interval [1.67, 2.29]). An adversarial language-model controller infers hidden certification from noisy evaluation receipts and times intervention accordingly. With permanent revocation, a mixture likelihood-ratio monitor bounds cumulative excess above a prespecified reference rate at square-root order, up to logarithmic factors, on every sample path. A single fixed alternative can permit linear expected excess under stationary attacks. Against a controller observing the monitor's rule and statistic, live mixture monitoring reduces violations from 12.00 to 3.81 per 24 assigned task opportunities. Revocation also reduces tasks executed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 有限期安全评估无法排除「认证前保持无攻击行为、认证后才激活」的自适应对手：该对手在 n 次试验中可获得 vE[(n-S0)+] 的认证后期望事件数，且对固定似然比检验而言在认证点切换恰好最优。正向清洁认证要求会强制线性最坏超额；带永久撤销的 mixture 似然比监视器把累积超额压到平方根量级（差对数因子），实测中把违规从 12.00 降到 3.81 每 24 个任务机会。
Motivation: 对具身与工具使用 AI 的有限安全评估无法排除延迟激活的对手：对手在认证前匹配完整观测律、认证后才干预，认证结果因此不能约束部署后行为。
Method: 刻画匹配观测律至不可逆认证点、并保留干预通道的对手的期望事件上界，覆盖自适应与私有随机化评估者；证明在无干预预算、无记忆且事件递增的干预下，认证点切换对固定似然比检验恰好最优；再给出 mixture 似然比监视器加永久撤销的路径wise 上界，并用 RoCo 协作仿真、预注册随机化 AgentDojo 试验与一个从含噪评估回执推断隐藏认证的语言模型控制器检验。
Result: 对手在 n 次试验中取得 vE[(n-S0)+] 期望认证后事件；正向清洁认证要求在线性上强制最坏期望超额，即使把认证推迟到截止时刻。RoCo 仿真中切换策略在 36 个认证后片段里有 34 个产生指令间隔违规；预注册 AgentDojo 试验估计每四任务续跑多出 1.98 起安全违规（95% 区间 [1.67, 2.29]）。永久撤销下 mixture 监视器把累积超额压到平方根量级（差对数因子），但单一固定备择在平稳攻击下仍可允许线性期望超额；对手观测到监视器规则与统计量时，实时 mixture 监控把违规从 12.00 降到 3.81 每 24 个任务机会，同时减少被执行的任务数。
Conclusion: 有限期认证加事后干预通道在数学上无法给出统计保证，除非引入永久撤销一类的持续机制；持续 mixture 监控能显著压低违规但同时牺牲任务完成量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Physical Layer Anomaly Detection via Adaptive Gaussian Mixture Model
papers.abstract_en: Physical-layer spoofing attacks pose a critical threat to wireless localization systems by manipulating channel state information (CSI). Detecting such attacks becomes particularly challenging when the attacker and the legitimate node are spatially proximate, as their CSI characteristics become increasingly similar. To address this challenge in indoor scenarios, we propose an adaptive Gaussian mixture model (GMM)-based detection framework that learns legitimate CSI patterns and detects spatial inconsistency through statistical anomaly detection. Using a massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) experimental dataset with 64 uniform linear array (ULA) antenna and 5 mm spatial resolution, we evaluated our detector against CSI spoofing attacks with spatial displacements ranging from 50 mm to 450 mm. The adaptive GMM achieves 95-98% detection rate for displacements above 150 mm while maintaining 1% false alarm rate. We benchmark our approach against conventional GMM, local outlier factor (LOF), one-class support vector machine (SVM) and k-nearest neighbors (k-NN) classifiers, demonstrating overall superior detection performance of our proposed classifier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对无线定位中的物理层欺骗攻击，提出自适应高斯混合模型 (adaptive GMM) 框架：学习合法 CSI 模式，再用统计异常检测识别空间不一致。在含 64 阵元 ULA、5 mm 空间分辨率的 massive MIMO 实验数据集上，对 150 mm 以上空间位移的欺骗攻击取得 95–98% 检出率，同时保持 1% 虚警率。
Motivation: 物理层欺骗攻击通过操纵 CSI 威胁无线定位；当攻击者与合法节点空间接近、CSI 特性趋同时，检测尤为困难。
Method: 自适应 GMM 学习合法 CSI 分布，通过统计异常检测判断空间一致性；在 64 阵元 ULA、5 mm 分辨率的 massive MIMO 实验数据上测试 50–450 mm 位移的欺骗攻击，并与常规 GMM、LOF、one-class SVM、k-NN 对比。
Result: 位移大于 150 mm 时检出率 95–98%，虚警率 1%；整体检测性能优于常规 GMM、LOF、one-class SVM 与 k-NN 基线。
Conclusion: 自适应 GMM 能在保持低虚警的前提下有效检出近距离物理层 CSI 欺骗，性能超过所比较的传统异常检测分类器。

summary_sections.method: 自适应 GMM 学习合法 CSI 分布，通过统计异常检测判断空间一致性；在 64 阵元 ULA、5 mm 分辨率的 massive MIMO 实验数据上测试 50–450 mm 位移的欺骗攻击，并与常规 GMM、LOF、one-class SVM、k-NN 对比。
summary_sections.result: 位移大于 150 mm 时检出率 95–98%，虚警率 1%；整体检测性能优于常规 GMM、LOF、one-class SVM 与 k-NN 基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 自适应 GMM 能在保持低虚警的前提下有效检出近距离物理层 CSI 欺骗，性能超过所比较的传统异常检测分类器。

papers.title: Semi-Amortized Bayesian Inference with Reusable Local Posteriors
papers.abstract_en: Amortized Bayesian inference uses simulations to perform Bayesian estimation when likelihoods are expensive or analytically unavailable. However, learning the full joint posterior is challenging in high-dimensional models with complex dependencies. We introduce a semi-amortized method that divides parameters into smaller blocks, and uses conditional independence to identify the information needed to infer each block. We train neural estimators for blocks whose posterior updates are computationally expensive or frequently repeated. Each estimator learns from simulations of the relevant model components to approximate the block's full conditional posterior, given the relevant observations and the values of the variables on which it depends. A Markov chain then alternates direct draws from these estimators with conventional updates of the remaining variables. Each neural update uses the current conditioning values and requires neither likelihood evaluation nor an acceptance-rejection step. Where the same conditional structure recurs, one estimator can be reused across blocks and datasets, with an output dimension determined by the block rather than the full model. We illustrate the approach in high-dimensional and computationally expensive hierarchical and spatiotemporal models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出半摊销 (semi-amortized) 贝叶斯推断：按条件独立把参数切成小块，为计算昂贵或反复出现的块训练神经估计器近似其 full conditional posterior，再用马尔可夫链交替直接从估计器抽样与对其余变量的常规更新。每次神经更新只用当前条件值，不需要似然评估也不需要接受-拒绝步骤；当同一条件结构复用时，一个估计器可跨块与跨数据集复用，输出维度由块而非全模型决定。
Motivation: 似然昂贵或无解析形式时，摊销推断要靠模拟学全联合后验，而高维、依赖复杂的模型（如分层与时空模型）让这种全后验学习变得困难。
Method: 用条件独立识别推断每个参数块所需的信息，把参数划分为更小的块；为后验更新计算昂贵或频繁重复的块训练神经估计器，每个估计器只从相关模型组件的模拟中学习，在给定相关观测与依赖变量取值下逼近该块的 full conditional posterior；马尔可夫链交替从这些估计器直接抽样与对其余变量的常规更新，且同一条件结构复用同一估计器，输出维度由块决定。
Result: 在高维且计算昂贵的分层模型与时空模型上说明该方法的可行性；每次神经更新无需似然评估与接受-拒绝步骤，估计器可跨块与跨数据集复用。
Conclusion: 把高维联合后验拆成条件独立的块并只对昂贵块做摊销学习，可以在不评估似然的马尔可夫链更新中复用局部后验估计器。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Wong--Zakai Convergence and FNO Learning for Stochastic Volterra Equations
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies Wong--Zakai convergence and Fourier neural operator learning for stochastic Volterra integral equations (SVIEs) describing random systems with memory. A Wong--Zakai theorem establishes convergence of pathwise solutions driven by piecewise linear approximations of Brownian motion to the corresponding SVIE solution. This convergence provides a foundation for using mirror-padded Fourier neural operators to learn the solution operator mapping initial conditions and driving noise to entire solution trajectories. Numerical experiments demonstrate competitive prediction accuracy and generalization to temporal grids finer than those used for training, while assessing the influence of padding and computational cost. As a follow-up to \citet{LKP:26}, this study extends their operator-learning framework to SVIEs through separate convergence and approximation analyses tailored to convolutional memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对带记忆的随机 Volterra 积分方程 (SVIE)，先证明分段线性 Brownian 逼近驱动的路径解收敛到 SVIE 解（Wong--Zakai 定理），再据此用 mirror-padded Fourier neural operator 学习从初值与驱动噪声到整条解轨迹的算子。数值实验显示预测精度具竞争力，并能泛化到比训练更细的时间网格。
Motivation: 带卷积记忆的随机 Volterra 系统缺少 Wong--Zakai 型收敛保证，算子学习框架无法直接套用到含记忆项的解算子上。
Method: 先建立分段线性 Brownian 逼近下路径解到 SVIE 解的 Wong--Zakai 收敛定理，再用 mirror padding 的 Fourier neural operator 学习解算子；收敛分析与逼近分析分别针对卷积记忆单独构造，并考察 padding 与计算开销的影响。
Result: 数值实验展示具竞争力的预测精度，以及对比训练所用更细时间网格的泛化能力；同时评估了 padding 方式与计算成本的影响。
Conclusion: Wong--Zakai 收敛为用 FNO 学习 SVIE 解算子提供了理论基础，该框架可从 LKP:26 的无记忆设定扩展到含卷积记忆的随机系统。
