papers.title: Beyond Equation Search: Conjecture-Guided Discovery with SCOPE and ClosureBench
papers.abstract_en: Most symbolic regression methods optimize candidate equations, but improving an equation's fit does not establish whether its underlying scientific conjecture should be retained, revised, or rejected. A conjecture may admit multiple mathematical realizations, and similarly accurate equations may imply different explanations. This motivates a shift from refining individual expressions to developing and testing the conjectures that guide them. We introduce SCOPE, a framework that sustains multiple conjecture-driven research trajectories. Multiple scientist agents independently pursue conjectures through equation modeling, question formulation, and active experimentation, then exchange evidence to revise their conjectures and research directions. Their findings are consolidated into a scientific report linking models, conclusions, and evidence. Existing equation-discovery benchmarks primarily assess recovered expressions, leaving the evidence and scientific conclusions established through the investigation underexamined. We therefore introduce ClosureBench, an interactive benchmark of 60 closure-discovery tasks across five scientific domains. ClosureBench focuses on closure-discovery tasks to give equation discovery a concrete scientific purpose. Each task embeds an unknown algebraic relation in a known PDE system, where agents control experimental conditions in OpenFOAM to acquire new data for equation discovery. Beyond equation accuracy, ClosureBench proposes three metrics to evaluate the discovery process: evidence faithfulness, mechanism insight, and experimental effectiveness. Compared with diverse baselines, SCOPE achieves higher equation accuracy on both ClosureBench and a real-world scientific discovery case, while producing more accurate, reliable, and effective scientific discoveries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCOPE 用多个 scientist agent 各自围绕一条科学猜想做方程建模、提问与主动实验，再交换证据修订猜想，最终汇总成模型-结论-证据对应的科学报告；配套发布 ClosureBench，含五个科学领域 60 个闭包发现任务，每个任务在已知 PDE 系统中嵌入未知代数关系，agent 在 OpenFOAM 中控制实验条件采集数据。相比多样基线，SCOPE 在 ClosureBench 与一个真实科学发现案例上都取得更高方程精度，并在证据忠实性、机理洞见、实验有效性三项过程指标上更准确可靠。
Motivation: 符号回归只优化候选方程，拟合变好并不能判定背后的科学猜想该保留、修订还是拒绝；同一猜想可有多种数学实现，拟合相近的方程可能暗示不同解释，而已有方程发现基准只看恢复出的表达式。
Method: SCOPE 框架让多个 scientist agent 独立推进各自的猜想驱动研究轨迹：方程建模、问题表述、主动实验，然后交换证据来修订猜想与研究方向，最后把模型、结论与证据整合成科学报告。评测用 ClosureBench：五个科学领域共 60 个闭包发现任务，每个任务把未知代数关系嵌入已知 PDE 系统，agent 在 OpenFOAM 中控制实验条件获取新数据。
Result: ClosureBench 在方程精度之外提出三项过程指标：evidence faithfulness、mechanism insight、experimental effectiveness。与多样基线相比，SCOPE 在 ClosureBench 和一个真实科学发现案例上都取得更高方程精度，并产出更准确、更可靠、更有效的科学发现。
Conclusion: 把研究对象从单个表达式上移到支撑它的科学猜想，并用证据交换与过程指标来评判发现，可以在闭包发现任务上同时提高方程精度和结论的可信度。

papers.title: Linear regression with probabilistic networks for network-linked data
papers.abstract_en: Network-linked data combine a network with covariates and responses observed for its nodes. Common regression approaches either model dependence among neighboring responses using the observed network or capture similarities associated with network structure without explicitly modeling response dependence. We propose a probabilistic network-linked data analysis framework that incorporates both features while accounting for randomness in network formation. The model uses normalized connection probabilities to weight peer responses and latent positions to capture network cohesion. A two-step likelihood procedure first estimates the network structure and then fits the response model. We establish theoretical guarantees for network recovery in sparse networks with heterogeneous node effects, and prove consistency and joint asymptotic normality of the regression estimators subject to suitable conditions. The analysis also clarifies when estimating the network preserves the classical convergence rate for spatial autoregressive models. Simulation studies demonstrate the estimation performance of the method and assess its inference accuracy. An analysis of diplomatic network data illustrates its practical application.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向网络关联数据 (network-linked data) 的概率回归框架：用归一化连接概率给同伴响应加权，用潜位置 (latent positions) 刻画网络内聚，并通过两步似然先估网络结构再拟合响应模型。理论上给出稀疏网络、异质节点效应下的网络恢复保证，以及回归估计量的一致性与联合渐近正态性；仿真检验估计与推断表现，并在外交网络数据上演示应用。
Motivation: 现有回归要么用已观测网络显式建模邻居响应间的依赖，要么只借网络结构刻画相似性而不建模响应依赖，二者不可兼得；且网络形成本身的随机性常被忽略。
Method: 概率网络关联数据框架：以归一化连接概率加权同伴响应、以潜位置捕捉网络凝聚力，同时对网络形成随机性建模；采用两步似然程序，先估计网络结构再拟合响应模型，并给出理论条件。
Result: 建立稀疏网络、异质节点效应下的网络恢复理论保证，证明回归估计量在适当条件下一致且联合渐近正态，并厘清估计网络何时能保持空间自回归 (spatial autoregressive) 模型的经典收敛速率；仿真研究展示估计性能并评估推断精度，外交网络数据提供实证应用。
Conclusion: 把响应依赖与网络结构相似性放进同一个概率模型并显式处理网络形成随机性是可行的，且在适当条件下估计网络不损失空间自回归模型的经典收敛速率。

papers.title: Delay Complexity Dimension: Learning with Delayed and Censored Labels
papers.abstract_en: We study PAC learning of binary classifiers when labels arrive after random delays and are censored beyond an observation window $W$. How many samples does this observation model require? We propose a distribution-dependent answer, the Delay Complexity Dimension (DCD). The DCD combines the VC dimension with the exact label-information rate of the observation channel. Every learner needs $Ω(\mathrm{DCD}/\varepsilon^2)$ samples. An oracle pseudo-label ERM matches this rate on the instance family of the lower bound, up to constants and logarithmic factors. On that family the DCD is within a constant factor of the classical censored-ERM complexity, and whether the DCD rate is achievable where the two separate remains open. The theory also yields a quantization scheme under which delay information lowers the residual label variance, an expedition policy with a $(1-1/e)$ guarantee for its version-space objective, and a phenomenon with no analogue in the no-delay setting. Under a fixed collection horizon, a moderate window can strictly beat immediate labels. Experiments on synthetic data and the Criteo conversion logs support these predictions. A budget-matched test of a companion labeler-diversity prediction is reported as a negative result.
papers.comment: accepted to 2026 13th International Conference on Data Science and Advanced Analytics (IEEE DSAA 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在标签随机延迟、超过观测窗 W 即被删失的二元分类 PAC 学习中，提出分布相关的样本复杂度刻画 Delay Complexity Dimension (DCD)，它把 VC 维与观测信道的精确标签信息率相乘。每个学习者都需要 Ω(DCD/ε²) 个样本，oracle 伪标签 ERM 在下界实例族上匹配该速率；固定采集预算下中等窗口可严格优于即时标签。
Motivation: 延迟与删失标签下 PAC 样本复杂度缺少分布相关的刻画：经典 censored-ERM 复杂度与信息论下界在何处分离并不清楚，且固定采集时限下何时该等待标签没有判据。
Method: 定义 DCD = VC 维 × 观测信道标签信息率，给出 Ω(DCD/ε²) 下界并构造 oracle 伪标签 ERM 上界；推导一个量化方案说明延迟信息降低残余标签方差，以及带 (1-1/e) 保证的版本空间目标 expedition policy。
Result: 下界 Ω(DCD/ε²)，oracle 伪标签 ERM 在该实例族上匹配到常数与对数因子；该族上 DCD 与经典 censored-ERM 复杂度相差常数因子。固定采集时限下中等观测窗可严格优于即时标签；在合成数据与 Criteo conversion logs 上检验这些预测，并以预算对齐实验报告了 companion labeler-diversity 预测的负结果。

papers.title: An Initial Study of Physiological Markers for Deepfake Speech Detection
papers.abstract_en: Conventional deepfake speech detectors primarily target synthesis artifacts and often degrade under unseen attacks or recording conditions. Human speech, however, contains physiological markers associated with respiration, phonation, and temporal coordination arising from the speech-production system that synthesizers may not reproduce faithfully. This motivates the hypothesis that deepfake speech can be detected by identifying inconsistencies in these patterns, which we test using 36 handcrafted physiological markers organized into respiratory, vocal, and temporal categories. We evaluate the marker vectors with logistic regression and SVM classifiers on pooled English recordings. The best in-domain system achieves a 21.40% equal error rate (EER), while logistic regression achieves 32.77% on the out-of-domain dataset pair. Since the markers describe specific speech-production properties, the logistic-regression coefficients indicate whether higher marker values push the classifier toward bona fide or deepfake speech. These results provide initial evidence that physiological markers offer a useful, interpretable signal for deepfake speech detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 36 个手工构造的生理标记（呼吸、发声、时序协调三类）表征人类发声系统的固有特征，检验其能否识别合成语音中不一致的发声模式。在合并的英文录音上，最佳域内系统等错误率 (EER) 为 21.40%，logistic regression 在跨域数据集对上为 32.77%。结果表明生理标记为深伪语音检测提供了可解释的信号，但域外性能明显退化。
Motivation: 现有深伪语音检测器主要针对合成伪影，在未见攻击或录音条件下性能下降；而呼吸、发声与时序协调等生理特征是发声系统产物，合成器可能无法忠实复现。
Method: 提取 36 个手工构造的生理标记，按呼吸、发声、时序分为三类，组成标记向量后用 logistic regression 与 SVM 分类器在合并的英文录音上评估；logistic regression 系数用于指示标记值升高将分类推向 bona fide 还是 deepfake。
Result: 最佳域内系统 EER 为 21.40%；logistic regression 在域外数据集对上 EER 为 32.77%。
Conclusion: 生理标记为深伪语音检测提供可解释的初步证据性信号，但跨域时误差率显著升高，属于初步研究。

papers.title: The Agentic Scientist: Orchestrating Coding Agents for Automated Scientific (Co-)Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Modern coding agents are fundamentally reshaping the role of human input for computational research: they write code, launch in silico experiments, analyze their results, and autonomously operate with ever-increasing time horizons. Despite these developments, fully autonomous research agents suffer from a limited ideation radius and myopic hill-climbing search dynamics. To bridge this gap, we introduce The Agentic Scientist, an end-to-end distributed pipeline for human researchers to conduct computational research alongside modern coding agents. Building on its predecessor, our system decomposes research into task drafting, idea generation, planning, sandboxed experimentation, result aggregation, baseline and ablation construction, post-hoc analysis, and report writing. Importantly, each step in the pipeline is powered by the next generation of coding agents and leverages agentic self-verification. The overall research process is driven by a meta-controller that manages parallel research agents and enforces rubric verification at each stage. This design enables the same orchestration layer to be reused across heterogeneous domains with different execution environments, agentic coding harnesses, and evaluation metrics. Our system can be used across a spectrum of autonomy: either as a co-scientist tool or to perform end-to-end scientific investigation. Within the co-scientist setting, we leveraged a development version of our system to submit a single research paper, which got accepted for publication at ALIFE 2026. We further apply The Agentic Scientist fully autonomously to open problem-solving tasks in machine learning, and demonstrate the system's capability of scientific discovery across different domains of computational research. Our ablations suggest that reliable scientific autonomy depends not only on base model capabilities, but also on the cross-agent orchestration layer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 The Agentic Scientist：把计算研究拆成任务起草、想法生成、规划、沙盒实验、结果聚合、基线与消融、事后分析、报告写作的分布式流水线，由 meta-controller 并行调度多个 coding agent 并在每阶段强制 rubric 校验。同一编排层可复用于不同领域与执行环境；作为 co-scientist 提交的一篇论文被 ALIFE 2026 接收，全自主运行则在机器学习开放问题上完成跨领域科学发现，消融显示可靠自主性同时依赖基础模型能力与跨 agent 编排层。
Motivation: 现有全自主研究 agent 的想法半径有限、搜索呈短视爬山，难以覆盖异构领域与不同评估指标的计算研究。
Method: 端到端分布式流水线：任务起草、想法生成、规划、沙盒实验、结果聚合、基线与消融构建、事后分析、报告写作，每步由新一代 coding agent 驱动并做 agentic self-verification；meta-controller 管理并行研究 agent，逐阶段执行 rubric 校验，编排层跨领域、跨执行环境、跨 agentic coding harness 复用。
Result: 在 co-scientist 模式下用开发版系统提交的单篇研究论文被 ALIFE 2026 接收；系统全自主应用于机器学习开放问题求解，展示跨不同计算研究领域的科学发现能力；消融表明可靠科学自主性不仅取决于基础模型能力，还取决于跨 agent 编排层。
Conclusion: 科学自主性的瓶颈在编排层而非仅在模型能力，同一套 rubric 校验的调度框架可在 co-scientist 到全自主的连续谱上跨领域复用。

papers.title: Why Static Skill Inconsistencies Do Not Equate to Runtime Risks: A Behavioral Analysis of LLM Agent Execution
papers.abstract_en: LLM agent frameworks heavily rely on external skill assets to standardize tool usage, encode operational workflows, and supply executable runtime resources. Despite their widespread adoption, multi-component skill packages frequently suffer from cross-artifact inconsistencies, where documentation, scripts, and configuration files specify conflicting behavioral constraints. Although static auditing techniques can uncover such contractual discrepancies, static defect volume cannot reliably reflect real-world agent performance degradation. This gap leaves practitioners without rigorous evidence to assess the practical risk of flawed agent skills. This paper presents a systematic empirical study to demystify the runtime implications of skill inconsistencies. We conduct large-scale auditing over 575 community and benchmark skills, yielding 1,182 manually validated contract inconsistencies. We further build a controlled evaluation pipeline with 49 executable agent tasks and three representative LLMs across NoSkill, OriginalSkill, and FixedSkill experimental settings. Through fine-grained behavioral analysis of 441 paired execution trajectories, we quantify the actual performance impacts of resolved defects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 LLM agent 技能包 (skill assets) 的静态契约不一致与运行时风险的关系做实证检验：审计 575 个社区与基准技能得到 1,182 条人工确认的不一致，再用 49 个可执行任务、3 个代表性 LLM 在 NoSkill/OriginalSkill/FixedSkill 三种设置下分析 441 条配对执行轨迹。结论是静态缺陷数量并不能可靠代表运行时性能下降，修复缺陷带来的实际影响要靠行为级轨迹分析来量化。
Motivation: 技能包的文档、脚本与配置常互相冲突，静态审计能查出这类契约不一致，但缺陷数量无法可靠反映 agent 的真实性能退化，从业者缺少评估有缺陷技能实际风险的严谨证据。
Method: 先对 575 个社区与基准技能做大规模静态审计，人工确认 1,182 条契约不一致；再搭建受控评测流水线，用 49 个可执行 agent 任务与 3 个代表性 LLM，在 NoSkill、OriginalSkill、FixedSkill 三种设置下采集并细粒度分析 441 条配对执行轨迹，量化修复缺陷后的性能变化。
Result: 审计覆盖 575 个技能，产出 1,182 条人工验证的契约不一致；评测含 49 个可执行任务、3 个代表性 LLM、三种设置（NoSkill/OriginalSkill/FixedSkill），行为分析基于 441 条配对执行轨迹，量化了被修复缺陷的实际性能影响。
Conclusion: 静态缺陷体量不等于运行时风险，评估有缺陷 agent 技能的实际风险必须结合受控执行下的行为级轨迹分析，而非只看审计计数。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Personalising Deformable Image Registration with Clinical Context and Deformation History for Adaptive Radiotherapy
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive radiotherapy must account for anatomical changes during treatment, but doing so depends on reliably mapping targets, organs at risk and dose across serial images. Existing registration methods treat each image pair independently, without using radiotherapy-specific context or the patient's preceding anatomical trajectory. We developed Clinical-context-Aware and Patient-adaptive Deformable Image Registration (CAP-DIR), integrating source contours, dose, clinical text and prior-registration features. We evaluated 16,361 CT examinations from 3,473 patients across four institutional cohorts and five public benchmarks. CAP-DIR increased internal-test organ-at-risk-region normalized cross-correlation from 84.76% to 96.92% relative to the strongest learning-based comparator, with low deformation folding, and remained superior across seven external cohorts. In a blinded review of 20 longitudinal cases, clinically acceptable contours increased from 45.0% to 82.5% for clinical target volumes and from 22.5% to 62.5% for organs at risk, while estimated editing time decreased. In a controlled benchmark, CAP-DIR reduced global dose-mapping error by 34.5% relative to the strongest comparator. These findings show that clinically informed, longitudinal registration can improve contour usability and dose mapping for adaptive radiotherapy.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 7 figures and 6 tables. The submission includes Supplementary Information
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAP-DIR 把放疗轮廓、剂量、临床文本与既往配准特征一起喂进可形变图像配准 (DIR)，让配准不再把每对图像当独立问题，而是沿患者自身的解剖变化轨迹做个体化。在 16,361 例 CT、3,473 例患者的四个机构队列与五个公开基准上，内部测试 OAR 区域 NCC 从 84.76% 升到 96.92%，剂量映射误差降 34.5%，盲评中 CTV 临床可接受轮廓率从 45.0% 升到 82.5%。
Motivation: 自适应放疗需要跨系列图像可靠映射靶区、危及器官与剂量，但现有配准方法逐对独立处理，既不用放疗专属上下文，也不用患者此前的解剖轨迹。
Method: CAP-DIR 整合源轮廓、剂量、临床文本与既往配准特征 (prior-registration features)；在四个机构队列与五个公开基准共 16,361 例 CT、3,473 例患者上评测，含内部测试、七个外部队列、20 例纵向盲评与受控剂量映射基准。
Result: 内部测试 OAR 区域 NCC 从 84.76% 提到 96.92%（相对最强学习型比较方法），形变折叠低，并在七个外部队列保持优势；20 例纵向盲评中 CTV 临床可接受轮廓率 45.0%→82.5%、OAR 22.5%→62.5%，编辑时间下降；受控基准中全局剂量映射误差相对最强比较方法降低 34.5%。
Conclusion: 带临床上下文与纵向历史的配准能同时提高轮廓可用性与剂量映射精度，从而支撑自适应放疗的日常使用。

papers.title: Sharp Asymptotic Theory of Maximum Likelihood Estimation for Gaussian Processes with an RBF Kernel
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian processes (GPs) are widely used across machine learning, spatial statistics, time-series analysis, optimization, Bayesian statistics, and scientific applications. A central component of a GP model is its kernel, which is typically specified through a parametric family. Among the most widely used choices is the radial basis function (RBF), also known as the squared exponential or Gaussian kernel, owing to its simple form, smoothness, and flexibility. In practice, the kernel parameters are routinely estimated by the maximum likelihood estimators (MLEs), as implemented by standard GP software. Despite this widespread use, the asymptotic behavior of the MLEs remains poorly understood under fixed-domain asymptotics, even for the RBF kernel. The main difficulty arises from the increasingly strong dependence among densely sampled observations and the nonlinear dependence of the covariance matrix on the kernel parameters. In this paper, we address this gap by providing, to the best of our knowledge, the first complete asymptotic characterization of the joint MLE of the spatial variance, lengthscale, and nugget variance under fixed-domain asymptotics. We establish consistency, derive convergence rates for all three parameters, prove joint asymptotic normality, and show that these rates are minimax optimal.

papers.title: Steering Diffusion Models to Rare Events with Sequential Monte Carlo
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are increasingly used as surrogates for expensive simulators in weather prediction, molecular dynamics, and materials design. In these models, computing the probability $p_0[E]$ of an event $E$ is difficult, especially when the event of interest is rare. A stable estimate using Monte Carlo becomes computationally intractable, requiring a growing sample size $\propto\!1/p_0[E]$ to compensate for an increasing rarity. In this paper, we present Diffusion rare event sampling with Sequential Monte Carlo (DireSMC), a sequential Monte Carlo scheme that guides a population of weighted samples towards the rare event, giving access not only to samples but also to a calibrated estimate of its probability. We set up our guidance using an analytical relaxation of the event set, allowing the method to easily extend to a wide range of user-defined rare events. We validate our method on a toy problem with analytical solutions and on a score-based climate emulator, where we obtain accurate rare-event probabilities on a range of rarities from $10^{-3}$ to $10^{-5}$, achieving net speed-ups of $9\times$ to $1413\times$ over Monte Carlo.
papers.comment: A previous version of this work was accepted at the NeurIPS 2026: AI for Stochastic Dynamics workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DireSMC：用序贯蒙特卡洛 (Sequential Monte Carlo) 引导扩散模型的加权样本群朝稀有事件聚集，既给出样本也给出校准过的事件概率估计，事件集通过解析松弛 (analytical relaxation) 定义以适配任意用户自定义稀有事件。在解析可解 toy 问题与基于 score 的气候 emulator 上，10^-3 到 10^-5 稀有度范围内概率估计准确，相对朴素 Monte Carlo 净加速 9× 到 1413×。
Motivation: 扩散模型作为天气、分子动力学与材料设计中昂贵模拟器的代理时，稀有事件概率 p0[E] 难以估计：朴素 Monte Carlo 需要随稀有度增长的样本量 ∝1/p0[E]，计算上不可行。
Method: DireSMC 用序贯蒙特卡洛引导一整群带权样本逐步逼近稀有事件集，事件集用解析松弛形式化，从而可推广到各类用户定义事件；输出同时包含样本与校准的事件概率。验证分两步：解析可解 toy 问题与 score-based 气候 emulator。
Result: 在 score-based 气候 emulator 上，稀有度 10^-3 至 10^-5 范围内得到准确的稀有事件概率；相对 Monte Carlo 的净加速为 9× 到 1413×；另在有解析解的 toy 问题上验证。
Conclusion: 序贯蒙特卡洛引导能把扩散模型的稀有事件概率估计从 ∝1/p0[E] 的样本量困境中解出来，在气候 emulator 稀有度 10^-3–10^-5 上既准又快。

papers.title: ProximalFM: Amortized Proximal Causal Inference under Hidden Confounding
papers.abstract_en: Standard causal identification methods often assume no unmeasured confounding and can fail when relevant confounders are unobserved. Proximal causal inference instead uses proxy variables to identify effects under hidden confounding. However, nonparametric proximal estimation can be challenging in practice: recovering causal estimands such as the conditional average treatment effect (CATE) requires solving an ill-posed integral equation that is data-hungry, hyperparameter-sensitive, and optimization-unstable. Bayesian inference for such models provides a desirable alternative, mitigating these difficulties by regularizing through the prior. However, computing a posterior is itself challenging, as a typical likelihood function will include latent variables. Following the recent success of tabular foundation models in backdoor, instrumental variable, and frontdoor settings, we propose that prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) are uniquely suited to resolve this bottleneck. Indeed, by training on synthetic data sampled from compliant structural causal models with access to oracle counterfactuals, we simplify the task substantially, amortizing the implied Bayesian operator inversion into a single transformer forward pass. Compared to prior literature that focuses primarily on point estimation, our model, ProximalFM, explicitly targets the Bayesian posterior distribution of the CATE. One unique aspect of this problem is that we need to provide Monte Carlo estimates of the oracle CATEs, leading to a novel variation of PFNs that accounts for the added stochastic error. Across a diverse suite of proximal regimes, ProximalFM achieves consistently strong CATE-estimation performance without dataset-specific tuning, with its largest advantage when latent confounding is substantial and the proxies are weakly informative; it also provides fast inference through a single amortized forward pass.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProximalFM 用 prior-data fitted networks (PFN) 做隐混杂下的摊销式近端因果推断：在符合近端可识别条件的合成 SCM 上采样并访问 oracle 反事实训练 transformer，把贝叶斯算子求逆压进一次前向传播，直接输出 CATE 的后验分布。在多组近端机制上 CATE 估计表现稳定且无需逐数据集调参，隐混杂强、代理变量弱信息时优势最大，推理只需一次前向。
Motivation: 非参数近端估计要解病态积分方程，数据饥渴、超参敏感、优化不稳；贝叶斯推断能靠先验正则化，但似然含隐变量使后验计算本身困难。
Method: 在符合要求的合成结构因果模型 (SCM) 上采样数据并获得 oracle 反事实，训练 transformer 形式的 PFN，把贝叶斯算子求逆摊销为单次前向；因 oracle CATE 只能以蒙特卡洛估计给出，提出能处理该附加随机误差的 PFN 新变体，目标是 CATE 的贝叶斯后验而非点估计。
Result: 在多样的近端机制 (proximal regimes) 上 CATE 估计性能一致较强，且无需数据集特定调参；当潜在混杂显著、代理变量弱信息时优势最大，推理为单次摊销前向、速度快。
Conclusion: 把近端因果推断的贝叶斯求逆摊销进 PFN，可以在隐混杂下免调参地给出 CATE 后验，尤其适合混杂强、代理弱的困难情形。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: EigenDEXplore: Structured Exploration for Dexterous Manipulation with Human Priors
papers.abstract_en: Dexterous manipulation poses a challenging high-dimensional optimization problem, as useful behaviors require coordinated motion across many hand joints. In reinforcement learning (RL) and sampling-based trajectory optimization, exploration commonly relies on independent robot joint perturbations, making coordinated behaviors difficult to discover. Prior work reduces this search space for grasp learning using low-dimensional spaces of coordinated joint motions learned from human hand data, but this restricts the expressivity required for general manipulation. Some combine learned and joint-space actions to restore expressivity, but this increases dimensionality and introduces redundancy. We study these effects across diverse manipulation settings, varying action dimensionality, exploration strategy, and the source of human data. Our experiments suggest that human-motion priors are most effective when used to structure exploration rather than change the action representation. Motivated by this finding, we propose EigenDEXplore, which induces correlated exploration by adding perturbations along human-derived eigenvectors to independent joint-space noise, leaving the action space unchanged. Across multiple dexterous hands, EigenDEXplore consistently outperforms joint-space and learned action-space baselines in grasping, in-hand reorientation, and contact-rich manipulation. These gains span unstructured and reference-guided RL, trajectory optimization, and sim-to-real deployment, and are largest in settings with less reward shaping and curriculum design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EigenDEXplore 在灵巧操作的 RL 与采样轨迹优化中，把独立关节噪声与从人手数据学出的特征向量方向的扰动相加，从而诱导相关探索而保持动作空间不变。在多种灵巧手上，它在抓取、手中重定向与接触丰富操作中持续优于关节空间与学习动作空间基线，且在奖励塑形和课程设计越少时增益越大。
Motivation: 灵巧操作是高维优化问题，RL 与采样轨迹优化通常对各关节独立加噪，难以发现需要多关节协同的行为；用低维人手先验改动作空间虽缩小搜索域却损失表达力，混合动作又抬高维度并引入冗余。
Method: 先在多样操作设定中系统改变动作维度、探索策略与人手数据来源，比较人手先验用于结构化探索与用于改变动作表示两种用法；据此提出 EigenDEXplore，在独立关节空间噪声之外叠加沿人手数据导出的特征向量 (human-derived eigenvectors) 的扰动，动作空间保持不变，覆盖无参考与参考引导 RL、轨迹优化及 sim-to-real 部署。
Result: 在多个灵巧手上，EigenDEXplore 在抓取、手中重定向 (in-hand reorientation) 与接触丰富操作上持续优于关节空间基线和学习动作空间基线；增益横跨无参考与参考引导 RL、轨迹优化和 sim-to-real 部署，并在奖励塑形与课程设计较少的设定中最大。
Conclusion: 人手先验最有效的用法是结构化探索过程而非改写动作表示：保留关节空间动作、只让噪声沿人手特征向量相关，即可同时保住表达力并提升协同行为的发现率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Crop Yield Prediction for Punjab, Pakistan: A Tree-Ensemble and Leaf-Health Prototype, and What Random Validation Hides
papers.abstract_en: Yield forecasts help planners and farmers decide on inputs, storage and imports, but small agricultural tables can make reported accuracy fail on a new season. We built a crop-yield prototype for Punjab, Pakistan that combines Random Forest, XGBoost, support vector regression and a Ridge-stacked ensemble with a MobileNetV2 leaf-health classifier, and deployed it as a web application with SHAP explanations. A random 80/20 split of a merged Kaggle-derived table (414 rows) gives the ensemble an R2 of 0.991. An audit showed that the table contains only 46 independent observations: a join with nine temperature records per year copied every crop-year nine times. Holding out whole years takes XGBoost on the same rows from R2 = 0.994 to -0.20. On deduplicated data, and on a longer FAOSTAT table (1990-2024, 70 observations), a per-crop linear trend (leave-one-year-out RMSE 0.29 Ton/Ha) beats every model not given the year (0.84-1.06). Neither pesticide use nor national temperature change explains the trend residuals. An apparent pesticide gain in the Kaggle table disappears on FAOSTAT, where the pesticide series is mostly imputed and the two releases disagree. An independent district-level wheat panel (36 districts, 13 seasons) shows that most variation in Punjab is spatial and that a district mean with a common trend matches the learned models. The leaf classifier reaches 99.87% accuracy on held-out PlantVillage images and recalls 96.4% of 336 unseen diseased leaves after near-duplicates were removed. However, no leaf image is paired with a yield record, so the health score used in the yield models had to be constructed and adds nothing. We report these negative findings together with the prototype.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在旁遮普邦 414 行小表上，随机 80/20 切分让 Ridge 堆叠集成的产量预测 R² 达 0.991，但审计发现表中仅 46 个独立观测（每年 9 条温度记录的 join 把每个作物年复制了 9 次）。按整年留出后 XGBoost 的 R² 从 0.994 跌到 -0.20；在去重数据与 FAOSTAT 1990–2024（70 观测）上，只用年份的逐作物线性趋势（留一年 RMSE 0.29 Ton/Ha）胜过一切未给年份的模型（0.84–1.06）。
Motivation: 小农业数据表上的随机切分会让报告精度在新季节失效：重复行与时间泄漏把 R² 抬到近乎完美，而真实跨年泛化可以是负的。
Method: 原型组合 Random Forest、XGBoost、support vector regression 与 Ridge-stacked ensemble，并接 MobileNetV2 叶片健康分类器，以 SHAP 解释部署为 web 应用；对照做法是随机 80/20 切分、整年留出、去重数据、FAOSTAT 1990–2024 长表与逐作物线性趋势（leave-one-year-out），另用 36 个县、13 个季节的小麦面板检验空间与时间变异。
Result: 随机 80/20 下集成 R²=0.991（Kaggle 合并表 414 行，实为 46 个独立观测）；整年留出使 XGBoost 在同样行上 R² 从 0.994 降到 -0.20。去重数据与 FAOSTAT（70 观测）上，逐作物线性趋势 leave-one-year-out RMSE 0.29 Ton/Ha，优于所有未给年份的模型（0.84–1.06）；农药使用与全国温度变化都解释不了趋势残差，Kaggle 表上的农药收益在 FAOSTAT 上消失。县级小麦面板显示变异主要是空间性的，县均值加共同趋势即可匹配学习模型。叶片分类器在 PlantVillage 留出图像上准确率 99.87%，去除近重复后对 336 张未见病叶召回 96.4%。
Conclusion: 作者主张把这批负结果与原型一起报告：随机验证会掩盖小表上的时间泄漏，产量模型应按整年留出检验，而未与产量记录配对的叶片健康分数对产量模型没有增益。

summary_sections.method: 原型组合 Random Forest、XGBoost、support vector regression 与 Ridge-stacked ensemble，并接 MobileNetV2 叶片健康分类器，以 SHAP 解释部署为 web 应用；对照做法是随机 80/20 切分、整年留出、去重数据、FAOSTAT 1990–2024 长表与逐作物线性趋势（leave-one-year-out），另用 36 个县、13 个季节的小麦面板检验空间与时间变异。
summary_sections.result: 随机 80/20 下集成 R²=0.991（Kaggle 合并表 414 行，实为 46 个独立观测）；整年留出使 XGBoost 在同样行上 R² 从 0.994 降到 -0.20。去重数据与 FAOSTAT（70 观测）上，逐作物线性趋势 leave-one-year-out RMSE 0.29 Ton/Ha，优于所有未给年份的模型（0.84–1.06）；农药使用与全国温度变化都解释不了趋势残差，Kaggle 表上的农药收益在 FAOSTAT 上消失。县级小麦面板显示变异主要是空间性的，县均值加共同趋势即可匹配学习模型。叶片分类器在 PlantVillage 留出图像上准确率 99.87%，去除近重复后对 336 张未见病叶召回 96.4%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者主张把这批负结果与原型一起报告：随机验证会掩盖小表上的时间泄漏，产量模型应按整年留出检验，而未与产量记录配对的叶片健康分数对产量模型没有增益。

papers.title: EMG-FM-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Foundation Model Transfer and Adaptation on Electromyography
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models (FMs) are increasingly being developed for general time series and physiological signals, yet their transferability to downstream physiological tasks remains poorly understood. This question is particularly challenging for electromyography (EMG), where signal distributions vary substantially across users, sensing configurations, acquisition hardware, and downstream tasks. We introduce EMG-FM-Bench, a systematic benchmark for studying foundation-model transfer and adaptation on EMG. EMG-FM-Bench unifies 20 public datasets with over 1 million EMG segments and evaluates nine pretrained foundation models across four questions: how pretrained models perform when frozen or fully fine-tuned, how much pretraining helps compared with training the same model from scratch, how well models generalize to new users with limited labeled data, and how performance changes across different EMG tasks. Across the benchmark, linear probing provides useful information about pretrained representations, but full fine-tuning can substantially change downstream EMG performance. Comparing each pretrained model with the same model trained from scratch shows that the benefit of pretraining varies substantially across models and is not universal. Performance decreases when models are evaluated on new users, while five-shot adaptation improves macro-F1 in 70.2% of evaluated model-dataset combinations but recovers only part of the lost performance. Model performance is highly consistent between upper- and lower-limb classification and remains strongly correlated with continuous EMG-to-text decoding. Together, these results provide a systematic view of when pretrained time-series models transfer effectively to EMG and how their performance depends on fine-tuning, user variation, and downstream task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EMG-FM-Bench 用 20 个公开数据集、超 100 万段 EMG 统一评测 9 个预训练基础模型的迁移与适配。全量微调可显著改变下游性能，预训练收益因模型而异并不普遍；换到新用户性能下降，五-shot 适配在 70.2% 的模型-数据集组合上提升 macro-F1 但只追回部分损失。
Motivation: 时序与生理信号基础模型的下游可迁移性尚不清楚，而 EMG 在用户、传感配置、采集硬件与任务间分布差异大，缺少统一评测口径。
Method: EMG-FM-Bench 统一 20 个公开数据集（超 100 万段 EMG），评测 9 个预训练基础模型，围绕四个问题设计实验：冻结 vs 全量微调、预训练 vs 同结构从零训练、少标签新用户泛化、跨 EMG 任务表现；并用五-shot 适配处理新用户。
Result: 线性探针 (linear probing) 能反映预训练表征但全量微调可大幅改变下游性能；与同结构从零训练相比，预训练收益因模型而异、并不普遍；新用户上性能下降，五-shot 适配在 70.2% 的模型-数据集组合上提升 macro-F1，但只追回部分损失；上肢与下肢分类表现高度一致，且与连续 EMG-to-text 解码强相关。
Conclusion: 预训练时序模型向 EMG 的迁移是否有效取决于具体模型、微调方式与用户差异，线性探针不足以判定可用性，少标签适配只能部分弥补换用户带来的损失。

papers.title: MiniCorp: The Last Mile to an AI Agent Corporation
papers.abstract_en: The last mile toward enterprise AGI is a company that runs itself. Training and adapting such agents require longitudinal enterprise data, which remain scarce, costly to acquire, and often restricted by privacy constraints. Historical archives are also frequently incomplete and record only what actually happened. They cannot show the outcomes of alternative decisions. We introduce MiniCorp, an office simulator for studying how agents can collectively run a company while generating enterprise data at scale. Using an e-commerce company as a demonstration, MiniCorp connects two interacting worlds. The external world models customers, dynamic competitors, and market mechanisms. The internal world consists of agents that observe events, discuss their options, and make strategic decisions. These decisions have lasting effects on the market, and the resulting feedback informs the firm's later decisions. As the firm and market interact, MiniCorp continuously records the agents' communications and decisions. These records preserve the information available at the time and the business results that followed. Checkpointing allows the same situation to be replayed under different decisions, providing comparisons unavailable in static archives. We evaluate end-to-end fidelity against patterns reported in empirical studies of real markets. These evaluations provide agents with realistic market feedback and reduce the risk that they learn to exploit flaws in the simulator. Our experiments show agents coordinating across roles and adapting their decisions to market feedback. With explicit long-term strategic guidance, they also sustain advertising exploration despite weak early returns. MiniCorp thus provides an environment for studying AI-run companies and a scalable source of longitudinal and counterfactual enterprise data for agent training and evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MiniCorp 是一个让多个 AI agent 协同经营公司的办公室模拟器：外部世界建模客户、动态竞争对手与市场机制，内部世界由 agent 观察事件、讨论并做战略决策，决策对市场产生持久影响并反馈给后续决策。它持续记录通信与决策，并支持 checkpointing 把同一情境按不同决策重放，得到静态档案无法提供的反事实对照；实验显示 agent 能跨角色协调并随市场反馈调整决策，在明确的长期战略引导下即使早期回报微弱也维持广告探索。
Motivation: 训练和适配企业级 agent 需要纵向企业数据，但这类数据稀缺、获取成本高、受隐私限制，且历史档案只记录实际发生的事，无法呈现备选决策的结果。
Method: 以一家电商公司为演示，MiniCorp 连接外部世界（客户、动态竞争对手、市场机制）与内部 agent 世界（观察事件、讨论选项、做战略决策），持续记录 agent 通信与决策及其对应的经营结果；checkpointing 机制允许同一情境在不同决策下重放，生成反事实数据。
Result: 对真实市场实证研究报告的模式做端到端保真度评估，为 agent 提供真实市场反馈并降低其钻模拟器漏洞的风险；实验显示 agent 能跨角色协调、随市场反馈调整决策，且在明确长期战略引导下，即使早期回报微弱仍持续广告探索。
Conclusion: MiniCorp 可作为研究 AI 经营公司的环境，以及为 agent 训练与评估提供可规模化、含纵向与反事实信息的企业数据来源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DMAD: Distribution Matching as Adversarial Distillation for Fast Visual Generation
papers.abstract_en: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) trains a few-step student from the difference between separately estimated target and student scores, so it must keep an auxiliary diffusion model fitted to the student's evolving distribution at extra memory and computation cost. We introduce DMAD, Distribution Matching as Adversarial Distillation, which recasts distribution matching as classification and learns the required log-density ratios directly. Two discriminator heads on a shared backbone distinguish real data and teacher samples from the student's, and linear losses on their logits train the student without auxiliary score fitting. We prove that at the discriminator optimum these losses recover the distribution-matching gradient underlying DMD, through the classical identity linking discriminator logits to log-density ratios. We further introduce gap-based reweighting, which adapts teacher supervision across noise levels from the real-data head's empirical logit gap between real and teacher samples. DMAD reaches a Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) of 1.04 with one-step generation on ImageNet-64x64, 14.47 with four-step SDXL on COCO-10K, and a VBench total score of 85.15 with four-step Wan2.1-T2V-14B, the best values among the compared few-step methods and the multi-step teachers. On MiniMax-H3-33B, our four-step student achieves overall human preference rates of 79.1% over DMD2 and 84.6% over rCM for joint audio-video generation, excluding ties. Our code, models and demos are available at https://yzmblog.github.io/projects/DMAD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DMAD 把分布匹配蒸馏改写成对抗判别：共享 backbone 上两个判别头区分真实数据与教师样本对学生的样本，对 logits 用线性损失直接学 log-density 比值，从而免去 DMD 必需的辅助 score 拟合。在判别器最优处这些损失可证明恢复 DMD 的分布匹配梯度；一步 ImageNet-64x64 FID 1.04、四步 SDXL 在 COCO-10K 上 FID 14.47、四步 Wan2.1-T2V-14B 的 VBench 总分 85.15，均为所比较少步方法与多步教师中的最优值。
Motivation: DMD 需要为不断演化的学生分布额外维护一个辅助扩散模型来估计目标与学生 score，带来额外显存与计算开销；把分布匹配直接转成分类问题即可绕开这一开销。
Method: 在共享 backbone 上挂两个判别头，分别区分真实数据与教师样本对学生的样本，对 logits 施加线性损失训练学生，不做辅助 score 拟合；用判别器 logits 与 log-density 比值的经典恒等式证明最优处损失恢复 DMD 梯度。另提出 gap-based reweighting，按真实数据头在真实与教师样本间的经验 logit gap 跨噪声水平自适应调整教师监督。
Result: ImageNet-64x64 一步生成 FID 1.04；COCO-10K 上四步 SDXL FID 14.47；四步 Wan2.1-T2V-14B 的 VBench 总分 85.15，均为所比较少步方法与多步教师中的最优值。MiniMax-H3-33B 上四步学生在音视频联合生成中剔除平局后对 DMD2 的整体人类偏好率 79.1%、对 rCM 为 84.6%。
Conclusion: 分布匹配可以等价地用对抗分类实现，只要在判别器最优处线性 logits 损失就恢复 DMD 梯度，从而在少步视觉与音视频生成上同时省掉辅助 score 模型并取得所比较方法中的最优质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Front-to-Back: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Asymmetric Cross-View Vehicle Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Matching the same vehicle across front and rear cameras is difficult because the cameras do not share a view and the vehicle's appearance changes substantially. We introduce Front2Back-ReID, a benchmark of 500 manually verified vehicle handovers from 20 recording sequences in South Africa. Each example asks a model to match a vehicle highlighted in a front-camera image to the same vehicle among at least three candidates in a later rear-camera image. We evaluate seven zero-shot vision-language models, four image-retrieval baselines, and 25 human participants. Models are tested using full front RGB images, cropped target vehicles, and binary silhouettes. The strongest VLM achieved 76.6 percent Rank-1 accuracy on target crops, compared with 74.0 percent for the frozen SigLIP2 baseline; this difference was not statistically clear. Human participants achieved 94.0 percent accuracy with full images and 92.2 percent with target crops. Under our evaluation setup, enabling reasoning improved accuracy across all three input conditions for every model evaluated in both modes. We also found that VLMs generally performed worse on full scenes than on target crops. These results show that general-purpose VLMs do not yet consistently outperform strong visual retrieval for front-to-rear vehicle matching, while humans remain substantially more reliable.
papers.comment: Submitted to the ACCV 2026 Workshop on Computer Vision for Developing Countries (CV4DC)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Front2Back-ReID 是跨前后摄像头的车辆重识别基准：500 个人工核验的交接样本、20 段南非录制序列，每个样本要求把前视图中标出的车在后视图至少三个候选中匹配出来。七个零样本 VLM 在目标裁剪图上最强达 76.6% Rank-1，仅略高于冻结 SigLIP2 基线的 74.0% 且差异不显著，而人类在完整图上达 94.0%；开启 reasoning 对所有被测模型的三种输入条件都提升准确率。
Motivation: 前后摄像头不共享视角且车辆外观变化大，通用 VLM 在这种非对称跨视图匹配上是否真强于专用视觉检索、以及与人类差距多大，此前缺少受控基准。
Method: 构建 Front2Back-ReID：500 个手工核验的车辆交接样本、来自南非 20 段录制序列，任务为把前视图高亮车辆与后视图中至少三个候选匹配；评测七个零样本 VLM、四个图像检索基线与 25 名人类被试，输入分完整前视 RGB、目标车辆裁剪、二值剪影三种条件，并对比开/关 reasoning 两种模式。
Result: 最强 VLM 在目标裁剪上 Rank-1 准确率 76.6%，冻结 SigLIP2 基线 74.0%，该差异不具统计显著性；人类被试在完整图上 94.0%、目标裁剪上 92.2%。开启 reasoning 在全部三种输入条件下对每个被双模式评测的模型都提升准确率；VLM 在完整场景上普遍弱于目标裁剪。
Conclusion: 通用 VLM 目前尚不能稳定胜过强视觉检索模型完成前到后视的车辆匹配，人类仍明显更可靠；完整场景输入对 VLM 反而是负担。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 构建 Front2Back-ReID：500 个手工核验的车辆交接样本、来自南非 20 段录制序列，任务为把前视图高亮车辆与后视图中至少三个候选匹配；评测七个零样本 VLM、四个图像检索基线与 25 名人类被试，输入分完整前视 RGB、目标车辆裁剪、二值剪影三种条件，并对比开/关 reasoning 两种模式。
summary_sections.result: 最强 VLM 在目标裁剪上 Rank-1 准确率 76.6%，冻结 SigLIP2 基线 74.0%，该差异不具统计显著性；人类被试在完整图上 94.0%、目标裁剪上 92.2%。开启 reasoning 在全部三种输入条件下对每个被双模式评测的模型都提升准确率；VLM 在完整场景上普遍弱于目标裁剪。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通用 VLM 目前尚不能稳定胜过强视觉检索模型完成前到后视的车辆匹配，人类仍明显更可靠；完整场景输入对 VLM 反而是负担。

papers.title: Policy-Conditioned AI-Use Detection: An Evidentiary Framework for Academic Publishing
papers.abstract_en: Major venues now publish detailed rules about how authors, reviewers, and area chairs may use AI, and those rules differ by role, by task, and by what must be disclosed. AI detection, the instrument usually proposed to enforce them, estimates something else: whether an AI model wrote the text. We argue that this target is misaligned with the decisions conferences and journals face, and propose policy-conditioned AI-use detection, an evidentiary framework for assessing whether a human--AI workflow complied with a stated rule. Policy makes the governing rule an explicit input. Inference reports hypotheses, evidence, calibration regime, and uncertainty in place of verdicts such as "AI detected". Evaluation builds benchmarks from reproducible pipelines that generate compliant and non-compliant workflows, and reports true positive rate at a false positive rate the venue fixes in advance. We work the framework through peer review, where at plausible violation rates a detector at a strong operating point still flags more compliant authors than violating ones. The framework therefore also names what a venue must instrument: structured disclosure, approved-tool routing that respects reviewer confidentiality, and a path by which a finding can be contested. Under this framing a detector is not an authorship classifier but an auditable procedure with an error rate the venue fixes in advance and can defend.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 AI-Native Academia Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出会议与期刊按角色、任务和披露要求制定的 AI 使用规则，与现有 AI 检测器实际测量的目标（文本是否由 AI 撰写）错位，因而提出 policy-conditioned AI-use detection：把成文规则作为显式输入，输出假设、证据、校准区间与不确定性而非「检出 AI」式裁决。在同行评审场景中，即使在可行的违规率下、检测器处于强工作点，被标记的合规作者仍多于违规作者，因此场馆必须配套结构化披露、尊重审稿保密的获批工具路由与申诉通道。
Motivation: 各大会刊已按角色、任务与披露要求分别立规，但通常被提议用来执行规则的 AI 检测器估计的是另一件事——文本是否由 AI 写成，这一目标与会议和期刊实际要做的合规判定不对齐。
Method: 提出 policy-conditioned AI-use detection 证据框架：以成文规则 (policy) 作为显式输入，推断环节报告假设、证据、校准状态与不确定性以取代「AI detected」式裁决；评测用可复现流水线构造合规与不合规工作流的基准，并在场馆预先固定的假阳性率下报告真阳性率。
Result: 在同行评审场景中，即使在合理的违规率下、检测器处于强工作点 (strong operating point)，被标记的合规作者数量仍超过违规作者数量；评测指标为场馆预先固定 FPR 下的 TPR。
Conclusion: 在该框架下检测器不是作者身份分类器，而是程序可审计、错误率由场馆事先固定且可辩护的流程；场馆还需配套结构化披露、尊重审稿保密的获批工具路由与可申诉路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Statistical Benefits of Multiple Responses for Learning from Demonstrations
papers.abstract_en: Many generative systems return multiple candidate responses and are evaluated according to the best one. Recent work shows that, when demonstrations are optimal, pass@$k$ can reduce the sample complexity of learning from demonstrations by a logarithmic factor in $k$. We ask what happens when the demonstrator is not assumed to be optimal. We find that multiple responses provide a qualitatively stronger benefit in this setting. In a finite reward-class model with no reward feedback, moving from pass@$1$ to any pass@$k$ with $k\ge2$ changes the worst-case dependence on target accuracy from $1/\varepsilon^2$ to $1/\varepsilon$, uniformly over demonstrator quality. Under standard evaluation, where an unknown reward is fixed before training, increasing $k$ provides an additional and distinct benefit: the optimal dependence on a reward class of size $N$ improves from $\log N$ to $\log N/\log k$. We further show that these two effects can be separated. Under robust evaluation, where one learned policy must compete with the demonstrator simultaneously for every reward in the class, the fast $1/\varepsilon$ dependence persists, while the $1/\log k$ improvement can disappear. We establish matching upper and lower bounds in the corresponding regimes and give a greedy multiplicative-weights learner achieving the upper bounds without any assumption on demonstrator quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在从示范学习 (learning from demonstrations) 中，当示范者不必最优时，pass@k 的多响应带来比已知结果更强的收益：有限奖励类且无奖励反馈下，从 pass@1 到任意 k≥2 把目标精度最坏依赖从 1/ε² 变为 1/ε，且对示范者质量一致；标准评估下奖励类规模 N 的依赖从 log N 改善到 log N/log k。
Motivation: 已有工作只在示范者最优的假设下得到 pass@k 带来 log k 的样本复杂度对数因子改进；示范者非最优时多响应究竟带来什么收益尚不清楚，而生成式系统普遍按最佳候选评估。
Method: 在有限奖励类、无奖励反馈的模型中分析 pass@k 的样本复杂度；区分标准评估（未知奖励在训练前固定）与稳健评估（单一策略须同时对类中每个奖励与示范者竞争），并给出匹配的上下界以及一个贪心 multiplicative-weights 学习者。
Result: k≥2 时目标精度依赖由 1/ε² 变为 1/ε，对示范者质量一致成立；标准评估下奖励类规模 N 的依赖由 log N 改善为 log N/log k；稳健评估下 1/ε 快依赖保留而 1/log k 改进可能消失；各情形给出匹配上下界，贪心 multiplicative-weights 学习者在不对示范者质量作假设时达到上界。
Conclusion: 多响应的两类收益（精度依赖与奖励类依赖）可被分离，且快速 1/ε 依赖不依赖示范者最优性，但奖励类上的 1/log k 改进依赖于评估方式。

papers.title: A bilingual AI audiologist built through rubric-guided closed-loop engineering outperforms human audiologists in a blinded evaluation of simulated cases
papers.abstract_en: Audiology consultation requires structured history-taking, audiometric interpretation and patient-centred communication, yet real-world case material is scarce. We present a bilingual AI audiologist pairing a general-purpose large language model with rubric-guided closed-loop engineering, multimodal audiogram interpretation and retrieval-augmented grounding, without fine-tuning the language-model backbone. Using a 21-item rubric and an AI patient simulator, we distilled experience-derived guidance into a 19-rule playbook from 73 training cases (43 English, 30 Chinese) and evaluated the system on 58 independent simulated cases (30 Chinese, 28 English) in a pre-specified, source-blinded comparison with 17 practising audiologists. The AI audiologist outperformed human audiologists on every case (58/58; mean paired $Δ$ = +1.35 on a 5-point composite, Cohen's d = 1.84, $P = 4.5 \times 10^{-20}$), on 20 of 21 rubric items and in both languages. Component ablation identified the playbook as the largest contributor, offering a practical route to specialist consultation agents in low-data medical domains.
papers.comment: 74 pages, including 51 pages of Supplementary Information. Revised presentation and terminology, with improved figure placement; experimental results unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 双语 AI 听力师 (AI audiologist) 用 21 项评分细则 (rubric) 引导的闭环工程，把通用 LLM 加多模态听力图解读与检索增强 (RAG) 组装成无需微调的问诊代理。在 58 例独立模拟病例、17 名执业听力师的源盲对照中，AI 在全部 58/58 例胜出，5 分制综合分平均配对差 +1.35（Cohen's d = 1.84，P = 4.5×10⁻²⁰），21 项细则中 20 项及中英双语均占优；消差显示 playbook 是最大贡献项。
Motivation: 听力学问诊依赖结构化病史采集、听力图判读与以患者为中心的沟通，而真实病例材料稀缺，专科问诊代理难以在低数据医疗领域训练。
Method: 通用 LLM 不微调主干，配 rubric 引导的闭环工程、多模态听力图解读与检索增强接地；用 21 项 rubric 和 AI 患者模拟器，从 73 例训练病例（43 英文、30 中文）蒸馏出 19 条规则的 playbook，再在 58 例独立模拟病例（30 中文、28 英文）上做预先设定、源盲的对照评估，对手为 17 名执业听力师，并做组件消融。
Result: AI 在 58/58 例全部胜过人类听力师，5 分制综合分平均配对差 Δ = +1.35，Cohen's d = 1.84，P = 4.5×10⁻²⁰；在 21 项 rubric 中的 20 项以及中英两种语言上均占优。组件消融把 playbook 识别为最大贡献项。
Conclusion: rubric 引导的闭环工程加 playbook 蒸馏，可在低数据医疗领域造出超越人类专科问诊水平的代理，且不必微调 LLM 主干。

papers.title: Shopping by algorithm: How agentic AI deploys human heuristics as a surrogate consumer
papers.abstract_en: Consumers increasingly delegate purchasing decisions to Large Language Models (LLMs) acting as surrogate consumers. Using "Tool-Lab," an adaptation of information-board process tracing that places product attributes behind costly tool calls, we examine how marketing pricing cues (i.e., just-below pricing and promotional framing) influence AI shopping agents. Across eight commercially deployed LLMs from three providers, we trace pre-choice information acquisition. Under zero cost, pricing cues rarely mislead. Imposing acquisition costs under a vague goal prompt leads LLMs to omit diagnostic attributes required to compute unit price and choose suboptimal choices resembling human heuristics. Relative to a specific goal prompt that mainly preserves diagnostic search and choice optimality, a vague goal prompt under constraints creates a search-mediated vulnerability. This research demonstrates that marketing heuristics in delegated AI shopping are governed by storefront information architecture, not necessarily immutable LLM flaws.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究 LLM 作为代理消费者 (surrogate consumer) 在购物决策中是否被营销定价线索误导：用 Tool-Lab（信息板过程追踪的改造版，把商品属性放在有成本的工具调用之后）追踪八个商用 LLM 的购买前信息获取。零成本时定价线索几乎不起误导作用；在模糊目标提示下引入获取成本，LLM 会漏掉计算单位价格所需的诊断性属性，做出类似人类启发式的次优选择，而具体目标提示基本保持诊断性搜索与选择最优性。
Motivation: 消费者把购买决策委托给 LLM，但营销线索（just-below pricing、促销框架）是否会操纵 AI 购物代理、以及这种脆弱性来自模型本身还是店面信息架构，此前缺少过程级证据。
Method: 提出 Tool-LLab（Tool-Lab），把信息板过程追踪 (information-board process tracing) 改造为商品属性需通过有成本的工具调用获取；比较零成本与有获取成本两种条件，以及模糊目标提示与具体目标提示，追踪八个来自三家提供商的商用 LLM 的购买前信息获取轨迹。
Result: 跨三家提供商八个商用 LLM：零成本下定价线索（just-below pricing、促销框架）很少误导；有获取成本且目标提示模糊时，LLM 漏掉计算单位价格所需的诊断性属性，选择类似人类启发式的次优选项；具体目标提示则主要保留诊断性搜索与选择最优性。
Conclusion: 委托式 AI 购物中的营销启发式效应由店面信息架构（属性获取成本与提示具体度）决定，而不一定是 LLM 不可改变的缺陷。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EduBehaviors: Assertion-based Schemas for Auditable Coding of Educational Dialogues
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have enabled rapid deployment of language classification and analysis, allowing users to describe complex constructs in natural language, such as pedagogical moves or expressions of learning and engagement, and label them in conversational datasets such as classroom or tutoring transcripts. However, because LLM reasoning is opaque, we have no verifiable, mechanistic insight into why a model chose a label for an utterance, and output differences over time or across models challenge replication. We introduce the EduBehaviors framework to generate interpretable, reliable, and scalable construct annotations in educational dialogue data that retain human agency while leveraging the strengths of generative AI, encoders, and machine learning models. We evaluate the framework on the TalkMoves dataset, predicting the Teacher TalkMoves labels. Our best configuration results in a macro-F1 of 0.764 and 0.756 Cohen's kappa, demonstrating improvements over direct prompting approaches and showing competitiveness with fine-tuned classifiers while gaining the benefit of greater transparency and comparability. To facilitate adoption and operationalization of the EduBehaviors framework in educational dialogue data by other researchers, we also release the EduBehaviors Toolkit with two complementary open-source tools based on the TalkMoves application.

papers.title: A more predictable Madden-Julian Oscillation index derived from Koopman spectral analysis
papers.abstract_en: The Madden-Julian oscillation (MJO) is a major source of subseasonal-to-seasonal (S2S) predictability. The MJO is commonly defined and tracked with indices such as the Real-time Multivariate MJO (RMM) index. Although the RMM provides a useful description of the MJO, its evolution can be noisy and difficult to predict. We define an MJO index using a data-driven approximation of the Koopman operator. The Koopman index captures similar tropical circulation and convection patterns to the RMM but evolves more smoothly and predictably. Skillful prediction extends to 46 days for the Koopman index compared to 11 days for the RMM under the same prediction framework. While this new approach does not recover the RMM as well as operational S2S models, which provide skillful forecasts up to 35 days, the Koopman index could complement existing MJO diagnostics in evaluating and developing extended-range forecast systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Koopman 算子的数据驱动近似重新定义 MJO 指数，其演变比 RMM 更平滑、更可预测：在同一预测框架下可预报技巧延伸到 46 天，而 RMM 只有 11 天。该指数仍能捕捉与 RMM 相似的热带环流和对流型态，但对 RMM 的还原度不及提供 35 天技巧预报的业务 S2S 模式，适合作为现有 MJO 诊断的补充。
Motivation: MJO 是次季节到季节 (S2S) 可预报性的主要来源，但常用的 RMM 指数演变噪声大、难以预测，限制了它在评估和开发延伸期预报系统中的作用。
Method: 用 Koopman 算子的数据驱动近似 (data-driven approximation of the Koopman operator) 定义新 MJO 指数，并在与 RMM 相同的预测框架下做可预报性对比，检验其对热带环流与对流型态的刻画。
Result: Koopman 指数的技巧预报时效达 46 天，同一框架下 RMM 为 11 天；业务 S2S 模式对 RMM 提供最长 35 天的技巧预报，而新指数对 RMM 的还原度不及这些业务模式。
Conclusion: Koopman 谱分析导出的 MJO 指数比 RMM 更平滑、更可预报，可作为现有 MJO 诊断的补充，用于评估和开发延伸期预报系统。

papers.title: Every Fixed Metric Has a Blind Spot: A Learned Atmospheric Critic for Scoring Forecast Realism
papers.abstract_en: Despite their high accuracy on point-wise metrics, machine learning weather forecasting models can exhibit different failure modes such as blurring, periodic irregularities, and other unphysical spatial artifacts. This has motivated a variety of metrics to detect known failure cases. Existing metrics fix a representation or transformation in advance, and that choice limits the artifacts they can detect. We propose to train a discriminator for separating reference data from the model's output, and using its output logit to obtain a divergence-like realism score. The discriminator learns whatever separates the model's fields from real weather, adapting to whichever failure mode that model exhibits. We compare our learned atmospheric critic to existing metrics using various synthetic corruptions applied to ERA5 reanalysis data. Our method successfully identifies the corruptions and ranks their severity, while existing metrics fail on at least one corruption. Additionally, we evaluate forecasts from real weather models, and find that the realism score degrades with longer lead times and the metric generally assigns higher realism to numerical models than to machine learning models.
papers.comment: Accepted to The 2nd Workshop on Advances in Representation Learning for Earth Observation at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 训练一个判别器区分 ERA5 真实场与模式输出，用其 logit 作为发散式的逼真度评分 (realism score)，让度量自己学习该模式的失效模式而非固定变换。在 ERA5 合成退化上该评分能识别全部损坏并按严重度排序，而既有指标至少在一种损坏上失效；对真实模式预报，逼真度随预报时效延长而下降，且数值模式得分普遍高于机器学习模式。
Motivation: ML 天气模式点指标精度高却出现模糊、周期性异常等非物理空间伪影，而现有指标预先固定表示或变换，只能检测已知的那类失效。
Method: 训练一个判别器 (discriminator) 分离参考数据与模式输出，取其输出 logit 作为发散式逼真度评分；判别器学习任何能区分模式场与真实天气的特征，随该模式的失效模式自适应。用施加于 ERA5 再分析数据的多种合成损坏与真实天气模式预报做比较。
Result: 在 ERA5 合成损坏上，该方法成功识别各类损坏并按严重度排序，而既有指标至少在一种损坏上失效；对真实天气模式预报，逼真度评分随预报时效 (lead time) 变长而下降，且该度量总体给数值模式比机器学习模式更高的逼真度。
Conclusion: 固定表示的度量各有盲点，可学习的大气判别器能随模式失效模式自适应地打分；该评分可区分数值模式与 ML 模式的逼真度差异，并随时效退化。

papers.title: Whom Do AI Agents Work For? Role Assignment Induces Sponsorship Bias in LLM Recommenders
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) now serve as conversational shopping assistants on platforms that also sell advertising. These AI agents face a conflict of duty. They advise consumers who rely on their judgment, yet are deployed by platforms that benefit when sponsored listings are chosen. Sponsorship disclosures, designed to allow consumers to penalize paid placements, now reach the AI agent rather than the consumer, and the agent's evaluation of them is hidden from the consumer. Drawing on the fiduciary concept of conflict of duty, we argue that an agent's evaluation of a sponsored listing should not depend on which party deployed it. In controlled choice experiments, we manipulate assigned roles in the system prompt to name either a traveler or a booking platform as the agent's principal. Platform delegation significantly attenuates the penalty that agents apply to sponsored listings and weakens the skepticism that disclosure triggers in their reasoning traces. We replicate out findings across LLMs and reasoning depths. A second study decomposes the disclosure label and shows that the divergence between the two delegates widens significantly when the paid placement is attributed to the platform. Stricter terminology ("Sponsored" instead of "Promoted") lowers choice of paid listings but does not close this gap when the platform is named. The findings show that disclosure mandates designed for human consumers cannot by themselves protect consumers in AI-mediated commerce.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在系统提示词里把 AI 购物代理的委托方从旅客改成订票平台，会显著削弱它对赞助位 (sponsored listing) 本应施加的惩罚，并削弱披露信息在其推理链中触发的怀疑；把付费位归因于平台时两个委托方之间的分歧显著扩大。更严格的措辞（用 Sponsored 而非 Promoted）会降低付费位被选中的比例，但在点名平台时并不能关闭这一差距。
Motivation: 面向消费者的赞助披露如今先到达 AI 代理而非消费者，且代理对披露的评估对消费者不可见；若代理的判断随部署方改变，为人类设计的披露规则在 AI 主导的购物场景中就失效。
Method: 受信义务中的 conflict of duty 概念出发，在系统提示词中操纵被指派角色，分别把 traveler 或 booking platform 设为代理的 principal，做受控选择实验；第二项研究拆解披露标签措辞（Sponsored vs Promoted）与付费位归因，并跨多个 LLM 与推理深度复现。
Result: 平台委托 (platform delegation) 显著削弱代理对赞助位施加的惩罚，也削弱披露在其推理链中触发的怀疑；该发现在多个 LLM 与推理深度上复现。第二项研究显示，当付费位被归因于平台时两个委托方之间的分歧显著扩大；更严格的措辞 Sponsored 相比 Promoted 降低付费位选择率，但在点名平台时未关闭该差距。
Conclusion: 代理对赞助披露的评价取决于谁部署了它，因此仅为人类消费者设计的披露强制措施本身不足以在 AI 中介的商业中保护消费者。

papers.title: When Do Language Models Add Value? Relative Competence in Hybrid Event Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: When a forecasting system already has a prediction from a market, crowd, or statistical model, when should it use a language model? Standalone accuracy cannot answer this question because a less accurate model may still improve the existing forecast. We study this distinction through relative competence, separating a model's replacement advantage from its complementary value. Under Brier loss (squared error between predicted probabilities and binary outcomes), we characterize when model disagreement can correct external forecast errors and derive the population gain from regime-specific affine pooling. We introduce a competence gate that estimates source weights from resolved outcomes, shrinks regime-specific estimates toward a global solution, and chronologically recalibrates the pooled forecast. Across 4,974 resolved binary questions and four language models, the best standalone model has 24.94% higher Brier loss than the calibrated external forecast, yet the gate improves that reference by 3.35% (95% CI, 1.80 to 4.90%). Model contributions vary across forecasting regimes, with larger corrections in thinner markets and forecasting crowds and smaller corrections in higher-participation settings. The gate also shows no statistically detectable performance difference from more flexible contextual aggregators. These results demonstrate that standalone superiority is not necessary for complementary predictive value and that language models should be evaluated relative to the forecasts already available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在混合事件预测中，语言模型即使单独精度更差，仍可通过相对能力 (relative competence) 为已有外部预测带来互补增益。提出的 competence gate 用已决结果估计来源权重、向全局解收缩并按时序重校准，在 4,974 个已决二元问题上把校准后的外部预测 Brier loss 再降 3.35%（95% CI 1.80–4.90%），尽管最佳单模型 Brier loss 比该外部预测高 24.94%。
Motivation: 已有预测系统（市场、crowd 或统计模型）在决定是否引入语言模型时，只看单独精度无法回答问题：更不准确的模型仍可能改善现有预测，需要区分替代优势与互补价值。
Method: 在 Brier loss 下刻画模型分歧何时能纠正外部预测误差，并推导 regime-specific affine pooling 的总体增益；提出 competence gate，从已决结果估计各来源权重、将分体制估计向全局解收缩，并对合并预测做时序重校准 (chronological recalibration)。
Result: 在 4,974 个已决二元问题、四个语言模型上：最佳单模型 Brier loss 比校准后的外部预测高 24.94%，而 gate 在该参考之上改进 3.35%（95% CI 1.80% 到 4.90%）；薄市场与预测 crowd 中修正更大，参与度高的场景修正更小；gate 与更灵活的 contextual aggregator 无可检测的性能差异。
Conclusion: 单独优于现有预测并非产生互补预测价值的必要条件，语言模型应相对于已有可得预测来评估；在参与度高的市场中其增量修正较小。

papers.title: ICM-Bench: Person-Level Identity Reasoning in Multimodal Agents with Long-Term Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon multimodal agents should remember not only what happened but also who participated. This capability depends on linking recurring faces, voices, names, person-associated objects, events, and social relations to consistent identities over time. Existing long-video and multimodal-agent benchmarks measure broad memory question answering, but they do not isolate the ability to maintain recurring person identities and reason over their cross-time relations. We introduce ICM-Bench (Identity-Centric Memory Benchmark), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate identity-centric reasoning over long video memories in multimodal agents. The benchmark contains 839 synthetic clips spanning 141 minutes and 1,217 open-ended questions about six recurring adults in a one-year life album. A theme-configurable pipeline generates the video collection and associates each question with its target identities and traceable supporting evidence. We compare direct caption-memory baselines, memory-augmented agents, and graph-retrieval systems. Gemini 3.1 Pro achieves the highest overall accuracy of 74.0%, yet its score falls to 60.3% on questions that require long-term identity profiles. The results show that current systems recover many event-level memories but remain less reliable when evidence must be accumulated around a stable person.

papers.title: MeshSplatBench: A Unified Benchmark for Triangle- and Mesh-Based Neural Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Triangle- and mesh-based neural rendering seeks to bridge neural representations and graphics engines through triangle primitives compatible with standard rasterization. Yet existing methods were developed and evaluated under inconsistent settings, with few direct comparisons and little evaluation in graphics engines. We introduce MeshSuite, the first benchmark for systematic evaluation of engine deployment and Non-Engine Render in triangle- and mesh-based neural rendering. MeshSuite evaluates two deployment settings: Standard Deployment, using an opaque mesh pipeline with vertex colors and hardware Z-buffering; and Dedicated Deployment, using method-specific engine implementations to preserve appearance and compositing features. For mesh splatting, we also audit exported surfaces for topological and geometric integrity as downstream graphics assets. Our results show that engine deployment reduces image quality in both settings; among evaluated methods, MeshSplatting degrades least under Standard Deployment. Dedicated Deployment preserves most fidelity at roughly 5-33x the runtime of Standard Deployment across two deployment datasets. For mesh splatting, explicit connectivity and shared indexing remain limited: shared vertex indexing alone guarantees neither manifoldness nor global connectivity. These findings show that rasterizability is only part of graphics readiness and underscore the need to assess engine deployment. Project page: https://prinasi.github.io/MeshSuite.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MeshSuite 是首个系统评测三角形/网格神经渲染在图形引擎中部署与 Non-Engine Render 的基准，含 Standard Deployment（不透明网格管线、顶点色、硬件 Z-buffer）与 Dedicated Deployment（按方法定制的引擎实现）两种设定。结果显示两种设定下引擎部署都会降低画质，其中 MeshSplatting 在 Standard Deployment 下退化最小；Dedicated Deployment 保真度更高，但运行时约为 Standard 的 5–33 倍。
Motivation: 三角形/网格神经渲染方法此前在互不一致的设定下开发与评测，直接对比少，且几乎不在图形引擎中评估，无法判断其作为下游图形资产的就绪程度。
Method: 提出 MeshSuite，评测 Standard Deployment（不透明网格管线 + 顶点色 + 硬件 Z-buffer）与 Dedicated Deployment（保留外观与合成功能的方法专用引擎实现）两种部署；对 mesh splatting 额外审计导出表面的拓扑与几何完整性，检查共享顶点索引下的流形性与全局连通性。
Result: 两种设定下引擎部署均降低图像质量；被评方法中 MeshSplatting 在 Standard Deployment 下退化最小。Dedicated Deployment 保真度更高，但在两个部署数据集上运行时约为 Standard Deployment 的 5–33 倍。对 mesh splatting 的审计显示：仅共享顶点索引既不保证流形性 (manifoldness)，也不保证全局连通性。
Conclusion: 可光栅化只是图形就绪 (graphics readiness) 的一部分，评估神经渲染方法时必须单独考察引擎部署下的画质与运行时代价。

papers.title: LLMs Can Design Near-Optimal OR Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: We ask whether large language models (LLMs) can design effective algorithms for well-specified operations research (OR) problems. We study inventory control, queueing network control, and assortment optimization, using benchmark instances from recent papers in each area. We evaluate two levels of LLM use: at level 1, the model receives one problem instance and returns a solution for that instance; at level 2, it receives only the problem class description and broad parameter ranges, and returns an algorithm that maps instance parameters to solutions. Human input is minimal: we give one untuned prompt that describes the problem, and the model has access to a Python sandbox tool with a fixed compute budget. The strongest model we test, gpt-5.6-sol, matches or outperforms the best method reported in those papers on almost all evaluated instances. This holds even at level 2, where the returned algorithm is fixed before seeing the evaluation instances. Performance also improves sharply across models released less than eight months apart, suggesting that this capability is moving quickly. Thus, for the well-specified operations problems we study, a single untuned LLM query can already produce algorithms competitive with specialized methods. These results suggest that frontier LLMs can be a serious empirical baseline for algorithm design in well-specified OR problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在库存控制、排队网络控制与 assortment optimization 三类良定义运筹 (OR) 问题上，让 LLM 直接设计算法：level 1 给单个实例求解，level 2 只给问题类描述与参数范围、返回参数到解的映射算法。最强模型 gpt-5.6-sol 在几乎所有评测实例上匹配或超过原论文报告的最好方法，level 2 亦然，且八个月内发布的模型间性能急剧提升。
Motivation: 良定义 OR 问题的算法设计长期依赖针对每个问题的专门方法，缺少检验前沿 LLM 能否直接产出有竞争力算法的系统评测。
Method: 用近期论文的 benchmark 实例，评测两个 LLM 使用层级：level 1 输入单实例返回解，level 2 只输入问题类描述与宽参数范围返回算法；仅一条未调优 prompt，模型可访问带固定计算预算的 Python sandbox。
Result: 最强模型 gpt-5.6-sol 在几乎所有评测实例上匹配或超过各领域原论文报告的最好方法，level 2（算法在见到评测实例前即固定）同样成立；相隔不足八个月发布的模型之间性能急剧提升。
Conclusion: 对所研究的良定义 OR 问题，单次未调优 LLM 查询产出的算法已可与专门方法竞争，前沿 LLM 可作为算法设计的严肃经验基线。

papers.title: Does Rank Still Matter? Position Bias When AI Agents Shop on Our Behalf
papers.abstract_en: When shopping is delegated to AI agents, it is unclear whether the ranking advantage documented for humans persists. Across 7,000 sessions with five large language models (LLMs) and varying reasoning effort, we compare AI agents with human field data. AI agents search more extensively than human consumers. As with humans, lower-ranked listings are less likely to be inspected, although the effect is smaller for AI agents. Unlike humans, AI agents show a pattern consistent with the lost-in-the-middle effect, whereby middle listings have the lowest probability of inspection. At the choice stage, position effects are concentrated at lower reasoning effort, but higher effort reduces the middle penalty for every LLM that exhibits it. These findings suggest that, when search is delegated, displayed attributes may matter more than placement, and that exposure to position bias depends on how the AI agent is configured.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 7,000 个购物委托会话中，五个 LLM 的 AI 代理与人类现场数据表现出不同的位置偏置：低排名商品被查看的概率同样更低但效应弱于人类，且出现 lost-in-the-middle 模式（中间位置查看概率最低）。选择阶段的位置效应集中在低推理强度，提高推理强度会削弱每个表现出该效应的 LLM 的中间惩罚，因此位置偏置暴露程度取决于代理配置。
Motivation: 人类搜索排序优势已被充分记录，但购物委托给 AI 代理后该优势是否延续并不清楚，且位置偏置是否随代理配置变化缺乏证据。
Method: 在 7,000 个会话中比较五个 LLM、不同推理强度 (reasoning effort) 下的 AI 代理行为，并与人类现场数据 (human field data) 对照，分搜索查看阶段与选择阶段考察位置效应。
Result: AI 代理搜索范围比人类消费者更广；低排名列表被查看概率更低但效应弱于人类；AI 代理呈 lost-in-the-middle 模式，中间列表查看概率最低；选择阶段位置效应集中在低推理强度，提高推理强度会降低每个表现出该效应的 LLM 的中间惩罚。
Conclusion: 搜索被委托后，展示属性可能比位置更重要，而位置偏置的暴露程度取决于 AI 代理的配置方式。

papers.title: Frozen Memory Is Not Enough: Rethinking External Memory as Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Methods for improving knowledge use in large language models typically fall into two regimes. Non-parametric retrieval offers flexible access to external knowledge, but adds retrieval latency, context overhead, and only shallow integration with the backbone. Parametric adaptation is efficient at inference time, but entangles knowledge with model weights and can be hard to update, audit, or transfer. Engram-style hashed memory occupies a middle regime: it stores learned information in an external, addressable table, yet consumes that table through a small learned reader. This raises a basic question: when such a memory is moved across backbones, what matters more, the frozen memory itself or the target-side reader? We study this question through cross-model frozen-memory extraction, in which a memory trained on a source model is frozen and attached to a different target model, with only a lightweight reader trained. Ablations show that learned memory content and correct addressing both matter, but the transferred table becomes useful only through a reader aligned to the target model. In downstream question answering tasks, a dual-layer, four-branch reader nearly closes the gap between same-model and cross-model reuse, achieving an average score of 38.8 under our controlled evaluation protocol. Moreover, when the provider reader is directly compatible with the target interface, the frozen artifact can provide substantial utility without target-side training, while optional reader adaptation yields further improvement. These results suggest that Engram can serve as a reusable external knowledge artifact, provided that the target has access to a compatible reader interface; target-side adaptation can further improve alignment when direct reader reuse is insufficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究 Engram 式哈希外部记忆在跨模型复用时的关键因素：把源模型上训练的记忆表冻结后迁移到不同目标模型，只训练一个轻量 reader。消融显示记忆内容与正确寻址都重要，但迁移表只有在与目标模型对齐的 reader 下才真正有用；双层四分支 reader 在下游问答上平均分 38.8，几乎弥合同模型与跨模型复用的差距。
Motivation: 非参数检索带来延迟与上下文开销、与骨干整合浅；参数化适配把知识纠缠进权重、难以更新审计。Engram 式外部记忆处于中间地带，但记忆表跨骨干迁移时，冻结记忆本身与目标侧 reader 哪个更关键并不清楚。
Method: 提出 cross-model frozen-memory extraction：在源模型上训练的记忆表冻结后挂到不同目标模型，仅训练轻量 reader。对比双层四分支 reader，并检验当 provider reader 与目标接口直接兼容时能否免目标侧训练直接复用。
Result: 消融表明学习到的记忆内容与正确寻址都重要，但迁移表需与目标模型对齐的 reader 才有用；双层四分支 reader 在下游问答任务上平均分 38.8（受控评估协议），几乎弥合同模型与跨模型复用的差距；reader 接口直接兼容时冻结产物无需目标侧训练即可提供可观效用，可选的 reader 适配还能进一步提升。
Conclusion: Engram 可作为可复用的外部知识产物，前提是目标侧能访问兼容的 reader 接口；当直接复用 reader 不够时，目标侧适配可进一步改善对齐。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AVA-Encoder: Towards Agent-Native Video Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Agentic video creation systems remain far from cinematic-grade quality: their underlying models struggle to plan how story, characters, visuals, and sound fit together, and high-quality creation trajectories to learn such planning abilities are scarce. Finished human films embody this knowledge, but in a tightly coupled audiovisual form that agents cannot directly read or manipulate. We propose the Agentic Video Auto-Encoder (AVA-Encoder), which works backward from finished films, turning them into agent-native representations with reconstruction itself as supervision. It encodes a film into a Film Knowledge Graph (Film KG) of structured-text nodes, typed dependency edges, and linked multimodal assets, then regenerates the film from this graph with a fixed decoder. Reconstruction residuals are distilled into textual gradients that drive dual-loop self-evolution: an outer loop learns a shared encoding policy across videos, and an inner loop refines each video's Film KG at test time. AVA-Encoder improves reconstruction fidelity by 20.7 percentage points over the strongest baseline; its learned policy outperforms a finely human-tuned policy with over 70 percent fewer system-prompt tokens; and Film KGs support coordinated editing and improve all tested downstream creation systems. We release the framework, a reconstruction benchmark, and a Film KG dataset.

papers.title: Rubric Dropout: A Simple Way to Mitigate Reward Hacking in Rubric-as-Reward RL
papers.abstract_en: Rubric-based reinforcement learning, in which an LLM judge scores responses against prompt-specific criteria, has become a standard way to post-train language models on tasks without verifiable answers. The rubric, however, is only a proxy for response quality, and a policy trained against it long enough learns to exploit the difference. We train models with GRPO on medical and science rubrics and grade their responses on out-of-distribution (OOD) benchmarks throughout training with two judges: the training judge and a stronger OOD judge. The two scores first rise together and then diverge. The policy is learning to satisfy the training judge without writing better responses, which is a form of reward hacking. To mitigate it, we propose Rubric Dropout, which applies dropout to rubric criteria: at each training step, a random subset of each rubric's criteria is removed from the reward, so the rewarded subset of criteria is resampled at each step. All responses sampled for the same prompt are scored on the same subset, so their rewards remain comparable, and evaluation always uses the full rubric. We also introduce Block Dropout, which drops semantically similar criteria together so that a near duplicate of a dropped criterion cannot keep rewarding the same behavior. Across both benchmarks and models from 1.7B to 8B, dropout improves the gold judge's score on OOD benchmarks by up to 3 percent on HealthBench-Hard and 7 percent on ResearchQA, and it reduces both the gap between the two judges and over-crediting. It keeps in-domain reward close to the baseline, and dropout rates of 30-50 percent work best. Block Dropout improves the gold judge's OOD score further at the same dropout rate. Changing which criteria are rewarded at each step is a simple, inexpensive way to make rubric rewards harder to exploit.

Motivation: 用 LLM judge 按 prompt 专属 rubric 打分做后训练时，rubric 只是回答质量的代理；策略训练足够久就会利用训练 judge 与真实质量之间的差距，即 reward hacking。
Method: 在医疗与科学 rubric 上用 GRPO 训练，训练全程用训练 judge 与更强的 OOD judge 双重评分观察二者分叉；提出 Rubric Dropout，每步随机移除 rubric 的一个 criteria 子集参与 reward，同一 prompt 的所有响应按同一子集打分，评测用完整 rubric；另提出 Block Dropout，把语义相近的 criteria 一起丢弃，防止近重复条目继续奖励同一行为。

Conclusion: 逐步改变被奖励的 criteria 子集是一种简单且低成本的手段，能让 rubric reward 更难被策略钻空子，且不必牺牲 in-domain reward。

papers.title: FACT: Failure-Aware Causal Training for World-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent world-action models (WAMs) show that co-training policies with future prediction can provide physical priors for action generation. Building on the future-prediction ability of video models, many WAMs generate future videos and recover actions with inverse-dynamics models, or use these predicted videos as goal conditions for action generation. In both cases, the world model is trained mostly on successful demonstrations and has little reason to predict the consequences of bad actions. We introduce FACT, a causal World-Action Model that predicts future video and task progress conditioned on the executed action. This action-conditioned interface allows failure rollouts to supervise action consequences, turning bad actions into valid future targets rather than being discarded. Failure-aware training makes the progress predictor aware of both successful and failed action outcomes, which can optionally be used to score sampled action candidates at inference. Extensive experiments on simulation and real-world bimanual manipulation tasks show that FACT outperforms many existing baselines, improves as failure data are incorporated into training, and reduces success-biased future hallucination under bad actions. See more details at https://fact-wam.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FACT 是一个因果式 world-action model：以已执行动作为条件预测未来视频与任务进度，让失败轨迹也能作为动作后果的监督信号，而不是被丢弃。失败感知训练使进度预测器同时见过成功与失败结果，并可在推理时给采样出的动作候选打分。在仿真与真实双臂操作任务上，FACT 优于多个现有基线，随失败数据加入训练而持续提升，并减少在坏动作下的成功偏置式未来幻觉。
Motivation: 现有 world-action model 的世界模型几乎只用成功示范训练，没有动力去预测坏动作的后果，导致对失败动作的未来预测出现成功偏置的幻觉。
Method: FACT 以执行过的动作为条件，联合预测未来视频与任务进度（action-conditioned interface）；失败 rollout 被转成合法的未来预测目标参与训练；训练出的进度预测器可在推理阶段对采样的动作候选打分。
Result: 在仿真与真实双臂操作 (bimanual manipulation) 任务上，FACT 超过多个现有基线；随失败数据被纳入训练，性能持续提升；在坏动作条件下减少了成功偏置的未来幻觉。
Conclusion: 把失败数据当作动作后果的监督而非噪声，可以让 world-action model 学到更忠实的因果动态，并在动作生成时利用进度预测器筛选候选动作。

papers.title: Hopformer: Homogeneity-Pursuit Transformer for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting multiple time-series with high-dimensional covariates presents a core challenge: unifying common temporal patterns while retaining meaningful series-specific information. We introduce Hopformer (Homogeneity-Pursuit Transformer), a two-stage framework that addresses this challenge. In the first stage, we perform a Sparsity Pattern Aggregation (SPA) scheme extracting a common low-variance trend that incorporates the covariates. This acts as a homogenization layer. In the second stage, a LoRA-fine-tuned Transformer models the remaining complex dependencies in the residual. Our method is theoretically grounded. We prove that SPA achieves a near-optimal bias-variance trade-off via an oracle inequality. We also provide generalization bounds for the second stage under dependent time series data. Hopformer sets a new state of the art, improving MASE by an average of 6.56% across synthetic and real-world forecasting benchmarks.
papers.comment: 36 pages, 5 figures, 25 tables. v2: new end-to-end risk bound under temporal dependence; expanded experiments (6 datasets, 10 baselines) with ablations and statistical inference; extended appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Hopformer 用两阶段框架处理带高维协变量的多序列时间序列预测：先用 Sparsity Pattern Aggregation (SPA) 抽取含协变量的公共低方差趋势做同质化，再用 LoRA 微调的 Transformer 建模残差中的复杂依赖。在合成与真实预测基准上平均把 MASE 改善 6.56%，并给出 SPA 的 oracle inequality 与第二阶段在相依数据下的泛化界。
Motivation: 多序列加高维协变量的预测要同时统一公共时序模式并保留序列特有信息，单一模型难以兼顾，且在时间相依数据上缺少理论保证。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段 Sparsity Pattern Aggregation (SPA) 抽取纳入协变量的公共低方差趋势作为同质化层；第二阶段用 LoRA 微调的 Transformer 对残差建模。理论上证明 SPA 通过 oracle inequality 达到近最优 bias-variance 权衡，并给出第二阶段在相依时间序列下的泛化界。
Result: 在合成与真实世界预测基准上平均提升 MASE 6.56%，达到新的 state of the art；arXiv comment 记录实验覆盖 6 个数据集、10 个基线，含消融与统计推断，v2 新增时间相依下的端到端风险界。
Conclusion: 把公共趋势的稀疏同质化与 LoRA 残差建模分成两阶段，能在保留序列特有信息的同时给出可证明的偏差-方差与泛化保证，并在多基准上刷新 MASE。

papers.title: Correlation-Aware Contextual Bandits with Surrogate Rewards for LLM Routing
papers.abstract_en: We study contextual bandit problems with correlated arms and access to surrogate reward signals produced by a machine learning model, motivated by applications such as large language model (LLM) routing. Unlike classical contextual bandits that rely solely on bandit feedback and assume conditional independence across arms, our setting allows context-dependent inter-arm correlations and auxiliary reward information that may be noisy or misspecified. We propose algorithms that leverage such surrogate rewards through two complementary designs. A coupled reward-mixing approach pools true and surrogate rewards to accelerate learning when surrogate signals are reliable, while a decoupled prediction-mixing approach maintains separate estimators for bandit feedback and surrogate rewards and adaptively combines their predictions. This decoupling yields robustness to surrogate misspecification, recovering regret guarantees comparable to reward-only bandit methods in the worst case, while achieving improved regret when surrogate predictions are sufficiently informative. We provide theoretical regret analyses for both approaches and evaluate them on LLM routing benchmarks under varying accuracy versus cost trade-offs. The results demonstrate improved sample efficiency and consistently better accuracy-cost trade-offs compared to standard contextual bandit baselines and strong static routing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 路由中臂间相关且带噪声代理奖励的 contextual bandit，提出两种利用 surrogate reward 的算法：coupled reward-mixing 混合真实与代理奖励加速学习，decoupled prediction-mixing 分别维护两个估计器并自适应组合预测。后者在代理奖励错设 (misspecified) 的最坏情形下仍能取得与仅用 bandit 反馈方法相当的 regret 保证，代理预测足够准时 regret 更优；在 LLM routing 基准上样本效率与 accuracy-cost 权衡均优于标准 contextual bandit 基线和强静态路由方法。
Motivation: 经典 contextual bandit 假设臂条件独立且只有 bandit 反馈，而 LLM 路由中各模型（臂）表现随上下文相关，且可获得机器学习模型产生的代理奖励——这类信号可能有噪声甚至错设，如何安全利用是缺口。
Method: 两种互补设计：coupled reward-mixing 将真实奖励与代理奖励混合以在代理可靠时加速学习；decoupled prediction-mixing 为 bandit 反馈与代理奖励分别维护估计器，再自适应组合预测。两者均给出理论 regret 分析，并在 LLM routing 基准上改变 accuracy-cost 权衡进行评估。
Result: 理论上，decoupled 设计在代理奖励错设的最坏情形下恢复与 reward-only bandit 方法相当的 regret 保证，在代理预测足够信息量时取得更优 regret。实验上，在 LLM routing 基准的不同 accuracy-cost 权衡设置下，相比标准 contextual bandit 基线与强静态路由方法，样本效率提升且 accuracy-cost 权衡持续更优。
Conclusion: 把代理奖励与 bandit 反馈在预测层面解耦，可以在不牺牲最坏情形 regret 的前提下利用代理信号的额外信息，从而改善 LLM 路由的样本效率与成本-准确率权衡。
