papers.title: RhyMix: A Lightweight Adaptive Multi-Rhythm Network for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Real-world time series exhibit complex dynamics characterized by multiple simultaneous temporal patterns: short-term fluctuations, periodic seasonal cycles, long-term trends, and irregular abrupt changes. However, most forecasting architectures rely on single-path temporal modeling---transformers capture long-range dependencies but smooth local variations, convolutions capture local patterns but have limited receptive fields, and linear models are efficient but cannot capture nonlinear dynamics---so no single architectural paradigm captures all these pattern types simultaneously. To address this, we introduce RhyMix (RHYthm MIXture), a hybrid neural architecture designed around a parallel dual-path modeling paradigm with adaptive gating mechanisms. RhyMix integrates two complementary encoding branches: (i) a Cyclic Path that incorporates explicit seasonal inductive bias through learnable cyclic embeddings; and (ii) a lightweight Multi-Scale Temporal Convolutional Network with Channel Attention (MSTCN-CA) Path that captures temporal dependencies across different receptive fields. Unlike prior hybrid architectures that combine components with fixed weights, RhyMix computes its fusion weights from the input, adapting to each sample. Its key methodological contribution is a two-level adaptive gating framework: a per-channel path gate that fuses four specialized forecasting heads, and a per-sample hybrid gate that balances the two paths. This design maintains linear complexity. Across 12 real-world benchmarks, RhyMix achieves the best average MSE on 9 datasets and the best average MAE on 8 datasets. The model remains lightweight (40K parameters for C=7) with low-latency inference (5.2--7.5 ms), making it suitable for resource-constrained edge devices and real-time deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RhyMix 用并行双路径（可学习周期嵌入的 Cyclic Path + 带通道注意力的多尺度时序卷积 MSTCN-CA）加两级自适应门控做长程时间序列预报，融合权重由输入逐样本计算而非固定。在 12 个真实基准上，9 个数据集平均 MSE 最优、8 个平均 MAE 最优；C=7 时仅 40K 参数、推理 5.2–7.5 ms，面向边缘与实时部署。
Motivation: 单一架构范式无法同时刻画短期波动、周期季节、长期趋势与突变：Transformer 平滑局部变化、卷积感受野有限、线性模型抓不住非线性动力学。
Method: 双路径编码：Cyclic Path 用可学习周期嵌入注入季节归纳偏置，MSTCN-CA Path 用多尺度时序卷积加通道注意力覆盖不同感受野；两级门控融合——逐通道 path gate 融合四个专用预报头，逐样本 hybrid gate 平衡两条路径，整体保持线性复杂度。
Result: 在 12 个真实世界基准上，9 个数据集取得最佳平均 MSE，8 个取得最佳平均 MAE；C=7 时参数量 40K，推理延迟 5.2–7.5 ms。
Conclusion: 输入自适应的门控混合双路径可以在保持线性复杂度与轻量规模的同时覆盖多时间尺度模式，适合资源受限的实时预报部署。

papers.title: What is Left for Us? Second Scholarship Against the Degradation of Research by AI
papers.abstract_en: We argue that generative AI can degrade research by eroding the very practices through which scholarly judgement is formed. As constitutive conditions for the production and validation of knowledge, these practices cannot be reduced to the outputs of research, which is what AI tools so effectively simulate. When scholars delegate central tasks of inquiry to Large Language Models (LLMs), they may stop engaging in these practices and lose the formation they provide: the output may improve while the researcher fails to develop. Against this risk, merely keeping humans "in the loop" as prompters or quality checkers of AI outputs is insufficient to preserve research as a site of intellectual formation. What is needed instead is a renewed commitment to research as a lived practice in which judgement is formed gradually, often through friction, and participation in a scholarly community. We defend it because it rests on four sources and warrants of research that cannot be automated: tacit knowledge, personal commitment, socialisation, and deep reading. These enact what we call second scholarship, i.e., the reappropriation of scholarly craft, chosen out of a critical experience of what AI tools can and cannot do. Researchers who practise it may delegate tasks to these tools, provided that their own judgement in the delegated competence is already formed, that they can answer for the output, and that they keep exercising the competence themselves. What cannot and should not be delegated becomes what research communities must value and answer for. This is what is left for us.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论证生成式 AI 会通过取代学者形成判断力的实践来侵蚀研究质量：即使产出变好，研究者本人却未得到训练。作者主张仅让人「在环内」做提示者或质检员不足以保住研究作为智识养成场所的作用，应以「second scholarship」——默会知识、个人投入、学术社会化与深度阅读这四种不可自动化的来源——重新占有学术手艺。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 能高效模拟研究的产出，但研究的判断力只能在实践中形成；一旦把核心探究任务委托给 LLM，产出可能改善而研究者不再成长，这威胁的是知识生产与验证的构成性条件本身。
Method: 规范性论证：区分研究产出与其形成过程，指出二者不可互换；论证 human-in-the-loop（提示者/质检员）不足以保存研究的养成功能；提出 second scholarship 概念，建立在默会知识、个人承诺、社会化、深度阅读四个不可自动化来源之上，并给出委托任务的三个条件（判断力已先形成、能为产出负责、持续亲自行使该能力）。
Result: 纯论证性论文，无实验或定量结果；核心定性主张是：委托任务给 LLM 时若研究者判断力尚未形成，产出改善与研究者成长会脱钩，而仅保留人在环内的监督角色无法弥补这一养成缺口。
Conclusion: 研究中不可委托、也不应委托的部分——即判断力的形成——正是学术共同体必须珍视并为之负责的部分；委托的合法性以判断力已形成且持续练习为前提。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LIME: Learning Intent-aware Camera Motion from Egocentric Video
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous robots often need to move their camera before they can act: to inspect an object, reveal an occluded region, or obtain a view that responds to a user's intent. While vision-language navigation translates instructions to base motion and vision-language-action policies map instructions to manipulation actions, vision-language conditioned camera motion remains comparatively underexplored as a first-class action. We formulate vision-language conditioned camera motion generation: given a current RGB observation and a free-form natural-language intent, predict a relative target camera pose for the next observation. The challenge is that useful viewpoint changes depend on latent perceptual intent, ranging from coarse spatial moves to fine-grained inspection or occlusion revealing. To model this structure, we mine multi-intent camera-motion supervision from egocentric video via hindsight labeling, pairing each relative SE(3) target pose with plausible intents and observation-gain descriptions inferred from the reached view. We propose LIME, a vision-language camera-motion generator that combines an autoregressive observation-gain output with a continuous flow-matching pose head. This design lets the model jointly predict what the next view should reveal while representing multi-hypothesis target views. Across viewpoint-prediction experiments and downstream robotic tasks, we show that LIME learns intent-conditioned camera motion from passive egocentric video, turning ordinary human recordings into supervision for a reusable active-perception primitive that supports general-purpose viewpoint selection, manipulation, embodied question answering, and mid-distance navigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LIME 把「按语言意图移动相机」形式化为条件相机运动生成：给定当前 RGB 与自由文本意图，输出下一个观测的相对 SE(3) 目标位姿。它用事后标注 (hindsight labeling) 从被动第一视角视频里挖出多意图监督，把每个相对位姿配上可能的意图与观测增益描述，再用自回归观测增益输出加连续 flow-matching 位姿头联合预测下一视图应揭示什么并表达多假设目标视图。
Motivation: 视觉语言导航把指令译成底盘运动、VLA 策略把指令映射到操作动作，而以视觉语言为条件的相机运动作为一等动作仍研究不足；有用的视角变化又取决于潜在的感知意图，从粗粒度空间移动到细粒度检查、遮挡揭示差异很大。
Method: 先从被动第一视角视频用 hindsight labeling 挖多意图相机运动监督，将每个相对 SE(3) 目标位姿与从到达视图推断出的可能意图和 observation-gain 描述配对；再提出 LIME 生成器，自回归地生成观测增益文本，同时用连续 flow-matching 位姿头回归目标位姿，二者联合建模下一视图应揭示的内容与多假设目标视图。
Result: 在视角预测实验与下游机器人任务上，LIME 能从被动第一视角视频学到意图条件化的相机运动，把普通人录像转成可复用的主动感知原语，支撑通用视角选择、操作、具身问答 (embodied question answering) 与中距离导航。
Conclusion: 普通人类录像可以充当意图条件相机运动的监督来源，使相机运动成为可跨视角选择、操作、具身问答与导航复用的主动感知动作原语。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Self-Organized Conformal Prediction: Reducing Regional Coverage Gaps with Unsupervised Group Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction guarantees marginal coverage, but a pooled calibration quantile can hide systematic undercoverage across heterogeneous regions of the feature space. We introduce Self-Organized Conformal Prediction (SOCP), a calibration scheme that discovers input-space groups with an unsupervised Self-Organizing Map (SOM) trained without calibration data. At prediction time, the query's best-matching unit (BMU) retrieves a calibration buffer from one cell, a fixed grid neighborhood, or a prototype enlargement (Regimes 1 to 3). When fixed neighborhoods are too sparse, Regime 3 adds cells by prototype distance, using a global budget selected from training cell occupancies and the planned calibration size before any calibration score is observed. The predictor and nonconformity score remain unchanged. Cell-only retrieval has exact cell-conditional validity, and each fixed union of cells has exact retrieved-set validity. Interpreting a neighborhood threshold at its central cell incurs an explicit Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) bias term. Across ten regression and classification benchmarks, SOCP lowers the mean weighted coverage gap (WCovGap) relative to pooled split conformal prediction (SCP) on all ten datasets. The mean relative change is -14.8%, with a mean increase of 3.0% in output size. Under fixed-neighborhood retrieval, SO calibration lowers mean WCovGap across ten seeds in 43 of 50 score and dataset comparisons, while SO-SCP lowers it for every dataset at all three tested external partition granularities. These results provide local group calibration without supervised partitions or predictor retraining, while the diagnostics make the cost and limits of locality explicit. The code is available at https://github.com/LouisTier/SOCP.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Updated to the camera-ready version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SOCP 用不看校准数据的 Self-Organizing Map (SOM) 在输入空间自动分组，按查询的 best-matching unit (BMU) 从单格、固定邻域或按原型距离扩充的格集合 (Regimes 1–3) 取校准缓冲，从而在保持边际覆盖的同时压低区域覆盖缺口。十个回归与分类基准上相对 pooled split conformal prediction (SCP) 的平均加权覆盖缺口 (WCovGap) 相对变化为 -14.8%，代价是输出尺寸平均增大 3.0%。
Motivation: Conformal prediction 只保证边际覆盖，单一 pooled 校准分位数会掩盖特征空间中异质区域的系统性欠覆盖；现有做法需要有监督分区或重训预测器。
Method: 用不使用校准数据训练的 SOM 发现输入空间分组；预测时按查询 BMU 从单个 cell、固定网格邻域或按原型距离增补 cell 的缓冲中检索 (Regime 3 的全局预算在观察任何校准分数之前，由训练期 cell 占用率与计划校准规模选定)。预测器与 nonconformity score 保持不变；单格检索具精确的 cell-conditional validity，固定 cell 并集具精确的 retrieved-set validity，邻域阈值在中心 cell 解释时引入显式 Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) 偏差项。
Result: 十个回归与分类基准上，SOCP 相对 pooled SCP 在全部十个数据集上都降低平均 WCovGap，平均相对变化 -14.8%，输出尺寸平均增加 3.0%。固定邻域检索下，SO 校准在 50 组 score×数据集比较中的 43 组上跨十个 seed 降低平均 WCovGap；SO-SCP 在三个外部划分粒度下对每个数据集都降低 WCovGap。
Conclusion: 无需有监督分区或重训预测器即可获得局部群体校准，且诊断明确给出局部性的代价与边界；代码见 github.com/LouisTier/SOCP。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: Geological text descriptions in ill-posed inverse problems: insights from learned hydraulic-conductivity inversion
papers.abstract_en: Hydraulic-conductivity inversion is ill posed: even complete head observations can leave structural ambiguity. Geological text descriptions can supply additional information about subsurface structure to constrain reconstruction. However, it remains unclear when descriptions improve reconstruction and how solvers use their stated content. We examine these questions in learned inversion using a synthetic Darcy-flow dataset with idealised descriptions, varying observation density and flow direction. After sparse-observation training, descriptions can improve reconstruction over models trained without them when observations leave structural ambiguity, though gains vary across conditions and runs. Instance-specific content can improve reconstruction beyond field-type information. Editing this content shifts reconstructions toward the stated geometry of selected features, less strongly as observations become more informative about those features. We do not establish a reconstruction advantage of text over numerical inputs encoding the same geological information. Finally, we discuss how this complementarity could guide the joint design of measurements and geological knowledge acquisition in site investigations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在合成 Darcy 流水力传导率 (hydraulic-conductivity) 反演中，稀疏观测留下结构歧义时，加入地质文本描述可使学习型反演的重建优于不带描述的模型；描述中的实例级内容还能把重建推向所陈述的目标几何，且观测越能约束该特征、编辑效果越弱。作者明确未确立文本相对编码同等地质信息的数值输入的重建优势。
Motivation: 水力传导率反演是不适定问题，即使完整水头观测也留有结构歧义；地质文本可补充地下结构信息，但描述何时真正改善重建、求解器如何使用其内容尚不清楚。
Method: 在合成 Darcy-flow 数据集上做学习型反演 (learned inversion)，使用理想化地质描述，变化观测密度与流向；先做稀疏观测训练，再对比带/不带描述的模型，并编辑描述中的实例级内容观察重建如何随之移动。
Result: 当观测留下结构歧义时，带描述的模型重建优于无描述训练的模型，但增益随条件与运行而变；实例级内容带来的改善超出仅场类型 (field-type) 信息；编辑该内容使重建向所陈述的目标几何移动，且观测对这些特征越具信息性、移动越弱。

papers.title: PROSE: Training-Free Egocentric Scene Registration with Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Registering two captures of the same indoor space taken at different times underpins persistent spatial memory for robots and AR systems, yet the realistic version of this task is egocentric and its most scalable form is RGB-only. Head-mounted cameras yield blurry, fast-moving, partially overlapping views from which dense geometry is hard to recover. Classical registration leans on exactly the clean point clouds this setting lacks, while learned scene-graph methods require a pre-built or annotated graph and a trained matcher that we find brittle under egocentric data. We take a different route, using a pretrained vision-language model as the source of both scene understanding and cross-scan matching. Our method, PROSE (Prompted Scene rEgistration), lifts each RGB sequence into an object-level 3D scene graph using off-the-shelf foundation models for geometry, segmentation, and language, then prompts the same VLM to match object instances across the two RGB sequences. To make this matching tractable and reliable, we leverage object heights as a prior and verify each proposed match with a paired same/different query, then solve for the rigid transform by hypothesizing a candidate per matched object and selecting the one with the strongest geometric consensus. PROSE adds no learned parameters and requires no depth sensor, training, or annotated graph. On the egocentric Aria Digital Twin and Aria Everyday Activities benchmarks, it outperforms both geometric and learned scene-graph baselines in registration accuracy, on ground-truth and RGB-reconstructed point clouds alike, and the scene graph it produces transfers directly to downstream tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PROSE 用同一个预训练视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 同时承担场景理解与跨扫描匹配，把两段第一人称 RGB 序列各自提升为物体级 3D 场景图，再以物体高度为先验、配对同/异查询验证候选匹配，最后按几何一致性最强的假设求解刚体变换。在 Aria Digital Twin 与 Aria Everyday Activities 两个第一人称基准上，其配准精度超过几何方法与已学习的 scene-graph 基线，且在真值点云与 RGB 重建点云上都成立。
Motivation: 机器人与 AR 的持久空间记忆需要在不同时间重访同一室内空间时把两次采集配准起来，但真实场景是第一人称、RGB-only：头戴相机画面模糊、运动快、重叠有限，难以恢复稠密几何；经典方法依赖干净点云，已学习的 scene-graph 方法又需要预建或标注图，且在第一人称数据上脆弱。
Method: PROSE (Prompted Scene rEgistration) 不引入任何可学习参数：用现成基础模型做几何、分割与语言，把每段 RGB 序列提升为物体级 3D 场景图；用物体高度作为先验缩小匹配空间，对每个候选匹配做配对的 same/different 查询验证；对每个已匹配物体假设一个候选刚体变换，选出几何一致性最强的那个作为最终解。无需深度传感器、训练或标注图。
Result: 在 egocentric Aria Digital Twin 与 Aria Everyday Activities 基准上，配准精度优于几何基线与已学习的 scene-graph 基线，且在 ground-truth 点云与 RGB 重建点云两种输入上都保持优势；产出的场景图可直接迁移到下游任务。
Conclusion: 免训练的 VLM 驱动配准在第一人称 RGB-only 条件下可行：把场景理解与跨扫描匹配都交给同一个预训练 VLM，配合高度先验与几何一致性验证，即可超过依赖干净点云或已训练匹配器的方案。

papers.title: DIRECT: When and Where Should You Allocate Test-Time Compute in Embodied Planners?
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as high-level planners for embodied agents, with an emerging strategy of scaling test-time compute to improve capability. However, we observe that doing so increases latency, token usage, and FLOPs while yielding uneven, often diminishing gains in downstream success, limiting where embodied agents can be deployed. We argue that choosing when and where to spend test-time compute is central to bringing frontier performance to the real world, and we can budget inference at the planning level. We introduce DIRECT, a routing framework that uses multimodal scene context to allocate compute at each step of a closed-loop agent, selecting a planner for every subtask, improving the success--cost Pareto frontier over fixed model selection. Across three dominant scaling axes, namely chain-of-thought depth, model size, and memory history, our experiments on VLABench and RoboMME show that test-time compute is not a uniform lever: different axes yield qualitatively distinct capability gains. We validate these insights on a physical Franka arm in a DROID setup spanning zero-shot manipulation and long-horizon chaining, where our router matches or exceeds a stronger model's success rate at up to 65% lower average latency. Ultimately, our results show that naively scaling test-time compute is wasteful, and DIRECT can provide frontier-level embodied planning at a fraction of the cost. Project page can be found at jadee-dao.github.io/direct/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出具身规划器的测试时算力路由框架 DIRECT：用多模态场景上下文在闭环 agent 的每个子任务步选择用哪个 planner，把算力预算下沉到规划层级。在 VLABench、RoboMME 与 Franka 实机 DROID 设置（含零样本操作与长程串联）上，DIRECT 在平均延迟降低最多 65% 的同时匹配或超过更强模型的成功率，改善成功-成本 Pareto 前沿。
Motivation: VLM 作为高层规划器时盲目放大测试时算力会推高延迟、token 用量与 FLOPs，而下游成功率增益不均且常递减，限制了具身 agent 的实际部署范围。
Method: DIRECT 是一个路由框架：以多模态场景上下文为输入，在闭环 agent 的每一步为每个子任务挑选 planner，从而在规划层面分配推理预算；实验沿三条扩展轴展开，即 chain-of-thought 深度、模型规模与记忆历史长度。
Result: 在 VLABench 与 RoboMME 上，三条扩展轴带来性质上不同的能力增益，说明测试时算力并非均匀杠杆；在物理 Franka 机械臂的 DROID 设置（覆盖零样本操作与长程串联）中，路由器以最多 65% 更低的平均延迟匹配或超过更强模型的成功率。
Conclusion: 朴素放大测试时算力是浪费的：按场景逐步路由 planner 可以用一小部分成本提供前沿水平的具身规划能力。

papers.title: HARP: Efficient Data Selection for Finetuning Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Finetuning data selection requires balancing two competing goals: selecting examples that improve the downstream objective, and doing so without repeatedly finetuning models. Train-free selectors are scalable but rely on proxies such as embedding similarity or clustering, which may not match the target objective. Train-based selectors better reflect downstream utility through gradient signals, subset evaluation, or Shapley attribution, but require many costly train-evaluate iterations. We propose Hierarchical Active Region Pruning (HARP), an efficient train-based selector that preserves downstream alignment while reducing selection cost. HARP organizes the training pool into a node-leaf hierarchy, evaluates only representative leaves, and infers unmeasured utilities with empirical Bayes posteriors. It then selects data using two complementary envelopes: HARP-C, which conservatively controls redundancy, and HARP-E, which additively rewards complementary regions. We theoretically show that, under local smoothness and bounded estimation error, HARP controls selection error while reducing train-evaluate cost. Across 3 base models, 3 finetuning datasets, and 4 reasoning benchmarks (36 settings), HARP variants achieve the highest accuracy among ranked methods in 23 settings and obtain 36-setting mean accuracies of 64.2 and 63.5, respectively, compared with 59.3 for the strongest baseline, NICE. HARP-C trains on roughly 9x fewer examples than the budgeted baselines and 75x fewer than full finetuning, combining higher mean accuracy with a smaller mean training-set size than every ranked baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HARP 是一种基于训练的数据选择器：把训练池组织成节点-叶层级，只评估代表性叶子，用 empirical Bayes 后验推断未测样本的效用，再用 HARP-C（保守控制冗余）与 HARP-E（加性奖励互补区域）两个包络选数据。在 3 个基座模型 × 3 个微调数据集 × 4 个推理基准共 36 个设置上，两个变体在 23 个设置中取得最高准确率，36 设置平均准确率 64.2 与 63.5，对比最强基线 NICE 的 59.3，且 HARP-C 的训练样本量约为预算基线的 1/9、全量微调的 1/75。
Motivation: 免训练选择器靠 embedding 相似度或聚类等代理量，可能与下游目标不对齐；基于训练的选择器能反映下游效用，但需要大量昂贵的训练-评估迭代。
Method: HARP（Hierarchical Active Region Pruning）将训练池组织为节点-叶层级，只评估代表性叶子，用 empirical Bayes 后验推断未测效用；随后用两个互补包络选数据：HARP-C 保守控制冗余，HARP-E 加性奖励互补区域。理论上在局部平滑与估计误差有界的条件下证明选择误差受控且训练-评估成本下降。
Result: 在 3 个基座模型、3 个微调数据集、4 个推理基准共 36 个设置中，HARP 变体在 23 个设置取得排序方法中最高准确率；36 设置平均准确率 HARP-C 64.2、HARP-E 63.5，最强基线 NICE 为 59.3。HARP-C 训练样本量约为预算基线的 1/9、全量微调的 1/75，且在平均准确率与平均训练集规模上同时优于每个排序基线。
Conclusion: 用层级采样加 empirical Bayes 推断替代反复的训练-评估，可以在保持与下游目标对齐的同时大幅压缩数据选择成本，并在推理微调任务上以更小训练集取得更高平均准确率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Robust inference for risk heterogeneity under group imbalance
papers.abstract_en: Population-level heterogeneity is ubiquitous in biomedical data, where differences across demographic or clinical subgroups can substantially alter risk patterns. For example, in intensive care unit (ICU) studies, the mortality risk associated with specific admission diagnoses can vary across ethnic groups. Existing approaches for detecting risk heterogeneity are often sensitive to baseline model misspecification and regularization bias, both of which commonly arise in practice. In this paper, we propose a robust framework for inferring risk heterogeneity between two populations using Neyman orthogonality, which yields estimators that are locally insensitive to nuisance parameter estimation error. The proposed estimator is consistent and asymptotically normal, and simulation studies demonstrate that in finite samples our method substantially reduces bias and improves inferential stability compared with standard likelihood-based approaches. In an application to the eICU Collaborative Research Database, our method reveals clinically meaningful ethnicity-specific heterogeneity in admission diagnoses for in-hospital mortality that standard likelihood-based methods fail to detect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对生物医学数据中群体间风险异质性检测对基线模型误设与正则化偏倚敏感的问题，提出基于 Neyman 正交性的稳健推断框架，使估计量对干扰参数估计误差局部不敏感。模拟中该方法相比标准似然方法显著降低偏倚、提升推断稳定性；在 eICU 数据上检出入院诊断对院内死亡率的族群特异异质性，而标准似然方法检不出。
Motivation: ICU 等生物医学数据中不同人口学或临床亚组的风险模式差异明显，但现有风险异质性检测方法对基线模型误设和正则化偏倚敏感，这两者在实践中普遍存在。
Method: 用 Neyman orthogonality 构建两群体间风险异质性的推断框架，得到对干扰参数估计误差局部不敏感的估计量；理论证明其一致性与渐近正态性，并通过模拟研究与标准似然方法比较。
Result: 模拟研究显示有限样本下相比标准似然方法显著降低偏倚、改善推断稳定性；在 eICU Collaborative Research Database 应用中检出入院诊断与院内死亡率之间具有临床意义的族群特异异质性，标准似然方法未能检出。
Conclusion: Neyman 正交化可让风险异质性推断在基线误设与正则化偏倚下保持稳健，从而发现似然方法漏掉的真实亚组差异。

summary_sections.result: 模拟研究显示有限样本下相比标准似然方法显著降低偏倚、改善推断稳定性；在 eICU Collaborative Research Database 应用中检出入院诊断与院内死亡率之间具有临床意义的族群特异异质性，标准似然方法未能检出。
summary_sections.conclusion: Neyman 正交化可让风险异质性推断在基线误设与正则化偏倚下保持稳健，从而发现似然方法漏掉的真实亚组差异。

papers.title: A Simple Plug-in for Improving Eviction-Based KV Cache Compression
papers.abstract_en: KV cache growth is a major bottleneck for long-context inference in large language models. Existing methods are often dominated by binary eviction or representation approximation, which may underutilize tokens that are not critical for exact retention but are still reconstructable. We present VECTOR, a plug-and-play augmentation for eviction-based pipelines that introduces three-way token routing: retention, approximation, and eviction. VECTOR combines an importance signal from the base scorer with a reconstructability signal from an offline-calibrated regression-based value estimation. By leveraging reconstructability, VECTOR recovers useful value information that would otherwise be irreversibly lost under binary eviction, while preserving key vectors for attention routing stability. On LongBench, RULER with contexts up to 128K tokens, and multi-turn SCBench, VECTOR yields significant gains over its base eviction methods under high compression. At a 90% compression ratio, SnapKV augmented with VECTOR outperforms six competing compression methods, including D2O and RocketKV, on all three evaluated models. Since VECTOR makes all routing decisions at prefill, decoding runs on a standard compressed cache with no measurable overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VECTOR 为基于驱逐 (eviction) 的 KV cache 压缩加装三分支 token 路由：保留、近似、驱逐，用基础打分器的重要性信号加上离线标定的回归式 value 估计给出的可重建性信号做决策。在 90% 压缩率下，加装 VECTOR 的 SnapKV 在三个评测模型上于 LongBench、RULER（上下文至 128K tokens）和多轮 SCBench 上全面超过六种压缩方法（含 D2O、RocketKV），且全部路由在 prefill 完成，解码无额外开销。
Motivation: 长上下文推理中 KV cache 膨胀是主要瓶颈，而现有方法多为二值驱逐或表示近似，会把那些不必精确保留但仍可重建的 token 直接丢掉，造成不可逆的信息损失。
Method: VECTOR 是即插即用的增强模块：三分支路由（retention / approximation / eviction），融合基础打分器的重要性信号与离线标定的回归式 value 估计所给出的可重建性信号；近似分支回收本会被二值驱逐丢弃的 value 信息，同时保留 key 向量以维持 attention 路由稳定性。所有路由决策在 prefill 阶段完成。
Result: 在 LongBench、RULER（上下文最长 128K tokens）与多轮 SCBench 上，高压缩率下 VECTOR 相对其基础驱逐方法带来显著增益；90% 压缩率时，SnapKV+VECTOR 在全部三个评测模型上均优于六种竞争压缩方法（含 D2O、RocketKV）。解码在标准压缩 cache 上运行，无可测开销。
Conclusion: 把二值驱逐改成三分支路由、并利用可重建性回收 value，可以在高压缩率下提升驱逐式 KV cache 压缩的质量，且不增加解码开销。

papers.title: How Far Are We From True Auto-Research?
papers.abstract_en: Recent auto-research systems can produce complete papers, but feasibility is not the same as quality, and the field still lacks a systematic study of how good agent-generated papers actually are. We introduce ResearchArena, a minimal scaffold that lets off-the-shelf agents (Claude Code using Opus 4.6, Codex using GPT-5.4, and Kimi Code using K2.5) carry out the full research loop themselves (ideation, experimentation, paper writing, self-refinement) under only lightweight guidance. Across 13 computer science seeds and 3 trials per agent-domain pair, ResearchArena yields 117 agent-generated papers, each evaluated under three complementary lenses: a manuscript-only reviewer (SAR), an artifact-aware peer review (PR) in which agents inspect the workspace alongside the manuscript, and an human conducted meta-review. Under SAR alone the picture is optimistic: Claude Code obtains the highest score, outperforms Analemma's FARS, and matches the weighted-average human ICLR 2025 submission, suggesting that minimally scaffolded agents can produce papers that look competitive on manuscript-only review. Manual inspection, however, reveals this picture is overstated: SAR scores are poorly aligned with its actual acceptance decisions and reward plausible framing without verifying experimental substance. Under artifact-aware PR scores drop sharply, and manual auditing identifies experimental rigor as the major bottleneck, decomposing into three failure modes (fabricated results, underpowered experiments, and plan/execution mismatch) that are highly agent-dependent: Codex 5%/8% paper-vs-artifact mismatch / fabricated references versus Kimi Code 77%/72%, a $\sim$15$\times$ spread that tracks distinct research personas the agents develop. None of the 117 agent-generated papers reaches the acceptance bar of a top-tier venue. This suggests that we are still gapped from the true auto-research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ResearchArena 让 Claude Code (Opus 4.6)、Codex (GPT-5.4)、Kimi Code (K2.5) 在 13 个计算机科学种子上自主完成选题、实验、写作与自我改进，产出 117 篇论文并用三种评审视角打分。仅看 manuscript-only 的 SAR 时 Claude Code 得分最高、超过 Analemma 的 FARS 并追平 ICLR 2025 人类投稿加权平均，但换成 artifact-aware peer review 后分数骤降，人工审计发现实验严谨性是主要瓶颈：Codex 的论文-工件不符/伪造引用为 5%/8%，Kimi Code 高达 77%/72%，约 15 倍差距；117 篇无一达到顶会接收线。
Motivation: 自动科研系统已能产出完整论文，但可行性不等于质量，领域缺少对 agent 生成论文实际水平的系统评估，尤其是只看稿件的评审是否会高估实验实质。
Method: 提出轻量脚手架 ResearchArena，让现成 agent 在少量引导下自行完成 ideation、experimentation、paper writing、self-refinement 全流程；在 13 个 CS 种子上每对 agent-domain 跑 3 次得 117 篇论文，用三种互补视角评估：manuscript-only reviewer (SAR)、可查看 workspace 的 artifact-aware peer review (PR)，以及人工 meta-review，并对工件做人工审计。
Result: SAR 单独打分下 Claude Code 得分最高，超过 Analemma 的 FARS 并与 ICLR 2025 人类投稿加权平均持平；但 SAR 分数与其真实接收决定对不上，奖励看似合理的框架而未核验实验实质。artifact-aware PR 下分数大幅下降，人工审计把瓶颈归为三类失败（伪造结果、实验功效不足、计划与执行不匹配），且高度依赖 agent：Codex 论文-工件不符 5%、伪造引用 8%，Kimi Code 分别为 77% 和 72%，约 15 倍差距。117 篇中无一达到顶会接收线。
Conclusion: 只看稿件的评审会系统性高估 agent 论文质量，必须让评审检查实验工件；按顶会标准，当前最小脚手架下的自动科研仍与真正 auto-research 有明显差距。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When and Why Adversarial Training Improves PINNs: A Neural Tangent Kernel Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are powerful surrogates for differential equations but are notoriously difficult to train due to spectral bias, stiffness, and poor accuracy on high-frequency or multiscale solutions. Adversarial training based on generative adversarial networks (GANs) has recently gained surprisingly strong empirical results in improving training, but the underlying mechanisms remain elusive. To this end, we propose a new analysis framework for adversarially trained PINNs, based on the key observation of how the discriminator in GANs can influence the training dynamics of PINNs. The framework first provides a much needed theoretical grounding to why and when adversarial training is effective in PINNs, then presents a unified analysis of GANs variants in such training, and finally leads to a new, practical, efficient training algorithm for PINNs. Empirical results demonstrate that our method can significantly reduce the pathology of PINNs training, thereby providing better models with superior performances, often several magnitudes more accurate than alternative methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从 NTK 视角解释 GAN 式对抗训练为何能改善 PINN 训练：判别器影响 PINN 的训练动力学，据此给出理论判据、统一分析 GAN 变体，并导出一个实用高效的 PINN 训练算法。经验上该方法显著缓解 PINN 训练病态，精度常比替代方法高若干数量级。
Motivation: PINN 因谱偏置 (spectral bias)、刚性 (stiffness) 以及在高频/多尺度解上精度差而难以训练；GAN 式对抗训练已有强经验效果，但机理不清。
Method: 提出针对对抗训练 PINN 的分析框架，核心是刻画 GAN 判别器如何影响 PINN 训练动力学；在此基础上统一分析各类 GAN 变体，并导出一个新的实用高效 PINN 训练算法。
Result: 经验结果显示该方法显著缓解 PINN 训练病态，得到更好的模型，性能常比替代方法精确若干数量级 (several magnitudes more accurate)。
Conclusion: 对抗训练对 PINN 的有效性可由判别器对训练动力学的影响给出理论解释，并可据此设计出更实用高效的训练算法。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: A finite-element-inspired bipartite graph learned simulator for manufacturability assessment in large-deformation sheet forming
papers.abstract_en: Explicit dynamic finite element (FE) simulations are widely used for large-deformation analysis but remain expensive for design-space exploration. In explicit FE analysis, nodal kinematics and element-level deformation measures evolve through a coupled node-element update process. An FE-inspired learned simulator can preserve this structure and learn nodal kinematics and elemental deformation on their native domains. Nodal displacement describes geometry evolution, while elemental thinning identifies local deformation and critical regions. Feeding both outputs back during rollout allows each field to inform subsequent updates of the other. This work proposes CAtt-BiGNN, a cross-attention-based bipartite graph neural network for coupled nodal-elemental learning. The bipartite graph encodes FE-guided state organisation and information flow without imposing equilibrium or constitutive constraints. Mesh nodes and elements are represented as distinct graph entities connected by directed node-element edges, enabling prediction of nodal displacement increments and elemental deformation on their native domains. An edge-aware cross-attention processor dynamically updates edge representations and weights messages using the receiving state and evolving local relations. For larger graphs, CAtt-BiUGNN uses separate nodal and elemental downsampling and upsampling to enhance long-range propagation while preserving their interaction across graph levels. The method is evaluated on dome-shaped cold-forming and corner-shaped hot-forming benchmarks. Comparisons with node-centred baselines, an FE-inspired hypergraph model, a Physics-Attention-based neural operator, a graph Transformer, and attention ablations show improved joint accuracy in nodal displacement and elemental thinning prediction during autoregressive rollout.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CAtt-BiGNN：把显式动力学有限元的节点-单元耦合更新直接搬进二部图神经网络，节点位移增量与单元减薄各自在其原生域上预测，并在自回归 rollout 中互相回馈。在穹顶冷成形与拐角热成形基准上，相对节点中心基线、FE 启发超图模型、Physics-Attention 神经算子和 graph Transformer 提高了节点位移与单元减薄的联合预测精度。
Motivation: 显式动力学 FE 仿真做大变形分析代价高，难以支撑设计空间探索；现有图学习模拟器多只在节点域建模，丢掉了 FE 中节点运动学与单元变形量耦合更新的结构。
Method: CAtt-BiGNN 用二部图把网格节点与单元表示为不同图实体，以有向节点-单元边连接，不施加平衡或本构约束；edge-aware cross-attention 处理器用接收方状态与演化中的局部关系动态更新边表示并加权消息。针对大图另提出 CAtt-BiUGNN，对节点与单元分别做下采样与上采样以增强长程传播并保留跨层交互。
Result: 在 dome-shaped cold-forming 与 corner-shaped hot-forming 两个基准上，与 node-centred 基线、FE 启发 hypergraph 模型、Physics-Attention 神经算子、graph Transformer 及注意力消融相比，自回归 rollout 中节点位移与单元减薄的联合预测精度更高。
Conclusion: 把 FE 的节点-单元耦合结构显式编码进二部图并让两域输出在 rollout 中互馈，能在大变形板材成形的可制造性评估中同时改善几何演化与局部减薄预测。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Can Digital Personas Reliably Approximate Human Survey Findings?
papers.abstract_en: Digital personas powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as substitutes for human survey respondents, yet it remains unclear when they can reliably approximate human survey findings. We answer this question using the LISS panel, constructing personas from respondents' background variables and pre-2023 survey histories, then testing them against the same respondents' held-out post-cutoff answers. Across four persona architectures, three LLMs, and two prediction tasks, we assess performance at the question, respondent, distributional, equity, and clustering levels. Digital personas improve alignment with human response distributions, especially in domains tied to stable attributes and values, but remain limited for individual prediction and fail to recover multivariate respondent structure. Retrieval-augmented architectures provide the clearest gains, but performance depends more on human response structure than on model choice: personas perform best for low-variability questions and common respondent patterns, and worst for subjective, heterogeneous, or rare responses. Our results provide practical guidance on when digital personas could be appropriate for survey research and when human validation remains necessary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 LISS 面板把受访者背景变量与 2023 年前的作答历史构造成 LLM 数字人格 (digital personas)，在同一批人 2023 年后的留出作答上检验其能否替代人类问卷。人格在群体作答分布上对齐度提升，检索增强 (retrieval-augmented) 架构增益最明显，但个体级预测仍受限、无法复现多变量受访者结构；表现好坏取决于人类作答本身的结构——低变异题与常见模式最好，主观、异质、稀有作答最差。
Motivation: LLM 人格被提议替代人类问卷受访者，但何时能可靠逼近真实调查结论并不清楚，尤其个体级预测与受访者群体结构能否复现存疑。
Method: 基于 LISS panel，用受访者背景变量与 pre-2023 调查历史构造人格，对其同一批人 post-cutoff 的留出作答做预测；比较四种人格架构、三个 LLM、两个预测任务，并在问题、受访者、分布、公平性 (equity)、聚类五个层级评估。

papers.title: Document-as-Image Representations Fall Short for Scientific Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Many recent document embedding models are trained on document-as-image representations, embedding rendered pages as images rather than the underlying source. Meanwhile, existing benchmarks for scientific document retrieval, such as ArXivQA and ViDoRe, treat documents as images of pages, implicitly favoring such representations. In this work, we argue that this paradigm is not well-suited for text-rich multimodal scientific documents, where critical evidence is distributed across structured sources, including text, tables, and figures. To study this setting, we introduce ArXivDoc, a new benchmark constructed from the underlying LaTeX sources of scientific papers. Unlike PDF or image-based representations, LaTeX provides direct access to structured elements (e.g., sections, tables, figures, equations), enabling controlled query construction grounded in specific evidence types. We systematically compare text-only, image-based, and multimodal representations across both single-vector and multi-vector retrieval models. Our results show that: (1) document-as-image representations are consistently suboptimal, especially as document length increases; (2) text-based representations are most effective, even for figure-based queries, by leveraging captions and surrounding context; and (3) interleaved text+image representations outperform document-as-image approaches without requiring specialized training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 LaTeX 源构建的科学文档检索基准 ArXivDoc，系统比较纯文本、页面图像与图文交错表示。结果显示 document-as-image 表示始终次优且随文档变长而恶化；纯文本表示最有效（包括图类查询，靠 caption 与上下文即可），图文交错表示无需专门训练即可超过 document-as-image。
Motivation: 现有科学文档检索基准（ArXivQA、ViDoRe）把文档当作页面图像，隐含偏向 document-as-image 嵌入模型，而这类表示不适合关键证据分散在正文、表格、图中的多模态科学文档。
Method: 从论文 LaTeX 源构建 ArXivDoc 基准，利用章节、表格、图、公式等结构元素做受证据类型约束的查询构造；在单向量与多向量检索模型上系统比较纯文本、图像、图文交错三类表示。
Result: 三点发现：document-as-image 表示一致次优，且随文档长度增加而更差；纯文本表示最有效，即使对图类查询也如此，靠 caption 与周边上下文；图文交错表示优于 document-as-image，且无需专门训练。
Conclusion: 对文本密集的多模态科学文档，检索应优先用源文本（含 caption）而非渲染页面图像，图文交错是免专门训练的更优替代。

papers.title: Scaling Human-AI Coding Collaboration Requires a Governable Consensus Layer
papers.abstract_en: Vibe coding turns natural-language intent into working software, but code generation alone does not give humans and agents a shared account of what they are building. As collaboration spans participants, components, and releases, design choices must remain understandable and open to revision. We argue that scaling human and AI coding collaboration requires a governable consensus layer. Agentic Consensus organizes collaboration around a versioned project-state model linking selected intent, structural commitments, executable artifacts, and evidence. Participants can clarify intent before implementation and coordinate proposed changes against commitments that humans can inspect and revise. Bidirectional synchronization connects intended changes to implementation and exposes conflicts or stale evidence as artifacts evolve. We implemented its review workflow in Consensus Control. In a small exploratory human study, 10 participants used the system on projects from their everyday work and reported clearer, faster understanding of agent-submitted changes. A three-condition comparison with the same participants collected 60 responses, with near-ceiling decision scores and measured representation and pipeline costs. Our research agenda asks how shared project state can preserve human understanding and control as agent contributions accumulate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Agentic Consensus：把人机协作围绕一个带版本的 project-state 模型组织起来，把选定意图、结构承诺、可执行产物与证据绑定，并用双向同步把意图变更对到实现、暴露冲突与过期证据。其评审工作流在 Consensus Control 中实现，10 人小规模探索性研究中参与者报告对 agent 提交的变更理解更清晰更快。
Motivation: Vibe coding 只解决自然语言意图到代码的生成，缺少人与 agent 对“正在构建什么”的共享、可修订的说明；协作跨参与者、组件与发布扩展后，设计选择会变得难以理解和修改。
Method: Agentic Consensus 用带版本的 project-state 模型串联 selected intent、structural commitments、executable artifacts 与 evidence；参与者在实现前澄清意图、对照可人工检查与修订的承诺协调变更；双向同步连接预期变更与实现并暴露冲突或 stale evidence。评审工作流实现为 Consensus Control。
Result: 小规模探索性人机研究中 10 名参与者在其日常工作的项目上使用系统，报告对 agent 提交的变更理解更清晰、更快；同一批参与者的三条件对比收集 60 条响应，决策分数接近天花板 (near-ceiling)，并测量了表示与流程开销 (representation and pipeline costs)。
Conclusion: 共享的、可治理的 project-state 能在 agent 贡献持续累积时保住人的理解与控制权；作者据此提出研究议程，追问共享项目状态如何维持这一能力。

papers.title: StaRPO: Stability-Augmented Reinforcement Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is effective in enhancing the accuracy of large language models in complex reasoning tasks. Existing RL policy optimization frameworks rely on final-answer correctness as feedback signals and rarely capture the internal logical structure of the reasoning process. Consequently, the models would generate fluent and semantically relevant responses but logically inconsistent, structurally erratic, or redundant. To this end, we propose StaRPO, a stability-augmented reinforcement learning framework that explicitly incorporates reasoning stability into the optimization objective. Our StaRPO decomposes stability into two computable lightweight metrics: the Autocorrelation Function (ACF) to evaluate local step-to-step coherence, and Path Efficiency (PE) to evaluate global goal-directedness of the reasoning trajectory. These stability rewards are combined with task rewards to provide complementary and process-aware feedback. We validate the effectiveness of using ACF and PE rewards by showing their correlation with logic errors on two backbone models. Experiments on four reasoning benchmarks show that StaRPO consistently outperforms compared baselines and can enhance both final-answer accuracy and logical stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StaRPO 把推理稳定性显式写进 LLM 强化学习目标，将稳定性分解为 ACF（自相关函数，衡量逐步局部连贯）与 PE（路径效率，衡量全局目标导向）两个可计算的轻量指标，与任务奖励叠加作为过程感知反馈。在两个 backbone 模型上 ACF/PE 奖励与逻辑错误相关，并在四个推理基准上一致优于对比基线，同时提升最终答案准确率与逻辑稳定性。
Motivation: 现有 RL 策略优化只用最终答案正确性作反馈，几乎不捕捉推理过程的内部逻辑结构，导致模型输出流畅、语义相关但逻辑不一致、结构混乱或冗余。
Method: StaRPO 将稳定性分解为 ACF（评估逐步局部连贯）与 PE（评估推理轨迹的全局目标导向）两个轻量可计算指标，把这两项稳定性奖励与任务奖励结合作为过程感知反馈，纳入策略优化目标。
Result: 在两个 backbone 模型上验证了 ACF 与 PE 奖励与逻辑错误的相关性；在四个推理基准上，StaRPO 一致优于所比较的基线，同时提升最终答案准确率与逻辑稳定性。
Conclusion: 仅靠最终答案正确性不足以约束推理质量，把可计算的稳定性奖励（ACF、PE）并入优化目标能同时改善答案准确率与推理过程的逻辑稳定。

papers.title: KiToke: Distribution-Aware Token Compression for Video Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) achieve strong performance on video understanding tasks but suffer from high inference costs due to the large number of visual tokens. We study training-free, query-agnostic video token compression, where heuristic importance rules can over-represent large redundant visual groups and miss less frequent visual patterns, particularly under aggressive token budgets. We propose KiToke, a distribution-aware compression framework that treats visual tokens as samples from the video's spatiotemporal token distribution. KiToke uses global embedding density as a proxy for representational redundancy and inverse-density sampling to balance token allocation across visual patterns of different frequencies. It further aggregates unselected tokens into retained anchors within detected temporal intervals to reduce cross-transition mixing. Across evaluated backbones, KiToke achieves the highest average accuracy among compared training-free methods and remains robust down to 1% retention, where most evaluated baselines underperform uniform random token sampling. On LLaVA-OneVision, it preserves 98.5% and 89.2% of the uncompressed model's four-benchmark mean accuracy at 10% and 1% token retention, with 6.8x and 12.5x prefill speedups, respectively, including compression overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KiToke 把视频视觉 token 当作时空 token 分布的样本，用全局嵌入密度估计冗余、以逆密度采样平衡不同频率视觉模式的 token 配额，并把未选 token 聚合进时间区间内的保留锚点以减少跨转场混合。在 LLaVA-OneVision 上，10% 与 1% 保留率分别保住未压缩模型四基准平均精度的 98.5% 与 89.2%，prefill 加速 6.8× 与 12.5×（含压缩开销）；在 1% 激进预算下多数被评基线反而不如均匀随机采样，KiToke 仍是最稳健的 training-free 方法。
Motivation: Video LLM 视觉 token 数量大导致推理成本高，现有 training-free、query-agnostic 压缩依赖启发式重要性规则，在激进 token 预算下会过度保留冗余的大视觉组、漏掉低频视觉模式。
Method: 把视觉 token 视为视频时空 token 分布的采样点：以全局嵌入密度 (global embedding density) 作为表示冗余的代理，用逆密度采样 (inverse-density sampling) 在不同频率的视觉模式间平衡 token 分配；再在检测出的时间区间内把未选 token 聚合进保留锚点，降低跨转场混合。整个流程 training-free 且 query-agnostic。
Result: 在被评测的多个 backbone 上，KiToke 取得所比较 training-free 方法中最高的平均精度。在 LLaVA-OneVision 上，10% 与 1% token 保留率分别保持未压缩模型四基准平均精度的 98.5% 与 89.2%，对应 prefill 加速 6.8× 与 12.5×（含压缩开销）；在 1% 保留率下多数被评测基线表现不如均匀随机 token 采样，KiToke 仍保持稳健。
Conclusion: 按 token 分布密度而非启发式重要性来分配预算，可以在极低保留率下保住视频理解精度并带来一个数量级的 prefill 加速；激进压缩时启发式规则会系统性失效。

papers.title: PLACID: Privacy-preserving Large language models for Acronym Clinical Inference and Disambiguation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer transformative solutions across many domains, but healthcare integration is hindered by strict data privacy constraints. Clinical narratives are dense with ambiguous acronyms, misinterpretation these abbreviations can precipitate severe outcomes like life-threatening medication errors. While cloud-dependent LLMs excel at Acronym Disambiguation, transmitting Protected Health Information to external servers violates privacy frameworks. To bridge this gap, this study pioneers the evaluation of small-parameter models deployed entirely on-device to ensure privacy preservation. We introduce a privacy-preserving cascaded pipeline leveraging general-purpose local models to detect clinical acronyms, routing them to domain-specific biomedical models for context-relevant expansions. Results reveal that while general instruction-following models achieve high detection accuracy (~0.988), their expansion capabilities plummet (~0.655). Our cascaded approach utilizes domain-specific medical models to increase expansion accuracy to (~0.81). This novel work demonstrates that privacy-preserving, on-device (2B-10B) models deliver high-fidelity clinical acronym disambiguation support.

TL;DR: PLACID 提出隐私保护的级联缩写消歧流水线：先用本地通用小模型检测临床缩写，再路由到生物医学领域模型给出上下文相关展开，全程在设备端 (on-device, 2B–10B) 运行以避免传输 PHI。通用指令模型检测准确率约 0.988 但展开能力仅约 0.655，接入领域医学模型后展开准确率提升到约 0.81。
Motivation: 临床叙述充满歧义缩写，误读可能引发危及生命的用药错误；云端 LLM 擅长缩写消歧，但把受保护健康信息 (PHI) 传到外部服务器违反隐私框架。
Method: 隐私保护级联流水线：通用本地模型检测临床缩写，将命中的缩写路由到领域特定生物医学模型生成上下文相关展开；评测完全在设备端 (2B–10B) 小参数模型上进行，对比通用指令模型与领域医学模型的检测与展开能力。
Result: 通用指令跟随模型检测准确率约 0.988，但展开准确率仅约 0.655；级联方案改用领域特定医学模型后展开准确率提升到约 0.81。
Conclusion: 检测与展开应拆开处理：通用小模型足以做检测，展开必须交给领域医学模型；2B–10B 的本地模型即可在不外传 PHI 的前提下提供高保真临床缩写消歧支持。

papers.title: LLMON: An LLM-native Markup Language to Leverage Structure and Semantics at the LLM Interface
papers.abstract_en: Textual Large Language Models (LLMs) provide a simple and familiar interface: a string of text is used for both input and output. However, the information conveyed to an LLM often has a richer structure and semantics, which is not conveyed in a string. For example, most prompts contain both instructions ("Summarize this paper into a paragraph") and data (the paper to summarize), but these are usually not distinguished when passed to the model. This can lead to model confusion and security risks, such as prompt injection attacks. This work addresses this shortcoming by introducing an LLM-native mark-up language, LLMON (LLM Object Notation, pronounced "Lemon"), that enables the structure and semantic metadata of the text to be communicated in a natural way to an LLM. This information can then be used during model training, model prompting, and inference implementation, leading to improvements in model accuracy, safety, and security. This is analogous to how programming language types can be used for many purposes, such as static checking, code generation, dynamic checking, and IDE highlighting. We discuss the general design requirements of an LLM-native markup language, introduce the LLMON markup language and show how it meets these design requirements, describe how the information contained in a LLMON artifact can benefit model training and inference implementation, and provide some preliminary empirical evidence of its value for both of these use cases. We also discuss broader issues and research opportunities that are enabled with an LLM-native approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LLMON（LLM Object Notation）：一种 LLM 原生标记语言，把提示中的结构与语义元数据（如指令与数据的区分）显式传给模型，供训练、提示与推理实现使用，类比编程语言类型系统用于静态检查、代码生成与 IDE 高亮。作者给出设计需求、语言定义，并提供初步经验证据说明其在准确性与安全（含提示注入防护）上的价值。
Motivation: 字符串接口丢失了提示本有的结构与语义，指令与数据不加区分，导致模型混淆与提示注入等安全风险。
Method: 定义 LLMON 标记语言并对照一组 LLM 原生标记语言的设计需求；说明 LLMON 工件中的结构信息如何用于模型训练与推理实现，并类比编程语言类型的多种用途。
Result: 给出 LLMON 语言设计与其满足设计需求的论证，并为训练与推理实现两个用例提供初步经验证据（preliminary empirical evidence）支持其价值。
Conclusion: 把结构与语义元数据显式编码进 LLM 接口，可同时改善模型准确性、安全性与对抗提示注入的鲁棒性，值得作为 LLM 输入输出的类型化替代方案。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Maximum-Entropy Exploration with Future State-Action Visitation Measures
papers.abstract_en: Maximum entropy reinforcement learning motivates agents to explore states and actions to maximize the entropy of some distribution, typically by providing additional intrinsic rewards proportional to that entropy function. In this paper, we study intrinsic rewards proportional to the entropy of the discounted distribution of state-action features visited during future time steps. This approach is motivated by two results. First, we show that the expected sum of these intrinsic rewards is a lower bound on the entropy of the discounted distribution of state-action features visited in trajectories starting from the initial states, which we relate to an alternative maximum entropy objective. Second, we show that the distribution used in the intrinsic reward definition is the fixed point of a contraction operator and can therefore be estimated off-policy. Experiments highlight that the new objective often leads to improved visitation of features within individual trajectories, in exchange for slightly reduced visitation of features in expectation over different trajectories, as suggested by the lower bound. It also leads to improved convergence speed for learning exploration-only agents. Control performance remains similar across most methods on the considered benchmarks.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于未来状态-动作访问测度 (future state-action visitation measures) 熵的内在奖励：该奖励之和是初始状态出发轨迹上状态-动作特征访问分布熵的下界，且奖励所用分布是压缩算子不动点，可离策略 (off-policy) 估计。实验显示单条轨迹内特征访问改善，代价是跨轨迹期望访问略降，纯探索智能体收敛更快，各基准上控制性能大体相当。
Motivation: 最大熵 RL 的常见内在奖励只针对即时或整体状态-动作熵，缺少对轨迹内特征覆盖的直接目标，也难以离策略估计未来访问分布。
Method: 定义与折扣状态-动作特征访问分布熵成比例的内在奖励，证明其期望和为初始状态轨迹访问分布熵的下界（对应另一最大熵目标），并证明该分布是压缩算子的不动点从而可 off-policy 估计；在若干基准上与既有最大熵方法对比。
Result: 新目标通常改善单条轨迹内的特征访问，但跨不同轨迹的期望特征访问略有下降（与下界一致）；纯探索智能体的学习收敛速度提升；在所考虑基准上各方法控制性能大体相近。
Conclusion: 把熵目标从整体分布移到未来访问测度的下界，可在轨迹内覆盖与跨轨迹期望覆盖之间做取舍，并让探索奖励离策略可估，而不牺牲控制性能。

papers.title: Automated Standardization of Legacy Biomedical Metadata Using an Ontology-Constrained LLM Agent
papers.abstract_en: Descriptive scientific metadata in public repositories are often incomplete and inconsistent with community standards and ontologies, limiting data FAIRness. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising approach to automatically standardizing such metadata when the LLM is provided with knowledge of the relevant standards in machine-actionable form (e.g., as metadata templates from systems such as the CEDAR Workbench). Entry of metadata standards through prompt engineering offers only fixed snapshots of the relevant standards, however, and it relies on an LLM's pretrained knowledge to interpret and satisfy constraints related to the standard. We evaluate whether giving an LLM access to metadata specifications and authoritative terminology at runtime improves automated metadata standardization. We present ARMS, a tool-augmented LLM agent that retrieves complete CEDAR metadata templates and dynamically queries authoritative biomedical terminology services at execution time. We compared ARMS with a prompt-based approach on 839 legacy metadata records from the Human BioMolecular Atlas Program (HuBMAP), using expert-standardized records as the reference standard. ARMS outperformed the prompt-based approach, increasing precision from 0.56 to 0.93 and recall from 0.51 to 0.85, with improvements across all field categories and assay types. The largest gains occurred for ontology-constrained fields, where precision increased from 0.36 to 0.92. Our findings show that access to appropriate metadata standards can substantially improve LLM-based standardization of legacy metadata. ARMS improves metadata standardization by giving LLMs runtime access to the authoritative resources that define valid metadata. Representation of metadata standards in machine-actionable form enhances the task of rectifying legacy metadata using LLM technology, especially when those standards can be queried dynamically.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ARMS：一个在运行时动态检索 CEDAR 元数据模板并查询权威生物医学术语服务的工具增强 LLM agent，用于把遗留生物医学元数据标准化到社区标准与本体约束。在 HuBMAP 839 条遗留记录上，以专家标准化记录为参考，ARMS 相比纯 prompt 方式把 precision 从 0.56 提到 0.93、recall 从 0.51 提到 0.85，本体约束字段的 precision 从 0.36 提到 0.92。
Motivation: 公共库中的描述性科研元数据常不完整、不一致，损害 FAIRness；把标准塞进 prompt 只能给出固定快照，且依赖 LLM 预训练知识去解释标准约束。
Method: ARMS agent 在执行期检索完整的 CEDAR 元数据模板，并动态查询权威生物医学术语服务，把标准以机器可操作形式提供给 LLM；对照组为 prompt-based 方式，参考标准为专家标准化的记录。
Result: 在 HuBMAP 839 条遗留元数据记录上，precision 0.56 → 0.93，recall 0.51 → 0.85，各字段类别与 assay 类型均有提升；本体约束字段提升最大，precision 0.36 → 0.92。
Conclusion: 让 LLM 在运行时访问定义合法元数据的权威资源，能大幅改善遗留元数据的自动标准化，尤其是标准可被动态查询时。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: NePPO: Near-Potential Policy Optimization for General-Sum Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is increasingly used to design learning-enabled agents that interact in shared environments. However, training MARL algorithms in general-sum games remains challenging: learning dynamics can become unstable, and convergence guarantees typically hold only in restricted settings such as two-player zero-sum or fully cooperative games. Moreover, when agents have heterogeneous and potentially conflicting preferences, it is unclear what system-level objective should guide learning. In this paper, we propose a new MARL pipeline called Near-Potential Policy Optimization (NePPO) for computing approximate Nash equilibria in mixed cooperative--competitive environments. The core idea is to learn a player-independent potential function such that the Nash equilibrium of a cooperative game with this potential as the common utility approximates a Nash equilibrium of the original game. To this end, we introduce a novel MARL objective such that minimizing this objective yields the best possible potential function candidate and consequently an approximate Nash equilibrium of the original game. We develop an algorithmic pipeline that minimizes this objective using zeroth-order gradient descent and returns an approximate Nash equilibrium policy. We empirically show the superior performance of this approach compared to popular baselines such as IPPO and MAPPO.
papers.comment: Accepted to the IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NePPO 面向一般和博弈 (general-sum) 的多智能体强化学习，学习一个与玩家无关的势函数 (potential function)，使以该势函数为公共效用的合作博弈的 Nash 均衡逼近原博弈的 Nash 均衡，并用零阶梯度下降 (zeroth-order gradient descent) 最小化新提出的 MARL 目标以返回近似均衡策略。在混合合作-竞争环境中，该方法经验上优于 IPPO 与 MAPPO 等常用基线。
Motivation: 一般和博弈中的 MARL 训练动力学不稳定，收敛保证通常只在两人零和或完全合作等受限设定下成立；当智能体偏好异质且可能冲突时，缺少明确的系统级目标来引导学习。
Method: 提出 Near-Potential Policy Optimization (NePPO) 流水线：学习一个玩家无关的势函数，使以它为公共效用的合作博弈 Nash 均衡逼近原博弈均衡；为此设计新的 MARL 目标，最小化该目标即得到最优势函数候选与原博弈的近似 Nash 均衡，并用零阶梯度下降最小化该目标、输出近似均衡策略。
Result: 在混合合作-竞争环境上的经验结果显示 NePPO 性能优于 IPPO 和 MAPPO 等常用基线。
Conclusion: 用玩家无关的势函数把一般和博弈的均衡求解转化为合作博弈目标的优化，可以在混合合作-竞争设定下得到近似 Nash 均衡策略并胜过 IPPO/MAPPO。

papers.title: MARS: Harmonizing Multimodal Convergence via Adaptive Rank Search
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) with parameter-efficient methods like Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is crucial for task adaptation. However, imbalanced training dynamics across modalities often lead to suboptimal accuracy due to negative interference, a challenge typically addressed with inefficient heuristic methods such as manually tuning separate learning rates. To overcome this, we introduce MARS (Multimodal Adaptive Rank Search), an approach to discover optimal rank pairs that balance training dynamics while maximizing performance. Our key innovation, a proposed framework of dual scaling laws, enables this search: one law models module-specific convergence time to prune the search space to candidates with aligned dynamics, while the other predicts final task performance to select the optimal pair from the pruned set. By re-purposing the LoRA rank as a controller for modality-specific convergence speed, MARS outperforms baseline methods and provides a robust, automated strategy for optimizing MLLM fine-tuning.
papers.comment: 29 pages; Project Page: this https URL: https://minkyoungcho.github.io/mars/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MARS 用两条 scaling law 自动搜索多模态大模型 LoRA 微调的秩对：一条建模各模块收敛时间以剪枝到动态对齐的候选，另一条预测最终任务性能以选出最优秩对，把 LoRA 秩当作调节各模态收敛速度的控制器。摘要称其优于基线方法，实现自动化、稳健的 MLLM 微调超参优化。
Motivation: MLLM 用 LoRA 等参数高效方法微调时，各模态训练动态不平衡导致负干扰、精度下降；现有做法靠手动调各模态学习率等启发式手段，效率低。
Method: MARS（Multimodal Adaptive Rank Search）搜索最优 LoRA 秩对：双 scaling law 框架中，第一条预测模块特定收敛时间并剪枝搜索空间到动态对齐的候选，第二条预测最终任务性能以在剪枝后集合中选出最优秩对；核心是把 LoRA 秩重新用作控制模态特定收敛速度的手段。
Result: 摘要为定性结论：MARS 在基线方法之上取得更优表现，并提供稳健的自动化 MLLM 微调优化策略；未给出具体数据集、指标或数值对比。
Conclusion: 通过联合建模收敛时间与最终性能来搜索秩对，可以把多模态 LoRA 微调中负干扰的调参过程自动化，替代手动调学习率的启发式做法。

papers.title: ANCRe: Adaptive Neural Connection Reassignment for Efficient Depth Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Scaling network depth has been a central driver behind the success of modern foundation models, yet recent investigations suggest that deep layers are often underutilized. This paper revisits the default mechanism for deepening neural networks, namely residual connections, from an optimization perspective. Rigorous analysis proves that the layout of residual connections can fundamentally shape convergence behavior, and even induces an exponential gap in convergence rates. Prompted by this insight, we introduce adaptive neural connection reassignment (ANCRe), a principled and lightweight framework that parameterizes and learns residual connectivities from the data. ANCRe adaptively reassigns residual connections with negligible computational and memory overhead ($<1\%$), while enabling more effective utilization of network depth. Extensive numerical tests across pre-training of large language models, diffusion models, and deep ResNets demonstrate consistently accelerated convergence, boosted performance, and enhanced depth efficiency over conventional residual connections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ANCRe 把残差连接的拓扑本身参数化为可学习变量，从数据中自适应重连，证明连接布局会带来收敛速率的指数级差距，并以不足 1% 的计算与内存开销加深网络有效深度。在 LLM 预训练、扩散模型与深层 ResNet 上均加速收敛、提升性能与深度利用效率。
Motivation: 深度扩展是基础模型成功的核心驱动，但近期研究显示深层常被闲置；默认的残差连接布局从优化角度看并非最优，会拖慢收敛。
Method: ANCRe (Adaptive Neural Connection Reassignment) 从优化视角参数化并从数据中学习残差连接拓扑，自适应重连，开销可忽略（计算与内存 <1%）；配套给出连接布局影响收敛行为的理论分析。
Result: 理论证明残差连接布局可根本改变收敛行为，甚至造成收敛速率的指数级差距；数值测试覆盖大语言模型预训练、扩散模型与深层 ResNet，一致显示相对常规残差连接的收敛加速、性能提升与深度效率增强，额外开销 <1%。
Conclusion: 残差连接不应再当作固定默认结构，而应作为可学习对象；自适应重连能以极小开销换来更快收敛和更高的深度利用率。

papers.title: When Is Enough Not Enough? Illusory Completion in Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: In agentic search, an LLM agent searches the web, reads the pages it finds, and decides what to look for next before returning an answer. But can we trust an answer simply because the agent returns it? Often not, and even a correct answer can be a lucky guess: on questions with several constraints, we find that agents conclude the task is complete while a constraint remains unverified in up to 48% of their correct answers. We call this illusory completion. To see how it arises, we introduce the Epistemic Ledger, which tracks at every turn what the retrieved pages establish about each constraint and what the agent claims. Across 13 agents, from 7B RL-trained models to frontier LLMs, training and scale raise accuracy but change the pattern of verification failures rather than eliminating them: constraints may be left unchecked, assumed without support, or retained despite refuting evidence. To measure what agents lose without tracking their constraints, we show them each constraint's state, approximated by LiveLedger, a lightweight 4B tracker. Agents then answer 4.4-16.1 points more questions correctly, suggesting that on their own, they may not track what they have verified and what remains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多约束网络检索问答中，LLM agent 常在仍有约束未核实的情况下判定任务完成，即使答案正确也可能是蒙对：正确答案中最多 48% 存在未验证约束（illusory completion）。作者提出 Epistemic Ledger 逐轮记录每个约束被检索页面证实的状态与 agent 的声称，并用轻量 4B 跟踪器 LiveLedger 把约束状态显式展示给 agent，正确率提升 4.4–16.1 个点。
Motivation: agentic search 中 agent 返回的答案无法直接信任：在带多个约束的问题上，agent 会把未核实约束当作已完成，训练与规模只提高准确率、不消除这种验证失败模式。
Method: 引入 Epistemic Ledger，逐轮追踪检索页面对每个约束的证据状态与 agent 的声称；跨 13 个 agent（7B RL 训练模型到前沿 LLM）分析验证失败模式；再用轻量 4B 跟踪器 LiveLedger 近似约束状态并显式展示给 agent。
Result: 在含多个约束的问题上，agent 的正确答案中最多 48% 仍有约束未被验证；13 个 agent 上训练与规模提升准确率但不改变验证失败模式（约束被漏查、无证据假设、或面对反证仍保留）；向 agent 展示每个约束状态后，正确回答多出 4.4–16.1 个点。
Conclusion: agent 自身并未可靠追踪已验证与待验证的约束，把约束状态显式外化即可显著提高多约束检索问答的正确率。

papers.title: Emergence of Physical Intelligence via Controllable Information Production
papers.abstract_en: Intrinsic Motivation (IM) aims to train agents without external rewards, enabling useful behavior to emerge from the agent's interaction with its environment alone. However, the dominant IM approaches rely on information-theoretic quantities with designer-chosen variables, introducing bias and lacking a principled connection to dynamics or optimal control (OC). We introduce Controllable Information Production (CIP), a novel IM method explicitly grounded in dynamical systems and OC. CIP measures the rate at which an agent produces information, capturing controllable complexity without external knowledge or bias. CIP unifies IM and OC into a single framework, formalizing physical intelligence as the control of information production. It further reveals connections between the structure of the value function and Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy. CIP consistently outperforms prior IM methods on standard benchmarks in robot learning and solves tasks they fail on, including humanoid self-righting. These results support an organizing principle: that physical intelligence emerges from driving systems toward the edge of controllable chaos.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Controllable Information Production (CIP)：用智能体自身产生信息的速率作为内在动机 (intrinsic motivation) 目标，把无外部奖励的学习与最优控制统一到同一框架，并将 physical intelligence 形式化为对信息产生的控制。在机器人学习标准基准上持续优于既有 IM 方法，并解出它们失败的任务（含 humanoid self-righting），支持「物理智能源于把系统推向可控混沌边缘」这一组织原则。
Motivation: 主流 IM 依赖由设计者选定变量的信息论量，引入偏差，且与动力学或最优控制缺乏原理性联系。
Method: CIP 度量智能体产生信息的速率，捕捉可控复杂度，不依赖外部知识或设计者偏差；把 IM 与 OC 统一为单一框架，并揭示价值函数结构与 Kolmogorov-Sinai 熵之间的联系。
Result: 在机器人学习标准基准上持续优于先前 IM 方法，并解决它们失败的任务，包括 humanoid self-righting。
Conclusion: 物理智能可被表述为对信息产生的控制，并从把系统驱动到可控混沌边缘 (edge of controllable chaos) 中涌现。

papers.title: SWE-Spot: Building Small Repo-Experts with Repository-Centric Learning
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of coding agents in privacy-sensitive and resource-constrained environments drives the demand for capable open-weight Small Language Models (SLMs). However, they suffer from a fundamental capability gap: unlike frontier large models, they lack the inference-time strong generalization to handle complicated, unfamiliar codebases. We identify that the prevailing Task-Centric Learning (TCL) approach, which scales exposure across disparate repositories, fails to address this limitation. In response, we propose Repository-Centric Learning (RCL), a shift that prioritizes vertical, single-repository depth over horizontal, single-task breadth for SLM training. To accomplish this depth, we design a four-unit Repository-Centric Experience, transforming static codebases into interactive learning signals, to train SWE-Spot-4B, a family of highly compact models built as repo-specialized experts. Under controlled comparisons with the same teacher and data budget, RCL consistently outperforms TCL across tasks, teachers, model scales, and programming languages. On seven target repositories, SWE-Spot-4B experts match or exceed existing open-weight models up to $8\times$ larger (e.g., CWM by Meta, Qwen3-Coder-30B) and surpass or match efficiency-focused commercial models (e.g., GPT-4.1-mini, GPT-5-nano) across multiple SWE tasks. Further analysis reveals that RCL yields higher training and inference efficiency, deep knowledge acquisition, and can scale to repository-cluster experts. Our work emphasizes that for building efficient intelligence, repository mastery is a distinct, necessary, and practical dimension that complements general coding capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Repository-Centric Learning (RCL)，把训练重心从跨仓库的任务广度转到单仓库深度，用四单元的 Repository-Centric Experience 把静态代码库变成交互式学习信号，训练出 4B 的仓库专家模型 SWE-Spot-4B。在相同教师与数据预算的受控对比下，RCL 在任务、教师、模型规模和编程语言上一致优于 Task-Centric Learning；在七个目标仓库上，SWE-Spot-4B 匹配或超过最大 8 倍大的开源模型（如 Meta 的 CWM、Qwen3-Coder-30B），并匹敌或超过面向效率的商业模型（如 GPT-4.1-mini、GPT-5-nano）。
Motivation: 隐私敏感与资源受限环境需要可部署的开源 Small Language Models，但它们缺少前沿大模型那种面对陌生复杂代码库的推理时强泛化能力；主流的 Task-Centric Learning 靠跨仓库堆任务曝光，无法补上这一能力缺口。
Method: RCL 优先做单仓库的纵向深度而非单任务的横向广度；设计四单元的 Repository-Centric Experience，把静态代码库转成交互式学习信号，据此训练 SWE-Spot-4B 这一仓库专家模型家族；对比实验控制同一教师与同一数据预算。
Result: 受控对比中 RCL 在多个任务、教师、模型规模和编程语言上一致优于 TCL；在七个目标仓库上，SWE-Spot-4B 匹配或超过最大 8 倍参数的开源模型（CWM、Qwen3-Coder-30B），并匹敌或超过 GPT-4.1-mini、GPT-5-nano 等效率导向商业模型；分析显示 RCL 训练与推理效率更高、知识获取更深，并可扩展到仓库簇专家。
Conclusion: 仓库掌握 (repository mastery) 是与通用编码能力互补的一个独立且必要的维度，用单仓库深度训练可以在 4B 规模上做出可部署的仓库专家。

papers.title: CASHEW: Stabilizing Multimodal Reasoning via Iterative Trajectory Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models achieve strong performance across a wide range of multimodal understanding and reasoning tasks, yet their multi-step reasoning remains unstable. Repeated sampling over the same input often produces divergent reasoning trajectories and inconsistent final predictions. To address this, we introduce two complementary approaches inspired by test-time scaling: (1) CASHEW, an inference-time framework that stabilizes reasoning by iteratively aggregating multiple candidate trajectories into higher-quality reasoning traces, with visual verification of object presence providing grounding cues during aggregation, and (2) CASHEW-RL, a learned variant that internalizes this aggregation behavior within a single model. CASHEW-RL is trained using Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) with a composite reward that encourages correct answers grounded in minimal yet sufficient visual evidence, while adaptively allocating reasoning effort based on task difficulty. This training objective enables robust self-aggregation at inference. Extensive experiments on 13 image understanding, video understanding, and video reasoning benchmarks show significant performance improvements, with CASHEW/CASHEW-RL achieving average gains of +4.1/+5.3 percentage points on Qwen3-VL-4B and +2.6/+3.0 percentage points on Qwen3-VL-8B, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Video-Browser: Towards Open-web Agentic Video Browsing
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents are shifting information seeking from passive retrieval toward proactive, open-ended research, yet this progress has largely bypassed video, one of the web's richest sources of evidence. We formalize Agentic Video Browsing, in which an agent must query video search engines, decide which returned videos to watch, and answer questions grounded in their visual content. To study this setting reproducibly, we introduce Video-BrowseComp, a benchmark and infrastructure suite with 660 human-annotated questions at three difficulty levels, paired online and offline evaluation tracks, and a fixed video search stack of roughly 12,000 videos spanning over 2,000 hours for evaluation and training-data construction. Our analysis reveals that the main bottleneck lies before video understanding: agents often fail to find the answer-bearing video at all. This bottleneck stems from two coupled challenges. Search engines index textual metadata such as titles and tags, whereas questions often target implicit visual or cross-source evidence absent from these surface forms; and exhaustively inspecting the many returned videos is prohibitively expensive. We propose Video-Browser, an evidence-surfacing agent that improves both sides of search. A Translation Memory helps the Planner phrase queries by analogy to past question-to-query transformations that successfully surfaced their target videos, and a Watcher performs sparse visual screening over returned candidates, retaining only videos that plausibly contain answer-bearing evidence for later dense verification. On the offline track, Video-Browser raises overall accuracy from 11.6% to 27.3% with Qwen3-VL-8B and from 39.8% to 45.1% with Gemini-3.1-Pro over the corresponding ReAct search agents, showing that better query formulation and post-search candidate selection improve end-to-end browsing performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Video-Browser 把开放网络上的视频浏览形式化为「查询视频搜索引擎—挑选要观看的视频—基于视觉内容作答」的 agentic 任务，并指出瓶颈在视频理解之前：根本找不到承载答案的那条视频。它用 Translation Memory 让 Planner 类比历史成功的 question-to-query 改写来构造查询，用 Watcher 对候选做稀疏视觉筛查、只留可能含答案证据的视频做后续稠密核验。离线赛道上整体准确率从 11.6% 提到 27.3%（Qwen3-VL-8B）、从 39.8% 提到 45.1%（Gemini-3.1-Pro），相对对应 ReAct 搜索 agent。
Motivation: 自主 agent 的开放式信息检索已绕开了视频这一网页证据富矿：搜索引擎只索引标题、标签等文本元数据，而问题常指向这些表层形式中不存在的隐式视觉或跨源证据，同时逐条查看返回视频代价过高。
Method: 提出 Video-Browser，一个改善搜索两端的证据浮出 (evidence-surfacing) agent：Translation Memory 让 Planner 按历史上成功浮出目标视频的 question-to-query 转换做类比式查询改写；Watcher 对返回候选做稀疏视觉筛查，只保留可能含答案证据的视频进入后续稠密核验。配套发布 Video-BrowseComp 基准与基础设施，含 660 道人工标注问题（三个难度级别）、配对的在线与离线评测赛道，以及约 12,000 条视频、超 2,000 小时的固定视频搜索栈。
Result: 离线赛道整体准确率：Qwen3-VL-8B 从 11.6% 升至 27.3%，Gemini-3.1-Pro 从 39.8% 升至 45.1%，均相对对应的 ReAct 搜索 agent。基准含 660 道三难度级别的人工标注问题，评测与训练数据构建用的固定搜索栈覆盖约 12,000 条视频、超 2,000 小时。
Conclusion: 端到端视频浏览的瓶颈在检索侧而非视频理解侧，更好的查询构造与搜索后候选筛选能直接抬升浏览准确率。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Dual-Evolving Reinforcement Learning for Automated Reward Design
papers.abstract_en: Crafting effective reward signals remains a central challenge in reinforcement learning (RL) for complex reasoning. Existing methods for automated reward optimization search with a fixed proposer which never learns from its costly trials. We present Dual-Evolving Reinforcement Learning (DERL), a dual-training framework for autonomous discovery of reward structures. An outer-loop proposer composes a reward from task primitives, and an inner policy trains with this reward. The proposer itself learns by policy gradient from the validation performance of the inner policy. Thus, DERL utilizes past-trial feedback to shape its reward-proposal distribution, an empirical meta-gradient of task success. We validate DERL on embodied (ALFWorld), scientific (ScienceWorld), and mathematical (GSM8K, MATH) reasoning. On multi-turn agent benchmarks, DERL outperforms strong baselines, significantly on out-of-distribution tasks. In mathematics, DERL improves on the outcome reward where directly added primitives hurt. Further analyses under matched compute show that our proposer effectively captures the meta-gradient to discover useful reward signals.
papers.comment: Work in Progress. We release our code and model at https://github.com/sitaocheng/DERL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DERL 用双层训练自动设计奖励：外层 proposer 从任务原语组合奖励，内层策略用该奖励训练，proposer 再用内层在验证集上的成功率做 policy gradient 更新，把历史试验反馈当作任务成功的经验 meta-gradient 来塑造奖励提议分布。在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、GSM8K、MATH 上验证，多轮 agent 基准显著优于强基线且在分布外任务上优势更明显，数学任务上改进了直接加原语反而有害的结果奖励。
Motivation: 复杂推理的自动奖励优化里，proposer 固定不变、从不从代价高昂的试验中学习，导致奖励搜索浪费已有试错信息。
Method: DERL (Dual-Evolving Reinforcement Learning) 双训练框架：外层 proposer 从任务原语 (task primitives) 组合出奖励，内层策略在该奖励下训练；proposer 用内层策略在验证集表现上的 policy gradient 自身学习，即以任务成功率为经验 meta-gradient 更新奖励提议分布。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、GSM8K、MATH 上验证：多轮 agent 基准上优于强基线，在分布外 (out-of-distribution) 任务上优势显著；数学任务上改进了结果奖励 (outcome reward)，而直接添加原语会使其变差；matched compute 下的进一步分析显示 proposer 能有效捕捉 meta-gradient 以发现有用的奖励信号。
Conclusion: 让奖励 proposer 与策略一起演化、以验证期任务成功率为 meta-gradient，能从历史试验中提取有用奖励信号，尤其在分布外任务和数学奖励设计上优于固定 proposer。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Open-Ended Visual Scientific Discovery with Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models in several scientific domains, including visual domains, learn representations that capture complex semantics from their respective fields. Despite this, most existing applications focus on pre-specified concepts or targets, excelling at confirmation but not open-ended discovery of unknown patterns. We study whether sparse autoencoders (SAEs) with heuristic feature ranking can provide a practical methodology for surfacing candidate visual features from vision foundation models for scientific discovery without concept-specific supervision. We evaluate this approach in three stages: (1) general-purpose concept rediscovery, (2) domain-specific concept rediscovery, and (3) question-driven feature ranking. On ADE20K, SAEs outperform baseline methods ($k$-means, PCA, SemiNMF) across most downstream metrics for concept rediscovery. On FishVista, the same approach recovers fine-grained fish anatomical features without concept supervision. Finally, on Heliconius butterflies, a heuristic based on the Mann-Whitney $U$ statistic consistently surfaces features corresponding to real diagnostic keys between mimic subspecies. Together, these results show that SAEs with heuristic ranking can efficiently learn and surface semantic structure in vision foundation model representations. We view this as a methodological prerequisite for open-ended visual scientific discovery: the present experiments validate feature surfacing and ranking through rediscovery, while prospective discovery of previously unknown scientific phenomena remains future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 加启发式特征排序，从视觉基础模型表征中无概念监督地挑出候选视觉特征，作为开放式科学发现的前置步骤。在 ADE20K 上概念重发现多数下游指标优于 k-means、PCA、SemiNMF；FishVista 上无监督恢复细粒度鱼体解剖特征；Heliconius 上基于 Mann-Whitney U 统计量的启发式稳定浮出区分拟态亚种的真实诊断特征。
Motivation: 视觉基础模型已学到复杂语义，但现有应用多针对预设概念或目标，擅长验证 (confirmation) 而无法开放式发现未知模式，且缺少概念特定监督下的候选特征提取手段。
Method: 三阶段评估：通用概念重发现、领域特定概念重发现、问题驱动的特征排序；用 SAE 从视觉基础模型表征中提出候选特征，再用启发式排序（含 Mann-Whitney U 统计量）挑选，数据集为 ADE20K、FishVista 与 Heliconius 蝴蝶，基线为 k-means、PCA、SemiNMF。
Result: ADE20K 上 SAE 在多数下游指标超过 k-means、PCA、SemiNMF；FishVista 上在无概念监督条件下恢复细粒度鱼解剖特征；Heliconius 上 Mann-Whitney U 启发式一致浮出对应拟态亚种真实诊断键的特征。
Conclusion: SAE 加启发式排序能高效提出并排序视觉基础模型表征中的语义结构，可作为开放式视觉科学发现的方法学前提；作者明确指出当前实验只验证特征提出与排序的重发现，前瞻性发现新现象属后续工作。

papers.title: It's My Agent, Not Me: Personal Privacy Boundaries in AI-Delegated Information Sharing
papers.abstract_en: Aligning AI systems with human privacy preferences requires understanding individuals' nuanced disclosure behaviors beyond general privacy norms. Yet eliciting these boundaries remains challenging because they involve context-dependent trade-offs. We present an elicitation approach that probes individuals' privacy boundaries through a discriminative task. Through a between-subjects study with varying communication roles and delegation conditions, we collected 1,650 privacy boundaries from 169 participants across 60 scenarios. We examined how communication roles, AI delegation, and individual differences influence boundaries. Results show that communication roles significantly influence sensitivity to disclosure granularity or identifiability, depending on whose private information is shared; AI delegation and individuals' need for privacy heighten sensitivity to disclosed identifiers. Our analysis further reveals how AI delegation shifts privacy preferences across contexts, highlighting new complexities in AI-mediated communication. We advocate eliciting nuanced privacy boundaries within real-world data flows by considering roles and AI delegation, and enabling user involvement in guiding privacy-aware AI behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用判别式任务 (discriminative task) 探询个人隐私边界，并在被试间实验中改变沟通角色与 AI 委托条件，收集到 169 名参与者、60 个场景下的 1,650 条隐私边界。结果显示沟通角色显著影响对披露粒度或可识别性的敏感度（取决于共享的是谁的隐私信息），AI 委托与个体隐私需求会提高对被披露标识符的敏感度。
Motivation: 对齐 AI 与人类隐私偏好需要个体层面的披露行为，而通用隐私规范无法刻画这种随情境变化的权衡，边界探询本身也很困难。
Method: 通过判别式任务探询隐私边界，采用被试间研究 (between-subjects study)，操纵沟通角色与 AI 委托条件，收集 1,650 条边界，覆盖 169 名参与者、60 个场景，并分析角色、AI 委托与个体差异的影响。

Conclusion: 隐私边界应在真实数据流中按沟通角色与 AI 委托条件来探询，并让用户参与引导隐私感知的 AI 行为。

papers.title: Anticipatory Evaluation of Language Models: Predicting LLM Benchmark Scores from Descriptions
papers.abstract_en: Modern ML research increasingly faces an evaluation bottleneck: building benchmarks and running experiments is costly, slowing iteration. We ask how much can be inferred about evaluation outcomes before experiments, given only a natural-language description of the task and setup. We call this setting anticipatory evaluation. We introduce EVALCAST, a literature-grounded resource of 2,290 description-performance pairs from 1,519 arXiv papers, including a test set of papers published after the model's knowledge cutoff. We evaluate two tasks: predicting absolute performance through regression and comparing benchmark difficulty through pairwise prediction. Experiments with frontier LLMs show that accurate regression remains challenging, while pairwise predictions can recover relative performance ordering under matched settings. Comparable performance on post-cutoff and streaming evaluations suggests that the observed signal is not solely attributable to previously reported results. Overall, EVALCAST provides a resource and evaluation framework for studying anticipatory evaluation and its potential use in prioritizing benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 anticipatory evaluation：只凭任务与设置的自然语言描述，在实验前预测 LLM 基准分数。构建文献支撑资源 EVALCAST，含来自 1,519 篇 arXiv 论文的 2,290 组描述-性能对，并含知识截止后发表的测试集；前沿 LLM 做绝对分数回归仍困难，而成对预测能在匹配设置下恢复相对性能排序。
Motivation: ML 研究的评测环节成本高、迭代慢：构建基准与跑实验都很贵，若能只凭任务描述提前推断评测结果，就能为基准优先级排序减负。
Method: 提出 anticipatory evaluation 设定与 EVALCAST 资源（2,290 组描述-性能对，来自 1,519 篇 arXiv 论文，含知识截止后发表的测试集），评测两项任务：回归预测绝对性能、成对预测比较基准难度，用前沿 LLM 做实验。
Result: 绝对性能回归仍具挑战，而成对预测在匹配设置下能恢复相对性能排序；在 post-cutoff 与 streaming 评测上表现相当，说明信号不只来自模型此前见过的已报告结果。
Conclusion: 从任务描述预测相对性能排序可行，可用于基准优先级排序；绝对分数预测在当前前沿 LLM 上仍不可靠。

papers.title: Sig-DEG for Distillation: Making Diffusion Models Faster and Lighter
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art generative performance but remain computationally expensive at inference, often requiring many discretization steps. We propose Sig-DEG (Signature-based Differential Equation Generator), a generator for distilling pre-trained diffusion models. Inspired by high-order stochastic Taylor expansions, Sig-DEG combines partial signatures that summarize Brownian motion over subintervals with a recurrent structure to approximate stochastic differential equation solutions to achieve universality. We formulate distillation as supervised learning, matching fine-resolution teacher trajectories on a coarse time grid. At inference, Sig-DEG enables fast generation, as the partial signatures can be simulated exactly from their known distributions without requiring fine-grained Brownian paths. Experiments on image and time-series generation demonstrate competitive sample quality with inference speedups of up to several hundred times over the teacher. A Schrödinger bridge example further demonstrates Sig-DEG's applicability beyond diffusion distillation.
papers.comment: 44 pages. Revised version with expanded theoretical analysis, updated experiments, and revised presentation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sig-DEG 用部分签名 (partial signatures) 概括子区间上的 Brownian 运动，配合递归结构逼近 SDE 解，把预训练扩散模型蒸馏成可在粗时间网格上单步生成的轻量生成器。推理时部分签名可从已知分布精确采样，无需细粒度 Brownian 路径，在图像与时序生成上达到与 teacher 相当的样本质量，推理加速最高可达数百倍。
Motivation: 扩散模型推理需大量离散化步数，计算开销高；现有蒸馏方法在粗网格上逼近轨迹时难以保证对随机 SDE 解的逼近能力。
Method: 提出 Signature-based Differential Equation Generator (Sig-DEG)：借高阶随机 Taylor 展开，用部分签名摘要子区间 Brownian 运动并结合递归结构逼近 SDE 解以获得普适性；把蒸馏形式化为监督学习，在粗时间网格上匹配细分辨率 teacher 轨迹；推理时部分签名从其已知分布精确模拟。
Result: 在图像与时序生成实验中样本质量与 teacher 相当，推理加速最高可达数百倍 (up to several hundred times)；另给出 Schrödinger bridge 示例，说明其可超出扩散蒸馏本身适用。
Conclusion: 基于签名的随机过程摘要可以在粗时间网格上复现扩散模型的轨迹并大幅加速推理，且该生成器框架可迁移到 Schrödinger bridge 等扩散蒸馏之外的问题。

papers.title: Linearly Convergent Algorithms for Nonsmooth Problems with Unknown Smooth Regions
papers.abstract_en: We develop efficient algorithms for optimizing piecewise smooth (PWS) functions when their smooth regions are \emph{unknown} to the algorithm. For convex PWS functions satisfying a quadratic growth (QG) condition, we demonstrate that the bundle-level (BL)-type method~\cite{lemarechal1995new} achieves global linear convergence---to our knowledge, the first such result for any algorithm for this problem class. We extend the method to solve weakly convex PWS problems, achieving the same order of complexity as in smooth non-convex optimization. Furthermore, we introduce a verifiable and accurate termination criterion for PWS optimization. Like the gradient norm in smooth optimization, this certificate tightly characterizes the optimality gap under the QG condition and can be evaluated without knowledge of any problem parameters. We develop a search subroutine for this certificate and embed it within a guess-and-check framework, resulting in almost parameter-free algorithms for both convex QG and weakly convex PWS problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对光滑区域未知的分段光滑 (PWS) 函数优化，证明 bundle-level (BL) 型方法在凸且满足二次增长 (QG) 条件时达到全局线性收敛，并把方法扩展到弱凸 PWS 问题，复杂度与光滑非凸优化同阶。另给出可验证的终止判据，在 QG 下紧刻画最优性间隙且无需已知问题参数，配合搜索子程序与 guess-and-check 框架得到近乎免参数的算法。
Motivation: 分段光滑函数的光滑区域对算法不可见，此前该问题类缺少任何算法的全局线性收敛结果，也缺少类似光滑优化中梯度范数那样可直接评估的最优性证书。
Method: 采用 bundle-level (BL) 型方法处理凸 PWS；引入可验证且精确的终止判据，设计针对该证书的搜索子程序，并嵌入 guess-and-check 框架，构造凸 QG 与弱凸 PWS 两类近乎免参数的算法。
Result: 凸 PWS 且满足 QG 时 BL 型方法达到全局线性收敛，作者称据其所知是该问题类首个此类结果；弱凸 PWS 情形达到与光滑非凸优化同阶的复杂度；终止证书在 QG 下紧刻画最优性间隙，且无需任何问题参数即可评估。
Conclusion: 光滑区域未知的 PWS 优化可以做到全局线性收敛并近乎免参数，关键在于用可评估的最优性证书替代对问题参数的依赖。
