papers.title: Is This Just Fantasy? Language Model Representations Reflect Human Judgments of Event Plausibility
papers.abstract_en: Language models (LMs) are used for a diverse range of tasks, from question answering to writing fantastical stories. In order to reliably accomplish these tasks, LMs must be able to discern the modal category of a sentence (i.e., whether it describes something that is possible, impossible, completely nonsensical, etc.). However, recent studies have called into question the ability of LMs to categorize sentences according to modality (Michaelov et al., 2025; Kauf et al., 2023). In this work, we identify linear representations that discriminate between modal categories within a variety of LMs, or modal difference vectors. Analysis of modal difference vectors reveals that LMs have access to more reliable modal categorization judgments than previously reported. Furthermore, we find that modal difference vectors emerge in a consistent order as models become more competent (i.e., through training steps, layers, and parameter count). Notably, we find that modal difference vectors identified within LM activations can be used to model fine-grained human categorization behavior. This potentially provides a novel view into how human participants distinguish between modal categories, which we explore by correlating projections along modal difference vectors with human participants' ratings of interpretable features. In summary, we derive new insights into LM modal categorization using techniques from mechanistic interpretability, with the potential to inform our understanding of modal categorization in humans.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多种语言模型中找出区分句子模态类别（可能、不可能、无意义等）的线性方向——模态差分向量 (modal difference vectors)，发现模型对模态的判断比既往报告更可靠，且这些方向随训练步数、层数和参数量增加以一致顺序浮现。模态差分向量上的投影还能拟合人类细粒度分类行为，并与人类对可解释特征的评分相关。
Motivation: 近期研究质疑 LM 按模态给句子分类的能力，但已有评测只看输出行为，未探查模型内部是否本就编码了更可靠的模态判断。
Method: 用机制可解释性 (mechanistic interpretability) 技术在多种 LM 激活中提取线性区分模态类别的方向（模态差分向量），分析其在训练步数、层与参数量维度上的浮现顺序，并把沿该方向的投影与人类被试的细粒度评分及可解释特征评分做相关。
Result: LM 内部可用于模态分类的判断比先前报告更可靠；模态差分向量随模型能力提升（训练步数、层数、参数量）以一致顺序浮现；这些方向上的投影可建模人类细粒度分类行为，并与人类对可解释特征的评分相关。
Conclusion: LM 的模态分类能力在表征层面比输出评测显示的更强，且该线性结构可作为理解人类模态区分方式的窗口。

papers.title: Prompt Stability Matters: Evaluating and Optimizing Auto-Generated Prompt in General-Purpose Systems
papers.abstract_en: Automatic prompt generation plays a crucial role in enabling general-purpose multi-agent systems to perform diverse tasks autonomously. Existing methods typically evaluate prompts based on their immediate task performance, overlooking the intrinsic qualities that determine their reliability. This outcome-centric view not only limits interpretability but also fails to account for the inherent stochasticity of large language models (LLMs). In this work, we bring attention to prompt stability-the consistency of model responses across repeated executions-as a key factor for building robust and effective prompt generation systems. To quantify this, we propose semantic stability as a criterion for assessing the response consistency of prompts. Based on the proposed metric, we developed the first stability-aware general-purpose prompt generation system that leverages stability feedback to iteratively enhance both prompt quality and system-level performance. Furthermore, we establish a logical chain between prompt stability and task success by analyzing the structural dependencies within our system, proving stability as a necessary condition for effective system-level execution. Empirical results across general and domain-specific tasks demonstrate that our stability-aware framework improves both accuracy and output consistency. By shifting the focus from one-off results to persistent reliability, our work offers a new perspective on prompt design and contributes practical tools for building more trustworthy general-purpose systems. The UI and source code for our system are publicly available at: https://xucheng63.github.io/MyDataPilot/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出语义稳定性 (semantic stability) 作为提示词质量判据，衡量同一提示重复执行时模型响应的一致性，并构建首个稳定性感知的通用提示生成系统，用稳定性反馈迭代改进提示与系统级性能。证明稳定性是系统级有效执行的必要条件；在通用与领域任务上同时提升准确率和输出一致性。
Motivation: 现有自动提示生成只按即时任务表现打分，忽略响应可靠性，无法应对 LLM 固有的随机性，也削弱可解释性。
Method: 定义语义稳定性指标量化提示重复执行的响应一致性；构建稳定性感知的通用多智能体提示生成系统，用稳定性反馈迭代优化提示质量与系统级表现；通过系统内结构依赖分析建立稳定性与任务成功的逻辑链，并证明稳定性是有效执行的必要条件。
Result: 在通用与领域特定任务上的实证结果显示，该稳定性感知框架同时提升准确率与输出一致性；系统 UI 与源码在 MyDataPilot 页面公开。
Conclusion: 提示设计应从一次性结果转向持续可靠性：稳定性不只是鲁棒性指标，而是系统级有效执行的必要条件。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有自动提示生成只按即时任务表现打分，忽略响应可靠性，无法应对 LLM 固有的随机性，也削弱可解释性。
summary_sections.method: 定义语义稳定性指标量化提示重复执行的响应一致性；构建稳定性感知的通用多智能体提示生成系统，用稳定性反馈迭代优化提示质量与系统级表现；通过系统内结构依赖分析建立稳定性与任务成功的逻辑链，并证明稳定性是有效执行的必要条件。
summary_sections.result: 在通用与领域特定任务上的实证结果显示，该稳定性感知框架同时提升准确率与输出一致性；系统 UI 与源码在 MyDataPilot 页面公开。
summary_sections.conclusion: 提示设计应从一次性结果转向持续可靠性：稳定性不只是鲁棒性指标，而是系统级有效执行的必要条件。

papers.title: Rule-based and reinforcement-learning policies for resource allocation in a pediatric echo lab: a simulation study
papers.abstract_en: Scheduling echocardiographic examinations in a hospital setting presents significant challenges due to non-deterministic factors such as patient no-shows, variable arrival times, and heterogeneous exam durations, as well as asymmetric resource constraints between fetal and non-fetal patient streams. Fetal cases involve specialized ultrasound examinations performed during pregnancy, whereas non-fetal cases correspond to general diagnostic echocardiography services. Using one week (184 patients) of operational data from the Echo Laboratory at Stanford University's Lucile Packard Children's Hospital, we estimate patient no-show probabilities and derive empirical distributions of arrival times and exam durations, and use them to build a discrete-event stochastic simulation model using SimPy, exposed through an open-source Gymnasium interface (https://github.com/desResLab/echo_rl). As a baseline for policy optimization, we systematically compare two scheduling paradigms: on-the-fly allocation, in which patients are served according to their arrival time without prior reservations, and reservation-based allocation, in which varying proportions of resources are preassigned. We consider a hospital with seven ultrasound rooms (one equipped for both fetal and non-fetal exams, six for non-fetal exams only) and six sonographers (four qualified for both exam types, two for non-fetal exams only). In this setting, on-the-fly allocation markedly reduces the average patient waiting time compared with every reservation-based configuration tested. Building on this foundation, we train a Dueling Double Deep Q-Network (DQN) with prioritized experience replay to approximate an optimal dynamic on-the-fly allocation policy. The learned RL policy is comparable to, but does not outperform, the best on-the-fly rule-based policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用斯坦福 Lucile Packard 儿童医院超声心动图实验室一周 184 例运营数据构建 SimPy 离散事件随机仿真（含爽约概率、到达与检查时长经验分布），比较即到即分配与预约制两种调度范式，并训练 Dueling Double DQN 学习动态分配策略。结果显示即到即分配在所有测试的预约配置下都显著降低平均患者等待时间，而 RL 策略与最佳规则式即到即分配策略相当但并未超越。
Motivation: 儿科超声心动图排程受患者爽约、到达时间不确定、检查时长异质以及胎儿与非胎儿流资源约束不对称影响，规则式策略与 RL 策略在该场景下的相对优劣缺乏量化比较。
Method: 用一周 184 例运营数据估计爽约概率与到达/时长经验分布，构建 SimPy 离散事件随机仿真并通过 Gymnasium 接口开源（echo_rl）；设定 7 间超声室（1 间兼做胎儿与非胎儿，6 间仅非胎儿）与 6 名超声技师（4 名兼做，2 名仅非胎儿）；对比即到即分配与不同资源预分配比例的预约制，并训练带优先经验回放的 Dueling Double DQN 近似最优动态即到即分配策略。
Result: 即到即分配相比所有测试过的预约配置都明显降低平均患者等待时间；Dueling Double DQN（带 prioritized experience replay）学到的策略与最佳规则式即到即分配策略相当，但没有超越。
Conclusion: 在该儿科超声实验室设定下，即到即分配优于预约制，而 RL 动态策略在此基础上未带来额外收益。

papers.title: Trustworthy AI Must Account for Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Trustworthy AI encompasses many aspirational aspects for aligning AI systems with human values, including fairness, privacy, robustness, explainability, and uncertainty quantification. The ultimate goal of Trustworthy AI research is to achieve all aspects simultaneously. However, efforts to enhance one aspect often introduce unintended trade-offs that negatively impact others. In this position paper, we review notable approaches to five aspects and systematically consider every pair, detailing the negative interactions that can arise. For example, applying differential privacy to model training can amplify biases, undermining fairness. Drawing on these findings, we take the position that current research practices of improving one or two aspects in isolation are insufficient. Instead, research on Trustworthy AI must account for interactions between aspects and adopt a holistic view across all relevant axes at once. We offer recommendations for how researchers can work towards integrated trust, and provide guidance for practitioners to manage interactions today.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 Trustworthy AI 立场论文：系统梳理公平、隐私、robustness、可解释性、不确定性量化五个方面两两之间的负向交互，例如对训练施加差分隐私 (differential privacy) 会放大偏差、损害公平。作者据此主张孤立提升一两个方面不够，研究必须同时权衡所有轴并采用整体视角，同时给出面向研究者与实践者的整合建议。
Motivation: Trustworthy AI 的终极目标是同时达成公平、隐私、robustness、可解释性与不确定性量化，但提升其中一项常以 unintended trade-off 的方式损害其他项，而现有研究实践通常只孤立改进一两个方面。
Method: 作为 position paper，回顾五个方面各自的代表性方法，并系统枚举每一对方面之间可能出现的负向交互（如差分隐私训练放大偏差），再据此提出立场与建议。
Result: 给出五个 Trustworthy AI 方面的全部两两配对的负向交互分析，并以差分隐私削弱公平为例说明交互机制；论文为立场论文，结论为研究实践层面的判断而非基准数字。
Conclusion: 孤立改进一两个 Trustworthy AI 方面是不够的，研究必须显式处理方面之间的交互并整体权衡所有相关轴，实践者则需要在当下就管理这些交互。

papers.title: TorchSpin: Differentiable Electron Paramagnetic Resonance Simulation in PyTorch
papers.abstract_en: Interpreting electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectra commonly requires repeated forward simulation and optimization of spin Hamiltonian parameters. Established software provides mature simulation and fitting methods, but these calculations are not generally available as differentiable components within machine-learning workflows. We present TorchSpin, an open-source PyTorch framework that ports the organization and numerical conventions of EasySpin into a tensor-based computational environment. Representative calculations spanning continuous-wave EPR, ENDOR, pulse EPR, spin dynamics, trajectory simulation, and magnetometry closely reproduced corresponding EasySpin results. In matched benchmarks, TorchSpin CPU execution was faster than EasySpin for six of nine workloads although performance depended strongly on the calculation. We therefore focused on the capabilities enabled by automatic differentiation in PyTorch. In a Cu(II) powder-spectrum demonstration, feedback propagated through TorchSpin improved the quality of a supervised convolutional neural network (CNN) without using parameter labels during refinement. Models trained from randomly initialized CNNs using only noisy spectra and TorchSpin reconstruction loss achieved median similarities of $\geq$ 0.99. CNNs trained on TorchSpin-generated libraries also transferred without adaptation to independently generated EasySpin spectra with performance comparable to EasySpin-trained controls. Once trained, the CNN produced initial parameter estimates in approximately 1 ms per spectrum while a batch of 512 was processed in approximately 1.3 ms with GPU acceleration. TorchSpin therefore provides both a tested Python implementation of established EPR calculations and a differentiable physical layer for rapid learned inference, spectral refinement, and parameter-label-free training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TorchSpin 把 EasySpin 的 EPR 前向模拟移植为 PyTorch 可微张量算子，使自旋哈密顿量参数优化能嵌入机器学习训练回路。在 Cu(II) 粉末谱演示中，仅用含噪谱与 TorchSpin 重建损失、不使用参数标签微调的 CNN 中位相似度达 ≥0.99，且在 EasySpin 独立生成的谱上零适配迁移。
Motivation: EPR 谱解释依赖反复前向模拟与自旋哈密顿量参数优化，但现有成熟软件无法作为可微组件接入机器学习工作流，参数标签获取成本高。
Method: 开源 PyTorch 框架 TorchSpin，按 EasySpin 的组织方式与数值约定实现张量化计算，覆盖连续波 EPR、ENDOR、脉冲 EPR、自旋动力学、轨迹模拟与磁强计；用自动微分把模拟器作为可微物理层接入 CNN 训练，以重建损失替代参数标签。
Result: 各类代表性计算结果与 EasySpin 高度吻合；匹配基准中 TorchSpin CPU 在 9 项工作负载中的 6 项快于 EasySpin，但速度强烈依赖具体计算。Cu(II) 粉末谱上，仅用含噪谱与重建损失从随机初始化训练的 CNN 中位相似度 ≥0.99；在 TorchSpin 生成库上训练的 CNN 零适配迁移到独立 EasySpin 谱，性能与 EasySpin 训练对照相当。训练后单谱参数估计约 1 ms，GPU 上 512 批次约 1.3 ms。
Conclusion: EPR 模拟器做成可微物理层后，可在无参数标签条件下训练出快速且可跨模拟器迁移的参数推断网络，同时保持与既有成熟实现一致的数值结果。

papers.title: Popularity Trajectories and Mixing Patterns of Urban Venues in Two European Cities
papers.abstract_en: Urban venues such as restaurants, shops, bars and parks host the daily life of a city, and their collective rise and fall signals how vibrant a neighbourhood is. The usual assumption is that a venue's fortunes follow its neighbourhood's, so that how wealthy an area is and how many people live there will decide a venue's performance. Yet whether there is a common performance trajectory shared by venues over time is underexplored. In this study, we use 5.5 years of Foursquare data for about 10^4 venues in London and Barcelona. We found six distinguishable shapes recur in both cities, that are (1) Fall, (2) Rise, (3) Rise & Fall, (4) Steady, (5) Ephemeral (an early hit that loses popularity fast) and (6) Underdogs (a slow starter that gains popularity late). However, no recovery shape appears, that is neither city yields a U-shaped fall-and-rise group. Additionally, we found that deprivation and population density are not indicative which shape a venue follows. We also discovered that how early a shape can be recognized depends on when its distinctive segment occurs, not a shape's complexity. Proximity between venues, however, does predict how well-performing a venue is. We uncovered a mixing pattern where venues of the same shape tend to locate together more often than chance within roughly 200 to 600 metres. Finally, our qualitative reading of two contrasting districts, one rising in London and one falling in Barcelona, show that comparable socioeconomic conditions but divergent gentrification histories can generate vastly different popularity trajectories. All in all, our results altogether point at that urban vibrancy emerges at the block- and street- level, and social and historical contexts matter in terms of the characteristics of such patterns.
papers.comment: 18 pages for main body, 8 pages for supplementary materials; 5 figures and 2 tables in main body, 7 figures and 9 tables in supplementary materials
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 5.5 年 Foursquare 数据刻画伦敦与巴塞罗那约 10^4 个场所的流行度轨迹，发现两城共享六种形态（Fall、Rise、Rise & Fall、Steady、Ephemeral、Underdogs），但都不出现 U 型先落后升的恢复形态。贫困度与人口密度无法指示场所走哪种形态，而同形态场所在约 200–600 米内比随机更倾向聚集；可识别早晚取决于该形态的特征段出现时间而非复杂度。
Motivation: 场所兴衰通常被归因于所在街区的财富与人口，但场所之间是否存在共同的流行度轨迹、以及轨迹形态由什么决定，此前研究不足。
Method: 基于伦敦与巴塞罗那约 10^4 个 Foursquare 场所、跨度 5.5 年的签到数据，聚类出六种轨迹形态；检验 deprivation、人口密度与形态的关联，用同形态场所的空间邻近度刻画 mixing pattern，并对伦敦一个上升街区与巴塞罗那一个衰落街区做定性对照阅读。
Result: 两城均复现六种形态且都不出现 U 型恢复组；deprivation 与人口密度不指示形态归属；形态可识别早晚由特征段位置而非复杂度决定；同形态场所在约 200–600 米范围内比随机更常相邻；两个社会经济条件相近但绅士化历史不同的街区呈现截然不同的流行度轨迹。
Conclusion: 城市活力在街区与街道尺度上涌现，社会与历史语境（如绅士化历程）而非单纯的富裕程度决定场所流行度形态。

papers.title: Interpolation of GEDI Biomass Estimates with Calibrated Uncertainty Quantification
papers.abstract_en: Wall-to-wall biomass density estimation from NASA's GEDI mission requires interpolating sparse LIDAR observations across heterogeneous landscapes. While Random Forest and XGBoost are widely used, they predict each location independently from satellite features, without adapting to the varying difficulty of heterogeneous landscapes. We introduce Attentive Neural Processes (ANPs), a probabilistic meta-learning architecture that explicitly conditions predictions on local observation sets as well as geospatial foundation model embeddings. ANPs learn a flexible spatial covariance approximator that is more uncertain in complex landscapes and less in homogeneous areas. We validate this approach across five distinct biomes ranging from tropical Amazonian forests to boreal, temperate, and alpine ecosystems, demonstrating that ANPs achieve competitive accuracy while maintaining uncertainty calibration. We demonstrate a scalable, empirically calibrated alternative to ensemble architectures for continental-scale biomass mapping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Attentive Neural Processes (ANP) 对 NASA GEDI 稀疏 LIDAR 生物量密度估计做空间插值，把预测显式条件在局部观测集与地理空间基础模型嵌入上，学出一个空间协方差近似器：复杂景观处不确定性更高、均质区域更低。在从热带 Amazon 森林到北方、温带与高山生态系统的五类生物 biome 上验证，ANP 达到有竞争力的精度并保持不确定性校准。
Motivation: GEDI 生物量估计要从稀疏 LIDAR 观测插值到连续覆盖，而 Random Forest、XGBoost 对每个位置独立预测，无法随异质景观的插值难度调整预测与不确定性。
Method: 提出概率元学习架构 Attentive Neural Processes (ANP)，预测同时条件于局部观测集和地理空间基础模型 (geospatial foundation model) 嵌入，学习灵活的空间协方差近似器，作为集成架构的可扩展、经验校准替代方案。
Result: 在五类 distinct biomes（热带 Amazon 森林、北方、温带、高山生态系统）上验证，ANP 达到有竞争力的精度 (competitive accuracy) 并保持不确定性校准 (uncertainty calibration)，用于大陆尺度生物量制图。
Conclusion: 按景观复杂度自适应调整不确定性的 ANP 可作为大陆尺度生物量制图中集成方法的可扩展、经验校准替代。

papers.title: Distinguishing Process Change, Instrument Fault and Data-Path Corruption in Streaming Telemetry: A Reference Implementation and Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: A reading departs from what a monitoring system expects for one of three reasons: the physical process changed, the instrument is failing, or the value was corrupted between the instrument and the software. The three call for different responses and look alike in a single sample. We state the three-cause problem, prove which pairs of causes one channel cannot separate, and propose a bank of online detectors - a Kalman tracker with CUSUM and EWMA charts on its innovation, a Hampel median with generalized-ESD confirmation, a robust noise statistic with ADWIN, exact-value checks and an optional two-channel complementary filter - combined by a deterministic, inspectable attribution rule. The detectors were merged into a public algorithm library. On 2,942 injected events of thirteen fault types the method detects 96.3% (95% interval 95.7-97.0) at 0.22 false alarms per hour and attributes 91.2% (90.6-91.8) of detected events correctly from one channel and 99.0% (98.6-99.4) with a second, rate channel; from one channel only 2 of 207 detected sensor drifts are attributed to the instrument, as the problem statement predicts. Injected into recorded industrial signals, the same catalogue is detected at 80.8% and attributed correctly at 84.5%, at 3.6 false alarms per hour. On the Skoltech Anomaly Benchmark the method detects 32 of 33 experiments with a median delay of 15 s, at 46 false alarms per hour against 11 for a rolling z-score.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/alxkm/telemetry-triage
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对流式遥测中「物理过程变化、仪器故障、数据通路损坏」三因同形的问题，给出可证明的单通道可分性结论与一套在线检测器组（Kalman tracker + CUSUM/EWMA、Hampel + generalized-ESD、稳健噪声统计 + ADWIN、精确值校验、可选第二通道互补滤波器），由确定性归因规则合并。在 2,942 条注入事件、13 类故障上单通道检测率 96.3%、误报 0.22/小时、归因正确 91.2%，加第二通道后归因升至 99.0%。
Motivation: 监控系统读数偏离预期有三种成因，处置方式完全不同，但在单样本上外观相似；需要先判定单通道在原理上能区分哪些成因对，再给出可审计的在线归因方案。
Method: 先形式化三因问题并证明单通道不可分的成因对；检测器组为 Kalman tracker 及其 innovation 上的 CUSUM 与 EWMA 控制图、Hampel 中值加 generalized-ESD 确认、稳健噪声统计量加 ADWIN、精确值校验，以及可选的双通道互补滤波器，最后由确定性、可检查的归因规则合并，代码并入公开算法库。
Result: 在 2,942 条注入事件（13 类故障）上检测 96.3%（95% 区间 95.7–97.0），误报 0.22 次/小时，归因正确 91.2%（90.6–91.8），加第二速率通道后 99.0%（98.6–99.4）；单通道下 207 个检出的 sensor drift 仅 2 个归因到仪器，与问题陈述的预测一致。注入录制工业信号后检测 80.8%、归因 84.5%、误报 3.6 次/小时；在 Skoltech Anomaly Benchmark 上 33 个实验检出 32 个，中位延迟 15 秒，误报 46 次/小时（rolling z-score 为 11 次/小时）。
Conclusion: 三因归因的上限由通道信息决定：单通道原理上无法分开的成因对，加一个速率通道即可把归因从 91.2% 抬到 99.0%；确定性归因规则在合成注入上远优于录制工业信号与公开基准上的表现。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Thompson Sampling for Learning in Zero-Sum Games
papers.abstract_en: Thompson sampling (TS) achieves logarithmic and asymptotically optimal regret in classical stochastic bandits, but its behavior in multi-agent learning remains less understood. We study TS in an unknown finite two-player zero-sum matrix game with Gaussian bandit feedback. Under centralized self-play, TS samples a single payoff matrix from the posterior and plays a Nash equilibrium of the sampled game. For every fixed zero-sum game with a unique Nash equilibrium, we show that the expected cumulative duality gap is $O(\sqrt T)$. The rate improves to $O(\log T)$ for pure equilibria. We then identify the exact coefficient of the $\sqrt T$ term, which depends only on the equilibrium strategies and the noise level. We also establish a minimax lower bound matching the square-root dependence on $T$ and an instance-dependent lower bound matching the logarithmic dependence on $T$ for a class of games with a unique pure equilibrium. Experiments support the predicted rates and coefficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在未知有限两人零和矩阵博弈（高斯 bandit 反馈）中，集中式自玩的 Thompson Sampling 每轮从后验抽一个收益矩阵并在其上玩 Nash 均衡，对任意具有唯一 Nash 均衡的固定零和博弈，期望累积 duality gap 为 O(√T)，纯均衡时改进为 O(√T) 之外的 O(log T)。√T 项的精确系数只依赖均衡策略与噪声水平，且与 T 的平方根依赖相匹配的 minimax 下界、以及对一类唯一纯均衡博弈的实例依赖下界同时成立，实验支持预测的速率与系数。
Motivation: Thompson Sampling 在经典随机 bandit 中有对数级渐近最优 regret，但在多智能体学习中的行为仍不清楚：零和博弈里缺少对 duality gap 增长速率与其系数的刻画。
Method: 设定为未知有限两人零和矩阵博弈、高斯 bandit 反馈、集中式自玩 (centralized self-play)：每轮从收益矩阵后验中抽样一个矩阵，并在该抽样博弈上玩其 Nash 均衡；分析对象是期望累积 duality gap，并给出 √T 项的精确系数表达。
Result: 对任意具有唯一 Nash 均衡的固定零和博弈，期望累积 duality gap 为 O(√T)；纯均衡情形改进为 O(log T)。√T 项的精确系数被识别，只依赖均衡策略与噪声水平。给出匹配 T 平方根依赖的 minimax 下界，以及对一类具有唯一纯均衡的博弈匹配对数依赖的实例依赖下界。实验支持预测的速率与系数。
Conclusion: 集中式自玩 TS 在零和矩阵博弈中继承 bandit 式的 regret 阶：一般唯一均衡为 √T，纯均衡为 log T，且 √T 系数由均衡策略与噪声水平决定。

papers.title: TheoPhysEval: Assessing AI agents at autonomous theoretical physics problem solving
papers.abstract_en: We present a suite of 50 unpublished research-level theoretical physics problems with verifiable answers. Without AI assistance, a typical problem in our collection could be solved by a world expert in about a day or less but would take considerably longer for experts in adjacent specialties. We test the ability of off-the-shelf AI agents to tackle these problems autonomously, without human hints. When given access to tools available in a realistic setting, including the ability to search the literature and write scripts for numerical and symbolic work, the best-performing agent, GPT-6-Astra harnessed in Codex, obtains the final answers with a near-perfect accuracy of 98% at an average cost under USD 3 per problem. On average, agents show only small changes in accuracy when denied web search and access to background research papers, suggesting significant memorization of the literature. These results suggest that state-of-the-art agents can accurately perform concrete calculations required across theoretical physics research. We comment on the broader implications of these findings and discuss possible explanations for the current lack of agent-led breakthroughs in theoretical physics despite their outstanding problem-solving abilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TheoPhysEval 用 50 道未发表、答案可验证的理论物理研究级问题测试现成 AI agent 的自主解题能力。在可搜索文献、可写数值与符号脚本的现实工具配置下，最佳 agent（GPT-6-Astra 挂在 Codex 中）以平均每题不到 3 美元的成本拿到 98% 的近满分准确率；而禁用网络搜索与背景论文后准确率仅小幅变化，作者据此判断 agent 显著依赖文献记忆。
Motivation: 缺少能衡量 AI agent 是否真能独立完成研究级理论物理计算的可验证基准；世界专家约一天可解、相邻领域专家明显更慢的问题，正好用来区分真解题与文献记忆。
Method: 构建 50 道未发表、答案可验证的研究级理论物理问题集，让现成 AI agent 在无人工提示下自主求解；工具配置贴近现实，包括文献搜索以及编写数值与符号计算脚本，并对比禁用网络搜索与背景论文的设置。
Result: 最佳 agent GPT-6-Astra（Codex 中运行）最终答案准确率 98%，平均每题成本低于 3 美元；禁用 web search 与背景研究论文后，agent 平均准确率仅小幅变化，提示对文献存在显著记忆效应。
Conclusion: 前沿 agent 已能准确完成理论物理研究所需的各类具体计算，但其高分部分来自文献记忆，且与当前缺少 agent 主导的理论物理突破这一现状并存。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Target-Constrained Pooling for Trajectory Extrapolation
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory extrapolation from a partial target trajectory is underdetermined, but completed related trajectories provide information about the unresolved continuation. We propose target-constrained pooling (TCP), which separates the finite-horizon endpoint from continuation shape and estimates that endpoint from two complementary source signals. Uniform pooling captures final response levels, while matched-increment pooling captures the remaining change after aligning source and target states. TCP selects representative sources, projects both endpoint estimates onto a target-consistent region, converts them into corrections of the free forecast, and controls their influence through strength calibration and degradation-aware weighting. Across 25,245 targets from five domains and both forecasting directions, TCP reduces mean RMSE by 35.8% to 42.1% for all ten target-only forecasters and improves all 100 forecaster, dataset, and direction comparisons. The two endpoint signals consistently outperform either alone, while representative selection remains within 0.64% to 1.02% of the full donor pool using 12.7x fewer donor inputs and 138.8x fewer matching distance computations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对部分目标轨迹外推的欠定问题，提出 target-constrained pooling (TCP)：用 uniform pooling 估计终点水平、matched-increment pooling 估计对齐后的剩余变化，再把两个终点估计投影到目标一致区域并作为自由预报的修正，经强度校准与退化感知加权控制影响。在五个领域 25,245 个目标、双向外推上，TCP 使全部十个 target-only 预报器的平均 RMSE 下降 35.8%–42.1%，100 组预报器×数据集×方向比较全部提升。
Motivation: 从部分目标轨迹外推未观测段是欠定的，单靠目标自身历史无法约束未解析的延续；而已完成的相关轨迹里含有可用于补全的信息，但如何把它们安全地注入自由预报尚无机制。
Method: TCP 分离有限时域终点与延续形状：uniform pooling 捕获最终响应水平，matched-increment pooling 在源与目标状态对齐后捕获剩余变化；随后挑选代表性源、把两个终点估计投影到目标一致区域、转成对自由预报的修正，并用 strength calibration 与 degradation-aware weighting 控制修正强度。
Result: 在五个领域共 25,245 个目标、覆盖两个外推方向上，TCP 使全部十个 target-only 预报器的平均 RMSE 降低 35.8% 到 42.1%，并在全部 100 个预报器×数据集×方向比较中取得改进；两个终点信号联用一致优于任一单独使用；代表性源选择相对完整 donor pool 只损失 0.64%–1.02%，同时 donor 输入减少 12.7 倍、匹配距离计算减少 138.8 倍。
Conclusion: 把终点水平与剩余变化拆成两个互补信号并约束到目标一致区域，可以在大幅削减 donor 计算量的同时稳定提升任意 target-only 轨迹预报器的外推精度。

summary_sections.tldr: 针对部分目标轨迹外推的欠定问题，提出 target-constrained pooling (TCP)：用 uniform pooling 估计终点水平、matched-increment pooling 估计对齐后的剩余变化，再把两个终点估计投影到目标一致区域并作为自由预报的修正，经强度校准与退化感知加权控制影响。在五个领域 25,245 个目标、双向外推上，TCP 使全部十个 target-only 预报器的平均 RMSE 下降 35.8%–42.1%，100 组预报器×数据集×方向比较全部提升。
summary_sections.motivation: 从部分目标轨迹外推未观测段是欠定的，单靠目标自身历史无法约束未解析的延续；而已完成的相关轨迹里含有可用于补全的信息，但如何把它们安全地注入自由预报尚无机制。
summary_sections.method: TCP 分离有限时域终点与延续形状：uniform pooling 捕获最终响应水平，matched-increment pooling 在源与目标状态对齐后捕获剩余变化；随后挑选代表性源、把两个终点估计投影到目标一致区域、转成对自由预报的修正，并用 strength calibration 与 degradation-aware weighting 控制修正强度。
summary_sections.result: 在五个领域共 25,245 个目标、覆盖两个外推方向上，TCP 使全部十个 target-only 预报器的平均 RMSE 降低 35.8% 到 42.1%，并在全部 100 个预报器×数据集×方向比较中取得改进；两个终点信号联用一致优于任一单独使用；代表性源选择相对完整 donor pool 只损失 0.64%–1.02%，同时 donor 输入减少 12.7 倍、匹配距离计算减少 138.8 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把终点水平与剩余变化拆成两个互补信号并约束到目标一致区域，可以在大幅削减 donor 计算量的同时稳定提升任意 target-only 轨迹预报器的外推精度。

papers.title: Remix the Timbre: Diffusion-Based Style Transfer Across Polyphonic Stems
papers.abstract_en: Timbre transfer aims to modify the timbral identity of a musical recording while preserving its original melody and rhythm. While single-instrument timbre transfer has made substantial progress, existing approaches to multi-instrument settings commonly rely on separate-then-transfer pipelines that propagate source-separation artifacts and process the resulting stems independently. This paper proposes MixtureTT, to the best of our knowledge the first system for flexible per-stem timbre transfer directly from a polyphonic mixture. Given a mixture and a separate timbre reference for each target voice, MixtureTT jointly transfers all stems to the specified instruments. Its Joint Stem Diffusion Transformer first models cross-stem harmonic context and then refines each output under its own content and timbre conditions. All stems are generated within a single joint diffusion process rather than through separate per-stem diffusion runs. This design avoids propagating waveform-level separation errors through a cascade and produces more coherent multi-stem outputs. Despite operating under a harder input condition, MixtureTT outperforms practical separate-then-transfer pipelines on objective and subjective evaluations, while remaining competitive with single-instrument methods given ground-truth isolated stems. Results on both synthesized and real-audio SATB benchmarks further demonstrate its generalization. Controlled ablations show that jointly modeling cross-stem dependencies improves over an equivalent independent-stem variant, while the structure and timing of this coordination are also critical for effective mixture-level timbre transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MixtureTT 直接从多声部混合音频做逐 stem 音色迁移 (per-stem timbre transfer)，用 Joint Stem Diffusion Transformer 在单次联合扩散过程中先建模跨 stem 和声上下文、再按各自内容与音色条件精修各输出，避免先分离再迁移的级联误差。在合成与真实音频 SATB 基准上，客观与主观评测均优于实用的 separate-then-transfer 流水线，并在给定真值分离 stem 时与单乐器方法相当。
Motivation: 多乐器音色迁移普遍走先分离再逐 stem 迁移的流水线，波形级分离伪影会沿级联传播，且各 stem 独立处理丢失跨声部协调。
Method: 输入为一段混合音频加每个目标声部各自的音色参考；Joint Stem Diffusion Transformer 先建模跨 stem 和声上下文，再在各自内容与音色条件下精修每个输出，所有 stem 在单一联合扩散过程中生成，而非逐 stem 独立扩散。
Result: 在合成与真实音频 SATB 基准上，MixtureTT 在客观与主观评测中超过实用 separate-then-transfer 流水线；在给定真值孤立 stem 的更难对照下与单乐器方法保持竞争力。受控消融显示联合建模跨 stem 依赖优于等价的独立 stem 变体，且协调的结构与时机对混合级音色迁移同样关键。
Conclusion: 在单一联合扩散里建模跨 stem 依赖能避免分离误差级联并产出更连贯的多 stem 输出，而协调的结构与时机是有效混合级迁移的必要条件。

papers.title: AI-Driven, Timing-Aware Power Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Post-route power recovery changes cell choices under tightly coupled timing, electrical and physical constraints, and the value of each change depends on what it costs to repair its side effects. We propose an AI-driven framework in which a learned model drives both phases of the optimization: it ranks the powerrecovery edits to try and the repair actions that follow, while deterministic electronic design automation (EDA) analyses govern every acceptance. The framework records baseline constraint margins, identifies the damage a recovery transaction introduces in each analysis view, holds pre-existing violations at their baseline rather than working them inside the power step, and caps repair spending at a fraction of the measured saving. An ensemble of gradient-boosted models predicts power change, normalized damage reduction and constraint-regression risk from action and timing-context features available before each trial; calibrated, conservative estimates feed separate acquisition scores for recovery and repair, with a deterministic fallback when the model is uncertain. Recovery and repair remain speculative until physical implementation and fresh analysis establish baseline preservation and positive net saving. We specify the contract, the learned policy, the transactional flow and a pre-registered public evaluation protocol on open designs. Evidence from a companion study on public designs supports the contract; the learned policy is proposed, and no trained-model results or proprietary design measurements are reported.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个由学习模型驱动的 post-route 功耗恢复框架：梯度提升集成模型对功耗恢复编辑和后续修复动作分别排序，但每一次接受都由确定性 EDA 分析裁决。恢复与修复在物理实现并重新分析确认基线约束保持、净节省为正之前都算投机；修复开销上限设为实测节省的一个分数。该框架目前是提案，配套研究只支持其事务契约，未报告训练模型结果。
Motivation: Post-route 功耗恢复要在时序、电气与物理约束强耦合下改换单元，每次改动的价值取决于修复其副作用的代价；现有流程缺少对恢复-修复事务的显式契约与预算约束。
Method: 梯度提升模型集成从动作与试验前的时序上下文特征预测功耗变化、归一化损伤削减与约束回归风险；校准后的保守估计分别进入恢复与修复的 acquisition score，模型不确定时走确定性回退。流程记录基线约束裕度，把既有违规保持在基线水平而不纳入功耗步骤处理，修复开销按实测节省的比例封顶，所有接受由确定性 EDA 分析决定。
Result: 给出契约、学习策略、事务流程与在公开设计上的预注册公开评测协议；配套研究在公开设计上的证据支持该契约，未报告训练模型结果或专有设计测量。
Conclusion: 功耗恢复应作为带预算上限和基线保持约束的事务来执行，学习模型只负责排序、由确定性分析负责裁决；学习策略本身的效果仍待预注册评测验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bayesian Causal Forests for Zero-Inflated Continuous Outcomes
papers.abstract_en: Estimating (heterogeneous) treatment effects is still challenging when the outcome is semicontinuous (i.e., exhibiting both a discrete point mass at zero and a skewed continuous distribution for positive values), despite the strong presence of this data type in real world settings. Existing methods either ignore the zero mass, impose fragile parametric assumptions, or suffer from extreme computational costs and data augmentation noise. This paper proposes Zero-Inflated Continuous Bayesian Causal Forests with Duan's Smearing (ZIC-BCF-Smear), a decoupled two-part nonparametric estimator that fits a Probit BCF on the full sample to model participation and a Gaussian BCF strictly on the active subpopulation to model positive intensity. Subpopulation Propensity Adjustment (SPA) mitigates regularization-induced confounding within the active subpopulation, and Duan's non-parametric smearing estimator re-transforms predictions to the response scale, bypassing the fragile scale multipliers of parametric models. A comprehensive simulation benchmark shows that ZIC-BCF-Smear matches well-specified parametric models without their assumptions and remains stable and calibrated where competitors either diverge or pathologically over-cover for nonlinear data. The method is then applied to individual-participant data from the SPECTRUM randomized phase III head-and-neck cancer trial, estimating the causal effect of assignment to panitumumab plus chemotherapy on the number of days patients spend with severe toxicity, an outcome for which a quarter of patients contribute an exact zero. Panitumumab assignment raises that burden by about ten days per patient under the trial's own differential treatment duration, and the decoupled structure localizes the effect mainly in the positive-intensity part rather than in whether the reconstructed severe-AE burden is positive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出零膨胀连续结局的贝叶斯因果森林 ZIC-BCF-Smear：全样本 Probit BCF 建模是否参与，活跃子群上的 Gaussian BCF 建模正强度，配合子群倾向调整 (SPA) 与 Duan's smearing 回变换。模拟中在设定正确的参数模型水平上保持稳定校准，而竞争方法发散或对非线性数据病态过覆盖；在 SPECTRUM 头颈癌 III 期试验中，panitumumab 分组使每位患者重度毒性天数负担约增加十天，效应主要落在正强度部分而非是否为正。
Motivation: 半连续结局（零点质量加右偏正值分布）在真实数据中普遍存在，但现有方法要么忽略零质量、要么依赖脆弱参数假设，要么计算代价极高且受数据增强噪声困扰。
Method: 两部分非参数估计器：全样本拟合 Probit BCF 建模参与概率，仅在活跃子群上拟合 Gaussian BCF 建模正值强度；用 Subpopulation Propensity Adjustment (SPA) 缓解活跃子群内的正则化诱导混杂，再用 Duan's 非参数 smearing 估计把预测回变换到响应尺度，绕开参数模型的尺度乘子。
Result: 综合模拟基准显示 ZIC-BCF-Smear 达到设定正确的参数模型的水平而无需其假设，在竞争方法发散或对非线性数据病态过覆盖处仍稳定且校准良好。应用于 SPECTRUM 随机 III 期头颈癌试验个体数据（约四分之一患者重度毒性天数恰为零），panitumumab 加化疗分配在试验自身差异化疗程下使该负担每人约增加十天，解耦结构把效应主要定位在正强度部分。
Conclusion: 把零质量与正强度拆成两部分并用非参数回变换，可以在不加参数假设的情况下稳定估计零膨胀连续结局的异质处理效应，并区分效应来自参与概率还是强度。

papers.title: Subspace-Decomposed JEPAs: Disentangling Progression and Content in Latent World Models
papers.abstract_en: World models used for planning learn to predict how a scene evolves, yet they rarely hold a global view of how far a task has progressed. We argue that such a view should be part of the representation, and that it can be compact: describing a scene takes many dimensions, but where the scene stands on its way to the goal can be summarised by only a few. We propose SD-JEPA, a joint-embedding predictive world model whose latent is split into a small progression subspace and a large content subspace. A temporal triplet loss keeps consecutive frames of a trajectory close in the progression coordinates and separates different trajectories, while a distributional regulariser keeps the content coordinates from collapsing. On four control benchmarks, the model plans as well as the same architecture without the split. In return, its latent becomes easier to read. A few percent of its dimensions are enough to predict progress within an episode, and the angle they form follows the task, moves backward when the agent backtracks and changes fastest around events such as grasps and releases. Surprise also becomes anchored in the trajectory: when the scene changes mid-episode, the angle spikes and then relocalizes on a new part of the progression, anchoring surprise in the agent's own map of the task.
papers.comment: Rewritten presentation, corrected method description, new figures, updated related work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SD-JEPA：把 JEPA 世界模型的 latent 拆成小的 progression 子空间和大的 content 子空间，用 temporal triplet loss 拉近同轨迹相邻帧、分开不同轨迹，再用分布正则防止 content 坍缩。在四个控制基准上规划能力与不拆分的同架构持平，但 latent 可读性显著提升：仅用百分之几的维度就能预测 episode 内进度，其夹角随任务推进、回溯时反向、在抓放等事件处变化最快。
Motivation: 用于规划的世界模型能预测场景演化，却缺少对任务整体进度的全局表征；描述场景需要很多维度，而任务进度本身只需极少维度即可概括。
Method: SD-JEPA 是一个 joint-embedding predictive world model，将 latent 分解为小的 progression 子空间与大的 content 子空间；训练用 temporal triplet loss 约束 progression 坐标（同轨迹相邻帧靠近、不同轨迹分开），并用 distributional regulariser 防止 content 坐标坍缩。
Result: 在四个控制基准上，SD-JEPA 的规划表现与不使用子空间拆分的同架构持平；其 latent 中仅百分之几的维度即可预测 episode 内进度，progression 夹角随任务推进、agent 回溯时反向、在抓取与释放等事件附近变化最快；场景中途变化时夹角出现尖峰并重新定位到进度轴的新位置。
Conclusion: 把进度与内容在 latent 中显式解耦，可以在不牺牲规划性能的前提下，让世界模型的表征变得可读，且 surprise 被锚定在 agent 自身的任务地图上。

papers.title: Physics-Guided Multi-Fidelity Surrogate Modeling for Natural Supercavity Geometry of an Axisymmetric Conical Cavitator
papers.abstract_en: Natural supercavitation behind conical cavitators generates a vapor-filled envelope that, when sustained over the full body of a high-speed underwater vehicles, reduces hydrodynamic skin-friction drag and enables performance levels unattainable in fully wetted flow. Accurate prediction of maximum cavity length and maximum cavity radius and local cavity profile as functions of cavitation number and cone half-angle is essential for both the static design and the real-time shape management of super-cavitating torpedo cavitators. Classical analytical models provide computationally inexpensive predictions but exhibit systematic disagreements in the practically important regime of moderate cavitation number and large angle, where slender-body assumptions begin to break down. Existing data-driven machine learning approaches offer higher accuracy but are constrained by the prohibitive cost of multiphase computational fluid dynamics (CFD) sweeps over the full design space. This study proposes a physics-guided multi-fidelity surrogate framework based on Extended Hierarchical Kriging (PG-EHK) that addresses this challenge by fusing the multiple competing analytical cavity formulas as non-level low-fidelity (LF) trend functions corrected by a sparse set of high-fidelity (HF) CFD data. It simultaneously incorporates the analytical models regardless of their local fidelity ordering, using Bayesian-estimated scaling factors to construct the trend function as physical baseline. The resulting surrogate maps operational condition inputs to cavity geometry responses using fewer than 20 high-fidelity CFD evaluations. Cross-validation on five independent hold-out CFD cases demonstrates that the proposed PG-EHK surrogate achieves 61% reduction in prediction error compared to the best-performing individual analytical approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出物理引导多保真代理 PG-EHK（Extended Hierarchical Kriging），把多个互相竞争的解析空泡公式作为非层级低保真趋势函数，用稀疏高保真 CFD 数据加贝叶斯标定的缩放因子校正，映射空化数与锥半角到最大空泡长度、半径及局部型线。少于 20 次高保真 CFD 评估即构建完成，在 5 个独立留出 CFD 算例上预测误差较最优单个解析模型降低 61%。
Motivation: 解析空泡公式计算便宜但在中等空化数、大锥半角（细长体假设失效）区间系统性偏差；纯数据驱动方法精度更高，却受限于全设计空间多相 CFD 扫描的高昂成本。
Method: 基于 Extended Hierarchical Kriging 的 PG-EHK 框架：把多个解析空泡公式无论其局部保真排序如何一并纳入，用贝叶斯估计的缩放因子合成趋势函数作为物理基线（非层级低保真），再以稀疏高保真 CFD 数据校正；输入为空化数与锥半角，输出最大空泡长度、最大空泡半径与局部空泡型线。
Result: 构建代理所需高保真 CFD 评估少于 20 次；在 5 个独立留出 CFD 算例的交叉验证中，预测误差较表现最好的单个解析方法降低 61%。
Conclusion: 把互相竞争的解析模型同时当作可标定的低保真趋势，再用极少量 CFD 校正，可在中等空化数、大锥半角区间以可承受成本达到解析模型达不到的空泡几何预测精度，适用于静设计与实时型线管理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Token Utility for On-Policy Distillation via Local Trust-Region Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Token-selection methods for on-policy distillation (OPD) prioritize student-visited positions using diverse signals, including uncertainty, teacher-student disagreement, and mismatch direction. We instead derive token importance from the distillation objective itself: how much can each position's loss decrease under an equal local KL budget on the student's predictive distribution? The answer is the utility $s_t=g_t^\top F_t^\dagger g_t$, where $g_t$ is the logit gradient and $F_t$ is the categorical Fisher matrix. For reverse-KL it equals the student-weighted variance of the student-teacher log-probability ratio, and for forward-KL it equals the Pearson $χ^2$ divergence, so the appropriate utility follows from the choice of objective. On shared training checkpoints, several independently motivated criteria, including student entropy, KL disagreement, and TIP, concentrate their importance on nearly the same positions as the derived utility at a 50\% selection fraction, while diverging at stricter fractions and for direction-specific criteria. We instantiate the utility as Fisher Utility Weighting (FUW), a continuous, mean-normalized token weighting. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks and three Qwen3 student-teacher pairs, FUW improves over matched uniform OPD under both reverse-KL (1.35-4.0 macro points) and forward-KL (1.08-2.71 macro points), and is competitive with existing selective methods using a single closed-form score derived from the training objective.
papers.comment: 10 pages, Accepted to Pre-to-Post workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 on-policy distillation (OPD) 中从蒸馏目标本身推导 token 重要性：在学生预测分布上给定等额局部 KL 预算时，每个位置损失能降多少即效用 s_t = g_t^T F_t^† g_t。reverse-KL 下它等于学生加权的 log 概率比方差，forward-KL 下等于 Pearson χ² 散度；实例化为 Fisher Utility Weighting (FUW) 后，在七个数学推理基准与三组 Qwen3 师生对上，相对同设置 uniform OPD 提升 reverse-KL 1.35–4.0 macro 点、forward-KL 1.08–2.71 macro 点。
Motivation: OPD 的 token 选择多依赖不确定性、师生分歧、失配方向等外部信号，缺少从蒸馏目标本身导出的、随目标函数（reverse/forward KL）自洽的权重定义。
Method: 把 token 效用定义为在等额局部 KL 预算下该位置损失的最大下降量，闭式解为 s_t = g_t^T F_t^† g_t（g_t 为 logit 梯度，F_t 为 categorical Fisher 矩阵）；reverse-KL 下化为学生加权的 log 概率比方差，forward-KL 下化为 Pearson χ² 散度。据此实现 Fisher Utility Weighting (FUW)，一种连续、均值归一化的 token 加权，并在共享训练 checkpoint 上与 student entropy、KL disagreement、TIP 等准则比较选择位置的一致性。
Result: 在七个数学推理基准、三组 Qwen3 师生对上，FUW 相对匹配的 uniform OPD：reverse-KL 提升 1.35–4.0 macro 点，forward-KL 提升 1.08–2.71 macro 点，且用单一闭式分数与现有选择性方法竞争。选择位置一致性方面，student entropy、KL disagreement、TIP 等准则在 50% 选择比例下与推导效用集中于几乎相同的位置，但在更严格的选择比例和方向性准则上出现分歧。
Conclusion: token 重要性应由蒸馏目标本身给出：同一闭式效用随 reverse/forward KL 自动切换形式，即可在数学推理蒸馏上超过 uniform 加权并与选择性方法竞争。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Following the Flow the Law Requires: Training Voice Agents to Transfer to Unseen Regulated Procedures in Debt Collection
papers.abstract_en: Voice agents built on large language models (LLMs) now handle customer calls, but in regulated applications completing the task is not enough: the agent must follow a conversational flow set by law. In debt collection, it must confirm it is speaking to the debtor before mentioning the debt, identify itself and the creditor, state the amount, and avoid prohibited language. Every creditor turns these rules into its own procedure and revises it. We ask whether a small, self-hosted policy can be trained once and then follow regulated procedures it has never seen. One machine-readable specification per deployment, FlowSpec, generates the policy instruction, gates the tools, supplies the supervision and defines the tests; the agent speaks only approved catalogue sentences. We fine-tune a 9-billion-parameter model on 2,506 conversations from 297 randomized procedures and evaluate a Thai outbound-call agent on four unseen deployment procedures (three debt collection, one non-debt), one from a wholly withheld lineage. Documented checks, fixed by the procedure, rise from 67--71 percents to 93--100 percents, while grounded checks, fixed by the conversation, already pass at 97--100 percents before training; scenario pass rate rises from 15/43 to 40/43. An audit of the shared specification finds 11 defects, 3 of which its own metric did not expose.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用一份机器可读的流程规范 FlowSpec 同时生成策略指令、工具门控、监督信号与测试，微调 9B 模型后，泰语催收外呼 agent 在 4 个从未见过的部署流程上，流程规定的文档检查通过率从 67–71% 升到 93–100%，场景通过率从 15/43 升到 40/43。规范审计另发现 11 处缺陷，其中 3 处是其自带指标暴露不出来的。
Motivation: 受监管场景里任务做完不等于合规：催收通话必须先核实债务人身份、表明身份与债权人、报出金额并回避禁用话术，而每个债权人又把法规改写成自己会不断修订的流程，小规模自托管模型难以对没见过的流程泛化。
Method: 每个部署写一份 FlowSpec 规范，由它生成策略指令、门控工具调用、提供训练监督并定义测试，agent 只允许说出已批准的目录句；在 297 个随机生成流程的 2,506 段对话上微调一个 90 亿参数模型，再在 4 个未见部署流程（3 个催收、1 个非催收，其中一个来自完全保留的流程谱系）上评测泰语外呼 agent。
Result: 流程固定的文档检查通过率从 67–71% 升到 93–100%；对话固定的 grounded 检查训练前就已达到 97–100%；场景通过率从 15/43 升到 40/43。对共享规范的审计发现 11 处缺陷，其中 3 处其自带指标未能暴露。
Conclusion: 一次训练即可让小模型遵循从未见过的受监管流程，前提是把流程写成单一规范来源；但该规范自身的指标会漏检部分缺陷，需要独立审计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do Perturbation Predictors Learn Gene Interactions? Diagnosing Extrapolation in Agentic Screening
papers.abstract_en: High-throughput perturbation screens increasingly use machine-learning models to predict the effects of gene combinations that were never measured. A difficult case arises when both genes in a test pair were seen individually during training, but their combination was not. In this setting, standard OOD methods often fail because neither gene appears unfamiliar on its own. We therefore compare each model prediction with a simple additive prediction obtained by summing the two observed single-gene effects. The difference between them, which we call additive disagreement (AD), measures how much extra interaction effect the model introduces for an unseen combination. Across eight prediction methods and three Perturb-seq datasets, specialised neural predictors do not consistently outperform this simple additive baseline. More importantly, predictions with larger deviations from the additive baseline tend to have larger errors. Conventional output-based and embedding-based confidence signals are inconsistent across datasets and models, whereas AD remains informative across all evaluated compositional settings. We further study how this signal can guide decisions in an agentic perturbation-screening workflow. The code is available at https://github.com/zygao930/OOD.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop ML4Molecules: Agentic Systems for Molecular Sciences
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在高通量扰动筛选中，当测试基因对的两个基因都在训练中单独出现过、但组合未被测量时，模型预测与两个单基因效应之和的差（additive disagreement, AD）可度量模型额外引入的交互效应。八个预测方法、三个 Perturb-seq 数据集上，偏离加性基线越大的预测误差越大，AD 在所有评估的组合设置中都保持信息量，而常规输出置信与 embedding 置信信号在数据集和模型间不一致。
Motivation: 组合扰动预测的困难情形是两个基因各自见过、组合未见，标准 OOD 方法因单个基因都不陌生而失效，需要能识别模型何时引入不可靠交互效应的信号。
Method: 将每个模型预测与两个已观测单基因效应之和得到的加性预测比较，差值定义为 additive disagreement (AD)；在八个预测方法与三个 Perturb-seq 数据集上对比 AD 与常规输出/embedding 置信信号，并研究该信号如何指导 agentic perturbation-screening 工作流的决策。
Result: 八个预测方法、三个 Perturb-seq 数据集上，专用神经预测器并不稳定优于加性基线；偏离加性基线更大的预测往往误差更大；常规输出与 embedding 置信信号在数据集和模型间不一致，而 AD 在所有被评估的组合设置中都保持信息量。
Conclusion: 对未见基因组合，加性分歧是比常规置信信号更一致的可靠性指标，可用于 agentic 筛选流程中决定哪些预测值得信任。

papers.title: Do Vision CIL Methods Transfer to Protein? A Diagnostic Benchmark of Frozen Protein Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Protein function annotation operates over an expanding label space, making class-incremental learning (CIL) a natural framework for incorporating newly discovered functions without full retraining. Yet existing CIL methods have been developed largely in vision and have not been systematically evaluated over frozen protein representations. We conduct a controlled benchmark of nine representative CIL methods across five sequence-, structure-, and sequence--structure-based protein encoders and two enzyme function datasets at different scales, while keeping the encoders frozen and evaluation settings consistent across representations. We find that no method transfers reliably across encoders, and that these failures persist across alternative phase constructions. Diagnostic analyses reveal that this instability arises from weak gradient-based stability signals, substantial heterogeneity in embedding geometry, and covariance assumptions whose appropriate capacity changes with both dataset scale and encoder. These findings suggest that the representation itself should be treated as a central component of continual-learning design rather than a passive feature extractor. More generally, reliable protein CIL will require encoder-aware methods that adapt their statistical assumptions and capacity to the geometry of the representation on which they operate. Code is available at https://github.com/zygao930/ProteinCIL.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Continual Learning for Foundation Models and Agents (CL4FM Agents)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结蛋白编码器上系统评测 9 种视觉类持续学习 (CIL) 方法，覆盖 5 个序列/结构/序列-结构编码器与两个不同规模的酶功能数据集。结论是没有任何方法能跨编码器稳定迁移，且换 phase 构造后失败依旧；根因是梯度稳定性信号弱、嵌入几何差异大、协方差假设的合适容量随数据规模与编码器变化。作者主张把表征本身当作持续学习设计的核心组件，而非被动特征提取器。
Motivation: 蛋白功能标注的标签空间不断扩张，CIL 适合增量吸收新功能而不全量重训；但现有 CIL 方法基本在视觉上开发，从未在冻结蛋白表征上被系统评测，迁移可靠性未知。
Method: 受控基准：9 种代表性 CIL 方法 × 5 个蛋白编码器（序列、结构、序列-结构三类）× 2 个不同规模的酶功能数据集，编码器全程冻结、评测设置跨表征一致；并用替代 phase 构造与诊断分析（梯度稳定性信号、嵌入几何、协方差假设容量）定位失效来源。
Result: 核心发现是定性的：没有方法能跨编码器可靠迁移，且这些失败在替代 phase 构造下依然存在；诊断分析把不稳定性归因于弱梯度稳定性信号、显著的嵌入几何异质性，以及协方差假设的合适容量随数据规模和编码器共同变化。
Conclusion: 可靠的蛋白 CIL 需要 encoder-aware 方法，其统计假设与容量必须随所作用表征的几何自适应；表征应被视为持续学习设计的中心组件。

papers.title: Inverse Reasoning Models for Efficient Post-Training and Verification from Answer-Only Data
papers.abstract_en: Post-training reasoning LLMs often requires making a tradeoff between costly supervision and compute inefficiency: supervised finetuning typically requires reasoning traces, which is data inefficient since in many applications one only has prompt-answer tuples and lacks the groundtruth chain-of-thought (CoT) sequence. On the other hand, reinforcement learning (with verifiable rewards, for example) can operate without CoT data but it is much more compute-inefficient since it requires multiple autoregressive completions per optimization step, none of which are guaranteed to give a non-zero policy gradient. In this work we explore a middleground, a self-distillation technique that uses answer-only data, treating CoT as latent variables. This relies on training a partner ``inverse reasoning LLM" that generates the original's reasoning traces conditioned on the answer. The inverse model is trained once and reused across incoming batches of answer-only data, with all generation happening offline and up front, making the approach particularly suited to continual post-training. Using Qwen3-0.6B on the Countdown and GSM8K tasks, we show that after GRPO training has saturated, a single offline distillation round from the inverse model roughly doubles pass@1 on hard prompts and, on Countdown, outperforms rejection-sampling self-distillation on every hard-tail metric at every mix ratio (with smaller gains on GSM8K); rejection sampling by construction has no signal on problems the model never solves on its own. Continued GRPO on the fresh data retains an edge at hard pass@1 but trails distillation at pass@8 and pass@32 while regenerating rollouts at every step. As an added bonus we see that the inverse model has a second application as an accurate verifier of correctness. When used for best-of-$n$ selection at test time, it raises selection accuracy on Countdown from 0.753 (majority voting) to 0.969.
papers.comment: Published at the COLM 2026 Workshop on Efficient Reasoning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出逆向推理模型 (inverse reasoning LLM)：以答案为条件生成原模型的思维链 (CoT)，把 CoT 当隐变量做离线自蒸馏，用于仅有 prompt-answer 对的后训练。在 Qwen3-0.6B 的 Countdown 与 GSM8K 上，GRPO 饱和后单轮离线蒸馏使难题 pass@1 约翻倍；逆向模型兼作验证器，best-of-n 选择准确率在 Countdown 上从 0.753（majority voting）升到 0.969。
Motivation: SFT 需要完整推理链而现实中常只有 prompt-answer 对；RL 虽可只用可验证奖励，但每步要多次自回归采样且常得到零策略梯度，算力开销大。
Method: 训练一个以答案为条件生成推理链的逆向推理模型，将其作为伙伴模型对原模型做自蒸馏，CoT 视为隐变量；逆向模型只训练一次并在后续 answer-only 数据批次上复用，全部生成离线前置完成，适合持续后训练；对照 GRPO 与 rejection-sampling 自蒸馏。
Result: 在 Qwen3-0.6B 上：GRPO 饱和后单轮离线蒸馏使难题 pass@1 约翻倍；在 Countdown 的每个 mix ratio 下，蒸馏在所有 hard-tail 指标上优于 rejection-sampling 自蒸馏（GSM8K 增益较小）；继续 GRPO 在 hard pass@1 上保持领先，但 pass@8、pass@32 落后于蒸馏，且每步都要重新生成 rollouts；逆向模型做 best-of-n 选择时，Countdown 选择准确率从 0.753（majority voting）提升到 0.969。
Conclusion: 答案条件的逆向推理模型可把 answer-only 数据转成离线可用的推理监督，在难题上同时胜过 rejection sampling 与持续 GRPO，并可复用为正确性验证器；rejection sampling 对模型自身解不出的题按构造没有信号。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lotus: Learning to Understand Time-series by Learning to Forecast
papers.abstract_en: Time-series language models typically align numerical signals with language using labels, captions, or question-answer pairs. Although such supervision encourages linguistic representations, it does not explicitly require them to preserve information about how the underlying time-series signal evolves. We introduce forecast grounding, a pretraining principle that requires language-aligned time-series representations to remain predictive of the future evolution before they are adapted to downstream tasks. We instantiate this principle in LOTUS, which divides each time-series channel into non-overlapping patches and maps them into the LLM embedding space. It then predicts the next patch from the LLM hidden states of the time-series tokens, encouraging the learned representation to retain temporal information. To capture both temporal changes and periodic patterns, we also propose a temporal-spectral patch representation that combines each raw time-series patch with its spectral representation before mapping it into the LLM embedding space. Across three language model backbones and six downstream evaluation datasets, LOTUS achieves the best average performance with minimal trainable parameters, reaching 59.91% accuracy and outperforming the strongest matched baseline by 3.36%. Our representation analyses further show that LOTUS uses the numerical input and preserves temporal structure in its learned patch representations. These results establish forecast grounding as a promising pretraining principle, enabling compact time-series language models to outperform models 25 to 50 times their size on TSRBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LOTUS 提出 forecast grounding 预训练原则：时间序列表示在接入下游任务前必须仍能预测信号的未来演化。它把每个通道切成不重叠 patch 映射进 LLM 嵌入空间，用 LLM 隐状态预测下一个 patch，并叠加时序-频谱 (temporal-spectral) patch 表示以同时捕捉变化与周期。在三个语言模型骨干和六个下游数据集上平均准确率 59.91%，比最强匹配基线高 3.36%，且可训练参数极少，在 TSRBench 上胜过规模大 25 到 50 倍的模型。
Motivation: 用标签、caption 或问答对齐时间序列与语言，只保证语言层面的表示，不强制保留信号如何随时间演化的信息，下游适配前表示可能已丢失时序结构。
Method: LOTUS 将每个时间序列通道切成不重叠 patch 并映射到 LLM 嵌入空间，从时间序列 token 的 LLM 隐状态预测下一个 patch，使表示保留时序信息；另提出 temporal-spectral patch 表示，把原始 patch 与其频谱表示结合后再映射进 LLM 嵌入空间。
Result: 在三个语言模型骨干、六个下游评测数据集上取得最佳平均性能且可训练参数最少，准确率 59.91%，比最强匹配基线 (strongest matched baseline) 高 3.36%；表示分析显示 LOTUS 确实使用数值输入并在 patch 表示中保留时序结构；在 TSRBench 上胜过规模为其 25 到 50 倍的模型。
Conclusion: forecast grounding 可作为时间序列语言模型的预训练原则：让表示先对未来预测负责，紧凑模型即可在下游任务上超过规模大 25 到 50 倍的模型。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Edgewise Envelopes Between Balanced Forman and Ollivier-Ricci Curvature
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating Ollivier-Ricci (OR) curvature on large-scale graphs is computationally prohibitive due to the necessity of solving an optimal transport problem for every edge. We bypass this bottleneck by deriving explicit, two-sided, piecewise-affine transfer moduli between the transport-based OR curvature and the combinatorial Balanced Forman (BF) curvature. We establish deterministic bounds for $\mathfrak{c}_{\rm OR}(i,j)$ parameterized by 2-hop local graph combinatorics, reducing the edgewise evaluation complexity from an optimal transport linear program to a worst-case $\mathcal{O}\left(\max_{v \in V} \operatorname{deg}(v)^{2.5}\right)$ time, entirely eliminating the reliance on global solvers. Empirical scalability benchmarks confirm these theoretical guarantees, demonstrating that the proposed transfer moduli yield significant asymptotic and constant-factor speedups over the steep polynomial scaling of exact OR evaluation. Furthermore, the tightness of these bounds is validated via distributional analyses on canonical random graphs and empirical networks, with the derived analytical bands enclosing the empirical distributions independent of degree heterogeneity, geometry, or clustering, providing a scalable, computationally efficient framework for rigorous statistical network analysis.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 4 figures. Accepted under the title 'Scalable Graph Curvature: Bounding Ollivier-Ricci via Local Combinatorics for Geometric Deep Learning' at the NeurIPS 2026 GDDL Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文给出 Ollivier-Ricci (OR) 曲率与组合 Balanced Forman (BF) 曲率之间显式双边分段线性转移模 (transfer moduli)，用 2-hop 局部组合量确定性地夹住每条边的 OR 曲率，把逐边求值从最优传输线性规划降到最坏 O(max_v deg(v)^2.5)，完全摆脱全局求解器。经验基准确认了这一加速，且解析区间在规范随机图与经验网络上都包住了经验分布，不依赖度异质性、几何或聚类。
Motivation: 大规模图上逐边计算 OR 曲率需要对每条边解一个最优传输问题，代价过高，阻碍其在 geometric deep learning 与统计网络分析中的使用。
Method: 推导 OR 曲率与 Balanced Forman 曲率之间显式双边分段线性转移模，给出以 2-hop 局部图组合量为参数的 c_OR(i,j) 确定性界；用经验可扩展性基准检验理论保证，并在规范随机图与经验网络上做分布分析检验界 tightness。
Result: 逐边求值复杂度从最优传输 LP 降到最坏 O(max_{v in V} deg(v)^2.5) 时间；基准显示相对精确 OR 求值的陡峭多项式标度有显著渐近与常数因子加速；推导的解析带在规范随机图与经验网络上包住经验分布，且与度异质性、几何、聚类无关。
Conclusion: OR 曲率可由 2-hop 局部组合量双边夹逼，从而在不依赖全局求解器的前提下做可扩展、可严格化的统计网络分析。
